lines: nārāyaṇaṃ suraguruṃ jagadekanāthaṃ bhaktapriyaṃ sakalalokanamaskṛtaṃ ca
namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase
ॐ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya ॐ namaḥ pitāmahāya ॐ namaḥ prajāpatibhyaḥ
ॐ namaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāya ॐ namaḥ sarvavighnavināyakebhyaḥ
romaharṣaṇaputra ugraśravāḥ sautiḥ paurāṇiko naimiśāraṇye śaunakasya kulapaterdvādaśavārṣike satre
veda vaiyāsikīḥ sarvāḥ kathā dharmāryaisaṃhitāḥ vakṣyāmi vo dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ śṛṇvantvadya tapodhanāḥ
samīpe pārthivendrasya samyakpārikṣitasya ca kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaproktāḥ supuṇyā vividhāḥ kathāḥ
āyuṣmantaḥ sarva eva brahmabhātā hi me matāḥ
kṛtābhiṣekāḥ śucayaḥ kṛtajapyā hutāgnayaḥ bhavanta āsate svasthā bravīmi kimahaṃ dvijāḥ
asacca saccaiva ca yadviśvaṃ sadasataḥ param parāvarāṇāṃ sraṣṭāraṃ purāṇaṃ paramavyayam
na tathā phalada sūte nārāyaṇakathā yathā
nāsti nārāyaṇasamaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
idaṃ tu triṣu lokeṣu mahajjñānaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
śuciḥ saniyamo vyāsaḥ śāntātmātapasi sthitaḥ bhāratasyetihāsasya dharmeṇānvīkṣya tāṃ gatim
adbhutaṃ cāpyacintyaṃ ca sarvatra samatāṃ matam
dṛśyante tāni tānyeva tathā bhāvā yugādiṣu
bhūtasthānāni sarvāṇi rahasyaṃ trividhaṃ ca yat
vedā yogaḥ savijñāno dharmo'rthaḥ kāma eva ca
nītirbharatavaṃśasya vistāraścaiva sarvaśaḥ itihāsāḥ sahavyākhyā vividhāśrutayo'pi ca
iha sarvamanukrāntamuktaṃ granthasya lakṣaṇam saṃkṣepeṇetihāsasya tato vakṣyati vistaram
utpādya dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pāṇḍuṃ vidurameva ca
teṣu jāteṣu vṛddheṣu gateṣu paramāṃ gatim
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismito bhūtvā prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ
vividhasya ca dharmasya hyāśramāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇam
ṛco yajūṣi sāmāni vedādhyātmaṃ tathaiva ca
nyāyaśikṣā cikitsā ca dānaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā
tīrthānāṃ caiva puṇyānāṃ deśānāṃ caiva kīrtanam
nadīnāṃ parvatānāṃ ca vanānāṃ sāgarasya ca
paraṃ na lekhakaḥ kaścidetasya bhuvi vidyate
janmaprabhṛti satyāṃ te vedmi gāṃ brahmavādinīm
asya kāvyasya kavayo na samarthā viśeṣaṇe
evamābhāṣya taṃ brahmā jagāma svaṃ niveśanam
śrutvaitatprāha vighneśo yadi me lekhanī kṣaṇam
likhato nāvatiṣṭheta tadā syāṃ lekhako hyaham
vyāso'pyuvāca taṃ devamabuddhvā mā likha kvacit
ahaṃ vedmi śuko vetti saṃjayo vetti vā na vā
tato'nyebhyo'nurūpebhyaḥ śiṣyebhyaḥ pradadau prabhu ṣaṣṭiṃ śatasahasrāṇi cakārānyāṃ sa saṃhitām
ekaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu mayoktaṃ vai nibodhata
duryodhano manyumayo mahādrumaḥ karṇaḥ skandhaḥ śakunistasya śākhāḥ
duśśāsanaḥ puṣpaphale samṛddhe mūlaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro'manīṣi
yudhiṣṭhire dharmamayo mahādrumaḥ skandho'rjuno bhīmaseno'sya śākhāḥ
mādrīsutau puṣpaphale samṛddhe mūlaṃ kṛṣṇo brahma ca brāhmaṇāśca
tato dharmopaniṣadaṃ bhūtvā bhartuḥ priyā pṛthā
taddattopaniṣanmādrī cāśvināvājuhāva ca jātāḥ pārthāstataḥ sarve kuntyā mādryāśca mantrataḥ
mādryā tu saha saṃgamya ṛṣiśāpaprabhāvataḥ mṛtaḥ pāṇḍurmahāpuṇye śataśṛṅge mahāgirau
śiṣṭāśca varṇāḥ paurā ye te harṣāccukruśurbhṛśam
āhuḥ kecinna tasyaite tasyaita iti cāpare
yadā ciramṛtaḥ pāṇḍuḥ kathaṃ tasyetadi cāpare
svāgataṃ sarvathā diṣṭyā pāṇḍoḥ paśyāma santatim
samṛddhāṃ tāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavānāṃ tadā śriyam
nirasya viduraṃ bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ śāradvataṃ kṛpam
na vigrahe mama matirna ca prīye kulakṣaye
na me viśeṣaḥ putreṣu sveṣu pāmḍusuteṣu vā
tatra yadyadyathā jñātaṃ mayāṃ saṃjaya tacchṛṇu
śrutvā tu mama vākyāni buddhiyuktāni tattvataḥ
yadā'śrauṣaṃ dhanurāyamya citraṃ viddhaṃ lakṣyaṃ pātitaṃ vai pṛthivyām
kṛṣṇāṃ hṛtāṃ prekṣatāṃ sarvarājñāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
indraprasthaṃ vṛṣṇivīrau ca yātau tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
agniṃ tathā tarpitaṃ khāṇḍave ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yuktaṃ caiṣāṃ viduraṃ svārthasiddhyai tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ draupadīṃ raṅgamadhye lakṣyaṃ bhittvā nirjitāmarjunena
yadā'śrauṣaṃ māgadhānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ jarāsandhaṃ kṣvamadhye jvalantam
dorbhyāṃ hataṃ bhīmasenena gatvā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
mahākratuṃ rājasūyaṃ kṛtaṃ ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ vāsasāṃ tatra rāśiṃ samākṣipatkitavo mandabuddhiḥ
duḥśāsano gatavānnaivaṃ cāntaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadāśrauṣaṃ vividhāstatra ceṣṭā dharmātmanāṃ prasthitānāṃ vanāya
jyeṣṭhaprītyā kliśyatāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
bhikṣābhujāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
adhīyānaṃ śaṃsitaṃ satyasandhaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
devairajeyā nirjitāścārjunena tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
kṛtārthaṃ cāpyāgataṃ śakralokāttadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ tīrthayātrāpravṛttaṃ pāṇḍoḥ sutaṃ sahitaṃ lomaśena
bṛhadaśvādakṣahṛdayaṃ ca prāptaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ vaiśravaṇena sārdhaṃ samāgataṃ bhīmanyāṃśca pārthān
tasmindeśe mānuṣāṇāmagamye tadā nāśaṃsi vijayāya saṃjayā
sveṣāṃ sutānāṃ karṇabuddhau ratānāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ yakṣarūpeṇa dharmaṃ samāgataṃ dharmarājena sūta
praśnānkāṃścidvibruvāṇaṃ ca samyak tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
virāṭarāṣṭre saha kṛṣṇayā ca tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ kīcakānāṃ variṣṭhaṃ niṣūditaṃ bhrātṛśatena sārdham
draupadyarthe bhīmasenena saṅkhye tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
virāṭarāṣṭre vasatā mahātmanā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
tāṃ cārjunaḥ pratyagṛhṇātsutārthe tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta yudhiṣṭhirasya tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ mādhavaṃ vāsudevaṃ sarvātmanā pāṇḍavārthe niviṣṭam
yasyemāṃ gāṃ vikramamekamāhustadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ naranārāyaṇau tau kṛṣṇārjunau vadato nāradasya
ahaṃ draṣṭā brahmaloke ca samyak tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
śamaṃ kurvāṇamakṛtārthaṃ ca yātaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ karṇaduryodhanābhyāṃ buddhiṃ kṛtāṃ nigrahe keśavasya
taṃ cātmānaṃ bahudhā darśayānaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
ārtāṃ pṛthāṃ sāntvitāṃ keśavena tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ mantriṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ tathā bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ ca teṣām
bhāradvājaṃ cāśiṣo'nubruvāṇaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā karṇo bhīṣmamuvāca vākyaṃ nāhaṃ yotsye yudhyamāne tvayīti
hitvā senāmapacakrāma cāpi tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
trīṇyugravīryāṇi samāgatāni tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
kṛṣṇaṃ lokāndarśayānaṃ śarīre tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
naiṣāṃ kaścidvadhyate khyātarūpastadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ cāpageyena saṅkhye svayaṃ mṛtyuṃ vihitaṃ dhārmikeṇa
taccākārṣuḥ pāṇḍaveyāḥ prahṛṣṭāstadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
śikhaṇḍinaṃ purataḥ sthāpayitvā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ śaratalpe śayānaṃ vṛddhaṃ vīraṃ sāditaṃ citrapuṅkhaiḥ
bhīṣmaṃ kṛtvā somakānalpaśeṣāṃstadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
bhūmiṃ bhittvā tarpitaṃ tatra bhīṣmaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadāśrauṣaṃ śukrasūryau ca yuktau kaunteyānāmanulomau jayāya
nityaṃ cāsmāñśvāpadā bhīṣayanti tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
na pāṇḍavāñśreṣṭhatarānnihanti tadā nāśaṃse vijayāyaṃ saṃjaya
bhittvā saubhadraṃ vīramekaṃ praviṣṭaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'bhimanyuṃ parivārya bālaṃ sarve hattvā hṛṣṭarūpā babhūvuḥ
krodhāduktaṃ saindhave cārjunena tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
satyāṃ tīrṇāṃ śatrumadhye ca tena tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
punaryuktvā vāsudevaṃ prayātaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ nāgabalaiḥ suduḥsahaṃ droṇānīkaṃ yuyudhānaṃ pramathya
yātaṃ vārṣṇeyaṃ yatra tau kṛṣṇapārthau tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ karṇamāsādya muktaṃ vadhādbhīmaṃ kutsayitvā vacobhiḥ
dhanuṣkoṭyā''tudya karṇena vīraṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā droṇaḥ kṛtavarmā kṛpaśca karṇo drauṇirmadrarājaśca śūraḥ
amarṣayansaindhavaṃ vadhyamānaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ devarājena dattāṃ divyāṃ śaktiṃ vyaṃsitāṃ mādhavena
ghaṭotkace rākṣase ghorarūpe tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ karṇaghaṭotkacābhyāṃ yuddhe muktāṃ sūtaputreṇa śaktim
yayā vadhyaḥ samare savyasācī tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
rathopasthe prāyagataṃ viśastaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ drauṇinā dvairathasthaṃ mādrīsutaṃ nakulaṃ lokamadhye
samaṃ yuddhe maṇḍalebhyaścarantaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā droṇe nihate droṇaputro nārāyaṇaṃ divyamastraṃ vikurvan
naiṣāmantaṃ gatavānpāṇḍavānāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ bhīmasenena pītaṃ raktaṃ bhrāturyudhi duḥśāsanasya
nivāritaṃ nānyatamena bhīmaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
tasminbhrātṛṇāṃ vigrahe devaguhye tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ droṇaputraṃ ca śūraṃ duḥśāsanaṃ kṛtavarmāṇamugram
yudhiṣṭiraṃ dharmarājaṃ jayantaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ nihataṃ madrarājaṃ raṇe śūraṃ dharmarājena sūta
sadā saṅgrāme spradhate yastu kṛṣṇaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
hataṃ saṅgrāme sahadevena pāpaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ śrāntamekaṃ śayānaṃ hradaṃ gatvā stambhayitvā tadambhaḥ
duryodhanaṃ virathaṃ bhagnaśaktiṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ pāṇḍavāṃstiṣṭhamānān gatvā hrade vāsudevena sārdham
amarṣaṇaṃ dharṣayataḥ sutaṃ me tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
mithyā hataṃ vāsudevasya buddhyā tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
kṛtaṃ bībhatsamayaśasyaṃ ca karma tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
kruddhenaiṣīkamavadhīdyena garbhaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
aśvatthāmnā maṇiratnaṃ ca dattaṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
yadā'śrauṣaṃ droṇaputreṇa garbhe vairāṭyā vai pātyamāne mahāstraiḥ
saṃjīvayāmīti hareḥ pratijñāṃ tadā nāśaṃse vijayāya saṃjaya
buddhvā cāhaṃ buddhihīno'dya sūta saṃtapye vai putrapautraiśca hīnaḥ
śocyā gāndhārī putrapautrairvihīnā tathā vadhvā pitṛbhirbhrātṛbhiśca
kṛtaṃ kāryaṃ duṣkaraṃ pāṇḍaveyaiḥ prāptaṃ rājyamasapatnaṃ punastaiḥ
kaṣṭaṃ yuddhe daśa śeṣāḥ śrutā me trayo'smākaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca sapta
saṃjñāṃ nopalabhe sūta mano vihvalatīva me
stokaṃ hyapi na paśyāmi phalaṃ jīvitadhāraṇe
taṃ tathā vādinaṃ dīnaṃ vilapantaṃ mahīpatim
niḥśvasantaṃ yathā nāgaṃ muhyamānaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
asmim̐lloke yaśaḥ prāpya tataḥ kālavaśaṃ gatān
śaibyaṃ mahārathaṃ vīraṃ sṛṃjayaṃ jayatāṃ varam
ete cānye ca rājānaḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
yeṣāṃ divyāni karmāṇi vikramastyāga eva ca
yeṣāṃ śāstrānugā buddhirna te muhyanti bhārata
kālaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ
saṃharantaṃ prajāḥ kālaṃ kālaḥ śamayate punaḥ
kālaḥ saṃkṣipate sarvāḥ prajā visṛjate punaḥ
kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ
atītānāgatā bhāvā ye ca vartanti sāṃpratam
vidvadbhiḥ kathyate loke purāṇe kavisattamaiḥ bhāratādhyayanaṃ puṇyamapi pādamadhīyataḥ
sa hi satyamṛtaṃ caiva pavitraṃ puṇyameva ca
śāśvataṃ brahma paramaṃ dhruvaṃ jyotiḥ sanātanam
avyaktādi paraṃ yacca sa eva parigīyate
navanītaṃ yathā dadhno dvipadāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā
adhītaṃ bhārataṃ tena kṛtsnaṃ syāditi me matiḥ
sa dīrghamāyuḥ kīrtiṃ ca svargatiṃ cāpnuyānnaraḥ
purā kila suraiḥ sarvaiḥ sametya tulayā dhṛtam
mahattve ca gurutve ca dhriyamāṇaṃ yato'dhikam
śṛṇudhvaṃ mama bho viprā bruvataśca kathāḥ śubhāḥ
rāma rāma mahābhāga prītāḥ sma tava bhārgava
anayā pitṛbhaktyā ca vikrameṇa tava prabho
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yamicchasi mahādyute
yadi me pitaraḥ prītā yadyanugrāhyatā mayi
taṃ kṣamasveti niṣiṣidhustataḥ sa virarāma ha
teṣāṃ samīpe yo deśo hradānāṃ rudhirāmbhasām
yena liṅgena yo deśo yuktaḥ samupalakṣyate
sametya taṃ dvijāstāśca tatraiva nidhaṃ gatāḥ
puṇyaśca ramaṇīyaśca sa deśo vaḥ prakīrtitaḥ
yathā deśaḥ sa vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu suvratāḥ
yathāvaccaiva no brūhi sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava
eko ratho gajaścaiko narāḥ pañca padātayaḥ
trayo gulmā gaṇo nāma vāhinī tu gaṇāstrayaḥ
jñeyaṃ śatasahasraṃ tu sahasrāṇi navaiva tu
sametāstatra vai deśe tatraiva nidhaṃ gatāḥ
ahanī yuyudhe dve tu karṇaḥ parabalārdanaḥ
kathitaṃ vistarārthaṃ ca yaśo vīryaṃ mahīkṣitām
pauṣyaṃ tatra ca paulomamāstīkaṃ cāditaḥ smṛtam
tato bakavadhaḥ parva parva caitrarathaṃ tataḥ
tataḥ svayaṃvaro devyāḥ pāñcālyāḥ parva cocyate
sabhāparva tataḥ proktaṃ mantraparva tataḥ param
saṃvādaśca tataḥ parva draupadīsatyabhāmayoḥ ghoṣayātrā tataḥ parva tataḥ prāyopaveśanem
kīcakānāṃ vadhaḥ parva parva grograhaṇaṃ tataḥ
śvetasya vāsudevena citraṃ bahukathāśrayam niryāṇaṃ ca tataḥ parva kurupāṇḍavasenayoḥ
divyaṃ cakṣurdadau yatra saṃjayāya mahāmuniḥ parvoktaṃ bhagavadgītā parva bhīṣmavadhastataḥ
karṇaparva tato jñeyaṃ śalyaparva tataḥ param
mausalaṃ parva coddiṣṭaṃ tato ghoraṃ sudāruṇam
daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ ca mahaujasām
yasya lokeṣu nāmnedaṃ prathitaṃ bhārataṃ kulam
bakasya nidhanaṃ caiva nāgarāṇāṃ ca vismayaḥ
sakhyaṃ kṛtvā tatastena tasmādeva ca śuśruve
anu praviśya viprārthe phālguno gṛhya cāyudham
samayaṃ pālayanvīro vanaṃ yatra jagāma ha
pārthasya vanavāse ca ulūpyā pathi saṅgamaḥ
adhyāyānāṃ śate dve tu saṃkhyāte paramarṣiṇā
dvitīyaṃ tu sabhāparva bahuvṛttāntamucyate sabhākriyā pāṇḍavānāṃ kiṅkarāṇāṃ ca darśanam
yajñe vibhūtiṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhāmarṣānvitasya ca
ślokānāṃ dve sahasre tu pañca ślokaśatāni ca
ataḥ paraṃ tṛtīyaṃ tu jñeyamāraṇyakaṃ mahat
śrutvā śakuninā dyūte nikṛtyā nirjitāṃśca tān
gamanaṃ kāmyake cāpi vyāse pratigate tataḥ
tīrthānāṃ ca phalaprāptiḥ puṇyatvaṃ cāpi kīrtitam
tābhyāṃ ca yatra sa muniryauvanaṃ pratipāditaḥ
vijitya sāgaraṃ prāptaṃ pitaraṃ labdhavānṛṣiḥ yavakrītasya cākhyānaṃ raibhyasya ca mahātmanaḥ
ārṣṭiṣeṇāśrame caiṣāṃ gamanaṃ vāsa eva ca
cakre cainaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ yatra bhīmo mahābalaḥ
yatra rāmeṇa vikramya nihato rāvaṇo yudhi
ekādaśa sahasrāṇi ślokānāṃ ṣaṭ śatāni ca
ataḥ paraṃ nibodhedaṃ vairāṭaṃ parva vistaram
yatra praviśya nagaraṃ chadmanā nyavasaṃstu te
godhanaṃ ca virāṭasya mokṣitaṃ yatra pāṇḍavaiḥ
samastā yatra pārthena nirjitāḥ kuravo yudhi
ślokānāṃ dve sahasre tu ślokāḥ pañcāśadeva tu
akṣauhiṇīṃ vā sainyasya kasya kiṃ vā dadāmyaham
vavre duryodhanaḥ sainyaṃ mandātmā yatra durmatiḥ
varadaṃ taṃ varaṃ vavre sāhāyyaṃ kriyatāṃ mama
viduro yatra vākyāni vicitrāṇi hitāni ca
prabhāte rājasamitau saṃjayo yatra vā vibho
pratyākhyānaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya rājñā duryodhanena vai
te tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā mantrayitvā ca yaddhitam
sāṅgrāmikaṃ tataḥ sarvaṃ sañjaṃ cakruḥ paraṃtapāḥ
ślokānāṃ ṣaṭ sahasrāṇi tāvantyeva śatāni ca
supratīkena nāgena sa hi śāntaḥ kirīṭinā
akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hato rājā jayadrathaḥ
yatra te pṛthivīpālāḥ prāyaśo nidhanaṃ gatāḥ
aṣṭau ślokasahasrāṇi tathā nava śatāni ca
vadhaḥ pāṇḍyasya ca tathā aśvatthāmnā mahātmanā
daṇḍasenasya ca tato daṇḍasya ca vadhastathā
dvairathe yatra pārthena hataḥ karṇo mahārathaḥ
vṛttāni cātha yuddhāni kīrtyante yatra bhāgaśaḥ
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi sauptikaṃ parva dāruṇam
pāñcālānāṃ prasuptānāṃ vadhaṃ prati mano dadhe
gatvā ca śibiradvāri durdarśaṃ tatra rākṣasam
kṛtavarmaṇā ca sahitaḥ kṛpeṇa ca nijaghnivān
vidureṇa ca yatrāsya rājña āśvāsanaṃ kṛtam
tathā pātraviśeṣāśca dānānāṃ ca paro vidhiḥ
mahābhāgyaṃ gavāṃ caiva brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca
saṅgrāme babhruvāhena saṃśayaṃ cātra jagmivān sudarśanaṃ tathā''khyānaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ dharmameva ca
yatra rājyaṃ samutsṛjya gāndhāryā sahito nṛpaḥ
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā prasthitaṃ sādhvī pṛthāpyanuyayau tadā
tyaktvā śokaṃ sadāraśca siddhiṃ paramikāṃ gataḥ
yatra dharmaṃ samāśritya viduraḥ sugatiṃ gataḥ
ataḥ paraṃ nibodhedaṃ mausalaṃ parva dāruṇam
yatra te'gniṃ dadṛśire lauhityaṃ prāpya sāgaram
svadharmanirjitaṃ sthānaṃ svarge prāpya sa dharmarāṭ
mumude pūjitaḥ sarvaiḥ sendraiḥ suragaṇaiḥ saha
ślokānāṃ dve śate caiva prasaṃkhyāte tapodhāḥ
indriyāṇāṃ samastānāṃ citrā iva manaḥ kriyāḥ
asya kāvyasya kavayo na samarthā viśeṣaṇe
dharme matirbhavatu vaḥ satatotthitānāṃ sa hyeka eva paralokagatasya bandhuḥ
arthāḥ striyaśca nipuṇairapi sevyamānā naivāptabhāvamupayānti na ca sthiratvam
dvaipāyanauṣṭhapuṭaniḥsṛtamaprameyaṃ puṇyaṃ pavitramatha pāpaharaṃ śivaṃ ca
yo bhārataṃ samadhigacchati vācyamānaṃ kiṃ tasya puṣkarajalairabhiṣecanena
yadrātrau kurute pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā girā
yo gośataṃ kanakaśṛṅgamayaṃ dadāti viprāya vedaviduṣe ca bahuśrutāya
puṇyāṃ ca bhāratakathāṃ śṛṇuyācca nityaṃ tulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati tasya ca tasya caiva
ākhyānaṃ tadidamanuttamaṃ mahārthaṃ vijñeyaṃ mahadiha parvasaṃgraheṇa
śrutvādau bhavati nṛṇāṃ sukhāvagāhaṃ vistīrṇaṃ lavaṇajalaṃ yathā plavena
janamejayaḥ pārikṣitaḥ saha bhrātṛbhiḥ kurukṣetre dīrghasatramupāste tasya bhrātarastrayaḥ śrutasena ugraseno bhīmasena iti
sa evamukto mātaraṃ pratyuvāca janamejayasya bhrātṛbhirabhihato'smīti
taṃ mātā pratyuvāca vyaktaṃ tvayā tatrāparāddhaṃ yenāsyabhihata iti
sa tāṃ punaruvāca nāparādhyāmi kiṃcinnāvekṣe havīṃṣi nāvaliha iti
tacchrutvā tasya mātā saramā putraduḥkhārtā tatsatramupāgacchadyatra sa janamejayaḥ saha bhrātṛbhirdīrghasatramupāste
sa tayā kruddhayā tatrokto'yaṃ me putro na kiṃcidaparādhyati nāvekṣate havīṃṣi nāvaleḍhi kimarthamabhihata iti
na kiṃciduktavantaste sā tānuvāca yasmādayamabhihato'napakārī tasmādadṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ bhayamāgamiṣyatīti
janamejaya evamukto devaśunyā saramayā bhṛśaṃ saṃbhrānto viṣaṇṇaścāsīt
sa tasminsatre samāpte hāstinapuraṃ pratyetya purohitamanurūpamanvicchamānaḥ paraṃ yatnamakarodyo me pāpakṛtyāṃ śamayediti
sa kadācinmṛgayāṃ gataḥ pārikṣito janamejayaḥ kasmiṃścitsvaviṣaya āśramamapaśyat
tasya tapasyabhirataḥ putra āste somaśravā nāma
tasya taṃ putramabhigamya janamejayaḥ pārikṣitaḥ paurohityāya vavre
sa namaskṛtya tamṛṣimuvāca bhagavannayaṃ tava putro mama purohito'stviti
sa evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca janamejayaṃ bho janamejaya putro'yaṃ mama sarpyāṃ jāto mahātapasvī svādhyāyasaṃpanno mattapovīryasaṃbhṛto macchukraṃ pītavatyāstasyāḥ kukṣau jātaḥ
samartho'yaṃ bhavataḥ sarvāḥ pāpakṛtyāḥ śamayitumantareṇa mahādevakṛtyām
asya tvekamupāṃśuvrataṃ yadenaṃ kaścidbrāhmaṇaḥ kaṃcidarthamabhiyācettaṃ tasmai dadyādayaṃ yadyetadutsahase tato nayasvainamiti
sa taṃ purohitamupādāyopāvṛtto bhrātṛnuvāca mayā'yaṃ vṛta upādhyāyo yadayaṃ brūyāttatkāryamavicārayadbhirbhavadbhiriti tenaivamuktā bhrātarastasya tathā cakruḥ
sa tathā bhrātṝnsaṃdiśya takṣaśilāṃ pratyabhipratasthe taṃ ca deśaṃ vaśe sthāpayāmāsa
upamanyurāruṇirbaidaśceti sa ekaṃ śiṣyaṃmāruṇiṃ pāñcālyaṃ preṣayāmāsa gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti
sa upādhyāyena saṃdiṣṭa āruṇiḥ pāñcālyastatra gatvā tatkedārakhaṇḍaṃ baddhuṃ nāśakat
sa tatra saṃviveśa kedārakhaṇḍe śayāne va tathā tasmiṃstadudakaṃ tasthau
tataḥ kadācidupādhyāya āpodo dhaumyaḥ śiṣyāvapṛcchat kva āruṇiḥ pāñcālyo gata iti
tau taṃ pratyūcaturbhagavaṃstvayaiva preṣito gaccha kedārakhaṇḍaṃ badhāneti
sa evamuktastau śiṣyau pratyuvāca tasmāttatra sarve gacchāmo yatra sa gata iti
sa tatra gatvā tasyāhvānāya śabdaṃ cakāraḥ
provāca cainamayamasmyatra kedārakhaṇḍe niḥsaramāṇamudakamavāraṇīyaṃ saṃroddhuṃ saṃviṣṭo bhagavacchabdaṃ śrutvaiva sahasā vidārya kedārakhaṇḍaṃ bhavantamupasthitaḥ
sa evamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca yasmādbhavānkedārakhaṇḍaṃ vidāryotthitastasmāduddālaka evanāmnā bhavānbhaviṣyatītyupādhyāyenānugṛhītaḥ
sarve ca te vedāḥ pratibhāsyanti sarvāṇi ca dharmaśāstrāṇīti
taṃ copādhyāyaḥ preṣayāmāsa vatsopamanyo gā rakṣasveti
sa upādhyāyavacanādarakṣadgāḥ sa cāhani gā rakṣitvā divasakṣaye gurugṛhamāgamyopādhyāyasyāgrataḥ sthitvā namaścakre
tamupādhyāyaḥ pīvānamapaśyaduvāca cainaṃ vatsopamanyo kena vṛttiṃ kalpayasi pīvānasi dṛḍhamiti
sa upādhyāyaṃ pratyuvāca bho bhaikṣyeṇa vṛttiṃ kalpayāmīti tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
sa tathetyuktaḥ punararakṣadgā ahani rakṣitvā niśāmukhe gurukulamāgamya guroragrataḥsthitvā namaścakre
vatsopamanyo sarvamaśeṣataste bhaikṣyaṃ gṛhṇāmi kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti
bhagavate nivedya pūrvamaparaṃ carāmi tena vṛttiṃ kalpayāmīti tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca
naiṣā nyāyyā guruvṛttiranyeṣāmapi bhaikṣyopajīvināṃ vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣi ityevaṃ vartamāno lubdho'sīti
sa tathetyuktvā gā arakṣadrakṣitvāca punarupādhyāyagṛhamāgamyopādhyāyasyāgrataḥ sthitvā namaścakre
vatsopamanyo ahaṃ te sarvaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ gṛhṇāmi na cānyaccarasi pīvānasi bhṛśaṃ kena vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti
sa evamuktastamupādhyāyaṃ pratyuvāca bho etāsāṃ gavāṃ payasā vṛttiṃ kalpayāmīti
tamuvācopādhyāyo naitannyāyyaṃ paya upayoktuṃ bhavato mayā nābhyanujñātamiti
sa tatheti pratijñāya gā rakṣitvā punarupādhyāyagṛhametya guroragrataḥ sthitvā namaścakre
vatsopamanyo bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāsi na cānyaccarasi payo na pibasi pīvānasi bhṛśaṃ kenedānīṃ vṛttiṃ kalpayasīti
bhoḥ phenaṃ pibāpi yamime vatsā mātṝṇāṃ stanātpibanta udgiranti
tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca ete tvadanukampayā guṇavanto vatsāḥ prabhūtataraṃ phenamudgiranti
tadeṣāmapi vatsānāṃ vṛttyuparodhaṃ karoṣyevaṃ vartamānaḥ phenamapi bhavānna pātumarhatīti sa tatheti pratiśrutya nirāhāraḥ punararakṣadgāḥ
tathā pratiṣiddho bhaikṣyaṃ nāśnāti nacānyaccarati payo na pibati phenaṃ nopayuhkte sa kadācidaraṇye kṣudhārto'rkapatrāṇyabhakṣayat
atha tasminnanāgacchati sūrye cāstācalāvalambini upādhyāyaḥ śiṣyānavocat
mayopamanyuḥ sarvataḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ sa niyataṃ kupitastato nāgacchati ciragatastviti
tato'nveṣya ityevamuktvā śiṣyaiḥ sārdhamaraṇyaṃ gatvā tasyāhvānāya śabdaṃ cakāra bho upamanyo kvāsi vatsaihīti
sa upādhyāyasya āhvānavacanaṃ śrutvā pratyuvācoccairayamasminkūpe patito'hamiti
tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca kathaṃ tvamasminkūpe patita iti
sa upādhyāyaṃ pratyuvāca arkapatrāṇi bhakṣayitvāndhībhūtosmyataścaṅkramyamāṇaḥ kūpe patita iti
aśvinau stuhi tau devabhiṣajau tvāṃ cakṣuṣmantaṃ kartārāviti
sa evamukta upādhyāyenopamanyuḥ stotumupacakrame devāvaśvinau vāgbhirṛgbhiḥ
prapūrvagau pūrvajau citrabhānū girā vāṃ śaṃsāmi tapasā hyanantau
divyau suparṇau virajau vimānāvadhikṣipantau bhuvanāni viśvā
hiraṇmayau śakunī sāṃparāyau nāsatyadasrau sunasau vaijayantau
tāvatsuvṛttāvanamaṃ tamāya yāvasattamā gā aruṇā udāvahat
ṣaṣṭiśca gāvastriśatāśca dhenava ekaṃ vatsaṃ suvate taṃ duhanti
ekāṃ nābhiṃ sapta sathā arāḥ śritāḥ pradhiṣvanyā viṃśatirarpitā arāḥ
anemi cakraṃ parivartate'jaraṃ māyā'śvinau samanakti carṣaṇī
ekaṃ cakraṃ vartate dvādaśāraṃ ṣaṇṇābhimekākṣamamṛtasya dhāraṇam
yasmindevā adhi viśve viṣaktāstāvaśvinau muñcato mā viṣīdatam
yuvāṃ diśo janayatho daśāgre samānaṃ mūrdhni rathayānaṃ viyanti
tau nāsatyāvaśvinau vāṃ mahe'haṃ srajaṃ ca yāṃ bibhṛthaḥ puṣkarasya
mukhena garbhaṃ labhatāṃ yuvānau gatāsuretatprapadena sūte
sadyo jāto mātaramatti garbhastāvaśvinau muñcathau jīvase gām
stotuṃ na śaknomi guṇairbhavantau cakṣurvihīnaḥ pathi saṃpramohaḥ
durge'hamasminpatito'smi kūpe yuvāṃ śaraṇyau śaraṇaṃ prapadye
ityevaṃ tenābhiṣṭutāvaśvināvājagmaturāhatuścaiṃ prītau sva eṣa te'pūpośānainamiti
sa evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca nānṛtamūcaturbhagavantau natvahametamapūpamupayoktumutsahe gurave'nivedyeti
āvābhyāṃ purastādbhavata upādhyāyenaivamevābhiṣṭutābhyāmapūpodatta upayuktaḥ sa tenānivedya gurave tvamapi tathaiva kuruṣva yathā kṛtamupādhyāyeneti
sa evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca etatpratyanunaye bhavantāvaśvinau notsahe'hamanivedya gurave'pūpamupayoktumiti
upādhyāyasya te kārṣṇāyasā dantā bhavato'pi hiraṇmayā bhaviṣyanti cakṣuṣmāṃśca bhaviṣyasi śreyaścāvāpsyasīti
sarve ca te vedāḥpratibhāsyanti sarvāṇi ca dharmaśāstrāṇīti
athāparaḥ śiṣyastasyaivāpodasya dhaumyasya baido nāma tamupādhyāyaḥ samādideśa vatsa baida ihāsyatāṃ tāvanmama gṛhe kaṃcitkālaṃ śuśrūṣuṇā ca bhavitavyaṃ śreyaste bhaviṣyatīti
gauriva nityaṃ guruṇā dhūrṣu niyojyamānaḥ śītoṣṇakṣuttṛṣṇāduḥkhasahaḥ sarvatrāpratikūlastasya mahatātkālena guruḥ paritoṣaṃ jagāma
sa upādhyāyenānujñātaḥ samāvṛttastasmādgurukulavāsādgṛhāśramaṃ pratyapadyata tasyāpi svagṛhe vasatastrayaḥ śiṣyā babhūvuḥ sa śiṣyānna kiṃciduvāca karma vā kriyatāṃ guruśuśrūṣā veti
duḥkhābhijño hi gurukulavāsasya śiṣyānparikleśena yojayituṃ neyeṣa
atha kasmiṃścitkāle baidaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ janamejayaḥ pauṣyaśca kṣatriyāvupetyopādhyāyaṃ varayāñcakratuḥ
bhoyatkiṃcidasmadgṛhe parihīyate tadicchāmyahamaparihīyamānaṃ bhavatā kriyamāṇamiti sa evaṃ pratisaṃdiśyottaṅkaṃ baidaḥ pravāsaṃ jagāma
upādhyāyānī te ṛtumatī upādhyāyaśca proṣito'syā yathā'yamṛturvandhyo na bhavati tathā kriyatāmeṣā viṣīdatīti
evamuktastāḥ striyaḥ pratyuvāca na mayā strīṇāṃ vacanādidamakāryaṃ karaṇīyam
uvāca cainaṃ vatsottaṅkaṃ kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti
dharmato hi śuśrūṣito'smi bhavatā tena prītiḥ paraspareṇa nau saṃvṛddhā tadanujāne bhavantaṃ sarvāneva kāmānavāpsyasi gamyatāmiti
sa evamuktaḥ pratyuvāca kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti evaṃ hyāhuḥ
tenaivamukta upādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca vatsottaṅka uṣyatāṃ tāvaditi
sa kadācittamupādhyāyamāhottaṅka ājñāpayatu bhavānkiṃ te priyamupāharāmi gurvarthamiti
tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca vatsottaṅka bahuśo māṃ codayasi gurvarthamupāharāmīti tadgacchaināṃ praviśyopādhyāyānīṃ pṛccha kimupāharāmīti eṣā yadbravīti tadupāharasveti
sa evamukta upādhyāyenopādhyāyānīmapṛcchadbhavatyupādhyāyenāsmyanujñāto gṛhaṃ gantumicchāmīṣṭaṃ te gurvarthamupahṛtyānṛṇo gantuṃ tadājñāpayatu bhavatī kimupāharāmi gurvarthamiti
saivamuktopādhyāyānī tamuttaṅkaṃ pratyuvāca gaccha pauṣyaṃ prati rājānaṃ kuṇḍale bhikṣituṃ tasya kṣatriyayā pinaddhe
ānayasvetaścaturthe'hani puṇyakarma bhavitā tābhyāmābaddhābhyāṃ śobhamānā brāhmaṇānpariveṣṭumicchāmi
tatsaṃpādayasva evaṃ hi kurvataḥ śreyo bhavitā'nyathā kutaḥ śreya iti
sa evamuktastayopādhyāyānyā prātiṣṭhatottaṅkaḥ sa pathi gacchannapaśyadṛṣabhamatipramāṇaṃ tamadhirūḍhaṃ ca puruṣamatipramāṇameva sa puruṣa uttaṅkamabhyabhāṣata
bhouttaṅkaitatpurīṣamasya ṛṣabhasya bhakṣayasveti sa evamukto naicchat
tamāha puruṣo bhūyo bhakṣayasvottaṅka mā vicārayopādhyāyenāpi te bhakṣitaṃ pūrvamiti
sa evamukto bāḍhamityuktvā tadā tadvṛpabhasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca bhakṣayitvottaṅkaḥ saṃbhramāḍhutthita evāpo'nuspṛśya pratasthe
ye vai te kṣatriyā pinaddhe kuṇḍale te bhavāndātumarhatīti
taṃ pratyuvāca pauṣyaḥ praviśyāntaḥpuraṃ kṣatriyā yācyatāmiti
sa pauṣyaṃ punaruvāca na yuktaṃ bhavatā'hamanṛtenopacarituṃ na hi te'ntaḥpure kṣatriyā sannihitā naināṃ paśyāmi
sa evamuktaḥ pauṣyaḥ kṣaṇamātraṃ vimṛśyottaṅkaṃ pratyuvāca
niyataṃ bhavānucchiṣṭaḥ smara tāvanna hi sā kṣatriyā ucchiṣṭenāśucinā śakyā draṣṭuṃ pativratātvātsaiṣā nāśucerdarśanamupaitīti
athaivamukta uttaṅkaḥ smṛtvovācāsti khalu mayā tu bhakṣitaṃ nopaspṛṣṭamāgacchateti
taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca eṣa te vyatikramo notthitenopaspṛṣṭaṃ bhavati śīghramāgacchateti
athottaṅkastaṃ tathetyuktvā prāṅmukha upāveśya suprakṣālitapāṇipādavadano niḥśabdābhiraphenābhiranuṣṇābhirhṛdgatābhiradbhistriḥ pītvā dviḥ parimṛjya khānyadbhirupaspṛśya cāntaḥpuraṃ praviveśa
tatastāṃ kṣatriyāmapaśyatsā ca dṛṣṭvaivottaṅkaṃ pratyutthāyābhivādyovāca svāgataṃ te bhagavannājñāpaya kiṃ karavāṇīti
sa tāmuvācaite kuṇḍale gurvarthaṃ me bhikṣite dātumarhasīti
sā prītā tena tasya sadbhāvena pātramayamanatikramaṇīyaśceti matvā te kuṇḍale avamucyāsmai prāyacchadāha cainamete kuṇḍale takṣako nāgarājaḥ subhṛśaṃ prārthayatyapramatto netumarhasīti
sa evamuktastāṃ kṣatriyāṃ pratyuvāca bhavatī sunirvṛtā bhavatu
āha cainaṃ bhoḥ pauṣya prīto'smīti tamuttaṅkaṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca
bhagavaṃścireṇa pātramāsādyate bhavāśca guṇavānatithistadicche śrāddhaṃ kartuṃ kriyatāṃ kṣaṇa iti
tamuttaṅkaḥ pratyuvāca kṛtakṣaṇa evāsmi śīghramicchāmi yathopapannamannamupaskṛtaṃ bhavateti sa tathetyuktvā yathopapannenānnenainaṃ bhojayāmāsa
athottaṅkaḥ sakeśaṃ śītamannaṃ dṛṣṭvā aśucyetaditi matvā taṃ pauṣyamuvāca
na yuktaṃ bhavatā'nnamaśuci dattvā pratiśāpaṃ dātuṃ tasmādannameva pratyakṣīkuru
atha tadannaṃ muktakeśyā striyopahṛtamanuṣṇaṃ sakeśaṃ cāśucyetaditi matvā tamṛṣimuttaṅkaṃ prasādayāmāsa
bhaghavannetadajñānādannaṃ sakeśamupāhṛtaṃ śītaṃ ca tatkṣāmaye bhavantaṃ na bhaveyamandha iti
na mṛṣā bravīmi bhūtvā tvamandho nacirādanandho bhaviṣyasīti
mamāpi śāpo bhavatā datto na bhavediti
taṃ pauṣyaḥ pratyuvāca na cāhaṃ śaktaḥ śāpaṃ pratyādātuṃ na hi me manyuradyāpyupaśamaṃ gacchati kiṃ caitadbhavatā na jñāyate
navanītaṃ hṛdayaṃ brāhmaṇasya vāci kṣuro nihitastīkṣṇadhāraḥ
tadubhayametadviparītaṃ kṣatriyasya vāṅgavanītaṃ hṛdayaṃ tīkṣṇadhāram iti
tadevaṃgate na śakto'haṃ tīkṣṇahṛdayatvāttaṃ śāpamanyathākartuṃ gamyatāmiti
bhavatā'hamannasyāśucibhāvamālakṣya pratyanunītaḥ prāk ca te'bhihitaṃ yasmādaduṣṭamannaṃ dūṣayasi tasmādanapatyo bhaviṣyasīti
duṣṭe cānne naiṣa mama śāpo bhaviṣyatīti
so'paśyadatha pathi nagnaṃ kṣapaṇakamāgacchantaṃ muhurmuhurdṛśyamānamadṛśyamānaṃ ca
etasminnantare sa kṣapaṇakastvaramāṇa upasṛtya te kuṇḍale gṛhītvā prādravat
tamuttaṅko'bhisṛtya kṛtodakakāryaḥ śuciḥ prayato namo devebhyo gurubhyaśca kṛtvā mahatā javena tamanvayāt
gṛhītamātraḥ sa tadrūpaṃ vihāya takṣakasvarūpaṃ kṛtvā sahasā dharaṇyāṃ vivṛtaṃ mahābilaṃ praviveśa
athottaṅkastasyāḥ kṣatriyāyā vacaḥ smṛtvā taṃ takṣakamanvagacchat
sa tadbilaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhena cakhāna na cāśakat taṃ kliśyamānamindro'paśyatsa vajraṃ preṣayāmāsa
tamuttaṅko'nuviveśa tenaiva bilena praviśya ca taṃ nāgalokamaparyantamanekavidhaprāsādaharmyavalabhīniryūhaśatasaṃkulamuccāvacakrīḍāścaryasthānāvakīrṇamapaśyat
sa tatra nāgāṃstānastuvadebhiḥ ślokaiḥ ya airāvatarājānaḥ sarpāḥ samitiśobhāḥ
ye cainamupasarpanti ye ca dūrapathaṃ gatāḥ
evaṃ stuvannapi nāgānyadā te kuṇḍale nālabhattadā'paśyatstriyau tantre adhiropya suveme paṭaṃ vayantyau
tasmiṃstantre kṛṣṇāḥ sitāśca tantavaścakraṃ cāpaśyaddvādaśāraṃ ṣaḍbhiḥ kumāraiḥ parivartyamānaṃ puruṣaṃ cāpaśyadaśvaṃ ca darśanīyam
trīṇyarpitānyatra śatāni madhye ṣaṣṭiśca nityaṃ carati dhruve'smin
tantraṃ cedaṃ viśvarūpe yuvatyau vayatastantūnsatataṃ vartayantyau
vajrasya bhartā bhuvanasya goptā vṛtrasya hantā namucernihantā
kṛṣṇe vasāno vasane mahātmā satyānṛte yo vivinakti loke
yo vājinaṃ garbhamapāṃ purāṇaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ vāhanamabhyupaiti
tataḥ sa enaṃ puruṣaḥ prāha prīto'smi te'hasanena stotreṇa kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti
sa cainaṃ puruṣaḥ punaruvāca etamaśvamapāne dhamasveti
tābhirnāgaloka upadhūpite'tha saṃbhrāntastakṣako'gnestejobhayādviṣaṇṇaḥ kuṇḍale gṛhītvā sahasā bhavanānniṣkramyottaṅkamuvāca
sa te pratijagrāhottaṅkaḥ pratigṛhya ca kuṇḍale'cintayat
adya tatpuṇyakamupādhyāyānyā dūraṃ cāhamabhyāgataḥ sa kathaṃ saṃbhāvayeyamiti
tata enaṃ cintayānameva sa puruṣa uvāca
upādhyāyānī ca snātā keśānāvāpayantyupaviṣṭottaṅko nāgacchatīti śāpāyāsya mano dadhe
athaitasminnantare sa uttaṅkaḥ praviśya upādhyāyakulaṃ upādhyāyānīmabhyavādayatte cāsyai kuṇḍale prāyacchatsā cainaṃ pratyuvāca
uttaṅka deśe kāle'bhyāgataḥ svāgataṃ te vatsa idānīṃ yadyanāgatosi kopitayā mayā śapto bhaviṣyasi śreyastavopasthitaṃ siddhimāpnuhīti
tamupādhyāyaḥ pratyuvāca vatsottaṅka svāgataṃ te kiṃ ciraṃ kṛtamiti
bhostakṣakeṇa me nāgarājena vighnaḥ kṛto'sminkarmaṇi tenāsmi nāgalokaṃ gataḥ
tatra ca mayā dṛṣṭe striyau tantre'dhiropya paṭaṃ vayantyau tasmiṃśca kṛṣṇāḥ sitāśca tantavaḥ
tatra ca mayā cakraṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dvādaśāraṃ ṣaṭcainaṃ kumārāḥ parivartayanti tadapi kiṃ puruṣaścāpi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sa cāpi kaḥ
pathi gacchatā ca mayā ṛṣabho dṛṣṭastaṃ ca puruṣo'dhirūḍhastenāsmi sopacāramukta uttaṅkāsya ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ bhakṣaya upādhyāyenāpi te bhakṣitamiti
tatastasya vacanānmayā tadṛṣabhasya purīṣamupayuktaṃ sa cāpi kaḥ tadetadbhavatopadiṣṭamiccheyaṃ śrotuṃ kiṃ taditi
ye te striyau dhātā vidhātā ca ye ca te kṛṣṇāḥ sitāstantavaste rātryahanī
yadapi taccakraṃ dvādaśāraṃ ṣaṭkumārāḥ parivartayanti tepi ṣaḍṛtavaḥ dvādaśārā dvādaśa māsāḥ saṃvatsaraścakram
yaḥ puruṣaḥsa parjanyaḥ yo'śvaḥ so'gniḥ ya ṛṣabhastvayā pathi gacchatā dṛṣṭaḥ sa airāvato nāgarāṭ
yaścainamadhirūḍhaḥ puruṣaḥ sa cendraḥ yadapi te bhakṣitaṃ tasya ṛṣabhasya purīṣaṃ tadamṛtaṃ tena khalvasi tasminnāgabhavane na vyāpannastvam
sa hi bhagavānindro mama sakhā tvadanukrośādimamanugrahaṃ kṛtavān
sa upādhyāyenānujñāto bhagavānuttaṅkaḥ kruddhastakṣakaṃ praticikīrṣamāṇo hāstinapuraṃ pratasthe
tasmai jayāśiṣaḥ pūrvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ prayujya saḥ
āsāṃ prajānāṃ paripālanena svaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ paripālayāmi
pravrūhi me kiṃ karaṇīyamadya yenāsi kāryeṇa samāgatastvam
sa evamuktastu nṛpottamena dvijottamaḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ
uvāca rājānamadīnasatvaṃ svameva kāryaṃ nṛpate kuruṣva
takṣakeṇa mahīndrendra yena te hiṃsitaḥ pitā
mama priyaṃ ca sumahatkṛtaṃ rājan bhaviṣyati
tadaiva hi sa rājendro duḥkhaśokāpluto'bhavat yadaiva vṛttaṃ pitaramuttaṅkādaśṛṇottadā
romaharṣaṇaputra ugraśravāḥ sautiḥ paurāṇiko naimiśāraṇye śaunakasya kulapaterdvādaśavārṣike satre ṛṣīnabhyāgatānupatasthe
paurāṇikaḥ purāṇe kṛtaśramaḥ sa kṛtāñjalistānuvāca mayottaṅkasya caritamaśeṣamuktaṃ janamejayasya sārpasatre nimittāntaramidamapi
paraṃ raumaharṣaṇe pravakṣyāmastvāṃ naḥ prativakṣyasi vacaḥ śuśrūṣatāṃ kathāyogaṃ naḥ kathāyoge
tatra bhagavān kulapatistu śaunako'gniśaraṇamadhyāste dīrghasatratvātsarvāḥ kathāḥ śrotuṃ kālosti
tato vakṣyasi yattvāṃ sa prakṣyati dvijasattamaḥ
tena pṛṣṭaḥ kathāḥ puṇyā vakṣyāmi vividhāśrayāḥ
so'tha viprarṣabhaḥ sarvaṃ kṛtvā kāryaṃ yathāvidhi
purāṇamakhilaṃ tāta pitā te'dhītavānpurā bhāratādhyayanaṃ sarvaṃ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanāttadā
purāṇe hi kathā divyā ādivaṃśāśca dhīmatām
kathayasva kathāmetāṃ kalyāḥ smaḥ śravaṇe tava
yadadhītaṃ ca pitrā me samyakkaiva tato mayā
imaṃ vaṃśamahaṃ pūrvaṃ bhārgavaṃ te mahāmune
varuṇasya kratau jātaḥ pāvakāditi naḥ śrutam
sā hi pūrvaṃ vṛtā tena pulomnā tu śucismitā
tasya tatkilbiṣaṃ nityaṃ hṛdi vartati bhārgava
śaṃsa me kasya bhāryeyamagne pṛcche ṛtena vai
mukhaṃ tvamasi devānāṃ vada pāvaka pṛcchate
mayā hīyaṃ vṛtā pūrvaṃ bhāryārthe varavarṇinī
seyaṃ yadi tathā me tvaṃ satyamākhyātumarhasi
jātavedaḥ paśyataste vada satyāṃ giraṃ mama
satyaṃ vadāmi yadi me śāpaḥ syādbrahmavittamāt
asatyaṃ cedahaṃ brūyāṃ patiṣye narakāndhruvam bhīto'nṛtācca śāpācca bhṛgorityabravīcchanaiḥ
kiṃ tviyaṃ vidhinā pūrvaṃ mantravanna vṛtā tvayā
pitrā tu bhṛgave dattā pulomeyaṃ yaśasvinī
nānṛtaṃ hi sadā loke pūjyate dānavottama
agneratha vacaḥ śrutvā tadrakṣaḥ prajahāra tām
tasyā mārgaṃ sṛtavatīṃ dṛṣṭvā tu saritaṃ tadā
sa evaṃ cyavano jajñe bhṛgoḥ putraḥ pratāpavān taṃ dadarśa pitā tatra cyavanaṃ tāṃ ca bhāminīm
sa pulomāṃ tato bhāryāṃ papraccha kupito bhṛguḥ
kenāsi rakṣase tasmai kathitā tvaṃ jihīrṣave
na hi tvā veda tadrakṣo madbhāryāṃ cāruhāsinīm
bibheti ko na śāpānme kasya cāyaṃ vyatikramaḥ
bhasmībhūtaṃ ca tadrakṣo māmutsṛjya papāta vai
dharme prayatamānasya satyaṃ ca vadataḥ samam
pṛṣṭo yadabravaṃ satyaṃ vyabhicāro'tra ko mama
so'pi tenaiva pāpena lipyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
śakto'hamapi śaptuṃ tvāṃ mānyāstu brāhmaṇā mama
jānato'pi ca te brahmankathayiṣye nibodha tat
agnihotreṣu satreṣu kriyāsu ca makheṣu ca
devatāḥ pitaraścaiva tena tṛptā bhavanti vai
amāvāsyāṃ hi pitaraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ hi devatāḥ
manmukhenaiva hūyante bhuñjate ca hutaṃ haviḥ
sarvabhakṣaḥ kathaṃ tveṣāṃ bhaviṣyāmi mukhaṃ tvaham
lokānāmiha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ kartā cānta eva ca
sa tathā kuru lokeśa nocchidyeranyathā kriyāḥ
tvaṃ pavitraṃ sadā loke sarvabhūtagatiśca ha
apāne hyarciṣo yāste sarvaṃ bhakṣyanti tāḥ śikhin
kravyādā ca tanuryā te sā sarvaṃ bhakṣayiṣyati
yathā sūryāṃśubhiḥ spṛṣṭaṃ sarvaṃ śuci vibhāvyate
devānāṃ cātmano bhāgaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mukhe hutam
ṛṣayaśca yathā pūrvaṃ kriyāḥ sarvāḥ pracakrire
evaṃ sa bhagavāñchāpaṃ lebhe'gnirbhṛgutaḥ purā evameṣa purā vṛtta hatihāso'gniśāpajaḥ
apsarā menakā tasya taṃ garbhaṃ bhṛgunandana
utsṛjya caiva taṃ garbhaṃ nadyāstīre jagāma sā
sa tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā kanyāṃ sthūlakeśo mahādvijaḥ
jagrāha ca muniśreṣṭhaḥ kṛpāviṣṭaḥ pupoṣa ca
tataḥ prādātpitā kanyāṃ rurave tāṃ pramadvarām
sā daṣṭā tena sarpeṇa papāta sahasā bhuvi
dadarśa tāṃ pitā caiva ye caivānye tapasvinaḥ
tāṃ te kanyāṃ vyasuṃ dṛṣṭvā bhujaṃgasya viṣārditām
śete sā bhuvi tanvaṅgī mama śokavivardhinī
pitṛmātṛsakhīnāṃ ca luptapiṇḍasya tasya me bāndhavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kiṃ nu duḥkhamataḥparam
yadi dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ guravo vā mayā yadi
[evaṃ lālapyatastasya bhāryārthe duḥkhitasya ca devadūtastadā'bhyetya vākyamāha ruruṃ vane ]
yadi me niścalā bhaktirmama jīvatu sā priyā
vilapyamāne tu rurau sarve devāḥ kṛpānvitāḥ
devaiḥ sarvairahaṃ brahmanpreṣito'smi tavāntikam tvaddhitaṃ tvaddhitairuktaṃ śṛṇu vākyaṃ dvijottama
abhidhatse ha yadvācā ruro duḥkhānna tanmṛṣā
taṃ yadīcchasi kartuṃ tvaṃ prāpsyasīha pramadvarām
ka upāyaḥ kṛto devairbūhi tattvena khecara
kariṣye'haṃ tathā śrutvā trātumarhati māṃ bhavān
tata udyamya damḍaṃ sa kāladaṇḍopamaṃ tadā
tatra me samayo ghora ātmanoraga vai kṛtaḥ
bhujaṃgaṃ vai sadā hanyāṃ yaṃ yaṃ paśyeyamityuta
anye te bhujagā brahmanye daśtīha mānavān
kena tvaṃ bhujaga brūhi ko'sīmāṃ vikriyāṃ gataḥ
ahaṃ purā ruro nāmnā ṛṣirāsaṃ sahasrapāt
sakhā babhūva me pūrvaṃ khagamo nāma vai dvijaḥ
sa mayā krīḍatā bālye kṛtvā tārṇaṃ bhujaṃgamam
labdhvā sa ca punaḥ saṃjñāṃ māmuvāca tapodhanaḥ
sakheti hasatedaṃ te narmārthaṃ vai kṛtaṃ mayā
nānṛtaṃ vai mayā proktaṃ bhavitedaṃ kathaṃcana
yattu vakṣyāmi te vākyaṃ śṛṇu tanme tapodhana
śrutvā ca hṛdi te vākyamidamastu sadā'nagha
utpatsyati rururnāma pramaterātmajaḥ śuciḥ taṃ dṛṣṭvā śāpamokṣaste bhavitā nacirādiva
sa tvaṃ rururiti khyātaḥ pramaterātmajo'pi ca
brāhmaṇaḥ saumya eveha bhavatīti parā śrutiḥ
brāhmaṇasya paro dharmo vedānāṃ dhāraṇāpi ca
kṣatriyasya hi yo dharmaḥ sa neheṣyeta vai tava
tadidaṃ kṣatriyasyāsītkarma vai śṛṇu me ruro
ityuktvāntarhite yogāttasminnṛṣivare prabhau saṃbhramāviṣṭahṛdayo rururmene tadadbhutam
sa mohe paramaṃ gatvā naṣṭasaṃjña ivābhavat
tatkīrtyamānaṃ bhagavañśrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ pitā cāsya tadākhyānaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ sarvaṃ nyavedayat
kasya putraḥ sa rājāsītsarpasatraṃ ya āharat
sa ca dvijātipravaraḥ kasya putro'bhidhatsva me
pūrvaṃ pracoditaḥ sūtaḥ pitā me lomaharṣaṇaḥ
na te labhante vasatiṃ svarge puṇyakṛto'pi hi kastvaṃ bandhurivāsmākamanuśocasi sattama
mama pūrve bhavanto vai pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ
ātmano'rthe'smadarthe ca dharma ityeva vā vibho
na hi dharmaphalaistāta na tapo'bhiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ
tāṃ gatiṃ prāpnuvantīha putriṇo yāṃ vrajanti vai
taddāragrahaṇe yatnaṃ saṃtatyāṃ ca manaḥ kuru
na dārānvai kariṣye'haṃ na dhanaṃ jīvitārthataḥ
sanāmnī yā bhavitrī me ditsitā caiva bandhubhiḥ
daridrāya hi me bhāryāṃ ko dāsyati viśeṣataḥ
tato niveśāya tadā sa vipraḥ saṃśitavrataḥ
mahīṃ cacāra dārārthī na ca dārānavindata
sa kadācidvanaṃ gatvā vipraḥ pitṛvacaḥ smaran
na sa tāṃ pratijagrāha na sanāmnīti cintayan
sanāmnīṃ codyatāṃ bhāryāṃ gṛhṇīyāmiti tasya hi
kiṃnāmnī bhaginīyaṃ te brūhi satyaṃ bhujaṃgama
jaratkāro jaratkāruḥ svaseyamanujā mama pratigṛhṇīṣva bhāryārthe mayā dattāṃ sumadhyamām
sa ca tāṃ pratijagrāha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
mātrā hi bhujagāḥ śaptāḥ pūrvaṃ brahmavidāṃ vara
sa ca tāṃ pratijagrāha vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā
āstīko nāma putraśca tasyāṃ jajñe mahāmanāḥ
āstīkaṃ ca sutaṃ prāpya dharmaṃ cānuttamaṃ muniḥ
jaratkāruḥ sumahatā kālena svargameyivān etadākhyānamāstīkaṃ yathāvatkathitaṃ mayā
saute tvaṃ kathayasvemāṃ vistareṇa kathāṃ punaḥ
te bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ kadrūśca vinatā ca ha
dvau putrau vinatā vavre kadrūputrādhikau bale
tejasā vapuṣā caiva vikrameṇādhikau ca tau
tasyai bhartā varaṃ prādādīdṛsau te bhaviṣyataḥ
evamastviti taṃ cāha kaśyapaṃ vinatā tadā
kṛtakṛtyā tu vinatā labdhvā vīryādhikau sutau
janayāmāsa viprendra dve cāṇḍe vinatā tadā
tataḥ putrārthinī devī vrīḍitā ca tapasvinī
na kariṣyasyanaṅgaṃ vā vyaṅgaṃ vāpi tapasvinam
so'pi taṃ rathamāruhya bhānoramitatejasaḥ sarvalokapradīpasya hyamaro'pyaruṇo'bhavat
etasminneva kāle tu bhaginyau te tapodhana
kathaṃ tadamṛtaṃ devairmathitaṃ kva ca śaṃsa me kāraṇaṃ cātra mathane saṃjātamamṛtātparam
mandaroddharaṇe yatnaḥ kriyatāṃ ca hitāya naḥ
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā tathā yoktraṃ ca vāsukim devā mathitumārabdhāḥ samudraṃ nidhimambhasām
vibudhāḥ sahitāḥ sarve yataḥ pucchaṃ tataḥ sthitāḥ
vāsukeragramāśliṣṭā nāgarājño mahāsurāḥ śira utkṣipya nāgasya punaḥ punaravākṣipan
vāsukeratha nāgasya sahasā kṣipyato'suraiḥ sadhūmāḥ sārciṣo vātā niṣpeturasakṛnmukhāt
amaratvaṃ surā jagmuḥ kāñcanasya ca niḥsravāt
śrāntāḥ sma subhṛśaṃ brahmannodbhavatyamṛtaṃ ca tat
tatra pūrvaṃ viṣaṃ jātaṃ tadbrahmavacanācchivaḥ prāgrasallokarakṣārthaṃ tato jyeṣṭhā samutthitā
śrīḥ surā caiva somaśca turagaśca manojavaḥ pārijātaśca tatraiva surabhiśca mahāmune
tato jajñe mahākāyaścaturdanto mahāgajaḥ kapilā kāmavṛkṣaśca kaustubhaścāpsarogaṇaḥ
sā tu nārāyaṇī māyā dhārayantī kamaṇḍalum
āsyamāneṣu daityeṣu paṅktyā ca prati dānavaiḥ
pāyayatyamṛtaṃ devānharau bāhubalānnaraḥ nirodhayati cāpena dūrīkṛtya dhanurdharān
ye ye'mṛtaṃ pibanti sma te te yuddhyanti dānavaiḥ;
praveritaṃ viyati muhuḥ kṣitau tathā papau raṇe rudhiramatho piśācavat
tato mahī pravicalitā sakānanā mahādripātābhihatā samantataḥ
tato mahīṃ lavaṇajalaṃ ca sāgaraṃ mahāsurāḥ praviviśurarditāḥ suraiḥ
viyadgataṃ jvalitahutāśanaprabhaṃ sudarśanaṃ parikupitaṃ niśāmya te
tataḥ surairvijayamavāpya mandaraḥ svameva deśaṃ gamitaḥ supūjitaḥ
vinādya khaṃ divamapi caiva sarvaśastato gatāḥ saliladharā yathāgatam
tato'mṛtaṃ sunihitameva cakrire surāḥ purāṃ mudamabhigamya puṣkalām
dado ca taṃ nidhimamṛtasya rakṣituṃ kirīṭine balabhidathāmaraiḥ saha
uccaiḥśravā hi kiṃvarṇo bhadre prabrūhi mā ciram
śveta evāśvarājo'yaṃ kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase śubhe
ehi sārdhaṃ mayā dīvya dāsībhāvāya bhāmini
evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā dāsībhāvāya vai mithaḥ
jagmatuḥ svagṛhāneva śvo drakṣyāva iti sma ha
āviśadhvaṃ hayaṃ kṣipraṃ dāsī na syāmahaṃ yathā
teṣāṃ tīkṣṇaviṣatvāddhi prajānāṃ ca hitāya ca
evaṃ saṃbhāṣya devastu pūjya kadrūṃ ca tāṃ tadā
tatra manyustvayā tāta na kartavyaḥ kathaṃcana
dṛṣṭaṃ purātanaṃ hyetadyajñe sarpavināśanam ityuktvā sṛṣṭikṛddevastaṃ prasādya prajāpatim
kadrūśca vinatā caiva bhaginyau te tapodhana
amarṣite susaṃrabdhe dāsye kṛtapaṇe tadā smagarasya paraṃ pāraṃ velāvanavibhūṣitam
mahānadībhirbahvībhiḥ spardhayeva sahasraśaḥ abhisāryamāṇamaniśaṃ dadṛśāte mahārṇavam
iti niścitya te tasya kṛṣṇā vālā iva sthitāḥ etasminnantare te tu sapatnyau paṇite tadā
jagmatuḥ parayā prītyā paraṃ pāraṃ mahodadheḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaraṇaṃ jagmurdevāḥ sarve vibhāvasum
agne mā tvaṃ pravardhiṣṭhāḥ kaccinno na didhakṣasi
na bhīḥ kāryā kathaṃ cātra paśyadhvaṃ sahitā mayā
tvaṃ hi dhātā vidhātā ca tvaṃ viṣṇuḥ surasattamaḥ
tvaṃ gatiḥ satataṃ tvattaḥ kathaṃ naḥ prāpnuyādbhayam balormimānsādhuradīnasattvaḥ
samṛddhimāndurviṣahastvameva tvattaḥ sṛtaṃ sarvamahīnakīrte hyanāgataṃ copagataṃ ca sarvam
divākaraḥ parikupito yathā dahetprajāstathā dahasi hutāśanaprabha
jagatprabho taptasuvarṇavarcasā tvaṃ pāhi sarvāṃśca surānmahātmanaḥ
bhayānvitā nabhasi vimānagāmino vimānitā vipathagatiṃ prayānti te
ṛṣeḥ sutastvamasi dayāvataḥ prabho mahātmanaḥ khagavara kaśyapasya ha
sa mā krudhaḥ kuru jagato dayāṃ parāṃ tvamīśvaraḥ praśamamupaihi pāhi naḥ
mahāśanisphuritasamasvanena te diśo'mbaraṃ tridivamiyaṃ ca medinī
calanti naḥ khaga hṛdayāni cāniśaṃ nigṛhyatāṃ vapuridamagnisannibham
tava dyutiṃ kupitakṛtāntasannibhāṃ niśāmya naścalati mano'vyavasthitam prasīda naḥ patagate prayācatāṃ śivaśca no bhava bhagavansukhāvahaḥ
sa śrutvā'thātmano dehaṃ suparṇaḥ prekṣya ca svayam
surārthāya samutpanno roṣo rāhostu māṃ prati
sahāya eva kāryeṣu na ca kṛcchreṣu dṛśyate
paśyanti grasyamānaṃ māṃ sahante vai divaukasaḥ
na tāvaddṛśyate sūryaḥ kṣayo'yaṃ pratibhāti ca
tasya pratividhānaṃ ca vihitaṃ pūrvameva hi
mahākāyo mahātejāḥ sa sthāsyati puro raveḥ
lokānāṃ svasti caivaṃ syādṛṣīṇāṃ ca divaukasām
sarpāṇāṃ sūryataptānāṃ vāriṇā tvaṃ plavo bhava
īśo asi pavaḥ sraṣṭuṃ tvamanalpaṃ puraṃdara
tvaṃ mahadbhūtamāścaryaṃ tvaṃ rājā tvaṃ surottamaḥ
tvaṃ sarvamamṛtaṃ deva tvaṃ somaḥ paramārcitaḥ
tvaṃ muhūrtastithistvaṃ ca tvaṃ lavastvaṃ punaḥ kṣaṇaḥ śuklastvaṃ bahulastvaṃ ca kalā kāṣṭhā truṭistathā
tvamuttamā sagirivanā vasuṃdharā sabhāskaraṃ vitimiramambaraṃ tathā
abhiṣṭutaḥ pibasi ca somamadhvare kaṣaṭkṛtānyapi ca havīṃṣi bhūtaye
tvaṃ vipraiḥ satatamihejyase phalārthaṃ vedāṅgeṣvatulabalaugha gīyase ca
āpūryata mahī cāpi salilena samantataḥ rasātalamanuprāptaṃ śītalaṃ vimalaṃ jalam
tatra te lavaṇaṃ ghoraṃ dadṛśuḥ pūrvamāgatāḥ
kiṃ kāraṇaṃ mayā mātaḥ kartavyaṃ sarpabhāṣitam
kimāhṛtya viditvā vā kiṃ vā kṛtveha pauruṣam
na ca te brāhmaṇaṃ hantuṃ kāryā buddhiḥ kathaṃcana
agnirarko viṣaṃ śastraṃ vipro bhavati kopitaḥ
sa te tāta na hantavyaḥ saṃkruddhenāpi sarvathā
jaṭhare na ca jīryedyastaṃ jānīhi dvijottamam
pakṣau te mārutaḥ pātu candrasūryau ca pṛṣṭhataḥ
śiraśca pātu vahniste vasavaḥ sarvatastanum viṣṇuḥ sarvagataḥ sarvamahgāni tava caiva ha
ahaṃ ca te sadā putra śāntisvastiparāyaṇā
tataḥ sa māturvacanaṃ niśamya vitatya pakṣau nabha utpapāta
sa tānniṣādānupasaṃharaṃstadā rajaḥ samuddhūya nabhaḥspṛśaṃ mahat
tataḥ sa cakre mahadānanaṃ tadā niṣādamārgaṃ pratirudhya pakṣirāṭ
tato niṣādāstvaritāḥ pravavrajuryato mukhaṃ tasya bhujaṃgabhojinaḥ
na hi me brāhmaṇo vadhyaḥ pāpeṣvapi rataḥ sadā
niṣādī mama bhāryeyaṃ nirgacchatu mayā saha
vardhayitvā ca garuḍamiṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha
kaccidvaḥ kuśalaṃ nityaṃ bhojane bahulaṃ suta
kaccicca mānuṣe loke tavānnaṃ vidyate bahu
mātā me kuśalā śaśvattathā bhrātā tathā hyaham
na hi me kuśalaṃ tāta bhojane bahule sadā
tanme tattvaṃ nibodhasya yatpramāṇau ca tāvubhau
śṛṇu tvaṃ vatsa bhadraṃ te kathāṃ vairāgyavardhinīm
pitrorarthavibhāge vai samutpannāṃ purāṇḍaja āsīdvibhāvasurnāma maharṣiḥ kopano bhṛśam
sa necchati dhanaṃ bhrātrā sahaikasthaṃ mahāmuniḥ
vibhāge bahavo doṣā bhaviṣyanti mahātapaḥ vibhāgaṃ bahavo mohātkartumicchanti nityaśaḥ
niyantu na hi śakyastvaṃ bhedato dhanamicchasi
yudhyataḥ saha devaiste yuddhe bhavatu maṅgalam
ṛco yajūṃṣi sāmāni pavitrāṇi havīṃṣi ca
rahasyāni ca sarvāṇi sarve vedāśca te balam vardhayiṣyanti samare bhaviṣyati khagottama
na no bhañjyāditi tadā divyāḥ kanakaśākhinaḥ
yasya chāyāṃ samāśritya sadyo bhavati nirvṛtaḥ;
spaṣṭamātrā tu padbhyāṃ sā garuḍena balīyasā
tāṃ bhaṅktvā sa mahāśākhāṃ smayamāno vilokayan
ṛṣayo hyatra lambante na hanyāmiti tānṛṣīn
atidaivaṃ tu tattasya karma dṛṣṭvā maharṣayaḥ
dadarśa kaśyapaṃ tatra pitaraṃ tapasi sthitam
dadarśa taṃ pitā cāpi divyarūpaṃ vihaṅgamam
putra mā sāhasaṃ kārṣīrmā sadyo lapsyase vyathām
mā tvāṃ daheyuḥ saṃkruddhā vālakhilyā marīcipāḥ
muktvā śākhāṃ giriṃ puṇyaṃ himavanta tapo'rthinaḥ
śākhino mahatīṃ śākhāṃ yāṃ pragṛhya yayau khagaḥ
sa taṃ gatvā kṣaṇenaiva parvataṃ vacanātpituḥ
tāvubhau bhakṣayitvā tu sa tārkṣyaḥ kūrmakuñjarau
sādhyānāṃ marutāṃ caiva ye cānye devatāgaṇāḥ
rajāṃsi mukuṭānyeṣāmutthitāni vyadharṣayan tatastrāsasamudvignaḥ saha devaiḥ śatakratuḥ
na ca śatruṃ prapaśyāmi yudhi yo naḥ pradharṣayet
samartho balināṃ śreṣṭho hartuṃ somaṃ vihaṃgamaḥ
rakṣadhvaṃ vibudhā vīrā yathā na sa haredbalāt
atulaṃ hi balaṃ tasya bṛhaspatiruvāca ha
carmāṇyapi ca gātreṣu bhānumanti dṛḍhāni ca
cakrāṇi paraghāṃścaiva triśūlāni paraśvadhān śaktīśca vividhāstīkṣṇāḥ karavālāṃśca nirmalān
iti samaravaraṃ surāḥ sthitāste parighasahasraśataiḥ samākulam
kaśyapasya dvijāteśca kathaṃ vai pakṣirāṭ sutaḥ
kathaṃ ca kāmacārī sa kāmavīryaśca khecaraḥ
yāthātathyena me brūta śrotuṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
na mithyā brahmaṇo vākyaṃ kartumarhatha sattamāḥ
bhavatāṃ hi na mithyā'yaṃ saṃkalpo vai cikīrṣitaḥ
etasminneva kāle tu devī dākṣāyaṇī śubhā
na cāpyevaṃ tvayā bhūyaḥ kṣeptavyā brahmavādinaḥ
vinatā cāpi siddhārthā babhūva muditā tathā
tatastasmādgirivarātsamudīrṇamahābalaḥ garuḍaḥ pakṣirāṭ tūrṇaṃ saṃprāpto vibudhānprati
kurvansutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ pakṣirāṇṇa vyakampata nirdahanniva cākāśe vainateyaḥ pratāpavān
sādhyāḥ prācīṃ sagandharvā vasavo dakṣiṇāṃ diśam
krathanena ca śūreṇa tapanena ca khecaraḥ
prarujena ca saṃgrāmaṃ cakāra pulinena ca
nabhaḥ spṛśantaṃ jvālābhiḥ sarvabhūtabhayaṃkaram tato navatyā navatīrmukhānāṃ
kṛtvā mahātmā garuḍastarasvī nadīḥ samāpīya mukhaistatastaiḥ suśīghramāgamya punarjavena
tau dṛṣṭvā sahasā khedaṃ jagāma vinatātmajaḥ
iti saṃcintya garuḍastayostūrṇaṃ nirākaraḥ tayoścakṣūṃṣi rajasā suparṇaḥ sahasā''vṛṇot
pratigṛhya vanau tau ca garuḍo viṣṇumabravīt
dhvajaṃ ca cakre bhagavānupari sthāsyasīti tam
vajrasya ca kariṣyāmi tavaiva ca śatakrato
na ca vajranipātena rujā me'stīha kācana
surūpaṃ patramālakṣya suparṇo'yaṃ bhavatviti taddṛṣṭvā mahadāścaryaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ puraṃdaraḥ
sakhyaṃ me'stu tvayā deva yathecchasi puraṃdara
balaṃ tu mama jānīhi mahaccāsahyameva ca
guṇasaṃkīrtanaṃ cāpi pṛṣṭenānyena gopate vaktavyaṃ na tu vaktavyaṃ svayameva śatakrato
sakheti kṛtvā tu sakhe pṛṣṭo vakṣyāmyahaṃ tvayā
evameva yathāttha tvaṃ sarvaṃ saṃbhāvyate tvayi
na kāryaṃ yadi somena mama somaḥ pradīyatām
sa cānvamodattaṃ cārthaṃ yathoktaṃ garuḍena vai
tataḥ snātuṃ gatāḥ sarpāḥ pratyuktvā taṃ tathetyuta
parasparakṛtadveṣāḥ somaprāśanakarmaṇi ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvamityuktvā te samādravan
tadvijñāya hṛtaṃ sarpāḥ pratimāyākṛtaṃ ca tat
tato dvidhā kṛtā jihvāḥ sarpāṇāṃ tena karmaṇā
abhavaṃścāmṛtasparśāddarbhāste'tha pavitriṇaḥ nāgāśca vañcitā bhūtvā visṛjya vinatāṃ tataḥ
tataḥ suparṇaḥ paramapraharṣavānvihṛtya mātrā saha tatra kānane
imāṃ kathāṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ sadā paṭheta vā dvijagaṇamukhyasaṃsadi
bhujaṅgamānāṃ śāpasya mātrā caiva sutena ca
pannagānāṃ tu nāmāni na kītaryasi sūtaja
na kīrtayiṣye sarveṣāṃ prādhānyena tu me śṛṇu
vṛttasaṃvartakau nāgau dvau ca padmāviti śrutau
eteṣāṃ prasavo yaśca prasavasya ca saṃtatiḥ
teṣāṃ tu bhagavāñcheṣaḥ kadrūṃ tyaktvā mahāyaśāḥ
teṣu teṣu ca puṇyeṣu tīrtheṣvāyataneṣu ca
tapyamānaṃ tapo ghoraṃ taṃ dadarśa pitāmahaḥ
kimidaṃ kuruṣe śeṣa prajānāṃ svasti vai kuru
brūhi kāmaṃ ca me śeṣa yaste hṛdi vyavasthitaḥ
sodaryā mama sarve hi bhrātaro mandacetasaḥ
na marṣayanti sasutāṃ satataṃ vinatāṃ ca te
taṃ ca dviṣanti satataṃ sa cāpi balavattaraḥ
kathaṃ me pretyabhāve'pi na taiḥ syātsaha saṅgamaḥ
tamevaṃ vādinaṃ śeṣaṃ pitāmaha uvāca ha
jānāmi śeṣa sarveṣāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ te viceṣṭitam
bhrātṝṇāṃ tava sarveṣāṃ na śokaṃ kartumarhasi
vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ mattaḥ śeṣa yatte'bhikāṅkṣitam
dāsyāmi hi varaṃ te'dya prītirme paramā tvayi diṣṭyā buddhiśca te dharme niviṣṭā pannagottama
bhūyo bhūyaśca te buddhirdharme bhavatu susthirā
eṣa eva varo deva kāṅkṣito me pitāmaha
dharme me ramatāṃ buddhiḥ śame tapasi ceśvara
prīto'smyanena te śeṣa damena ca śamena ca
tvaṃ śeṣa samyak calitāṃ yathāvatsaṃgṛhya tiṣṭhasva yathā'calā syāt
tathā mahīṃ dhārayitā'smi niścalāṃ prayacchatāṃ me vivaraṃ prajāpate
adho mahīṃ gaccha bhujaṅgamottama svayaṃ tavaiṣā vivaraṃ pradāsyati
imāṃ dharāṃ dhārayatā tvayā hi me mahatpriyaṃ śeṣa kṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati
tathaiva kṛtvā vivaraṃ praviśya sa prabhurbhuvo bhujagavarāgrajaḥ sthitaḥ
bibharti devīṃ śirasā mahīmimāṃ samudranemiṃ parigṛhya sarvataḥ
śeṣo'si nāgottama dharmadevo mahīmimāṃ dhārayase yadekaḥ
anantabhogaiḥ parigṛhya sarvāṃ yathāhamevaṃ balabhidyathā vā
anante'bhiprayāte tu vāsukiḥ sa mahābalaḥ abhyaṣicyata nāgaistu daivatairiva vāsavaḥ
mātuḥ sakāśāttaṃ śāpaṃ śrutvā vai pannagottamaḥ
tataḥ sa mantrayāmāsa bhrātṛbhiḥ saha sarvaśaḥ
na tu mātrā'bhiśaptānāṃ mokṣaḥ kvacana vidyate
śaptā ityeva me śrutvā jāyate hṛdi vepathuḥ
nūnaṃ sarvavināśo'yamasmākaṃ samupāgataḥ śāpaḥ sṛṣṭo mahāghoro mātrā khalvavinītayā
na hyetāṃ so'vyayo devaḥ śapatnīṃ pratyaṣedhayat
yathā bhaveddhi sarveṣāṃ mā naḥ kālo'tyagādayam
api mantrayamāṇā hi hetuṃ paśyāma mokṣaṇe
yathā naṣṭaṃ purā devā gūḍhamagniṃ guhāgatam yathā sa yajño na bhavedyathā vā'pi parābhavaḥ
janamejayaṃ tu bhikṣāmo yajñaste na bhavediti
tatra buddhiṃ pradāsyāmo yathā yajño nivartsyati
sa no bahumatānrājā buddhyā buddhimatāṃ varaḥ
yajñārthaṃ prakṣyati vyaktaṃ neti vakṣyāmahe vayam
hetubhiḥ kāraṇaiścaiva yathā yajño bhavenna saḥ
taṃ gatvā daśatāṃ kaścidbhujaṅgaḥ sa mariṣyati
tasminmṛte yajñakāre kratuḥ sa na bhaviṣyati
srugbhāṇḍaṃ niśi gatvā ca apare bhujagottamāḥ
janāndaśantu vai sarve naivaṃ trāso bhaviṣyati
vaśyatāṃ ca gato'sau naḥ kariṣyati yathepsitam
naiṣā vo naiṣṭhikī buddhirmatā kartuṃ bhujaṅgamāḥ
sarveṣāmeva me buddhiḥ pannagānāṃ na rocate
kiṃ tatra saṃvidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ syāddhitaṃ tu yat
na ca jānāti me buddhiḥ kiṃcitkartuṃ vaco hivaḥ
mayā hīdaṃ vidhātavyaṃ bhavatāṃ yaddhitaṃ bhavet
sarpāṇāṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā sarveṣāmiti ceti ca
heyeti yadi vo buddhistavāpi ca tathā prabho
astu kāmaṃ mabhādyāpi buddhiḥ smaraṇamāgatā tāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena pannagāḥ
na sa yajño na bhavitā na sa rājā tathāvidhaḥ
ahaṃ śāpe samutsṛṣṭe samaśrauṣaṃ vacastadā māturutsaṅgamārūḍho bhayātpannagasattamāḥ
śāpaduḥkhāgnitaptānāṃ pannagānāmanāmayam kṛpayā parayā''viṣṭāḥ prārthayanto divaukasaḥ
teṣāṃ vināśo bhavitā na tu ye dharmacāriṇaḥ
tasya putro jaratkārorbhaviṣyati tapodhanaḥ āstīko nāma yajñaṃ sa pratiṣetsyati taṃ tadā
tatra mokṣyanti bhujagā ye bhaviṣyanti dhārmikāḥ
tasyāṃ janayitā putraṃ vedavedāṅgapāragam sanāmāyāṃ sanāmā sa kanyāyāṃ dvijasattamaḥ
jaratkāruṃ svasāraṃ vai paraṃ harṣamavāpa ca
hito hyayaṃ sadāsmakaṃ priyakārī ca nāgarāṭ
vinaśiṣyanti ye pāpā na tu ye dharmacāriṇaḥ
uktaṃ nāma yathā pūrvaṃ sarvaṃ tacchrutavānaham yathā tu jāto hyāstīka etadicchāmi veditum
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya sautiḥ provāca śāstrataḥ
atha kālasya mahataḥ sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ
cacāra sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ mahātmā na cāpi dārānmanasādhyakāṅkṣat
na hi tena mṛgo viddho jīvangacchati vai vane
mayā viddho mṛgo naṣṭaḥ kaccittaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi
sa munistaṃ tu novāca kiṃcinmaunavrate sthitaḥ
tasya skandhe mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ kruddho rājā samāsajat
na sa kiṃciduvācainaṃ śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham sa rājā krodhamutsṛjya vyathitastaṃ tathāgatam
na hi taṃ rājaśārdūlaṃ kṣamāśīlo mahāmuniḥ
sakhyoktaḥ krīḍamānena sa tatra hasatā kila
saṃrambhātkopano'tīva viṣakalpo muneḥ sutaḥ uddiśya pitaraṃ tasya yacchrutvā roṣamāharat
śavaṃ skandhena vahati mā śṛṅgingarvito bhava
kva te puruṣamānitvaṃ kva te vācastathāvidhāḥ
darpajāḥ pitaraṃ draṣṭā yastvaṃ śavadharaṃ tathā
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ viṣṇuṃ davematoṣayat vanyānnabhojī satataṃ munirmaunavrate sthitaḥ
evaṃbhūtaḥ sa tejasvī sa me'dya mṛtadhārakaḥ
kiṃ me pitrā kṛtaṃ tasya rājño'niṣṭaṃ durātmanaḥ
brūhi tatkṛśa tattvena paśya me tapaso balam
sa ca maunavratopeto naiva taṃ pratyabhāṣata
tasya rājā dhanuṣkoṭyā sarpaṃ skandhe samāsajat
āviṣṭaḥ sa hi kopena śaśāpa nṛpatiṃ tadā
yo'sau vṛddhasya tātasya tathā kṛcchragatasya ha
sa tamalakṣya pitaraṃ śṛṅgī skandhagatena vai
śrutvemāṃ dharṣaṇāṃ tāta tava tena durātmanā
rājñā parikṣitā kopādaśapaṃ tamahaṃ nṛpam yathārhati sa evograṃ śāpaṃ kurukulādhamaḥ
na me priyaṃ kṛtaṃ tāta naiṣa dharmastapasvinām
nyāyato rakṣitāstena tasya pāpaṃ na rocaye
kṣantavyaṃ putra dharmo hi hato hanti na saṃśayaḥ
yadi rājā na saṃrakṣetpīḍā naḥ paramā bhavet
na śaknuyāma carituṃ dharmaṃ putra yathāsukham
carāmo vipulaṃ dharmaṃ teṣāṃ bhāgo'sti dharmataḥ
arājake janapade doṣā jāyanti vai sadā
udvṛttaṃ satataṃ lokaṃ rājā daṇḍena śāsti vai
manuṣyāṇāṃ ca yo dhātā rājā rājyakaraḥ punaḥ
na hyarhati nṛpaḥ śāpamasmattaḥ putra sarvathā
yadyetatsāhasaṃ tāta yadi vā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam
priyaṃ vāpyapriyaṃ vā te vāguktā na mṛṣā bhavet
nāhaṃ mṛṣā bravīmyevaṃ svaireṣvapi kutaḥ śapan
pitrā putro vayastho'pi satataṃ vācya eva tu
kiṃ punarbāla eva tvaṃ tapasā bhāvitaḥ sadā
utsīdeyurime lokāḥ kṣaṇā cāsya pratikriyā so'haṃ paśyāmi vaktavyaṃ tvayi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
putratvaṃ bālatāṃ caiva tavāvekṣya ca sāhasam
cara krodhamimaṃ hitvā naivaṃ dharmaṃ prahāsyasi
krodho hi dharmaṃ harati yatīnāṃ duḥkhasaṃcitam
śama eva yatīnāṃ hi kṣamiṇāṃ siddhikārakaḥ
mayā tu śamamāsthāya yacchakyaṃ kartumadya vai
śamīko nāma rājendra vartate viṣaye tava
tadanyathā na śakyaṃ ca kartuṃ kenacidapyuta
na hi śaknoti saṃyantuṃ putraṃ kopasamanvitam
iti śrutvā vaco ghoraṃ sa rājā kurunandanaḥ
taṃ ca maunavrataṃ śrutvā vane munivaraṃ tadā
na hi mṛtyuṃ tathā rājā śrutvā vai so'nvatapyata
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ rājño munirgauramukhastadā samanujñāpya vegena prajagāmāśramaṃ guroḥ
rakṣāṃ ca vidadhe tatra bhiṣajaścauṣadhāni ca
śrutaṃ hi tena tadabhūdyathā taṃ rājasattamam
taṃ dadarśa sa nāgendrastakṣakaḥ kāśyapaṃ pathi
kva bhavāṃstvarito yāti kiṃca kāryaṃ cikīrṣati
taṃ daṣṭaṃ pannagendreṇa tenāgnisamatejasam pāṇḍavānāṃ kulakaraṃ rājānamamitaujasam - - oc gacchāmitvaritaṃ saumya sadyaḥ kartumapajvaram
vijñātaviṣavidyo'haṃ brāhmaṇo lokapūjitaḥ asmadgurukaṭākṣeṇa kalyo'haṃ viṣanāśane
ahaṃ sa takṣako brahmaṃstaṃ dhakṣyāmi mahīpatim
nivartasva na śaktastvaṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ cikitsitum
ahaṃ taṃ nṛpatiṃ gatvā tvayā daṣṭamapajvaram
yadi daṣṭaṃ mayeha tvaṃ śaktaḥ kiṃciccikitsitum
tato vṛkṣaṃ mayā daṣṭamimaṃ jīvaya kāśyapa
paraṃ mantrabalaṃ yatte taddarśaya yatasva ca
daśa nāgendra vṛkṣaṃ tvaṃ yadyetadabhimanyase ahamenaṃ tvayā daṣṭaṃ jīvayiṣye bhujaṃgama
paśya mantrabalaṃ me'dya nyagrodhaṃ daśa pannaga
taṃ dagdhvā sa nagaṃ nāgaḥ kāśyapaṃ punarabravīt
palāśinaṃ śākhinaṃ ca tathā viṭapinaṃ punaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jīvitaṃ vṛkṣaṃ kāśyapena mahātmanā
dvijendra yadviṣaṃ hanyā mama vā madvidhasya vā
ghaṭamānasya te vipra siddhiḥ saṃśayitā bhavet
tato yaśaḥ pradīptaṃ te triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam
dhanārthī yāmyahaṃ tatra tanme dehi bhujaṃgama
divyajñānaḥ sa tejasvī jñātvā taṃ nṛpatiṃ tadā
tacca sarvaṃ sa rājendraḥ pratijagrāha vīryavān
kṛtvā teṣāṃ ca kāryāṇi gamyatāmityuvāca tān
vidhinā saṃprayukto vai ṛṣivākyena tena tu
astamabhyeti savitā viṣādadya na me bhayam
takṣako nāma bhūtvā vai tathā parihṛtaṃ bhavet
tasmātphalādviniṣkramya yattadrājñe niveditam veṣṭayitvā ca bhogena vinadya ca mahāsvanam
taṃ tathā mantriṇo dṛṣṭvā bhogena pariveṣṭitam
taṃ tu nāgaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā mantriṇaste pradudruvuḥ
tatastu te tadgṛhamagninā vṛtaṃ pradīpyamānaṃ viṣajena bhoginaḥ
bhayātparityajya diśaḥ prapedire papāta taccāśanitāḍitaṃ yathā
tato nṛpe takṣakatejasāhate prayujya sarvāḥ paralokasatkriyāḥ
śucirdijo rājapurohitastadā tathaiva te tasya nṛpasya mantriṇaḥ
nṛpaṃ śiśuṃ tasya sutaṃ pracakrire sametya sarve puravāsino janāḥ
śaśāsa rājyaṃ kurupuṃgavāgrajo yathā'sya vīraḥ prapitāmahastathā
tatastu rājānamamitratāpanaṃ samīkṣya te tasya nṛpasya mantriṇaḥ
tataḥ sa rājā pradadau vapuṣṭamāṃ kurupravīrāya parīkṣya dharmataḥ
sa cāpi tāṃ prāpya mudā yuto'bhavanna cānyanārīṣu mano dadhe kvacit
saraḥsu phulleṣu vaneṣu caiva prasannacetā vijahāra vīryavān
tathā sa rājanyavaro vijahrivān yathorvaśīṃ prāpya purā purūravāḥ
vapuṣṭamā cāpi varaṃ pativratā pratītarūpā samavāpya bhūpatim
ardhena vāpi nistartumāpadaṃ brūta mā ciram
asti nastāta tapasaḥ phalaṃ pravadatāṃ vara
santānaṃ hi paro dharmaṃ evamāha pitāmahaḥ
lambatāmiha nastāta na jñānaṃ pratibhāti vai
śocate caiva kāruṇyācchṛṇu ye vai vayaṃ dvija
praṇaṣṭaṃ nastapastīvraṃ na hi nastanturasti vai
astitveko'dya nastantuḥ so'pi nāsti yathā tathā
na tasya bhāryā putro vā bāndhavo vā'sti kaścana
sa taṃ taporataṃ mandaṃ śanaiḥ kṣapayate tudan
chinnaḥ kālena so'pyatra gantā vai narakaṃ tataḥ
tapo vā'pyatha cā yajño yaccānyatpāvanaṃ mahat
tatsarvaṃ na samaṃ tāta saṃtatyeti satāṃ matam
sa tāta dṛṣṭvā brūyāstaṃ jaratkāruṃ tapodhana
mama pūrve bhavanto vai pitaraḥ sapitāmahāḥ
putra diṣṭyā'si saṃprāpta imaṃ deśaṃ yadṛcchayā
kimarthaṃ ca tvayā brahmanna kṛto dārasaṅgrahaḥ
na dārānvai kariṣye'hamiti me bhāvitaṃ manaḥ
evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu bhavataḥ śakuntāniva lambataḥ
pratigrahītā tāmasmi na bhareyaṃ ca yāmaham evaṃvidhamahaṃ kuryāṃ niveśaṃ prāpnuyāṃ yadi
evamuktvā tu sa pitṝṃścacāra pṛthivī muniḥ
na ca sma labhate bhāryāṃ vṛddho'yamiti śānaka
uvāca kanyāṃ yācāmi tisro vācaḥ śanairimāḥ
yāni bhūtāni santīha sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
antarhitāni vā yāni tāni śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ
yasya kanyā'sti bhūtasya ye mayeha prakīrtitāḥ
te me kanyāṃ prayacchantu carataḥ sarvatodiśam
mama kanyā sanāmnī yā bhaikṣyavaccoditā bhavet
bhareyaṃ caiva yāṃ nāhaṃ tāṃ me kanyāṃ prayacchata
tataste pannagā ye vai jaratkārau samāhitāḥ
teṣāṃ śrutvā sa nāgendrastāṃ kanyāṃ samalaṅkṛtām
tato nāma sa kanyāyāḥ papraccha bhṛgunandana
vāsukiṃ bharaṇaṃ cāsyā na kuryāmityuvāca ha
sanāmnī tava kanyeyaṃ svasā me tapasānvitā
bhariṣyāmi ca te bhāryāṃ pratīcchemāṃ dvijottama rakṣaṇaṃ ca kariṣye'syāḥ sarvaśaktyā tapodhana
na bhariṣye'hametāṃ vai eṣa me samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
apriyaṃ ca na kartavyaṃ kṛte caināṃ tyajāmyaham
sa tatra samayaṃ cakre bhāryayā saha sattamaḥ
vipriyaṃ me na kartavyaṃ na ca vācyaṃ kadācana
tyajeyaṃ vipriye ca tvāṃ kṛte vāsaṃ ca te gṛhe
śuklapakṣe yathā somo vyavardhata tathaiva saḥ
kiṃ nu me sukṛtaṃ bhūyādbharturutthāpanaṃ na vā
sandhyā pravartate ceyaṃ paścimāyāṃ diśi prabho
samīpe te na vatsyāmi gamiṣyāmi yathāgatam
śaktirasti na vāmoru mayi supte vibhāvasoḥ
astaṃ gantuṃ yathākālamiti me hṛdi vartate
kiṃ punardharmaśīlasya mama vā madvidhasya vā
dharmalopo na te vipra syādityetanmayā kṛtam
na me vāganṛtaṃ prāha gamiṣye'haṃ bhujaṃgame
samayo hyeṣa me pūrvaṃ tvayā saha mithaḥ kṛtaḥ
ito mayi gate bhīru gataḥ sa bhagavāniti
tvaṃ cāpi mayi niṣkrānte na śokaṃ kartumarhasi
dharme sthitāṃ sthito dharme sadā priyahite ratām
pradāne kāraṇaṃ yacca mama tubhyaṃ dvijottama
tadalabdhavatīṃ mandāṃ kiṃ māṃ vakṣyati vāsukiḥ
tvatto hyapatyalābhena jñātīnāṃ me śivaṃ bhavet
uvāca bhaginīṃ dīnāṃ tadā dīnataraḥ svayam
jānāsi bhadre yatkāryaṃ pradāne kāraṇaṃ ca yat
kāmaṃ ca mama na nyāyyaṃ praṣṭuṃ tvāṃ kāryamīdṛśam
ācakṣva bhadre bhartuḥ svaṃ sarvameva viceṣṭitam
uddharasva ca śalyaṃ me ghoraṃ hṛdi cirasthitam
svaireṣvapi na tenāhaṃ smarāmi vitathaṃ vacaḥ
na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ kāryaṃ prati bhujaṃgame
ityuktvā sa hi māṃ bhrātargato bhartā tapodhanaḥ
tasmādvyetu paraṃ duḥkhaṃ tavedaṃ manasi sthitam
etacchrutvā sa nāgendro vāsukiḥ parayā mudā
atha kāle tu sā brahmanprajajñe bhujagasvasā
āsīdyathā sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ kāle mahāyaśāḥ
caritaṃ pārthivendrasya yathā niṣṭhāṃ gataśca saḥ
dharmātmā ca mahātmā ca prajāpālaḥ pitā tava
āsīdihāyathā vṛttaḥ sa mahātmā śṛṇuṣva tat
dveṣṭārastasya naivāsansa ca dveṣṭi na kaṃcana
tatastvaṃ puruṣaśreṣṭha dharmeṇa pratipedivān idaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ kurukulāgatam
nāsminkule jātu babhūva rājā yo na prajānāṃ priyakṛtpriyaśca
viddhvā cānvasarattūrṇaṃ taṃ mṛgaṃ gahane vane
na cāsasāda gahane mṛgaṃ naṣṭaṃ pitā tava
sa taṃ papraccha rājendro muniṃ maunavrate sthitam
na bubodha ca taṃ rājā maunavratadharaṃ munim
sa taṃ krodhasamāviṣṭo dharṣayāmāsa te pitā
na covāca sa medhāvī tamatho sādhvasādhu vā
tasthau tathaiva cākruddhaḥ sarpaṃ skandhena dhārayan
tataḥ sa rājā rājendra skandhe tasya bhujaṃgamam
muneḥ kṣutkṣāma āsajya svapuraṃ prayayau punaḥ
brahmāṇaṃ samupāgamya muniḥ pūjāṃ cakāra ha
sakhyuḥ sakāśātpitaraṃ pitrā te dharṣitaṃ purā
mṛtaṃ sarpaṃ samāsaktaṃ sthāṇubhūtasya tasya tam
śubhācāraṃ śubhakathaṃ susthitaṃ tamalolupam akṣudramanasūyaṃ ca vṛddhaṃ maunavrate sthitam
anāgasi gurau yo me mṛtaṃ sarpavāsṛjat
saptarātrāditaḥ pāpaṃ paśya me tapaso balam
ityuktvā prayayau tatra pitā yatrā'sya so'bhavat
dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ tasmai taṃ śāpaṃ pratyavedayat
sa cāpi muniśārdūlaḥ prerayāmāsa te pituḥ
śapto'si mama putreṇa yatto bhava mahīpate
śrutvā ca tadvaco ghoraṃ pitā te janamejaya
kva bhavāṃstvarito yāti kiṃ ca kāryaṃ cikīrṣati
yatra rājā kuruśreṣṭhaḥ parikṣinnāma vai dvija
takṣakeṇa bhujaṃgena dhakṣyate kila so'dya vai
mayā'bhipannaṃ taṃ cāpi na sarpo dharṣayiṣyati
ahaṃ ta takṣako brahmanpaśya me vīryamadbhutam
na śaktastvaṃ mayā daṣṭaṃ taṃ saṃjīvayituṃ nṛpam
gṛhāṇa matta eva tvaṃ sannivartasva cānagha
sa evamukto nāgena kāśyapo dvipadāṃ varaḥ
taṃ nṛpaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭhaṃ pitaraṃ dhārmikaṃ tava
etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā janamejayaḥ
daṣṭaṃ yadi mayā vipraḥ pārthivaṃ jīvayiṣyati
vicintyaivaṃ kṛtā tena dhruvaṃ tuṣṭirdvijasya vai
ekaṃ tu śrotumicchāmi tadvṛttaṃ nirjane vane
saṃvādaṃ pannagendrasya kāśyapasya ca kastadā śrutavāndṛṣṭavāṃścāpi bhavatsu kathamāgatam
na budhyetāmubhau tau ca nagasthaṃ pannagadvijau
yathā vṛttaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ takṣakasya dvijasya ca etatte kathitaṃ rājanyathādṛṣṭaṃ śrutaṃ ca yat
mantriṇāṃ tu vacaḥ śrutvā sa rājā janamejayaḥ
muhūrtamiva ca dhyātvā niścitya manasā nṛpaḥ
śrutvaitadbhavatāṃ vākyaṃ piturme svargatiṃ prati niściteyaṃ mama matiryā ca tāṃ me nibodhata
śṛṅgiṇaṃ hetumātraṃ yaḥ kṛtvā dagdhvā ca pārthivam
iyaṃ durātmatā tasya kāśyapaṃ yo nyavartayat
yadyāgacchetsa vai vipro nanu jīvetpitā mama
parihīyeta kiṃ tasya yadi jīvetsa pārthivaḥ
yo me hiṃsitavāṃstātaṃ takṣakaḥ sa durātmavān
pratikuryāṃ yathā tasya tadbhavanto bruvantu me
api tatkarma viditaṃ bhavatāṃ yena pannagam
yathā tena pitā mahyaṃ pūrvaṃ dagdho viṣāgninā
iti paurāṇikāḥ prāhurasmākaṃ cāsti sa kratuḥ
evamuktaḥ sa rājarṣirmene dagdhaṃ hi takṣakam
yasmindeśe ca kāle ca māpaneyaṃ pravartitā
brāhmaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kṛtvā nāyaṃ saṃsthāsyate kratuḥ
kṣattāraṃ na hi me kaścidajñātaḥ praviśediti
avaśāni vinaṣṭāni pannagānāṃ tu tatra vai
mattā iva ca mātaṅgā mahākāyā mahābalāḥ
uccāvacāśca bahavo nānāvarṇā viṣolbaṇāḥ ghorāśca parighaprakhyā dandaśūkā mahābalāḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
tamindraḥ prāha suprīto na tavāstīha takṣaka
tasmāttava bhayaṃ nāsti vyetu tenaso jvaraḥ
dahyante'ṅgāni me bhadre na diśaḥ pratibhānti mām
sīdāmīva ca saṃmohāddhūrṇatīva ca me manaḥ
ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāpto yadarthamasi me svasaḥ
āstīkaḥ kila yajñaṃ taṃ vartantaṃ bhujagottame
tadvatse brūhi vatsaṃ svaṃ kumāraṃ vṛddhasaṃmatam
ahaṃ tava pituḥ putra bhrātrā dattā nimittataḥ
kiṃnimittaṃ mama piturdattā tvaṃ mātulena me
tata ācaṣṭa sā tasmai bāndhavānāṃ hitaiṣiṇī
tayā śaptā ruṣitayā sutā yasmānnibodha tat
uccaiḥ śravāḥ so'śvarājo yanmithyā na kṛto mama
bhrātaraṃ cāpi me tasmāttrātumarhasi pāvakāt na moghaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tatsyādyadahaṃ tava dhīmate
pitre dattā vimokṣārthaṃ kathaṃ vā putra manyase
bhava svasthamanā nāga na hi te vidyate bhayam
na me vāganṛtaṃ prāha svaireṣvapi kuto'nyathā
taṃ vai nṛpavaraṃ gatvā dīkṣitaṃ janamejayam
sa saṃbhāvaya nāgendra mayi sarvaṃ mahāmate
na te mayi mano jātu mithyā bhavitumarhati
janamejayasya taṃ yajñaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditaṃ guṇaiḥ
sa prāpya yajñāyatanaṃ variṣṭhaṃ dvijottamaḥ puṇyakṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ
somasya yajño varuṇasya yajñaḥ prajāpateryajña āsītprayāge
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
śakrasya yajñaḥ śatasaṅkhya uktastathāparaṃ tulyasaṅkhyaṃ śataṃ vai
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
yamasya yajño harimedhasaśca yathā yajño rantidevasya rājñaḥ
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
gayasya yajñaḥ śaśabindośca rājño yajñasaltathā vaiśravaṇasya rājñaḥ
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
nṛgasya yajñastvajamīḍhasya cāsīdyathā yajño dāśaratheśca rājñaḥ
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
yajñaḥ śruto divi devasya sūnoryudhiṣṭhirasyājamīḍhasya rājñaḥ
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
kṛṣṇasya yajñaḥ satyavatyāḥ sutasya svayaṃ ca karma pracakāra yatra
tathā yajño'yaṃ tava bhāratāgrya pārikṣita svasti no'stu priyebhyaḥ
ime ca te sūryasamānavarcasaḥ samāsate vṛtrahaṇaḥ kratuṃ yathā
naiṣāṃ jñātuṃ vidyate jñānamadya dattaṃ yebhyo na praṇaśyetkadācit
ṛtviksamo nāsti lokeṣu caiva dvaipāyaneneti viniścitaṃ me
etasya śiṣyā hi kṣitiṃ saṃcaranti sarvartvijaḥ karmasu sveṣu dakṣāḥ
pradakṣimāvartaśikhaḥ pradīpto havyaṃ tavedaṃ hutabhugvaṣṭi devaḥ
naiha tvadanyo vidyate jīvaloke samo nṛpaḥ pālayitā prajānām
dhṛtyā ca te pratīmanāḥ sadāhaṃ tvaṃ vā varuṇo dharmarājo yamo vā
śakraḥ sākṣādvajrapāṇiryatheha trātā loke'smiṃstvaṃ tatheha prajānām
matastvaṃ naḥ puruṣendreha loke na ca tvadanyo bhūpatirasti jajñe
vālmīkivatte nibhṛtaṃ svavīryaṃ vasiṣṭhavatte niyataśca kopaḥ
yamo yathā dharmaviniścayajñaḥ kṛṣṇo yathā sarvaguṇopapannaḥ
śriyāṃ nivāso'si yathā vasūnāṃ nidhānabhūto'si tathā kratūnām
dambhodbhavenāsi samo balena rāmo yathā śastravidastravicca
evaṃ stutāḥ sarva eva prasannā rājā sadasyā ṛtvijo havyavāhaḥ
teṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvitānīṅgitāni provāca rājā janamejayo'tha
bālo'pyayaṃ sthavira ivāvabhāṣate nāyaṃ bālaḥ sthaviro'yaṃ mato me
icchāmyahaṃ varamasmai pradātuṃ tanme viprāḥ saṃvidadhvaṃ yathāvat
bālo'pi vipro mānya eveha rājñā yaścāvidvānyaśca vidvānyathāvat
prasādayainaṃ tvarito narendra dvijātivaryaṃ sakalārthasiddhaye sarvānkāmāṃstvatta evārhate'dya yathā ca nastakṣaka eti śīghram
vyāhartukāme varade nṛpe dvijaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tato'byuvāca
hotā vākyaṃ nātihṛṣṭāntarātmā karmaṇyasmiṃstakṣako naiti tāvat
yathā cedaṃ karma samāpyate me yathā ca vai takṣaka eti śīghram
tathā bhavantaḥ prayatantu sarve paraṃ śaktyā sa hi me vidviṣāṇaḥ
yathā śastrāṇi naḥ prāhuryathā śaṃsati pāvakaḥ
yathā sūto lohitākṣo mahātmā paurāṇiko veditavānpurastāt
purāṇamāgamya tato bravīmyahaṃ dattaṃ tasmai varamindreṇa rājan
vaseha tvaṃ matsakāśe sugupto na pāvakastvāṃ pradahiṣyatīti
etacchrutvā dīkṣitastapyamāna āste hotāraṃ codayankarma kāle
indreṇa sārdhaṃ takṣakaṃ pātayadhvaṃ vibhāvasau na vimucyeta nāgaḥ hotā ca yatto'syājuhāvātha mantrairatho mahendraḥ svayamājagāma
āyātu cendro'pi satakṣakaḥ patedvibhāvasau nāgarājena tūrṇam
jambhasya hanteti juhāva hotā tadā jagāmāhidattābhayaḥ prabhuḥ
balāhakaiścāpyanugamyamāno vidyādharairapsarasāṃ gaṇaiśca nāgasya nāśo mama caiva nāśo bhaviṣyatītyeva vicintayānaḥ
tasyottarīye nihitaḥ sa nāgo bhayodvignaḥ śarma naivābhyagacchat
tato rājā mantravido'bravītpunaḥ kruddho vākyaṃ takṣakasyāntamicchan
indrasya bhavane viprā yadi nāgaḥ sa takṣakaḥ
hotā juhāva tatrasthaṃ takṣakaṃ pannagaṃ tathā
hitvā tu takṣakaṃ trastaḥ svameva bhavanaṃ yayau
indre gate tu rājendra takṣako bhayamohitaḥ mantraśaktyā pāvakārcissamīpamavaśo gataḥ
ayamāyāti tūrṇaṃ sa takṣakaste vaśaṃ nṛpa
nūnaṃ mukto vajrabhṛtā sa nāgo bhraṣṭo nākānmantravitrastakāyaḥ
asmai tu dvijamukhyāya varaṃ tvaṃ dātumarhasi
vṛṇīṣva yatte'bhimataṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ tatte pradāsyāmyapi cedadeyam
tatte dadyāṃ varaṃ vipra na nivartetkraturmama
suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ gāśca na tvāṃ rājanvṛṇomyaham
anyaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te varaṃ dvijvarottama
ayācata na cāpyanyaṃ varaṃ sa bhṛgunandana
tato vedavidastāta sadasyāḥ sarva eva tam
yathāsmṛti tu nāmāni pannagānāṃ nibodha me
koṭiśo mānasaḥ pūrṇaḥ śalaḥ pālo halīmakaḥ
ete vāsukijā nāgāḥ praviṣṭā havyavāhane anye ca bahavo vipra tathā vai kulasaṃbhavāḥ
mudgaraḥ śiśuromā ca suromā ca mahāhanuḥ
aṣṭāvakraḥ komalakaḥ śvasano maunavepagaḥ bhairavo muṇḍavedāṅgaḥ piśaṅgaścodapārakaḥ
eteṣāṃ prasavo yaśca prasavasya ca santatiḥ
na śakyaṃ parisaṃkhyātuṃ ye dīptaṃ pāvakaṃ gatāḥ dviśīrṣāḥ pañcaśīrṣāśca saptaśīrṣāstathā'pare
na sma sa prāpatadvahnau takṣako bhayapīḍitaḥ
kiṃ sūta teṣāṃ viprāṇāṃ mantragrāmo manīṣiṇām
na pratyabhāttadā'gnau yatsa papāta na takṣakaḥ
yathā tiṣṭhati vai kaścitkhaṃ ca gāṃ cāntarā naraḥ
sa yajñaḥ pāṇḍaveyasya rājñaḥ pārikṣitasya ha
nimittaṃ brāhmaṇa iti tasmai vittaṃ dadau bahu
sa gatvā paramaprīto mātulaṃ mātaraṃ ca tām
etacchrutvā prīyamāṇāḥ sametā ye tatrāsanpannagā vītamohāḥ
āstīke vai prītimanto babhūvurūcuścainaṃ varamiṣṭaṃ vṛmīṣva
bhūyobhūyaḥ sarvaśaste'bruvaṃstaṃ kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāmādya vidvan
prītā vayaṃ mokṣitāścaiva sarve kāmaṃ kiṃ te karavāmādya vatsa
sāyaṃ prātarye prasannātmarūpā loke viprā mānavā ye pare'pi
dharmākhyānaṃ ye paṭheyurmamedaṃ teṣāṃ yuṣmannaiva kiṃcidbhayaṃ syāt
taiścāpyukto bhāgineyaḥ prasannairetatsatyaṃ kāmamevaṃ varaṃ te
prītyā yuktāḥ kāmitaṃ sarvaśaste kartāraḥ sma pravaṇā bhāgineya
asitaṃ cārtimantaṃ ca sunīthaṃ cāpi yaḥ smaret
divā vā yadi vā rātrau nāsya sarpabhayaṃ bhavet
yo jaratkāruṇā jāto jaratkārau mahāvaśāḥ āstīkaḥ sarpasatre vaḥ pannagānyo'bhyarakṣata
taṃ smarantaṃ mahābhāgā na māṃ hiṃsitumarhatha
sarpāpasarpa bhadraṃ te gaccha sarpa mahāviṣa
āstīkasya vacaḥ śrutvā yaḥ sarpo na nivartate
saṃprāpya prītiṃ vipulāṃ mahātmā tato mano gamanāyātha dadhre
ityevaṃ nāgarājo'tha nāgānāṃ madhyagastadā uktvā sahaiva taiḥ sarpaiḥ svameva bhavanaṃ yayau
yatkīrtayitvā sarpebhyo na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit
yadvākyaṃ śrutavāṃścāhaṃ tathā ca kathitaṃ mayā
yāḥ kathā vyāsasaṃpannāstāśca bhūyo vicakṣva me
tvatta icchāmahe śrotuṃ saute tvaṃ vai pracakṣva naḥ
yaṃ nāti tapasā kaścinna vedādhyayanena ca
na vratairnopavāsaiśca na prasūtyā na manyunā
vivyāsaikaṃ caturdhā yo vedaṃ vedavidāṃ varaḥ
yaḥ pāṇḍuṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca viduraṃ cāpyajījanat
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca arghyaṃ gāṃ ca vidhānataḥ
bhagavānāpi taṃ dṛṣṭvā kuśalaṃ prativedya ca
tacca yuddhaṃ kathaṃ vṛttaṃ bhūtāntakaraṇaṃ mahat
pitāmahānāṃ sarveṣāṃ daivenāviṣṭacetasām kārtsnyenaitanmamācakṣva yathā vṛttaṃ dvijottama
śṛṇu rājanyathā vīrā bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ virodhamanvagacchanta dhārtarāṣṭrairdurātmabhiḥ
śrotuṃ pātraṃ ca rājaṃstvaṃ prāpyemāṃ bhāratīṃ kathām
mṛte pitari te vīrā vanādetya svamandiram
tato duryodhanaḥ krūraḥ kuliṅgasya mate sthitaḥ
teṣāṃ tu viprakāreṣu teṣu teṣu mahāmatiḥ
tatra tānvāsayāmāsa pāṇḍavānamitaujasaḥ sutapriyaiṣī tānrājā pāṇḍavānambikāsutaḥ
ādīpya jātuṣaṃ veśma dagdhvā caiva purocanam
hatvā ca taṃ rākṣasendraṃ bhītāḥ samavabodhanāt
prāptā hiḍimbā bhīmena yatra jāto ghaṭotkacaḥ
te uktā dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa rājñā śāntanavena ca
evaṃ cakrurimāṃ sarve vaśe kṛtsnāṃ vasundharām
sa vai saṃvatsaraṃ pūrṇaṃ māsaṃ caikaṃ vane vasan
sā śacīva mahendreṇa śrīḥ kṛṣṇeneva saṅgatā
tasyāṃ duryodhano mando lobhaṃ cakre sudurmatiḥ
ajñātamekaṃ rāṣṭre ca tato varṣaṃ trayodaśam
dhṛtarāṣṭre gate svargaṃ vidure pañcatāṃ gate
svaṃ dhāma yāte vārṣṇeye kṛṣṇadārānprarakṣya ca
kathitaṃ vai samāsena tvayā sarvaṃ dvijottama
na hi tṛpyāmi pūrveṣāṃ śṛṇvānaścaritaṃ mahat
na tatkāraṇamalpaṃ vai dharmajñā yatra pāṇḍavāḥ
kimarthaṃ te naravyāghrāḥ śaktāḥ santo hyanāgasaḥ
kathaṃ sā draupadī kṛṣṇā kliśyamānā durātmabhiḥ
kathaṃ vyasaninaṃ dyūte pārthau mādrīsutau tadā
kathaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ suto dharmasya dharmavit
kathaṃ ca bahulāḥ senāḥ pāṇḍavaḥ kṛṣṇasārathiḥ
adhyāyānāṃ sahasre dve parvaṇāṃ śatameva ca ślokānāṃ tu sahasrāṇi navatiśca daśaiva ca
idaṃ hi vedaiḥ samitaṃ pavitramapi cottamam
vīraṃ janayate putraṃ kanyāṃ vā rājyabhāginīm
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca bharatarṣabha yadihāsti tadanyatra yannehāsti na kutracit
śarīreṇa kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vācā ca manasaiva ca
sarvaṃ saṃtyajati kṣipraṃ ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ
dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ svargyaṃ tathaiva ca
ya idaṃ mānavo loke puṇyārthe brāhmaṇāñchucīn
vijñeyaḥ sa ca vedānāṃ pārago bhārataṃ paṭhan
bhagavāṃścāpi deveśo yatra devī ca kīrtyate
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ yatra kīrtyate
śrāvayiṣyanti ye viprā ye ca śroṣyanti mānavāḥ
sarvathā vartamānā vai na te śocyāḥ kṛtākṛtaiḥ
na tāṃ svargagatiṃ prāpya tuṣṭiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
idaṃ hi vedaiḥ samitaṃ pavitramaṣi cottamam
pārikṣita kathāṃ divyāṃ puṇyāya vijayāya ca
pravakṣyāmi pitṝṇāṃ te teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛmu
uśanaso duhitā devayānī vṛṣaparvaṇaśca duhitā śarmiṣṭhā nāma
tatrānuvaṃśo bhavati yaduṃ ca turvasuṃ caiva devayānī vyajāyata
druhyaṃ cānuṃ ca pūruṃ ca śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī
pūrorbhāryā kausalyā babhūva tasyāmasya jajñe janamejayaḥ
śayyātistu triśaṅkorduhitaraṃ varāṅgīṃ nāmopayeme tasyāmasya jajñe'haṃyātiḥ
sārvabhaumastu khalu jitvā''jahāra kaikayīṃ sundarāṃ nāma tāmupayeme
ayutānāyī tu khalu pṛthuśravaso duhitaramupayeme bhāsāṃ nāma
devātithistu khalu vaidarbhīmupayeme maryādāṃ nāma tasyāmasya jajñe ṛcaḥ
duṣyantastu lākṣīṃ nāma bhāgīrathīmupayeme tasyāmasya jajñe janamejayaḥ
tatremau ślokau bhavataḥ mātā bhastrā pituḥ putro yasmājjātaḥ sa eva saḥ
tvaṃ cāsya dhātā garbhasya satyamāha śakuntalā
tato'sya bharatatvam bharatastu khalu kāśeyīṃ sārvasenīmupayeme sunandāṃ nāma
suhotrastu khalvaikṣvākīmupayeme jayantīṃ nāma tasyāmasya jajñe hastī
hastī khalu traigartīmupayeme yaśodāṃ nāma tasyāmasya jajñe vikuñjataḥ
tatra ajamīḍhādṛkṣāyāṃ saṃvaraṇo jajñe sa vaṃśakaraḥ
yamāhuḥ pratīpa iti pratīpastu khalu śaibyāmupayeme sunandīṃ nāma
tasyāṃ trīnputrānutpādayāmāsa devāpiṃ śantanuṃ bāhlīkaṃ ceti
tatra śloko bhavati yaṃ yaṃ karābhyāṃ spṛśati jīrṇaṃ sa sukhamaśnute
punaryuvā ca bhavati tasmāttaṃ śantanuṃ viduḥ
tadasya śantanutvaṃ śantanustu khalu gaṅgāṃ bhāgīrathīmupayeme tasyāmasya jajñe devavrataḥ
bhīṣmastu khalu pituḥ priyacikīrṣayā satyavatīmānayāmāsa mātaraṃ
tasyāmeva śantanordvau putrau babhūvatuḥ citrāṅgado vicitravīryaśca
tataḥ satyavatī cintayāmāsa kathaṃ nu khalu śantanoḥ piṇḍavicchedo na syāditi
sātha dvaipāyanaṃ cintayāmāsa so'grataḥ sthitaḥ kiṃ karavāṇīti
taṃ satyavatyuvāca bhrātā te'napatya eva svargataḥ tasyārthe'patyamutpādayeti
sa paramityuvāca sa tatra trīnputrānutpādayāmāsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ pāṇḍuṃ viduraṃ ceti
dhṛtarāṣṭrātputraśataṃ babhūva gāndhāryāṃ varadānāddvaipāyanasya teṣāṃ ca dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ catvāraḥ pradhānāḥ duryodhano duśśāsano vikarṇaścitrasenaśceti
sa mṛgayāṃ caranmaithunagatamṛṣiṃ mṛgacāriṇaṃ bāṇena jaghāna
yo'kṛtārthaṃ hi māṃ grūra bāṇenāghnā mṛgavratam
sa viṣaṇṇarūpaḥ pāṇḍustaṃ śāpaṃ pariharannopasarpati bhārye
purāṇeṣu paṭhyamānaṃ śṛṇomi nānapatyasya lokāḥ santīti
sā kuntī putrānutpādayāmāsa dharmādyudhiṣṭhiraṃ mārutādbhīmasenamindrādarjunamiti sa hṛṣṭarūpaḥ pāṇḍuruvāca
iyaṃ te sapatnī bhavati mādryanapatyā vrīḍitā sādhvī asyāmapatyamutpādyatāmiti
sā kuntī tasyai mādryai tatheti vratamādideśa
mādrīṃ tu khalu svalaṅkṛtāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍurbhāvaṃ cakre
tataḥ pañcapāṇḍavānsaha kuntyā hāstinapuraṃ nayanti sma tapasvinaḥ
tatra bhīṣmāya dhṛtarāṣṭravidurayoḥ pāṇḍoḥ svargagamanaṃ yāthātathyaṃ nivedayantisma tapasvinaḥ
tato bhīmo hiḍimbaṃ hatvā putramutpādayāmāsa hiḍimbāyāṃ ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma
tataḥ pāñcālaviṣayaṃ gatvā svayaṃvare draupadīṃ labdhvā'rdharājyaṃ prāpyendraprasthanivāsinastasyāṃ putrānutpādayāmāsurdraupadyām
śrutakīrtimarjunaḥ śatānīkaṃ nakulaḥ śrutasenaṃ sahadeva iti
bhīmasenastu vārāṇasyāṃ kāśirājakanyāṃ jalandharāṃ nāmopayeme svayaṃvarasthāṃ
arjunastu khalu dvāravatīṃ gatvā bhagavato vāsudevasya bhaginīṃ subhadrāṃ nāmodavahadbhāryāṃ
sahadevastu khalu mādrīmeva svayaṃvare vijayāṃ nāmodavahadbhāryām
bhīmasenaśca pūrvameva hiḍimbāyāṃ rākṣasyāṃ putramutpādayāmāsa ghaṭotkacaṃ nāma
tato maṇalūrupatikanyāyāṃ citrāṅgadāyāmarjunaḥ putramutpādayāmāsa babhruvāhanaṃ nāma
ṣāṇmāsikaṃ garbhamahaṃ jīvayāmi pādasparśāditi vāsudeva uvāca
ahaṃ jīvayāmi kumāramanantavīryaṃ jāta evāyamajāyata abhimanyoḥ satyena ceyaṃ pṛthivī dhārayatviti vāsudevasya pādasparśātsajīvo'jāyata
janamejayāttu bhavataḥ khalu vapuṣṭamāyāṃ putrau dvau śatānīkaḥ śaṅkukarṇaśca
tvayā hi dharmo vidhṛtaḥ kṛtsnaṃ dhārayate jagat
devānahaṃ pālayitā pālaya tvaṃ hi mānuṣān loke dharmaṃ pālaya tvaṃ nityayuktaḥ samāhitaḥ
vasupūrṇā ca vasudhā vasa cediṣu cedipa
na ca mithyā pralāpo'tra svaireṣvapi kuto'nyathā
na ca pitrā vibhajyante putrā guruhite ratāḥ
yuñjate dhuri no gāśca kṛśānsaṃdhukṣayanti ca
sarve varṇāḥ svadharmasthāḥ sadā cediṣu mānada
yaṣṭiṃ ca vaiṇavīṃ tasmai dadau vṛtraniṣūdanaḥ
prayayau daivataiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāryaṃ divaukasām
tatastu rājā cedīnāmindrābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ indradattaṃ vimānaṃ tadāsthāya prayayau purīm
mārgaśīrṣe mahārāja pūrvapakṣe mahāmakham tataḥprabhṛti cādyāpi yaṣṭeḥ kṣitipasattamaiḥ
ramante nāgarāḥ sarve tathā jānapadaiḥ saha
evaṃ jānapadāḥ sarve cakrurindramahaṃ vasuḥ yathā cedipatiḥ prītaścakārendramahaṃ vasuḥ
etāṃ pūjāṃ mahendrastu dṛṣṭvā vasukṛtāṃ śubhām
āsthāya saha śacyā ca vṛto hyapsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ vasunā rājamukhyena samāgamyābravīdvacaḥ
ye pūjayiṣyanti ca mudā yathā cedipatirnṛpaḥ
evaṃ mahātmanā tena mahendreṇa narādhipa vasuḥ prītyā maghavatā mahārājo'bhisatkṛtaḥ
evaṃ kṛtvā mahendrastu jagāma svaṃ niveśanam
utsavaṃ kārayiṣyanti sadā śakrasya ye narāḥ bhūmiratnādibhirdānaistathā pūjyā bhavanti te
giriṃ kolāhalaṃ taṃ tu padā vasuratāḍayat
tasyāṃ nadyāṃ sa janayanmithunaṃ parvataḥ svayam
cakāra patnīṃ kanyāṃ tu tathā tāṃ girikāṃ nṛpaḥ
vasoḥ patnī tu girikā kāmakālaṃ nyavedayat
vāyunā preryamāṇastu dhūmrāya mudamanvagāt bhāryāṃ cintayamānasya manmathāgniravardhata
tasya retaḥ pracaskanda carato gahane vane
pratijagrāha mithyā me na patedreta ityuta
aṅgulīyena śuklasya rakṣāṃ ca vidadhe nṛpaḥ aśokastabakai raktaiḥ pallavaiścāpyabandhayat
idaṃ mithyā pariskannaṃ reto me na bhavediti
ṛtuśca tasyāḥ patnyā me na moghaḥ syāditi prabhuḥ
saṃcintyaivaṃ tadā rājā vicārya ca punaḥpunaḥ
matpriyārthamidaṃ saumya śukraṃ mama gṛhaṃ naya
māse ca daśame prāpte tadā bharatasattama
saṃtyajya matsyarūpaṃ sā divyaṃ rūpamavāpya ca
sā kanyā duhitā tasyā matsyā matsyasagandhinī
rājñā dattā ca dāśāya kanyeyaṃ te bhavatviti
śuśrūṣārthaṃ piturnāvaṃ vāhayantīṃ jale ca tām
dṛṣṭvaiva sa ca tāṃ dhīmāṃścakame cāruhāsinīm
divyāṃ tāṃ vāsavīṃ kanyāṃ rambhorūṃ munipuṅgavaḥ
saṃbhavaṃ cintayitvā tāṃ jñātvā provāca śaktijaḥ
kva karṇadhāro nauryena nīyate brūhi bhāmini
śobhanaṃ vāsavi śubhe kiṃ cirāyasi vāhyatām
divyajñānena dṛṣṭaṃ hi dṛṣṭamātreṇa te vapuḥ
teṣāṃ tvaṃ mānasī kanyā acchodā nāma viśrutā
sā tvanyaṃ pitaraṃ vavre svānatikramya tānpitṝn
nāmnā vasuriti khyātaṃ manuputraṃ divi sthitam
tairuktā sā tu mābhaiṣīstena sā saṃsthitā divi
sadyaḥ phalanti karmāṇi devatve pretya mānuṣe
tasmāttvaṃ patase putri pretyatvaṃ prāpsyase phalam
pitṛhīnā tu kanyā tvaṃ vasorhi tvaṃ sutā matā
jyeṣṭhaṃ citrāṅgadaṃ vīraṃ citravīraṃ ca viśrutam
evamuktā purā taistvaṃ jātā satyavatī śubhā
tasyāṃ jātāsi sā kanyā rājño vīryeṇa caivahi
tasmādvāsavi bhadraṃ te yāce vaṃśakaraṃ sutam
yena deśaḥ sa sarvastu tamobhūta ivābhavat
dṛṣṭvā sṛṣṭaṃ tu nīhāraṃ tatastaṃ paramarṣiṇā
kanyātve dūṣite vāpi kathaṃ śakṣye dvijottama
uvāca matpriyaṃ kṛtvā kanyaiva tvaṃ bhaviṣyati
vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ bhīruṃ yaṃ tvamicchasi bhāmini
vṛthā hi na prasādo me bhūtapūrvaḥ śucismite
parāśareṇa saṃyuktā sadyo garbhaṃ suṣāva sā
jajñe ca yamunādvīpe pārāśaryaḥ sa vīryavān
pādāpasāriṇaṃ dharmaṃ sa tu vidvānyuge yuge
sumantuṃ jaiminiṃ pailaṃ śukaṃ caiva svamātmajam

prabhurvariṣṭho varado vaiśaṃpāyanameva ca saṃhitāstaiḥ pṛthaktvena bhāratasya prakāśitāḥ - aa [tato ramye vanoddeśe divyāstaraṇasaṃyute - ab vīrāsanamupāsthāya yogī dhyānaparo'bhavat - aa śvetapaṭṭagṛhe ramye paryaṅke sottaracchade - ab tūṣṇīṃbhūtāṃ tadā kanyāṃ jvalantīṃ yogatejasā - aa dṛṣṭvā tāṃ tu samādhāya vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ - ab sa cintayāmāsa muniḥ kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet - aa śiṣṭānāṃ tu samācāraḥ śiṣṭācāra iti smṛtaḥ - ab śrutismṛtivido viprā dharmajñā jñāninaḥ smṛtāḥ - aa dharmajñairvihito dharmaḥ śrautaḥ smārto dvidhā dvijaiḥ - ab dānāgnihotramijyā ca śrautasyaitaddhi lakṣaṇam - aa smārto varṇāśramācāro yamaiśca niyamairyutaḥ - ab dharme tu dhāraṇe dhātuḥ sahatve cāpi paṭhyate - aa tatreṣṭaphalabhāgdharma ācāryairupadiśyate - ab aniṣṭaphalabhākreti tairadharmo'pi bhāṣyate - aa tasmādiṣṭaphalārthāya dharmameva samāśrayet - ab brāhmo daivastathaivārṣaḥ prājāpatyaśca dhārmikaḥ - aa vivāhā brāhmaṇānāṃ tu gāndharvo naiva dhārmikaḥ - ab trivarṇetarajātīnāṃ gāndharvāsurarākṣasāḥ - aa paiśāco naiva kartavyaḥ paiśācaścāṣṭamo'dhamaḥ - ab sāmarṣāṃ vyaṅgikāṃ kanyāṃ mātuśca kulajāṃ tathā - aa vṛddhāṃ pravrājitāṃ vandhyāṃ patitāṃ ca rajasvalām - ab apasmārakule jātāṃ piṅgalāṃkuṣṭhinīṃ vraṇīm - aa na cāsnātāṃ striyaṃ gacchediti dharmānuśāsanam - ab pitā pitāmaho bhrātā mātā mātula eva ca - aa upādhyāyartvijaścaiva kanyādāne prabhūttamāḥ - ab etairdattāṃ niṣeveta nādattāmādadīta ca - aa ityeva ṛṣayaḥ prāhurvivāhe dharmavittamāḥ - ab asyā nāsti pitā bhrātā mātā mātula eva ca - aa gāndharveṇa vivāhena na spṛśāmi yadṛcchayā - ab kriyāhīnaṃ tu gāndharvaṃ na kartavyamanāpadi - aa yadasyāṃ jāyate putro vedavyāso bhavedṛṣiḥ - ab kriyāhīnaḥ kathaṃ vipro bhavedṛṣirudāradhīḥ - aḷ vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca - aa evaṃ cintayato bhāvaṃ maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ -
