priyaṃ ca me syādyadi tatra kaścidvrajecchamārthaṃ kurupāṇḍavānām
sa bhīṣmamāmantrya kurupravīraṃ vaicitravīryaṃ ca mahānubhāvam
droṇaṃ saputraṃ viduraṃ kṛpaṃ ca gāndhārarājaṃ ca samūtaputram
save ca ye'nye dhṛtarāṣṭraputrā balapradhānā nigamapradhānāḥ
sthitāśca dharmeṣu yathā svakeṣu lokapravīrāḥ śrutaśīlavṛddhāḥ
eteṣu sarveṣu samāgateṣu paureṣu vṛddheṣu ca saṃgateṣu
bravītu vākyaṃ praṇipātayuktaṃ kuntīsutasyārthakaraṃ yathā syāt
sarvāsvavasthāsu ca te na kopyā grasto hi so'rtho balamāśritaistaiḥ
priyābhyupetasya yudhiṣṭhirasya dyūte prasaktasya hṛtaṃ ca rājyam
sa dīvyamānaḥ pratidīvya cainaṃ gāndhārarājasya sutaṃ matākṣam
hitvā hi karṇaṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca samāhvayaddevitumājamīḍhaḥ
sa dīvyamānaḥ pratidevanena akṣeṣu nityaṃ svaparāṅbhukheṣu
saṃrambhamāṇo vijitaḥ prasahya tatrāparādhaḥ śakunerna kaścit
tathā hi śakyo dhṛtarāṣṭraputraḥ svārtheṃ niyoktuṃ puruṣeṇa tena
sāmnā jito'rtho'rthakaro bhaveta yuddhe'nayo bhavitā neha so'rthaḥ
taccāpi vākyaṃ parinindya tasya samādade vākyamidaṃ samunyuḥ
santi vai puruṣāḥ śūrāḥ santi kāpuruṣāstathā
ye tu śṛṇvanti te vākyaṃ tānasūyāmi mādhava
samāhūya mahātmānaṃ jitavanto'kṣakovidāḥ anakṣajñaṃ yathā'śraddhaṃ teṣu dharmajayaḥ kutaḥ
yadi kuntīsutaṃ gehe krīḍantaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
nikṛtyā jitavantaste kiṃ nu teṣāṃ paraṃ śubham
kathaṃ ca dharmayuktāste na ca rājyaṃ jihīrṣavaḥ
anunītā hi bhīṣmeṇa droṇena vidureṇa ca
na vyavasyanti pāṇḍūnāṃ pradātuṃ paitṛkaṃ vasu
atha te na vyavasyanti praṇipātāya dhīmataḥ
na hi te yuyudhānasya saṃrabdhasya yuyutsataḥ
ko hi gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṃ kaśca cakrāyudhaṃ yudhi
māṃ cāpi viṣahetkruddhaṃ kaśca bhīmaṃ durāsadam
te vayaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putraṃ śakuninā saha
dhārtarāṣṭro hyayuddhena na rājyaṃ dātumicchati adya pāṇḍusuto rājyaṃ labhatāṃ vā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
nihatā vā raṇe sarve svapsyanti vasudhātale
na hi duryodhano rājyaṃ madhureṇa pradāsyati
baladevasya vākyaṃ tu mama jñāne na yujyate
na tu vācyo mṛduvaco dhārtarāṣṭraḥ kathaṃcana
kekayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dūtā gacchantu śīghragāḥ
sa ca duryodhano nūnaṃ preṣayiṣyati sarvaśaḥ
mahaddhi kāryaṃ voḍhavyamiti me vartate matiḥ
śalyasya preṣyatāṃ śīghraṃ ye ca tasyānugā nṛpāḥ
kāmbhojā ṛṣikā ye ca paścimānūpakāśca ye
samudraseno rājā ca saha putreṇa vīryavān
yathā duryodhano vācyo yathā sāntanavo nṛpaḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭro yathā vācyo droṇaśca rathināṃ varaḥ
yatheṣṭaṃ vartamāneṣu pāṇḍaveṣu ca teṣu ca
te vivāhārthamānītā vayaṃ sarve tathā bhavān
bhavānvṛddhatamo rājñāṃ vayasā ca śrutena ca
śiṣyavatte vayaṃ sarve bhavāmeha na saṃśayaḥ
ācāryayoḥ sakhā cāsi droṇasya ca kṛpasva ca
cālayantīva gāṃ devīṃ saparvatavanāmimām tataḥ prajñāvayovṛddhaṃ pāñcālyaḥ svapurohitam
sa bhavānkṛbuddhīnāṃ pradhāna iti me matiḥ kulena ca viśiṣṭo'si vayasā ca śrutena ca
viditaṃ cāpi te sarvaṃ yathāvṛttaḥ sa kauravaḥ
te tathā vañcayitvā tu dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
na kasyāṃcidavasthāyāṃ rājyaṃ dāsyanti vai svayam
amātyeṣu ca bhinneṣu yodheṣu vimukheṣu ca
bhidyamāneṣu ca sveṣu lambamāne tathā tvayi
na tathā te kariṣyanti senākarma na saṃśayaḥ
na ca tebhyo bhayaṃ te'sti brāhmaṇo hyasi vedavit
gate dvāravatīṃ kṛṣṇa baladeve ca mādhave
sa tayoḥ svāgataṃ kṛtvā yathāvatpratipūjya tau
samaṃ hi bhavataḥ sakhyaṃ mama caivārjune'pi ca
ahaṃ cābhigataṃ santo bhajante pūrvasāriṇaḥ tvaṃ ca śreṣṭhatamo loke satāmadya janārdana
pravāraṇaṃ tu bālānāṃ pūrvaṃ kāryamiti śrutiḥ
te vā yudhi durādharṣā bhavantvekasya sainikāḥ
etadviditvā kaunteya vicārya ca punaḥ punaḥ tānvā varaya sāhāyye māṃ sācivye'thavā punaḥ
sahasrāṇāṃ mahasraṃ tu yodhānāṃ prāpya bhārata
kṛṣṇaṃ cāpahṛtaṃ jñātvā saṃprāpa paramāṃ mudam
tato'bhyayādbhīmabalo rauhiṇeyaṃ mahābalam sarvaṃ cāgamane hetuṃ sa tasmai saṃnyavedayat
na ca tadvākyamuktaṃ vai keśavaṃ pratyapadyata
na cāhamutsahe kṛṣṇaṃ vinā sthātumapi kṣaṇam
nāhaṃ sahāyaḥ pārthasya nāpi duryodhanasya vai
sārathyaṃ tu tvayā kāryamiti me mānasaṃ sadā
sārathyaṃ te kariṣyāmi kāmaḥ saṃpadyatāṃ tava
śalyaḥ śrutvā tu dūtānāṃ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ
tathā hi vipulāṃ senāṃ bibharti sa nararṣabhaḥ
tatra mālyāni māṃsāni bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ ca satkṛtam
kūpāśca vividhākārā audakāni gṛhāṇi ca sa tāḥ sabhāḥ samāsādya pūjyamāno yathā'maraḥ
duryodhanasya sacivairdeśe deśe samantataḥ ājagāma sabhāmanyāṃ devāvasathavarcasam
sa tatra viṣayairyuktaiḥ kalyāṇairatimānuṣaiḥ mene'bhyadhikamātmānamavamene purandaram
papraccha sa tataḥ preṣyānprahṛṣṭaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhaḥ yudhiṣṭhirasya puruṣāḥ ke'tra cakruḥ sabhā imāḥ
ānīyantāṃ sabhākārāḥ pradeyārhā hi me matāḥ pradeyameṣāṃ dāsyāmi kuntīputro'numanyatām - - a tataḥ prahṛṣṭaṃ rājānaṃ jñātvā te sacivāstadā duryodhanāya tatsarvaṃ kathayanti sma vismitāḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā madrarājaśca jñātvā yatnaṃ ca tasya tam
satyavāgbhava kalyāṇa varo vai mama dīyatām
anumānyaṃ ca pālyaṃ ca bhaktaṃ ca bhaja māṃ vibho
tvayyadhīnāḥ sma rājendra varadānaṃ smarasva naḥ
kṣiprameṣyāmi bhadraṃ te gacchasva svapuraṃ nṛpa
śalyo jagāma kaunteyānākhyātuṃ karma tasya tat
upaplāvyaṃ sa gatvā tu skandhāvāraṃ praviśya ca
tathā bhīmārjunau hṛṣṭau svastrīyau ca yamāvubhau
draupadī ca subhadrā ca abhimanyuśca bhārata
pādyamarghyaṃ ca gāṃ caiva pratigrāhya purodhasā
duṣkaraṃ te kṛtaṃ rājannirjane gahane vane
ajñātavāsaṃ ghoraṃ ca vasatā duṣkaraṃ kṛtam
satye tapasi dāne ca tava buddhiryudhiṣṭhira
kṣamā damaścāhiṃsā ca satyaṃ caiva yudhiṣṭhira
sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ tāta viditaṃ te parantapa
tacca śuśrūṣitaṃ sarvaṃ varadānaṃ ca bhārata
ekaṃ tvicchāmi bhadraṃ te kriyamāṇaṃ mahīpate
mama tvavekṣayā vīra śṛṇu vijñāpayāmi te
karṇasya bhavatā kāryaṃ sārathyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
tatra pālyo'rjuno rājanyadi matpriyamicchasi tejovadhaśca te kāryaḥ sauterasmañjayāvahnaḥ
śrṛṇu pāṇḍava bhadraṃ te yadbravīṣi mahātmanaḥ
vāsudevena hi samaṃ nityaṃ māṃ so'bhimanyato
yacca duḥkhaṃ tvayā prāptaṃ dyūte vai kṛṣṇayā saha
ekena ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ pibanniva nirīkṣate
sa tapasvī mudurdānto dharme tapasi codyataḥ
kathaṃ sajjecca bhogeṣu na ca tapyenmahattapaḥ
yathā sa sajjetriśirāḥ kāmabhogeṣu vai bhṛśam
pralobhayata bhadraṃ vaḥ śamayadhvaṃ bhayaṃ mama
tathā yatnaṃ kariṣyāmaḥ śakra tasya pralobhane
taṃ praloyituṃ deva gacchāmaḥ sahitā vayam
yatiṣyāmo vaśe kartuṃ vyapanetuṃ ca te bhayam
tāstu yatnaṃ paraṃ kṛtvā punaḥ śakramupasthitāḥ
na sa śakyaḥ sudurdharṣo dhairyāccālayituṃ prabho
śāstrabuddhyā viniścitya kṛtvā buddhiṃ vadhe dṛḍhām
na śarma lebhe devendro dīpitatastasya tejasā
hato'pi dīptatejāḥ sa jīvanniva hi dṛśyate
śirāṃsi tasyājāyanta trīṇyeva śakunāstrayaḥ tittiriḥ kalaviṅkaśca tathaiva ca kapiñjalaḥ
kṣipraṃ chindhi śirāṃsyasya kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama
kartuṃ cāhaṃ na śakṣyāmi karma rādbhirvigarhitam
mā bhaistvaṃ śīghrametadvai kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama
mayā hi nihataḥ śete triśirāstvaṃ ca vidvi vai
kṣipraṃ chindhi śirāṃsi tvaṃ kariṣye'nugrahaṃ tava
śiraḥ paśoste dāsyanti bhāgaṃ yajñeṣu mānavāḥ
yena vedānadhīte sma pibate somameva ca
tatasteṣu nikṛtteṣu vijvaro maghavānatha takṣṇe tathā varaṃ dattvā prahṛṣṭastridaśeśvaraḥ
takṣāpi svagṛhaṃ gatvā naiva śaṃsati kasyacit
atha saṃvatsare pūrṇe bhūtāḥ paśupateḥ prabho tamākrośanta maghavānnaḥ prabhurbrahmahā iti
samudreṣu pṛthivyāṃ ca vanaspatiṣu strīṣu ca
varadastu varaṃ dattvā pṛthivyai sāgarāya ca
tvaṣṭā prajāpatiḥ śrutvā śakreṇātha hataṃ sutam
tapyamānaṃ tapo nityaṃ kṣāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam
tasmācchakravināśāya vṛtramutpādayāmyaham lokāḥ paśyantu me vīryaṃ tapasaśca balaṃ maham
sa ca paśyatu devendro durātmā pāpacetanaḥ
agnau hutvā samutpādya ghoraṃ vṛtramuvāca ha
śakraṃ jahīti cāpyukto jagāma tridivaṃ tataḥ
tato jagrāha devendraṃ vṛtro vīraḥ śatakratum
jahṛṣuśca surāḥ sarve śakraṃ dṛṣṭvā viniḥsṛtam
yadā vyavardhata raṇe vṛtro balasamanvitaḥ tvaṣṭustejobalāviddhastadā śakro nyavartata
amantrayanta te sarve munibhiḥ saha bhārata
kathaṃ nu kāryaṃ bhadraṃ vo durdharṣaḥ sa hi me mataḥ
tejasvī ca mahātmā ca yuddhe cāmitavikramaḥ
amṛtaṃ cāhṛtaṃ viṣṇo daityāśca nihatā raṇe
baliṃ baddhvā mahādaityaṃ śakro devādhipaḥ kṛtaḥ
tvaṃ prabhuḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvayā sarvamidaṃ tatam
sāma tasya prayuñjadhvaṃ tata enaṃ vijeṣyatha
bhaviṣyati jayo devāḥ śakrasya mama tejasā
vṛtrasya saha śakreṇa sandhiṃ kuruta māciram
yayuḥ sametya sahitāḥ śakraṃ kṛtvā puraḥsaram
samīpametya ca yadā sarva eva mahaujasaḥ
taṃ tejasā prajvalitaṃ pratapantaṃ diśo daśa
dadṛśuste tato vṛtraṃ śakreṇa saha devatāḥ
vyāptaṃ jagadidaṃ sarvaṃ tejasā tava durjaya
na ca śaknoṣi nirjeṣuṃ vāsavaṃ balināṃ vara
sakhyaṃ bhavatu te vṛtra śakreṇa saha nityadā
avāpsyasi sukhaṃ tvaṃ ca śakralokāṃśca śāśvatān
yadbrūtha tacchrutaṃ sarvaṃ mamāpi śrṛṇutānaghāḥ sandhiḥ kathaṃ vai bhavitā mama śakrasya cobhayoḥ
tejasorhi dvayordevāḥ sakhyaṃ vai bhavitā katham
sakṛtsatāṃ saṅgatamīpsitavyaṃ tataḥ paraṃ bhavitā bhavyameva
dṛḍhaṃ satāṃ saṅgataṃ cāpi nityaṃ brūyāccārthaṃ hyarthakṛcchreṣu dhīrāḥ
mahārthavatsatpuruṣeṇa saṅgataṃ tasmātsantaṃ na jighāṃseta dhīraḥ
tena te saha śakreṇa sandhirbhavatu nityadā
na śuṣkeṇa na cādreṇa nāśmanā na ca dāruṇā
na śastreṇa na cāstreṇa na divā na tathā niśi
vadhyo bhaveyaṃ viprendrāḥ śakrasya saha daivataiḥ
evaṃ me rocate sandhiḥ śakreṇa saha nityadā
evaṃ vṛtte tu sandhāne vṛtraḥ pramudito'bhavat
tataḥ sandhiṃ mithaḥ kṛtvā ṛṣayo dīptatejasaḥ
yuktaḥ sadā'bhavaccāpi śakro harṣasamanvitaḥ vṛtrasya vadhasaṃyuktānupāyānanvacintayat - - a abhisandhirmahendrasya sandhikarmaṇi yaḥ kṛtaḥ ṛṣibhistvīritaṃ yacca mahendrastadanusmaran
sandhyeyaṃ vartate raudrā na rātrirdivasaṃ na ca
yadi vṛtraṃ na hanmyadya vañcayitvā mahāsuram
mahābalaṃ mahākāyaṃ na me śreyo bhaviṣyati
nāyaṃ yuṣko na cādro'yaṃ na ca śastramidaṃ tathā
savajramatha phenaṃ taṃ kṣipraṃ vṛtre nisṛṣṭavān
praviśya phenaṃ taṃ viṣṇuratha vṛtraṃ vyanāśayat
nihate tu tato vṛtre diśo vitimirā'bhavan
pravavau ca śivo vāyuḥ prajāśca jahṛṣustathā
hatvā śatruṃ prahṛṣṭātmā vāsavaḥ saha daivataiḥ
tato bhītā'bhavandevāḥ ko no rājā bhavediti
na sma kaścana devānāṃ rājye vai kurute matim
tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca dhārmikaścaiva nityadā
te gatvā tvabruvansarve rājā no bhava pārthiva
asmākaṃ tapasā yuktaḥ pāhi rājyaṃ triviṣṭape
abhiṣiktaḥ sa rājendra tato rājā triviṣṭape
sudurlabhaṃ varaṃ labdhvā prāpya rājyaṃ triviṣṭape
sahye mahendre malaye samudreṣu saritsu ca
vāditrāṇi ca sarvāṇi gītaṃ ca madhurasvanam
saṃprāptā darśanaṃ devī śakrasya mahiṣī priyā
sa tāṃ saṃdṛśya duṣṭātmā prāha sarvānsabhāsadaḥ
uktavānasi māṃ pūrvamṛtāṃ tāṃ kuru vai giram
yaduktāsi mayā devi satyaṃ tadbhavitā dhruvam
atha śuśrāva nahuṣa indrāṇīṃ śaraṇīṃ gatām
kruddhaṃ tu nahuṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā devā ṛṣipurogamāḥ
devarāja jahi krodhaṃ tvayi kruddhe jagadvibho
jahi krodhamimaṃ sādho na kupyanti bhavadvidhāḥ
parasya patnī sā devī prasīdasva sureśvara
devarājo'si bhadraṃ te prajā dharmeṇa pālaya
jīvato bharturindreṇa sa vaḥ kiṃ na nivāritaḥ
bahūni ca nṛśaṃsāni kṛtānīndreṇa vai purā
vaidharmyāṇyupadhāścaiva sa vaḥ kiṃ na nivāritaḥ
yuṣmākaṃ ca sadā devāḥ śivamevaṃ bhaviṣyati
jahi krodhamimaṃ vīra prīto bhava sureśvara
ityuktvā taṃ tadā devā ṛṣibhiḥ saha bhārata
te tvāṃ devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaśca mahādyute
evamukte tu sā devī bāṣpamutsṛjya sasvanam
na tasya bījaṃ rohati rohakāle na tasya varṣaṃ varṣati varṣakāle
bhītaṃ prapannaṃ pradadāti śatrave na sa trātāraṃ labhate trāṇamicchan
bhītaṃ prapannaṃ pradadāti yo vai na tasya havyaṃ pratigṛhṇanti devāḥ
pramīyate cāsya prajā hyakāle sadā vivāsaṃ pitaro'sya kurvate
bhītaṃ prapannaṃ pradadāti śatrave sendrā devāḥ praharantyasya vajram
indrāṇīṃ viśrutāṃ loke śakrasya mahiṣīṃ priyāṃ
asyā hitaṃ bhavedyacca mama cāpi hitaṃ bhavet
bahuvighnaḥ surāḥ kālaḥ kālaḥ kālaṃ nayiṣyati
ekapatnyasi satyā ca gacchasva nahuṣaṃ prati
evamuktā tu sā devī nahuṣeṇa pativratā
praṇamya sā hi brahmāṇaṃ śirasā tu kṛtāñjaliḥ
na hi vijñāyate śakraḥ kiṃ vā prāptaḥ kva vā gataḥ
tattvametattu vijñāya yadi na jñāyate prabho
evaṃ bhavatu suśroṇi yathā māmiha bhāṣase
nahuṣeṇa visṛṣṭā ca niścakrāma tataḥ śubhā
gatiśca nastvaṃ deveśa pūrvajo jagataḥ prabhuḥ
kiṃcitkālamidaṃ devā marṣayadhvamatandritāḥ śrutvā viṣṇoḥ śubhāṃ satyāṃ vāṇīṃ tāmamṛtopamām
vibhajya brahmahatyāṃ tu vṛkṣeṣu ca nadīṣu ca
parvateṣu pṛthivyāṃ ca strīṣu caiva yudhiṣṭhira
saṃvibhajya ca bhūteṣu visṛjya ca sureśvaraḥ
pranaṣṭe tu tataḥ śakre śacī śokasamanvitā
hā śakreti tadā devī vilalāpa suduḥkhitā
yadi dattaṃ yadi hutaṃ guravastoṣitā yadi
devīṃ rātriṃ namasyāmi sidhyatāṃ me manorathaḥ
prayatā ca niśāṃ devīmupātiṣṭhata tatra sā
yatrāste devarājo'sau taṃ deśaṃ darśayasva me
icchāmi tvāmahaṃ jñātuṃ kā tvaṃ brūhi varānane
darśanaṃ caiva saṃprāptā tava satyena bhāmini
pativratā ca yuktā ca yamena niyamena ca
sarasastasya madhye tu padminī mahatī śubhā
padmasya bhittvā nālaṃ ca viveśa sahitā tayā
taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca susūkṣmeṇa rūpeṇāvasthitaṃ prabhum
upatiṣṭheti sa krūraḥ kālaṃ ca kṛtavānmama
yadi na trāsyasi vibho kariṣyati sa māṃ vaśe
etena cāhaṃ saṃprāptā drutaṃ śakra tavāntikam
tejaḥ samāpnuhi vibho devarājyaṃ praśādhi ca
guhyaṃ caitattvayā kāryaṃ nākhyātavyaṃ śubhe kvacit
evaṃ tava vaśe prītā bhaviṣyāmīti taṃ vada
svāgataṃ te varārohe kiṃ karomi śucismite
bhaktaṃ māṃ bhaja kalyāṇi kimicchasi manasvini
na ca vrīḍā tvayā kāryā suśroṇi mayi viśvaseḥ
satyena vai paśe devi kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
vākyaṃ praṇayasaṃyuktaṃ tataḥ syāṃ vaśagā tava
yanna viṣṇorna rudrasya na surāṇāṃ na rakṣasām
vahantu tvāṃ mahābhāgā ṛṣayaḥ saṅgatā vibho
sarveṣāṃ teja ādatse svena vīryeṇa darśanāt
na te pramukhataḥ sthātuṃ kaścicchaknoti vīryavān
dṛḍhaṃ me ruciraṃ devi tvadvaśo'smi varānane
na hyalpavīryo bhavati yo vāhānkurute munīn
mayi kruddhe jaganna syānmayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
na me kruddhasya paryāptāḥ sarve lokāḥ śucismite
cakṣuṣā yaṃ prapaśyāmi tasya tejo harāmyaham
ahamindro'smi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca maheśvaraḥ mayi havyaṃ ca kavyaṃ ca lokāścaiva sanātanāḥ
tasmātte vacanaṃ devi kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
paśya māhātmyayogaṃ me ṛddhiṃ ca varavarṇini
evamuktvā tu tāṃ devīṃ visṛjya ca varānanām - - b atha saṃcintya nahuṣo balavīryeṇa bhārata
haṃsayuktaṃ vimānaṃ ca hariyuktaṃ tathā ratham
sa tu darpeṇa mahatā paribhūya mahāmunīn vimāne yojayitvā ca ṛṣīnniyamāmāsthitān
śakraṃ mṛgaya śīghraṃ tvaṃ bhaktāyāḥ kuru me dayām
na hyeṣa sthāsyati ciraṃ gata eṣa narādhamaḥ
sa diśaḥ pradiśaścaiva parvatāṃśca vanāni ca pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca vicityātha manogatiḥ
āpaḥ śeṣāḥ sadā cāpaḥ praveṣṭuṃ notsahāmyaham
nāpaḥ praveṣṭuṃ śakṣyāmi kṣayo me'tra bhaviṣyati
śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapanno'smi svasti testu mahādyute
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati
kṛtvā tubhyaṃ namo viprāḥ svakarmavijitāṃ gatim
gacchanti saha patnībhiḥ sutairapi ca śāśvatīm
sṛṣṭvā lokāṃstrīmimānhavyavāha prāpte kāle pacasi punaḥ samiddhaḥ
tvaṃ sarvasya bhuvanasya prasūtistvamevāgre bhavasi punaḥ pratiṣṭhā
evaṃ stuto havyavāṭ sa bhagavānkaviruttamaḥ bṛhaspatimathovāca prītimānvākyamuttamam
mahendra dānavānhatvā lokāstrātāstvayā vibho apāṃ phenaṃ samāsādya viṣṇutejotibṛṃhitam
tvayā vṛtro hataḥ pūrvaṃ devarāja jagatpate
tvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu śaraṇya īḍyastvayā samaṃ vidyate neha bhūtam
tvayā dhāryante sarvabhūtāni śakra tvaṃ devānāṃ mahimānaṃ cakartha
svaṃ caiva vapurāsthāya babhūva sa balānvitaḥ
kathaṃ ca nahuṣo rājyaṃ devānāṃ prāpa durlabham tapasā kena vā yuktaḥ kiṃvīryo vā bṛhaspate
tvayi pranaṣṭe deveśa viśvaṃ pravyathitaṃ jagat
devā bhītāḥ śakramakāmayanta tvayā tyaktaṃ mahadaindraṃ padaṃ tat
tadā devāḥ pitaro'tharṣayaśca gandharvamukhyāśca sametya sarve
gatvā'bruvannahuṣaṃ tatra śakra tvaṃ no rājā bhava bhuvanasya goptā
tānabravīnnahuṣo nāsmi śakta āpyāyadhvaṃ tapasā tejasā mām
trailokye ca prāpya rājyaṃ maharṣīnkṛtvā vāhānyāti lokāndurātmā
tejoharaṃ dṛṣṭiviṣaṃ sughoraṃ mā tvaṃ paśyernahuṣaṃ vai kadācit
devāśca sarve nahuṣaṃ bhṛśārtā na paśyante gūḍharūpāścarantaḥ
evaṃ vadatyaṅgirasāṃ variṣṭhe bṛhaspatau lokapālaḥ kuberaḥ
vaivasvataścaiva yamaḥ purāṇo daveśca somo varuṇaścājagāma
te vai samāgamya mahendramūcurdiṣṭyā tvāṣṭro nihataścaiva vṛtraḥ
diṣṭyā ca tvāṃ kuśalinamakṣataṃ ca paśyāmo vai nihatāriṃ ca śakra
sa tānyathāvacca hi lokapālānsametsa vai prītamanā mahendraḥ
rājā devānāṃ nahuṣo ghorarūpastatra sāhyaṃ dīyatāṃ me bhavadbhiḥ
te cābruvannahuṣo ghorarūpo dṛṣṭīviṣastasya bibhīma īśa
tvaṃ cedrājānaṃ nahuṣaṃ parājayestato vayaṃ bhāgamarhāma śakra
saṃprāpnuvantvadya sahaiva daivatai ripuṃ jayāma taṃ nahuṣaṃ ghoradṛṣṭim
tataḥ śakraṃ jvalano'pyāha bhāga prayaccha mahyaṃ tava sāhyaṃ kariṣye tamāha śakro bhavitā'gne tavāpi cendrāgnyorvai bhāga eko mahākratau
kuberaṃ sarvayakṣāṇāṃ dhanānāṃ ca prabhuṃ tathā
vaivasvataṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca varuṇaṃ cāpyapāṃ tathā
so'bravīdarcya devendraṃ diṣṭyā vai vardhate bhavān
pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca gāmarghyaṃ ca pratīccha me
śrṛṇu śakra priyaṃ vākyaṃ yathā rājā durātmavān
ya ime brahmaṇā proktā mantrā vai prokṣaṇe gavām
ete pramāṇaṃ bhavata utāho neti vāsava
tato vivadamānaḥ sa munibhiḥ saha vāsava
adṛṣṭaṃ dūṣayasi me yacca mūrdhyraspṛśaḥ padā
dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ nāma tava vaṃśasamudbhavam nihato brahmaśāpena prapadyasva triviṣṭapam
upāgamyābruvansarve diṣṭyā vardhasi śakruhan hataśca nahuṣaḥ pāpo diṣṭyāgastyena dhīmatā
varaṃ ca pradadau tasmai atharvāṅgirase tadā
atharvāṅgirasaṃ nāma vede'sminvai bhaviṣyati udāharaṇametaddhi yajñabhāgaṃ ca lapsyase
evaṃ tvamapi rājendra rājyaṃ prāpsyasi bhārata
vṛtraṃ hatvā yathā prāptaḥ śakraḥ kauravanandana
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito vīra draupadyā ca sahānayā
upākhyānamidaṃ śakravijayaṃ vedasaṃmitam rājñā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu śrotavyaṃ jayamicchatā
na cārijaṃ bhayaṃ tasya nāputro vā bhavennaraḥ nāpadaṃ prāpnuyātkāṃciddīrghamāyuśca vindati
akṣauhiṇī tu sā senā tadā yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ balam
kekayāśca naravyāghrāḥ sodarāḥ pañca pārthivāḥ saṃharṣayantaḥ kaunteyonakṣauhiṇyā samāgatāḥ
sa ca saṃprāpya kauravyaṃ tatraivāntardadhe tadā
tataḥ pañcanadaṃ caiva kṛtsnaṃ ca kurujāṅgalam
tatra sainyaṃ tathā yuktaṃ dadarśa sa purohitaḥ
tayoḥ samānaṃ draviṇaṃ paitṛkaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya ye putrāḥ prāptaṃ taiḥ paitṛkaṃ vasu
pāṇḍuputrāḥ kathaṃ nāma na prāptāḥ paitṛkaṃ vasu
vanaṃ gataiḥ pāṇḍaveyairviditaṃ vaḥ purā yathā
na prāptaṃ paitṛkaṃ dravyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa yaddhṛtam
śeṣavanto na śakitā netuṃ vai yamasādanam
te sarvaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā tatpūrvaṃ karma kilviṣam
teṣāṃ ca vṛttamājñāya vṛttaṃ duryodhanasya ca
na hi te vigrahaṃ vīrāḥ kurvanti kurubhiḥ saha
sa ca heturna mantavyo balīyāṃsastathā hi te
bahulatvaṃ ca senānāṃ vikramaṃ ca kirīṭinaḥ
buddhimattvaṃ ca kṛṣṇasya buddhvā yudhyeta ko naraḥ
diṣṭyā kuśalinaḥ sarve saha dāmodareṇa te
diṣṭyā sahāyavantaśca diṣṭyā dharme ca te ratāḥ
diṣṭā na yuddhamanasaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ
atitīkṣṇaṃ tu te vākyaṃ brāhmaṇyāditi me matiḥ
asaṃśayaṃ kseśitāste vane ceha ca pāṇḍavāḥ
ko hi pāṇḍusutaṃ yuddhe viṣaheta dhanañjayam
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ samartha iti me matiḥ
punaruktena kiṃ tena bhāṣitena punaḥ punaḥ
sa taṃ samayamāśritya rājyaṃ necchati paitṛkam
yadi kāṅkṣanti te rājyaṃ pitṛpaitāmahaṃ punaḥ
adhārmikīṃ tu mā buddhiṃ maurkhyātkurvantu kevalāt
kiṃ nu rādheya vācā te karma tatsmartumarhasi eka eva yadā pārthaḥ ṣaḍrathāñjitavānyudhi - - a virāṭanagare dhīraḥ kiṃ tvaṃ tatraiva nāgataḥ bahuśo jīyamānasya karma dṛṣṭaṃ tadaiva te
na cedevaṃ kariṣyāmo yadayaṃ brāhmaṇo'bravīt dhruvaṃ yudhi hatāstena bhakṣayiṣyāma pāṃsukān
sa taṃ satkṛtya kauravyaḥ preṣayāmāsa pāṇḍavān
sarvānvadeḥ sañjaya svastimantaḥ kṛcchraṃ vāsamatadarhā niruṣya
nāhaṃ kvacitsañjaya pāṇḍavānāṃ mithyāvṛttiṃ kāṃcana jātvapaśyam
sarvāṃ śriyaṃ hyātmavīryeṇa labdhāṃ paryākārṣuḥ pāṇḍavā mahyameva
doṣaṃ hyeṣāṃ nādhyagacchaṃ parīcchansūkṣmaṃ kaṃcidyena garheya pārthān
dharmārthābhyāṃ karma kurvanti nityaṃ sukhapriye nānurudhyanti kāmāt
dharmaṃ śītaṃ kṣutpipāse tathaiva nidrāṃ tandrīṃ krodhaharṣau pramādam
dhṛtyā caiva prajñayā cābhibhūya dharmārthayogānprayatanti pārthāḥ
tyajanti mitreṣu dhanāni kāle na saṃvāsāñjīryati teṣu maitrī
yathārhamānārthakarā hi pārthāsteṣāṃ dveṣṭā nāstyājamīḍhasya pakṣe anyatra pāpādvipamānmandabuddherduryodhanātkṣudratarācca karṇāt
putro mahyaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ jagāma duryodhanaḥ sañjaya rāgabuddhiḥ
teṣāṃ hīmau hīnasukhapriyāṇāṃ mahātmanāṃ saṃjanayato hi tejaḥ
utthānavīryaḥ sukhamedhamāno duryodhaḥ sukṛtaṃ manyate tat
teṣāṃ bhāgaṃ yacca manyeta bālaḥ śakyaṃ hartuṃ jīvatāṃ pāṇḍavānām
mādrīputrau sṛñjayāścāpi yānti purā yuddhātsādhu tasya pradānam
tiṣṭheta kastasya martyaḥ purastādyaḥ sarvalokeṣu vareṇya ekaḥ
yaścaiva devānkhāṇḍave savyasācī gāṇḍīvadhanvā prajigāya sendrān
gadābhṛtāṃ nāsti samo'tra bhīmāddhastyāroho nāsti samaśca tasya
sadā'tyamarṣī na valātsa śakyo yuddhe jetuṃ vāsavenāpi sākṣāt
sutejasau valinau śīghrahastau suśikṣitau bhrātarau phālgunena
śyenau yathā pakṣipūgānrujantau mādrīputrau śepayetāṃ na śatrūn
etadbalaṃ pūrṇamasmākamevaṃ yatsatyaṃ tānprāpya nāstīti manye
sahāmātyaḥ somakānāṃ prabarhaḥ santyaktātmā pāṇḍavārthe śruto me
ajātaśatruṃ prasaheta ko'nyo yeṣāṃ sa syādagraṇīrvṛṣṇisiṃha
sa vai saputraḥ pāṇḍavārthe ca śaśvadyudhiṣṭhire bhakta iti śrutaṃ me
avaruddhā rathinaḥ kekayebhyo maheṣvāsā bhrātaraḥ pañca santi
yaṃ taṃ kārṣṇipratimamāhurekaṃ sa sātyakiḥ pāṇḍavārthe niviṣṭaḥ
teṣāṃ madhye sūryamivātapantaṃ śriyā vṛtaṃ cedipatiṃ jvalantam
astambhanīyaṃ yudhi manyamānyo jyāṃ karṣatāṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ pṛthivyām
sarvotsāhaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ nihatya prasahya kṛṣṇastarasā saṃmamarda
yasya sarve vardhayanti sma mānaṃ karūśarājapramukhā narendrāḥ
tamasahyaṃ keśavaṃ tatra matvā sugrīvayuktena rathena kṛṣṇam
saṃprādravaṃścedipatiṃ vihāya siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣudramṛgā ivānye
parākramaṃ me yadavedayanta teṣāmarthe sañjaya keśavasya
na jātu tāñchatruranyaḥ saheta yeṣāṃ sa syādagraṇīrvṛṣṇisiṃhaḥ
pravepate me hṛdayaṃ bhayena śrutvā kṛṣṇāvekarathe sametau
na cedgacchetsaṅgaraṃ mandabuddhistābhyāṃ labheccharma tadā suto me
mate hi me śakrasamo dhanañjayaḥ sanātano vṛṣṇivīraśca viṣṇuḥ
duryodhanena nikṛto manasvī no cetkruddhaḥ pradaheddhārtarāṣṭrān
yathā rājñaḥ krodhadīptasya sūta manyorahaṃ bhītataraḥ sadaiva
mahātapā brahmacaryeṇa yuktaḥ saṅkalpo'yaṃ mānasastasya siddhyet
tasya krodhaṃ sañjayāhaṃ samīkṣya sthāne jānanbhṛśamasmyadya bhītaḥ
sa gaccha śīghraṃ prahito rathena pāñcālarājasya camūniveśanam
ajātaśatruṃ kuśalaṃ sma pṛccheḥ punaḥ punaḥ prītiyuktaṃ vadestvam
janārdanaṃ cāpi sametya tāta mahāmātraṃ vīryavatāmudāram
na tasya kiṃcidvacanaṃ na kuryāt kuntīputro vāsudevasya sūta
anāmayaṃ madvacanena pṛccheḥ sarvāṃstathā draupadeyāṃśca pañca
yadyattatra prāptakalaṃ parebhyastvaṃ manyethā bhāratānāṃ hitaṃ ca tadbhāṣethāḥ sañjaya rājamadhye
diṣṭyā rājaṃstvāmarogaṃ prapaśye sahāyavantaṃ ca mahendrakalpam
anāmayaṃ pṛcchati tvāmbikeyo vṛddho rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro manīṣī
kaccidbhīmaḥ kuśalī pāṇḍavāgryo dhanañjayastau ca mādrītanūjau
kaccitkṛṣṇā draupadī rājaputrī satyavratā vīrapatnī suputrā
manasvinī yatra ca vāñchasi tvamiṣṭānkāmānbhārata svastikāmaḥ
gāvalgaṇe sañjaya svāgataṃ te prītātmā'haṃ tvā'bhinandāmi sūta
anāmayaṃ pratimāne tavāhaṃ sahānujaiḥ kuśalī cāsmi vidvan
cirādidaṃ kuśalaṃ bhāratasya śrutvā rājñaḥ kuruvṛddhasya sūta
manye sākṣāddṛṣṭamahaṃ narendraṃ dṛṣṭvaiva tvāṃ sañjaya prītiyogāt
pitāmaho naḥ sthaviro manasvī mahāprājñaḥ sarvadharmopapannaḥ
sakauravyaḥ kuśalī tāta bhīṣmo yathāpūrvaṃ vṛttirastyasya kaccit
kaccidrājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputro vaicitravīryaḥ kuśalī mahātmā
sa somadattaḥ kuśalī tāta kaccidbhūriśravāḥ satyasandhaḥ śalaśca
droṇaḥ saputraśca kṛpaśca vipro maheṣvāsāḥ kaccidete'pyarogāḥ
sarve kurubhyaḥ spṛhayanti sañjaya dhanurdharā ye pṛthivyāṃ pradhānāḥ
kaccinmānaṃ tāta labhanta ete dhanurbhṛtaḥ kacidete'pyarogāḥ
yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre nivasati darśanīyo maheṣvāsaḥ śīlavāndroṇaputraḥ
vaiśyāputraḥ kuśalī tāta kaccit mahāprājño rājaputro yuyutsuḥ
karṇo mānī kuśalī tāta kaccit suyodhano yasya mando vidheyaḥ
striyo vṛddhā bhāratānāṃ jananyo mahādāsyo dāsabhāryāśca sūta
vadhvaḥ putrā bhāgineyā bhaginyo dauhitrā vā kaccidapyavyalīkāḥ
kaccidrājā brāhmaṇānāṃ yathāvat pravartate pūrvavattāta vṛttim
svargasya kaccinna tathā vartmabhūtāmupekṣate teṣu sadaiva vṛttim
etañjyotiścottamaṃ jīvaloke śuklaṃ prajānāṃ vihitaṃ vidhātrā
te ceddoṣaṃ na niyacchanti mandāḥ kṛtsno nāśo bhavitā kauravāṇām
kaccinna pāpaṃ kathayanti tāta te pāṇḍavānāṃ kuravaḥ sarva eva
droṇaḥ saputraśca kṛpaśca vīro nāsmāsu pāpāni vadanti kaccit
kaccidrājye dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ saputraṃ sametyāhuḥ kuravaḥ sarva eva
na cāpaśyaṃ kaṃcidahaṃ pṛthivyāṃ yodhaṃ samaṃ vā'dhikamarjunena
nāgaḥ prabhinna iva naṅghaleṣu caṃkramyate kaccidenaṃ smaranti
vāmenāsyandakṣiṇenaiva yo vai mahābalaṃ kaccidenaṃ smaranti
purā jetuṃ nakulaḥ preṣito'yaṃ śibīṃstrigartānsañjaya paśyataste
diśaṃ pratīcīṃ vaśamānayanme mādrīsutaṃ kaccidenaṃ smaranti
na karmaṇā sādhunaikena nūnaṃ sukhaṃ śakyaṃ vai bhavatīha sañjaya
sarvātmanā parijetuṃ vayaṃ cenna śaknumo dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putram
yathā''ttha me pāṇḍava tattathaiva kurūnkuruśreṣṭha janaṃ ca pṛcchasi
santyeva vṛddhāḥ sādhavo dhārtarāṣṭre santyeva pāpāḥ pāṇḍava tasya viddhi
sa cāpi jānāti bhṛśaṃ ca tapyate śocatyantaḥ sthaviro'jātaśatro
śṛṇoti hi brāhmaṇānāṃ sametya mitradrohaḥ pātakebhyo yarīyān
smaranti tubhyaṃ naradeva saṅgame yuddhe ca jiṣṇośca yudhāṃ praṇetuḥ
mādrīsutau cāpi tathā''jimadhye sarvā diśaḥ saṃpatantau smaranti
senāṃ varṣantau śagvaiparajamaṃ mahārathau samare duṣprakampau
na tveva manye puruṣasya rājannanāgataṃ jñāyate yadbhaviṣyam
tvaṃ cettathā sarvadharmopapannaḥ prāptaḥ kleśaṃ pāṇḍava kṛcchrarūpam tvamevaitatkṛcchragataśca bhūyaḥ samīkuryāḥ prajñayā'jātaśatro
na kāmārthaṃ santyajeyurhi dharmaṃ pāṇḍoḥ sutāḥ sarva evendrakalpāḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sṛñjayāśca ye cāpyante sanniviṣṭā narendrāḥ
yanmāṃ bravīddhṛtarāṣṭro niśāyāmajātaśatro vacanaṃ pitā te
sahāmātyaḥ sahaputraśca rājan sametya tāṃ vācamimāṃ nibodha
samāgatāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sṛñjayāśca janārdano yuyudhāno virāṭaḥ
yatte vākyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrānuśiṣṭaṃ gāvalgaṇe brūhi tatsūtaputra
ajātaśatruṃ ca vṛkodaraṃ ca dhanañjayaṃ mādravatīsutau ca
āmantraye vāsudevaṃ ca śauriṃ yuyudhānaṃ cekitānaṃ virāṭam
pañcālānāmadhipaṃ caiva vṛddhaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ pārṣataṃ yājñasenim
sarve vācaṃ śṛṇutemāṃ madīyāṃ vakṣyāmi yāṃ bhūtimicchankurūṇām
jātāḥ kule hyanṛśaṃsā vadānyā hīniṣevāḥ karmaṇāṃ niścayajñāḥ
na yujyate karma yuṣmāsu hīnaṃ satvaṃ hi vastādṛśaṃ bhīmasenāḥ
sarvakṣayo dṛśyate yatra kṛtsnaḥ pāpodayo bhāvasaṃsthaḥ kurūṇām
kastatra kuryāñjātu karma prajānan parājayo yatra samo jayaśca
te vai dhanyā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ jñātikāryaṃ te vai putrāḥ suhṛdo bāndhavāśca
upakruṣṭaṃ jīvitaṃ santyajeyuryataḥ kurūṇāṃ niyato vai bhavaḥ syāt
te cetkurūnanuśiṣyātha pārthā nirṇīya sarvāndviṣato nigṛhya
samaṃ vastajjīvitaṃ mṛtyuna syādyajjīvadhvaṃ jñātivadhena sādhu
raṇe vijetuṃ viṣaheta rājan rādheyaguptānsaha bhūmipālaiḥ
mahadbalaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya rājñaḥ ko vai śakto hantumakṣīyamāṇaḥ
so'haṃ jaye caiva parājaye ca niḥśreyasaṃ nādhigacchāmi kiṃcit
kathaṃ hi nīcā iva dauṣkuleyā nirdharmārthaṃ karma kuryuśca pārthāḥ
so'haṃ prasādya praṇato vāsudevaṃ pañcālānāmadhipaṃ caiva vṛddham
kṛtāñjaliḥ śaraṇaṃ vaḥ prapadye kathaṃ svasti syātkurusṛñjayānām
na hyevamevaṃ vacanaṃ vāsudevo dhanañjayo vā jātu kiṃcinna kuryāt
etadrājño bhīṣmapurogamasya mataṃ yadvaḥ śāntirihottamā syāt
kāṃ nu vācaṃ sañjaya me śṛṇoṣi yuddhaiṣiṇīṃ yena yuddhādbibheṣi
ayuddhaṃ vai tāta yuddhādgarīyaḥ kastallabdhvā jātu yuddhyeta sūta
akurvataścetpuruṣasya sañjaya siddhyetsaṅkalpo manasā yaṃ yamicchet
na karma kuryādviditaṃ mamaitadanyatra yuddhādbahu yallaghīyaḥ
kuto yuddhaṃ jātu naro'vagacchetko devaśapto hi vṛṇīta yuddham
sukhaiṣiṇaḥ karma kurvanti pārthā dharmādahīnaṃ yacca lokasya pathyam
dharmodayaṃ sukhamāśaṃsamānāḥ kṛcchropāyaṃ tattvataḥ karma duḥkham
ka indriyāṇāṃ prītivaśānurānāṃ karmābhijñaḥ svaśarīraṃ dunoti
yayā pramukto na karoti duḥkhaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajetsarvadharmādapetām
yathedhyamānasya samiddhatejaso bhūyo balaṃ vardhate pāvakasya
kāmārthalābhena tathaiva bhūyo na tṛpyate sarpiṣevāgniriddhaḥ saṃpaśyemaṃ bhogacayaṃ mahāntaṃ sahāsmābhirdhṛtarāṣṭrasya rājñaḥ
nāśreyānvai sevate mālyagandhānna cāpyaśreyānanulepanāni nāśreyānvai prāvārānsaṃvivaste kathaṃ tvasmānsaṃpraṇudetkurubhyaḥ
svayaṃ rājā viṣamasthaḥ pareṣu sāmarthyamanvicchati tanna sādhu
yathā''tmanaḥ paśyati vṛttameva tathā paretāmapi so'bhyupaiti
āsannamagniṃ tu nidāghakāle gambhīrakakṣe gahane visṛjya
yathā vivṛddhaṃ vāyuvaśena śocetkṣemaṃ mumukṣuḥ śiśiravyapāye
prāptaiśvaryo dhṛtarāṣṭro'dya rājā lālapyate sañjaya kasya hetoḥ
pragṛhya durbuddhimanārjave rataṃ putraṃ mandaṃ mūḍhamamantriṇaṃ tu
sutasya rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ priyaiṣī saṃbudhyamāno viśate'dharmameva
medhāvinaṃ hyarthakāmaṃ kurūṇāṃ bahuśrutaṃ vāgminaṃ śīlavantam
sa taṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ kurubhyo na sasmāra viduraṃ putrakāmyāt
sutasya rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ priyaiṣī prapaśyamānaḥ prājahāddharmakāmau
tadaiva me sañjaya dīvyato'bhūnmatiḥ kurūṇāmāgataḥ syādabhāvaḥ
kāvyāṃ vācaṃ viduro bhāṣamāṇo na vindate yaddhārtarāṣṭrātpraśaṃsām
kṣatturyadā nānvavartanta buddhiṃ kṛcchraṃ kurūnsūta tadā'bhyājagāma
tadarthalubdhasya nibodha me'dya ye mantriṇo dhārtarāṣṭrasya sūta
duḥśāsanaḥ śakuniḥ sūtaputro gāvalgaṇe paśya saṃmohamasya
so'haṃ na paśyāmi parīkṣamāṇaḥ kathaṃ svasti syātkurusṛñjayānām
āttaiśvaryo dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ parebhyaḥ pravrājite vidure dīrghadṛṣṭau
āśaṃsate vai dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputro mahārājyamasapatnaṃ pṛthivyām
tasmiñśamaḥ kevalaṃ nopalabhyaḥ sarvaṃ svakaṃ madgate manyate'rtham
yattatkarṇo manyate pāraṇīyaṃ yuddhe gṛhītāyudhamarjunaṃ vai
āsaṃśca yuddhāni purā mahānti kathaṃ karṇo nābhavaddvīpa eṣām
karṇaśca jānāti suyodhanaśca droṇaśca jānāti pitāmahaśca
anye ca ye kugvastatra santi yathā'rjunānnāmtyaparo dhanurdharaḥ
jānantyetankuravaḥ sarva eva ye cāpyanye bhūmipālāḥ sametāḥ
tenānubandhaṃ manyate dhārtarāṣṭraḥ śakyaṃ hartuṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mamatvam
kirīṭinā tālamātrāyudhena tadvedinā saṃyugaṃ tatra gatvā
kruddhaṃ na cedīkṣate bhīmasenaṃ suyodhano manyate siddhamartham
dhanañjaye nakule caiva sūta tathā vīre sahadeve'sahiṣṇau
sacedetāṃ pratipadyeta buddhiṃ vṛddho rājā saha putreṇa sūta
evaṃ raṇe pāṇḍavakopadagdhā na naśyeyuḥ sañjaya dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
jānāmi tvaṃ kleśamasmāsu vṛttaṃ tvāṃ pūjayanmañjayāhaṃ kṣameyam
vaccāsmākaṃ kauravairbhṛtapūrvaṃ yā no vṛttidhārtarāṣṭre tadā''sīt
adyāpi sā tatra tathaiva vartatāṃ yānti gamiṣyāmi yathā nvamāttha
dvandrāpravye bhavatu mamaiva rājyaṃ sūyodhano yacchatu bhāgnāgryaḥ
dharmanityā pāṇḍava te viceṣṭā loke śrutā dṛśyate cāpi pārtha
mahāśrāvaṃ jīvita cāpyanityaṃ saṃpaśya tvaṃ pāṇḍava mā vyanīnaśaḥ
bhaikṣacaryāmandhakavṛṣṇirājye śreyo manye na tu yuddhena rājyam
alpakālaṃ jīvitaṃ yanmanuṣye mahāsrāvaṃ nityaduḥkhaṃ calaṃ ca
bhūyaśca tadyaśaso nānurūpaṃ tasmātpāpaṃ pāṇḍava mā kṛthāstvam
kāmā manuṣyaṃ prasajanta ete dharmasya ye vighnamūlaṃ narendra
nibandhanī hyarthatṛṣṇeha pārtha tāmicchatāṃ bādhyate dharma eva
dharmaṃ tu yaḥ praṇṛṇīte sa buddhaḥ kāme gṛdhno hīyate'rthānurodhāt
dharmaṃ kṛtvā karmaṇāṃ tāta mukhyaṃ mahāpratāpaḥ saviteva bhāti
hīno hi dharmeṇa mahīmapīmāṃ labdhvā naraḥ sīdati pāpabuddhiḥ
paraṃ sthānaṃ manyamānena bhūya ātmā datto varṣapūgaṃ sukhebhyaḥ
sukhapriye sevamāno'tivelaṃ yogābhyāse yo na karoti karma
evaṃ punarbrahmacaryā'prasakto hitvā dharmaṃ yaḥ prakarotyadharmam
aśraddadhatparalokāya mūḍho hitvā dehaṃ tapyate pretya mandaḥ
na karmaṇāṃ vipraṇāśo'styamutra puṇyānāṃ vā'pyathavā pāpakānām
iha kṣetre kriyate pārtha kāryaṃ na vai kiṃcitkriyate pretya kāryam
kṛtaṃ tvayā pāralokyaṃ ca karma puṇyaṃ mahatsadbhiratipraśastam
jahāti mṛtyuṃ ca jarāṃ bhayaṃ ca na kṣutpipāse manaso'priyāṇi
na kartavyaṃ vidyate tatra kiṃcidanyatra vai cendriyaprīṇanāddhi
tyaja krodhaṃ pāṇḍava harṣajaṃ ca lokāvubhau mā prahāsīścirāyā
antaṃ gatvā karmaṇāṃ yā praśaṃsā satyaṃ damaṃ cārjavamānṛśaṃsyam
aśvamedhaṃ rājasūyaṃ tatheṣṭvā pāpasyāntaṃ karmaṇo mā punargāḥ
taccedevaṃ dveṣarūpeṇa pārthāḥ kariṣyadhvaṃ karma pāpaṃ cirāya
nivasadhvaṃ varṣapūgānvaneṣu duḥkhaṃ vāsaṃ pāṇḍavā dharma eva
pravrajyayā yātayitvā purastādātmādhīnaṃ yadbalaṃ te tadā'sīt
nityaṃ ca vaśyāḥ sacivāstaveme janārdano yuyudhāśca vīraḥ
matsyo rājā rukmarathaḥ saputraḥ prahāribhiḥ sahaputrairvirāṭaḥ
rājānaste ye vijitāḥ purastāttvāmeva te saṃśrayeyuḥ samastāḥ
aprājño vā pāṇḍava yuddhyamāno'dharmajño vā bhūtimatho'bhyupaiti
prajñāvānvā buddhyamāno'pi dharmaṃ saṃstambhādvā so'pi bhūterapaiti
nādharme te dhīyate pārtha buddhirna saṃrambhātkarma cakartha pāpam
āttha kiṃ tatkāraṇaṃ yasya hetoḥ prajñāviruddhaṃ karma cikīrṣasīdam
avyādhijaṃ kaṭukaṃ śīrṣarogi yaśomuṣaṃ pāpaphalodayaṃ vā
satāṃ peyaṃ yanna pibantyasanto manyuṃ mahārāja piba praśāmya
pāpānubandhaṃ ko nu taṃ kāmayeta kṣamaiva te jyāyasī nota bhogāḥ
yatra bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo hataḥ syādyatra droṇaḥ sahaputro hataḥ syāt
kṛpaḥ śalyaḥ saumadattirvikarṇo viviṃśatiḥ karṇaduryodhanau ca
labdhvā'pīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ sāgarāntāṃ jarāmṛtyū naiva hi tvaṃ prajahyāḥ
priyāpriye sukhaduḥkhe ca rājannaivaṃ vidvānnaiva yuddhaṃ kuru tvam
amātyānāṃ yadi kāmasya hetorevaṃ yuktaṃ karma cikīrṣasi tvam
apakrameḥ svaṃ pradāyaiva teṣāṃ māgāstvaṃ vai devayānātpatho'dya
asaṃśayaṃ sañjaya satyametaddharmo varaḥ karmaṇāṃ yattvamāttha
jñātvā tu māṃ sañjaya garhayestvaṃ yadi dharmaṃ yadyadharmaṃ carāmi
yatrādharmo dharmarūpāṇi dhatte dharmaḥ kṛtsno dṛśyato'dharmarūpaḥ
bibhraddharmo dharmarūpaṃ tathā ca vidvāṃsastaṃ saṃprapaśyanti buddhyā
ādyaṃ liṅgaṃ yasya tasya pramāṇamāpaddharmaṃ sañjaya taṃ nibodha
luptāyāṃ tu prakṛtau yena karma niṣpādayettatparīpsedvihīnaḥ
prakṛtisthaścāpadi vartamāna ubhau garhyau bhavataḥ sañjayaitau
manīṣiṇāṃ sattvicchedanāya vidhiyate satsu vṛttiḥ sadaiva
abrāhmaṇāḥ santi tu ye na vaidyāḥ sarvotsaṅgaṃ sādhu manyeta tebhyaḥ
tadadhvānaḥ pitaro ye ca pūrve pitāmahā ye ca tebhyaḥ pare'nye
yajñaiṣiṇo ye ca hi karma kuryurnānyaṃ tato nāstiko'smīti manye
yatkiṃcanedaṃ vittamasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ yaddevānāṃ tridaśānāṃ paraṃ yat
prājāpatyaṃ tridivaṃ brahmalokaṃ nādharmataḥ sañjaya kāmayeyam
yadi hyahaṃ visṛjatsāma garhyo niyudhyamāno yadi jahyāṃ svadharmam
upāsīnā vāsudevasya buddhiṃ nigṛhya śatrūnsuhṛdo nandayanti
vṛṣṇyandhakā hyugrasenādayo vai kṛṣṇapraṇītāḥ sarva evendrakalpāḥ
kāśyo babhruḥ śriyamuttamāṃ gato labdhvā kṛṣṇaṃ bhrātaramīśitāram
yasmai kāmānvarṣati vāsudevo grīṣmātyaye megha iva prajā'bhyaḥ
īdṛśo'yaṃ keśavastāta vidvān viddhi hyenaṃ karmaṇāṃ niścayajñam
priyaśca naḥ sādhutamaśca kṛṣṇo nātikrāme vacanaṃ keśavasya
avināśaṃ sañjaya pāṇḍavānāmicchāmyahaṃ bhūtimeṣāṃ priyaṃ ca
tathā rājño dhṛtarāṣṭrasya sūta samāśaṃse bahuputrasya vṛddhim
kāmo hi me sañjaya nityameva nānyadbrūyāṃ tānprati śāmyateti
rājñaśca hi priyametacchṛṇomi manye caitatpāṇḍavānāṃ samakṣam
suduṣkarastatra śamo hi nūnaṃ pradarśitaḥ sañjaya pāṇḍavena
yasmingṛddho dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraḥ kasmādeṣāṃ kalaho nāvamūrcchet
na tvaṃ dharmaṃ vicaraṃ sañjayeha mattaśca jānāmi yudhiṣṭhirācca
atho kasmātsajjaya pāṇḍavasya utsāhinaḥ pūrayataḥ svakarma
karmaṇā''huḥ siddhimeke paratra hinvā karma vidyayā siddhimeke
yā vai vidyāḥ sādhayantīha karma tāsāṃ phalaṃ vidyate netarāsām
tatreha vai dṛṣṭaphalaṃ tu karma pītvodakaṃ śāmyati tṛṣṇayā''rtaḥ
so'yaṃ vidhirvihitaḥ karmaṇaiva saṃvartate sañjaya tatra karma
tatra yo'nyatkarmaṇaḥ sādhu manyenmoghaṃ tasyālapitaṃ durbalasya
karmaṇā'mī bhānti devāḥ paratra karmaṇaiveha plavate mātariśvā
atandrito dahate jātavedāḥ samiddhyamānaḥ karma kurvanprajābhyaḥ
atandritā bhāramimaṃ mahāntaṃ bibharti devī pṛthivī valena
atandritāḥ śīghrasapo vahanti santarpayantyaḥ sarvabhūtāni nadyaḥ
hitvā sukhaṃ manasaśca priyāṇi tena śakraḥ karmaṇā śraiṣṭhyamāpa
satyaṃ dharmaṃ pālayannapramatto damaṃ titikṣāṃ samatāṃ priyaṃ ca
etāni sarvāṇyupasevamāno yo devarājyaṃ maghavānprāpa mukhyam
hitvā sukha pratirudhyendriyāṇi tena devānāmagamadgauravaṃ saḥ
tathā nakṣatrāṇi karmaṇā'mutra bhānti rudrādityā vasavo'thāpi viśve
yamo rājā vaiśravaṇaḥ kubero gandharvayakṣāpsarasaśca sūta
brahmavidyāṃ brahmacaryaṃ kriyāṃ ca nipevamāṇā ṛṣayo'mutra bhānti
jānannimaṃ sarvalokasya dharmaṃ viprendrāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca
sa kasmāttvaṃ jānatāṃ jñānavānsan vyāyacchaseka sañjaya kauravārthe
āmnāyeṣu nityasaṃyogamasya tathā'śvamedhe rājasūye ca viddhi
saṃyujyate dhanupā varmaṇā ca hastyaśvādyai rathaśastraiśca bhūyaḥ
dharmatrāṇaṃ puṇyameṣāṃ kṛtaṃ syādārye vṛtte bhīmasenaṃ nigṛhya
te cetpitrye karmaṇi vartamānā āpadyerandiṣṭavaśena mṛtyum
utāho tvaṃ manyase śāmyameva rājñāṃ yuddhe vartate dharmatantram
ayuddhe vā vartate dharmatantraṃ tathaiva te vācamimāṃ śrṛṇomi
cāturvarṇyasya prathamaṃ saṃvibhāgamavekṣya tvaṃ sañjaya svaṃ ca karma
niśamyātho pāṇḍavānāṃ ca karma praśaṃsa vā ninda vā yā matiste
adhīyīta brāhmaṇo vai yajeta dadyādīyāttīrthamukhyāni caiva
adhīyīta kṣatriyo'tho yajeta dadyāddhanaṃ na tu yāceta kiṃcit
na yājayenna tu cādhyāpayīta evaṃ smṛtaḥ kṣatradharmaḥ purāṇaḥ
tathā rājanyo rakṣaṇaṃ vai prajānāṃ kṛtvā dharmeṇāpramatto'tha dattvā
sa dharmātmā dharmamadhītya puṇyaṃ yadṛcchayā vrajati brahmalokam
paricaryā vandanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ nādhīyīta pratiṣiddho'sya yajñaḥ nityotthito bhūtaye'tandritaḥ syādevaṃ smṛtaḥ śūdradharmaḥ purāṇaḥ
sa taṃ draṣṭumanuśiṣyanprajānāṃ na caitadbudhyediti tasminnasādhuḥ
tato rājñāmabhavadyuddhametattatra jātaṃ varma śastraṃ dhanuśca indreṇaitaddasyuvadhāya karma utpāditaṃ varma śastraṃ dhanuśca
tatra puṇyaṃ dasyuvadhena labhyate so'yaṃ doṣaḥ kurubhistīvrarūpaḥ
tatra rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputro dharmyaṃ haretpāṇḍavānāmakasmāt
nāvekṣante rājadharmaṃ purāṇaṃ tadanvayāḥ kuravaḥ sarva eva
steno haredyatra dhanaṃ hyadṛṣṭaḥ prasahya vā yatra hareta dṛṣṭaḥ
ubhau garhyau bhavataḥ sañjayaitau kiṃ vai pṛthatkaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putre
bhāgaḥ punaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ niviṣṭastaṃ naḥ kasmādādadīranpare vai
asminpade yudhyatāṃ no vadho'pi ślāghyaḥ pitryaṃ paparājyādviśiṣṭam
idaṃ punaḥ karma pāpīya eva sabhāmadhye paśya vattaṃ kurūṇām
priyaṃ bhāryāṃ draupadīṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ yaśasvinīṃ śīlavṛttopapannām
tāṃ cettadā te sakumāravṛddhā avārayiṣyankuravaḥ sametāḥ
mama priyaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro'kariṣyat putrāṇāṃ ca kṛtamasyābhaviṣyat
duḥśāsanaḥ pratilomyānnināya sabhāmadhye śvaśurāṇāṃ ca kṛṣṇām
sā tatra nītā karuṇaṃ vyapekṣya nānyaṃ kṣatturnāthamavāpa kiṃcit
ekaḥ kṣattā dharmyamarthaṃ bruvāṇo dharmabuddhyā pratyuvācālpabuddhim
kṛṣṇā tvetatkarma cakāra śuddhaṃ suduṣkaraṃ tatra sabhāṃ sametya
yatrābravītsūtaputraḥ sabhāyāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ sthitāṃ śvaśurāṇāṃ samīpe
na te gatirvidyate yājñaseni prapadyethā dhārtarāṣṭrasya veśma
parājitāste patayo na santi patiṃ cānyaṃ bhāmini tvaṃ vṛṇīṣva
yo bībhatsorhṛdaye prota āsīdasthi chindanmarmaghātī sughoraḥ
ete sarve ṣaṇḍatilā vinaṣṭāḥ kṣayaṃ gatā narakaṃ dīrghakālam
parājito nakulaḥ kiṃ tavāsti kṛṣṇayā tvaṃ dīvya vai yājñasenyā jānāsi tvaṃ sañjaya sarvametat dyūte vākyaṃ garhyamevaṃ yathoktam
svayaṃ tvahaṃ prārthaye tatra gantuṃ samādhātuṃ kāryametadvipannam
jānāsi tvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya mohaṃ durātmanaḥ pāpavaśānugasya
ahāpayitvā yadi pāṇḍavārthaṃ śamaṃ kurūṇāmapi cecchakeyam
puṇyaṃ ca me syāccaritaṃ mahodayaṃ mucyeraṃśca kuravo mṛtyupāśāt
api me vācaṃ bhāṣamāṇasya kāvyāṃ dharmārāmāmarthavatīmahiṃsrām
avekṣerandhārtarāṣṭrāḥ samakṣaṃ māṃ ca prāptaṃ kuravaḥ pūjayeyuḥ
parājitānpāṇḍaveyāṃstu vāco raudrā rūkṣā bhāṣate dhārtarāṣṭraḥ
gadāhasto bhīmaseno'pramatto duryodhanaṃ smārayitā hi kāle
suyodhano manyumayo mahādrumaḥ skandhaḥ karṇaḥ śakunistasya śākhāḥ
duḥśāsanaḥ puṣkaphale samṛddhe mūlaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro'manīṣī
yudhiṣṭhiro dharmamayo mahādrumaḥ skandho'rjuno bhīmaseno'sya śākhāḥ
mādrīputrau puṣpaphale samṛddhe mūlaṃ tvahaṃ brahma ca brāhmaṇāśca
vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraḥ siṃhā vane sañjaya pāṇḍaveyāḥ
siṃhābhiguptaṃ na vanaṃ vinaśyet siṃho na naśyeta vanābhiguptaḥ
nirvano vadhyate siṃho niḥsiṃhaṃ vadhyate vanam tasmātsiṃho vanaṃ rakṣedvanaṃ siṃhaṃ ca pālayet
vanaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ vane vyāghrāśca pāṇḍavāḥ
mā vanaṃ chindhi savyāghraṃ vyāghrā neśurvanaṃ vinā
nirvano vadhyate vyāghro nirvyāghraṃ chidyate vanam
tasmādvyāghro vanaṃ rakṣedvayaṃ vyāghraṃ ca pālayet
āmantraye tvāṃ naradevadeva gacchāmyahaṃ pāṇḍava svasti te'stu
kaccinna vācā vṛjinaṃ hi kiṃciduccāritaṃ me manaso'bhiṣaṅgāt
janārdanaṃ bhīmasenārjunau ca mādrīsutau sātyakiṃ cekitānam
āmantrya gacchāmi śivaṃ sukhaṃ vaḥ saumyena māṃ paśyata cakṣuṣā nṛpāḥ
anujñātaḥ sañjaya svasti gaccha na naḥ smarasyapriyaṃ jātu vidvan
vidmaśca tvāṃ te ca vayaṃ ca sarve śuddhātmānaṃ madhyagataṃ sabhāstham
āpto dūtaḥ sañjaya supriyo'si kalyāṇavāk śīlavāṃstṛptimāṃśca
na muhyestvaṃ sañjaya jātu matyā na ca kruddhyerucyamāno'pi tattvam
na marmagāṃ jātu vaktā'si rūkṣāṃ nopaśrutiṃ kaṭukāṃ noti śuṣkām
tvameva naḥ priyatamo'si dūta ihāgacchedviduro vā dvitīyaḥ
ito gatvā sañjaya kṣiprameva upātiṣṭhethā brāhmaṇānye tadarhāḥ
svādhyāyino brāhmaṇā bhikṣavaśca tapasvino ye ca nityā vaneṣu
abhivādya tānmadvacanena vṛddhāṃstathaiva tānkuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
purohitaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya rājñastathācāryānṛtvijo ye ca tasya
tāṃścaivatvaṃ sahitānvai yathāvat saṅgacchethāḥ kuśalenaiva sūta
aśrotriyā ye ca vasanti vṛddhā manasvinaḥ śīlabalopapannāḥ
ślāghasva māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo hyanāmayaṃ tāta pṛccherjaghanyam
ye jīvti vyavahāreṇa rāṣṭre paśūṃśca ye pālayanto vasanti kṛṣīvalā bibhrati ye ca lokaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṣāṃ kuśalaṃ sma pṛccheḥ
ācārya iṣṭo nayago vidheyo vedānabhīpsanbrahmacaryaṃ cacāra
gandharvaputrapratimaṃ tarasvinaṃ tamaśvatthāmānaṃ kuśalaṃ sma pṛccheḥ
tvaṃ māmabhīkṣṇaṃ parikīrtayanvai kṛpasya pādau sañjaya pāṇinā spṛśeḥ
yasminśauryamānṛśaṃsyaṃ tapaśca prajñā śīlaṃ śrutarūpe dhṛtiśca
pādau gṛhītvā kurusattamasya bhīṣmasya māṃ tatra nivedayethāḥ
prajñācakṣuryaḥ praṇetā kurūṇāṃ bahuśruto vṛddhasevī manīṣī
tasmai rājñe sthavirāyābhivādya ācakṣīthāḥ sañjaya māmarogam
jyeṣṭhaḥ putro dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mando mūrkhaḥ śaṭhaḥ sañjaya pāpaśīlaḥ
yasyāpavādaḥ pṛthivīṃ yāti sarvāṃ suyodhanaṃ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
bhrātā kanīyānapi tasya mandastathāśīlaḥ sañjaya sopi śaśvat
maheṣvāsaḥ śūratamaḥ kurūṇāṃ duḥśāsanaḥ kuśalaṃ tāta vācyaḥ
yasya kāmo vartate nityameva nānyaḥ śamādbhāratānāmiti sma
gatvā sma taṃ madvacanena brūyāḥ śalyaṃ tathā madvacanātpratītaḥ
maheṣvāso rathināmuttamo'gryaḥ samaḥ śalo rakṣitā pṛṣṭhamasya
hīniṣevo devitā yo matākṣaḥ satyavrataḥ purumitro jayaśca ye prasthānaṃ tatra me nābhyanandaṃsteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
guṇairanekaiḥ pravaraiśca yukto vijñānavānnaiva ca niṣṭhuro yaḥ
snehādamarṣaṃ sahate sadaiva sa somadattaḥ pūjanīyo mato me
arhattamaḥ kuruṣu saumadattiḥ sa no bhrātā saṃjaya matsakhā ca
maheṣvāso rathināmuttamo'rhaḥ sahāmātyaḥ kuśalaṃ tasya pṛccheḥ
ye caivānye kurumukhyā yuvānaḥ putrāḥ pautrā bhrātaraścaiva ye naḥ
yaṃyameṣāṃ manyase yena yogyaṃ tattatprocyānāmayaṃ sūta vācyāḥ
ye rājānaḥ pāṇḍavāyodhanāya samānītā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa kecit
vaśātayaḥ sālvakāḥ kekayāśca tathāmbaṣṭhā ye trigartāśca mukhyāḥ
prācyodīcyā dākṣiṇyātyāśca śūrāstathā pratīcyāḥ pārvatīyāśca sarve
anṛśaṃsāḥ śīlavṛttopunnāsteṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ kuśalaṃ sūta pṛccheḥ
ākhyāya māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma nityamanāmayaṃ paripṛccheḥ samagrān
tathā rājño hyarthayuktānamātyān dauvārikānye ca senāṃ nayanti
āyavyayaṃ ye gamayanti nityamarthāṃśca ye mahataścintayanti
na tasya yuddhaṃ rocate vai kadācidvaiśyāputraṃ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
yo durjayo devarathena saṅkhye sa citrasenaḥ kuśalaṃ tāta vācyaḥ
mānaṃ kurvandhārtarāṣṭrasya sūta mithyābuddheḥ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
yo muhyatāṃ mohayitā'dvitīyo vaikartanaḥ kuśalaṃ tasya pṛccheḥ
sa eva bhaktaḥ sa guruḥ sa bhartā sa vai pitā sa ca mātā suhṛcca
agādhabuddhirviduro dīrghadarśī sa no mantrī kuśalaṃ taṃ sma pṛccheḥ
vṛddhāḥ striyo yāśca guṇopapannā jñāyante naḥ sañjaya mātarastāḥ
tābhiḥ sarvābhiḥ sahitābhiḥ sametya strībhiḥ savṛddhābhirabhivādaṃ vadethāḥ
iti smotkā sañjaya brūhi paścādajātaśatruḥ kuśalī saputraḥ
rājño bhāryāḥ sañjaya vettha tatra tāsāṃ sarvāsāṃ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
yathā ca vaḥ syuḥ patayo'nukūlāstathā vṛttimātmanaḥ sthāpayadhvam
yā naḥ snuṣāḥ sañjaya vettha tatra prāptāḥ kulebhyaśca guṇopapannāḥ
prajāvatyo brūhi sametya tāśca yudhiṣṭhiro vo'bhyavadatprasannaḥ
kanyāḥ svajethāḥ sadaneṣu sañjaya anāmayaṃ madvacanena pṛṣṭvā
kalyāṇā vaḥ santu patayo'nukūlā yūyaṃ patīnāṃ bhavatānukūlāḥ
alaṅkṛtā vastravatyaḥ sugandhā abībhatsāḥ sukhitā bhogavatyaḥ
laghu yāsāṃ darśanaṃ vākva laghvī veśastriyaḥ kuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
dāsyaḥ syuryā ye ca dāsāḥ kurūṇāṃ tadāśrayā bahavaḥ kubjakhañjāḥ
ākhyāya māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo'pyanāmayaṃ paripṛccherjaghanyam
kaccidvṛttiṃ vartate vai purāṇīṃ kaccidbhogāndārtarāṣṭro dadāti
andhāśca sarve badhirāstathaiva hastājīvā bahavo ye'tra santi
ākhyāya māṃ kuśalinaṃ sma tebhyo'pyanāmayaṃ paripṛccherjaghanyam
mā bhaiṣṭa duḥkhena kujīvitena nūnaṃ kṛtaṃ paralokeṣu pāpam
nigṛhya śatrūnsuhṛdo'nugṛhya vāsobhirannena ca vo bhariṣye
na cāpyetacchakyamekena vaktuṃ nānādeśā bahavo jātisaṅghāḥ
viproṣito bālavaddraṣṭumicchannamasye'haṃ sañjaya bhaimasenān te me yathā vācamimāṃ yathoktāṃ tvayocyamānāṃ śrṛṇuyuktathā kuru
santyeva me brāhmaṇebhyaḥ kṛtāni bhāvīnyatho no bata vartayanti
tānpaśyāmi yuktarūpāṃstathaiva tāmeva siddhiṃ śrāvayethā nṛpaṃ tam
ye cānāthā durbalāḥ sarvakālamātmanyeva prayatante'tha mūḍhāḥ
tāṃścāpi tvaṃ kṛpaṇānsarvathaiva hyasmadvākyātkuśalaṃ tāta pṛccheḥ
dṛṣṭvā tāṃścaivārhataścāpi sarvānsaṃpṛcchethāḥ kuśalaṃ cāvyayaṃ ca
pṛṣṭvā sarvānkuśalaṃ tāṃśca sūta paścādahaṃ kuśalī teṣu vācyaḥ
na hīdṛśāḥ santyapare pṛthivyāṃ ye yodhakā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa labdhāḥ
dharmastu nityo mama dharma eva mahābalaḥ śatrunibarhaṇāya
idaṃ punarvacanaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ suyodhanaṃ sañjaya śrāvayethāḥ
yaste śarīre hṛdayaṃ dunoti kāmaḥ kurūnasapatno'nuśiṣyām
na vidyate yuktiretasya kācinnaivaṃ vidhāsyāmi yathā priyaṃ te
dadasva vā śakrapurīṃ mamaiva yudhvasva vā bhāratamukhyavīra
uta santamasantaṃ vā bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ ca sañjaya
tāta saṃhatya jīvāmo dviṣatāṃ mā vaśaṃ gamaḥ
sa tvaṃ kuru tathā tāta svamatena pitāmaha
yathā jīvanti te pautrāḥ prītimantaḥ parasparam
droṇaṃ saputraṃ śalyaṃ ca mahārājaṃ ca bāhlikam
vikarṇaṃ somadattaṃ ca śakuniṃ caiva saubalam viviṃśatiṃ citrasenaṃ jayatsenaṃ ca sañjaya
bhagadattaṃ tathā caiva śūraṃ raṇakṛtāṃ varam
ye cāpyanye kuravastatra santi rājānaścedbhūmipālāḥ sametāḥ
yuyutsavaḥ saindhavāḥ pārthivāśca samānītā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa sūta
yathānyāyaṃ kuśalaṃ vandanaṃ ca samāgame madvacanena vācyāḥ
tato brūyāḥ sañjaya rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ pāpakṛtāṃ pradhānam
arjunena samādiṣṭastathetsuktvā tu sañjayaḥ pārthānāmantrayāmāsa keśavaṃ ca yaśasvinam
tadā tu sañjayaḥ kṣipramekāhena parantapaḥ yāti sma hāstinapuraṃ niśākāle parantapa
.....dyamatrātyayikaṃ hi me'sti ..... stho'tha śrutvā nṛpatiṃ jagāda
prāpto dūtaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ sakāśāt praśādhi rājankimayaṃ karotu
ācakṣva māṃ kuśalinaṃ kalpamasmai praveśyatāṃ svāgataṃ sañjayāya
na cāhametasya bhavāmyakalpaḥ sa me kasmāddvāri teṣṭhecca saktaḥ
sañjayo'haṃ bhūmipate namaste prāpto'smi gatvā naradeva pāṇḍavān
abhivādya tvāṃ pāṇḍuputro manasvī yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kuśalaṃ cānvapṛcchat
sa te putrānpṛcchati prīyamāṇaḥ kaccitputraiḥ prīyase naptṛbhiśca
tathā suhṛdbhiḥ sacivaiśca rājan ye cāpi tvāmupajīvanti taiśca
abhinandya tvāṃ tāta vadāmi sañjaya ajātaśatruṃ ca sukhena pārtham
kaccitsa rājā kuśalī saputraḥ sahāmātyaḥ sānujaḥ kauravāṇām
sahāmātya kuśalī pāṇḍuputro bubhūṣate yacca te'gre tmanā'bhūt
paro dharmaḥ pāṇḍavasyānṛśaṃsyaṃ dharmaḥ paro vittacayānmato'sya
sukhapriye'dharmahīne'napārthe nu rudhyate bhārata tasya buddhiḥ
paraprayuktaḥ puraṣo viceṣṭate sūtraprotā dārumayīva yoṣā
imaṃ dṛṣṭvā niyamaṃ pāṇḍavasya manye paraṃ karma daivaṃ manuṣyāt
imaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tava karma doṣaṃ pāpodarkaṃ ghoramavarṇarūpam
ajātaśatrustu vihāya pāpaṃ jīrṇāṃ tvacaṃ sarpa ivāsamarthām
virocate hyāryavṛttena vīro yudhiṣṭhirastvayi pāpaṃ visṛjya
upakrośaṃ ceha gato'si rājan bhūyaśca pāpaṃ prasajedamutra
sa tvamarthaṃ saṃśayitaṃ vinā tairāśaṃsase putravaśānugo'sya
adharmaśabdaśca mahānpṛthivyāṃ nedaṃ karma tvatsamaṃ bhāratāgrya
hīnaprajño dauṣkuleyo nṛśaṃso dīrghaṃ vairī kṣatravidyāsvadhīraḥ
kule jāto balavānyo yaśasvī bahuśrutaḥ sukhajīvī yatātmā
dharmādharmau grathitau yo bibharti sa hyasya diṣṭasya vaśādupaiti
kathaṃ hi mantrāgryadharo manīṣī dharmārthayorāpadi saṃpraṇetā
evamuktaḥ sarvamantrairahīno naro nṛśaṃsaṃ karma kuryādamūḍhaḥ
tava hyamī mantravidaḥ sametya samāsate karmasu nityayuktāḥ
iccheñjātu tvayi pāpaṃ visṛjya nindā ceyaṃ tava loke'bhaviṣyat
kimanyatra viṣayādīśvarāṇāṃ yatra pārthaḥ paralokaṃ sma druṣṭum
atyakrāmatsa tathā saṃmataḥ syānna saṃśayo nāsti manuṣyakāraḥ
balirhi rājā pāramavindamāno nānyatkālātkāraṇaṃ tatra mene
cakṣuḥśrotre nāsikā tvak ca jihvā jñānasyaitānyāyatanāni jantoḥ
tāni prītānyeva tṛṣṇākṣayānte tānyavyatho duḥkhahīnaḥ praṇudyāt
natveva manye puruṣasya karma savartate suprayuktaṃ yathāvat
priyāpriye sukhaduḥkhe ca rājannindāpraśaṃse ca bhajanta eva
sa tvāṃ garhe bhāratānāṃ virodhādanto nūnaṃ bhavitā'yaṃ prajānām
tvamevaiko jātu putrasya rājan vaśaṃ gatvā sarvaloke nerandra
kāmātmanaḥ ślāghano dyūtakāle nāgāḥ śamaṃ paśya vipākamasya
anāptānāṃ saṅgrahāttvaṃ narendra tathā''ptānāṃ nigrahāccaiva rājan
druṣṭumicchati te pādau kiṃ karotu praśādhi mām
ahaṃ hi vidurasyāsya nākalpo jātu darśane
na hi te darśane'kalpo jātu rājā'bravīddhi mām
sañjayo vidura prāpto garhayitvā ca māṃ gataḥ
ajātaśatroḥ śvo vākyaṃ sabhāmadhye sa vakṣyati
tasyādya kuruvīrasya na vijñātaṃ vaco mayā
tadbrūhi tvaṃ hi nastāta dharmārthakuśalo hyasi
yataḥ prāptaḥ sañjayaḥ pāṇḍavebhyo na me yathāvanmanasaḥ praśāntiḥ
sarvendriyāṇyaprakṛtiṃ gatāni kiṃ vakṣyatītyeva me'dya pracintā
tanme brūhi vidura tvaṃ yathāvanmanīṣitaṃ sarvamajātaśatroḥ
yathā na nastāta hitaṃ bhavecca prajāśca sarvāḥ sukhitā bhaveyuḥ
śrotumicchāmi te dharmyaṃ paraṃ naiśreyasaṃ vacaḥ
duryodhane saubale ca karṇe duḥśāsane tathā
etasmādrājanbruvato me nibodha ekasmādvai jāyate'sacca sacca
krodho harṣaśca darpaśca hrīḥ stambho mānyamānitā
yasya kṛtyaṃ na jānanti mantraṃ vā mantritaṃ pare
kṛtamevāsya jānanti sa vai paṇḍita ucyate
yasya kṛtyaṃ na vighnanti śītamuṣṇaṃ bhayaṃ ratiḥ
kāmādarthaṃ vṛṇīte yaḥ sa vai paṇḍita ucyate
kṣipraṃ vijānāti ciraṃ śrṛṇoti vijñāya cāryaṃ bhajate na kāmāt
nāsaṃpṛṣṭo vyupayuṅkte parārthe tatprajñānaṃ prathamaṃ paṇḍitasya
āpatsu ca na muhyanti narāḥ paṇḍitabuddhayaḥ
niścitya yaḥ prakramate nāntarvasati karmaṇaḥ avandhyakālo vaśyātmā sa vai paṇḍita ucyate
āryakarmaṇi rajyante bhūtikarmāṇi kurvate hitaṃ ca nābhyasūyanti paṇḍitā bharatarṣabha
gāṅgo hrada ivākṣobhyo yaḥ sa paṇḍita ucyate
āśu granthasya vaktā ca yaḥ sa paṇḍita ucyate
śrutaṃ prajñānugaṃ yasya prajñā caiva śrutānugā
mithyā carati mitrārthe yaśca mūḍhaḥ sa ucyate
amitraṃ kurute mitraṃ mitraṃ dveṣṭi hinasti ca
ciraṃ karoti kṣiprārthe sa mūḍho bharatarṣabha
śrāddhaṃ pitṛbhyo na dadāti daivatāni na cārcati
paraṃ kṣipati doṣeṇa vartamānaḥ svayaṃ tathā
yaśca krudhyatyanīśānaḥ sa ca mūḍhatamo naraḥ
aśiṣyaṃ śāsti yo rājanyaśca śiṣyaṃ na śāsti ca
ekaḥ pāpāni kurute phalaṃ bhuṅkte mahājanaḥ
pañca jitvā viditvā ṣaṭ sapta hitvā sukhī bhavā
ekaḥ svādu na bhuñjīta ekaścārthānna cintayet
eko na gacchedadhvānaṃ naikaḥ supteṣu jāgṛyāt
so'sya doṣo na mantavyaḥ kṣamā hi paramaṃ balam
kṣamā guṇo hyaśaktānāṃ śaktānāṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ kṣamā
kṣamā vaśīkṛtīrloke kṣamayā kiṃ na sādhyate
śāntikhaṅgaḥ kare yasya kiṃ kariṣyati durjanaḥ
eko dharmaḥ paraṃ śreyaḥ kṣamaikā śāntiruttamā
dvāvabhyasi niveṣṭavyau gale badhvā dṛḍhāṃ śilām
varapradānaṃ rājyaṃ ca putrajanma ca bhārata
śatrośca mokṣaṇaṃ kṛcchrātrīṇi caikaṃ ca tatsamam
bhaktaṃ ca bhajamānaṃ ca tavāsmīti ca vādinam
catvāri rājñā tu mahābalena varjyānyāhuḥ paṇḍitastāni vidyāt
alpaprajñaiḥ saha mantraṃ na kuryānna dīrghasūtrairalasaiścāraṇaiśca
catavāri te tāta gṛhe vasantu śriyā'bhijuṣṭasya gṛhasthadharme
vṛddho jñātiravasannaḥ kulīnaḥ sakhā daridro bhaginī cānapatyā
pañca tvā'nugamiṣyanti yatra yatra gamiṣyasi mitrāṇyamitrā madhyasthā upajīvyopajīvinaḥ
ṣaḍdoṣāḥ puruṣeṇeha hātavyā bhūtimicchatā nidrā tandrī bhayaṃ krodha ālasyaṃ dīrghasūtratā
grāmakāmaṃ ca gopālaṃ vanakāmaṃ ca nāpitam
ṣaḍeva tu guṇāḥ puṃsā na hātavyāḥ kadācana
arthāgamo nityamarogitā ca priyā ca bhāryā priyavādinī ca
vaśyaśca putro'rthakarī ca vidyā ṣaḍjīvalokasya sukhāni rājan
svapratyayā vṛttirabhītavāsaḥ ṣaṭ jīvalokasya sukhāni rājan
sapta doṣāḥ sadā rājñā hātavyā vyasanodayāḥ
striyo'kṣā mṛgayā pānaṃ vākpāruṣyaṃ ca pañcamam
aṣṭau gumāḥ puruṣaṃ dīpayanti prajñā ca kaulyaṃ ca damaḥ śrutaṃ ca
parākramaścābahubhāṣitā ca dānaṃ yathāśakti kṛtajñatā ca
kṣetrajñādhiṣṭhitaṃ vidvānyo veda sa paraḥ kaviḥ
daśa dharmaṃ na jānanti dhṛtarāṣṭra nibodha tān
mattaḥ pramatta unmattaḥ śrāntaḥ kruddho bubhukṣitaḥ
tvaramāṇaśca lubdhaśca bhītaḥ kāmī ca te daśa
yaḥ kāmamanyū prajahāti rājā pātre pratiṣṭhāpayate dhanaṃ ca
jānāti viśvāsayituṃ manuṣyān vijñātadoṣeṣu dadhāti daṇḍam
jānāti mātrāṃ ca tathā kṣamāṃ ca taṃ tādṛśaṃ śrīrjuṣate samagrā
sudurbalaṃ nāvajānāti kaṃcidyukto ripuṃ sevate buddhipūrvam
na vigrahaṃ rocayate balasthaiḥ kāle ca yo vikramate sa dhīraḥ
duḥkhaṃ ca kāle sahate mahātmā dhurandharastasya jitāḥ sapatnāḥ
anarthakaṃ vipravāsaṃ gṛhebhyaḥ pāpaiḥ sandhiṃ paradārābhimarśam
dambhaṃ stainyaṃ paiśunaṃ madyamānaṃ na sevate yaḥ sa sukhī sadaiva
na mitrārthe rocayate vivādaṃ nāpūjitaḥ kupyati cāpyamūḍhaḥ
na yo'bhyasūyatsayanukampate ca na durbalaḥ prātibhāvyaṃ karoti
nātyāha kiṃcitkṣamate vivādaṃ sarvatra tādṛglabhate praśaṃsām
yo noddhataṃ kurute jātu veṣaṃ na pauruṣeṇāpi vikatthate'nyān
na mūrcchitaḥ kaṭukānyāha kiṃcitpriyaṃ sadā taṃ kurute jano hi
na vairamuddipayati praśāntaṃ na darpamārohati śāntimeti
na sve sukhe vai kurute praharṣaṃ nānyasya duḥkhe bhavati prahṛṣṭaḥ
dattvā na paścātkurute'nutāpaṃ sa kathyate satpuruṣāryaśīlaḥ
sa yatra tatrābhigataḥ sadaiva mahājanasyādhipatyaṃ karoti
dambhaṃ mohaṃ matsaraṃ pāpakṛtyaṃ rājadviṣṭaṃ paiśunaṃ pūgavairam
etāni yaḥ kurute naityakāni tasyotthānaṃ devatā rādhayanti
samairvivāhaṃ kurute na hīnaiḥ samaiḥ sakhyaṃ vyavahāraṃ kathāṃ ca
guṇairviśiṣṭāṃśca puro dadhāti vipaścitastasya nayāḥ sunītāḥ
mitaṃ bhuṅkte saṃvibhajyāśritebhyo mitaṃ svapityamitaṃ karma kṛtvā
cikīrṣitaṃ viprakṛtaṃ ca yasya nānye janāḥ karma jānanti kiṃcit
mantre gupte samyaganuṣṭhite ca nālpo'pyasya cyavate kaścidarthaḥ
atīva sa jñāyate jñātimadhye mahāmaṇirjātya iva saprannaḥ
ya ātmanā'patrapate bhṛśaṃ naraḥ sa sarvalokasya gururbhavatyuta
anantajejāḥ sumanāḥ samāhitaḥ sa tejasā sūrya ivāvabhāsate
vane jātāḥ śāpadagdhasya rājñaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putrāḥ pañca pañcendrakalpāḥ
tvayaiva bālā vardhitāḥ śikṣitāśca tavādeśaṃ pālayantyāmbikeya
pradāyaiṣāmucitaṃ tātarājyaṃ sukhī putraiḥ sahito modamānaḥ
na devānāṃ nāpi ca mānuṣāṇāṃ bhaviṣyasi tvaṃ garhaṇīyo narendra
tadbrūhi tvaṃ hi nastāta dharmārthakuśalaḥ śuciḥ
yanmanyase pathyamadīnasatva śreyaskaraṃ brūhi tadvai kurūṇām
kaje tanme brūhi tatpaṃ yathāvanmanīṣitaṃ sarvamajātaśatroḥ
śubhaṃ vā yadi vā pāpaṃ dveṣyaṃ vā yadi vā priyam
tathaiva yogavihitaṃ yattu karma na sidhyati
saṃpradhārya ca kurvīta sahasā na samācaret
anubandhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya vipākaṃ caiva karmaṇām
utthānamātmanaścaiva dhīraḥ kurvīta vā na vā
yaḥ pramāṇaṃ na jānāti sthāne vṛddhau tathā kṣaye
kośe janapade daṇḍe na sa rājye'vatiṣṭhate
yacchakyaṃ grasituṃ grasyaṃ grastaṃ pariṇamecca yat
sa nāpnoti rasaṃ tebhyo bījaṃ cāsya vinaśyati
phalādrasaṃ sa labhate bījāccaiva phalaṃ punaḥ
puṣpaṃ puṣpaṃ vicinvīta mūlacchedaṃ na kārayet
kiṃ nu me syādidaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ nu me syādakurvataḥ
iti karmāṇi sañcintya kuryādvā puruṣo na vā
na taṃ bhartāramicchanti ṣaṇḍhaṃ patimiva striyaḥ
na taṃ bhartāramicchanti ṣaṇḍhaṃ patimiva striyaḥ
ṛju paśyati yaḥ sarvaṃ cakṣuṣā nu pibanniva
apakvaḥ pakvasaṅkāśo na tu śīryeta karhicit
cakṣuṣā manasā vācā karmaṇā ca caturvidham
atha saṃtyajato dharmamadharmaṃ cānutiṣṭhataḥ pratisaṃveṣṭate bhūmiragnau carmāhitaṃ yathā
ya eva yatnaḥ kriyate pararāṣṭravimardane sa eva yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ svarāṣṭraparipālane
dharmamūlāṃ śriyaṃ prāpya na jahāti na hīyate
gandhena gāvaḥ paśyanti vedaiḥ paśyanti brāhmaṇāḥ
bhūyāṃsaṃ labhate kleśaṃ yā gaurbhavati durduhā
atha yā sudughā rājannaiva tāṃ vitudantyapi
yacca svayaṃ nataṃ dāru na tatsaṃnāmayedbudhaḥ
indrāya sa praṇamate namate yo balīyase
satyena rakṣyate dharmo vidyā yogena rakṣyate
mṛjayā rakṣyate rūpaṃ kulaṃ vṛttena rakṣyate
na kulaṃ vṛttahīnasya pramāṇamiti me matiḥ
ya īrṣuḥ paravitteṣu rūpe vīrye kulānvaye
gatirātmavatāṃ santaḥ santa eva satāṃ gatiḥ
asatāṃ ca gatiḥ santo na tvasantaḥ satāṃ gatiḥ
jitā sabhā vastravatā miṣṭāśā gomatā jitā
adhvā jito yānavatā sarvaṃ śīlavatā jitam
na tasya jīvitenārtho na dhanena na bandhubhiḥ
prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktirna vidyate
rathaḥ śarīraṃ puruṣasya rājannātmā niyantendriyāṇyasya cāśvāḥ
tairapramattaḥ kuśalī sadaśvairdāntaiḥ sukhaṃ yāti rathīva dhīraḥ
sa eva niyato bandhuḥ sa eva niyato ripuḥ
śuṣkeṇārdraṃ dahyate miśrabhāvāttasmātpāpaiḥ saha sandhiṃ na kuryāt
vākcaiva guptā dānaṃ ca naitānyantyeṣu bhārata
śuśrūpā tu valaṃ strīṇāṃ kṣamā guṇavatāṃ balam
arthavacca vicitraṃ ca na śakyaṃ bahu bhāṣitum
vācā duruktaṃ bībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati vākkṣatam
vākchaśalyastu na nirhartuṃ śakyo hṛdiśayo hi saḥ
parasya nāmarmasu te patanti tānpaṇḍito nāvasṛjetparebhyaḥ
seyaṃ buddhiḥ parītā te putrāṇāṃ bharatarṣabha
sarvatīrtheṣu vā snānaṃ sarvabhūteṣu cārjavam ubhe tvete same syātāmārjavaṃ vā viśiṣyate
iha kīrti parāṃ prāpya pretya svargamavāpsyasi
svayaṃvare sthitā kanyā keśinī nāma nāmataḥ
kiṃ brāhmaṇāḥ svicchreyāṃso ditijāḥ svidvirocana atha kena sma paryaṅkaṃ sudhanvā nādhirohati
prājāpatyāstu vai śreṣṭhā vayaṃ keśini sattamāḥ asmākaṃ khalvime lokāḥ ke devāḥ ke dvijātayaḥ
tathā bhadre kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṃ bhīru bhāṣase
sudhanvānaṃ ca māṃ caiva prātardraṣṭāsi saṅgatau
atītāyāṃ ca śarvaryāmudite sūryamaṇḍale athājagāma taṃ deśaṃ sudhanvā rājasattama
virocano yatra vibho keśinyā sahitaḥ sthitaḥ
sudhanvā ca samāgacchatprāhlādiṃ keśinīṃ tathā samāgataṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśinī bharatarṣabha
pratyutthāyāsanaṃ tasmai pādyamarghyaṃ dadau punaḥ - - a iti hovāca vacanaṃ virocanamanuttamam āssva talpe hi sauvarṇe prāhlāde brāhmaṇastvaham
tavārhate tu phalakaṃ kūrcaṃ vāpyathavā bṛsī
vṛddhau vaiśyau ca śūdrau ca na tvanyāvitaretaram
bālaḥ sukhaidhito gehe na tvaṃ kiñcana budhyase
hiraṇyaṃ ca gavāśvaṃ ca yadvittamasureṣu naḥ
sudhanvanvipaṇe tena praśnaṃ pṛcchāva ye vuduḥ
hiraṇyaṃ ca gavāśvaṃ ca tavaivāstu virocana
prāṇayostu paṇaṃ kṛtvā praśnaṃ pṛcchāva ye viduḥ
na tu deveṣvahaṃ sthātā na manuṣyeṣu karhicit
putrasyāpi sa hetorhi prahlādo nānṛtaṃ vadet
imau tau saṃpradṛśyete yābhyāṃ na caritaṃ saha
kiṃ vai sahaivaṃ caratho na purā carathaḥ saha
prahlāda tattvaṃ pṛcchāmi mā praśnamanṛtaṃ vadeḥ
udakaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca praśnavācārpitaṃ mama prahlada tvaṃ tu me tathyaṃ praśnaṃ prabrūhi pṛcchataḥ
na kalmāṣo na kapilo na kṛṣṇo na ca lohitaḥ
abhivādyo bhavānbrahmansākṣye caiva niyojitaḥ putra eko mama brahmaṃstvaṃ ca sākṣādihāsthitaḥ
yadetattvaṃ na vakṣyasi yadi vāpi vivakṣyasi
atha yo naiva prabrūyātsatyaṃ vā yadi vā'nṛtam
haṃsa tatvaṃ ca pṛcchāmi kiyadenaḥ karoti saḥ
pṛṣṭo dharmaṃ na vibrūyādgokarṇaśithilaṃ caran dharmādbhraśyati rājaṃstu nāsya loko'sti na prajāḥ
pādasteṣu sabhāsatsu yatra nindyo na nindyate
kartārameno gacchedvā nindyo yatra hi nindyate
mohādvā caiva kāmādvā mithyāvādaṃ yadi bruvan
dhṛtarāṣṭra tatvaṃ pṛcchāmi durvivaktā tu kiṃ vaset
yāṃ ca bhārābhitaptāṅgo durvivaktā tu tāṃ vaset
yāṃ ca rātrimabhidrugdho yāṃ ca mitre priye'nṛte
sarvasvena ca hīno yo durvivaktā tu tāṃ vaset
pañca paśvanṛte hanti daśa hanti gavānṛte
sarvaṃ bhūmyanṛte hanti mā sma bhūmyanṛtaṃ vadeḥ
mātāsya śreyasī mātustasmāttvaṃ tena vai jitaḥ
eṣa prahlāda putraste mayā datto virocanaḥ
yaṃ tu rakṣitumicchanti buddhyā saṃyojayanti tam
yathāyathā hi puruṣaḥ kalyāṇe kurute manaḥ
nainaṃ chandāṃsi vṛjināttārayanti māyāvinaṃ māyayā vartamānam
sāmudrikaṃ vaṇijaṃ corapūrvaṃ śalākadhūrtaṃ ca cikitsakaṃ ca
ariṃ ca mitraṃ ca kuśīlavaṃ ca naitānsākṣye tvadhikṛrvīta sapta
bhrūṇahā gurutalpī ca yaśca syātpānapo dvijaḥ
tṛṇolkayā jñāyate jātarūpaṃ vṛttena bhadro vyavahāreṇa sādhuḥ
jarā rūpaṃ harati hi dhairyamāśā mṛtyuḥ prāṇāndharmacaryāmasūyā
krodhaḥ śriyaṃ śīlamanāryasevā hriyaṃ kāmaḥ sarvamevābhimānaḥ
na krodhino'rtho na nṛśaṃmasya mitraṃ krṛgasya na strī sukhino na vidyā
na kāmino hrīralasasya na śrīḥ sarvaṃ tu na syādanavasthitasya
aṣṭau guṇāḥ puruṣaṃ dīpayanti prajñā ca kaulyaṃ ca damaḥ śrutaṃ ca
parākramaścābahubhāṣitā ca dānaṃ yathāśakti kṛtajñatā ca
rājā yadā satkurute manuṣyaṃ sarvānguṇānepa guṇotibhāti
aṣṭau nṛpemāni manuṣyaloke svargasya lokasya nidarśanāni
na sā sabhā yatra na santi vṛddhā na te vṛddhā ye na vadanti dharmam
nāsau dharmo yatra na satyamasti na tatsatyaṃ yacchalenānuviddham
satyaṃ rūpaṃ śrutaṃ vidyā kaulyaṃ śīlaṃ balaṃ dhanam
śauryaṃ ca citrabhāṣyaṃ ca daśeme svargayonayaḥ
pāpaṃ prajñāṃ nāśayati kriyamāṇaṃ puḥna puḥnaḥ
puṇyaṃ prajñāṃ vardhayati kriyamāṇaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
vṛddhaprajñaḥ puṇyameva nityamārabhate naraḥ puṇyaṃ kurvanpuṇyakīrtiḥ puṇyaṃ sthānaṃ sma gacchati
pūrve vayasi tatkuryādyena vṛddhaḥ sukhaṃ vaset
yāvajjīvaṃ tu tatkuryādyena pretya sukhaṃ vaset
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca nadīnāṃ ca kulānāṃ ca mahātmanām
ātreyasya ca saṃvādaṃ sādhyānāṃ ceti naḥ śrutam
sādhyā devā mahāprājñaṃ paryapṛcchanta vai purā
sādhyā devā vayamete maharṣe dṛṣṭvā bhavantaṃ na śaknumo'numātum
śrutena dhīro buddhimāṃstvaṃ mato naḥ kāvyāṃ vācaṃ vaktumarhasyudārām
etatkāryamamarāḥ saṃśrutaṃ me dhṛtiḥ śamaḥ satyadharmānuvṛttiḥ
granthiṃ vinīya hṛdayasya sarvaṃ priyāpriye cātmasamaṃ nayīta
nākrośī syānnāvamānī parasya mitradrohī nota nīcopasevī
na cābhimānī na ca hīnavṛtto rūkṣāṃ vācaṃ ruśatīṃ varjayīta
marmāṇyasthīni hṛdayaṃ tathāsūnrūkṣā vāco nirdahantīha puṃsām
vidyādalakṣmīkatamaṃ jananāṃ mukhe nibaddhāṃ nirṛtiṃ vai vahantam
yadi santaṃ sevati yadyasantaṃ tapasvinaṃ yadi vā stenameva
vāso yathā raṅgavaśaṃ prayāti tathā sa teṣāṃ vaśamabhyupaiti
ativādaṃ na pravadenna vādayedyo nāhataḥ pratihanyānna ghātayet
hantuṃ ca yo necchati pāpakaṃ vai tasmai devāḥ spṛhayantyāgatāya
avyāhṛtaṃ vyāhṛtācchreya āhuḥ satyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ taddvitīyam
priyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ tattṛtīyaṃ dharmyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ taccaturtham
nindāpraśaṃsāsu samasvabhāvo na śocate hṛṣyati naiva cāyam
randhraṃ parasya jānāti yaḥ sa madhyamapūruṣaḥ
na syacinmitramatho durātmā kalāścaitā adhamasyeha puṃsaḥ
na śraddadhāti kalyāṇaṃ parebhyo'pyātmaśaṅkitaḥ nirākaroti mitrāṇi yo vai so'dhamapūruṣaḥ
na tveva samyaglabhate praśaṃsāṃ na vṛttamāpnoti mahākulānām
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ viduraṃ praśnametaṃ bhavanti vai kāni mahākulāni
tapo damo brahmavittvaṃ titikṣā ijyā vivāhāḥ sāntvanaṃ cānnadānam
aṣṭāvete nityamevaṃ bhavanti satāṃ guṇāstāni mahākulāni
yeṣāṃ na vṛttaṃ vyathate na yoniścittaprasādena caranti dharmam
ye kīrtimicchanti kule viśiṣṭāṃ tyaktānṛtāstāni mahākulāni
kulasaṃkhyāṃ na gacchanti yāni hīnāni vṛttataḥ
kulasaṅkhyāṃ ca gacchanti karṣanti ca mahadyaśaḥ
vṛttaṃ yatnena saṃrakṣedvittameti ca yāti ca
akṣīṇo vittataḥ kṣīṇo vṛttatastu hato hataḥ
kulāni na prarohanti yāni hīnāni vṛttataḥ
mā naḥ kule vairakṛtkaścidastu rājā baddho mā parasvāpahārī
mitradrohī naikṛtiko'nṛtī vā pūrvāśī vā pitṛdevātithibhyaḥ
yaśca no brāhmaṇānhanyādyaśca no brāhṇaṇān dviṣet
na naḥ sa samitiṃ gacchedyaśca no nirvapetkṛṣim
sūkṣmo'pi bhāraṃ nṛpate syandano vai śakto voḍhuṃ na tathā'nye mahījāḥ
evaṃ yuktā bhārasahā bhavanti mahākulīnā na tathānye manuṣyāḥ
na tanmitraṃ yasya kopādbibheti yadvā mitraṃ śaṅkitenopacaryam
arthāḥ samabhivartate haṃsāḥ śuṣkaṃ saro yathā
satkṛtāśca kṛtārthāśca mitrāṇāṃ na bhavanti ye
arthayedeva mitrāṇi sati vā'sati vā dhane
amitrāśca prahṛṣyanti mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
punarnaro mriyate jāyate ca punarnaro hīyate vardhate ca
punarnaro yācati yācyate ca punarnaraḥ śocati śocyate ca
sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca bhavābhavau ca lābhālābhau maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca
paryāyaśaḥ sarvamete spṛśanti tasmāddhīro na ca hṛṣyenna socet
calāni hīmāni ṣaḍindriyāṇi teṣāṃ yadyadvardhate yatrayatra
buddhyā bhayaṃ praṇudati tapasā vindate mahat
svāstīrṇāni śayanāni prapannā na vai bhinnā jātu nidrāṃ labhante
na strīṣu rājanratimāpnuvanti na māgadhaiḥ stūyamānā na sūtaiḥ
na vai bhinnā jātu caranti dharmaṃ na vai sukhaṃ prāpnuvantīha bhinnāḥ
na vai bhinnā gauravaṃ prāpnuvanti na vai bhinnāḥ praśamaṃ rocayanti
na vai teṣāṃ svadate pathyamuktaṃ yogakṣemaṃ kalpate naiva teṣām
bhinnānāṃ vai manujendra parāyaṇaṃ na vidyate kiñcidanyadvināśāt
saṃpannaṃ goṣu saṃbhāvyaṃ saṃbhāvyaṃ brāhmaṇe tapaḥ
saṃbhāvyaṃ cāpalaṃ strīṣu saṃbhāvyaṃ jñātito bhayaṃ
brāhmaṇeṣu ca ye śūrāḥ strīṣu jñātiṣu goṣu ca
vṛntādiva phalaṃ pakvaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭra patanti te
prasahya eva vātena saskandho mardituṃ kṣaṇāt
atha ye sahitā vṛkṣāḥ saṅghaśaḥ supratiṣṭhitāḥ
avadhyā brāhmaṇā gāvo jñātayaḥ śiśivaḥ striyaḥ yeṣāṃ cānnāni bhuñjīta ye ca syuḥka śaraṇāgatāḥ
avyādhijaṃ kaṭukaṃ śīrṣarogi pāpānubandhaṃ paruṣaṃ tīkṣṇamuṣṇam
satāṃ peyaṃ yanna pibantyasanto manyuṃ mahārāja piba praśāmya
rogārditā na phalānyādriyante na vai labhante viṣayeṣu tattvam
duḥkhopetā rogiṇo nityameva na budhyante dhanabhogānnasaukhyam
purā hyuktaṃ nākarostvaṃ vaco me dyūte jitāṃ draupadīṃ prekṣya rājan
na tadbalaṃ yanmṛdunā virudhyate sūkṣmo dharmastarasā sevitavyaḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ pāṇḍavānpālayantu pāṇḍoḥ sutāstava putrāṃśca pāntu
ekārimitrāḥ kuravo hyekakāryā jīvantu rājansukhinaḥ samṛddhāḥ
sandhatsva tvaṃ kaurava pāṇḍuputrairmā ne'ntaraṃ ripavaḥ prārthayantu
satye sthitāste naradeva sarve duryodhanaṃ sthāpaya tvaṃ narendra
yaścāśiṣyaṃ śāsti vai yaśca tuṣyedyaścātivelaṃ bhajate dviṣantam
striyaśca yo rakṣati bhadramaśrute yaścāyācyaṃ yācate katthate vā
aśraddadhānāya ca yo bravīti yaścākāmyaṃ kāmayate narendra
vadhvā'vahāsaṃ śvaśuro manyate yo vadhvā'vasannabhayo mānakāmaḥ
parakṣetre nirvapati yaśca bījaṃ striyaṃ ca yaḥ parivadate'tivelam
yaścāpi labdhvā na smarāmīti vādī dattvā ca yaḥ katthati yācyamānaḥ
yasminyathā vartate yo manuṣyastasmiṃstathā vartitavyaṃ sa dharmaḥ
māyācāro māyayā vartitavyaḥ sādhvācāraḥ sādhunā pratyupeyaḥ
jarā rūpaṃ harati hi dhairyamāśā mṛtyuḥ prāṇāndharmacaryāmasūyā
kāmo hriyaṃ vṛttamanāryasevā krodhaḥ śriyaṃ sarvamevābhimānaḥ
ādeśakṛdvṛttihantā dvijānāṃ preṣakaśca yaḥ śaraṇāgatahā caiva sarve brahmahaṇaḥ samāḥ
nānarthakṛtyākulitaḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyo mṛduḥ svargamupaiti vidvān
apriyasya tu pathyasya vaktā śrotā ca durlabhaḥ
yo hi dharmaṃ samāśritya hitvā bhartuḥ priyāpriye
uktaṃ mayā dyūtakāle'pi rājannedaṃ yuktaṃ vacanaṃ prātipeya
tadauṣadhaṃ pathyamivāturasya na rocate tava vaicitravīrya
hitvā siṃhānkroṣṭukāngūhamānaḥ prāpte kāle śocitā tvaṃ narendraḥ
yastāta na krudhyati sarvakālaṃ bhṛtyasya bhaktasya hite ratasya
tasminbhṛtyā bhartari viśvasanti na cainamāpatsu parityajanti
na bhṛtyānāṃ vṛttisaṃrodhanena rājyaṃ dhanaṃ sañjighṛkṣedapūrvam
tyajanti hyenaṃ vañcitā vai viruddhāḥ snigdhā hyamātyā parihīnabhogāḥ
kṛtyāni pūrvaṃ parisaṅkhyāya sarvāṇyāyavyaye cānurūpāṃ ca vṛttim
abhiprāyaṃ yo viditvā tu bhartuḥ sarvāṇi kāryāṇi karotyatandrī
vaktā hitānāmanurakta āryaḥ śaktijña ātmeva hi so'nukampyaḥ
vākyaṃ tu yo nādriyate'nuśiṣṭaḥ pratyāha yaścāpi niyujyamānaḥ
prajñābhimānī pratikūlavādī tyājyaḥ sa tādṛk tvarayaiva bhṛtyaḥ
na viśvāsāñjātu parasya gehe gacchennaraścetayāno vikāle
na catvare niśi tiṣṭhennigūḍho na rājakāmyāṃ yoṣitaṃ prārthayīta
na ca brūyānnāśvasimi tvayīti sakāraṇaṃ vyapadeśaṃ tu kuryāt
ghṛṇī rājā puṃścalī rājabhṛtyaḥ putro bhrātā vidhavā bālaputrā
aṣṭau guṇāḥ puruṣaṃ dīpayanti prajñā ca kaulyaṃ ca śrutaṃ damaśca
parākramaścābahubhāṣitā ca dānaṃ yathāśakti kṛtajñatā ca
rājā yadā satkurute manuṣyaṃ sarvānguṇaneṣa guṇo bibharti
guṇā daśa snānaśīlaṃ bhajante balaṃ rūpaṃ svaravarṇapraśuddhiḥ
sparśaśca gandhaśca viśuddhatā ca śrīḥ saukumāryaṃ pravarāśca nāryaḥ
guṇāśca ṣaṇmitabhuktaṃ bhajante ārogyamāyuśca balaṃ sukhaṃ ca
anāvilaṃ cāsya bhavatyapatyaṃ na cainamādyūna iti kṣipanti
akarmaśīlaṃ ca mahāśanaṃ ca lokadviṣṭaṃ bahumāyaṃ nṛśaṃsam
niṣṭhūriṇaṃ kṛtavairaṃ kṛtaghnametānbhṛśārtopi na jātu yācet
sahāyabandhanā hyarthāḥ sahāyāścārthabandhanāḥ - - anyonyabandhanāvetau vinānyonyaṃ na siddhyataḥ
utpādya putrānanṛṇāṃśca kṛtvā vṛttiṃ ca tebhyo'nuvidhāya kāṃcit
sthāne kumārīḥ pratipādya sarvā araṇyasaṃstho'tha munirbubhūṣet
paśya doṣānpāṇḍavairvigrahe tvaṃ yatra vyatheyurapi devāḥ saśakrā
bhīṣmasya kopastava caivendrakalpa droṇasya rājñaśca yudhiṣṭhirasya
tava putraśataṃ caiva karṇaḥ pañca ca pāṇḍavāḥ
mā vanaṃ chindhi savyāghraṃ mā vyāghrā nīnaśanvanāt
na syādvanamṛte vyāghrānvyāghrā na syurṛte vanam
yo dharmamarthaṃ kāmaṃ ca yathākālaṃ niṣevate
sa śriyo bhājanaṃ rājanyaścāpatsu na muhyati
balaṃ pañcavidhaṃ nityaṃ puruṣāṇāṃ nibodha me
na homamantrā na ca maṅgalāni nātharvaṇā nāpyagadāḥ susiddhāḥ
sa eva khalu dārubhyo yadā nirmathya dīpyate
latādharmā tvaṃ saputraḥ sālaḥ pāṇḍusutā matāḥ
vanaṃ rājaṃstava putro'mbikeya siṃhānvane pāṇḍavāṃstāta viddhi
siṃhairvihīnaṃ hi vanaṃ vinaśyet siṃhā vinaśyeyurṛte vanena
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkrāmanti yūnaḥ sthavira āyati
pīṭhaṃ dattvā sādhave'bhyāgatāya ānīyāpaḥ parinirṇijya pādau
sukhaṃ pṛṣṭvā prativedyātmasaṃsthāṃ tato dadyādannamavekṣya dhīraḥ
yasyodakaṃ madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ ca na mantravitpratigṛhṇāti gehe
cikitsakaḥ śalyakartāvakīrṇī stenaḥ krūro madyapo bhrūṇahā ca
avikreyaṃ lavaṇaṃ pakvamannaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ madhu tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ ca
tilā māṃsaṃ phalamūlāni śākaṃ raktaṃ vāsaḥ sarvagandhā guḍāśca
dīrghau buddhimato bāhū yābhyāṃ hiṃsati hiṃsitaḥ
ślakṣṇo madhuravākstrīṇāṃ na cāsāṃ vaśago bhavet
piturantaḥpuraṃ dadyānmāturdadyānmahānasam goṣu cātmasamaṃ dadyātsvayameva kṛṣiṃ vrajet
bhṛtyairvāṇijyacāraṃ ca putraiḥ seveta ca dvijān
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati
yasya mantraṃ na jānanti bāhyāścābhyantarāśca ye
kṛtāni sarvakāryāṇi yasya pāriṣadā viduḥ dharme cārthe ca kāme ca sa rājā rājasattamaḥ
gūḍhamantrasya nṛpatestasya siddhirasaṃśayam apraśastāni kāryāṇi yo mohādanutiṣṭhati
sa teṣāṃ viparibhraṃśādbhraśyate jīvitādapi karmaṇāṃ tu praśastānāmanuṣṭhānaṃ sukhāvaham
teṣāmevānanuṣṭhānaṃ paścāttāpakaraṃ matam anadhītya yathā vedānna vipraḥ śrāddhamarhati
evamaśrutaṣāṅguṇyo na mantraṃ śrotumarhati sthānavṛddhikṣayajñasya ṣāṅguṇyaviditātmanaḥ
anavajñātaśīlasya svādhīnā pṛthivī nṛpa amoghakrodhaharṣasya svayaṃ kṛtvānvavekṣiṇaḥ
ātmapratyayakośasya vasudaiva vasundharā nāmamātreṇā tuṣyeta chatreṇa ca mahīpatiḥ
bhṛtyebhyo visṛjedarthānnaikaḥ sarvaharo bhavet brāhmaṇaṃ brāhmaṇo veda bhartā veda striyaṃ tathā
amātyaṃ nṛpatirveda rājā rājānameva ca na śatrurvaśamāpanno moktavyo vadhyatāṃ gataḥ
kīrti ca labhate loke na cānarthena yujyate
na taṃ bhartāramicchanti ṣaṇḍhaṃ patimiva striyaḥ
dhṛtiḥ śamo damaḥ śaucaṃ kāruṇyaṃ vāganiṣṭhurā
na ca rātrau sukhaṃ śete sasarpa iva veśmani
ye cānārye samāsaktāḥ sarve te saṃśayaṃ gatāḥ
yatra strī yatra kitavo bālo yatrānuśāsitā
prayojaneṣu ye saktā na viśeṣeṣu bhārata
yaṃ praśaṃsanti kitavā yaṃ praśaṃsanti cāraṇāḥ
yaṃ praśaṃsanti bandhakyo na sa jīvati mānavaḥ
anīśvaro'yaṃ puruṣo bhavābhave sūtraprotā dārumayīva yoṣā
dhātrā tu diṣṭasya vaśe kṛto'yaṃ tasmādvada tvaṃ śravaṇe dhṛto'ham
mantramūlabalenānyo yaḥ priyaḥ priya eva saḥ
dveṣyo na sādhurbhavati na medhāvī na paṇḍitaḥ
priye śubhāni kāryāṇi dveṣye pāpāni caiva ha
uktaṃ mayā jātamātre'pi rājan duryodhanaṃ tyaja putraṃ tvamekam
na sa kṣayo mahārāja yaḥ kṣayo vṛddhimāvahet
kṣayaḥ sa tviha mantavyo yaṃ labdhvā bahu nāśayet
na cotsahe sutaṃ tyaktuṃ yato dharmastato jayaḥ
ye vai bhedanaśīlāstu sakāmā nistrapāḥ śaṭhāḥ
ye pāpā iti vikhyātāḥ saṃvāse pirigarhitāḥ
yā caiva phalanirvṛtiḥ sauhṛde caiva yatsukham
alpe'pyapakṛte mohānna śāntimadhigacchati tādṛśaiḥ saṅgataṃ nīcairnṛśaṃsairakṛtātmabhiḥ
evaṃ loke yaśaḥ prāptaṃ bhaviṣyati narādhipa
vṛddhena hi tvayā kāryaṃ putrāṇāṃ tāta śāsanam
mayā cāpi hitaṃ vācyaṃ viddhi māṃ tvaddhitaiṣiṇam jñātibhirvigrahastāta na kartavyaḥ śubhārthinā
jñātibhiḥ saha kāryāṇi na virodhaḥ kadācana
digdhahastaṃ mṛga iva sa enastasya vindati
dvārāṇyetāni yo jñātvā saṃvṛṇoti sadā nṛpa
matyā parīkṣya medhāvī buddhyā saṃpādya cāsakṛt
duṣkulīnaḥ kulīno vā maryādāṃ yo na laṅghayet
yayościttena vā cittaṃ nibhṛtaṃ nibhṛtena vā
sameti prajñayā prajñā tayormaitrī na jīryati
anirvedaḥ śriyo mūlaṃ lābhasya ca śubhasya ca
arthānarthau samau yasya tasya nityaṃ kṣamā hitā
na cātiguṇavatsveṣā nātyantaṃ nirguṇeṣu ca neṣā guṇānkāmayate nairguṇyānnānurajyate
na sa tasya phalaṃ pretya bhuṅkte'rthasya durāgamāt
udyateṣu ca śastreṣu nāsti satvavatāṃ bhayam
samīkṣya ca samārambho viddhi mūlaṃ bhavasya tu
tapo balaṃ tāpamānāṃ brahma brahmavidāṃ balam
aṣṭau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ
core kṛtaghne viśvāso na kāryo na ca nāstike
arervā praṇipātena mā .. teṣu manaḥ kṛthāḥ
adhvā jarā dehavatāṃ parvatānāṃ jalaṃ jarā
asaṃbhogo jarā strīṇāṃ vākchalyaṃ manaso jarā
suvarṇasya malaṃ rūpyaṃ rūpyasyāpi malaṃ trapu
jñeyaṃ trapumalaṃ sīmaṃ sīsasyāpi malaṃ malam
na svapnena jayennidrāṃ na kāmena jayetstriyaḥ
nendhanena jayedagniṃ na pānena surāṃ jayet
yasya dānajitaṃ mitraṃ śatravo yudhi nirjitāḥ
samatā yadi te rājansveṣu pāṇḍusuteṣu vā
kṣipraṃ yaśastaṃ samupaiti mantamalaṃ prasannā hi sukhāya santaḥ
sukhaṃ suduḥkhānyavamucya śete jīrṇāṃ tvacaṃ sarpa ivāvamucya
anṛte ca samutkarpo rājagāmi ca paiśunam
ālasyaṃ madamohau ca cāpalaṃ goṣṭhireva ca
ete vai sapta doṣāḥ syuḥ sadā vidyārthināṃ matāḥ sukhārthinaḥ kuto vidyā nāsti vidyārthinaḥ sukhaṃ
sukhārthī vā tyajedvidyāṃ vidyārthī vā tyajetsukham
āśā dhṛtiṃ hanti samṛddhimantakaḥ krodhaḥ śriyaṃ hanti yaśaḥ kadaryatā
apālanaṃ hanti paśūṃśca rājannekaḥ kruddho brāhmaṇo hanti rāṣṭram
ajāśca kāṃsyaṃ rajataṃ ca nityaṃ madhvākarṣaḥ śakuniḥ śrotriyaśca
vṛddho jñātiravasannaḥ kulīna etāni te santu gṛhe sadaiva
idaṃ ca tvāṃ sarvaparaṃ bravīmi puṇyaṃ padaṃ tāta mahāviśiṣṭam
na jātu kāmānna bhayānna lobhāddharmaṃ jahyājjīvisyāpi hetoḥ
nityo dharmaḥ sukhaduḥkhe tvanitye jīvo nityo dhāturasya tvanityaḥ
tyaktvā'nityaṃ pratitiṣṭhasva nitye saṃtuṣya santoṣaparā hi santaḥ
mṛtaṃ putraṃ duḥkhapuṣṭaṃ manuṣyā utkṣipya rājansvagṛhānnirharanti
taṃ muktakeśāḥ karuṇaṃ rudanti citāmadhye kāṣṭhamiva kṣipanti
anyo dhanaṃ pretagatasya bhuṅkte vayāṃsi cāgniśca śarīradhātūn
dvābhyāmayaṃ saha gacchatyamutra puṇyena pāpena ca veṣṭyamānaḥ
agnau prāstaṃ tu puruṣaṃ karmānveti svayaṃ kṛtam
tadvai mahāmohanamindriyāṇāṃ buddhyasva mā tvāṃ pralabheta rājan
idaṃ vacaḥ śakṣyasi cedyathāvanniśamya sarvaṃ pratipattumeva
yaśaḥ paraṃ prāpsyasi jīvaloke bhayaṃ nacāmutra naceha te'sti
ātmā nadī bhārata puṇyatīrthā satyodayā dhṛtikūlā dayormiḥ
tasyāṃ snātaḥ pūyate puṇyakarmā puṇyo hyātmā nityamalobha eva
prajñāvṛddhaṃ dharmavṛddhaṃ svabandhuṃ vidyāvṛddhaṃ vayasā cāpi vṛddham
kāryākārye pūjayitvā prasādya yaḥ saṃpṛcchenna sa muhyetkadācit
cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca karmaṇā
satyaṃ bruvangurave karma kurvanna brāhmaṇaśryavate brahmalokāt
adhītya vedānparisaṃstīrya cāgnīniṣṭvā yajñaiḥ pālayitvā prajāśca
gobrahmaṇārthaṃ śastrapūtāntarātmā hataḥ saṅgrāme kṣatriyaḥ svargameti
tretāpūtaṃ dhūmamāghrāya puṇyaṃ pretya svarge divyasukhāni bhuṅkte
brahma kṣatraṃ vaiśyavarṇaṃ ca śūdraḥ krameṇaitānnyāyataḥ pūjayānaḥ
cāturvarṇyasyaiṣa dharmastavokto hetuṃ cānubruvato me nibodha
mamāpi ca matiḥ saumya bhavatyevaṃ yathāttha mām
sā tu buddhiḥ kṛtāpyevaṃ pāṇḍavānprati me sadā
diṣṭameva dhruvaṃ manye pauruṣaṃ tu nirarthakam
anuktaṃ yadi te kiñcidvācā vidura vidyate
tanme śuśrūṣato brūhi vicitrāṇi hi bhāṣase
dhṛtarāṣṭra kumāro vai yaḥ purāṇaḥ sanātanaḥ
kiṃ tvaṃ na veda tadbhūyo yanme brūyātsanātanaḥ
brāhmīṃ hi yonimāpannaḥ saguhyamapi yo vadet
na tena garhyo devānāṃ tasmādetadbravīmi te
bravīhi vidura tvaṃ me purāṇaṃ taṃ sanātanam
sa ca taccintitaṃ jñātvā darśayāmāsa bhārata
yo na śakyo mayā vaktuṃ tvamasmai vaktumarhasi
lābhālābhau priyadveṣyau yathainaṃ na jarāntakau viṣaheranbhayāmarṣau śrutpipāse madodbhavau
tato rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro manīṣī saṃpūjya vākyaṃ vidureritaṃ tat
sanatsujātaṃ rahite mahātmā papraccha buddhiṃ paramāṃ bubhūṣan
sanatsujāta yadimaṃ śṛṇomi na mṛtyurastīti tavopadeśam
ubhe satye kṣatriyādya pravṛtte moho mṛtyuḥ saṃmato'yaṃ kavīnām
pramādaṃ vai mṛtyumahaṃ bravīmi tathā'pramādamamṛtatvaṃ bravīmi
naiva mṛtyurvyāghra ivātti jantūnna hyasya rūpamupalabhyate hi
asyādeśānniḥsarate narāṇāṃ krodhaḥ pramādo lobharūpaśca mṛtyuḥ
ahaṃ gatenaiva caranvimārgānna cātmano yogamupaiti kaścit
te mohitāstadvaśe vartamānā itaḥ pretāstatra punaḥ patanti
karmodaye karmaphalānurāgāstatrānu te yānti na taranti mṛtyum
abhidhyā vai prathamaṃ hanti lokān kāmakrodhāvanugṛhyāśu paścāt
ete bālānmṛtyave prāpayanti dhīrāstu dhairyeṇa taranti mṛtyum
nainaṃ mṛtyurmṛtyurivātti bhūtvā evaṃ vidvānyo vinihanti kāmān
amūḍhavṛtteḥ puruṣasyeha kuryātkiṃ vai mṛtyustārṇa ivāsya vyāghraḥ
amanyamānaḥ kṣatriya kiñcidanyannādhīyate tārṇa ivāsya sarpaḥ
krodhāllobhānmohabhayāntarātmā sa vai mṛtyustvaccharire ya eṣaḥ
evaṃ mṛtyuṃ jāyamānaṃ viditvā jñāne tiṣṭhanna bibhetīha mṛtyoḥ vinaśyate viṣaye tasya mṛtyurmṛtyoryathā viṣayaṃ prāpya martyaḥ
teṣāṃ parārthaṃ kathayantīha vedā etadvidvānnaiti kathaṃ nu karma
evaṃ hyavidvānupayāti tatra tatrārthajātaṃ ca vadanti vedāḥ
saveha āyāti paraṃ parātmā prayāti mārgeṇa nihatya mārgān
ko'sau niyuṅkte tamajaṃ purāṇaṃ sa cedidaṃ sarvamanukrameṇa
kiṃ vāsya kāryamathavā sukhaṃ ca tanme vidvanbrūhi sarvaṃ yathāvat
doṣo mahānatra vibhedayoge hyanādiyogena bhavanti nityāḥ
ya etadvā bhagavānsa nityo vikārayogena karoti viśvam
tathāca tacchaktiriti sma manyate tathārthayogena bhavanti vedāḥ
dharmaḥ pāpena pratihanyate svidutāho dharmaḥ pratihanti pāpam
tasminsthitau vāpyubhayaṃ hi nityaṃ jñānena vidvānpratihanti siddham
tathānyathā puṇyamupaiti dehī tathāgataṃ pāpamupaiti siddham
gatvobhayaṃ karmaṇā yujyate sthiraṃ śubhasya pāpasya sa cāpi karmaṇā
dharmeṇa pāpaṃ praṇudatīha vidvān dharmo balīyāniti tatra viddhiḥ
yānihāhuḥ svasya dharmasya lokāndvijātīnāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ sanātanān
te brāhmaṇā itaḥ pretya svarge yānti prakāśatām
yeṣāṃ dharme ca vispardhā teṣāṃ jajjñānasādhanam
te brāhmaṇā ito muktāḥ svargaṃ yānti triviṣṭapam
yo vā kathayamānasya hyātmānaṃ nānusaṃjvaret brahmasvaṃ nopabhuñjīta tadannaṃ saṃmataṃ satām
yathā khaṃ vāntamaśnāti śvā vai nityamabhūtaye
jñātīnāṃ tu vasanmadhye naivaṃ vindeta kiñcana
kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ coreṇātmāpahāriṇā
anāḍhyā mānuṣe vitte āḍhyā daive tathā kratau
na sa māno brāhmaṇasya tasminprayatate svayam
na mānyaṃ mānayiṣyanti evaṃ manyeta mānitaḥ
na vai mānaṃ ca maunaṃ ca sahitau vasataḥ sadā
ayaṃ hi loko mānasya asau maunasya tadviduḥ
dvārāṇi tasyeha vadanti santo bahuprakārāṇi durādharāṇi
kasyaiṣa maunaḥ katarannu maunaṃ prabrūhi vidvanniha maunabhāvam
maunena vidvānuta yāti maunaṃ kathaṃ mune maunamihācaranti
yato na vedā manasā sahainamanupraviśanti tato'tha maunam
yatrotthito vedaśabdastathāyaṃ sa tanmayatvena vibhāti rājan
ṛco yajūṃṣi yo veda sāmavedaṃ ca veda yaḥ
pāpāni kurvanpāpena lipyate kiṃ na lipyate
trāyante karmaṇaḥ pāpānna te mithyā bravīmyaham
na cchandāṃsi vṛjināttārayanti māyāvinaṃ māyayā sarvamānam
na cedvedā vedavidaṃ trātuṃ śaktā vicakṣaṇa
tadarthayuktaṃ tapa etadijyā tābhyāmasau puṇyamupaiti vidvān
asminkṛtaṃ tatparigṛhya sarvamamutra bhuṅkte punareti mārgam
brāhmaṇānāṃ tapaḥ svṛddhamanyeṣāṃ tāvadeva tat etatsamṛddhamatyṛddhaṃ tapo bhavati kevalam
kalmaṣaṃ tapaso brūhi śrutaṃ niṣkalmaṣaṃ tapaḥ
krodhādayo dvādaśa yasya doṣāstathā nṛśaṃsāni daśa tri rājan
dharmādayo dvādaśaite pitṝṇāṃ śāstre guṇā ye viditā dvijānām
krodhaḥ kāmo lobhamohau vidhitsā'kṛpā'sūye mānaśokau spṛhā ca
īrṣyā jugupsā ca manuṣyadoṣā varjyāḥ sadā dvādaśaite narāṇām
etānpāpāḥ ṣaṇṇarāḥ pāpadharmān prakurvate no trasantaḥ sudurge
vargapraśaṃsī vanitāsu dveṣṭā ete pare sapta nṛśaṃsavargāḥ
dharmaśca satyaṃ ca damastapaśca āmātsaryaṃ hrīstitikṣānasūyā
yajñaśca dānaṃ ca dhṛtiḥ śrutaṃ ca vratāni vai dvādaśa brāhmaṇasya
yastvetebhyaḥ prabhaveddvādaśabhyaḥ sarvāmapīmāṃ pṛthivīṃ sa śiṣyāt
tribhirdvābhyāmekato vārthito yastasya svamastīti sa veditavyaḥ
anṛtaṃ cābhyasūyā ca kāmārthau ca tathā spṛhā
krodhaḥ śokastathā tṛṣṇā lobhaḥ paiśūnyameva ca
mado'ṣṭādaśadoṣaḥ syāttyāgo bhavati ṣaḍvidhaḥ viparyayāḥ smṛtā ete madadoṣā udāhṛtāḥ
tena duḥkhaṃ taratyeva bhinnaṃ tasmiñjitaṃ kṛte
śreyāṃstu ṣaḍvidhastyāgaḥ śriyaṃ prāpya na hṛṣyati
kāmatyāgaśca rājendra sa tṛtīya iti smṛtaḥ
apyavācyaṃ vadantyetaṃ sa tṛtīyo guṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
na ca karmasvasiddheṣu duḥkhaṃ te na ca na glapet
apriye ca samutpanne vyathāṃ jātu na gacchati
satyaṃ dhyānaṃ samādhānaṃ codyaṃ vairāgyameva ca
aṣṭau doṣāḥ pramādasya tāndoṣānparivarjayet indriyebhyaśca pañcabhyo manasaścaiva bhārata
satyātmā bhava rājendra satye lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
teṣāṃ tu kataraḥ sa syādyamahaṃ veda vai dvijam
jñānaṃ vai nāma pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ jāyate tapaḥ
vidyādbahu paṭhantaṃ tu dvijaṃ vai bahupāṭhinam
tasmātkṣatriya mā maṃsthā jalpitenaiva vai dvijam
ya eva satyānnāpaiti sa jñeyo brāhmaṇastvayā
chandāṃsi nāma kṣatriya tānyatharvā purā jagau maharṣisaṅgha eṣaḥ
chandovidaste ya uta nādhītavedā na vedavedyasya vidurhi tattvam
chandāṃsi nāma dvipadāṃ variṣṭha svacchandayogena bhavanti tatra
chandovidaste na ca tānadhītya gatā na vedasya na vedyamāryāḥ
na vedānāṃ veditā kaścidasti kaścittvetānbuddhyate vāpi rājan
yo veda vedānna sa veda vedyaṃ satye sthito yastu sa veda vedyam
na vedānāṃ veditā kaścidasti vedyena vedaṃ na vidurna vedyam
yo veda vedaṃ sa ca veda vedyaṃ yo veda vedyaṃ na sa veda satyam
yo veda vedānsa ca veda vedyaṃ na taṃ vidurvedavido na vedāḥ
tathāpi vedena vidanti vedaṃ ye brāhmaṇā vedavido bhavanti
dhāmāṃśabhāgasya tathā hi vedā yathā ca śākhā hi mahīruhasya
saṃvedane caiva yathāmananti tasminhi satye paramātmano'rthe
avicinvannimaṃ vede tapaḥ paśyati taṃ prabhum
svalakṣaṇaṃ tu yo veda sa muniḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
sanatsujāta yāmimāṃ parāṃ tvaṃ brāhmīṃ vācaṃ vadase viśvarūpām
parāṃ hi kāmena sudurlabhāṃ kathāṃ prabrūhi me vākyamidaṃ kumāra

atyantavidyāmiti yatsanātanīṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ brahmacaryeṇa siddhām
anārabhyāṃ vasatīha kāryakāle kathaṃ brāhmaṇyamamṛtatvaṃ labheta

yāṃ prāpyainaṃ martyalokaṃ tyajanti yā vai vidyā guruvṛddheṣu nityā
ācāryayonimiha ye praviśya bhūtvā garbhe brahmacaryaṃ caranti

evaṃ hyete samājñāya tādṛgbhāvaṃ gatā ime
ya āśrayetpāvayeccāpi rājansarvaṃ śarīraṃ tapasā tapyamānaḥ
