na pṛthivyāṃ tiṣṭhati nāntarikṣe naitatsamudre salilaṃ bibharti
na tārakāsu na ca vidyudāśritaṃ na cābhreṣu dṛśyate rūpamasya
na cāpi vāyau na ca devatāsu naitaccandre dṛśyate nota sūrye
naivarkṣu tanna yajuṣṣu nāpyatharvasu na dṛśyate vai vimaleṣu sāmasu
rathantare bārhadrathe vāpi rājanmahāvrate naiva dṛśyedbhruvaṃ tat

dvādaśapūgāṃ saritaṃ pibanto devarakṣitām madhvīkṣantaśca te tasyāḥ saṃcarantīha ghorām

samānametadamṛtasyetarasya muktāstatra madhva utsaṃ samāpuḥ yoginastaṃ prapaśyanti bhagavantaṃ sanātanam

evaṃrūpo mahātmā sa pāvakaṃ puruṣo giran yo vai taṃ puruṣaṃ veda tasyehārtho na riṣyate

gūhanti sarpā iva gahvarāṇi svaśikṣayā svena vṛttena martyāḥ
teṣu pramuhyanti janā vimūḍhā yathādhvānaṃ mohayante bhayāya yoginastaṃ prapaśyanti bhagavantaṃ sanātanam
nāhaṃ sadā'satkṛtaḥ syāṃ na mṛtyurna cāmṛtyuramṛtaṃ me kutaḥ syāt

evaṃ yaḥ sarvabhūteṣu ātmānamanupaśyati anyatrānyatra yukteṣu kiṃ sa śocettataḥ param
aṅguṣṭhamātraḥ puruṣo mahātmā na dṛśyate'sau hṛdi saṃniviṣṭaḥ

yatra kṛṣṇau ca kṛṣṇā ca satyabhāmā ca bhāminī

tava putrasya lobhaṃ ca vardhamānaṃ prapaśyataḥ
