yadā draṣṭā svabalaṃ saṃpramūḍhaṃ tadā paścāttapsyati mandabuddhiḥ
kāndigbhūtaṃ chinnagātraṃ visaṃjñaṃ duryodhano drakṣyati sarvasainyam
prajāpateḥ karma yathārthaniṣṭhitaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā tapsyati mandabuddhiḥ
yadā rathe gāṇḍivaṃ vāsudevaṃ divyaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pāñcajanyaṃ hayāṃśca
tūṇāvakṣayyau devadattaṃ ca māṃ ca dṛṣṭvā yuddhe dhārtarāṣṭro'nvatapsyat
sabhrātā vai sahasainyaḥ sabhṛtyo bhraṣṭaiśvaryaḥ krodhavaśo'lpacetāḥ
pūrvāhṇe māṃ kṛtajapyaṃ kadācidvipraḥ provācodakānte manojñam
kartavyaṃ te duṣkaraṃ karma pārtha yoddhavyaṃ kate śatrubhiḥ savyasācin
indro vā te harivānvajrahastaḥ purastādyātu samare'rīnvinighnan
sugrīvayuktena rathena vā te paścātkṛṣṇo rakṣatu vāsudevaḥ
sa me labdho dasyuvadhāya kṛṣṇo manye cetadvihitaṃ daivaterme
ayuddhyamāno manasāpi yasya jayaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ puruṣasyābhinandet
evaṃ sarvānsa vyatīyādamitrān sendrāndevānmānuṣe nāsti cintā
tejasvinaṃ kṛṣṇamatyantaśūraṃ yuddhena yo vāsudevaṃ jigīṣet
giriṃ ya icchettu talena bhettuṃ śiloccayaṃ śvetamatipramāṇam
tasyaiva pāṇiḥ sanakho viśīryenna cāpi kiñcitsa girestu kuryāt
agniṃ samiddhaṃ śamayedbhujābhyāṃ candraṃ ca sūryaṃ ca nivārayeta
hareddevānāmamṛtaṃ prasahya yuddhena yo vāsudevaṃ jigīṣet
yo rukmiṇīmekarathena bhojanutsādya rājñaḥ samare prasahya
uvāha bhāryāṃ yaśasā jvalantīṃ yasyāṃ jajñe raukmiṇeyo mahātmā
ayaṃ gāndhārāṃstarasā saṃpramathya jitvā putrānnagnajitaḥ samagrān
baddhaṃ mumoca vinadantaṃ prasahya sudarśanaṃ vai devatānāṃ lalāmam
ayaṃ kavāṭe nijaghāna pāṇḍyaṃ tathā kaliṅgāndantavakraṃ mamarda
anena dagdhā varṣapūgānvināthā vārāṇasī nagarī saṃbabhūva
ayaṃ sma yuddhe manyate'nyairajeyaṃ tamekalavyaṃ nāma niṣādarājam
vegenaiva śailamabhihatya jambhaḥ śete sa kṛṣṇena hataḥ parāsuḥ
tathograsenasya sutaṃ suduṣṭaṃ vṛṣṇyandhakānāṃ madhyagataṃ sabhāstham
ayaṃ saubhaṃ yodhayāmāsa svasthaṃ vibhīṣaṇaṃ māyayā sālvarājam
saubhadvāri pratyagṛhṇācchataghnīṃ dorbhyāṃ ka enaṃ viṣaheta martyaḥ
prāgjyotiṣaṃ nāma babhūva durgaṃ puraṃ ghoramasurāṇāmasahyam
mahābalo narakastatra bhaumo jahārādityā maṇikuṇḍale śubhe
na taṃ devāḥ saha śakreṇa śekuḥ samāgatā yudhi mṛtyorabhītāḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ vikramaṃ keśavasya balaṃ tathaivāstramavāraṇīyam
nirmocane ṣaṭsahasrāṇi hatvā saṃcchidya pāśānsahasā kṣurāntān
muraṃ hatvā vinihatyaugharakṣo nirmocanaṃ cāpi jagāma vīraḥ
tatraiva tenāsya babhūva yuddhaṃ mahābalenātibalasya viṣṇoḥ
śete sa kṛṣṇena hataḥ parāsurvāteneva mathitaḥ karṇikāraḥ
āhṛtya kṛṣṇo maṇikuṇḍale te hatvā ca bhaumaṃ narakaṃ mura ca
asmai varāṇyadadaṃstatra devā dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ karma kṛtaṃ raṇe tat
śramaśca te yudhyamānasya na syādākāśe cāpsu ca te kramaḥ syāt
śastrāṇi gātre na ca te kramerannityeva kṛṣṇaśca tataḥ kṛtārthaḥ
sadā hyenaṃ tarkayate durātmā taccāpyayaṃ sahate'smānsamīkṣya
paryāgataṃ mama kṛṣṇasya caiva yo manyate kalahaṃ saṃprasahya
śakyaṃ hartuṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mamatvaṃ tadveditā saṃyugaṃ tatra gatvā
namaskṛtvā śāntanavāya rājñe droṇāyātho sahaputrāya caiva
dharmeṇāptaṃ nidhanaṃ tasya manye yo yotsyate pāṇḍavairdharmacārī
mithyā glahe nirjitā vai nṛśaṃsaiḥ saṃvatsarānvai dvādaśa rājaputrāḥ
vāsaḥ kṛcchro vihitaścāpyaraṇye dīrghaṃ kālaṃ caikamajñātavarṣam
te hi kasmājjīvatāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ nandiṣyante dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ padasthāḥ
dharmādadharmaścarito garīyāṃstato dhruvaṃ nāsti kṛtaṃ ca sādhu
na cedidaṃ pauruṣaṃ karmabaddhaṃ na cedasmānmanyate'sau viśiṣṭān
na cedidaṃ karma narendra vandhyaṃ na cedbhavetsukṛtaṃ niṣphalaṃ vā
idaṃ ca taccābhisamīkṣya nūnaṃ parājayo dhārtarāṣṭrasya sādhuḥ
pratyakṣaṃ vaḥ kuravo yadbravīmi yuddhyamānā dhārtarāṣṭrā na santi
anyatra yuddhātkuravo yadi syurna yuddhe vai śeṣa ihāsti kaścit
apyevaṃ no brāhmaṇāḥ santi vṛddhā bahuśrutāḥ śīlavantaḥ kulīnāḥ
sāṃvatsarā jyotiṣi cābhiyuktā nakṣatrayogeṣu ca niścayajñāḥ
uccāvacaṃ daivayuktaṃ rahasyaṃ divyāḥ praśnā mṛgacakrā muhūrtāḥ
kṣayaṃ mahāntaṃ kurusṛñjayānāṃ nivedayante pāṇḍavānāṃ jayaṃ ca
yathā hi no manyate'jātaśatruḥ saṃsiddhārtho dvipatāṃ nigrahāya
ahaṃ tathainaṃ khalu bhāvirūpaṃ paśyāmi buddhayā svayamapramattaḥ
dṛṣṭiśca me na vyathate purāṇī saṃyudhyamānā dhārtarāṣṭrā na santi
anālabdhaṃ jṛmbhati gāṇḍivaṃ dhanuranāhatā kampati me dhanurjyā
khaṅgaḥ kośānniḥsarati prasanno hitveva jīrṇāsuragastvacaṃ svām
dhvaje vāco raudrarūpā bhavanti kadā ratho yokṣyate te kirīṭin
mṛgāḥ śrṛgālāḥ śitikaṇṭhāśca kākā gṛdhrā bakāścaiva tarakṣavaśca
sthūṇākarṇaṃ pāśupataṃ mahāstraṃ brāhmaṃ cāstraṃ yacca śakro'pyadānme
vadhe dhṛto vegavataḥ pramuñcannāhaṃ prajāḥ kiñcidihāvaśiṣye
śāntiṃ lapsye paramo hyepa bhāvaḥ sthiro mama brūhi gāvalgaṇe tān
ye vaijayyāḥ samare sūta labdhvā devānapīndragramukhānsametāt
tairmanmate kalahaṃ saṃprasahya sa dhārtarāṣṭraḥ paśyata mohamasya
vṛddho bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kṛpaśca droṇaḥ saputro viduraśca dhīmān
ete sarve yadvadante tadastu āyuṣmantaḥ kuravaḥ santu sarve
ādityāścaiva sādhyāśca ye ca saptarpayo divi
bhavantaṃ nopatiṣṭhete tau naḥ śaṃsa pitāmaha
yāvetau pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ ca bhāsayantau tapasvinau
etau hi karmaṇā lokaṃ nandayāmāsaturdhruvam dvidhābhūtau mahāprājñau viddhi brahmanparantapau
tadā devāsure yuddhe bhaye jāte divaukasām
tābhyāṃ ca sahitaḥ śakro vijigye daityadānavān
ajeyau mānuṣe loke sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ eṣa nārāyaṇaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ phālgunaśca naraḥ smṛtaḥ
duryodhana tadā tāta smartāsi vacanaṃ mama
tavaiva hi mataṃ sarve kuravaḥ paryupāsate
na hi me vṛjinaṃ kiñciddhārtarāṣṭrā viduḥ kvacit
prāgviruddhaiḥ śamaṃ sadbhiḥ kathaṃ vā kriyate punaḥ rājño hi dhṛtarāṣṭrasya sarvaṃ kāryaṃ priyaṃ mayā
tathā duryodhanasyāpi sa hi rājye samāhitaḥ
karṇasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ punaḥ
sarve hyastrividaḥ śūrāḥ sarve prāptā mahadyaśaḥ api sarvāmaraiśvaryaṃ tyajeyurna punarjayam
nanu tatrāpi bhīmena pārthena ca mahātmanā
bhīṣmasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā bhāradvājo mahāmatāḥ
purā yuddhātsādhu manye pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṅgatam
na hyasya triṣu lokeṣu sadṛśo'sti dhanurdharaḥ
tataḥ sa sañjayaṃ rājā paryapṛcchata pāṇḍavān
śrutveha bahulāḥ senāḥ prītyarthaṃ naḥ samāgatāḥ
ke svidenaṃ vārayanti yuddhācchāmyeti vā punaḥ
yudhiṣṭhirasya bhadraṃ te sa sarvānanuśāsti ca
yaḥ pramāṇaṃ mahārāja dharme dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
yasya bāhubale tulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana yo vai sarvānmahīpālānvaśe cakre dhanurdharaḥ
yasya vīryeṇa sahasā catvāro bhuvi pāṇḍavāḥ
kṛṣṇāyāṃ caratā prītiṃ yena krodhavaśā hatāḥ
yaḥ pratīcīṃ diśaṃ cakre vaśe mlecchagaṇāyutām
sa tatra nakulo yoddhā citrayodhī vyavasthitaḥ
aśvatthāmā dhṛṣṭaketū rukmī pradyumna eva ca
tapaścacāra yā ghoraṃ kāśikanyā purā satī
pāñcālasya sutā jajñe daivācca sa punaḥ pumān
strīpuṃsīḥ puruṣavyāghra yaḥ sa veda guṇāguṇān
yaṃ yakṣaḥ puruṣaṃ cakre bhīṣmasya nidhanecchayā
raṇe tena virāṭena bhavitā vaḥ samāgamaḥ
yaḥ sa kāśipatī rājā vārāṇasyāṃ mahārathaḥ
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ prācyodīcyā mahīkṣitaḥ
sarva ete mahotsāhā ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ
ekatastveva te sarve sametā bhīma ekataḥ
bhīmasenāddhi me bhūyo bhayaṃ sañjāyate mahat
jāgarmi rātrayaḥ sarvā dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasan
sarveṣāṃ mama putrāṇāṃ sa ekaḥ krūravikramaḥ
udvepate me hṛdayaṃ ye me duryodhanādayaḥ
tasya vīryeṇa saṃkliṣṭā nityameva sutā mama
sañjayācakṣva me śūraṃ bhīmasenamamarṣaṇam - - b.......... ye'haṃ yattena ripughātinā
yena bhīmabalā yakṣā rākṣasāśca purā hatāḥ
kathaṃ tasya raṇe vegaṃ mānuṣaḥ prasahiṣyati
na sa jātu vaśe tasthau mama bālye'pi sañjaya
kiṃ punarmama duṣputraiḥ kliṣṭaḥ saṃprati pāṇḍavaḥ
iti bālye śrutaḥ pūrvaṃ mayā vyāsamukhātpurā
śataghnīṃ śatanirhādāṃ kathaṃ śakṣyanti me sutāḥ
krośato me na śrṛṇvanti bālāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ
viṣamaṃ na hi manyante prāpataṃ madhudarśinaḥ
prahitāṃ duḥkhasaṃsparśāṃ kathaṃ śakṣyanti me sutāḥ
agneḥ prajvalitasyeva api mucyeta me prajā
pravekṣyati raṇe senāṃ putrāṇāṃ me vṛkodaraḥ
prabhaṅkṣyati raṇe senāṃ putrāṇāṃ mama sañjaya
yanna tasya vaśe jagmuḥ kevalaṃ daivameva tat
sa mokṣyati raṇe tejaḥ putreṣu mama sañjaya
paśyannapi jayaṃ teṣāṃ na niyacchāmi yatsutān
pautrā bhīṣmasya śiṣyāśca droṇasya ca kṛpasya ca
sa vai śocāmi sarvānvai ye yuyutsanti pāṇḍavaiḥ
na tu manye vighātāya jñānaṃ duḥkhasya sañjaya
saṃśaye tu mahatyasminkiṃ nu me kṣamamuttaram
kiṃ nu kuryāṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ kva nu gacchāmi sañjaya
ete naśyanti kuravo mandāḥ kālavaśaṃ gatāḥ
avaśo'haṃ tadā tāta putrāṇāṃ nihate śate
śroṣyāmi ninadaṃ strīṇāṃ kathaṃ māṃ maraṇaṃ spṛśet
yathā nidāghe jvalanaḥ samaddho dahetkakṣaṃ vāyunā codyamānaḥ
gadāhastaḥ pāṇḍavo vai tathaiva hantā madīyānsahito'rjunena
tasyaiva ca na paśyāmi yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ
mahānsyātsaṃśayo loke na tvasti vijayo mama
ghṛṇī karṇaḥ pramādī ca ācāryaḥ sthaviro guruḥ
sarve hyastravidaḥ śūrāḥ sarve prāptā mahadyaśaḥ
na tu hantārjunasyāsti jetā cāsya na vidyate
manyustasya kathaṃ śāmyenmandānprati ya utthitaḥ anye'pyastrāṇi jānanti jīyante ca jayanti ca
naivāsti no dhanustadṛṅva yoddhā na ca sārathiḥ tacca mandā na jānanti duryodhanavaśānugāḥ
na tu śeṣaṃ śarāstāta kuryurastāḥ kirīṭinā
vitrastā bahudhā senā bhāratī pratibhāti me
yadā hayabhīkṣṇaṃ subuhūnprakārān śrotāsmi tānāvasathe kurūṇām
teṣāṃ samantācca tathā raṇāgre kṣayaḥ kilāyaṃ bharatānupaiti
sa sraṣṭā jagataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ jaye dhṛtaḥ
mayābhyāṃ bhīmasenācca bhayaṃ me tāta jāyate
na me sainyāstariṣyanti tataḥ krośāmi sañjaya
dhṛtyā ca puruṣavyāghro naibhṛtyena ca pāṇḍavaḥ
yuddhe vināśaḥ kṛtsnasya kulasya bhavitā dhruvam
eṣā me paramā buddhiryayā śāmyati me manaḥ
yadi tvayuddhamiṣṭaṃ vo vayaṃ śāntyai yatāmahe
idaṃ tu nābhijānāmi tava dhīrasya nityaśaḥ
āstheyaṃ hi hitaṃ tena na drogdhā gururucyate
asyatāṃ phālgunaḥ śreṣṭho gāṇḍīvaṃ dhanuṣāṃ varam keśavaḥ sarvabhūtānāmāyudhānāṃ sudarśanam
evametāni sa ratho vahate saha yo raṇe
yasya bhīmārjinau yodhau sa rājā rājasattama
pārthaṃ hyete gatāḥ sarve vīryajñāstasya dhīmataḥ
bhaktyā hyasya virudhyante tava putraiḥ sadaiva te
dyūtakāle mayā coktaṃ vidureṇa ca dhīmatā
na bhetavyaṃ mahārāja na śocyā bhavatāṃ vayam
samarthāḥ sma parāñjetuṃ balinaḥ samare vibho
tataḥ sthāsyanti samaye pāṇḍavā iti me matiḥ
ṛte ca vidurātsarve yūyaṃ vadhyā matā mama
samucchedaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ naḥ kṛtvā tāta janārdanaḥ
tatra kiṃ prāptakālaṃ naḥ praṇipātaḥ palāyanam
dhikkṛtāḥ pārthivaiḥ sarvaiḥ svajanena ca sarvaśaḥ
praṇipāte na doṣosti sandhirnaḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
matkṛte duḥkhamāpannaṃ kleśaṃ prāptamanantakam kṛtaṃ hi tava putraiśca pareṣāmavarodhanam
abhidrugdhāḥ pare cenno na bhetavyaṃ parantapa
ātmānaṃ manyate sarvo vyetu te bhayamāgatam
jetuṃ samagrāṃ senāṃ me vāsavo'pi na śaknuyāt
tanmithyā na hi me kṛtsnaṃ prabhāvaṃ vetsi bhārata
matsamo hi gadāyuddhe pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana
tasmānna bhīmānnānyebhyo bhayaṃ me vidyate kvacit
duryodhanasamo nāsti gadāyāmiti niścayaḥ saṅkarṣaṇasya bhavane yattadainamupāvasam
gadāprahāraṃ bhīmo me na jātu viṣahedyudhi
ekaṃ prahāraṃ yaṃ dadyāṃ bhīmāya ruṣito nṛpa
suciraṃ prārthito hyeṣa mama nityaṃ manorathaḥ
gadayā nihato hyājau mayā pārtho vṛkodaraḥ
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ karṇo bhūriśravāstathā
ekaika eṣāṃ śaktastu hantuṃ bhārata pāṇḍavān
na hantā vidyate cāpi rājanbhīṣmasya kaścana
ayonijāstrayo hyete pitā mātā ca mātulaḥ
aśvatthāmno mahārāta sa ca śūraḥ sthito mama
bhīṣmādroṇakṛpāṇāṃ ca tulyaḥ karṇo mato mama
kuṇḍale rucire cāstāṃ karṇasya sahaje śubhe
te śacyarthaṃ mahendreṇa yācitaḥ sa parantapaḥ
vijayo me dhruvaṃ rājanphalaṃ pāṇāvivāhitam abhivyaktaḥ pareṣāṃ ca kṛtsno bhuvi parājayaḥ
ahnā hyekena bhīṣmoyaṃ prayutaṃ hanti bhārata
bhīmasene ca nihate ko'nyo yudhyeta bhārata
pañca te bhrātaraḥ sarve dhṛṣṭadyumno'tha sātyakiḥ
pareṣāṃ sapta ye rājanyodhāḥ sāraṃ balaṃ matam
akṣauhiṇyo hi me rājandaśaikā ca samāhṛtāḥ
balaṃ triguṇato hīnaṃ yodhyaṃ prāha bṛhaspatiḥ
guṇahīnaṃ pareṣāṃ ca bahu paśyāmi bhārata
nyūnatāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca na mohaṃ gantumarhasi
akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta labdhvā rājabhiḥ saha sañjaya
rathaṃ tu divyaṃ kaunteyaḥ sarvā vibhrājayandiśaḥ
tamapaśyāma sannaddhaṃ meghaṃ vidyudyutaṃ yathā samantātsamabhidhyā hṛṣyamāṇo'bhyabhāṣata
arjunasya rathe brūhi kathamaśvāḥ kathaṃ dhvajāḥ
rūpāṇi kalpayāmāsa tvaṣṭā dhātā sadā vibho
mahādhanāni divyāni mahānti ca laghūni ca
sarvā diśo yojanamātramantaraṃ satiryagūrdhvaṃ ca rurodha vai dhvajaḥ
na saṃsañjettarubhiḥ saṃvṛto'pi tathā hi māyā vihitā bhaumanena
yathā''kāśe śakradhanuḥ prakāśate na caikavarṇaṃ na ca vedmi kiṃ nu tat
tathā dhvajo vihito bhaumanena bahvākāraṃ dṛśyate rūpamasya
tathā dhvajo vihito bhaumanena na cedbhāro bhavitā nota rodhaḥ
bhuvyantarikṣe divi vā narendra yeṣāṃ gatirhīyate nātra sarvā śataṃ yattatpūryate nityakālaṃ hataṃhataṃ dattavaraṃ purastāt
tathā rājño dantavarṇā bṛhanto rathe yuktā bhānti tadvīryatulyāḥ
ṛkṣaprakhyā bhīmasenasya vāhā rathe vāyostulyavega babhūvuḥ
bhrāturbīrasya svaisturaṅgairviśiṣṭā mudā yuktāḥ sahadevaṃ vahanti
mādrīputraṃ nakulaṃ tvājamīḍhaṃ mahendradattā harayo vājimukhyāḥ
samā vāyorbalavantastarasvino vahanti vīraṃ vṛtraśatruṃ yathendram
ye yotsyante pāṇḍavārthe putrasya mama vāhinīm
cekitānaṃ ca tatraiva yuyudhānaṃ ca sātyakim
yo veda mānuṣaṃ vyūhaṃ daivaṃ gāndharvamāsuram
bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo rājanbhāgaḥ klṛptaḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ taṃ virāṭo'nusaṃyātā sārdhaṃ matsyaiḥ prahāribhiḥ
arjunasya tu bhāgena karṇe vaikartano mataḥ
trigartānāṃ ca vai mukhyau yau tau saṃśaptakāviti
saubhadreṇa kṛto bhāgo rājā caiva bṛhadbalaḥ
ulūkaṃ caiva kaitavyaṃ ye ca sārasvatā gaṇāḥ
na santi sarve putrā me mūḍhā durdyūtadevinaḥ
yeṣāṃ yudhiṣṭhiro netā goptā ca madhusūdanaḥ
pitāmahaṃ ca droṇaṃ ca kṛpaṃ karṇaṃ ca durjayam
aśaktaḥ samare jetuṃ kiṃ punastāta pāṇḍavāḥ
sarve ca pṛthivīpālā madarthe tāta pāṇḍavān
matpriyaṃ pārthivāḥ sarve ye cikīrṣanti bhārata
unmatta iva me putro vilapatyeṣa sañjaya
na hi śakto rame jetuṃ dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
jānāti hi yathā bhīṣmaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ yaśasvinām
kiṃ tu sañjaya me brūhi punasteṣāṃ viceṣṭitam
bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ karṇaṃ drauṇiṃ śalyaṃ suyodhanam
tathā bruvantaṃ dharmātmā prāha rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
tava dhairyaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca pāñcālaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
sa tvaṃ śūraśca vīraśca vikrāntaśca nararṣabha
evaṃ bruvati kaunteye dharmātmani yudhiṣṭhire dhṛṣṭadyumna uvācedaṃ māṃ vaco gatasādhvasam
duḥśāsanaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca tathā duryodhanaṃ nṛpam bhīṣmaṃ ca brūhi gatvā tvamāśu gaccha ca māciram
rājyaṃ daddhvaṃ dharmarājasya tūrṇaṃ yācadhvaṃ vai pāṇḍavaṃ lokavīram
na sajeyomanuṣyeṇa mā sma kṛddhvaṃ mano yudhi
jāta eṣa tavābhāvastvaṃ tu mohānna buddhyase
na ca bhīṣmo na ca droṇo nāśvatthāmā na sañjayaḥ
na somadatto na śalo na kṛpo yuddhamicchati
te yuddhaṃ nābhinandanti tattubhyaṃ tāta rocatām
na tvaṃ karoṣi kāmena karṇaḥ kārayitā tava
nāhaṃ bhavati na droṇe nāśvatthāmni na sañjaye
na bhīṣme na kāmbhoje na kṛpe na ca bāhlike
anyeṣu vā tāvakeṣu bhāraṃ kutvā samāhvayam
ahaṃ ca tāta karṇaśca raṇayajñaṃ vitatya vai
ratho vedī sruvaḥ khaṅgo gadā sruk kavaco'jinam
cāturhotraṃ ca dhuryā me śarā darbhā haviryaśaḥ
vijitya ca sameṣyāvo hatāmitrau śriyā vṛtau
ahaṃ ca tāta karṇaśca bhrātā duḥśāsanaśca me
māṃ vā hatvā pāṇḍuputrā bhoktāraḥ pṛthivīmimāṃ
tyaktaṃ me jīvitaṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ sarvaṃ ca pārthiva
balaṃ kurūṇāṃ bhīmena tadā smartāsi me vacaḥ
yajarjuna uvāca tvāṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ ca śalyaṃ ca mahārājaṃ ca bāhlikam
drauṇiṃ ca saumadattiṃ ca śakuniṃ cāpi saubalam
vikarṇaṃ citrasenaṃ ca jayatsenaṃ ca pārthivam
bhagadattaṃ ca rājānaṃ jalasandhaṃ ca pauravam
ye cāpyanye pārthivāstatra yoddhuṃ samāgatāḥ kauravāṇāṃ priyārtham
mumūrṣavaḥ pāṇḍavāgnau pradīpte samānītā dhārtarāṣṭroṇa sūta
yathānyāyaṃ kuśalaṃ vandanaṃ ca samāgatā madvacanena vācyāḥ
idaṃ brūvāḥ sañjaya rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ pāpakṛtāṃ pradhānam
amarṣaṇaṃ durmatiṃ rājaputraṃ pāpātmānaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ sulubdham sarvaṃ mamaitadvacanaṃ samagraṃ sahāmātyaṃ sañjaya śrāvayethāḥ
evaṃ pariṣvajya dhanañjayo māṃ tato'rthavaddharmavaccāpi vākyam
yathāśrutaṃ te vadato mahātmano yadupravīrasya vacaḥ samāhitam
tathaiva vācyaṃ bhavatāpi madvacaḥ samāgateṣu kṣitipeṣu sarvaśaḥ
yathā na homaḥ kriyate mahāmṛdhe tathā sametya prayatadhvamādṛtāḥ
nayāmi vaḥ sāśvapadātikuñjarāndiśaṃ pitṝṇāmaśivāṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tato'hamāmantrya caturbhujaṃ hariṃ dhanañjayaṃ caiva namasya satvaram
javena saṃprāpta ihāmaradyute tavāntikaṃ prāpayituṃ vaco mahat
yadā tu mene bhūyiṣṭhaṃ tadvaco guṇadoṣataḥ
punareva kurūṇāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca buddhimān śaktiṃ śaṅkhyātumārebhe tadā vai manujādhipaḥ
priyāmi caiṣāṃ kurvanti yathāśakti hitāni ca
te devaiḥ sahitāḥ pārthā na śakyāḥ prativīkṣitum
rathaśca caturantāyāṃ yasya nāsti samaḥ kṣitau
yaṃ cātimānuṣaṃ vīrye kṛtsno loko vyavasyati
devānāmapi jetāraṃ yaṃ viduḥ pārthivā raṇe
yamāha bhīṣmo droṇaśca kṛpo drauṇistathaiva ca
madrarājastathā śalyo madhyasthā ye ca mānavāḥ
śamo me rocate nityaṃ pārthaistāta na vigrahaḥ
yadvā paramakaṃ tejo yena yuktā divaukasaḥ
aśmavarṣaṃ ca vāyuṃ ca śamayāmīha nityaśaḥ
bhayānakāni viṣaye vyālādīni na santi me
dharmiṣṭhāśca prajāḥ sarvā ītayaśca na santi me
na sma trayodaśa samāḥ pārthā duḥkhabhavāpnuyuḥ
naiva devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca rākṣasāḥ
nānyathā bhūtapūrvaṃ ca satyavāgiti māṃ viduḥ
āśvāsanārthaṃ bhavataḥ proktaṃ na ślāghayā nṛpa
saritaḥ sāgaraṃ prāpya yathā naśyanti sarvaśaḥ
parā buddhiḥ paraṃ tejo vīryaṃ ca paramaṃ mama
parā vidyā paro yogo mama tebhyo viśiṣyate
tathā tu pṛcchantamatīva pārthaṃ vaicitravīryaṃ tamacintayitvā
mithyā pratijñāya mayā yadastraṃ rāmātkṛtaṃ brahmamayaṃ purastāt
mahāparādhe hyapi yanna tena maharṣiṇā'haṃ guruṇā ca śaptaḥ
śaktaḥ pradagdhuṃ hyapi tigmatejāḥ sasāgarāmapyavaniṃ maharṣiḥ
prasāditaṃ hyasya mayā mano'bhūcchuśrūṣayā svena ca pauruṣeṇa
tadasti cāstraṃ mama sāvaśeṣaṃ tasmātsamartho'smi mamaiṣa bhāraḥ
pitāmahastiṣṭhatu te samīpe droṇaśca sarve ca narendramukhyāḥ
ṛṣiprasādena balena gatvā pārthānhaniṣyāmi mamaiṣa bhāraḥ
evaṃ bruvantaṃ tamuvāca bhīṣmaḥ kiṃ katthase kālaparītabuddhe
na karṇa jānāsi yathā pradhāne hate hatāḥ syurdhṛtarāṣṭraputrāḥ
yatkhāṇḍavaṃ dāhayatā kṛtaṃ hi kṛṣṇadvitīyena dhanañjayena
śrutvaiva tatkarma niyantumātmā yuktastvayā vai sahabāndhavena
yāṃ cāpi śaktiṃ tridaśādhipaste dadau mahātmā bhagavānmahendraḥ
bhasmīkṛtāṃ tāṃ samare viśīrṇāṃ cakrāhatāṃ drakṣyasi keśavena
yaste śaraḥ sarpamukho vibhāti sadā'gryamālyairmahitaḥ prayatnāt
sa pāṇḍuputrābhihataḥ śaraughaiḥ saha tvayā yāsyati karṇa nāśam
bāṇasya bhaumasya ca karṇa hantā kirīṭinaṃ rakṣati vāsudevaḥ
yastvādṛśānāṃ ca varīyasāṃ ca hantā ripūṇāṃ tumule pragāḍhe
asaṃśayaṃ vṛṣṇipatiryathoktastathā ca bhūyāṃśca tato mahātmā
ahaṃ yaduktaḥ paruṣaṃ tu kiṃcitpitāmahastasya phalaṃ śṛṇotu
nyasyāmi śastrāṇi na jātu saṅkhye pitāmaho drakṣyati māṃ sabhāyām
tvayi praśānte tu mama prabhāvaṃ drakṣyanti sarve bhuvi bhūmipālāḥ
ityevamuktvā sa mahādhanuṣmān hitvā sabhāṃ svaṃ bhavanaṃ jagāma
bhīṣmastu duryodhanameva rājan madhye kurūṇāṃ prahasannuvāca
satyapratijñaḥ kila sūtaputrastathā kasa bhāraṃ viṣaheta kasmāt
vyūhaṃ prativyūhya śirāṃsi bhittvā lokakṣayaṃ paśyata bhīmasenāt
ahaṃ haniṣyāmi sadā pareṣāṃ sahasraśaścāyutaśaśca yodhān
tathoktavākye nṛpatīndra bhīṣme nikṣipya śastrāṇi gate ca karṇe
vayaṃ ca te'pi tulyā vai vīryeṇa ca parākramaiḥ
samena vayasā caiva prātibhena śrutena ca
astreṇa yodhayugyā ca śīghratve kauśale tathā
nāhaṃ bhavati na droṇe na kṛpe na ca bāhlike
ahaṃ vaikartanaḥ karṇo bhrātā duḥśāsanaśca me
brāhmaṇāṃstarpayiṣyāmi gobhiraśvairdhanena ca yadā parikariṣyanti aiṇeyāniva tantunā
tadā darpaṃ vimokṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ sa ca keśavaḥ
mohito mṛtyupāśena kālasya vaśamāgataḥ tāta karṇena sahitaḥ putro duryodhano mama
yeṣāṃ ca pratiṣedhārthaṃ kṣatraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā
tasya liṅgaṃ pravakṣyāmi yeṣāṃ samudayo damaḥ
etāni yasya rājendra sa dāntaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
kāmo lobhaśca darpaśca manyurnidrā vikatthanam māna īrṣyāṃ ca śokaśca naitaddānto niṣevate
prāpyeha loke saṃmānaṃ sugatiṃ pretya gacchati
yatra vai vivadiṣyete tatra me vaśameṣyataḥ
upasṛtya pramattau tau jagrāha mṛgahā tadā
evaṃ ye jñātayo'rtheṣu mitho gacchanti vigraham
ye sma kāle sumanasaḥ sarve vṛddhānupāsate
śrutvā tadapi kauravya yathā śreyastathā kuru
na ca paśyāmi tejosya vikramaṃ vā tathāvidham
virāṭanagare bhagnāḥ kiṃ tatra tava dṛśyatām
pratīkṣamāṇo yo vīraḥ kṣamate vīkṣitaṃ tava
bhīmasenaṃ ca kaunteyaṃ yasya nāsti samo bale
yudhi gāṇḍivadhanvānaṃ ko nu yudhyeta buddhimān
taṃ kṛṣṇaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ ko nu yuddhyeta buddhimān
droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca mahārājaṃ ca bāhlikam
utsṛjya gāḥ susantrastaṃ balaṃ te samaśīryata
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam
ātmanaśca pareṣāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca niścayam
gāvalgaṇe brūhi naḥ sāraphalgu svesanāyaṃ yāvadihāsti kiṃcit
tvaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ nipuṇaṃ vettha sarvaṃ kimeṣāṃ jyāyaḥ kimu teṣāṃ kanīyaḥ
sa me pṛṣṭaḥ sañjaya brūhi sarvaṃ yudhyamānāḥ katare'sminna santi
na tvāṃ brūyāṃ rahite jātu kiṃcidasūyā hi tvāṃ praviśeta rājan
ānayasva pitaraṃ mahāvrataṃ gāndhārīṃ ca mahiṣīmājamīḍha
to te'sūyāṃ vinayetāṃ narendra dharmajñau tau nipuṇau niścayajñau
tayostu tvāṃ sannidhau tadvadeyaṃ kṛtsnaṃ mataṃ keśavapārthayoryat
saṃpṛcchate dhṛtarāṣṭraya sañjaya ācakṣva sarvaṃ yāvadeṣo'nuyuṅkte
narakaṃ śambaraṃ caiva kaṃsaṃ caidyaṃ ca mādhavaḥ
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca dyāṃ caiva puruṣottamaḥ
na tu kṛtsnaṃ jagacchaktaṃ kiñcitkartuṃ janārdane
yataḥ satyaṃ yato dharmo yato hrīrārjavaṃ yataḥ
tato bhavati govindo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca divaṃ ca puruṣottamaḥ
kālasya ca hi mṛtyośca jaṅgamasthāvarasya ca
ye tameva prapadyante na te muhyanti mānavāḥ
śrṛṇu rājanna te vidyā mama vidyā na hīyate
gāvalgaṇe'tra kā bhaktiryā te nityā janārdane
māyāṃ na seve bhadraṃ te na vṛthādharmamācare
āpto naḥ sañjayastāta śaraṇaṃ gaccha keśavam
aiśvaryajītite hitvā pitaraṃ māṃ ca bāliśa
vardhayandurhṛdāṃ prītiṃ māṃ ca śokena vardhayan
yasya te sañjayo dūto yastvāṃ śreyasi yokṣyate
jānātyeṣa hṛṣīkeśaṃ purāṇaṃ yacca vai param
sitā bahuvidhaiḥ pāśairye na tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ
eṣa ekāyanaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛtyumatyeti mahāṃstatra na sañjati
buddhiśca te mā cyuvatu niyacchaināṃ yatastataḥ
etajjñānaṃ ca panthāśca yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
yataḥ satvaṃ na cyavate yacca yatvānna hīyate
pūraṇātsadanāccāpi tato'saupuruṣottamaḥ asataśca sataścaiva sarvasya prabhavāpyayāt
atattvaṃ kurute tattvaṃ tena mohayate prajāḥ
cakṣuṣmatāṃ vai spṛhayāmi sañjaya drakṣyanti ye vāsudevaṃ samīpe
vibhrājamānaṃ vapuṣā pareṇa prakāśayantaṃ pradiśo diśaśca
nihantāraṃ kṣobhaṇaṃ śātravāṇāṃ muñcantaṃ ca dviṣatāṃ vai yaśāṃsi
draṣṭāro hi kuravastaṃ sametā mahātmānaṃ śabruhaṇaṃ vareṇyam
ṛṣiṃ sanātanatabhaṃ vipaścitaṃ vācaḥsamudraṃ kalaśaṃ yatīnām
ariṣṭanemiṃ garuḍaṃ suparṇaṃ hariṃ prajānāṃ bhuvanasya dhāma
śukrasya dhātāramajaṃ ca nityaṃ paraṃ pareṣāṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
narādhipānāṃ viduṣāṃ pradhānamindrānujaṃ taṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye
prayāte sañjaye sādhau kauravānprati vai tadā
arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca mādrīputrau ca bhārata
virāṭaṃ drupadaṃ caiva kekayānāṃ mahārathān abruvīdupasaṅgamya śaṅkhacakragadādharam
yathā bhīṣmeṇa droṇena bāhlīkena ca dhīmatā
anyaiśca kurubhiḥ sārdhaṃ na yudhyemahi saṃyuge
eṣa naḥ prathamaḥ kalpa etanniśreya uttamam
tadā ca duḥsahāḥ sarve sadasyāste nararṣabhāḥ
janārdanaṃ samāsādya kuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ abravītparavīradhnaṃ dāśārhaṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāpto mitrāṇāṃ mitravatsala
na ca tvadanyaṃ paśyāmi yo na āpatsu tārayet
tathā te pāṇḍavā rakṣyāḥ pāhyasmānmahato bhayāt
kariṣyāmi hi tatsarvaṃ yattvaṃ vakṣyasi bhārata
śrutaṃ te dhṛtarāṣṭrasya saputrasya cikīrṣitam etaddhi sakalaṃ kṛṣṇa sañjayo māṃ yadabravīt - - a mṛdupūrvaṃ sāmamiśraṃ samamugraṃ ca mādhava na katṛṃ nyāyamāsthāya garhitāśca tato vayam
yathoktaṃ dūta ācaṣṭe vadhyaḥ syādanyathā bruvan
sthātā naḥ samaye tasmindhṛtarāṣṭra iti prabho
nāhāsma samayaṃ kṛṣṇa taddhi no brāhmaṇā viduḥ
ito duḥkhataraṃ kiṃ nu yadahaṃ mātaraṃ tataḥ
saṃvidhātuṃ na śaknomi mitrāṇāṃ vā janārdana
bhavatā caiva nāthena pañca grāmā vṛtā mayā
pañca nastāta dīyantāṃ grāmā vā nagarāṇi vā
vasema sahitā yeṣu mā ca no bharatā naśan
lobhaḥ prajñānamāhanti prajñā hanti hatā hriyaṃ
hrīrhatā bādhate dharmaṃ dharmo hanti hataḥ śriyam
dhanamāhuḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ dhane sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
jīvanti dhanino loke mṛtā ye tvadhanā narāḥ
te dharmamarthaṃ kāmaṃ ca pramathnanti naraṃ ca tam
na tathā bādhyate kṛṣṇa prakṛtyā nirdhano janaḥ
yathā bhadrāṃ śriyaṃ prāpya tayā hīnaḥ sukhaidhitaḥ
nādharme kurute buddhiṃ na ca pāpe pravartate
ahrīko vā vimūḍho vā naiva strī na punaḥ pumān
tadidaṃ mayi te dṛṣṭaṃ pratyakṣaṃ madhusūdana
te vayaṃ na śriyaṃ hātumalaṃ nyāyena kenacit
atra no yatamānānāṃ vadhaścedapi sādhu tat
tatra naḥ prathamaḥ kalpo yadvayaṃ te ca mādhava
ye punaḥ syurasaṃbaddhā anāryāḥ kṛṣṇa śatravaḥ
sa naḥ svadharmo'dharmo vā vṛttiranyā vigarhitā
śūdraḥ karoti śuśrūṣāṃ vaiśmā vai paṇyajīvikāḥ
kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ hanti matsyo matsyena jīvati
śvā śvānaṃ hanti dāśārha paśya dharmo yathāgataḥ
yuddhe kṛṣṇa kalirnityaṃ prāṇāḥ sīdanti saṃyuge
nāpyakāle sukhaṃ prāpyaṃ duḥkhaṃ vā'pi yadūttama
sarvathā vṛjinaṃ yuddhaṃ ko dhnanna pratihanyate
ye hyeva dhīrā hrīmanta āryāḥ karuṇavedinaḥ
ta eva yuddhe hanyante yavīyānmucyate janaḥ
utsādayati yaḥ sarvaṃ yaśasā sa vimucyate
na cāpi vairaṃ vaireṇa keśava vyupaśāmyati
antaraṃ lipsamānānāmayaṃ doṣo nirantaraḥ pauruṣe yo hi balavānādhirhṛdayabādhanaḥ
tasya tyāgena vā śāntirmaraṇenāpi vā bhavet
yā tu tyāgena śāntiḥ syāttadṛte vadha eva saḥ
na ca tyaktuṃ tadicchāmo na cecchāmaḥ kulakṣayam
atra yā praṇipātena śāntiḥ saiva garīyasī
tatra yo balavānkṛṣṇa jitvā sotti tadāmiṣam
pitā rājā ca vṛddhaśca sarvathā mānamarhati
na mamaitanmataṃ kṛṣṇa yattvaṃ yāyāḥ kurūnprati
suyodhanaḥ sūktamapi na kariṣyati te vacaḥ
teṣāṃ madhyāvataraṇaṃ tava kṛṣṇa na rocaye
na hi naḥ prīṇayeddravyaṃ na devatvaṃ kutaḥ sukham
na ca sarvāmaraiśvaryaṃ tava droheṇa mādhava
na cāpi mama paryāptāḥ sahitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ kruddhasya saṃyuge sthātuṃ siṃhasyevetare mṛgāḥ
na jātu gamanaṃ pārtha bhavettatra nirarthakam arthaprāptiḥ kadācitsyādantato vāpyavācyatā
yattubhyaṃ rocate kṛṣṇa svasti prāpnuhi kauravān
yathā sarve sumanasaḥ saha syāma sucetasaḥ
bhrātā cāsi sakhā cāsi bībhatsormama ca priyaḥ
tattatkeśava bhāṣethāḥ sāntvaṃ vā yadi vetarat
sañjayasya śrutaṃ vākyaṃ bhavataśca śrutaṃ mayā
sarvaṃ jānāmyabhiprāyaṃ teṣāṃ ca bhavataśca yaḥ
na caivaṃ naiṣṭhikaṃ karma kṣatriyasya viśāṃpate
jayo vadho vā saṅgrāme dhātrā''diṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ
etadeva nimittaṃ te dhārtarāṣṭro yathā tvayi
brāhmaṇānāṃ ca sādhūnāṃ rājñaśca nagarasya ca
na cāpatrapate tena nṛśaṃsaḥ svena karmaṇā
nāmadheyaṃ ca gotraṃ ca tadapyeṣāṃ na śiṣyate
ślāghate jñātimadhye sma tvayi pravrajite vanam
sarve duryodhanaṃ tatra nindanti sma sabhāsadaḥ
kulīnasya ca yā nindā vadho vā'mitrakarśana
mahāguṇo vadho rājannu tu nindā kujīvikā
yattvaṃ pitari bhīṣme ca praṇipātaṃ samācareḥ
ahaṃ tu sarvalokasya gatvā chetsyāmi saṃśayam
tava saṅkīrtayiṣyāmi ye ca tasya vyatikramāḥ
śamaṃ vai yācamānastvaṃ nādharmaṃ tatra lapsyase
yatiṣye praśamaṃ kartuṃ lakṣayiṣye ca ceṣṭitam
nimittāni hi sarvāṇi tathā prādurbhavanti me
mṛgāḥ śakuntāśca vadanti ghoraṃ hastyaśvamukhyeṣu niśāmukheṣu
yodhāśca sarve kṛtaniścayāste bhavantu hastyaśvaratheṣu yattāḥ
sāṅgrāmikaṃ te yadupārjanīyaṃ sarvaṃ samagraṃ kuru tannarendra
duryodhano na hyalamadya dātuṃ jīvaṃstavaitannṛpate kathaṃcit
yatte purastādabhavatsamṛddhaṃ dyūte hṛtaṃ pāṇḍavamukhya rājyam
tathātathaiva bhāṣethā mā sma yuddhena bhīṣayeḥ
mriyetāpi na bhajyeta naiva jahyātsvakaṃ matam
nīcairbhūtvā'nuyāsyāmo mā sma no bharatā naśan
vāsudeva tathā kāryaṃ na kurūnanayaḥ spṛśet
vācyaḥ pitāmaho vṛddho ye ca kṛṣṇa samāsadaḥ
arjuno naiva yuddhārthī bhūyasī hi dayā'rjune
na ca svapiṣi jāgarṣi nyubjaḥ śeṣe parantapa
nāsmiñjane na ramase rahaḥ kṣipasi pāṇḍava
bhrukiṭiṃ ca punaḥ kurvannoṣṭhau ca vidaśanniva
yathā ca paścānnirmukto dhruvaṃ paryeti raśmivān
iti sma madhye bhrātṛṇāṃ satyenālabhase vadām
anityaṃ kila martyasya pārtha cittaṃ calācalam
sa dṛṣṭvā svāni karmāṇi kule janma ca bhārata
uttiṣṭhasva viṣādaṃ mā kṛthā vīra sthiro bhava
yadojasā na labhate kṣatriyo na tadaśrute
vetsi dāśārha satyaṃ me dīrghakālaṃ sahoṣitaḥ
uta vā māṃ na jānāsi plavanhṛda ivāplave
kathaṃ hi bhīmasenaṃ māṃ jānankaścana mādhava
ātmanaḥ pauruṣaṃ caiva balaṃ ca na samaṃ paraiḥ
yadīme sahasā kruddhe sameyātāṃ śile iva
ya etatprāya mucyeta na taṃ paśyāmi purūṣam
na hi tvaṃ nābhijānāsi mama vikramamacyuta
yathā mayā vinirjitya rājāno vaśagāḥ kṛtāḥ
atha cenmāṃ na jānāsi sūryasyevodyataḥ prabhām
vigāḍhe yudhi saṃbādhe vetsyase māṃ janārdana
draṣṭā māṃ tvaṃ ca lokaśca vikarṣantaṃ varānvarān
na me sīdanti gātrāṇi na mamodvepate manaḥ
sarvalokādabhikruddhānna bhayaṃ vidyate mama kiṃ tu sauhṛdamevaitatkṛpayā madhusūdana
sarvāṃstitikṣe saṃkleśānmā sma no bharatā naśan
vedāhaṃ tava māhātmyasuta te veda yadbalam
uta te veda karmāṇi na tvāṃ paribhavāmyaham
vināśe'pi sa evāsya sandigdhaṃ karma pauruṣam
śītamuṣṇaṃ tathā varṣaṃ kṣutpipāse ca bhārata
ya evaṃ kṛtabuddhiḥ sa karmasveva pravartate
nāsiddho vyathate tasya na siddhau harṣamaśrute
śamaṃ cette kariṣyanti tato'nantaṃ yaśo mama
bhavatāṃ kaca kṛtaḥ kāmasteṣāṃ ca śreya uttamam
ahaṃ hi yantā bībhatsorbhavitā saṃyuge sati
dhanañjayasyaiṣa kāmo na hi yuddhaṃ na kāmaye
tava vākyaṃ tu me śrutvā pratibhāti parantapa
naiva praśamamatra tvaṃ manyase sukaraṃ prabho
tadidaṃ bhāṣitaṃ vākyaṃ tathācana tathaiva tat
kurvanti teṣāṃ karmāṇi yeṣāṃ nāsti phalodayaḥ
sa tathā kṛṣṇa vartasva yathā śarma bhavetparaiḥ
pāṇḍavānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca bhavānnaḥ prathamaḥ suhṛt
evaṃ ca kāryatāmeti kāryaṃ tava janārdana
bhaviṣyati ca tatsarvaṃ yathā tava cikīrṣitam
śarma taiḥ saha vā no'stu tava vā yaccikīrṣitam
vicāryamāṇo yaḥ kāmastava kṛṣṇa sa no guruḥ
na sa nārhati duṣṭātmā vadhaṃ sasutabāndhavaḥ
yena dharmasute dṛṣṭā na sā śrīrupamarṣitā
kathaṃ hi puruṣo jātaḥ kṣatriyeṣu dhanurdharaḥ
kriyā kathaṃca mukhyā syānmṛdunā cetareṇa vā
tasmādyanmanyase yuktaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ hitaṃ ca yat
evametanmahābāho yathā vadasi pāṇḍava pāṇḍavānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca pratipatsye nirāmayam
tatra vai pauruṣaṃ brūyurāsekaṃ yatra kāritam
daive ca mānuṣe caiva saṃyuktaṃ lokakāraṇam
devaṃ tu na mayā śakyaṃ karma kartuṃ kathaṃcana
sa hi dharmaṃ ca lokaṃ ca tyaktvā carati durmatiḥ
na hi santapyate tena tathārūpeṇa karmaṇā
sa hi tyāgena rājyasya na śamaṃ samupaiṣyati
yācyamānaśca rājyaṃ sa na prajāsyati durmatiḥ
na tu manye sa tadvācyo yadyudhiṣṭhiraśātanam
tathā pāpastu tatsarvaṃ na kariṣyati kauravaḥ
mama cāpi sa vadhyo hi jagataścāpi bhārata
tena kaumārake yūyaṃ sarve viprakṛtāḥ sadā
vipraluptaṃ ca vo rājyaṃ nṛśaṃsena durātmanā
na copaśāmyate pāpaḥ śriyaṃ dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhire
na mayā tadgṛhītaṃ ca pāpaṃ tasya cikīrṣetam
jānāsi hi mahābāho tvamapyasya paraṃ matam
saṃjānaṃstasya cātmānaṃ mama caiva paraṃ matam
vidhānaṃ vihitaṃ pārtha kathaṃ śarma bhavetparaiḥ
yattu vācā mayā śakyaṃ karmaṇā vā'pi pāṇḍava
kariṣye tadahaṃ pārtha na tvāśaṃse śamaṃ paraiḥ
kathaṃ goharaṇe hyukto naitaccharma tathā hitam
lavaśaḥ kṣaṇaśaścāpi na ca tuṣṭaḥ suyodhanaḥ
sarvathā tu mayā kāryaṃ dharmarājasya śāsanam
vibhāvyaṃ tasya bhūyaśca karma pāpaṃ durātmanaḥ
dharmajñena vadānyena śrutaṃ caiva hi tattvayā
na tathā praṇayo rājye yathā saṃprati vartate
āttaśastrānraṇe dṛṣṭvā na vyathediha kaḥ pumān
brūyādvākyaṃ yathā mando na vyatheta suyodhanaḥ
sahadevaṃ ca māṃ caiva tvāṃ ca rāmaṃ ca keśava
sātyakiṃ ca mahāvīryaṃ virāṭaṃ ca mahātmajam
drupadaṃ ca mahāmātyaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca mādhava
kāśirājaṃ ca vikrāntaṃ dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca cedipam
śrotā cārthasya vidurastvaṃ ca vaktā janārdana
tathāpi yuddhaṃ dāśārha yojayethāḥ sahaiva taiḥ
kathaṃ nu dṛṣṭvā pāñcālīṃ tathā kṛṣṇa sabhāgatām
kṛcchre vane vā vastavyaṃ pure vā nāgasāhvaye
evaṃ vadi vākyaṃ tu yuyudhāne mahāmatau
saṃpūjya sahadevaṃ ca sātyakiṃ ca mahāratham
yathā ca sañjayo rājñā mantraṃ rahasi śrāvitaḥ
yathoktaḥ sañjayaścaiva tacca sarvaṃ śrutaṃ tvayā
pañca nastāta dīyantāṃ grāmā iti mahādyute
na cāpi hyakarodvākyaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇa suyodhanaḥ
śakṣyanti hi mahābāho pāṇḍavāḥ sṛñjayaiḥ saha
na hi sāmnā na dānena śakyo'rthasteṣu kaścana
tasmātteṣu na kartavyā kṛpā te madhusūdana
sāmnā dānena vā kṛṣṇa ye na śāmyanti śatravaḥ
tvayā caiva mahābāho pāṇḍavaiḥ saha sṛñjayaiḥ
sa vadhyasyāvadhe dṛṣṭa iti dharmavido viduḥ
yathā tvāṃ na spṛśedeṣa doṣaḥ kṛṣṇa tathā kuru
kā tu sīmantinī mādṛkaṃ pṛthivyāmasti keśava
dhṛṣṭadyumnasya bhaginī tava kṛṣṇa priyā sakhī
sutā me pañcabhirvīraiḥ pañca jātā mahārathāḥ
abhimanyuryathā kṛṣṇa tathā te tava dharmataḥ
sā'haṃ keśagrahaṃ prāptā parikliṣṭā sabhāṃ gatā
pāhi māmiti govinda manasā cintitosi me
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva pāñcāli varārhā'si matā mama
adāsāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ santu sarathāḥ sāyudhā iti
śnuṣā bhavāmi dharmeṇa sā'haṃ dāsīkṛtā balāt
yadi te'hamanugrāhyā yadi te'sti kṛpā mayi
dhārtarāṣṭreṣu vai kopaḥ sarvaḥ kṛṣṇa vidhīyatām
pitā me yotsyate vṛddhaḥ saha putrairmahārathaiḥ
pañca caiva mahāvīryāḥ putrā me madhusūdana
yadyahaṃ tu na paśyāmi kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
trayodaśa hi varṣāṇi pratīkṣantyā gatāni me
dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ kālapakvā na cecchṛṇvanti me vacaḥ
caleddhi himavāñśailo medinī śatadhā bhavet dyauḥ patecca sanakṣatrā na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet - - a śuṣyettoyanidhiḥ kṛṣṇe na me moghaṃ vaco bhavet satyaṃ te pratijānāmi kṛṣṇe bāṣpo nigṛhyatām
tato vyapete tamasi sūrye vimala udgate
ratha āropyatāṃ śaṅkhaścakraṃ ca gadayā saha
pūjitaḥ prayayau kṛṣṇaḥ kurūṇāṃ sadanaṃ prati
yo vai na kāmānna bhayānna lobhānnārthakāraṇāt
asmatkṛte ca satataṃ yayā duḥkhāni mādhava
api jātu sa kālaḥ syātkṛṣṇa duḥkhaviparyayaḥ
sā nūnaṃ mriyate duḥkhaiḥ sā cejjīvati keśava
bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva mahārājaṃ ca vāhlikam
drauṇiṃ ca somadattaṃ ca sarvāṃśca bharatānpṛthak
yathāvayo yathāsthānaṃ prapadyasva janārdana viduraṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ kurūṇāṃ mantradhāriṇam
yadasmākaṃ vibho vṛttaṃ purā vai mantraniścaye
tasya taṃ ninadaṃ śrutvā saṃprāvepanta dhanvinaḥ
ityuktvā keśavaṃ tatra tathā cohvā viniścayam
kaccillokeṣu kuśalaṃ kacciddharmaḥ svanuṣṭhitaḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ trayo varṇāḥ kaccittiṣṭhanti śāsane
tebhyaḥ prayujya tāṃ pūjāṃ provāca madhusūdanaḥ
kiṃ vā kāryaṃ bhagavatāmahaṃ kiṃ karavāṇi yaḥ
adhaśśirāḥ sarpamālī maharṣiḥ sa hi devalaḥ arvāvasuḥ sujānuśca maitreyaḥ śunako balī
śīlavānaśanirdhātā śūnyapālo'kṛtavraṇaḥ śvetaketuḥ kaholaśca rāmaścaiva mahātapāḥ
daivāsurasya druṣṭāraḥ purāṇasya mahāmate sameta pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ didṛkṣantaśca sarvataḥ
sabhāyāṃ madhurā vācaḥ śuśrūṣantastvayeritāḥ kurūṇāṃ prativācaśca śrotumicchāma mādhava
tvaṃ ca yādavaśārdūla sabhāyāṃ vai sameṣyatha
tava vākyāni divyāni tathā teṣāṃ ca mādhava śrotumicchāma govinda satyāni ca hitāni ca
padātīnāṃ sahasraṃ ca sādināṃ ca parantapa
tāni me śrṛṇu sarvāṇi daivānyautpātikāni ca
viparitā diśaḥ sarvā na prājñāyata kiṃcana
yatrayatra ca vārṣṇeyo vartate pathi bhārata
vavarṣa puṣpavarṣaṃ ca kamalāni ca bhūriśaḥ
taṃ kiranti mahātmānaṃ vanyaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sugandhibhiḥ
tasya tanmatamājñāya cakrurāvasathaṃ narāḥ kṣaṇena cānnapānāni rarāvanti samārjayan
bhuktā ca saha taiḥ sarvairavasattāṃ kṣapāṃ sukham
droṇaṃ ca sañjayaṃ caiva viduraṃ ca mahāmatim
sa no mānyaśca pūjyaśca sarvathā madhusūdanaḥ
tasmindhṛtiśca vīryaṃ ca prajñā caujaśca mādhave
sa mānyatāṃ naraśreṣṭhaḥ sa hi dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
yathā prītirmahābāho tvayi jāyeta tasya vai
tathā kuruṣva gāndhāre kathaṃ vā bhīṣma manyase
mālyāni ca sugandhīni tāni rājā dadau tataḥ
tāḥ sabhāḥ keśavaḥ sarvā ratnāni vividhāni ca
sphītasya vṛṣṇirāṣṭrasya bhartā goptā ca mādhavaḥ
ādityā vasavo rudrā yathā buddhiṃ bṛhaspateḥ
pratyakṣaṃ tava dharmajña tāṃ me kathayataḥ śruṇu
divā rātrau ca bhātyeṣa sutejā vimalo maṇiḥ
śivaṃ ca ramaṇīyaṃ ca sarvartu sumahādhanam
na tu tvaṃ dharmamuddiśya tasya vā priyakāraṇāt
na ca ditsasi tebhyastāṃstacchamaṃ na kariṣyasi
arthena tu mahābāhuṃ vārṣṇeyaṃ tvaṃ jihīrṣasi
na ca vittena śakyo'sau nodyamena na garhayā
pāṇḍavānāṃ ca rājendra tadasya vacanaṃ kuru
vartasva pitṛvatteṣu vartante te hi putravat
deśaḥ kālastathā'yukto na hi nārhati keśavaḥ
na tatkuryādbudhaḥ kāryamiti me niścitā matiḥ
sa hi pūjyatamo loke kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthulalocanaḥ
na tu tasmai pradeyaṃ syāttathā kāryagatiḥ prabho
satkṛto'satkṛto vā'pi na krudhyeta janārdanaḥ nāvamaṃsyatyavajñātṝnavajñāto'pi keśavaḥ
yattu kāryaṃ mahābāho manasā kāryatāṃ gatam
dharmyamarthyaṃ ca dharmātmā dhruvaṃ vaktā janārdanaḥ
tasminvācyāḥ priyā vāco bhavatā bāndhavaiḥ saha
idaṃ tu sumahatkāryaṃ śruṇu me yatsamarthitam
pāṇḍavāśca vidheyā me sa ca prātarihaipyati
maivaṃ vocaḥ prajāpāla naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
dūtaśca hi hṛṣīkeśaḥ saṃbandhī ca priyaśca naḥ
tava putraḥ sahāmātyaḥ kṣaṇena na bhaviṣyati
pradadau puṇḍarīkākṣo ratnāni ca dhanāni ca tānprasthāpya mahābāhurupāyātkurusaṃsadam
na strī na vṛddho na śiśurvāsudevadidṛkṣayā
atha droṇaṃ sabāhlīkaṃ saputraṃ ca yaśasvinam
kṛpaṃ ca somadattaṃ ca samīyāya janārdanaḥ
atha gāṃ madhuparkaṃ cāpyudakaṃ ca janārdane
ete bālyānprabhṛtyeva guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ parasparasya suhṛdaḥ saṃmatāḥ samacetasaḥ
ahārṣuśca vanaṃ yāntaḥ samūlaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama
bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te mayā satatalālitāḥ
ye sma vāraṇaśabdena hayānāṃ heṣitena ca
krūraṃ ca ninadaṃ śrutvā śvāpadānāṃ mahāvane
na smopayānti nidrāṃ te natadarhā janārdana
ajātaśatrurdharmātmā śuddhajāmbūnadaprabhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kuruṣu sarveṣu dharmataḥ śrutavṛttataḥ
sāmarṣaḥ pāṇḍavo nityaṃ priyo bhrātuḥ priyaṃkaraḥ
śūraḥ krodhavaśānāṃ ca hiḍimbasya bakasya ca
krodhaṃ balamamarṣaṃ ca yo nidhāya paraṃtapaḥ
āste parighabāhuḥ sa madhyamaḥ pāṇḍavo balī
sa te bhrātā sakhā caiva kathamadya dhanañjayaḥ
śuśrūṣuṃ mama vārṣṇeya mādrīputraṃ pracakṣva me
bhrātṝṇāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ priyaḥ prāṇo bahiścaraḥ
kaccitsa kuśalī kṛṣṇa vatso mama sukhaidhitaḥ
api jātu mahābāho paśyeyaṃ nakulaṃ punaḥ
na labhāmi dhṛtiṃ vīra sā'dya jīvāmi paśya mām
sarvaiḥ putraiḥ priyatarā draupadī me janārdana
na nūnaṃ karmabhiḥ puṇyairaśrute puruṣaḥ sukham
na priyo mama kṛṣṇāyā bībhatsurna yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
vṛttena hi bhavatyāryo na dhanena na vidyayā
sā śokārtā ca hṛṣṭā ca dṛṣṭvā govindamāgatam
dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ parikliṣṭā yathā na kuśalaṃ tathā
na me kleśatamaṃ tatsyātputraiḥ saha parantapa
na me viśepo jātvāsīddhārtarāṣṭreṣu pāṇḍavaiḥ tena satyena kṛṣṇa tvāṃ hatāmitraṃ śriyā vṛtam
naiva śakyāḥ parājetuṃ sarvaṃ hyeṣāṃ tathāvidham
pitaraṃ tveva garheyaṃ nātmānaṃ na suyodhanam
adāttu kuntibhojāya sakhā sakhye mahātmane sā'haṃ pitrā ca nikṛtā śvaśuraiśca parantapa
yanmāṃ vāgabravīnnaktaṃ sūtake savyasācinaḥ putraste pṛthivīṃ jetā yaśaścāsya divaṃ spṛśet
kṛṣṇāya mahate nityaṃ dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ
tvaṃ cāpi tattathā kṛṣṇa sarvaṃ saṃpādayiṣyasi
na māṃ mādhava vaidhavyaṃ nārthanāśo na vairitā
tathā śokāya dahati yathā putrairvinā bhavaḥ
yā'haṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam dhanañjayaṃ na paśyāmi kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
dhanañjayaṃ ca govinda yamau taṃ ca vṛkodaram
bhūyāṃste hīyate dharmo mā putraka vṛthā kṛthāḥ
parāśrayā vāsudeva yā jīvati ghigastu tām
nṛśaṃsena ca vo yuktāṃstyajeyaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
arjunaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ vīraṃ draupadyāḥ padavīṃ cara
viditau hi tavātyantaṃ kruddhau tau tu yathāntakau
bhīmārjunau nayetāṃ hi devānapi parāṃ gatim
na hi vairaṃ samāsādya praśāmyati vṛkodaraḥ
sucirādapi bhīmasya na hi vairaṃ praśāmyati
na duḥkhaṃ rājyaharaṇaṃ na ca dyūte parājayaḥ
pravrājanaṃ tu putrāṇāṃ na me tadduḥkhakāraṇam
yattu sā bṛhatī śyāmā ekavastrā sabhāṃ gatā
aśṛṇotparuṣā vācaḥ kiṃ nu duḥkhataraṃ tataḥ
etāni pārthā nirjitya nityaṃ vīrasukhe ratāḥ
anteṣu remire dhīrā na te madhyeṣu remire
yathāyathā tvaṃ manyethāḥ kuryāḥ kṛṣṇa tathātathā
tvameva naḥ kule dharmastvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ tapo mahat
tvaṃ trātā tvaṃ mahadbrahma tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca lokānāṃ cāparājita sarvasyaitasya vārṣṇeya gatistvamasi mādhava
prabhāvo buddhivīryaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ tava keśava
duḥśāsanaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca śakuniṃ cāpi saubalam
nivedayāmāsa tadā gṛhānrājyaṃ ca kauravaḥ - - b āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ sarvaratnavibhūṣitam
kṛṣṇārthamevaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt tatra govindamāsīnaṃ prasannādityavarcasam
tato duryodhano rājā vārṣṇeyaṃ jayatāṃ varam
saṃbandhī dayitaścāsi dhṛtarāṣṭrasya mādhava tvaṃ hi govinda dharmārthau vettha tattvena sarvaśaḥ
kṛtārthā bhuñjate dūtāḥ pūjāṃ gṛhṇanti caiva ha
kṛtārthaṃ vā'kṛtārthaṃ vā tvāṃ vayaṃ madhusūdana
yatāmahe pūjayituṃ dāśārha na ca śaknumaḥ
na ca tatkāraṇaṃ vidmo yasmānno madhusūdana
vairaṃ no nāsti bhavatā govinda na ca vigrahaḥ
na ca saṃprīyate rājanna caivāpadgatā vayam
dviṣadannaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ dviṣantaṃ naiva bhojayet pāṇḍavāndviṣase rājanmama prāṇā hi pāṇḍavāḥ
yastāndveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭi yastānanu samāmanu
guṇavantaṃ ca yo dveṣṭi tamāhuḥ puruṣādhamam
sarve bhavante gacchantu sarvā me'pacitiḥ kṛtā
śraddhayā parayā yukta idaṃ vacanamabravīt saṃvṛtaistuṣya govinda etannaḥ dhanam
bhīṣme droṇe kṛpe karṇe droṇaputre jayadrathe
bhūyasīṃ vartate vṛttiṃ na śame kurute manaḥ
ekaḥ karṇaḥ parāñjetuṃ samartha iti niścitam
yatra sūktaṃ duruktaṃ ca samaṃ syānmadhusūdana
so'yaṃ balastho mūḍhaścana kariṣyati te vacaḥ
tava madhyāvataraṇaṃ mama kṛṣṇa na rocate
pratīpaṃ vacanaṃ madhye tava kṛṣṇa na rocate
tvayyasya mahatī śaṅkā na kariṣyati te vacaḥ
madhye tiṣṭhanhastyanīkasya mando rathāśvayuktasya balasya mūḍhaḥ
duryodhano manyate bītabhītiḥ kṛtsnā mayeyaṃ pṛthivī jiteti
āśaṃsate vai dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putro mahārājyamasapatnaṃ pṛthivyām
tasmiñśamaḥ kevalo nopalabhyo baddhaṃ santaṃ manyate labdhamartham
samāgatāḥ sarvayodhāḥ pṛthivyāṃ rājānaśca kṣitipālaiḥ sametāḥ
sarve caite kṛtavairāḥ purastāttvayā rājāno hṛtasārāśca kṛṣṇa
tyaktātmānaḥ saha duryodhanena hṛṣṭā yoddhuṃ pāṇḍavānsarvayodhāḥ
mṛtyurjayo veti kṛtaikabhāvāḥ kāmātmāno manyuvaśāvinītāḥ teṣāṃ madhye praviśethā yadi tvaṃ na tanmataṃ mama dāśārhavīra
prabhāvaṃ pauruṣaṃ buddhiṃ jānāmi tava śatruhan
yā me prītiḥ pāṇḍaveṣu bhūyaḥka sā tvayi mādhava
vidurasya vacaḥ śrutvā praśritaṃ puruṣottamaḥ idaṃ hovāca vacanaṃ madhuraṃ madhusūdanaḥ
satyaṃ prāptaṃ ca yuktaṃ vā'pyevameva yathā''ttha mām
prāpto bhavati tatpuṇyamatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
na prāpnoti phalaṃ tasyetyevaṃ dharmavido viduḥ
vyasane kliśyamānaṃ hi yo mitraṃ nābhipadyate
hitaṃ hi dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca
hṛdayasya ca me prītirānṛṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati
jñātīnāṃ hi mitho bhede yanmitraṃ nābhipadyate
puṇyaṃ ca me syāccaritaṃ mahātmanmucyeraṃśca kuravo mṛtyupāśāt
avekṣerandhārtarāṣṭrāḥ śamārthaṃ māṃ ca prāptaṃ kuravaḥ pūjayeyuḥ
na cāpi mama paryāptāḥ sahitāḥ sarvapārthivāḥ
sātyakiḥ kṛtavarmā ca vṛṣṇīnāṃ cāpare rathāḥ
śaṅkhāśca dadhmire tatra vādyānyanyāni yāni ca
pāṇau gṛhītvā viduraṃ sātyakiṃ ca mahāyaśāḥ
tatra tiṣṭhansa dāśārho rājamadhye parantapaḥ apaśyadantarikṣasthānṛṣīnparapurañjayaḥ
tatastānabhisaṃprekṣya nāradapramukhānṛṣīn abhyabhāṣata dāśārho bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ śanaiḥ
pārthivīṃ samitiṃ draṣṭumṛṣayo'bhyāgatā nṛpa nimantryantāmāsanaiśca satkāreṇa ca bhūyasā
naiteṣvanupaviṣṭeṣu śakyaṃ kenacidāsitum pūjā prayujyatāmāśu munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
āsanānyatha mṛṣṭāni mahānti vipulāni ca maṇikāñcanacitrāṇi samājahrustatastataḥ
teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu gṛhītārghyeṣu bhārata niṣasādāsane kṛṣṇo rājānaśca yathāsanam
duḥśāsanaḥ sātyakaye dadāvāsanamuttamam viviṃśatirdadau pīṭhaṃ kāñcanaṃ kṛtavarmaṇe
avidūre tu kṛṣṇasya karṇaduryodhanāvubhau ekāsane mahātmānau niṣīdaturamarṣaṇau
gāndhārarājaḥ śakunirgāndhārairabhirakṣitaḥ niṣasādāsane rājā sahaputro viśāṃpate
viduro maṇipīṭhe tu śuklaspardhyājinottare saṃspṛśannāsanaṃ śaurermahāmatirupāviśat
cirasya dṛṣṭvā dāśārhaṃ rājānaḥ sarva eva te amṛtasyeva nātṛpyanprekṣamāṇā janārdanam
kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca śamaḥ syāditi bhārata
idaṃ hyadya kulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvarājasu pārthiva
tvaṃ hi dhārayitā śreṣṭhaḥ kurūṇāṃ kurusattama
śakyā ceyaṃ śamayituṃ tvaṃ cedicchasi bhārata
na duṣkaro hyatra śamo mato me bharatarṣabha
ājñā tava hi rājendra kāryā putraiḥ sahānvayaiḥ
na hi tvāṃ pāṇḍavairjetuṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ mahātmabhiḥ
indropi devaiḥ sahitaḥ prasaheta kuto nṛpāḥ
yatra bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca kṛpaḥ karṇo viviṃśatiḥ
suhṛdbhiḥ sarvato guptaḥ sukhaṃ śakṣyasi jīvituṃ
etāneva purodhāya yatkṛtya ca yathā purā
etairhi sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ svaiśca bhārata
trāhi rājannimaṃ lokaṃ na naśyeyurimāḥ prajāḥ
saha bhuktvā ca pītvā ca pratiyāntu yathāgṛham
amarṣaṃ ca nirākṛtya vairāṇi ca parantapa
bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te tvayaiva parivardhitāḥ
nāhāsma samayaṃ tāta tacca no brāhmaṇā viduḥ
tasminnaḥ samaye tiṣṭha sthitānāṃ bharatarṣabha nityaṃ saṃkleśitā rājansvarājyāṃśaṃ labhemahi
tvaṃ dharmamarthaṃ saṃjānansamyaṅvastrātumarhasi gurutvaṃ bhavati prekṣya bahūnkleśāṃstitikṣmahe
sa bhavānmātṛpitṛvradasmāsu pratipadyatām gurorgarīyasī vṛttiryā ca śiṣyasya bhārata
vartāmahe tvayi ca tāṃ tvaṃ ca vartasva nastathā pitrā sthāpayitavyā hi vayamutpathamāsthitāḥ
saṃsthāpaya pathipvasmāṃstiṣṭha dharme suvartmani āhuścemāṃ pariṣadaṃ putrāste bharatarṣabha
dharmajñeṣu sabhāsatsu neha yuktamasāṃpratam yatra dharmo hyadharmeṇa satyaṃ yatrānṛtena ca
hanyate prekṣamāṇānāṃ hatāstatra sabhāsadaḥ viddho dharmo hyadharmeṇa sabhāṃ yatra prapadyate
te satyamāhurdharmyaṃ ca nyāyyaṃ ca bharatarṣabha
bruvantu te mahīpālāḥ sabhāyāṃ ye samāsate
praśāmya bharataśreṣṭha mā manyuvaśamanvagāḥ pitryaṃ tebhyaḥ pradāyāṃśaṃ pāṇḍavebhyo yathocitam
ajātaśatruṃ jānīṣe sthitaṃ dharme satāṃ sadā
saputre tvayi vṛttiṃ ca vartate yāṃ narādhipa
sa tāmavasthāṃ saṃprāpya kṛṣṇāṃ prekṣya sabhāṃ gatām
ahaṃ tu tava teṣāṃ ca śreya icchāmi bhārata
na tatra kaścidvaktuṃ hi vācaṃ prākrāmadagrataḥ
iti sarve manobhiste cintayanti sma pārthivāḥ
tathā teṣu ca sarveṣu tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu rājasu
imāṃ me sopamāṃ vācaṃ śrṛṇu satyāmaśaṅkitaḥ
tāṃ śrutvā śreya ādatsva yadi sādhviti manyase
akhilāṃ bubhuje sarvāṃ pṛthivīmiti naḥ śrutam
sa sma nityaṃ niśāpāye prātarutthāya vīryavān
asti kaścidviśiṣṭo vā madvidho vā bhavedyudhi
śūdro vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyo vā brāhmaṇo vā'pi śastrabhṛt
taṃ ca vaidyā akṛpaṇā brāhmaṇāḥ sarvato'bhayāḥ
evamuktaḥ sa rājā tu punaḥ papraccha tāndvijān
kva tau vīrau kvajanmānau kiṃkarmāṇau ca kau ca tau
āyātau mānuṣe loke tābhyāṃ yuddhyasva pārthiva
sa rājā mahatīṃ senāṃ yojayitvā ṣaḍaṅginīm
sa gatvā viṣamaṃ ghoraṃ parvataṃ gandhamādanam
na hyasminnāśrame yuddhaṃ kutaḥ śastraṃ kuto'nṛjuḥ
ahaṃ hi te vineṣyāmi yuddhaśraddhāmitaḥ param yadāhvayasi darpeṇa brāhmaṇapramukhāñjanān
brahmaṇyo bhava dharmātmā mā ca smaivaṃ punaḥ kṛthāḥ
mā ca darpasamāviṣṭaḥ vā tatte rājansamāhitam kṛtaprajño vītalobho nirahaṅkāra ātmavān
dāntaḥ kṣānto mṛduḥ saumya prajāḥ pālaya pārthiva māsma bhūyaḥ kṣipeḥ kaṃcidaviditvā balābalam
anujñātaḥ svasti gacca maivaṃ bhūyaḥ samācareḥ
etairviddhāḥ sarva eva maraṇaṃ yānti mānavāḥ
svapanti ca plavante ca cchardayanti ca mānavāḥ mūtrayante ca satataṃ rudanti ca hasanti ca
vīraṃ kapidhvajaṃ jiṣṇuṃ yasya nāsti samo yudhi
āryāṃ matiṃ samāsthāya śāmya bhārata pāṇḍavaiḥ
atha cenmanyase śreyo na me bhedo bhavediti
praśāmya bharataśreṣṭha mā ca yuddhe manaḥ kṛthāḥ
bhavatāṃ ca kuruśreṣṭha kulaṃ bahumataṃ bhuvi
te ca kṣayānte jagato hitvā lokatrayaṃ sadā
kṣayaṃ gacchanti vai sarve sṛjyante ca punaḥ punaḥ
bhūyiṣṭhena tu rājānaḥ śriyaṃ bhuktvā''yuṣaḥ kṣaye
na balaṃ balināṃ madhye balaṃ bhavati kaurava balavanto hi te sarve pāṇḍavā devavikramāḥ
mātuḥ kulaṃ pitṛkulaṃ yatra caiva pradīyate
apagāhyaiva vicitau na ca me rocate varaḥ
bhāryayā tu sa saṃmantrya saha rātrau sudharmayā
na me devamanuṣyeṣu guṇakeśyāḥ samo varaḥ
syena vā sūta kāryeṇa śāsanādvā śatakratoḥ
tatra devarṣisadṛśīṃ pūjāṃ sa prāpa nāradaḥ
eṣa vai śīlavṛttena śaucena ca viśiṣyate
adityāścaiva yaḥ putro jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛtaḥ smṛtaḥ
yatprāpya suratāṃ prāptāḥ surāḥ surapateḥ sakhe
sarvataḥ salilaṃ śītaṃ jīmūta iva varṣati
tamasā mūrchitaṃ bhāti yena nārchati darśanam
idamadbhiḥ samaṃ prāptā ye kecidbhuvi jaṅgamāḥ
mṛtā hi divase sūta punarjīvanti vai niśi
paśya yadyatra te kaścidrocate guṇato varaḥ
nāsya jātiṃ nisargaṃ vā kathyamānaṃ śrṛṇomi vai
pitaraṃ mātaraṃ cāpi nāsya jānāti kaścana
na me'tra rocate kaścidanyato vraja māciram
dānavā nivasanti sma śūrā dattavarāḥ purā
naite śakreṇa nānyena yamena varuṇena vā
jānāsi ca yathā śakro naitāñśakroti bādhituṃ
bahuśo mātale tvaṃ ca tava putraśca gomukhaḥ
paśya veśmāni raukmāṇi mātale rājatāni ca
devarṣe naiva me kāryaṃ vipriyaṃ tridivaukasām
anyatra sādhu gacchāva draṣṭuṃ nārhāmi dānavān
sarve hyete śriyā yuktāḥ sarve śrīvatsalakṣaṇāḥ
hṛdi caiṣāṃ sadā viṣṇurviṣṇureva sadā gatiḥ
yadyatra na ruciḥ kācidehi gacchāva mātale
taṃ nayiṣyāmi deśaṃ tvāṃ varaṃ yatropalapsyase
phenapā nāma te khyātāḥ phenāhārāśca mātale
ugre tapasi vartante yeṣāṃ bibhyati devatāḥ
pūrvāṃ diśaṃ dhārayate surūpā nāma saurabhī
paścimā vāruṇī dikca dhāryate vai subhadrayā
āsāṃ ta payasā miśraṃ payo nirmathya sāgare
sudhāhāreṣu ca sudhāṃ svadhābhojiṣu ca svadhām
paurāṇī śrūyate loke gīyate yā manīṣibhiḥ
na nāgaloke na svarge na vimāne triviṣṭape
eṣa śeṣaḥ sthito nāgo yeneyaṃ dhāryate sadā
karavīraḥ pīṭharakaḥ saṃvṛtto vṛtta eva ca
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kaśyapasyātmajāḥ smṛtāḥ
mātale paśya yadyatra kaścitte rocate varaḥ
sthito ya eṣa purataḥ kauravyasyāryakasya tu
kaḥ pitā jananī cāsya katamasyaiṣa bhoginaḥ
praṇidhānena dhairyeṇa rūpeṇa vayasā ca me
nivedayāmāsa tadā māhātmyaṃ janma karma ca
āryakasya mataḥ pautro dauhitro vāmanasya ca
etasya hi pitā nāgaścikuro nāma mātale
asmai nāgāya vai dātuṃ priyāṃ duhitaraṃ mune
śakrasyāyaṃ sakhā caiva mantrī sārathireva ca
sumukho bhavataḥ pautro rocate duhituḥ patiḥ
yadi te rocate samyagbhujagottama mā ciram
sumukhasya guṇaiścaiva śīlaśaucadamādibhiḥ abhigamya svayaṃ kanyāmayaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ
sa tu dīnaḥ prahṛṣṭaśca prāha nāradamāryakaḥ
vriyamāṇe tathā pautre putre ca nidhanaṃ gate
manye naitadbahumataṃ maharṣe vacanaṃ tava sakhā śakrasya saṃyuktaḥ kasyāyaṃ nepsito bhavet
tena harṣaḥ pranaṣṭo me suparṇavacanena vai
so'yaṃ mayā ca sahito nāradena ca pannagaḥ
āryakeṇābhyanujñātā gamyatāmiti bhārata tataste sumukhaṃ gṛhya sarva eva mahaujasaḥ
labdhvā varaṃ tu sumukhaḥ sumukhaḥ saṃbabhūva ha
āhāro vihito dhātrā kimarthaṃ vāryate tvayā
anena ca mayā deva bhartavyaḥ prasavo mahān
ye ca bhṛtyā mama gṛhe prītimānbhava vāsava
śrutvā suparṇavacanaṃ sumukho durmukhastadā tyaktvā rūpaṃ vivarṇastu sarparūpadharo'bhavat
na matkṛtaṃ vainateya na māṃ kroddhuṃ tvamarhasi dattābhayaḥ sa sumukho viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā
tvayi tiṣṭhati deveśa na viṣṇuḥ kāraṇaṃ mama
mamāpi dakṣasya sutā jananī kaśyapaḥ pitā
tena me gauravaṃ naṣṭaṃ tvattaścāsmācca vāsava
na tvaṃ vahasi māṃ dorbhyāṃ moghaṃ tava vikatthanam imaṃ tāvanmamaikaṃ tvaṃ bāhuṃ savyetaraṃ vaha
ityuktvā bhagavāṃstasya skandhe bāhuṃ samāsajat āropitaṃ samudvoḍhuṃ bhāraṃ taṃ nāśakadbalāt
yāvānhi bhāraḥ kṛtsnāyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ parvataiḥ saha
tato hi jīvitaṃ tasya na vyanīnaśadacyutaḥ
sa viṣṇuṃ śirasā pakṣī praṇamya vinatāsutaḥ
na hi jñātaṃ balaṃ deva mayā te parama vibho
tena manyāmyahaṃ vīryamātmano na samaṃ paraiḥ
maivaṃ bhūya iti snehāttadā cainamuvāca ha
dhanañjayaścendrasuto na hanyātāṃ tu kaṃ raṇe
ete devāstvayā kena hetunā vīkṣituṃ kṣamāḥ
tadalaṃ te virodhena śamaṃ gaccha nṛpātmaja
yathaiveśvarasṛṣṭo'smi yadbhāvi yā ca me gatiḥ
tathā maharṣe vartāmi kiṃ pralāpaḥ kariṣyati
tataḥ kaṇvo'bravītkruddho duryodhanamapaṇḍitam yasmādūkaṃ tāḍayasi ūrau mṛtyurbhaviṣyati
durlabho vai suhṛcchrotā durlabhaśca hitaḥ suhṛt
tiṣṭhate hi suhyadyatra na bandhustatra tiṣṭhate
na kartavyaśca nirbandho nirbandho hi sudāruṇaḥ
paramānnasya yatnena na ca taṃ pratyapālayat
bhaktaṃ pragṛhya mūrdhnā vai bāhubhyāṃ saṃśitavrataḥ
sa dṛṣṭvā śirasā bhaktaṃ dhriyamāṇaṃ maharṣiṇā
bhuktvā prītosmi viprarṣe tamuktvā sa munirgataḥ
śuśrūṣayā ca bhaktyā ca prītimānityuvāca ha
anujñāto mayā vatsa yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha gavālava
dakṣiṇānāṃ hi dātā vai apavargeṇa yujyate
aṣṭau śatāni me dehi gaccha gālava mā ciram
nāste na śete nāhāraṃ kurute gālavastadā
tvagasthibhūto hariṇāścintāśokaparāyaṇaḥ śocamāno'timātraṃ sa dahyamānaśca manyunā
kutaḥ puṣṭāni mitrāṇi kuto'rthāḥ sañcayaḥ kṛtaḥ
kuto me bhojane śraddhā sukhaśraddhā kutaśca me
śraddhā me jīvitasyāpi chinnā kiṃ jīvitena me
ahaṃ pāre samudrasya pṛthivyā vā paraṃ parāt
gatvā''tmānaṃ vimuñcāmi kiṃ phalaṃ jīvitena me
suhṛdāṃ hi dhanaṃ bhuktvā kṛtvā praṇayamīpsitam
nānṛtasyādhipatyaṃ ca kuta eva gatiḥ śubhā
kutaḥ kṛtaghnasya yaśaḥ kutaḥ sthānaṃ kutaḥ sukham
aśraddheyaḥ kṛtaghno hi kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ
na jīvatyadhanaḥ pāpaḥ kutaḥ pāpasya tantraṇam
mānayanti ca māṃ sarve tridaśā yajñasaṃstare ahaṃ tu vibudhaśreṣṭhaṃ devaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram
viṣṇuṃ gacchāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ gatiṃ gatimatāṃ varam
sahṛdbhavānmama mataḥ suhṛdāṃ ca mataḥ suhṛt
pūrvamuktastvadarthaṃ ca kṛtaḥ kāmaśca tena me
sa bhavānetu gacchāva nayiṣye tvāṃ yathāsukham deśaṃ pāraṃ pṛthivyā vā gaccha gālava mā ciram
brūhi kāmaṃ tu kāṃ yāmi draṣṭuṃ prathamamo diśam
pūrvāṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ vāhamathavā paścimāṃ diśam
uttarāṃ vā dvijaśreṣṭha kuto gacchāmi gālava
savitā yatra sandhyāyāṃ sādhyānāṃ vartate tapaḥ
yasyāṃ pūrvaṃ matirjātā yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat
cakṣuṣī yatra dharmasya yatra caiṣa pratiṣṭhitaḥ
kṛtaṃ yato hutaṃ havyaṃ sarpate sarvatodiśam
atra pūrvaṃ prasūtā vai dākṣāyaṇyaḥ prajāḥ striyaḥ
ata eva ca sarveṣāṃ pūrvāmāśāṃ pracakṣate
atra labdhavaraḥ somaḥ suraiḥ kratuṣu pīyate
sūtiścaiva pratiṣṭhā ca nidhanaṃ ca prakāśate
pibanti munayo yatra havirdhūmaṃ sma dhūmapāḥ
prokṣitā yatra bahavo varāhādyā mṛgā vane
etaddvāraṃ trilokasya svargasya ca sukhasya ca
eṣa pūrvo diśāṃ bhāgo viśāvo'tra yadīcchasi
priyaṃ kāryaṃ hi me tasya yasyāsmi vacane sthitaḥ
brūhi gālava yāsyāmi śṛṇu cāpyaparāṃ diśam
iyaṃ vivasvadā pūrvaṃ śrautena vidhinā kila
gurave dakṣiṇā dattā dakṣiṇetyucyate ca dik
atra viśve sadā devāḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhamāsate
atra dharmaśca satyaṃ ca karma cātra nigadyate
eṣā diksā dvijaśreṣṭha yāṃ sarvaḥ pratipadyate
vṛtā tvanavabodhena sukhaṃ tena na gamyate
atra sāmāni gāthābhiḥ śrutvā gītāni raivataḥ
atra siddhāḥ śivā nāma brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ
abhedyaṃ bhāskareṇāpi svayaṃ vā kṛṣṇavartmanā eṣa tasyāpi te mārgaḥ paricārasya gālava
brūhi me yadi gantavyaṃ pratīcīṃ śṛṇu cāparām
iyaṃ digdiyitā rājño varuṇasya tu gopateḥ
atra paścādahaḥ sūryo visarjayati gāḥ svayam
atra pītvā samastānvai varuṇasya rasāṃstu ṣaṭ
asto nāma yataḥ sandhyā paścimā pratisaryati
ato rātriśca nidrā ca nirgatā divasakṣaye
atra mūlaṃ himavato mandaraṃ yāti śāśvatam
atra vāyustathā vahnirāpaḥ khaṃ cāpi gālava
āhnikaṃ caiva naiśaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ sparśaṃ vimuñcati
eṣa te paścimo mārgo digdvāreṇa prakīrtitaḥ
brūhi gālava gacchāvo buddhiḥ kā dvijasattama
mārgaḥ paścimapūrvābhyāṃ digbhyāṃ vai madhyamaḥ smṛtaḥ
na sa dṛśyo munigaṇaistathā devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ
atra viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasracaraṇo'vyayaḥ sahasraśirasaḥ śrīmānekaḥ paśyati māyayā
atra kāmaśca roṣaśca śailaścomā ca saṃbabhuḥ
atra te ṛṣayaḥ sapta devī cārundhatī tathā
atra yajñaṃ samāsādya dhruvaṃ sthātā pitāmahaḥ
parivartasahasrāmi kāmabhojyānani gālava yathāyathā praviśati tasmātparataraṃ naraḥ
ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ naraṃ vā jiṣṇumavyayam
atra viṣṇupadaṃ nāma kramatā viṣṇunā kṛtam
brāhmaṇeṣu ca yatkṛtsnaṃ svantaṃ kṛtvā dhanaṃ mahat
vavre dhanaṃ maharṣiḥ sa jaimūtaṃ taddhanaṃ tataḥ
kasya kāryaṃ kimiti vai parikrośānti gālava
catasraḥ kramayogena kāmāśāṃ gantumicchasi udyato'haṃ dvijaśreṣṭha tava darśayituṃ diśaḥ
naya māṃ tārkṣya pūrveṇa yatra dharmasya cakṣuṣī
pūrvametāṃ diśaṃ gaccha yā pūrvaṃ parikīrtitā
atra satyaṃ ca dharmaśca tvayā samyakprakīrtitaḥ iccheyaṃ tu samāgantuṃ samastairdaivatairaham
mahārṇavasya ca ravaiḥ śrotre me badhire kṛte
na śrṛṇomi na paśyāmi nātmano vedmi kāraṇam
na dṛśyate ravistāta na diśo na ca khaṃ khaga
tama eva tu paśyāmi śarīraṃ te na lakṣaye
maṇī va jātyau paśyāmi cakṣuṣī te'hamaṇḍaja
śarīraṃ tu na paśyāmi tava caivātmanaśca ha
sa me nirvāpya sahasā cakṣuṣī śāmyate punaḥ
saṃnivarta mahābhāga na vegaṃ viṣahāmi te
naiva me'sti dhanaṃ kiṃcinna dhanenānvitaḥ suhṛt
evaṃ bahu ca dīnaṃ ca bruvāṇaṃ gālavaṃ tadā
na cāpi kṛtrimaḥ kālaḥ kālo hi parameśvaraḥ
atra viśramya bhuktvā ca nivartiṣyāva gālava
grahītuṃ hi manaścakre rūpātsākṣādiva śriyam atha bhraṣṭatanūjāṅgamātmānaṃ dadṛśe khagaḥ
vāso'yamiha kālaṃ tu kiyantaṃ nau bhaviṣyati
kiṃ nu te manasā dhyātamaśubhaṃ dharmadūṣaṇam
na hyayaṃ bhavataḥ svalpo vyabhicāro bhaviṣyati
imāṃ siddhāmito netuṃ tatra yatra prajāpatiḥ
yatra devo mahādevo yatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ
na bhetavyaṃ suparṇo'si suparṇa tyaja saṃbhramam
ninditāsmi tvayā vatsa na ca nindāṃ kṣamāmyaham
lokebhyaḥ sapadi bhraśyedyo māṃ nindeta pāpakṛt
na ca te garhaṇīyā'haṃ garhitavyāḥ striyaḥ kvacit
tadeva naṣṭadehastu syā vai tvaṃ pannagāśana
tasyaiva hi prasādena devadevasya cintanāt tvaṃ tu sāṅgastu sañjātaḥ punareva bhaviṣyasi
viśvāmitro'tha taṃ dṛṣṭvā gālavaṃ cādhvani sthitaḥ
tasya kālo'pavargasya yathā vā manyate bhavān
athāha gālavaṃ dīnaṃ suparṇaḥ patatāṃ varaḥ nirmitaṃ vahninā bhūmau vāyunā śodhitaṃ tathā
nityaṃ proṣṭhapadābhyāṃ ca śukre dhanapatau tathā
ajaikapādahirbudhnyau rakṣyete dhanadena ca evaṃ na śakyate labdhumalabdhavyaṃ dvijarṣabha
apīḍya rājā paurānhi yo nau kuryātkṛtārthinau
asti somānvavāye me jātaḥ kaścinnṛpaḥ sakhā
abhigacchāvahe taṃ vai tasyāsti vibhavo bhuvi
sa dāsyati mayā cokto bhavatā cārthitaḥ svayam
tathā tau kathayantau ca cintayantau ca yatkṣamam
ayaṃ me nāhuṣa sakhā gālavastapaso nidhiḥ
aṣṭau śatāni me dehi hayānāṃ candravarcasām
pātraṃ pratigrahasyāyaṃ dātuṃ pātraṃ tathā bhavān
vimṛśyāvahito rājā niścitya ca punaḥ punaḥ
dṛṣṭvā priyasakhaṃ tārkṣyaṃ gālavaṃ ca dvijarṣabham
nidarśanaṃ ca tapaso bhikṣāṃ ślāghyāṃ ca kīrtitām
adya me saphalaṃ janma tāritaṃ cādya me kalam
adyāyaṃ tārito deśo mama tārkṣya tvayā'nagha
vaktumicchāmi tu sakhe yathā jānāsi māṃ purā
na tathā vittavānasmi kṣīṇaṃ vittaṃ ca me sakhe
na ca śakto'smi te kartuṃ moghamāgamanaṃ khaga
abhigamya hatāśo hi nivṛtto dahate kulam
prathāśānāśanaṃ loke dehi nāstīti vā vacaḥ
tasmāccaturṇāṃ vaṃśānāṃ sthāpayitrī sutā mama mādhavī nāma tārkṣyeyaṃ sarvadharmapradāyinī
iyaṃ surasutaprakhyā sarvadharmopacāyinī sadā devamanuṣyaṇāmasurāṇāṃ ca gālava
kāṅkṣitā rūpato bālā sutā me pratigṛhyatām
asyāḥ śulkaṃ pradāsyanti nṛpā rājyamapi dhravam
kiṃ punaḥ śyāmakarṇānāṃ hayānāṃ dve catuḥśate
sa bhavāpratigṛhṇātu mamaitāṃ mādhavīṃ sutām ahaṃ dauhitravāntsyāṃ vai vara eṣa mama prabho - - a sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇaḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ pratigṛhya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ gālavaḥ saha pakṣiṇā
gate patagarāje tu gālavaḥ saha kanyayā
gambhīrā triṣu cāṅgeṣu iyaṃ raktā ca pañcasu
śroṇyau lalāṭamūrū ca ghrāṇaṃ ceti ṣaḍunnatam sūkṣmāṇyaṅguliparvāṇi keśaromanasvatvacaḥ
svaraḥ satvaṃ ca nābhiśca trigambhīraṃ pracakṣate
pāṇipādatale rakte netrāntau ca nakhāni ca
hrasvāni catvāri ca liṅgapṛṣṭhe grīvā ca jaṅghe ca hitapradāni
sūkṣmāṇi catvāri ca liṅgapṛṣṭhe grīvā ca jaṅghe ca hitapradāni
sūkṣmāṇi pañca daśanāṅguliparvakeśā stvakvaiva vai kararuhāśca na duḥkhitānām
brūhi śulkaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha samīkṣya vibhavaṃ mama
dve me śate saṃnihite hayānāṃ yadvidhāstava
etacchrutvā tu sā kanyā gālavaṃ vākyamabravīt
sa tvaṃ dadasva māṃ rājñe pratigṛhya hayottamān
nṛpebhyo hi caturbhyaste pūrṇānyaṣṭau śatāni vai
bhaviṣyanti tathā putrā mama catvāra eva ca
eṣā tāvanmama prajñā yathā vā manyase dvija
pratigṛhya sa tāṃ kanyāṃ gālavaṃ pratinandya ca
haryaśvaḥ satyavacane sthitaḥ sthitvā ca pauruṣe
tatra gacchāvahe bhadre śanairāgaccha mā śucaḥ
dhārmikaḥ saṃyame yuktaḥ satye caiva janeśvaraḥ
vidhipūrvāṃ ca tāṃ rājā kanyāṃ pratigṛhītavān
reme sa tasyāṃ rājarṣiḥ prabhāvatyāṃ yathā raviḥ
svāhāyāṃ ca yathā vahniryathā śācyāṃ ca vāsavaḥ
yathā candraśca rohiṇyāṃ yathā dhūmorṇayā yamaḥ
varuṇaśca yathā gauryāṃ yathā cardhyāṃ dhaneśvaraḥ
yathā nārāyaṇo lakṣmyāṃ jāhnavyāṃ ca yathodadhiḥ
yathā rudraśca rudrāṇyāṃ yathā vedyāṃ pitāmahaḥ
ṛcīkaḥ satyavatyāṃ ca sarasvasyāṃ yathā manuḥ
vaidehyāṃ ca yathā rāmo rukmiṇyāṃ ca janārdanaḥ
tathaiva tāṃ śriyaṃ tyaktvā kanyā bhūtvā yaśasvinī
iya kanyā sutau dvau te janayiṣyati pārthivau
asyāṃ bhavānavāptārtho bhavitā pretya ceha ca
gurvartho'yaṃ samārambho na hayaiḥ kṛtyamasti me
na putraphalabhoktā hi rājarṣe pātyate divaḥ
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yatra gacchantyanātmajāḥ
śrutavānasmi te vākyaṃ yathā vadasi gālava
kāmato hi dhanaṃ rājā pārakyaṃ yaḥ prayacchati
na sa dharmeṇa dharmātmanyujyate yaśasā na ca
reme sa tāṃ samāsādya kṛtapuṇya iva śriyam
kandareṣu ca śailānāṃ nadīnāṃ nirjhareṣu ca
upasthāya sa taṃ vipro gālavaḥ pratigṛhya ca
diṣṭyā kṛtārthaṃ paśyāmi bhavantamiha vai dvija
prayatnaste na kartavyo naiṣa saṃpatsyate tava
purā hi kānyakubje vai gādheḥ satyavatīṃ sutām
iṣṭvā te puṇḍarīkeṇa dattā rājñā dvijātiṣu
tebhyo dve dve śate krītvā prāpte taiḥ pārthivaistadā
evaṃ na śakyamaprāpyaṃ prāptuṃ gālava karhicit
asyāṃ rājarṣibhiḥ putrā jātā vai dhārmikāstrayaḥ
bhavato hyanṛṇo bhūtvā tapaḥ kuryāṃ yathāsukham
viśvāmitrastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā gālavaṃ saha pakṣiṇā
kimiyaṃ pūrvameveha na dattā mama gālava
jātamātraṃ sutaṃ taṃ ca viśvāmitro mahāmuniḥ
niryātya kanyāṃ śiṣyāya kauśikopi vanaṃ yayau
piturniryātya tāṃ kanyāṃ prayayau vanameva ha
sa tu rājā punastasyāḥ kartukāmaḥ svayaṃvaram
sravantīnāṃ ca puṇyānāṃ surasāni sucīni ca
tābhbhāṃ pratiṣṭhito loke paraloke ca nāhuṣaḥ
ko'nvayaṃ kasya vā rājñaḥ kathaṃ vā svargamāgataḥ
kathaṃ vā jñāyate svarge kena vā jñāyate'pyuta
sarve te hyāvṛtajñānā nābhyajānanta taṃ nṛpam
na ca prajñāyase gaccha patasveti tamabravīt
yayātirupajighranvai nipapāta mahīṃ prati bhūmau svarge ca saṃbaddhāṃ nadīṃ dhūmamayīmiva
ko bhavānkasya vā bandhurdeśasya nagarasya vā
yakṣo vā'pyathavā devo gandharvo rākṣaso'pi vā
na hi mānuṣarūposi kovārthaḥ kāṅkṣyate tvayā
na ca me pravaṇā buddhiḥ parapuṇyavināśane
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te kiṃ kurmaḥ śāsanaṃ tava
ājñāpyā hi vayaṃ sarve tava putrāstapodhane
teṣāṃ tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā mādhavī parayā mudā
dauhitrāstava rājendra mama putrā na te parāḥ
tataste pārthivāḥ sarve śirasā jananīṃ tadā
abhivādya namaskṛtya mātāmahamathābruvan uccairanupamaiḥ snigdhaiḥ svarairāpūrya medinīm
tadapyatha ca dāsyāmi tena saṃyujyatāṃ bhavān
yacca me phalamādhāne tena saṃyujyatāṃ bhavān
prāptavānasmi yalloke kṣatravaṃśodbhavaṃ yaśaḥ vīraśabdaphalaṃ caiva tena saṃyujyatāṃ bhavān
yathā dharme ratirnityaṃ tena satyena khaṃ vraja
yathā bāleṣu nārīṣu vaivāhyeṣu tathaiva ca
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me tena satyena khaṃ vraja
yathā prāṇāṃśca rājyaṃ ca rājankāmasukhāni ca
tyajeyaṃ na punaḥ satyaṃ tena satyena khaṃ vraja
yathā satyena me dharmo yathā satyena pāvakaḥ
prītaḥ śatakratuścaiva tena satyena khaṃ vraja
na me ratnāni na dhanaṃ na tathā'nye paricchadā
tathatathā vasumatīṃ tyaktvā rājā divaṃ yayau
dauhitrāḥ svena dharmeṇa yajñadānakṛtena vai caturṣu rājavaṃśeṣu saṃbhūtāḥ kulavardhanāḥ
sthānaṃ ca pratipanno'si karmaṇā svena nirjitam
kathaṃ tadalpakālena kṣīṇaṃ yenāsmi pātitaḥ bhagavanvettha lokāṃśca śāśvatānmama nirmitān
kathaṃ nu mama tatsarvaṃ vipranaṣṭaṃ mahādyute
nāyaṃ mānena rājarṣe na balena na hiṃsayā
na śāṭhyena na māyābhirloko bhavati śāśvataḥ
na hi mānapradagdhānāṃ kaścidasti śamaḥ kvacit
na kartavyo hi nirbandho nirbandho hi kṣayodayaḥ
tasmāttvamapi gāndhāre mānaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjaya
sa bhavānsuhṛdāṃ pathyaṃ vaco gṛhṇātu mā'nṛtam
dadāti yatpārthiva yatkarati yadvā tapastapyati yañjuhoti
na tasya nāśo'sti na cāpakarṣo nānyastadaśnāti sa eva kartā
samīkṣya loke bahudhā pradhāritaṃ trivargadṛṣṭiḥ pṛthivīmupāśnute
etatpuṇyatamaṃ rājanyayāteścaritaṃ mahat yacchrutvā śrāvayitvā ca svargaṃ yāntīha mānavāḥ
svargyaṃ lokyaṃ ca māmāttha dharmyaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca keśava
na tvahaṃ svavaśastāta kriyamāṇaṃ na me priyam na maṃsyante durātmānaḥ putrā mama janārdana
aṅga duryodhanaṃ kṛṣṇa mandaṃ śāstrātigaṃ mama
na śrṛṇoti mahābāho vacanaṃ sādhu bhāṣitam gāndhāryāśca hṛṣīkeśa vidurasya ca dhīmataḥ
ta etadīdṛśaṃ kuryuryathā tvaṃ tāta manyase
dharmārthayuktā loke'sminpravṛttirlakṣyate satām asatāṃ viparītā tu lakṣyate bharatarṣabha
taddhitaṃ ca priyaṃ caiva dhṛtarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ
jñātīnāṃ caiva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ mitrāṇāṃ ca parantapa
śame śarma bhavettāta sarvasya jagatastathā hrīmānasi kule jātaḥ śrutavānānṛśaṃsyavān
tiṣṭha tāta pituḥ śāstre mātuśca bharatarṣabha
etacchreyo hi manyante pitā yacchāsti bhārata
rocate te pitustāta pāṇḍavaiḥ saha saṅgamaḥ
śrutvā yaḥ suhṛdāṃ śāstraṃ martyo na pratipadyate
yo'satsevī vṛthācāro na śrotā suhṛdāṃ satām
na ca te jātu kupyanti dharmātmāno hi pāṇḍavāḥ
na hi dharmādapaityarthaḥ kāmo vā'pi kadācana
ātmānaṃ takṣati hyeṣa vanaṃ paraśunā yathā yaḥ samyagvartamāneṣu mithyā rājanpravartate
na tasya hi matiṃ chindyādyasya necchetparābhavam
chidyate hyātataṃ sarvaṃ pramāṇaṃ paśya bhārata
na caite tava paryāptā jñāne dharmārthayostathā
idaṃ sanihitaṃ tāta samagraṃ pārthivaṃ balam
ayaṃ bhīṣmastathā droṇaḥ karṇaścāyaṃ tathā kṛpaḥ
aśaktāḥ sarva evaite pratiyoddhuṃ dhanañjayam ajeyo hyarjunaḥ saṅkhye sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ
yasmiñcite jitaṃ te syātpumānekaḥ sa dṛśyatāṃ
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca paryāptaṃ tannidarśanam
yuddhe yena mahādevaḥ sākṣātsantoṣitaḥ śivaḥ tamajeyamanādhṛṣyaṃ vijetuṃ jiṣṇumacyutam
astu śeṣaṃ kauravāṇāṃ mā parābhūdidaṃ kulam
pāṇḍavaiḥ saṃśamaṃ kṛtvā kṛtvā ca suhṛdāṃ vacaḥ
kṛṣṇena vākyamukto'si sṛhṛdāṃ śamamicchatā anvapadyasva tattāta mā manyuvaśamanvagāḥ
śreyo na jātu na sukhaṃ na kalyāṇamavāpsyasi
mā kulaghnaḥ kupuruṣo durmatiḥ kāpathaṃ gamaḥ
mātaraṃ pitaraṃ caiva mā mañjīḥ śokasāgare
ye tvāṃ protsāhayantyete naite kṛtyāya karhicit
mā jīghanaḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ putrānbhrātṝṃstathaiva ca
yathoktaṃ jāmadagnyena bhūyāneṣa tato'rjunaḥ kṛṣṇo hi devakīputro devairapi suduḥsahaḥ
na hi tvāmutsahe vaktuṃ bhūyo bharatasattama
imo tu vṛddhau śocāmi gāndhārīṃ pitaraṃ ca te
yāvanna prekṣate krūddhaḥ senāṃ tava yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yāvanna śātayatyājau śirāṃsi gajayodhinām gadayā vīraghātinyā phalānīva vanaspateḥ
śālaskandho mahābahustvāṃ svajāno vṛkodaraḥ - - bsāmnā'bhivadatāṃ cāpi śāntaye bharatarṣabha
bhavānkṣattā ca rājā vā'pyācāryo vā pitāmahaḥ
atha sarve bhavanto māṃ vidviṣanti sarājakāḥ
jitāḥ śakuninā rājyaṃ tatra kiṃ mama duṣkṛtam
aparādho na cāsmākaṃ yatte hyakṣaiḥ parājitāḥ
ajeyā jayatāṃ śreṣṭha pārthāḥ pravrājitā vanam
na cāpi vayamugreṇa karmaṇā vacanena vā
na ca taṃ kṛṣṇa paśyāmi kṣatradharmamanuṣṭhitam
utsaheta yudhā jetuṃ yo naḥ śatrunibarhaṇa
devairapi yudhā jetuṃ śakyāḥ kimuta pāṇḍavaiḥ
astreṇa nidhanaṃ kāle prāpsyāmaḥ svargyameva tat
te vayaṃ vīraśayanaṃ prāpsyāmo yadi saṃyuge
kaśca jātu kule jātaḥ kṣatradharmeṇa vartayan
eṣa dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ matametacca me sadā
na sa labhyaḥ punarjātu mayi jīvati keśava
yāvacca rājā dhriyate dhṛtarāṣṭro janārdana nyastaśastrā vayaṃ te vā'pyupajīvāma mādhava
apradeyaṃ purā dattaṃ rājyaṃ paravato mama
dhriyamāṇe mahābāhau mayi saṃprati keśava yāvaddhi tīkṣṇayā sūcyā viddhyedagreṇa keśava
sthiro bhava sahāmātyo vimardo bhavitā mahān
tvayā durmantritaṃ dyūtaṃ saubalena ca bhārata
asatāṃ tatra jāyante bhedāśca vyasanāni ca
tadidaṃ vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ tvayā dyūtamukhaṃ kṛtam
ānīya ca sabhāṃ vyaktaṃ yathoktā draupadī tvayā
karṇaduḥśāsanābhyāṃ ca tvayā ca bahuśaḥ kṛtam
āsthitaḥ paramo yatno na samṛddhaśca tattava
śāmyeti muhuruktosi na ca śāmyasi pārthiva
na śarma prāpsyase rājannutkramya suhṛdāṃ vacaḥ
baddhvā kila tvāṃ dāsyanti kuntīputrāya kauravāḥ
vaikartanaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ ca trīnetānmanujarṣabha
pāṇḍavebhyaḥ pradāsyanti bhīṣmo droṇaḥ pitā ca te
viduraṃ ca somadattaṃ ca mahārājaṃ ca bāhlikam
kṛpaṃ ca somadattaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ janārdanam
vartamānaṃ jagatsarvaṃ muhūrtānna bhaviṣyati iti matvā'bravīddharmaṃ parameṣṭhī prajāpatiḥ
varuṇaḥ sāgare yatto nityaṃ rakṣati dānavān
tathā duryodhanaṃ karṇaṃ śakuniṃ cāpi saubalam
kṛṣṇasya tu vacaḥ śrutvā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ
durbuddherduḥsahāyasya śamārthaṃ bruvatī vacaḥ api no vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ duryodhanakṛtaṃ mahat
śamayeccirarātrāya yogakṣemavadavyayam rājñastu vacanaṃ śrutvā viduro dīrghadarśinīm
ānāyaya sutaṃ kṣipraṃ rājyakāmukamāturam nahi rājyamaśiṣṭena śakyaṃ dharmārthalopinā
tvaṃ hyevātra bhṛśaṃ garhyo dhṛtarāṣṭra sutapriyaḥ
bhinnaṃ hi svajanena tvāṃ prahariṣyanti śatravaḥ
yā hi śakyā mahārāja sāmnā bhedena vā punaḥ
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ kṣattā suhṛdāṃ kuru tadvacaḥ
bhīṣmasya tu pituścaiva mama cāpacitiḥ kṛtā
na hi rājyaṃ mahāprājña svena kāmena śakyate
tau tu śatrū vinirjitya rājā vijayate mahīm
yābhyāṃ hi devāḥ svaryātuḥ svargasya pidadhurmukham
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca dambhaṃ darpaṃ ca bhūmipaḥ
īpsannarthaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca dviṣatāṃ ca parābhavam
sveṣu cānyeṣu vā tasya na sahāyā bhavantyuta
pāṇḍavaiḥ pṛthivīṃ tāta bhokṣyase sahitaḥ sukhī
na yuddhe tāta kalyāṇaṃ na dharmārthau kutaḥ sukham
na cāpi vijayo nityaṃ mā yuddhe ceta ādhithāḥ
bhīṣmeṇa hi mahāprājña pitra te bāhlikena ca
nigṛhya suhṛdāṃ manyuṃ śādhi rājyaṃ yathocitam
bhīṣme droṇe kṛpe karṇe bhīmasene dhanañjaye
dhṛṣṭadyumne ca saṃkruddhe na syuḥ sarvāḥ prajā dhruvam
eṣā hi pṛthivī kṛtsnā mā gamattvatkṛte vadham
samaṃ hi rājyaṃ prītiśca sthānaṃ hi viditātmanām
duryodhanaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ karṇaṃ duḥśāsano'bravīti nocetsandhāsyase rājansvena kāmena pāṇḍavaiḥ
vaikartanaṃ tvāṃ ca māṃ ca trīnetānbharatarṣabha
pāṇḍavebhyaḥ pradāsyanti bhīṣmadroṇau pitā ca te
ekāntamupasṛtyeha mantraṃ punaramantrayat saubalena matākṣeṇa rājñā śakuninā saha
ayaṃ hyeṣāṃ mahābāhuḥ sarveṣāṃ śarma varma ca asmingṛhīte varade ṛṣabhe sarvasātvatām
sa praviśya sabhāṃ vīraḥ siṃho giriguhāmiva
paṭenāgniṃ prajvalitaṃ yathā bālā yathā jaḍāḥ
na tvayaṃ ninditaṃ karma kuryātpāpaṃ kathaṃcana
ete hi yadi govindamicchanti saha rājabhiḥ
na tvahaṃ ninditaṃ karma kuryāṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃcana
pāṇḍavārthe hi lubhyantaḥ svārthānhāsyanti te sutāḥ
nigṛhya rājanpārthebhyo dadyāṃ kiṃ duṣkṛtaṃ bhavet
anāyāsena pārthānāṃ parvatāṃ ca śivaṃ mahat nigṛhya rājanpārthebhyo dadyāṃ cetsukṛtaṃ bhavet
idaṃ tu na pravarteyaṃ ninditaṃ karma bhārata
pāpaiḥ sahāyaiḥ saṃhatya pāpaṃ karma cikīrṣasi
yo na śakyo balātkartuṃ devairapi savāsavaiḥ
taṃ tvaṃ prārthayase manda bālaścandramasaṃ yathā
na soḍhuṃ samare śakyastaṃ na budhyasi keśavam
durdharā pṛthivī mūrdhnā durgrāhyaḥ keśavo balāt
duryodhana nibodhedaṃ vacanaṃ mama sāṃpratam saubhadvāre vānarendro dvivido nāma nāmataḥ
grahītuṃ nāśakaccainaṃ taṃ tvaṃ prārthayase balāt
grahītuṃ nāśakattatra taṃ tvaṃ prārthayase balāt
grahītuṃ nāśakaṃścainaṃ taṃ tvaṃ prārthayase balāt
anena hi hatā bālye pūtanā śiśunā tadā
ayaṃ kartā na kriyate kāraṇaṃ cāpi pauruṣe
evamuktvā jāhāsoccaiḥ keśavaḥ paravīrahā tasya saṃsmayataḥ śaurervidyudrūpā mahātmanaḥ
tasya brahmā lalāṭastho rudro vakṣasi cābhavat
netrābhyāṃ nāsikābhyāṃ ca śrotrābhyāṃ ca samantataḥ
romakūpeṣu ca tathā sūryasyeva marīcayaḥ sahasracaraṇaḥ śrīmāñśatabāhuḥ sahasradṛk
tasya vai nāgalokaśca gulphādho dadṛśe tadā
candrasūryau tathā netre grahaḥ vai sarvataḥ sthitāḥ
asthīni parvatāḥ sarve vṛkṣā romāṇi tasya hi nimeṣaṇaṃ rātryahanī jihvāyāṃ śāradā tathā
ṛta droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca viduraṃ ca mahāmatim
tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ kinnarāśca mahoragāḥ ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā lokapālaiḥ samanvitāḥ
krodhaṃ prabho saṃhara saṃhara svaṃ rūpaṃ ca yaddarśitamātmasaṃstham
yāvattvime devagaṇaiḥ sametā lokāḥ samastā bhuvi nāśamīyuḥ
tvaṃ ca kartā vikartā ca tvameva parirakṣase
kiyanmātrā mahīpālāḥ kiṃvīryāḥ kiṃparākramāḥ teṣāmarthe mahābāho divyaṃ rūpaṃ pradarśivān
cacāla ca mahī kṛtsnā sāgaraścāpi cukṣubhe
tataḥ sa puruṣavyāghraḥ sañjahāra vapuḥ svakam
niścakrāma tataḥ śauriḥ sadhūma iva pāvakaḥ
sūpaskareṇa śubhreṇa vaiyāghreṇa varūthinā śaibyasugrīvayuktena pratyadṛśyata dārukaḥ - - atathaiva rathamāsthāya kṛtavarmā mahārathaḥ vṛṣṇīnāṃ saṃmato vīro hārdikyaḥ samadṛśyata
pratyakṣaṃ te na te kiṃcitparokṣaṃ śatrukarśana
droṇaṃ pitāmahaṃ bhīṣmaṃ kṣattāraṃ bāhlikaṃ kṛpam
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ kṣattā dhṛtarāṣṭro'tha bāhlikaḥ
kurūṇāṃ paśyatāṃ draṣṭuṃ svasāraṃ sa pituryayau
ṛṣibhiścaiva ca mayā na cāsau tadgṛhītavān
kālapakvamidaṃ sarvaṃ suyodhanavaśānugam sarvakṣatraṃ kṣaṇenaiva dahyate pārthavahninā
tadbrūhi tvaṃ mahāprajñe śuśrūṣe vacanaṃ tava
bhūyāṃste hīyate dharmo mā putraka vṛthā kṛthāḥ
aṅgāvekṣasva dharmaṃ tvaṃ yathā sṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃbhuvā
śrṛṇu cātropamāmekāṃ yā vṛddhebhyaḥ śrutā mayā
purā vaiśravaṇaḥ prīto na cāsau tadgṛhītavān
yaṃ hi dharmaṃ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā vindena bhārata
tadā kṛtayuṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate
kālo vā kāraṇaṃ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam
iti te saṃśayo mā bhūdrājā kālasya kāraṇam
yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam
tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
rājadoṣeṇa hi jagatspṛśyate jagataḥ sa ca
na hyetāmāśiṣaṃ pāṇḍurna cāhaṃ na pitāmahaḥ
prayuktavantaḥ pūrvaṃ te yayā carasi medhayā
yajño dānaṃ tapaḥ śauryaṃ prajñā santānameva ca
te tu vaidyāḥ kule jātā avṛttyā tāta pīḍitāḥ
sāmnā bhedena dānena daṇḍenātha nayena vā
ito duḥkhataraṃ kiṃ nu yadahaṃ dīnabāndhavā
mā gamaḥ kṣīṇapuṇyastvaṃ sānujaḥ pāpikāṃ gatiṃ
na mayā tvaṃ na pitrā ca jātaḥ kvābhyāgatohyasi
manaḥ kṛtvā sukalyāṇaṃ mā bhaistvaṃ pratisaṃhara
uttiṣṭha he kāpuruṣa mā śeṣvaivaṃ parājitaḥ
api vā saṃśayaṃ prāpya jīvite'pi parākrameḥ
uttiṣṭha he kāpuruṣa mā svāpsīḥ śatrunirjitaḥ
mā'staṃ gamastvaṃ kṛpaṇo vi śrūyasva svakarmaṇā
mā madhye mā jaghanye tvaṃ mā'dho bhūstiṣṭha garjitaḥ
muhūrtaṃ jvalitaṃ śreyo na ca dhūmāyitaṃ ciram
mā ha sma kasyacidgehe janī rājñaḥ svarīmṛduḥ
alabdhvā yadi vā labdhvā nānuśocati paṇḍitaḥ
udbhāvayasvaṃ vīryaṃ vā tāṃ vā gaccha dhruvāṃ gatim
dharmaṃ putrāgrataḥ kṛtvā kiṃnimittaṃ hi jīvasi
iṣṭāpūrtaṃ hi te klība kīrtiśca sakalā hatā
vicchinnaṃ bhogamūlaṃ te kiṃnimittaṃ hi jīvasi
udyamya dhuramutkarṣedājāneyakataṃ smaran kuru satvaṃ ca mānaṃ ca viddhi pauruṣamātmanaḥ
udbhāvaya kulaṃ magnaṃ tvatkṛte svayameva hi
yasya vṛttaṃ na jalpanti mānavā mahadadbhutam
rāśivardhanamātraṃ sa naiva strī na punaḥ pumān
dāne tapasi satye ca yasya noccaritaṃ yaśaḥ
śrutena tapasā vā'pi śriyā vā vikrameṇa vā
kṣamāvānniramarṣaśca naiva strī na punaḥ pumān
saṃtoṣo vai śriyaṃ hanti tathā'nukrośa eva ca
āyasaṃ hṛdayaṃ kṛtvā mṛgayasva punaḥ svakam
ya ātmanaḥ priyamukhe hitvā mṛgayate śriyam
kiṃ nu me māmapaśyantyāḥ pṛthivyā api sarvayā kimābharaṇakṛtyaṃ te kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā
pairarvihanyamānasya jīvitenāpi kiṃ phalam nirmanyukānāṃ ye lokā dviṣantastānavāpnuyuḥ
anu tvāṃ tāta jīvantu brāhmaṇāḥ suhṛdastathā
tridaśā iva śakrasya sādhu tasyeha jīvitam
sa loke labhate kīrtiṃ paratra ca śubhāṃ gatim
yo hi tejo yathāśakti na karśayati vikramāt
kṣatriyo jīvitākāṅkṣī stena ityeva taṃ viduḥ
santi vai sindhurājasya santuṣṭā na tathā janāḥ
taiḥ kṛtvā saha saṃghātaṃ giridurgālayaṃ cara
sañjayo nāmataśca tvaṃ na ca paśyāmi tattvayi
anvarthanāmā bhava me putra mā vyarthanāmakaḥ
tasmāttāta bravīmi tvāṃ vakṣyāmi ca punaḥpunaḥ
yadā māṃ caiva bhāryāṃ ca draṣṭāsi bhṛśadurbalām
na tadā jīvitenārtho bhavitā tava sañjaya
yadi kṛtyaṃ na paśyāmi tavādyāhaṃ yathā purā
ślāghanīyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
neti cedbrāhmaṇaṃ brūyāṃ dīryeta hṛdayaṃ mama
na hyada na ca me bhartā neti brāhmaṇamuktavān
vayamāśrayaṇīyāḥ sma na śrotāraḥ parasya ca
apāre bhava naḥ pāramaplave bhava naḥ plavaḥ
sarve te śatravaḥ śakyā na ceñjīvitumarhasi
māhendraṃ ca grahaṃ lebhe lokānāṃ ceśvaro'bhavat
nāma viśrāvya vai śaṅkhye śatrūnāhūya daṃśitān
senāgraṃ cāpi vidrāvya hatvā vā puruṣaṃ varam
tyaktvātmānaṃ raṇe dakṣaṃ śūraṃ kāpuruṣā janāḥ
rājyaṃ cāpyugravi bhraṃśaṃ saṃśayo jīvitasya vā
na labdhasya hi śatrorvai śeṣaṃ kurvanti sādhavaḥ
mā tvā dṛśaṃ sukṛpaṇaṃ śatrūṇāṃ bhayavardhanam
pṛṣṭhato'nuvrajantaṃ vā kā śāntirhṛdayasya me nāsmiñjātu kule jāto gacchedyonyasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
mātaṅgo matta iva ca parīyātsa mahāmanāḥ
kṛṣṇāyasasyeva ca te saṃhatya hṛdayaṃ kṛtam
kiṃ nu te māmapaśyantyāḥ pṛthivyā api sarvayā
taṃ tvāmayaśasā spṛṣṭaṃ na brūyāṃ yadi sañjaya
avidyā vai mahatyasti yāmimāṃ saṃśritāḥ prajāḥ
tava syādyadi sadvṛttaṃ tena me tvaṃ priyo bhaveḥ
ramate yastu putreṇa moghaṃ tasya prajāphalam
akurvanto hi karmāṇi kurvanto ninditāni ca
sukhaṃ naiveha nāmutra labhante puruṣādhamāḥ yuddhāya kṣatriyaḥ sṛṣṭaḥ sañjayeha jayāya ca
jayanvā vadhyamāno vā prāpnotīndrasalokatām na śakrabhavane puṇye divi tadvidyate sukham
ātmānaṃ vā parityajya śatruṃ vā vinipātya ca prāpyate neha śāntirhi nityameva tu sañjaya
yasya svalpaṃ priyaṃ loke dhruvaṃ tasyālpamapriyam
neyaṃ matistvayā vācyā mātaḥ putre viśeṣataḥ
codyaṃ māṃ codayasyetadbhṛśaṃ vai codayāmi te
atha tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmi hatvā vai sarvasaindhavān
putra nātmāvamantavyaḥ pūrvābhirasamṛddhibhiḥ abhūtvā hi bhavantyarthā bhūtvā naśyanti cāpare
anityamiti jānanto na bhavanti bhavanti ca
atha ye naiva kurvanti naiva jātu bhavanti te
atha dvaiguṇyamīhāyāṃ phalaṃ bhavati vā navā
spardhinaścaiva ye kecittānyukta upadhāraya etena tvaṃ prakāreṇa mahato bhetsyase gaṇān
te tvāṃ priyaṃ kariṣyanti purodhāsyanti ca dhruvam
taṃ viditvā parākrāntaṃ vaśe na kurute yadi
dhanavantaṃ hi mitrāṇi bhajante cāśrayanti ca
naiva rājñā daraḥ kāryo jātu kasyāṃcidāpadi
atha cedapi dīrṇaḥ syānnaiva varteta dīrṇavat
api te pūjitāḥ pūrvamapi te suhṛdo matāḥ
mā dīdarastvaṃ suhṛdo mā tvāṃ dīrṇaṃ prahāsiṣuḥ
prabhāvaṃ pauruṣaṃ buddhiṃ jijñāsantyā mayā tava
tādṛśā hi sahāyā vai puruṣasya bubhūṣataḥ
udake nauriyaṃ dhāryā vaktavyaṃ pravaṇe mayā
sadaśca iva sa kṣiptaḥ praṇunno vākyasāyakaiḥ
mahīṃ vijayate kṣipraṃ śrutvā śatrūṃśca mardati
abhīkṣṇaṃ garbhiṇī śrutvā dhruvaṃ vīraṃ prajāyate
brāhmayā śriyā dīpyamānaṃ sādhuvāde ca saṃmatam
arjunaṃ keśava brūyāstvayi jāte sma sūtake
athāntarikṣe vāgāsīddivyarūpā manoramā sahasrākṣasamaḥ kunti bhaviṣyatyeṣa te sutaḥ
putraste pṛthivīṃ jetā yaśaścāsya divaṃ spṛśet
tvaṃ cāpi tattathā kṛṣṇa sarvaṃ saṃpādayiṣyasi
namo dharmāya mahate dharmo dhārayati prajāḥ
na hi vairaṃ samāsādya sīdanti puruṣarṣabhāḥ
viditā te sadā buddhirbhīmasya na sa śāmyati
tāvadeva mahāpabāhurniśāsu na sukhaṃ labhet sarvadharmaviśeṣajñāṃ snuṣāṃ pāṇḍormahātmanaḥ
vrūyā mādhava kalyāṇīṃ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇāṃ yaśasvinīm
na rājyaharaṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ dyūte cāpi parājayaḥ
pravrājanaṃ sutānāṃ vā na me tadduḥkhakāraṇam
yatra sā bṛhatī śyāmā sabhāyāṃ rudatī tadā
taṃ vai brūhi mahābāho sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
bhīmārjunau nayetāṃ hi devānapi parāṃ gatim
māṃ vai kuśalinīṃ brūyāsteṣu bhūyo janārdana
abhivādyātha tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
tataḥ prayāte dāśārhe kuravaḥ saṅgatā mithaḥ
mantrayāmāsa ca tadā karṇena suciraṃ saha
te vyatītya mahādhvānaṃ kṣipraṃ śyenā ivāśugāḥ
śrutaṃ te puruṣavyāghra kuntyāḥ kṛṣṇasya saṃnidhau
na hi te jātu śāmyerannṛte rājyena kaurava
sabhāyāṃ draupadī caiva taiśca tanmarṣitaṃ tava
kṛtāstraṃ hyarjunaṃ prāpya bhīmaṃ ca kṛtaniścayam
gāṇḍīvaṃ ceṣudhī caiva rathaṃ ca dhvajameva ca
sahāyaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca na kṣaṃsyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
pratyakṣaṃ te mahābāho yathā pārthena dhīmatā
virāṭanagare pūrvaṃ sarve sma yudhi nirjitāḥ
tau ca tvāṃ guruvatpromṇā pūjayā pratyudīyatām
saṃgaccha bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ mānaṃ saṃtyajya pārthiva
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ tatastvaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
samāliṅgya ca harṣeṇa nṛpā yāntu parasparam
alaṃ yuddhena rājendra suhṛdāṃ śṛṇu vāraṇam
dhruvaṃ vināśo yuddhe hi kṣatriyāṇāṃ pradṛśyate
tvayyāyatto mahābāho śamo vyāyāma eva ca
bhīmasya ca mahānādaṃ nadataḥ śuṣmiṇo raṇe śrutvā smartāsi me vākyaṃ gāṇḍīvasya ca niḥśvanam
saṃhatya ca bhruvormadhyaṃ na kiñcidvyājahāra ha
aśvatthāmni yathā putre bhūyo mama dhanañjaye
yasya loke samo nāsti kaścidanyo dhanurdharaḥ
na satsu labhate pūjāṃ yajñe mūrkha ivāgataḥ
tvamuktaḥ kuruvṛddhena mayā ca vidureṇa ca
asti me balamityeva sahasā tvaṃ titīrṣasi
nideśe yasya rājānaḥ sarve tiṣṭhanti kiṅkarāḥ
tvaṃ tu hitvā sukhaṃ rājyaṃ mitrāṇi ca dhanāni ca
mantrī janārdano yasya bhrātā yasya dhanañjayaḥ
alaṃ yuddhena tairvīraiḥ śāmya tvaṃ kuruvṛddhaye
mṛdu vā yadi vā tīkṣṇaṃ tanmamācakṣva sarvaśaḥ
ānupūrvyeṇa vākyāni tīkṣṇāni ca mṛdūni ca
priyāṇi dharmayuktāni satyāni ca hitāni ca
voḍhāraṃ pitaraṃ tasya prāhuḥ śāstravido janāḥ
so'si karṇa tathājātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putrosi dharmataḥ
pitṛpakṣe ca te pārthā mātṛpakṣe ca vṛṣṇayaḥ
mayā sārdhamito yātamadya tvāṃ tāta pāṇḍavāḥ
pādau tava grahīṣyanti bhrātaraḥ pañca pāṇḍavāḥ
ṣaṣṭhe tvāṃ ca tathā kāle draupadyupagamiṣyati
agniṃ juhotu vai dhaumyaḥ saṃśitātmā dvijottamaḥ
yuvarājo'stu te rājā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ gṛhītvā vyajanaṃ śvetaṃ dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ
chatraṃ ca te mahāśvetaṃ bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca draupadeyāśca pañca ye pañcālāścānuyāsyanti śikhaṇḍī ca mahārathaḥ
bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ mahābāho bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
stuvantu tvāṃ ca bahubhiḥ stutibhiḥ sūtamāgadhāḥ
praśādhi rājyaṃ kaunteya kuntīṃ ca pratinandaya
saubhrātraṃ caiva te'dyāstu bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
sosmi kṛṣṇa tathājātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putrosmi dharmataḥ
kuntyā tvahamapākīrṇo yathā na kuśalaṃ tathā
sā me mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca pratijagrāha mādhava
sa hi me jātakarmādi kārayāmāsa mādhava
nāma vai vasuṣeṇeti kārayāmāsa vai dvijaiḥ
tāsu putrāśca pautrāśca mama jātā janārdana
tāsu me hṛdayaṃ kṛṣṇa saṃjātaṃ kāmabandhanam
na pṛthivyā sakalayā na suvarṇasya rāśibhiḥ
māṃ ca kṛṣṇa samāsādya kṛtaḥ śastrasamudyamaḥ
yadi hyadya na gaccheyaṃ dvairathaṃ savyasācinā
yadi jānāti māṃ rājā dharmātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ
kuntyāḥ prathamajaṃ putraṃ na sa rājyaṃ grahīṣyati
sa eva rājā dharmātmā śāśvato'stu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
netā yasya hṛṣīkeso yoddhā yasya dhanañjayaḥ
pṛthivī tasya rāṣṭraṃ ca yasya bhīmo mahārathaḥ
caidyaśca cekitānaśca śikhaṇḍī cāparājitaḥ indragopakavarṇāśca kekayā bhrātarastathā
śaṅkhaḥ putro virāṭasya nidhistvaṃ ca janārdana
asya yajñasya vettā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi janārdana
hotā caivātra bībhatsuḥ sannaddhaḥ sa kapidhvajaḥ
gāṇḍīvaṃ sruk tathā cājyaṃ vīryaṃ puṃsāṃ bhaviṣyati aindraṃ pāśupataṃ brāhmaṃ sthūṇākarṇaṃ ca mādhava
gītaṃ stotraṃ sa saubhadraḥ samyak tatra bhaviṣyati
sa caiva tatra dharmātmā śaśvadrājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
nakulaḥ sahadevaśca mādrīputrau yaśasvinau śāmitraṃ tau mahāvīryau samyak tatra bhaviṣyataḥ
yadā drakṣyasi māṃ kṛṣṇa nihataṃ savyasācinā
ānardaṃ nardataḥ samyak tadā sūyaṃ bhaviṣyati
yadā droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca pāñcālyau pātayiṣyataḥ
mayā dattāṃ hi pṛthivīṃ na praśāsitumicchasi

viśeṣeṇa hi vārṣṇeya citrāṃ pīḍayate grahaḥ
