gṛdhrāḥ kaṅkā bakāḥ śyenā yātudhānāstathā vṛkāḥ
pūrvā diglohitākārā śastravarṇā ca dakṣiṇā āmapātrapratīkāśā paścimā madhusūdana
uttarā śaṅkhavarṇābhā diśāṃ varṇā udāhṛtāḥ pradīptāśca diśaḥ sarvā dhārtarāṣṭrasya mādhava
mahadbhayaṃ vedayanti tasminnutpātadarśane sahasrapādaṃ prāsādaṃ svapnānte sma yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
adhirohanmayā dṛṣṭaḥ saha bhrātṛbhiracyuta śvetoṣṇīṣāśca dṛśyante sarve vai śuklavāsasaḥ
āsanāni ca śubhrāṇi sarveṣāmupalakṣaye tava cāpi mayā kṛṣṇa svapnānte rudhirāvilā
āntreṇa pṛthivī dṛṣṭā parikṣiptā janārdana asthisañcayamārūḍhaścāmitaujā yadhiṣṭhiraḥ

viditaṃ me hṛṣīkeśa śriyā paramayā jvalan
tvayā sārdhaṃ hṛṣīkeśa śriyā paramayā jvalan
yūyaṃ sarve vadhiṣyadhvaṃ tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
mayā sārdhaṃ mahābāho dhārtarāṣṭreṇa vā vibho
agastyaśāstāṃ ca diśaṃ prayātāḥ sma janārdana
ahaṃ cānye ca rājāno yacca tatkṣatramaṇḍalam
gāṇḍivāgniṃ pravekṣyāma iti me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
yathā hi me vacaḥ karṇa nopaiti hṛdayaṃ tava
athavā saṅgamaḥ kṛṣṇa svarge no bhavitā dhruvam
ityuktvā mādhavaṃ karṇaḥ pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam
krośato naca gṛhṇīte vacanaṃ me suyodhanaḥ
rājā tu dhṛtarāṣṭro'yaṃ vayovṛddho na śāmyati
jayadrathasya karṇasya tathā duḥśāsanasya ca saubalasya ca durbuddhyā mitho bhedaḥ prapatsyate
kriyamāṇe balāddharme kurubhiḥ ko na saṃjvaret
cintayanna labhe nidrāmahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca
sā niḥśvasantī duḥkhārtā manasā vimamarśa ha
bhārataiḥ saha yotsyanti kiṃ nu duḥkhamataḥparam
paśye doṣaṃ dhruvaṃ yuddhe tathā'yuddhe parābhavam adhanasya mṛtaṃ śreyo na hi jñātikṣayo jayaḥ
iti me cintayantyā vai hṛdi duḥkhaṃ pravartate
nācāryaḥ kāmavāñśiṣyaidrauṇoyuddhyeta jātucit pāṇḍaveṣu kathaṃ hārdaṃ kuryānna ca pitāmahaḥ
mohānuvartī satataṃ pāpo dveṣṭi ca pāṇḍavān
karṇaḥ sadā pāṇḍavānāṃ tanme dahati saṃprati
toṣito bhagavānyatra durvāsā me varaṃ dadau
balābalaṃ ca mantrāṇāṃ brāhmaṇasya ca vāgbalam
kathaṃ nu sukṛtaṃ me syānnāparādhavatī katham
bhaveyamiti saṃcintya brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ namasya ca
prāptā kimarthaṃ bhavatī brūhi kiṃ karavāmi te
kaunteyastvaṃ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā
nāsi sūtakule jātaḥ karṇa tadviddhi me vacaḥ
kānīnastvaṃ mayā jātaḥ pūrvajaḥ kukṣiṇā dhṛtaḥ
adya paśyantu kuravaḥ karṇārjunasamāgamam saubhrātreṇa samālakṣya saṃnamantāmasādhavaḥ
asādhyaṃ kiṃ nu loke syādyuvayoḥ saṃhitātmanoḥ
satyamāha pṛthā vākyaṃ karṇa mātṛvacaḥ kuru
evamuktasya mātrā ca svayaṃ pitrā ca bhānunā
na caitacchraddadhe vākyaṃ kṣatriye bhāṣitaṃ tvayā
ahaṃ cetkṣatriyo jāto na prāptaḥ kṣatrasatkriyām
tvatkṛte kiṃ nu pāpīyaḥ śatruḥ kuryānmamāhitam
na vai mama hitaṃ pūrvaṃ mātṛvacceṣṭitaṃ tvayā
kṛṣṇena sahitātko vai na vyatheta dhanaṃjayāt
kodya bhītaṃ na māṃ vidyātparthānāṃ samitiṃ gatam
pāṇḍavānyadi gacchāmi kiṃ māṃ kṣatraṃ vadiṣyati
ahaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ kuryāṃ tadaphalaṃ katham
namaskurvanti ca sadā vasavo vāsavaṃ yathā
manyante te kathaṃ teṣāmahaṃ chindyāṃ manoratham
apāre pārakāmā ye tyajeyaṃ tānahaṃ katham
kṛtārthāḥ subhṛtā ye hi kṛtyakāle hyupasthite
rājakilbiṣiṇāṃ teṣāṃ bhartṛpiṇḍāpahāriṇām naivāyaṃ na paro loko vidyate pāpakarmaṇām
balaṃ ca śaktiṃ cāsthāya na vai tvayyanṛtaṃ vade
na ca te'yaṃ samārambho mayi mogho bhaviṣyati
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca yamau caivārjunādṛte
arjunaṃ hi nihatyājau saṃprāptaṃ syātphalaṃ mayā
na te jātu naśiṣyanti putrāḥ pañca yaśasvini
nirarjunāḥ sakarṇā vā sārjunā vā hate mayi
evaṃ vai bhāvyametena kṣayaṃ yāsyanti kauravāḥ
yathā tvaṃ bhāṣase karṇa daivaṃ tu balavattaram
saṃbhāṣya suciraṃ kālaṃ mantrayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
mayā nāgapuraṃ gatvā sabhāyāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ tathyaṃ pathyaṃ hitaṃ cokto na ca gṛhṇāti durmatiḥ
kiṃca sarve nṛpatayaḥ sabhāyāṃ ye samāsate
apriyaṃ hṛdaye mahyaṃ tanna tiṣṭhati keśava
teṣāṃ vākyāni govinda śrotumicchāmyahaṃ vibho yathā ca nābhipadyeta kālastāta tathā kuru
bhavānhi no gatiḥ kṛṣṇa bhavānnātho bhavānguruḥ
madhye kurūṇāṃ rājendra sabhāyāṃ tannibodha me
tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā dvitīyaḥ syātkathaṃ sutaḥ
na cocchedaṃ kulaṃ yāyādvistīryecca kathaṃ yaśaḥ
pratijñāṃ duṣkarāṃ kṛtvā piturarthe kulasya ca arājā cordhvaretāśca yathā suviditaṃ tava
dāreṣvapyatisaktaśca yakṣmāṇaṃ samapadyata yadā tvarājake rāṣṭre na vavarṣa sureśvaraḥ
upakṣīṇāḥ prajāḥ sarvā rājā bhava bhavāya naḥ
vyādhīnpraṇudya vīra tvaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālaya
prajānāṃ krośatīnāṃ vai naivākṣubhyata me manaḥ pratijñāṃ rakṣamāṇasya tadvṛttaṃ smaratastathā
tataḥ paurā mahārāja mātā kālī ca me śubhā
sa tvamasmaddhitārthaṃ vai rājā bhava mahāmate
ūrdhvaretā hyarājā ca kulasyārthe punaḥ punaḥ
viśeṣatastvadarthaṃ ca dhuri mā māṃ niyojaya
ayācaṃ bhratṛdāreṣu tadā vyāsaṃ mahāmunim saha mātrā mahārāja prasādya tamṛṣiṃ mahāmunim
andhaḥ karaṇahīnatvānna vai rājā pitā tava
sa rājā tasya te putrāḥ piturdāyādyahāriṇaḥ
mā tāta kalahaṃ kārṣī rājyasyārdhaṃ pradīyatām
māvamaṃsyā vaco mahyaṃ śamamicchāmi vaḥ sadā
na viśeṣo'sti me putra tvayi teṣu ca ṣārthiva
madhye nṛpāṇāṃ bhadraṃ te vacanaṃ vacanakṣamaḥ
jyeṣṭhāya rājyamadadaddhṛtarāṣṭrāya dhīmate yavīyase tathā kṣatre kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhanaḥ
vanaṃ jagāma kauravyo bhāryābhyāṃ sahito nṛpaḥ
nīcaiḥ sthitvā tu vidura upāste sma vinītavat
visṛjya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya rājyaṃ sa vidurāya ca
kathaṃ tasya kule jātaḥ kulabhedaṃ vyavasyasi
samamācāryakaṃ tāta tava teṣāṃ ca me sadā
aśvatthāmā yathā mahyaṃ tathā śvetahayo mama
bahunā kiṃ pralāpena yato dharmastato jayaḥ

punarbhedaśca me yukto yadā sāma na gṛhyate
adbhutāni ca ghorāṇi dāruṇāni ca bhārata
rādheyaṃ bhīṣayitvā ca saubalaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ

nikṛtaśca mayā pūrvaṃ saha sarvaiḥ sahodaraiḥ

vividhāni ca śastrāṇi cakruḥ sarvāṇi sarvaśaḥ

kuntyāśca vipulaprajña prajñā kārtsnyena te śrutā
na ca bhīṣmasya durmedhāḥ śṛṇoti vidurasya vā
naiṣa kāmayate dharmaṃ naiṣa kāmayate yaśaḥ
jitaṃ sa manyate sarvaṃ durātmā karṇamāśritaḥ
na ca taṃ labdhavānkāmaṃ durātmā pāpaniścayaḥ

yasminyatnaḥ kṛto'smābhiḥ sa no hīnaḥ prayatnataḥ

senā ca vāhinī caiva pṛtanā dhvajinī camūḥ
akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca saṅkhyātāḥ sapta caiva ha
tatra duryodhano rājā śūrānbuddhimato narān prasamīkṣya mahābāhuścakre senāpatīṃstadā
kṛpaṃ droṇaṃ ca śalyaṃ ca saindhavaṃ ca jayadratham
droṇaputraṃ ca karṇaṃ ca bhūriśravasameva ca
śakuniṃ saubalaṃ caiva bāhlīkaṃ ca mahābalam
divase divase teṣāṃ prativelaṃ ca bhārata
cakre sa vividhāḥ pūjāḥ pratyakṣaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
tathā viniyatāḥ sarve ye ca teṣāṃ padānugāḥ
nahi jātu dvayorbuddhiḥ samā bhavati karhicit
śauryaṃ ca valanetṝṇāṃ spardhate ca parasparam
te sma yuddhe prabhajyante trayo varṇāḥ punaḥ punaḥ
senāpatiṃ prakurvanti te jayanti raṇe ripūn
bhavānuśanasā tulyo hitaiṣī ca sadā mama
asaṃhārthaḥ sthito dharme sa naḥ senāpatirbhava
parvatānāṃ yathā meruḥ suparṇaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ yathā
bhavatā hi vayaṃ guptāḥ śatreṇeva divaukasaḥ
yathaiva hi bhavanto me tathaiva mama pāṇḍavāḥ
api caiva mayā śroyo vācyaṃ teṣāṃ narādhipa
saṃyoddhavyaṃ tavārthāya yathā me samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
na tu paśyāmi yoddhāramātmanaḥ sadṛśaṃ bhuvi
na tu māṃ vivṛto yuddhe jātu yudhyeta pāṇḍavaḥ
ahaṃ sa ca kṣaṇenaiva nirmanuṣyamidaṃ jagat
na tvevotsādanīyā me pāṇḍoḥ putrā janādhipa
na cette māṃ haniṣyanti pūrvameva samāgame
karṇo vā yudhyatāṃ pūrvamahaṃ vā pṛthivīpate
spardhate hi sadātyarthaṃ sūtaputro mayā raṇe
hate bhīṣme tu yotsyāmi saha gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
tato drupadamānāyya virāṭaṃ śinipuṅgavam dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pāñcālyaṃ dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca pārthiva
śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca pāñcālyaṃ sahadevaṃ ca māgadham
arjunasyāpi netā ca saṃyantā caiva vājinām
tatastaṃ pāṇḍavo rājā kare pasparśa pāṇinā
pāṇḍavā hi yathāsmākaṃ tathā duryodhano nṛpaḥ
tasyāpi kriyatāṃ sāhyaṃ sa paryeti punaḥpunaḥ
dhruvo jayaḥ pāṇḍavānāmiti me niścitā matiḥ
ubhau śiṣyau hi me vīrau gadāyaddhaviśāradau
trīṇyevaitāni divyāni dhanūṃṣi divicāriṇām vāruṇaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tatra māhendraṃ vijayaṃ dhanuḥ
śārṅga tu vaiṣṇavaṃ prāhurdivyaṃ tejomayaṃ dhanuḥ
puraṃ tadbhuvi vikhyātaṃ nāmnā bhojakaṭaṃ nṛpa
tataḥ sa kavacī dhanvī talī khaṅgī śarāsanī
sahāyosmi sthito yuddhe yadi bhītosi pāṇḍava
na hi me vikrame tulyaḥ pumānastīha kaścana
śrṛṇvatāṃ pārthivendrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ vāsudevamabhiprekṣya dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
upajīvya raṇe rudraṃ śakraṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ yamam
varuṇaṃ pāvakaṃ caiva kṛpaṃ droṇaṃ ca mādhavam
kauravāmāṃ kule jātaḥ pāṇḍoḥ putro viśeṣataḥ
nāsmi bhīto mahābāho sahāyārthaśca nāsti me
yathākāmaṃ yathāyogaṃ gaccha vātraiva tiṣṭha vā
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya vijayasya ca dhīmataḥ vinivartya tato rukmī senāṃ sāgarasaṃnibhām
gate rāme tīrthayātrāṃ bhīṣmakasya sute tathā
na śaknomi niyantuṃ vā kartuṃ vā hitamātmanaḥ
evaṃ gate vai yadbhāvi tadbhaviṣyati sañjaya
kṣatradharmaḥ kila raṇe tanutyāge hi pūjitaḥ
śṛṇuṣvānavaśeṣeṇa vadato mama pārthiva ya ātmano duścaritādaśubhaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ
na sa kālaṃ na vā devānenasā gantumarhati
hayānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām
vaiśasaṃ samare vṛttaṃ yattanme śṛṇu sarvaśaḥ
yathābhūtaṃ mahāyuddhe śrutvā mā vimanā bhava
na hyeva kartā puruṣaḥ karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ
ārakṣasya vidhiṃ kṛtvā yodhānāṃ tatra bhārata
karṇaṃ duḥśāsanaṃ caiva śakuniṃ cāpi saubalam
tatra duryodhano rājā karṇena saha bhārata
gatvā mama vaco brūhi vāsudevasya śrṛṇvataḥ
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ somakaiśca sakekayaiḥ kathaṃ vā dhārmiko bhūtvā tvamadharme manaḥ kṛthāḥ
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyo pātā tvamiti me matiḥ
śrūyate hi purā gītaḥ śloko'yaṃ bharatarṣabha
prahlādenātha bhadraṃ te hṛte rājye tu daivataiḥ
yasya dharmadhvajo nityaṃ surā dhvaja ivocchritaḥ
pracchannāni ca pāpāni baiḍālaṃ nāma tadbratam
sa vai kṛtvā manaḥśuddhiṃ pratyayārthaṃ śarīriṇām
sametya ca praśaṃsanti mārjāraṃ taṃ viśāṃpate
ātmakāryaṃ kṛtaṃ mene cāryāyāśca kṛtaṃ phalam
atha dīrghasya kālasya taṃ deśaṃ mūṣikā yayuḥ
dadṛśustaṃ ca te tatra dhārmikaṃ vratacāriṇam
bahumitrā vayaṃ sarve teṣāṃ no mātulo hyayam
te vayaṃ sahitāḥ sarve bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
sa no rakṣa mahāprajña tridaśāniva vajrabhṛt
dvayoryogaṃ na paśyāmi tapaso rakṣaṇasya ca
avaśyaṃ tu mayā kāryaṃ vacanaṃ bhavatāṃ hitam
na cāpi gamane śaktiṃ kāṃcitpaśyāmi cintayan
tataḥ sa pāpo duṣṭātmā mūṣikānatha bhakṣayan
mātulo vardhate nityaṃ vayaṃ kṣīyāmahe bhṛśam
sādhu sādhviti te sarve pūjayāñcakrire tadā
anyathā kila te vākyamanyathā karma dṛśyate
yudhyāmahe kathaṃ saṅkhye kopayema ca pāṇḍavān
jātuṣe ca gṛhe dāhaṃ smara taṃ puruṣo bhava
kiṃ nu yuddhātparaṃ lābhaṃ kṣatriyo bahu manyate
kiṃca tvaṃ kṣatriyakule jātaḥ saṃprathito bhuvi
ātmārthaṃ pāṇḍavārthaṃ ca yatto māṃ pratiyodhaya
indrajālaṃ ca māyāṃ vai kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā
vayamapyutsahema dyāṃ khaṃ ca gacchema māyayā
rasātalaṃ viśāmopi aindraṃ vā purameva tu
manasaiva hi bhūtāni dhātaiva kurute vaśe
ghātayitvā pradāsyāmi pārthebhyo rājyamuttamam ācacakṣe ca me sarvaṃ sañjayastava bhāṣitam
yuddhyasvādya raṇe yattaḥ paśyāmaḥ puruṣo bhava
karoti dviṣatāṃ śokaṃ sa jīvati sujīvitam
akasmāccaiva te kṛṣṇa khyātaṃ loke mahadyaśaḥ
virāṭanagare pārtha yastvaṃ sūdo hyabhūḥ purā
pratijñātaṃ sabhāmadhye na tanmithyā tvayā purā
tvaṃ hi bhojye puraskāryo bhakṣye peye ca bhārata
kva yuddhaṃ kva ca bhoktavyaṃ yudhyasva puruṣo bhava
tadvṛthā ca sabhāmadhye valgitaṃ te vṛkodara
yudhiṣṭhirānurāgaṃ ca dveṣaṃ ca mayi bhārata
brūyāstvaṃ sahadevaṃ ca rājamadhye vaco mama
yuddhyedānīṃ raṇe yattaḥ kleśānsmara ca pāṇḍava
virāṭadrupadau cobhau brūyāstvaṃ vacanānmama na dṛṣṭapūrvā bhartāro bhṛtyairapi mahāguṇaiḥ
te yūyaṃ saṃhatā bhūtvā tadvadhārthaṃ mamāpi ca
ātmārthaṃ pāṇḍavārthaṃ ca prayuddhyadhvaṃ mayā saha
eṣa te samayaḥ prāpto labdhavyaśca tvayāpi saḥ
kuru karma raṇe yattaḥ paśyāmaḥ pauruṣaṃ tava
balaṃ vīryaṃ ca śauryaṃ ca paraṃ cāpyastralāghavam
pauruṣaṃ darśayanyuddhe kopasya kuru niṣkṛtim parikliṣṭasya dīnasya dīrghakāloṣitasya ca
āsthitaṃ rājyamākramya kopaṃ kasya na dīpayet
amitrāṇāṃ vaśe sthānaṃ rājyaṃ ca punaruddhara
apriyāṇāṃ ca vacanaṃ prabruvatsu punaḥ punaḥ
iha te dṛśyatāṃ pārtha yuddhyasva puruṣo bhava
puṣṭāste'śvā bhṛtā yodhāḥ śvo yuddhyasva sakeśavaḥ
sūtaputraṃ sudurdharṣaṃ śalyaṃ ca balināṃ varam
droṇaṃ ca balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śacīpatisamaṃ yudhi
na hi śuśruma vātena merumunmathitaṃ girim
yugaṃ vā rivarteta yadyevaṃ syādyathāttha mām
pārtho vā itaro vāpi konyaḥ svasti gṛhānvrajet
kiṃ darduraḥ kūpaśayo yathemāṃ na budhyase rājacamūṃ sametām
nānājanaughaṃ yudhi saṃpravṛddhaṃ gāṅgaṃ yathā vegamapāraṇīyam
māṃ ca sthitaṃ nānābalasya madhye yuyutsase manda kimalpabuddhe
akṣayyāviṣudhī caiva agnidattaṃ ca te ratham
jānīmo hi raṇe pārtha ketuṃ divyaṃ ca bhārata
sarve bhaveyuḥ siddhārthāḥ katthane ko hi durgataḥ
janāmi te vāsudevaṃ sahāyaṃ jānāmi te gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram
jānāmyahaṃ tvādṛśo nāsti yoddhā jānānaste rājyametaddharāmi
na tu paryāyadharmema siddhiṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ
na vai mokṣastadā yo bhūdvinā kṛṣṇamaninditāṃ
dhṛtā hi vemī pārthena virāṭanagare tadā
evameva sadā daṇḍaṃ kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriye dadhuḥ
na bhayādvāsudevasya na cāpi tava phalguna
na māyā hīndrajālaṃ vā kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā
saṃyugaṃ gaccha bhīṣmeṇa bhindhi vā śirasā girim
praśāmya rājyaṃ hi sudurlabhaṃ tvayā bubhūṣitaḥ svarga ivātapasvinā
ulūka na bhayaṃ te'sti brūhi tvaṃ vigatajvaraḥ
sṛñjayānāṃ ca matsyānāṃ kṛṣṇasya ca yaśasvinaḥ
bhūmipānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ madhye vākyaṃ jagāda ha
samaḥ panthā bhṛtāsteśvāḥ śvo yudhyasva sakeśavaḥ
sūtaputraṃ sudurgharṣaṃ śalyaṃ ca balināṃ varam
droṇaṃ ca balināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śacīpatisamaṃ yudhi
na hi śuśruma vātena merumunmathitaṃ girim
yugaṃ vā parivarteta yadyevaṃ syādyathāttha mām
gajo vājī ratho vāpi punaḥ svasti gṛhānvrajet
kiṃ durduraḥ kūpaśayo yathemāṃ na budhyame rājacamūṃ sametām
nānājanaughaṃ yudhi saṃpravṛddhaṃ nāṅgaṃ yathā vegamapārakaṇīyam
māṃ ca sthitaṃ nāgabalasya madhye yuyutsame manda kimalpabuddhe
sarve bhaveyuḥ siddhārthāḥ katthane ko hi durgataḥ
jānāmi te vāsudevaṃ sahāyaṃ jānāmi te gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram
na tu paryāyadharmeṇa rājyaṃ prāpnoti mānuṣaḥ
dhṛtā hi veṇī pārthena virāṭanagare tadā
na bhayādvāsudevasya na cāpi tava phālguna
na māyā hīndrajālaṃ vā kuhakā vāpi bhīṣaṇā
saṃyugaṃ gaccha bhūṣmeṇa bhindhi vā śirasā girim
praśāmya rājyaṃ hi sudurlabhaṃ tvayā bubhūṣitaḥ svarga ivātapasvinā
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ruṣitāḥ pāṇḍavā bhṛśam
śrutaṃ vākyaṃ gṛhītortho mataṃ yatte tathāstu tat
sṛñjayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kṛṣṇasya ca yaśasvinaḥ
bhūmipānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ madhye vākyaṃ jagāda ha
tadavasthaṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā pārthaṃ sā samitirnṛpa
śrutaṃ te cavanaṃ mūrkha yattvāṃ duryodhano'bravīt
tanme kathayato manda śrṛṇu vākyaṃ durāsadam
marṣitaṃ te durācāra tattvaṃ na bahu manyase
mayāpi ca pratijñāto vadhaḥ sabhrātṛkasya te
sa tathā bhavitā pāpa nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
sahāyaste yadi yamaḥ kubero rudra eva vā yathāpratijñaṃ durbuddhe prakariṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
api bhīṣmaṃ puruskṛtya taṃ neṣyāmi yamakṣayam
śrṛṇu pāpa vaco mahyaṃ yadvācyo hi pitātvayā
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya saṃbandho yadi na syāttvayā saha
bhīmasena na te santi yeṣāṃ vairaṃ tvayā saha
ulūkaśca na te vācyaḥ paruṣaṃ puruṣottama
samagraṃ pārthivaṃ kṣatraṃ sarvaṃ na gaṇayāmyaham
śvo bhūte katthitasyāsya prativākyaṃ camūmukhe gāṇḍīvenābhidhāsyākami klībā hi vacanottarāḥ
ulūka gaccha kaitavya brūhi tāta suyodhanam
pāṇḍaveṣu sadā pāpa nityaṃ jihmaṃ pravartate svavīryādyaḥ parākramya pāpa āhvayate parān
sa pāpaḥ kṣatriyo bhūtvā asmānāhūya saṃyuge
sa tvaṃ pareṣāṃ vīryeṇa ātmānaṃ bahumanyase
śva idānīṃ prapadyethāḥ puruṣo bhava durmate
manyase yacca mūḍha tvaṃ na yotsyati janārdanaḥ
sārathyena vṛtaḥ pārthairiti tvaṃ na bibheṣi ca
na tvāṃ samīkṣate pārtho nāpi rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
svavīryaṃ yaḥ samāśritya samāhvayati vai parān
abhīto yudhyate śatrūnsa vai puruṣa ucyate
sa tvaṃ pareṣāṃ vīryeṇa manyase vīryamātmanaḥ
na haniṣyanti gāṅgeyaṃ pāṇḍavā ghṛṇayeti hi
yasya vīryaṃ samāśritya dhārtarāṣṭra vikatthase hantāsmi prathamaṃ bhīṣmaṃ miṣatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
kaitavya gatvā bharatānsametya suyodhanaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ vadasva
ahaṃ hantā sṛñjayānāmanīkaṃ sālveyakāṃśceti mamaiṣa bhāraḥ kaitavya gatvā bharatānsametya suyodhanaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ vadasva
hanyāmahaṃ droṇamṛte'pi lokaṃ na te bhayaṃ vidyate pāṇḍavebhyaḥ
tato hi te labdhamataṃ ca rājyamāpadgatāḥ pāṇḍavāśceti bhāvaḥ
sa darpapūrṇo na samīkṣase tvamanarthamātmanyapi vartamānam
tasmādahaṃ te prathamaṃ samūhe hantā samakṣa kuruvṛddhameva
sūryodaye yuktasenaḥ pratīkṣya dhvajī rathī rakṣata satyasandham
ahaṃ hi vaḥ paśyatāṃ dvipamenaṃ bhīṣmaṃ rathātpātayiṣyāmi bāṇaiḥ
āśā te jīvite mūḍha rājye vā kena hetunā
śānte bhīṣme tathā droṇe sūtaputre ca pātite
nirāśo jīvite rājye putreṣu ca bhaviṣyasi
bhrātṝṇāṃ nidhanaṃ śrutvā putrāṇāṃ ca suyodhana
na dvitīyāṃ pratijñāṃ hi pratijānāmi kaitava
ulūka madvaco brūhi gatvā tāta suyodhanam
svena vṛttena me vṛttaṃ nādhigantuṃ tvamarhasi
kiṃ punarjñātiṣu vadhaṃ kāmayeyaṃ kathaṃ ca na
etadarthaṃ mayā tāta pañca grāmā vṛtāḥ purā
kathaṃ tava sudurbuddhe na prekṣye vyasanaṃ mahat
sa tvaṃ kāmaparītātmā mūḍhabhāvācca katthase tathaiva vāsudevasya na gṛhṇāsi hitaṃ vacaḥ
kiṃcedānīṃ bahūktena yudhyasva saha bāndhavaiḥ mama vipriyakartāraṃ kaitavya saha bāndhavaiḥ
mama vipriyakartāraṃ kaitavya brūhi kauravam śrutaṃ vākyaṃ gṛhīto'rtho mataṃ yatte tathāstu tat
bhīmasenastato vākyaṃ bhūya āha nṛpātmajam ulūka madvaco brūhi durmatiṃ pāpapūruṣam
śaṭhaṃ naikṛtikaṃ pāpaṃ durācāraṃ suyodhanam gṛdhrodare vā vastavyaṃ pure vā nāgasāhvaye
pratijñātaṃ mayā yacca sabhāmadhye narādhama kartāhaṃ tadvacaḥ satyaṃ satyenaiva śapāmi te
duḥśāsanasya rudhiraṃ hatvā pāsyāmyahaṃ mṛdhe sakthinī tava bhaṃktvaiva hatvā hi tava sodanān
hatvā suyodhana tvāṃ vai sahitaṃ sarvasodaraiḥ
śrutaṃ te gadato vākyaṃ sarvameva yathātatham tathā kartāsmi kauravya yathā tvamanuśāsi māṃ - - asahadevo'pi nṛpate idamāha vaco'rthavat suyodhana matiryā te vṛthaiṣā te bhaviṣyati
imaṃ ca kleśamasmākaṃ hṛṣṭo yattvaṃ vikatthase
virāṭadrupadau vṛddhāvulūkamidamūcatuḥ dāsabhāvaṃ niyaccheva sādhoriti matiḥ sadā
tau ca dāsāvadāsau vā pauruṣaṃ yasya yādṛśam
paśya tvaṃ māṃ raṇe rājankurvāṇaṃ karma dāruṇam
yasya vīryaṃ samāsādya manyase vijayaṃ yudhi
suyodhano mama vaco vaktavyo nṛpateḥ sutaḥ
avaśyaṃ ca mayā kāryaṃ pūrveṣāṃ caritaṃ mahat kartā cāhaṃ tathā karma yathā nānyaḥ kariṣyati
sa gaccha māciraṃ tāta ulūka yadi manyase
iha vā tiṣṭha bhadraṃ te vayaṃ hi tava bāndhavāḥ
āmantrya prayayau tatra yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ
nakulasya virāṭasya drupadasya ca bhārata sahadevasya ca vaco dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṇḍinoḥ
duḥśāsanaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca śakuniṃ cāpi bhārata
tūrṇaṃ pariyayuḥ senāṃ kṛtsnāṃ karṇasya śāsanāt
aśvātthāmne ca nakulaṃ śaibyaṃ ca kṛtavarmaṇe
sa samarthaṃ hi taṃ mene pārthādabhyadhikaṃ raṇe
evaṃ vibhajya yodhāṃstānpṛthakva saha caiva ha
hatameva hi paśyāmi gāṅgeyaṃ pitaraṃ raṇe
namaskṛtya kumārāya senānye śaktipāṇaye ahaṃ senāpatiste'dya bhaviṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ
yātrāyāne ca yuddhe ca tathā praśamaneṣu ca
bhṛśaṃ veda mahārāja yathā veda bṛhaspatiḥ
vidyate me na gāṅgeya bhayaṃ devāsureṣvapi
gāndhāre śrṛṇu rājendra rathasaṃkhyāṃ svake bale
rathānāṃ tava senāyāṃ yathāmukhyaṃ tu me śruṇu
arthasiddhiṃ tava raṇe kariṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
spardhate vāsudevena nityaṃ yo vai raṇeraṇe bhāgineyānnijāṃstyaktvā śalyaste'tiratho mataḥ
bhūriśravāḥ kṛtāsraśca tava cāpi hitaḥ suhṛt
sindhurājo mahārāja mato me dviguṇo rathāḥ
etena hi tadā rājaṃstapa āsthāya dāruṇam
trigartā bhrātaraḥ pañca rathodārā matā mama
te rathāḥ pañca rājendra yeṣāṃ satyaratho mukham
yuddhānāṃ ca viśeṣajñau praṇetārau ca sarvaśaḥ
rathau tau kuruśārdūla matau me rathasattamau
yotsyate tava saṅgrāme svena sainyena pālitaḥ
naiṣa śakyo mayā vīraḥ saṃkhyātuṃ rathasattamaḥ
na me ratho nātiratho mataḥ pārthivasattama
raṇe karma mahatkartā atra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
bharadvājātmajaḥ kartā karma tīvraṃ hitaṃ tava
ślāghate yaṃ sadā vīra pārthasya guṇavistaraiḥ
pradhakṣyati ripūṇāṃ te balaṃ tu balināṃ varaḥ
ratha eṣa mahārāja mato me rājasattama
eṣa vikrāntayodhī ca citrayodhī ca saṃgare
na hyeṣa samaraṃ prāpya nivarteta kathañcana
etasya samaraṃ dṛṣṭvā na vyathāsti kathañcana
sakhā te dayito nityaṃ ya eṣa raṇakarkaśaḥ
mantrī netā ca bandhuśca mānī cātyantamucchritaḥ
eṣa naiva rathaḥ pūrṇo na cāpyatiratho raṇe
kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca divyābhyāṃ viyuktaḥ satataṃ ghṛṇī
ghṛṇī karṇaḥ pramādī ca tena me'rdharatho mataḥ
tvaṃ tuṃ māṃ mānyase mandaṃ yathā kāpuruṣaṃ tathā
bhavānardharatho mahyaṃ mato vai nātra saṃśayaḥ
sarvasya jagataścaiva gāṅgeyo na mṛṣā vadet
na hāyanairna palitairna vittairna ca bandhubhiḥ
bhinnā hi senā nṛpate duḥsandheyā bhavatyuta
eṣāṃ dvaidhaṃ samutpannaṃ yodhānāṃ yudhi bhārata
kvaca yuddhaṃ vimardo vā mantre suvyāhṛtāni ca
ekākī spardhati nityaṃ sarveṇa ramatā saha
na tveva hyativṛddhānāṃ punarbālāhi te matāḥ
senāpatau yaśo gantā na tu yodhānkathañcana
hate bhīṣme tu yoddhā'smi sarvaireva mahārathaiḥ
mitho bhedo na me kāryastena jīvasi sūtaja
na hyahaṃ tvadya vikramya sthaviro'pi śiśostava
na me vyathā kṛtā kācittvaṃ tu me ki kariṣyasi
vakṣyāmi tu tvāṃ santapto nihīna kulapāṃsana
yudhyasva samare pārthaṃ yena vispardhase saha
māṃ samīkṣasva gāṅgeya kāryaṃ hi mahadudyatam
prabhātāyāṃ rajanyāṃ vai idaṃ yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati
yadi kautūhalaṃ te'dya pāṇḍavānāṃ bale nṛpa
na tasyāsti samo yuddhe gadayā sāyakairapi
nāgāyutabalo mānī tejasā na sa mānuṣaḥ
na caiṣāṃ puruṣāḥ kecidāyudhāni gadāḥ śarān
udyantuṃ vā gadā gurvīḥ śarānvā kṣeptumāhave
vidhvaṃsayiṣyanti raṇe mā sma taiḥ saha saṃgamaḥ
draupadyāśca parikleśaṃ dyūte ca paruṣā giraḥ
te smarantaśca saṅgrāme cariṣyanti ca rudravat
na hi deveṣu vā pūrvaṃ manuṣyeṣūrageṣu ca
rākṣaseṣvatha yakṣeṣu nareṣu kuta eva tu
bhūtotha vā bhaviṣyo vā rathaḥ kaścinmayā śrutaḥ
gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanurdivyaṃ te cāśvā vātaraṃhasaḥ
tava senāṃ mahābāhuḥ svāṃ caiva paripālayan
jīmūta iva gharmānte mahāvātasamīritaḥ samāyuktastu kaunteyo vāsudevasahāyavān
etacchrutvā tu bhīṣmasya rājñāṃ dadhvaṃsire tadā
manobhiḥ saha saṃvegaiḥ saṃsmṛtya ca purātanam
pāṇḍavaiḥ saha rājendra tava senāsu bhārata
yatiṣyete paraṃ śaktyā sthitau vīragate pathi
kāraṇaṃ prāpya tu narāḥ sarva eva mahābhujāḥ
śūrā vā kātarā vāpi bhavanti kurupuṅgava
śikhaṇḍī rathamukhyo me mataḥ pārthasya bhārata
kṣatradharmā tu rājendra mato me'rdharatho nṛpa
eṣa cedipatiḥ śūraḥ saha putreṇa bhārata
yotsyante samare tāta saṃrabdhā iva kuñjarāḥ
yotsyete balinau śūrau paraṃ śaktyā yatiṣyataḥ
sa hi saṅgrāmaśobhī ca bhaktaścāpi kirīṭinaḥ cekitānaḥ satyadhṛtiḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathau
matau mama rathodārau pāṇḍavānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
yaḥ samo vāsudevena bhīmasenena vā vibho
sa yotsyati hi vikramya samare tava sainikaiḥ
māṃ ca droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva yathā saṃmanyate bhavān
ayaṃ ca yudhi vikrānto mantavyoṣṭaguṇo rathaḥ
mātulo bhīmasenasya sa ca me'tiratho mataḥ
eṣa vīro maheṣvāsaḥ kṛtī ca nipuṇaśca ha
citrayodhī ca śaktaśca mato me rathapuṅgavaḥ
sa yotsyati hi vikramya maghavāniva dānavaiḥ
yodhā ye cāsya vikhyātāḥ sarve yuddhaviśāradāḥ
ye cāsya rākṣasā vīrāḥ sacivā vaśavartinaḥ
neṣyanti samare senāṃ bhīmāṃ yaudhiṣṭhirīṃ nṛpa
yaṃ caiva te rathodārāḥ pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ
ete rathāścātirathāśca tubhyaṃ yathāpradhānaṃ nṛpa kīrtitā mayā
tathā pare ye'rdharathāśca kecittathaiṃva teṣāmapi kauravendra
arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca ye cānye tatra pārthivāḥ
pāñcālyaṃ tu mahābāho nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam
naiva hanyāṃ striyaṃ jātu na strīpūrvaṃ kadācana
sa hi strīpūrvako rājañśikhaṇḍī yadi te śrutaḥ
kanyā bhūtvā pumāñcāto na yotsye tena bhārata
yadarthaṃ yudhi saṃprekṣya nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam
tasmiṃśca nidhanaṃ prāpte satyavatyā mate sthitaḥ
tathā'śrauṣaṃ mahābāho tisraḥ kanyāḥ svayaṃvare rūpeṇāpratimāḥ sarvāḥ kāśirājasutāstadā
apaśyaṃ tā mahābāho tisraḥ kanyāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ
vīryaśulkāśca tā jñātvā samāropya rathaṃ tadā avocaṃ pārthivānsarvānahaṃ tatra samāgatān
te yatadhvaṃ paraṃ śaktyā sarve mokṣāya pārthivāḥ
prasahya hi harāmyeṣa miṣatāṃ vo nararṣabhāḥ
tataste māṃ mahīpālāḥ sarva eva viśāṃ pate
te nivṛttāśca bhagnāśca dṛṣṭvā tallāghavaṃ mama - - bpraṇipetuśca sarve vai praśaśaṃsuśca pārthivāḥ
tata ādāya tāḥ kanyā nṛpatīṃśca visṛjya tān athā'haṃ hāstinapuramāyāṃ jitvā mahīkṣitaḥ
tato'haṃ tāśca kanyā vai bhrāturarthāya bhārata
imāḥ kāśipateḥ kanyā mayā nirjitya pārthivān
āha satyavatī hṛṣṭā diṣṭyā putra jitaṃ tvayā
uvāca vākyaṃ savrīḍā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā
śrutvā ca vacanaṃ dharmyaṃ mahyaṃ kartumihārhasi
tena cāsmi vṛtā pūrvaṃ rahasyavidite pituḥ
sa māṃ pratīkṣate vyaktaṃ sālvarājo viśāṃpate
kṛpāṃ kuru mahābāho mayi dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
tvaṃ hi satyavrato vīra pṛthivyāmiti naḥ śrutam
tato'haṃ samanujñāpya kālīṃ gandhavatīṃ tadā mantriṇaścartvijaścaiva tathaiva ca purohitān
anujñātā yayau sā tu kanyā sālvapateḥ puram
tvaṃ hi me manasā dhyātastvayā cāpyupamantritā
gaccha bhadre punastatra sakāśaṃ bhīṣmakasya vai
nāhamicchāmi bhīṣmeṇa gṛhītāṃ tvāṃ prasahya vai
tvaṃ hi bhīṣmeṇa nirjitya nītā prītimatī tadā
yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ bhadre mā tvāṃ kālo'tyagādayam
bhaktānāṃ hi parityāgo na dharmeṣu praśasyate
bhaginyau mama ye nīte ambikāmbālike nṛpa
yathā sālvapate nānyaṃ varaṃ yāmi kathaṃcana
tāmevaṃ bhāṣamāṇāṃ tu sālvaḥ kāśipateḥ sutām
tataḥ sā manyunā''viṣṭā jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ sutā
tvayā tyaktā gamiṣyāmi yatra tatra viśāṃpate
tatra me gatayaḥ santu santaḥ satyaṃ yathā dhruvam
evaṃ tāṃ bhāṣamāṇāṃ tu kanyāṃ sālvapatistadā
gaccha gaccheti tāṃ sālvaḥ punaḥ punarabhāṣata
na ca śakyaṃ punargantuṃ mayā vāraṇasāhvayam
pravṛtte dāruṇe yuddhe sālvārthaṃ nāpataṃ purā
dhigbhīṣmaṃ dhikka me mandaṃ pitaraṃ mūḍhacetasam
anayasyāsya tu mukhaṃ bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo mama
tapasā vā yudhā vāpi duḥkhahetuḥ sa me mataḥ
ko nu bhīṣmaṃ yudhā jetumutsaheta mahīpatiḥ
ācakhyau ca yathāvṛttaṃ sarvamātmani bhārata vistareṇa mahābāho nikhilena śucismitā
haraṇaṃ ca visargaṃ ca sālvena ca visarjanam
ārtā tāmāha sa muniḥ śaikhāvatyo mahātapāḥ
evaṃ gate tu kiṃ bhadre śakyaṃ kartuṃ tapasvibhiḥ
mayaiva yāni karmāṇi pūrvadehe tu mūḍhayā
notsahe tu punargantuṃ svajanaṃ prati tāpasāḥ
sāntvayāmāsa kāryaṃ ca pratijajñe dvijaiḥ saha
neti kecidvyavasyanti pratyākhyātā hi tena sā
evaṃ gate tu kiṃ śakyaṃ bhadre kartuṃ manīṣibhiḥ
alaṃ pravrajiteneha bhadre śrṛṇu hitaṃ vacaḥ
ito gacchasva bhadraṃ te pitureva niveśanam
pratipastyati rājā sa pitā te yadanantaram
na ca te'nyā gatirnyāyyā bhavedbhadre yathā pitā patirvāpi gatirnāryāḥ pitā vā varavarṇini
gatiḥ patiḥ samasthāyā viṣame ca pitā gatiḥ
bhadre doṣā hi vidyante bahavo varavarṇini
āśrame vai vasantyāste na bhaveyuḥ piturgṛhe
uṣitāsmi tathā bālye piturveśmani tāpasāḥ nāhaṃ gamiṣye bhadraṃ vastatra yatra pitā mama
yathā pare'pi me loke na syādevaṃ mahātyayaḥ
ityevaṃ teṣu vipreṣu cintayansu yathātatham rājarṣistadvanaṃ prāptastapasvī hotravāhanaḥ
tāṃ tathā bhāvinīṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutvā codvigramānasaḥ
tataste tāpasāḥ sarve pūjayanti sma taṃ nṛpam
punareva kathāṃ cakruḥ kanyāṃ prati vanaukasaḥ
tāṃ tathāvādinīṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā ca sa mahātapāḥ
sa vepamāna utthāya mātustasyāḥ pitā tadā
sā ca tasmai yathāvṛttaṃ vistareṇa nyavedayat
mā gāḥ piturgṛhaṃ bhadre mātuste janako hyaham
duḥkhaṃ chindyāmahaṃ te vai mayi vartasva putrike
paryāptaṃ te mano vatse yadevaṃ pariśuṣyasi
haniṣyati raṇe bhīṣmaṃ na kariṣyati cedvacaḥ
pratiṣṭhāpayitā sa tvāṃ same pathi mahātapāḥ
api nāmādya paśyeyamāryaṃ taṃ lokaviśrutam kathaṃ ca tīvraṃ duḥkaṃ me nāśakayiṣyati bhārgavaḥ
etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ yathā yāsyami tatra vaiḥ
rāmaṃ drakṣyasi bhadre tvaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ mahāvane
mahendraṃ vai giriśreṣṭhaṃ rāmo nityamupāsti ha
tatra gacchasva bhadraṃ te brūyāścainaṃ vaco mama
abhivādya ca taṃ mūṃrdhnā tapovṛddhaṃ dṛḍhavratam
mayi saṃkīrtite rāmaḥ sarvaṃ tatte kariṣyati
mama rāmaḥ sakhā vatse prītiyuktaḥ suhṛcca me
evaṃ bruvati kanyāṃ tu pārthive hotravāhane
sa ca rājā vayovṛddhaḥ sṛñyayo hotravāhanaḥ
akṛtavraṇa śakyo vai druṣṭuṃ vedavidāṃ vara
iha rāmaḥ prabhāte śvo bhaviteti matirmama
iyaṃ ca kanyā rājarṣe kimarthaṃ vanamāgatā
kasya ceyaṃ tava ca kā bhavatīcchāmi veditum
tatā kila mahāvīryo bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo nṛpān
taṃ tu vaivāhikaṃ dṛṣṭvā kanyeyaṃ samupārjitam
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ bhīṣmaḥ saṃmantrya saha mantribhiḥ
anujñātā tu bhīṣmeṇa sālvaṃ saubhapatiṃ tataḥ
mayā ca pratyabhijñātā vaṃśasya parikīrtanāt asya duḥkhasya cotpattiṃ bhīṣmameveha manyate
sṛñjayasya vacaḥ śrutvā tava caiva śucismite
yadatra te bhṛśaṃ kāryaṃ tadadyaiva vicintyatām
dharmaṃ prativaco brūyāḥ śrṛṇu cadaṃ vaco mama
tena tvaṃ nirjitā bhadre yasmānnītāsi bhāmini
bhīṣmaḥ puruṣamānī ca jitakāśī tathaiva ca
bhīṣmaṃ vā sālvarājaṃ vā yaṃ vā doṣeṇa gacchasi
evaṃ kathayatāmeva teṣāṃ sa divaso gataḥ
tatastaṃ tāpasā dṛṣṭvā sa ca rājā mahātapāḥ
tasthuḥ prāñjalayo rājansā ca kanyā tapasvinī
paramaṃ kathyatāṃ ceti tāṃ rāmaḥ pratyabhāṣata
yathā tvaṃ sṛṃjayasyāsya tathā me tvaṃ nṛpātmaje
brūhi yatte manoduḥkhaṃ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
tasyāśca dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ca vapuścābhinavaṃ punaḥ
kariṣyati vaco mahyaṃ śrutvā ca sa narādhipaḥ
athavā te matistatra rājaputri na vartate
mama tu vyasanasyāsya bhīṣmo mūlaṃ mahāvrataḥ
sa hi lubdhaśca nīcaśca jitakāśī ca bhārgava
eṣa me hriyamāṇāyā bhāratena tadā vibho
jahi bhīṣmaṃ mahābāho yathā vṛtraṃ purandaraḥ
uvāca rudatīṃ kanyāṃ codayantīṃ punaḥ punaḥ
kāśye na kāmaṃ gṛhṇāmi śastraṃ vai varavarṇini
vācā bhīṣmaśca sālvaśca mama rājñi vaśānugau
na tu śastraṃ grahīṣyāmi kathaṃcidapi bhāmini
tacca bhīṣmaprasūtaṃ me taṃ jahīśvara mā ciram
jahi bhīṣmaṃ raṇe rāma mama cedicchasi priyam
yadi bhīṣmo raṇe rāma samāhūtastvayā mṛdhe
vākyaṃ satyaṃ ca te vīra bhaviṣyati kṛtaṃ vibho iyaṃ cāpi pratijñā te tadā rāma mahāmune
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdraścaiva raṇe yadi
yaśca kṛtsnaṃ raṇe kṣatraṃ vijeṣyati samāgatam
dīptātmānamahaṃ taṃ ca haniṣyāmīti bhārgava sa evaṃ vijayī rāma bhīṣmaḥ kurukulodvahaḥ
tathaiva tta kariṣyāmi yathā sāmnaiva lapsyate
yadi bhīṣmo raṇaślāghī na kariṣyati me vacaḥ
na hi bāṇā mayotsṛṣṭāḥ sajjantīha śarīriṇām
tataste tāmuṣitvā tu rajanīṃ tatra tāpasāḥ
parāmṛṣṭāṃ tvayā hīmāṃ ko hi gantumihārhati
pratyākhyātā hi sālvena tvayā nīteti bhārata
ayācaṃ bhṛguśārdūlaṃ na caiva praśaśāma saḥ
abruvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃ tadyattvaṃ yuddhaṃ mayecchasi
jānīṣe māṃ guruṃ bhīṣma gṛhṇāsīmāṃ na caiva ha
na hi me vidyate śāntiranyathā kurunandana
naitadevaṃ punarbhāvi brahmarṣe kiṃ śrameṇa te
prasādaye tvāṃ bhagavaṃstyaktaiṣā tu purā mayā
ko jātu parabhāvāṃ hi nārīṃ vyālīmiva sthitām
prasīda mā vā yadvā te kāryaṃ tatkuru mā ciram
sa tvaṃ gururiti premṇā mayā saṃmānito bhṛśam
guruvṛttiṃ na jānīṣe tasmādyotsyāmi vai tvayā
guruṃ na hanyāṃ samare brāhmaṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
brahmahatyā na tasya syāditi dharmeṣu niścayaḥ
arthe vā yadi vā dharme samartho deśakālavit
paśya me bāhuvīryaṃ ca vikramaṃ cātimānuṣam
evaṃ gate'pi tu mayā yacchakyaṃ bhṛgunandana
tatkariṣye kurukṣetre yotsye vipra tvayā saha
dvandve rāma yatheṣṭaṃ me sañjībhava mahādyute
tatra tvaṃ nihato rāma mayā śaraśatārditaḥ
api yatra tvayā rāma kṛtaṃ śaucaṃ purā pituḥ
tatrāhamapi hatvā tvāṃ śaucaṃ kartāsmi bhārgava
na tadā jātavānbhīṣmaḥ kṣatriyo vāpi madvidhaḥ
yaste yuddhamayaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ ca vyapanāśayet so'haṃ jāto mahābāho bhīṣmaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
vyapaneṣyāmi te darpaṃ yuddhe rāma na saṃśayaḥ
diṣṭyā bhīṣma mayā sārdhaṃ yoddhumicchasi saṃgare
ayaṃ gacchāmi kauravya kurukṣetraṃ tvayā saha
tatra tvāṃ nihataṃ mātā mayā śaraśatācitam
ehi gaccha mayā bhīṣma yuddhakāmuka durmada
gatvā'haṃ tatkurukṣetraṃ sa ca rāmaḥ pratāpavān
vāditrāṇi ca divyāni meghavṛndāni caiva ha
bhūṣmeṇa saha mā yotsīḥ śiṣyeṇeti punaḥ punaḥ
mā maivaṃ putra nirbandhaṃ kuru vipreṇa pārthiva
yathā ca rāmo rājendra mayā pūrvaṃ pracoditaḥ
tataḥ sā rāmamabhyetya jananī me mahānadī
bhīṣmeṇa saha mā yotsīḥ śiṣyeṇeti vaco'bravīt sa ca tāmāha yācantīṃ bhīṣmameva nivartaya
na ca me kurute kāmamityahaṃ tamupāgamam
āroha syandanaṃ vīra kavacaṃ ca mahābhuja
badhāna samare rāma yadi yoddhuṃ mayecchasi
ratho me medinī bhīṣma vāhā vedāḥ sadaśvavat
evaṃ bruvāṇo gāndhāre rāmo māṃ satyavikramaḥ
āhvayānaḥ sa māṃ yuddhe mano harṣayatīva me
yotsye tvayā raṇe rāma sadṛśenādhikena vā
dharmo hyeṣa mahābāho viśiṣṭaiḥ saha yudhyatām
yudhyasva tvaṃ raṇe yatto dhairyamālambya kaurava
na tu te jayamāśāse tvāṃ vijetumahaṃ sthitaḥ
gaccha yudhyasva dharmeṇa prīto'smi caritena te
tato yuddhaṃ samabhavanmama tasya ca bhārata
ācāryatā mānitā me nirmaryāde hyapi tvayi
ye te vedāḥ śarīrasthā .... yacca te mahat
tapaśca te mahattaptaṃ na tebhyaḥ praharāmyaham
prahare kṣatradharmasya yaṃ tvaṃ rāma samāśritaḥ
paśya me dhanuṣo vīryaṃ paśya bāhvorbalaṃ mama
eṣa te kārmuka vīra chinadmi niśiteṣuṇā
tathaiva ca pṛṣatkānāṃ śatāni nataparvaṇām cikṣepa kaṅkapatrāṇāṃ jāmadagnyarathaṃ prati
celuḥ kṣaranto rudhiraṃ nāgā iva ca te śarāḥ
te samāsādya māṃ raudrā bahudhā marmabhedinaḥ
aho bata kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ mayedaṃ kṣatradharmaṃ ca bhārata
tato na prāharaṃ bhūyo jāmadagnyāya bhārata
ātmanastu tataḥ sūto hayānāṃ ca viśāṃpate
dṛṣṭvā bhāṃ tūrṇamāyāntaṃ daṃśitaṃ syandane sthitam
sa ca māṃ śaravarṣeṇa varṣantaṃ samavākiram
tatastvastrāṇi divyāni jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān mayi prayojayāmāsa tānyahaṃ pratyaṣedhayam
yāhi sūta yato rāmaḥ sajjo'haṃ gatavedanaḥ
tataste sūditāḥ sarve mama bāṇāḥ susaṃśitāḥ
tataḥ punaḥ śaraṃ dīptaṃ suprabhaṃ kālasaṃmitam
mumoha samare rāmo bhūmau ca nipapāta ha
tataḥ sa vihvalaṃ vākyaṃ rāma utthāya cābravīt
tiṣṭha bhīṣma hato'sīti bāṇaṃ saṃdhāya kārmuke
sa mukto nyapatattūrṇaṃ savye pārśve mahāhave
tato vāyoḥ prakampācca sūryasya ca gabhastibhiḥ
rāmaḥ śarāṇāṃ saṃkruddho mayi tūrṇaṃ nyapātayat
sandhyākāle vyatīte tu vyapāyātsa ca me guruḥ
tataḥ śaktiṃ prāhiṇoddhorarūpāmastre ruddhe jāmadagnyo mahātmā
kālotsṛṣṭāṃ prajvalitāmivolkāṃ saṃdīptāgrāṃ tejasā vyāpya lokam
chittvā tridhā pātayāmāsa bhūmau tato vavau pavanaḥ puṇyagandhiḥ
tasyāṃ chinnāyāṃ krodhadīpto'tha rāmaḥ śaktīrghorāḥ prāhiṇoddvādaśānyāḥ
tāsāṃ rūpaṃ bhārata nota śakyaṃ tejasvitvāllāghavāccaiva vaktum
kintvevāhaṃ vihvalaḥ saṃpradṛśya digbhyaḥ sarvāstā mahotkā ivāgneḥ
tato jālaṃ bāṇamayaṃ vivṛttaṃ saṃdṛśya bhittvā śarajālena rājan
vicitritāḥ kāñcanapaṭṭanaṃddhā yathā maholkā jvalitāstathā tāḥ
nirmiktānāṃ pannagānāṃ sarūpā dṛṣṭvā śaktīrhemacitrā nikṛttāḥ
samācinoccāpi bhṛśaṃ śarīraṃ hayānsūtaṃ sarathaṃ caiva mahyam
rathaḥ śarairme nicitaḥ sarvato'bhūttathā vāhāḥ sārathiścaiva rājan
yugaṃ ratheṣāṃ ca tathaiva cakre tathaivākṣaḥ śarakṛtto'tha bhagnaḥ
tatastasminbāṇavarṣe vyatīte śaraugheṇa pratyavarṣaṃ guruṃ tam
sa vikṣato mārgaṇairbrahmarāśirdehādasaktaṃ mumuce bhūri raktam
tato yuddhaṃ vyaramaccāparāhṇe bhānāvastaṃ pratiyāte mahīdhram
tataḥ prabhāte rājendra sūrye vimalatāṃ gate
tataḥ sūte hate tasminkṣipatastasya me śarān
tataḥ sūtavyasaninaṃ viplutaṃ māṃ sa bhārgavaḥ
matvā tu nihataṃ rāmastato māṃ bharatarṣabha
tathā tu patite rājanmayi rāmo mudā yutaḥ
mama tatrābhavanye tu kuravaḥ pārśvataḥ sthitāḥ āgatā api yuddhaṃ tañjanāstatra didṛkṣavaḥ
ārtiṃ paramikāṃ jagmuste tadā patite mayi
te māṃ samantātparirvāya tasthuḥ svabāhubhiḥ paridhāryājimadhye
mā bhairiti samaṃ sarve svasti te'stviti cāsakṛt tatasteṣāmahaṃ vāgbhistarpitaḥ sahasotthitaḥ
pādau jananyāḥ pratigṛhya cāhaṃ tathā pitṝṇāṃ rathamabhyaroham
rarakṣa sā māṃ sarathaṃ hayāṃścopaskārāṇi ca
ulkāśca śataśaḥ petuḥ sanirghātāḥ sakampanāḥ - - barkaṃ ca sahasā dīptaṃ svarbhānurabhisaṃvṛṇot
kalyaṃkalyaṃ viṃśatiṃ vai dināni tathaiva cānyāni dināni trīṇi
tato'haṃ niśi rājendra praṇamya śirasā tadā
brāhmaṇānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
na ca rāmaṃ mahāvīryaṃ śaknomi raṇamūrdhani
yadi śakyo mayā jetuṃ jāmadagnyaḥ pratāpavān
tato niśi ca rājendra prasuptaḥ śaravikṣataḥ
utthāpito dhṛtaścaiva mā bhairiti ca sāntvitaḥ
ta eva māṃ mahārāja svapne darśanametya vai
uttiṣṭha mā bhairgāṅgeya na bhayaṃ te'sti kiṃcana
rakṣāmahe tvāṃ kauravya svaśarīraṃ hi no bhavān
na tvāṃ rāmo raṇe jetā jāmadagnyaḥ kathaṃcana
na hīdaṃ veda rāmo'pi pṛthivyāṃ vā pumānkvacit
na ca rāmaḥ kṣayaṃ gantā tenāstreṇa narādhipa
enasā na tu saṃyogaṃ prāpsyase jātu mānada
prasuptaṃ vā mṛtaṃ veti tulyaṃ manyāmahe vayam
na ca rāmeṇa martavyaṃ kadācidapi pārthiva
tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ mama tasya ca bhārata
tato bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ vavarṣa mayi bhārgavaḥ
hyastanena ca kopena śaktiṃ vai prāhiṇonmayi
sa vakṣasi pāpatograḥ śaro vyāla iva śvasan
saṃprāpya tu punaḥ saṃjñāṃ jāmadaghnyāya dhīmate
tata enaṃ pariṣvajya sakhā vipro mahātapāḥ
asaṃprāpyaiva rāmaṃ ca māṃ ca bhāratasattama
tato vyomni prādurabhūtteja eva hi kevalam
cintitaṃ ca tadastraṃ me manasi pratyabhāttadā
ete viyati karavya divi devagaṇāḥ sthitāḥ
te tvāṃ nivārayantyadya prasvāpaṃ mā prayojaya
tato rāmo hṛṣito rājasiṃha dṛṣṭvā tadastraṃ vinivartitaṃ vai
jito'smi bhīṣmeṇa sumandabuddhirityeva vākyaṃ sahasā vyamuñcat
tato'paśyatpitaraṃ jāmadagnyaḥ pitustathā pitaraṃ cāsya mānyam
te tatra cainaṃ parivārya tasthurūcuścainaṃ sāntvapūrvaṃ tadanīm
mā smaivaṃ sāhasaṃ tāta punaḥ kārṣīḥ kathañcana
na hi rāmo raṇe jetuṃ tvayā nyāyyaḥ kurūdvaha
naraḥ prajāpatirvīraḥ pūrvadevaḥ sanātanaḥ savyasācīti vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu vīryavān
evamuktaḥ sa pitṛbhiḥ pitṝnrāmo'bravīdidam nāhaṃ yudhi nivarteyamiti me vratamāhitam
tyajeyaṃ śāśvataṃ dharmamiti me niścitā matiḥ
bhāgīrathī ca me mātā raṇamadhyaṃ prapedire
nāvanītaṃ hi hṛdayaṃ viprāṇāṃ śāmya bhārgava
avadhyo vai tvayā bhīṣmastvaṃ ca bhīṣmasya bhārgava
praihi rāmaṃ mahābāho guruṃ lokahitaṃ kuru
dṛṣṭvā nivartitaṃ rāmaṃ suhṛdvākyena tena vai
mama caiva samakṣaṃ tāṃ kanyāmāhūya bhārgavaḥ
yathāśaktyā mayā yuddhaṃ kṛtaṃ vai pauruṣaṃ param
na caivamapi śaknomi bhīṣmaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varam
eṣā me paramā śaktiretanme paramaṃ balam
yatheṣṭaṃ gamyatāṃ bhadre kimanyadvā karomi te
bhīṣmameva prapadyasva na te'nyā vidyate gatiḥ
yathāśakti yathotsāhaṃ mama kāryaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā
gamiṣyāmi tu tatrāhaṃ yatra bhīṣmaṃ tapodhana
tāpasye dhṛtasaṃkalpā sā me cintayatī vadham
yathāvṛttaṃ mahārāja sā ca māṃ pratyanandata
pratyāharaṃśca me yuktāḥ sthitāḥ priyahite sadā
yadaiva hi vanaṃ prāyātsā kanyā tapase dhṛtā
na hi māṃ kṣatriyaḥ kaścidvīryeṇa vyajayadyudhi
vyāse caiva tathā kāryaṃ tau cobhau māmavocatām
na viṣādastvayā kāryo bhīṣma kāśisutāṃ prati
cyavanasyāśrame caiva brahmaṇaḥ sthāna eva ca
tāmabravīcca kauravya mama mātā jale sthitā
kimarthaṃ kliśyase bhadre tathyameva vadasva me
vicarāmi mahīṃ devi yathā hanyāmahaṃ nṛpam
yadi bhīṣmavināśāya kāśye carasi vai vratam
vratasthā ca śarīraṃ tvaṃ yadi nāma vimokṣyasi
dustīrthā na tu vijñeyā vārṣikī nāṣṭamāsikī
mātā mama mahābhāgā smayamāneva bhāminī kadācidaṣṭame māsi kadāciddaśame tathā
sā nadī vatsabhūmyāṃ tu prathitāmbeti bhārata
sā kanyā tapasā tena dehārdhena vyajāyata
vadhārthaṃ tasya dīkṣā me na lokārthaṃ tapodhanāḥ
patilokādvihīnā ca naiva strī na pumāniha
eṣa me hṛdi saṃkalpo yadidaṃ kathitaṃ mayā
bhīṣme praticikīrṣāmi nāsmi vāryeti vai punaḥ
madhye teṣāṃ mahārṣīṇāṃ svena rūpeṇa tāpasīm
tataḥ sā punarevātha kanyā rudramuvāca ha
upapadyetkathaṃ deva striyā yudhi jayo mama
strībhāvena ca me gāḍhaṃ manaḥ śāntamumāpate
yathā sa satyo bhavati tathā kuru vṛṣadhvaja
yathā hanyāṃ samāgamya bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ yudhi
na me vāgamṛtaṃ prāha satyaṃ bhadre bhaviṣyasi
haniṣyasi raṇe bhīṣmaṃ puruṣatvaṃ ca lapsyati
smariṣyasi ca tatsarvaṃ dehamanyaṃ gatā satī
citāṃ kṛtvā sumahatīṃ pradāya ca hutāśanam
kathaṃ śikhaṇḍī gāṅgeya kanyāṃ bhūtvā purā tadā
bhāryā tu tasya rājendra drupadasya mahīpateḥ
etasminneva kāle tu drupado vai mahīpatiḥ
ṛte kanyāṃ mahādeva putro mesyāditi bruvan
sa tu gatvā ca nagaraṃ bhāryāmidamuvāca ha
kanyā bhūtvā pumānbhāvī iti coktosmi śaṃbhunā
tataḥ sā niyatā bhūtvā ṛtukāle manasvinī
tato dadhāra sā devī garbhaṃ rājīvalocanā
tāṃ sa rājā priyāṃ bhāryāṃ drupadaḥ kurunandana
yathākālaṃ tu sā devī mahiṣī drupadasya ha
aputrasya tu rājñaḥ sā drupadasya manasvinī
khyāpayāmāsa rājendra putro hyeṣa mameti vai
tataḥ sa rājā drupada pracchannāyā narādhipa
rakṣaṇaṃ caiva mantrasya mahiṣī drupadasya sā
na ca tāṃ vedaka nagare kaścidanyatra pārṣatāt
chādayāmāsa tāṃ kanyāṃ pumāniti ca sobravīt
tato lekhyādiṣu tathā śilpeṣu ca paraṃtapa
iṣvastre caiva rājendra droṇaśiṣyo babhūva ha
codayāmāsa bhāryārthaṃ kanyāyāḥ putravattadā tatastāṃ pārṣato dṛṣṭvā kanyāṃ saṃprāptayauvanām
striyaṃ matvā tataścintāṃ prapede saha bhāryayā
yadi te rocate rājanvakṣyāmi śrṛṇu me vacaḥ
bhavitā tadvacaḥ satyamiti me niścitā matiḥ
tato rājā drupado rājasiṃhaḥ sarvānrājñaḥ kulataḥ sanniśāmya
sa ca prādānmahīpālaḥ kanyāṃ tasmai śikhaṇḍine
kṛte vivāhe tu tadā sā kanyā rājasattama
yauvanaṃ samanuprāptā sā ca kanyā śikhaṇḍinī
kṛtadāraḥ śikhaṇḍī ca kāmpilyaṃ punarāgamat na ca sā veda tāṃ kanyāṃ kaṃcitkālaṃ striyaṃ kila
dhātrīṇāṃ ca sakhīnāṃ ca vrīḍayānā nyavedayat
kanyāṃ pāñcālarājasya sutāṃ tāṃ vai śikhaṇḍinīm
vipralambhaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ sa ca cukrodha pārthivaḥ
avamanyase māṃ nṛpate nūnaṃ durmantritaṃ tava
avamatya ca vīryaṃ me kulaṃ cāritrameva ca
sa rājā bhūya evātha jñātvā tattvamathāgamat
abhiyāne matiṃ cakre drupadaṃ prati bhārata
sa hi prakṛtyā vai bhītaḥ kilbiṣī ca narādhipaḥ
kimatra tathyaṃ suśroṇi mithyā kiṃ brūhi śobhane
śrutvā tvattaḥ śubhaṃ vākyaṃ saṃvidhāsyāmyahaṃ tathā
ahaṃ hi saṃśayaprāpto bālā ceyaṃ śikhaṇḍinī
tvaṃ ca rājñi mahatkṛcchraṃ saṃprāptā varavarṇini
śikhaṇḍini ca mā bhaistvaṃ vidhāsye tatra tattvataḥ
mayā dāśārṇako rājā vañcitaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ
janātā ha narendreṇa khyāpanārthaṃ parasya vai
kanyā śikhaṇḍinī jātā puruṣo vai niveditā
bhāryā coḍhā tvayā rājandaśārṇādhipateḥ sutā mayā ca pratyabhihitaṃ devavākyārthadarśanāt
etacchrutvā drupado yajñasenaḥ sarvaṃ tattvaṃ mantravidbhyo nivedya
mantraṃ rājā mantrayāmāsa rājan yathāyuktaṃ rakṣaṇe vai prajānām
saṃbandhakaṃ caiva samarthya tasmin dāśārṇake vai nṛpatau narendra
svayaṃ kṛtvā vipralambhaṃ yathāvanmantryaikāgro niścayaṃ vai jagāma
ārtiṃ ca paramāṃ rājā jagāma saha bhāryayā
kathaṃ saṃbandhinā sārdhaṃ na me syādvigraho mahān
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tadā rājandevī devaparaṃ tadā
ayuddhena nivṛttiṃ ca manasā cintaya prabho
daivaṃ hi mānuṣopetaṃ bhṛśaṃ siddhyati pārthiva
evaṃ sā niścayaṃ kṛtvā bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇā
nirjagāma gṛhaṃ tyaktvā gahanaṃ nirjanaṃ vanam
aśakyayiti sā yakṣaṃ punaḥ punaruvāca ha
āpanno me pitā yakṣa na cirānnāśameṣyati
tasmādrakṣasva māṃ yakṣa mātaraṃ pitaraṃ ca me
yāvadeva sa rājā vai nopayāti puraṃ mama
bhavitavyaṃ tathā taddhi mama duḥkhāya kaurava
bhadre kāmaṃ kariṣyāmi samayaṃ tu nibodha me
svaṃ te puṃstvaṃ pradāsyāmi strītvaṃ dhārayitā'smi te kiṃcitkālaṃ tu te dāsye pulliṅgaṃ svamidaṃ tava
āgantavyaṃ tvayā kāle satyaṃ caiva vadasva me
satyaṃ me pratijānīhi kariṣyāmi priyaṃ tava
ityuktvā samayaṃ tatra cakrāte tāvubhau nṛpa
viveśa nagaraṃ hṛṣṭaḥ pitaraṃ ca samāsadat
yathāvṛttaṃ tu tatsarvamācakhyau drupadasya tat mātuśca rahite rājanprasādaṃ yakṣajaṃ tadā
puruṣo'yaṃ mama sutaḥ śraddhattāṃ me bhavāniti
tasmai pāñcālako rājā gāmarghyaṃ ca susatkṛtam
tāṃ pūjāṃ nābhyanandatsa vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha
āgamaḥ kriyatāṃ vyaktaḥ kumāro'yaṃ suto mama
tataḥ sa rājā drupadasya śrutvā vimarśayukto yuvatīrvariṣṭhāḥ
tāḥ preṣitāstattvabhāvaṃ viditvā prītyā rājñe tacchaśaṃsurhi sarvam
tataḥ kṛtvā tu rājā sa āgamaṃ prītimānatha
śikhaṇḍine ca muditaḥ prādādvittaṃ janeśvaraḥ hastino'śvāṃśca gāścaiva dāsīrbahuśatāstathā - c pūjitaśca pratiyayau nirbhartsya tanayāṃ kila
sthūṇasya yakṣasya viveśa veśma svalaṃkṛtaṃ mālyaguṇairvicitraiḥ
lācaiśca gandhaiśca tathā vitānairabhyarcitaṃ dhṛnadhṛpitaṃ ca
tatsthānaṃ tasya dṛṣṭvā tu sarvataḥ samalaṃkṛtam
nopasarpati māṃ caiva kasmādadya sa mandadhīḥ
tasmāttasmai mahādaṇḍo dhāryaḥ syāditi me matiḥ
kartāsmi nigrahaṃ tasya pratyuvāca punaḥ punaḥ
śikhaṇḍino lakṣaṇaṃ pāpabuddhe strīlakṣaṇaṃ cāgrahīḥ pāpakarman
tasmādadya prabhṛtyeva strī tvaṃ sā puruṣastathā
śikhaṇḍini hate yakṣāḥ svaṃ rūpaṃ pratipatsyate
gamanaṃ tava ceto hi paulastyasya ca darśanam
mudaṃ ca paramāṃ lebhe pāñcālyaḥ saha bāndhavaiḥ
jyeṣṭhā kāśipateḥ kanyā ambā nāmeti viśrutā
ācāryo vā maheṣvāsaḥ kṛpo vā''śu mahābalaḥ
divyāstraviduṣaḥ sarve bhavanto hi bale mama
etadicchāmyahaṃ jñātuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
śrṛṇu rājanmama raṇe yā śaktiḥ paramā bhavet
muñceyaṃ yadi vāstrāṇi mahānti samare sthitaḥ
nihanyā iti taṃ droṇaḥ pratyuvāca hasanniva
eṣā me paramā śaktiretanme paramaṃ balam
dvābhyāmeva tu māsābhyāṃ kṛpaḥ śāradvato'bravīt drauṇistu daśarātreṇa pratijajñe balakṣayam
jahāsa sasvanaṃ hāsaṃ vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha
śakyamevaṃ ca bhūyaśca tvayā vaktuṃ yatheṣṭataḥ
te pravṛttiṃ prayacchanti mamemāṃ vyuṣitāṃ niśām
kena kālena pāṇḍūnāṃ hanyāḥ sainyamiti prabho
apaitu te manastāpo yathā satyaṃ bravīmyaham
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca nimeṣāditi me matiḥ
yāvadiccheddharirayaṃ tāvadasti na cānyathā yattaddhoraṃ paśupatiḥ prādādastraṃ mahanmama
kairāte dvandvayuddhe tu tadidaṃ mayi vartate
tanna jānāti gāṅgeyo na droṇo na ca gautamaḥ
na ca droṇasuto rājankuta eva tu sūtajaḥ
na tu yuktaṃ raṇe hantuṃ divyairastraiḥ pṛthagjanam
sa kṣipraṃ nabhavedvyaktamiti tvāṃ vedmi kaurava
āplāvya śucayaḥ sarve sragviṇaḥ śuklavāsasaḥ gṛhītaśastrā dhvajinaḥ svasti vācya hutāgnayaḥ
na viśeṣaṃ vijānanti purasya śibirasya vā
vaṇijo gaṇikāścārā ye caiva prekṣakā janāḥ
bhīmaṃ ca yuyudhānaṃ ca pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanaṃjayam
ayutaṃ ca padātīnāṃ rathāḥ pañcaśataṃ tathā
madhyame ca virāṭaṃ ca jayatsenaṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ
anvayātāṃ tadā madhye vāsudevadhanañjayau tau dṛṣṭvā pṛthivīpālā naṣṭamityeva menire
babhūvuratisaṃrabdhāḥ kṛtapraharaṇā narāḥ teṣāṃ viṃśatisāhasrā hayāḥ śūrairadhiṣṭhitāḥ
śakaṭāpaṇaveśāśca yānaṃ yugyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ tatra nāgasahasrāṇi hayānāmayutāni ca
evaṃ tasya balaṃ bhīmaṃ kuntīputrasya dhīmataḥ
dadhmatuḥ puruṣavyāghrau divyau śaṅkhau rathe sthitau
śrutvā tu ninadaṃ yodhāḥ śakṛnmūtraṃ prasusruvuḥ
yathā siṃhasya nadataḥ svanaṃ śrutvetare mṛgāḥ
astaṃ gata ivādityaḥ sainyena rajasā vṛtaḥ
ubhe sainye ca rājendra yuddhāya mudite bhṛśam
rathī ca rathinā yodhyo gajena gajadhūrgataḥ
samābhāṣya prahartavyaṃ na viśvaste na vihvale
kṣīṇaśastro vivarmā ca na hantavyaḥ kadācana
na sūteṣu na dhuryeṣu na ca śastropanāyiṣu
kālaparyāyamāhāya mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthā
etasya sarvaṃ saṃgrāme na parokṣaṃ bhaviṣyati
prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ vā divā vā yadi vā niśi
nainaṃ śastrāṇi bhetsyanti nainaṃ bādhiṣyate śramaḥ
pāṇḍavānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ prathayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
na caiva śakyaṃ saṃyantuṃ yato dharmastato jayaḥ
śyenā gṛdhrāśca kākāśca kāṅkāśca sahitā bakaiḥ
ubhe pūrvāpare sandhye nityaṃ paśyāmi bhārata
ālakṣe prabhayā hīnāṃ paurṇamāsīṃ ca kīrtikīm
praṇādaṃ yudhyato rātrau raudraṃ nityaṃ pralakṣaye
vamanti rudhiraṃ cāsyaiḥ svidyanti prapatanti ca
parjanyaḥ pāṃsuvarṣī ca māṃsavarṣī ca bhārata
kharā goṣu prajāyante ramante mātṛbhiḥ sutāḥ
govatsaṃ vaḍavā sūte śvā sṛgālaṃ mahīpate
jātamātrāśca nṛtyanti gāyanta ca hasanti ca
abhāvaṃ hi viśeṣeṇa kurūṇāṃ tatra paśyati
śyāmo grahaḥ prajvalitaḥ sadhūma iva pāvakaḥ
dhruvaṃ prajvalito ghoramapasavyaṃ pravartate rohiṇīṃ pīḍayatyevamubhau ca śaśibhāskaro
tā gāvaḥ prasnutā vatsaiḥ śoṇitaṃ prakṣarantyuta
raudraṃ vadanti saṃrabdhāḥ śoṇitaṃ chardayanti ca
viṣamaṃ janayantyeta ākrandajananaṃ mahat triṣu pūrveṣu sarveṣu nakṣatreṣu viśāṃpate
caturdaśīṃ pañcadaśīṃ bhūtapūrvāṃ ca ṣoḍaśīm imāṃ tu nābhijānāmi amāvāsyāṃ trayodaśīm
aparvaṇi graheṇaitau prajāḥ saṃkṣapayiṣyataḥ māṃsavarṣaṃ punastīvramāsītkṛṣṇacaturdaśīm
viniḥsṛtya maholkābhistimiraṃ sarvato diśam anyonyamupatiṣṭhadbhistatra coktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ
vṛkṣāḥ patanti caityāśca grāmeṣu nagareṣu ca
evaṃvidhaṃ durnimittaṃ kṣayāya pṛthīvīkṣitām bhaumaṃ divyaṃ cāntarikṣaṃ trividhaṃ jāyate'niśam
yathā lokaḥ samucchedaṃ nāyaṃ gaccheta bhārata
iha kīrtiṃ pare loke dīrghakālaṃ mahatsukham
jñātīnāṃ vai kurūṇāṃ ca saṃbandhisuhṛdāṃ tathā
dharmyaṃ darśaya panthānaṃ samartho hyasi vāraṇe
na vadhaḥ pūjyate vede hitaṃ naiva kathaṃcana
hanyātsa enaṃ yo hanyātkuladharmaṃ svikāṃ tanum
luptadharmā pareṇāsi dharmaṃ darśaya vai sutān
kiṃ te rājyena durdharṣayena prāpto'si kilviṣam
yaśo dharmaṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca pālayansvargamāpsyasi
labhantāṃ pāṇḍavā rājyaṃ śamaṃ gacchantu kauravāḥ
yathā bhavānvetti tathaiva vettā bhāvābhāvau viditau me yathārthau
svārthe hi saṃmuhyati tāta loko māṃ cāpi lokātmakameva viddhi
prasādaye tvāmatulaprabhāvaṃ tvaṃ no gatirdarśayitā ca dhīraḥ
na cāpi te vaśagā me sutāśca na cādharmaṃ kartumarhā hi me matiḥ
tvaṃ hi dharmaḥ pavitraṃ ca yaśaḥ kīrtirdhṛtiḥ smṛtiḥ
gambhīraghoṣāśca mahāsvanāśca śaṅkhā mṛdaṅgāśca nadanti yatra
iṣṭā vācaḥ prasṛtā vāyasānāṃ saṃprasthitānāṃ ca gamiṣyatāṃ ca
ye pṛṣṭhataste tvarayanti rājanye cāgrataste pratiṣedhayanti
kalyāṇavācaḥ śakunā rājahaṃsāḥ śukāḥ krauñcāḥ śatapatrāśca yatra
pradakṣiṇāścaiva bhavanti saṅkhye dhruvaṃ jayastatra vadanti viprāḥ
bhrājiṣmatī duṣprativīkṣaṇīyā yeṣāṃ camūste vijayanti śatrūn
hṛṣṭā vācastathā satvaṃ yodhānāṃ yatra bhārata
na mlāyanti srajaścaiva te taranti raṇodadhim
prayāṇe vāyaso vāme dakṣiṇe pravivikṣatām paścātsaṃsādhayatyarthaṃ purastātpratiṣedhati
anugā vāyavo vānti tathā'bhrāṇi vayāṃsi ca
alpāyāṃ vā mahatyāṃ vā senāyāmiti niścayaḥ
durnivartyā tadā caiva prabhagnā mahatī vamūḥ
bhītānbhagnāṃśca saṃprekṣya bhayaṃ bhūyo'bhivardhate prabhagnā sahasā rājandiśo vidravate camūḥ
jaghanya eṣa vijayo yo yuddhena viśāṃpate
api pañcāśataṃ śūrā mṛdganti mahatīṃ camūm
api vā pañca ṣaṭ sapta vijayantyanivartinaḥ
na bāhulyena senāyā jayo bhavati nityaśaḥ adhruvo hi jayo nāma daivaṃ cātra parāyaṇam
jayavanto hi saṃgrāme kṛtakṛtyā bhavanti hi
na vā śāmyanti nighnanto vardhayanti yamakṣayam
deśānāṃ ca parīmāṇaṃ nagarāṇāṃ ca saṃjaya
ya etāṃ veda gāyatrīṃ puṇyāṃ sarvaguṇānvitām
tattvena bharataśreṣṭha sa loke na praṇaśyati
ete grāmyāḥ samākhyātāḥ paśavaḥ sapta sādhubhiḥ
bhūmau ca jāyate sarvaṃ bhūmau sarvaṃ vinaśyati
tathā janapadānāṃ ca ye cānye bhūmimāśritāḥ
pramāṇaṃ ca pramāṇajña pṛthivyā mama sarvataḥ
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ
catvāro'psu guṇā rājangandhastatra na vidyate śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca tejaso'tha guṇāstrayaḥ
śabdaḥ sparśaśca vāyau dvau akāśe śabda eva tu
anyonyaṃ nābhivartante sāmyaṃ bhavati vai yadā
acintyāḥ khalu ye bhāvā na tāṃstarkeṇa sādhayet
dviraśastu tataḥ plakṣo dviraṃśaḥ śālmalirmahān dviraṃśaḥ pippalastasya dviraṃśaśca kuśo mahān
tasya pramāṇāṃ prabrūhi tato vakṣyasi pippalam
evaṃ rājñā sa pṛṣṭastu saṃjayo vākyamabravīt - - ḷa saṃjaya uvāca prāgāyatā mahārāja ṣaḍete varṣaparvatāḥ
vasanti teṣu satvāni nānājātīni sarvaśaḥ idaṃ tu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ tato haimavataṃ param - - a tataḥ kiṃpuruṣāvāsaṃ varṣaṃ himavataḥ param hemakūṭātparaṃ caiva harivarṣaṃ pracakṣate
tataḥ paraṃ mālyavataḥ parvato gandhamādanaḥ parimaṇḍalastayormadhye meruḥ kanakaparvataḥ
yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi ṣoḍaśādhaḥ kila smṛtaḥ ūrdhvaṃ ca caturaśītirdvātriṃśanmūrdhni vistṛtaḥ
tatra brahmā ca rudraśca śakraścāpi sureśvaraḥ
tatra gacchanti bhadraṃ te sadā parvaṇi parvaṇi
paśyanti nahi durvṛttaiḥ śakyo druṣṭuṃ maheśvaraḥ
tayā hyutpāditaḥ puṇyaḥ sa hradaḥ sāgaropamaḥ
ekādaśasahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ paramāyuṣaḥ tatra kṛṣṇā narā rājaṃstejoyuktā mahābalāḥ
ilāvṛttaṃ madhyamaṃ tu pañca dīrghāṇi caiva hi
hemakūṭastu sumahānkailāso nāma parvataḥ - - byatra vaiśravaṇo rājanguhyakaiḥ saha modate
ramyaṃ bindusaro nāma yatra rājā bhagīrathaḥ
tatreṣṭvā tu gataḥ siddhiṃ sahasrākṣo mahāyaśāḥ
tatra divyā tripathagā prathamaṃ tu pratiṣṭhitā
jambūnadī ca sītā ca gaṅgā siṃdhuśca saptamī
dṛśyā'dṛśyā ca bhavati tatra tatra sarasvatī
etā divyāḥ sapta gaṅgāstriṣu lokeṣu viśrutāḥ
rakṣāṃsi vai himavati hemakūṭe tu guhyakāḥ
sarpā nāgāśca niṣadhe gokarṇaṃ ca tapovanam
devāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śvetaparvata ucyate gandharvā niṣadhe nityaṃ nīle brahmarṣayastathā
yāṃ tu pṛcchasi māṃ rājandivyāmetāṃ śaśākṛtim pārśve śaśasya dve varṣe ukte ye dakṣiṇottare
karṇau tu śākadvīpaśca kāśyapadvīpa eva ca
dakṣiṇena tu nīlasya meroḥ pārśve tathottare
puṣpāṇi ca sugandhīni rasavanti phalāni ca
ye kṣaranti sadā kṣīraṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ cāmṛpotamam
sarvā maṇimayī bhūmiḥ sūkṣmakāñcanavālukā sarvartusukhasaṃsparśā niṣpaṅkā ca janādhipa
mithunaṃ jāyate kāle samaṃ tacca pravardhate
jīvanti te mahārāja na cānyonyaṃ jahatyuta
yojanānāṃ sahastraṃ ca śataṃ ca bharatarṣabha
aratnīnāṃ sahasraṃ ca śatāni daśa pañca ca
tasyā jambāḥ phalaraso nadī bhūtvā janādhipa
tasminphalarase pīte na jarā bādhate ca tān
tathā mālyavataḥ śrṛṅge dṛśyate havyavāṭ sadā
brahmalokacyutāḥ sarve sarve sarveṣu sādhavaḥ tapastapyanti te tīvraṃ bhavanti hyūrdhvaretasaḥ
varṣāṇāṃ caiva nāmāni parvatānāṃ ca saṃjaya
ācakṣva me yathātattvaṃ ye ca parvatavāsinaḥ
varṣaṃ ramaṇakaṃ nāma jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
niḥsapatnāśca te sarve jāyante tatra mānavāḥ
varṣaṃ hiraṇmayaṃ nāma yatra hairaṇvatī nadī
āyuḥpramāṇaṃ jīvanti śatāni daśa pañca ca
ekaṃ maṇimayaṃ tatra tathaikaṃ raukmamadbhutam sarvaratnamayaṃ caikaṃ bhavanairupaśobhitam
tatra svayaṃprabhā devī nityaṃ vasati śāṇḍilī
na tatra sūryastapati na jīryante ca mānavāḥ
sṛjate ca punaḥ sarvaṃ neha vidyati śāśvatam
yadidaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ yatredaṃ mūrcchitaṃ balam
yatra gṛddhā pāṇḍuputrā yatra me sañjate manaḥ
etanme tattvamācakṣva tvaṃ hi me buddhimānmataḥ
na tatra pāṇḍavā gṛddhāḥ śṛṇu rājanvaco mama
ye gṛddhā bhārate varṣe na mṛṣyanti parasparam
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi varṣaṃ bhārata bhāratam
somakasya ca durdharṣa dilīpasya tathaiva ca
śrṛṇu me gadato rājanyanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
āryā mlecchāśca kauravya tairmiśrāḥ puruṣā vibho
nadīṃ pibanti vipulāṃ gaṅgāṃ sindhuṃ sarasvatīm
godāvarīṃ narmadāṃ ca bāhudāṃ ca mahānadīm
śatadrūṃ candrabhāgāṃ ca yamunāṃ ca mahānadīm
nadīṃ vetravatīṃ caiva kṛṣṇaveṇīṃ ca nimnagām
gomatīṃ dhūtapāpāṃ ca vandanāṃ ca mahānadīm
rahasyāṃ śatakumbhāṃ ca sarayūṃ ca tathaiva ca
makarīṃ pravarāṃ menāṃ hemāṃ ghṛtavatīṃ tathā
purāvatīmanuṣṇāṃ ca śaibyāṃ kāpīṃ ca bhārata
vastrāṃ suvastrāṃ gaurīṃ ca kampanāṃ sahiraṇvatīm
varāṃ vīrakarāṃ cāpi pañcamīṃ ca mahānadīm
vidiśāṃ kṛṣṇaveṇāṃ ca tāmrāṃ ca kapilāmapi
śīghrāṃ ca picchilāṃ caiva bhāradvājīṃ ca nimnagām
nīlāṃ dhṛtavatīṃ caiva parṇāśāṃ ca mahānadīm
brāhmaṇīṃ ca mahāgaurīṃ durgāmapi ca bhārata
mandākinīṃ supuṇyāṃ ca sarvāṃ gaṅgāṃ ca bhārata
aṅgā vaṅgāḥ kaliṅgāśca yakṛllomāna eva ca
na cāpi tṛptiḥ kāmānāṃ vidyate'dyāpi kasyacit
sāmnā bhedena dānena daṇḍenaiva ca bhārata
pitā bhrātā ca putrāśca khaṃ dyauśca narapuṅgava
ācakṣva me vistareṇa harivarṣaṃ tathaiva ca
kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca tiṣyaṃ ca kuruvardhana
dve sahasre dvāpare tu bhuvi tiṣṭhanti sāṃpratam
garbhasthāśca mriyante'tra tathā jātā mriyanti ca
prajāyante ca jātāśca munayo vai tapodhanāḥ
sarvavarṇāśca jāyante sadā caiva ca dvāpare
īrṣyā mānastathā krodho māyā'sūyā tathaiva ca
tiṣye bhavati bhūtānāṃ rāgo lobhaśca bhārata
śākadvīpaṃ ca me brūhi kuśadvīpaṃ ca sañjaya
śālmaliṃ caiva tattvena krauñcadvīpaṃ tathaiva ca
ṣaṭ śatāni ca pūrṇāni viṣkambho jambuparvataḥ
śṛṇu me tvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ bruvataḥ kurunandana
kṣīrodo bharataśreṣṭha yena saṃparivāritāḥ tatra puṇyā janapadāstatra na mriyate janaḥ
kuta eva hi durbhikṣaṃ kṣamātejoyutā hi te
tato meghāḥ pravartante prabhavanti ca sarvaśaḥ
uttareṇa tu rājendra śyāmo nāma mahāgiriḥ navameghaprabhaḥ prāṃśuḥ śrīmānujjvalavigrahaḥ
parivārya tu kauravya dairghyaṃ hrasvatvameva ca
śāko nāma mahārāja prajā tasya sadānugā
tatra puṇyā janapadāḥ pūjyate tatra śaṃkaraḥ
tatra gacchanti siddhāśca cāraṇā daivatāni ca
varṇāḥ svakarmaniratā na ca steno'tra dṛśyate
nadyaḥ puṇyajalāstatra gaṅgā ca bahudhā gatā
sukumārī kumārī ca śītāśī veṇikā tathā
mahānadī ca kauravya tathā maṇijalā nadī
na tāsāṃ nāmadheyāni parimāṇaṃ tathaiva ca
na tatra rājā rājendra na daṇḍo na ca daṇḍikāḥ
etāvadeva śakyaṃ tu tatra dvīpe prabhāṣitum
uttareṣu ca kauravya dvīpeṣu śrūyate kathā
evaṃ tatra mahārāja bruvataśca nibodha me
tatra ratnāni divyāni svayaṃ rakṣati keśavaḥ
viharante ramante ca na teṣu mriyate janaḥ
na teṣu dasyavaḥ santi mlecchajātyopi vā nṛpa
krauñcātparo vāmanako vāmanādandhakārakaḥ andhakārātparo rājanmainākaḥ parvatottamaḥ
tatra nityaṃ prabhavati svayaṃ devaḥ prajāpatiḥ
taṃ paryupāsate nityaṃ devāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ
brahmacaryeṇa satyena prajānāṃ hi damena ca
ārogyāyuḥpramāṇābhyāṃ dviguṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ tataḥ eko janapado rājandvīpeṣveteṣu bhārata
sa rājā sa śivo rājansa pitā pratitāmahaḥ
tataḥ paraṃ samā nāma dṛśyate lokasaṃsthitiḥ
tatra vai vāyavo vānti digbhyaḥ sarvābhya eva hi
śatadhā punarevāśu te tānmuñcanti nityaśaḥ śvasadbhirmucyamānāstu diggajairiha mārutāḥ
paro vai vistaro'tyarthaṃ tvayā sañjaya kīrtitaḥ
uktā dvīpā mahārāja grahaṃ vai śṛṇu tattvataḥ
āyurbalaṃ ca kīrtiśca tasya tejaśca vardhate
idaṃ tu bhārataṃ varṣaṃ yatra vartāmahe vayam
sa śete nihato rājansaṃkhye bhīṣmaḥ śikhaṇḍinā
na hato jāmadagnyena sa hato'dya śikhaṇḍinā
sa śete nihato bhūmau vātabhagna iva drumaḥ
tava durmantrite rājanyathā nārhaḥ sa bhārata
kathamācakṣva me yodhā hīnā bhīṣmeṇa saṃjaya
ārtiṃ parāmāviśati manaḥ śaṃsasi me hatam
yaḥ sa śakra ivākṣayyaṃ varṣaṃ śaramayaṃ kṣipan
sa śete nihato bhūmau vātabhugna iva drumaḥ
kathaṃ ca nājayadbhīṣmo droṇe jīvati sañjaya
bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ
yaḥ spardhate raṇe nityaṃ jāmadagnyaṃ mahābalam
sañjayācakṣva me vīraṃ yena śarma na vidmahe
yacchrutvā puruṣavyāghraṃ hataṃ bhīṣmaṃ na dīryate
yasminsatyaṃ ca medhā ca nītiśca bharatarṣabhe
aprameyāṇi durdharṣe kathaṃ sa nihato yudhi
ke rakṣannuttaraṃ cakraṃ vīrā vīrakasya yudhyataḥ
kathaṃ prahartumapi te śekuḥ sañjaya pāṇḍavāḥ
taṃ nimagnaṃ naravyāghraṃ bhīṣmaṃ śaṃsasi sañjaya
yasya vīryaṃ samāśritya mama putro bṛhadbalaḥ
yaḥ purā vibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ sahāye yuddhadurmadaḥ
śokaṃ dainyaṃ ca duḥsvaṃ ca prājahātsa ca tatkṣaṇe
hataṃ śāntanavaṃ śrutvā manye śeṣaṃ hataṃ balam
yatra vṛddhaṃ guruṃ hatvā rājyamicchanti pāṇḍavāḥ
hataṃ śaṃsasi me bhīṣmaṃ kiṃ nu duḥkhamataḥ param
asakṛtkṣatriyavrātāḥ saṅkhye yena vinirjitāḥ jāmadagnyena vīreṇa paravīranighātinā
na hato yo mahābuddhiḥ sa hato'dya śikhaṇḍinā
śaṃsa me tadyathā cāsīdyudbhaṃ bhīṣmasya pāṇḍavaiḥ
yoṣeva hatavīrā me senma putrasya sañjaya
agādhe salile magnāṃ nāvaṃ dṛṣṭveva pāragāḥ
bhīṣme hate bhṛśaṃ duḥkhānmanye śocanti putrakāḥ
yacchrutvā puruṣavyāghraṃ hataṃ bhīṣmaṃ na dīryate
aprameyāṇi durdharṣe kathaṃ sa nihato yudhi
na cāstreṇa na śauryeṇa tapasā medhayā na ca
yatra śāntanavaṃ bhīṣmaṃ hataṃ śaṃsasi sañjaya
nāhaṃ sveṣāṃ pareṣāṃ vā buddhyā sañjaya cintayan
kathaṃ vā nihato bhīṣmaḥ pitā sañjaya me paraiḥ
prāṇadyūte pratibhaye ke'dīvyanta nararṣabhāḥ ke jīyante jitāstatra kṛtalakṣyā nipātitāḥ
na hi me śāntirastīha śrutvā devavrataṃ hatam
ārtiṃ me hṛdaye rūḍhāṃ mahatīṃ putrahānijām
dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ bhīṣmaṃ manye śocanti putrakāḥ
krameṇa yena yasmiṃśca kāle yacca yathā'bhavat
hayānāṃ ca gajānāṃ ca rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām
pratyakṣaṃ yanmayā dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ yogabalena ca
śṛṇu tatpṛthivīpāla mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
nātaḥ kāryatamaṃ manye raṇe bhīṣmasya rakṣaṇāt
śrūyate strī hyasau pūrvaṃ tasmādūrtyo raṇe mama
śikhaṇḍino vadhe yattāḥ sarve tiṣṭhantu māmakāḥ
vāmaṃ cakraṃ yudhāmanyuruttamaujāśca dakṣiṇam goptārau phālgunaṃ prāptau phālgunopi śikhaṇḍinaḥ
yathā na hanyādgāṅgeyaṃ duḥśāsana tathā kuru
gājānāṃ bṛhatāṃ caiva yodhānāṃ cāpi garjatām
rājendra tava putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca
tvadīyānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca śastravanti mahānti ca
atīva śuśubhe tatra pitā te pūrṇacandravat
sveṣāṃ caiva pareṣāṃ ca dyutimantaḥ sahasraśaḥ
dṛṣṭvā camūmukhe bhīṣmaṃ samakampanta pāṇḍavāḥ sṛñjayāśca maheṣvāsā dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ
yugānte samavetau dvau dṛśyete sāgarāviva naiva nastādṛśo rājandṛṣṭapūrvo na ca śrutaḥ
yuyudhāte tavārthāya yathā sa samayaḥ kṛtaḥ
idaṃ vaḥ kṣatriyā dvāraṃ svargāyāpāvṛtaṃ mahat
eṣa vaḥ śāśvataḥ panthāḥ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraiḥ kṛtaḥ
sa tu vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ sāmātyaḥ saha bandhubhiḥ
sa tu govāsanaḥ śaibyaḥ sahitaḥ sarvarājabhiḥ yayau mātaṅgarājena rājārheṇa patākinā
kṣemadhanvā ca śalyaśca tasthuḥ pramukhato rathāḥ syandanena mahārheṇa ketunā vṛṣabheṇa ca
putrāṇāṃ tava durdharṣa pāṇḍavānāṃ tathaiva ca
sveṣāṃ caiva pareṣāṃ ca samadṛśyanta bhārata
ṛṣabhākṣā maheṣvāsāścamūmukhagatā babhuḥ pṛṣṭhagopāstu bhīṣmasya putrāstava narādhipa
akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca tava putrasya bhārata
arkṣāṃhiṇīṃ daśaikāṃ ca vyūḍhāṃ dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yo veda mānuṣaṃ vyūhaṃ daivaṃ gāndharvamāsuram
kathaṃ bhīṣmaṃ sa kaunteyaḥ pratyayūhata sañjaya
asmākaṃ ca tathā sainyamalpīyaḥ sutarāṃ paraiḥ
eṣa vyūhāmi te vyūhaṃ rājasattama durjayam
yaḥ sa vāta ivodbhūtaḥ samare duḥsahaḥ paraiḥ
sa naḥ puro yotsayate vai bhīmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
na hi so'sti pumām̐lloke yaḥ saṃkruddhaṃ vṛkodaram
bruvāṇaṃ tu tathā pārthaṃ sarvasainyāni bhārata
akṣauhiṇyātha pāñcālyo yajñaseno mahāmanāḥ virāṭamanvayātpaścātpāṇḍavārthaṃ parākramī - - ateṣāmādityacandrābhāḥ kanakottamabhūṣaṇāḥ nānācihnadharā rājanratheṣvāsanmahādhvajāḥ
vajro nāmaiṣa sa vyūho nirbhayaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
vyaśīryata sanādā ca bhūstadā bharatarṣabha nirghātā bahavo rājandikṣu sarvāsu cābhavan
sūryodaye sañjaya ke nu pūrvaṃ yuyutsavo hṛṣyamāṇā ivāsan
māmakā vā bhīṣmanetrāḥ samīpe pāṇḍavā vā bhīmanetrāstadānīm
keṣāṃ jaghanyau samasūryau savāyū keṣāṃ senāṃ śvāpadāścābhaṣanta
keṣāṃ yūnāṃ mukhavarṇāḥ prasannāḥ sarvaṃ hyetadbrūhi tattvaṃ yathāvat
ubhe sene tulyamivopayāte ubhe vyūhe hṛṣṭarūpe narendra
ubhe sene bṛhatyau bhīmarūpe tathaivobhe bhārata durviṣahye
paścānmukhāḥ kuravo dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sthitāḥ pārthāḥ prāṅmukhā yotsyamānāḥ
daityendraseneva ca kauravāṇāṃ devendraseneva ca pāṇḍavānām
śīto vāyuḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāñśvāpadā vyāharanta
gajendrāṇāṃ madagandhāṃśca tīvrānna sehire tava putrasya nāgāḥ
duryodhano hastinaṃ padmavarṇaṃ suvarṇakakṣaṃ jālavantaṃ prabhinnam
taṃ sarvataḥ śakuniḥ pārvatīyaiḥ sārdhaṃ gāndhārairyāti gāndhārarājaḥ
bhīṣmo'grataḥ sarvasainyasya vṛddhaḥ śvetacchatraḥ śvetadhanuḥ sakhaṅgaḥ
tasya sainye dhārtarāṣṭrāśca sarve bāhlīkānāmekadeśaḥ śalaśca
ye cāmbaṣṭhāḥ kṣatriyā ye ca sindhostathā sauvīrāḥ pañcanadāśca śūrāḥ
āpto guruḥ prathitaḥ sarvarājñāṃ paścāccamūmindra ivābhiyāti
vārdhakṣatriḥ sarvasainyasya madhye bhūriśravāḥ purumitro jayaśca
sālvā matsyāḥ kekayāśceti sarve gajānīkairbhrātaro yotsyamānāḥ
sāgraṃ śatasahasraṃ tu nāgānāṃ tava bhārata
aśve'śve daśa dhānuṣkā dhānuṣke śata carmiṇaḥ
anantarūpā dhvajinī narendra bhīmā tvadīyā na tu pāṇḍavānām
tāṃ caiva manye bṛhatīṃ duṣpragharṣāṃ yasyā netā keśavaścārjunaśca
vyūhaṃ bhīṣmeṇa cābhedyaṃ kalpitaṃ prekṣya pāṇḍavaḥ
te vayaṃ saṃśaynaṃ prāptāḥ sasainyāḥ śatrukarṣaṇa
yathā tu nāradaḥ prāha yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ
anu kṛṣṇaṃ jayemeti yairuktaṃ tatra tairjitam
tasya te na vyathāṃ kāṃcidiha paśyāmi bhārata
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā svāṃ senāṃ samacodayat
purohitāḥ śatruvadhaṃ vadanto brahmarṣisiddhāḥ śrutavanta enam
japyaiśca mantraiśca mahauṣadhībhiḥ samantataḥ svastyayanaṃ bruvantaḥ
tataḥ sa vastrāṇi tathaiva gāśca phalāni puṣpāṇi tathaiva niṣkān
dhanurdharo yasya samaḥ pṛthivyāṃ na vidyate no bhavitā kadācit
uddhartayiṣyaṃstava putrasenāmatīva raudraṃ sa bibharti rūpam
anāyudho yaḥ subhujo bhujābhyāṃ narāśvanāgānyudhi bhasma kuryāt
sa bhīmasenaḥ sahito yamābhyāṃ vṛkodaro vīrarathasya goptā
samīkṣya senāgragataṃ durāsadaṃ saṃvivyathuḥ paṅkagatā yathā dvipāḥ
ya eṣa roṣātpratapanbalastho yo naḥ senāṃ siṃha ivekṣate ca
etānyanīkāni mahānubhāvaṃ gūhanti meghā iva raśmimantam
etāni hatvā puruṣapravīra kāṅkṣasva yuddhaṃ bharatarṣabheṇa
tvaṃ brahmavidyā vidyānāṃ mahānidrā ca dehinām
svāhākāraḥ svadhā caiva kalā kāṣṭhā sarasvatī
sāvitrī vedamātā ca tathā vedānta ucyate
nityaṃ vasasi pātāle yuddhe jayasi dānavān
tvaṃ jambhanī mohinī ca māyā hrīḥ śrīstathaiva ca
saṃdhyā prabhāvatī caiva sāvitrī jananī tathā
tataḥ pārthasya vijñāya bhaktiṃ mānavavatsalā - - bantarikṣagatovāca govindasyāgrataḥ sthitā
labdhvā varaṃ tu kaunteyo mene vijayamātmanaḥ
ya idaṃ paṭhate stotraṃ kalya utthāya mānavaḥ
na cāpi ripavastebhyaḥ sarpādyā ye ca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ
na bhayaṃ vidyate tasya sadā rājakulādapi
prāptakālamidaṃ vākyaṃ kālapāśena kuṇṭhitāḥ dvaipāyano nāradaśca kaṇvo rāmastathānaghaḥ
yatra dharmo dyutiḥ kāntiryatra hrīḥ śrīstathā matiḥ
yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ
udagramanasaḥ ke vā ke vā dīnā vicetasaḥ
ubhayoḥ senayo rājanmahānvyatikaro'bhavat anyonyaṃ vīkṣamāṇānāṃ yodhānāṃ bharatarṣabha
kuñjarāṇāṃ ca nadatāṃ sainyānāṃ ca prahṛṣyatām
asmākaṃ tu viśiṣṭā ye tānnibodha dvijottama
nāyakā mama sainyasya saṃjñārthaṃ tānbravīmi te
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā madarthe tyaktajīvitāḥ
sīdanti mama gātrāṇi mukhaṃ ca pariśuṣyati
na ca śaknomyavasthātuṃ bhramatīva ca me manaḥ
na kāṅkṣe vijayaṃ kṛṣṇa na ca rājyaṃ sukhāni ca
kiṃ no rājyena govinda kiṃ bhogairjīvitena vā
yeṣāmarthe kāṅkṣitaṃ no rājyaṃ bhogāḥ sukhāni ca
ta ime'vasthitā yuddhe prāṇāṃstyaktvā dhanāni ca
api trailokyarājyasya hetoḥ kiṃ nu mahīkṛte
svajanaṃ hi kathaṃ hatvā sukhinaḥ syāma mādhava
aho bata mahatpāpaṃ kartuṃ vyavasitā vayam
klaibyaṃ mā sma gamaḥ pārtha naitattvayyupapadyate
kathaṃ bhīṣmamahaṃ saṅkhye droṇaṃ ca madhusūdana
gurūnahatvā hi mahānubhāvān śreyo bhoktuṃ bhaikṣamapīha loke
na caitadvidmaḥ kataranno garīyo yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ
yāneva hatvā na jijīviṣāmaste'vasthitāḥ pramukhe dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
yacchreyaḥ syānniścitaṃ brūhi tanme śiṣyaste'haṃ śādhi māṃ tvāṃ prapannam
na yotsya iti govindamuktvā tūṣṇīṃ babhūva ha
natvevāhaṃ jātu nāsaṃ na tvaṃ neme janādhipāḥ
na caiva nabhaviṣyāmaḥ sarve vayamataḥ param
yaṃ hi na vyathayantyete puruṣaṃ puruṣarṣabha
nāsato vidyate bhāvo nābhāvo vidyate sataḥ
avināśi tu tadviddhi yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
ya enaṃ vetti hantāraṃ yaścainaṃ manyate hatam
ubhau tau na vijānīto nāyaṃ hanti na hanyate
na jāyate mriyate vā kadācinnāyaṃ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ
ajo nityaḥ śāśvato'yaṃ purāṇo na hanyate hanyamāne śarīre
kathaṃ sa puruṣaḥ pārtha kaṃ ghātayati hanti kam
vāsāṃsi jīrṇāni yathā vihāya navāni gṛhṇāti naro'parāṇi
tathā śarīrāṇi vihāya jīrṇānyanyāni saṃyāti navāni dehī
nainaṃ chindanti śastrāṇi nainaṃ dahati pāvakaḥ
na cainaṃ kledayantyāpo na śoṣayati mārutaḥ
atha cainaṃ nityajātaṃ nityaṃ vā manyase mṛtam
jātasya hi dhruvo mṛtyurdhruvaṃ janma mṛtasya ca
āścaryavaccainamanyaḥ śṛṇoti śrutvā'pyenaṃ veda na caiva kaścit
atha cettvamimaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ na kariṣyasi
tataḥ svadharmaṃ kīrtiṃ ca hitvā pāpamavāpsyasi
yeṣāṃ ca tvaṃ bahumato bhūtvā yāsyasi lāghavam
nindantastava sāmarthyaṃ tato duḥkhataraṃ nu kim
hato vā prāpsyasi svargaṃ jitvā vā bhokṣyase mahīm
eṣā te'bhihitā sāṅkhye buddhiryoge tvimāṃ śṛṇu
buddhyā yukto yayā pārtha karmabandhaṃ prahāsyasi
yogasthaḥ kuru karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā dhanaṃjaya
siddhyasiddhyoḥ samo bhūtvā samatvaṃ yoga ucyate
karmajaṃ buddhiyuktā hi phalaṃ tyaktvā manīṣiṇaḥ
tadā gantāsi nirvedaṃ śrotavyasya śrutasya ca
sthitadhīḥ kiṃ prabhāṣeta kimāsīta vrajeta kiṃ
nābhinandati na dveṣṭi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
tāni sarvāṇi saṃyamya yukta āsīta matparaḥ
vaśe hi yasyendriyāṇi tasya prajñā pratiṣṭhitā
yā niśā sarvabhūtānāṃ tasyāṃ jāgarti saṃyamī
yasyāṃ jāgrati bhūtāni sā niśā paśyato muneḥ
tadvatkāmā yaṃ praviśanti sarve sa śāntimāpnoti na kāmakāmī
eṣā brāhmī sthitiḥ pārtha naināṃ prāpya vimuhyati
tatkiṃ karmaṇi ghore māṃ niyojayasi keśava
karmendriyāṇi saṃyamya ya āste manasā smaran
niyataṃ kuru karma tvaṃ karma jyāyo hyakarmaṇaḥ
tairdattānapradāyaibhyo yo bhuṅkte stena eva saḥ
bhuñjate te tvaghaṃ pāpā ye pacantyātmakāraṇāt
ātmanyeva ca saṃtuṣṭastasya kāryaṃ na vidyate
na me pārthāsti kartavyaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana
yadi hyahaṃ na varteyaṃ jātu karmaṇyatandritaḥ
utsīdeyurime lokā na kuryāṃ karma cedaham
guṇā guṇeṣu vartanta iti matvā na sajjate
prakṛtiṃ yānti bhūtāni nigrahaḥ kiṃ kariṣyati
atha kena prayukto'yaṃ pāpaṃ carati pūruṣaḥ
manasastu parā buddhiryo buddheḥ paratastu saḥ
sa kāleneha mahatā yogo naṣṭaḥ paraṃtapa
sa evāyaṃ mayā te'dya yogaḥ proktaḥ purātanaḥ
bhakto'si me sakhā ceti rahasyaṃ hyetaduttamam
aparaṃ bhavato janma paraṃ janma vivasvataḥ
bahūni me vyatītāni janmāni tava cārjuna
tānyahaṃ veda sarvāṇi na tvaṃ vettha paraṃtapa
yadā yadā hi dharmasya glānirbhavati bhārata
janma karma ca me divyamevaṃ yo vetti tattvataḥ
tyaktvā dehaṃ punarjanma naiti māmeti so'rjuna
ye yathā māṃ prapadyante tāṃstathaiva bhajāmyaham
kāṅkṣantaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiṃ yajanta iha devatāḥ
kṣipraṃ hi mānuṣe loke siddhirbhavati karmajā
na māṃ karmāṇi limpanti na me karmaphale spṛhā
iti māṃ yo'bhijānāti karmabhirna sa badhyate
evaṃ jñātvā kṛtaṃ karma pūrvairapi mumukṣubhiḥ
kuru karmaiva tasmāttvaṃ pūrvaiḥ pūrvataraṃ kṛtam
karmaṇo hyapi boddhavyaṃ boddhavyaṃ ca vikarmaṇaḥ
karmaṇyakarma yaḥ paśyedakarmaṇi ca karma yaḥ
samaḥ siddhāvasiddhau ca kṛtvāpi na nibadhyate
brahmaiva tena gantavyaṃ brahma karma samādhinā
evaṃ bahuvidhā yajñā vitatā brahmaṇo mukhe
na hi jñānena sadṛśaṃ pavitramiha vidyate
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na sukhaṃ saṃśayātmanaḥ
saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi
jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ
nādatte kasya citpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmādbrahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
anāśritaḥ karmaphalaṃ kāryaṃ karma karoti yaḥ
sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavaddṛḍham
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
śraddhāvānbhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
ye caiva sātvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatiṃ
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ
kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram
prayāṇakāle manasā'calena bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyaksa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva dāneṣu yatpuṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛk sāma yajureva ca
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
kaunteya pratijānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatiṃ
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
bhūya eva mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṅghān
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
amī hi tvā surasaṅghā viśanti kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṅghāḥ stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā viśve'śvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca
dṛṣṭvā hi tvā pravyathitāntarātmā dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṅghaiḥ
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokāstavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo namo'stu te devavara prasīda
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
ṛte'pi tvā na bhaviṣyanti sarve ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva jitvā śatrūnbhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca karṇaṃ tathānyānapi yodhavīrān
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi māvyathiṣṭhā yuddhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṅghāḥ
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman garīyase brahmaṇo'pyādikartre
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇastvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam
vettā'si vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
namo namaste'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ mayā pramādātpraṇayena vā'pi
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahastamicchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānairna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ
mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo me bhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñameva ca
etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛk ca yadvikāri yataśca yat
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṅghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatiṃ
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
satvaṃ sukhe saṃjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata
rajaḥ satvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ satvaṃ rajastathā
yadā satve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt
satvātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti satvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava
na dveṣṭi saṃpravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vā'pi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi sanniviṣṭo mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa satvamāho rajastamaḥ
trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā
sātvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ
yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sātvikaṃ smṛtam
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha
kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ
niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama
etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca
sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sātviko mataḥ
na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ
yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate
hatvā'pi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate
jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṅkāreṇa vā punaḥ
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sātvikī
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathā''pnoti nibodha me
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
buddhyā viśuddhayā yukto dhṛtyā''tmānaṃ niyamya ca
ahaṅkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ
