iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me
ahaṃ tvā sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ
vismayo me mahānrājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ
gītā gaṅgā ca gāyatrī govindeti hṛdi sthite
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ ślokamekaṃ gītāyā mānamucyate bhāratāmṛtasarvasvagītāyā mathitasya ca
te sene stimite sañje vīkṣamāṇe parasparam
evaṃ pravatte te sene niḥśabde janasaṃsadi citre paṭa ivālekhye darśanīyatare śubhe
te sene sāgaraprakhye muhuḥ prajvalite nṛpa
vimucya kavacaṃ vīro nikṣipya ca varāyudham
evaṃ gate tvayi jyeṣṭhe mama bhrātari bhārata
bhīme dunoti hṛdayaṃ brūhi gantā bhavānkva nu
utsṛjya kva nu gantāsi śatrūnabhimukho nṛpa
eṣa bhīṣmaṃ tathā droṇaṃ gautamaṃ śalyameva ca
dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dūrāddhārtarāṣṭrasya sainikāḥ mithaḥ saṃkathayāṃcakrureṣo hi kulapāṃsanaḥ - - avyaktaṃ bhīta ivābhyeti rājāsau bhīṣmamantikam yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasodaryaḥ śaraṇārthaṃ prayācakaḥ
dhanañjaye kathaṃ nāthe pāṇḍave ca vṛkodare
na nūnaṃ kṣatriyakule jātaḥ saṃprathite bhuvi
tataste sainikāḥ sarve praśaṃsanti sma kauravān
hṛṣṭāḥ sumanaso bhūtvā celāni dudhuvuśca ha
kiṃ nu vakṣyāti rājā'sau kiṃ bhīṣmaḥ prativakṣyati
kiṃ bhīmaḥ samaraślāghī kiṃ nu kṛṣṇārjunāviti
tamuvāca tataḥ pādau kārabhyāṃ pīḍya pāṇḍavaḥ
āmantraye tvāṃ durdharṣa tvayā yotsyāmahe saha
evaṃ gate mahārāja na tavāsti parājayaḥ
arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit
kāmaṃ yotsye parasyārthe brūhi yatte vivakṣitam
etanme mantraya hitaṃ yadi śreyaḥ prapaśyasi
nainaṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yo māṃ yudhyantamāhave
hanta pṛcchāmi tasmāttvāṃ pitāmaha namostu te
na sma taṃ tāta paśyāmi samare yo jayeta mām
karavāṇi ca te kāmaṃ brūhi tvamabhikāṅkṣitam
arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit
yudhyasva kauravasyārthe vara eṣa vṛto mayā
yato dharmastataḥ kṛṣṇo yataḥ kṛṣṇastato jayaḥ
yudhyasva gaccha kaunteya pṛccha māṃ kiṃ bravīmi te
ācārya praṇipatyaiṣa pṛcchāmi tvāṃ namo'stu te
na śatruṃ tāta paśyāmi yo māṃ hanyādrathe sthitam
ṛte prāyagataṃ rajannyastaśastramacetanam hanyānmāṃ yudhi yodhānāṃ satyametadbravīmi te
śastraṃ cāhaṃ raṇe jahyāṃ śrutvā tu mahadapriyam
so'bhivādya kṛpaṃ rājā kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit iti satyaṃ mahārāja baddho'smyarthena kauravaiḥ
hanta pṛcchāmi te tasmādācārya śrṛṇu me vacaḥ
anumānya kṛpaṃ rājā prayayau yena madrarāṭ
śapeyaṃ tvāṃ mahārāja parībhāvāya vai raṇe
brūhi caiṣa paraṃ vīra kenārthaḥ kiṃ dadāmi te
arthasya puruṣo dāso dāsastvartho na kasyacit
kariṣyāmi hi te kāmaṃ bhāgineya yathepsitam
kimatra brūhi sāhyaṃ te karomi nṛpasattama
sa eva me varaḥ śalya udyoge yastvayā kṛtaḥ
śrutaṃ me karṇa bhīṣmasya dvoṣātkila na yotsyase
hate tu bhīṣme rādheya punareṣyasi saṃyugam
yuyutso vāsudevaśca vayaṃ ca brūma sarvaśaḥ
vṛṇomi tvāṃ mahābāho yudhyasva mama kāraṇāt
tato vyūhaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ pratyavyūhanta te punaḥ
sauhṛdaṃ ca kṛpāṃ caiva prāptakālaṃ mahātmanām
dayāṃ ca jñātiṣu parāṃ kathayāṃcakrire nṛpāḥ
ke pūrvaṃ prāharaṃstatra kuravaḥka pāṇḍavā nu kim
bhīṣmaṃ pramukhataḥ kṛtvā prayayau saha senayā
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ tasya sainyāstava vitatrasuḥ
sarve tvanye mahīpālāḥ prekṣakā iva bhārata
nātra sveṣāṃ pareṣāṃ vā viśeṣaḥ samadṛśyata
dhvajaṃ ciccheda samare sārathiṃ ca vyapātayat
anyonyaṃ ca śaraiḥ kruddhau tatakṣāte parasparam
tau vīkṣya tu mahātmānau kṛtinau citrayodhinau
tasya mādrīsutaḥ ketuṃ saśaraṃ ca śarāsanam
sahadevastato vīro durmukhasya mahāraṇe śareṇa bhṛtaśīkṣṇena pātayāmāsa sārathim - - atāvanyonyaṃ samāsādya samare yuddhadurmadau - - btrāsayetāṃ śarairghoraiḥ kṛtapratikṛtaiṣiṇau
tridhā ciccheda samare pāñcālyasya tu kārmukam
saumadattiṃ raṇe śaṅkho rabhasaṃ rabhaso yudhi
tasya vai dakṣiṇaṃ vīro nirbibheda raṇe bhujam
bāhlīkaṃ tu raṇe kruddha kruddharūpo viśāṃpate
vivyādha samare tūrṇaṃ matto mattamiva dvipam
tau tatra samare kruddhau nardantau ca punaḥ punaḥ
bṛhatkṣatraṃ tu kaikeyaṃ kṛpaḥ śāradvato yayau
tājayāmāsa samare sa ca taṃ pratyabidhyata
abhyadravata rājendra mattaḥ siṃha iva dvipam
śrutāyustu tataḥ kruddhaḥ phālguneḥ samare hayān
ayudhyetāṃ sthirau bhūtvā mahatyā senayā saha
uttaraścāpi taṃ vīraṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
padātīnāṃ ca samare tava teṣāṃ ca saṃkule
gajo gajena samare rathinaṃ ca rathī yayau
na putraḥ pitaraṃ jajñe pitā vā putramaurasam
na bhrātā bhrātaraṃ tatra svastrīyaṃ na ca mātulaḥ
na mātulaṃ ca svasrīyo na sakhāyaṃ sakhā tathā
āviṣṭā iva yudhyante pāṇḍavāḥ kurubhiḥ saha
gadābhirmusalaiścaiva bhindipālaiḥ satomaraiḥ āyasaiḥ parighaiścaiva nistiraṃśairvimalai śitaiḥ
aśvārohaiśca samare hastisādibhireva ca pratimāneṣu gātreṣu pārśvaṣvabhi ca vāraṇān
apare kṣatrikayāḥ śūrāḥ kṛtavairāḥ parasparam naiva śastraṃ vimuñcanti naiva krandanti māriṣa
anye ca virathāḥ śūrā rathamanyasya saṃyuge prārthayānā nipatitāḥ saṃkṣuṇṇā varavāraṇaiḥ
nijaghāna pitā putraṃ putraśca pitaraṃ raṇe
svastrīyo mātulaṃ cāpi svasrīyaṃ cāpi mātulaḥ
sakhā sakhāyaṃ ca tathā saṃbandhī bāndhavaṃ tathā
evaṃ yuyudhire tatra kuravaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
ketunā pañcatāreṇa tālena bhāratarṣabha rājatena mahābāhurucchritena mahārathe
durmukhaḥ kṛtavarmā ca kṛpaḥ śalyo viviṃśatiḥ
tathaiva kṛtavarmā ca kṛpaḥ śalyaśca māriṣa
atha bhīṣmo mahāsrāṇi divyāni subahūni ca
teṣāṃ javenāpatatāṃ bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo raṇe pāñcālyaṃ tribhirānarcchatsātyakiṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya vāraṇarājasya javenāpatato rathe śalyo nivārayāmāsa vegamapratimaṃ śaraiḥ
tasya kruddhaḥ sa nāgendro bṛhataḥ sādhuvāhinaḥ
bhīmamārtasvaraṃ kṛtvā papāta ca mamāra ca
uttaraṃ vai hataṃ dṛṣṭvā vairāṭirbhrātaraṃ tadā
sapta caiva pṛṣatkāṃśca śvetasyoparyapātayan tataḥ punarameyātmā bhallaiḥ saptabhirāśugaiḥ
aprāptāḥ saptabhirbhallaiściccheda paramāstravit - - btataḥ samādāya śaraṃ sarvakāyavidāraṇam
tasya dehe nipatito bāṇo vajrātigo mahān
dṛṣṭvā senāpatiṃ tūrṇaṃ yāntaṃ śalyarathaṃ prati
tato bhīṣmaṃ puraskṛtya tava putro mahābalaḥ
saubhadre bhīmasena ca sātyakau ca mahārathe
kaikeye ca virāṭe ca dhṛṣṭadyumne ca pārṣate eteṣu narasiṃheṣu cedimatsyeṣu caiva ha
evaṃ śvete maheṣvāse prāpte śalyarathaṃ prati
bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ kiṃ vā tanmamācakṣva pṛcchataḥ
pitā putraṃ ca samare nābhijānāti kaścana
cakre bhagne yuge cchinne ekadhurye haye hataḥ
evaṃ ca samare sarve vīrāśca virathīkṛtāḥ
tena tena sma dṛśyante dhāvamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ
gajo hataḥ śiraśchinnaṃ marma bhinnaṃ hayo hataḥ
bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ yuddhe sthitāḥ paśyāma sarvaśaḥ
jīvitaṃ dustyajaṃ tyaktvā bhayaṃ ca sumahāhave
śvetaṃ cāpi tathā bhīṣmaḥ śaraughaiḥ samavākirat
śaraiḥ paramasaṃkruddho yadi śveto na pālayet
durmukhaḥ kṛtavarmā ca kṛpaḥ śalyo viśāṃpatiḥka
nigṛhya kārmukaṃ śveto bhīṣmaṃ vivyādha saptabhiḥ
bhīṣmasya patitaṃ ketuṃ dṛṣṭvā tālaṃ mahātmanaḥ
bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ śūrastathā satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ
bāhlīkaḥ kṛtavarmā ca śalaḥ śalyaśca bhārata
śvetaṃ vivyādha rājendra kaṅkapatraiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ pravyathito rājā bhīṣmaṃ dṛṣṭvā nivāritam
pravīraṃ sarvalokasya śvetena yudhi vai tadā
taṃ vīraṃ vāritaṃ dṛṣṭvā śvetena śaravikṣatam
dhvajamunmatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca senāṃ nivāritām
tānāvārya raṇe śveto bhīṣmasya rathināṃ varaḥ
dhvajaṃ dvābhyāṃ tu ciccheda saptamena ca sārathe
virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ
tataḥ śaktiṃ raṇe śveto jagrāhograṃ mahābhayām
abravīcca tadā śveto bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ raṇe
tiṣṭhedānīṃ susaṃrabdhaḥ paśya māṃ puruṣo bhava
gadāṃ jagrāha saṃhṛṣṭo bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ prati
śvetaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo bhrāmayitvā tu tāṃ gadām
rathe bhīṣmasya cikṣepa yathā devo dhaneśvaraḥ
virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ bhīṣmaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathottamakāḥ
bhīṣmabhīṣma mahābāho śīghraṃ yatnaṃ kuruṣva vai
eṣa hyasya jaye kālo nirdiṣṭo viśvayoninā
saṃprahṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe
virathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā padātinam
devadūtavacaḥ śrutvā vadhe tasya mano dadhe
pitā te bharataśreṣṭha śvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahārathaiḥ
ājaghne viśikhaiḥ ṣaṣṭyā senānyaṃ sa mahārathaḥ
ājaghne bharataśreṣṭhastribhiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ sātyakiṃ ca śatenājau bharatānāṃ pitāmahaḥ - - adhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca viṃśatyā kaikeyaṃ cāpi pañcabhiḥ tāṃśca sarvānmaheṣvāsānpitā devavratastava
sa tasya kavacaṃ bhitvā hṛdayaṃ cāmitaujasaḥ
taṃ bhīṣmeṇa naravyāghraṃ tathā vinihataṃ yudhi
prahṛṣṭāśca sutāstubhyaṃ kuravaścāpi sarvaśaḥ - - btato duḥśāsano rājañśvetaṃ dṛṣṭvā nipātitam
tato'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca nardatāṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ pārthā vimanaso bhūtvā nyavartanta mahārathāḥ
( śvete senāpatau tāta saṃgrame nihate paraiḥ
manaḥ prīṇāti me vākyaṃ jayaṃ saṃjaya śrṛṇvataḥ
kṛtaṃ vairaṃ sadā tena pituḥ putreṇa dhīmatā
sarvaṃ balaṃ parityajya durgaṃ saṃśritya tiṣṭhati
pāṇḍavānāṃ pratāpena durgaṃ deśaṃ niveśya ca
āścaryaṃ vai sadā teṣāṃ purā rājñāṃ sudurmatiḥ tato yudhiṣṭhire bhaktaḥ kathaṃ sañjaya sūditaḥ )
prakṣiptaḥ saṃmataḥ kṣudraḥ putro me puruṣādhamaḥ
na yuddhaṃ rocayedbhīṣmo na cācāryaḥ kathaṃcana
na kṛpo na ca gāndhārī nāhaṃ sañjaya rocaye
na bhīmo nārjunaścaiva na yamau puruṣarṣabhau
vāryamāṇo mayā nityaṃ gāndhāryā vidureṇa ca
tasyāhaṃ vyasanaṃ ghoraṃ manye prāptaṃ tu sañjaya
śvetasya ca vināśena bhīṣmasya vijayena ca
arjunāddhi bhayaṃ bhūyastanme tāta na śāmyati
sa hi śūraśca kaunteyaḥ kṣiprakārī dhanaṃjayaḥ
teṣāṃ krodhaṃ cintayaṃstu ahaḥsu ca niśāsu ca na śāntimadhigacchāmi duryodanakṛtena hi
śvetaṃ tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā virāṭasya camūpatim
te tu bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ śaṅkhamūrdhniṃ nyapātayan
na śekuḥ pāṇḍaveyasya yodhā bhīṣmaṃ nirīkṣitum
tataḥ sainyeṣu bhagneṣu mathiteṣu ca sarvaśaḥ
prāpte cāstaṃ dinakare na prājñāyata kiṃcana
bhīṣmaṃ ca samudīryantaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthā mahāhave
bhīṣme ca yuddhasaṃrabdhe hṛṣṭe duryodhane tathā
śakyo jetuṃ yamaḥ kruddho vajrapāṇiśca saṃyuge
na tu bhīṣmo mahājetāḥ śakyo jetuṃ mahābalaḥ
vanaṃ yātsāmi vārṣṇeya śreyo me tatra jīvitum
kṣapayiṣyati senāṃ me kṛṣṇa bhīṣmo mahāstravit
kiṃ nu kṛtvā hitaṃ me syādbrūhi mādhava māciram
eko bhīmaḥ paraṃ śaktyā yudhyatyeva mahābhujaḥ
sa tvaṃ paśya mahābhāga yogeśvara mahāratham
bhīṣmaṃ yaḥ śamayetsaṃkhye dāvāgniṃ jalado yathā
śokārtaṃ tamatho jñātvā duḥkhopahatacetasam abravīttatra govindo harṣayansarvapāṇḍavān - - amāśuco bharataśreṣṭa na tvaṃ śocitumarhasi yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrāḥ sarvalokeṣu dhanvinaḥka
eṣa te pārṣato nityaṃ hitakāmaḥ priye rataḥ
śikhaṇḍī ca mahābāho bhīṣmasya nidhanaṃ kila etacchrutvā tato dharmo dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ mahāratham
sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla vikramya jahi kauravān
ahaṃ ca te'nuyāsyāmi bhīmaḥ kṛṣṇaśca māriṣa
ahaṃ droṇāntakaḥ pārtha vihitaḥ śambhunā purā
raṇe bhīṣmaṃ kṛpaṃ droṇaṃ tathā śalyaṃ jayadratham
tena ratnavatā pārthaḥ sa ca gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
grīvāyāṃ niyutaṃ cāpi sahasrāmi ca saptatiḥ
sūryodhayaṃ ta icchataḥ sthitā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ teṣāmādityavarmāni vimalāni mahānti ca
ekaikaśaḥ samarthā hi yūyaṃ sarve mahārathāḥ
tato bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca tava putrāśca māriṣa
pṛṣṭhagopāstu tasyāsannānādeśyā janeśvarāḥ - - bketumānvasudānaśca putraḥ kāśyasya cābhibhūḥ
tataste tāvakāḥ sarve hṛṣṭā yuddhāya bhārata
teṣāṃ śrutvā tu hṛṣṭānāṃ vṛddhaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ
tataḥ śaṅkhāśca bheryaśca peśyaśca vividhāḥ paraiḥ
tathā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu sannaddharuciradhvajāḥ tāvakāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ yathā'yudhyanta tacchṛṇu
saubhadre bhīmasene ca sātyakau ca mahārathe
kaikeye ca virāṭe ca dhṛṣṭadyumne ca pārṣate
eṣa bhīṣmaḥ susaṃkruddho vārṣṇeya mama vāhinīm
eṣa droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ śalyo vikarṇaśca janārdana
evamuktvā tataḥ śaurī rathaṃ taṃ lokaviśrutam
trasayanataṃ raṇe śūrānmardayantaṃ ca sāyakaiḥ saindhavapramukhairguptaḥ prācyasauvīrakekayaiḥ
sa bhīṣmaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā kṛpaṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
droṇaṃ ṣaṣṭyā naravyāghro vikarṇaṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
śalyaṃ caiva tribhirbāṇai rājānaṃ caiva pañcabhiḥ
tato droṇaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ gāṅgeyasya priye ratam
teṣāṃ tu ninadaṃ śrutvā sahitānāṃ prahṛṣṭavat
teṣāṃ mahārathānāṃ sa madhyaṃ prāpya dhanaṃjayaḥ
pīḍyamānaṃ svakaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthena saṃyuge
eṣa pāṇḍusutastāta kṛṣṇena sahito balī yatatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ mūlaṃ naḥ parikṛntati
tvayi jīvati gāṅgeya droṇe ca rathināṃ vare
tvatkṛte caiva karṇo'pi nyastaśastro viśāṃpate na yudhyati raṇe pārthānhitakāmaḥ sadā mama
sa tathā kuru gāṅgeya yathā hanyeta phalgunaḥ
dhik kṣātraṃ dharmamityuktvā prāyātpārthaṃ rathaṃ prati
parivārya raṇe bhīṣmaṃ sthitā yuddhāya māriṣa
arjunaḥ pañcaviṃśatyā bhīṣmamārcchacchitaiḥ śaraiḥ bhīṣmopi samare pārthaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ kruddho mahārāja bhīṣmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
tato'rjuno bhṛśaṃ kruddho nirviddhaṃ prekṣya mādhavam
yatamānau tu tau vīrāvanyonyasya vadhaṃ prati
dāritā sahasā bhūmiścakampe ca nanāda ca
dharme sthitasya hi yathā na kaścidvṛjinaṃ kvacit
na śakyau yudhi saṃrabdhau jetumetau kathaṃcana
na hi śakyo raṇe jetuṃ bhīṣmaḥ pārthena dhīmatā
na vijetuṃ raṇe bhīṣma utsaheta dhanurdharam
ālokādapi yuddhaṃ hi samametadbhaviṣyati iti sma vāco'śrūyanta proccarantyakastatastataḥ
ubhayoḥ senayoḥ śūrā nyakṛntanta parasparam vartamāne tathā ghore tasminyuddhe sudāruṇe
diṣṭameva paraṃ manye pauruṣāditi me matiḥ
na śakyāḥ pāṇḍavā jetuṃ devairapi savāsavaiḥ
taṃ ca dīptaṃ śaraṃ ghoramāyāntaṃ mṛtyumātmanaḥ
ciccheda śaravṛṣṭiṃ ca bhāradvāje mumoca ha
tata uccukruśuḥ sarve pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
sa cchinnadhanvā samare gadāṃ gurvī mahāyaśāḥ
vyaṃsayitvā gadāṃ tāṃ ca preṣayāmāsa pārṣatam
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
tataḥ sa vipulaṃ carma śatacandraṃ ca bhānumat
khaṅgaṃ ca vipulaṃ divyaṃ pragṛhya subhujo balī
āmiṣārthī yathā siṃho vane mattamiva dvipam
lāghavaṃ cāstrayogaṃ ca balaṃ bāhvośca bhārata
na śaśāka tato gantuṃ balavānapi saṃyuge
tataḥ sā mahatī sena kaliṅgānāṃ janeśvara
kaliṅgānāṃ ca samare bhīṣmasya ca mahātmanaḥ
putreṇa tava rājendra sa tathokto mahābalaḥ
tataḥ śrutāyuḥ saṃkruddho rājñā ketumatā saha
ayutena gajānāṃ ca niṣādaiḥka saha ketumān
anyonyaṃ sma tadā yodhā vikarṣanto viśāṃpate
śakradeva iti khyāto jaghnatuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ śaraiḥ
rathairanekasāhasrairbhīmasyāvārayaddiśaḥ ayutena gajānāṃ ca niṣādaiḥ parivāritaḥ
tato bhīmo mahāvegāṃ tyaktvā gurvī mahāgadāṃ
na ca taṃ mamṛṣe bhīmaḥ siṃhanādaṃ mahāhave
na bhīmaṃ samare mene mānuṣaṃ bharatarṣabha
aśvabṛndeṣu nāgeṣu rathānīkeṣu cābhibhūḥ padātīnāṃ ca saṅgheṣu vinighnañśoṇitokṣitaḥ
nikṛtya rathināṃ cājau ratheṣāśca yugāni ca
chainnadantāgrahastāśca bhinnakumbhāstathā'pare viyodhāḥ svānyanīkāni jaghnurbhārata vāraṇāḥ
sa cakre vasudhāṃ kīrṇāṃ śabalaiḥ kusumairiva
evaṃ sā bahulā senā kaliṅgānāṃ tarasvinām
śrutāyuṣamabhiprekṣya bhīmasenaḥ samabhyayāt tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya kāliṅgo navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
saṃnivārya sa tāṃ ghorāṃ śaravṛṣṭiṃ samutthitām
bibheda samare tūrṇaṃ prekṣya bhīṣmaṃ mahāratham
prākampanta ca sainyāni vāhanāni ca sarvaśaḥ
senāpativacaḥ śrutvā śikhaṇḍipramukhā gaṇāḥ bhīmamevābhyavartanta rathānīkaiḥ prahāribhiḥ - - adharmarājaśca tānsarvānupajagrāha pāṇḍavaḥ mahatā meghavarṇena nāgānīkena pṛṣṭhataḥ
na hi pañcālarājasya loke kaścana vidyate
śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau ca samare siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca
sa ca pārāvatāśvasya rathe hemapariṣkṛte kovidāradhvajaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmasenaḥ samāśvasat
tau dūrātsātyakiṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnavṛkodarau kaliṅgānsamare vīrau yodhayetāṃ manasvinau
sa tatra gatvā śaineyo javena jayatāṃ varaḥ
tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ śrutvā taṃ ninadaṃ raṇe
parivārya tu te sarve gāṅgeyaṃ tarasā raṇe
śaktiṃ cikṣepa tarasā gāṅgeyasya rathaṃ prati
mahāvyūhaḥ kaliṅgānāmekena mṛditastvayā evamuktvā śinernaptā dīrghabāhurarindama
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tu saṃyuktaṃ drauṇinā vīkṣya bhārata
sa śalyaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā kṛpaṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tato duryodhano rāja dṛṣṭvā putraṃ mahāratham
sannivṛtte tava sute sarva eva janādhipāḥ
sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ śūraiḥ śūro yudhi sudurjayaiḥ
nāpyantarikṣaṃ na diśo na bhūmirna ca bhāskaraḥ
dhvajānāṃ carmaṇāṃ caiva vyajanānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
pratodānāṃ ca yokrāṇāṃ kaśānāṃ caiva māriṣa
yo yo hi samare pārthaṃ pratyudyāti viśāṃpate
eṣa pāṇḍusuto vīra kṛṣṇena sahito balī
na hyeṣa samare śakyo vijetuṃ hi kathaṃcana
na nivartayituṃ cāpi śakyeyaṃ mahatī camūḥ
śrāntā bhītāśca no yodhā na yotsyanti kathaṃcana
prayayuḥ śibirāyaiva dhanañjayapuraskṛtāḥ vāditraghoṣaiḥ saṃhṛṣṭā praṇadyanto mahārathāḥ
tato'vahāraḥ sainyānāṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
gāruḍaṃ ca mahāvyūhaṃ cakre śāntanavastadā putrāṇāṃ te jayākāṅkṣī bhīṣmaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ
cakṣuṣī ca bharajvājaḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
vyūḍhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tatsainyaṃ savyasācī paraṃtapaḥ
madhye sainyasya mahataḥ sthitā yuddhāya bhārata tatraiva dharmarājo'pi gajānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ
sarvasya jagato goptā goptā yasya janārdanaḥ tatrānurathināṃ śreṣṭho vāmaśrṛṅge vyavasthitaḥ
vadhārthaṃ tava putrāmāṃ tatpakṣe ye ca saṅgatāḥ
dhāvatāṃ ca rathoghānāṃ nighnatāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak
babhūva tumulaḥ śabdo vimiśro dundubhisvanaiḥ divaspṛṅvaravīrāṇāṃ nighnatāmitaretaram
saṃprahāre sutumule tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
prārthayānā yaśo dīptāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam
na diśaḥ pradiśo vāpi jajñire'tra samāgatāḥ
avartata tadā yuddhaṃ tatra tatra viśāṃpate
na vyūho bhidyate tatra kauravāṇāṃ kathañcana
sa gajaṃ pātayāmāsa gajī ca rathināṃ varam
padātī rathinaṃ saṅkhye rathī cāpi padātinam
tato rathasahasreṇa putro duryodhanastava abhyayātpāṇḍavaṃ yuddhe rākṣasaṃ ca ghaṭotkacam - - atathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve mahatyā senayā saha droṇabhīṣmau raṇe yattau pratyudyayurarindamau
tataste pārthivāḥ kruddhāḥ phalgunaṃ vīkṣya saṃyuge
cikṣiṣuḥ samare kruddhāḥ phalgunasya rathaṃ prati
tato dharmasutoka rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṃ ca jagāma ha
taṃ visaṃjñaṃ viditvā tu tvaramāṇo'sya sārathiḥ
droṇasya paśyataḥ sainyaṃ gāṅgeyasya ca paśyataḥ
dravamāṇaṃ tu tatsainyaṃ tava putrasya saṃyuge
vāryamāṇaṃ ca bhīṣmeṇa droṇena ca mahātmanā
yatra yatra hi putraṃ te ye ye paśyanti bhārata
tathā droṇasya saṅgrame draumeścaiva kṛpasya ca
anugrāhyāḥ pāṇḍusutāstava nūnaṃ pitāmaha yathemāṃ kṣamase vīra vadhyamānāṃ varūthinīm - - aso'smi vācyastvayā rājanpūrvameva samāgame na yotsye pāṇḍavānsaṅkhye nāpi pārṣatasātyakī
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tubhyamācāryasya kṛpasya ca
yattu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ vṛddhenādya gatāyuṣā
dadhmuḥ śaṅkhānmudā yuktā bherīḥ saṃjaghnire bhṛśam
pāṇḍavā hi tato rājañśrutvā taṃ ninadaṃ mahat
tiṣṭha sthito'smi viddhyainaṃ nivartasva sthiro bhava
na dṛṣṭaṃ na śrutaṃ vāpi yuddhametādṛśaṃ nṛpa
yathā tava sutānāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhārata
tāta bhrātaḥ sakhe bandho vayasya mama mātula
mā māṃ parityajetyanye cukruśuḥ patitā raṇe
athābhyehi tvamāgaccha kiṃ bhītosi kva yāsyasi
sthito'haṃ samare mā bhairiti cānye vicukruśuḥ
tamekaṃ samare śūraṃ pāṇḍavāḥ sṛñjayaiḥ saha
pūrvasyāṃ diśi taṃ dṛṣṭvā pratīcyāṃ dadṛśurjanāḥ
evaṃ sa samare śūro gāṅgeyaḥ pratyadṛśyata
kurvāṇaṃ samare karma sūdayānaṃ ca vāhinīm
vyākrośanta raṇe tatra narā bahuvidhā bahu
na hi moghaḥ śaraḥ kaścidāsīdbhīṣmasya saṃyuge
yo yo bhīṣmaṃ naravyāghramabhyeti yudhi kaścana
muhūrtadṛṣṭaḥ sa mayā patito bhuvi dṛśyate
abhajyata mahārāja na ca dvau saha dhāvataḥ
jaghānātra pitā putraṃ putraśca pitaraṃ tathā
priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ cākrande sakhā daivabalātkṛtaḥ - - bvimucya kavacānyanye pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ
asaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ pārtha paste'bhikāṅkṣitaḥ
praharasva naravyāghra na cenmohādvimuhyase yattvayā kathitaṃ vīra purā rājñāṃ samāgame
bībhatso paśya sainyaṃ svaṃ bhajyamānaṃ tatastataḥ
sādhu pārtha mahābāho sādhu bho pāṇḍunandana
prīto'smi subhṛśaṃ putra kuru yuddhaṃ mayā saha
punaścāpi susaṃrabdhaḥ śaraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ kṛṣṇayoryudhi saṃrabdho bhīṣmāḥ prācchādayaddiśaḥ
kartavyaṃ nābhijānāti raṇe bhīṣmasya gauravāt tathā cintayatastasya bhūya eva pitāmahaḥ
teṣāṃ bahutvāsu bhṛsaṃ śarāṇāṃ diśaśca sarvāḥ pihitā babhūvuḥ
na cāntarikṣaṃ na diśo na bhūmirna bhāskaro'dṛśyata raśmimālīka
vavuśca vātāstumulāḥ sadhūmā diśaśca sarvāḥ kṣubhitā babhūvuḥ
droṇo vikarṇo'tha jayadrathaśca bhūriśravāḥ kṛtavarmā kṛpaśca
kva kṣatriyā yāsyatha naiṣa dharmaḥ satāṃ purastātkathitaḥ purāṇaiḥ
mā svāṃ pratijñāṃ tyajata pravīrāḥ svaṃ vīradharmaṃ paripālayadhvam
pārthasya dṛṣṭavā mṛduyuddhātāṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca saṅkhye samudīryamāṇam
amṛṣyamāṇaḥ sa tato mahātmā yaśasvinaṃ sarvadaśārhabhartā
ye yānti te yāntu śinipravīra ye'pi sthitāḥ sātvata te'pi yāntu
bhīṣmaṃ rathātpaśya nipātyamānaṃ droṇaṃ ca saṅkhye sagaṇaṃ mayā'dya
na sāratheḥ sātvata kauravāṇāṃ kruddhasya mucyeta raṇe'dya kaścit
tasmādahaṃ gṛhya rathāṅgamugraṃ prāṇaṃ hariṣyāmi mahāvratasya
nihatya bhīṣmaṃ sagaṇaṃ tathājau droṇaṃ ca śaineya rathapravīrau
prītiṃ kariṣyāmi dhanaṃjayasya rājñaśca bhīmasya tathā'śvinośca
nihatya sarvāndhṛtarāṣṭraputrāṃstatpakṣiṇo ye ca narendramukhyāḥ rājyena rājānamajātaśatruṃ saṃpādayiṣyāmyahamadya hṛṣṭaḥ
itīdamuktvā sa mahānubhāvaḥ sasmāra cakraṃ niśitaṃ purāṇam
kṣurāntamudyamya bhujena cakraṃ rathādavaplutya visṛjya vāhān saṃkampayangāṃ caraṇairmahātmā vegena kṛṣmaḥ prasasāra bhīṣmam
so'bhidravanbhīṣmamanīkamadhye kruddho mahendrāvarajaḥ pramāthī vyālambipītāmbaradhṛkkakāśe ghano yathā khe taḍitāvanaddhaḥ
sarvāṇi bhūtāni bhṛśaṃ vineduḥ kṣayaṃ kurūṇāmiva cintayitvā
asaṃbhramaṃ tadvicakarṣa dorbhyāṃ mahādhanurgāmaḍivatulyaghoṣam uvāca bhīṣmastamanantapauruṣaṃ govindamājāvavimūḍhacetāḥ
ehyehi deveśa jagannivāsa namostu te mādhava cakrapāṇe
prasahya māṃ pātaya lokanātha rathottamātsarvaśaraṇya saṅkhye
tvayā hatasyāpi mamā'dya kṛṣṇa śreyaḥ parisminniha caiva loke
nigṛhyamaṇāśca tadā''didevo bhṛśa saroṣaḥ kila nāma yogī
ādāya vegena jagāma viṣṇurjiṣṇuṃ mahāvāta ivaikavṛkṣam
pārthastu viṣṭabhya balena pādau bhīṣmāntikaṃ tūrṇamabhidravantam
balānnijagrāha hariṃ kirīṭī pade'tha rājandaśame kathaṃcit
avasthitaṃ ca praṇipatya kṛṣṇaṃ prīto'rjunaḥ kāñcanacitramālī
na hāsyate karma yathāpratijñaṃ putraiḥ śape keśava sodaraiśca
tataḥ pratijñāṃ samayaṃ ca tasya janārdanaḥ prītamanā niśamya
sthitaḥ priye kauravasattamasya rathaṃ sacakraḥ punarāruroha
tataḥ pratijñāṃ samavāpya bhīṣmaḥ kṛtāñcaliḥ stutyamathākarodvai
traivikrame yasya vapurbabhāse tathaiva dṛṣṭvā tu samuñjvalantam
pragṛhya śaṅkhaṃ dviṣatākaṃ nihantā sa tānabhūṣūnpunarādadānaḥ
bhīṣmaṃ śaraiḥ saṃparivārya saṅkhye ciccheda bhūriśravasaśca cāpam
śalyaṃ ca viddhvā navabhiḥ pṛṣatkairduryodhaṃ vakṣasi nirbibheda
vinādayāmāsa tato diśaśca sa pāñcajanyasya raveṇa śauriḥ
gāṇḍīvaghoṣaḥ stanayitnukalpo jagāma pārthasya nabho diśaśca
jagmuśca bāṇā vimalāḥ prasannāḥ sarvā diśaḥ pāṇḍavacāpamuktāḥ
taṃ kauravāṇāmadhipo javena bhīṣmeṇa bhūriśravasā ca sārdham
athārjunāya prajighāya bhallān bhūriśravāḥ sapta suvarṇapuṅkhān
sa saptabhiḥ sapta śarapravekān saṃvārya bhīriśravasā visṛṣṭān
tataḥ śubhāmāpatatīṃ sa śaktiṃ vidyutprabhāṃ śāntanavena muktām
gadāṃ ca madrādhipabāhumuktāṃ dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ nicarta vīraḥ
tato diśaḥ so'nudiśaśca pārthaḥ śaraiḥ sudhāraiḥ samare vitatya
sarvāṇi sainyāni tu tāvakāni yatoyato gāṇḍivajaḥ praṇādaḥ
tatastataḥ sannatimeva jagmurna taṃ pratīpo'bhisasāra kaścit
tasminsughore kanṛpa saṃprahāre hatāḥ pravīrāḥ sarathāśvasūtāḥ
dṛḍhaṃ hatāḥ pātribhirugravegaiḥ pārthena bhallairvimalaiḥ śitāgnaiḥ
padātisaṅghāśca rathāśca saṅkhye hayāśca nāgāśca dhanañjayena
nadī sughorā naramedaphenā pravartitā tatra raṇājire vai
hatapravīrāṃ ca tathaiva dṛṣṭvā senāṃ kurūṇāmatha phalgunena
te cedipāñcālakarūṣamatsyāḥ pārthāśca sarve sahitāḥ praṇeduḥ
vitrāsya senāṃ dhvajinīpatīnāṃ siṃho mṛgāṇāmiva yūthasaṅghān
tato raviṃ saṃvṛtaraśmijālaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛśaṃ śastraparikṣatāṅgāḥ
avāpaya kīrti ca yaśaśca loke vijitya śatrūṃśca dhanaṃjayo'pi
yayau narendraiḥ sahasodaraiśca samāptakarmā śibiraṃ niśāyām
tataḥ prajajñe tumulaḥ kurūṇāṃ niśāmukhe ghoratamaḥ praṇādaḥ
raṇe rathānāmayutaṃ nihatya hatā gajāḥ saptaśatārjunena
mahatkṛtaṃ karma dhanañjayena kartuṃ yathā nārhati kaścidanyaḥ
droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ saindhavabāhlikau ca bhūriśravāḥ śalyaśalau ca rājan
anye ca yodhāḥ śataśaḥ sametāḥ kruddhena pārthena raṇasya madhye
iti bruvantaḥ śibirāṇi jagmuḥ sarve gaṇā bhārata ye tvadīyāḥ
vyuṣṭāṃ niśāṃ bhārata bhāratānāmanīkinīnāṃ pramukhe mahātmā
yayau sapatnānprati jātakopo vṛtaḥ samagreṇa balena bhīṣmaḥ
rarāja rājā sa tu rājamukhyairvṛtaḥ sadevairiva vajrapāṇiḥ
senāmahognā sahasā kurūṇāṃ vego yathā bhīma ivāpagāyāḥ
viniryayau ketumatā rathena nararṣabhaḥ śvetahayena kāle
tathā mahātmā saha keśavena varīthinīnāṃ pramukhe rarāja
kapidhvajaṃ prekṣya rathaṃ viṣeduḥ sahaiva putraistava kauraveyāḥ
yathaiva pūrve'hani dharmarājñā vyūhaḥ kṛtaḥ kauravasattamena
yathā na bhūto bhuvi mānuṣeṣu na dṛṣṭapūrvo na ca saṃśrutaśca
tato yathādeśamupetya tasthuḥ pāñcālamukhyāḥ saha cedimukhyaiḥ
tataḥ sabāṇāni mahāsvanāni visphāryamāṇāni dhanūṃṣi vīraiḥ
rathī rathenābhihataḥ sasūtaḥ papāta sāśvaḥ sarathaḥ saketuḥ
gajo gajenābhihatāḥ papāta padātinā cābhihataḥ padātiḥ
kṛpaśca śalyaśca viviṃśatiśca duryodhanaḥ saumadattiśca rājan
tataḥ sa tūrṇaṃ rudhirodaphenāṃ kṛtvā nadīmāśu raṇe ripūṇām
babhūva sadṛśaḥ kārṣṇernāstre nāpi ca lāghave
pīḍayānaṃ tu tatsainyaṃ pautraṃ tava viśāṃpate
pratyudyayau sa saubhadrastejasā ca balena ca
tasya lāghavamārgasthamādityasadṛśaprabham vyadṛśyata mahaccāpaṃ samare yudhyataḥ paraiḥ
sa drauṇimiṣuṇaikena viddhvā śalyaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
śalyasya ca mahāvegānasyataḥ samare śarān dhanuściccheda bhallena tīvravegana phālguniḥ
tau tu tatra pitāputrau parikṣiptau mahārathau
pārāvatāśvaḥ sa rathamāsthāya paravīrahā dhanurviṣphārya saṃkruddho nodayitvā ca vāhinīm
tataḥ sa madrakānhatvā daśaiva daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
taṃ nihatya gadāgreṇa sa lebhe paramāṃ mudam
tau tatra samare śūrau sametau yuddhadurmadau
nityaṃ hi māmakāṃstāta hatāneva hi śaṃsasi
vibhagnāṃśca pranaṣṭāṃśca nityaṃ śaṃsasi māmakān hīnānpuruṣakāreṇa māmakānadya sañjaya
pāṇḍavā hi jayantyeva jīyante caiva māmakāḥ
śroṣyāmi satataṃ tāta duḥsahāni bahūni ca
te vai sameyuḥ saṃgrāme rājandurmantrite tava
satyavrataṃ ca samare purumitraṃ ca bhārata
tataḥ śalyo mahārāja svastrīyau rathināṃ varau
chādyamānau tatastau katu mādrīputrau na celatuḥ
āpatantaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā gajānīkaṃ vṛkodaraḥ
nākulistu śatānīkaḥ samare śatrupūgahā kṣuraiḥ kṣuraprairbhallaiśca pītaiścāñjalikaiḥ śitaiḥ
vihnalanto gatā bhūmiṃ śailā iva dharātale
taṃ hi vīraṃ maheṣvāsaṃ saubhadrapramukhā rathāḥ
yathā paśūnāṃ saṅghātaṃ yaṣṭyā pālaḥ prakālayet
tataḥ śaikyāyasīṃ gurvīṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām
taṃ tathā mahatīṃ senāṃ drāvayantaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
nāśaknavandhārayituṃ tadānīṃ sarve gaṇā bhārata ye tvadīyāḥ
śaraiścaturbhiḥ pratividdhya taṃ ca naptā śinerabhyapatadrathena
anvāgataṃ vṛṣṇivaraṃ niśamya taṃ śatrumadhye parivartamānam
tathāpi taṃ dhārayituṃ na śekurmadhyaṃdine sūryamivātapantam
na tatra kaścinnaviṣaṇṇa āsīdṛte rājansomadattasya putrāt
sa vai samādāya dhanurmahātmā bhiriśravā bhārata saumadattiḥ
taṃ caiva pāṇḍavāḥ sarve sātyakiṃ rabhasaṃ raṇe
saphalaḥ sūta cādyeha yo'haṃ paśyāmi sodarān
tatra tiṣṭhati sannaddhaḥ svayaṃ rājā suyodhanaḥ
taṃ tu duryodhanaḥ ṣaṣṭyā viddhvā bhīmaṃ mahābalam
samare prekṣya yantāraṃ viśokaṃ tu vṛkodaraḥ
suṣeṇaṃ ca tato hatvā preṣayāmāsa mṛtyave
adṛśyaṃ samare cakre jīmūta iva bhāskaram
ta enaṃ śaravarṣeṇa samantātparyavārayan - - bgajaṃ ca śaravṛṣṭyā tu bibhiduste samantataḥ
ājaghāna mahārāja śareṇānataparvaṇā so'tividdho maheṣvāsastena rājñā mahārathaḥ
sa kṛtvā dāruṇāṃ māyāṃ bhūrūṇāṃ bhayavardhinīm
airāvataṃ samārūḍhaḥ sa vai māyākṛtaṃ svayam
ghaṭotkacastu svaṃ nāgaṃ codayāmāsa taṃ tadā
tasya taṃ nadato nādaṃ sughoraṃ bhīmaniḥśvanam
tatra gacchāma bhadraṃ vo rājānaṃ parirakṣitum
te tvaradhvaṃ mahāvīryāḥ kiṃ cireṇa prayāmahe
bhīṣmasya tadvacaḥ śrutvā sarva eva mahārathāḥ
tasya taṃ ninadaṃ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā nāgāṃśca yudhyataḥ
na rocate me saṃgrāmo haiḍimbena durātmanā
naiṣa śakyo yudhā jetumapi vajrabhṛtā svayam
labdhalakṣaḥ prahārī ca vayaṃ ca śrāntavāhanāḥ
idānīṃ yudhi nirjetuṃ na śakyo'sau sa rākṣasaḥ astamabhyeti savitā rātrau yoddhuṃ kana śakyate
avahāramataḥ kurmaḥ śvo yotsyāmaḥ parai saha
yuddhe sumanaso bhūtvā jagmuḥ svaśibiraṃ prati
vinadanto mahātmānaḥ kampayantaśca medinīm ghaṭṭayantaśca marmāṇi tava putrasya māriṣa
muhūrtaṃ cintayāmāsa bāṣpaśokasamākulaḥ tataḥ kṛtvā vidhiṃ sarvaṃ śibirasya yathāvidhi
putrāṇāṃ ca parābhāvaṃ śrutvā sañjaya sarvaśaḥ
cintā me mahatī sūta bhaviṣyati kathaṃ tviti
tathā hi dṛśyate sarvaṃ daivayogena sañjaya
kena dattavarāstāta kiṃ vā jñānaṃ vidanti te
yena kṣayaṃ na gacchanti divi tārāgaṇā iva
punaḥpunarna mṛṣyāmi hataṃ sainyaṃ tu pāṇḍavaiḥ
yathā'vadhyāḥ pāṇḍusutā yathā vādhyāśca me sutāḥ
na hi pāraṃ prapaśyāmi duḥkhasyāsya kathaṃcana
putrāṇāṃ vyasanaṃ manye dhruvaṃ prāptaṃ sudāruṇam
na hi paśyāmi taṃ vīraṃ yo me rakṣetsutānraṇe
dhruvaṃ vināśaḥ saṃprāptaḥ putrāmāṃ mama sañjaya
tasmānme kāraṇaṃ sūta śaktiṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ
śriyā paramayā yuktā yato dharmastato jayaḥ
sarvaṃ ca tadanādṛtya putrāṇāṃ tava kilbiṣam
dharmamūlāḥ sadaivāsanpāṇḍavāḥ pāṇḍupūrvaja na caitānbahumanyante putrāstava viśāṃpate
sa tvaṃ bhuṅkṣva mahārāja saputraḥ samuhṛñjanaḥ
vākyaṃ hitaṃ ca pathyaṃ ca martyaḥ pathyamivauṣadham
śṛṇu bhūyo yathātattvaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ paryāptā iti me matiḥ
śṛṇu rājanvaco mahyaṃ yathā vakṣyāmi kaurava
bahuśaśca mayokto'si na ca me tattvayā kṛtam
na ca me krośatastāta śrutavānasi vai purā
taṃ śṛṇuṣva mahābāho mama kīrtayataḥ prabho
nāsti lokeṣu tadbhūtaṃ bhavitā no bhaviṣyati
purā kila surāḥ sarve ṛṣayaśca samāgatāḥ
viśvāvasurviśvamūrtirhi viśve viṣvakseno viśvakarmā vaśī ca
pādau tava dhā devī diśo bāhu divaṃ śiraḥ
balaṃ tapaśca satyaṃ ca karma dharmātmakaṃ tava
aśvinau śravaṇau nityaṃ devī jihvā sarasvatī
na saṅkhyānaṃ parīmāṇaṃ na tejo na parākramam
tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ netā tvaṃ jagadguruḥ
jagato dhāraṇārthāya vijñāpyaṃ kuru me vibho
vāsudevamayaḥ so'haṃ tvayaivāsmi vinirmitaḥ tasmādyācāmi lokeśa caturātmānamātmanā
dharmaṃ prāpya yaśaḥ prāpya yogaṃ prāpsyati tattvataḥ
sthitāśca sarve tvayi bhūtasaṅghāḥ kṛtvāśrayaṃ tvāṃ varadaṃ subāho
vāgbhiḥ stuto variṣṭhābhiḥ śrotumicchāma taṃ vayam
yattatparaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhavitavyaṃ ca yatparam
bhūtātmā ca prabhuścaiva brahma yacca paraṃ padam
tenāsmi kṛtasaṃvādaḥ prasannena surarṣabhāḥ jagato'nugrahārthāya yācito me jagatpatiḥ
ta ime nṛṣu saṃbhūtā ghorarūpā mahābalāḥ
yattatpuruṣasaṃjñaṃ vai gīyate jñāyate na ca
yoginaṃ taṃ mahātmānaṃ praviṣṭaṃ mānuṣīṃ tanum
evaṃ viditvā tattvārthaṃ lokānāmīśvareśvaraḥ vāsudevo namaskāryaḥ sarvalokaiḥ surottamāḥ
kathāṃ tāṃ brahmaṇā gītāṃ śrutvā prītā divaṃ yayuḥ
etamarthaṃ ca vijñāya śrutvā ca prabhumavyayam
yasya caivātmajo brahmā sarvasya jagataḥ pitā
mā gaccha saṃyugaṃ tena vāsudevena dhanvinā
mā pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhamiti tattvaṃ mohānna budhyase
manye tvāṃ rākṣasaṃ krūraṃ tathā cāsi tamovṛtaḥ
sarkavalokamayo nityaḥ śāstā dhātā dharo dhruvaḥ
yataḥ kṛṣṇastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ
śreyoyuktāṃ sadā buddhiṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ dadhāti yaḥ
balaṃ caiva raṇe nityaṃ bhayebhyaścaiva rakṣati
sa eṣa śāśvato devāḥ sarvaguhyamayaḥ śivaḥ
vāsudeva iti jñeyo yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārata
sa eṣa sarvaṃ suramartyalokaṃ samudrakakṣyāntaritāṃ purīṃ ca
yugeyuge mānuṣaṃ caiva vāsaṃ punaḥpunaḥ sṛjate vāsudevāḥka
śrutaṃ me tāta rāmasya jāmadagnyasya jalpataḥ nāradasya ca devarṣeḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyanasya ca
sa sṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ devīṃ sarvalokeśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
apsu vai śayanaṃ cakre mahātmā puruṣottamaḥ
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuṃ ca prajānāṃ prabhavāpyayau
eṣa kartā ca kāryaṃ ca āderādiḥ svayaṃ prabhuḥ
ubhe sandhye divaḥ khaṃ ca niyamāṃśca janārdanaḥ
yo dhārayati bhūtāni dharāṃ cemāṃ saparvatām dhyānayogena viprāśca taṃ vidanti mahaujasam
tamugramugrakarmāṇamugrāṃ buddhaiṃ samāsthitam harantaṃ brahmaṇo vedāñjaghāna brahmaṇaḥ pitā
eṣa dhātā vidhātā ca sarveṣāṃ prāmināṃ hariḥ
paraṃ hi puṇḍarīkākṣānna bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
sadā naraḥ paṭhaṃścedaṃ svastimānsa sukhī bhavet
ye ca kṛṣṇaṃ prapadyante te na muhyanti mānavāḥ
bhaye mahati magnāṃśca pāti nityaṃ janārdanaḥka
sa taṃ yudhiṣṭhiro jñātvā yāthātathyena bhārata sarvātmanā mahātmānaṃ keśavaṃ jagadīśvaram
stavaṃ vai brahmasaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu kṛṣṇasya bhārata
brahmarṣibhiśca devaiśca yaḥ purā kathito bhuvi
yajñaṃ tvāṃ caiva yajñānāṃ tapaśca tapasāmapi
purāṇāṃ caiva paramaṃ viṣṇo rūpaṃ taveti ca
vāsudevo vasūnāṃ tvaṃ śakraṃ sthāpayitā tathā
avyaktaṃ te śarīrotthaṃ vyaktaṃ te manasi sthitam
śirasā te divyaṃ vyāptaṃ bāhubhyāṃ pṛthivī tathā
jaṭharaṃ te trayo lokāḥ puruṣo'si sanātanaḥ
keśavasya yathā tattvaṃ suprīto bhaja keśavam
narasya ca yathātattvaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ pṛcchase nṛpa
yathā ca pāṇḍavā rājannavadhyā yudhi kasyacit
vyasarjayacca rājānaṃ śayanaṃ ca viveśa ha
śiśye ca śayane śubhre rātriṃ tāṃ bharatarṣabha
te sarve sahitā yuddhe samālokya parasparam
vyūhau ca vyūhya saṃrabdhāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
ajātaśatruḥ śatrūṇāṃ manāṃsi samakampayat śyenavadvyūhya taṃ vyūhaṃ dhaumyasya vacanātsvayam
sa hi tasya suvijñāta agnicityeṣu bhārata
praviśya tu raṇe bhīmo makaraṃ mukhatastadā
pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭvā vadhaṃ ghoraṃ balasya balināṃ varaḥ
bhrātṝṇāṃ ca vadhaṃ yuddhe smaramāṇo mahārathaḥ
ācāryaḥ satataṃ hi tvaṃ hitakāmo mamānagha
vayaṃ hi tvāṃ samāśritya bhīṣmaṃ caiva pitāmaham
devānapi raṇe jetuṃ prārthayāmo na saṃśayaḥ
sa tathā kuru bhadraṃ te yathā vadhyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
tatra saṃprekṣya rājanaṃ saṃkruddha iva niścasan
na śakyā hi yathā jetuṃ pāṇḍavā hi mahābalāḥ
yathābalaṃ yathāvīryaṃ karma kuryāmahaṃ hi te ityuktavā te sutaṃ rājannabhyapadyata vāhinīm
śaineyaṃ tu raṇe kruddho bhāradvājaḥ pratāpāvān
tato droṇaśca bhīṣmaśca tathā śalyaśca māriṣa
tato droṇo mahārāja abhyadravata taṃ raṇe
śikhaṇḍī tu samāsādya droṇaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varam
prāvartata kurūṇāṃ ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhārata
gadānāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca hastānāṃ corubhiḥ saha
pādānāṃ bhūṣaṇānāṃ ca keyūrāṇāṃ ca saṅghaśaḥ
jaghnuḥ paraspara tatra kṣatriyāḥ kāla āgate
dhvajaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā pārthasya sarvānno bhayamāviśat
suvarṇapṛṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvaṃ raṇe drakṣyāmi bhārata vidyutaṃ meghamadhyasthāṃ bhrājamānāmivāmbare
diśaṃ prācīṃ pratīcīṃ ca na jānīmo'stramohitāḥ
cedikāśipadātaiśca rathaiḥ pāñcālasṛñjayaiḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sahitāḥ sarve dhṛṣṭadyumnapurogamāḥ
matsyā duryodhanaṃ jagmuḥ śaṃkuniṃ na viśāṃpate
sūryavarṇaiśca nistriṃśaiḥ pātyamānāni sarvaśaḥ dikṣu sarvāsvadṛśyanta śarīrāṇi śirāṃsi ca
śarāhatā bhinnadehā baddhayokrā hayottamāḥ yugāni paryakarṣanta tatratatra sma bhārata
teṣāṃ tathā karṣatāṃ tu gajānāṃ rūpamābabhau
droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca maheṣvāsaṃ mahābalam
saindhavaṃ ca maheṣvāsaṃ sāmātyaṃ saha bandhubhiḥ
dhṛṣṭaketuśca samare rākṣasaśca ghaṭotkacaḥ nākuliśca śatānīkaḥ samare rathapuṅgavaḥ
naiva khaṃ na diśo rājanna sūryaṃ śatrutāpana
tataḥ saṃdhāya vai tīkṣṇaṃ śaraṃ paramadāruṇam
nyahanatpāṇḍavīṃ senāmāsurīmiva vṛtrāhā te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ somakaiḥ saha
tasya te kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
drauṇiṃ tyaktvā tato yuddhe kaunteyaḥ śvetavāhanaḥ
satyavrataṃ ca saptatyā viddhvā śakrasamo yudhi
nṛtyanniva raṇe vīra ārtiṃ naḥ samajījanat
tasya dṛṣṭvā tu tatkarma parivavruḥ sutāstava
dahantaṃ samare sainyaṃ vane kakṣaṃ yatholbaṇam
vivyādha niśitaiḥ ṣaṅabhiḥ sārathiṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
śaktiṃ cikṣepa saṃkruddhaḥ saubhadrasya rathaṃ prati
yattatsakhyustu pūrveṇa arjunādupaśikṣitam pragāḍhaṃ laghu citraṃ ca darśayanhastalāghavam
sa hi saṃdṛśya senāṃ te yuyudhānena pātitām
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yuyudhānasya sutā daśa mahābalāḥ
ehi yudhyasva saṃgrāme samastaiḥ pṛthageva vā
asmānvā tvaṃ parājitya yaśaḥ prāpnuhi saṃyuge
vayaṃ vā tvāṃ parājitya prītiṃ dhāsyāmahe pituḥ
sādhvidaṃ kathyate vīrā yaṃdyevaṃ matiradya vaḥ
yudhyadhvaṃ sahitā yattā nihaniṣyāmi vo raṇe
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca sametānāṃ raṇājire
te hatā nyapatanrājanvajrabhagnā iva drumāḥ - - btāndṛṣṭvā nihatānvīro raṇe putrānmahābalān
saṃprāpyaiva gatā nāśaṃ śalabhā iva pāvakam
te sene bhṛśasaṃvigne yayatuḥ svaṃ niveśanam
tataḥ śabdo mahānāsīttava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
sātyakirdharmarājaśca vyūhagrīvāṃ samāsthitāḥ pṛṣṭhamāsīnmahārāja virāṭo vāhinīpatiḥ - - adhṛṣṭadyumno mahārāja mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ kekayā bhrātaraḥ pañca vāmapārśvaṃ samāśritāḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu maheṣvāsaḥ somakaiḥ saṃvṛto balī
vyūḍhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tatsainyaṃ pitā devavratastava
pṛṣṭhe cāstāṃ maheṣvāsāvāvantyau sapadānugauḥ svasenayā ca sahitaḥ śuśarmā prasthalādhipaḥ
tato yuddhāya saṃjagmuḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kauravaiḥ saha
tavāpi ca babhau senā grahairdyauriva saṃvṛtāḥ
te vadyamānā droṇena bhīṣmeṇa ca narottamāḥ
nātivṛddhamabālaṃ ca na kṛśaṃ na ca pīvaram
asiyuddhe niyuddhe ca gadāyuddhe ca kovidam
kampaneṣu ca cāpeṣu kaṇapeṣu ca sarvaśaḥ
aparokṣaṃ ca vidyāsu vyāyāme ca kṛtaśramam
na goṣṭhyā nopakāreṇa na ca bandhunimittataḥ
ṛṣayo vā mahābhāgāḥ purāṇā bhuvi sañjaya
ukto'pi vidureṇāhaṃ hitaṃ pathyaṃ ca nityaśaḥ
na ca jagrāha tanmandaḥ putro duryodhano mama
tathyāṃ manye matiṃ tasya sarvajñasya mahātmanaḥ
purā dhātrā yathā diṣṭaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā
tava doṣeṇa yuddaṃ ca pravṛttaṃ saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
iha vā pretya vā rājaṃstvayā prāptaṃ yathātatham
śṛṇu yuddhaṃ yathā vṛttaṃ śaṃsato me narādhipa
athālokya praviṣṭaṃ tamūcuste sarva eva tu
sa taiḥ parivṛtaḥ pārtho bhrātṛbhiḥ kṛtaniścayaiḥ
saṃprāpya madhyaṃ sainyasya na bhīḥ pāṇḍavamāviśat yathā devāsure yuddhe mahendraṃ prāpya dānavān
yāvadetānhaniṣyāmi dhārtarāṣṭrānsahānugān ityuktvā bhīmasenastu praviśya mahatīṃ camūm
mama prāṇaiḥ priyatamaḥ kva bhīma iti duḥkhitaḥ
pratipālaya māṃ sūta niyamyāśvānmuhūrtakam yāvadevānnihanmyadya ya ime madvadhodyatāḥ
na hi me jīvitenāpi vidyate'dya prayojanam
yadi yāmi vinā bhīmaṃ kiṃ māṃ kṣatraṃ vadiṣyati
tasya na svasti kurvanti devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ
raurave narake mañjedaplave dustare nṛbhiḥ mama bhīmaḥ sakhā caiva saṃbandhī ca mahābalaḥ
so'haṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra yāto vṛkodaraḥ
evamuktvā tato vīro yayau madhyena vāhinīm
sa dadarśa tadā bhīmaṃ dahantaṃ ripuvāhinīm
abhidrutaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ samantataḥ pāṇḍavaṃ lokavīraḥ
sainyena ghoreṇa susaṃhitena dṛṣṭvā balī pārṣato bhīmasenam
bhṛśaṃ pariṣvajya ca bhīmasenamāśvāsayāmāsa sa śatrumadhye
tasminvimarde tava saṃpravṛtte dṛṣṭvā raṇe vākyamidaṃ babhāṣe
ayaṃ durātmā drupadasya putraḥ samāgato bhīmasenena sārdham
taṃ yāma sarve mahatā balena mā vo ripuḥ prārthayatāmanīkam
śrutvā tu vākyaṃ tamamṛṣyamāṇā jyeṣṭhajñayā noditā dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
pragṛhya cāstrāṇi dhanūṃṣi vīrā jyāṃ nemighoṣaiḥ pravikampayantaḥ
nihatya tāṃścāpi śaraiḥ sutīkṣṇairna vivyathe samare citrayodhī
jighāṃsurugro drupadātmajo yuvā pramohanāstraṃ yuyuje mahārathaḥ kruddho bhṛśaṃ tava putreṣu rājandaityeṣu yadvatsamare mahendraḥ
sa vai tato'straṃ sumahāprabhāvaṃ pramohanaṃ droṇadattaṃ mahātmā
prayojayāmāsa udārakarmā tasminraṇe tava sainyasya rājan
pradudruvuḥ kuravaścaiva sarve savājināgāḥ sarathāḥ samantāt parītakālāniva naṣṭasaṃjñānmohopetāṃstava putrānniśamya
etasminneva kāle tu bhīmaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
so'tividdhastato rājanraṇe droṇena pārthivaḥ apāyāddrupado rājanpūrvavairamanusmaran
jitvā tu drupadaṃ droṇaḥ śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān
atha śuśrāva tejasvī droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca vicarantau mahāraṇe
pravṛttimadhigacchantu na hi śuddhyati me manaḥ
gacchantu parayā śaktyā bhavanta iti me matiḥ
ta evaṃ samanujñātāḥ śūrā vikrāntayodhinaḥ bāḍhamityevamuktvā tu sarve puruṣamāninaḥ
madhyaṃdinagate sūrye prayayuḥ sarva eva hi
na saṃvārayituṃ śaktā tava senā janādhipa
droṇamiṣvastrakuśalaṃ sarvavidyāsu pāragam dṛṣṭvā tu sahasāyāntaṃ pāñcālyo gurumātmanaḥ
nāśaṃsata vadhaṃ vīraḥ putrāṇāṃ tava pārṣataḥ
vaivasvatakṣayaṃ ghoraṃ preṣayāmāsa bhārata sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena preṣayāmāsa bhārata
vadhyamānaṃ tu tatsainyaṃ droṇena niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tathā dṛṣṭvā ca tatsainyaṃ jahṛṣe tāvakaṃ balam dṛṣṭvācāryaṃ susaṃkruddhaṃ tapantaṃ ripuvāhinīm
sajyaṃ śarāsanaṃ saṅkhye śarairvivyādha te sutam
tau daṣṭvā samare kruddhau vinighnantau parasparam
tatyajuḥ samare bhīmaṃ tava putrā mahābalāḥ
pārṣatena ca te sarve kaikayā draupadīsutāḥ
tādṛṣṭvā samare kruddhāṃstava sainye mahārathāḥ duryodhanaprabhṛtayaḥ pragṛhītaśarāsanāḥ
tāvakānāṃ ca balināṃ pareṣāṃ caiva bhārata
hatāśvaṃ rathamutsṛjya vikarṇastu mahārathaḥ āruroha rathaṃ rājaṃścitrasenasya bhārata
kurūṇāṃ caiva sainyeṣu pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhārata
adya tvāṃ nihaniṣyāmi yadi notsṛjase raṇam
adya kuntyāḥ parikleśaṃ vanavāsaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ
tato'sya kārmukaṃ dvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ dvābhyāṃ ca vivyadhe
chittvā taṃ ca nanādoccaistava putrasya paśyataḥ
tataḥ sa rājā sindhūnāṃ rathaśreṣṭho mahābalaḥ
bhittvā dehaṃ gatā bhūmiṃ jvalanta iva pannagāḥ
sā durmukhasya vimalaṃ varma bhittvā yaśasvinaḥ
visaṃjñaṃ prekṣya te sarve bhrātaraḥ paryavārayan
taṃ dṛṣṭvā virathaṃ tatra sutasomo mahārathaḥ
tato'sya dhanurekena dvābhyāṃ sūtaṃ ca māriṣa
ciccheda samare tūrṇaṃ taṃ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ
duṣkarṇaṃ nākuliḥ kruddho vivyādha hṛdaye bhṛśam
sa papāta tato bhūmau vajrāhata iva drumaḥ
viviśuste paraṃ sainyaṃ siṃhā iva vanādvanam
arjuno vāsudevaśca kauravāṇāmanīkinīm hatvā vidrāvya ca śaraiḥ śibirāyaiva jagmatuḥ
vidārya hatvā ca nipīḍya śūrāṃste pāṇḍavā labdhajayāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ
saṃmohya sarvānyudhi kīrtimanto vyūhaṃ ca taṃ makaraṃ mṛtyukalpam
praviśya bhīmena raṇe hato'smi ghoraiḥ śarairmṛtyudaṇḍaprakāśaiḥ
kruddhaṃ tamudvīkṣya bhayena rājansaṃmūrcchito na labhe śāntimadya
icche prasādāttava satyasandha prāptuṃ jayaṃ pāṇḍaveyāṃśca hantum
taṃ pratyuvācāvimanā manasvī gaṅgāsutaḥ sastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaḥ
pareṇa yatnena vigāhya senāṃ sarvātmanā'haṃ tava rājaputra
icchāmi dātuṃ vijayaṃ sukhaṃ ca na cātmānaṃ chādaye'haṃ tvadarthe
ete tu raudrā bahavo mahārathā yaśasvinaḥ śūratamāḥ kṛtāstrāḥ
ye pāṇḍavānāṃ samare sahāyā jitaklamā roṣaviṣaṃ vamanti
keneha śakyāḥ sahasā vijetuṃ vīryoddhatāḥ kṛtavairāstvayā ca
ahaṃ hyetānpratiyotsyāmi rājansarvātmanā jīvitaṃ tyajya vīra
raṇe tavārthāya mahānubhāva na jīvitaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ mamādya
sarvāṃstavārthāya sadevadaityām̐llokāndaheyaṃ kimu śatrusenām - - atānpāṇḍavānyodhayiṣyāmi rājan priyaṃ ca te sarvamahaṃ kariṣye
śrutvā pituste vacanaṃ pratīto duryodhanaḥ prītamanā babhūva
sarvāṇi sainyāni tataḥ prahṛṣṭo nirgacchatetyāha nṛpāṃśca sarvān
samuddhataṃ vai taruṇārkavarṇaṃ rajo babhau cchādayatsūryaśmīn
rejuḥ patākā rathadantisaṃsthā vāteritā bhrāmyamāṇāḥ samantāt
nānāliṅgaiḥ samare tatra rājan meghairyutā vidyutaḥ khe yathaiva
ahaṃ droṇaśca śalyaśca kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
bṛhadbalaśca kausalyaścitraseno viviṃśatiḥ kṛpaśca saha sodaryaistava rājanpadānugāḥ
devānapi raṇe jetuṃ samarthā iti me matiḥ
avaśyaṃ hi mayā rājaṃstava vācyaṃ hitaṃ sadā
sarvathā'haṃ tu rājendra kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
pāṇḍavāṃśca raṇe jeṣye māṃ vā jeṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
tataḥ prabhāte vimale svena sainyena vīryavān
nāgenāge rathāḥ sapta sapta cāśvā ratherathe
anvaśvaṃ daśa dhānuṣkā dhānuṣke daśa carmiṇaḥ
evaṃ vyūhaṃ mahārāja tava sainyasya daṃśitam
sthitaṃ raṇāya mahate bhīṣmeṇa yudhi pālitam
daśāśvānāṃ sahasrāṇi dantināṃ ca tathaiva ca
rakṣyamāṇāḥ sa taiḥ śūrairgopyamānāśca tena te
citrasenaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca tathā durmarṣaṇaṃ vibhuḥ
ya ime māṃ yaduśreṣṭha yoddhukāmā raṇājire
te hanyamānāḥ pārthena bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ yayuḥ
pratyudyāte ca gāṅgeye tvaritaṃ vijayaṃ prati
dṛṣṭvā duryodhano rājā raṇe pārthasya vikramam tvaramāṇaḥ samabhyetya sarvāṃstānabravīnnṛpān - - ateṣāṃ tu pramukhe śūraṃ suśarmāṇaṃ mahābalam madhye sarvasya sainyasya bhṛśaṃ saṃharṣayanniva
taṃ prayāntaṃ raṇe vīraṃ sarvasainyena bhāratam
na śekuḥ pāṇḍavā draṣṭuṃ śvetaṃ grahamivoditam
āruroha rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ putrasya rathināṃ varaḥ
tatastu tau pitāputrau bhāradvājaṃ rathe sthitau
cikṣepa samare tūrṇaṃ śaṅkhaṃ prati janeśvaraḥ
sa tasya hṛdayaṃ bhittvā pīttvā śoṇitamāhave
śitaistu bahuśo rājaṃstaṃ ca vivyādha patribhiḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ khaṅgaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ tena sāyakaiḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu bhṛśaṃ rājaṃstaḍyamānaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ardhacandreṇa samare taṃ ca vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
tadastraṃ bhasmāsātkṛtvā māyāṃ tāṃ rākṣasīṃ tadā
vivyathe na ca rājendra tava putro janeśvara
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca samare tūrṇaṃ vivyādha patribhiḥka
pracchādayāmāsa ca taṃ mahāmegho raviṃ yathā
svālasya te mahārāja tava putrasya paśyataḥ
bahūni hi vicitrāṇi dvairathāni sma sañjaya
na caiva māmakaṃ kiṃciddhṛṣṭaṃ śaṃsasi sañjaya
na hi rakṣanti rājānaḥ sarvathā'trāpi jīvitam
yudhyatāṃ hi tathā rājanviśeṣo na vyadṛśyata
bhallābhyāṃ ca sutīkṣṇābhyāṃ dhanuḥ ketuṃ ca māriṣa
yudhāmanyū raṇe kruddho bhrātarau tau mahārathau
tasmiṃstu patite bhūmau gatasatve tu sārathau
tau sa jitvā mahārāja yajñasenasutaḥ prabhuḥ
nivṛtteṣu tu pāṇḍūnāṃ punaḥ sainyeṣu bhārata
tridhā ciccheda nṛpatiḥ sā vyakīryata medinīṃ
taṃ vijitya raṇe śūraṃ vikrāntaṃ khyātapauruṣam
ajayyaṃ samare vīraṃ yamena varuṇena ca
pāṇḍavīṃ samare senāṃ saṃmamarda sa kuñjaraḥ
nijaghāna raṇe taṃ tu sūtaṃ cāsya nyapātayat
ekasthau tu raṇe śūrau dṛḍhe vikṣipya kārmuke
prahasanniva tāṃ cāpi śastravṛṣṭiṃ jaghāna ha
niṣasāda mahārāja kaśmalaṃ ca jagāma ha
taṃ visaṃjñaṃ nipatitaṃ sūtaḥ saṃprekṣya saṃyuge
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā madhyaṃ prāpte divākare
te tasva kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
ketu nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śrutāyuḥ sa tu pārthivaḥ
sa tu dhairyeṇa taṃ kopaṃ sannivārya mahāyaśāḥ
nijaghāna śaraiḥ kṣipraṃ sūtaṃ ca sumahābalaḥ
hatāśvaṃ tu rathaṃ tyaktvā dṛṣṭvā rājño'sya pauruṣam
vyāttānano yathā kālastava sainyaṃ jaghāna ha
sa tayā vīraghātinyā gadayā gadināṃ varaḥ
ete hi bahavaḥ śūrāḥ kṛtāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ
yathā hanyurna naḥ senāṃ tathā mādhava codaya
tataḥ pravṛttaḥ sumahānsaṃgrāmaḥ śoṇitodakaḥ tāvakānāṃ ca samare pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhārata
sa tāḍyamānastu śarairdhanaṃjayaḥ padāhato nāga iva śvasanbalī
bāṇāṃśca bāṇena mahārathānāṃ ciccheda cāpāni raṇe prasahya
saṃchidya cāpāni ca tāni rājñāṃ teṣāṃ raṇe vīryavatāṃ kṣaṇena
tathaiva te taṃ parivārya pārthaṃ vikṛṣya cāpāni mahāravāṇi
ṣaṣṭyā śaraiḥ saṃyati tailadhautairjaghāna tānapyatha pṛṣṭhagopān
rathāṃśca tāṃstanavajitya saṅkhye dhanañjayaḥ prītamanā yaśasvī
raṇe puraskṛtya narādhipāṃstān jagāma pārthaṃ tvarito vadhāya
abhidrutaṃ cāstrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ dhanaṃjayaṃ vīkṣya śikhaṇḍimukhyāḥ
bhīṣmaṃ yiyāsuryudhi saṃdadarśa duryodhanaṃ saindhavādīṃśca rājñaḥ
utsṛjya rājānamanantavīryo jayadrathādīṃśca nṛpānmahaujāḥ yayau tato bhīmabalo manasvī gāṅgeyamājau śaracāpapāṇiḥ
bhīṣmo'pi dṛṣṭvā samare kṛtāstrān sa pāṇḍavānāṃ rathino'bhyudārān
vihāya saṃgrāmamukhe dhanaṃjayaṃ javena pārthaṃ punarājagāma
yudhiṣṭhiraśca prabalo mahātmā samāyayau tvarito jātakopaḥ
madrādhipaṃ samabhityajya saṅkhye svabhāgamāptaṃ tamanantakīrtiḥ sārdhaṃ sa mādrīsutabhīmasenairbhīṣmaṃ yayau śāntanavaṃ raṇāya
taiḥ saṃprayuktaiḥ sa mahārathāgryairgaṅgāsutaḥ samare citrayodhī
na vivyadhe śāntanavo mahātmā samāgataiḥ pāṇḍusutaiḥ samastaiḥ
athaitya rājā yudhi satyasandho jayadratho'tyugrabalo manasvī
ciccheda cāpāni mahārathānāṃ prasahya teṣāṃ dhanuṣā vareṇa
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ bhīmasenaṃ yamau ca pārthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yudhi saṃjātakopaḥ
kṛpeṇa śalyena śalena caiva tathā vibho citrasenena caujau
chinnāyudhaṃ śāntanavena rājā śikhaṇḍinaṃ prekṣya ca jātakopaḥ
ajātaśatruḥ samare mahātmā śikhaṇḍinaṃ kruddha uvāca vākyam
uktvā tathā tvaṃ pituragrato māmahaṃ haniṣyāmi mahāvrataṃ tam
bhīṣmaṃ śaraughairvimalārkavarṇaiḥ satyaṃ vadāmīti kṛtā pratijñā
tvayā ca naināṃ saphalāṃ karoṣi devavrataṃ yanna nihaṃsi yuddhe
mithyāpratijño bhava mātra vīra rakṣasva dharmaṃ svakulaṃ yaśaśca
prekṣasva bhīṣmaṃ yudhi bhīmavegaṃ sarvāṃstapantaṃ mama sainyasaṅghān
vihāya bandhūnatha sadarāṃśca kva yāsyase nānurūpaṃ tavedam
dṛṣṭvā hi bhīṣmaṃ tamanantavīryaṃ bhagnaṃ ca sainyaṃ dravamāṇamevam
bhīto'si nūnaṃ drupadasya putra tathā hi te mukhavarṇo'prahṛṣṭaḥ
ajñāyamāne ca dhanaṃjaye tu mahāhāve saṃprasakte nṛvīre
kathaṃ hi bhīṣmātprathitaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bhayaṃ tvamadya prakaroṣi vīra
sa dharmarājasya vaco niśamya - - brūkṣākṣaraṃ vipralāpānubaddham
pratyādeśaṃ manyamāno mahātmā pratatvare bhīṣmavadhāya rājan
nivārayāmāsa hi śalya enamastreṇa ghoreṇa sudurjayena
na saṃmumoha drupadasya putro rājanmahendrapratimaprabhāvaḥ tasthau ca tatraiva mahādhanuṣmān śaraistadastraṃ pratibādhamānaḥ
tadastramastreṇa vidāryamāṇaṃ khasthāḥ surā dadṛśuḥ pārthivāśca
bhīṣmastu rājansamare mahātmā dhanuśca citraṃ dhvajameva cāpi
tataḥ samutsṛjya dhanuḥ sabāṇaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ vīkṣya bhayābhibhūtam
gadāṃ pragṛhyābhipapāta saṅkhye jayadrathaṃ bhīmasenaḥ padātiḥ
tamāpatantaṃ sahasā javena jayadrathaḥ sagadaṃ bhīmasenam
vivyādha ghorairyamadaṇḍakalpaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ pañcaśaraiḥ samantāt
jayadratho bhagravāhaṃ rathaṃ ta tyaktvā yayau yatra rājā kurūṇām
bhayena bhīmasya samūḍhacetāḥ sasaubalastatra yuddhasya bhītaḥ
bhīmo'pyathainaṃ sahasā vinadya pratyudyayau gadayā tarjayānaḥ
samudyatāṃ tāṃ yamadaṇḍakalpāṃ dṛṣṭvā gadāṃ te kuravaḥ samantāt
vihāya sarve tava putramugraṃ pātaṃ gadāyāḥ parihartukāmāḥ
rathaṃ samutsṛjya padātirājau pragṛhya khaṅgaṃ vipulaṃ ca carma avaplutaḥ siṃha uvācalāgrājjagāmānyaṃ bhramapa bhūmideśam
gadāpi sā prāpya rathaṃ sucitraṃ sāśva sasūtaṃ vinihatya saṅkhye
jagāma bhūmiṃ jvalitā maholka bhraṣṭā'mbarādgāmiva saṃpatantī
sarve vineduḥ sahitāḥ samantātpupūjire tava putrasya śauryam
taṃ tu cchitvā raṇe bhīṣmo nārācaṃ kalasaṃmitam
hatāśvaṃ tu rathaṃ tyaktvā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yamāvapi hi saṃkruddhaḥ samāsādya raṇe tadā
tataste pārthivāḥ sarve śrutvā pārthasya bhāṣitam
taṃ carantaṃ raṇe pārthā dadṛśuḥ kauravaṃ yudhi
raṇe bhārata siṃhasya dadṛśuḥ kṣatriyā gatim
sṛṃjayāstu tato dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaṃ bhīṣma mahāraṇe
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā na tyajanti sma saṃyugam
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ tāvakānāṃ mahārathau
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mahatyā senayā vṛtaḥ
parivārya raṇe bhīṣmaṃ yuyudhuḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
yudhyatāṃ tu tathā teṣāṃ kurvatāṃ karma duṣkaram
yayau svaśibiraṃ rājā niśāyāṃ senayā vṛtaḥ
avajitya tataḥ saṅkhye yayau svaśibiraṃ prati
bhīṣmaṃ śāntanavaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayātaḥ śibiraṃ prati
droṇo drauṇiḥ kṛpaḥ śalyaḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
parivārya camūṃ sarvāḥ prayayuḥ śibiraṃ prati
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śūrā nyasya gulmānyathāvidhi
apanīya ca śalyāni snātvā ca vividhairjalaiḥ
te prasupte bale tatra pariśrāntajane nṛpa
pariṇāmya niśāṃ tāṃ tu sukhasuptā janeśvarāḥ
bhīṣmaśca rathināṃ śreṣṭho bhāradvājaśca vai dvijaḥ
kūrmavyūhaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitā tava viśāṃpate
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahāvyūhaṃ tāvakānāṃ mahārathaḥ
prativyūhaṃ raṇe śūra kuru kṣipraṃ mahāratha
tataḥ sa pārṣataḥ krūro vyūhaṃ cakre sudāruṇam
madhye yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
tataḥ śūrāḥ samāsādya samare te parasparama netrairanimiṣai rājannavaikṣanta parasparam - - amanobhiste manuṣyendra yuddhaṃ yodhāḥ pracakrire punarāhūya te'nyonyaṃ śarīrairapi cakrire
nārācā niśitāḥ saṅkhye saṃpatanti sma bhārata
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
bhīṣmaṃ tu samare kruddhaṃ pratapantaṃ samantataḥ
na śekuḥ pāṇḍavā draṣṭuṃ tapantamiva bhāskaram
te vadhyamānā bhīṣmeṇa pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
sa teṣāṃ rathināṃ vīro bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavo yudhi
sa hi bhīṣmaṃ samāsādya chādayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ
bhīmastu sārathiṃ hatvā bhīṣmasya rathināṃ varaḥ
nāmṛṣyanta raṇe śūrāḥ sodarāḥ sapta saṃyuge
sa taṃ na mamṛṣe bhīmaḥ śatrubhirvadhamāhave
sa śaraḥ paṇḍitaṃ hatvā viveśa dharaṇītalam
ādityaketoḥ ketuṃ ca cchittvā bāṇena saṃyuge
manyamānā hi tatsatyaṃ sabhāyāṃ tasya bhāṣitam
na budhyase purā yattattathyamuktaṃ vaco mahat
tathaiva ca vadhārthāya putrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavo balī
nūnaṃ jāto mahābāhuryathā hanti sma kauravān
nihatā bhrātaraḥ śūrā bhīmasenena me yudhi
gāndhāryā ca yaśasvinyā tattvaṃ tāta na buddhavān
samayaśca mayā pūrvaṃ kṛto vai śatrukarśana
yaya hi dhartarāṣṭrāṇāṃ bhīmo drakṣyati saṃyuge
sa tvaṃ rājansthiro bhūtvā raṇe kṛtvā dṛḍhāṃ matim
na śakyaḥ pāṇḍavā jetuṃ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ
tasmādyuddhe sthirāṃ kṛtvā matiṃ yuddhyasva bhārata
ahanyahani me putrāḥ kṣayaṃ gacchanti sañjaya
yatra me tanayāḥ sarve jīyante na jayantyuta
yatra bhīṣmasya droṇasya kṛpasya ca mahātmanaḥ
na hi duryodhano mandaḥ purā proktamabudhyata
vāryamāṇo mayā tāta bhīṣmeṇa vidureṇa ca
na śṛṇomi purā vākyaṃ martyaḥ pathyamivauṣadham
akṛtvā vacanaṃ pathyaṃ kṣayaṃ gacchanti kauravāḥ
kūjatāṃ krandatāṃ caiva stanatāṃ caiva bhārata
cakāra kadanaṃ ghoraṃ kruddhaḥ kāla ivāparaḥ
tato bhīmo raṇe kruddho rabhasaśca viśeṣataḥ
arjunena hataiḥ saṅkhye tathā bhārata rājabhiḥ
kruddhe śāntanave bhīṣme droṇe ca rathasattame
kāryārthaṃ tāṃ ca jagrāha pārthaḥ kāmavaśānugām
sa nāgaloke saṃvṛddho mātrā ca parirakṣitaḥ
irāvānasmi bhadraṃ te putraścāhaṃ tava prabho
pariṣvajya sutaṃ cāpi ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṃ guṇaiḥ
sa cāpi naraśārdūlaḥ śārdūlasamavikramaḥ abravīcca tadā pārthamayamasmi tavānagha
sthitaḥ preṣyaśca putraśca sarvathā tvaṃ praśādhi mām
kaṃ karomi ca te kāmaṃ kaṃ ca kāmaṃ tvamicchasi
pariṣvajya sutaṃ premṇā vāsaviḥ pratyuvāca tam prītipūrvaṃ ca kāryaṃ ca kāryā prītiśca mānadaḥ
yuddhakāle tu sāhāyyaṃ dātavyaṃ no bhavediti
tataḥ kṣīṇe hayānike kiṃciccheṣe ca bhārata
urasyapi ca pṛṣṭhe ca pārśvayośca bhṛśāhataḥ
vikṛṣya ca śitaṃ khaṅgaṃ gṛhītvā ca śarāvaram
paśya vīra yathā hyeṣa phalgunasya suto balī
tvaṃ ca kāmagamastāta māyāstre ca viśāradaḥ
irāvānapi saṃkruddhastvaramāṇaḥ parākramī hantukāmamayitraghno rākṣasaṃ pratyavārayat
tena māyāmayāḥ sṛṣṭā hayāstāvanta eva hi
ciccheda kārmukaṃ dīptaṃ śaravāpaṃ ca kañcukam
sa nikṛttaṃ dhanurdṛṣṭvā khaṃ javena samāviśat
tathā sa rākṣasaśreṣṭhaḥ śaraiḥ kṛttaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
māyā hi saharāja samavāpa ca yauvanam
paraśvathena tīkṣṇena ciccheda ca punaḥ punaḥ sa tena balinā vīraśchidyamāna iva drumaḥ - - arākṣaso vyanadaddhoraṃ sa śabdastumulo'bhavat paraśvathakṣataṃ rakṣaḥ susrāva bahuśoṇitam
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā tādṛśīṃ māyāṃ rākṣasasya durātmanaḥ
tena yaudhiṣṭhire sainye bahavo mānavā hatāḥ
tatra bhārata bhīṣmasya raṇe dṛṣṭvā parākramam
eka eva raṇe śakto nihantuṃ sarvasainikān
irāvantaṃ tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthā mahārathāḥ
irāvantaṃ tu nihataṃ saṃgrāme vīkṣya rākṣasaḥ
antarikṣaṃ diśaścaiva sarvāśca pradiśastathā celuśca sahasā tatra tena nādena nāditāḥ
taṃ śrutvā sumahānādaṃ tava sainyasya bhārata ūrustambhaḥ samabhavadvepathuḥ sveda eva ca
sarva eva mahārāja tāvakā dīnacetasaḥ sarvataḥ samaceṣṭanta siṃhabhītā gajā iva
narditvā sumahānādaṃ nirghātamiva rākṣasaḥ jvalitaṃ śūlamudyamya rūpaṃ kṛtvā vibhīṣaṇam
tamāpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya saṃkruddhaṃ bhīmadarśanam svabalaṃ ca bhayāttasya prāyaśo vimukhīkṛtam
tato duryodhano rājā ghaṭotkacamupādravat pragṛhya vipulaṃ cāpaṃ siṃhavadvinadanmuhuḥ
putraṃ tava mahārāja cukopa sa niśācaraḥ
tattu dṛṣṭvā mahatkarma putrasya tava māriṣa
saṃdaśya daśanairoṣṭhaṃ sṛkiṇī parisaṃlihan śaravarṣeṇa mahatā duryodhanamavākirat
dadhāra yudhi rājendro yathā varṣaṃ mahādvipaḥ
sa tairviddhaḥ sravanraktaṃ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ
dadhre matiṃ vināśāya rājñaḥ sa piśitāśanaḥ
prabhagnaṃ ca balaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma paramāṃ vyathām
aśaktaḥ pratiyoddhuṃ vai dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya ātmanaścātimānitām
taṃ śrutvā ninidaṃ ghoraṃ tasva bhīmasya rakṣasaḥ
haiḍimbo yudhyate nūnaṃ rājñā duryodhanena ca
naiṣa śakyo hi saṃgrāme jetuṃ bhūtena kenacit
tatra gacchata bhadraṃ vo rājānaṃ parirakṣitum
etaddhi paramaṃ kṛtyaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ paraṃtapāḥ
kṛpo bhiriśravāḥ śalya āvantyaḥ sa bṛhadbalaḥ
rākṣasasya tu taṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yathā'sya śrūyate śabdo nadato bhairavaṃ svanam
teṣāṃ ca rakṣaṇārthāya yudhyate phalgunaḥ paraiḥ
gaccha rakṣasva haiḍimbaṃ śaṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gatam
teṣāmāpatatāṃ śrutvā śabdaṃ taṃ tāvakaṃ balam
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃka tatra teṣāṃ mahātmanām
hayā hayaiḥ samājagmuḥ pādātāśca padātibhiḥ rathā rathaiḥ samāgacchannāgā nāgaiśca saṃyuge
pitā putraṃ na jānīte putro vā pitaraṃ tathā
narāṇāṃ caiva kāyebhyaḥ śirasāṃ patatāṃ raṇe
svasainyaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam
kṣipraṃ gacchata bhadraṃ vo rājānaṃ parirakṣata
guruṃ pravyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam
avaplutya rathāttūrṇaṃ tasthau giririvācalaḥ samudyamya gadāṃ gurvī yamadaṇḍopamāṃ raṇe
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃśayaṃ prāptaṃ pīḍyamānaṃ mahāratham
abhimanyuprabhṛtayaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥka abhyadāvanparīpsantaḥ prāṇāṃstyaktvā sudustyajān
spardhate hi maheṣvāso nityaṃ droṇasutena saḥ
sa viṣphārya mahaccāpaṃ drauṇiṃ vivyādha patriṇā
yathā śakro mahārāja purā vivyādha dānavam
yena lokatrayaṃ krodhātrāsitaṃ svena tejasāka - - bsa rudreṇa jitaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato mātariśvanā
jaghāna caturo vāhānpātayāmāsa ca dhvajam sūtaṃ caikena bhallena rathanīḍādapāharat
saptamena ca bhallena nīlaṃ vivyādha vakṣasi
ghaṭotkaco'bhisaṃkruddho jñātibhiḥ parivāritaḥ abhidudrāva vegena drauṇimāhavaśobhinam
tathetare cābhyadhāvanrākṣasā yuddhadurmadāḥ - - a bhīmaseno mahābāhurnīlaṃ nīlāñjanaprabham āropya svarathaṃ vīro duryodhanamapādravat
nijaghāna ca saṃkruddho rākṣasānbhīmadarśanān yo'bhavannagrataḥ kruddhā rākṣasasya puraḥsarāḥ
prāyaśaśca maheṣvāsā ye pradhānāḥ sma kauravāḥ
taddṛṣṭvā tāvakaṃ sainyaṃ vidrutaṃ śibiraṃ prati
yudhyadhvaṃ mā palāyadhvaṃ māyaiṣā rākṣasī raṇe
tāṃśca pradravato dṛṣṭvā jayaṃ prāptāśca pāṇḍavāḥ
evaṃ tava balaṃ sarvaṃ haiḍimbena mahātmanā
tasminmahati saṃkrande rājā duryodhanastadā parājayaṃ rākṣasena nāmṛṣyata paraṃtapaḥ
nideśe tava tiṣṭhanti mayā sārdhaṃ paraṃtapa
tvāṃ samāśritya durdharṣaṃ tanme kartuṃ tvamarhasi
śṛṇu rājanmama vaco yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi kaurava
arjunena yamābhyāṃ vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ
na tu kāryastvayā rājanhaiḍimbena durātmā ahaṃ droṇaḥ kṛpo drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
raudre tasminrākṣasendre yadi te hṛcchayo mahān
te nipeturmahārāja nāgeṣu ca ratheṣu ca
sa nāgaḥ preṣitastena bāṇo jyācodito yathā
cedipo dhṛṣṭaketuśca saṃrabdhāḥ sarva eva te
tamāpatantaṃ samare jagaṃ jagapatiḥ sa ca
tena saṃloḍyamānaṃ tu pāṇḍavānāṃ balaṃ mahat
bhagnaṃ tu svabalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhagadattena dhīmatā
nāgaṃ jighāṃsuḥ sahasā cikṣepa ca mahābalaḥ
śūlaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvidhā kṛttaṃ ca pārthivaḥ
utpatya rākṣasastūrṇaṃ jagrāha ca nanāda ca
taṃ tu śrutvā mahānādaṃ prahṛṣṭānāṃ mahātmanām
kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ ghoraṃ mahāmatiḥka
anye ca bahavo vīrāḥ saṃgrāme madhusūdana
adhanasya mṛtaṃ śreyo na ca jñātivadhādvanam
kiṃ nu prāpsyāmahe kṛṣṇa hatvā jñātīnsamāgatān
kṛtaṃ rājñā mahābāho yācatā ta suyodhanam
rājyārdhaṃ pañca vā grāmānnākārṣītsa ca durmatiḥka
nāyaṃ klībāyituṃ kālo vidyate mādhava kvacit
parivārya raṇe droṇaṃ vasavo vāsavaṃ yathā
tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ kṛpaśca rathināṃ varaḥ
tāḍayāmāsa saṃkruddhaḥ so'bhavadvyathitendriyaḥ apareṇa tu bhallena pītena niśitena tu
sa sapta saṃdadhe hantuṃ putrāste bharatarṣabha
adbhutaṃ ca mahārāja tatra cakre vṛkodaraḥ
astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya teṣāṃ so'tiratho raṇe pravīrāṃstava sainyeṣu preṣayāmāsa mṛtyave
vyaṃsitaṃ vīkṣya nistriṃśaṃ saubhadreṇa raṇe tadā
anyonyaṃ hi raṇe śūrāḥ keśeṣvākṣiṣya māninaḥ
nyahanacca pitā putraṃ putraśca pitaraṃ tathā
karaiḥ śabdaṃ vimuñcadbhiḥ śīkaraṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ
yantraiśca bahudhā cchinnaistomaraiścāpi kāñcanaiḥ rarāja subhṛśaṃ bhūmistatratatra viśāṃpate
parasparaṃ samāsādya tava teṣāṃ ca saṃyuge
teṣu śrānteṣu bhagneṣu mṛditeṣu ca bhārata
ghore niśāmukhe raudre vartamāne mahābhaye avahāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā sahitāḥ kurupāṇaḍvāḥ
kathaṃ pāṇḍusutāḥ saṅkhye jetavyāḥ sagaṇā iti
droṇo bhīṣma kṛpaḥ śalyaḥ saumadattiśca saṃyuge
na pārthānprati bādhante na jāne kiṃnu kāraṇam
droṇasya pramukhe vīrā hatāste bhrātaro mama
bhīmasenena rādheya mama caiva ca paśyataḥ
mā śoca bharataśreṣṭha kariṣye'haṃ priyaṃ tava
nivṛtte yudhi gāṅgeye nyastaśastre ca bhārata
paśyato yudhi bhīṣmasya śape satyena te nṛpa
pāṇḍaveṣu dayāṃ nityaṃ sa hi bhīṣmaḥ karoti vai
abhimānī raṇe bhīṣmo nityaṃ cāpi raṇapriyaḥ
sa kathaṃ pāṇḍavānyuddhe jeṣyate tāta saṃgatān
sa tvaṃ śīghramito gatvā bhīṣmasya śibiraṃ prati
anumānya guruṃ vṛddhaṃ śastraṃ nyāsaya bhārata
dhārtarāṣṭro mahārāja vibabhau sa pathi vrajan
taṃ prayāntaṃ naravyāghraṃ bhīṣmasya śibiraṃ prati anujagmurmaheṣvāsāḥ sarvalokasya dhanvinaḥ
padātayaśca tvaritā nakharaprāsayodhinaḥ parivavrurmaheṣvāsaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ mahāratham
sa pūjyamānaḥ kurubhiḥ kauravāṇāṃ mahābalaḥ prayayau sadanaṃ rājā gāṅgeyasya yaśasvinaḥ
dakṣiṇaṃ dakṣiṇaḥ kāle saṃbhṛtya svabhujaṃ tadā
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā pradīpaiḥ kāñcanairjvalan
saṃprāpya tu tato rājā bhīṣmasya sadanaṃ śubham
abhivādya tato bhīṣmaṃ niṣaṇṇaḥ paramāsane kāñcane sarvatobhadre sparddhyāstaraṇasaṃvṛte
tvāṃ vayaṃ hi samāśritya saṃyuge śatrusūdana utsahema raṇe jetuṃ sendrānapi surāsurān
tasmādarhasi gāṅgeya kṛpāṃ kartuṃ mayi prabho
ghaṭamānaṃ yathāśaktiṃ kurvāṇaṃ ca tava priyam
droṇaṃ ca yudhi saṃrabdhaṃ māṃ ca nirjitya saṃyuge
vijitya ca yadā karṇaṃ sadā puruṣamāninam
ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ tadā
tvaṃ tu mohānna jānīṣe vācyāvācyaṃ suyodhana
svayaṃ vairaṃ mahatkṛtvā pāṇḍavaiḥ saha sṛñjayaiḥ yuddhyasva tānadya raṇe paśyāmaḥ puruṣo bhava
tānvā nihatya samare prītiṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ tava
pūrva hi strī samutpannā śikhaṇḍī rājaveśmani
yā'sau prāṅvarmitā dhātrā saiṣā vai strī śikhaṇḍinī
sukhaṃ svapihi gāndhāre śvo'smi kartā mahāraṇam
abhivādya guruṃ mūrdhnā prayayau svaṃ niveśanam
āgamya tu tato rājā visṛjya ca mahājanam
prahṛṣṭaḥ sa niśāṃ tāṃ ca gamayāmāsa pārthivaḥ
adya bhīṣmo raṇe kraddho nihaniṣyati somakān
sa no guptaḥ sahāyaḥ syāddhanyātpārthāṃśca saṃyuge
naiva cāhaṃ striyaṃ jātu na strīpūrvaṃ kathaṃcana
ayaṃ strīpūrvako rājañchikhaṇḍī yadi te śrutaḥ
udyoge kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yathā jātā śikhaṇḍinī
kanyā bhūtvā pumāñjātaḥ sa ca yotsyati bhārata
evaṃ māṃ bharataśreṣṭha gāṅgeyaḥ prāha śāstravit
mātulaḥ śakuniḥ śalyaḥ kṛpo droṇo viviṃśatiḥ
yattā rakṣantu gāṅgeyaṃ tasmingupte dhruvo jayaḥ
kampayanto bhuvaṃ dyāṃ ca kṣobhayantaśca pāṇḍavān
sarve te sma vyatiṣṭhanta rakṣantastaṃ mahāratham
tato duryodhano rājā punarbhrātaramabravīt savyaṃ cakraṃ yudhāmanyuruttamaujāśca dakṣiṇam
yathā bhīṣmaṃ na no hanyādduḥśāsana tathā kuru
bhīṣmaṃ pramukhataḥ kṛtvā prayayau saha senayā
tataḥ śāntanavo bhīṣmo niryayau saha senayā
bhīṣmeṇa sahitāḥ sarve putraiśca tava bhārata
evaṃ ca taṃ tadā vyūhaṃ kṛtvā bhārata tāvakāḥ
sthitā raṇe mahārāja mahatyā senayā vṛtāḥ
pāṇḍavāḥ samare śūrāḥ sthitā yuddhāya daṃśitāḥ
śvānaśca vividhairnādairbhaṣantastatra māriṣa jvalitāśca maholkā vai samāhatya divākaram
tratāraṃ nādhyagacchanta paṅkte magnā iva dvīpāḥ
śarāśca niśitāḥ pītā niścaranti sma saṃyuge
mohayitvā kṛpaṃ droṇaṃ drauṇiṃ ca sabṛhadbalam
saindhavaṃ ca maheṣvāso vyacarallaghu suṣṭhu ca
taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣatriyāḥ śurāḥ pratapantaṃ tarasvinam
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ tava sainyasya bhārata
tasya cānyatra paśyāmi saṃyuge bheṣajaṃ mahat
sa gatvā tvaritaṃ vīraṃ jahi saubhadramāhave
prayayau samare tūrṇaṃ tava putrasya śāsanāt
tasya śabdena mahatā pāṇḍavānāṃ balaṃ mahat
kārṣṇiścāpi mudā yuktaḥ pragṛhya saśaraṃ dhanuḥ
tataḥ sa rākṣasaḥ kruddhaḥ saṃprāpyaivārjunaṃ raṇe
nātidūre sthitāṃ tasya drāvayāmāsa vai camūm
tāṃ vadhyamānāṃ ca tathā pāṇḍavānāṃ mahācamūm
pratyadyayau raṇe rakṣo devasenāṃ yathā balaḥ
pramṛdya ca raṇe senāṃ padminīṃ vāraṇo yathā
te tu kruddhā maheṣvāsā draupadeyāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
rākṣasaṃ dudruvuḥ saṅkhye grahāḥ pañca raviṃ yathā
parasparamavekṣetāṃ kālānalasamau yudhi āśīviṣāviva kruddhau netrābhyāmitaretaram
dhanaṃjayaśca kiṃ cakre mama sainyeṣu saṃyuge
bhīmo vā rathināṃ śreṣṭho rākṣaso vā ghaṭotkacaḥ
etadācakṣva me satyaṃ kuśalo hyasi sañjaya
rathābhyāṃ rathinau śreṣṭhau yathā vai devadānavau
te tasya viviśustūrṇaṃ kāyaṃ nirbhidya marmasu
tena te viśikhā muktā yamadaṇḍopamāḥ śitāḥ
vimukhaṃ ca raṇe rakṣo vadhyamānaṃ raṇe'riṇā
hatamāyaṃ tato rakṣo vadhyamānaṃ ca sāyakaiḥ
ārjuniḥ samare sainyaṃ tāvakaṃ saṃmamarda ha
koṣṭhīkṛtya ca taṃ vīraṃ dhārtarāṣṭrā mahārathaḥ
ubhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ karma sa piturmātulasya ca
abhyadravadraṇe drauṇiṃ rāhuḥ khe śaśinaṃ yathā
ciccheda samare drauṇiḥ siṃhanādaṃ mumoca ha
dṛṣṭvā putraṃ ca taṃ grastaṃ rāhuṇeva niśākaram
priyo hi pāṇḍavo nityaṃ bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ
ācāryaśca raṇe nityaṃ priyaḥ pārthasya sañjaya
na droṇaḥ samare pārthaṃ jānīte priyamātmanaḥ
raṇe bhārata pārthena droṇo viddhastribhiḥ śaraiḥ
te śarāḥ prāpya kaunteyaṃ samantādviviśuḥ prabho
arjunastu raṇe nādaṃ vinadya rathināṃ varaḥ
te vadhyamānāḥ pārthena kāleneva yugakṣaye pārthamevābhyavartanta maraṇe kṛtaniścayāḥ
mumucuḥ śaravṛṣṭiṃ ca pāṇḍavasya rathaṃ prati
praśaśāma tato vayuḥ prasannāśca diśo daśa
bhīmastu rathināṃ śreṣṭho gadāṃ gṛhya mahāhave
sādināṃ śastravṛṣṭiṃ ca vyadhamadgadayā tataḥ vāyuvegasamāyukto vyacaratpāṇḍavo yudhi
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tato viddhvā virāṭaṃ ca śaraistribhiḥ
śikhaṇḍī taṃ ca vivyādha bharatānāṃ pitāmaham
tathā bhīmo mahārāja draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ
ṛddhyā vaiśravaṇāṃ cāti nayena ca bṛhaspatim
gajo gajaṃ samāsādya dravamāṇaṃ mahāhave yayau pramṛdya tarasā pādātānvājinastathā
evaṃ te bahudhā rājanpratyamṛdganparasparam dṛśyantesma mahābāho tatratatra mahābalāḥ
evaṃ bahuvidhā vācaḥ śrūyante sma parasparam
bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ kṛpaṃ caiva śalyaṃ covāca bhārata
iti duryodhanotsṛṣṭāḥ sarve yuyudhire nṛpāḥ tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
etasmātkāraṇāddhoro vartate svajanakṣayaḥ daivādvā puruṣavyāghra tava cāpanayānnṛpa iti śrāmanmahābhārate bhīṣmaparvaṇi bhīṣmavadhaparvaṇi navamadivasayuddhe tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ
suśarmāpi tato bāṇaiḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha saṃyuge
vāsudevaṃ ca saptatyā pārthaṃ ca navabhiḥ punaḥ
bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ śeṣā hi pradrutā narāḥ
tathaiva drupado rājā droṇaṃ viddhvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ārjuniścitrasenena viddho bahubhiraśugaiḥ atiṣṭhadāhave śūraḥ kiranbāṇānsahasraśaḥ
samāgatau tau tu raṇe mahāmātrau vyarocatām
tasyāśvāṃścaturo hatvā sūtaṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
sa viddhvā bhārataṃ ṣaṣṭyā niśitai romavāhibhiḥ
chittvā śaktiṃ tu gāṅgayaḥ sātyakiṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya kāryaṃ tvayā vīra rakṣaṇaṃ sumahātmanaḥ
parivārya sthito bhīṣmaṃ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ
nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
khurāhatā dharā rājaṃścakampe ca nanāda ca
heṣatāṃ caiva śabdena na prājñāyata kiṃcana antardadhe mahāñśabdastena śabdena mohitaḥ
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
tato duryodhano dīno dṛṣṭvā sainyaṃ parājitam
eṣa pāṇḍusuto jyeṣṭho yamābhyāṃ sahito raṇe
paśyatāṃ vo mahābāho senāṃ drāvayati prabho
putrasya tava tadvākyaṃ śrutvā śalyaḥ pratāpavān
sa yayau rathavaṃśena yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
madrarājaṃ ca samare dharmarājo mahārathaḥ daśabhiḥ sāyakaistūrṇamājaghāna stanāntare
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ punaḥ ṣaṣṭyā vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tato bhīṣmaśca droṇaśca sainyena mahatā vṛtau
tataḥ pitā tava kruddho niśitaiḥ sāyakottamaiḥ
nakulaṃ ca tribhirviddhvā sahadevaṃ ca saptabhiḥ
taṃ dvādaśākhyairnakulo mādhavaśca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca saptatyā bhīmasenaśca saptabhiḥ
sauvīrā kitavāḥ prācyāḥ pratīcyodīcyamālavāḥ abhīṣāhāḥ śūrasenāḥ śibayo'tha vasātayaḥ
yathā hi sumahānagniḥ kakṣe carasi sānilaḥ tathā bhīṣmo mahārāja divyamastramudīrayan
cedikāśikarūṣāṇāṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśa mahārathāḥ samākhyātāḥ kalaputrāstanutyajaḥ
bāhubhiḥ kārmukaiḥ khaṅgaiḥ śirobhiśca sakuṇḍalaiḥ talatrairaṅgulitraiśca dhvajaiśca vinipātitaiḥ
abhajyata mahārāja na ca dvau samadhāvatām
jaghānātra pitā putraṃ putraśca pitaraṃ tatha
ayaṃ sa kālaḥ saṃprāptaḥ pārtha yaḥ kāṅkṣitastava
yatpurā kathitaṃ vīra tvayā rājñāṃ samāgame
avadhyānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā rājyaṃ vā narakottaram
duḥkhāni vanavāse vā kiṃ nu me sukṛtaṃ bhavet
sa cāśvānrajataprakhyāṃścodayāmāsa mādhavaḥ yato bhīṣmastato rājanduṣprekṣyo raśmivāniva
cakarṣa ca tato dorbhyāṃ dhanurjaladaniḥsvanam athāsya tadapi kruddhaściccheda dhanurarjunaḥ
hato bhīṣmo hato bhīṣma iti tatrasma sainikāḥ
sa siṃha iva mātaṅgaṃ yatharṣabha ivarṣabham
tamāpatantaṃ saṃprekṣya puṇḍarīkākṣamāhave asaṃbhramaṃ raṇe bhīṣmo vicakarṣa mahaddhanuḥ
tvayā hi deva saṃgrāme hatasyāpi mamānagha
śreya eva paraṃ kṛṣṇa loke bhavati sarvataḥ
praharasva yatheṣṭaṃ vai dāso'smi tava cānagha
yattvayā kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ na yotsyāmīti keśava
mamaiṣa bhāraḥ sarvo hi haniṣyāmi pitāmaham
śape keśava śastreṇa satyena sukṛtena ca
mādhavastu vacaḥ śrutvā phalgunasya mahātmanaḥ abhavatparamaprīto dṛṣṭvā pārthasya vikramam
na kiṃciduktvā sakrodha āruroha rathaṃ punaḥ
tau rathasthau naravyāghrau bhīṣmaḥ śāntanavaḥ punaḥ
tathā pāṇḍavasainyāni babhañja yudhi te pitā
tathā pāṇḍavasainyāni drāvyamāṇāni bhārata trātāraṃ nādhyagacchanta gāvaḥ paṅkagatā iva
pipīlikā iva kṣuṇṇā durbalā balinā raṇe
samare mṛditāḥ sarve pāṇḍavāḥ saha sṛñjayaiḥ
mahārathaṃ bhārata duṣprakampaṃ śaraughiṇaṃ pratapantaṃ narendrān
bhīṣmaṃ na śekuḥ prativīkṣituṃ te śarārciṣaṃ sūryamivātapantam
raṇe karūṇādhipacedipairbalairvṛtānsadā cakradharasya paśyataḥ tato balānāṃ śramakarśitānāṃ
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā sandhyāṃ saṃdṛśya bhārata
bhīṣmaṃ ca yudhi saṃrabdhaṃ pīḍayantaṃ mahāratham
somakāṃśca jitāndṛṣṭvā nirutsāhānmahārathān niśāmukhaṃ ca saṃprekṣya ghorarūpaṃ bhayānakam
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā mantrayitvā ciraṃ nṛpa
śakyo jetuṃ yamaḥ kruddho vajrapāṇiśca devarāṭ
na tu bhīṣmaḥ susaṃkruddhaḥ śakyo jetuṃ mahāhave
vanaṃ yāsyāmi durdharṣa śreyo vai tatra me gatam
na yuddhaṃ rocate kṛṣṇa hanti bhīṣmo hi naḥ sadā
jīvitaṃ bahu manye'haṃ jīvitaṃ hyadya durlabham
dharmaputra viṣādaṃ tvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ satyasaṃgara
yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrā durjayāḥ satrusūdanāḥ
māṃ vā niyuṅkṣva sauhārdādyotsye bhīṣmeṇa pāṇḍava
tvaprayukto mahārāja kiṃ na kuryāṃ mahāhave
yadi bhīṣme hate vīre jayaṃ paśyasi paṇḍava
yaḥ śatruḥ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ macchatruḥ sa na saṃśayaḥ
madarthā bhavadarthā ye ye madīyāstavaiva te
tava bhrātā mama sakhā saṃbandhī śiṣya eva ca
eṣa cāpi naravyāghro matkṛte jīvitaṃ tyajet
sa māṃ niyuṅkṣva rājendra yāvatsajjo bhavāmyaham
anujñātena pārthena mayā kāryaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
tvayā nāthena govinda kimu bhīṣmaṃ mahāratham
mantrayiṣye tavārthāya na tu yotsye kathaṃcana
sa hi rājyasya me dātā mantrasyaiva ca mādhava
rucite tava pṛcchāmi mantraṃ vārṣṇeya māciram
yathā ca vakṣyate kṛṣṇa tathā kartāsmi saṃyuge
sa no jayasya dātā syānmantrasya ca dṛḍhavrataḥ
bālāḥ pitrā vihīnāśca tena saṃvardhitā vayam
rocate me mahāprājña rājendra tava bhāṣitam
vaktamarhati satyaṃ sa tvayā pṛṣṭo viśeṣataḥ
te vayaṃ tatra gacchāmaḥ praṣṭuṃ kurupitāmaham
gatvā śāntanavaṃ vṛddhaṃ mantraṃ pṛcchāma bhārata
sa no dāsyati mantraṃ yaṃ tena yotsyāmahe parān
praviśya ca tadā bhīṣmaṃ śirobhiḥ praṇipedire
svāgataṃ tava vārṣṇeya svāgataṃ te dhanañjaya
kiṃ vā kāryaṃ karomyadya yuṣmākaṃ prītivardhanaṃ
yuddhādanyatra he vatsāḥ prīyantāṃ mā viśaṅkatha sarvātmanāpi kartāsmi yadapi syātsaduṣkaram
kathaṃ jayema sarvajña kathaṃ rājyaṃ labhemahi
prajānāṃ saṃśayo na syātkathaṃ tanme bada prabho
bhavantaṃ samare vīra viṣahema kathaṃ vayam
na hi te sūkṣmamapyasti randhraṃ kurupitāmaha
kṣayaṃ nitā hi pṛtanā saṃyuge mahatī mama
yathā yudhi jayema tvāṃ yathā rājyaṃ bhṛśaṃ mama
mama sainyasya ca kṣemaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha - - ḷsañjaya uvāca tato'bravīcchāntanavaḥ pāṇḍavānpāṇḍupūrvaja
na kathaṃcana kaunteya mayi jīvati saṃyuge
nirjite mayi yuddhena raṇe jeṣyatha pāṇḍavāḥ
kṣipraṃ mayi praharata yadīcchatha raṇe jayam
anujānāmi vaḥ pārthāḥ praharadhvaṃ yathāsukham evaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ manye bhavatāṃ vidito hyaham
hate mayi hataṃ sarvaṃ tasmādevaṃ vidhīyatām
brūhi tasmādupāyaṃ no yathā yuddhe jayemahi
nāhaṃ jetuṃ raṇe śakyaḥ sendrairapi surāsuraiḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ
tato māṃ nyastaśastraṃ tu ete hanyurmahārathāḥ
dravamāṇe ca bhīte ca tavāsmīti ca vādini
strījite strīpradhāne ca strīpradhāyini dharmaja striyāṃ strīnāmadheye ca vikale caikaputriṇi
aprasūte ca ṣaṇḍe ca na yuddhaṃ rocate mama
imaṃ me śṛṇu rājendra saṃkalpaṃ pūrvacintitam
ya eṣa draupado rājaṃstava sainye mahārathaḥ
na taṃ paśyāmi lokeṣa māṃ hanyādyaḥ samudyatam
pārṣataṃ tu purodhāya klībamadya mamāgrataḥ āttaśastro raṇe yatto gṛhītavarakārmukaḥ
māṃ pātayatu bībhatsurevaṃ tava jayo dhruvam
krīḍatā hi mayā bālye vāsudeva mahāmanāḥ
iti māmabravīdbālye yaḥ sa vadhyaḥ kathaṃ mayā
kāmaṃ vadhyatu sainyaṃ me nāhaṃ yotsye mahātmanā
jayo vāstu vadho vā me kathaṃ vā kṛṣṇa manyase
kathamasmādvidhaḥ kṛṣṇa jānandharmaṃ sanātanam nyastaśastre ca vṛddhe ca prahareddhi pitāmahe
pratijñāya vadhaṃ jiṣṇo purā bhīṣmasya saṃyuge
kṣatradharme sthitaḥ pārtha kathaṃ nainaṃ haniṣyasi
yaddṛṣṭaṃ hi purā pārtha tattathā na tadanyathā
jahi bhīṣmaṃ sthiro bhūtvā śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
śikhaṇḍī nidhanaṃ kṛṣṇa bhīṣmasya bhavitā dhruvam
dṛṣṭvaiva hi sadā bhīṣmaḥ pāñcālyaṃ vinivartate
te vayaṃ pramukhe tasya puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam
śrutaṃ hi kurumukhyasya nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam
kanyā hyeṣā purā bhūtvā puruṣaḥ samapadyata
arjunasya vacaḥ śrutvā bhīṣmasya vadhasaṃyutam jahṛṣurhṛṣṭaromāṇaḥ sakṛṣṇāḥ pāṇḍavāstadā
ityevaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā pāṇḍavāḥ sahamādhavāḥ anumānya mahātmānaṃ prayayurhṛṣṭamānasāḥ
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā yamābhyāṃ sahitaḥ prabhuḥ
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
kathaṃ vā pāṇḍavā yuddhe pratyudyātāḥ paraṃtapāḥ
pīḍite tava putrasya sainye pāṇḍava sṛñjayaiḥ
nāmṛṣyata tadā bhīṣmaḥ sainyaghātaṃ raṇe paraiḥ
nijaghne samare kruddho hastyaśvaṃ cāmitaṃ bahu
pārthā vimanaso bhūtvā praikṣanta pitaraṃ tava
sa tenātibhṛśaṃ viddhaḥ prekṣya bhīṣmaḥ śikhaṇḍinam
kāmaṃ prahara vā mā vā na tvāṃ yotsye kathaṃcana
yaiva hi tvaṃ kṛtā dhātrā saiva hi tvaṃ śikhaṇḍinī
mayā śrutaṃ ca te yuddhaṃ jāmadagnyena vai saha
divyaśca te prabhāvo'yaṃ mayā ca bahuśaḥ śrutaḥ
janannapi prabhāvaṃ te yotsye'dyāhaṃ tvayā saha
dhruvaṃ ca tvāṃ haniṣyāmi śape satyena te'grataḥ
kāmaṃ yudhyasva vā mā vā na me jīvanpramokṣyase
na hi te saṃyuge pīḍāṃ śaktāḥ kartuṃ mahābalāḥ
ahatvā samare bhīṣma yadi yāsyasi māriṣa
tathā kuru raṇe yatnaṃ sādhayasva pitāmaham
droṇaṃ ca droṇaputraṃ ca kṛpaṃ cātha suyodhanam
citrasenaṃ vikarṇaṃ ca saindhavaṃ ca yajadratham
bhagadattaṃ tathā śūraṃ māgadaṃ ca mahābalam
na mṛṣyāmi raṇe bhīṣmaṃ pratyudyātaṃ śikhaṇḍinā
nāśīryata dhanuścāsya rathabhaṅgo na cāpyabhūt yudhyamānasya saṃgrāme bhīṣmasya bharatarṣabha
na hi bhīṣmaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ pāṇḍavāḥ pāṇḍupūrvaja
nānyāṃ gatiṃ prapaśyāmi sthāne yuddhe ca bhārata
pātayiṣye ripūnanyānpāṇḍavānpratipālayan pratijñāto jayo hyadya pāṇḍavānāṃ mahātmanām
ahaṃ vā'dya hataḥ śeṣye haniṣye vā'dya pāṇḍavān
aśakyāḥ pāṇḍavā jetuṃ devairapi savāsavaiḥ kiṃ punarmartyadharmeṇa kṣatriyeṇa mahābalāḥ
adya te puruṣavyāghra pratariṣye ṛṇaṃ tava
pāñcālānāṃ ca ye śreṣṭhā rājaputrā mahārathāḥ
prajajvāla raṇe bhīṣmo vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
na cāpi bhīstvayā kāryā bhīṣmādadya kathaṃcana
virāṭadrupadau vṛddhau kuntibhojasya daṃśitaḥ abhyadravata gāṅgeyaṃ putrasya tava paśyataḥ
sātyakiṃ samare kruddhamārsyaśṛṅgivārayat bhīṣmasya vadhamicchantaṃ pāṇḍavaprītikāmyayā
anye ca tāvakā yodhāḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathān
abhyadravata mābhaiṣṭa bhīṣmo hi prāpsyate na vaḥ
bhīṣmasya jīvitākāṅkṣī dhanañjayamupādravat - - btathaiva pāṇḍavāḥ śūrā gāṅgeyasya rathaṃ prati
tathaiva pāṇḍavaṃ kruddhaṃ tava putro nyavārayat
ubhau candrārkasadṛśau kāntyā dīptyā ca bhārata
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
yathaiva pannagā rājaṃstaṭākaṃ tṛṣitāstathā duḥśāsanastribhiḥ kruddhaḥ pārthaṃ vivyādha patribhiḥ
tasya pārtho dhanuśchitvā rathaṃ cāsya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ājaghāna tataḥ paścātputraṃ te niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ śarānsaṃdhāya kārmuke
yathā haṃsā mahārāja taṭākaṃ prāpya bhārata
hitvā pārthaṃ raṇe tūrṇaṃ bhīṣmasya rathamāvrajat
śaraiḥ suniśitaiḥ pārthaṃ yathā vṛtraṃ purandaraḥ
mādhavastu bhṛśaṃ viddho rākṣasena raṇe tadā
dhairyamālambya tejasvī jahāsa ca nanāda ca
vihāya rākṣasaṃ yuddhe śaineyo rathināṃ varaḥ
bhagadattaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tathā kuruta kauravyā yathāḥ vaḥ sātyako yudhi
śaineyaṃ yodhayāmāsarbhīṣmāyābhyudyataṃ raṇe abhimanyuṃ tadā''yāntaṃ bhīṣmasyābhyudyataṃ vadhe
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tayostasya ca bhārata
aśvatthāmā tatastau tu vivyādha bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ
yathā nāgo vane nāgaṃ matto mattamupādravat
nakulaṃ tu raṇe kruddho vikarṇaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
ghaṭotkacaṃ raṇe yāntaṃ nighnantaṃ tava vāhinīm
taṃ caiva pārṣato rājanhārdikyaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ tu kaunteyaṃ mahatyā senayā vṛttam
droṇena vāritā yattā na cacāla padātpadam
cekitāna raṇe yattaṃ bhīṣmaṃ prati janeśvara
vimukhīkṛtya putraṃ te senāṃ tava mamarda ha
kathaṃ bhīṣmaṃ na no hanyāditi niścitya bhārata
sā vadhyamānā samare putrasya tava vāhinī
ayaṃ hi divasastāta yatra pārtho mahābalaḥ
jighāṃsuḥ samare bhīṣmaṃ paraṃ yatnaṃ kariṣyati
utpatanti hi me bāṇā dhanuḥ prasphuratīva ca
yogamastrāṇi necchanti krūraṃ me vartate manaḥ
rasate vyathate bhūmiḥ kampatīva ca sarvaśaḥ
kampante ca hasante ca nṛtyanti ca rudanti ca
dhārtarāṣṭrasya sainyeṣu na ca bhrājanti daṃśitāḥka
hṛṣyanti romakūpāṇi sīdatīva ca me manaḥ
abravīcca purā bhīṣmo nāhaṃ hanyāṃ śikhaṇḍinam
strī hyeṣā vihitā dhātrā daivācca sa punaḥ pumān
vijayī ca raṇe nityaṃ bhairavāstraśca pāṇḍavaḥ - - babhyudyataṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā bhairavāstraṃ ca pāṇḍavam
hemacitrāṇi śūraṇāṃ mahānti ca śubhāni ca
chidyante ca dhvajāgrāṇi tomarāśca dhanūṃṣi ca
yāhi svargaṃ puraskṛtya yaśase vijayāya ca
brahmaṇyatā damo dānaṃ tapaśca caritaṃ mahat
ihaiva dṛśyate pārthe bhrātā yasya dhanañjayaḥ
pārṣataṃ yāhi rājānaṃ yudhyasva ca vṛkodaram
ko hi necchetpriyaṃ putraṃ jīvantaṃ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
eṣa cātiraṇe bhīṣmo dahate vai mahācamūm
bhagadattaḥ kṛpaḥ śalyaḥ kṛtavartā tathaiva ca
kṛpasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ madhye ciccheda bhārata
durmarṣaṇaṃ ca viṃśatyā citrasenaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
saindhavasya tathā'śvāṃśca sārathiṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya bhīmo dhanurmadhye dvābhyāṃ ciccheda māriṣa
tadā na mamṛṣe śalyo bhīmasesya vikramam
sa ca tānprati vivyādha pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥka
śalyaṃ vivyādha saptatyā punaśca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena gāḍhaṃ vivyādha marmaṇi
te hi yattā maheṣvāsāḥ pāṇḍavaṃ yuddhakovidam
te cāpi rathināṃ śreṣṭhā bhīmāya niśitāñśarān
tomaraṃ saindhavo rājā paṭṭasaṃ ca mahābhujaḥ
śataghnīṃ ca kṛpo rājañcharaṃ śalyaśca saṃyuge
sa bibheda śataghnīṃ ca navabhiḥ kaṅkapatribhiḥ
tau tu tatra mahātmānau sametau vīkṣya pāṇḍavau
ye sma bhīmaṃ raṇe rājanyodhayanto vyavasthitāḥ
prāgjyotiṣaṃ ca samare saindhavaṃ ca jayadratham
durmarṣaṇaṃ ca rājendra hyāvantyau ca mahārathau
jayadratho raṇe pārthaṃ viddhvā bhārata sāyakaiḥ
śalyaśca samare jiṣṇuṃ kṛpaśca rathināṃ varaḥ
tau tatra rathināṃ śreṣṭhau kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau
teṣāṃ ca rathināṃ madhye kaunteyau bharatarṣabhau
chittvā dhanūṃṣi śūrāṇāṃ śarāṃśca bahudhā raṇe
rathāśca bahavo bhagnā hayāśca śataśo hatāḥ
kauravāṇāṃ camūṃ ghorāṃ bhṛśaṃ dudruvatū raṇe
tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā hastāvāpaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
taṃ bhīmaḥ samaraślāghī guruṃ pitṛsamaṃ raṇe
tato bhīṣmaśca rāja ca kausalyaśca bṛhadbalaḥ
tatra pāṇḍusutaiḥ sārdhaṃ bhīṣmasya vijayaṃ prati
bhīṣmo'pi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ pratijagrāha tāṃ camūm
yathā ca tadabhūdyuddhaṃ tattu vakṣyāmi sāṃpratam
arjunaṃ ca sapāñcālyaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃśayitā janāḥ
śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ tāta dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca jalpataḥ
ghnataśca me gataḥ kālaḥ subahūnprāṇino raṇe
madvadhe kriyatāṃ yatno mama cedicchasi priyam
bhīṣmaṃ prati yayau rājā saṃgrāme saha sṛñjayaiḥ
mā vo bhīṣmādbhayaṃ kiṃcidastvadya yudhi sṛñjayāḥ
te tathā samayaṃ kṛtvā daśame'hani pāṇḍavāḥ
bhīṣmasya pātane yatnaṃ paramaṃ te samāsthitāḥ
droṇaṃ prati yayau yattaḥ pāñcālyaḥ saha sodaraiḥ
śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca putrāste pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanañjayam
tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śāntanavaṃ raṇe
tayoḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva yudhi bhārata
dvidhā ciccheda te putraḥ kṣurapreṇa mahārathaḥ
tāṃ śaktiṃ patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā kārṣṇiḥ paramakopanaḥ
aśvatthāmā tu samare sātyakiṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
nanāda balavannādaṃ vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tau tu tatra maheṣvāsau mahāmātrau mahārathau
punarvivyādha taṃ ṣaṣṭyā punaśca navabhi śaraiḥ
suśarmā tu raṇe kruddhastava putraṃ viśāṃpate
ājaghāna rame kruddhaḥ sa ca taṃ pratyavidhyata
bhīṣmasya samare rājanyaśo mānaṃ ca vardhayan
nākampayata saṃgrāme vivyādha ca punaḥ śaraiḥ
phālguniṃ samare kruddho vivyādha bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ
pratyudyayau ca taṃ rājā bhagadattaḥ pratāpavān
tato'rjuno mahārāja bhīṣmamabhyadravaddrutam śikhaṇḍinaṃ puraskṛtya tato yuddhamavartata
tataste tāvakāḥ śūrāḥ pāṇḍavaṃ rabhasaṃ yudhi
yaḥ saṃprāpya raṇe bhīṣmaṃ jīvite sma mano dadhe
nājaghāna raṇe bhīṣmaḥ sa ca tannāvabuddhavān
kiṃ te vivakṣayā vīra jahi bhīṣmaṃ mahāratham
yaḥ śaktaḥ samare bhīṣmaṃ yodhayeta pitāmaham
tathaiva ca camūṃ sarvāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathaḥ
karmaṇā tena samare tava putrasya dhanvinaḥ
sa hi taṃ samare rājannirjitya vijayo'rjunaḥ
na ca sma te rujaṃ cakruḥ pitustava janeśvara
sarveṣāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ samare śarma varma ca
devā api samudyuktā nālaṃ bhīṣmaṃ samāsitum
tasmāddravata mā yodhāḥ phalgunaṃ prāpya saṃyuge
tacchrutvā tu vaco rājaṃstava putrasya dhanvinaḥ
abhipetū raṇe pārthaṃ pataṅgā iva pāvakam
te tu bhittvā tava sutaṃ duḥśāsanamayomukhāḥ
hayāṃścāsya tato jaghne sārathiṃ ca nyapātayat
kṛpaṃ vikarṇaṃ śalyaṃ ca viddhvā bahubhirāyasaiḥ
evaṃ te virathāḥ sarve kṛpaḥ śalyaśca māriṣa
prajajvāla raṇe pārtho vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
bhīṣmaṃ prati parākrāntāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saha sṛñjayaiḥ
śvānaḥ kākāśca gṛdhrāśca vṛkā gomāyubhiḥ saha
dṛśyamāneṣu rakṣaḥsu bhūteṣu ca nadatsu ca
samantataśca dṛśyante patitā dharaṇītale - - biṣubhistāḍyamānāśca nārācaiśca sahasraśaḥ
abhyadravata gāṅgeyaṃ sainikāḥ kiṃ kṛtena vaḥ
rathā na rathibhiḥ sārdhaṃ pādātā na padātibhiḥ
yathā hi śaiśiraḥ kālo gavāṃ marmāṇi kṛntati tathā pāṇḍusutānāṃ vai bhīṣmo marmāṇi kṛntati
tathaiva tava sainyasya pārthena ca mahātmanā
channamāyodhanaṃ reje śirobhiśca sakuṇḍalaiḥ - - btasminneva mahārāja mahāvīravarakṣaye
bhīṣme ca yudhi vikrānte pāṇḍave ca dhanañjaye
icchanto nidhanaṃ yuddhe svargaṃ kṛtvā parāyaṇam
bhayaṃ tyaktvā raṇe śūrā brahmalokāya tatparāḥ
eko bhīṣmo hi matsyeṣu pāñcāleṣu ca saṃyuge
śatānīkaṃ ca samare hatvā bhīṣmaḥ pratāpavān
madhyaṃ prāptaṃ yathā grīṣme tapantaṃ bhāskaraṃ divi
yamau ca cekitānaśca kekayāḥ pañca caiva ha
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pīḍitā bhīṣmasāyakaiḥ
tatastasya ca teṣāṃ ca yuddhe devāsuropame
evaṃ te pāṇḍavāḥ sarve puraskṛtya śikhaṇḍinam
na vivyathe tadā bhīṣmo bhidyamāneṣu marmasu
tataḥ sātyakibhīmau ca pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanañjayam
drupadaṃ ca virāṭaṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam
na cakruste rujaṃ tasya svarmapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ
taṃ śabdaṃ tumulaṃ śrutvā pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu raṇe śreṣṭho rakṣmamāṇaḥ kirīṭinā
evaṃ sa pāṇḍavaḥ kruddha āttamāttaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
tāṃ ca cikṣepa saṃkruddhaḥ phalgunasya rathaṃ prati
tasya ciccheda tāṃ śaktiṃ pañcadhā pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ
sā papāta tathā cchinnā saṃkruddhena kirīṭinā
meghabṛndaparibhraṣṭā vicchinneva śatahradā chinnāṃ tāṃ śaktimālokya bhīṣmaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ
yadyeṣāṃ na bhavedgoptā viṣvakseno mahābalaḥ ajayyaścaiva sarveṣāṃ lokānāmiti me matiḥ
pitrā tuṣṭena me pūrvaṃ yadā kālīmudavaham
na ca tāḥ śuśruve kaścitteṣāṃ saṃvadatāṃ giraḥ
ṛte bhīṣmaṃ mahābāhuṃ māṃ cāpi munitejasā
iti devagaṇānāṃ ca vākyaṃ śrutvā mahātapāḥ
na cakruste rujaṃ tasya rukmapuṅkhāḥ śilāsitāḥ
eṣa pārtho raṇe kruddhaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathaḥ
na caiṣa samare śakyo jetuṃ vajrabhṛtā api
