māṃ cāpi śaktā nirjetuṃ kimu martyā mahārathāḥ - - bṛte'rjunaṃ susaṃkruddhametatsatyaṃ bravīmi te
evaṃ tayoḥ saṃvadatoḥ phalguno niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
susalā iva me dhnanti neme bāṇaḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ
arjunasya ime bāṇā neme bāṇāḥ śikhaṇḍinaḥ
kṛntanti mama gātrāṇi māghamāṃ segavā iva
sarve hyapi na me duḥkhaṃ kuryuranye narādhipāḥka
śaktiṃ bhīṣmaḥ sa pārthāya tataścikṣepa bhārata
samaṃ ca viṣamaṃ caiva na prājñāyata kiṃcana
pīḍyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śastraiḥ prādravāma raṇe tadā
pāṇḍavaiḥ pañcabhiḥ sārdhaṃ sātyakena ca dhanvinā
bhidyamānāḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ sarve kārṣṇipurogamaiḥ droṇadrauṇikṛtaiḥ sārdhaṃ sarve śalyaśalādayaḥ
sālvāśrayāstrigartāśca ambaṣṭhāḥ kekayaiḥ saha dvādaśaite janapadāḥ śarārtā vraṇapīḍitāḥ
hāheti divi devānāṃ pārthivānāṃ ca bhārata
dharaṇīṃ na sa pasparśa śarasaṅghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
antarikṣe ca śuśrāva divyā vācaḥ samantataḥ
te tu bhīṣmaṃ samāsādya ṛṣayo haṃsarūpiṇaḥ
te taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
udagāyana āditye haṃsāḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ
prāṇānāṃ ca samutsarga aiśvaryaṃ niyataṃ mama
yaśca datto varo mahyaṃ pitrā tena mahātmanā
evaṃ kurūṇāṃ patite śṛṅge bhīṣme mahaujasi
dadhyuścaiva mahārāja na yuddhe dadhire manaḥ
avadhye śantanoḥ putre hate bhīṣme mahaujasi duḥkhārtāste tato rājankurūṇāṃ patayo'bhavan
pāṇaḍavāśca jayaṃ labdhvā paratra ca parāṃ gatim
bharatānāṃ ca ye pūrve te cainaṃ praśaśaṃsire
adyaiva nihataṃ śrutvā pitaraṃ mama durmateḥ
śrutvā vinihataṃ bhīṣmaṃ śatadhā yanna dīryate
na hato jāmadagnyena divyairastraiśca yaḥ purā
rarāsa pṛthivī caiva bhīṣme śāntanave hate
dṛṣṭvā ca patitaṃ bhīṣmaṃ putro duḥśāsanastava
te tu bhīṣmaṃ samāsādya śayānaṃ bharatarṣabham
svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ svāgataṃ vo mahārathāḥ
abhinandya sa tānevaṃ śirasā lambatā'bravīt parapārśve tava sutānsthitānudvīkṣya bhārata
tato nṛpāḥ samājahrustanūni ca mṛdūni ca
dhanañjaya mahābāho śiro me tāta lambate
preṣyo'haṃ tava durdharṣa kriyatāṃ kiṃ pitāmaha
tamabravīcchāntanavaḥ śiro me tāta lambate - - bdīyatāmupadhānaṃ me yadyuktamiha manyase
vīraśayyānurūpaṃ vai śīghraṃ vīra prayaccha me
tvaṃ hi pārtha samartho vai śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadhanuṣmatām
ye tadā dhārayiṣyanti te ca prekṣyanti māṃ nṛpāḥ
parikhāḥ khanyatāmatra mamāvasadane nṛpāḥ upāsiṣye vivasvantamevaṃ śaraśatācitaḥ
kṣatradharme praśastāṃ hi prāpto'smi paramāṃ gatim
te'bhivādya tato bhīṣmaṃ kṛtvā ca triḥpradakṣiṇam
vidhāya rakṣāṃ bhīṣmasya sarva eva samantataḥ
diṣṭyā jayasi kauravya diṣṭyā bhīṣmo nipātitaḥ
tvāṃ tu cakṣurhaṇaṃ prāpya dagdho ghoreṇa cakṣuṣa
tvaṃ hi naḥ śaraṇaṃ kṛṣṇa bhaktānāmabhayaṃkaraḥ
rakṣitā samare nityaṃ nityaṃ cāpi hite rataḥ
sarvathā tvāṃ samāsādya nāścaryamiti me matiḥ
na me'dya sevituṃ yogyā bhogāḥ kevalamānuṣāḥ
evamuktvā tadovāca bhīṣmaḥ śaraśataiścitaḥ payaḥ pāsyāmi gopālā gomayaṃ na tu gomayam
tvaṃ hi śakto maheṣvāsa dātumāpo yathāvidhi
vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni sarve śrutvā ca pārthivāḥ
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā rathena rathināṃ varaḥ
saṃdhāya ca śaraṃ dīptamabhimantrya sa pāṇḍavaḥ
utpapāta tato dhārā vāriṇo vimalā śubhā
na vai śrutaṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṇa vākyaṃ mayocyamānaṃ vidureṇa caiva
droṇena rāmeṇa janārdanena muhurmuhuḥ sañjayenāpi coktam
parītabuddhirhi visaṃjñakalpo duryodhano na ca tacchraddadhāti
sa śeṣyate vai nihataścirāya śāstrātigo bhīmabalābhibhūtaḥ
etacchrutvā tadvacaḥ kauravendro duryodhano dīnamanā babhūva
kṛṣṇo vā devakīputro nānyo vedeha kaścana
yāvanna te camūḥ sarvāḥ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
etatkṣamamahaṃ manye tava caiva kulasya ca
tyaktvā manyuṃ vyupaśāmyasva pārthaiḥ paryāptametadyatkṛtaṃ phalgunena
bhīṣmasyāntādastu vaḥ sauhṛdaṃ ca jīvantu śeṣāḥ sādhu rājanprasīda
mā mitradhrukpārthivānāṃ jaghanyaḥ pāpāṃ kīrtiṃ prāpsyase kauravendra
pitā putraṃ mātulaṃ bhāgineyo bhrātā caiva bhrātaraṃ praitu rājan
na cedevaṃ prāptakālaṃ vaco me mohāviṣṭaḥ pratipatsyasyabuddhyā
tapsyasyante etadantāḥ stha sarve satyāmetāṃ bhāratīmīrayāmi
etadvākyaṃ sauhṛdādāpageyo madhye rājñāṃ bhārataṃ śrāvayitvā
śrutvā tu nihataṃ bhīṣmaṃ rādheyaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
na vipriyaṃ mamaiveha yatspardhethā mayā saha
yadi māṃ nādhigacchethā na te śreyo dhruvaṃ bhavet
kaunteyastvaṃ na rādheyo na tavādhirathaḥ pitā
na ca dveṣosti me tāta tvayi satyaṃ bravīmi te
brahmaṇyatāṃ ca śauryaṃ ca dāne ca paramāṃ sthitim
brahmaṇyaḥ sattvayodhī ca tejasā ca balena ca
vyapanīto'dya manyurme yastvāṃ prati purā kṛtaḥ
yathā vadasi me bhīṣma kaunteyo'haṃ na sūtajaḥ
vamu caiva śarīraṃ ca putradāraṃ tathā yaśaḥ
avaśyabhāvī hyartho'yaṃ yo na śakyo nivartitum
vijayiṣye raṇe pāṇḍūniti me niścitaḥ manaḥ
praśame hi kṛto yatnaḥ sumahānsuciraṃ mayā
na caiva śakitaḥ kartuṃ yato dharmastato jayaḥ
śṛṇvate te mahārāja proktaṃ pāpaharaṃ śubham
śraddhāvantaśca ye cāpi śroṣyanti manujā bhuvi
tamapratimasatvaujobalavīryaparākramam hataṃ devavrataṃ śrutvā pāñcālyena śikhaṇḍinā
yaṃ prāpya samare vīrā na trasyanti mahābhaye
anumānya ca gāṅgeyaṃ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
ajāvaya ivāgopā vane śvāpadasaṃkule karṇakarṇeti cākrandañcheṣā bhārata pārthivāḥ
āsurīva yathā senā nigṛhīte nṛpe valau
tasyāṃ trastā nṛpatayaḥ sainikāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ pātāla iva majjanto hīnā devavratena te
sa hi nābudhyata tadā daśāhāni mahāyaśāḥ
sa tu tenaiva kopena rājangāṅgeyamuktavān tvayi jīkate kauravya nāhaṃ yotsye kadācana
hate vā tvayi pārthaistu yudhi svargamupeyuṣi
nāyudhyata tataḥ karṇaḥ putrasya tava saṃyate
evaṃ te sma hi rādheyaṃ sūtaputraṃ nataḷḷḷḷ cukruśuḥ sahitā yodhāḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ
tathā tu sañjayaṃ karṇaṃ kīrtayantaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
sa hi vai puruṣavyāghro loke sañjaya kathyate
ārtānāṃ bāndhavānāṃ ca krandatāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ parityajya raṇe prāṇāṃstattrāṇārthaṃ ca śarma ca
hataṃ bhīṣmamathādhirathirviditvā bhinnāṃ nāvaṃ vāridhāvatyagādhe sodaryavadvyasanātsūtaputraḥ
śrutvā tu karṇaḥ puruṣendramacyutaṃ nipātitaṃ śāntanavaṃ mahāratham
hate tu rathasattame parairnimajjatīṃ nāvamivārṇave kurūn
sammṛjya divyaṃ dhanurātatajyaṃ sa rāmadattaṃ ripusaṅghahantā bāṇāṃśca kālānalavāyukalpānullālayanvākyamidaṃ babhāṣe
yasmindhṛtirbuddhiparākramaujaḥ satyaṃ smṛtirvīraguṇāśca sarve astrāṇi divyānyatha saṃnatihrīḥ priyā ca vāganasūyā ca bhīṣme
sadā kṛtajñe dvijaśatrughātake sanātanaṃ candramasīva lakṣmīḥ
sa cetpraśāntaḥ paravīrahantā manye hatāneva ca sarvavīrān
neha dhruvaṃ kiṅcana jātu vidyate loke hyasminkarmaṇo'nityayogāt
sūryodaye ko hi vimuktasaṅśayo bhāvaṃ kurvītāryamahāvrate hate
vasūni putrāṃśca vasuṃdharāṃ tathā kurūṃśca śocadhvamimāṃ ca vāhinīm
mahāprabhāve varade nipātite lokeśvare śāstari cāmitaujasi
parājiteṣu bharateṣu durmanāḥ karṇo bhṛśaṃ nyaśvasadaśru vartayan
idaṃ ca rādheyavaco niśamya sutāśca rājaṃstava sainikāśca ha
pravartamāne tu punarmahāhave vigāhyamānāsu camūṣu pārthivaiḥ
bhavatsu tiṣṭhatsviha pātito mṛdhe niriprakāśaḥ kurupuṅgavaḥ katham
nipātite śāntanave mahārathe divākare bhūtalamāsthite yathā
na pārthivāḥ soḍhumalaṃ dhanaṃjayaṃ giripravoḍhāramivānilaṃ drumāḥ
maryā kukhṇāṃ paripālyamāhave balaṃ yathā tena mahātmanā tathā
samāhite cātmani bhāramīdṛśaṃ jagattathā'nityamidaṃ ca lakṣaye
nipātitaṃ cāhavaśauṇḍamāhakhe kathaṃ nu kuryāmahamīdṛśe bhayam
yaśaḥ paraṃ jagati vibhāvya vartitā parairhato bhuvi śayitāthavā punaḥ
yamau raṇe yatra yamopamau bale sasātyakiryatra ca devakīsutaḥ
tapo'bhyudīrṇaṃ tapasaiva bādhyate balaṃ balenaiva tathā manasvibhiḥ
manaśca me śatrunivāraṇe dhruṃ svarakṣaṇe cācalavadvyavasthitam
evaṃ caiṣāṃ bādhamānaḥ prabhāvaṃ gatvaivāhaṃ tāñjayāmyadya sūta
mitradroho marṣaṇīyo na me'yaṃ bhagne sainye yaḥ sameyātsa mitram
mayā kṛtyamiti jānāmi sūta tasmādrājñastvadya śatrūnvijeṣye
kurūnrakṣanpāṇḍuputrāñjighāṃsaṃstyaktvā prāṇānghorarūpe raṇe'smin sarvānsaṅkhye śatrusaṅghānnihatya dāsyāmyahaṃ dharmaḷḷḷḷḷḷḷḷ
nibadhyatāṃ me kavacaṃ vicitraṃ haimaṃ śubhraṃ maṇiratnāvabhāsi
asīṃśca śaktīśca gadāśca gurvīḥ śaṅkhaṃ ca jāmbūnadacitranālam
imāṃ raukmīṃ nāgakakṣyāṃ vicitrāṃ dhvajaṃ jaitraṃ divyamindīvarāṅkam
citrāṇi cāpāni ca vegavanti jyāścottamāḥ sannahanopapannāḥ
prāyātrikaṃ cānayatāśu sarvaṃ pūrṇaṃ kāntyā vīrakāṃsyāṃ ca haimam
ānīya mālāmavabadhya cāṅge pravādayantvāśu jayāya bherīḥ
prayāhi mūtāśu yataḥ kirīṭī vṛkodaro dharmasuto yamau ca
tānvā haniṣyāmi sametya saṅkhye bhīṣmo yathaiṣyāmi hato dviṣadbhiḥ
vāsudevaḥ sātyakiḥ sṛṃjayāśca manye balaṃ tadajayyaṃ mahīpaiḥ
tathāpi hantāsmi sametya saṅkhye yāsyāmi vā bhīṣmamukho yamāya
na tvevāhaṃ na gamiṣyāmi teṣāṃ madhye śarāṇāṃ tatra cāhaṃ bravīmi
mitradruho durbalabhaktayo ye pāpātmāno na mamaite sahāyāḥ
samṛddhimantaṃ rathamuttamaṃ dṛḍhaṃ sakūbaraṃ hemapariṣkṛtaṃ śubham
hutāśanābhaḥ sa hutāśanaprabhe śubhaḥ śubhe vai svarathe dhanurdharaḥ
dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaṃ bhīṣmaṃ sarvakṣatrāntakaṃ gurum divyairastrairmaheṣvāsaṃ pātitaṃ savyasācinā
jayāṇā tava putrāṇāṃ saṃbhagnā śarma varma ca
kakudaṃ sarvasainyānāṃ lakṣma sarvadhanuṣmatām dhanantayaśarairvyāptaṃ pitaraṃ te mahāvratam
karṇo'hamasmi bhadraṃ te vada māmabhi bhārata
yatra dharmaparo vṛddhaḥ śete bhuvi bhavāniha
adya gāṇḍīvamuktānāmaśanīnāmiva ḷḷḷḥ trāsayiṣyati bāṇānāṃ kurūnanyāṃśca pathiḷḷ
samiddho'gniryathā vīra mahājvālo drumāndaḷḷḷt dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ idhakṣyanti tathā bāṇāḥ kirīṭiḷḷ
yena yena prasarato vāyvagnī sahitau vane
ḷḷdataḥ pāñcajanyasya rasato gāṇḍivasya ca śrutvā sarvāṇi sainyāni trāsaṃ yāsyanti bhārata
śabdaṃ soḍhuṃ na śakṣyanti tvāmṛte vīra pārthivāḥ
ko hyarjunaṃ yodhayituṃ tvadanyaḥ pārthivo'rhati yasya divyāni karmāṇi pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
ko'nyaḥ śakto raṇe jetuṃ pūrvaṃ yo na jitastvayā jito yena raṇe rāmo bhavatā vīryaśālinā
satyasya ca yathā santo bījānāmiva corvarā
parjanya iva bhūtānāṃ pratiṣṭhā suhṛdāṃ bhavān
utkalā mekalāḥ pauṇḍrāḥ kaliṅgāndhrāśca saṃyuge niṣādāśca trigartāśca bāhlīkāśca jitāstvayā
bahavaśca jitāḥ karṇa tvayā vīrā mahaujasā
tavāpi dharmataḥ sarve yathā tasya vayaṃ tathā
yathā ca kuravo yuddhe yodhayanti sma pāṇḍavān
karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ yuddhāya samupasthitam kṣveḍitāsphoṭitaravaiḥ siṃhanādaravairapi
atra kiṃ nu samarthaṃ yaddhitaṃ tatsampradhāryatām
brūhi naḥ puruṣavyāghra tvaṃ hi prājñatamo nṛṣu
yathā cārthapatiḥ kṛtyaṃ paśyate na tathetaraḥ
te sma sarve tava vacaḥ śrotukāmā nareśvara
na vinā nāyakaṃ senā muhūrtamapi tiṣṭhati āhaveṣu viśeṣeṇa bhraṣṭanetreṣvivāñjanam
adeśiko yathā sārthaḥ sarvaḥ kṛcchraṃ samṛcchati
yaṃ hi senāprametāraṃ bhavānvakṣyati saṃyuge taṃ vayaṃ sahitāḥ sarve kariṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ
yugapanna tu te śakyāḥ kartuṃ sarve puraḥsarāḥ
eka eva tu kartavyo yasminvaiśeṣikā guṇāḥ
śeṣā vimanaso vyaktaṃ na yotsyanti hitāstava
yuktaḥ senāpatiḥ kartuṃ droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ko hi tiṣṭhati durdharṣe droṇe śastrabhṛtāṃ vare
na ca so'pyasti te yodhaḥ sarvarājasu bhārata
yukto bhavatsaśro goptā rājñāmanyo na vidyate
sarveṣāmiva lokānāṃ viśvasya ca yathā kṣayaḥ
akṣauhiṇyo daśaikā ca vaśagāḥ santu te'nagha
sainikāśca mudā yuktā vardhayanti dvijottamam duryodhanaṃ puraskṛtya prārthayanto mahadyaśaḥ
pārṣataṃ tu raṇe rājanna haniṣye kathañcana
sa hi sṛṣṭo vadhārthāya mamaiva puruṣarṣabhaḥ
na ca māṃ pāṇḍavā yuddhe yodhayiṣyanti harṣitāḥ
saināpatye yathā skandaṃ purā śakramukhāḥ surāḥ
na hi karṇaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā yudhi sthāsyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
karṇo hi samare śakto jetuṃ devānsavāsavān
bhīṣmeṇa tu raṇe pārthāḥ pālitā bāhuśālinā
yathā prajvalitaḥ sūryo yugānte vai vasuṃdharām
dīpyandṛśyeta hi tathā ketuḥ sarvatra dhīmataḥ
tāvakānāṃ mukhe karṇaḥ pareṣāṃ ca dhanaṃjayaḥ
gṛdhrāḥ śyenā bakāḥ kaṅkā vāyasāśca sahasraśaḥ
bhāskarasyābhavadrājanprayāte vāhinīpatau ete cānye ca bahavaḥ prādurāsansudāruṇāḥ
te tvanyonyaṃ susaṃrabdhāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kauravaiḥ saha
saṃyamya tu tato droṇaḥ samavasthāpya cāhave
khacaranagarakalpaṃ kalpitaṃ śāstradṛṣṭyā caladanilapatākaṃ hlādanaṃ valgitāśvam
vyathitāḥ pāṇḍavā dṛṣṭvā na cainaṃ paryavārayan
tatrainamarjunaścaiva dhṛṣṭadyumnaśca pārṣataḥ ye cānye pārthivā rājanpāṇḍavasyānusainikāḥ
prākampanta raṇe yodhā gāvaḥ śītārditā iva
athāsya dhanuṣo bāṇā nissarantaḥ sahasraśaḥ vyāpya sarvā diśaḥ peturnāgāśvarathapattiṣu
sakekayānāṃ pravarāṃśca pañca pāñcālarājaṃ ca śaraiḥ pramathya
taṃ bhīmasenaśca dhanañjayaśca śineśca naptā drupadātmajaśca
śaibyātmajaḥ kāśipatiḥ śibiśca dṛṣṭvā nadanto vyakirañcharaughaiḥ
śreṇīkṛtāḥ saṃyati moghavegā dvīpe nadīnāmiva kāśarohāḥ
anyāṃśca vīrānsamare mamarda droṇaḥ sutānāṃ tava bhūtikāmaḥ
etāni cānyāni ca kauravendra karmāṇi kṛtvā samare mahātmā
pratāpya lokāniva kālasūryo droṇo gataḥ svargamito hi rājan
sainyānāṃ ca tato rājannācārye nihate yudhi
dyāṃ dharāṃ khaṃ diśo vāpi pradiśarścānunādayan
devatāḥ pitaraścaiva pūrve ye cāsya bāndhavāḥ
kiṃ kurvāṇaṃ raṇe droṇaṃ jaghruḥ pāṇḍavasṛñjayāḥ
kurvāṇaṃ dāruṇaṃ karma raṇe yattaṃ mahāratham
vyaktaṃ hi daivaṃ balavatpauruṣāditi me matiḥ
na nūnaṃ paraduḥkhena mriyate ko'pi sañjaya yatra droṇamahaṃ śrutvā hataṃ jīvāmi mandadhīḥ
daivameva paraṃ manye nanvanarthaṃ hi pauruṣam
yacchrutvā nihataṃ droṇaṃ śatadhā na vidīryate
brāhmaṇā rājaputrāśca sa kathaṃ mṛtyunā hṛtaḥ
mandānāṃ mama putrāṇāṃ jayāśā yasya vikrame
ke nu taṃ raudrakarmāṇaṃ yuddhe pratyudyayū rathāḥ
nanu rukmarathaṃ dṛṣṭvā prādravanti sma pāṇḍavāḥ
sa kathaṃ brāhmaṇo vṛddhaḥ śastreṇa vadhamāptavān
divi śakra iva śreṣṭho mahāsatvo mahābalaḥ
sa kathaṃ nihataḥ pārthaiḥ kṣudramatsyairyathā timiḥ
na yasya vijayākāṅkṣī viṣayaṃ prāpya jīvati
yaṃ dvau na jahataḥ śabdau jīvamānaṃ kadācana
nāhaṃ manye hataṃ droṇaṃ sa hi lokamayotsyata
ke nu paścādavartanta gacchato durgamāṃ gatim
ke'rakṣandakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ savyaṃ ke ca mahātmanaḥ
droṇasya samare vīrāḥ ke'kurvanta parāṃ dhṛtim
parāmapyāpadaṃ prāpya sa kathaṃ nihataḥ paraiḥ
etadāryeṇa kartavyaṃ kṛcchrāsvāpatsu sañjaya parākramedyathā śaktyā tacca tasminpratiṣṭhitam
sa labdhvā śanakaiḥ saṃjñāṃ vepamāno mahīpatiḥ
dāntaṃ bahumataṃ loke ke śūrāḥ paryavārayan
yaḥ karoti mahatkarma śatrūṇāṃ vai mahābalaḥ
ko hi gāṇḍīvadhanvānaṃ raṇe soḍhuṃ naro'rhati
ke tatra nājahurdroṇaṃ ke kṣudrāḥ prādravanbhayāt
ke vā tatra tanūstyaktvā pratīpaṃ mṛtyumāvrajan
na ca vegaṃ sitāśvasya visahiṣyanti māmakāḥ
viṣvakseno yasya yantā yasya yoddhā dhanañcayaḥ
aśakyaḥ sa ratho jetuṃ manye devāsurairapi
satyaṃ dhṛtiśca śauryaṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ ca kevalam
yasminnastrāṇi satyaṃ ca brahmacaryaṃ ca sarvadā
visṛṣṭā dakṣiṇā yasya gaṅgājalamavārayat gaṅgāsrotasi yāvatyaḥ sikatā apyaśeṣataḥ
na pūrve nāpare cakruridaṃ kecana mānavāḥ
jātaṃ cāpi janiṣyantaṃ dvitīyaṃ cāpi sāmpratam
gatiṃ yasya na yāsyanti mānuṣā lokavāsinaḥ
prepsantaṃ samare droṇaṃ ke vīrāḥ paryavārayan
pārthānāṃ jayakāmaṃ taṃ taṃ putrāṇāṃ mama kaṇṭakam
ete cānye ca bahavo yeṣāmajitaṃ yudhi
yeṣāṃ ca puruṣavyāghraḥ śārṅgadhanvā vyapāśrayaḥ lokānāṃ gururatyarthaṃ lokanāthaḥ sanātanaḥ
nārāyaṇoraṇe nātho divyo divyātmakaḥ prabhuḥ yasya divyāni karmāṇi pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
pūtanāṃ śakaṭaṃ hatvā keśinaṃ caiva vājinam
ṛṣabhaṃ dhenukaṃ caiva ariṣṭaṃ ca mahābalam
cāṇūraṃ muṣṭikaṃ caiva raṅgamadhye nihatya ca
pralambaṃ narakaṃ jambhaṃ pīṭhaṃ cāpi mahāsuram
ārādhitaḥ sadāreṇa sa cāsmai pradadau varān
amṛṣyamāṇā rājāno yasya jātyā hayā iva
nānto vikramayuktasya buddhyā yuktasya vā punaḥ
api vā hyeṣa pāṇḍūnāṃ yotsyate'rthāya sañjaya
na tadā pratisaṃyoddhā bhavitā tatra kaścana
yadi sma kuravaḥ sarve jayeyurnāma pāṇḍavān
yasya yantā hṛṣīkeśo yoddhā yasya dhanañjayaḥ
rathasya tasya kaḥ saṅkhye pratyanīko bhavedrathaḥ
arjune vijayo nityaṃ kṛṣṇe kīrtiśca śāśvatī
mohādduryodhanaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ yo na vettīha keśavam mohito daivayogena mṛtyupāśapuraskṛtaḥ
na veda kṛṣṇaṃ dāśārhamarjunaṃ caiva pāṇḍavam
bhīṣmasya ca vadhastāta droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
na hyeva brahmacaryeṇa na vedādhyayanena ca
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā kinnu jīvāmi sañjaya
yāṃ tāṃ śriyamasūyāmaḥ purā dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhire
pakvānāṃ hi vadhe sūta vajrāyante tṛṇānyuta
prāptaḥ prakṛtito dharmo na dharmo māmakānprati
krūraḥ sarvavināśāya kālo'sau nātivartate anyathā cintitā hyarthā naraistāta manasvibhiḥ
śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvāṃ śaṃsato mama bhārata hanta te kathayiṣyāmi sarvaṃ pratyakṣadarśivān
madhye sarvasya sainyasya putraṃ te vākyamabravīt
karomi kāmaṃ kaṃ te'dya pravṛṇīṣva yamicchasi
tataḥ kurūṇāmācāryaḥ śrutvā putrasya te vacaḥ
na vadhaṃ tasya durdharṣa varamadya prayācase
kimarthaṃ ca naravyāghra na vadhaṃ tasya kāṅkṣase
yadīcchasi tvaṃ jīvantaṃ kulaṃ rakṣasi cātmanaḥ
rājyāṃśaṃ prati dattvā ca saubhrātraṃ kartumicchasi
dhanyaḥ kuntīsuto rājā sujātaṃ cāsya dhīmataḥ
sahasā niḥsṛto bhāvo yosya nityaṃ hṛdi sthitaḥ
hate yudhiṣṭhire pārthā hanyuḥsarvānhi no dhruvam
yadi sarve haniṣyante pāṇḍavāḥ sasutā mṛdhe
tataḥ kṛtsnaṃ vaśe kṛtvā niḥśeṣaṃ nṛpamaṇḍalam
satyapratijñe tvānīte punardyūtena nirjite tasmiñjīvati cāyāte hyupāyairbahubhiḥ kṛtaiḥ
so'yaṃ mama jayo vyaktaṃ dīrghakālaṃ bhaviṣyati
taṃ varaṃ sāntaraṃ tasmai dadau saṃcintya buddhimān
na hi śakyo raṇe pārthaḥ sendrairdevāsurairapi
grahaṇe hi jayastasya na vadhe puruṣarṣabha grahaṇaṃ hi vadhāttasya dharmarājasya manyase
phalgunasya samīpe tu na hi śakyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
evamukte tadā tasminyuddhe devāsuropame sāntaraṃ tu pratijñāte rājño droṇena nigrahe
tato duryodhanenāpi grahaṇaṃ pāṇḍavasya tat skandhāvāreṣu sarveṣu yathāsthāneṣu māriṣa
pāṇḍaveyeṣu sāpekṣaṃ droṇaṃ jānāti te sutaḥ
sāntare tu pratijñāne rājño droṇena nigrahe tataste sainikāḥ śrutvā taṃ yudhiṣṭhiranigraham
yathā me na vadhaḥ kārya ācāryasya kathañcana
tathā tava parityāgo na me rājaṃścikīrṣitaḥ
na sa taṃ jīvaloke'sminkāmaṃ prāptā kathañcana
na tvāṃ droṇo nigṛhṇīyājjīvamāne mayi dhruvam
yadi tasya raṇe sāhyaṃ kurute vajrabhṛtsvayam
viṣṇurvā sahito devairna tvāṃ prāpsyatyasau mṛdhe
mayi jīvati rājendra na bhayaṃ kartumarhasi
anyacca brūyāṃ rājendra pratijñāṃ mama niścalām
tato vyūḍhānyanīkāni tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
na śekuḥ sṛñjayā yuddhe taddhi droṇena pālitam
na śekuḥ pāṇḍavīṃ senāṃ pālyamānāṃ kirīṭīnā
āstāṃ te stimite sene rakṣyamāṇe parasparam
tena muktāḥ śarā ghorā viceruḥ sarvatodiśam
sa diśaḥ sarvato ruddhvā saṃvṛtya khamajihmagaiḥ
raudrā hastavatā muktāḥ sammṛdganti ssa sāyakāḥ
sa vīraḥ satyavānprājño dharmanityaḥ sadā punaḥ
tasya mādrīsutaḥ ketuṃ dhanuḥ sūtaṃ hayānapi nātikruddhaḥ śaraiśchittvā ṣaṣṭhyā vivyādha saubalam
droṇaḥ pāñcāladāyādaṃ vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ tayostatra mahārāja bāṇavarṣaiḥ prakāśitam
nipātya nakulaḥ saṅkhye śaṅkhaṃ dadhmau pratāpavān
kṛpaṃ vivyādha saptatyā dhvajaṃ cāsya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
taṃ bhojaḥ saptasaptatyā viddhvā''śu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ kruddhaḥ saumadattiṃ viśāmpate
tataḥ saindhavamālokya kārṣṇirutsṛjya pauravam utpapāta rathāttūrṇaṃ śyenavannipapāta ca
tataścarma ca khaṅgaṃ ca samutkṣipya mahābalaḥ
śarā daśa diśo muktā vṛṣasenena saṃyuge
prajānāṃ saṃkṣaye ghore yathā sūryodayo bhavet
alaṃ drutena vaḥ śūrā iti droṇo'bhyabhāṣata
bhāradvājamamarṣaśca vikramaśca samāviśat samuddhṛtya niṣaṅgācca dhanurjyāmavamṛjya ca
na hi māmabhivarṣantaṃ saṃyuge tāta pāṇḍavāḥ
na māmutsahate tāta na bhīmo na ca sātyakiḥ
yāhi sargaṃ puraskṛtya yaśase ca jayāya ca
tasya droṇo dhanuśchitvā taṃ drutaṃ samupādravat
saṃvārya ca raṇe droṇaṃ kumārastu mahābalaḥ
sa madhyaṃ prāpya sainyānāṃ sarvāḥ pravicarandiśaḥ
sātyakiṃ pañcabhirviddhvā matsyaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ sa viddhvā tu śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parīpsanto yudhiṣṭhiram
adya rājā dhārtarāṣṭraḥ kṛtārtho vai bhaviṣyati
na diśo nāntarikṣaṃ ca na dyaurnaiva ca medinī
sūrye cāstamanuprāpte tamasā cābhisaṃvṛte nājñāyata tadā śatrurna suhṛnna ca kaścana
pṛṣṭhataḥ sarvasainyānāṃ mudito vai sakeśavaḥ masāragalvarkamuvarṇarūpairvajrapravālasphaṭikaiśca mukhyaiḥ
citre rathe pāṇḍusuto babhāse nakṣatracitre viyatīva candraḥ
te sene śibiraṃ gatvā nyaviśetāṃ viśāmpate
iti tadvaḥ prayatatāṃ kṛtaṃ pārthena saṃyuge
gāśca vāsāṃsi ca punaḥ samābhāṣya parasparam
śṛṇvatāṃ sarvabhūtānāmuccairvāco babhāṣire sarve dhanañjayavadhe pratijñāṃ cāpi cakrire
ye vai lokāścāvratināṃ ye caiva brahmaghātinām
madyapasya ca ye lokā gurudāraratasya ca
śaraṇāgataṃ ca tyajato yācamānaṃ tathā ghnataḥ
agāradāhināṃ caiva ye ca gāṃ nighnatāmapi
apakāriṇāṃ ca ye lokā ye ca brahmadviṣāmapi
nyāsāpahāriṇāṃ ye ca śrutaṃ nāśayatāṃ ca ye
yadi tvasukaraṃ loke karma kuryāma saṃyuge
eṣa ca bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ suśarmā''hvayate raṇe
ayaṃ vai satyajidrājannadya tvāṃ rakṣitā yudhi
hate tu puruṣavyāghre raṇe satyajiti prabho
tato dauryodhanaṃ sainyaṃ mudā paramayā yutam
te kirīṭinamāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā harṣeṇa māriṣa atīva samprahṛṣṭāste hyupalakṣya dhanañjayam
sa diśaḥ pradiśaḥ sarvā nabhaścaiva samāvṛṇot
athavā harṣakālo'yaṃ traigartānāmasaṃśayam kunarairduravāpānhi lokānprāpsyanti saṃyuge
mayā hatā hiṃ saṅgrāme lokānprāpsyanti puṣkalān evamuktvā mahābāhurhṛṣīkeśaṃ tato'rjunaḥ āsasāda raṇe vyūḍhāṃ trigartānāmanīkinīm
sā senā bharataśreṣṭha niśceṣṭā śuśubhe tadā
citre paṭe yathā nyastā kuśalaiḥ śilpibhirnaraiḥ
svanena tena sainyānāṃ divamāvṛṇvatā tadā sasvanā pṛthivī sarvā tathaiva ca mahodadhiḥ
vāhāsteṣāṃ vivṛttākṣāḥ stabdhakarṇaśirodharāḥ viṣṭabdhacaraṇā mūtraṃ rudhiraṃ ca prasusruvuḥ
sa ca tānprativivyādha dvābhyāṃ dvābhyāṃ parākramī
jahāra pārthaḥ sainyeṣu sahasre dve ca yodhinām
alaṃ drutena vaḥ śūrā na bhayaṃ kartumarhatha
śaptvā'tha śapathānghorānsarvasainyasya paśyataḥ gatvā dauryodhanaṃ sainyaṃ kiṃ vai vakṣyatha mukhyaśaḥ
naite hāsyanti saṅgrāmaṃ jīvanta iti me matiḥ
tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ smitaṃ kṛtvā pratinandya śivena tam
baddhvā ca bhrukuṭiṃ vaktre krodhasya pratilakṣaṇam
aśobhanta raṇe yodhāḥ puṣpitā iva kiṃśukāḥ
na dhvajo nārjunastatra na ratho na ca keśavaḥ
kvāsi pārtha na paśyāmi kaccijjīvasi śatruhan
praḍīnāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ kāle vṛkṣebhya iva māriṣa
rajaśca cāpyabhavaddurgā kabandhaśatasaṅkulā tadbabhau raudrabībhatsaṃ bībhatsoryānamāhave
ākrīḍamiva rudrasya ghnataḥ kālātyaye paśūn kate vadhyamānāḥ pārthena vyākulāśvarathadvipāḥ
tamevābhimukhāḥ kṣīṇāḥ śakrasyātithitāṃ gatāḥ sā bhūmīrbharataśreṣṭha nihataistairmahārathaiḥ
āstīrṇā sambabhau sarvā pretībhūtaiḥ samantataḥ etasminnantare caiva pramatte savyasācini
vyūḍhānīkastato droṇo yudhiṣṭhiramupādravat taṃ pratyagṛhṇaṃstvaritā vyūḍhānīkāḥ prahāriṇaḥ
pariṇāmya niśāṃ tāṃ tu bhāradvājo mahārathaḥ
uktvā subahu rājendra vacanaṃ vai suyodhanam
niṣkrānte ca tadā pārthe saṃśaptakavadhaṃ prati
vyūḍhāṃ dṛṣṭvā suparṇena bhāradvājasya tāṃ camūm
kaliṅgāḥ siṃhalāḥ prācyāḥ śūrā bhīrā daśerakāḥ
śakā yavanakāmbhojāstathā haṃsapathāśca ye grīvāyāṃ śūrasenāśca darandā madrakekayāḥ
na hi śakto raṇe droṇo vijetuṃ māṃ kathañcana
sa hi jāto mahārāja droṇasya nidhanaṃ prati
tataḥ kiranniṣūṃstīkṣṇāndrupadasya varūthinīm bharādvājo yayau tūrṇaṃ pārṣataṃ varjayanyudhi
taṃ tu samprekṣya putraste durmukhaḥ śatrukarṣaṇaḥ
pārṣatasya ca śūrasya durmukhasya ca bhārata
naiva khaṃ na diśo bhūmirbabhāse na ca bhāskaraḥ naiva sve na pare rājannājñāyanta parasparam
āhatā sahasā bhūmiścakampe ca nanāda ca
jaghānātra pitā putraṃ putraśca pitaraṃ tathā
tataḥ satyajitaścāpaṃ chittvā droṇo vṛkasya ca
sa tanna mamṛṣe droṇaḥ pāñcālyenārdito mṛdhe
raudrā hastavatā muktāḥ pramathnanti sma sāyakāḥ
te droṇaṃ sahitāḥ śūrāḥ sarvataḥ pratyavārayan
tato droṇaḥ satyasandhaḥ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ
sa madhyaṃ prāpya sainyānāṃ sarvāḥ pravicarandiśaḥ
taṃ droṇaḥ sadhanuṣkaṃ tu sāśvayantāramākṣiṇot sa hataḥ prāpatadbhūmau rathājjyotirivāmbarāt
hatvā taṃ vibabhau droṇaḥ kurubhiḥ parivāritaḥ
sāśvaṃ ca samare rājanhato vai prāpatatkṣitau
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā kṣatriyāṇāṃ yaśaskarīm
sa hi vīronnataḥ śūro yo bhagneṣu nivartate
yathā tu bhagnā droṇena vāteneva mahādrumāḥ
na cāpi pāṇḍavā yuddhe bhajyeranniti me matiḥ
smaramāṇā na hāsyanti saṅgrāmamiti me matiḥ
kokā iva mahānāgaṃ mā vai hanyuryatavratam
sarveṣāmeva me brūhi rathacihvāni sañjaya ye droṇamabhyavartanta kruddhā bhīmapurogamāḥ
dūyate me manastāta droṇaṃ prati parantapam
taṃ virāṭo'nvayācchīghraṃ saha sarvairmahārathaiḥ kekayāśca sikhaṇḍī ca dhṛṣṭaketustathaiva ca
ekastu dhārtarāṣṭrebhyaḥ pāṇḍavānyaḥ samāśritaḥ taṃ bṛhanto mahākāyā yuyutsumavahanraṇe
ūhuḥ sutumule yuddhe hayā hṛṣṭāḥ svalaṅkṛtāḥ
astrāṇāṃ ca dhanurvede brāhme vede ca pāragam
rājānaṃ rocamānaṃ te hayāḥ saṅkhye samāvahan
aśvaiśca dhanuṣā caiva śuklaiḥ śuklo nyavartata
yaṃ tu sarvamanuṣyebhyaḥ prāhuḥ śūrataraṃ nṛpam
keśave na hate saṅkhye pitaryatha narādhipe
bhinne kapāṭe pāṇḍānāṃ vidruteṣu ca bandhuṣu
iyeṣa dvārakāṃ hantuṃ kṛtsnāṃ jetuṃ ca medinīm
ete cānye ca bahavo dhvajā hemavibhūṣitāḥ
yukta eva hi bhāgyena dhruvamutpadyate naraḥ
sa tathā''kṛṣyate tena na yathā svayamicchati
arthe me kekayā labdhāḥ kāśikā kosalāścaye
pṛthivī bhūyasī tāta mama pārthasya no tathā
duryodhanena tatsarvaṃ prāptaṃ sūta mayā saha
nṛśaṃsaṃ tu paraṃ tāta tyaktvā duryodhanaṃ yadi
putraśeṣaṃ cikīrṣeyaṃ kṛtsnaṃ na maraṇaṃ vrajet
yo hi dharmaṃ parityajya bhavatyarthaparo naraḥ
avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi kakude mṛdite sati
vyaktameva ca me śaṃsa yathā yuddhamavartata
dhanuñjayaṃ ca me śaṃsa yadyaccakre ratharṣabhaḥ
māmakānāṃ ca ye śūrāḥ ke kāṃstatra nyavārayan
kṛtavarmā śineḥ pautraṃ droṇaṃ prepsuṃ viśāmpate
kṛtavarmā ca śaineyaṃ matto mattamiva dvipam
tathaiva rājā bāhlīko rājānaṃ drupadaṃ śaraiḥ
taṃ kruddhaṃ prativivyādha prativindhyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
sa lakṣmaṇasyeṣvasanaṃ chittvā lakṣma ca bhārata
vidhūya tadbāṇajālaṃ babhau tava suto balī
tasya taddhi babhau vaktraṃ sanālamiva paṅkajam
sa ca tāṃśchādayāmāsa śarajālaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ
naiva karṇo na te pañca dadṛśarbāṇasaṃvṛtāḥ
tayostasya ca tadyuddhamatyadbhutamivābhavat siṃhasya dvipamukhyābhyāṃ prabhinnābhyāṃ yathā vane
vārdhakṣemiṃ tu vārṣṇeyaṃ kṛpaḥ śāradvataḥ śaraiḥ
rathaṃ ca svaṃ samāsthāya dhanurādāya cāparam
padātīnāṃ ca bhadraṃ te tava teṣāṃ ca saṅkule
naitādṛśo dṛṣṭapūrvaḥ saṅgrāmo naiva ca śrutaḥ
sa nāga iva nāgena govṛṣeṇeva govṛṣaḥ
te gajā girisaṅkāśāḥ kṣarantaḥ sarvato madam
bhallābhyāṃ kārmukaṃ caiva kṣipraṃ ciccheda pāṇḍavaḥ
punargātrāṇi nāgasya praviveśa vṛkodaraḥ yāvatpratigajāyātaṃ svabalaṃ pratyavaikṣata
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā hataṃ matvā vṛkodaram
taṃ rathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhāḥ parivārya parantapāḥ
sa kuñjarastho rathibhiḥ śuśubhe sarvato vṛtaḥ
śineḥ pautrasya tu rathaṃ parigṛhya mahādvipaḥ
tamekaṃ dviradaṃ saṅkhye menire śataśo dvipān
putrastu tava sambhrāntaḥ saubhadrasyāpluto ratham sa kuñjarastho visṛjanniṣūnariṣu pārthivaḥ
sa nāgarājaḥ pravarāṅkuśāhataḥ purā sapakṣo'drivaro yathā nṛpa
bhayaṃ tadā ripuṣu samādadhadbhṛśaṃ vaṇigjanānāṃ kṣubhito yathā'rṇavaḥ
kṣitiṃ viyad dyāṃ vidiśo diśastathā samāvṛṇotpārthivasaṃyuge tataḥ
sa tena nāgapravareṇa pārthivo bhṛśaṃ jagāhe dviṣatāmanīkinīm
bhṛśaṃ vavau jvalanasakho viyadrajaḥ samāvṛṇonmuhurapi caiva sainikān
tamekanāgaṃ gaṇaśo yathā gajān samantato drutamatha menire janāḥ
rajo dṛṣṭvā samudbhūtaṃ śrutvā ca gajaniḥsvanam
siṃhanādaṃ mahatkṛtvā dhanurbāṇaravaiḥ saha vidrāvyamāṇaṃ sampaśya hatabhūyiṣṭhanāyakam
dṛṣṭvā vinadya sahasā mama senāṃ pramṛdgati
iha vā vinivarteyaṃ gaccheyaṃ vā yudhiṣṭhiram
naiva kuntīsutaḥ pārtho naiva kṛṣṇo janārdanaḥ
na hayā na ratho rājandṛśyante sma śaraiścitāḥ
duṣkaraṃ samare yatte kṛtamadyeti me matiḥ
iti me tvaṃ mataṃ vetsi tatra kiṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet
tathā vikṣobhyamāṇā sā pārthena tava vāhinī
matiṃ kṛtvā raṇe krūrāṃ vīrā jayaparājaye
kalpitābhyāṃ yathāśāstraṃ rathena ca gajena ca
sa cāpi śaravarṣaṃ taṃ śaravarṣeṇa vāsivaḥ
sa tathā śaravarṣeṇa pārthaṃ samabhihatya vai
prāgjyotiṣo vā pārthasya tanme śaṃsa yathātatham
tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā parivāraṃ nihatya ca
śīrṇavarmā sa tu gajaḥ śaraiḥ subhṛśamarditaḥ
tataśchatraṃ dhvajaṃ caiva cchittvā rājño'rjunaḥ śaraiḥ
ityuktvā puṇḍarīkākṣa pratijñāṃ svāṃ na rakṣasi
yadyahaṃ vyasanī vā syāmaśakto vā nivāraṇe
tatastvayaivaṃ kāryaṃ syānna tu kāryaṃ mayi sthite
sa saṅgatya tayā sārdhaṃ prītastasyā varaṃ dadau
sā vavre viṣṇusadṛśaṃ putramastraṃ ca vaiṣṇavam
babhūva ca sutastasyā narako nāma viśrutaḥ
astraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ tasmai dadau nārāyaṇaḥ svayam
jahi prāgjyotiṣaṃ kṣipraṃ vākyaśeṣaṃ ca me śṛṇu
ekā mūrtistapaścaryāṃ kurute me bhuvi sthitā
taṃ tu kālamanuprāptaṃ viditvā pṛthivī tadā
avocaṃ caitadastraṃ vai hyamoghaṃ bhavatu kṣame
avadhyo'yaṃ mahāstreṇa bhagadattaḥ surāsuraiḥ vairiṇaṃ jahi durdharṣaṃ bhagadattaṃ suradviṣam
sa samāsādya taṃ nāgaṃ bāṇo vajra ivācalam
sa tu viṣṭabhya gātrāṇi dantābhyāmavaniṃ yayau
śarāsanaṃ śarāṃścaiva gatāsuḥ pramumoca ha śirasastasya vibhraṣṭaṃ papāta ca varāṃśukam
tau sametyārjunaṃ vīrau puraḥ paścācca dhanvitau
yaśo daśaḥ diśaḥ puṇyaṃ gamayitvā vyavasthitau
evaṃ bahuvidhā māyāḥ saubalasya kṛtāḥ kṛtāḥ
sā hanyamānā pārthena tava putrasya vāhinī
gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣaḥ śruto dakṣiṇato mayā
yaudhiṣṭhirābhyanīkāni praharanti tatastataḥ nānāvidhānyanīkāni putrāṇāṃ tava bhārata
te hanyamānāḥ pārthena tvadīyā vyathitā bhṛśam
śalabhā iva sampetuḥ saṃvṛṇvānā diśo daśa
pitā sutaṃ tyajati suhṛdvaraṃ suhṛt tathaiva putraḥ pitaraṃ śarāturaḥ
svarakṣaṇe kṛtamatayastadā janā satyajanti vāhānapi pārthapīḍitāḥ
teṣvanīkeṣu bhagneṣu pāṇḍuputreṇa sañjaya - - bcalitānāṃ drutānāṃ ca kathamāsīnmanāṃsi vaḥ
droṇaṃ droṇamiti hyeke mā droṇamiti cāpare
droṇena caratā saṅkhye prabhagnāni śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
naiva tasyopamā kāciditi me niścitā matiḥ
mayaikena hi yudhyasva kruddhaḥ prahara cāśu mām
dhanurdhvajaṃ ca cchatraṃ ca dviṣataḥ sannyakṛntata
dakṣiṇena tu senāyāḥ kurute kadanaṃ balī
so'bhyāhanadguruṃ ṣaṣṭyā karṇaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
droṇaṃ pañcāśateṣūṇāṃ karṇaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
babhramuḥ samare nāgā mṛdrantaḥ śataśo narān
hanti smātra pitā putraṃ rathenābhyetya saṃyuge
hā tāta hā putra sakhe kvāsi tiṣṭha kva dhāvasi praharāhara jahmenaṃ smitaśveḍitagarjitaiḥ
tataḥ senāpatiḥ śīghramayaṃ krāla iti bruvan
tato droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo drauṇī rājā jayadrathaḥ
śarārtā na jahurdroṇaṃ pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavai saha
tasya dīptaśaraughasya dīptacāpadharasya ca vāruṇena tadastreṇa vidhūyātha dhanañjayaḥ
te nikṛttāyughāḥ śūrā nirviṣā bhujagā iva
jahāra sadyo bhallena vipāṭasya śiro rathāt
bhallābhyāṃ sādhu muktābhyāṃ chittvā karṇasya kārmukam
tato duryodhano droṇo rājā caiva jayadrathaḥ
padātirathanāgāśvā gajāśvarathapattibhiḥ rathino nāgapattyaśvairatha pattīratha dvipaiḥ
gajairgajā rathibhirudāyudhā rathā hayairhayāḥ pattigaṇaiśca pattayaḥ
pramodane śvāpadapakṣirakṣasāṃ janakṣaye vartati tatra dāruṇe
tato bale bhṛśalulite parasparaṃ nirīkṣamāṇe rudhiraughasamplute
divākare'staṃgirimāsthite śanai rubhe prayāte śibirāya bhārata
droṇe ca moghasaṅkalpe rakṣite ca yudhiṣṭhire
icchataste na mucyeta cakṣuḥprāpto raṇe ripuḥ
nārhase māṃ tathā jñātuṃ ghaṭamānaṃ tava priye
nālaṃ lokā raṇe jetuṃ pālyamānaṃ kirīṭinā
na hyajñātamasādhyaṃ vā tasya saṅkhye'sti kiñcana
tato'rjunasyātha paraiḥ sārdhaṃ samabhavadraṇaḥ tādṛśo yādṛśo nānyaḥ śruto dṛṣṭopi vā kvacit
sa kṛtvā duṣkaraṃ karma hatvā vīrānsahasraśaḥ
mahārathaṃ śalyaputraṃ pautraṃ te lakṣmaṇaṃ tathā ṣaṭsu vīreṣu saṃsakto dauḥśāsanivaśaṃ gataḥ
na bhūto bhavitā vāpi kṛṣṇasya sadṛśaḥ pumān
nakule tvābhirūpyaṃ ca śauryaṃ ca niyatāni ṣaṭ
ye ca kṛṣṇe guṇāḥ sphītāḥ pāṇḍaveṣu ca ye guṇāḥ
abhimanyau kilaikasthā dṛśyante te guṇāḥ śubhāḥ
raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā bhṛśaṃ me dīryate manaḥ
sthiro bhava mahārāja śokaṃ dhāraya durdharam
pārśvataḥ sindhurājasya vyarājanta mahārathāḥ tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam
tāvakānāṃ pareṣāṃ ca mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam
ete cānye ca sagaṇāḥ kṛtāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ
na śekuḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ bhāradvājasya pāṇḍavāḥ
aśakyaṃ tu tamanyena droṇaṃ mattvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
etya no nārjuno garhedyathā tāta tathā kuru
droṇānīkasya na vayaṃ vidmo bhedaṃ kathañcana
tvaṃ vā'rjuno vā kṛṣṇo vā bhindyātpradyumna eva vā
abhimanyo varaṃ tāta yāce tvāṃ dātumarhasi
pitṝṇāṃ mātulānāṃ ca sainyānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ
vayaṃ tvā'nugamiṣyāmo yena tvaṃ tāta yāsyasi
dhanañjayasamaṃ yuddhe tvāṃ vayaṃ tāta saṃyute
sakṛdbhinnaṃ tvayā vyūhaṃ tatra tatra punaḥ punaḥ
mātulasya ca yatprītiṃ kariṣyati pituśca me
nāhaṃ pārthena jātaḥ syāṃ na ca jātaḥ subhadrayā
yadi me saṃyuge kaścijjīvito nādya mucyate
evaṃ te bhāṣamāṇasya balaṃ saubhadra vardhatām
ācāryo hi kṛtī droṇaḥ paramāstre kṛtaśramaḥ
sārathe konvayaṃ droṇaḥ samagraṃ kṣatrameva vā
yodhayeyaṃ raṇamukhe na me kṣatre'dya vismayaḥ
api viśvajitaṃ viṣṇuṃ mātulaṃ prāpya sūtaja
vīra te tena mā yuddhamiti saubhadramabravīt
te hanyamānā vivaśā nānāliṅgaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
dviṣacchirobhiḥ pṛthivīṃ sa vai tastāra phālguniḥ
nikṛttacarmakavacāñśakṛnmūtrāsṛgāplutān nipātayannaśvavarāṃstāvakānsa vyarocata eko viṣṇurivācintyaṃ kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
evamekena tāṃ senāṃ saubhadreṇa sitaiḥ śaraiḥ
purā'bhimanyurlakṣaṃ naḥ paśyatāṃ hanti vīryavān tamādravata mābhaiṣṭa kṣipraṃ rakṣata kauravam
evamuktāstatastena bhāradvājena dhīmatā kṛtajñānabalotsedhāḥ suhṛdo jitakāśinaḥ
droṇo drauṇiḥ kṛpaḥ karṇaḥ kṛtavarmā ca saubalaḥ
tato rathapadātyoghāḥ kuñjarāḥ sādinaśca ha kopitāstena śūreṇa śarairāśīviṣopamaiḥ
tataḥ karṇaḥ kṛpo droṇo drauṇirgāndhārarāṭ śalaḥ śalyo bhūriśravāḥ krāthaḥ somadatto viviṃśatiḥ
tasya bhittvā tanutrāṇaṃ dehaṃ nirbhidya cāśugaḥ
aśvatthāmā ca viṃśatyā kṛtavarmā ca saptabhiḥ
taṃ hi dṛṣṭvā tathā viddhaṃ saubhadreṇa yaśāsvinā
ārjuniṃ māmakāḥ saṅkhye ke tvenaṃ samavārayan
cakraṃ yugaṃ ca tūṇīraṃ hyanukarṣaṃ sāyakaiḥ
laghuhastaḥ praciccheda dadṛśe taṃ na kaścana
yo yosmai prāharatpūrvaṃ taṃ taṃ vivyādha patribhiḥ
dūramasya guruṃ bhāraṃ sādhvasaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
dvaidhībhavati me cittaṃ śucā tuṣṭyā ca sañjaya
vistareṇaiva me śaṃsa sarvaṃ gāvalgaṇe punaḥ
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca yathāsīttumulo raṇaḥ
droṇaṃ karṇaṃ kṛpaṃ śalyaṃ drauṇiṃ bhojaṃ bṛhadbalam
eṣa gacchati saubhadraḥ pārthānāṃ prathito yuvā
nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca bhīmasenaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
nāsya yuddhe samaṃ manye kañcidanyaṃ dhanurdharam
ārjuniṃ prati saṅkruddho droṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā smayanniva
kimaṅga punarevānyo martyaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ
miṣatāṃ pāṇḍu putrāṇāṃ pāñcālānāṃ ca paśyatām
tau ca śrutvā mṛtau vyaktaṃ pāṇḍoḥ kṣetrodbhavāḥ sutāḥ
śivena māṃ dhyāhi rājanneṣa hanmi ripūṃstava
amarṣitāyāḥ kṛṣṇāyāḥ kāṅkṣitasya ca me pituḥ adya kauravya bhīmasya bhavitāsmyanṛṇo yudhi
na hi me mokṣyase jīvanyadi notsṛjase raṇaṃ
tasyorastūrṇamāsādya jatrudeśe vibhidya tam jagāma saha puṅkhena valmīkamiva pannagaḥ athainaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā punareva samārpayat
śarairagnisamasparśairākarṇasamacoditaiḥ sa gāḍhaviddho vyathito rathopastha upāviśat duḥśāsano mahārāja kaśmalaṃ cāviśanmahat
paśya duḥśāsanaṃ vīramabhimanyuvaśaṃgatam pratapantamivādityaṃ nighnantaṃ śātravānraṇe
atha caite susaṃrabdhāḥ siṃhā iva balotkaṭāḥ
vāditrāṇi ca sañjaghnaḥ saubhadraṃ cāpi tuṣṭuvuḥ
karṇikāramivādhūtaṃ vātenāpatitaṃ nagāt karṇānujaṃ ca samprekṣya tāvakā vyathitā'bhavan
tiṃṣṭha karṇa maheṣvāsa kṛpa duryodhaneti ca
tāvakānāṃ tu yodhānāṃ vadhyatāṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
te ghorā raudrakarmāṇo vipāṭhā bahavaḥ śitāḥ
sa śabdo bharataśceṣṭha diśaḥ sarvā vyanādayat
taṃ tadā nānupaśyāmaḥ sainye ca rajasā''vṛte
kṣamena bhūyaḥ paśyāmaḥ sūryaṃ madhyaṃdine yathā
tenaiva tu pathā yāntaḥ pitaro mātulaiḥ saha
atyadbhutamahaṃ manye balaṃ śauryaṃ ca saindhave
tasya prabrūhi me vīryaṃ karma cāgryaṃ mahātmanaḥ
kiṃ japtaṃ hutamiṣṭaṃ vā kiṃ sutaptamatho tapaḥ
damo vā brahmacaryaṃ vā sūta yaccāsya sattama
evamuktastu deveśo jayadrathamathābravīt dadāmi te varaṃ saumya vinā pārthaṃ dhanañjayam
dṛṣṭvā tu kṣatriyā bhāraṃ saindhave sarvamāhitam
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭyā virāṭaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
dhanurdhvajaṃ ca cchatraṃ ca kṣitau kṣipramapātayat
yo yo hi yatate bhettuṃ droṇānīkaṃ tavāhitaḥ
teṣāṃ tasya ca sammardo dāruṇaḥ samapadyata
abravīcca na me jīvañjīvato yudhi mokṣyase
vivyādha hṛdi saubhadraḥ sa papāta vyasuḥ kṣitau
sa śakra iva vikrāntaḥ śakrasūnoḥ suto balī
alaṃ trāsena vaḥ śūrā naiṣa kaścinmayi sthite
tribhiśca dakṣiṇe bāhau savye ca niśitaistribhiḥ
dṛṣṭvā rukmarathaṃ rugṇaṃ putraṃ śalyasya māninam
sasūtāśvadhvajaṃ tasya syandanaṃ taṃ ca māriṣa
prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ saṅkhye preṣitā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
yathā vadasi me sūta ekasya bahubhiḥ saha
saṅgrāmaṃ tumulaṃ ghoraṃ jayaṃ caiva mahātmanaḥ
kintu nātyadbhutaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ dharmo vyapāśrayaḥ
abhyadhāvansusaṅkruddhāḥ saubhadramaparājitam te tu pautreṇa te rājanprāyaśo vimukhīkṛtāḥ
pautraṃ tava ca durdharṣaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ priyadarśanam
atyantasukhasaṃvṛddhaṃ dhaneśvarasutopamam āsasāda raṇe kārṣṇirmatto mattamiva dvipam
sudṛṣṭaḥ kriyatāṃ loko hyamuṃ lokaṃ gamiṣyasi
tato duryodhanaḥ kruddhaḥ priye putre nipātite
tato droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo droṇaputro bṛhadbalaḥ
āvavrustasya panthānaṃ gajānīkena daṃśitāḥ kaliṅgāśca niṣādāśca krāthaputraśca vīryavān
tataḥ kruddhāḥ śaravrātai rājānaḥ samavārayan athetare sannivṛttāḥ punardroṇamukhā rathāḥ
taṃ tu droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo drauṇiśca sabṛhadbalaḥ
karṇaṃ ca karṇinā karṇe pītena ca śitena ca
sa tu bāṇaiḥ śitaistūrṇaṃ pratyavidhyata māriṣa
babhañja ca sahasrāṇi daśa rājñāṃ mahātmanām
sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe punarvivyādha phālguniḥ
karṇaṃ cāpyakarotkruddho rudhirotpīḍavāhinam karṇo'pi vibabhau śūraḥ śaraiśchinno'sṛgātapluḥ
pitā tavāhavaṃ tyaktvā gataḥ kāpuruṣo yathā
diṣṭyā tvamapi jānīṣe yoddhuṃ na tvadya mokṣyase
sarva enaṃ vimathnīmaḥ puraikaikaṃ hinasti naḥ
anvasya pitaraṃ cādya carataḥ sarvato diśam
antaraṃ yasya saṃrabdhā na paśyanti mahārathāḥ asyato laghuhastasya diśaḥ sarvā maheṣubhiḥ
śakyaṃ tvasya dhanuśchettuṃ jyāṃ ca bāṇaiḥ samāhitaiḥ
raṇe'bhimanyuḥ kṣaṇamāsa raudraḥ sa vāsudevānukṛtiṃ prakurvan
punaścaiva vasātīyāñjaghāna rathino daśa kekayānāṃ rathānsapta hatvā ca daśa kuñjarān
taṃ tathā patitaṃ śūraṃ tāvakāḥ paryavārayan
dāvaṃ dagdhvā yathā śāntaṃ pāvakaṃ śiśirātyaye
pūrṇacandrābhavadanaṃ kākapakṣavṛtālikam taṃ bhūmau patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāvakāste mahārathāḥ
eko'yaṃ nihataḥ śete naiṣa dharmo mato hi naḥ
svargameṣa gataḥ śūro yo hato na parāṅmukhaḥ
rathāśvanaramātaṅgānvinihatya sahasraśaḥ avitṛptaḥ sa saṅgrāmādaśocyaḥ puṇyakarmakṛt
vayaṃ tu pravaraṃ hatvā teṣāṃ taiḥ śarapīḍitāḥ
tato niśāyā divasasya cāśivaḥ śivārutaiḥ sandhiravartatādbhutaḥ
atīva hṛṣṭāḥ śvaśṛgālavāyasā bakāḥ suparṇāśca vṛkāstarakṣavaḥ
vayāṃsyasṛkpānyatha rakṣasāṃ gaṇāḥ piśācasaṅghāśca sudāruṇā raṇe
tvaco vinirbhidya pibanvasāmasṛk tathaiva majjāḥ piśitāni cāśnuvan
vapāṃ vilumpanti hasanti gānti ca prakarṣamāṇāḥ kuṇapānyanekaśaḥ
bhayāvahā vaitaraṇīva dustarā pravartitā yodhavaraistadā nadī
uvāha madhyena raṇājire bhṛśaṃ bhayāvahā dīnamṛtapravāhinī
pibanti ca snānti ca yatra durdṛśāḥ piśācasaṅghāstu nadanti bhairavāḥ
raṇe'bhimanyuṃ dadṛśustadā janā vyapoḍhahavyaṃ sadasīva pāvakam
abhimanyau hate vīre bhrātuḥ putre mahārathe
enaṃ jitvā kṛpaṃ śalyaṃ rājānaṃ ca suyodhanam
vikrīḍitaṃ raṇe tena nighnatā vai parānvarān
yo hi bhojye puraskāryo yāneṣu śayaneṣu ca
na me jayaḥ prītikaro na rājyaṃ na cāmaratvaṃ na suraiḥ salokatā
mayā proktaḥ sa saṅgrāme dvāraṃ sañjanayasva naḥ
ta ete nihatāḥ saṅkhye tulyarūpā narairnarāḥ
naiṣāṃ paśyāmi hantāraṃ prāṇināṃ saṃyuge kvacit
jetavyamiti cānyonyaṃ yeṣāṃ nityaṃ hṛdi sthitam
atha ceme hatāḥ prājñāḥ śerate vigatāyuṣaḥ
mṛtā iti ca śabdoyaṃ vartate ca tato'rthavat
atra me saṃśayaḥ prāptaḥ kutaḥ saṃjñā mṛtā iti kasya mṛtyuḥ kuto mṛtyuḥ kena mṛtyurimāḥ prajāḥ
purā kṛtayuge tāta āsīdrājā hyakampanaḥ sa śatruvaśamāpanno madhye saṅgrāmamūrdhani
sa dṛṣṭvā pitaraṃ yuddhe tadavasthaṃ mahādyutiḥ
parānīkaṃ vibhidyājau mokṣayitvā ca taṃ nṛpam
sa karma duṣkaraṃ kṛtvā saṅgrāme śatrutāpanaḥ
sa rājā pretakṛtyāni tasya kṛtvā śucānvitaḥ
sa tu rājā mahābhāgo dṛṣṭvā devarṣisattamam
śatrubhirvijayaṃ saṅkhye putrasya ca vadhaṃ tathā
śṛṇu me prāṇināṃ cāpi mṛtyuḥ prabhavate kila ka eṣa mṛtyurbhagavankiṃvīryabalapauruṣaḥ
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nārado varadaḥ prabhuḥ
prajāḥ sṛṣṭā tadā brahmā ādisarge pitāmahaḥ
tasya cintā samutpannā saṃhāraṃ prati pārthiva
tena sarvā diśo vyāptāḥ sāntardeśā didhakṣatā
tato hatāni bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca mahatā krodhavegena trāsayanniva vīryavān
kiṃ karma kāmaṃ kāmārha kāmājjāto'si putraka
kariṣyāmi priyaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi sthāṇo yadicchasi
tā dṛṣṭvā mama kāruṇyaṃ prasīda bhagavanprabho
saṃhartuṃ na ca me kāma etadevaṃ bhavediti
pṛthivyā hitakāmaṃ tu tato māṃ manyurāviśat
iyaṃ sannā tadā devī bhārārtā samacūcudat
palvalāni ca sarvāṇi sarvai caiva tṛṇolapāḥ
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva niḥśeṣaṃ kurute jagat
prasīda bhagavansa tvaṃ roṣo na syādvaro mama
sarve hi sṛṣṭā naśyanti tava deva kathaṃcana
abhāvaṃ neha gaccheyurutsannajananāḥ prajāḥ bhavatā hi niyukto'haṃ prānāṃ pālane vibhā
dayā te na samutpannā prajāsu vibudheśvara
śrutvā hi vacanaṃ devaḥ prajānāṃ hitakāraṇe
pravṛttaṃ ca nivṛttaṃ ca kalpayāmāsa vai prabhuḥ
sā niḥsṛtya tathā khebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritā
tāṃ tu tatra tadā devīṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ uktavānmadhuraṃ vākyaṃ sāntvayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
mṛtyo iti mahīpāla jahi cemāḥ prajā iti
tvaṃ hi saṃhārabuddhyā'tha prādurbhūtā ruṣo mama
aviśeṣeṇa caiva tvaṃ prajāḥ saṃhara bhāmini
mama tvaṃ hi niyogena tataḥ śreyo hyavāpsyāsi
evamuktā tu sā tena mṛtyuḥ kamalalocanā
tvayā sṛṣṭā kathaṃ nārī īdṛśī vadatāṃ vara
yamasya bhavanaṃ deva gaccheyaṃ na surottama
pradiśemaṃ varaṃ deva tvaṃ mahyaṃ bhagavanprabho
na hi śakṣyāmi deveśa prāṇānprāṇabhṛtāṃ priyān
gaccha saṃhara sarvāstvaṃ prajā mā te vicāraṇā
bhava tvaninditā loke kuruṣva vacanaṃ mama
sā tatra paramaṃ tīvraṃ cacāra vratamuttamam
sā tada hyekapādena tasthau padmāni ṣoḍaśa
tasthau padmāni ṣaṭ caiva sapta caikaṃ ca pārthivā
tataḥ padmāyutaṃ tāta mṛgaiḥ saha cacāra sā
apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṃ ca sā'nayat
sā pūrvaṃ kauśikīṃ puṇyāṃ jagāma niyamaidhitā
saptagaṅgāsu sā puṇyā kanyā vetasakeṣu ca
tato gatvā tu sā gaṅgāṃ mahāmeruṃ ca kevalam
tatrāṅguṣṭhena sā tasthau nikharvaṃla paramā śubhā
ārtā cānāgasī nārī yācāmi bhava me gatiḥ
adharmo nāsti te mṛtyo saṃharantyā imāḥ prajāḥ
mayā coktaṃ mṛṣā bhadre bhavitā na kathañcana
ahaṃ ca vibudhāścaiva punardāsyāma te varam
tavājñā mūrdhni me nyastā yatte vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu
tathā bhaviṣyate mṛtyo sādhu saṃhara bhoḥ prajāḥ
yānyaśrubindūni kare mamāsaṃ-- ste vyādhayaḥ prāṇināmātmajātāḥ
te mārayiṣyanti narāngatāsū-- nnādharmaste bhavitā mā sma bhaiṣīḥ
nādharmaste bhavitā prāṇināṃ vai tvaṃ vai dharmastvaṃ hi dharmasya ceśā
prāptā tathā no bhavitā kadāci-- devaṃ mayādyaiva niyojyase tvam
sarveṣāṃ vai prāṇināṃ kāmaroṣau santyajya tvaṃ saṃharasveha jīvān yeṣāṃ dharmāste bhaviṣyantyanantā mithyāvṛttaṃ mārayiṣyatyadharmaḥ
tasmātkāmaṃ roṣamapyāgataṃ tvaṃ santyajyāntaḥ saṃharasveti jīvān
sā vai bhīmā mṛtyusaṃjñopadeśā-- cchāpādbhītā bāḍhamityabravīttam
sā ca prāṇaṃ prāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau tyajya haratyasaktā
mṛtyustveṣāṃ vyādhayastatprasūtā vyādhī rogo rujyate yena jantuḥ
sarveṣāṃ ca prāṇināṃ prāyaṇānte tasmācchokaṃ mākṛthā niṣphalaṃ tvam
sarve devāḥ prāṇibhiḥ prāyaṇānte gatvā vṛttāḥ sannivṛttāstathaiva
evaṃ sarve prāṇinastatra gatvā vṛttā devā martyavadrājasiṃha
vāyurbhīmo bhīmanādo mahaujā bhettā dehānprāṇināṃ sarvago'sau
sarve devā martyasaṃjñāviśiṣṭā-- stasmātputraṃ māśuco rājasiṃha
svargaṃ prāpto modate te tanūjo nityaṃ ramyānvīralokānavāpya
tyaktvā duḥkhaṃ saṅgataḥ puṇyakṛdbhi-- reṣā mṛtyurdevadiṣṭā prajānām
prāpte kāle saṃharantī yathāva-- tsvayaṃ kṛtā prāṇaharā prajānām
ātmānaṃ vai prāṇino ghnanti sarve naitānmṛtyurdaṇḍapāṇirhinasti
tasmānmṛtānnānuśocanti dhīrā mṛtyuṃ jñātvā niścayaṃ brahmasṛṣṭam itthaṃ sṛṣṭiṃ devaklṛptāṃ viditvā putrānnaṣṭācchokamāśu tyajasva
puṇyaṃ yaśasyaṃ svargyaṃ ca dhanyamāyuṣyameva ca
etadarthapadaṃ śrutvā tadā rājā yudhiṣṭhira kṣatradharmaṃ ca vijñāya śūrāṇāṃ ca parāṃ gatim
asinā gadayā śaktyā dhanuṣā ca mahārathaḥ
tasmātparāṃ dhṛtiṃ kṛtvā bhrātṛbhiḥ saha pāṇḍava
kiyantyo dakṣiṇā dattāḥ kāśca dattā mahātmabhiḥ
anyepi yajvanāṃ lokā anye cāpi tapasvinām
kṣatriyasya tuṃ saṅgrāme śatrūnhatvā hatasya vā
śaibyasya nṛpateḥ punaḥ sṛñjayo nāma nāmataḥ
uṣā svidbhāḥ svidarkasya jvalanasya śikhāpi vā
pūrvaṃ mamaiva manasā viddhi bhāryāṃ vṛtāmṛṣe
na tveṣāṃ niścitā niṣṭhā tvayā sā manasā smṛtā
evaṃ vidvāṃstu māṃ yasmādanuvyāhṛtavānasi tasmāttvamapi na svargaṃ gamiṣyasi mayā vinā
anyonyamevaṃ śaptvā vai tasthatustatra tau tadā
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te yādṛśaṃ putramīpsitam
tathoktaḥ prāñjalī rājā putraṃ vavre guṇānvitam
yasya mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca kledaḥ svedaśca kāñcanam
ruditasya ca netrābhyāmapatattasya netrajam mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ svedaśca sarvaṃ bhavati kāñcanam
atha dasyugaṇāḥ śrutvā dṛṣṭvā cainaṃ tathāvidham
hatvā viśasya cāpaśyam̐ llubdhā vasu na kiñcana
hatvā parasparaṃ naṣṭāḥ kumāraṃ cādbhutaṃ bhuvi
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ putraṃ varadattaṃ mahātapāḥ
tyaja śokaṃ mahārāja vaiklabyaṃ tyaja buddhiman
na mṛtaḥ śocato jīvenmuhyato vā narādhipa
tyaja śokaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha na śocanti bhavadvidhāḥ vīro bhavānmahārāja jñānavṛddho'pi me mataḥ
yasya caite vayaṃ gehe uṣitā brahmavādinaḥ
āvikṣitaṃ maruttaṃ ca mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
saṃvarto yājayāmāsa spardhayā vai bṛhaspateḥ yasmai rājarṣaye prādāddhanaṃ sa bhagavānprabhuḥ
yasya sendrāmaragaṇā bṛhaspatipurogamāḥ devā viśvasṛjaḥ sarve yajanānte samāsate
yasya sarvaṃ tadā hyannaṃ manobhiprāyagaṃ śuci kāmato bubhujurviprāḥ sarve cānnārthino dvijāḥ
payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ kṣaudraṃ bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca śobhanam
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca pitṝṇāṃ ca devānāṃ sukhajīvinam
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
suhotraṃ nāma rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
sammānya cātmanaḥ śreyaḥ pṛṣṭvā teṣāṃ mate sthitaḥ
aṅgaṃ ca pauravaṃ vīraṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
yaḥ sahasraṃ sahasrāṇi kanyā hemavibhūṣitāḥ dhūryujāśvagajārūḍhāḥ sagṛhakṣetragośatāḥ
hemaśṛṅgyo raupyakhurāḥ savatsāḥ kāṃsyadohanāḥ dāsīdāsakharoṣṭrāṃśca prādādājāvikaṃ bahu
ratnānāṃ vividhānāṃ ca vividhāṃścānnaparvatān tasminsaṃvitate yajñe dakṣiṇāmatyakālayat
tatrāsya gāthā gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ aṅgasya yajamānasya api viṣṇupade vayam
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
bibharti dakṣiṇā yasya gaṅgāyāḥ srota āvṛṇot
yāvatyo varṣato dhārā yāvatyo divi tārakāḥ
udanvati ca yāvanti ratnāni prāṇino'pi ca
akṣayaṃ dadato vittaṃ śraddhā kīrtistathā kriyāḥ
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ caiva mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma yaṃ prajā anvamodanta pitā putramivaurasam
rāmo hṛtāṃ rākṣasena bhāryāṃ śrutvā jaṭāyuṣaḥ
jaghāna sa mahābāhuḥ paulastyaṃ sagaṇaṃ raṇe
hatvā tatra ripuṃ saṅkhye bhāryayā saha saṅgataḥ
sa ca laṅkeśvaraṃ cakre dharmātmānaṃ vibhīṣaṇam
bhrātaraṃ bharataṃ vīraṃ śatrughnaṃ caiva lakṣmaṇam
sa nirgalaṃ mukhyatamamaśvamedhaśataṃ prabhuḥ ājahāra sureśasya haviṣā mudamāharan
atisarvāṇi bhūtāni rāmo dāśarathirbabhau ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca mānuṣāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
nāhīyata tadā prāmaḥ prāṇināṃ na tadā vyathā
dīrghāyuṣaḥ prajāḥ sarvā yuvā na mriyate tadā
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca vividhaṃ niṣpūrtaṃ hutameva ca
na ca jyeṣṭhāḥ kaniṣṭhebhyastadā śrāddhāni kurvate
caturvidhāḥ prajā rāmaḥ svargaṃ nītvā divaṃ gataḥ
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
bhagīrathaṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ
ratherathe śataṃ nāgāḥ sarve vai hemamālinaḥ
tāṃ tu gāthā jaguḥ prītā gandharvāḥ sūryavarcasaḥ
yo ya iccheta vipro vai yatrayatrātmanaḥ priyam
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
dilīpaṃ cāpi rājendra mṛtāṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
tantrajñānārthasampannā yajvānaḥ putrapautriṇaḥ svacchandāḥ puṇyagandhāśca subhakṣā hemamālinaḥ
rājāno vitate yajñe upahārānupāharan dilīpasya tu yajñeṣu kṛtaḥ panthā hiraṇmayaḥ
taṃ dharma iva kurvāṇāḥ sendrā devāḥ samāgaman
yatra vīṇāṃ vādayati prītyā viśvāvasuḥ svayam
pañca śabdā na jīryanti dilīpasya niveśane
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
yaṃ devāvaśvinau garbhe pituḥ pārśve cakarṣatuḥ
māmevāyaṃ dhayatvaṅga iti ha smāha vāsavaḥ
tatastu dhārāṃ payaso ghṛtasya ca mahātmanaḥ
imāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāmekāhnā sa vyajījayat
asitaṃ ca nṛgaṃ caiva māndhātā mānavo'jayat
udeti ca yataḥ sūryo yatra ca pratitiṣṭhati
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
yayātiṃ nāhuṣaṃ caiva mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ jitvā sasamudrāṃ saparvatām
sarasvatī puṇyatamā nadīnāṃ tathā samudrāḥ saritaḥ sādrayaśca
ījānāya puṇyatamāya rājñe ghṛtaṃ payo duduhurnāhuṣāya
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
śaraṇyamīyuḥ śaraṇaṃ tava sma iti vādinaḥ
sa tu tānvaśagānkṛtvā jitvā cemāṃ vasundharām
ghṛtaṃ madhu payastoyaṃ dadhīni rasavanti ca
tatra sma gāthā gāyanti kṣībā hṛṣṭāḥ paṭhanti ca
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
śaśibinduṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
kanyāṅkanyāṃ śataṃ nāgā nāgenāge śataṃ rathāḥ
śaśibindurimāṃ bhūmiṃ ciraṃ bhuktvā divaṃ gataḥ
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
tasmai hyagnirvaraṃ prādāttato vavre varaṃ gayaḥ
kanyāsu ca savarṇāsu suprajastvaṃ ca me bhavet
annamojo maho mahyaṃ dharme me ramatāṃ manaḥ
avighnaṃ cāstu me nityaṃ dharmakāryeṣu pāvaka
sauvarṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtvā ya imāṃ pramiśarkarām
nagareṣu ca rāṣṭreṣu divi vyomni ca ye'vasan
gayasya sadṛśo yajño nāstyanya iti te'bruvan
sa cenmamāra sañjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
sāṅkṛtiṃ rantidevaṃ ca mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
tubhyaṃ niṣkaṃ tubhyaṃ niṣkamiti ha sma prabhāṣate
ekāhnā tāmyati tataḥ kvādya viprā iti bruvan
tatrāsya gāthā gāyanti ye purāṇavido janāḥ
dhanaṃ ca pūryamāṇaṃ naḥ kiṃ punarmanujeṣviti
sūpaṃ bhūyiṣṭhamaśnīdhvaṃ nādya māṃsaṃ yathā purā
dauṣyanti bharataṃ cāpi mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
iṣṭvā śākuntalo rājā tarpayitvā dvijāndhanaiḥ sahasraṃ yatra padmānāṃ kaṇvāya bharato dadau
dāsī dāsaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gāḥ savatsāḥ payasvinīḥ
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ
puthuṃ vainyaṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ prajā dṛṣṭvā raktāḥ smeti yadabruvan
nyavasanta yathākāmaṃ vṛkṣeṣu ca guhāsu ca
taṃ vanaspatayaḥ śailā devāsuranaroragāḥ saptarṣayaḥ puṇyajanā gandharvāpsaraso'pi ca
samrāḍasi kṣatriyo'si rājā goptā pitā'si naḥ dehyasmabhyaṃ mahārāja prabhuḥ sannīpsitānvarān
kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi prajā rājanmayā vinā
ekasyārthāya yo hanyādātmano vā parasya vā
yadi cedvacanādadya na kariṣyasi me priyam
sañjīvaya prajā nityaṃ śaktā hyasi vasundhare
vatsaṃ tvaṃ paśya rājanvai kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā
samāṃ tu kuru sarvajña māṃ tu dharmabhṛtāṃ vara
yathā viṣyandamānaṃ vai kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvaye
na hi pūrvanisarge vai viṣame vasudhātale
pravibhāgaḥ purāṇāṃ vā grāmāṇāṃ vā mahīpate
na sasyāni na gorakṣyaṃ na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ
yatrayatra ca sāmyaṃ tu bhūmāvāsītkilānagha tatratatra prajāstāta nivāsamabhirocayan
ehyehi vasudhe kṣipraṃ kṣaraibhyaḥ kāṅkṣitaṃ payaḥ
vatsaṃ pātrāṇi dogdhṝṃśca kṣīrāṇi ca samādiśa
tato dāsyāmyahaṃ bhadra sarvaṃ yasya yathepsitam
dogdhā ca savitā devo dugdhamūrjaskaraṃ priyam
kṛṣiṃ ca sasyaṃ ca narā duduhuḥ pṛthivītale
alābupātre ca tathā viṣaṃ dugdhā vasundharā
dogdhā bṛhaspatiḥ pātraṃ chando vatsaśca somarāṭ
evaṃ nikāyaistairdugdhā payo'bhīṣṭaṃ hi sā virāṭ
sa ṣaṣṭiṃ gosahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭiṃ nāgaśatāni ca
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyatarastubhyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ ayajvānamadakṣiṇyamabhi śvaityetyudāharat
yaḥ kṣatriyaiḥ parāmṛṣṭe vatse pitari cābruvan
śiṣṭānvadhvā ca hatvā vai teṣāṃ mṛrdhni vibhidya ca guṇāvatīmuttareṇa khāṇḍavāddakṣiṇena ca
ayajvānamadakṣiṇyaṃ mā putramanutapyathāḥ ete caturbhadratarāstvayā bhadraśatādhikāḥ
tatte sampatsyate sarvaṃ na mṛṣāvādino vayam
na tu svargādayaṃ lokaḥ kāmyate svargavāsibhiḥ
yāṃ yogino dhyānaviviktadarśanāḥ prayānti yāṃ cottamayajvino janāḥ
tapobhiriddhairanuyānti yāṃ tathā tāmakṣayāṃ te tanayo gato gatim
evaṃ jñātvā sthiro bhūtvā mā śuco dhairyamāpnuhi
jīvanhi puruṣaḥ śocyo na tu svargagato'nagha
evaṃ vidvansamuttiṣṭha prayato bhava mā śucaḥ
sṛñjayasya tu putro'sau mṛtaḥ sañjīvitaḥ śrutaḥ
abhimanyau hate cāpi bāle balavatāṃ vare
maharṣisattame yāte vyāse sa tu yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
kathaṃ saṃśaptakebhyo vā nivṛtto vānaradhvajaḥ kena vā kathitastasya praśāntaḥ sutapāvakaḥ
yaccāsīnmānasaṃ tasya yacca kṛṣṇena bhāṣitam yathā ca kathitastasya nihataḥ sutapāvakaḥ
vistareṇaiva me sarvaṃ bruvataḥ śṛṇu māriṣa
kiṃ tu me hṛdayaṃ trastaṃ vākva sajjati keśava
maṅgalyāni ca gītāni na gāyanti paṭhanti ca
yodhāścāpi hi māṃ dṛṣṭvā nivartante hyadhomukhāḥ
karmāṇi ca yathāpūrvaṃ kṛtvā nābhivadanti mām
api svasti bhavedadya bhrātṛbhyo mama mādhava
na hi śuddhyati me bhāvo dṛṣṭvā svajanamākulam
sarveṣāṃ caiva yodhānāṃ sāmagryaṃ syānmamācyuta na ca māmadya saubhadraḥ prahṛṣṭo bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
evaṃ saṅkathayantau tau praviṣṭau śibiraṃ svakam
na cābhimanyuṃ paśyāmi na ca māṃ pratinandatha
na ca vastasya bhettā'sti vinā saubhadramarbhakam
sadā mama priyaṃ brūta kathamāyodhane hataḥ
subhadrāyāḥ priyaṃ putraṃ draupadyāḥ keśavasya ca
yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam
sveṣāṃ priyahite yuktaṃ pitṝṇāṃ jayagṛddhinam na ca pūrvaṃ prahartāraṃ samprame naṣṭasambhramam
yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam
pradyumnasya priyaṃ nityaṃ keśavasya mamaiva ca
yadi putraṃ na paśyāmi yāsyāmi yamasādanam
aśṛṇvataḥ svanaṃ tasya kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
apaśyato hi vīrasya kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
nādyāhaṃ yadi paśyāmi kā śāntirhṛdayasya me
bodhayantyadya taṃ nūnaṃ śvāpadā vikṛtaiḥ svanaiḥ
bhāgyahīnasya kālena yathā me nīyase balāt
sā ca saṃyamanī nūnaṃ sadā sukṛtināṃ gatiḥ
kathaṃ tvayi ca bhīme ca dhṛṣṭadyumne ca jīvati
athavā matprasūtaḥ sa svasrīyo mādhavasya ca
subhadrāyāṃ ca sambhūto na caivaṃ vaktumarhati
upayāntaṃ ripūnhatvā so'dya māṃ kiṃ na paśyati
nūnaṃ sa pātitaḥ śete dharaṇyāṃ rudhirokṣitaḥ
raṇe vinihataṃ śrutvā śokārtā vai vinaṅkṣati
draupadīṃ caiva duḥkhārtāṃ kiṃ vā vakṣyāmi tāmaham
kiṃ na lajjantyadharmajñāḥ pārthivā dṛśyatāṃ balam
āgamiṣyati vaḥ kṣipraṃ phalaṃ pāpasya karmaṇaḥ
putraśokārditaṃ pārthaṃ dhyāyantaṃ sāśrulocanam nigṛhya vāsudevastaṃ putrādhibhirabhiplutam
dharmakṛdbhiḥ kṛto dharmaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ raṇe kṣayaḥ
ime te bhrātaraḥ sarve dīnā bharatasattama
viditaṃ veditavyaṃ te na śokaṃ kartumarhasi
kṣipraṃ drakṣyanti te nūnaṃ mama putraṃ nihatya vai
kathaṃ ca vaḥ kṛtāstrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastrapāṇinām
kathaṃ ca vo rathasyānāṃ śaravarṣāṇi muñcatām
aho vaḥ pauruṣaṃ nāsti na ca vo'sti parākramaḥ
tamantakamiva kruddhaṃ niḥśvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ mahendramiva tiṣṭhantaṃ vajrodyatamahābhujam
na bhāṣituṃ śaknuvanti draṣṭuṃ vā suhṛdo'rjunam
te pīḍyamānā droṇena droṇānīkaṃ na śaknumaḥ
sa tathā codito'smābhiḥ sadaśva iva vīryavān
tato droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo drauṇiḥ kausalya eva ca
parivārya tu taiḥ sarvairyudhi bālo mahārathaiḥ
tato dauḥśāsaniḥ kṣipraṃ tathā tairvirathīkṛtam saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaṃ padātinamavasthitam
gataḥ sukṛtināṃ lokānye ca svargajitāṃ śubhāḥ
hā putra iti niḥśvasya vyathito nyapatadbhuvi
pāṇiṃ pāṇau viniṣpiṣya dantānkaṭakaṭāyya ca triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭīṃ kṛtvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
bhavantaṃ vā mahārāja śvo'smi hantā jayadratham
pāpaṃ bālavadhe hetuṃ śvo'smi hantā jayadratham
rakṣamāṇāśca taṃ saṅkhye ye māṃ yotsyanti kecana
ye lokā mātṛhantṝṇāṃ ye cāpi pitṛghātinām
gurudāragatānāṃ ye piśunānāṃ ca ye sadā
sādhūnasūyatāṃ ye ca ye cāpi parivādinām
ye ca nikṣepahantṝṇāṃ ye ca viśvāsaghātinām
brahmaghnānāṃ ca ye lokā ye ca goghātināmapi
pāyasaṃ vā yavānnaṃ vā śākaṃ kṛsarameva vā saṃyāvāpūpamāṃsāni ye ca lokā vṛthāśnatām
spṛśato brāhmaṇaṃ gāṃ ca pādenāgniṃ ca yā bhavet yā'psu śleṣma purīṣaṃ ca mūtraṃ vā muñcatāṃ gatiḥ
tāṃ gaccheyaṃ gatiṃ kaṣṭāṃ na ceddhanyāṃ jayadratham
utkocināṃ mṛṣoktīnāṃ vañcakānāṃ ca yā gatiḥ
ātmāpahāriṇāṃ yā ca yā ca mithyābhiśaṃsinām
tāṃ gaccheyaṃ gatiṃ ghorāṃ na ceddhanyāṃ jayadratham
saṃśritaṃ cāpi yastyaktvā sādhuṃ tadvacane ratam
arhate prātiveśyāya śrāddhaṃ yo na dadāti ca
teṣāṃ gatimiyāṃ kṣipraṃ na ceddhānyāṃ jayadratham
bhuñjānānāṃ tu savyena utsaṅge cāpi khādatām
ye cāvarjayatāṃ lokāḥ svapatāṃ ca tathoṣasi
ṣaṇmāsaṃ tatra vasatāṃ tathā śāstraṃ vinindatām
agāradāhināṃ caiva garadānāṃ ca ye matāḥ
yā ca vai bahuyājināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ śvavṛttinām
brāhmaṇasya pratiśrutya yo vai lobhāddadāti na
teṣāṃ gatiṃ gamiṣyāmi śvo na hanyāṃ jayadratham
yadi vyuṣṭāmimāṃ rātriṃ śvo na hanyāṃ jayadratham
imāṃ cāpyaparāṃ bhūyaḥ pratijñāṃ me nibodhata
asurasuramanuṣyāḥ pakṣiṇo voragā vā pitṛrajanicarā vā brahmadevarṣayo vā
caramacaramapīdaṃ yatparaṃ cāpi tasmā-- ttadapi mama ripuṃ taṃ rakṣituṃ naiva śaktāḥ
yadi viśati rasātalaṃ tadagryaṃ viyadapi devapuraṃ diteḥ puraṃ vā
pradadhmau tatra saṅkruddho devadattaṃ ca phalgunaḥ
atha mṛditatamāgryadāmamālyaṃ tava sutaśokamayaṃ ca roṣajātam
tadā bhīmaṃ balaṃ sarve tena nādena mohitam
śrutvā tu taṃ mahāśabdaṃ pāṇḍūnāṃ putragṛddhinām
śokasammūḍhahṛdayo duḥkhenābhyāhato bhṛśam majjamāna ivāgādhe vipule śokasāgare
yo'sau pāṇḍoḥ kila kṣetre jātaḥ śakreṇa kāminā
na trāsyanti bhavanto māṃ samastāḥ patayaḥ kṣiteḥ
adarśanaṃ gamiṣyāmi na māṃ drakṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
na bhetavyaṃ naravyāghra ko hi tvāṃ puruṣarṣabha
māyāvī balavāñchūro rākṣasaścāpyalambusaḥ ete cānye ca bahavo nānājanapadeśvarāḥ
tvaṃ cāpi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ svayaṃ śūro'mitadyute
sa kathaṃ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayaṃ paśyasi vaindhava
yattā yotsyanti mābhaistvaṃ saindhava vyetu te bhayam
na tu te yudhi santrāsaḥ kāryaḥ pārthātkathañcana
ahaṃ hi rakṣitā tāta bhayāttvāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
vyūhayiṣyāmi taṃ vyūhaṃ yaṃ pārtho na tariṣyati
ahaṃ ca sahaputreṇa adhruvā iti cintyatām
paryāyeṇa vayaṃ sarve kālena balinā hatāḥ
ta ime śīghramāgamya pravṛttiṃ vedayanti naḥ
tato vimanasaḥ sarve trastāḥ kṣudramṛgā iva
sa mantrakāle saṃmantrya sarvāṃ naiśreyasīṃ kriyām
pratijñāto hi senāyā madhye tena vadho mama
tāṃ na devā na gandharvā nāsuroragarākṣasāḥ
te māṃ rakṣata saṅgrāme mā vo mūrdhni dhanañjayaḥ
atha rakṣā na me samyakkriyate kurunandana
saṃvidhānaṃ ca vihitaṃ rathāśca kila sajjitāḥ
sthāsyate rakṣite vīraiḥ sindhurāṭ sa sudurmadaḥ
dhanuṣyastre ca vīrye ca prāṇe caiva tathaurase
sahitā hi naravyāghra na śakyā jetumañjasā
teṣāṃ vīryaṃ mamārdhena na tulyamiti me matiḥ
tathāpi bāṇairnihataṃ śvo draṣṭāsi raṇe mayā
yasya goptā maheṣvāso droṇaḥ pāpasya durmateḥ
āstīryamāṇāṃ pṛthivīṃ draṣṭā'si śvo mayā yudhi
tathā prabhāte kartā'smi yathā kṛṣṇa suyodhanaḥ
nānyaṃ dhanurdharaṃ loke maṃsyate matsamaṃ yudhi
gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanurdivyaṃ yoddhāraṃ ca dhanañjam
yathā lakṣma sthiraṃ candre samudre ca yathā jalam
evametāṃ pratijñāṃ me satyāṃ viddhi janārdana
gāṇḍīvaṃ ca dhanurdivyaṃ yoddhā cāhaṃ nararṣabha
tvaṃ ca yantā hṛṣīkeśa kinnu syādajitaṃ mayā
yathābhiyāya saṅgramaṃ na jito vai jayāmi ca
tena satyena saṅgrāme hataṃ viddhi jayadratham
tvaṃ ca mādhava sarvaṃ tattathā pratividhāsyasi
dhruvaṃ vai brāhmaṇe satyaṃ dhruvā sādhuṣu sannatiḥ
śrīrdhruvā'pi ca dakṣeṣu dhruvo nārāyaṇe jayaḥ
tathā kāryaṃ tvayā kṛṣṇa pratijñā syādyathā dhruvā
āśvāsaya subhadrāṃ tvaṃ bhaginīṃ snuṣayā saha
snuṣāṃ cāsyā vayasyāśca viśokāḥ kuru mādhava
mā śokaṃ kuru vārṣṇeyi kumāraṃ prati sasnuṣā
sadṛśaṃ maraṇaṃ hyetattava putrasya mā śucaḥ
santo yāṃ gatimicchanti tāṃ prāptastava putrakaḥ
mā śucastanayaṃ bhadre gataḥsa paramāṃ gatim
svādhyāyayuktaṃ brāhmamī yācitāraṃ svādhyāyayuktaṃ brāhmaṇī yācitāraṃ
gaurboḍhāraṃ kṣipragantāramaśvā dāsaṃ śūdrā karmakāraṃ tu vaiśyā śūraṃ sūte tvadvidhā rājaputrī
śvaḥ śiraḥ pādamūlaṃ te saindhavasyāhṛtaṃ dhruvam
paddhyāṃ pramathitāsi tvaṃ viśokā bhava mā rudaḥ
kṣatradharmaṃ puraskṛtya gataḥ śūraḥ satāṃ gatim
vayaṃ ca prāpnuyāmeha ye cānye śastrajīvinaḥ
gatastava varārohe putraḥ svargaṃ jvaraṃ jahi
āśvāsaya snuṣāṃ rājñi mā śucaḥ kṣatriye bhṛśam
śvaḥ priyaṃ sumahacchrutvā viśokā bhava nandini
cikīrṣitaṃ hi te bharturna bhavejjātu niṣphalam
yadi ca manujapannagāḥ piśācā rajanicacārāḥ patagāḥ surāsurāśca
raṇagatamabhiyānti sindhurājaṃ na sa bhavitā saha tairapi prabhāte
hā putrā mama mandāyāḥ kathametyāsi saṃyugam
mukhaṃ te dṛśyate vatsa guṇṭhitaṃ raṇareṇunā
pāṇḍaveṣu ca nātheṣu vṛṣṇivīreṣu vā vibho
yatra tvaṃ keśave nāthe satyanātho yathā hataḥ atṛptadarśanā putra darśanasya tavānagha
tava putra kadā bhūyo mukhaṃ drakṣyāmi nirvraṇam
ye tvāṃ raṇagataṃ vīraṃ na śekurabhirakṣitum
ehyehi tṛṣito vatsa stanau pūrṇau pibāśu me
hā vīra dṛṣṭo naṣṭaśca dhanaṃ svapna ivāsi me
tvayā vinā kathaṃ putra jīrṇāṃ patitamānasām
vihāya phalakāle māṃ sugṛddhāṃ tava darśane
hatvārīnnihatānāṃ ca saṅgrāme tāṃ gati vraja
naiveśikaṃ cābhimataṃ dadatāṃ yā gatiḥ śubhā
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ śaraṇyebhyo nidhiṃ nidadhatāṃ ca yā
yā cāpi nyastadaṇḍānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
ekapatnyaśca yāṃ yānti tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
paiśunyācca nivṛttānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
amoghātithināṃ yā ca tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
gatiḥ śokāgnidagdhānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
ṛtukāle svakāṃ bhāryāṃ gacchatāṃ yā manīṣiṇām
parastrībhyo nivṛttānāṃ tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
yāṃ gatiṃ sādhavo yānti tāṃ gatiṃ vraja putraka
sā prakāmaṃ ruditvā ca vilapya ca suduḥkhitā
ye cānye'pi kule santi puruṣā no varānane
sarve na te gatiṃ yānti yā'bhimanyoryaśasvinaḥ
viveśāntaḥ pure rājaṃste ca jagmuḥ svamālayam
tato'rjunasya bhavanaṃ praviśyāpratimaṃ vibhuḥ spṛṣṭvāmbhaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ sthaṇḍile śubhalakṣaṇe
supyatāṃ pārtha bhadraṃ te kalyāṇāya vrajāmyaham
śiśye ca śayane śubhre bahukṛtya vicintayan
na pāṇḍavānāṃ śibire kaścitsuṣvāpa tāṃ niśām
sa hatvā saindhavaṃ saṅkhye punaretu jayī sukhī
na śakyamanṛtāṃ kartuṃ pratijñāṃ vijayena hi
yadi no'sti kṛtaṃ kiñcidyadi dattaṃ hutaṃ yadi
tasyā rajanyā madhye tu pratibuddho janārdanaḥ
yathā jayadrathaṃ pārtho na hanyāditi saṃyuge
akṣauhiṇyo hi tāḥ sarvā rakṣiṣyanti jayadratham
so'pi taṃ notsahetājau hantuṃ droṇena rakṣitam
na hi dārā na mitrāṇi jñātayo na ca bāndhavāḥ
udīkṣituṃ na śakto'haṃ bhavitā na ca tattathā
śvo nirīkṣantu me vīryaṃ trayo lokā mahāhave
jñāsyanti lokāḥ sarve māṃ suhṛdaṃ savyasācinaḥ
yastaṃ dveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭi yastaṃ cānu sa māmanu
yathā tvaṃ me prabhātāyāmasyāṃ niśi rathottamam
gadāṃ kaumodakīṃ divyāṃ śaktiṃ cakraṃ dhanuḥ śarān
āropya vai rathe sūta sarvopakaraṇāni ca
sthānaṃ ca kalpayitvā'tha rathopasthe dhvajasya me
śrutvā ca bhairavaṃ nādamupeyāstvaṃ javena mām
jaya eva dhruvastasya kuta eva parājayaḥ
taṃ tu śokena santaptaṃ svapne kapivaradhvajam
na lopayati dharmātmā bhaktyā premṇā ca sarvadā
pratyutthāya ca govindaṃ svaṃ tasmai cāsanaṃ dadau
mā viṣāde manaḥ pārtha kṛthāḥ kālo hi durjayaḥ
kimarthaṃ ca viṣādaste tadbrūhi dvipadāṃ vara
na śocyaṃ viduṣāṃ śreṣṭha śokaḥ kāryavināśanaḥ
hīnaceṣṭasya yaḥ śokaḥ sa hi śatrurdhanañjaya
daśa caikā ca tāḥ kṛṣṇa akṣauhiṇyaḥ sudurjayāḥ
kathaṃ śakyeta sandraṣṭuṃ durātmā kṛṣṇa saindhavaḥ
pratijñāyāṃ ca hīnāyāṃ kathaṃ jīvati madvidhaḥ
drutaṃ ca yāti savitā tata etadbravīmyaham
yadi tadviditaṃ te'dya śvo hantā'si jayadratham
taṃ devaṃ manasā dhyātvā joṣamāssva dhanañjaya
puṇyaṃ himavataḥ pādaṃ maṇimantaṃ ca parvatam
keśavena gṛhītaḥ sa dakṣiṇe vibhunā bhuje
saricchreṣṭhāṃ ca tāṃ gaṅgāṃ vīkṣamāṇo bahūdakām
sa tuṅgaṃ śataśṛṅgaṃ ca śaryātivanameva ca
viyaddyāṃ pṛthivīṃ caiva tathā viṣṇupadaṃ vrajan
vismitaḥ saha kṛṣṇena kṣipto bāṇa ivābhyagāt
samāsādya tu taṃ śailaṃ śailāgre samavasthitam taponityaṃ mahātmānamapaśyadvṝṣabhadhvajam
vāsudevastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā jagāma śirasā kṣitim
manasaḥ paramaṃ yoniṃ khaṃ vāyuṃ jyotiṣāṃ nidhim
yogānāṃ ca paraṃ dhāma dṛṣṭaṃ brahmavidāṃ nidhim
yena kāryeṇa samprāptau yuvāṃ tatsādhayāmi kim
tatastadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratyutthāya kṛtāñjalī vāsudevārjunau śarvaṃ tuṣṭuvāte mahāmatī
namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca
abhigamyāya kāmyāya stutyāyāryāya sarvadā namo'stu devadevāya mahābhūtadharāya ca
namo viśvasya pataye pattīnāṃ pataye namaḥ
namo viśvasya pataye mahatāṃ pataye namaḥ
bhaktānukampine nityaṃ sidhyatāṃ no varaḥ prabho
tato'bhipūjya manasā kṛṣṇaṃ śarvaṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ
tataḥ pārthasya vijñāya varārthe vacanaṃ tadā
yena kāmena samprāptau bhavaddhyāṃ taṃ dadāmyaham
tatra me taddhanurdivyaṃ śaraśca nihitaḥ purā
yena devārayaḥ sarve mayā yudhi nipātitāḥ
tathetyuktvā tu tau vīrau sarvapāriṣadaiḥ saha
tau tajjagṛhatuḥ prītau dhanurbāṇaṃ ca suprabham
tataḥ pāśvādvṝṣāṅkasya brahmacārī nyavartata piṅgākṣastapasaḥ kṣetraṃ balavānnīlalohitaḥ
sa tadgṛhya dhanuḥśreṣṭhaṃ tasthau sthānaṃ samāhitaḥ
tasya maurvī ca muṣṭiṃ ca sthānaṃ cālakṣya pāṇḍavaḥ
sa sarasyeva taṃ bāṇaṃ mumocātibalaḥ prabhuḥ
tataḥ prītaṃ bhavaṃ jñātvā smṛtimānarjunastadā varamāraṇyake dattaṃ darśanaṃ śaṅkarasya ca
prāptau svaśibiraṃ vīrau mudā paramayā yutau
kṛtvendriyāṇāmaikāgryaṃ manasaśca mahāmanāḥ jajāpa japyaṃ kaunteyaḥ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ
tathā gāḥ kapilā dogdhrīḥ savatsāḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
mālyaṃ ca jalakumbhāṃśca jvalitaṃ ca hutāśanam
dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā ca kaunteyo bāhyāṃ kakṣyāṃ tato'gamat
praveśyatāṃ samīpaṃ me kimarthaṃ pravilambase āsanaṃ ca madhughnāya dīyatāṃ paramārcitam
darśanādeva te saumya na kiñcidaśubhaṃ mama
anujñātaśca rājñā sa prāveśayata taṃ janam
virāṭaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca sātyakim
cedipaṃ dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca drupadaṃ ca mahāratham
prārthayāmo jayaṃ yuddhe śāśvatāni sukhāni ca
tvaṃ hi rājyavināśaṃ ca dviṣadbhiśca nirākriyām
sa tathā kuru vārṣṇeya yathā tvayi mano mama
parāṃ titīrṣatāmadya pluvo no bhava mādhava
yudhi yatkuruṣe kṛṣṇa sārathyaṃ tvaṃ samāsthitaḥ
viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama
varadaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ tatsatyaṃ kuru mādhava
yadyasya devā goptāraḥ sendrāḥ sarve tathā'pyasau
tādṛgrūpā ca te cchāyā prasannaśca janārdanaḥ
tataḥ śirobhiravaniṃ spṛṣṭvā sarve ca vismitāḥ
sa tu lokavaraḥ puṃsāṃ kirīṭī hemavarmabhṛt
sa rathe rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kāñcane kāñcanāvṛtaḥ vibabhau vimalo'rciṣmānmerāviva divākaraḥ
pāṇḍavānāṃ tvadīyānāṃ viparītāni māriṣa dṛṣṭvā'rjuno nimittāni vijayāya pradakṣiṇam
yuyudhānādya yuddhe me dṛśyate vijayo dhruvaḥ
so'haṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra saindhavako nṛpaḥ
yathā paramakaṃ kṛtyaṃ saindhavasya vadho mama
yathaiva hi mayā guptastvayā gupto bhavettathā
na paśyāmi ca taṃ loke yastvāṃ yuddhe parājayet
tvayi cāhaṃ parāśvastaḥ pradyumne vā mahārathe
mayyapekṣā na kartavyā goptā'yaṃ mama keśavaḥ
rājña eva parā guptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā tvayā
kathaṃ tatkilbiṣaṃ kṛtvā nirbhayā brūhi māmakāḥ
kintu sañjaya saṅgrame vṛttaṃ duryodhanaṃ prati
so'dya na śrūyate śabdaḥ sūta putra yathā purā
dīnānāmadya taṃ śabdaṃ na śṛṇomi samīritam
anyeṣāṃ ca sutānāṃ me na tathā śrūyate dhvaniḥ
brāhmaṇaāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā yaṃ śiṣyāḥ paryupāsate
ślakṣṇastasya gṛhe śabdo nādya drauṇeryathā purā
śrūyate so'dya na tathā kekayānāṃ ca veśmasu
nṛtyatāṃ śrūyate tāta gaṇānāṃ so'dya na svanaḥ
saumadattiṃ śrutanidhiṃ teṣāṃ na śrūyate dhvaniḥ
vāditranāditānāṃ ca so'dya na śrūyate mahān
tato duḥśāsanasyaiva karṇasya ca mataṃ dvayoḥ
anvavartata māṃ hitvā kṛṣṭaḥ kālena durmatiḥ
na hyahaṃ yuddhamicchāmi viduro droṇa eva vā
jayaḥ kṛpo vā dharmātmā ye cānye mama bāndhavāḥ
ślakṣṇā madhurasambhāṣā jñātimadhye priyaṃvadāḥ kulīnāḥ sammatāḥ prājñāḥ sukhaṃ jīvanti mānavāḥ
dharmāpekṣī naro nityaṃ sarvatra labhate sukham
arhāste pṛthivīṃ bhoktuṃ samarthāḥ sādhane'pi ca
na ca tvā'bhibhaviṣyanti hitvā dharmaṃ pṛthātmajāḥ
santi me jñātayastāta yeṣāṃ śroṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
droṇasyātha vikarṇasya bāhlīkasya kṛpasya ca anyeṣāṃ caiva vṛddhānāṃ bharatānāṃ mahātmanām
kaṃ vā tvaṃ manyase teṣāṃ yastvāṃ brūyādato'nyathā
kṛṣṇo na dharmaṃ sañjahyātsarve te hi tadanvayāḥ
na ca me śrutavānmūḍho manye kālasya paryayam
yamau ca puruṣavyāghrau mantrī ca madhusūdanaḥ
divyamastraṃ vikurvāṇānprasahedvā parānmama anyo duryodhanātkārṇācchakuneścāpi saubalāt
tathā mama vilāpānāṃ nāyaṃ duryodhanaḥ smaret
hatau hi puruṣavyāghrau bhīṣmadroṇau tvamāttha vai
himātyaye yathā kakṣaṃ śuṣkaṃ vāterito mahān
ācakṣva mama tatsarvaṃ kuśalo hyasi sañjaya
abhimanyau hate tāta kathamāsīnmano hi vaḥ
na jātu tasya karmāṇi yudhi gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ
kinnuḥ duryodhanaḥ kṛtyaṃ karṇaḥ kṛtyaṃ kimabravīt
lobhānugasya durbuddheḥ krodhena vikṛtātmanaḥ rājyakāmasya mūḍhasya rāgopahatacetasaḥ
durnītaṃ vā sunītaṃ vā tanmamācakṣva sañjaya
śuśrūṣasva sthiro bhūtvā tava hyapanayo mahān
yadi tvaṃ hi purā dyūtātkuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
yuddhakāle punaḥ prāpte tadaiva bhavatā yadi
nivartitāḥ syuḥ saṃrabdhā na tvāṃ vyasanamāvrajet
pāñcālā vṛṣṇayaḥ sarve ye cānye'pi narādhipāḥ
sa kṛtvā pitṛkarma tvaṃ putraṃ saṃsthāpya satpathe
vartethā yadi dharmeṇa na tvāṃ vyasanamāvrajet
tvaṃ tu prājñatamo loke hitvā dharmaṃ sanātanam
na tathā manyate kṛṣṇo na ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
na bhīṣmo naiva ca droṇo yathā tvaṃ manyase nṛpa
vyajānīta yadā tu tvāṃ lubdhaṃ dharmapravādinam
na hi rakṣanti rājāno yudhyanto jīvitaṃ raṇe
yāṃ tu kṛṣṇārjunau senāṃ yāṃ sātyakivṛkodarau
yeṣāṃ yoddhā guḍākeśo yeṣāṃ mantrī janārdanaḥ
yeṣāṃ ca sātyakiryoddhā yeṣāṃ yoddhā vṛkodaraḥ
anyatra kauraveyebhyo ye vā teṣāṃ padānugāḥ
kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu tattvataḥ
tasyāṃ niśāyāṃ vyuṣṭāyāṃ droṇaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
viṣphārya ca dhanūṃṣyanye jyāḥ pare parimṛjya ca
saghaṇṭāścandanādigdhāḥ svarṇavajravibhūṣitāḥ samutkṣipya gadāścānye paryapṛcchanta pāṇḍavam
kvārjunaḥ kva sa govindaḥ kva ca mānī vṛkodaraḥ
kva ca te suhṛdasteṣāmāhvayante raṇe tadā
tatrasthaṃ tvāṃ na saṃsoḍhuṃ śaktā devāḥ savāsavāḥ
kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍavāḥ sarve samāśvasihi saindhava
evamuktaḥ samāśvastaḥ sindhurājo jayadrathaḥ samprāyātsahagāndhārairvṛtastaiśca mahārathaiḥ
paścārdhe tasya padmastu garbhavyūhaḥ punaḥ kṛtaḥ
sūcīpadmasya garbhastho gūḍho vyūhaḥ kṛtaḥ punaḥ
teṣāṃ ca pṛṣṭhato rājā balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
śakaṭasya tu rājendra bhāradvājo mukhe sthitaḥ
śvetavarmāmbaroṣṇīṣo vyūḍhorasko mahābhujaḥ dhanurvisphārayandroṇastasthau kruddha ivāntakaḥ
tasya sainyasya sarvasya netā goptā ca vīryavān
ahitahṛdayabhedanaṃ mahadvai śakaṭamavekṣya kṛtaṃ nananda rājā
anīkānāṃ ca saṃhrāde vāditrāṇāṃ ca niḥsvane
cacāla ca mahī kṛtsnā bhaye ghore samutthite
te cāpi rathinaḥ sarve tvaritāḥ kṛtahastavat
kabandha utthitaḥ kaścidviṣphārya saśaraṃ dhanuḥ kiñcitkhaṅgaṃ viniṣkṛṣya bhujenodyamya tiṣṭhati
ayaṃ pārthaḥ kutaḥ pārthaḥ pārtho'yamiti sarvaśaḥ tiṣṭha pārthehi māṃ pārtha kva yāsīti ca jalpatām
yo yaḥ sma samare pārthaṃ pratisañcarate naraḥ
pramukhe tiṣṭhamānaṃ ca na kañcinna nihanti saḥ
yathā madhyaṃdine sūryo duṣprekṣyaḥ prāṇibhiḥ sadā
tathā dhanañjayaḥ kruddho duṣprekṣyo yudhi śatrubhiḥ
tattathā tava putrasya sainyaṃ yudhi parantapa
bhūrdiśaścāntarikṣaṃ ca śabdenāsītsamāvṛtam yuvarājo balaślāghī piṅgalaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
siṃhanādena mahatā narasiṃho dhanañjayaḥ tadācalaghanaprakhyaṃ patākāśatasaṅkulam gajānīkamamitrāṇāmabhito vyadhamaccharaiḥ
nānāvāditraśabdena pāñcajanyasvanena ca devadattasya ghoṣeṇa gāṇḍīvaninadena ca
apare dantaveṣṭeṣu kumbheṣu ca kaṭeṣu ca
maurvī dhvajaṃ dhanuścaiva yugamīṣāṃ tathaiva ca
evaṃ bale drute yāte rājaputraṃ mahāratham
jīvitena kathaṃ gantā duruktaṃ yāvadadya te
tadvākyasadṛśaṃ karma kuru tvaṃ yadi manyase
sa tu droṇaṃ samāsādya vyūhasya pramukhe sthitam
śivena dhyāhi māṃ brahmansvasti caiva vadasva me
nihantuṃ dvipadāṃ śreṣṭha pratijñāṃ rakṣa me prabho
māmajitvā na bībhatso śakyo jetuṃ jayadrathaḥ
vivyādha ca hayānasya dhvajaṃ sārathimeva ca
arjunaṃ ca trisaptatyā dhvajaṃ cāsya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
yaddroṇaṃ tarasā pārtho vṛddhaṃ bālo'pi nātarat
tataḥ pārthaṃ samudvignaṃ lakṣya cintayate'cyutaḥ droṇasya cāpi vikrāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhuniṣūdanaḥ
pārthapārtha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet
nanu nāma raṇe śatrumajitvā na nivartase
gururbhavānna me śatruḥ śiṣyaḥ putrasamo'smi te
na cāsti sa pumām̐lloke yastvāṃ yudhi parājayet
tato jayo mahārāja kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
nārāyaṇāśca gopālāḥ kāmbhojānāṃ ca ye gaṇāḥ
aśvo viddho rathaśchinnaḥ sārohaḥ pātito gajaḥ
atha tau vadhyamānau tu droṇena rathasattamau
cintayāmāsa vārṣṇeyo na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet
tāvanye dhanuṣī sajye kṛtvā bhojaṃ vijaghnatuḥ
na lebhāte tu tau dvāraṃ vāritau kṛtavarmaṇā
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu tathā''yāntaṃśūro rājā śrutāyudhaḥ
hatāśvaṃ rathamutsṛjya sa tu rājā śrutāyudhaḥ
varuṇasyatmajo vīraḥ sa tu rājā śrutāyudhaḥ
astrasyāsya prabhāvādvai vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
ayudhyati na moktavyā sā tvayyeva patediti
na cākarotsa tadvākyaṃ prāpte kāle śrutāyudhaḥ
sa tayā vīraghātinyā janārdanamatāḍayat pratijagrāha tāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ pīnenāṃsena vīryavān
jaghāna cāsthitaṃ vīraṃ śrutāyudhamamarṣaṇam sa papāta hato bhūmau viśirā vibhujo balī
gadāṃ nivartitāṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ ca śrutāyudham hāhākāro mahāṃstatra sainyānāṃ samajāyata
yathoktaṃ varuṇenājau tathā sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ
patamānastu sa babhau parṇāśāyāḥ priyaḥ sutaḥ
vāsudevaṃ tribhirviddhvā punaḥ pārthaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā ketuṃ ciccheda māriṣa
bhallābhyāṃ bhṛśatīkṣṇābhyāṃ taṃ ca vivyādha pāṇḍavaḥ
rathaṃ cānyaiḥ subahubhiścakre viśakalaṃ śaraiḥ sudakṣiṇaṃ taṃ kāmbhojaṃ moghasaṅkalpavikramam
gireḥ śikharajaḥ śrīmānsuśākhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ nirbhagna iva vātena karṇikāro himātyaye
viśīrṇaḥ patito rājā prasārya vipulau bhujau
tataḥ sarvāṇi sainyāni vyadravanta sutasya te
hataṃ śrutāyudhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāmbhojaṃ ca sudakṣiṇam
te sma bhītāḥ palāyante vyāghrātkṣudramṛgā iva
te nivṛttāḥ punaḥ pārthaṃ sarvataḥ paryavārayan
kṣate kṣāraṃ sa hi dadau pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ
te jaghnustau maheṣvāsau tābhyāṃ muktāṃśca sāyakān
te na śakyāḥ sma saṅkhyātuṃ vrātāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ
abhyavarṣanta te sarve pāṇḍavaṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
abhracchāyāmiva śaraiḥ sainye kṛtvā dhanañjayaḥ muṇḍārdhamuṇḍāñjaṭilānaśucīñjaṭilānanān
dehebhyo rājaputrāṇāṃ nāgāśvarathasādinām yathā sthalaṃ ca nimnaṃ ca na syādvarṣati vāsave
śūnyānkurvanrathopasthānmānavaiḥ saṃstaranmahīm prānṛtyadiva sambādhe cāpahasto dhanañjayaḥ
tasyārjunaḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ kaṅkapatraparicchadaiḥ nyapātayaddhayāñśīghraṃ yatamānasya māriṣa
āsasāda raṇe pārthaṃ keśavaṃ ca mahāratham
arjuno'tha bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ so'mbaṣṭhaṃ prati bhārata
atha tāṃ patitāṃ dṛṣṭvā gṛhyānyāṃ ca mahāgadām
ambaṣṭhe tu tadā bhagne tava sainyamabhajyata
rathānīkāvagāḍhaśca vāraṇāśvaśatairvṛtaḥ adṛśyata padā pārtho ghanaiḥ sūrya ivāvṛtaḥ
yathā sa puruṣavyāghro na hanyeta jayadrathaḥ
tathā vidhatsva bhadraṃ te tvaṃ hi naḥ paramā gatiḥ
atikrānte hi kaunteye bhittvā sainyaṃ parantapa
sarvaṃ hyadyāturaṃ manye nedamasti balaṃ mama
jānāmi tvāṃ mahābhāga pāṇḍavānāṃ hite ratam
prīṇāmi ca yathāśakti tacca tvaṃ nāvabudhyase
na hyahaṃ tvāṃ vijānāmi madhudigdhamiva kṣuram
nahyahaṃ tvāṃ vijānāmi sarvaṃ maṇḍūkarāviṇam nādāsyaccedvaraṃ mahyaṃ bhavānpāṇḍavanigrahe
sa tathā kuru śoṇaśva yathā mucyeta saindhavaḥ
satyaṃ tu te pravakṣyāmi tajjuṣasva viśāmpate
alpaṃ ca vivaraṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ yāti dhanañjayaḥ
gatvā yodhaya mā bhaistvaṃ tvaṃ hyasya jagataḥ patiḥ
rājā śūraḥ kṛtī dakṣo vairamutpādya pāṇḍavaiḥ
vīraḥ svayaṃ prayāhyāśu yatra pārtho dhanañjayaḥ
api śakyo raṇe jetuṃ vajrahastaḥ purandaraḥ
sudakṣiṇaśca nihataḥ sa ca rājā śrutāyudhaḥ
taṃ kathaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ yuddhe dahantamiva pāvakam pratiyotsyāmi durdharṣaṃ tanmamācakṣva sattam
kṣamaṃ cenmanyase yuddhaṃ mama tenādya śādhi mām
eṣa te kavacaṃ rājaṃstathā badhnāmi kāñcanam
yathā na bāṇā nāstrāṇi prahariṣyanti te raṇe
yodhayanti trayo lokāḥ sanarā nāsti te bhayam
na kṛṣṇo na ca kaunteyo na cānyaḥ śastrabhṛdraṇe
tvaramāṇaḥ svayaṃ yāhi na tvā'sau viṣahiṣyati
karotu svasti te brahmā svasti kurvantu brāhmaṇāḥ
tubhyaṃ rājarṣayaḥ sarve svasti kurvantu te sadā
svāhā svadhā śacī caiva svasti kurvantu te sadā
vasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapaścaiva svasti kurvantu te nṛpa
dhṛtāḥ sa ca hataḥ śūro hyavadhyo devatāgaṇaiḥ
pārṣidā vaśagā yasya svasti tubhyaṃ prayacchatu
diggajāścaiva catvāraḥ kṣitiśca gaganaṃ grahāḥ diśaśca vidiśaścaiva siddhā lokahite ratāḥ
svasti kurvantu te nityaṃ mantreṇānena rastutāḥ
gatirbhava suraśreṣṭha trāhi no mahato bhayāt
atha pārśve sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ śakrādīṃśca surottamān
rakṣyā me satataṃ devāḥ sahendrāḥ sadvijātayaḥ
tvaṣṭuḥ sudurdharaṃ tejo yena vṛtro vinirmitaḥ
dṛṣṭvā jeṣyatha vṛtraṃ taṃ kṣipraṃ gacchata mandaram
te gatvā sahitā devā brahmaṇā saha mandaram
hṛtaujasāṃ no vṛtreṇa gatirbhava divaukasām mūrtīrīkṣasva no deva prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ śaraṇaṃ tvāṃ prapannāḥ sma gatirbhava maheśvara
viditaṃ vo yathā devāḥ kṛtyeyaṃ sumahābalā
avaśyaṃ tu mayā kāryaṃ sāhyaṃ sarvadivaukasām
mamedaṃ gātrajaṃ śakra kavacaṃ gṛhya bhāsvaram
sa tena varmaṇā guptaḥ prāyādvṛtracamūṃ prati
na sandhiḥ śakyate bhettuṃ varmabandhasya tasya tu
sa tena varmaṇā gupto vṛtraṃ devaripuṃ tadā
taṃ ca mantramayaṃ bandhaṃ varma cāṅgirase dadau aṅgirāḥ prāha putrasya mantrajñasya bṛhaspateḥ
agniveśyo mama prādāttena badhnāmi varma te
hiraṇyagarbheṇa yathā baddhaṃ viṣṇoḥ purā raṇe
yathā ca brahmaṇā baddhaṃ saṅgrāme tārakāmaye
śakrasya kavacaṃ divyaṃ tathā badhnāmyahaṃ tava
baddhā tu kavacaṃ tasya mantreṇa vidhipūrvakam
tato raṇe naravyāghraḥ pārṣataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
tathā tu yatamānasya droṇasya yudhi bhārata
rathaṃ nāgaṃ hayaṃ cāpi pattinaśca viśāmpate
pāṇḍavānāṃ tu sainyeṣu nāsti kaścitsa bhārata
ajātaśatruṃ kaunteyaṃ jvalantamiva pāvakam madrāṇāmīśvaraḥ śalyo rājā rājānamāvṛṇot
sātyakiṃ prayayau kruddhaḥ śūro rathavaraṃ yudhi
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tu pāñcālyaṃ krūraiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhadrakaiḥ
rakṣamāṇaḥ svathaṃ vyūhaṃ droṇo'pi saha sainikaiḥ
aśobhata bhṛśaṃ lakṣmyā puṣpāḍhya iva kiṃśukaḥ
śakuniṃ rabhasaṃ yuddhe kṛtavairaṃ ca bhārata
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ rājandagdhuṃ sarvāṃ samudyataḥ
śakuniḥ pāṇḍuputrābhyāṃ kṛtaḥ sa vimukhaḥ śaraiḥ
na sma jānāti kartavyaṃ yuddhe kiñcitparākramam
tapanīyatanutrāṇāḥ saṃsiktā rudhireṇa ca kovidārā ivābhānti puṣpitāstatra bhārata
gṛdhrāḥ kaṅkā bakāḥ śyenā vāyasā jambukāstathā
raṇe jayaṃ prārthayānā bhṛśaṃ yuyudhire tadā
kṣībā ivānye conmattā raṅgeṣviva ca vāraṇāḥ
droṇo drupada putrasya khaṅgaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
dhvajaṃ chatraṃ ca bhallābhyāṃ tathā tau pārṣṇisārathī
sātyakiṃ prekṣya goptāraṃ pāñcālyaṃ ca mahāhave
tato droṇaṃ śineḥ pautro grasantamapi sṛñjayān
bāṇe tasminnikṛtte tu dhṛṣṭadyumne ca mokṣite
evamuktastataḥ sūtaḥ sātyakasyāvahadratham tato rajatasaṅkāśā mādhavasya hayottamāḥ
iṣujālāvṛtaṃ vyoma cakratuḥ puruṣarṣabhau pūrayāmāsaturvīrāvubhau daśa diśaḥ śaraiḥ
na sma sūryastadā bhāti na vavau ca samīraṇaḥ
ubhayostau rathau rājaṃste cāśvāstau ca sārathī
ubhayoḥ patite chatre tathaiva patitau dhvajau
ubhau rudhirasiktāṅgāvubhau ca vijayaiṣiṇau sravadbhiḥ śoṇitaṃ gātraiḥ prasrutāviva vāraṇau
sajyaṃ cakāra tadapi cicchedāsya sa sātyakiḥ
sajyaṃ sajyaṃ dhanuścāsya ciccheda niśithaiḥ śaraiḥ
na cāntaraṃ tayordṛṣṭaṃ sandhāne cchedane'pi ca
bhīṣme ca puruṣavyāghre yadidaṃ sātvatāṃ vare
taṃ cāsya manasā droṇaḥ pūjayāmāsa vikramam
astre te vāruṇāgneye yadā bāṇaiḥ samāhite
rajasā saṃvṛte loke śarajālasamāvṛte sarvamāvignamabhavanna prājñāyata kiñcana
sainyena rajasā dhvaste nirmaryādamavartata tenāntareṇa pārthastu raṇe jitvā mahāripūn
vartamāne tadā yuddhe droṇasya saha pāṇḍubhiḥ parivartamāna āditye tatra sūrye ca raśmibhiḥ
bhajyatāṃ jayatāṃ caiva jagāma tadahaḥ śanaiḥ
cakāra yaṃ ca panthānaṃ yayau tena janārdanaḥ
rathe krośamatikrānte tasya te ghnanti śātravān
nendrasya na tu rudrasya nāpi vaiśravaṇasya ca
hatānāṃ vājināgānāṃ rathānāṃ ca naraiḥ saha
tayostu dhanuṣī muṣṭau bhallābhyāṃ śvetavāhanaḥ ciccheda samare tūrṇaṃ bhūya eva dhanañjayaḥ
dhanuṣī cicchide tūrṇaṃ bhūya eva dhanañjayaḥ
sa papāta hataḥ pṛthvyāṃ vātarugṇa iva drumaḥ
vindaṃ tu nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā hyanuvindaḥ pratāpavān
tasyārjunaḥ śaraiḥ ṣaḍbhirgrīvāṃ pādau bhujau śiraḥ
śrāntaṃ cainaṃ samālakṣya jñātvā dūre ca saindhavam
śarārditāśca glānāśca hayā dūre ca saindhavaḥ
brūhi kṛṣṇa yathātattvaṃ tvaṃ hi prājñatamaḥ sadā
mama tvanantaraṃ kṛtyaṃ yadvai tattvaṃ nibodha me
chādayantaḥ śaraiḥ pārthaṃ meghā iva divākaram
narasiṃhaṃ rathodārāḥ siṃhaṃ mattā iva dvipāḥ
arjune dharaṇīṃ prāpte hayahaste ca keśave
sa pārthaḥ pārthivānsarvānbhūmisthopi rathasthitān eko nivārayāmāsa lobhaḥ sarvaguṇāniva ]
parīpsante jalaṃ ceme peyaṃ na tvavagāhanam
bhayaṃ vipulamasmāsu tāvadhattāṃ narottamau tejo vidadhatuścograṃ yatsainyaṃ tāvakaṃ vibho
na cainaṃ yudhi tiṣṭhantaṃ sainyeṣu tava māriṣa
samprekṣya tatra govindaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanañjayam
teṣāṃ śramaṃ ca glāniṃ ca vamathuṃ vepathuṃ vraṇān
sa taṃ rathavaraṃ śauriḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
yathā devāsure yuddhe tṛṇīkṛtya ca dānavān
rathaṃ yuṅktvā hi dāśārho miṣatāṃ sarvadhanvinām
vilayaṃ samanuprāptā tacca rājā na budhyate
vidrāvya tu tataḥ sainyaṃ pāṇḍavaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
śarārtāścaraṇe yodhāḥ śekuḥ kṛṣṇau na vīkṣitum
tau tu dṛṣṭvā vyatikrāntau droṇānīkaṃ mahādyutī
droṇahārdikyayoḥ kṛṣṇau na mokṣyete iti prabho
yadyasya samare goptā śakro devagaṇaiḥ saha
iti kṛṣṇau mahābāhū mithaḥ kathayatāṃ tadā
tāvakā vīkṣya muktau tau vikrośanti sma sarvaśaḥ
dṛṣṭvā duryodhanaṃ tatra kṛṣṇayoḥ pramukhe sthitam
ye ca te sindhurājasya goptāraḥ pāvakopamāḥ
te prāhṛṣyanta samare dṛṣṭvā putraṃ tava prabho
kṛtī ca satataṃ pārtha nityaṃ dveṣṭi ca pāṇḍavān
kathaṃ hi rājā rājyārthī tvayā gaccheta saṃyugam
diṣṭyā tvidānīṃ samprāpta eṣa te bāṇagocaram
na ca te saṃyuge vīryaṃ jānāti puruṣarṣabha
jahyenaṃ tvaṃ mahābāho yathā vṛtraṃ purandaraḥ
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā jahi pārthāvicārayan
parikleśaṃ ca kṛṣṇāyā hṛdi kṛtvā parākrama
diṣṭyā jānāti saṅgrāme yoddhavyaṃ hi tvayā saha
diṣṭyā ca saphalāḥ pārtha sarve kāmā hyakāmitāḥ
yathendreṇa hataḥ pūrvaṃ jambho devāsure mṛdhe
vairasya diṣṭyā sahajaṃ mūlaṃ chindhi durātmanām
na cakāra bhayaṃ prāpte bhaye mahati māriṣa
dṛṣṭvā tu pārthaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca māriṣa
śokamāpuḥ paraṃ caiva kuravaḥ sarva eva te
amanyanta ca putraṃ te vaiśvānaramukhe hutam
tathā tu dṛṣṭvā yodhāste prahṛṣṭau kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau
hato rājā hato rājetyūcire ca bhayārditāḥ
vyetu vo bhīrahaṃ kṛṣṇau preṣayiṣyāmi mṛtyave
pārtha yacchikṣitaṃ te'straṃ divyaṃ pārthivameva ca
taddarśaya mayi kṣipraṃ yadi jāto'si pāṇḍunā
yadbalaṃ tava vīryaṃ ca keśavasya tathaiva ca
teṣāṃ naiṣphalyamālokya punarnava ca pañca ca
tvayā sampreṣitāḥ pārtha nārthaṃ kurvanti patriṇaḥ
muṣṭiśca te yathā pūrvaṃ bhujayośca balaṃ tava
na vā kaccidayaṃ kālaḥ prāptaḥ syādadya paścimaḥ
vismayo me mahānpārtha tava dṛṣṭvā śarānimān
śarāḥ kurvanti te nārthaṃ pārtha kā'dya viḍambanā
eko droṇo hi vaidaitadahaṃ tasmācca sattamāt
api vajreṇa govinda svayaṃ maghavatā yudhi
jānaṃstvamapi vai kṛṣṇa māṃ vimohayase katham
yadvṛttaṃ triṣu lokeṣu yacca keśava vartate
na tvidaṃ veda vai kaścidyathā tvaṃ madhusūdana
yattvatra vihitaṃ kāryaṃ naiṣa tadvetti mādhava
paśya bāhvośca me vīryaṃ dhanuṣaśca janārdana
punardadau surapatirmahyaṃ varma sasaṅgraham daivaṃ yadyasya varmaitadbrahmaṇā vā svayaṃ kṛtam
naitadastraṃ mayā śakyaṃ dviḥ prayoktuṃ janārdana
astraṃ māmeva hanyāddhi hanyāccāpi balaṃ mama
bhūya evābhyavarṣacca samare kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau śaravarṣeṇa mahatā tato'hṛṣyanta tāvakāḥ
tataḥ kruddho raṇe pārthaḥ sṛkviṇī parisaṃlihan
