[prayatnajño hi kauntayo nakhamāṃsāntareṣubhiḥ sa vedanābhirāvignaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ]
atha nārjunagovindau na ratho vā vyadṛśyata
tatra vyaṅgī kṛtāḥ petuḥ śataśo'tha rathadvipāḥ
tasya śaṅkhasya nādena dhanuṣo niḥsvanena ca
te dṛṣṭvā sahasā pārthaṃ goptāraḥ saindhavasya tu
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ tāvakānāṃ samutthitam
sa śabdo bharataśreṣṭha vyāpya sarvā diśo daśa
atha kṛṣṇau mahābhāgau tāvakā vīkṣya daṃśitau
vyaśobhanta tadā śīghrā dīpayanto diśo daśa
devadattaṃ ca kaunteyaḥ pāñcajanyaṃ ca keśavaḥ
śalyasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ muṣṭau ciccheda vīryavān
karṇo dvātriṃśatā caiva vṛṣasenaśca saptabhiḥ jayadrathastrisaptatyā kṛpaśca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ śarāṇāṃ ṣaṣṭyā tu drauṇiḥ pārthamavākirat
vāsudevaṃ ca viṃśatyā punaḥ pārthaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
saumadattiṃ tribhirvidvvā śalyaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
gautamaṃ pañcaviṃśatyā saindhavaṃ ca śatena ha
teṣāṃ tu rathamukhyānāṃ ratheṣu vividhā dhvajāḥ
anekavarṇā vividhā dhvajāḥ paramaśobhanāḥ te dhvajāḥ saṃvṛtāsteṣāṃ patākābhiḥ samantataḥ
patākī kāñcanaḥ sragvī dhvajaḥ karṇasya saṃyuge
tena tasya ratho bhāti mayūreṇa mahātmanaḥ
sā sītā bhrājate tasya rathamāsthāya māriṣa
yathā devāsure yuddhe purā pūṣā sma śobhate
śalasya tu mahārāja rājato dvirado mahān
sa ketuḥ śobhayāmāsa sainyaṃ te bharatarṣabha
sarve droṇarathaṃ prāpya pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
tato droṇo bhṛśaṃ kruddho darmarājasya saṃyuge
sa kṛcchraṃ paramaṃ prāpto dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ tyaktvā tatkārmukaṃ chinnaṃ bhāradvājena saṃyuge
chittvā tu tāñśarānrājakrodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ śaktaṃ jagrāha samare girīṇāmapi dāriṇīm
samutkṣipya ca tāṃ hṛṣṭo nanāda balavadbalī
sā rājabhujanirmuktā nirmuktoragasannibhā prajvālayantī gaganaṃ diśaḥ sapradiśastathā
vidvvā taṃ ca raṇe droṇaṃ pañcabhirnataparvabhiḥ
te gade sahasā mukte samāsādya parasparam
tato droṇo bhṛśaṃ kruddho dharmarājasya māriṣa
virathaṃ taṃ samālokya vyāyudhaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
hṛto rājā hṛto rājā bhāradvājena māriṣa
taṃ nihatya raṇe hṛṣṭo bṛhatkṣatro mahārathaḥ
tāṃ tu śaktiṃ mahāvīryāṃ dorbhyāmāyasya bhārata
tayā tu vīraghātinyā śaktyā tvabhihato bhṛśam
mādreyastu tataḥ kruddho durmukhaṃ ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
taṃ raṇe rabhasaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahadevaṃ mahābalam
durmukhasya tu bhallena cchittvā ketuṃ mahābalaḥ
sahadevo raṇe chittvā taṃ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ
hatāśvaṃ tu rathaṃ tyaktvā durmukho vimanāstadā
taṃ tu hatvā mahābāhuḥ sahadevo vyarocata
yathā dāśarathī rāmaḥ kharaṃ hatvā mahābalam
nāśayitvā raṇe sainyaṃ tvadīyaṃ tu samantataḥ
tato droṇo bhṛśaṃ kruddhaḥ sahasodvṛtya cakṣuṣī
te pīḍitā bhṛśaṃ tena raudreṇa sahasā vibho
pramūḍhā naiva vividurmṛdhe kṛtyaṃ sma kiṃcana
sa tānprati mahārāja pañca cikṣepa sāyakān
nanāda balavannādaṃ vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tadrakṣaḥ samare viddhaṃ kṛtvā nādaṃ bhayāvaham
abhyadravattato bhīmaṃ ye ca tasya padānugāḥ
sa bhīmaṃ pañchabhirvidvvā śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ bhaimānparijaghānāśu rathāṃstriśatamāhave
pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāṃ mārutiḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ vikṛṣya kārmukaṃ ghoraṃ bhārasādhanamuttamam
sa vadhyamānaḥ samare bhīmacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ smaranbhrātṛvadhaṃ caiva pāṇḍavena mahātmanā
tiṣṭhedānīṃ raṇe pārtha paśya me'dya parākramam bāko nāma sudurbuddhe rākṣasapravaro balī
parokṣaṃ mama tadvṛttaṃ yaddhātā me hatastvayā
jagāma dharaṇīṃ caiva kṣudraḥ khaṃ sahasā'gamat
śilāḥ khaṅghā guḍāścaiva ṛṣṭīrvajrāṇi caiva ha
sā rākṣasavisṛṣṭā tu śastravṛṣṭiḥ sudāruṇā jaghāna pāṇḍuputrasya sainikānraṇamūrdhani ]
rathebhyo rathinaḥ petustasya nunnāḥ sma sāyakaiḥ
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ tava sainyasya pāṇḍavaḥ
sandadhe tvāṣṭramastraṃ sa svayaṃ tvaṣṭeva mārutiḥ
dṛṣṭvā tato maheṣvāso nighnantaṃ ca rathānbhṛśam
raktoṣṭhaḥ sadhanuṣpāṇiḥ prāṃśuḥ kalpa iva sthitaḥ
sātyakistu rathavyāghro dṛṣṭvā taṃ rākṣasaṃ yudhi
tataḥ pratihate cakre sa vīro roṣasaṃkulaḥ
yāṃyāṃ ghaṭotkaco yuddhe māyāṃ darśayate nṛpa
ta enaṃ bhṛśasaṃvignāḥ sarvataḥ pravarā rathaiḥ
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ tribhirviddhā sahadevaṃ ca saptabhiḥ nakulaṃ ca trisaptatyā dropadeyāṃśca māriṣa
taṃ bhīmaseno navabhiḥ sahadevastu pañcabhiḥ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śatenaiva rākṣasaṃ pratyavidhyata
haiḍimbo rākṣasaṃ viddhvā yuddhe pañcāśatā śaraiḥ
taṃ kruddhaṃ rākṣasaṃ yuddhe pratikruddhastu rākṣasaḥ
śarāḥ prādurbhavanti sma dvirephā iva śākhinaḥ
na sma vijñāyate kiñcidandhakāre kṛte śaraiḥ
akṣamīṣāṃ yugaṃ caiva ciccheda yudhi tāḍayan
bhrāmayitvā tu taṃ khaṅgaṃ pāṇḍoḥ kirmīranandanaḥ
cikṣepāsya śiro hartuṃ sa ca tasya ghaṭotkacaḥ
patitau tau tu bāhubhyāṃ rākṣasau samasajjatām
pāṇḍavānāṃ tataḥ senā taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinipātitam
patatā tena mahatā rathināṃ dantināṃ daśa
tāvakāśca hataṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasendraṃ mahābalam alambusaṃ tathā śūrā viśīrṇamiva parvatam
sa pūjyamānaḥ pitṛbhiḥ sabāndhavai-- rghaṭotkacaḥ karmaṇi duṣkare kṛte
ripuṃ nihatyābhinananda vai tadā hyalambusaṃ pakvamalambuṣaṃ yathā
niśamya taṃ pratyanadaṃstu pāṇḍavā-- stato dhvanirbhuvanamathā'spṛśadbhṛśam
mūrdhnyupāghrāya taṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ pariṣvajya ca pāṇḍavaḥ
sañjayācakṣva tattvena paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
tataḥ kruddho maheṣvāso bhūya eva mahābalaḥ
taṃ tu samprekṣya te putrāḥ sainikāśca viśāmpate
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ pīḍyamānaṃ ca mādhavam
eṣa vṛṣṇivaro vīraḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ grasyate yudhi vīreṇa bhānumāniva rāhuṇā
abhidravata gacchadvaṃ sātyakiryatra yudhyate dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pāñcālyamidamāha janādhipaḥ
abhidrava drutaṃ droṇaṃ kimu tiṣṭhasi pārpata
na paśyasi bhayaṃ droṇāddhoraṃ naḥ samupasthitam
pāṇḍavānāṃ ca bhadraṃ te sṛñjayānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
bhāradvājaṃ ca te sarve na śekuḥ prativīkṣitum
droṇaṃ sma dadṛśuḥ śūraṃ vinighnantaṃ varānvarān
kekayānāṃ śataṃ hatvā vidrāvya ca samantataḥ
taṃ tathā samare droṇaṃ nighnantaṃ saumakānraṇe
na nūnaṃ svasti pārthāya yathā nadati śaṅkharāṭ
yaḥ sa dharmaḥ purā dṛṣṭaḥ sadbhiḥ śaineya śāśvataḥ
yo hi prītamanā nityaṃ yaśca nityamanuvrataḥ
sa kārye sāmparāye tu niyojya iti me matiḥ
yathā ca keśavo nityaṃ pāṇḍavānānaṃ parāyaṇam
so'haṃ bhāraṃ samādhāsye tvayi taṃ voḍhumarhasi
abhiprāyaṃ ca me nityaṃ na vṛthā kartumarhasi
sa tvaṃ bhrāturvayasyasya gurorapi ca saṃyuge
pṛthivīṃ ca dvijātibhyo yo dadyātsa samo bhavet
śrutāśca bahavo'smābhī rājāno ye divaṃ gatāḥ
vikrāntasya ca vīrasya yuddhe prārthayato yaśaḥ
śūra eva sahāyaḥ syānnetaraḥ prākṛto janaḥ
tvadanyo hi raṇe goptā vijayasya na vidyate
prājñaḥ sarvāstravicchūro muhyate na ca saṃyuge
śiṣyo mama sakhā caiva priyo'syāhaṃ priyaśca me
rāmo vāpyaniruddho vā pradyumno vā mahārathaḥ
gado vā māraṇo vāpi sāmvo vā saha vṛṣṇibhiḥ
tasya tvamevaṃ saṅkalpaṃ na vṛthā kartumarhasi
so'bhijātyā ca bhaktyā ca sakhyasyācāryakasya ca
suyodhano hi sahasā gato droṇena daṃśitaḥ
mahāntaṃ caraṇe śabdaṃ dīryamāṇāṃ ca bhāratīm
nāgānāṃ śṛṇu śabdaṃ ca pattīnāṃ ca sahasraśaḥ
sādināṃ dravatāṃ caiva śṛṇu kampayatāṃ mahīm
aparyante bale magno jahyādapi ca jīvitam
tasmiṃśca nihate yuddhe kathaṃ jīveta mādṛśaḥ
tanna jānāmi vārṣṇeya yadi jīvati vā na vā
eka eva ca bībhatsuḥ praviṣṭastāta bhāratīm
na hi me vartate buddhiradya yuddhe kathañcana
droṇo'pi rabhaso yuddhe mama pīḍayate balam
pratyakṣaṃ te mahābāho yathā'sau carati dvijaḥ yugapacca sametānāṃ kāryāṇāṃ tvaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ
nāhaṃ śocāmi dāśārhaṃ goptāraṃ jagataḥ patim
sa hi śakto raṇe tāta trīm̐llokānapi saṅgatān
tasya tvaṃ padavīṃ gaccha gaccheyustvādṛśā yathā
iti bruvanti lokeṣu janāstava guṇāṃstathā samāgameṣu sarveṣu pṛthageva ca sarvadā
sambhāvanā hi lokasya mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ
na hi śaineya dāśārhā raṇe rakṣanti jīvitam
praviśya ca yathānyāyaṃ saṅgamya ca mahārathaiḥ
prītiyuktaṃ ca hṛdyaṃ ca mānanīyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
kālayuktaṃ ca citraṃ ca svadhiyā cābhibhāṣitam
nyāyayuktaṃ ca satyaṃ ca phalgunārthe yaśaskaram
evaṃvidhe tathā kāle mādṛśaṃ prekṣya sattama
vaktumarhasi rājendra yathā pārthaṃ tathaiva mām
na me dhanañjayasyārthe prāṇā rakṣyāḥ kathañcana
avaśyaṃ tu mayā sarvaṃ vijñāpyastvaṃ narādhipa
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā yāvaddhanmi jayadratham
tvayi cāhaṃ mahābāho pradyumne vā mahārathe
jānīṣe hi raṇe droṇaṃ kuruṣu śreṣṭhasammatam
pratijñā cāpi te nityaṃ śrutā droṇasya mādhava
sa tvamadya raṇe yatto rakṣa mādhava pāṇḍavam
rakṣeṇe dharmarājasya dhruvo hi vijayo mama
asmākaṃ gamanaṃ vyaktaṃ vanaṃ prati bhavetpunaḥ
so'yaṃ mama jayo vyaktaṃ vyartha eva bhaviṣyati
sa tvamadya mahābāho priyārthaṃ mama mādhava
jayārthaṃ ca yaśorthaṃ ca rakṣa rājānamāhave
tasyāpi ca mahābāho nityaṃ paśyāmi saṃyuge
māṃ cāpi manyate yuddhe bhāradvājasya dhīmataḥ so'haṃ saṃbhāvanānaṃ caitāmācāryavacanaṃ ca tat
pṛṣṭhato notsahe kartuṃ tvāṃ vā tyaktuṃ mahīpate
tasmai tvāṃ visṛjeyaṃ vai sa tvāṃ rakṣedyathā'rjunaḥ
kuru tvamātmano guptiṃ kaste goptā gate mayi
evaṃ jñātvā mahārāja vyetu te bhīrdhanañjaye
evaṃ vīrau maheṣvāsau kṛṣṇau satyaparākramau na tatra karmaṇo vyāpatkathaṃcidapi vidyate
mayi cāpi sahāye te gacchamāne'rjunaṃ prati
ācāryo hi bhṛśaṃ rājannigrahe tava gṛdhyati
kuruṣvādyātmano guptiṃ kaste goptā gate mayi
na hyahaṃ tvāṃ mahārāja anikṣipya mahāhave
na paśyāmi rathaṃ kañcidyaste goptā bhavediha
śaktaṃ yaṃ manyase rājangoptāraṃ prati pāṇḍava
dṛṣṭvā śreyaḥ paraṃ buddhyā tato rājanpraśādhi mām
na tu me śuddhyate bhāvaḥ śvetāśvaṃ prati māriṣa
gaccha tvaṃ samanujñāto yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
sa tvamātiṣṭha yānāya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
draupadeyāśca māṃ tāta rakṣiṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
dhṛṣṭaketuśca balavānkuntibhojaśca mātulaḥ nakulaḥ sahadevaśca pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayāstathā
na droṇaḥ saha sainyena kṛtavarmā ca saṃyuge
samāsādayituṃ śakto na ca māṃ dharṣayiṣyati
na droṇasya balaṃ tāta kramettatra kathañcana
kavacī sa śarī khaṅgī dhanvī ca varabhūṣaṇaḥ
eṣa droṇaṃ raṇe kruddhaṃ vārayeta sa vai prabho
pāñcālaḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca dhanvibhiḥ
vikrudhaṃ gaccha śaineya mā kārṣīrmayi sambhramam
na māṃ bhītamiti brūyātprayāntaṃ phalgunaṃ prati
kṛtāṃ cenmanyase rakṣāṃ svasti te'stu viśāmpate
na hi me pāṇḍavātkaścittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
tvatkṛte na ca me kiñcidakartavyaṃ kathañcana
yathā hi me gurorvākyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ dvipadāṃ vara
priye hi tava vartete bhrātarau kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau
tayoḥ priye sthitaṃ caiva viddhi māṃ rājapuṅgava
anādiṣṭastu guruṇā ko nu yudhyeta mānavaḥ
ādiṣṭastu yathā rājanko na yudhyeta mādṛśaḥ
dhanurvede gatāḥ pāraṃ muṣṭiyuddhe ca kovidāḥ
te na klāntā na ca śrāntā dṛḍhāvaraṇakārmukāḥ
kṛpaṃ ca saumadattiṃ ca droṇaṃ ca rathināṃ varam
te tu sarve'dya samprāptā mama nārācagocaram
ete durvāraṇā nāma kāmbhojā yadi te śrutāḥ
yāsyāmi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ pravaraṃ ca dhanuṣmatām
tena mūrdhanyupāghrātaḥ kṛtasvasyayano'pi ca āśiṣo vividhāḥ śrutvā dharmarājamukheritāḥ
tataste vājino hṛṣṭāḥ supuṣṭā vātaraṃhasaḥ ajayyā jaitramūhustaṃ vikurvāṇāḥ sma saindhavāḥ
tvaṃ bhīma rakṣa rājānametatkāryatamaṃ hi te
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca śreyo rājño'bhirakṣaṇam jānīṣe mama vīryaṃ tvaṃ tava cāhamarindama
tathoktaḥ sātyakiṃ prāha vraja tvaṃ kāryasiddhaye
gaccha gaccha dhruvaṃ pārtha dhruvo hi vijayo mama
nimittāni ca dhanyāni yathā bhīma vadanti māṃ
nihate saindhave pāpe pāṇḍavena mahātmanā pariṣvajiṣye rājānaṃ dharmātmānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
apramādaśca te kāryo droṇaṃ prati mahāratham
etāvaduktvā bhīmaṃ tu visṛjya ca mahāyaśāḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pravivikṣantaṃ sainyaṃ tava janādhipa
tataḥ prayātaḥ sahasā tava sainyaṃ sa sātyakiḥ
prayāte tava sainyaṃ tu yuyudhāne yuyutsayā dharmarājo mahārāja svenānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ
jahi prahara gṛhṇīhi vidhya vidrava cādrava
śatamekena vivyādha śatenaikaṃ ca patriṇām dvipārohāndvipāṃścaiva hayārohānhayāṃstathā
nānāvidhāni sainyāni tava hatvā tu sātvataḥ
nivārya tu raṇe droṇo yuyudhānaṃ mahāratham
sa taṃ na mamṛṣe droṇaṃ yuyudhāno mahārathaḥ
siṃhanādaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā droṇaṃ vivyādha sātyakiḥ
yuyudhānaḥ punardroṇaṃ vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ekena sārathiṃ cāsya caturbhiścaturo hayān
taṃ tathā śarajālena pracchādya mahatā punaḥ
tavācāryo raṇaṃ hitvā gataḥ kāpuruṣo yathā
tvaṃ hi me yudhyato nādya jīvanyāsyasi mādhava
yadi māṃ tvaṃ raṇe hitvā na yāsyācāryavaddrutam
gacchāmi svasti te brahmanna me kālātyayo bhavet
tasmādeva vrajāmyāśu yathā me sa gururgataḥ
droṇaḥ kariṣyate yatnaṃ sarvathā mama vāraṇe
yatto yāhi raṇe sūta śṛṇu cedaṃ vacaḥ param
*tataḥ śakyo mahāvyūho bhettuṃ sa sahasā raṇe
taṃ deśaṃ tvaritā yāmo mṛdgranto yudhi śātravān
madhyato yāhi yatrograṃ karṇasya sumahadbalam yatraite paramakruddhā dākṣiṇātyā mahārathāḥ
sa ca sainyaṃ mahadbhittvā dākṣiṇātyabalaṃ ca tat
sātyako hi tataḥ sainyaṃ drāvayansa samantataḥ
praviṣṭe yuyudhāne tu sainikeṣu druteṣu ca
sa tasya dehāvaraṇaṃ bhittvā dehaṃ ca sāyakaḥ
tataḥ praśīrṇe dhanuṣi śaktyā śaktimatāṃ varaḥ
sarathaṃ kṛtavarmāṇaṃ samantātparyavārayat chādayitvā raṇe rājanhārdikyaṃ sa tu sātyakiḥ
sa papāta hataḥ sūto hārdikyasya mahārathāt
sa tatra bahubhiḥ śūraiḥ sanniruddho mahārathaiḥ
sandhāya ca camūṃ droṇo bhoje bhāraṃ niveśya ca
tathā tamanudhāvantaṃ yuyudhānasya pṛṣṭhataḥ nyavārayanta saṃhṛṣṭāḥ pāṇḍusainye brṛhattamāḥ
samāsādya tu hārdikyaṃ rathānāṃ pravaraṃ ratham
nigṛhītāstu bhojena bhojānīkepsavo raṇe atiṣṭhannāryavadvīrāḥ prārthayanto mahadyaśaḥ
hārdikyaṃ samare yattā na śekuḥ prativīkṣitum
nāgeṣvaśveṣu bahuśo ratheṣu ca parīkṣitam carmanistriṃśayuddhe ca niyuddhe ca viśāradam
nānāhūtaṃ nāpyabhṛtaṃ mama sainyaṃ babhūva ha
kṛtamānopacāraṃ ca yaśasvi ca manasvi ca
tatra śeṣaṃ na paśyāmi praviṣṭe savyasācini
sātvate ca rathodāre mama sainyasya sañjaya
sindhurājaṃ tu samprekṣya gāṇḍīvasya ca gocaram
kiṃ nu vā kuravaḥ kṛtyaṃ vidadhuḥ kālacoditāḥ
vikramo'pi raṇe teṣāṃ na tathā dṛśyate hi vai
na ca yodho'bhavatkaścinmama sainye tu sañjaya
tathā putraiśca me tāta jñātibhiśca sabāndhavaiḥ
te ca prāpyaiva saṅgrāme nirjitāḥ savyasācinā
rakṣyate yaśca saṅgrāme ye ca sañjaya rakṣiṇaḥ
ekaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ panthāra rakṣyasya saha rakṣibhiḥ
putro mama bhṛśaṃ mūḍhaḥ kiṃ kāryaṃ pratyapadyata
dṛṣṭvā kāṃ vai dhṛtiṃ yuddhe pratyapadyanta māmakāḥ
nirāśā vijaye sarve manye śocanti putrakāḥ
kṣaṇena dṛṣṭvā tau vīrau manye śocanti putrakāḥ
tanme sarvaṃ samācakṣva kuśalo hyasi sañjaya
mā hārṣīḥ pāṇḍavānrājanniti tanna tvayā śrutam
suhṛdāṃ hitakāmānāṃ vākyaṃ yo na śṛṇoti ha
sa mahadvyasanaṃ prāpya śocate vai yathā bhavān
na ca taṃ labdhavānkāmaṃ tvattaḥ kṛṣṇo mahāyaśāḥ
tava nirguṇatāṃ jñātvā pakṣapātaṃ suteṣu ca dvaidhībhāvaṃ tathā dharme pāṇḍaveṣu ca matsaram - - tava jihmamabhiprāyaṃ viditvā pāṇḍavānprati ārtapralāpāṃśca bahūnmanujādhipa sattama
na hi tai sukṛtaṃ kiñcidādau madhye ca bhārata
tasmādadya sthiro bhūtvā jñātvā lokasya nirṇayam
praviṣṭe tava sainyaṃ tu śaineye satyavikrame
dvābhyāṃ śarābhyāṃ hārdikyo nijaghāna dvidhā tadā
sā chinnā patitā bhūmau śaktiḥ kanakabhūṣaṇā
śaktiṃ vinihatāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmaścukrodha vai bhṛśam
te'pi taṃ pratyavidhyanta saptabhiḥ saptabhiḥ śaraiḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu tataḥ kruddhaśchinne dhanuṣi satvaraḥ
asiṃ jagrāha samare śatacandraṃ ca bhāsvaram
sa tasya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ chittvā rājanmahānasiḥ
śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca vivyādha tribhiḥ pañcabhireva ca
taṃ viṣaṇṇaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā tāvakāḥ puruṣarṣabha
sāditaṃ tu rathopasthe dṛṣṭvā pārthāḥ śikhaṇḍinam
te vadhyamānāḥ samare hārdikyena sma pāṇḍavāḥ
śrutvā sa ninadaṃ bhīmaṃ tāvakānāṃ mahāhave
enaṃ jitvā punaḥ sūta yāsyāmi vijayaṃ prati
kṛtavarmā tu hārdikyaḥ śaineyaṃ niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
abhajyatātha pṛtanā śaineyaśarapīḍitā palāyanakṛtotsāhā bhramantī tatratatra ha
dṛṣṭvā tu tava tatsainyaṃ rathāśvadvi pasaṅkulam
ete hi bahavaḥ sūta durnivāryāśca saṃyuge
na cājitvā raṇe hyetāñśakyaḥ prāptuṃ jayadrathaḥ
nāpi sūta mayā pārthaḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṃ kathañcana
tataḥ prāyācchanaiḥ sūtaḥ sātvatasya mate sthitaḥ
āpatantaṃ raṇe taṃ tu śaṅkhavarṇairhayottamaiḥ parivavustataḥ śūrā gajānīkena sarvataḥ
kṣuraprairardhacandraiśca sātvatena vidāritāḥ kṣaranto'sṛktathā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ ca pradudruvuḥ
jalasandhasya ciccheda vivyādha ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
sa nirbhidya bhujaṃ savyaṃ mādhavasya mahāraṇe
nirbhinne tu bhuje savye sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ
pragṛhya tu tataḥ khaṅgaṃ jalasandho mahābalaḥ ārṣabhaṃ carma ca mahacchatacandrakasaṅkulam
āvidhya ca tataḥ khaṅgaṃ sātvatāyotsasarja ha
viṣphārya vivyadhe kruddho jalasandhaṃ śareṇa ha
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ kurūṇāṃ sātvatasya ca
sātvatasya raṇe karma dṛṣṭvā yoddhuṃ mahārathāḥ
taṃ droṇaḥ saptasaptyā jaghāna niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
duryodhanaṃ tribhirviddhvā supuṅkhaistigmatejanaiḥ tato rukmāṅgadaṃ cāpaṃ vidhunvāno mahārathaḥ
athainaṃ chinnadhanvānaṃ śarairbahubhirācinot nirbhinnaśca śaraistena dviṣatā kṣiprakāriṇā
vivyādha sātyakiṃ tūrṇaṃ sāyakānāṃ śatena ha
pīḍitaṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putraṃ mahārathāḥ
sa cchādyamāno bahubhistava putrairmahārathaiḥ ekaikaṃ pañcabhirviddhvā punarvivyādha saptabhiḥ
sa vidhyamānaḥ samare śaineyasya śarottamaiḥ prādravatsahasā rājanputro duryodhanastava
taṃ tu śabdamatha śrutvā kṛtavārmā mahārathaḥ
hatāśvasūte tu rathe sthitāya śinipuṅgavaḥ suvarṇapuṅkhaṃ viśikhaṃ samādāya ca sātyakiḥ
so'vidhyatkṛtavarmāṇaṃ yamadaṇḍopamaḥ śaraḥ jāmbūnadavicitraṃ ca varma nirbhidya bhānumat
na hi tasya śaro'pārthaḥ kathañcidapi pārthiva
didṛkṣuḥ sa hi vegena prāyādyatra dhanañjayaḥ
tato droṇaḥ śineḥ pautraṃ citraiḥ sarvāyasaiḥ śaraiḥ
ājaghāna bhṛśaṃ kruddho dhvajaṃ ca niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
taṃ vai na mṛmaṣe droṇaḥ siṃhanādaṃ mahātmanaḥ
anāsādya tu śaineyaṃ sā śaktiḥ kālasannibhā
tato droṇaṃ śineḥ pautro rājanvivyādha patriṇā
te ghorāḥ kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
sa rathaḥ pradrutaḥ saṅkhye maṇḍalāni sahasraśaḥ
iti sma cukruśuḥ sarve rājaputrāḥ sarājakāḥ
droṇaṃ sa jitvā puruṣapravīra-- stathaiva hārdikyamukhāṃstvadīyān
prahasya sūtaṃ vacanaṃ babhāṣe śinipravīraḥ kurupuṅgavāgrya
nimittamātraṃ vayamadya sūta dagdhā rathāḥ keśavaphalgunābhyām
taṃ yāntamaśvaiḥ śaśiśaṅkhavarṇai-- rvigāhya sainyaṃ puruṣapravīram
asahyavikrāntamadīnasatvaṃ sarve gaṇā bhārata ye tvadīyāḥ
tathaiva śakrapratimo'pi sātyakiḥ sudarśane yānkṣipati sma sāyakān
vivyādha dehāvaraṇaṃ vibhidya te sātyakerāviviśuḥ śarīram
athāsya sūtasya śiro nikṛtya bhallena śakrāśanisannibhena
sakuṇḍalaṃ pūrṇaśaśiprakāśaṃ bhrājiṣṇu vaktraṃ vicakarta dehāt
yathā purā vajradharaḥ prasahya balasya saṅkhye'tibalasya rājan
mudā sametaḥ parayā mahātmā rarāja rājansurarājakalpaḥ
tato yayāvarjunameva vīro nivārya sainyaṃ tava mārgaṇaughaiḥ
prāṇāpahāriṇaṃ raudraṃ vāditroddhuṣṭanāditam śūrāṇāṃ sukhasaṃsparśamaspṛśyamatha bhīruṇām
hārdikyaṃ yodhavaryaṃ ca manye prāptaṃ dhanañjayam
na hi me jāyate trāso dṛṣṭvā sainyānyanekaśaḥ
dravate tadyathā sainyaṃ tena bhagnaṃ mahātmanā rathairviparidhāvadbhirgajairaśvaiśca sārathe
na sambhramo me vārṣṇeya vidyate satyavikrama
droṇo vā rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛpo madreśvaro'pi vā
śaravāṇāsanadharā yavanāśca prahāriṇaḥ śakāḥ kirātā daradā barbarāstāmraliptakāḥ
na ca me sambhramaḥ kaścidbhūtapūrvaḥ kathañcana
adya snehaṃ ca bhaktiṃ ca pāṇḍaveṣu mahātmasu
balaṃ vīryaṃ kṛtajñatvaṃ mama jñāsyanti kauravāḥ
te hanyamānā vīreṇa mlecchāḥ sātyakinā raṇe
pañca ṣaṭ sapta cāṣṭau ca bhibheda yavanāñśaraiḥ
hitvā dehāṃstathā teṣāṃ patanti sma mahītale
yavanānāṃ ca tatsainyaṃ śakānāṃ ca mahadbalam
jagāma tava sainyasya madhyena rathināṃ varaḥ
tāvakānāṃ babhau madhye gavāṃ madhye yathā vṛṣaḥ
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrāḥ śastravanto durāsadāḥ
idameti samuddhūtaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrabalaṃ mahat māmevābhimukhaṃ tūrṇaṃ gajāśvarathapattimat
pṛthivīṃ cāntarikṣaṃ ca kampayansāgarānapi etadbalārṇavaṃ sūta vārayiṣye mahāraṇe
eṣa sainyāni śatrūṇāṃ vidhamāmi śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ityevaṃ bruvatastasya sātyakeramitaujasaḥ samīpe sainikāste tu śīghramīyuryuyutsavaḥ
tānevaṃ bruvato vīrānsātyakirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ jaghānaṃ triśatānaśvānkuñjarāṃśca catuḥśatān
padātinaṃ rathaṃ nāgaṃ sādinaṃ turagaṃ tathā
tato duryodhano rājā sātvatasya tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ sa rathināṃ śreṣṭhastava putrasya sārathim
vidrutaṃ tatra tatsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārata sātyakiḥ
taṃ prayāntaṃ mahābāhuṃ tāvakāḥ prekṣya māriṣa
taṃ śarānādadānaṃ ca rakṣamāṇaṃ ca sārathim
nirhīkā mama te putrāḥ kimakurvata sañjaya
kiṃ nu vakṣyanti te kṣātraṃ sainyamadhye parājitāḥ
kathaṃ ca mama putrāṇāṃ jīvatāṃ tatra sañjaya
ekasya hi na paryāptaṃ yatsainyaṃ tasya sañjaya
parāṃ yuddhe matiṃ krūrāṃ tava putrasya śāsanāt
kulindāstaṅkaṇāmbaṣṭhāḥ paiśācāśca sabarbarāḥ pārvatīyāśca rājendra kruddhāḥ pāṣāṇapāṇayaḥ
añjanasya kule jātā vāmanasya ca bhārata
abhidravata mābhaiṣṭa na vaḥ prāpsyati sātyakiḥ
hataśiṣṭāḥ sarudhirā bhinnamastakapiṇḍikāḥ vibhinnaśiraso rājandantaiśchinnaiśca dantinaḥ
taṃ śabdaṃ tumulaṃ śrutvā droṇo yantāramabravīt
eṣa sūta raṇe kruddhaḥ sātvatānāṃ mahārathaḥ
na śaknuvanti yantāraḥ saṃyantuṃ tumule hayān
ime ca saṃhatāḥ śūrāḥ pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
svāne vā gamane vāpi dūraṃ yātaśca sātyakiḥ
yaistu duḥśāsanaḥ sārdhaṃ rathaiḥ pūrvaṃ nyavartata
dāsī jitā'si dyūte tvaṃ yathā kāmacarī bhava
vāsasāṃ vāhikā rājño bhrāturjyeṣṭhasya me bhava
na santi patayaḥ sarve te'dya ṣaṇḍhatilaiḥ samāḥ
svayaṃ vairaṃ mahatkṛtvā pāñcālaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
na jānīṣe purā tvaṃ tu gṛhṇannakṣāndurodare
kva te mānaśca darpaśca kva te vīryaṃ kva garjitam
śocyeyaṃ bhāratī senā rājyaṃ caiva suyodhanaḥ
nanu nāma tvayā vīra dāryamāṇā bhayārditā
sa tvamadya raṇaṃ hitvā bhīto harṣayase parān vidrute tvayi sainyasya nāyake śatrumūdana
ko'nyaḥ sthāsyati saṅgrāme bhīto bhīte vyapāśraye
yamau ca drakṣyasi raṇe tadā vai kiṃ kariṣyasi
na tulyāḥ sātyakiśarā yebhyo bhītaḥ palāyase
yāvatte pṛthivīṃ pārthā hatvā bhrātṛśataṃ raṇe
ajeyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ saṅkhye saumya saṃśāmya taiḥ saha
mayā śamavatā cokto rakṣa śeṣaṃ suyodhana
sa yuddhe dhṛtimāsthāya yatto yudhyasva pāṇḍavaiḥ
tavāpi śoṇitaṃ bhīmaḥ pāsyatīti mayā śrutam
kiṃ bhīmasya na jānāsi vikramaṃ tvaṃ subāliśa
gaccha tūrṇaṃ rathenaiva yatra tiṣṭhati sātyakiḥ
praviśya ca raṇe droṇaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ varūthinīm
tato droṇo mahārāja nāma viśrāvya saṃyuge
sanniruddhaṃ rame droṇaṃ pāñcalā vīkṣya māriṣa
citraketuḥ sudhanvā ca citravarmā ca bhārata
tataḥ śaramayaṃ jālaṃ droṇasteṣāmavāsṛjat te hanyamānā droṇasya śarairākarṇacoditaiḥ
te rathebhyo hatāḥ petuḥ kṣitau rājansuvarcasaḥ
pāñcālānnihatāndṛṣṭvā devakalpānmahārathān dhṛṣṭadyumno bhṛśodvigno netrābhyāṃ pātayañjalam
niṣasāda rathopasthe kaśmalaṃ ca jagāma ha
taṃ vai tathāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ parākramī
cāpamutsṛjya śīghraṃ tu asiṃ jagrāha vīryavān
avaplutya rathāccāpi tvaritaḥ sa mahārathaḥ āruroha rathaṃ tūrṇaṃ bhāradvājasya māriṣa
te hi vaitastikā nāma śarā āmannayodhinaḥ
āruhya svarathaṃ vīraḥ pragṛhya ca mahaddhanuḥ
mohayantau manāṃsyājau yodhānāṃ droṇapārṣatau sṛjantau śaravarṣāṇi varṣāsviva balāhakau
kṣatriyāśca mahārāja ye cānye tava sainikāḥ
vijitya pāṇḍupāñcālānbhāradvājaḥ pratāpavān svaṃ vyūhaṃ punarāsthāya sthito'bhavadarindamaḥ
na cainaṃ pāṇḍavā yuddhe jetumutsehire prabho
sa vidvvā sātyakiṃ ṣaṣṭyā tathā ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
parjanya iva ghoṣeṇa nādayanvai diśo daśa
sātyakiṃ ca śatenājau viddhvā nādaṃ mumoca saḥ
rathaṃ sūtaṃ dhvajaṃ taṃ ca cakre'dṛśyamajihmagaiḥ
tvaransamāvṛṇodbāṇairduḥśāsanamamitrajit dṛṣṭvā duḥśāsanaṃ rājā tathā śaraśatācitam
te tu taṃ rathavaṃśena mahatā paryavārayan
sthirāṃ kṛtvā matiṃ yuddhe bhūtvā saṃśaptakā mithaḥ
sa tu taṃ prativivyādha pañcabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tāṃ tu śaktiṃ tadā ghorāṃ tava putrasya sātyakiḥ
sātyakiṃ ca śarairviddhvā siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca
sātyakistu raṇe kruddho mohayitvā sutaṃ tava
dhvajaṃ ca rathaśaktiṃ ca bhallābhyāṃ paramastrivit
bhīmasenena tu vadhaḥ sutānāṃ tava bhārata
tato duḥśāsanaṃ jitvā sātyakiḥ saṃyuge prabho
yatkṛtaṃ vṛṣṇivīreṇa karma śaṃsasi me raṇe
na santi tasmātputrā me yathā sañjaya bhāṣase
nāsti loke samaḥ kaścitsamūha iti me matiḥ
na ca vai tādṛśo vyūha āsītkaścidviśāmpate
tvadbale prāṇḍavānāṃ ca sahasrāṇi śatāni ca
anyonyaṃ nighnatāṃ caiva narāṇāṃ śuśruve svanaḥ
yatra yātau mahātmānau tūrṇaṃ parapurañjayau te yūyaṃ sahitā bhūtvā tūrṇameva balārṇavam
kavacānāṃ prabhāstatra sūryaraśmivirājitāḥ dṛṣṭīḥ saṅkhye sainikānāṃ pratijaghnuḥ samantataḥ
samprahṛṣṭaḥ sa sahasā tava sainyārṇavaṃ prati
tatra sma kadanaṃ ghoraṃ vartate pāṇḍupūrvaja
kruddhe'rjune tathā droṇe sātvate ca mahārathe
tathā yāteṣu sainyeṣu tathā kṛcchragataḥ svayam
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca sannipāto mahāhave
ekasya bahubhiḥ sārdhaṃ śṛṇuṣva gadato mama
tatastāṃ prahatāṃ senāṃ dṛṣṭvā putreṇa te nṛpa
varma cāśu samāsādya te bhittvā kṣitimāviśan
yathā vṛtravadhe devāḥ purā śakraṃ maharṣayaḥ
arjunasya mahābāho tāvakānāṃ ca dhanvinām madhye bhāratasainyasya mādhavasya mahāraṇe
kruddhe'rjune tathā droṇe sātvate ca mahārathe
tava priyahite yukto maheṣvāso mahābalaḥ citrapuṅkhaiḥ śitairbāṇaiḥ kalaśottamasambhavaḥ
taṃ droṇo dvipadāṃ śreṣṭho nārācena samārpayat
dvābhyāṃ dhvajaṃ ca cchatraṃ ca cchittvā bhūmāvapātayat
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sārathī rathināṃ varam
tasya droṇo dhanurmadhye kṣurapreṇa śitena ca
tomaraṃ vyasṛjadvīraḥ śaktiṃ ca kana kojjvalām
sa tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā hṛdayaṃ cāmitaujasaḥ
pataṅgaṃ hi graseccāṣo yathā kṣudraṃ bubhukṣitaḥ
chādayitvā rame droṇaṃ rathasthaṃ rathināṃ varam
tato droṇo mahārāja nāma viśrāvya saṃyuge
te tu nāmāṅkitā bāṇā droṇenāstāḥ śilāśitāḥ
hata droṇaṃ hata droṇamiti te droṇamabhyayuḥ
ninīpavo raṇe droṇaṃ yamasya sadanaṃ prati
brāhmaṇena tapo nūnaṃ caritaṃ duścaraṃ mahat
tathā hi yudhi saṅkruddho dahati kṣatriyarpabhān
dharmo yuddhaṃ kṣatriyasya brāhmaṇasya paraṃ tapaḥ
tasya sūte hate te'śvā rathamādāya vidrutāḥ
śataśaḥ śerate bhūmau nikṛttā govṛṣā iva
yudhiṣṭhiro dadarśātha naiva pārthaṃ na mādhavam
apaśyansātyakiṃ cāpi vṛṣṇīnāṃ pravaraṃ ratham cintayābhiparītāṅgo dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
atibhāre niyuktaśca mayā śaineyanandanaḥ sa tu mitroparodhena gauravāttu mahābalaḥ
praviṣṭo bhāratīṃ senāṃ makaraḥ sāgaraṃ yathā
prāptakālaṃ subalavanniścitaṃ bahudhā hi me tatraiva pāṇḍaveyasya bhīmasenasya dhanvinaḥ
gamanaṃ rocate mahyaṃ yatra yātau mahārathau
na cāpyasahyaṃ bhīmasya vidyate bhuvi kiñcina
śakto hyeṣa raṇe yattaḥ pṛthivyāṃ sarvadhanvinām
vanavāsānnivṛttāḥ sma na ca yuddheṣu nirjitāḥ
ito gate bhīmasene sātvataṃ prati pāṇḍave
tataḥ pratikṛtaṃ manye vidhānaṃ sātyakiṃ prati evaṃ niścitya manasā dharmaputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
sa kaśmalasamāviṣṭo bhīmamāhūya pārthivaḥ abravīdvacanaṃ rājankuntīputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi bhīmasenānujasya te
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājendra śādhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
na hyasādhyamakāryaṃ vā vidyate mama mānada
ājñāpaya kuruśreṣṭha mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
nūnamadya hataḥ śete tava bhrātā dhanañjayaḥ
tasya vai gamanaṃ vidmo bhīma nāvartanaṃ punaḥ
tasya lakṣma na paśyāmi tena vindāmi kaśmalam
taṃ viddhi puruṣavyāghraṃ sātvataṃ ca mahāratham
sahayo nāsya vai kaścittena vindāmi kaśmalam
na hi me śudhyate bhāvastayoreva parantapa
sa tatra gaccha kaunteya yatra yāto dhanañjayaḥ
vacanaṃ mama dharmajña bhrātā jyeṣṭho bhavāmi te
dṛṣṭvā kuśalinau kṛṣṇau sātvataṃ caiva sātyakim
tamāsthāya gatau kṛṣṇau na tayorvidyate bhayam
tavājñāṃ śirasā bibhradeṣa gacchāmi mā śucaḥ
etāvaduktvā prayayau paridāya yudhiṣṭhiram dhṛṣṭadyumnāya balavānsuhṛdbhyaśca punaḥpunaḥ
viditaṃ te mahābāho yathā droṇo mahārathaḥ
na ca me gamane kṛtyaṃ tādṛkpārṣata vidyate
yādṛśaṃ rakṣaṇe rājñaḥ kāryamātyayikaṃ hi naḥ
prayāsye tatra yatrāsau mumūrṣuḥ saindhavaḥ sthitaḥ
yāsyāmi padavīṃ bhrātuḥ sātvatasya ca dhīmataḥ
so'dya yatto raṇe rārthaṃ parirakṣa yudhiṣṭhiram
tato nikṣipya rājānaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumne ca pāṇḍavam
abhivādya guruṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ prayayau yena phalgunaḥ
bhīmaseno mahābāhuḥ kavacī śubhakuṇḍalī sagadaḥ satalatrāṇaḥ saśarī rathināṃ varaḥ
prayāte bhīmasene tu tava sainyaṃ yuyutsayā
taṃ śrutvā ninadaṃ ghoraṃ trailokyatrāsanaṃ mahat
nūnamāryā mahatkuntī pāpaṃ vyasanamīdṛśam draupadī ca subhadrā ca paśyanti saha bandhubhiḥ
tadbhīma tvarayā yukto yāhi yatra dhanañjayaḥ
diśaśca pradiśaḥ pārtha sātvatasya ca kāraṇāt
jyeṣṭhena prahito bhrātrā bhrātā bhrātuḥ priyaṅkaraḥ
āhatya dundubhiṃ bhīmaḥ śaṅkhaṃ pradhmāpya cāsakṛt
taiḥ samantādvṛtaḥ śūraiḥ samareṣu mahārathaḥ tānsamīkṣya tu kaunteyo bhīmasenaḥ parākramī
te mahāstrāṇi divyāni tatra vīrā adarśayan
te vadhyamānāḥ samare tava putrā mahārathāḥ
vindānuvindau sahitau suvarmāṇaṃ ca te sutam
tataḥ sudarśanaṃ vīraṃ putraṃ te bharatarṣabha
vivyādha samare tūrṇaṃ sa papāta mamāra ca
tato vai rathaghoṣeṇa garjitena mṛgā iva bhajyamānāśca samare tava putrā viśāmpate
vadhyamānā mahārāja bhīmasenena tāvakāḥ tyaktvā bhīmaṃ raṇājjagmuścodayanto hayottamān
yadi te sānujaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ praviṣṭo'numate mama
anīkaṃ na tu śakyaṃ me praveṣṭumiha vai tvayā
kruddhaḥ provāca vai droṇaṃ raktatāmrekṣaṇaḥ śvasan
praviṣṭaḥ sa hi durdharṣaḥ śakrasyāpi viśedbalam
yena tvaṃ paramāṃ pūjāṃ kurvatā mānito hyasi
nārjuno'haṃ ghṛṇī vipra bhīmaseno'smi te ripuḥ
pitā nastvaṃ gururbandhustadā putrā hi rte vayam
iti manyāmahe sarve bhavantaṃ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ
tadadya viparītaṃ te vadato'smāsu dṛśyate yadi śatruṃ tvamātmānaṃ manyase tattathā'stviha
eṣa te sadṛśaṃ karma śatrorbhīmaḥ kariṣyati
droṇaṃ tu virathaṃ kṛtvā bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ
sa taistu saṃvṛto bhīmaḥ krodhena pradahanniva udyacchansa gadāṃ tebhyaḥ sughorāṃ siṃhavannadan
jvalantī tejasā bhīmā trāsayāmāsa te sutān
prādravanta raṇe bhītā vyāghraghrātā mṛgā iva
bhīmaṃ tu samare droṇo vārayitvā śarormibhiḥ
droṇasya ca mahārāja bhīmasya ca mahātmanaḥ
aṃse śiro bhīmasenaḥ karau kṛtvorasi sthirau
yathā hi govṛṣo varṣaṃ pratigṛhṇāti līlayā
sa vadhyamānaḥ samare rathaṃ droṇasya māriṣa
droṇastu satvaro rājankṣipto bhīmena saṃyuge dadṛśe tāvakairyodhairvismayotphullalocanaiḥ
tamāyāntaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā bhagnotsāhaṃ guruṃ tadā
gatvā vegātpunarbhīmo dhuraṃ gṛhya rathasya tu
rathena yattaḥ kaunteyo vegena prayayau tadā
taṃ tasya ninadaṃ ghoraṃ pārthaḥ śuśrāva nardataḥ
tau śrutvā yugapadvīrau ninadaṃ tasya śuṣmiṇaḥ
tataḥ pārtho mahānādaṃ muñcanvai mādhavaśca ha
tathā tu nardamāne vai bhīmasene madotkaṭe
hṛdgataṃ manasā prāha dhyātvā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
na hi teṣāṃ jayo yuddhe yeṣāṃ dveṣṭā'si pāṇḍava
diṣṭyā ca kuśalī vīraḥ sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ
yena śakraṃ raṇe jitvā tarpito havyavāhanaḥ
sa hantā dviṣatāṃ saṅkhye diṣṭyā jīvati phalgunaḥ
sa hantā ri pusainyānāṃ diṣṭyā jīvati phalgunaḥ
nirjitā dhanuṣaikena diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati
mama priyaśca satataṃ diṣṭyā pārthaḥ sa jīvati
putraśokābhisantaptaścikīrṣankarma duṣkaram jayadrathavadhānveṣī pratijñāṃ kṛtavānhi yaḥ
śeṣasya rakṣaṇārthaṃ ca sandhāsyati suyodhanaḥ evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tasya rājñaścintayatastadā
ninadantaṃ tathā taṃ tu bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam
na hi paśyāmyahaṃ taṃ vai triṣu lokeṣu kañcana
na hi paśyāmyahaṃ yuddhe yastiṣṭhedagrataḥ pumān
rathaṃ rathena yo hanyātkuñjaraṃ kuñcareṇa ca
kāleneva prajāḥ sarvāḥ ke bhīmaṃ paryavārayan
tathā tu nardamānaṃ taṃ bhīmasenaṃ mahābalam
bhīmo'pi dṛṣṭvā sāvegaṃ puro vaikartanaṃ sthitam
rathināṃ sādināṃ caiva tayoḥ śrutvā talasvanam
khaṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca saṃruddhāṃ menire kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ
cikṣepa ca punarbāṇāñśataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ sa śarairarditastena karṇena dṛḍhadhanvinā
nirjitya tu raṇe karṇaṃ bhīmasenaḥ pratāpavān
mṛdupūrvaṃ tu rādheyo dṛḍhapūrvaṃ tu pāṇḍavaḥ
vivyādha sārathiṃ cāsya hayāṃśca caturaḥ śaraiḥ dhvajaṃ cāsya patākāṃ ca bhallaiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
rathaṃ ca cakrarakṣau ca bhīmaściccheda māriṣa
bhīmaściccheda khaṅgaṃ ca carmaṇā saha māriṣa
dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ ca pārthena bādhitaṃ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ duryodhano mahārāja duśśalaṃ pratyabhāṣata karṇaṃ kṛcchragataṃ paśya śīghraṃ yānaṃ prayacchaha
tau pārthaḥ sahasā gatvā vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
bhīmo viddhā hayāṃścaiva sārathiṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
tasminvilulite sainye saindhavāyārjune gate sātvate bhīmasene ca putraste droṇamabhyayāt
sa rathastava putrasya tvarayā parayā yutaḥ
iha dṛṣṭa ito naṣṭaḥ sarathaḥ prādravannṛpaḥ muhūrtādiva putraste droṇamāsādya māriṣa
āścaryabhūto loke'sminsamudrasyeva śoṣaṇam nirjayastava viprāgrya sātvatenārjunena ca
kathaṃ droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye dhanurvedasya pāragaḥ
nāśa eva tu me nūnaṃ mandabhāgyasya saṃyuge
evaṃ gate tu kṛtye'sminbrūhi yatte vivakṣitam
tatsaṃvidhīyatāṃ kṣipraṃ sādhu sañcintya no dvija
cintyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ tāta yatkṛtyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva me
sā purastācca paścācca gṛhītā bhāratī camūḥ
samprāptaṃ tadidaṃ dyūtaṃ yattacchakunibuddhijam na sabhāyāṃ jayo vṛtto nāpi tatra parājayaḥ
yatra te bahavastāta kauraveyā vyavasthitāḥ sennāṃ durodaraṃ viddhi śarānakṣānviśāmpate
glahaṃ ca saindhavaṃ rājaṃstatra dyūtasya niścayaḥ
saindhave tu mahaddyūṃta samāsaktaṃ paraiḥ saha
atra te dhruvamāyatto jayo vā'jaya eva vā
atra sarve mahārāja tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ saindhavasya raṇe rakṣāṃ vidhivatkartumarhatha
yatra te parameṣvāsā yattā rakṣanti saindhavam
tatra gaccha svayaṃ śīghraṃ tāṃśca rakṣasva rakṣiṇaḥ
yau tu pūrvaṃ mahārāja vāritau kṛtavarmaṇā
pārśve bhittvā camūṃ vīrau praviṣṭau tava vāhinīm
hayeṣu patiteṣvasya ciccheda parameṣuṇā yudhāmanyurdhanuḥ śīghraṃ śarāvāpaṃ ca saṃyuge
tataḥ sa hemacitraṃ taṃ gadayā syandanaṃ gatī
bhaṅktvā rathaṃ sa putraste hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ
yathā nāgo vane nāgaṃ matto mattamabhidravet
mṛdupūrvaṃ ca rādheyo dṛḍhapūrvaṃ ca pāṇḍavaḥ
yau tau karṇaśca bhīmaśca samprayuddhau mahābalau
pūrvaṃ hi nirjitaḥ karṇo bhīmasenena saṃyuge
bhīmo vā sūtatanayaṃ pratyudyātaḥ kathaṃ raṇe
bhayādyasya mahābāho na śete bahulāḥ samāḥ cintayannityaśo vīryaṃ rādheyasya mahātmanaḥ
kathaṃ karṇaṃ yudhāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yodhayāmāsa pāṇḍavaḥ
bhrātṛtvaṃ darśitaṃ pūrvaṃ ghṛṇī cāpi sa sūtajaḥ
bhīmo vā sūtaputreṇa smaranvairaṃ purā kṛtam
ayudhyata kathaṃ śūraḥ karṇena saha saṃyuge
āśāste ca sadā sūtaputre duryodhano mama
jayāśā yatra putrasya mama mandasya saṃyuge
yaṃ samāsādya putrairme kṛtaṃ vairaṃ mahārathaiḥ
taṃ sūtatanayaṃ tāta kathaṃ bhīmo hyayodhayat
taṃ sūtatanayaṃ yuddhe kathaṃ bhīmo hyayodhayat
yo jātaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca kavacena sahaiva ca
karṇa uvāca bhīmāhitaistava raṇaḥ svapne'pi na vibhāvitaḥ
taddarśayasi kasmānme pṛṣṭhaṃ pārthadidṛkṣayā kuntyāḥ putrasya sadṛśaṃ nedaṃ pāṇḍavanandana
hatvā tasyānugāṃstaṃ ca hantukāmo mahābalaḥ tasmai vyasṛjadugrāṇi vividhāni parantapaḥ
bibhradbhīmo mahārāja na jagāma vyathāṃ raṇe
nipetuḥ sarvato vīre kūjanta iva pakṣiṇaḥ
tatra bhārata bhīmaṃ tu dṛṣṭavantaḥ sma sāyakaiḥ
tattu bhīmo mahābāhoḥ karṇasya caritaṃ raṇe
sa vaiklavyaṃ mahatprāpya cchinnadhanvā śarāhataḥ tathā puruṣamānī sa lajjāmutsṛjya bhārata
tadviśiṣṭo'pi vā karṇaḥ śiṣyaḥ śiṣyaguṇairyutaḥ kuntīputreṇa bhīmena nirjitaḥ sa tu līlayā ]
kathaṃ ca yuyudhe bhīmo vīryaślāghī mahābalaḥ
karṇo vā samare tāta kimakārṣīdataḥ param
cāpaśabdaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā talaśabdaṃ ca bhairavam
tṛṇīkṛtya ca yatpārthāṃstava putro vavalga ha
sa sāyakayairjālairbhīmaḥ karṇarathaṃ prati bhānumadbhiḥ śilādhautairbhānoḥ prācchādayatprabhāṃ
karṇaḥ pratyudyayau yuddhe matto mattamiva dvipam
sa kathaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ yuddhe bhrājamānamiva śriyā
kathaṃ ca yuddhaṃ sambhūtaṃ tayoḥ prāṇadurodare
atra manye samāyatto jayo vā'jaya eva ca
karṇaṃ prāpya raṇe sūta mama putraḥ suyodhanaḥ
na ca tadbudhyate mandaḥ putro duryodhano mama
dhanaṃ dhaneśvarasyeva hṛtvā pārthasya me sutaḥ
aśakta iti matvā tu mama putrairnirākṛtaḥ
tasmānme sañjaya brūhi karṇabhīmau yathā raṇe
pragṛhya ca mahāśaktiṃ kālarātrimivāparām samutkṣipya ca rādheyaḥ sandhāya ca mahābalaḥ
taṃ ca nādaṃ tataḥ śrutvā putrāste harṣitā'bhavan
chittvā bhīmo mahārāja nādaṃ siṃha ivānadat
tasya bhīmaḥ punaścāpaṃ muṣṭau ciccheda māriṣa śaṅkhavarṇāṃśca tānaśvānbāṇairninye yamakṣayam
tato vaikartanaḥ karṇaścintāṃ prāpa duratyayām sa cchādyamānaḥ samare hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ
tathā kṛcchragataṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ duryodhano nṛpaḥ
gaccha durjaya rādheyaṃ purā grasati pāṇḍavaḥ
ṣaṅbhiḥ sūtaṃ tribhiḥ ketaṃ punastaṃ cāpi saptabhiḥ
bāḍhaṃ hataṃ kṣitau kṣuṇṇaṃ veṣṭamānaṃ yathoragam
sa tu taṃ virathaṃ kṛtvā smayannatyantavairiṇam
na jahau samare bhīmaṃ kruddharūpaṃ parantapaḥ
dhvajamekena vivyādha viśokaṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ vajrakalpāṃ catuṣkiṣkuṃ gurvī rukmāṅgadāṃ gadām
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā svarṇacitraṃ mahojasaḥ
te bhīmasenasya bhujaṃ savyaṃ nirbhidya patriṇaḥ
susrāva rudhiraṃ bhūri parvataḥ salilaṃ yathā
karṇaḥ pārthānsagovindāñjetumutsahate raṇe na ca karṇasamaṃ loke paśyāmi kañcana
tatra taṃ nirjitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhujaṅgamiva nirviṣam
na śaktyāḥ pramukhe sthātuṃ nūnaṃ bhīmasya sañjaya
na sa pāṇḍusuto jetuṃ śakyaḥ kenacidāhave
droṇaṃ yaḥ sampramathyaikaḥ praviṣṭo mama vāhinīm
karṇo duḥśāsano'haṃ ca jeṣyāmo yudhi pāṇḍavān
sa nūnaṃ virathaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ bhīmena nirjitam
na pārthā na ca pañcālā na ca keśavasātyakī
aho mama sutānāṃ hi vipannaṃ sūta jīvitam
tvamasya jagato mūlaṃ vināśasya na saṃśayaḥ
svayaṃ vairaṃ mahatkṛtvā putrāṇāṃ vacane sthitaḥ
yatpratyakṣaṃ tava sutā bhīmena nihatā raṇe
tasya bhīmo hayānhatvā vinihatya ca sārathim
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā tathā bāhuṃ ca dakṣiṇam
tvaradhvaṃ sarvato yattā rādheyasya rathaṃ prati
te hatā nyapatanbhūmau vātarūgṇā iva drumāḥ
sa nandayanraṇe pārthaṃ keśavaṃ ca yaśasvinam
tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmaṃ viddhā tribhiḥ śūraiḥ punaśca ṣaḍbhistīkṣṇāgrairavidhyatkaṅkapatribhiḥ
sa karṇaṃ karṇinā karṇe pītena niśitena ca
sa muhūrtātpunaḥ saṃjñāṃ lebhe karṇaḥ parantapaḥ
tataḥ kruddho raṇe karṇaḥ pīḍito dṛḍhadhanvanā
tāvubhau naraśārdūlau śārdūlāviva daṃṣṭriṇau śaradaṃṣṭrau samāsādya tatakṣaturarindamau
tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ ṣaṣṭhameva hi
saptamaṃ cāṣṭamaṃ caiva navamaṃ daśamaṃ tathā
tathā saptadaśaṃ vegādaṣṭādaśamathāpi vā bahūni bhīmaściccheda karṇasyaivaṃ dhanūṃṣi hi
bhīmaṃ praikṣata rādheyo ghoraṃ ghoreṇa cakṣuṣā
tatra bhārata bhīmasya balaṃ vīryaṃ parākramam
na sma sūryastadā bhāti na sma vāti samīraṇaḥ
punaścāsṛjadugrāṇi śaravarṣāṇi pāṇḍavaḥ tasya tānyādade karṇaḥ sarvāṇyastrāṇyabhītavat
tasyeṣudhī dhanurjyāṃ ca bāṇaiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ raśmīnyoktrāṇi cāśvānāṃ kruddhaḥ karṇo'cchinanmṛdhe
sopasṛtya drutaṃ sūto yudhāmanyo rathaṃ yayau
dhvajaṃ ciccheda rādheyaḥ patākāṃ ca vyapātayat
sa dhanuḥ sūtaputrasya sajyaṃ chittvā mahānasiḥ
papāta bhuvi rājendra kruddhaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt
sa tasya caritaṃ dṛṣṭvā saṅgrāme vijayaiṣiṇaḥ
tadasya sarvaṃ ciccheda kṣiptaṃkṣiptaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
rakṣamāṇaḥ pratijñāṃ tāṃ yā kṛtā savyasācinā
tamevaṃ vyākulaṃ bhīmaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
vyāyudhaṃ nāvadhīccainaṃ karṇaḥ kuntyā vacaḥ smaran
dhanuṣā spṛṣṭamātreṇa kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan
yatra bhojyaṃ bahuvidhaṃ bhakṣyaṃ peyaṃ ca pāṇḍava
tatra tvaṃ durmate yogyo na yuddheṣu kadācana
ucitastvaṃ vane bhīma na tvaṃ yuddhaviśāradaḥ
kva yudvaṃ kva munitvaṃ ca vanaṃ gaccha vṛkodara
vanāya vraja kaunteya na tvaṃ yuddhaviśāradaḥ
na tvāṃ śastrasamudyoge yogyaṃ manye vṛkodara
evaṃ taṃ virathaṃ dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā karṇo'bravīdvacaḥ
yoddhavyaṃ māriṣānyatra na yoddhavyaṃ ca mādṛśaiḥ
gaccha vā yatra tau kṛṣṇau tau tvāṃ rakṣiṣyato raṇe
gṛhaṃ vā gaccha kaunteya kiṃ te yuddhena bālaka
mallayuddhaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ kuru duṣkulasambhava mahābalo mahābhogī kīcako nihato yathā
evaṃ taṃ virathaṃ kṛtvā karṇo rājanvyakatthayat
taṃ bruvāṇaṃ tu bhīmaḥ sa kāṅkṣanbhīmaparākramaḥ
evamuktastadā pārthaḥ keśavena mahātmanā bhīmasenaṃ tathābhūtaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ
na vigraho hi balinā śreyase syādyathātathā
ato'nyadvāpi kṛtvaiva jīvyaṃ loke nareṇa vai
jīvataiva paro lokaḥ sādhyate caiva sarvathā
vināśe sarvathotpanne na bālo budhyate kriyām
ahanyahani me dīptaṃ yaśaḥ patati sañjaya
hatā me bahavo yodhā manye kālasya paryayam
apriyaṃ sumahatkṛtvā sindhurājaḥ kirīṭinaḥ kruddhasya devarājasya śakrasyeva mahādyuteḥ
tasya me vṛṣṇivīrasya brūhi yuddhaṃ yathātatham
tathā tu vaikarta napīḍitaṃ taṃ bhīmaṃ prayāntaṃ puruṣapravīram
nadanyathā vajradharastapānte jvalanyathā jaladānte ca sūryaḥ
nighnannamitrāndhanuṣā dṛḍhena sa kampayaṃstava putrasya senām
taṃ yāntamaśvai rajataprakāśai-- rāyodhane vīrataraṃ nadantam
nāśaknuvanvārayituṃ tvadīyāḥ sarve rathā bhārata mādhavāgryam
tayorabhūdbhārata samprahāro yathāvidho naiva babhūva kaścit
prekṣanta evāhavaśobhinau tau yodhāstvadīyāśca pare ca sarve
āvidhyadenaṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkai-- ralambuso rājavaraḥ prasahya
anāgatāneva tu tānpṛṣatkāṃ-- ściccheda bāṇaiḥ śinipuṅgavo'pi
vivyādha dehāvaraṇaṃ vidārya te sātyakerāviviśuḥ śarīram
athāsya sūtasya śiro nikṛtya bhallena kālānalasannibhena
sakuṇḍalaṃ pūrmaśaśiprakāśaṃ bhrājiṣṇu vaktraṃ nicakarta dehāt
nihatya taṃ pārthivaputrapautraṃ saṅkhye yadūnāmṛṣabhaḥ pramāthī
sa cāpi tānpravaraḥ sātvatānāṃ nyavārayadbāṇajālena vīraḥ
tato'rjuno harṣamavāpa saṅkhye kṛṣṇaśca dṛṣṭvā puruṣapravīram
athainamanuvṛttāstu trigartāḥ sahitāḥ punaḥ tīvreṇa rathavaṃśena mahatā paryavārayan
pratīcyāṃ diśi taṃ dṛṣṭvā prācyāṃ paśyāmi lāghavāt
eṣa śiṣyaḥ sakhā caiva tava satyaparākramaḥ
eṣa droṇaṃ tathā bhojaṃ kṛtavarmāṇameva ca
priyaḥ śiṣyaśca te pārtha tvayā tulyaparākramaḥ
yasya nāsti samo yodhaḥ kauraveṣu kathañcana
eṣa duryodhanaṃ jitvā bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaṃ raṇe
na me priyaṃ mahābāho yanmāmabhyeti sātyakiḥ
na hi jānāmi vṛttāntaṃ dharmarājasya keśava
sātvatena vihīnaḥ sa yadi jīvati vā na vā
etena hi mahābāho rakṣitavyaḥ sa pārthivaḥ
jñātavyaśca hi me rājā rakṣitavyaśca sātyakiḥ
na ca bhūriśravāḥ śrāntaḥ sasahāyaśca keśava
apīdānīṃ bhavedasya kṣemamasminsamāgame kaccinna sāgaraṃ tīrtvā sātyakiḥ satyavikramaḥ
na hi me mokṣyase jīvanyadi notsṛjase raṇam
adya tvāṃ samare hatvā nityaṃ śūrābhimāninam
adya dharmasuto rājā śrutvā tvāṃ nihataṃ mayā
adya me vikramaṃ pārtho vijñāsyati dhanañjayaḥ
purā devāsure yuddhe śakrasya balinā yathā
adya yuddhaṃ mahāghoraṃ tava dāsyāmi sātvata
adya saṃyamanīṃ yātā mayā tvaṃ nihato raṇe
tatstriyo nandayiṣyāmi ye tvayā nihatā raṇe
maccakṣurviṣaye prāpto na tvaṃ mādhava mokṣyase
kauraveya na santrāso vidyate mama saṃyuge
nāhaṃ bhīṣayituṃ śakyo vāṅmātreṇa tu kevalam
sa māṃ nihanyātsaṅgrāme yo māṃ kuryānnirāyudham
śrutvā tvadgarjitaṃ vīra hāsyaṃ hi mama jāyate
cirakālepsitaṃ loke yuddhamadyāstu kaurava tvarate me matistāta tava yuddhābhikāṅkṣiṇī
sametau tau maheṣvāsau śuṣmiṇau spardhinau raṇe
nirbhidantau hi gātrāṇi vikṣarantau ca śoṇitam
ārṣabhe carmaṇī citre pragṛhya vipule śubhe
vikośau cāpyasī kṛtvā samare tau viceratuḥ
carantau vividhānmārgānmaṇḍalāni ca bhāgaśaḥ muhurājaghnatuḥ kruddhāvanyonyamarimardanau
paśyasvainaṃ virathaṃ yudhyamānaṃ raṇe varaṃ sarvadhanurdharāṇām
sīdantaṃ sātyakiṃ paśya pārthainaṃ parirakṣa ca
praviṣṭo bhāratīṃ bhittvā tava pāṇḍava pṛṣṭhataḥ
dhārtarāṣṭrāśca ye mukhyā ye ca mukhyā mahārathāḥ
tato jaladanirghoṣaḥ samīpe nṛpasattama hāhākāro mahānāsītsainyānāṃ bharatarṣabha
pariśrāntaṃ gataṃ bhūmau kṛtvā karma suduṣkaram
athābravīddhṛṣṭamanā vāsudevaṃ dhanañjayaḥ paśya vṛṣṇipravīreṇa krīḍantaṃ kurupuṅgavam
aprāpto'yaṃ mayā kṛṣma hantuṃ bhūriśravā raṇe
anyena tu samāsaktaṃ mama notsahate manaḥ
avaśyaṃ ca mayā kṛṣṇa vṛṣṇivīrasya rakṣaṇam
adharmo vā'stu dharmo vā mama mādhava mādhavaḥ
evaṃ sma yudhyate vīraḥ sātyakiṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ
tathā tu kṛṣyamāṇaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā sātyakimāhave
anityo vikramaḥ pārtha yatra bhūriśravā raṇe
sa harṣayati māṃ bhūyaḥ kurūṇāṃ nandivardhanaḥ
evaṃ tu manasā rājanpārthaḥ sampūjya kauravam
atha kośādviniṣkṛṣya khaṅgaṃ bhūriśravāḥ śitam mūrdhajeṣu ca jagrāha padā corasyātāḍayat
eṣa tvasukaraṃ karma yādavārthe karomyaham mama śiṣyo mamārthāya yudhyate mama śatrubhiḥ
sa bāhurnyapatadbhūmau sakhaṅgaḥ saśubhāṅgadaḥ ādadhajjīvalokasya duḥkhamadbhutamuttamaḥ
sa moghaṃ kṛtamātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārthena kauravaḥ
sa vibāhurmahārāja ekapakṣa ivāṇḍajaḥ ekacakro ratho yadvaddharaṇīmāsthito nṛpaḥ
yeṣu yeṣu naraḥ pārtha vartate susamāhitaḥ
kiṃ nu vakṣyasi rājānaṃ dharmaputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram kiṃ kurvāṇo mayā saṅkhye hato bhūriśravā iti
astraṃ rudreṇa vā pārtha droṇenātha kṛpeṇa vā
idaṃ tu yadatikṣudraṃ vārṣṇeyārthe kṛtaṃ tvayā
ko hi nāma pramattāya pareṇa saha yudhyate
īdṛśaṃ vyasanaṃ dadyādyo na kṛṣṇasakho bhavet
vṛṣṇyandhakāḥ kathaṃ pārtha pramāṇaṃ bhavatā kṛtāḥ
evamukto raṇe pārtho bhūriśravasamabravīt vyaktaṃ hi jīryamāṇo'pi buddhiṃ jarayate naraḥ
jānanneva hṛṣīkeśaṃ garhase māṃ ca pāṇḍavam
na cādharmamahaṃ kuryāṃ jānaṃścaiva hi muhyase
yudhyante kṣatriyāḥ śatrūnsvaiḥsvaiḥ parivṛtā narāḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhiḥ putraistathā sambandhibāndhavaiḥ
sa kathaṃ sātyakiṃ śiṣyaṃ sukhasambandhimeva ca
na ca tvaṃ rakṣitavyo hi eko raṇagatena hi yo yasya yudhyate'rthāya saṃrakṣyo narādhipa
tai rakṣyamāṇaiḥ sa nṛpo rakṣitavyo mahāmṛdhe
rakṣitavyo mayā yasmāttasmāllabdho mayā sa ca
yacca māṃ garhase rājankṛṣṇena saha saṅgatam
bahubhiḥ saha saṅgamya nirjitya ca mahārathān śrāntaśca śrāntavāhaśca kṣīṇasarvāyudhastvayā
īdṛśaṃ sātyakiṃ saṅkhye nirjitya ca mahāratham
icchasi tvaṃ śirastasya asinā hartumāhave tathā kṛcchragataṃ dṛṣṭvā sātyakiṃ kaḥ kṣamiṣyati
tvaṃ tu garhaya cātmānaṃ svadharmaṃ yo na rakṣasi
kathaṃ rakṣiṣyase vīra ye vai tvāṃ saṃśritā janāḥ
abhimanyorvadhaṃ tāta dhārmikaḥ ko nu pūjayet
sūrye cakṣuḥ samādhāya prasannaṃ salile manaḥ
amūṣyamāṇo manasā teṣāṃ tasya ca bhāṣitam
na śakyo māmako hantuṃ yo me syādbāṇagocare
na hi dharmamavijñāya yuktaṃ garhayituṃ param
ye me pratyakṣato vīrā hanyeranniti me matiḥ
dhigastu kṣatradharmaṃ tu yatra tvaṃ puruṣeśvaraḥ
yatra tvaṃ puruṣavyāghraḥ prāptaḥ pāpāmimāṃ daśām
yatra tvaṃ kuruśārdūla prāptaḥ pāpāmimāṃ daśām
ko hi nāma pumām̐lloke mādṛśaḥ puruṣottama
praharettvadvidhe tvadya pratijñā yadi no bhavet
yā prītirdharmarāje me bhīme ca balināṃ vare
nakule sahadeve ca sā me tvayi śalāgraja
mayā tvaṃ samanujñātaḥ kṛṣṇena ca mahātmanā
ye lokā mama vimalāḥ sakṛdvibhātā brahmādyaiḥ suravṛṣabhairapīṣyamāṇāḥ
tānkṣipraṃ vraja satatāgnihotrayāji-- nmattulyo bhava garuḍottamāṅgayānaḥ
avāṅmukhā babhūvuśca sainikāḥ sarva eva te
utthitaḥ sa tu śaineyo vimuktaḥ saumadattinā
vāryamāṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇena pārthena ca mahātmanā
nābhyanandanta taṃ sainyāḥ sātyakiṃ tena karmaṇā
tasmānmanyurna vaḥ kāryaḥ krodho duḥkhataro nṛṇām
anye na yuktamityeva bhavitavyaṃ tatheti ca
na hantavyo na hantavya iti mandāḥ prabhāṣata
yuṣmābhirnihato yuddhe tadā dharmaḥ kva vo gataḥ
mayā tvetatpratijñātaṃ kṣepe kasmiṃścideva hi śrutvā tatsarvabhāvena garhayadhvaṃ na cārjunam
yo māṃ niṣpiṣya saṅgrame jīvanhanyātpadā ruṣā
yukto hyasya pratīghātaḥ kṛto me kurupuṅgavāḥ
bhavitavyaṃ hi yadbhāvi daivaṃ ceṣṭayate hi tat
api cāpaṃ purā gītaḥ śloko vālmīkinā bhuvi
na hantavyāḥ striya iti yadbravīṣi plavaṅgama
sarvakālaṃ manuṣyeṇa vyavasāyavatā sadā pīḍākaramamitrāṇāṃ yatsyātkartavyameva tat
aśvasya medhyasya śiro nikṛttaṃ nyastaṃ havirdhānamivāntareṇa
sa tejasā śastrakṛtena pūto mahāhave dehavaraṃ visṛjya
ākrāmadūrdhvaṃ varado varārho vyāvṛttya dharmeṇa parema rodasī
ajito droṇarādheyavikarṇakṛtavarmabhiḥ yaścaivotsahate vetuṃ samastaṃ māmakaṃ balama
yathā ca bhūriśravaso yatra te saṃśayo nṛpa
atreḥ putro'bhavatsomaḥ somasya tu budhaḥ smṛtaḥ
śūrasya śaurirnṛvaro vasudevo mahāyaśāḥ dhanuṣyanavaraḥ śūraḥ kārtavīryasamo yudhi
dhanuṣyanavaraḥ śūraḥ kārtavīryasamo yudhi tadvāryaścāpi tatraiva kule śinirabhūnnṛpa
tatra vai devakīṃ devīṃ vasudevārthamāśu vai
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā devakīṃ śūro rathasthāṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
asimudyamya keśeṣu pragṛhya ca padā hataḥ
kṛpayā ca punastena sa jīveti visarjitaḥ
tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo varāṇāṃ varadaḥ prabhuḥ
vareṇa cchandayāmāsa sa tu vavre varaṃ nṛpaḥ
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā somadattasya pārthiva evamastviti tatroktvā sa devo'ntaradhīyata
na hi śakyo raṇe jetuṃ sātvato manujarṣabhaiḥ
na tulyaṃ vṛṣṇibhiriha dṛśyate kiñcana prabho
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yatra te saṃśayaḥ prabho
codayāśvānbhṛśaṃ kṛṣṇa yato rājā jayadrathaḥ [śrūyate puṇḍarīkākṣa triṣu dharmeṣu vartate ]
yathā nābhyeti sūryo'staṃ yathā satyaṃ bhavedvacaḥ
upāyāntaṃ* tu rādheyaṃ dṛṣṭvā pārtho mahārathaḥ
na ca tāvatkṣamaḥ pārtha tava karṇena saṅgaraḥ prajvalantī maholkeva tiṣṭhatyasminhi vāsavī
na karṇaṃ prākṛtaṃ manye tena yoddhuṃ na sāmpratam
pramādācca ghṛṇitvācca tena śociti me manaḥ
ataḥ karṇaḥ prayātvatra sātvatasya yathā tathā
tadā gantāsi pārtha tvaṃ tena yoddhuṃ durātmanā
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yathāvṛttaṃ mahāraṇe paśyatāṃ sarvasainyānāṃ keśavāryunayorapi
atītānāgate rājansa hi vetti janārdanaḥ tataḥ sūtaṃ samāhūya dārukaṃ saṃdideśa ha
ratho me yujyatāṃ kalyamiti rājanmahābālaḥ na hi devā na gandharvā na yakṣoragarākṣasāḥ
mānavā vā'pi jetāraḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ santi kecana
tayoḥ prabhāvamatulaṃ śṛṇu yuddhaṃ tu tattathā
sātyakiṃ virathaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ cābhyudyataṃ raṇe
dāruko'vetya sandeśaṃ śrutvā śaṅkhasya ca svanam
yuktaṃ samāruhya ca taṃ vimānapratimaṃ ratham
naiva daivaṃ na gāndharvaṃ nāsuraṃ na ca rākṣasam tādṛśaṃ bhuvi no yuddhaṃ divi vā śrutamityuta
mitrārthe tau parākrāntau śuṣmiṇau spardhinau rame
karṇaḥ śokasamāviṣṭo mahoraga iva śvasan sa śaineyaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ pradahanniva cakṣuṣā
tataḥ karṇaṃ śineḥ pautraḥ sarvapārasavaiḥ śaraiḥ
chittvā dhvajaṃ rathaṃ caiva śatadhā punarṣarṣabha
cakāra virathaṃ karṇaṃ tava putrasya paśyataḥ
tato vimanaso rājaṃstāvakāste mahārathāḥ vṛṣasenaḥ karṇasutaḥ śalyo madrādhipastathā
tataḥ paryākulaṃ sarvaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana
tathā sātyakinā vīre virathe sūtaje kṛte
tathā tu virathaṃ karṇaṃ putrāṃśca paripālayan
bhīmasenena tu vadaḥ putrāṇāṃ te pratiśrutaḥ
anudyūte ca pārthena vadhaḥ karṇasya saṃśrutaḥ
drauṇiśca kṛtavarmā ca tathaivānye mahārathāḥ nirjitā dhanuṣaikena śataśaḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ
kāṅkṣatā paralokaṃ ca dharmarājasya ca priyam
kṛṣṇo vā'pi bhavelloke pārtho bā'pi dhanurdharaḥ
śaineyo vā naravyāghra caturthastu na vidyate
ajayyaṃ vāsudevasya rathamāsthāya sātyakiḥ virathaṃ kṛtavānkarṇaṃ vāsudevasamo yudhi
kaccidanyaṃ samārūḍhaḥ sātyakiḥ śatrutāpanaḥ etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ kuśalo hyasi bhāṣitum
hemakakṣyādhvajopetaṃ klṛptayantrapatākinam agryaṃ rathaṃ suyantāraṃ bahuśastraparicchadam
śataśo nihatāḥ śūrāḥ sātvatenārjunena ca bhīṣmaṃ pramukhataḥ kṛtvā bhagadattaṃ ca bhārata
tathā gateṣu śūreṣu teṣāṃ mama ca sañjaya
evaṃ vaktā ca me vadhyastena coktastathā hyaham
etadvrataṃ mahābāho tvayā saha kṛtaṃ mayā
tathaitanmama kaunteya yathā tava na saṃśayaḥ
yathā bhavati tatsatyaṃ tathā kuru dhanañjaya
adharmabuddhe śṛṇu me yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi sāmpratam
dvāvevaṃ karṇa śūrāṇāṃ raṇe dṛṣṭau jayājayau
raṇamutsṛjya nirlajja gacchase ca punaḥ punaḥ māhātmyaṃ paśya bhīmasya karma janma kule tathā
yadṛcchayā raṇe bhīmaṃ yudhyamānaṃ mahābalam kathañcidvirathaṃ kṛtvā yattvaṃ rūkṣamabhāṣathāḥ
nāriṃ jitvā'tikatthante na ca jalpanti durvacaḥ
na ca kañcana nindanti santaḥ śūrā nararṣabhāḥ
yudhyamānaṃ parākrāntaṃ śūramāryavrate ratam yadavoco'priyaṃ bhīmaṃ naitatsatyaṃ vacastava
yasmāttu bahu rūkṣaṃ ca śrāvitaste vṛkodaraḥ parokṣaṃ yacca saubhadro yuṣmābhirbahubhirhataḥ
dṛṣṭvā duryodhano mando bhṛśaṃ tapsyati pātitam
sātyakiṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca yattau tau darśayanniva
ayaṃ sa vaikartana yuddhakālo vidarśayasvātmabalaṃ mahātman
yathā na vadhyeta raṇe'rjunena jayadrathaḥ karṇa tathā kuruṣva
alpāvaśeṣo divaso hi sāmprataṃ nivārayehādya ripuṃ śaraughaiḥ
dinakṣayaṃ prāpya narapravīra dhruvo hi naḥ karṇa jayo bhaviṣyati
kathaṃ jīvati durdharṣe tvapi rādheya phalgunaḥ
drauṇinā rakṣyamāṇaṃ ca mayā duḥśāsanena ca
yudhyante bahavaḥ śūrā lambate ca divākaraḥ
śaṅke jayadrathaṃ pārtho naiva prāpsyati mānada
sa tvaṃ karṇa mayā sārdhaṃ śūraiścānyairmahārathaiḥ drauṇinā tvaṃ hi sahito madreśena kṛpeṇa ca
sthātavyamiti tiṣṭhāmi raṇe samprati mānada nāṅgamiṅgati kiñcinme santaptasya maheṣubhiḥ
yotsyāmi tu yathāśaktyā tvadarthaṃ jīvitaṃ mama
na hi me yudhyamānasya sāyakānasyataḥ śitān
adya yuddhaṃ kuruśreṣṭha mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ
kṣuraiściccheda bībhatsurdvidhaikaikaṃ tridhaiva ca hayānvāraṇamukhyāṃśca padātīṃśca samantataḥ
sa vidvā daśabhiḥ pārthaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca saptabhiḥ
nivārya tāñśaravrātairdivyānyastrāṇi darśayan hatabhūyiṣṭhayodhaṃ tatkṛtvā tava balaṃ balī
tasya tallāghavaṃ dṛṣṭvā nāmṛṣyata raṇe'rjunaḥ tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā vivyādhainaṃ stanāntare
karṇa pārtho'sti tiṣṭhatvaṃ karṇo'haṃ tiṣṭha phalgunna
vidhyetāṃ samare vīrau citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca
etasminntare rājandṛṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ākarṇamuktairiṣubhiḥ karṇasya caturo hayān
taṃ tathā virathaṃ dṛṣṭvā rathamāropya taṃ tadā
caturbhiḥ sindhurājaśca vṛṣasenaśca saptabhiḥ pṛthakpṛthaṅmahārāja vivyadhuḥ kṛṣṇapāṇḍavau
saindhavaṃ daśabhirbāṇairvṛṣasenaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ śāradvataṃ ca viṃśatyā vidvvā pārtho nanāda ha
taṃ pratyudīyaḥ kuruvaḥ pāṇḍuputraṃ rathairmahārhaiḥ śaravarṣaṃ sṛjantaḥ
no muhyata prāpya sa rājaputraḥ kirīṭamālī vyasṛjaccharaughān
tataḥ kirīṭi mahatā mahāyaśāḥ śarāsanenāsya śarānanīkajit
gadāśca gurvīḥ parighānayasmayā-- nasīṃśca śaktīśca raṇe narādhipāḥ
mahānti śastrāṇi ca bhīmadarśanāḥ pragṛhya pārthaṃ sahasā'bhidudruvuḥ
tato yugāntābhrasamasvanaṃ maha-- nmahendracāpapratimaṃ ca gāṇḍivam
trāsodvignaṃ tathoddhāntaṃ tvadīyaṃ tadbalaṃ nṛpa yugāntavātasaṅkṣubdhaṃ caladvīcitaraṅgitam
utkarṣantaṃ sṛjantaṃ ca na sma paśyāma lāghavāt
śalabhā iva te dīptamagniṃ prāpya yayuḥ kṣayam
evaṃ sa mṛdrañśatrūṇāṃ jīvitāni yaśāṃsi ca
satomarāngajasthānāṃ saprāsānhayasādinām sacarmaṇaḥ padātīnāṃ rathināṃ ca sadhanvanaḥ
svarṇacitratanutraiśca bhāṇḍaiśca gajavājinām kirīṭaśatasaṅgīrṇā tatra tatra samācitā
visṛjantaṃ ca kaunteyaṃ nānupaśyāma vai tadā
tathā sarvā diśo rājansarvāṃśca rathino raṇe ākulīkṛtya kaunteyo jayadrathamupādravat
śalyaṃ ṣoḍaśabhirbāṇaiḥ karṇaṃ dvātriṃśatā śaraiḥ saindhavaṃ tu catuḥṣaṣṭyā vidvvā siṃha ivānadat ]
sa vikṣipyārjunastūrṇaṃ saindhavaprahitāñśarān yugapattasya ciccheda śarābhyāṃ saindhavasya ha
naiva śakyastvayā hantuṃ nirvyājaṃ bharatarṣabha srakṣyāmyahamupāyaṃ tamādityasyāpavāraṇe tato'staṃ gatamādityaṃ maṃsyate sindhurāḍiha
unnāmya vaktrāṇi tadā sa ca rājā jayadrathaḥ
vīkṣamāṇe tatastasminsindhurāje divākaram unnamayya śirogrīvāṃ vīkṣate sūryamaṇḍalam
evaṃ tūṇīśayaṃ ghoramindrāśanisamaprabham varmabhedinamatyarthaṃ gandhamālyārcitaṃ sadā
sa tu gāṇḍīvanirmuktaḥ śaraḥ śyena ivāśunaḥ
prapatiṣyati śīrṣe tu kṛṣṇo'rjunamathābravīt pārtha pārtha śiro hyetadyathā neyānmahītalam
tathā kuru kuruśreṣṭha vakṣye tasyāpi kāraṇam
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya tvaramāṇo'stramāyayā tathā'haracchirastasya śarairūrdhvaṃ dhanañjayaḥ
yathā tamāṃsyabhyuditastamoghnaḥ pūrṇāṃ pratijñāṃ sa samāpya vīraḥ
kimarthametanna nipātyamurvyāṃ kva ca prayātavyamidaṃ ca śaṃsa śaknomyahaṃ yatra bhavānbravīti
pārtha pārtha śiro hyenadyatkṛte na patedbhuvi
sa ca ghoreṇa tapasā daindhavaṃ prāptavānsutam
tavātmajo manuṣyendra kulaśīladamādibhiḥ guṇairbhaviṣyati vibho sadṛśo vaṃśayordvayoḥ
dharaṇyāṃ mama putrasya pātayiṣyati yaḥ śiraḥ
tasyāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
yadi cedasti me lābhastapaso vā damasya vā
so'yaṃ tapyati tejasvī tapo ghoraṃ durāsadam
tavāpi śatadhā mūrdhā phaliṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
yathā cedaṃ na jānīyātsa rājā tapasi sthitaḥ
na hyasādhyamakāryaṃ vā vidyate tava kiñcana
sarvadā samare yasya goptā nityaṃ janārdanaḥ
kathaṃ tasya jayo na syāditi bhūtāni menire
kṛtvā tacca mahatkarma nihatya ca jayadratham
saṃhāraṃ ca pramokṣaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā tatra divaukasaḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu nihataṃ saṅkhye sindhurājaṃ mahāratham
hataṃ jayadrathaṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putrā narādhipa
śrutvā mahāntaṃ taṃ śabdaṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
te tu sarve prayatnena bhāradvājaṃ jighāṃsavaḥ
pāṇḍavāstu jayaṃ labdhvā saindhavaṃ vinihatya ca
saindhavaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇe pārthena bhārata
dṛṣṭvā śāradvataṃ pārtho mūrcchitaṃ śarapīḍitam dhigdhiṅmāmiti caivoktvā kṛpaṇaṃ paryadevayat
śarārditaḥ sa hi mayā prekṣamāṇo mahādyutiḥ śocayatyeṣa niyataṃ bhūyaḥ putravadhāddhi mām
kṛpaṇaṃ svarathe sannaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa yathāgatam
tadidaṃ narakāyādya kṛtaṃ karma mayā dhruvam
tathā vilapamāne tu savyasācini taṃ prati *tato rājanhṛṣṭīkeśaḥ saṃṅgāmaśirasi sthitam
diṣṭhyā sampāditā jiṣṇo pratijñā mahatī tvayā
sīdeta samare jiṣṇo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
na taṃ paśyāmi lokeṣu cintayanpuruṣaṃ kvacit
te tvāṃ prāpya raṇe kruddhā nābhyavartanta daṃśitāḥ
tavaiṣa bhāro dhārṣṇeya tavaiva vijayaḥ prabho
prārthayanto jaye yuddhe prathitaṃ ca mahadyaśaḥ
