imāṃśca girikūṭābhānnāgānairāvatopamān kṣarataḥ śoṇitaṃ bhūri śastracchedadarīmukhaiḥ
śatakratau cāpi ca devasattame mahāhave jaghnuṣi daityadānavān ]
te nivārya śarairdrauṇiṃ karṇaṃ ca saha bhūmipaiḥ
ajātaśatruṃ samupetya pāṇḍavaṃ nivedayāmāsa hataṃ jayadratham
sa tvevamuktaḥ kṛṣṇena hṛṣṭaḥ parapurañjayaḥ tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā rathādāplutya bhārata
diṣṭyā ca nihataḥ pāpaḥ saindhavaḥ puruṣādhamaḥ
tvayā guptena govinda ghnatā pāpaṃ jayadratham
kintu nātyadbhutaṃ teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ nastvaṃ samāśrayaḥ na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
dhruvo hi teṣāṃ vārṣṇeya yeṣāṃ tuṣṭo'si mānada
na teṣāṃ vidyate pāpaṃ saṅgrāme vā parājayaḥ
sthitaḥ sarvātmanā nityaṃ priyeṣu ca hiteṣu ca tvāṃ caivāsmābhirāśritya kṛtaḥ śastrasamudyamaḥ
bālyātprabhṛti te kṛṣṇa karmāṇi śrutavānaham amānuṣāṇi divyāni mahānti ca bahūni ca
ye paśyanti hṛṣīkeśa na te muhyanti karhicit
ye prapannāḥ suraguruṃ na te muhyanti karhicit
paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ parāṇāṃ paramaṃ ca yat
gāyanti caturo vedā yaśca deveṣu gīyate
tvaṃ tejastvaṃ paraṃ brahma tvaṃ satyaṃ tvaṃ mahattapaḥ
pralaye samanuprāpte tvāṃ vai niviśate punaḥ
bhūtātmānaṃ mahātmānamanantaṃ viśvatomukham api devā na jānanti guhyamādyaṃ jagatpatim
paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇānāṃ paraṃ ca yat
evamādiguṇānāṃ te karmaṇāṃ divi ceha ca
diṣṭyā satyā pratijñeyaṃ kṛtā hatvā jayadratham
evamuktvā guḍākeśaṃ dharmarājo mahāyaśāḥ pasparśa puṇyagandhena pṛṣṭhe hastena pārthivāḥ ]
tvāṃ hi cakṣurhaṇaṃ vīra kopayitvā suyodhanaḥ
yātā mṛtyuvaśaṃ te vai yeṣāṃ kruddho'pi mādhava
rājyaṃ prāṇāḥ śriyaḥ putrāḥ saukhyāni vividhāni ca
tato bhīmo mahābāhuḥ sātyakiśca mahārathaḥ abhivādya guruṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ mārgaṇaiḥ kṣatavikṣatau
tau dṛṣṭvā mudito vīrau prāñjalī cāgrataḥ sthitau
diṣṭyā paśyāmi vā śūrau vimuktau sainyasāgarāt
yuvāṃ vijayinau cāpi diṣṭyā paśyāmi saṃyuge
diṣṭyā droṇo jitaḥ saṅkhye hārdikyaśca mahābalaḥ
vimukhaśca kṛtaḥ śalyo yuvābhyāṃ puruṣarṣabhau diṣṭyā yuvāṃ kuśalinau saṅgrāmātpunarāgatau
mama vākyasamau caiva diṣṭyā paśyāmi vāmaham
pāṇḍavānāṃ raṇe hṛṣṭaṃ yuddhāya tu mano dadhe
dṛṣṭvā tatkadanaṃ ghoraṃ svabalasya kṛtaṃ mahat
sa vivarṇaḥ kṛśo dīno bāṣpaviplutalocanaḥ ] amanyatārjunasamo na yoddhā bhuvi vidyate
na droṇo na ca rādheyo nāśvatthāmā kṛpo na ca
pārthasya sammakhe sthātuṃ paryāptā iti māriṣa
nirjitya hi raṇe pārthaḥ sarvānmama mahārathān
na hyasya vidyate trātā sākṣādapi purandaraḥ
sa karṇo nirjitaḥ saṅkhye hataścaiva jayadrathaḥ
sa karṇo nirjitaḥ saṅkhye saindhavaśca nipātitaḥ
tṛṇavattamahaṃ manye sa karṇo nirjito yudhi
kṛtvā pramukhataḥ śūraṃ bhīṣmaṃ mama pitāmaham
akṣauhiṇīḥ sapta hatvā hato rājā jayadrathaḥ
kiṃ vakṣyati hi durdharṣaḥ sametya paralokajit
vyāyacchanto hatāḥ śūrā madarthe ye parāṅmukhāḥ
iṣṭāpūrtena ca śape vīryeṇa ca sutairapi
nihatya tānrame sarvānpāñcālānpāṇḍavaiḥ saha sāntiṃ labdhā'smi teṣāṃ vā raṇe gantā salokatām
so'haṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra te puruṣarṣabhāḥ hatā madarthe saṅgrāme yudhyamānāḥ kirīṭinā - - na hīdānīṃ sahāyā me parīpsantyanupaskṛtāḥ śreyo hi pāṇḍūnmanyante na tathāsmānmahābhuja
yau me yuddhasya kṛtyasya jihmācāraiḥ samīyatuḥ hato jayadrathaścaiva saumadattiśca viryavān
droṇastu tadvacaḥ śrutvā putrasya tava durmanāḥ
yaṃ puṃsāṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvaśūramamaṃsma hi
yānsma tānglahate tāta śakuniḥ kurusaṃsadi akṣānna te'kṣā niśitā bāṇāste śatrutāpanāḥ
akṣāṃstu manyase bāṇāñchobhamānāñchitāñśarān ta ete ghnanti nastāta viśikhāḥ pārthacoditāḥ
dhīrasya vāco nāśrauṣīḥ kṣemāya vadataḥ śivāḥ
svamataṃ kurute mūḍhaḥ sa śocyo nacirādiva
druhyetko nu naro loke madanyo brāhmaṇabruvaḥ
sa hi naḥ krodhavṛkṣaśca kṛtamūlo mahātmanām
sindhurājānamāśritya sa vo madhye kathaṃ hataḥ
kathaṃ tvayi ca karṇe ca kṛpe śalye ca jīvati
sindhurājaṃ paritrātuṃ vo madhye kathaṃ hataḥ
mayyeva hi viśeṣeṇa tathā duryodhana tvayi
madhye mahārathānāṃ kiṃ śeṣaṃ tatra manyase
hato bhūriśravāścaiva kiṃ śeṣaṃ tatra manyase
kṛpa eva ca durdharṣo yadi jīvati pārthiva
na te vasundharā'stīti tadāhaṃ cintaye nṛpa
imāni pāṇḍavānāṃ ca sṛjjayānāṃ ca bhārata
kartā'smi samare karma dhārtarāṣṭra hitaṃ tava
ānṛśaṃsye dame satye cārjave ca sthiro bhava
na caiṣāṃ vipriyaṃ kāryaṃ te hi vahniśikhopamāḥ
tvaṃ ca duryodhana balaṃ yadi śakto'si pālaya
tato duryodhano rājā droṇenaivaṃ pracoditaḥ amarṣavaśamāpanno yuddhāyaiva mano dadhe
paśya rādheya pṛthvīśāḥ pṛthivyāṃ pravarā yudhi
alpāvaśeṣaṃ sainyaṃ me kṛtaṃ śakrātmajena ha
kathaṃ vai yudhyamānasya droṇasya yudhi phalgunaḥ
anicchataḥ kathaṃ vīra droṇasya yudhi pāṇḍavaḥ
rakṣāmi saindhavaṃ yuddhe nainaṃ prāpsyati phalgunaḥ
ācāryaṃ mā vigarhasva śaktyā'sau yudhyate dvijaḥ
kṛtī dakṣo yuvā śūraḥ kṛtāstro laghuvikramaḥ
tasya doṣaṃ na paśyāmi droṇasyānena hetunā
yato no yudhyamānānāṃ paraṃ śaktyā suyodhana
saindhavo nihato yuddhe daivamatra paraṃ smṛtam
paraṃ yatnaṃ kurvatāṃ ca tvayā sārdhaṃ raṇājire
hatvā'smākaṃ pauruṣaṃ vai daivaṃ paścātkaroti naḥ
kṛtaṃ kṛtaṃ hi tattasyaṭa daivena vinipātyate
dagdhā jatugṛhe cāpi dyūtena ca parājitāḥ
yatatastava teṣāṃ ca daivaṃ mārgeṇa yāsyati
na teṣāṃ matipūrvaṃ hi sukṛtaṃ dṛśyate kvacit
duṣkṛtaṃ tava vā vīra buddhyā hīnaṃ kurūdvaha
daivaṃ pramāṇaṃ sarvasya sukṛtasyetarasya vā ananyakarma daivaṃ hi jāgarti svapatāmapi
tena yukto hi puruṣaḥ kāryākārye niyujyate
śaṅke daivasya tatkarma pauruṣaṃ yena nāśitam
na bhrājante yathā pūrvaṃ bhāskarasya ca nāśanāt
tathā hateṣu sainyeṣu tathā kṛcchragataḥ svayam
ekasya ca bahunāṃ ca sannipāto mahānabhūt
droṇaḥ karṇaḥ kṛpaścaiva kṛtavarmā ca sātvataḥ
eṣā nītiḥ parā yuddhe dṛṣṭā tatra manīṣibhiḥ
praviṣṭe vai mama sute pareṣāṃ vai mahadbalam
ekasya ca bahūnāṃ ca śṛṇu me bruvato dhruvam
droṇena vāryamāṇo'sau karṇena ca kṛpeṇa ca
yathā madhyandine sūryaṃ pratapantaṃ gabhastibhiḥ tathā tava sutaṃ madhye pratapantaṃ śarārcibhiḥ
na tādṛśaṃ rame karma kṛtavantastu tāvakāḥ
putreṇa tava sā senā pāṇḍavī mathitā raṇe
babhūva pāṇḍavī senā tava putrasya tejasā
pāṇḍusenāṃ hatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tava putreṇa bhārata
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca saptatyā dharmaputraṃ ca saptabhiḥ
ghaṭotkacaṃ ca samare viddhvā siṃha ivānadat
sā tena pāṇḍavī senā vadhyamānā śilīmukhaiḥ
vivyādha cainaṃ daśabhiḥ samyagastaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
marma bhittvā tu te sarve saṃlagnāḥ kṣitimāviśan
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā tava putrasya māriṣa śaraṃ ca sūryaraśmyābhamatyugramanivāraṇam
atha droṇo drutaṃ tatra pratyadṛśyata saṃyuge
pratyudyayustaṃ tvaritāḥ pāñcālā jayagṛddhinaḥ tāndroṇaḥ pratijagrāha parīpsankurusattamam
uktā duryodhanaṃ mandaṃ mama śāstrātigaṃ sutam
manye te samavepanta gāvo vai śiśire yathā
sāyāhne saindhavaṃ hatvā rājñā pārthaḥ sametya ca
tathaiva nakulo dhīmānsahadevaśca durjayaḥ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śatānīko virāṭaśca sakekayaḥ mātsyāḥ sālvāḥ sasenāśca droṇameva yayuryudhi
tasyāṃ rajanyāṃ ghorāyāṃ nadantyaḥ sarvataḥ śivāḥ
droṇasya ca mahārāja sṛñjayānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
tamasā cāvṛte loke na prājñāyata kiñcana
naiva sve na pare rājanprājñāyanta tamovṛte
tāni nāgasahasrāṇi rathānāmayutāni ca padātihayasaṅghānāṃ prayutānyarbudāni ca
nihate saindhave vīre bhūriśravasi caiva ha
ke ca taṃ varadaṃ vīramanvayurdvijasattamam ke cāsya pṛṣṭhato'gacchanvīrāḥ śūrasya yudhyataḥ
śiśire kampamānā vai kṛśā gāva iva prabho
sarveṣu yodheṣu ca saṅgateṣu rātrau sameteṣu mahāratheṣu
saṃloḍyamāneṣu pṛthagbaleṣu ke vastadānīṃ matimanta āsan
hatāṃścaiva viṣaktāṃśca parābhūtāṃśca śaṃsasi rathino virathāṃścaiva kṛtānyuddheṣu māmakān - - teṣāṃ saṃloḍyamānānāṃ pāṇḍavairhatacetasām andhe tamasi magnānāmabhavatkā matistadā
taṃ śibiḥ prativivyādha triṃśatā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya droṇo hayānhatvā sārathiṃ ca mahātmanaḥ
kaliṅgānāṃ tu taṃ śūraṃ kruddhaṃ kruddho vṛkodaraḥ
tataḥ śatrurathaṃ tyaktvā bhīmo drumarathaṃ gataḥ
jayarātaṃ tu caraṇe gṛhya bhīmo mahābalaḥ
pādayorgṛhya tau vīrau bhīmaḥ karṇasya paśyataḥ
bhūmāvāviddhya jaghne sa tau ca prāṇairvyayujyatām
tamāyāntaṃ jighāṃsantaṃ bhīmaṃ kruddhamivāntakam nyavārayanmahābāhuṃ tava putrā viśāmpate
durmadastu tato yānaṃ duṣkarṇasyāvacakrame tāvekarathamārūḍhau bhrātarau paratāpanau
durmadasya ca vīrasya duṣkarṇasya ca taṃ ratham
tataḥ sutau te balinau śūrau duṣkarṇadurmadau
tato hāhākṛte sainye dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ nṛpā'bruvan
visaṃjñā vāhayanvāhānna ca dvau saha dhāvataḥ
tato bale bhṛśalulite niśāmukhe supūjito nṛpavṛṣabhairvṛkodaraḥ
tato yamau drupadavirāṭakekayā yudhiṣṭhiraścāpi parāṃ mudaṃ yayuḥ
vṛkodaraṃ bhṛśamanupūjayaṃśca te yathāndhake pratinihate haraṃ surāḥ
tataḥ sutāste varuṇātmajopamā rupānvitāḥ saha guruṇā mahātmanā
ghaṭotkaco jayavijayau drumo vṛkaḥ sasṛñjayāstava tanayānavārayan
prāyopaviṣṭe tu hate putre sātyakinā tadā
taṃ tvaṃ sātvata santajya dasyudharme kathaṃ rataḥ
dvāveva kila vṛṣṇīnāṃ tatra khyātau mahārathau
nṛśaṃsaṃ bata dīnaṃ ca tādṛśaṃ kṛtavānasi
adya chetsyāmi te mūḍha śiro vikramya patriṇā
na hanyāṃ narake ghore pateyaṃ vṛṣṇipāṃsana
dadhmau śaṅkhaṃ ca tāreṇa siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca
kauraveya na me trāsaḥ kathañcidapi vidyate
yadi sarveṇa sainyena gupto māṃ yodhayiṣyasi
tathāpi na vyathā kācittvayi syānmama kaurava
yadi te'sti yuyutsā'dya mayā saha narādhipa
yadi tvāṃ sasutaṃ pāpaṃ na hanyāṃ yudhi roṣitaḥ
śakuniśca susaṅkruddhaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ putrapautraiḥ parivṛto bhrātṛbhiścendravikramaiḥ
sāgraṃ śatasahasraṃ tu hayānāṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ droṇasya saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
virāṭaṃ matsyamaṣṭābhirdrupadaṃ daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ yudhāmanyuṃ tribhiḥ ṣaḍbhiruttamaujasamāhave anyāṃśca sainikānvidvvā yudhiṣṭhiramupādravat
kālyamānaṃ tu tatsainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇena phalgunaḥ
yoyo hi pramukhe tasya tasthau droṇasya purūṣaḥ
evaṃ sā pāṇḍavī senā vadhyamānā mahātmanā
samprabhagnaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇena niśi bhārata
bhīmaseno'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā yāntaṃ droṇāya phalgunam
tau dṛṣṭvā bhrātarau yattau droṇānīkamabhidrutau pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayā mātsyāścedikārūśakosalāḥ
tamudyatamahācāpaṃ rākṣasendraṃ ghaṭotkacam bhayārditā pracukṣobha putrasya tava vāhinī
vihatāyāṃ tu māyāyāmamarṣī sa ghaṭotkacaḥ visasarja śarānghorāṃste'śvatthāmānamāviśan
na hi putreṇa haiḍimba pitā nyāyyaḥ prabādhitum
kāmaṃ khalu na roṣo me haiḍimbe vidyate tvayi
sa te nāstraiṇa śailendraḥ kṣiptaḥ kṣipraṃ vyanaśyata
tataḥ sa toyado bhūtvā nīlaḥ sendrāyudho divi
tiṣṭha duryodhanādya tvaṃ na kāryaḥ sambhramastvayā
na tvetadadbhutaṃ manye yatte mahadidaṃ manaḥ
jahi bhīmaṃ yamau cobhau dharmarājaṃ ca mātula
asurāniva devendro jayāśā me tvayi sthitā
evamukto yayau śīghraṃ putreṇa tava saubalaḥ
pureva tripuraṃ dagdhvā divi devo maheśvaraḥ
drauṇiṃ hateti mahatīṃ codayāmāsa tāṃ camūm
dhṛṣṭadyumnarathaṃ gatvā bhaimasenistato nṛpa dhanurghoraṃ samādāya mahadindrāyudhopamam
tato bhīmātmajaṃ rakṣo dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca sānugam
jaghāna surathaṃ nāma drupadasya sutaṃ vibhuḥ
jaghāna sa pṛṣadhraṃ ca candrasenaṃ ca māriṣa
asvatthāmā susaṅkruddhaḥ sandhāyogramajihmagam mumocākarṇapūrṇena dhanuṣā śaramuttamam
sa bhittvā hṛdayaṃ tasya rākṣasasya mahāśaraḥ
taṃ hataṃ patitaṃ jñātvā dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārathaḥ
tataḥ parāṅmukhanṛpaṃ sainyaṃ yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ nṛpa parājitya raṇe vīro droṇaputro nanāda ha
taṃ siddhagandharvapiśācasaṅghā nāgāḥ suparṇāḥ pitaro vayāṃsi
vṛddhaṃ vṛddhaguṇairyuktaṃ yayātimiva nāhuṣam vivyādha daśabhistīkṣṇaiḥ śarairvajranipātanaiḥ
sa tathā'bhihato bhīmaścakampe ca mumoha ca
sa papāta hataḥ pṛthvyāṃ vajrāhata ivādrirāṭ
te viddhā vyasavaḥ petuḥ syandanebhyo hataujasaḥ
tato vṛkaratho nāma bhrātā karṇasya viśrutaḥ
sainyāni drāvayantaṃ taṃ droṇo dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiram
tasminvinihate cāstre bhāradvājo yudhiṣṭhire vāruṇaṃ yāmyamāgneyaṃ tvāṣṭraṃ sāvitrameva ca
tataḥ sā bhāratī senā vadhyamānā kirīṭinā
droṇena vāryamāṇāste svayaṃ tava sutena ca
ayaṃ sa kālaḥ samprāpto mitrāṇāṃ mitravatsala
priyaṃ tava mayā kāryamiti jīvāmi pārthiva
tava vaśyā bhaviṣyanti vanaṃ yāsyanti vā punaḥ
mayi jīvati kauravya viṣādaṃ mā kṛthāḥ kvacit
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ karṇaṃ tu kṛpaḥ śāradvato'bravīt
tvayā nāthena rādheya vacasā yadi sidhyati
na tu te vikramaḥ kaściddṛśyate phalameva vā
pārthena nirjitā yuddhe tvaṃ ca karṇa sahānujaḥ
niṣphalo dṛśyase karṇa tacca rājā na budhyate
ārātpārthaṃ hi te dṛṣṭvā durlabhaṃ garjitaṃ punaḥ
bāhubhiḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūrā vāgbhiḥ śūrā dvijātayaḥ dhanuṣā phalgunaḥ śūraḥ karṇaḥ śūro manorathaiḥ
toṣito yena rudro'pi kaḥ pārthaṃ pratighātayet
yaṃ bhāraṃ puruṣo voḍhuṃ manasā hi vyavasyati
vyavasāyadvitīyo'haṃ manasā bhāramudvahan hatvā pāṇḍusutānājau sakṛṣṇānsahasātvatān
garjāmi yadyahaṃ vipra tava kiṃ tatra naśyati
vṛthā śūrā na garjanti sajalā iva toyadāḥ
utsahāmi raṇe jetuṃ tato garjāmi gautama
paśya tvaṃ garjitasyāsya phalaṃ me vipra sānugān hatvā pāṇḍusutānājau sahakṛṣṇānsasātvatān
sadā kṣipasi vai kṛṣṇau dharmarājaṃ ca pāṇḍavam
yeṣāmarthāya yudhyante na teṣāṃ vidyate kṣayaḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo gaṇāḥ pāṇḍusutasya vai
kāmaṃ khalu jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam sayakṣarākṣasagaṇaṃ sabhūtabhujagadvipam
abravīcca tadā karṇo guraṃ śāradvataṃ kṛpam
ete cānye ca bahavo guṇāḥ pāṇḍusuteṣu vai
tathāpi pārthāñjeṣyāmi śaktyā vāsavadattayā mama hyamoghā datteyaṃ śaktiḥ śakreṇa vai dvija
hate tu pāṇḍave kṛṣṇe bhrātaraścāsya sodarāḥ
anarjunā na śakṣyanti mahīṃ bhoktuṃ kathañcana
tvaṃ tu vipraśca vṛddhaśca aśaktaścāpi saṃyuge
atrāpi śṛṇu me vākyaṃ yathāvadbruvato dvija
ete cānye ca rājāno devairapi sudurjayāḥ
yastānbalavato nityaṃ manyase tvaṃ dvijādhama yatiṣye'haṃ yathāśakti yoddhuṃ taiḥ saha saṃyuge
kva te vīryaṃ kva cāstrāṇi yaṃ tvāṃ nirjitya saṃyuge
yaṃ hi kṛṣṇena sahitaṃ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varam
jetuṃ na śaktāḥ sahitāḥ sendrā api surāsurāḥ
tamudyataṃ tu vegena rājā duryodhanaḥ svayam
kopaḥ khalu na kartavyaḥ sūtaputraṃ kathañcana
tvayi karṇe kṛpe droṇe madrarāje'tha saubale
karṇo'pi rathināṃ śreṣṭhaścāpamudyamya vīryavān kauravāgryaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śakro devagaṇairiva
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ karṇasya saha pāṇḍavaiḥ
ayaṃ karṇaḥ kutaḥ karṇastiṣṭha karṇa mahāraṇe
anye tu dṛṣṭvā rādheyaṃ krodharakrekṣaṇā'bruvan hanyatāmayamutsiktaḥ sūtaputro'lpacetanaḥ
ghnatainamiti jalpantaḥ kṣatriyāḥ samupādravan mahatā śaravarṣeṇa cchādayanto mahārathāḥ
na vivyathe sūtaputro na ca trāsamagacchata
tatastu śaravarṣeṇa pārthivāstamavārayan dhanumpi te vidhunvānāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
yathā devāsure yuddhe śakrasya saha dānaivaḥ
yadenaṃ sarvato yattā nāpnuvanti pare yudhi
nivārya ca śaraughāṃstānpārthivānāṃ mahārathaḥ yugeṣvīṣāsu cchatreṣu dhvajeṣu ca hayeṣu ca
tato duryodhano rājā dṛṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam
dṛṣṭvaitāṃ nirjitāṃ senāṃ raṇe karṇena dhīmatā
tato drauṇiḥ kṛpaḥ śalyo hārdikyaśca mahārathaḥ pratyudyayustadā pārthaṃ sūtaputraparīpsayā
pratyudyayau tadā karṇaṃ yathā vṛtraṃ śatakratuḥ
āśaṃsate ca bībhatsuṃ yuddhe jetuṃ sudāruṇam
sa tu taṃ sahasā prāptaṃ nityamatyantavairiṇam
āyāntaṃ pāṇḍava dṛṣṭvā gajaṃ pratigajo yathā
tasya viddhasya bāṇena karāccāpaṃ papāta ha
śaravṛṣṭiṃ tu tāṃ muktāṃ sūtaputreṇa bhārata
tataḥ pārtho maheṣvāso dṛṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam
alaṃ drutena vaḥ śūrāstiṣṭhadhvaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ eṣa pārthavadhāyāhaṃ svayaṃ gacchāmi saṃyuge
adya bāṇamayaṃ varṣaṃ sṛjato mama dhanvinaḥ
tiṣṭhadhvaṃ samare śūrā bhayaṃ tyajata phalgunāt
ityuktvā prayayau rājā sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ
mayi jīvati gāndhāre na yuddhaṃ gantumarhasi
na hi sambhramaḥ kāryaḥ pārthasya vijayaṃ prati
dharmarājapniyārthaṃ vā draupadyā vā na vidma tat
ko hi śastravidāṃ mukhyo maheśvarasamo yudhi
śatruṃ na kṣapayecchakto yo na syādgautamīsutaḥ
tavāstragocare śaktāḥ sthātuṃ devā na dānavāḥ
ete hi somakā vipra pāñcālāśca yaśasvinaḥ
ādau vā yadi vā paścāttavedaṃ karma māriṣa
na te'stragocare śaktāḥ sthātuṃ devāḥ savāsavāḥ
na tvāṃ samarthāḥ saṅgrāme pāṇḍavāḥ saha somakaiḥ
gacchagaccha mahābāho na naḥ kālātyayo bhavet
śakto hyasi mahābāho divyena svena tejasā
duryodhanenaivamukto drauṇirāhavadurmadaḥ cakārārivadhe yatnamindro daityavadhe yathā
priyā hi pāṇḍavā nityaṃ mama cāpi pituśca me
tathaivāvāṃ priyau teṣāṃ na tu yuddhe kurūdvaha
ahaṃ karṇaśca śalyaśca kṛpo hārdikya eva ca
jīvatsu pāṇḍuputreṣu taddhi satyaṃ bravīmi te
kimarthaṃ tava sainyāni na haniṣyanti bhārata
anyānapi sa naḥ kṣudra śaṅkase pāpabhāvitaḥ
ahaṃ tu yatnamāsthāya tvadarthe tyaktajīvitaḥ eṣa gacchāmi saṅgrāmaṃ tvatkṛte kurunandana
yotsye'haṃ śatrubhiḥ sārdhaṃ jeṣyāmi ca varānvarān
adya dharmasuto rājā dṛṣṭvā mama parākramam
na hi te vīra mokṣyante madbāhvantaramāgatāḥ
evamuktvā mahābāhuḥ putraṃ duryodhanaṃ tava abhyavartata yuddhāya trāsayansarvadhanvinaḥ
drauṇiṃ prati mahārāja jalaṃ jaladharā iva
parityajya raṇe drauṇiṃ vyadravanta diśo daśa
ācāryaputra bhadraṃ te kimanyairnihataistava samāgaccha mayā sārdhaṃ yadi śūro'si saṃyuge
te tu paṅktīkṛtā drauṇiṃ śarā viviśurāśugāḥ rukmapuṅkhāḥ prasannāgrāḥ sarvakāyāvadāraṇāḥ
na jānīṣe pratijñāṃ me viprotpattiṃ tathaiva ca
droṇaṃ hatvā kila mayā hantavyastvaṃ sudurmate
tatastvā'haṃ na hanmyadya droṇe jīvati saṃyuge
imāṃ tu rajanīṃ prāptāmaprabhātāṃ sudurmate nihatya pitaraṃ te'dya tatastvāmapi saṃyuge
yaste pārtheṣu vidveṣo yā bhaktiḥ kauraveṣu ca
tāṃ darśaya sthiro bhūtvā na me jīvanvimokṣyase
sa vadhyaḥ sarvalokasya yathā tvaṃ puruṣādhamaḥ
tau punaḥ sannyavartetāṃ prāṇadyūtapaṇe raṇe nipīḍayantau bāṇaughaiḥ parasparamamarṣiṇau
ayudhyetāṃ mahābāhū citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca
tau prabuddhau raṇe dṛṣṭvā vane vanyau gajāviva
tato drauṇirmahārāja pārṣatasya mahātmanaḥ dhvajaṃ dhanustathā chatramubhau ca pārṣṇisārathī
śatena ca śataṃ hatvā pāñcālānāṃ mahārathaḥ
te vadhyamānāḥ pāñcālāḥ samare saha sṛñjayaiḥ
vyarocata droṇasutaḥ pratāpavā-- nyathā surendro'rigaṇānnihatya vai
tato duryodhano rājā bhāradvājena saṃvṛtaḥ abhyayātpāṇḍavānsaṅkhye tato yuddhamavartata
tataḥ sā bhāratī senā hanyamānā kirīṭinā
droṇena vāryamāṇāste svayaṃ tava sutena ca
sātyakiḥ prāha yantāraṃ somadattāya māṃ vaha
na hyahatvā raṇe śatruṃ somadattaṃ mahābalam
somadattaṃ tu saṅkruddho raṇe vivyādha sātyakiḥ
sa papāta dvidhā cchinna āyasaḥ parigho mahān
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ tatra somadattaṃ mahārathāḥ
chādyamānaṃ śarairdṛṣṭvā yuyudhānaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ pāṇḍavāśca mahārāja saha sarvaiḥ prabhadrakaiḥ
sainyāni drāvayantaṃ tu droṇo dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiram
ciccheda ca dhanurdīrghaṃ brāhmaṇasya ca pāṇḍavaḥ tato'nyaddhanurādatta droṇaḥ kṣatriyamardanaḥ
yatate hi sadā droṇo grahaṇe tava saṃyuge
yo'sya sṛṣṭo vināśāya sa evainaṃ haniṣyati
parivarjya guruṃ yāhi yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ
rājā rājñā hi yoddhavyo nārājñā yuddhamiṣyate
rathaghoṣeṇa mahatā nādayanvasudhātalam parjanya iva dharmānte nādayanvai diśo daśa
tamasā saṃvṛte loke rajasā ca mahīpate
naranāgāśvamathanaṃ paramaṃ romaharṣaṇam droṇakarṇakṛpā vīrā bhīmapārṣatasātyakāḥ
anye tamasi mūḍhāni putrasya tava mantrite
vyamuhyanta raṇe tatra tamasā saṃvṛte sati
kathaṃ prakāśasteṣāṃ vā mama sainyasya vā punaḥ
babhūva loke tamasā tathā sañjaya saṃvṛte
tataḥ sarvāṇi sainyāni hataśiṣṭāni yāni vai
droṇaḥ purastājjaghane tu śalya-- stathā drauṇiḥ kṛtavarmā saubalaśca
svayaṃ tu sarvāṇi balāni rāja-- nrājā'bhyayādgopayanvai niśāyām
te coditāḥ pārthivasattamena tataḥ prahṛṣṭā jagṛhuḥ pradīpān
nāgāḥ sayakṣoragakinnarāśca hṛṣṭā divisthā jagṛhuḥ pradīpān
sā bhūya eva dhvajinī vibhaktā vyarocatāgniprabhayā niśāyām
ratherathe pañca vidīpakāstu pradīpakāstatra gaje trayaśca
pratyaśvamekaśca mahāpradīpaḥ kṛtāstu taiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ kauraveyaiḥ
kṣaṇena sarve vihitāḥ pradīpā vyādīpayanto dhvajinīṃ tavāsu
prakāśitāyāṃ tu tato dhvajinyāṃ droṇo'gnikalpaḥ pratapansapatnān
rarāja rājendara suvarṇavarmā madhyaṃ gataḥ sūrya ivāṃśumālī
pīteṣu śastreṣu ca pāvakasya pratiprabhāstatra tadā babhūvuḥ
gadāśca śaikyāḥ parighāśca śubhrā ratheṣu śaktyaśca vivartamānāḥ
chatrāṇi vālavyajanāni khaṅgā dīptā maholkāśca tathaiva rājan
vyāghūrṇamānāśca suvarṇamālā vyāyacchatāṃ tatra tadā virejuḥ
śastraprabhābhiśca virājamānaṃ dīpaprabhābhiśca tadā balaṃ tat
prakāśitaṃ cābharaṇaprabhābhi-- rbhṛśaṃ prakāśaṃ nṛpate babhūva
dīptāṃ prabhāṃ prājanayanta tatra tapātyaye vidyudivāntarikṣe
mahāvane dārumaye pradīpte yathā prabhā bhāskarasyāpi naśyet
tathā tadā''sīdvajinī pradīptā mahābhayā bhārata bhīmarūpā
sarveṣu sainyeṣu padātisaṅghā-- nacodayaṃste'pi cakruḥ pradīpān
gajegaje sapta kṛpāḥ pradīpā ratherathe caiva daśa pradīpāḥ
dvāvaśvapṛṣṭhe paripārśvato'nye dhvajeṣu cānye jaghaneṣu cānye
senāsu sarvāsu ca pārśvato'nye paścātpurastācca samantataśca
madhye tathā'nye jvalitāgnihastāḥ senādvaye'pi sma narā viceruḥ
vyadīpayaṃste dhvajinīṃ pradīptā-- stathā balaṃ pāṇḍaveyābhiguptam
tena pradīptena tathā pradīptaṃ-- balaṃ tavāsīdbalavadbalena
tayoḥ prabhāḥ pṛthivīmantarikṣaṃ sarvā vyatikramya diśaśca vṛddhāḥ
tena prakāśena bhṛśaṃ prakāśaṃ babhūva teṣāṃ tava caiva sainyam
tena prakāśena divaṃ gatena sambodhitā devagaṇāśca rājan
śastraugavarṣaṃ rudhirāmbudhāraṃ niśi pravṛttaṃ rathadurdinaṃ tat
asajjanta tato vīrā vireṣveva pṛthakpṛthak nāgā nāgaiḥ samājagmusturagā hayasādibhiḥ
droṇaṃ ca ke vyarakṣanta praviṣṭe śvetavāhane
ke'rakṣandakṣiṇaṃ cakraṃ ke ca droṇasya savyataḥ ke pṛṣṭhataścāpyabhavanvīrā vīrānvinighnataḥ
karṇaṃ ca vṛṣasenaṃ ca madrarājaṃ ca kaurava
durdharṣaṃ dīrghabāhuṃ ca ye ca teṣāṃ padānugāḥ
droṇaṃ yattāḥ parākrāntāḥ sarve rakṣantu pṛṣṭhataḥ
trigartānāṃ ca ye śūrā hataśiṣṭā mahārathāḥ
ācāryo hi susaṃyatto bhṛśaṃ yattāśca pāṇḍavāḥ
te yūyaṃ sahitāḥ sarve bhṛśaṃ yattā mahārathāḥ
pāṇḍavīyeṣu sainyeṣu na taṃ paśyāma kañcana
tathā'rjunaṃ ca rādheyo haniṣyati mahārathaḥ bhīmasenamahaṃ cāpi yuddhejeṣyāmi dīkṣitaḥ
soyaṃ mama jayo vyakto dīrghakālaṃ bhaviṣyati
droṇaṃ prati samāyāntaṃ matto mattamiva dvipam
dhanuściccheda bhallena taṃ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ
tasya pārtho dhanuśchittvā hastāvāpaṃ nikṛtya ca
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā hemacitraṃ mahādhanam
vivyādha pāṇḍavaṃ ṣaṣṭyā sūtaṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
etasminneva kāle tu gṛhya pārthaḥ punardhanuḥ
tatastu samare śūro vṛṣṇīnāṃ pravaro rathī
tatastu pāṇḍavo jyeṣṭhaḥ khaṅgaṃ carma samādade
tomaraṃ tu tato gṛhya svarṇadaṇḍaṃ durāsadam
sa tu śaktyā vibhinnāṅgo nipapāta rathottamāt
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā hataṃ śūramaśvatthāmā mahārathaḥ
yuddhaśraddhāmahaṃ te'dya vineṣyāmi raṇājire ityuktvā krodhatāmrākṣo rākṣasaḥ paravīrahā
sa mārgaṇagaṇairdrauṇirdiśaḥ pracchādya sarvataḥ. priyārthaṃ tava putrāṇāṃ rākṣasaṃ samavākirat
sa mohaṃ samare prāpto dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśritaḥ
tato hāhākṛtaṃ sainyaṃ tava sarvaṃ janādhipa
hataṃ sma menire sarve droṇasūnuṃ janādhipāḥ
sa bhittvā hṛdayaṃ tasya rākṣasasya śarottamaḥ
tathā tu samare viddhvā rākṣasendraṃ ghaṭotkacam
atha duryodhano rājā bhīmaṃ vivyādha patribhiḥ
tasya bhīmo dhanuśchittvā dhvajaṃ ca daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho bhanuranyanmahattaram gṛhītvā bharataśreṣṭho bhīmasenaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
dvitīyaṃ ca tṛtīyaṃ ca caturthaṃ pañcamaṃ tathā
sa tathā bhidyamāneṣu kārmukeṣu punaḥ punaḥ
aprāptāmeva tāṃ śaktiṃ tridhā ciccheda kauravaḥ
tato bhīmo mahārāja gadāṃ gurvīṃ mahāprabhām
tataḥ sā sahasā vāhāṃstava putrasya saṃyuge
sārathiṃ ca gadā gurvī mamardāsya rathaṃ punaḥ
putrastu tava rājendra bhīmādbhītaḥ praṇaśya ca
tato bhīmo hataṃ matvā tava putraṃ mahāratham
teṣāṃ tu ninadaṃ śrutvā trastānāṃ sarvayodhinām
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā hataṃ matvā suyodhanam
sajyaṃ cāsya dhanuḥ śīghraṃ ciccheda laghuhastavat
sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena drutaṃ ninye yamakṣayam
rathacakraṃ pragṛhyājau mumocādhirathaṃ prati tadāpatadvai sahasā kālacakramivodyatam
mā yudhyasva raṇe'dhīra viśiṣṭai rathibhiḥ saha
sadṛśairyudhya mādreya vaco me mā viśaṅkithāḥ
eṣo'rjuno raṇe tūrṇaṃ yudhyate kurubhiḥ saha
tatra gacchasva mādreya gṛhaṃ vā yadi manyase
evamuktvā tu taṃ karṇo rathena rathināṃ varaḥ
sūtaṃ dhvajaṃ ca samare śarābhyāṃ sannyapātayat
so'tividdho mahārāja rathopastha upāviśat kaśmalaṃ cāviśattīvraṃ virāṭo bharatarṣabha
tataḥ sā mahatī senā prādravanniśi bhārata
prayātau tatra rājendra yatra śalyo vyavasthitaḥ
raudreṇa citrapakṣeṇa vivṛtākṣeṇa kūjatā dhvajenocchritadaṇḍena gṛdhrarājena rājatā
atitīvraṃ mahādyuddhaṃ nararākṣasayostadā draṣṭṝṇāṃ prītijananaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra bhārata
punaḥ sajyaṃ kṛtaṃ cāpaṃ tadapyasya dvidhā'cchinat
sa tu taṃ prativivyādha daśabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
sa cchinnadhanvā samare vivarmā ca mahārathaḥ
tasya tatkurvataḥ karma nakulasya suto raṇe
dvidhā ciccheda bhallena pītena niśitena ca
tūṇādākṛṣya vimalaṃ bhallaṃ pītaṃ śitaṃ dṛḍham
kārmuke yojayitvā taṃ drupadaṃ sannirīkṣya ca
hṛdayaṃ tasya bhittvā ca jagāma vasudhātalam
sārathistamapovāha smaransārathiceṣṭitam tasminprabhagne rājendra pāñcālānāṃ mahārathe ]
prativindhyaṃ tu samare kurvāṇāṃ karma duṣkaram apūjayanmahārāja tava sainye mahārathāḥ
sārathiṃ cāsya bhallena dhvajaṃ ca samapātayat
taṃ dṛṣṭvā virathaṃ tatra bhrātaro'sya mahārathāḥ
āplutaḥ sa tato yānaṃ sutasomasya bhāsvaram
tatastu tāvakāḥ sarve parivārya sutaṃ tava
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata
nakulaṃ rabhasaṃ yuddhe nighnantaṃ vāhinīṃ tava
nakulastu bhṛśaṃ vidvaḥ śyālena tava dhanvinā
viśikhena ca tīkṣṇena pītena niśitena ca ūrū nirbhidya caikena nakulaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
śyenaṃ sapakṣaṃ vyādhena pātayāmāsa taṃ tadā
taṃ visaṃjñaṃ nipatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā śyālaṃ tavānagha
tataḥ sañcukruśuḥ pārthā ye ca teṣāṃ padānugāḥ
nirjitya ca raṇe śatruṃ nakulaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ
śarajālāvṛtaṃ vyoma cakratustau mahārathau meghāviva tapāpāye vīrau samaradurmadau
tasya kruddhaḥ kṛpo rājañśaktiṃ cikṣepa dāruṇām
vimukhaṃ tu raṇe dṛṣṭvā yājñaseniṃ mahāratham
dravatāṃ sādināṃ caiva gajānāṃ ca viśāmpate
tasminneva pade yattā nigṛhṇanti sma bhārata
babhūva tatra sainyānāṃ śabdaḥ suvipulo niśi
ādityena yathā vyāptaṃ tamo loke praṇaśyati
divaṃ ca pṛthivīṃ caiva diśaśca pradiśastathā
rajasā tamasā vyāptā dyotitāḥ prabhayā punaḥ
astrāṇāṃ kavacanānāṃ ca maṇīnāṃ ca mahātmanām
avadhītsamare putraṃ pitā bharatasattama putraśca pitaraṃ mohātsakhāyaṃ ca sakhā tathā
tato droṇaṃ mahārāja pāñcālyaḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ
vivyādha hṛdaye tūrṇaṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca
taṃ droṇaḥ pañcaviṃśatyā viddhā bhārata saṃyuge
sa visṛṣṭo balavatā śaro ghoro mahāmṛdhe
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā śaraṃ ghoraṃ devagandharvamānavāḥ
chittvā tu samare bāṇaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvabhiḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tataḥ karṇo vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
sa viddhaḥ saptabhirghorairdroṇasyārthe mahāhave sarvānasambhramādrāja pratyaviddhyattribhistribhiḥ
droṇaṃ drauṇiṃ ca karṇaṃ ca vivyādha ca tavātmajam
te bhinnā dhanvinā tena dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ punarmṛdhe
na tu tanmamṛṣe karṇo dhanuṣaśchedanaṃ tathā
dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ tu saṃrabdhaṃ te vīrāḥ ṣaḍratharṣabhāḥ
sa sātyakestu balinaḥ karṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
astrairastrāṇi saṃvārya teṣāṃ karṇasya vā vibho
tataḥ karṇo hataṃ matvā vṛṣasenaṃ mahāratham
sa karṇaṃ daśabhirviddhvā vṛṣasenaṃ ca saptabhiḥ
śrutvā tu rathanirghoṣaṃ gāṇḍīvasya ca niḥsvanam
eṣa sarvāṃ camūṃ hatvā mukhyāṃścaiva nararṣabhān
ayaṃ madhye sthito'smākaṃ sātyakiḥ sātvatāṃ varaḥ
sātyakiṃ yadi hanyāma dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam
asaṃśayaṃ mahārāja dhruvo no vijayo bhavet
te tvaradhvaṃ tathā śūrāḥ śarāṇāṃ mokṣaṇe bhṛśam yathā tviha vrajatyeṣa paralokāya mādhavaḥ
vṛtaḥ sahasrairdaśabhirgajānāmanivartinām rathaiśca daśasāhasraistūrṇaṃ yāhi dhanañjayam
jahi kṛṣṇau mahābāho dharmarājaṃ ca mātula
nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca bhīmasenaṃ tathaiva ca
devānāmiva devendre jayāśā tvayi me sthitā
mahatyā senayā sārdhaṃ saha putraiśca te vibho
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha
bhāradvājastato gatvā dhṛṣṭadyumnarathaṃ prati mahadyuddhaṃ tadāsīttuṃ droṇasya niśi bhārata
śrutvā ca vipulaṃ nādaṃ niśīthe romaharṣaṇe
pāñcālānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ bharatānāṃ ca dāruṇam
ciccheda tarasā yuddhe tava putrasya mādhava
ninye ca caturo vāhānyamasya sadanaṃ prati
tau tu viddhā mahārāja pāṇḍavo niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
dhṛṣṭadyumno mahārāja droṇaṃ viddhā tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
ciccheda dhanuṣastūrṇaṃ jyāṃ śareṇa śitena ha
abhyetya sahasā karṇaṃ droṇaṃ ca jayatāṃ varam
yadyahaṃ bhavatostyājyo na vācyo'smi tadaiva hi
vākpratodena tau vīrau praṇunnau tanayena te
karṇaśca daśabhirbāṇaiḥ putraśca tava saptabhiḥ daśabhirvṛṣasenaśca saubalaścāpi saptabhiḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca samare droṇaṃ nighnantaṃ pāṇḍavīṃ camūm
putrānanye pitṝnanye bhrātṝnanye ca mātulān bhāgineyānvayasyāṃśca tathā sambandhibāndhavān
pāṇḍavānāṃ raṇe yodhāḥ paralokaṃ gatāḥ pare
sā tathā pāṇvī senā pīḍyamānā mahātmanā
tamasā saṃvṛte loke na prājñāyata kiñcana
tāṃ tu vidravatīṃ dṛṣṭvā ūcatuḥ keśavārjunau
mā vidravata vitrastā bhayaṃ tyajata pāṇḍavāḥ
droṇaṃ ca sūtaputraṃ ca prayatāvaḥ prabādhitum
etau hi balinau śūrau kṛtāstrau jitakāśinau
sañjaya uvāca tayoḥ saṃvadatorevaṃ bhīmakarmā mahābalaḥ
āyādvṛkodaraḥ śīghraṃ punarāvartya vāhinīm vṛkodaramathāyāntaṃ dṛṣṭvā tatra janārdanaḥ
punarevābravīdrājanharṣayanniva pāṇḍavam eṣa bhīmo raṇaślāghī vṛtaḥ somakapāṇḍavaiḥ
abhyavartata vegena droṇakarṇau mahārathau etena sahito yuddhya pāñcālaiśca mahārathaiḥ
āśvāsanārthaṃ sainyānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandana tatastau puruṣavyāghrāvubhau mādhavapāṇḍavau
tatastatpunarāvṛttaṃ yudhiṣṭhirabalaṃ mahat tato droṇaśca karṇaśca parānmamṛdaturyudhi
pāṇḍavānāṃ ca rājendra kauravāṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
tataḥ karṇo raṇe dṛṣṭvā pārṣataṃ paravīrahā
dṛṣṭvā vinirjitaṃ yuddhe pārṣataṃ te mahārathāḥ
bāhū ciccheda vai karṇaḥ śiraścaiva sakuṇḍalam
te vadhyamānāḥ samare pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayaiḥ saha
api svaṃ samare yodhaṃ dhāvamānaṃ vicetasam
droṇena ca diśaḥ sarvā vīkṣamāṇāḥ pradudruvuḥ
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā svasainyaṃ prekṣya vidrutam
paśyāmi nāntaraṃ pārtha kṣapayiṣyati no dhruvam
evaṃ gate prāptakālaṃ karṇānīke punaḥ punaḥ
sa savāṃstatra yātvāśu yatra karṇo mahārathaḥ
na tu tāvadahaṃ manye prāptakālaṃ tavānagha
rakṣyate śaktireṣā hi raudrāṃ rūpaṃ bibharti ca
sa hi bhīmena balinā jātaḥ suraparākramaḥ
satataṃ cānurakto vo hitaiṣī ca ghaṭotkacaḥ
vijeṣyati raṇe karṇamiti me nātra saṃśayaḥ
kavacī saśaraḥ khaṅgī sadhanvā ca viśāmpate abhivādya tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ pāṇḍavaṃ ca dhanañjayam
ghaṭotkaca vijānīhi yattvāṃ vakṣyāmi putraka prāpto vikramakālo'yaṃ tava nānyasya kasyācit
sa tvaṃ nimajjatāṃ yuddhe bandhūnāṃ bāndhavo bhava
yāvanti ca tavāstrāṇi santi māyāśca rākṣasīḥ
sa tvaṃ kuru mahābāho karma yuktamihātmanaḥ
tava hyatra balaṃ bhīmaṃ māyāśca tava dustarāḥ
jahi karṇaṃ hameṣvāsaṃ niśīthe māyayā raṇe
jahi karṇaṃ raṇe śūraṃ sātvatena sahāyavān
evameva mahābāho yathā vadasi māṃ prabho
adya dāsyāmi saṅgrāmaṃ sūtaputrāya taṃ niśi
na cātra śūrānmokṣyāmi na bhītānna kṛtāñjalīn
dṛṣṭvā ghaṭotkacaṃ rājansūtaputrarathaṃ prati āyāntaṃ tu tathāyuktaṃ jighāṃsuṃ karṇamāhave
etadrakṣo raṇe tūrṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam
vṛtaḥ sainyena mahatā yāhi yatra mahābalaḥ
rakṣa karṇaṃ raṇe yatto vṛtaḥ sainyena mānada
jaṭāsuro mama pitā rakṣasāṃ grāmaṇīḥ purā
tvaṃ tu gaccha mayā''jñapto jahi yuddhe ghaṭotkacam
alambalaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca kurusainyaṃ ca dustaram
punaḥ kuñjaraśārdūlau punaḥ svarbhānubhāskarau evaṃ māyāśatasṛjāvanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇau
hayābhyāṃ ca gajābhyāṃ ca rathābhyāṃ ca padātibhiḥ
abhyetya ca mahābāhuḥ smayamānaḥ sa rākṣasaḥ
eṣa te nihato bandhustvayā dṛṣṭo'sya vikramaḥ
svadharmamarthaṃ kāmaṃ ca tritayaṃ yo'bhivāñchati riktapāṇirna paśyeta rājānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ striyam
yena vaikartanaḥ karṇaḥ saṅgrāme tena nirjitaḥ
kīdṛśaṃ varma caivāsya śirastrāṇaṃ ca kīdṛśam
kuṇḍale bālasūryābhe mālāṃ hemamayīṃ śubhām dhārayanvipulaṃ kāṃsyaṃ kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham
sa tena vibhrājata vai savidyudiva toyadaḥ
rākṣaso'sya virūpākṣaḥ sūto dīptāsyakuṇḍalaḥ ghorarūpo mahākāyaḥ karālo vikṛtānanaḥ
sañchindantau ca gātrāṇi sandadhānau ca sāyakān
dhanurghoṣeṇa vitrastāḥ sve pare ca tadā'bhavan
ghaṭotkacaṃ yadā karṇo viśeṣayati no nṛpa
na hayānna rathaṃ tasya na dhvajaṃ na ghaṭotkacam
sa tu kṛtvā virūpāṇi vadanānyaśubhāni ca
aṅguṣṭhamātro bhūtvā ca punareva sa rākṣasaḥ
kṣitiṃ khaṃ ca diśaścaiva māyayā'bhyetya daṃśitaḥ
ityuktvā roṣatāmrākṣaṃ rakṣaḥ krūraparākramam utpapātāntarikṣaṃ ca jahāsa ca suvistaram
dṛṣṭvā ca vihatāṃ māyāṃ karṇena bharatarṣabha
tataḥ so'sreṇa śailendro vikṣipto vai vyanaśyata
tataḥ sa toyado bhūtvā nīlaḥ sendrāyudho divi
sa mārgaṇagaṇaiḥ karṇo diśaḥ pracchādya sarvaśaḥ
sa dṛṣṭvā punarāyāntaṃ rathena rathināṃ varam
sa hatvā rākṣasīṃ senāṃ śuśubhe sūtanandanaḥ
pureva tripuraṃ dagdhvā divi devo maheśvaraḥ
sa yayau ghorarūpeṇa rathena rathināṃ varaḥ dvairathaṃ sūtaputreṇa punareva viśāmpate
sa cikṣepa punaḥ kruddhaḥ sutaputrāya rākṣasaḥ
evaṃ kṛtvā raṇe karṇa āruroha rathaṃ punaḥ
evaṃ sa vai mahākāyo māyayā lāghavena ca
pratihatya tu tāṃ māyāṃ divyenāstreṇa rākṣasīm
sa bhagnamāyo haiḍimbiḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ tadā
mahatyā senayā yukto duryodhanamupāgamat rākṣasānāṃ virūpāṇāṃ sahasraiḥ parivāritaḥ
tasya jñātirhi vikrānto brāhmaṇādo bako hataḥ
sa matta iva mātaṅgaḥ saṅkrudva iva coragaḥ
viditaṃ te mahārāja yathā bhīmena rākṣasāḥ
nivāraya balaṃ sarvaṃ vayaṃ yotsyāma pāṇḍavān
tvāṃ puraskṛtya sagaṇaṃ vayaṃ yotsyāmahe parān
na hi vairāntamanasaḥ sthāsyanti mama sainikāḥ
tasyāpyakṣasamā bāṇā rukma puṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ so'pi vīro mahābāhuryathaiva sa ghaṭotkacaḥ
sa cāpi rūpeṇa ghaṭotkacasya śrīmattamo hyantakasannikāśaḥ
gadī bhuśuṇḍī musalī halī ca śarāsanī vāraṇatulyavarṣmā
rarāja sahkhye parivartamāno vidyunmālī megha ivāntarikṣe
te cāpi sarvapravarā narendrā mahābalā varmimaścarmiṇaśca
na drauṇirna kṛpadroṇau na śalyo na ca mādhavaḥ
eka eva tu tenāsīdyoddhā karṇo raṇe vṛṣā
tavaiṣa bhāraḥ samare jñātimadhye mayā kṛtaḥ
evamuktaḥ sa rājñā tu rākṣaso bhīmavikramaḥ
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasendraṃ bhīmo bhīmaparākramaḥ
te cāpi rākṣasāḥ sarve rajanyāṃ bhīmarūpiṇaḥ
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā mahāghoraṃ vartamānaṃ mahāhavam
tasmai gurvīṃ gadāṃ ghorāṃ vinadannutsasarja ha
gadayā rākṣaso ghoro nijaghāna nanāda ca
tayoḥ sutumulaṃ yuddhaṃ babhūva niśi rakṣasoḥ
tataste'pyāyayurhatvā rākṣasānyatra sūtajaḥ nakulaḥ sahadevaśca sātyakiśca mahārathaḥ
te karṇe yodhayāmāsuḥ pāñcālā droṇameva tu
sā hayāṃśca rathaṃ cāsya sārathiṃ ca mahāsvanā
sa samāsthāya māyāṃ tu vavarṣa rudhiraṃ bahu
tāṃ prekṣya mahatīṃ māyāṃ rākṣaso rākṣasasya ca
so'bhivīkṣya hatāṃ māyāṃ māyāvī māyayaiva hi
aśmavarṣaṃ sa taṃ ghoraṃ śaravarṣeṇa vīryavān
atīva sā niśā teṣāṃ babhūva vijayāvahā
dhruvaṃ sa tena hantavya ityamanyata pārthivaḥ
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ bhīmasenātmajena vai
tasya taṃ tumulaṃ śabdaṃ śrutvā hṛdayakampanam
jyānemighoṣastanayitnumānvai dhanustaṭinmaṇḍalaketuśṛṅgaḥ śaraughavarṣākulavṛṣṭimāṃśca saṅkrāmameghaḥ sa babhūva rājan
tadadbhutaṃ śaila ivāprakampo varṣaṃ mahāśailasamānasāraḥ vidhvaṃsayāmāsa raṇe narenadra vaikartanaḥ śatrugaṇāvamardī
kecidvisūtā vihayāśca keci-- dvaikartanenāśu kṛtā babhūvuḥ
avindamānāstvatha śarma saṅkhye yaudhiṣṭhiraṃ te balamabhyapadyan
vaikartanaṃ karṇamupetya cāpi vivyādha vajrapratimaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ
tayorhi vīrottamayorna kaści-- ddadarśa tasminsamare viśeṣam
ghaṭotkacaṃ yadā karṇo na viśeṣayate nṛpa
antarhitaṃ rākṣasendraṃ viditvā samprākrośankuravaḥ sarva eva
kathaṃ nāyaṃ rākṣasaḥ kūṭayodhī hanyātkarṇaṃ samare'dṛśyamānaḥ
tataḥ karṇo laghucitrāstrayodhī sarvā diśaḥ prāvṛṇodbāṇajālaiḥ
na vai kiñcitprāpatattatra bhūtaṃ tamobhūte sāyakairantarikṣe
naivādadāno na ca sandadhāno na ceṣudhīspṛśamānaḥ kāragraiḥ
tato māyāṃ dāruṇāmantarikṣe ghorāṃ bhīmāṃ vihitāṃ rākṣasena
tatastasyāṃ vidyutaḥ prādurāsa-- nnulkāścāpi jvalitāḥ kauravendra
mayūkhinaḥ parighā lohabaddhā gadāścitrāḥ śitadhārāśca śūlāḥ
vṛṣṭiṃ viśālāṃ jvalitāṃ patantīṃ karṇaḥ śaraughairna śaśāka hantum
śarāhatānāṃ patatāṃ hayānāṃ vajrāhatānāṃ ca tathā gajānām
śilāhatānāṃ ca mahārathānāṃ mahānninādaḥ patatāṃ babhūva
dauryodhanaṃ vai balamārtarūpa-- māvartamānaṃ dadṛśe bhramattat
saṃlīyamānaṃ ca viṣaṇṇarūpam te tvāryabhāvātpuruṣapravīrāḥ parāṅmukhā no babhūvustadānīm
tāṃ rākṣasīṃ bhīmarūpāṃ sughorāṃ vṛṣṭiṃ mahāśastramayīṃ patantīm
dṛṣṭvā balaughāṃśca nipātyamānā-- nmahadbhayaṃ tava putrānviveśa
rakṣogaṇānnardataścāpi vīkṣya narendra yodhā vyathitā babhūvuḥ
te'vākiraṃstava putrasya sainyaṃ tato raudraṃ kaśmalaṃ prādurāsīt
vikīrṇāntrā vihatairuttamāṅgaiḥ sambhagnāṅgaḥ śiśyire tatra śūrāḥ
chinnā hayāḥ kuñjarāścāpi bhagnā na mucyante yācamānāḥ subhītāḥ
evaṃ mahacchastravarṣaṃ sṛjanta-- ste yātudhānā bhuvi ghorarūpāḥ
māyāḥ sṛṣṭāstatra ghaṭotkacena nāmuñcanvai yācamānaṃ na bhītam
te vai bhagnāḥ sahasā vyadravanta prākrośantaḥ kauravāḥ sarva eva
palāyadhvaṃ kuravo naitadasti sendrā devā ghnanti naḥ pāṇḍavārthe
tathā teṣāṃ majjatāṃ bhāratānāṃ tasmindvīpaḥ sūtaputro babhūva
tasminsaṅkrande tumule vartamāne sainye bhagne līyamāne kurūṇām
annīkānāṃ pravibhāge prakāśe na jñāyante kuravo netare ca
nirmaryāde vidrave ghorarūpe sarvā diśaḥ prekṣamāṇāḥ sma śūnyāḥ
tāṃ śastravṛṣṭimurasā gāhamānaṃ karṇaṃ smaikaṃ tatra rājannapaśyan
tato bhītāḥ samudaikṣanta karṇaṃ rājansarve saindhavā bāhlikāśca
asammohaṃ pūjayanto'sya saṅkhye sampaśyanto vijayaṃ rākṣasasya
tato hatāśvādavaruhya yānā-- dantarmanāḥ kuruṣu prādruvatsu
tato'bruvankuravaḥ sarva eva karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā ghorarūpāṃ ca māyām
śaktyā rakṣo jahi karṇādya tūrṇaṃ naśyantyete kuravo dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ
kariṣyataḥ kiñca no bhīmapārthau tapantamenaṃ jahi pāpaṃ niśīthe
yo naḥ saṅgrāmāddhorarūpādvimucye-- tsa naḥ pārthānsabālānyodhayeta
tasmādenaṃ rākṣasaṃ ghorarūpaṃ śaktyā jahi tvaṃ dattayā vāsavena
mā kauravāḥ sarva evendrakalpā rātriyuddhe karṇa neśuḥ sayodhāḥ
sa vadhyamāno rakṣasā vai niśīthe dṛṣṭvā rājaṃstrāsyamānaṃ balaṃ ca
mahacchrutvā ninadaṃ kauravāṇāṃ matiṃ dadhre śaktimokṣāya karṇaḥ
sa vai kruddhaḥ siṃha ivātyamarṣī nāmarṣayanpratighātaṃ raṇe'sau
śaktiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ vaijayantīmasahyāṃ samādade tasya vadhaṃ cikīrṣan
yā'sau rājannihitā varṣapūgā-- nvadhāyājau satkṛtā phalgunasya
yāṃ vai prādātsūta putrāya śakraḥ śaktiṃ śreṣṭhāṃ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ nimāya
tāṃ vai śaktiṃ lelihānāṃ pradīptāṃ pāśairyuktāmantakasyeva jihvām
tāmuttamāṃ parakāyāvahantrīṃ dṛṣṭvā śaktiṃ bāhusaṃsthāṃ jvalantīm
bhītaṃ rakṣo vipradudrāva rājan kṛtvā''tmānaṃ vindhyatulyapramāṇam
sā tāṃ māyāṃ bhasma kṛtvā jvalantī bhittvā gāḍhaṃ hṛdayaṃ rākṣasasya
avākśirāḥ stabdhagātro vijihvo ghaṭotkaco mahadāsthāya rūpam
sa tadrūpaṃ bhairavaṃ bhīmakarmā bhīmaṃ kṛtvā bhaimaseniḥ papāta
hato'pyevaṃ tava sainyaikadeśa-- mapothayatsvena dehena rājan
patadrakṣaḥ svena kāyena tūrṇa-- matipramāṇena vivardhatā ca
priyaṃ kurvanpāṇḍavānāṃ gatāsu-- rakṣauhiṇīṃ tava tūrṇaṃ jaghāna
tato miśrāḥ prāṇadansiṃhanādai-- rbheryaḥ śaṅkhā murajāścānakāśca
dagdhāṃ māyāṃ nihataṃ rākṣasaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭvāḥ prāṇadankauraveyāḥ
tataḥ karṇaḥ kurubhiḥ pūjyamāno yathā śakro vṛtravadhe marudbhiḥ
ārcchatāṃ māmakānyuddhe kathaṃ sañjaya śaṃsa me
amarṣitāśca saṅkruddhā raṇaṃ cakruḥ kathaṃ yudhi
śokasthāne tu samprāpte haiḍimbasya vadhena tu
tadadya śaṃsa me pṛṣṭaḥ satyaṃ satyavatāṃ vara
atiharṣamimaṃ prāptaṃ śṛṇu me tvaṃ dhanañjaya
śaktihastaṃ punaḥ karṇaṃ ko loke'sti pumāniha
vāsavo vā kubero vā varuṇo vā jaleśvaraḥ
na śaktau svo raṇe jetuṃ tathāyuktaṃ nararṣabham
utkṛtya kavacaṃ yasmātkuṇḍale vimale ca te
tathā'dya bhāti karṇo me śāntajvāla ivānalaḥ
tāṃ prāpyāmanyata vṛṣā satataṃ tvāṃ hataṃ raṇe
evaṃ gato'pi śakyo'yaṃ hatuṃ nānyena kenacit
ṛte tvāṃ puruṣavyāghra śape satyena cānagha
madhyaṃgata ivādityo yo na śakyo nirīkṣitum
eko hi yogo'sya bhavedvadhāya cchidre hyenaṃ svapramattaḥ pramattam
kṛcchraṃ prāptaṃ rathacakre vimagne hanyāḥ pūrvaṃ tvaṃ tu saṃjñāṃ vicārya
na hyudyatāstraṃ yudhi hanyādajayya-- mapyekavīro balabhitsavajraḥ
ekaikaśo nihatāḥ sarva ete yogaistaistaistvaddhitārthaṃ mayaiva
te hi vīrā maheṣvāsāḥ kṛtāstrā dṛḍhayodhinaḥ
ajayyā hi vinā yogairmṛdhe te daivatairapi
ekaiko hi pṛthak teṣāṃ samastāṃ ripuvāhinīm
tatra sā rākṣasī ghorā jarānāmnī suvikramā
sā tu bhūmiṃ gatā pārtha hatā sasutabāndavā
sendrā devā na taṃ hantuṃ raṇe śaktā narottama
tvaddhitārthaṃ tu sa mayā hataḥ saṅgrāmamūrdhani
yadi hyenaṃ nāhaniṣyatkarṇaḥ śaktyā mahāmṛdhe mayāṃ vadhyo'bhaviṣyatsa bhaimasenirghaṭotkacaḥ
eṣa hi brāhmaṇadveṣī yajñadveṣī ca rākṣasaḥ dharmasya loptā pāpātmā tasmādeva nipātitaḥ
yehi dharmasya loptāro vadhyāste mama pāṇḍava
brahma satyaṃ damaḥ śaucaṃ dharmo hīḥ śrīrdhṛtiḥ kṣamā
yatra tatra rame nityamahaṃ satyena te śape
na viṣādastvayā kāryaḥ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ prati
tasyāpi ca vadhopāyaṃ vakṣyāmi tava pāṇḍava
vidravanti ca sainyāni tvadīyāni diśo daśa
labdhalakṣyā hi kauravyā vidhamanti camūṃ tava
dahatyeṣa ca vaḥ sainyaṃ droṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
kasmātsarvānsamutsṛjya sa tāṃ pārthe na muktavān
tasminhate hatā hi syuḥ sarve pāṇḍavasṛñjayāḥ
śatrubhirvyaṃsitaḥ pāpaḥ kathaṃ nu sa jayedarīn
yā hyasya paramā śaktirjayasya ca parāyaṇam
yathā varāhasya śunaśca yudhyato-- stayorabhāve śvapacasya lābhaḥ
manye vidvanvāsudevasya tadva-- dyuddhe lābhaḥ karṇahaiḍimbayorvai
ghaṭotkaco yadi hanyādvi karṇaṃ paro lābhaḥ sa bhavetpāṇḍavānām
vaikartano vā yadi taṃ nihanyā-- ttathāpi kṛtyaṃ śaktināśātkṛtaṃ syāt
iti prājñaḥ prajñayaitadvicintya ghaṭotkacaṃ sūtaputreṇa yuddhe
aghātayadvāsudevo nṛsiṃhaḥ priyaṃ kurvanpāṇḍavānāṃ hitaṃ ca
tadaiva kṛtakāryā hi vayaṃ syāma kurūdvaha
virodhī ca kumantrī ca prājñamānī mamātmajaḥ
sa vā karṇo mahābuddhiḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
kṛṣṇo hi mūlaṃ pāṇḍūnāṃ pārthaḥ skandha ivodgataḥ
kṛṣṇaṃ hi vidvi pāṇḍūnāṃ mūlaṃ sarvatra sarvadā
kṛtsnā vasumatī rājanvaśe tasya na saṃśayaḥ
yadi hi sa nihataḥ śayīta bhūmau yadukulapāṇḍavanandano mahātmā nanu tava vasudhā narendra sarvā sagirisamudravanā vaśaṃ vrajeta
sā tu buddhiḥ kṛtā'pyevaṃ jāgrati tridaśeśvare
amoghāṃ tāṃ kathaṃ śaktiṃ moghāṃ kuryāmiti prabho
na so'sti triṣu lokeṣu yo jayeta janārdanam
kimarthaṃ sūtaputreṇa na muktā phalgune tu sā
duḥśāsanaśca karṇaśca śakuniśca masaindhavaḥ satataṃ mantrayanti sma duryodhanapurogamāḥ
nānyasya śaktireṣā te moktavyā jayatāṃ vara
hṛdi nityaṃ ca karṇasya vadho gāṇḍīvadhanvanaḥ
na nidrā na ca me hārṣo manaso'sti yudhāṃvara
ghaṭotkace vyaṃsitāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śinipuṅgava
na pitā na ca me mātā na yūyaṃ bhrātarastathā
na ca prāṇāstathā rakṣyā yathā bībhatsurāhave
ataśca prahito yuddhe mayā karṇāya rākṣasaḥ
na hyanyaḥ samare rātrau śaktaḥ karṇaṃ prabādhitum
yadi jānītha tāṃ śaktimekaghnīṃ satataṃ raṇe
sā kimarthaṃ tu karṇena pravṛtte samare purā
na devakīsute muktā phalgune vā'pi sañjaya
anyeṣāṃ caiva yodhānāṃ sā buddhirnāśyate punaḥ
na jaghāna raṇe pārthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vā devakīsutam
pārthe vā śakrakalpe vai vadhārthaṃ vāsavīṃ prabho
gatā hi vāsavī hatvā tṛṇabhūtaṃ ghaṭotkacam
karṇaśca mama putrāśca sarve cānye ca pārthivāḥ
bhūya eva tu me śaṃsa yathā yuddhamavartata
kṛrūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca haiḍimbau nihate tadā
samārcchanmāmakā yuddhe kathaṃ sañjaya śaṃsa me
amarpitāḥ susaṅkruddhā raṇaṃ cakruḥ kathaṃ niśi
āpatatsu ca vegena vadhyamāne bale'pi ca
vigāḍhāyāṃ rajanyāṃ ca rājā dainyaṃ paraṃ gataḥ
taṃ tathā vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt
uttiṣṭha rājanyudhvasva vaha gurvīṃ dhuraṃ vibho
viditā me mahābāho dharmāṇāṃ paramā gatiḥ
bālenāpi satā tena kṛtaṃ sāhyaṃ janārdana
uṣitaśca sahāsmābhiryāvannāsīddhanañjayaḥ gandhamādanayātrāyāṃ durgebhyaśca sma tāritāḥ
madarthe duṣkaraṃ karma kṛtaṃ tena mahāhave
svabhāvādyā ca me prītiḥ sahadeve janārdana
saiva me dviguṇā prītī rākṣasendre ghaṭotkace
droṇakarṇau tu saṃyattau paśya yuddhe mahārathau
citrāstratāṃ ca pārthasya vikramante ca kauravāḥ
eṣa droṇaśca karṇaśca rājā caiva suyodhanaḥ
nihatya rākṣasaṃ yuddhe hṛṣṭā nardanti saṃyuge
kathaṃ vā'samāsu jīvatsu tvayi caiva janārdana
vyāyacchataśca khaṅgena dvidhā khaṅgaṃ cakāra ha
vyasane vartamānasya kṛtavarmā nṛśaṃsavat aśvāñjaghāna sahasā tathobhau pārṣṇisārathī
alpe ca kāraṇe kṛṣṇa hato gāṇḍīvadhanvanā
yadi śatruvadho nyāyyo bhavetkartuṃ hi pāṇḍavaiḥ
karṇadroṇau raṇe pūrvaṃ hantavyāviti me matiḥ
avaśyaṃ tu mayā kāryaḥ sūtaputrasya nigrahaḥ
sa viṣphārya mahaccāpaṃ śaṅkhaṃ pradhmāpya bhairavam
tato rathasahasreṇa gajānāṃ ca śataistribhiḥ vājibhiḥ pañcasāhasraiḥ pāñcālaiḥ saprabhadrakaiḥ
tato bherīḥ samājaghnuḥ paṇavānakagomukhān śahkhaśabdaravāṃścaiva pāṇiśabdāṃśca daṃśitāḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā yāntaṃ bhūtaputrajighāṃsayā śokopahatasaṅkalpaṃ dahyamānamivāgninā
diṣṭyā rakṣo hataṃ yuddhe sūtaputreṇa mānada
mā krudho bharataśreṣṭha mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
pañcame divase tāta pṛthivī te bhaviṣyati
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ tapo dānaṃ kṣamāṃ satyaṃ ca pāṇḍava
ghaṭotkace tu nihate sūtaputreṇa tā niśām
dṛṣṭvā bhīmena mahatīṃ vāryamāṇāṃ camūṃ tava
tvaṃ hi droṇavināśāya samutpanno hutāśanāt saśaraḥ kavacī khaṅgī dhanvī ca paratāpanaḥ
abhidrava raṇe hṛṣṭo mā ca te bhīḥ kathañcana
tathaiva rathinaḥ sarve hastyaśvaṃ yacca kiñcana
vadhyatāṃ ca tathā teṣāṃ kṣatānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
tava caiva pareṣāṃ ca gatāstrā vigateṣavaḥ
ātmānaṃ samare jaghnuḥ svāneva ca parānapi
asmākaṃ ca mahārāja parebhyo bahavo janāḥ
śrāntā bhavanto nidrāndhāḥ sarva eva savāhanāḥ
tamasā ca vṛte sainye rajasā bahulena ca
upāramata pāṇḍūnāṃ senā tava ca bhārata
sā tu samprāpya viśrāmaṃ dhvajinī tava bhārata
iti te taṃ naravyāghraṃ praśaṃsanto mahārathāḥ
samāṃ ca viṣamāṃ cakruḥ khurāgrairvikṛtāṃ mahīm hayāḥ kāñcanayoktrāste kesarālambibhiryugaiḥ
tattathā nidrayā bhagnaṃ tadbabhau niḥsvanaṃ balam
te kṣatriyāḥ kuṇḍalino yuvānaḥ parasparaṃ sāyakavikṣatāṅgāḥ
kumbheṣu līnāḥ suṣupurgajānāṃ kuceṣu lagnā iva kāminīnām
paryagacchañchanaiḥ sarvā diśaḥ khaṃ ca kṣitiṃ tathā
sarvathā parihīnāḥ sma tejasā ca balena ca
divyānyastrāṇi sarvāṇi brāhmādīni ca yāni ha
na pāṇḍaveyā na vayaṃ nānye loke dhanurdharāḥ
śiṣyatvaṃ vā puraskṛtya mama vā mandabhāgyatām
sthaviraḥ sanparaṃ śaktyā ghaṭe duryodhanāhave ataḥ paraṃ mayā kāryaṃ kṣudraṃ vijayagṛddhinā
yadbhavānmanyate cāpi śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
tasya vīryaṃ mahābāho śṛṇu satyena kaurava
taṃ na devā na gandharvā na yakṣā na ca rākṣasāḥ
yakṣā nāgāstathā daityā ye cānye balagarvitāḥ
vijigye puruṣavyāghraḥ sa śakyo mānuṣaiḥ katham
pratyakṣaṃ caiva te sarvaṃ yathā balamidaṃ tava
ahaṃ duḥśāsanaḥ karṇaḥ śakunirmātulaśca me haniṣyāmo'rjunaṃ saṅkhye dvidhā kṛtvā'dya bhāratīm
tiṣṭha sa tvaṃ mahābāho nityaṃ śiṣyaḥ priyastava
taṃ na vittapatirnendro na yamo na jaleśvaraḥ
ahaṃ ca tāta karṇaśca bhrātā duḥśānaśca me
anutiṣṭha pratijñāṃ tāṃ satyavāgbhava taiḥ saha
ityuktvā samare droṇo nyavartata yataḥ pare
tato rathāśvāṃśca manuṣyayānā-- nyutsṛjya sarve kurupāṇḍuyodhāḥ
sa savyasācī bhīmena coditaḥ keśavena ca
tamājiśīrṣamāyāntaṃ dahantaṃ kṣatriyarṣabhān parākrāntaṃ parākramya tataḥ kṣatriyapuṅgavāḥ
na dyaurna bhūmirna diśaḥ prājñāyanta tathāgate
naiva te na vayaṃ rājanprājñāsiṣma parasparam śabdamātreṇa jānīmo vayaṃ te ca parasparam
uddeśena hi tena sma samayudhyanta pārthivāḥ
jīvanta iva tatra sma vyadṛśyanta bhayārditāḥ
tato virāṭadrupadau droṇaṃ prati yayū raṇe
drupadaṃ ca virāṭaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa mṛtyave
hate virāṭe drupade kekayeṣu tathaiva ca
hateṣu triṣu vīreṣu drupadasya ca naptṛṣu droṇasya karma taddṛṣṭvā kopaduḥkhasamanvitaḥ
droṇo yasyādya mucyeta yaṃ vā droṇaḥ parābhavet
pāñcālāstvekato droṇabhyaghnanpāṇḍavaiḥ saha duryodhanaśca karṇaśca śakuniścāpi saubalaḥ
pitṛputravadhaṃ prāpya puṃstvaṃ ko vā praharṣayet
eṣa vaiśvānara iva samiddhaḥ svena tejasā
sthitāḥ paśyata me karma droṇameva vrajāmyaham
naiva nastādṛśaṃ yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ na ca śrutam
te rātrau kṛtakarmāṇaḥ śrāntāḥ sūryasya tejasā
hayānāṃ heṣatāṃ cāpi rathānāṃ ca nivartatām
teṣu sarveṣvanīkeṣu vyatiṣakteṣvanekaśaḥ sve svāñjaghnuḥ pare svāṃśca svānpareṣāṃ pare parān
mañjatsu cakreṣu rathānsatvamāsthāya vājinaḥ kathañcidavahanśrāntā vepamānāḥ śarārditāḥ
pāñcālānāṃ ca saṃsaktaṃ na prājñāyata kiñcana
na tatra karṇaṃ droṇaṃ vā nārjunaṃ na yudhiṣṭhiram
na bhīmasenaṃ na yamau na pāñcālyaṃ na sātyakim
na ca duḥśāsanaṃ drauṇiṃ na duryodhanasaubalau
na kṛpaṃ madrarājaṃ ca kṛtavarmāṇameva ca
na cānyānnaiva cātmānaṃ na kṣitiṃ na diśastathā
na jñāyante kauraveyā na pāñcālā na pāṇḍavāḥ
na diśo dyaurna corvī ca na samaṃ viṣamaṃ tathā
tatra nāgā hayā yodhā rathino'tha padātayaḥ
yodhāste tu mahārāja krodhāmarṣasamanvitāḥ spardhinaśca maheṣvāsāḥ kṛtayatnā dhanurdharāḥ
apasavyaṃ kṛtaṃ saṅkhye bhrātṛvyenātyamarṣiṇā nāmṛṣyata tamapyājau praticakre parantapaḥ
saṃsmṛtya sarvaduḥkhāni tava durmantritaṃ ca tat
nainaṃ duḥśāsanaḥ sūtaṃ nāpi kaścana sainikaḥ
yuyudhe rathināṃ śreṣṭho laghu citraṃ ca suṣṭhu ca
sa nivṛttastataḥ karṇaḥ saṅghaṭṭita ivoragaḥ bhīmamāvārayāmāsa vikiranniśitāñcharān
avāsṛjadrathe tāṃ tu bibheda gadayā gadām
tāṃ gadāṃ bahubhiḥ karṇaḥ supuṅkhaiḥ supravejitaiḥ
dhvajaṃ śarāsanaṃ caiva śarāvāpaṃ ca bhārata
karṇo'pyanyaddhanurgṛhya hemapṛṣṭhaṃ durāsadam tataḥ punastu rādheyo hayānasya ratheṣubhiḥ
mohayantau manuṣyāṇāṃ cakṣūṃṣi ca manāṃsi ca
upāramanta te sarve yodhā'smākaṃ pare tathā vicitrānpṛtanāmadhye rathamārgānudīrya tau
yadā droṇo na śaknoti pāṇḍavaṃ sma viśeṣitum
naivedaṃ mānuṣaṃ yuddhaṃ nāsuraṃ na ca rākṣasam
na daivaṃ na ca gāndharvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhruvamidaṃ param
vicitramidamāścaryaṃ na no dṛṣṭaṃ na ca śrutam
tatra śakyopamā kartumanyatra tu na vidyate
jñānamekasthamācārye jñānaṃ yogaśca pāṇḍave śauryamekasthamācārye balaṃ śauryaṃ ca pāṇḍave
nemau śakyau maheṣvāsau yuddhe kṣapayituṃ paraiḥ
tataścacāla pṛthivī saparvatavanadrumā saritaśca pratisrotaḥ pravahurvai kṣaṇāntaram

gatiṃ paramikāṃ prāptamajānanto nṛyonayaḥ nāpaśyangacchamānaṃ hi taṃ sārdhamṛṣipuṅgavaiḥ

harṣeṇa mahatā mahatā yukto bhāradvāje nipātite
na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sainikāśca ha
evaṃ taṃ nihataṃ saṅkhye dadṛśe sainiko janaḥ
te tu dṛṣṭvā śiro rājanbhāradvājasya tāvakāḥ
apaśyāma divaṃ stabdhvā gacchantaṃ taṃ mahādyutim
patite tvatha saṃrabdhe senāyāṃ tatra bhārata

abravīcca tadā bhīmaḥ pārṣataṃ śatrutāpanam bhūyo'haṃ tvāṃ pariṣvajya parivakṣyāmi pārṣata
sūtaputre hate pāpe dhārtarāṣṭre ca saṃyuge
arikṣayaṃ ca saṅgrāme tena te sukhamāpnuvan
aśrukaṇṭhā yathā daityā hiraṇyākṣe purā hate

śaṃsātra bhadraṃ te sarvaṃ yathā sainyamidaṃ drutam

sa madhyaṃ prāpya pāṇḍūnāṃ śararaśmiḥ pratāpavān
naiṣa jātu naraiḥ śakyo jetuṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
te yūyaṃ dharmamutsṛjya jayaṃ rakṣata pāṇḍavāḥ
hataṃ taṃ saṃyuge kaścidākhyātvasmai mṛṣā naraḥ
aśvatthāmā hata iti taṃ nābudhyata te pitā
hataṃ vā'pyahataṃ vā''jau tvāṃ pitā putravatsalaḥ
na hantavyo na hantavya iti te sarvato'bruvan
hata eva nṛśaṃsena pitā tava nararṣabha
vayaṃ cāpi nirutsāhā hate pitari te'nagha
tataḥ kruddho raṇe drauṇirbhṛśaṃ jajvāla māriṣa
icchanti puruṣāḥ putraṃ loke nānyaṃ kathañcana
tāni putrāya vā dadyuḥ śiṣyāyānugatāya vā
sa śiṣyaḥ prāpya tatsarvaṃ saviśeṣaṃ ca sañjaya
rāmasya tu samaḥ śastre purandarasamo yudhi

nigṛhītaḥ pade ṣaṣṭhe balena balināṃ varaḥ

bhavantaśca yathā'smākaṃ bhavatāṃ ca tathā vayam
pārṣatasya kṣama tvaṃ vai kṣamatāṃ pārṣataśca te
yuddhaśruddhāṃ ca kaunteya jīvitaṃ cāsya saṃyuge

saṃrabdhā hi sthirībhūtā droṇa putreṇa kauravāḥ
yathā śiloccaye śailaḥ sāgaraiḥ sāgaro yathā
cukṣubhe pṛthivī sarvā diśaśca pratisasvanuḥ sambhrāntānyapi bhūtāni jalajānyapi māriṣa te ca sarve tadā yodhāḥ samprahṛṣṭā yuyutsavaḥ
sampatatsu rathaugheṣu tava teṣāṃ ca bhārata

tathā tadastraṃ pāṇḍūnāṃ dadāha dhvajinīṃ prabho
sātyake tvaṃ ca gacchasva vṛṣṇyandhakavṛto mahān
ahaṃ hi saha sodaryaiḥ pravekṣye havyavāhanam
yena vibruvatī praśnaṃ tathā kṛṣṇā sabhāṃ gatā
rakṣaṇe ca mahānyatnaḥ saindhavasya kṛto yudhi
vyūhadvāri vayaṃ caiva dhṛtā yena jigīṣavaḥ
kavacena tathā gupto rakṣārthaṃ saindhavasya ca
grahaṇe ca paro yatnaḥ kṛtastena yathā mama
snehaśca darśito nityaṃ pratyakṣaṃ vo mahārathāḥ
yathāyathā hi yudhyante yodhā hyastramidaṃ prati
nikṣepsyanti ca śastrāṇi vāhanebhyo'varuhya ye ye'ñjaliṃ kurvate vīra namasti ca vivāhanāḥ
īṣuḥ sarve samutsraṣṭuṃ manobhiḥ karaṇena ca
na hi me vikrame tulyaḥ kaścidasti pumāniha
adya paśyata me vīryaṃ bāhvoḥ pīnāṃsayoryudhi
arjunārjuna bībhatso na nyasyaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tvayā
bhīma nārāyaṇāstre me goṣu ca brāhmaṇeṣu ca
tasya śaṅkhasvanaṃ śrutvā bāhuśabdaṃ ca tāvakāḥ
tataḥ śastrāṇi te sarve samutsṛjya mahītale
sa hi bhīmo rathaścāsya hayāḥ sūtaśca māriṣa
tathā praviṣṭaṃ tattejo na ājñāyata pāṇḍavaḥ
tadastraṃ bhīmahuṅkārādapayāti punaḥpunaḥ punaḥ punastamāyāti huṃkārāttaṃ vimuñcati
tato devāḥ sagandharvā bhīmaṃ dṛṣṭvā suvismitāḥ
rathebhyastvavatīrṇāḥ sma sarva eva hi tāvakāḥ
babhūvurvimalāḥ sarvā diśaḥ pradiśa eva ca
vyapoḍhe ca tato ghore tasmiṃstejasi bhārata
āvṛtaṃ hi nivarteta prayoktāraṃ na saṃśayaḥ
asya tu hyeṣa vai dātā mānuṣeṣu na vidyate
parāvarajño lokānāṃ na tadasti na vetti yat
tvayi śastrāṇi divyāni tryambake cāmitaujasi ghnataitānsumahāvīrya śātravānyudvakovidaḥ
icchato na hi te mucyetsaṅkruddho hi purandaraḥ
taṃ drauṇiḥ samare kruddhaṃ chādayāmāsa patribhiḥ

sa labdhvā sanakaiḥ saṃjñāṃ tāśca dṛṣṭvā striyo nṛpaḥ
tato dhyātvā ciraṃ kālaṃ niḥśvasya ca punaḥpunaḥ
dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ vepamāno muhurmuhuḥ
saṃstabhya ca mano bhūyo rājā dhairyasamanvitaḥ
na tvayā kathitaṃ vākyaṃ śrutaṃ sañjaya tanmayā
kaccidduryodhanaḥ sūta na gato vai yamakṣayam jaye nirāśaḥ putro me satataṃ jayakāmukaḥ
evamukto'bravītsūto rājānaṃ janamejaya hato vaikartano rājansahaputrairmahārathaḥ
etacchrutvā mahārāja dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ dahyamāno'bravītsūtaṃ muhūrtaṃ tiṣṭha sañjaya
vavande prāñjalirbhūtvā mūrdhnā pādau nṛpasya ha
hā kaṣṭamiti coktvā sa tato vacanamādade
droṇe ca parameṣvāse bhṛśaṃ me vyathitaṃ manaḥ
yo rathānāṃ sahasrāṇi daṃśitānāṃ daśaiva tu
taṃ droṇaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dhṛṣṭadyumnena saṃyuge
satyasandhaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ bhṛśaṃ me vyathitaṃ manaḥ
tau droṇabhīṣmau śrutvā tu hatau me vyathitaṃ manaḥ
trailokye yasya cāstreṣu na pumānvidyate samaḥ
taṃ droṇaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā kimakurvata māmakāḥ
nārāyaṇāstre ca hate droṇaputrasya dhīmataḥ vipradrutānahaṃ manyenimagnāñśokasāgare
plavamānānhate droṇe sannanaukānivārṇave duryodhanasya karṇasya bhojasya kṛtavarmaṇaḥ
madrarājasya śalyasya drauṇeścaiva kṛpasya ca matputrasya ca śeṣasya tathā'nyeṣāṃ ca sañjaya
vipradruteṣvanīkeṣu mukhavarṇo'bhavatkatham etatsarvaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tathā gāvalgaṇe mama
tacchrutvā mā vyathāṃ kārṣīrdiṣṭe na vyathate budhaḥ
yasmādabhāvī bhāvī vā bhavedartho naraṃ prati
aprāptau tasya vā prāptau na kaścidyathate budhaḥ
viśrāvya vairaṃ pārthena śrutāyuḥ sa nipātitaḥ
pattīnāṃ nihatāḥ saṅghā hayānāṃ prayutāni ca
ete cānye ca bahavo rājānaḥ sagaṇā raṇe
mahendreṇa yathā vṛtro yathā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ
yathā kṛṣṇena narako muruśca nihato raṇe
yathā skandena mahiṣo yathā rudreṇa cāndhakaḥ
jayāśā dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ vairasya ca mukhaṃ nṛpaḥ
na kṛtaṃ ca tvayā pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā balāt
hate droṇe maheṣvāse tava putrā mahārathāḥ
prābhraśyanta karāgrebhyo dṛṣṭvā droṇaṃ hataṃ yudhi
bhavatāṃ bāhuvīryaṃ hi samāśritya mayā yudhi
jayo vā'pi vadho vā'pi yudhyamānasya saṃyuge
paśyadhvaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ yudhi
amoghayā raṇe śaktyā nihato bhairavaṃ nadan
sarva eva bhavantaśca śaktāḥ pratyekaśo'pi vā pāṇḍuputrānraṇe hantuṃ sasainyānkisu saṃhatāḥ
evamuktvā tataḥ karṇaṃ cakre senāpatiṃ tadā
mitravarmā ca pāñcālyaḥ kṣatradharmā ca bhārata
mātsyādavarajaḥ śrīmāñśatānīko nipātitaḥ śreṇimāṃśca mahārāja yudhyamānaḥ parākramī
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ
hatā droṇena vikramya yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi kakude mṛdite sati
tau hi vīrau maheṣvāsau madarthe kurusattamau
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā konvartho jīvitena me
yasya bāhvorbalaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam
ahatānapi me śaṃsa ye'tra jīvanti kecana
eteṣu hi mṛteṣvadya ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ
ye'pi jīvanti te sarve mṛtā iti matirmama
divyāni rājanvihitāni caiva droṇena vīre dvijasattamena
svayaṃ bhojaḥ kṛtavarmā kṛtāstro vyavasthito yodvukāmastvadarthe
yaḥ svasrīyānpāṇḍaveyānvisṛjya satyāṃ vācaṃ svāṃ cikīrṣustarasvī
mahārathaḥ kekayarājaputraḥ sadaśvayuktaṃ ca patākinaṃ ca
tathā sutaste jvalanārkavarṇaṃ rathaṃ samāsthāya kurupravīraḥ
vyavasthitaḥ purumitro narendra vyabhre sūryo bhrājamāno yathā khe
duryodhano nāgakulasya madhye vyavasthitaḥ siṃha ivābabhāse
padmaprabho vahnirivālpadhūmo meghāntare sūrya iva prakāśaḥ
vyavasthitau citrasenena sārdhaṃ hṛṣṭātmānau samare yoddhakāmau
śalaśca satyavrataduḥśalau ca vyavasthitāḥ sahasainyā narāgryāḥ
vyavasthitā yodvukāmā narāgryāḥ prahāriṇo māninaḥ satyasandhāḥ
karṇātmajaḥ satyasandho mahātmā vyavasthitaḥ samare yodvukāmaḥ
athāparau karṇasutau varāstrau vyavasthitau laghuhastau narendra
vyavasthito nāgakulasya madhye yathā mahendraḥ kururājo jayāya
ākhyātā jīvamānā ye pare sainyā yathāyatham
evaṃ bruvanneva tadā dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ hatapravīraṃ bhūyiṣṭhaṃ kiñciccheṣaṃ svakaṃ balam
vyākulaṃ me manastāta śrutvā sumahadapriyam mano muhyati cāṅgāni na ca śaknomi dhāvitum
ityevamuktvā vacanaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭro'mbikāsutaḥ bhrāntacittastataḥ so'tha babhūva jagatīpatiḥ
śrutvā karṇaṃ hataṃ yudve putrāṃścaiva palāyinaḥ
vṛṣabho vṛṣabhasyeva yo yuddhe na nivartate
sa kathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ karṇaḥ pārthena saṃyuge
yo nāmanyata vai nityamacyutaṃ ca dhanañjayam
pāñcālāṃśca videhāṃśca kulindānkāśikosalān sūhmānaṅgāṃśca vaṅgāṃśca niṣādānpuṇḍrakīkaṭān
karamāhārayāmāsa jitvā sarvānarīṃstathā duryodhanasya vṛddhyarthaṃ rādheyo rathināṃ varaḥ
vṛṣo mahendro deveṣu vṛṣaḥ karṇo nareṣvapi
uccaiḥ śravā varo'śvānāṃ rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇo varaḥ
varo mahendro devānāṃ karṇaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
yaṃ labdhvā māgadho rājā sāṃtvamāno'tha sauhṛdaiḥ
taṃ śrutvā nihataṃ karṇaṃ dvairathe savyasācinā
taṃ vṛṣaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā dvairathe rathināṃ varam
ko madanyaḥ pumām̐lloke na jahyātsūta jīvitam
viṣamagniṃ prapātaṃ ca parvatāgrādahaṃ vṛṇe mahāprasthānagamanaṃ jalaṃ prāyopaveśanam
na hi śakṣyāmi duḥkhāni soḍhuṃ kaṣṭāni sañjaya
śriyā kulena yaśasā tapasā ca śrutena ca
sa kathaṃ nihataḥ śete vāyurugṇa iva drumaḥ
cintā me vardhate'tīva mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate
karṇasya nidhanaṃ śrutvā vijayaṃ phalgunasya ca
yacchrutvā puruṣavyāghraṃ hataṃ karṇaṃ na dīryate
āryurnūnaṃ sudīrghaṃ me vihitaṃ daivataiḥ purā
yatra karṇaṃ hataṃ śrutvā jīvāmīha suduḥkhitaḥ
dhigjīvitamidaṃ caiva suhṛdvīnasya sañjaya adya cāhaṃ daśāmetāṃ gataḥ sañjaya garhitām
paribhūtaḥ kathaṃ sūta paraiḥ śakṣyāmi jīvitum
yo balaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ yato bhayam
śete vinihato vīraḥ śakreṇeva purā balaḥ
jalasya dhārāṃ janitāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍusutena ca
yathā hi śakuniṃ gṛhya chittvā pakṣau ca sañjaya
kāṃ diśaṃ pratipatsyāmi dīnaḥ śatruvaśaṃ gataḥ
sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samare vāhuśālibhiḥ
uktaṃ tvayā purā tāta yathā vīro nipātitaḥ
nyāyena yudhyansamare tadvai satyaṃ bravīmi te
karṇaṃ tvasyantamastrāṇi divyāni ca bahūni ca
nāgamaddvairathaṃ vīraḥ sa kathaṃ nihato raṇe
iti vyapadiśanpārtho varjayansūtajaṃ raṇe sa kathaṃ nihato vīraḥ pārthena paravīrahā ]
rathabhahgo na cettasya dhanurvā na vyaśīryata
na cedastrāṇi naṣṭāni sa kathaṃ nihataḥ paraiḥ
ko hi śakto raṇe karṇaṃ vidhunvānaṃ mahaddhanuḥ vimuñcantaṃ śarānghorāndivyānyastrāṇi cāhave
dhravaṃ tasya dhanuśchinnaṃ ratho vā'pi mahīṃ gataḥ astrāṇi vā pranaṣṭāni yathā śaṃsasi me hatam
na hyanyadapi paśyāmi kāraṇaṃ tasya nāśane
na hinmi phalgunaṃ yāvattāvatpādau na dhāvaye
yasya bhīto rame nidrāṃ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
mama putraḥ sabhāṃ bhāryāṃ pāṇḍūnāṃ nītavānbalāt
tatrāpi ca sabhāmadhye pāṇḍavānāṃ ca paśyatām

sabhāyāṃ sūtajaḥ kṛṣṇāṃ sa kathaṃ nihataḥ paraiḥ

dyūtaṃ kṛtvā purā hṛṣṭho vañcayitvā ca pāṇḍavān
madrarājo maheṣvāsaḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ karṇaṃ sārathye rathināṃ varaḥ
dṛṣṭvā vinihataṃ sarve yodhā vāraṇadurjayāḥ ye ca kena rājānaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yodvumāgatāḥ
droṇe tu nihate vīre rathavyāghre nararṣabhe
madrarājaḥ kathaṃ śalyo niyukto rathināṃ varaḥ
vāmaṃ cakraṃ rarakṣurvā ke vā vīrasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
ke karṇaṃ na jahuḥ śūrāḥ ke kṣudrāḥ prādravaṃstataḥ
kathaṃ ca vaḥ sametānāṃ hataḥ karṇo mahārathaḥ
avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi kakude mṛdite sati
tau hi vīrau maheṣvāsau madarthe tyaktajīvītau
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā ko nvartho jīvitena me
punaḥ punarna mṛṣyāmi vadhaṃ karṇasya pāṇḍavaiḥ
yasya bāhvorbalaṃ tulyaṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śataṃ śatam
droṇe hate ca yadvṛttaṃ kauravāṇāṃ paraiḥ saha
tathā ca dviṣatāṃ hantā raṇe śāntastaducyatām
yuddhā ca suciraṃ kālaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha bhārata
śrameṇa mahatā yuktaṃ tathā droṇavadhena ca
dīnarūpā raṇe karma kṛtvā ghoraṃ ca śarvarīm
viśaṃ prāpya sā senā viśramya muditā'bhavat
mataṃ matimatāṃ śreṣṭhāḥ sarve prabrūta mā ciram
teṣāṃ niśāmyeṅgitāni yuddhe prāṇāñjuhūṣatām samudvīkṣya mukhaṃ rājño bālārkasamavarcasam
nītimantastathā yuktā dakṣā raktāśca te hatāḥ
vaivasvata ivāsahyaḥ śakto jetuṃ raṇe nipūn
āśāṃ bahumatīṃ cakre varṇaṃ prati sa vai tadā
hate bhīṣme ca droṇe ca karṇo jeṣyati pāṇḍavān
tāmāśāṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā samāśvasya ca bhārata [tato duryodhanaḥ prītaḥ priyaṃ śrutvā'sya tadvacaḥ
karṇa jānāmi te vīryaṃ sauhṛdaṃ paramaṃ mayi
tathā'pi tvāṃ mahābāho pravakṣyāmi hitaṃ vacaḥ
śrutvā yatheṣṭaṃ ca kuru vīra yattava rocate
bhavānprājñatamo nityaṃ mama caiva parā gatiḥ
vṛddho ca tau maheṣvāsau sāpekṣo ca dhanañjaye
mānitau ca mayā vīrau rādheya vacanāttava
nyastaśastre tu bhavati hato bhīṣmaḥ pitāmahaḥ
tenāpi rakṣitāḥ pārthāḥ śiṣyatvāditi me matiḥ
sa cāpi nihato vṛddho dhṛṣṭadyumnena satvaram
tvatsamaṃ samare yodhaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi cintayan
bhavāneva tu naḥ śakto vijayāya na saṃśayaḥ
pūrvaṃ madhye ca paścāśca tathaiva vihitaṃ hitam
tathā bhavānimāṃ senāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrīṃ bibhartu vai
jahi śatrugaṇānsarvānmahendro dānavāniva avasthitaṃ rame dṛṣṭvā pāṇḍavāstvāṃ mahārathāḥ
draviṣyanti ca pāñcālā viṣṇuṃ dṛṣṭveva dānavāḥ
bhavatyavasthite yatte pāṇḍavā mandacetasaḥ draviṣyanti sahāmātyāḥ pāñcālāḥ sṛñjayāśca ha
evamuktastu rādheyo rājñā duryodhanena ha rājñāṃ madhye mahābāhuḥ prītātmā sa mahābalaḥ
sthiro bhava mahārāja jitānvidvi ca pāṇḍavān
na hyalaṃ tvadvisṛṣṭānāṃ śarāṇāṃ vai sakeśavāḥ
na hi pārthāḥ sapāñcālāḥ sthātuṃ śaktāstavāgrataḥ
tava putrairvṛtaḥ karṇaḥ śuśubhe tatra bhārata
tathoktaśca svayaṃ rājñā snigdhaṃ bhrātṛsamaṃ vacaḥ
sannahyatāṃ narāṇāṃ ca vājināṃ ca viśāmpate
dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ rathasthaṃ rathināṃ varam
makarasya tu tuṇḍe vai karṇo rājanvyavasthitaḥ
anupāde tu yo vāmastatra śalyo vyavasthitaḥ
vṛto rathamahasreṇa dantināṃ ca tribhiḥ śataiḥ
pucche hyāstāṃ mahāvīryau bhrātarau pārthivau tadā
paśya pārtha yathā senā dhārtarāṣṭrīha saṃyuge
eko hyatra maheṣvāsaḥ sūtaputro virājate sadevāsuragandharvaiḥ sakinnaramahoragaiḥ
evaṃ jñātvā mahābāho vyūhaṃ vyūha yathecchasi
madhye vyūhasya rājā tu pāṇḍavaśca dhanañjayaḥ
śeṣāṃ nṛpatayo vīrāḥ sthitā vyūhasya daṃśitāḥ
dṛṣṭvā vyūḍhāṃ tava camūṃ sūtaputreṇa saṃyuge
tathaiva pāṇḍavīṃ senāṃ vyūḍhāṃ dṛṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ maheṣvāsaṃ mukhe vyūhasya daṃśitam
tau janaṃ harṣayantau ca siṃhanādaṃ pracakratuḥ
tataḥ kruddho raṇe bhīmaṃ kṣemadhūrtiḥ parābhinat
taṃ hataṃ nṛpatiṃ dṛṣṭvā karūśānāṃ yaśaskaram
neduḥ seduśca mamluśca babhrumuśca diśo daśa
athānye dhanuṣī citre pragṛhya ca mahāśarān
sātyakiṃ chādayantau tau ceraturlaghu suṣṭhu ca
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ śūraṃ bhrātā tasya mahārathaḥ
sa ṣaṣṭyā sātyakiṃ vidvvā svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śilāśitaiḥ
hatvā ca sārathī tūrṇaṃ hayāṃśca rathināṃ varau
sātyakestu tathaivāsau carma ciccheda pārthivaḥ carma cchittvā tu kaikeyastārāgaṇaśatairvṛtam
taṃ nihatya raṇe śūraḥ śaineyo rathasattamaḥ
tamutsṛjya raṇe śatruṃ pradudrāva diśo daśa
dhanuściccheda bhallena taṃ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ
rarāja samare vīraḥ sapuṣpa iva kiṃśukaḥ
rājānaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā te'bhisāraṃ tu māriṣa
te vadhyamānāḥ samare tava pautreṇa dhanvinā
sā papāta dvidhā chinnā prativindhyaśaraiḥ śitaiḥ
śaktiṃ tāṃ prahatāṃ dṛṣṭvā citro gṛhya mahāgadām
sā jaghāna hayāṃstasya sārathiṃ ca mahāraṇe
samāsādya raṇe śūraṃ prativindhyaṃ mahāprabhā nirbhidya dakṣiṇaṃ bāhuṃ nipapāta mahītale
sa tasya gātrāvaraṇaṃ bhittvā hṛdayameva ca
sa papāta tadā rājā tomareṇa samāhataḥ
taḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva sahasā tayoḥ
śaraiḥ sarāṃstato drauṇiḥ saṃvārya yudhi pāṇḍavam
yathā śṛṅgaṃ vane dṛptaḥ khaṅgo dhārayate nṛpa
tato drauṇiṃ raṇe bhīmo yatamānaṃ parākramī
tathaiva pāṃṇḍavo yuddhe drauṇiṃ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ
tataḥ pravikṛte yatnaṃ kurvāṇau tau mahāraṇe
te vāṇāḥ samasajjanta muktāstābhyāṃ tu bhārata
aho bhīmabalo bhīma etasya ca kṛtāstratā
rudrau dvāvi sambhūtau yathā dvāviva bhāskarau
iti vācaḥ sma śrūyante siddhānāṃ vai muhurmuhuḥ
adbhutaṃ cāpyacintyaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā karma tayo raṇe
sādhu drauṇe mahābāho sādhu bhīmeti cābruvan
tāvanyanyaṃ dhvajaṃ vidvvā sārathiṃ ca mahāraṇe
tataḥ kruddhau mahārāja bāṇau gṛhya mahāhave

vidvvā vivyādha saptatyā sārathiṃ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
nipapāta tato bhūmau cyutaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt
tato bāṇāṃścatuḥ ṣaṣṭiṃ tava putro mahāraṇe
sa taṃ nirbhidya vegena bhittvā ca kavacaṃ mahat
apovāha bhṛśaṃ trasto vadhyamānaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
parājitya raṇe taṃ tu kauravyaṃ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
tathā sā kauravī senā mṛditā tena bhārata
nakulastu tataḥ karṇaṃ prahasannidamabravīt cirasya bata dṛṣṭo'haṃ daivataiḥ saumyacakṣuṣā
yasya me tvaṃ raṇe pāpa cakṣurviṣayamāgataḥ tvaṃ hi mūlamanarthānāṃ vairasya kalahasya ca
praharasva ca me vīra paśyāmastava pauruṣam
karma kṛtvā rame śūra tataḥ katthitumarhasi
anuktvā samare tāta śūrā yudhyanti śaktitaḥ
prayudhyasva mayā śaktyā haniṣye darpameva te
te tasya kavacaṃ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave
āśīviṣā yathā nāgā bhittvā gāṃ salilaṃ papuḥ
karṇaṃ vivyādha saptatyā sārathiñca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
nirudve tatra mārge ca śarasaṅghaiḥ samantataḥ
te sene hanyamāne tu tābhyāṃ divyairmahāśaraiḥ
tataḥ kruddho raṇe karṇaḥ kṛtvā ghorataraṃ vapuḥ
athāsya taṃ rathaṃ divyaṃ tilaśo vyadhamaccharaiḥ
patākāṃ cakrarakṣāṃśca gadāṃ khaṅgaṃ ca māriṣa
mā yotsīḥ kurubhiḥ sārdhaṃ balavadbhiśca pāṇḍava
sadṛśaistāta yudhyasva vrīḍāṃ mā kuru pāṇḍava
gṛhaṃ vā gaccha mādreya yatra vā kṛṣṇaphalgunau
evamuktvā mahārāja visasarja sa taṃ tadā
smṛtvā kuntyā vaco rājaṃstata enaṃ vyasarjayat
bhagnacakrai rathaiḥ kaiścicchinnadhyavajapatākibhiḥ hatāśvairhatasūtaiśca bhagnākṣaiścaiva māriṣa
hataśeṣāstu ye vīrāḥ pāñcālānāṃ mahārathāḥ tānprabhagrāndutānvīraḥ pṛṣṭho vikirañcharaiḥ
yuyutsaṃ tava putrasya drāvayantaṃ balaṃ mahat
śākuniṃ tu tataḥ ṣaṣṭyā vivyādha bharatarṣabha
athāsya samare kruddho dhvajaṃ ciccheda kāñcanam
jaghāna caturo'śvāṃśca taṃ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ
sā kṛtvā syandanaṃ bhasma hayāṃścaiva sasārathīn
sutamomaṃ tu śakunirvidvvā tu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
nākampayata saṅkruddho vāryogha iva parvatam tasyāśvānketanaṃ sūtaṃ tilaśo vyadhamaccharaiḥ
vyasṛjatsāyakāṃścaiva svarṇapuṅkhāñśilāśitān chādayāmāsuratha te tava śyālasya taṃ ratham
tatrātuṣyanta yodhāśca sidvāścāpi divi sthitāḥ sutasomasya tatkarma dṛṣṭvā'śradveyamadbhutam
ciccheda tāṃstu khaṅgena śikṣayā ca balena ca
sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahānasiḥ
tacchittvā saguṇaṃ cāpaṃ raṇe tasya mahātmanaḥ
saubalaṃ samare dṛṣṭvā vicarantamabhītavat tānyanīkāni dṛptāni śastravanti mahānti ca
yathā dṛṣṭvā vane siṃhaṃ śarabho vārayedyudhi
vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni kṣayaṃ prāptaṃ ca menire
apīyaṃ vāhinī kṛtsnā mucyeta mahato bhayāt
ācāryaḥ kṣiprahastaśca vijayī ca sadā yudhi
pārṣataśca mahāyudve vimukho'dyābhilakṣyate ityevaṃ vividhā vācastāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha
kartavyaṃ na sma jānāti mohena mahatā vṛtaḥ
īdṛśaṃ vyasanaṃ yuddhe na te dṛṣṭaṃ mayā kvacit
avadhyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ manye yena te vikramo hataḥ
arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ vā samare prāpya sārathe
yato bhīmo maheṣvāso yuyudhe tava sainikaiḥ
pradrutaṃ ca rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhṛṣṭadyumnasya māriṣa
kṛtavarmā tu saṅkraddho bhittvā ṣaṣṭyā patatribhiḥ
tāvanyonyaṃ bhṛśaṃ vidvvā rudhireṇa samukṣitau popluyamānau hi yathā mahāntau śoṇitahade
yathā ca kiṃśukau phullau puṣpamāse samāgate rudhirokṣitasarvāṅgau raktacandanarūṣitau
anyonyasya vadhe yatnaṃ kurvāṇau tau mahārathau
tato'sya samare bāṇaṃ bhojaḥ praharatāṃ varaḥ
te hanyamānāḥ samare na jahuḥ pāṇḍavaṃ raṇe
sa vidvo bahubhiḥ saṅkhye prativivyādha tānnṛpān
śrutañjayaṃ ca rājānaṃ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ
samuddiśya raṇe kṛṣṇaṃ siṃhanādaṃ nanāda ca
sa nirbhidya bhujaṃ savyaṃ mādhavasya mahātmanaḥ
pratodaṃ gṛhya so'nyattu raśmīnsaṅgṛhya ca drutam
tato rajatapuṅkhena rājañśīrṣaṃ mahātmanaḥ mitradevasya ciccheda kṣurapreṇa mahārathaḥ
hārāṇāmatha niṣkāṇāṃ tanutrāṇāṃ ca bhārata chatrāṇāṃ vyajanānāṃ ca śirasāṃ kumuṭaiḥ saha
sa tu taṃ prativivyādha navabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ṣaṣṭhena tu dhvajaṃ rājñaḥ saptamena tu kārmukam aṣṭamena tathā khaṅgaṃ pātayāmāsa bhūtale
te śūrāḥ samare sarve citraṃ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca
na hi te samaraṃ cakruḥ pṛṣṭhato vai kathañcana
cachā sāvaraṇānkāṃścittatratatra viśāmpate rathānnāgāḥ samāsādya parigṛhya ca māriṣa
udyamya ca bhujānanye nikṣipya ca mahītale
jīvataśca tathaivānyaḥ śastraṃ kāye nyamajjayat muṣṭiyuddhaṃ mahaccāsīdyodhānāṃ tatra bhārata
saṃsakteṣu ca yodheṣu vartamāne ca saṅkule
naiva sve na pare rājanvijñāyante śarāturāḥ
aparāhṇe gate sūrye kāṅkṣatāṃ vipulaṃ yaśaḥ
yathā tvaṃ me kathayase yathā yudvamavartata
na santi sūta kauravyā iti me niścitā matiḥ
dharmaputraḥ kathaṃ cakre tasya vā nṛpatiḥ katham
krodhena mahatā yuktaḥ saviṣo bhujago yathā duryodhanaḥ samālakṣya dharmarājaṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
tatra māṃ prāpaya kṣipraṃ sārathe yatra pāṇḍavaḥ
tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ krudvaḥ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ
athānyadvanurādāya putraste bharatarṣabha yudhiṣṭhirasya cikṣepa śarānkanakabhūṣaṇān
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā putraṃ tava śaraistribhiḥ
prativivyādha taṃ tūrṇaṃ tava putro mahīpatiḥ
tato duryodhano rājā śaktiṃ cikṣepa bhārata
tribhiściccheda sahasā taṃ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ
samādhatta ca taṃ bāṇaṃ dhanurmadhye mahābalaḥ
cikṣepa ca mahārāja tataḥ krudvaḥ parākramī
sa tu bāṇaḥ samāsādya tava putraṃ mahāratham
vyāmohayata rājānaṃ dharaṇīṃ ca dadāra ha
rathasthaḥ sa tayā vidvo varma bhittvā stanāntare
bhṛśaṃ saṃvignahṛdayaḥ papāta ca mumoha ca
nāyaṃ vadhyastava nṛpa ityuktaḥ sa nyavartata
dviradanararathāśvaśaṅkhaśabdaiḥ parihṛṣitā vividhaiśca śastrapātaiḥ dviradarathapadātisādisaṅghāḥ parikupitābhimukhāḥ prajaghnire te
śitaparaśvathasāsipaṭṭasai-- riṣubhiranekavidhaiśca sūditāḥ dviradarathahayā mahāhave varapuruṣaiḥ puruṣāśca vāhanaiḥ
kamaladinakarendusannibhaiḥ sitadaśanaiḥ sumukhākṣināsikaiḥ ruciramakuṭakuṇḍalairmahī puruṣaśirobhirupastṛtā babhau
prahatarathanarāśvakuñjaraṃ pratibhayadarśanamulbaṇavraṇam tadahitahatamābabhau balaṃ pitṛpatirāṣṭramiva prajākṣaye
atha tava naradeva sainikā-- stava ca sutāḥ surasūnusannibhāḥ amitabalapuraḥ sarā raṇe kuruvṛṣabhāḥ śiniputramabhyayuḥ
surapatisamavikramastata-- stridaśavarāvarajopamaṃ yudhi dinakarakiraṇaprabhaiḥ pṛṣatkai ravitanayo'bhyahanacchinipravīram
tamapi sarathavājisārathiṃ śinivṛṣabho vividhaiḥ śaraistvaran bhujagaviṣasamaprabhai raṇe puruṣavaraṃ samavāstṛṇottadā
śinivṛṣabhaśarairnipīḍitaṃ tava suhṛdo vasuṣeṇamabhyayuḥ tvaritamatirathā ratharṣabhaṃ dviradarathāśvapadātibhiḥ saha
tadudadhinibhamādravadbalaṃ tvaritataraiḥ samabhidrutaṃ paraiḥ drupadasutamukhaistadā'bhavat puruṣarathāśvagajakṣayo mahān
atha puruṣavarau kṛtāhnikau bhavamabhipūjya yathāvidhi prabhum arivadhakṛtaniścayau drutaṃ tava balamarjunakeśavau sṛtau
jaladaninadaniḥsvanaṃ rathaṃ pavanavidhūtapatākaketanam sitahayamupayāntamantikaṃ kṛtamanaso dadṛśustadā'rayaḥ
vidvvā vivyādha viṃśatyā kṛṣṇaṃ pārthaṃ punaḥpunaḥ
atha sātyakirāgatya karṇaṃ viddvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
uttamaujā yuyutsuśca yamau pārṣata eva ca
tāṃ śastravṛṣṭiṃ bahudhā karṇaśchittvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
diśaṃ khaṃ caiva bhūmiṃ ca prāvṛṇoccharavṛṣṭibhiḥ
tamasā ca mahārāja rajasā ca viśeṣataḥ
na kiñcitpratyapaśyāma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
jayaṃ sumanasaḥ prāpya pārthāḥ svaśibiraṃ yayuḥ
kṛte'vahāre tairvīraiḥ sainikāḥ sarva eva te
ekaścemāṃ mahīṃ jitvā cakre balibhṛto nṛpān
na te nindyāḥ praśasyāste yatte cakrurbravīhi tat
tānabravīttataḥ karṇaḥ krudvaḥ sarpa iva śvasan
śvastvahaṃ tasya saṅkalpaṃ sarvaṃ hantā mahīpate
te'nujñātā nṛpāḥ sarve svāni veśmāni bhejire
sukhoṣitāstāṃ rajanīṃ hṛṣṭā yudvāya niryayuḥ te'paśyanvihitaṃ vyūhaṃ dharmarājena durjayam
kṛte'vahāre sainyānāṃ pravṛtte ca raṇe punaḥ
kathaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ sarve yuyudhustatra sūtajam
yaḥ saubalaṃ tathā tāta nītimāniti manyate
manyate'bhyadhikaṃ pārthādevaṃ cāsya hṛdi sthitam vijeṣyati raṇe karṇa ekaḥ parthānsasomakān
mama caiva sadā mandaḥ śaṃsate nityamagrataḥ
aho dyūtasya niṣṭheyaṃ ghorā samprati vartate
saubalaṃ ca tadā tāta nītimāniti manyate
karṇaśca rabhaso nityaṃ rājā ta cāpyanuvrataḥ
na pāṇḍavānāṃ samare kaścidasti hataḥ kila
taccāsya na bhavetkāryaṃ cintayā ca vinaśyati
tadidaṃ tava kāryaṃ tu dūraprāptaṃ vijānatā
nihaniṣyāmi taṃ vīraṃ sa vā māṃ nihaniṣyati
idaṃ tu me yathāprajñaṃ śṛṇu vākyaṃ viśāmpate
āyudhānāṃ ca me vīryaṃ divyānāmarjunasya ca
sauṣṭhave cāstrapāte ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ
prāṇe śaurye'tha vijñāne vikrame cāpi bhārata
yasya ghoṣeṇa daityānāṃ vyāmuhyanta diśo daśa
tena yotsye mahābāhumarjunaṃ jayatāṃ varam yathendraḥ samare sarvāndaiteyānvai samāgatān
dhanuṣo hyasya karmāṇi divyāni prāha bhārgavaḥ
na hi me vikramaṃ soḍhuṃ sa śakto'gniṃ taruryathā
avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyaṃ yena hīno'smi phalgunāt
jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathā'kṣayye maheṣudhī
tasya divyaṃ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ gāṇḍīvamajitaṃ yudhi
ayaṃ tu sadṛśaḥ śaureḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ
sārathyaṃ yadi me kuryāddruvaste vijayo bhavet
tasya me sārathiḥ śalyo bhavatvasukaraḥ paraiḥ
tathā śalyasamo nāsti hayajñāne hi kaścana
samudyātuṃ na śakṣyanti devā api savāsavāḥ
kriyatāmeṣa kāmo me mā vaḥ kālo'tyagādayam
evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ mahyaṃ tvayā sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati
na hi me samare śaktāḥ samudyātuṃ surāsurāḥ
anuyāsyāma karṇa tvāṃ vayaṃ sarve ca pārthivāḥ
evamukto mahārāja tava putraḥ pratāpavān madreśvaraṃ prati raṇe surasainyabhayaṅkaram
madrājaṃ ca samare praṇamya ca mahāratham
matpriyārthaṃ hitārthaṃ ca tathā pārthavadhāya ca śrutavānasi karṇasya bruvato vadatāṃ vara
yathā nṛpatisiṃhānāṃ madhye tvāṃ varaye svayam
tvaṃ pāhi sarvataḥ karṇaṃ bhavaṃ brahmeva suvrata
tvayi yantari rādheyo vidviṣo me vijeṣyate
abhīṣūṇāṃ hi karṇasya grahītānyo na vidyate
ṛte hi tvāṃ mahābhāga vāsudevasamaṃ yudhi
sa pāhi sarvathā karṇaṃ yathā brahmā maheśvaram yathā ca sarvathā''patsu vārṣṇeyaḥ pāti pāṇḍavam
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kṛpaḥ karṇo bhavānbhojaśca vīryavān
śakuniḥ saubalo drauṇirahameva ca no balam
na ca bhāgo'tra bhīṣmasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
tābhyāmatītya tau bhāgau nihatā mama śatravaḥ
vṛdvau hi tau maheṣvāsau chalena nihatau yudhi
asmadīyāśca bahavaḥ svargāya gamitāḥ paraiḥ tyaktvā prāṇānaythāśakti ceṣṭāṃ kṛtvā ca puṣkalām
balaṃ śeṣaṃ na hanyurme yathā tatkuru pārthiva
tena yukto raṇe pārtho rakṣyamāṇaśca pārthiva
yāni karmāṇi kurute pratyakṣāṇi tathaiva tat
idānīṃ vikramo hyasya kṛṣṇena sahitasya ca
taṃ bhāgaṃ saha karṇena yugapannāśayādya hi
aruṇena yathā sārdhaṃ tamaḥ sūryo vyapohati
tathā karṇena sahito jahi pārthaṃ mahāhave
sūryāruṣau yathā dṛṣṭvā tamo naśyati māriṣa
rathināṃ pravaraḥ karṇo yantṝṇāṃ pravaro bhavān
yathā sarvāsvavasthāsu vārṣmeyaḥ pāti pāṇḍavam tathā bhavānparitrātu karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ raṇe
yathā ca samare kṛṣṇo rakṣate sarvato'rjunam
tathā tvamapi rādheyaṃ rakṣasva ca mahāraṇe
tvayā sārathinā hyeṣa apradhṛṣyo bhaviṣyati devatānāmapi raṇe saśakrāṇāṃ mahīpate
kiṃ punaḥ pāṇḍaveyānāṃ mā viśaṅkīrvaco mama
triśikhāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ kṛtvā dhunvanhastau punaḥpunaḥ krodharakte mahānetre parivṛtya mahābhujaḥ
brahmaṇā brāhmaṇāḥ sṛṣṭā mukhātkṣatraṃ ca bāhutaḥ
ūrubhyāmatha vaiśyā vai śūdrāḥ padbhyāmiti śrutiḥ
kṛṣiśca pāśupālyaṃ ca viśāṃ dānaṃ ca dharmataḥ
na kṣatriyo vai sūtānāṃ śṛṇuyācca kathañcana
na cāhaṃ yudhi rādheyaṃ gaṇaye tulyamātmanaḥ
paśya vīryaṃ mamādya tvaṃ saṅgrāme dahato ripūn
na cāpi kāmānkauravya nidhāya hṛdaye pumān
api cāpyavamāno me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana
paśya bhīmau mama bhujau vajrasaṃhananau dṛḍhau
dhanuḥ paśya ca me citraṃ śarāṃścāśīviṣapamān
rathaṃ ca paśya me citraṃ sadaśvairvātavegibhiḥ
gadāṃ ca paśya gāndhāre hemapaṭṭavibhūṣitām dārayeyaṃ mahīṃ kruddho vikireyaṃ ca parvatān
na cāpi mama rādheyaḥ kalāmarhati ṣoḍaśīm
sakarṇā ye trayo lokāḥ sārjunāḥ sajanārdanāḥ
na cāhaṃ prākṛtaḥ kaścinna cāsmyadhigataḥ svayam
ayaṃ cāpyavamāno me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana
āpṛcche tvādya gāndhāre yāsyāmi viṣayaṃ prati
āpṛcche tvā'dya gāndhāre gamiṣyāmi gṛhāya vai
na karṇo'bhyadhikastvatto na cānye caiva pārthivāḥ
na ca madreśvara tvāṃ vai kṛṣṇaḥ soḍhuṃ ca śakṣyati
na ca tvatto hi rādheyo na cāhamapi vīryavān
manye cābhyadhikaṃ śalya guṇaiḥ karṇaṃ dhanañjayāt
yanmāṃ bravīṣi gāndhāre madhye sainyasya kaurava
yudhyataḥ pāṇḍavāgryeṇa yathā tvaṃ vīra manyase
samayaśca hi me vīra kaścidvaikartanaṃ prati
bhūya eva tu madreśa yattvā vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu
yaduktavānpiturmahyaṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahātapāḥ bruvatastadaśeṣeṇa mama rājarṣisattama
nibodha manasā cātra na te kāryā vicāraṇā
samutpanno hi rājānaḥ pramoha iti niścayam
nirjitāśca tato daityā daivatairiti naḥ śrutiḥ
tapa ugraṃ samāsthāya niyame parame sthitāḥ
teṣāṃ pitāmahaḥ prīto varadaḥ pradadau varam
avadhyatvaṃ ca te sarve sarvabhūteṣu sarvadā
tānabravīttadā devaḥ sarvalokaguruḥ prabhuḥ nāsti sarvāmaratvaṃ vai nivartadhvamito'surāḥ
anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīdhvaṃ vai rocate yādṛśo hi vaḥ
yakṣarakṣoragagaṇairnānājātibhireva ca na kṛtyābhirna śastraiśca na śāpairbrahmavādinām
te tu labdhavarāḥ prītāḥ sampradhārya parasparam puratrayavisṛṣṭyarthaṃ mayaṃ vavrurmahārathāḥ
tato mayaḥ svatapasā cakre dhīmānpurāṇi ca
trīṇi kāñcanamekaṃ vai raupyaṃ kārṣṇāyasaṃ tathā
yo hi yaṃ manasā kāmaṃ dadhyau tripurasaṃśrayaḥ
tasmai tasmai mayastaṃ taṃ vidadhe māyayā tadā
sa tu labdhvā varaṃ vīrastārakākṣasuto hariḥ
sasṛje tatra vāpīṃ tāṃ mṛtasañjīvinīṃ prabho
yena rūpeṇa yo daityo yena veṣeṇa cāpyatha kṣipyate nihato vāpyāṃ tādṛśenaiva jāyate
evaṃ vīryeṇa saṃyuktāṃ kṛtāṃ tena mahātmanā
mahatā tapasā siddhāḥ surāṇāṃ bhayavardhanāḥ ekasminnihate daitye sṛjanti sma daśāsurān
na teṣāṃ vidyate yudve kṣayo rājankathañcana
devodyānāni sarvāṇi sthānāni ca divaukasām ṛṣīṇāmāśramānpuṇyānramyāñcanapadāṃstathā
niḥsthānāśca kṛtā devā ṛṣayaḥ pitṛbhiḥ saha
tadā bhītaḥ surapatirmuktvā tāni purāṇyatha taireva vibudhaiḥ sārdhaṃ pitāmahamarindama
te tattvaṃ sarvamākhyāya śirobhiḥ sampraṇamya ca
durātmāno'surā nityaṃ te cāpi vibudhā mama
na śaknuvanti te sarve yuṣmānvai pīḍayanti te
ahaṃ samastu sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
śaktastu tāni bāṇena bhettuṃ kāmaṃ trilocanaḥ
yodvāraṃ vṛṇuta kṣipraṃ sa tānhantā suretarān
te devāstena vākyena coditāḥ praṇatāḥ sthitāḥ divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai tapastaptvā surarṣabhāḥ
devadevaṃ paraṃ sthāṇuṃ varadaṃ tryambakaṃ śivam
yaḥ sāṅkhyamātmanā vetti yasya cātmā veśe sadā
taṃ te dadṛśurīśānaṃ tejorāśimumāpatim pareṇa yatnena bhavaṃ tridaśāḥ śarvamīśvaram
ekaśca bhagavāṃstatra nānārūpamakalpayat ātmanaḥ pratirūpāṇi rūpāṇyatha mahātmani
arhāya caiva śudvāya kṣayāya krathanāya ca
gavāṃ ca pataye nityaṃ yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ namostu te sasainyāya tryambakāyāmitaujase
provāca vyetu vastrāso brūta kiṃ karavāṇi vaḥ
nāstyanyo yudhi teṣāṃ vai nihantā iti naḥ śrutam tānatikrāntamaryādānnānyaḥ saṃhartumarhati
sa tvaṃ deva prapannānāṃ yācatāṃ ca divokasām
śaraṇyastvaṃ hi devānāṃ vayaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ
hantavyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve yuṣmākamiti me matiḥ
te yūyaṃ sahitāḥ sarve madīyenāpi tejasā
bibhartuṃ tava tejordhaṃ na śakṣyāma sureśvara
sarveṣāṃ no balārdhena tvameva jahi śātravān
vayaṃ ca sarvathā deva rakṣaṇīyāstathaiva ca
sa no rakṣa mahādeva tvameva jahi śātravān
mama tejo na śaktā hi sarve dhārayituṃ yadi
balārdhaṃ yadi me devā na dhārayitumāhave
śaktāḥ sarve hi saṅgamya yūyaṃ tatprabravīmi vaḥ
samā bhavanti me sarve dānavāścāmarāśca ye
śivo'smi sarvabhūtānāṃ śivatvaṃ tena me surāḥ
śaraṇaṃ vaḥ prapannānāṃ dharmeṇa ca jigīṣatām
sāhāyyaṃ vaḥ kariṣyāmi nihaniṣyāmi vo ripūn
dīyatāṃ ca balārdhaṃ me sarvairapi pṛthakpṛthak
paśutvaṃ caiva me lokāḥ sarve kalpantu pīḍitāḥ
paśūnāṃ tu patitvaṃ me bhavatvadya divaukasaḥ
evaṃ na pāpaṃ prāpsyāmi paśūnhatvā suradvipaḥ
dhanuḥ śaraṃ sārathiṃ ca tato jeṣyāmi vo ripūn
iti śrutvā vaco devā devadevasya bhūpateḥ
śrūyatāṃ paśubhāvasya vimokṣaḥ kriyatāṃ ca saḥ
yo vaḥ paśupateścaryāṃ cariṣyati sa mokṣyate
ye cāpyanye cariṣyanti vrataṃ mokṣyanti te'pi ca
māsaṃ dvādaśarātraṃ guhyaṃ vrataṃ divyaṃ cariṣyatha
tasmātpaśupatiścokto bhavatvācca bhaveti vai ardhamādāya sarveṣāṃ tejasā prajvalanniva
bhāsayāmāsa tānsarvāndevadevo mahādyutiḥ tato'bhiṣiṣicyuḥ sarve surā rudraṃ purāriṇam
śamyāṃ dhṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca sthitiṃ sannatimeva ca
sinīvālīmanumatiṃ kuhūṃ rākāṃ ca suprabhām yoktāṇi cakre cāśvānāṃ kūśmāṇḍāṃścāpi pannagān
yajñāḥ sarve pṛthaklṛptā rathāṅgāni ca bhāgaśaḥ
varma yoddhuṃ ca vihitaṃ namo grahagaṇākulam
tasmādraudrī kālarātrī jyā kṛtā dhanuṣo jarā
evaṃ te vājino yuktā yajñavidbhistathā rathe
tasya vājāṃśca puṅkhaṃ ca kalpayāmāsa vai tadā
dṛṣṭā tu taṃ rathaṃ divyaṃ kavacī sa śarāsanī
sa śobhamāno varadaḥ khaṅgī bāṇī śarāsanī
sa bhaviṣyati deveśa sārathiste na saṃśayaḥ
taṃ sārathiṃ kurudhvaṃ vai svayaṃ sañcintya mā ciram
etacchrutvā vaco devāḥ sarve gatvā pitāmaham
sārathiṃ ca na jānīmaḥ kaḥ syāttasminrathottame
tasmādvidhīyatāṃ kaścitsārathirdevasattama saphalāṃ tāṃ giraṃ deva kartumarhasi no vibho
sadaiva yukto rathasattamo vai durādharṣo drāvaṇaḥ śātravāṇām
tathaiva vedāśca hayā rathāgrya dharā saśailā ca ratho mahātmanaḥ
taṃ praviṣṭā rathaṃ devā rathayodvārameva ca
kavacāni ca śastrāṇi kārmukaṃ ca pitāmaha
tvāmṛte sārathiṃ tatra nānyaṃ paśyāmahe vayam
tvaṃ deva śakto lokeśa niyantuṃ pradrutānimān
yodvuṃ balena vīryeṇa satvena vinayena ca
tvaṃ hi deveśa sarvaistu viśiṣṭo vadatāṃ vara
taṃ rathaṃ tvaṃ samāruhya saṃyaccha paramānhayān
sa no rakṣa mahābāho daityebhyo mahato bhayāt
tvaṃ hi no gatiravyagra tavaṃ ntre goptā mahāvrata
sarvathā rathinaḥ śreyānkartavyo rathasārathiḥ tasmādetadyathātattvaṃ jñātvā yuṣmāṃśca saṅgatān
evamuktvā jaṭābhāraṃ saṃyamya prapitāmahaḥ paridhāyājinaṃ gāḍhaṃ sannyasya ca kamaṇḍalum
sārathau kalpite devairīśānasya mahātmanaḥ tasminnārohati rathaṃ kalpitaṃ lokasambhṛtam
abhīśubhistu bhagavānudyamya ca hayānvibhuḥ astu vīryaṃ ca śauryaṃ ca vedāśvānāmiti prabhuḥ
atharvāṅgirasau cāstāṃ cakrarakṣau mahātmanaḥ athādhijyaṃ dhanuḥ kṛtvā śarvaḥ sandhāya taṃ śaram
trīṇi dṛṣṭvaiva saṃsthāni purāṇyatha pinākadhṛt sa tadvikṛṣya bhagavāndivyaṃ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ
bāṇatejognidagdhaṃ tadviprakīrṇaṃ sahasradhā mahadārtasvaraṃ kṛtvā nāvaśeṣamupāgatam
tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇācca karṇācca phalgunācca guṇādhikaḥ
samāsaktaṃ mahīpāla kuru me hitamīpsitam yudve hyayaṃ rudrakalpastvaṃ ca brahmasamo'nagha
tasmācchaktau yuvāṃ jetuṃ macchatrūndivi vā surān
sa yathā śalya karṇo'yaṃ śvaṃtāśvaṃ kṛṣṇasārathim
tvayi rājyaṃ sukhaṃ caiva jīvitaṃ jayameva ca
imaṃ cāpyaparaṃ bhūya iti hāsaṃ nibodha me
piturmama sakāśe vai brāhmaṇaḥ prāha dharmavit
kuru śalya viniścitya mā bhūdatra vicāraṇā
tasmai tuṣṭo mahādevo bhaktyā ca praśamena ca hṛdgataṃ cāsya vijñāya darśayāmāsa śaṅkaraḥ
rāma tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te viditaṃ tava cepsitam
dāsyāmi te tadā'strāṇi yadā pūto bhaviṣyasi
tataḥ sa tapasā caiva vratena niyamena ca
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṃ pratigṛhya ca sarvaśaḥ
prītaśca bhagavāndevaḥ karmaṇā tena tasya vai
nipātāttava śastrāṇāṃ śarīre yā'bhavadrujā tayā te mānuṣaṃ karma vyapohaṃ bhṛgunandana
