tato'strāṇi samagrāṇi varāṃśca manasepsitān labdhvā bahuvidhānrāmaḥ praṇamyaśirasā śivam
sūtena vardhito nityaṃ na sūto nṛpa eva saḥ
viśuddhayoniṃ vijñāya divyānyastrāṇyadādbhṛguḥ nāpi sūtakule jātaṃ manye karṇaṃ kathañcana
sarvathā na hyaso śalya karṇaḥ sūtakulodbhavaḥ
vakṣaḥ paśya viśālaṃ ca sarvaśastrasahaṃ raṇe
na tveva prākṛtaḥ kaścitkarṇo vaikartano vṛṣā
yathā devairmahārāja īśvarādadhiko vṛtaḥ tathā devairmahārāja kṣipraṃ rudrasyava pitāmahaḥ
yathā ca cakre sārathyaṃ bhavasya prapitāmahaḥ
dṛṣṭvā pārthaṃ hi nihataṃ svayaṃ yotsyati keśavaḥ
śaṅkhacakragadāpāṇirdhakṣyate tava vāhinīm na cāpi tasya kruddhasya vārṣṇeyasya mahātmanaḥ
pratyakṣa te mahābāho yathā rātrau ghaṭotkacaḥ
mādrīputrau tathā śūrau yena jitvā mahāraṇe
kamapyarthaṃ puraskṛtya na hatau yudhi māriṣa
taṃ kathaṃ pāṇḍavā yudve vijeṣyanti mahāratham
bāhuvīryeṇa te tulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ nāsti kaścana
tava bāhubalaṃ prāpya na śekuḥ sarvasātvatāḥ
yathā hi kṛṣṇena balaṃ dhāryaṃ vai phalgune hate
kimarthaṃ ca bhavānsainyaṃ na haniṣyati māriṣa
sodarāṇāṃ ca vīrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca mahīkṣitām
yanmāṃ bravīṣi gāndhāre agre sainyasya mānada
yudhyataḥ pāṇḍavāgryeṇa yathā tvaṃ vīra manyase
samayaśca hi me vīra kaścidvaikartanaṃ prati
tasya tvaṃ puruṣavyāghra niyaccha turagānyudhi karṇo hatvetarānsarvānphalgunaṃ hantumicchati
tataḥ śalyaḥ pariṣvajya sutaṃ te vākyamabravīt
tatra sarvātmanā yukto vakṣye kāryaṃ parantapa
īśānasya yathā brahmā yathā pārthasya keśavaḥ
tathā nityaṃ hite yukto madrarāja bhavasva naḥ
ayaṃ te karṇa sārathyaṃ madrarājaḥ kariṣyati
yodhe tvayi rathasthe ca madrarāje ca sārathau
taṃ rathaṃ rathināṃ śreṣṭhaḥ karṇo'bhyarcya yathāvidhi
tataḥ śalyāśritaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaḥ svaṃ rathamuttamam
abhrājetāṃ yathā meghaṃ sūryāgnī sahitau divi
sa śalyasaṅgṛhītāśve rathe karṇaḥ sthito babhau
gṛhāṇa dharmarājaṃ vā jahi vā tvaṃ dhanañjayam
jayaśca te'stu bhadraṃ te prayāhi puruṣarṣabha
bhīmasenaṃ yamau cobhau rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram
adya paśyatu me śalya bāhuvīryaṃ dhanañjayaḥ
yadā drakṣyasi saṅgrāme dharmaputraṃ yamau tathā
tato dundubhinirghoṣairbherīṇāṃ ninadena ca koṇaśabdaiśca vividhairgarjitaiśca tarasvinām
prayāte tu tataḥ karṇe ratheṣu maditeṣu ca
cacāla ca mahī sarvā rarāsa ca suvisvaram
ete cānye ca bahava utpātāstatra māriṣa
na ca tāngaṇayāmāsuḥ sarve daivena mohitāḥ
alaṃ manuṣyasya sukhāya vartituṃ tathāhi yudve nihataḥ parairguruḥ
naye ba-haspatyuśanaḥsamaṃ sadā na cainamastraṃ tadupāsta duḥsaham
kṛtyaṃ mayā nādya jānāmi śalya prayāhi tasmāddviṣatāmanīkam
sa yatra rājā pāṇḍavaḥ satyasandho vyavasthito bhīmasenārjunau ca
sa vāsudevaḥ sātyakiḥ sṛñjayāśca yamau ca kastānviṣahenmadanyaḥ
tānvā haniṣyāmi sametya saṅkhye yāsyāmi vā droṇamukho yamāya
na tvevāhaṃ na gamiṣyāmi madhye teṣāṃ śūrāṇāmiti śalyādya vidvi
mitradroho marṣaṇīyo na me'yaṃ tyaktvā prāṇānanuyāsyāmi droṇam
prājñasya mūḍhasya ca jīvitānte nāsti pramokṣo'ntakasannibhasya
ato vidvannabhiyotsyāmi pārthaṃ diṣṭaṃ na śakyaṃ vyativartituṃ vai
kalyāṇavṛttaḥ satataṃ hi rājā vaicitravīryasya suto mamāsīt
rathaprabarhaṃ turagaprabārhai-- ryuktaṃ prādānmahyamimaṃ hi rāmaḥ
dhanūṃṣi citrāṇi nirīkṣya śalya dhvajāngadāḥ sāyakāṃścograrūpān
asiṃ ca dīptaṃ paramāyudhaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ ca śubhraṃ svanavantamugram
imaṃ samāsthāya ratharṣabhaṃ raṇe dṛḍhaṃ haniṣyāmyahamarjunaṃ balāt
taṃ cenmṛtyuḥ sarvaharo'bhirakṣe-- tsadā'pramattaḥ samare pāṇḍuputram
taṃ vā haniṣyāmi raṇe sametya yāsyāmi vā droṇamukho yamāya
jugupuriha sametya phalgunaṃ kimu bahunā saha tairjayāmi tam
iti raṇarabhasasya katthata-- stadupaniśamya vacaḥ sa madrarāṭ
avahasadavamanya vīryavān pratiṣiṣidhe ca jagāda cottaram
kva ca hi naravaro dhanañjayaḥ kva punariha tvamaho narādhamaḥ
smarasi nanu yadā parairhṛtaḥ sahadhṛtarāṣṭrasuto vimokṣitaḥ
smarasi nanu yadā pramocitāḥ khacaragaṇānavajitya pāṇḍavaiḥ
samuditabalavāhanāḥ punaḥ puruṣavareṇa jitāḥ stha gograhe
sagurugurusutāḥ sabhīṣmakāḥ kimu na jitaḥ sa tadā tvayā'rjunaḥ
idamaparamupasthitaṃ puna-- stava nidhanāya suyudvamadya vai
yadi na ripubhayātpalāyase samaragato'dya hato'si sūtaja
iti bahuparuṣaṃ prabhāṣati pramanasi madrapatau ripustavam
bhavatu bhavatu kiṃ vikatthase nanu marma tasya hi yuddhamudyatam
yadi sa jayati māmihāhave tata idamastu sukatthitaṃ tava
yāhi śalyeti cāpyenaṃ kaṃrṇaḥ prāha yuyutsayā
tataḥ prāyātprītimānvai rathena vaiyāghreṇa śvetayujā'tha karṇaḥ
sa cālokya dhvajinīṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanañjayaṃ tvarayā paryapṛcchat
śataṃ dadyāṃ gavāṃ tasmai naityakaṃ kāṃsyadohanam
śataṃ grāmavarāṃścaiva dadyāmarjunadarśine tathā tasmai punardadyāṃ śvetamaśvatarīratham
tasmai dadyāṃ śataṃ nāgāñśataṃ grāmāñśataṃ rathān
suvarṇasya ca mukhyasya hayāgryāṇāṃ śataṃ śatān
dadyāṃ tasmai savatsānāṃ yo me brūyādvanañjayam
rathaṃ ca śubhraṃ sauvarṇaṃ dadyāṃ tasmai svalaṅkṛtam
anyadasmai varaṃ dadyāṃ kuñjarāṇāṃ śatāni ṣaṭ
anyaṃ tasmai varaṃ dadyāṃ yamasau kāmayetsvayam
hatvā ca sahitau kṛṣṇau tayorvittāni sarvaśaḥ
tā vācaḥ sūtaputrasya tathā yuktā niśamya tu
tathā prahṛṣṭe sainye taṃ pluvamānaṃ mahāratham vikatthamānaṃ ca tadā rādheyamarikarśanam
purā sṛjasi yaccāpi vittaṃ bahu ca mūḍhavat
yatpravedayase vittaṃ bahu tena khalu tvayā
yacca prārthayase hantuṃ kṛṣṇau mohādvṛthaiva tat
na hi śuśruma sammarde kroṣṭrā siṃhau nipātitau
aprārthitaṃ prārthayase suhṛdo na hi santi te
samudrataraṇaṃ dorbhyāṃ kaṇṭhe baddhvā yathā śilām
hitārthaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya bravīmi tvāṃ na hiṃsayā
śraddhasvedaṃ mayā proktaṃ yadi te'sti jijīviṣā
iti karṇasya vākyānte śalyaḥ prāhottaraṃ vacaḥ
yadā vai tvāṃ phalgunabāhuvegā-- jjyācoditā vegavanto'gnikalpāḥ
anvetāraḥ kaṅkapatrāḥ śitāgrā-- styakṣyatyeṣā svāṃ tadā karṇa buddhiḥ
yadā dirvya dhanurādāya pārthaḥ pratāpayanpṛtanāṃ savyasācī
tvāṃ mardayiṣyatyasukhaiḥ pṛṣatkai-- stadāpṛcchāṃ tyakṣyase pāṇḍavasya
tadvanmohāddayotāmānaṃ rathasthaṃ jetuṃ pārthaṃ kāṅkṣase sūtaputra
harādastraṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ yathā'dya sarvāṇi gātrāṇi nikarṣasi tvam
hanyādasiṃ tīkṣṇadhāraṃ yathā'taḥ sutejanaṃ nihitaṃ vai pṛthivyām
triśūlamāśliṣya sutīkṣṇadhāraṃ sarvāṇi gātrāṇi vigharṣasi tvam
kruddhaṃ siṃhaṃ kesariṇaṃ bṛhantaṃ bālo mūḍhaḥ kṣudramṛgastarasvī
samāhvayedvṛṣṭamupetya yoddhuṃ tathā tvamadyāhvayase hi pārtham
mā sūtaputrāhvaya rājaputraṃ mahāvīryaṃ kesariṇaṃ yathaiva
vane śṛgālaḥ piśitena tṛptaḥ pārthaṃ samāsādya vinaṅkṣyasi tvam
śaśako hayase yudve karṇa pārthaṃ dhanañjayam
śṛgāla iva mūḍhastvaṃ nṛsiṃhaṃ karṇa pāṇḍavam
vatsa āhvayase yudve karṇa pārthaṃ dhanañjayam
yathā ca śvā gṛhasthastu vyāghraṃ vanagataṃ bhaṣet
tathā tvaṃ bhaṣase karṇa naravyāghraṃ dhanañjayam
śṛgālo hi vane karṇa śaśaiḥ parivṛto vasan
vyāghraṃ tvaṃ manyase''tmānaṃ yāvatkṛṣṇau na paśyasi
tāvadeva tvayā karṇa śakyaṃ vaktuṃ yathecchasi
yathā śṛgālaḥ siṃhaśca yathā ca śaśakuñjarau
yathā'nṛtaṃ ca satyaṃ ca yathā cāpi viṣāmṛte
tvaṃ tu nityaṃ guṇairhīnaḥ kiṃ jñāsyasi guṇāguṇān
arjunasya mahāstrāṇi krodhaṃ vīryaṃ dhanuḥ śarān
ahaṃ śalyābhijānāmi na tvaṃ jānāsi tattathā
yathāhaṃ śalya jānāmi na tvaṃ jānāsi tattathā
sarveṣāṃ vṛṣṇivīrāṇāṃ kṛṣṇe lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhitā sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍuputrāṇāṃ jayaḥ pārthe pratiṣṭhitaḥ
maṇī sūtra iva protau draṣṭāsi nihatau mayā
saṃstauṣi tau tu kenāpi hetunā tvaṃ kudeśaja
tau hatvā samare hantā tvāmadya saha bāndhavam
suhṛdrūpo ripuḥ kiṃ māṃ kṛṣṇābhyāṃ bhīṣayiṣyasi
tau vā māmadya hantārau haniṣye vā'pi tāvaham
striyo bālāśca vṛdvāśca prāyaḥ krīḍāgatā janāḥ
tā gāthāḥ śṛṇu me śalya madrakeṣu durātmasu
śrutvā caikamanā mūḍha mama vā brūhi cottaram
mitradhruṅmadrako nityaṃ yo no dveṣṭi sa madrakaḥ
bhaginī duhitā bhrātā naptā'nye te ca bāndhavāḥ
pītvā śīdhu sagomāṃsaṃ krandanti ca hasanti ca
nāpi vairaṃ na sauhārdaṃ madrakeṇa samācaret
madrake saṅgataṃ nāsti madrako hi sadā malaḥ
madrakeṣu ca saṃsṛṣṭaṃ śaucaṃ gāndhārakeṣu ca
yathaiva saṃgataṃ kṛtvā naraḥ patati madrakaiḥ
bāleṣvapi sadā na sma dhanaṃ vṛścika te viṣam
kurvanti bheṣajaṃ prājñāḥ satyaṃ taccāpi dṛśyate
tāsāṃ putra kathaṃ dharmaṃ madrako vaktumarhati
yāstiṣṭhantyaḥ pramehanti yathaivoṣṭradaśerakāḥ tāsāṃ vibhraṣṭadharmāṇāṃ nirlajjānāṃ tatastataḥ
mā māṃ sauvīrakaṃ kaścidyācatāṃ dayitaṃ mama
putraṃ dadyāṃ patiṃ dadyāṃ na tu dadyāṃ suvīrakam
śuddhā nādbhirna mṛdbhiśca nityocchiṣṭā bhavanti hi
madrakāḥ sindhusauvīrā dharmaṃ vidyuḥ kathaṃ tviha
eṣa mukhyatamo dharmaḥ kṣatriyasyeti naḥ śrutam
tadarthe hi mama prāṇā yacca me vidyate vasu
kāmaṃ na khalu śakyo'haṃ tvadvidhānāṃ śatairapi
sāraṅga iva gharmārtaḥ kāmaṃ vilapa śuṣya ca
yā gatirguruṇā proktā premṇā rāmeṇa tāṃ smare
na tadbhūtaṃ prapaśyāmi triṣu lokeṣu madrapa
na tvāṃ hatvā pradāsyāmi kravyādbhyo madrakādham
karṇaṃ vā jaghnatuḥ kṛṣṇau karṇo vā nijaghāna tau
yathaiva matto madyena tvaṃ tathā lakṣyase vṛṣa
imāṃ kākopamāṃ karṇa procyamānāṃ nibodha me
avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyaṃ buddhvā tava hitāhitam
samaṃ ca viṣamaṃ caiva rathinaśca balābalam
śramaḥ khedaśca satataṃ hayānāṃ rathinā saha
sāraṃ caivāpyāsaraṃ ca śalyānāṃ ca pratikriyā
astrayogaṃ ca yudvaṃ ca nimittāni tathaiva ca sarvametanmayā jñeyaṃ rathasyāsya kuṭumbinā
ehi tvamapi śakto hi kasmānna patitaṃ tvayā
teṣāṃ yaṃ pravaraṃ mene haṃsānāṃ dūrapātinām sa tamāhvata durbuddhiḥ patāva iti pakṣiṇam
pakṣiṇāṃ ca vayaṃ nityaṃ dūrapātena pūjitāḥ
kathaṃ haṃsaṃ nu balinaṃ cakrāṅgaṃ dūrapātinam kāko bhūtvā nipatane samāhvayasi durmate
kathaṃ tvaṃ patitā kāka sahāsmābhirbravīhi tat
atha haṃsavaco mūḍhaḥ kutsayitvā punaḥ punaḥ
śatamekaṃ ca pātānāṃ patitā'smi na saṃśayaḥ
saṃpātaṃ samudīṣaṃ ca tato'nyadvyatiriktakam gatāgataṃ pratigataṃ bahvīśca nikulīnakāḥ
kartā'smi miṣatāṃ vo'dya tato drakṣayatha me balam
te vai dhruvaṃ viniścitya sampatadhvaṃ mayā saha
pātairebhiḥ khalu khagāḥ patituṃ khe nirāśraye
uvāca kākaṃ rādheya vacanaṃ tannibodha me
śatamekaṃ ca pātānāṃ tvaṃ kāka patitā dhruvam ekameva tu yaṃ pātaṃ viduḥ sarve vihaṅgamāḥ
tamahaṃ patitā kāka nānyaṃ jānāmi kañcana
pata tvamapi tatrāśu yena pātena manyase
atha kākaṃ prajahasurye tatrāsansamāgatāḥ kathamekena pātena haṃsaḥ pātaśataṃ jayet
haṃsaścotpatitaḥ kāko balavānāśuvikramaḥ prapetatuḥ spardhayā ca tatastau haṃsavāyasau
pūrvameva tu vai kākaḥ sa taṃ tūrṇaṃ pracakrame
tuṇḍenābhyahanaccainaṃ kurvannāmāpasavyataḥ rorūyanniva cāpyenaṃ samāhvayati vai muhuḥ
bhīścainamāviśattīvraṃ kākaṃ karṇa vicetasam dvīpāndrumānvitānpaśyanviśramārthaṃ śramāturaḥ
gāmbhīryārdvi samudrasya na viśeṣaṃ kulādhama diśaśca nāmbhasāṃ karṇa samudrasthā vidurjanāḥ
atikramya ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaṃ taṃ samudaikṣata
taṃ prahasya ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaṃ mandagatiṃ tadā hīyamānamatho dṛṣṭvā haṃsaḥ prāha yathārthavat
jalaṃ nāma patitaṃ kāka yattvaṃ patasi sāmpratam
jalaṃ spṛśasi pakṣābhyāṃ tuṇḍena ca punaḥ punaḥ
prabrūhi katamo'yaṃ te pāto vartati vāyasa
ehyehi kāka śīghraṃ tvameṣa tvāṃ paripālaye
sa pakṣābhyāṃ spṛśannārtastuṇḍena ca jalaṃ tadā
kāko dṛḍhaṃ pariśrāntaḥ sahasā nipapāta ha
śatamekaṃ ca pātānāṃ patāmyahamiti sma ha
pratyuvāca tataḥ kākaḥ sīdamāna idaṃ vacaḥ
tamevaṃ karuṇaṃ dīnaṃ vilapantamacetasam kākakāketi vāśantaṃ nimajjantaṃ mahārṇave
sa haṃsaḥ pṛṣṭhamāropya kākaṃ karṇa vicetasam avismayaṃstadā karṇa punareva samānayat
utsṛjya tvabravīnmaivaṃ punaḥ kāryaṃ tvayeti ha sthāpya cainaṃ punardvīpe samāśvasya ca viklavam
gato yathepsitaṃ deśaṃ haṃso mana ivāśugaḥ
virāṭanagare pārthamekaṃ kiṃ nāvadhīstadā yatra vyastāḥ samastāśca nirjitāḥ stha kirīṭinā
sṛgālā iva siṃhena kva te vīryaṃ tadā gatam
punaḥ prabhāvaḥ pārthasya purāṇaḥ keśavasya ca
avadhyau vadatoḥ kṛṣṇau sannidhau ca mahīkṣitām
putraṃ ca vasudevasya kuntīputraṃ ca pāṇḍavam
yadā śaraśataiḥ pārtho darpaṃ tava vadhiṣyati
tau māvamaṃsthā maurkhyāttvaṃ svadyota iva rocanau
śaure rathaṃ vāhayato'rjunasya balaṃ mahāstrāṇi ca pāṇḍavasya
ahaṃ vijānāmi yathāvadadya parokṣabhūtaṃ tava tattu śalya
tau cāpyahaṃ śastrabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhau vyapetabhīryodhayiṣyāmi kṛṣṇau
santāpayatyabhyadhikaṃ hi rāmā-- cchāpo'dya māṃ brāhmaṇasattamācca
purā mahendrādrivare samudre tapasvinaṃ rāmamupetya śalya
astrārthinaṃ mā'dya śiṣyaṃ gṛhāṇe-- tyathā'bruvaṃ brāhmaṇacchadmanā ca
tajjāmadagnyena paraṃ mahāstraṃ samantrayuktaṃ vihitaṃ mamāsīt
astraṃ yadā tadviditaṃ mamāsī-- ttadā'bravīdbrāhmaṇo māṃ maharṣiḥ
āpadgatenāstramidaṃ prayojyaṃ tvayā raṇe gacchatā sādhayeti
tatrāpi me devarājena vighno hitārthinā phalgunasyaiva śalya
kṛto vibhedena mamorumetya praviśya kīṭasya tanuṃ virūpām
mamorumetya prabibheda kīṭaḥ supte gurau tatra śiro nidhāya
gurorbhayāccāpi na celivānahaṃ tato vibuddho dadṛśe sa vipraḥ
sa dhairyayuktaṃ prasamīkṣya māṃ vai na tvaṃ vipraḥ ko'si satyaṃ vadeti
tasmai tadā''tmānamahaṃ yathāva-- dākhyātavānsūta ityeva śalya
sūta tvayā hyāptamidaṃ tavāstraṃ na karmakāle pratibhāsyatīti
anyatra tu syāttava mṛtyukālā-- dabrāhmaṇe brahma na hi dhruvaṃ syāt
satyapratijñaṃ yudhi pāṇḍaveyaṃ dhanañjayaṃ mṛtyumukhaṃ nayiṣye
astraṃ tato'nyatpratipannamadya yena kṣepsye samare śatrupūgān
pratāpinaṃ balavantaṃ kṛtāstraṃ tamugradhanvānamamitaujasaṃ ca krūraṃ śūraṃ raudramamitrasāhaṃ dhanañjayaṃ saṃyuge'haṃ haniṣye
mahāravaṃ yaḥ kurute samudro veleva taṃ vārayāmyaprameyam
kuntīputraṃ pratiyotsyāmi yuddhe jyāṃ karṣatāmuttamaṃ martyaloke
surāsurānyudhi vai yo jayeta tenādya me paśya yudvaṃ sughoram
abhīrmānī pāṇḍavo yudvakāmo hyamānuṣairasyati māṃ mahāstraiḥ
tamonudaṃ megha ivātimātraṃ dhanañjayaṃ chādayiṣyāmi bāṇaiḥ
parjanyabhūtaḥ śaravarṣairyathā'gniṃ tathā pārthaṃ śamayiṣyāmi yuddhe
viśāradaṃ rathamārgeṣu śaktaṃ dhuryaṃ nityaṃ samareṣu pravīram
loke varaṃ sarvadhanurdharāṇāṃ dhanañjayaṃ saṃyuge'haṃ haniṣye
adyāhave yasya na tulyamanyaṃ manye manuṣyaṃ dhanurādadānam
sarvāmimāṃ yaḥ pṛthivīṃ saheta tathāpi tenādya raṇe sameṣye
ko jīvitaṃ rakṣamāṇo hi tena yuyutsate'strairmānuṣo māmṛte'nyaḥ
tasyāhamadyātirathasya kāyā-- cchiro hariṣyāmi śitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ
yotsyāmyenaṃ śalya dhanañjayaṃ vai mṛtyuṃ puraskṛtya raṇe jayaṃ vā
anyo hi na hyekarathena martyo yudhyeta yaḥ pāṇḍavamindrakalpam
tasyāhave pauruṣaṃ pāṇḍavasya brūyāṃ pṛṣṭaḥ samitau kṣatriyāṇām
kiṃ tvaṃ mūrkhaḥ prahasanmūḍhacetā ākhyāsi me pauruṣaṃ phalgunasya
atyapriyo yaḥ puruṣo niṣṭhuro hi kṣudraḥ kṣeptā kṣamiṇaścākṣamāvān
hanyāmahaṃ tvādṛśānāṃ śatāni kṣamāmyahaṃ kṣamiṇāṃ kāla eṣaḥ
mayyārjave jihmamatiryatastvaṃ mitradrohī sāptapadaṃ hi mitram
tathāpyahaṃ pāṇḍavavāsudevau yotsye raṇe madvidhasyaiva karma
na prākṛtaḥ sajjate vai kadāci-- dyaḥ pratyudīyātkṛṣṇadhanañjayau tau
duryodhane sarvamidaṃ mamāsti taccāpi sarvaṃ mama vetti rājā
śatruḥ śadeḥ śāsatervā śyatervā śṛṇātervā śvasateḥ sīdatervā
śrameḥ śuco bahuśaḥ sūdateśca prāyeṇa sarvaṃ tvayi tacca mahyam
tasmādahaṃ pāṇḍavavāsudevau yotsye yatnātkarma ca paśya me'dya
śalyādyāhaṃ saṅgataḥ pāṇḍavena mucyeyaṃ cejjīvamānaḥ kathañcit
astraṃ brāhmaṃ manasā sañjapanvai yadā'syate krodhitaḥ savyasācī
tadāpi me naiva mucyeta pārtho na cetpatedviṣame me'dya cakram
astrāṇi viddhvā samare gatāni brāhmāṇi divyānyatha mānuṣāṇi
iti śalya vijānīhi yathā nāhaṃ bibhemyuta
tasmānna me bhayaṃ pārthānnāpi caiva janārdanāt
saha yuddhaṃ hi me tābhyāṃ sāmparāye bhaviṣyati
śvabhre te patatāṃ cakramiti māṃ brāhmaṇo'bravīt
caranvai vijane śalya tato'nu vyājahāra saḥ
śvabhre te patitā cakraṃ yudhyamānasya śatruṇā
tata eva dhruvaṃ mṛtyuṃ sūta prāpsyasi saṃyuge
dadmi tairdvijamukhyo me prasādaṃ na cakāra saḥ
yatkiñcinmāmakaṃ vittaṃ tvadadhīnaṃ karomi tat iti māṃ yācamānaṃ vai brāhmaṇaḥ pratyavārayat
vyāhṛtaṃ yanmayā sūta tattathā na tadanyathā
mā tvaṃ brahmagatiṃ hiṃsyāḥ prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ tvayā
saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ gacchetkathaṃ vā manyate bhavān
ityevaṃ te mayā''khyātaṃ kṣiptena na suhṛttayā
yadi māṃ devatāḥ sarvā yodhayeyuḥ savāsavāḥ
tathāpi me bhayaṃ na syātkimu pārthātsakeśavāt
aśakto hi guṇānvaktuṃ valgase bahu durmate
na hi karṇaḥ samudbhūto bhayārthamiha madraka
mayi taccāhitaṃ śalya tena jīvasi me kṣaṇam
kṛtaśca samayaḥ pūrvaṃ kṣantavyaṃ vipriyaṃ tava
samayaḥ paripālyo me tena jīvasi sāmpratam
na te karṇasahasreṇa śakyā jetuṃ pare yudhi
tathā bruvantaṃ paruṣaṃ karṇo madrādhipaṃ tadā
govardhano nāma vaṭaḥ subhāṇḍaṃ nāma pattanam
pānaṃ guḍāsavaṃ pītvā gomāṃsaṃ laśunaiḥ saha
gāyantyatha ca nṛtyanti striyo mattā vivāsasaḥ
māmanusmaratī śete bāhlīkaṃ kuruvāsinam śatadruṃ nu kadā tīrtvā tāṃ ca ramyāmirāvatīm
gatvā svadeśaṃ drakṣyāmi sthūlajaṅghāḥ śubhāḥ striyaḥ
nagare śākale sphīte āhatya niśi dundubhim
gavyasya tṛptā māṃsasya pītvā gauḍaṃ surāsavam
dhānāśca ye na khādanti teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam
evaṃ gāyanti ye mattāḥ śīdhunā pīlukāvane
sabālavṛddhāḥ krandanti teṣāṃ dharmaḥ kathaṃ bhavet
iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te
āraṭṭā nāma bahlīkā eteṣvāryo hi no vaset
āvikaṃ cauṣṭrikaṃ caiva kṣīraṃ gārdabhameva ca
tadvikārāṃśca bāhlīkāḥ khādanti ca pibanti ca
iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te
āraṭṭā nāma bāhlīkā na teṣvāryo dvyahaṃ vaset
āraṭṭā nāma te deśā bāhlīkaṃ nāma tadvanam
iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te
na ca kena ca dharmeṇa virudhyante prajā imāḥ
tatra vai brāhmaṇo bhūtvā punarbhavati kṣatriyaḥ
iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te
dharmaṃ purāṇamupajīvanti santo madrānṛte pāñcanadāṃśca jihmān
evaṃ vidvāndharmakathāsu rājaṃ-- stūṣṇīṃbhūtaḥ śalya bhaveḥ sadā tvam
tvaṃ tasya goptā ca janasya rājā ṣaḍbhāgahartā śubhaduṣkṛtasya
iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te
malaṃ pṛthivyā bāhlīkāḥ strīṇāṃ kautūhalaṃ malam
mānuṣāṇāṃ malaṃ mlecchā mlecchānāṃ muṣṭikā malam
brāhayāḥ pañcālāḥ kauraveyāstu dharmyāḥ satyā matsyāḥ śūrasenāśca yājyāḥ
prācyā dāsā vṛṣalā dākṣiṇātyāḥ stenā bāhlīkāḥ saṅkāra vai surāṣṭrāḥ
āpāñcālāḥ kuravo naimiśāśca matsyāścaivāpyanujānanti dharmam athodīcyāścodayo bhāgadhāśca śiṣṭāndharmānupajīvanti vṛddhāḥ
udīcīṃ bhagavānsoma brahmā ca brāhmaṇaiḥ saha
dhruvaṃ sarvāṇi bhūtāni viṣṇuḥ pāti surottamaḥ
pārvatīyāśca viṣayā yathaiva girayastathā sarvajñā yavanā rājañśūrāścaiva viśeṣataḥ
pratirabdhāstu bāhlīkā na ca kecana madrakāḥ
evaṃ jñātvā joṣamāssva pratīpaṃ mā sma kruddhaḥ pāpabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha
pūrvaṃ hatvā tvāṃ saputraṃ balaiśca paścāddhaṃsye vāsudevārjunau ca
sarvatra brāhmaṇāḥ santi santi sarvatra kṣatriyāḥ
vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathā karṇa striyaḥ sādhvyaśca suvratāḥ
anyonyena ratāḥ kṣībā deśedeśe ca maithunam
ātmavācyaṃ na jānīte jānannapi ca muhyati
camūṃ tavemāṃ vipulāṃ samṛdvā-- masaṅkheyāmaśvanarākulāṃ ca
tathā praveṣṭā samare dhanañjayaḥ kakṣaṃ dahandīpta ivāśrayāśī
rathe stitau vīravarau vareṇyau siṃhaskandhau lohitapadmanetrau
draṣṭā bhavānadya vinā prayatnā-- ttathāhi me śakunā vedayanti
adya draṣṭā'si taṃ vīraṃ śvetāśvaṃ kṛṣṇasārathim
taṃ cedvantā'si rādheya tvaṃ no rājā bhaviṣyasi
paśya karṇa mahāghoraṃ bhayaṃ vai romaharṣaṇam
ānakānāṃ ca rādheya mṛdaṅgānāṃ ca hanyatām
śrūyate meghasaṅkāśo rathanemisvanastathā paśya kuntīsutaṃ vīraṃ bībhatsumaparājitam
karoti kadanaṃ caiṣa saṅgāme dviṣatāṃ balī
iti bruvāṇaṃ madreśaṃ karṇaḥ provāca manyumān
paśya saṃśaptakaiḥ kruddhaiḥ samantātsamabhidrutaḥ eṣa sūrya ivāmbhodaiśchannaḥ pārtho na dṛśyate
na hi śakyo'rjuno jetuṃ yudhi devāsurairapi
na hi śakyo yudhā jetumanyaṃ kuru manoratham
ete tiṣṭhanti kārṣṇeyāḥ pañca pañcācalā iva
yatra kṛṣṇārjunau vīrau yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
tatra dharmaśca satyaṃ ca yato dharmastato jayaḥ
yādṛśaṃ kṣatriyaiḥ śūraiḥ śūrāṇāṃ dīvyatāṃ yudhi
kṛtvā'nṛtāṃ pratijñāṃ vo nāsmi prāptā mahatphalam arjunaṃ bhīmasenaṃ ca yaśca māṃ pratiyotsyati
evamukte tataḥ sarvā harṣitā bhāratī camūḥ
sa sannipāto rathayūthapānāṃ mahāhave bhārata lobhanīye
tataḥ pravṛtte yudhi samprahāre bhūtāni sarvāṇi sadaivatāni
divyaiśca gandhaiḥ paramaiśca puṣpai-- ranyaiśca ratnairvividhairnarāgryāḥ
samīraṇastāṃstu niṣevya gandhā-- nniṣevate tānapi yodhamukhyān
tathā tu tasmiṃstumule pravṛtte duryodhanaḥ krodhamamṛṣyamāṇaḥ
tāni sarvāṇi sainyāni karṇa dṛṣṭvā viśāmpate
adya karṇaṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā phalguno vidraviṣyati
athavā kaṃ naraṃ loke na spṛśanti manorathāḥ
kathaṃ sañjaya rādheyaḥ pratyavyūhata pāṇḍavān dhṛṣṭadyumnamukhānsaṅkhye bhīmasenābhirakṣitān
ke ca prapakṣau pakṣau vā mama sainyasya sañjaya
ko hyarjunasya sānnidhye śakto jetuṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
teṣāṃ prapakṣāḥ kāmbhojāḥ śakāśca yavanaiḥ saha
aśokastu mahābāhuḥ sūryavaiśvānaraprabhaḥ mahādvipaskandhagataḥ piṅgākṣaḥ priyadarśanaḥ
duḥśāsano vṛtaḥ sainyaiḥ sthito vyūhasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
tanmadhye sa mahābāhuḥ svayaṃ duryodhano nṛpaḥ
aśvatthāmā kurūṇāṃ ca ye pravīrā mahārathāḥ nityamattāśca mātaṅgāḥ śūrairmlecchaiḥ samanvitāḥ
tataḥ senāmukhe karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yathā yathā bhavānāha tattathā na tadanyathā yattasya vihitaṃ kāryaṃ tatkariṣyāmi suvrata
te te ca tāṃstānahitānasmākaṃ ghntu māmakāḥ
saṃśaptakāḥ kathaṃ pārthaṃ kathaṃ karṇaṃ ca pāṇḍavāḥ
na hi tṛpyāmi vīrāṇāṃ śṛṇvāno yudhi vikramam
sa pārṣato babhau dhanvī kālo vigrahavāniva
ciccheda dviṣatāṃ pārthaḥ śirāṃsi ca sahasraśaḥ
nimagnaṃ taṃ rathaṃ matvā neduḥ saṃśaptakā mudā
dakṣiṇena ca paścācca kruddho rudraḥ paśūniva
samaṃ ca viṣamaṃ caiva samāyāntīṃ mahābhayām
ke ca pravīrāḥ pārthānāṃ yudhi karṇamavārayan
iti bhūtāni taṃ śabdaṃ menire te ca vivyathuḥ
cakrarakṣau tu karṇasya putrau māriṣa durjayau
pṛṣṭhagoptā tu karṇasya jyeṣṭhaḥ putro mahārathaḥ
ta enaṃ vividhaiḥ śastraiḥ śaradhārābhireva ca
nārācaiḥ saptabirviddhvā hṛdi bhīmaṃ nanāda ha
karṇaṃ ca tūrṇaṃ vivyādha trisaptatyā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ulūkaṃ ca patatriṃ ca cakāra virathāvubhau
ciccheda ca dhanuḥ śīghraṃ kṣurapreṇa mahārathaḥ
sa tu bāṇairdiśo rājannācchādya paravīrahā ājaghne sārathiṃ cāsya suṣeṇaṃ ca tatastribhiḥ
punarvivyādha saptatyā sārathiṃ ca tribhiḥ śitaiḥ
kopaṃ cakre mahārāja kruddho vegaṃ ca dāruṇam
jagrāheṣuvarānvīraḥ śīghraṃ vai daśa pañca ca
athāvasannaḥ svarathe muhūrtātpunarutthitaḥ sa raṇe yuyudhānena visūtāśvarathadhvajaḥ
duḥśāsanastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā virathaṃ vyāyudhaṃ kṛtam
nakulaṃ triṃśatā bāṇaiḥ śatānīkaṃ ca saptabhiḥ
śikhaṇḍī daśabhirvīro dharmarājaḥ śatena tu ete cānye ca rājendra pravīrā jayagṛdvinaḥ
na hyādadānaṃ dadṛśuḥ sandadhānaṃ ca sāyakān
vimuñcantaṃ ca saṃrambhāda paśyannaiva taṃ janāḥ
pratīcyāṃ diśi taṃ dṛṣṭvā prācyāṃ paśyāma lāghavāt
na ca paśyāma rājendra kva nu karṇo vyatiṣṭhata
te hanyamānāḥ karṇena palāyanta diśo daśa
tataste tu pare rājañchikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ rādheyātparirakṣanto rājānaṃ paryavārayan
tathaiva tāvakāḥ sarve karṇaṃ durvāraṇaṃ raṇe
yadbalaṃ yacca te vīryaṃ pradveṣo yastu pāṇḍuṣu
sa tu vegavatā mukto bāṇo vajrāśanisvanaḥ
viveśa sahasā karṇaṃ savye pārśve mahāratham
sa tu tena prahāreṇa pīḍitaḥ pramumoha vai
sa hemavikṛtaṃ cāpaṃ visphārya vijayaṃ mahat
jaghāna candradevaṃ ca daṇḍadhāraṃ ca saṃyuge
śalyaṃ navatyā vivyādha trisaptatyā ca sūtajam
na cacāla raṇe karṇo mahendro dānavairiva
sṛjjayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śataśo nihatā raṇe
tatasteṣāṃ mahārāja pāṇḍavānāṃ mahārathāḥ sṛñjayānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ
bibheda kavacaṃ rājño raṇe karṇaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
narditvā ca ciraṃ kālaṃ pāṇḍavo rabhaso raṇe
bhallaiściccheda rādheyaḥ sā tvaśīryata vai raṇe
udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ krudvaḥ sarpa iva śvasan
jaghāna sūtaṃ pārthasya pārṣṭhiṃ ca navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
iṣudhī cāsya ciccheda rathaṃ ca tilaśo'cchinat
śaineyaṃ tu tatuḥ kruddhaḥ karṇaḥ pañcabhirāyasaiḥ
dakṣiṇaṃ tu bhujaṃ tasya tribhiḥ karṇo'bhyavidhyata
hatāśvasūte tu rathe sthitaḥ sa śinipuṅgavaḥ
ardayitvā śaraistāṃstu siṃhaḥ kṣudramṛgāniva pīḍayandharmarājānaṃ śaraiḥ sannataparvamiḥ
kathaṃ nāma kule jātaḥ kṣatradharme vyavasthitaḥ
mā sma yudhyasva kaunteya mā sma vīrānsamāsadaḥ
mā caivaṃ vipriyaṃ brūhi mā ca tvaṃ bhaja saṃyugam
vaktavyā māriṣā'nye tu na vaktavyāstu mādṛśāḥ
svagṛhaṃ gaccha kaunteya yatra vā keśavārjunau
na hi tvāṃ samare rājanhanyātkarṇaḥ kathañcana
evamuktvā tataḥ pārthaṃ visṛjya ca mahābalaḥ
athāpayātaṃ rājānaṃ matvā'nvīyustamacyutam cedipāṇḍavapāñcālāḥ sātyakiśca mahārathaḥ
abhavattumulaḥ śabdo yodhānāṃ tatra bhārata rathahastyaśvapattīnāṃ dravatāṃ ninado mahān
vipatākadhvajacchatrā vyaśvasūtarathāyudhāḥ vyaṅgāṅgāvayavāḥ petuḥ kṣitau kṣīṇāḥ kṣitīśvarāḥ
sārohāsturagāḥ peturhatavīrāḥ sahasraśaḥ vipravidvāyudhāṅgāśca dviradā rathibhirhatāḥ
yathā bhuvi tathā vyomni niḥsvanaṃ śuśruvurjanāḥ
sainyena rajasā vṛttate sve svāñjaghnuḥ pare parān
tasyā nadyāḥ paraṃ pāraṃ vrajanti vijayaiṣiṇaḥ
nāgena ca plavanto vai nimajjyonmajjya cāpare
rathānaśvānnārānnāgānāyudhābharaṇāni ca varmāṇi cāpyapaśyāma patitāni sahasraśaḥ
khaṃ dyāṃ bhūmiṃ diśaścaiva prāyaḥ paśyāma lohitāḥ
lohitasya tu gandhena spardena ca rasena ca rūpeṇa cātiraktatena śabdena ca visarpatā
hantāsmyadya raṇe karṇaṃ sa vā māṃ nihaniṣyati
īdṛśaṃ nāsya rūpaṃ me dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ kadācana
abhimanyau hate karṇa rākṣase ca ghaṭotkace
bhīmasenaṃ prati vibho tatsatyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
ajñātavāsaṃ vasatā virāṭanagare tadā draupadyāḥ priyakāmena kevalaṃ bāhusaṃśrayāt
arjunaṃ samare hanyāṃ māṃ vā hanyādvanañjayaḥ
nihate bhīmasene vā yadi vā virathīkṛte abhiyāsyati māṃ pārthastanme sādhu bhaviṣyati
sa vai sampatsyate karṇa satyametadbravīmi te
hantā'hamenaṃ saṃrabdhaṃ māṃ vā hantā vṛkodaraḥ
samāpatantaṃ samprekṣya karṇo vaikartano vṛṣā ājaghāna susaṅkruddho nārācena stanāntare
tasya karṇo dhanurmadhye dvidhā ciccheda patribhiḥ
so'nyatkārmukamādāya sūtataputraṃ vṛkodaraḥ rājanmarmasu marmajño vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
sa bhīmasenābhihataḥ sūtaputraḥ kurūdvaha niṣasāda rathopasthe visaṃjñaḥ pṛtanāpatiḥ
tāṃ tathā kuru bhadraṃ te pratijñāṃ savyasācinaḥ
tataḥ kopābhibhūtena śeṣaṃ na gaṇitaṃ mayā patite cāpi rādheye na me manyuḥ śamaṃ gataḥ)
anena sunṛśaṃsena samaveteṣu rājasu asmākaṃ śṛṇvatāṃ śalya yāni vākyāni mātula
nūnaṃ caitatpratijñātaṃ dūrasthasyāpi pārthiva chedanaṃ cāsya jihvāyāstadaivākāṅkṣitaṃ mayā
asminvinaṣṭe naṣṭāḥ smaḥ sarva eva sakeśavāḥ
adya caiva nṛśaṃsātmā pāpaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ varaḥ
karṇo hyeko raṇe hantā pāṇḍavānsṛñjayaiḥ saha
parājitaṃ tu rādheyaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhīmena saṃyuge
śīghraṃ gacchata bhadraṃ vo rādheyaṃ parirakṣata
te tu rājñā samādiṣṭā bhīmasenaṃ jighāṃsavaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ śūraṃ bhrātaraḥ sarvatastadā
tatastu tvarito bhīmaḥ krāthaṃ ninye yamakṣayam
dṛṣṭvā mama mahārāja tau sametau mahārathau
karṇaṃ raṇe mahārāja putrāṇāṃ tava paśyatām
tataḥ karṇo bhṛśaṃ kruddho bhīmaṃ navabhirāyasaiḥ
tataḥ karṇo mahārāja āśīviṣa iva śvasan
tataḥ karṇo bhṛśaṃ kruddho dṛḍhamādāya kārmukam bhīmaṃ vivyādha daśabhiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ
kārmukaṃ cāsya ciccheda bhallena niśitena ca
tato bhīmo mahābāhurhemapaṭṭavibhūṣitam parighaṃ ghoramādāya mṛtatyudaṇḍamivāparam
tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmasenaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya bhittvā tanutrāṇaṃ bhittvā kāyaṃ ca sāyakaḥ
dantaveṣṭeṣu netreṣu kumbheṣu ca kaṭeṣu ca
arditā bhīmasenena vinadanto bhṛśāturāḥ tataste prādravanbhītāḥ prahatāśca punaḥpunaḥ
vihāya samare karṇaṃ dudruvurvai diśo daśa
tataḥ sa pradrutaṃ sainyaṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇo mahārathaḥ
prājñāsiṣma vayaṃ te vā śarairmuktaiḥ sahasraśaḥ
tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ madhyaṃ prāpte divākare
te tu sene samāsādya vegavatyau parasparam
yasya yaddhi raṇe vyaṅgaṃ pitṛto mātṛto'pi vā
karmataḥ śīlato vā'pi sa tacchrāvayate yudhi
gadānāṃ parighāṇāṃ ca śaktīnāṃ ca parasparam
pattayaḥ pattisaṅghāṃśca hayasaṅghāṃśca pattayaḥ pattayo rathamātaṅgānrathā hastyaśvameva ca
nāgāśca samare tryaṅgaṃ mamṛduḥ śīghragā nṛpa
vadhyatāṃ tatra śūrāṇāṃ krośatāṃ ca parasparam
śaśaśoṇitadigdheva śātakumbhamayīva ca bhūrbabhau bharataśreṣṭha śāntārcirbhirivānalaiḥ
niṣkāṇāṃ hemasūtrāṇāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ ca dhanvinām carmaṇāṃ sapatākānāṃ saṅghāstatrāpatanbhuvi
agamyakalpā pṛthivī sarvato bhṛśakardamā gajā gajānsamāsādya viṣāṇairārdayannṛpa
viṣāṇāgrahatāstatra bhrājante dviradottamāḥ rudhireṇāvasiktāṅgā gairikaprasravā iva prāvṛṭkāle mahārāja meghā iva savidyutaḥ
tathā rejū raṇe nāgā rudhireṇa samāplutāḥ
vegāṃścānye rame cakruḥ pañcāsyā iva pannagāḥ
vartamāne tathā ghore saṅkule sarvato diśam
naiva sve na pare rājanvyajñāyanta tamovṛtāḥ
pītvā ca śoṇitaṃ tatra vasāṃ bhuktvā ca bhārata
pitṛnāmāni ca raṇe gotranāmāni vā vibho
sa tasya śaravarṣāṇi vavarṣa rathināṃ varaḥ
suśarmā tu tataḥ pārthaṃ viddhvā daśabhirāśugaiḥ
kapestu ninadaṃ śrutvā santrastā tava vāhinī
tataḥ sā śuśubhe senā niśceṣṭā'vasthitā nṛpa
sañchādya samare pārthaṃ parivavruḥ samantataḥ te hayānrathacakre tu ratheṣāṃ cāpi māriṣa
nigṛhya tu rathaṃ tasya yodhāste tu sahasraśaḥ
pādabandhaṃ sa teṣāṃ vai cakre tena mahāstravit
yānuddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ pādabandhaṃ cakāra ha
tataḥ suśarmā rājendra gṛhītāṃ vīkṣya vāhinīm
vipramuktāḥ svakā yodhāḥ phalgunasya rathaṃ prati
tāṃ mahāstramayīṃ vṛṣṭiṃ śaraiḥ sañchidya bhārata
tata uccukruśuḥ sarve hataḥ pārtha iti bruvan
pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāṃ śvetāśvaḥ kṛṣṇasārathiḥ so'tividdho maheṣvāsaḥ śarairāśīvipopamaiḥ
ayutaṃ tatra yodhānāṃ hatvā pāṇḍusuto raṇe
tatra yuddhaṃ mahaccāsīttāvakānāṃ viśāmpate śūreṇa balinā sārdhaṃ pāṇḍavena kirīṭinā
ulūkaḥ saubalaścaiva rājā ca saha sodaraiḥ
śikhaṇḍī ca tataḥ kruddho gautamaṃ tvarito yayau
śikhaṇḍinaṃ raṇe kruddho vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ
tataḥ kṛpaḥ śaraistīkṣṇaiḥ so'tividdho mahārathaḥ tataḥ suniśitaistīkṣṇaiḥ kṣuraprairhemabhūṣitaiḥ
khaṅgaṃ carma tathā gṛhya satvaraṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yayau
dṛṣṭvā viṣaktaṃ taṃ caiva brāhmaṇaṃ ca nivāritam
viddhvā vivyādha saptatyā punaścainaṃ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ
gautamastu tataḥ kruddho dhanurgṛhya navaṃ dṛḍham
gautamaṃ samare tyaktvā dudruvuste diśo daśa
dṛṣṭvā tu vāritāṃ yuddhe śastravṛṣṭiṃ durāsadām
gṛhītvā carma khaṅgaṃ ca rathaṃ tasyāvapupluve
sa taṃ na mamṛṣe yudve talaśabdaṃ samīritam
na sma sampatate bhūtaṃ drauṇerdṛṣṭvā parākramam
tathetarāṇi sainyāni na sma cakruḥ parākramam
yudhiṣṭhirastrisaptatyā prativindhyaśca saptabhiḥ śrutakarmā tribhirvāṇaiḥ śrutakīrtiśca saptabhiḥ
anye ca vahavaḥ śūrā vivyadhustaṃ samantataḥ
sa tu kruddhastato rājannāśīvipa iva śvasan
śrutakīrtiṃ ca navabhiḥ sutasomaṃ ca pañcabhiḥ
śatānīkaṃ ca navabhirdharmaputraṃ ca pañcabhiḥ tathetarāṃstataḥ śūrāndvābhyāṃ dvābhyāmatāḍayat
sātyakistu tataḥ kruddho drauṇeḥ praharato raṇe
chinnadhanvā tato drauṇiḥ śaktyā śaktimatāṃ varaḥ
jānāmi tvāṃ yudhi śreṣṭha vīryavantaṃ balānvitam
tatastvāṃ balavantaṃ ca kṛtavidyaṃ ca vidmahe
na hi vai pārpataṃ dṛṣṭvā samare śatrusūdanam
bhavettava balaṃ kiñcidbravīmi tvāṃ na tu dvijam
naiva nāma tava prītirnaiva nāma kṛtajñatā
brāhmaṇena tapaḥ kāryaṃ śamaśca damaeva ca
yukta tattvaṃ ca sañcintya nottaraṃ kiñcidabravīt
pārtho'payātaḥ śīghraṃ vai pragṛhya mahatīṃ camūm
prayayau tāvakaṃ sainyaṃ yuktaḥ krurāya karmaṇe
tato duryodhanaḥ kruddo nakulaṃ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ
nakulastu tataḥ kruddhastava putraṃ ca saptabhiḥ
tatastau rabhasau yuddhe bhrātarau bhrātaraṃ yudhi
tataḥ kruddho mahārāja tava putro mahārathaḥ
te tu bāṇā mahārāja svarṇapuṅkhāḥ śilāśitāḥ
parākramaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā tava sūnormahārathāḥ
pārṣataḥ prayayau tatra yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ
viddhvā nanāda pāñcālyaṃ ṣaṣṭyā pañcabhireva ca
te varma hemavikṛtaṃ bhittvā rājñaḥ śilīmukhāḥ
rathaṃ sopaskaraṃ chatraṃ śaktiṃ khaṅgaṃ gadāṃ dhvajam
vyāghraketuḥ suśarmā ca śukraścitrāyudhaḥ kratuḥ durjayo rocamānaśca siṃhasenastathā'ṣṭamaḥ
sṛjantaḥ sāyakāṃstūrṇaṃ karṇamāhavaśobhinam yatamānāṃstu tāñśūrānmanujendraḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
viṣṇuṃ ca viṣṇuvarmāṇaṃ devāpiṃ bhadrameva ca
daṇḍadhāraṃ ca samare citraṃ ciṃtrāyudhaṃ harim
naivaṃ bhāṣmo na ca droṇo nānye yudhi ca tāvakāḥ
cakruḥ sma tādṛśaṃ karma yādṛśaṃ kṛtavānraṇe
sūtaputro'tha nāgeṣu hayeṣu ca ratheṣu ca
siṃhaṃ sma hi yathā prāpya na jīvanti mṛgāḥ kvacit
tathā karṇamanuprāptā na jīvanti sma sṛñjayāḥ
karṇāgriṃ samare prāpya dagdhā bhārata sṛñjayaḥ
vartamāne tathā rodre saṅgrāme'dbhutadarśane nihatya pṛtanāmadhyaṃ saṃśaptakagaṇānbahūn
hastikakṣyo hyasau kṛṣṇa ketuḥ karṇasya dhīmataḥ
na ca karṇaṃ raṇe śaktā jetumete mahārathāḥ
tatra yāhi yataḥ karṇo drāvayatyeṣa no balam trigartānvarjayanyāhi sūtaputraṃ mahāratham
etanme rocate kṛṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate
kruddhau tau tu naravyāghro yogavantau babhūvatuḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yudhi vikrāntaṃ senāyāṃ tava bhārata
mahī viyaddiśaḥ sarvāḥ samudrā girayo'pi vā
sudakṣiṇādavarajaṃ kāmbhojā dadṛśurhatam prāṃśuṃ kamalapatrākṣamatyarthaṃ priyadarśanam
pūrṇacandrābhavakrāṇi svakṣibhrūdaśanāni ca śirāṃsyunmathya vīrāṇāṃ śitairbhallairdhanañjayaḥ
taṃ pravīrāḥ susaṃrabdhā nardamānā ivarṣabhāḥ vāsitārthamiva kruddhamabhidrutya mahotkaṭāḥ
tataḥ sarvātmanā tvadya yudvātithyaṃ prayaccha me
saṃśaptakāśca me vadhyā drauṇirāhvayate ca mām
yadatrānantaraṃ prāptaṃ śaṃsa me tadvi mādhava
sūkṣmo vivādo viprāṇāṃ sūkṣmau kṣāstrau jayājayau
sa tadā kṣiprakārī ca dṛḍhahastaśca pāṇḍavaḥ
vikramaṃ ca hṛtaṃ mene ātmanastena saṃyuge
hīyamāne ca kaunteye kṛṣṇaṃ roṣaḥ samāviśat
drauṇiṃ dadarśa saṅgrāme phalgunaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ
kaccitte gāṇḍivaṃ haste muṣṭirvā na vyaśīryata
udīryamāṇaṃ hi raṇe paśyāmi drauṇimāhave guruputra iti hyenaṃ mānayanpāṇḍavarṣabha
upekṣāṃ mā kṛthāḥ pārtha nāyaṃ kāla upekṣitum
paśya mādhava daurātmyaṃ guruputrasya māṃ prati vadhaṃ prāptau manyate nau prāveśya śavareśmani
eṣosmi hanmi saṅkalpaṃ śikṣayā ca balena ca
dhanuśchatraṃ patākāṃ ca rathaśaktiṃ gadāṃ varām
ye ye dadṛśire tatra yadyadrūpāstadā janāḥ
sa keśavaṃ cārjunaṃ cātitejā vivyādha marmasvatiraudrakarmā
carmāṇi varmāṇi manoramāṇi prasahya caiṣāṃ sa śirāṃsi caiva
sriccheda pārtho dviṣatāṃ sumuktai-- rbāṇaiḥ sthitānāmaparāṅmukhānām
teṣāṃ dvipānāṃ nicakarta pārtho varmāṇi carmāṇi karānniyantṝn
dhvajāḥ patākāśca tataḥ prapetu-- rvajrāhatānīva gireḥ śirāṃsi
teṣu prabhagneṣu gurostanūjaṃ bāṇaiḥ kirīṭi navasūryavarṇaiḥ
pracchādayitvā divi candrasūryau nanāda so'mbhoda ivātapānte
vāṇāndhakāraṃ sahasaiva kṛttvā vivyādha pārtho varahemapuṅkhaiḥ
teṣāṃ ca pañcārjunamabhyavidhya-- npañcācyutaṃ nirbibhuduḥ supuṅkhāḥ
samāptavidyena tathā'bhibhūtau hatau raṇe tāviti menire'nye
athārjunaṃ prāha daśārhanāthaḥ pramādyase kiṃ jahi yodhametam
bhujau varau candanasāradigdhau vakṣaḥ śiro'thāpratimau tathorū
gāṇḍīvamuktaiḥ kupitāhikalpai-- drauṇiṃ śaraiḥ saṃyati nirbibheda
chittvā tu raśmīṃsturagānavidhya-- tte taṃ raṇādūhuratīva dūram
āvṛtya naiva vyaṣahatsa yoddhuṃ pārthena sārdhaṃ matimānvimṛśya
jānañjayaṃ niyataṃ vṛṣṇivīre dhanañjaye cāṅgirasāṃ variṣṭhaḥ
viveśa karṇasya balaṃ tarasvī bhagnotsāhaḥ kṣīṇavāṇāstrayogaḥ
sa māgadhānāṃ pravaro mahābalo'-- śubhagraho yodhagaṇaiḥ samanvitaḥ
sapatnasenāṃ pramamātha dāruṇo bhīmaṃ samagrāṃ balavāniva graham
dvipāṃśca bāṇairnijaghāna vīryavā-- nsamantato ghnanniva kālacakravat
narāṃstu kāṃsyāyasavarmabhūṣaṇā-- nnipātya sāśvānapi pattibhiḥ saha
tato'rjunaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ śarottamai-- rjanārdanaṃ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ samārpayat
sa daṇḍadhārasturagāṃstribhistribhi--- stato nanāda prajahāsa cāsakṛt
athāsya bāhū dvipahastasannibhau śiraśca pūrṇendunibhānanaṃ tribhiḥ
kṣuraiḥ praciccheda sahaiva pāṇḍava-- stato dvipaṃ bāṇaśataiḥ samarpayat
bhṛśaṃ cakāśe niśi parvato yathā dāvāgninā prajvalitauṣadhidrumaḥ
hate raṇe bhrātari daṇḍa āvraja-- jjighāṃsurindrāvarajaṃ dhanañjayam
samarpayitvā vinanāda cārdayaṃ-- stato'sya bāhū nicakarta pāṇḍavaḥ
kṣuraprakṛttau vipulau satomarau śubhāṅgadau candanarūṣitau bhujau
athā'rdhacandreṇa hataṃ kirīṭinā papāta daṇḍasya śiraḥ kṣitiṃ dvipāt
sa śoṇitārdro nipatanvireje divākaro'stādiva paścimāṃ diśam
bibheda pārthaḥ sa papāta nādayan himādrikūṭaṃ kuliśāhataṃ yathā
tato'paraṃ tatpratimā gajottamā jigīṣavaḥ saṃyati savyasācinā
tathā kṛtāste'pi yathaiva tau dvipau tataḥ prabhagnaṃ sumahadriporbalam
gajā rathāśvāḥ puruṣāśca saṅghaśaḥ parasparaghnāḥ paripeturāhave
parasparaṃ praskhalitāḥ samāhatā bhṛśaṃ ca tattadbahubhāṣiṇo hatāḥ
athārjunaṃ sve parivārya sainikāḥ purandaraṃ devagaṇā ivābruvan
abhaiṣma yasmānmaraṇādiva prajāḥ sa vīra diṣṭyā nihatastvayā ripuḥ
itīva bhūyaśca suhṛdbhirīḍitā niśamya vācaḥ sumanāstadā'rjunaḥ
yathā'nurūpaṃ pratipūjya taṃ janaṃ jagāma saṃśaptakasaṅghahā punaḥ
taṃ pravīrāstvadīyānāṃ nardamānā'bhidudruvuḥ vāsitārthe yuyutsanto vṛṣabhā vṛṣabhaṃ yathā
vimuñcanvā śarāñśīghraṃ dṛśyante vai narā hatāḥ
anukarṣānupāsaṅgānpatākā vividhāndhvajān yodhānāṃ ca mahāśaṅkhānpāṇḍurāṃśca prakīrṇakān
sajīvāṃśca narānpaśya kūjamānānsamantataḥ upāsyamānāṃśca bahūnnyastaśastraiśca bhūpate
na tvasya karma saṅgrāme tvayā sañjaya kīrtitam
śikṣāṃ prabhāvaṃ vīryaṃ ca pramāṇaṃ darpameva ca
na mene cātmanā tulyaṃ kañcideva nareśvaram
mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa divaṃ bhūmiṃ ca nādayan
ye ye dadṛśire rūpaṃ visaṃjñāḥ prāyaśo'bhavan
parjanya iva gharmānte vṛṣṭyā sādridrumāṃ mahim
hateśvaro dantivaraḥ sukalpita-- satvarābhisṛṣṭaḥ pratiśabdago balī
sasarja śīghraṃ paripīḍayangajaṃ guroḥ sutāya draviḍeśvaro nadan
tataḥ prajajvāla pareṇa manyunā pādāhato nāgapatiryathā tathā
dvipasya pādāgrakarānsa pañcabhi-- rnṛpasya bāhū ca śiro'tha ca tribhiḥ
bhujau dharāyāṃ patitau nṛpasya tau viceṣṭatustārkṣyahatāvivoragau
kṣitāvapi bhrājati tatsakuṇḍalaṃ viśākhayormadhyagataḥ śaśī yathā
[sa tu dvipaḥ pañcabhiruttameṣubhiḥ kṛtaḥ ṣaḍaṃśaścaturo nṛpastribhiḥ
kṛto daśāṃśaḥ kuśalena yudhyatā yathā havistaddaśa daivataṃ tathā
svadhāmivāpya jvalanaḥ pitṛpriya-- stataḥ praśāntaḥ salilapravāhataḥ]
samāptavidyaṃ tu guroḥ sutaṃ nṛpaḥ samāptakarmāṇamupetya te sutaḥ
asau bhīmo maheṣvāsaḥ prativṛtto raṇaṃ prati
asau gacchati kaunteya drauṇiḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
aśvatthāmnā hatāḥ saṅkhye sarve kaunteya sṛñjayāḥ
etacchrutvā ca dṛṣṭvā ca bhrātṛṇāṃ vyasanaṃ mahat
samāsādya tu te karṇaṃ vyaśīryanta mahārathāḥ
vijayaṃ tu dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ vidhṛnvāno mahārathaḥ
te hemavikṛtaṃ varma bhittvā tasya mahātmanaḥ
tadapāsya dhanuśchinnaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ pratāpavān tato'nyaddhanurādāya sāravadbhārasādhanam
āsīddhoraṃ ca citraṃ ca prekṣaṇīyaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
sa dṛṣṭvā samare yāntamabhītaṃ ca mahāratham
rathaṃ rathena sampīḍya pārṣatasya tu brāhmaṇaḥ
tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti brahmaghna na me jīvanvimokṣyase ityuktvā subhṛśaṃ vīraḥ śīghrakṛnniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
yathā hi samare drauṇiḥ pārṣataṃ dṛśyata māriṣa
sa jñātvā pituratyantarairiṇaṃ tu mahāhave ātmānaṃ samare jñātvā'śastravadhyaṃ mahābalaḥ
tāvanyonyaṃ tu dṛṣṭvaiva saṃrambhaṃ jagmatuḥ param
pāpaṃ hi yattvayā karma kṛtaṃ tātaṃ ghnatā raṇe
adya tvaṃ prāpsyase tadvai yathā hyakuśalastathā arakṣyamāṇaḥ pārthena yadi tiṣṭhasi saṃyuge
āśiṣaṃ tāṃ pravaktavyāṃ māmako dāsyate tava
yenaiva te piturdattā yatamānasya saṃyuge eṣa te prativākyaṃ vai asirdāsyati māmakaḥ
tvāmidānīṃ kathaṃ yuddhe na haniṣyāmi kilbiṣam
naivāntarikṣaṃ na diśo nāpi yodhāḥ sahasraśaḥ dṛśyante vai mahārāja śaraiśchannāḥ samantataḥ
sa pārṣatasya rājendra dhanuḥ śaktiṃ gadāṃ dhvajam
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ tu virathaṃ hatāśvarathasārathim śastraiśca bahudhā viddhamastraiśca śakalīkṛtam
tasyāntamiṣubhī rājanyadā drauṇirna gacchati atha tyaktvā rathaṃ vīraḥ pārṣataṃ tvarito'nvagāt
paśya drauṇiṃ pārṣatasya yatamānaṃ vadhaṃ prati
yatnaṃ karoti vipulaṃ hanyāccainaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
śarāṃścikṣepa vai pārtho drauṇiṃ prati mahārathaḥ
pragṛhya ca dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṃ pārthaṃ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ
sa brāhmaṇasyāṃsadeśe nipapāta mahādyuteḥ sa vihvalo mahārāja śaravegena saṃyuge
taṃ tu matvā hataṃ vīraṃ sārathiḥ śatrukarśanam
mokṣitaṃ pārṣataṃ dṛṣṭvā droṇaputraṃ ca pīḍitam
tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipadvijayaṃ dhanuḥ dṛṣṭvārjunaṃ raṇe kruddhaḥ prekṣate ca muhurmuhuḥ
śrutvā gajā bhṛśaṃ tresuḥ peturmamluśca sainikāḥ
teṣāṃ ninadatāṃ caiva śastravarṣaṃ ca muñcatām
pañca pāñcālavīrāṇāṃ rathāndaśa ca pañca ca
varma vā carma vā'śritya nipātamapi dehinaḥ
dhvajāḥ śirāṃsi cchinnāḥ peturmahītale vadhyatāṃ dāruṇāḥ śabdāḥ patatāṃ stanatāmapi
mṛditānīva padmāni pramlānā iva ca srajaḥ
sa papāta hato mlecchastenaiva saha dantinā
nāgānāṃ prāsphuṭankumbhā marmāṇi ca nakhāni ca
tāṃ te senāṃ samāloḍya pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ
tato rajasi saṃśānte prakāśaḥ sarvato'bhavat etasminnantare pārthaṃ kṛṣṇo vacanamabravīt
karṇena ca kṛto rājā vimukho'dya tu dṛśyate
balavām̐llughuhastaśca kṛtī yuddhaviśāradaḥ rādheyaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭhaṃ śaktaḥ pīḍayituṃ raṇe
anyairapi ca pārthasya kṛtaṃ karma mahārathaiḥ
brāhmo bale sthito hyeṣa na kṣātre hi bale vibhuḥ
na jīvati mahārājo manye pārtha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
āturo me mato rājā avipahyaśca bhārata
na keturdṛśyate rājñaḥ karṇasya pihitaḥ śaraiḥ
pāñcālānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ cedīnāṃ caiva bhārata
paśya paśya yathā pārtha gacchantyete mahārathāḥ
hastikakṣyāṃ raṇe paśya carantīṃ tatratatra ha
śatruṃ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṅkhaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
ete nardanti kauravyā dṛṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam
abhidravata bhadraṃ vo drutaṃ dravata kauravāḥ
tathā kuruta saṃyattā vayaṃ yāsyāma pṛṣṭhataḥ
eṣa tvāṃ prekṣate karṇaḥ sakaṭākṣaṃ dhanañjaya
asau nivṛtto rādheyo dṛṣṭvā te vānaradhvajam prārthayansamaraṃ pārtha tvayā saha parantapa
tvāṃ ca pārthābhisaṃrabdhaṃ karṇaṃ prati mahāratham
atmānaṃ ca kṛtārthaṃ ca samīkṣya bharatarṣabha
tvayā yaśaśca rājyaṃ ca sukhaṃ cottamamicchatā
paśyantu kauravāḥ sarve tava pārtha parākramam
tvāṃ ca dṛṣṭvātisaṃrabdhaṃ karṇaṃ ca bharatarṣam
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā pratyehi rathayūthapam
vṛtaḥ sṛñjaya sainyena śaineyena ca bhaptata
vadhyanta ete samare kauravā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
ete nardinti pāñcālā dhmāpayanti ca vārijān
abhidravanti ca raṇe mṛdrantaḥ sāyakaiḥ parān
paśya svargasya māhātmyaṃ pāñcālā hi parākramāt
rathanāgahayā vīrā yaśasyāḥ sarva eva ca]
tasya caiva bhujau chinnau bhīmasenena garjataḥ
śaktitomarasaṅghatairvinighnanto vṛkodaram saptasapta ca nāgasthā vaijayantyaśca sadhvajāḥ
na śaknuvanti vai pārthaṃ pārthivāḥ samudīkṣitum
śaraiḥ santrāsitāḥ sahkhye na labhante sukhaṃ kvacit
rādheyo bahubhiḥ sārdhamasau gacchati vegitaḥ vardhayitvā tu bhīruṃ taṃ pārśvato hyānayaddhanuḥ
etacchrutvā mahābāhurvāsudevāddhanañjayaḥ bhīmasenena tatkarma kṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā suduṣkaram
nivṛtte bhīmasene ca pāṇḍave ca yudhiṣṭhire
avaśeṣaṃ na paśyāmi mama sainyeṣu sañjaya
aho bata daśāṃ prāpto na hi śakṣyāmi jīvitum
kathaṃ jīvāmi nihatāñśrutvā ca mama sainikān
dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ mahābāhuṃ tava putraḥ pratāpavān
tiṣṭhatiṣṭha pṛthāputra paśya me'dya parākramam adya tvāṃ preṣāyaṣyāmi yamasya sadanaṃ prāte
ityuktvā prayayau karṇo yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ
śikhaṇḍī tu yayau karṇaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ sutaṃ tava
arjunaṃ ca raṇe yatto droṇaputro mahārathaḥ
karṇaṃ vivyādha samare navatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
tasya karṇo hayānhatvā sārathiṃ ca śaraiḥ
tasya duḥśāsano bāhuṃ savyaṃ vivyādha māriṣa
tataḥ sa pārṣataḥ kruddho dhanuściccheda māriṣa
tava putrasya te dṛṣṭvā vikramaṃ sumahātmanaḥ
tataḥ pravavṛte yudvaṃ tāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha
nakulaṃ tu tataḥ śūro vṛṣaseno hasanniva
śatruṃ vivyādha viṃśatyā sūtaṃ caivāsya saptabhiḥ
sa dṛṣṭvā pradrutāṃ senāṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya sūtajaḥ
nivṛtte tu tataḥ sainye nakulaḥ kauravānyayau
sātyakiḥ śakuniṃ viddhvā viṃśatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
vidārya kavacaṃ bhūyo dhvajaṃ ciccheda kāñcanam
cakre lokeśvaraṃ tatra tenātuṣyanta vai janāḥ
yudhāmanyuḥ kṛpaṃ viddhvā dhanurasyāśu cicchade athānyaddhanurādāya kṛpaḥ śastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
tādṛśaṃ na mayā yuddhaṃ dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ viśāmpate
bhīmasenasya tatkarma rājannekasya dhīmataḥ nighnataḥ sarvabhūtāni rudrasyeva ca nirbabhau ]
duryodhanaṃ ca viṃśatyā nārācānāṃ kṛtī balī
dṛṣṭvā tava sutaṃ tatra gāḍhaviddhaṃ sutejanaiḥ
vadhyamāne tadā sainye dharmaputreṇa māriṣa sāyakairvividhaistīkṣṇaiḥ kaṅkapatraiḥ śilāśitaiḥ
yatra yatra sa dharmātmā duṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ vyasarjayat
yudhiṣṭhiraścāpi sa taṃ svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ]
sa pīḍito bhṛśaṃ tena dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
tathaiva nakulasyāpi hayānhatvā mahārathaḥ tato'pareṇa bhallena bhṛśaṃ tīkṣṇena bhārata
tataḥ śalyaḥ prahasyedaṃ karṇaṃ punaruvāca ha
yadarthaṃ dhārtarāṣṭreṇa satataṃ mānito bhavān taṃ pārtha jahi rādheya kiṃ te hatvā yudhiṣṭhiram
hate yasmindhruvaṃ pārthaḥ sarvāñjeṣyati no rathān
tasminhi dhārtarāṣṭrasya nihate tu dhruvo jayaḥ dhvajo'sau dṛśyate tasya rocamānoṃ'śumāniva
sāro hyeṣa mahābāho kiṃ te hatvā yudhiṣṭhiram
sarvāṃ grasati naḥ senāṃ karṇa paśyainamāhave
uttaraṃ cāsya vai śūraścakraṃ rakṣati sāṃtyakiḥ
bhīmasenaśca vai rājñā dhārtarāṣṭreṇa yudhyate yathā na hanyāttaṃ bhīmaḥ sarveṣāṃ no'dya paśyatām
kuru rādheya vai rājā yathā mucyeta tattathā
kiṃ nu mādrīsutau hatvā rājānaṃ vā yudhiṣṭhiram
gate karṇe tu kaunteyaḥ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
gacchanta tvaritau vīrau yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ
tataste pāṇḍavāḥ sarve samābhāṣya parasparam anīkaṃ bhīmasenasya pāṇḍavāvabhyagacchatām
jīmūta iva nardaṃstu yudhyate sa vṛkodaraḥ
avacchannau tataḥ kṛṣṇau dṛṣṭvā tatra mahārathāḥ
tato'rjuno rathānsarvānhatvā tasya padānugān cakāra samare bhūmiṃ śoṇitaughapariplutām
tayostu vyākule yuddhe drauṇeḥ pārthasya dāruṇe
pārthena samare rājankṛto ghoro janakṣayaḥ nihatā rathinaḥ petuḥ pārthacāpacyutaiḥ śaraiḥ ]
sañchādya samare drauṇiṃ cicchedāsya ca kārmukam
sa papāta tadā bhūmau nikṛttaḥ pārthasāyakaiḥ
vigāhya tāṃ pāṇḍavabāṇavṛṣṭiṃ śaraiḥ paraṃ nāma tataḥ prakāśya
śatena kṛṣṇaṃ sahasābhyaviddhyā-- ttribhiḥ śatairarjunaṃ kṣudrakāṇām
tato'rjunaḥ sāyakānāṃ śatena guroḥ sutaṃ marmasu nirbibheda
aśvāṃśca sūtaṃ ca tathā dhanurjyā-- mavākiratpaśyatāṃ tāvakānām
sa viddhvā marmasu drauṇiṃ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā
tenāsya samare yodhāstuṣṭuvuḥ sarva eva te
pāṇḍavāstu jayaṃ labdhvā tava sainyaṃ samādravan
sajyaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja sammṛjya ca punaḥ punaḥ
sañcannā pāṇḍavī senā na prājñāyata kiñcana
karṇastveko yudhāṃ śreṣṭho vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ
tatra tatra vyamuhyanta vanadāhe yathā dvipāḥ
teṣāṃ tu krośatāṃ dīnaṃ bhītānāṃ raṇamūrdhani
dhāvatāṃ ca tato rājaṃstrastānāṃ ca samantataḥ
te vadhyamātāḥ samare sūtaputreṇa sṛñjayāḥ arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca krośanti ca muhurmuhuḥ
śrutvā tu ninadaṃ teṣāṃ vadhyatāṃ karṇasāyakaiḥ athābravīdvāsudevaṃ kuntīputro dhanañjayaḥ
naitadastraṃ hi samare śakyaṃ hantuṃ kathañcana
sūtaputraṃ ca saṃrabdhaṃ paśya kṛṣṇa mahāraṇe
mṛtasya tu hṛpīkeśa bhaṅga eva kuto jayaḥ
eṣa karṇo raṇe bhāti madhyāhna iva bhāskaraḥ
tato janārdanaḥ śrutvā tasya vākyaṃ viśāmpate
karṇaṃ ca samare rājangrāhayiṣyañśramaṃ prati viśvamārthaṃ ca kauravya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ
tato dhanañjayaḥ śrutvā rājānaṃ śalyapīḍitam yāhiyāhiti bahuśo vāsudevamacodayat
rājānaṃ prati vārṣṇeya dūyate me dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ
yuddhaṃ kṛtvā tu kaunteyo droṇaputreṇa bhārata
duḥsahaṃ vajriṇā saṅkhye parājitya guroḥ sutam
drauṇiṃ parājitya tatogradhanvā kṛtvā mahadduṣkaraṃ śūrakarma
uvāca bhīmaṃ tarasābhyupetya rājñaḥ pravṛttistviha kutra ceti
nūnaṃ sa viddho'tibhṛśaṃ pṛṣatkaiḥ karṇena rājā śibiraṃ gato'sau
yaḥ samprahārairyudhi sampravṛtte droṇena viddho'tibhṛśaṃ tarasvī
tasthau sa tatrāpi jayapratīkṣo droṇena yāvanna hataḥ kilāsīt
sa saṃśayaṃ gamitaḥ pāṇḍavāgryaḥ saṅkhye'dya karṇena mahānubhāvaḥ
jñātuṃ prayāhyāśu tamadya bhīma sthāsyāmyahaṃ śatrugaṇānnirudhya
tvameva jānīhi mahānubhāva rājñaḥ pravṛttiṃ bharatarṣabhasya
ahaṃ hi yadyarjuna yāmyamitrā vadanti māṃ bhīta iti pravīrāḥ
etānahatvādya mayā na śakya-- mitopayātuṃ ripusaṅkhamadhyāt
saṃśaptakānpratiyotsyāmi saṅkhye sarvānahaṃ yāhi dhanañjaya tvam
rājānaṃ prati vārṣṇeya dūyate me dṛḍhaṃ manaḥ codayāśvānhṛṣīkeśa vihāyaitadbalārṇavam
naitaccitraṃ tava karmādya bhīma yāsyāvahe jahi pārthārisaṅghān
tato yayau hṛṣīkeśo yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
sandiśya cainaṃ rājendra yuddhaṃ prati vṛkodaram
ityevamupasaṅgṛhya ubhau tu pāñjalī sthitau śastrakṣatau mahārāja rudhireṇa samukṣitau
hate mahāsure jambhe śakraviṣṇū yathā guruḥ
manyamāno hataṃ karṇaṃ prītaḥ parapurañjayaḥ sa bhūtvā puruṣavyāghro rājā tatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
agragaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śarma varma ca
antakaṃ mama mitrāṇāṃ hatvā karṇaṃ mahāmṛdhe
tena yuddhamabhītena mayā'dyāpyacyutārjunau kṛtaṃ ghoraṃ mahābāhū dhṛṣṭadyumnasya paśyataḥ
tena ketuśca me cchinno hatau ca pārṣṇisārathī
tatra tatra yudhāṃ śreṣṭha paribhūya na saṃśayaḥ
na sma nidrāṃ labhe rātrau na cāhani sukhaṃ kvacit
kathaṃ karṇo mayā śakyo yuddhe kṣapayituṃ bhavet
yatra yatra hi gacchāmi karṇādbhīto dhanañjaya
tatra tatra hi paśyāmi karṇamevāgrataḥ sthitam
ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho bhavetpunaḥ
sa tvāṃ pṛcchāmi kaunteya yathā na kuśalastathā
tava mṛtyuṃ raṇe karṇaṃ manyante puruṣarṣabha
sa tvayā puruṣavyāghra kathaṃ yuddhe niṣūditaḥ
sotsedhamasya ca śiraḥ paśyatāṃ suhṛdāṃ hṛtam
sarvā diśaḥ paryapatattvadarthaṃ tvāṃ sūtaputraḥ samare parīpsan
ditsannṛṇāṃ śakaṭaṃ ratnapūrṇaṃ kathaṃ tvayāsau nihato'dya karṇaḥ
kaccitkṛtaṃ me paramaṃ tvayādya priyaṃ raṇe sūtaputraṃ nihatya
sarvā diśaḥ paryapatattvadarthaṃ mudānvito garvitaḥ sūtaputraḥ
sa śūramānī samare sametya kaccittvayā nihataḥ sūtaputraḥ
rājyaṃ paraṃ hastigavāśvayuktaṃ rathaṃ ditsuryaḥ parebhyastvardarthe
tvayā raṇe spardhate yaḥ sa pāpaḥ kaccittvayā nihataḥ pāpabuddhiḥ
yo'sau nityaṃ śauryamadena matto vikatthate saṃsadi kauravāṇām
prītyarthaṃ vai tāta suyodhanasya kaccitsa pāpo nihatastvayādya
śete bhinnaḥ pāṃsuṣu sūtaputraḥ kaccidbhagrau dhārtarāṣṭrasya bāhū
yo'sau sadā ślāghate rājamadhye duryodhanaṃ harṣayandarpayuktaḥ
hantā'smi sarvāniti pāṇḍuputrā-- nahaṃ hantā phalgunasyeti mohāt
kaccidvaco'sya vitathaṃ tvayā kṛtaṃ yattatpriyāmavadattāta karṇaḥ
kaccidbhuvaṃ śatrurayaṃ mahātmā hyadhārayaddvādaśa yaḥ samāstu
pādau na dhāve yāvadahaṃ na hanmi dhanañjayaṃ samareṣūgravegam
kaccidraṇe phalguna taṃ nihatya kaccidvrataṃ tasya bhagnaṃ tvayā'dya
kiṃ pāṇḍavāṃstvaṃ na jahāsi kṛṣṇe sudurbalānpatitānhīnasatvān
yo'sau karṇaḥ pratyajānāttvadarthe nāhaṃ hatvā saha kṛṣṇena pārtham
kaccitsaṅgrāmo vidito vai tavāyaṃ samāgame sṛñjaya kauravāṇām
yenāvasthāmīdṛśīṃ prāpito'haṃ kaccittvayā so'dya hato durātmā
yattanmayā bāṇasamarpitena dhyāto'si karṇasya vadhāya vīra
tanme tvayā kaccidamoghamadya dhyānaṃ kṛtaṃ karṇanipātanena
kaccittvayā so'dya samāśrayo'sya bhagnaḥ parākramya suyodhanasya
yo naḥ purā ṣaṇḍhatilānavoca-- tsabhāmadhye kauravāṇāṃ samakṣam
sa durmatiḥ kaccidupetya saṅkhye tvayā hataḥ sūtaputro'tyamarṣī
yaḥ prāhiṇotsūtaputro durātmā kṛṣṇāṃ jitāṃ saubalehānayeti
yaḥ śastrabhṛcchreṣṭhatamaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pitāmahaṃ vyākṣipadalpacetāḥ saṅkhyāyamāno'rdharathaḥ sa kacci-- ttvayāṃ hato'dyādhirathirmahātman
amarṣajaṃ nikṛtisamīraṇeritaṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ jvalanamimaṃ sadā mama
hato mayā so'dya sametya karṇa iti bruvanpraśamayase'dya phalguna
taddharmaśīlasya vaco niśamya rājñaḥ kruddhasyātiratho mahātmā
droṇaṃ hataṃ pārtha karṇo viditvā bhinnāṃ nāvavimāvatyagādhe kurūṇām
raṇe rathenādhirathirmahātmā tato hi māṃ tvaritaḥ so'bhyadhāvat
sa me dṛṣṭvā śūratamo dhvajāgraṃ samādiśadrathasaṅghānanekān
teṣāmahaṃ pañcaśataṃ nihatya āsādayaṃ droṇaputraṃ nadantam
sa me rānsarvataḥ kaṅkapatrā-- navāsṛjadvai pṛthivīprakāśān
nivārya tūrṇaṃ paramājimadhye tato'pi māṃ bāṇagaṇaiḥ samārpayat
ākarṣaṇaṃ vāpi vikṛṣya muktaṃ na dṛśyate tasya mahārathasya
na sandadhānaḥ kuta ādadāno na vyākṣipanna vikarṣanvimuñcan
savyena vā yadi vā dakṣiṇena na jñāyate katareṇāsyatīti
dṛṣṭvīviṣaṃ cāsuharaṃ pareṣāṃ sarvā diśaḥ pūrayānaṃ śaraudhaiḥ
alātacakrapratimaṃ mahātmanaḥ sadā nataṃ kārmukaṃ brahmabandhoḥ
sasarja śīghrāstrabalena vīra-- stoyaṃ yathā prāvṛṣi kālameghaḥ
sa nirviddho viratho droṇaputro rathānīkaṃ cādhiratherviveśa
tato'bhibhūtaṃ yudhi vīkṣya sainyaṃ vidhvastayodhaṃ drutanāgayūtham
sarve pāñcālā hyudvijante sma karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā gāvaḥ kesariṇaṃ yathaiva
haniṣye'haṃ bhārata sūtaputra-- masminsaṅgrāme yadi dṛśyate'dya
āyāhi paśyādya yuyutsamānau māṃ sūtaputraṃ ca dhṛtau raṇāya
mahājhaṣasyeva mukhaṃ prapannāḥ prabhadrakāḥ karṇamukhaṃ prapannāḥ
ṣaṭsāhasrā bhārata rājaputrāḥ svargāya lokāya raṇe nimagnāḥ
tānadya yāsyāmi raṇādvimoktuṃ sarvātmanā sūtaputraṃ ca hantum
evaṃ gate kiñca mayā'dya śakyaṃ kāryaṃ kartuṃ nigrahe sūtajasya
tathaiva rājñaśca suyodhanasya ye cāpi māṃ yoddhukāmāḥ sametāḥ
karṇaṃ na cedadya nihanmi rāja-- nsabāndhavaṃ yudhyamānaṃ prasahya
pratiśrutyā'kurvatāṃ yā gatirvai kaṣṭāṃ yāyāṃ tāmahaṃ rājasiṃha
āmantraye tvāṃ brūhi raṇe jayaṃ me purā bhīmaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrā grasanti
sautiṃ haniṣyāmi narendrasiṃha sainyaṃ tathā śatrugaṇāṃśca sarvān
vaikartanaṃ kuśalinaṃ niśamya kruddhaḥ pārthaḥ phalgūnasyāmitaujāḥ
imāṃ ca vasatiṃ hitvā bhayātkarṇena phalguna
ahaṃ ca bhīmasenaśca mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
vāsudevena sahitā vayaṃ karṇena nirjitāḥ punareva vanaṃ gatvā tapaścaryāṃ ca kurmahe
idaṃ yadi dvaitavane tu sūktaṃ karṇaṃ niyoddhuṃ na sahe nṛpeti
vayaṃ tataḥ prāptakālaṃ yathāva-- tkṛtvā'bhyupekṣāma tathaiva rājyam
mayi pratiśrutya vadhaṃ hi tasya balasya cārdhasya tathaiva yuddhe
ānīya māṃ śatrumadhye sa kasmā-- tsamunnāmya sthaṇḍile pratyapiṃṣṭhāḥ
anvāsya satyena yadāttha pārtha satyaṃ śapanvāsudevena sārdham
tannaḥ satyamaphalaṃ hyakārṣīḥ phalasya kāle cācchinnaḥ puṣpavṛkṣam
pracchāditastvaṃ bāliśa duryaśobhi-- ranarthavākyo'syarjuna naiva sādhuḥ
tyaktvā bhīmaṃ sarvabhīmeṣu bhīmaṃ saṃyojitastvaṃ sūtaputraṃ nihantum
yattadvṛthā vāguvācāntarikṣe saptāhni jāte tvayi mandabuddhau
ayaṃ jetā pāṇḍavo devasaṅghān sarvāṇi bhūtānyapi cottamaujāḥ
ayaṃ jetā madrakaliṅgajātā-- ndaityāṃśca rakṣāṃsi samāgatāni
bhūmiṃ ca sarvāṃ nikhilena jetā kurūṃśca jetā svagaṇāṃśca jetā
asmātparo no bhavitā dhanurdharo naiṣyanna bhūtaḥ kaścidenaṃ vijetā
icchannayaṃ sarvabhūtāni kuryā-- dvaśī vaśe sarvasamāptavidyaḥ
kāntyā śaśāṅkasya javena vāyoḥ syairyeṇa meroḥ kṣamayā pṛthivyāḥ
agneśca tāpe dhanadasya lakṣmyā śauryeṇa śakrasya jayena viṣṇoḥ
tulyo mahātmā tava kunti putro jāto'diterviṣṇurivāmitaujāḥ
sveṣāṃ jayāya dviṣatāṃ vadhāya jāto mahātmā tava nandikartā
evaṃvidhastvaṃ na ca bhūtastathādya devāśca nūnamanṛtaṃ vadanti
tathā pareṣāmṛṣisattamānāṃ śrutvā giraḥ pūjayatāṃ sadā tvām
na sannatiṃ yāmi suyodhanasya na tvāṃ jānāmyādhiratherbhayārtam
tvaṣṭrā kṛtaṃ vāhamakūjanākṣaṃ śubhaṃ samāsthāya kapidhvajaṃ tam
khaṅgaṃ gṛhītvā hemacitrāvanadvaṃ dhanurvaraṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram tvaṃ vāsudevenohyamānaḥ kathaṃ nu karṇādbhīto vyapayāto'si pārtha
pūrvaṃ yaduktaṃ hi suyodhanena na phalgunaḥ pramukhe sthāsyatīti
karṇasya yuddhe hi mahābalasya maurkhyāttu tannāvabuddhaṃ mayā'sīt
tenādya tapsye bhṛśamaprameyaṃ yanmitravargo narakaṃ praviṣṭaḥ
tadaiva vācyo'smi nanu tvayā'haṃ na yotsye'haṃ sūtaputraṃ kathañcit
tato nāhaṃ sṛñjayānkekayāṃśca samānayeyaṃ suhṛdo raṇāya
evaṃ gate kiṃ ca mayā'dya śakyaṃ kāryaṃ kartuṃ nigrahe sūtajasya
tathaiva rājñaśca suyodhanasya ye vāpi māṃ yoddhukāmāḥ sametāḥ
dhigastu majjīvitamadya kṛṣṇa yo'haṃ vaśaṃ sūtaputrasya yātaḥ
madhye kurūṇāṃ samuyodhanānāṃ ye cāpyanye yoddhukāmāḥ sametāḥ
ekaḥ sa me bhīmaseno'dyaṃ nātho yenābhipanno'smi raṇe mahābhaye
vimocya māṃ cāpi rupānvitastataḥ śareṇa tīkṣṇena bibheda karṇam
tyaktvā prāṇānsamare bhīmasena-- ścakre yuddhaṃ kurumukhyaiḥ sametaiḥ
asau hi bhīmasya mahāninādo muhurmahuḥ śrūyate dhārtarāṣṭraiḥ
yadi sma jīvetsamare nihantā mahārathānāṃ pravaro narottamaḥ
tavābhimanyustanayo'dya pārtha na cāsmi gantā samare parābhavam
athāpi jīvetsamare ghaṭotkaca-- stathā'pi nāhaṃ samare parāṅyukhaḥ
yaṃ taṃ ḷḷḷsādya riporvalaṃ no nimīlitākṣaṃ bhayaviplutaṃ bhavet
ḷḷḷḷḷniśi yuddhameka-- styaksā raṇaṃ yatva bhayādravante
sa cetsamāsādya mahānubhāvaḥ karṇaṃ raṇe bāṇagaṇaiḥ pramohyaḥ
dhairye sthitenāpi ca sūtajena śakyā hato vāsavadattayā tayā
mamaiva bhāgyāni purā kṛtāni pāpāni nūnaṃ phalavanti yuddhe
tṛṇaṃ ca kṛtvā samare bhavantaṃ tato'hamevaṃ nikṛto durātmanā vaikartanenaiva tathā kṛto'haṃ yathā hyaśaktaḥ kriyate tvabāndhavaḥ
āpadgrataṃ yaśca naro vimokṣaye-- tsa bāndhavaḥ snehayutaḥ suhṛcca
evaṃ purāṇā ṛṣayo vadanti dharmaḥ sadā sadbhiranuṣṭhitaśca
khaṅgaṃ vibhrajjātarūpatsaruṃ ca dhanurvedaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ tālamātram
sa keśavenohyamānaḥ kathaṃ nu karṇātpārthastvamapaituṃ samaiṣīḥ
sa gāṇḍīvaṃ keśavāya pradāya yantā bhavestvaṃ yadi keśavasya
māse'patiṣyo yadi pañcame tvaṃ na vā garbho yadyabhavaḥ pṛthāyāḥ
mattaḥ śreyānrājaputro'bhaviṣya-- nna te yaśaḥ phalguna ityapeyāt
uvāca kimidaṃ khaṅgaṃ gṛhṇāsyarjuna śaṃma me
sa rājā bhavatā dṛṣṭaḥ kuśalī ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
na taṃ paśyāmi kaunteya yaste vadhyo bhavediha
tattvāṃ pṛcchāmi kaunteya kimidaṃ te cikīrṣitam
arjunaḥ prāha govindaṃ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan
anyasmai dehi gāṇḍīvamiti māṃ yaḥ pracodayet bhindyāmahaṃ tasya śira ityupāṃśu vrataṃ mama
etadarthaṃ mayā khahgo gṛhīto yadunandana so'haṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ hatvā satyasyānṛṇyatāṃ gataḥ
kiṃ vā tvaṃ manyase prāptamasminkārya upasthite
tattathā prakariṣyāmi yathā māṃ vakṣyate bhavān
idānīṃ pārtha jānāmi na vṛddhāḥ sevitāstvayā
anusṛtya tu ye dharmaṃ kavayaḥ samupasthitāḥ
evaṃ sa muhyatyavaśo yathā tvaṃ pārtha muhyasi
na hi kāryamakāryaṃ vā sukhaṃ jñātuṃ kathañcana
śrutena jñāyate sarvaṃ tacca tvaṃ nāvahudhyase
prāṇināṃ tvaṃ vadhaṃ pārtha dhārmiko nāvabudhyase
prāṇināṃ hi vadhāttāta vṛthā dharmo mato mama
anṛtaṃ tu bhavedvācyaṃ na tu hiṃsā kadācana
sa kathaṃ bhrātaraṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ rājānaṃ dharmakovidam
na vadhaḥ pūjyate sadbhistacca sarvaṃ gurau tava
tvayā caitadvrataṃ pārtha bāleneva kṛtaṃ purā
idaṃ dharmarahasyaṃ ca tava vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava
yadbrūyāttava bhīṣmo vā rājā vāpi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
viduro vā punaḥ kṣattā gāndhārī vā yaśasvinī kuntī vā bharataśreṣṭha draupadī vā yaśasvinī
satyasyaṃ vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param
sudurvidaṃ hi tattvena tatsatyamiti me satiḥ
andhe hate tato vyomnaḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca
atha kauśikamabhyetya procuste satyavādinam katareṇa pathā yātā bhagavanniti vai janāḥ
satyena pṛṣṭaḥ prabrūhi yadi tadvettha śaṃsa naḥ
satyasya tvavibhāgajñaḥ satyaṃ tebhyaḥ śaśaṃsa ha bahuvṛkṣalatāgulmametadgahanamāśritāḥ
satyaṃ dharma iti hyeke vadanti bahavo janāḥ
śrutistu dhāryā ityeke vadanti bahavo janāḥ
yatsyādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ahiṃsārthāya hiṃsrāṇāṃ dharmapravacanaṃ kṛtam
avaśyaṃ kūjitavye ha śaṅkeranvāpyakūjanāt ye'nyāyena jihīrṣanto dharmaṃ pṛcchanti kasyacit
sarvasvasya ca lope vā vaktavyamanṛtaṃ bhavet
adharmaṃ hi na paśyanti mṛṣodyaṃ tatra paṇḍitāḥ
yaḥ stenaiḥ saha sambandho mucyate śapathādapi
na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ deyaṃ satyāditi kathañcana pāpebhyo'pi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet
etajjñātvā brūhi pārtha yadi vadhyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
suhṛdbrūyādyathā'smākaṃ tathoktaṃ vacanaṃ tvayā bhavānmātṛsamo'smākaṃ bhavānpitṛsamo'pi ca
gatiśca paramā kṛṣṇa tvameva ca parāyaṇam
na hi te triṣu lokeṣu vidyate'viditaṃ kvacit
jānāsi dāśārha mama vrataṃ tu yo māṃ brūyātkaścana mānuṣeṣu
anyasmai tvaṃ gāṇḍivaṃ dehi pārtha yo matto'stre vīryato vā viśiṣṭaḥ
hanyāmahaṃ keśava taṃ prasahya bhīmo hanyāttūvaraketi coktaḥ
taṃ hanyāṃ cetkeśava jīvaloke sthātā nāhaṃ kālamapyalpamātram
dhyātvā nūnaṃ hyenasā cāpi mukto vadhaṃ rājño bhraṣṭavīryo vicetāḥ
yathā pratijñā mama lokabuddhau bhavetsatyā dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭha
yathā jīvatpāṇḍavo'haṃ ca kṛṣṇa tathā buddhiṃ dātumapyarhasi tvam
rājā śrānto vikṣato duḥkhitaśca karṇena sahkhye niśitairbāṇasaṅghaiḥ
yaścāniśaṃ sūtaputreṇa vīra śarairbhṛśaṃ tāḍito yudhyamānaḥ
akopito hyeṣa yadi sma saṅkhye karṇaṃ na hanyāditi cābravītsaḥ
jānāti taṃ pāṇḍava eṣa cāpi pāpaṃ loke karṇamasahyamanyaiḥ
tatastvamukto bhṛśaroṣitena rājñā samakṣaṃ paruṣāṇi pārtha
nityodyukte satataṃ cāprasahye karṇe dyūtaṃ hyadya raṇe nibaddham
tasminhate kuravo nirjitāḥ syu-- revaṃ buddhiḥ pārthive dharmaputre
tato badhaṃ nārhati dharmaputra-- stvayā pratijñā'rjuna pālanīyā
jīvannayaṃ yena mṛto bhaveddhi tanme nibodheha tavānurūpam
yadā mānaṃ labhate mānanārha-- stadā sa vai jīvati jīvaloke
yadā'vamānaṃ labhate mahāntaṃ tadā jīvanmṛta ityucyate saḥ
sammānitaḥ pārthivo'yaṃ sadaiva tvayā ca bhīmena tathā yamābhyām
vṛddhaiśca loke puruṣaiśca śūrai-- stasyāpamānaṃ kalayā prayuṅkṣva
yadā hyaṃ pāṇḍava dharmarāja-- satvatto'yuktaṃ lapsyate caiva sādhu
tato'sya pādāvabhivādya paścā-- cchreyo brūyātsāntvayuktaṃ hitaṃ ca
bhrātā prājñastava kopaṃ na jātu kuryādrājā dharmamārgānusārī
mukto'nṛtādvātṛvadhācca pāpā-- ddhṛṣṭaḥ karṇaṃ tvaṃ jahi pārtha paścāt
mā tvaṃ rājanvyāharasvādya pāpaṃ tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi krośamātre vyapetya
bhīmastu māmarhati garhaṇāya yo yudhyate sarvalokapravīraiḥ
kāle hi śatrūnparipīḍya vīro hatvā pravīrānvasudhādhipānām
suduṣkaraṃ karma karoti bhīmaḥ kartuṃ yathā nārhati kaścidanyaḥ
rathādavaskandya gadāṃ parāmṛśaṃ-- stathā raṇe hanti tathaiva vāraṇān
sa kuñjarāṇāmadhikaṃ sahasraṃ hatvā nadaṃstumulaṃ siṃhanādam
asau bhīmo dhārtarāṣṭreṣu magnaḥ sa māmupālabdhumarindamo'rhati
varāsinā cātha narāśvakuñjarāṃ-- stathā rathāṅgairdhanuṣā ca hantyarīn
pramṛdya paddhyāmahitāṃstu hanti punaśca dorbhyāṃ śatamanyuvikramaḥ
mahābalo vaiśravaṇāntakopamaḥ prasahya hartā dviṣatāṃ yaśāṃsi
sa bhīmaseno'rhati garhaṇāya na tvaṃ nityaṃ rakṣyamāṇaḥ suhṛdbhiḥ
nihanti yaḥ śatrugaṇānanekaśaḥ sa māṃ hi vaktuṃ prabhavatyamānagasam
sṛjecca yo bāṇasaṅghānpareṣu mahābalo megha ivāmbudhārāḥ
rathāśca nāgāśca hayāśca rāja-- nbhīmenājau nihatāḥ saṅghaśo'dya
dhṛtarāṣṭraputrā balinaśca yena mahābalā nihatāḥ prāyaśo vai
ekaḥ sahetāpratisahyapauruṣa-- stenāsmi vācyo na tvayā vai kadācit
mahārathā yatra yatraiva yuddhe bhindanti sainyaṃ tava kāmato'dya
tatraiva tatraiva raṇe mahātmā dṛḍhaṃ bhīmaḥ parasaṅghānamṛdrāt
tenāsmi vācyo na tvayā haṃ kadāci-- nmā mā vocaḥ krūramihādya pārtha
nāsmadvidho vai bhavatā tu vācyo yathā bhavānsarvalokasya vācyaḥ
evaṃ hi mā te bruvato narendra kathaṃ na dīryecchatadhā'dya jihvā
balaṃ na vādhiṣṭhitaṃ sattamānāṃ yatkṣatriyāṇāṃ bahulaṃ vadanti
tvaṃ cābalo bhārata niṣṭhuro'si tvameva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho'ham
nakulena rājangajavājiyodhā hatāśca vīrāḥ sahasā sametya
kṛtaṃ karma sahadevena duṣkaraṃ yo yudhyate parasainyāvamardī
na cābravītkiñcidihāgato balī paśyāntaraṃ tasya cevātmanaśca
ete'dya yudhi samprapīḍitā-- ste māmulapālabdhumarhanti na tvam
tvanmūlamasmābhiridaṃ hi vairaṃ prāptaṃ tathā vyasanaṃ cātighoram
tvameva rājansatataṃ pramatta-- stvameva mūḍho bhāratānāmasādhuḥ
tvāṃ prāpya rājyaṃ ca vinaṣṭameta-- tprāptā mahatpāṇḍavāścāpi dāsyam
tvattaḥ kṛto'smakadvanavāsaduḥkhaṃ rājyasya nāśo hyabhimanyośca ghoraḥ
ātmānamevaṃ sunṛśaṃsarūpaṃ jñātvā kimarthaṃ garhase mādya vīra
lajjasva rājanyadi te'sti lajjā tūṣṇīmbhūtaḥ paśya sarvaṃ kṛtaghnaḥ
bhīmo nityaṃ samarasya kartā darpasya bhettā punareva nityam
svayaṃ hyaśaktena narendra yuddhe nareṇa kāryā satataṃ kṣamaiva
balaṃ hi vāci dvijasattamānāṃ kṣātraṃ dvijā bāhubalaṃ vadanti
tvaṃ vāgbalo bhārata niṣṭhuro'si tvameva māṃ vetsi yathāvidho'ham
ghaṭāmi nityaṃ tava kartumiṣṭaṃ dāraiḥ sutairjīvitenātmanā ca
evañca māṃ vākchalākairhinatsi tvattaḥ sukhaṃ na vayaṃ vidma kiñcit
sarvātiśaṅkī bhavasi pramatta-- stvattaḥ sukhaṃ nābhijānāmi kiñcit
proktaḥ svayaṃ satyasandhena mṛtyu-- stava priyārthaṃ naradeva yuddhe
śikhaṇḍināmnā pradhane tavārthe mayābhiguptena hataśca bhīṣmaḥ
droṇo hato yaḥ satatopakārī dhṛṣṭadyumnena syandanādviprakṛṣṭaḥ
drauṇiśca ruddhaḥ sagaṇo mahātmā tathāpi te vai vacanaṃ nṛśaṃsavat
duḥkhaṃ priyaṃ te naradeva kartuṃ yasya priyaṃ te na karomyahaṃ vai
na yucyate vai divi ceha yaḥ pumā-- nyaste madanyo'priyamārabheta
na cābhinandāmi tathāhi rājyaṃ yatastvamakṣeṣu dṛḍhaṃ prasaktaḥ
svayaṃ kṛtaṃ pāpamanāryajuṣṭa-- masmābhirājau vyasanaṃ titīrṣasi
akṣeṣu doṣā bahavo vidharmyāḥ śrutāstvayā sahadevo'bravīdyān
tānnecchasi tyaktumanāryajuṣṭā-- nghore sma sarve niraye tvayā'stāḥ
tvaṃ devitā tvatkṛte rājyanāśaṃ-- stvatsambhavaṃ vyasanaṃ no narendra
etā vācaḥ paruṣāḥ savyasācī sthirapratijñaḥ śrāvayitvā narendram
tamāha kṛṣṇaḥ kimidaṃ punarbhavā-- nvikośamākāśanibhaṃ karotyasim
prabrūhi satyaṃ punaruttaraṃ sakhe vacaḥ pravakṣyābhi tavārthasiddhaye
itīva pṛṣṭaḥ puruṣottamena suduḥkhitaḥ keśavamāha pārthaḥ
prabrūhi pārtha svaguṇānihātmana-- stato hatātmā bhavasīti niścayaḥ
tathā tu kṛṣṇasya vaco niśamya tato'rjunaḥ prāha dhanuḥ pragṛhya
yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭhaṃ śṛṇuṣva rājanniti durvacaḥ svayam
na mādṛśo'nyo naradeva vidyate dhanurdharo devamṛte pinākinam
mayā hi rājansadigīśvarā diśo vijitya sarvā bhavataḥ kṛtā vaśe
sa rājasūyaśca samāptadakṣiṇaḥ sabhā ca divyā bhavato mamaujasā
pāṇī pṛṣatkālikhitāvimau puna-- rdhanuśca savye vitataṃ sabāṇam
pādau ca me lakṣaṇataḥ praśastau na mādṛśaṃ yuddhagataṃ jayanti
hatā udīcyā nihatāḥ pratīcyāḥ prācyā nirastā dākṣiṇātyā viśastāḥ
saṃśaptakānāṃ kiñcidevāvaśiṣṭaṃ sarvasya lokasya hataṃ mayā'rdham
śete mayā nihatā śatrusenā chinnairgātrairbhūmitale skhalantī
anastrajñānnaiva nihanmi cāstrai-- stasmānna bhasmaiva karomi lokān
jaitraṃ rathaṃ bhīmamāsthāya kṛṣṇa yāvacchīghraṃ sūtaputraṃ nihantum
rājā bhavatvadya sunirvṛto'yaṃ karṇaṃ raṇe nāśayitāsmi bāṇaiḥ
ityevamuktvā punarāha pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham
adyāputrā sūtamātā bhavitrī kuntī vātho vā mayā tena vāpi satyaṃ vadāmyadya na karṇamājau śarairahatvā kavacaṃ vimokṣye
ityevamuktvā punareva pārtho yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham
vimucya śastrāṇi dhanurvisṛjya kośe ca khaṅgaṃ vinidhāya tūrṇam
sa vrīḍayā namraśirāḥ kirīṭī yudhiṣṭhiraṃ prāñjalirabhyuvāca
prasīda rājankṣama yanmayoktaṃ kāle bhavānvetsyati tannamaste
tatastu pādāvupagṛhya pārthaḥ samutthito dīptatejāḥ kirīṭi
yāmyeṣa bhīmaṃ samarādvimoktuṃ sarvātmanā sūtaputraṃ ca hantum
bhavatpriyārthaṃ mama jīvitaṃ hi bravīmi satyaṃ tadavehi rājan
adyāpyaputrā tena hatena rādhā kuntī mayā vā tadidaṃ viddhi rājan
etacchrutvā pāṇḍavo dharmarājo bhrāturvākyaṃ paruṣaṃ phalgunasya
kṛtaṃ mayā pārthaṃ na sādhukarma yena prāptaṃ vyasanaṃ vaḥ sughoram
vṛddhāvamansuḥ paruṣatya caiva kiṃ te ciraṃ māmanusṛjya rūkṣam
gacchāmyahaṃ vanamadyaiva pāpaḥ sukhaṃ bhavānvartatāṃ madvihīnaḥ
yogyo rājā bhīmaseno mahātmā klībasya kiṃ vā mama rājyakṛtyam
na cāpi śaktaḥ paruṣāṇi soḍhuṃ punastavemāni ruṣānvitasya
bhīmo'stu rājā mama jīvitena na kāryamadyāvamatasya vīra
iyeṣa nirgantumatho vanāya taṃ vāsudevaḥ praṇato'bhyuvāca
tataḥ satyāṃ pratijñāṃ tāṃ pārthena pratirakṣatā
satyaṃ te pratijānāmi hataṃ vidvyadya sūtajam
iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sasambhramaṃ hṛṣīkeśamutthāpya praṇataṃ tadā
mocitā vyasanāddhorādvayamadya tvayācyuta bhavantaṃ nāvamāsādya hyāvāṃ vyasanasāgarāt
kathaṃ nāma bhavedetadyadi tvaṃ pārtha dharmajam
hatvā tu nṛpatiṃ pārtha kariṣyasi kimuttaram
narakaṃ ghorarūpaṃ ca bhrāturjyetusya vai vathāt
sa tvaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rājānaṃ dharmasaṃhitam
prasādya bhaktyā rājānaṃ prīte caiva yudhiṣṭhire
hatvā tu samare karṇaṃ tvamadya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ
evaṃ kṛte kṛtaṃ caiva tava kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati
tata āśliṣya taṃ premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavaḥ prītyā paramayā yukto vismayaṃśca punaḥpunaḥ
karṇena me mahābāho sarvasainyasya paśyataḥ kavacaṃ ca dhvajaṃ caiva dhanuḥ śaktirhayāḥ śarāḥ
so'haṃ dṛṣṭvā raṇe tasya karṇa karṇasya phalguna
vyavasīdāmi duḥkhena na tu me jīvitaṃ priyam
na cedadya hi taṃ vīraṃ nihaniṣyasi saṃyuge
prāṇāneva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama
satyena te śape rājaṃstvatpādena tathaiva ca
bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṃ ca mahīpate
ahamenaṃ naraśreṣṭha sāmātyaṃ ca mahīpate yathādya samare karṇaṃ haniṣyāmi hatopi vā
evamābhāṣya rājānamabravīnmādhavaṃ vacaḥ adya karṇaṃ raṇe kṛṣṇa sūdayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ
tvamanudhyāhi bhadraṃ te vadhaṃ tasya durātmanaḥ
śakto'si bharataśreṣṭha yatnaṃ kartuṃ yadāttha mām
eṣa cāpi hi me kāmo nityameva mahāratha
hanyate dvairathe bhūyo yujyantāṃ vai rathottame
rathopakaraṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ satvaraṃ yātu me rathaḥ
evamukto mahārāja phalgunena mahātmanā uvāca dārukaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kuru sarvaṃ yadabravīt
ājñaptastvatha kṛṣṇena dāruko rājasattama yojayāmāsa ca rathaṃ vaiyāghnaṃ śatrutāpanam
yuktaṃ tu rathamāsthāya dārukeṇa mahātmanā upasthitaṃ rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā padmanābho raṇāntakṛt
diṣṭyāsi rājanvirujo diṣṭyā na grahaṇaṃ gataḥ
ehyehi pārtha bībhatso māṃ pariṣvaja pāṇḍava
manyuṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ pārtha yanmayokto'si dāruṇaṃ
tamutthāpya tato rājā pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam
māhātmyaṃ vijayaṃ caivaṃ bhūyaḥ prāpnuhi śāśvatam
adya taṃ pāpakarmāṇaṃ sānubandhaṃ raṇe śaraiḥ
iti satyena te pādau spṛśāmi jagatīpate
iti bruvāṇaṃ sumanāḥ kirīṭinaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha vaco bṛhattaram
yaśo'kṣayaṃ jīvitamīpsitaṃ te jayaṃ sadā vīryamarikṣayaṃ tadā
prayāhi vṛddhiṃ ca diśantu devatā yathāhamicchāmi tavāstu tattathā
prayāhi śīghraṃ jahi karṇamāhave purandaro vṛtramivātmavṛdvaye
prasādya dharmarājānaṃ prahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā sampūjya devatāḥ sarva brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca
babhūvurvimalāḥ sarvā diśo rājansamantataḥ cāṣāśca śatapatrāśca krauñcāścaiva janeśvara
kaṅkā gṛdhrā bakāḥ śyenā vāyasāśca viśāmpate
cintā ca vipulā jajñe kathaṃ cedaṃ bhaviṣyati
na teṣāṃ mānuṣo jetā tvadanya iha vidyate
tvāṃ prāpya samare śūraṃ prayātāḥ paramāṃ gatim
ko hi droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca bhagadattaṃ ca māriṣa
śrutāyuṃ cāśrutāyuṃ ca śatāyuṃ ca mahāratham
pratyudgamya bhavetkṣemī yo na syāttvadvidhaḥ prabhuḥ
tava hyastrāṇi divyāni lāghavaṃ balameva ca asammohaśca yuddheṣu vijñānasya ca sannatiḥ
pṛthivyāṃ tu raṇe pārtha na yoddhā tvatsamaḥ pumān
ātmanastu samaṃ teṣāṃ na paśyāmi śṛṇomi ca
brahmaṇā hi prajāḥ sṛṣṭā gāṇḍīvaṃ ca mahaddhanuḥ
yena tvaṃ yudhyase pārtha tasmānnāsti tvayā samaḥ
avaśyaṃ tu mayā vācyaṃ yatpathyaṃ tava pāṇḍava
kṛtī ca citrayodhī ca deśakālasya kovidaḥ
bahunātra kimuktena saṃkṣepācchṛṇu pāṇḍava tvatsamaṃ tvadviśiṣṭaṃ vā karṇaṃ manye mahāratham
ṛte tvāmiti me buddhistadadya jahi sūtajam
devairapi hi saṃyattairbibhradbhirmāṃsaśoṇitam aśakyaḥ sa ratho jetuṃ sarvairapi yuyutsubhiḥ
durātmānaṃ pāpavṛttaṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ duṣṭaprajñaṃ pāṇḍaveyeṣu nityam
hīnasvārthaṃ pāṇḍaveyairvirodhe hatvā karṇaṃ niścitārtho bhavādya
taṃ sūtaputraṃ rathināṃ variṣṭhaṃ niṣkālikaṃ kālavaśaṃ nayādya
taṃ sūtaputraṃ rathināṃ variṣṭhaṃ hatvā prītiṃ dharmarāje kuruṣva
jānāmi te pārthaṃ vīryaṃ yathāva-- ddurvāraṇīyaṃ ca surāsuraiśca
sadāvajānāti hi pāṇḍuputrā-- nasau darpātsūtaputro durātmā
ātmānaṃ manyate vīraṃ yena pāpaḥ suyodhanaḥ
tamadya mūlaṃ pāpānāṃ jahi sautiṃ dhanañjaya
ahaṃ tvāmanujānāmi vīryeṇa ca balena ca
jahi karṇaṃ raṇe śūraṃ mātaṅgamiva kesarī
tamadya pārtha saṅgrāme karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ jahi
bhūtvā hi vipulā senā tāvakānāṃ paraiḥ saha
tvāṃ vai śatruṃ samāsādya vinaṣṭā raṇamūrdhani
pāñcālaiḥ pāṇḍavairmātsyaiḥ kārūśaiścedibhiḥ saha magadhaiḥ pārijātaiśca dākṣiṇātyaiḥ sakeralaiḥ
ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṃ kauravāṃstāta saṃyuge
bhagadattaṃ ca rājānaṃ ko'nyaḥ śaktastvayā vinā
tathemāṃ vipulāṃ senāṃ guptāṃ pārtha tvayā'nagha
na śekuḥ pārthivāḥ sarve cakṣurbhirapi vīkṣitum
tathaiva satataṃ pārtha rakṣitābhyāṃ tvayā raṇe
ko hi śakto raṇe pārtha bhāratānāṃ mahārathau
ko hi śāntanavaṃ bhīṣmaṃ droṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ kṛpam
drauṇiṃ ca saumadattiṃ ca kṛtavarmāṇameva ca
saindhavaṃ madrarājaṃ ca rājānaṃ ca suyodhanam
gaṇāśca dāsamīyānāṃ vasātīnāṃ ca bhārata prācyānāṃ vāṭadhānānāṃ bhojānāṃ cābhimāninām
tvāṃ samāsādya nidhanaṃ gatā bhīmaṃ ca bhārata
na śakyā yudhi nirjetuṃ tvadanyena parantapa
yadi tvaṃ na bhavestrātā pratīyātko nu mānavaḥ
bhīmasenaṃ samāsādya tvāṃ ca pāṇḍava kauravāḥ
tathā senāmukhe tatra nihate pārtha pāṇḍavaiḥ
dināni daśa bhīṣmeṇa nighnatā tāvakaṃ balam
na śekuḥ sṛñjayā draṣṭuṃ tathaivānye mahīkṣitaḥ
vicarantaṃ tathā taṃ tu saṅgrame jitakāśinam
sarvodyamena mahatā pāṇḍavānsamabhidravat sa tu vidrāvya samare pāṇḍavānsṛñjayānapi
taṃ śikhaṇḍī samāsādya tvayā gupto mahāvratam
sa eṣa patitaḥ śete śaratalpe pitāmahaḥ
tvāṃ prāpya puruṣavyāghraṃ vṛtraḥ prāpyeva vāsavam
dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ samāsādya sa gataḥ paramāṃ gatim
nāvārayiṣyaḥ saṅgrāme na sma droṇo vyanaṅkṣyata
bhavatā tu balaṃ sarvaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrasya vāritam
tato droṇo hato yuddhe pārṣatena dhanañjaya
kaśca śakto raṇe kartuṃ tvadanyaḥ puruṣabruvaḥ
yādṛśaṃ te kṛtaṃ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṃ prati
nivārya senāṃ mahatīṃ hatvā śūrāṃśca pārthivān
anāścāryaṃ hi tattvattastvaṃ hi pārtha mahārathaḥ
tvāṃ hi prāpya raṇe kṣatramekāhāditi bhārata
vidhvastā hi raṇe pārtha seneyaṃ bhīmavikrama
drauṇiśca kṛtavarmā ca karṇo madrādhipaḥ kṛpaḥ
yadi vā dvipadāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ droṇaṃ mānayato gurum
etatte sukṛtaṃ karma nātra kiñcana vidyate
karṇamadya naraśreṣṭha jahi pārtha śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
dahane yatsaputrāyā niśi mātustavānagha dyūtārthe yacca yuṣmāsu prāvartata suyodhanaḥ
tasya sarvasya duṣṭātmā karṇo vai mūlamityuta
yaśca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān
karṇaṃ hi manyate trāṇaṃ nityameva suyodhanaḥ
rucito bhavatā sārdhaṃ jānato'pi balaṃ tava
karṇo jalpati vai nityamahaṃ pārthānsamāgatān vāsudevaṃ ca dāśārhaṃ vijeṣyāmi mahāraṇe
yacca yuṣmāsu pāpaṃ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ pratāpavān
tanme dahati gātrāṇi sakhe satyena te śape
na śakto hyabhimanyostu karṇaḥ sthātuṃ raṇāgrataḥ
prahasansa tu duṣṭātmā karṇo rājā ca kauravaḥ yacca karṇo'bravītkṛṣṇāṃ sabhāyāṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ
vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇe śāśvataṃ narakaṃ gatāḥ
na pāṇḍavāḥ prabhavanti tava kṛṣṇe kathañcana
dāsabhāryā ca pāñcāli svayaṃ dāsī ca śobhane
adya duryodhano rājā pṛthivyāṃ nṛpatiḥ smṛtaḥ
paśyedānīṃ yadā bhadre niviṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samam
vyaktaṃ ṣaṇḍatilā hyete narake ca nimajjitāḥ
adya karṇaṃ raṇe grastaṃ paśyantu kuravastvayā
adya te samare vīryaṃ paśyantu kuruyodhinaḥ
sūtaputre hate pārtha jānantu tvāṃ mahāratham
adya tvāṃ pratimardantu pāñcālāḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha
yathā vṛtravadhe vṛtte devāḥ sarve śatakratum
adya karṇaṃ raṇe hatvā prāpya caivottamaṃ yaśaḥ
tathā tvamapi rādheyaṃ ghorāṃ kṛtvā mahātanum
jahi yuddhe mahābāho trāyasva ca bhayātsvakān
taṃ ca svaśoṇite magnaṃ śayānaṃ patitaṃ bhuvi
tvayā cādya hate tasya vikrame bharatarṣabha
tathā cādhirathau yāte prayāntu kuravo diśaḥ
sa vai cādya bhayāttyaktvā dhārtarāṣṭro mahācamūm
tathā cādya hataṃ śrutvā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ
adya jānantu te pārtha vikramaṃ sarvayodhinaḥ
yātu karṇo raṇe pārtha śvāvicchalalato yathā
taṃ kathaṃ karṇamāsādya vidraveyurmahārathāḥ yastvekaḥ sarvapāñcālānahanyahani nāśayan
tamapyāsādya samare mitrārthe mitravatsala tathā jvalantamastraiśca śūraṃ sarvadhanuṣmatām
ete bhramanti pāñcālā utkrayanti ca māriṣa
eṣa bhīmo dṛḍhakrodho vṛtaḥ pārtha samantataḥ
nānyaṃ tvatto hi paśyāmi yodhaṃ yaudhiṣṭhire bale
yathā pratijñāṃ tva pārtha tīrtvā kīrtimavāpsyasi
tvaṃ hi śakto raṇe karṇaṃ vijetuṃ saha pārthivaiḥ
nānyo yudhi yudhāṃ śreṣṭha satyametadbravīmi te
kṛtārthaḥ saphalaḥ pārtha sukhī bhava narottama
sa keśavasya bībhatsuḥ śrutvā bhārata bhāṣitam
tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eva jayo mama
prāpayeyaṃ paraṃ lokaṃ kimu karṇaṃ mahāhave
bhārgavāstraṃ ca paśyāmi jvalantaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvaśaḥ
anena khalu saṅgrāme yattu kṛṣṇa mayā kṛtam
adya kṛṣṇa vikarṇā me karṇaṃ neṣyanti mṛtyave
guṇavantaṃ hi yo hitvā nirguṇaṃ kurute prabhum
sa śocati ciraṃ kṛṣṇa kṣipramevāgate kṣaye
yathā ca puruṣaḥ kaścicchittvā cāmravaṇaṃ mahat
dṛṣṭvā puṣpaṃ pale gṛdhnuḥ phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā'nuśocati tathedaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya puṣpalupdhasya mānada
phalaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhṛśaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati janārdana
sūtaputre hate tvadya nirāśo bhavitā prabhuḥ
bhaviṣyati hate karṇe kṛṣṇa satyaṃ bravīmi te
smaratāṃ tava vākyāni śamaṃ prati janeśvaraḥ
adyāsau saubalaḥ kṛṣṇa glahāñjānātu vai śarān
durodaraṃ ca gāṇḍīvaṃ gaṇḍavaṃ ca rathaṃ mama
vyapaneṣyāmi govinda hatvā karṇaṃ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ
adya kuntīsuto rājā hate sūtasute mayā
yasya caitadvrataṃ mahyaṃ vadhe kila durātmanaḥ
ete ṣaṇḍatilāḥ kṛṣṇe nirvīryā hatavikramāḥ ahaṃ vaḥ pāṇḍaveyebhyo bhayāttrāsyeti cābravīt
adya karṇe hate kṛṣṇa dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ
vidravanti diśo bhītāḥ siṃhaṃ dṛṣṭvā mṛgā iva
hate karṇe mayā saṅkhye saputre sasuhṛjjane
jānātu māṃ raṇe kṛṣṇa pravaraṃ sarvadhanvinām
adya duryodhano dīptāṃ śriyaṃ rājyaṃ ca hāsyati
hate vaikartane karṇe bhīṣme droṇe ca saṃyuge
kātaraṃ tadbalaṃ kṛṣṇa praviṣṭaṃ bhokṣyate tu yat
adya taṃ nihataṃ śrutvā karṇaṃ vaikartanaṃ mayā
adya kṛṣṇa hate karṇe kurutāṃ cirasambhṛtam
adya tvambā ca kṛṣṇā ca tvaramāṇe parasparam
udīkṣetāṃ hate karṇe kṛṣṇa saumyena cakṣuṣā
sasvajāno hyahaṃ dorbhyāṃ prāpsyāmi vipūlaṃ yaśaḥ

atāpayatsainyamatīva bhīmaḥ kāle śucau madhyagato yathā'rkaḥ
atha tvidānīṃ tumule vimarde dviṣadbhireko bahubhiḥ samāvṛtaḥ

bhīmaṃ samantātsamare'bhyarohan vṛkṣaṃ śakuntā iva puṣpahetoḥ
tato'bhiyāte tava sainye sa bhīmaḥ prāduścakre vegamanantavegaḥ
vyāttānanasyāpatato yathaiva kālasya kāle harataḥ prajā vai
tato balaṃ bhārata bhāratānāṃ pradahyamānaṃ samare mahātmanā
tato dhīmānsārathimabravīdbalī sa bhīmasenaḥ punareva hṛṣṭaḥ
yudhyanhyahaṃ nābhijānāmi kiñci-- nmā sainyaṃ svaṃ chādayiṣye pramattaḥ
arīnviśokānhi nirīkṣya sarvato mahāṃśca manyuḥ punareti māṃ bhṛśam
etadduḥkhaṃ dhāraye dharmarājo yanmāṃ hitvā yātavāñśatrumadhye
nainaṃ jīvaṃ nābhijānāmyajīvaṃ bībhatsuṃ vā tanmamādyātiduḥkham
etannihatyājimadhye sametaṃ prīto bhaviṣyāmi saha tvayādya
sarvāṃstūṇānsāyakānāmavekṣya kiṃ śiṣṭaṃ syātsāyakānāṃ rathe me
kā vā jātiḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ ca teṣāṃ jñātvā vyaktaṃ tatsamācakṣva sūta kati vā sahasrāṇi kati vā śatāni hyācakṣva me sārathe kṣiprameva
madrāśca vaṅgā magadhāḥ kuṇindā ānartakāvartakāḥ pārvatīyāḥ
sarve gṛhītapravarāyudhāstvāṃ saṃveṣṭya saṃveṣṭya tato viveduḥ
rathe tavāsminniśitāḥ supītā-- stato bhallā dvādaśa vai sahasrāḥ
nārācānāṃ dve sahasre ca vīra trīṇyepa ca pradarāṇāṃ sma pārtha
adyaiva nūnaṃ kathayantu siddhāṃ mama pratijñāṃ sarvaloke viśoka
na mokṣyate samare bhīmasena ekaḥ śatrūnsamare vāpyajaiṣīt āśaṃsitānāmidamekamastu tanme devāḥ sakalaṃ sādhayantu
cchannaṃ bāṇairāhavaṃ ghorarūpaṃ naṣṭādityaṃ mṛtyulokena tulyam
adyaitadyai viditaṃ pārthivānāṃ bhaviṣyati hyākumāraṃ ca sūta
nimagno vā samare bhīmasena ekaḥ kurūnvā samare vyajaiṣīt
sarve saṅkhye kuravo niṣpatantu māṃ vā lokāḥ kīrtayantvākumāram
sarvānekastānahaṃ pātayiṣye te vā sarve bhīmasenaṃ tudantu
āśāstāraḥ karma cāpyuttamaṃ ye tanme devāḥ saphalaṃ sādhayantu
āyātīha keśavasārathī rathī śakrastūrṇaṃ yajña ivopahūtaḥ
īkṣasvaitāṃ bhāratīṃ dīryamāṇā-- mete kasmādvidravante narendrāḥ
vyaktaṃ dhīmānsavyasācī narāgryaḥ sainyaṃ hyetacchādayatyāśu bāṇaiḥ
paśya dhvajāṃśca dravato viśoka nāgānhayānpattisaṅghāṃśca saṅkhye
āpūryate kauravī cāpyabhīkṣṇaṃ senā hyasau subhṛśaṃ hanyamānā
sammuhyamānāḥ kauravāḥ sarva eva dravanti nāgā iva dāhabhītāḥ
kiṃ bhīma nainaṃ tvamihāśṛṇoṣi visphāritaṃ gāṇḍivasyātighoram
kruddhena pārthena vikṛṣyato'dya kaccinnemau tava karṇau vinaṣṭau
sarve kāmāḥ pāṇḍava te samṛddhāḥ kapirhyasau dṛśyate hastisainye
kapirhyasau vīkṣate sarvato vai dhvajāgramāruhya dhanañjayasya
divākarābho maṇireṣa divyo vibhrājate caiva kirīṭasaṃsthaḥ
pārśve bhīmaṃ pāṇḍurābhraprakāśaṃ paśyasva saṅkhaṃ devadattaṃ sughoṣam
raviprabhaṃ vajranābhaṃ kṣurāntaṃ pārśve sthitaṃ paśya janārdanasya
cakraṃ yaśovardhanaṃ keśavasya sadārcitaṃ yadibhiḥ paśya vīra
mahādvipānāṃ saraladrumopamāḥ karā nikṛttāḥ prapatantyamī kṣuraiḥ
kirīṭinā tena punaḥ sasādinaḥ śarairnikṛttāḥ kuliśairivādrayaḥ
tathaiva kṛṣṇasya ca pāñcajanyaṃ mahārhametaṃ dvijarājavarṇam
kaunteya paśyorasi kaustubhaṃ ca jājvalyamānaṃ vijayāṃ srajaṃ ca
dhravaṃ rathāgryaḥ samupaiti pārtho vidrāvayansainyamidaṃ pareṣām
ayaṃ samabhyeti tavāntikaṃ balī nighnankurūṃścitra iva graho'rjunaḥ
samṛddhakāmo'si hatāstavāhitā balaṃ tavāyuśca cirāya vardhatām
dadāni te grāmavarāṃścaturdaśa priyākhyāne sārathe suprasannaḥ
dāsīśataṃ cāpi rathāṃśca viṃśatiṃ yadarjunaṃ vedayase viśoka
śrutvā tu rathanirghoṣaṃ siṃhanādaṃ ca saṃyuge
arjunaḥ prāha govindaṃ śīghraṃ vāhaya vājinaḥ
eṣa gacchāmi sukṣipraṃ yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ

tyaktvā prāṇānmahārāja senāṃ tava mamarda ha

nyavartanta tadā śūrā mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam

tatra me buddhirutpannā vāhayātra rathaṃ mama
mā sma karṇo raṇe pārthānsṛñjayāṃśca mahārathān

asajjamāno rādheya taṃ yāhi prati bhārata
śikhaṇḍinaṃ sātyakiṃ ca dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam
nakulaṃ sahadevaṃ ca vaśagāṃste samīkṣya tu
tvaṃ karṇa pratiyāhyenaṃ nāstyanyo hi dhanurdharaḥ
na taṃ paśyāmi loke'smiṃstvatto hyanyaṃ dhanurdharam
arjunaṃ samare kruddhaṃ yo velāmiva vārayet
na cāsya rakṣāṃ paśyāmi pārśvato na ca pṛṣṭhataḥ
tvaṃ hi kṛṣṇau raṇe śakto yoddhumetau parantapau
vanasthitaṃ yathā vyāghraṃ jahi karṇa dhanañjayam
dravatāmatha teṣāṃ tu nānyo'sti yudhi mānavaḥ
ete tvāṃ kuravaḥ sarve dvīpamāsādya saṃyuge

tāṃ dhṛtiṃ kururādheya tataḥ pratyehi pāṇḍavam
paśya bāhvorbalaṃ me'dya śikṣitasya ca paśya me
kṛṣṇau ca puruṣavyāghra tataḥ satyaṃ bravīmi te
nāhatvā yudhi tau vīrau vyapayāsye kathañcana
śiśye vā nihatastābhyāmanityo hi raṇe jayaḥ
kṛtārtho'dya bhaviṣyāmi hatvā vāpyatha vā hataḥ
