jaghāna cāśvānkṛtavarmaṇaḥ śubhān dhvajaṃ ca ciccheda tavātmajasya ha
tataḥ prakīrṇaṃ sumahadvalaṃ tava prapīḍitaṃ saviturivaujasā bhṛśam
tataḥ prayātaṃ tvaritaṃ dhanañjayaṃ śatakratuṃ vṛtranijaghruṣaṃ yathā samanvadhāvanpunarutthitairdhvajai rathaiḥ suyuktairapare yuyutsavaḥ
kurupravīrāḥ saha pṛñjayairyathā surārayo devapatiṃ yathā tathā
jayepsavaḥ svargamanāya cotsukāḥ patanti nāgāśvarathāḥ parantapa
tathaiva sarve bahavaśca vivyadhuḥ śaraiḥ sumuktairitaretaraṃ pṛthak
śarāndhakāre tu mahātmabhiḥ kṛte mahāmṛdhe yodhavaraiḥ parasparam
caturdiśo vai vidiśaśca pārthiva prabhā ca sūryasya tamovṛtā'bhavat
sa pakṣisaṅghācaritamākāśaṃ pūrayañśaraiḥ dhanañjayo mahābāhuḥ kurūṇāmantako'mayat
gātrāṇi prācchinatpārthaḥ śirāṃsi ca cakarta ha
catuḥ śatā rathavarā hatāḥ petuḥ kirīṭinā
visphāritaṃ ca gāṇḍīvamatyāsīdbhairavasvanam sughoṣaṃ vajraniṣpeṣaṃ stanayanniva toyadaḥ
utsṛjya ca mahābāhuṃ bhīmasenaṃ tathā raṇe
samāgamya ca bhīmena mantrayitvā ca phalgunaḥ
gadāpāṇiṃ tadā dṛṣṭvā bhīmaṃ bhārata bhāratāḥ
gadāpāṇiṃ tato bhīmaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhārata tāvakāḥ
sa matta iva mātaṅgaḥ saṅkruddhaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ
vigāhya ca gajānīkaṃ pragṛhya mahatīṃ gadām
na hyatrāsīdanirbhinno rathaḥ sādī hayo gajaḥ
na jahau samaraṃ prāpya phalgunaṃ śatrutāpanam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vikramaṃ tasya kuravaḥ savyasācinaḥ
te hitvā samare pārthaṃ vadhyamānāśca sāyakaiḥ
kuravo hi mahārāja nirviṣāḥ pannagā iva
sambhagnaṃ hi balaṃ dṛṣṭvā balātpārthena tāvakam
sañcintayitvā pārthasya vadhe dadhre manaḥ śvasan
tataḥ karṇaḥ kuruṣu pradruteṣu varūthinā śvetahayena rājan
śatānīkaṃ sutasomaṃ ca bhallai-- ravākiraddhanuṣī cāpyakṛntat
tasyārdhacandraistribhiruccakarta prahasya bāhū ca śiraśca karṇaḥ
putre hate krodhaparītayetāḥ karṇaḥ śinīnāṃ pravaraṃ jighāṃsuḥ
tamasya ciccheda śaraṃ śikhaṇḍī tribhistribhiśca pratutoda karṇam
śikhaṇḍinaḥ kārmukaṃ ca dhvajaṃ ca cchittvā kṣurābhyāṃ nyahanatsujātaḥ
athākrande tumule vartamāne dhārṣṭadyumne nihate tatra kṛṣṇaḥ
apāñcālyaṃ kriyate yāhi pārtha karṇaṃ jahīlābravīdrājasiṃha
tato'pare bhārata duṣprakampyāḥ pāñcālānāṃ rathasaṅghāḥ sametāḥ
visphārya gāṇḍīvamathograghoṣaṃ jyayā samāhatya tale bhṛśaṃ ca
tau rājaputrau tvaritau rathābhyāṃ karṇāya yātāvaribhirviṣaktau
karṇaṃ bibheduḥ sahitāḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ sannardamānāḥ saha pārṣatena
te pañca pāñcālarathāḥ sametā vaikartanaṃ karṇamabhidravantaḥ
teṣāṃ dhanūṃṣi dhvajavājisūtāṃ-- stūrṇaṃ patākāśca nikṛtya bāṇaiḥ
sādridrumā syātpṛthivī viśīrṇe-- tyatīva matvā janatā vyapīdat
śikhaṇḍinaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ parābhina-- cchitaiḥ śaraiḥ ṣaḍbhirathottamaujasam
parājitāḥ pañca mahārathāstu te mahāhave sūtasutena māriṣa
tataḥ śinīnāmṛṣabhaḥ śitaiḥ śarai-- rnikṛtya karṇaprahitāniṣūnvahūn
kṛpo'tha bhojaśca tavātmajastathā svayaṃ ca karṇo niśitairatāḍayat
babhūva durdharṣataraḥ sa sātyakiḥ śarannabhomadhyagato yathā raviḥ
punaḥ samāsthāya rathānsudaṃśitāḥ śinipravīraṃ jugupuḥ parantapāḥ
tato'bhavadyuddhamatīva dāruṇaṃ tavāhitānāṃ tava sainikaiḥ saha
ālokya tau caiva parasparaṃ tataḥ samaṃ ca śūrau ca sasārathī tadā
tayo rathau sārathisampracoditau samaṃ rathau tau mahasā samīyatuḥ
diṣṭyā'si duḥśāsana adya dṛṣṭaḥ kṣaṇaṃ pratīcche sahavṛddhi mūlam
ciroditaṃ yanmayā te sabhāyāṃ kṛṣṇābhimarśena gṛhāṇa mattaḥ
sa evamuktastu tato mahātmā duḥśāsano vākyamuvāca vīraḥ
sarvaṃ smaranneva visaṃsmarāmi udīryamāṇaṃ śṛṇu bhīmasena
smarāmi cātmaprabhavaṃ cirāya yajjātuṣe veśmani rātryahāni
viśvāsahīnā mṛgayāṃ caranto vasanti sarvatra nirākṛtāstu
mahābhayaṃ rātryahāni smaranta-- stathopabhogācca sukhācca hīnāḥ
māyāṃ yūyaṃ kāmapi sampraviṣṭā yato vṛtaḥ kṛṣṇayā phalguno vaḥ
ekā vṛtā pañcabhiḥ sābhipannā hyalajjamāneśca parasparasya
smare sabhāyāṃ subalātmajena dāsīkṛtā yatsaha kṛṣṇayā ca
ityevamuktastu tavātmajena pāṇḍoḥ sutaḥ kopavaśaṃ bhṛśaṃ
dhanuḥ kṣurābhyāṃ dhvajameva cācchinat lalāṭamapyasya bibheda patriṇā
śiraśca kāyātprajahāra sāratheḥ sa rājaputro'nyadavāpya kārmukaṃ
sara rājaputreṇa samārcchadugra-- duḥśāsanena nikṛto nikṛtyā
dhanucchittvā bhīmasenasya saṅkhye ṣaḍbhiḥ śaraiḥ sārathimabhyavidhyat
sa kārmukaṃ gṛhya tu bhārasādhanaṃ bhīmastadā rājaputraṃ hyavidhyat
tatastu rājanvirathaṃ mahātmā duḥśāsano bhīmasenaṃ cakāra
nihatya saṅkhye caturo'sya bāhā-- ñchittvā ratheṣāṃ punareva cākṣipat
tataḥ kṣitisvo hyabaruhya yānā-- dvṛkodaro madayā tasya vāhān
yamakṣayaṃ preṣayitvā mahātmā rathaṃ samākarpata rājasūnoḥ
sa tena viddho hyurasi hyaprameyo gadāṃ tasmai visasarjāprameyām
saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya tathā pratijñā-- mugrāmasau rājaputrau vyaṣīdat
pragṛhya vajrāśanitulyavegāṃ gadāṃ kareṇātha vṛkodaro ruṣā
nipātayitvā pṛthivītale bhṛśaṃ sa tājayāmā vṛkodaro balī
atīva santāḍitabhinnagātro duḥśāsano vai nipapāta bhūmau
ākramya kaṇṭhe yudhi rājaputraṃ saṃraktanetro hyabravīddhārtarāṣṭram
tadbrūhi kiṃ tvaṃ parimārgamāṇo hyasmānparābhūya ihāgataḥ punaḥ
duḥśāsanaṃ kaṇṭhadeśe pramṛdraṃ-- stataḥ krūraṃ bhīmasenaścakāra
kataṃ vyaṃsayitvā sahasā sasāra balādasau dhārtarāṣṭrastarasvī
mṛgaṃ muhuḥ siṃhaśiśuryathā vane tathāśvabhidrutya mahābalaṃ balī
nigṛhya cainaṃ parameṇa karmaṇā utkṣipya cotkṣipya ca tūrṇamenam
bhūmau tadā niṣpipeṣātha vīra asiṃ vikośaṃ vimalaṃ cakāra
taṃ pātayitvā tu vṛkodaro'tha jagarja harṣeṇa vinādayandiśaḥ
duḥśāsanaṃ tatra samīkṣya rāja-- nbhīmo mahābāhuracintyakarmā
smṛtvā ca keśagrahaṇaṃ ca devyā vastrāpahāraṃ ca rajasvalāyāḥ
jajvāla kopādatha bhīmasena ājyaprasikto hi yathā hutāśaḥ
tatrāha karṇaṃ ca suyodhanaṃ ca kṛpaṃ drauṇiṃ kṛtavarmāṇameva
tathā tu vikramya rame vṛkodaro mahāgajaṃ kesariko yathaiva nigṛhya duḥśāsanamekavīraḥ suyodhanasyādhiratheḥ samakṣam
asiṃ samudyamya sitaṃ sudhāraṃ kaṇṭhe padākramya ca vepamānam
ye rājasūyāvabhṛthe pavitrā jātāḥ kachā yājñasenyā durātman
te pāṇinā katareṇāvakṛṣṭā-- stadbrūhi tvāṃ pṛcchati bhīmasenaḥ
śrutvā tu tadbhīmavacaḥ sughoraṃ duḥśāsano bhīmasenaṃ nirīkṣya
jajvāla bīmaṃ sa tadā smayena saṃśṛṇvatāṃ kauravasomakānām uktastadājau sa tathā saroṣaṃ jagāda bhīmaṃ parivṛttanetraḥ
ayaṃ karikarākāraḥ pīnastanavimardanaḥ gosahasrapradātā ca kṣatriyāntakaraḥ karaḥ
anena yājñasenyā me bhīma keśā vikarṣitāḥ
evaṃ tvasau rājasutaṃ niśamya bruvantamājau vinipīḍya vakṣaḥ
bhīmo balāttaṃ pratigṛhya dorbhyā-- muccairnanādātha samastayodhān
uvāca yasyāsti balaṃ sa rakṣa-- tvasau bhavedadya nirastabāhuḥ
duḥśānaṃ jīvitaṃ protsṛjanta-- mākṣipya yodhāṃstarasā mahābalaḥ
evaṃ kruddho bhīmasenaḥ kareṇa utpāṭayāmāsa bhujaṃ mahātmā
duḥśāsanaṃ tena sa vīramadhye jaghāna vajrāśanisannibhena
kaṇṭhe samākramya ca vepamānaṃ kṛtvā'nu rūpaṃ paramaṃ sughoram
kālāntakābhyāṃ sadṛśaṃ tadānīṃ vidārya vakṣaśca mahārathasya
duḥśāsanasya nipuśāsanasya uddhṛtya vakṣaḥ patitasya bhūmau
tato'pibacchoṇitamasya koṣṇa-- māsvādya cāsvādya ca vīkṣamāṇaḥ
kruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo nijagāda vākyaṃ stanyasya mātuḥ payaso'mṛtasya
mādhvīkajasyeva rasasya tasya madhośca pānādyavakasya pānāt
evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ punarutthitaṃ ta-- māsphoṭya valgantamatiprahṛṣṭam
ye bhīmasenaṃ dadṛśustadānīṃ prāyeṇa te'pi vyathitā nipetuḥ
ye cāpi nāsanpatitā manuṣyā-- steṣāṃ karebhyaḥ patitaṃ tu śastram
ye tatra bhīmaṃ rudhiraṃ pibantaṃ duḥśāsanasya dadṛśuḥ prapannāḥ
sa pītvā rudhiraṃ tasya caraṇau gṛhya bhārata
eṣa te rudhiraṃ tīvraṃ pibāmi puruṣādavat
raktārdrapāṇistu tato mahātmā gadāpāṇiḥ kāla ivāntakāle
vibhīṣayaṃstava putrasya sainya-- mitastato dhāvati vāhinīṃ te
tataḥ kṣaṇādbhārata śūnyamāsī-- dāyodhanaṃ ghorataraṃ kurūṇām
duḥśāsane yādṛśaṃ saṃśrutaṃ na-- stadavāptaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ sarvameva
śiro mṛditvā'sya punaśca śāntiṃ yāsyāmyahaṃ kauravāṇāṃ samakṣam
yā sā'patiḥ sā sapatirhi jātā yāstāḥ sapatyo'patayastu jātāḥ
paśyantu citraṃ vividhaṃ hi loke ye vai tilāḥ ṣaṇḍatilā babhūvuḥ
te cetsaṃsiddhā nidhanaṃ gatāḥ pare kiṃ citrarūpaṃ bata jīvaloke
nanarta caivātibalo mahātmā vṛtraṃ nihatyeva sahasranetraḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu nṛtyantamudagravīryaṃ kālaṃ yathā tvantakāle prajānām
mahadbhayaṃ cādhirathiṃ viveśa jaye nirāśāśca sutāstvadīyāḥ
duḥśāsane tu nihate putrāstava mahārathāḥ mahatkrodhaviṣaṃ vīrā dhārayanto mahābalāḥ
uvāca vacanaṃ karṇaṃ prāptakālaṃ hitaṃ tadā
sa tvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla pauruṣe mahati sthitaḥ
bhāro hi dhārtarāṣṭreṇa tvayi sarvaḥ samāhitaḥ
jaye syādvipulā kīrtirdhruvaḥ svargaḥ parājaye vṛṣasenaśca rādheya saṅkruddhastanayastava
hṛdi mānuṣyakaṃ bhāvaṃ kṛtvā yudvāya susthiram
bāṇaiḥ kirantaṃ pratiyāti cograṃ vyāttānanaṃ kālamivāpatantam
karṇasya putraṃ samare prahṛṣṭaṃ jiṣṇurjighāṃsurmaghaveva jambham
tato dhvajaṃ sphāṭikahemacitraṃ ciccheda dhairyānnakulaḥ kṣureṇa
athānyadādāya dhanuḥ sa śīghraṃ karṇātmajaḥ pāṇḍavamabhyavidhyat
jaghāna cāśvānnakulasya vīro raṇājire sūtaputrasya putraḥ
tato hatāśvādavaruhya yānā-- ccarmā''dade ruciraṃ barhicitram
te prāpatannasinā vai viśastā yathā'śvamedhe paśavaḥ śamitrā
tatastato vijitā yuddhaśauṇḍā nānādeśyāḥ suhṛdaḥ satyasandhāḥ
bhūmau carantaṃ nakulaṃ rathaughāḥ samantataḥ sāyakaiḥ pratyagṛhṇan
sa tudyamāno nakulo vihaṅgai-- ścacāra saṅkhye dviṣato vinighnan
nighnantamaṣṭādaśabhiḥ pṛṣatkai-- rvivyādha vīraḥ sa cukopa viddhaḥ
tasyātha kāṃsyaṃ suśitaṃ supīta-- masipravīraṃ gurubhārāsāham
kṣipraṃ śaraiḥ ṣaṅbhiramitrasāha-- ścakarta khaṅgaṃ niśitaiḥ sudhāraiḥ
punaśca pārthaṃ niśitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ stanāntare kṣipramivātyavidhyat
sa bhīmasenasya rathaṃ ca gatvā vavarṣa vai śaravarṣaṃ sughoram
pavanacalapatākā hlādino valgitāśvāḥ parapuruṣaniyuktāḥ svai rathaiḥ śīghramīyuḥ
drupadasutavariṣṭhāḥ pañca śaineyaṣaṣṭhā drupadaduhitṛputrāḥ pañca cāmitrasāhāḥ
dviradarathanarāśvānsūdayantastvadīyān bhagavata iva rudrāḥ saṅkhyayā hetimantaḥ
atha tava rathamukhyāstānpratīyustvarantaḥ kṛpahṛdikasutau ca drauṇiduryodhanau ca
śakuniśukavṛkāśca krāthadevāvṛdhau ca dviradajaladaghauṣaiḥ syandanaiḥ kārmukaiśca
sukalpitā haimavatā mahotkaṭā raṇābhikāmaiḥ kṛtibhiḥ samāsthitāḥ
suvarṇajālairvitatā babhurgajā-- stathā yathā khe jaladāḥ savidyutaḥ
tataḥ śaradvatsutasāyakairhataḥ sahaiva nāgena papāta bhūtale
jaghāna bhojasya hayānathāpatan kṣaṇādviśastāḥ kṛtavarmaṇe hayāḥ
nipetururvyāṃ vyasavo vicetanā-- stathā yathā vajrahatā mahācalāḥ
tavātmajaṃ tasya tavātmajaḥ śaraiḥ śitaiḥ śarīraṃ vyahanaddvipaṃ ca tam
sa nāgarājaḥ saha rājasūnunā papāta raktaṃ bahu sarvataḥ kṣaran
rathī dvipasthena hato'pataccharaiḥ krāthādhipaḥ parvatajena durjayaḥ
vṛko dvipasthaṃ girirājavāsinaṃ bhṛśaṃ śarairdvādaśabhiḥ parābhinat
tato vṛkaṃ sāśvarathaṃ mahādvipo drutaṃ caturbhiraṇairvyapothayat
sa pothito nāgaraveṇa vīryavā-- nparābhinaddvādaśabhiḥ śilīmukhaiḥ
kuṇindarājasya suto'parastadā sa cāpi śūraḥ sahasā samarpitaḥ
gajena vāhāñśakuneḥ kuṇindajo nināya vaivasvatamandiraṃ raṇe
rathaṃ ca saṃkṣubhya nanāda nardata-- stato'sya gāndhārapatiḥ śiro'harat
tataḥ kuṇindeṣu gateṣu teṣu prahṛṣṭarūpāstava te mahārathāḥ
tathā'bhavadyuddhamatīva dāruṇaṃ punaḥ kurūṇāṃ saha pāṇḍusṛñjayaiḥ
tataḥ śatānīkahatā mahāgajā hayā rathāḥ pattigaṇāśca tāvakāḥ
suparṇavātaprahatā yathoragā-- stathā gatā gāṃ vivaśā vicūrṇitāḥ
tato'bhyaviddhyadbahubhiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ sa vindaputro nakulātmajaṃ smayan
tataḥ śatānīkamavidhyadāyasai-- stribhiḥ śaraiḥ karṇasuto'rjunaṃ tribhiḥ
tribhiśca bhīmaṃ nakulaṃ ca saptabhi-- rjanārdanaṃ dvādaśabhiśca sāyakaiḥ
parākramajñāstu dhanañjayasya ye huto'yamagnāviti te tu menire
mādrīsutaṃ nakulaṃ lokamadhye samīkṣya kṛṣṇaṃ bhṛśavikṣataṃ ca samabhyadhāvadvṛṣasenamāhave sa sūtajasya pramukhe sthitastadā
abhyāpatatkarṇasuto mahārathaṃ yathā mahendraṃ namuciḥ purā tathā
tau tatra śūrau rathakuñjarau raṇe parasparasyābhimukhau mahārathau
tato drutaṃ caikaśareṇa pārthaṃ śitena viddhvā yudhi karṇaputraḥ
nanāda nādaṃ sumahānubhāvo viddhveva śakraṃ namuciḥ sa vīraḥ
punaḥ sa pārthaṃ vṛṣasena ugrai-- rbāṇairaviddhyadbhujamūle tu savye
tathaiva kṛṣṇaṃ navabhiḥ samārdaya-- tpunaśca pārthaṃ daśabhirjaghāna
pūrvaṃ yathā vṛṣasenaprayuktai-- rabhyāhataḥ śvetahayaḥ śaraistaiḥ
tataḥ kirīṭi raṇamūrdhni kopāt kṛtvā triśākhāṃ bhrukuṭiṃ lalāṭe
mumoca tūrṇaṃ viśikhānmahātmā vadhe dhṛtaḥ karṇasutasya saṅkhye āraktanetro'ntakaśatruhantā uvāca karṇaṃ bhṛśamutsmayaṃstadā
duryodhanaṃ drauṇimukhāṃśca sarvā-- nahaṃ raṇe vṛṣasenaṃ tamugram
sampaśyataḥ karṇa tavādya saṅkhye nayāmi lokaṃ niśitaiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ
ūnaṃ ca tāvaddhi janā vadanti sarvairbhavadbhirmama sūnurhato'sau
eko ratho madvihīnastarasvī ahaṃ haniṣye bhavatāṃ samakṣam
saṃrakṣyatāṃ rathasaṃsthāḥ suto'ya-- mahaṃ haniṣye bhavatāṃ samakṣam
paścādvadhiṣye tvāmapi sampramūḍha-- mahaṃ haniṣye'rjuna ājimadhye
tamadya mūlaṃ kalahasya saṅkhye duryodhanāpāśraya jātadarpam
tvāmadya hantā'smi raṇe prasahya asyaiva hantā yudhi bhīmasenaḥ duryodhanasyādhamapūruṣasya yasyānayādeṣa mahānkṣayo'bhavat
sa evamuktvā vinimṛjya cāpaṃ lakṣyaṃ hi kṛtvā vṛṣasenamājau
vivyādha cainaṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkai-- rmarmasvaśaṅkaṃ prahasankirīṭī
ciccheda cāsyeṣvasanaṃ bhujau ca kṣuraiścaturbhirniśitaiḥ śiraśca
supuṣpito vajrahato'timātro bhagno yathā sāla ivāvakṛttaḥ
taṃ pārthabāṇābhihataṃ patantaṃ samprekṣya karṇaḥ sutamāśukārī

rathaṃ rathenāśu jagāma roṣā-- tkirīṭinaḥ putravadhābhitaptaḥ - - ḷ sañjaya uvāca - - a tamāyāntamabhiprekṣya velodvṛttamivārṇavam - - b garjantaṃ sumahākāyaṃ durnivāraṃ surairapi - - c arjunaṃ prāha dāśārhaḥ prahasya puruṣarṣabhaḥ - - a arya saratha āyāsi śvetāśvaḥ śalyasārathiḥ - - b yena te saha yoddhavyaṃ sthiro bhava dhanañjaya - - a paśya cainaṃ samāyuktaṃ rathaṃ karṇasya pāṇḍava - - b śvetavājisamāyuktaṃ yuktaṃ rādhāsutena ca - - a nānāpatākākalilaṃ kiṅkiṇījālamālinam - - b uhyamānamivākāśo vimānaṃ pāṇḍurairhayaiḥ - - a dhvajaṃ ca paśya karṇasya nāgakakṣaṃ mahātmanaḥ - - b ākhaṇḍaladhanuḥprakhyamullikhantamivāmbaram - - a paśya karṇaṃ samāyāntaṃ dhārtarāṣṭrapriyaiṣiṇam - - b śaradhārā vimuñcantaṃ dhārāsāramivāmbudam - - a eṣa madreśvaro rājā rathāgre paryavasthitaḥ - - b niyacchati hayānasya rādheyasyāmitaujasaḥ - - a śṛṇu dundubhinirghoṣaṃ śaṅkhaśabdaṃ ca dāruṇam - - b siṃhanādāṃśca vividhāñśṛṇu pāṇḍava sarvataḥ - - a antardhāya mahāśabdānkarṇenāmitatejasā - - b dodhūyamānasya bhṛśaṃ dhanuṣaḥ śṛṇu niḥsvanam - - a ete dīryanti sagaṇāḥ pāñcālānāṃ mahārathāḥ - - b dṛṣṭvā kesariṇaṃ kruddhaṃ mṛgā iva mahāvane - - a sarvayatnena kaunteya hantumarhasi sūtajam - - b na hi karṇaśarānanyaḥ soḍhumutsahate naraḥ - - a sadevāsuragandharvāṃstrīm̐llokānsacarācarān - - b tvaṃ hi jetuṃ raṇe śaktastathaiva viditaṃ mama - - a bhīmamugraṃ mahātmānaṃ tryakṣaṃ śarvaṃ kapardinam - - b na śaktā draṣṭumīśānaṃ kiṃ punaryodhituṃ prabhum - - a tvayā sākṣānmahādevaḥ sarvabhūtaśivaḥ śivaḥ - - b yuddhenārādhitaḥ sthāṇurdevāśca varadāstava - - a tasya pārtha prasādena devadevasya śūlinaḥ - - b jahi karṇaṃ mahābāho namuciṃ vṛtrahā yathā - - a śreyaste'stu sadā pārtha yuddhe jayamavāpnuhi - - b ḷ arjuna uvāca - - a dhruva eva jayaḥ kṛṣṇa mama nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ - - b sarvalokagururyastvaṃ tuṣṭo'si madhusūdana - - a codayāśvānhṛṣīkeśa rathaṃ mama mahāratha - - b nāhatvā samare karṇaṃ nivartiṣyati phalgunaḥ - - a adya karṇaṃ hataṃ paśya maccharaiḥ śakalīkṛtam - - b māṃ vā drakṣyasi govinda karṇena nihataṃ śaraiḥ - - a upasthitamidaṃ ghoraṃ yuddhaṃ trailokyamohanam - - b yajjanāḥ kathayiṣyanti yāvadbhūmirdhariṣyati - - a evaṃ bruvaṃstadā pārthaḥ kṛṣṇamakliṣṭakāriṇam - - b pratyudyayau rathenāśu gajaṃ pratigajo yathā - - a punarapyāha tejasvī pārthaḥ kṛṣṇamarindama - - b codayāśvānhṛṣīkeśa kālo'yamativartate - - a evamuktastadā tena pāṇḍavena mahātmanā - - b jayena sampūjya sa pāṇḍavaṃ tadā - - c pracodayāmāsa hayānmanojavān - - a sa pāṇḍuputrasya ratho manojavaḥ - - b kṣaṇena karṇasya rathāgrago'bhavat
śvetāśvau puruṣādityāvāsthitāvarimardanau śuśubhāte mahātmānau candrādityau yathā divi
tau dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ jagmuḥ sarvasainyāni māriṣa
tau rathāvabhyadhāvanta kṣatriyāḥ sarva eva hi
hastikakṣyāṃ ca karṇasya vānaraṃ ca kirīṭinaḥ
tau rathau samprasaktau tu dṛṣṭvā bhārata pārthivāḥ
śrutvā tayordvairathaṃ ca tatra yodhāḥ sahasraśaḥ
tau dṛṣṭvā puruṣavyāghrau rathasthau rathināṃ varau
siṃhaskandhau dīrghabhujau raktākṣau hemamālinau siṃhaskandhapratīkāśau vyūḍhoraskau mahābalau
tau tu sthitau mahārāja samare yuddhaśālinau
vyāśrayanta dvidhā bhinnāḥ sarve lokāstu māriṣa devadānavagandharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ
īhāmṛgā vyālamṛgā maṅgalā mṛgapakṣiṇaḥ maṅgalāḥ paśavaścaiva siṃhavyāghrāstathaiva ca
vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā rudrā devāśvināvapi agnī rudraśca somaśca pannagāśca diśo daśa
devatāḥ pitṛbhiḥ sārdhamṛṣibhiśca parantapa tumburupramukhāḥ sarve gandharvā bharatarṣabha
devarṣibrahmarṣigaṇāḥ sarve ca khacarāśca ye prāleyāḥ sahamauneyāḥ śubhāścāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
ye tvantakāle puruṣaṃ viparītamupāśritam praviśanti naraṃ kṣipraṃ mṛtyukāle'bhyupāgate
te bhāvāḥ sahitāḥ karṇaṃ praviṣṭāḥ sūtanandanam
tato devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ
vimānāni vicitrāṇi guṇavanti ca sarvaśaḥ samāruhya samājagmurdvairathaṃ karṇapārthayoḥ
evaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu dvidhā bhūteṣu bhārata āśaṃsamāneṣu jayaṃ rādheyasyārjunasya ca
īhāmṛgavyālamṛgairdipāśvarathapaṅktibhiḥ ūhyamānāḥ pare meghairvāyunā ca manīṣiṇaḥ
vijitya karṇaḥ svidimāṃ vasundharā-- mathārjunaḥ svitpratipadyate'khilām
itīśvarasyāpi babhūva saṃśayaḥ prajāpateḥ prekṣya tayormahadbalam
nāvasthānaṃ ca paśyāmi kruddhayoḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ kvacit
anugamyāstrayo lokāḥ saha devarṣicāraṇaiḥ sarvadevagaṇāścāpi sarvabhūtāni yāni ca
kleśito hi vane pārtho dirghakālaṃ pitāmaha
vijayaḥ pāṇḍaveyasya karṇasya ca vadho bhavet
na ca vidma hyavasthānaṃ kruddhayoḥ kṛṣṇayoḥ kvacit
karṇo vaikartanaḥ śūro vijayastu nare dhruvaḥ
tattathā vyetu te rogaḥ śamāpnuta vimanyavaḥ
iti śrutvendravacanaṃ sarvabhūtāni māniṣa vismitānyabhavanrājanpūjayāñcakrire tadā
rathau tayoḥ śvetahayau divyau yuktau mahāsvanau samāsthitau lokavīrau śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ pṛthakpṛthakam
tayordhvajau hi vimalau śuśubhāte rathe sthitau
prākurvatāṃ dhvajau yuddhaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvataraṃ tadā
hayā hayānabhyaheṣanspardhamānāḥ parasparam avidhyatpuṇḍarīkākṣaḥ śalyaṃ nayanasāyakaiḥ
yadi pārtho raṇe hanyādadya māmiha karhicit
yadi karṇa raṇe hanyādadya tvāṃ śvetavāhanaḥ
hanyāṃ karṇaṃ tathā śalyaṃ bāhubhyāmeva saṃyuge
na hi me śāmyate manyuryadanena purā kṛtam
adya tā madhurā vācaḥ śrotāsi madhusūdana
diṣṭyā jayasi vārṣṇeya iti karṇe nipātite
kuntīṃ pitṛṣvasāraṃ ca prahṛṣṭaḥ san janārdana
vinādayanto vasudhāṃ diśaśca svanena sarvāndviṣato nijaghnuḥ
tathā pravṛte tumule sudāruṇe dhanañjayaścādhirathiśca sāyakaiḥ diśaśca sainyaṃ ca śitairajihmagaiḥ parasparaṃ prāvṛṇutāṃ sudaṃśitau
tatastvadīyāśca pare ca sāyakaiḥ kṛte'ndhakāre dadṛśurna kiñcana
tato'stramastreṇa parasparaṃ tau vidhūya vātāviva pūrvapaścimau
ghanāndhakāre vitate tamonudau yathoditau tadvadatīva rejatuḥ
na cābhisartavyamiti pracoditāḥ pare tvadīyāśca tathā'vatasthire
mahārathau tau parivārya sarvataḥ surāsurāḥ śambaravāsavāviva
didhakṣamāṇau sacarācaraṃ jaga-- dyugāntasūryāviva duḥsahau raṇe
tato visasruḥ punararditā narā narottamābhyāṃ kurupāṇḍavāśrayāḥ
sanāgapattyaśvarathā diśo drutā-- stathā yathā siṃhahatā vanaukasaḥ
tatastu duryodhanabhojasaubalāḥ kṛpo guroścāpi suto mahāhave
dhanūṃṣi teṣāmiṣudhīndhvajānhayā-- nrathāṃśca sūtāṃśca dhanañjayaḥ śaraiḥ
hayāṃśca nāgāṃśca rathāṃśca yudhyato dhanañjayaṛ śatrugaṇānkṣitau kṣiṇaut
tavātmajaḥ sūtasutaśca na vyathāṃ na vismayaṃ jagmaturekaniścayau
prasīda duryodhana śāmya pāṇḍavai-- ralaṃ virodhena dhigastu vigraham
hato gururbrahmasamo mahāstravi-- ttathaiva bhīṣmapramukhā mahārathāḥ
ahaṃ tvavadhyo mama cāpi mātulaḥ praśādhi rājyaṃ saha pāṇḍavaiściram
dhanañjayaḥ syāsyati vārito mayā janārdano naiva virodhamicchati
yudhiṣṭhiro bhūtahite rataḥ sadā vṛkodarastadvaśagastathā yamau
tvayā tu pārthaiśca kṛte ca saṃvide prajāḥ śivaṃ prāpnuyuricchayā tava
vrajantu śeṣāḥ svapurāṇi pārthivā nivṛttavairāśca bhavantu sainikāḥ na cedvacaḥ śroṣyasi me narādhipa dhruvaṃ hi tapto'si hato'ribhiryudhi
yathocitaṃ ca vai rājyamanujñāsyati te prabhuḥ
bhīmasenārjunau cobhau mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau vāsudevamate caiva pāṇḍavasya ca dhīmataḥ
rājyaṃ śrīścaiva bhadraṃ te jīvamāne ca kalpate
mṛtasya tu khalu kauravya naiva rājyaṃ kutaḥ sukham
śāmya tvaṃ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ śeṣaṃ rakṣa kulasya ca
mā bhūtsa kālaḥ kauravya yadā'hamahitaṃ vacaḥ
brūyāṃ kāmaṃ mahābāho mā'vamaṃsthā vaco mama
dharmiṣṭhamidamatyarthaṃ rājñaścaiva kulasya ca etaddhi paramaṃ śreyaḥ kuruvaṃśasya vṛddhaye
prayāhi taṃ ca gāndhāre kulasya ca sukhāvaham
na jeṣyati naravyāghra iti me niścitā matiḥ
idaṃ ca dṛṣṭaṃ jagatā saha tvayā kṛtaṃ yadekena kirīṭamālinā
yathā na kuryādbalabhinna cāntako na ca pracetā bhagavānna yakṣarāṭ
ato'pi bhūyānsvaguṇairdhanañjayo na cātivartiṣyati me vaco'khilam
tavānuyātrāṃ ca sadā kariṣyati prasīda rājendra śamaṃ tvamāpnuhi
mamābhimānaḥ paramaḥ sadā tvayi bravīmyatastvāṃ paramācca sauhṛdāt
nivārayiṣyāmi ca karṇamāhave mahānhi me'sti praṇayo'tha sūtaje
vadanti maitrīṃ sahajāṃ vicakṣaṇā-- stathaiva sāmnā ca dhanena cārjitām
pratāpataścopanatāṃ caturvidhāṃ tadasti sarvaṃ tava pāṇḍaveṣu
nisargataste tava vīra bāndhavāḥ punaśca sāmnā hitamāpnuyuḥ prabho
tvayi prasanne yadi mitratāṃ gate hitaṃ kṛtaṃ syājjagatastvayā'tulam
itīdamuktaḥ suhṛdā vaco hitaṃ vicintya niḥśvasya ca durmanā'bravīt
yathā bhavānāha sakhe tathaiva ta-- nmamāpi vijñāpayato vacaḥ śṛṇu
vṛkodarastadvṛdaye mama sthitaṃ na tatparokṣaṃ bhavataḥ kutaḥ śamaḥ
na cāpi karṇaṃ prasahedraṇe'rjuno mahāgiriṃ merumivogramārutaḥ
na cāśvasiṣyanti pṛthātmajā mayi prasahya vairaṃ bahuśo vicintya
na cāpi karṇaṃ guruputra saṃyugā-- dupārametyarhasi vīra bhāṣitum
śrameṇa yukto mahatādya phalguna-- stameṣa karṇaḥ prasabhaṃ haniṣyati
vasundharāyāḥ parivartanaṃ bhave-- dvrajecca śoṣaṃ makarālayo'rṇavaḥ
plaveyurapyadrivarā mahāmbudhau na cārjuno jeṣyati karṇamāhave
apāṃ pṛthivyā nabhaso nabhasvataḥ sutigmadīpteśca hiraṇyaretasaḥ
abhāva eṣāmapi sarvato bhave-- nna cārjuno jeṣyati karṇamāhave
tau śaṅkhabherīninade samṛddhe samīyatuḥ śvetahayau narāgryau
vaikartanaḥ sūtaputro'rjunaśca durmantrite te sasutasya rājan
yathā gajau haimavatau prabhinnau pravṛddhadantāviva vāsitārthe
balāhakeneva mahābalāhako yadṛcchayā vā giriṇā yathā giriḥ
yathā'calau dvau calatastathā tau yathā'rṇavau cāśu caturyugānte
yathā'calau vā calitau mahājalai-- stathā mahāstrairitaretaraṃ hataḥ
susannikṛṣṭāvaniloddhatau yathā tathā rathau tau dhvajinau samīyatuḥ
ubhau mahendrasya samānavikramā-- vubhau mahendrapratimau mahārathau
yadā'rjunaṃ matta iva dvipo dvipaṃ samabhyayādādhirathirjighāṃsayā
udakrośansomakāstatra pārthaṃ tvarasva yāhyarjuna bhindhi karṇam
chindhyasya mūrdhānamalaṃ cireṇa śraddhāṃ ca rājyādvṛtarāṣṭrasūnoḥ
tathā'smākaṃ bahavastatra yodhāḥ karṇaṃ tathā yāhi yāhītyavocan
jahyarjunaṃ karṇa tataḥ sudīnāḥ punarvanaṃ yāntvacirāya pārthāḥ
jaghāna taṃ cāpi tataḥ kirīṭī śaraistadāṣṭādaśabhiḥ sumuktaiḥ
taṃ cāpi pārtho daśabhiḥ śitāgraiḥ kakṣyāntare tīkṣṇamukhairavidhyat
jaghāna pārthaṃ navabhiḥ śitāgraiḥ kakṣyānte nāgamiva prabhinnam
tato'parābhyāṃ yudhi sūtaputro dvābhyāṃ kṣurābhyāṃ harimāśukārī
samājaghāna tvarayā mahātmā yathā surendraṃ namuciḥ prasahya
te śoṇitaṃ tasya papustadānīṃ kālasya dūtā iva pārthabāṇāḥ
karṇo'pi pārthaṃ saha vāsudevaṃ samācinodbhārata vatsadantaiḥ
parasparaṃ tau viśikhaiḥ pramuktai-- statakṣatuḥ sūtaputro'rjunaśca
samīkṣya karṇo jvalanāstramudyataṃ sa vāruṇaṃ tatpraśamārthamāhave
samutsṛjatsūtaputraḥ pratāpavān sa tena vahniṃ śamayāñcakāra
tataḥ so'straṃ dayitaṃ devarājñaḥ prāduścakre vajramamitratāpanaḥ
sahasraśo vajrasamānavegā-- ste sarvataḥ paryadhāvanta ghorāḥ
pārtheṣavaḥ karṇarathaṃ vilagnā adhomukhāḥ pakṣigaṇā dinānte
jyotiṣprabhāṃ yadvadupāgataḥ sa-- ndivākaro nāśayate kṣaṇena
pāṇiṃ svapāṇau sa viniṣpiṣya roṣā-- damarṣito vākyamuvāca pārtham
tvāṃ sūtaputro nu kathaṃ kirīṭi-- nratheṣubhirhanti śitāgradhāraiḥ
dhṛtyā hi bhūtāni yayā'jayastvaṃ grāsaṃ dadatkhāṇḍave pāvakāya
dhṛtyā tayā sūtaputraṃ jahi tva-- mahaṃ vainaṃ gadayā pothayiṣye
sametya pārthaṃ sunṛśaṃsavādī jīvannāyaṃ yāsyati kālapakvaḥ
amūmuṣatpaśyata eva te'dya hyastrāṇi karṇo'stragaṇaiḥ kirīṭin
sa pārtha kiṃ muhyasi vetsi caiva tā-- ndṛṣṭvā sametānnadataḥ kurūstvam
yayā dhṛtyā tāmasaṃ jaghnivāṃstvaṃ tatsaṃyuge tāmasāṃścātighorān
dambhodbhavaṃ cāsuramāhave tvaṃ darpotsiktaṃ vīryavantaṃ kirīṭin tayā dhṛtyā tvaṃ jahi karṇamadya pārthāhave tyaktumastraṃ samarthaḥ
anena cāśu kṣuraneminādya mayā visṛṣṭena sudarśanena
chindhyasya mūrdhānamareḥ prasahya vajreṇa śakro namucerivāreḥ
kirātarūpī bhagavānyayā ca tvayā mahātmā paritoṣito'bhūt
sa tāṃ punarvīra dhṛtiṃ gṛhītvā sahānubandhaṃ jahi sūtaputram
tato mahīṃ sāgaramekhalāṃ tvaṃ sapattagā grāmavatīṃ samṛddhām
prayaccha rājñe nihatārisaṅghāṃ yaśaśca pārthātulamāpnuhi tvam
karṇaṃ puraskṛtya nadantiṃ sarve tavāstramagryaṃ pratihatya vīrāḥ
kuru prayatnaṃ bharatapravīra dravantyamī sṛñjayāḥ somakāśca dṛṣṭvātha karṇaṃ samare prahṛṣṭaṃ tvāṃ cāpi dṛṣṭvā parihīyamānam
prāduṣkarobhyeṣa mahāstramugraṃ śivāya lokasya vadhāya sauteḥ
tanme'nujānātu bhavānsurāśca brahmā śivo brahmavidaśca sarve
iti smoktvā pāṇḍavaḥ savyasācī namaskṛtvā brahmaṇe so'mitātmā
sṛṣṭāstu bāṇā bharatarṣabheṇa śataṃ śataṃ bhīmamukhāḥ sutīkṣṇāḥ
te cākṣayāḥ pāṇḍavamabhyupeyuḥ parjanyasṛṣṭā iva vāridhārāḥ
tataḥ sa kṛṣṇaṃ ca kirīṭinaṃ ca vṛkodaraṃ cāpratimaprabhāvaḥ
tribhistribhirbhīmabalo nihatya nanāda ghoraṃ mahatā svanena
tataḥ sa bāṇābhihataḥ kirīṭī bhīmaṃ tathā prekṣya janārdanaṃ ca
sa ketumekena śareṇa viddhvā śalyaṃ caturbhistribhireva karṇam
sa rājaputro viśirā vibāhu-- rvivājisūto vidhanurviketuḥ
punaśca karṇaṃ tribhiraṣṭabhiśca dvābhyāṃ caturbhirdaśabhiśca viddhā
catuśśataṃ dviradānāṃ nipātya rathāñjaghānāṣṭarathānkirīṭi sahasramaśvāṃśca punaśca sādī-- naṣṭau sahasrāṇi ca pattivīrān
karṇaṃ ca pārthaṃ ca niyamya vāhānsarve variṣṭhāśca tato'vatasthuḥ
pracchādayāmāsa tataḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ saghoṣamācchidya ca gāṇḍivajyām
ṣaṣṭyā bibhedāśu ca vāsudevaṃ tadantare prātvaransomakāśca
tato navajyāṃ sudṛḍhāṃ kirīṭi svabāhuvikṣepasahāṃ pragṛhya
jyāchedanaṃ jyāvidhānaṃ ca tasya naivāvabudhyatsūtaputro laghutvāt
pārthasya saṅkhye dviṣatāṃ nihantu-- stadadbhutaṃ tatra babhūva rājan
śalyaṃ tu pārtho daśabhirnimeṣā-- dbhṛśaṃ tanutre prahasannavidhyat
tataḥ karṇaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ pṛṣatkai-- rviddhvā punaḥ saptabhirapyavidhyat
vibhinnagātraḥ kṣatajokṣitāṅgaḥ karṇo babhau rudra ivāntakāle
vegena gāṃ te viviśuśca rāja-- nsnātvā karṇā'bhimukhāḥ pratīyuḥ
tataḥ prajajvāla kirīṭamālī krodhena kakṣaṃ pradahannivāgniḥ
sa karṇamākarṇavikṛṣṭasṛṣṭaiḥ śaraiḥ śarīrāntakarairjvaladbhiḥ marmasvavidhyatsa cacāla duḥkhā-- ddhairyāttuṃ tasthāvatimātradhairyaḥ
śarāstu te kāñcanacitrapuṅkhāḥ sampetururvyāṃ śataśo mahāntaḥ
tataḥ śaraughaiḥ pradiśo diśaśca raviprabhāḥ karṇarathaśca rājan
sacakrarakṣā api pṛṣṭhagopāḥ karṇasya ye cāpi puraḥsarāśca
bhītā dravanti sma nihanyamānā maheṣubhiḥ pārthakarapraṇunnaiḥ
tato'rjuno vai bharatapravīro mahānubhāvaḥ samare nihantā
atho palāyanta vihāya karṇaṃ tavātmajā ye kuravaśca śiṣṭāḥ
sarve praṇeśuḥ kuravo vibhagnāḥ pārtheṣubhiḥ samparitapyamānāḥ
bhoḥ kṣatriyāḥ śūratamāstu sarve kṣatre ca dharme niratāḥ stha yūyam
na yuktarūpaṃ bhavatāṃ samīpā-- tpalāyanaṃ karṇamatiprahāya
kṣaṇena naṣṭāḥ pradiśo diśaśca sarve tataḥ prekṣya diśo viśūnyāḥ
tato'payātāḥ śarapātamātra-- mavasthitā vai kuravo narendra
kruddhena pārthena śaraṃ visṛṣṭaṃ vadhāya karṇasya mahāvimarde
[tato jālaṃ bāṇamayaṃ mahāntaṃ sarve'drākṣuḥ kuravaḥ somakāśca
nānyaṃ ca bhūtaṃ dadṛśustadā te bāṇāndhakāre tumule'tha kiñcit
tau sandadhānāvaniśaṃ ca rājan samasyantau cāpi śarānanekān
sandarśayetāṃ yudhi mārgānvicitrā-- ndhanurdharau tau vividhaiḥ kṛtāstraiḥ
ghoraṃ tayordurviṣahaṃ raṇe'nyai-- ryodhāḥ sarve vismayamabhyagacchan
bhoḥ karṇa sādhvarjuna sādhu ceti viyatsu vāṇī śrūyate sarvatopi
ayaṃ hi kālosya durātmano vai pārthasya vairapratiyātanāya
sañcintya tūrṇaṃ praviveśa caiva karṇasya rājanśararūpadhārī
karṇo'tha pārthaṃ na viśeṣayadyadā bhṛśaṃ ca pārthena śarābhitaptaḥ
tatastu vīraḥ śaravikṣatāṅgo dadhre mano hyekaśayasya tasya ]
tato ripughnaṃ samadhatta karṇaḥ susañcitaṃ sarpamukhaṃ jvalantam
tataḥ prajajvāla diśo nabhaśca ulkāśca ghorāḥ śataśaḥ prapetuḥ
tasmiṃstu nāge dhanuṣi prayukte hāhākṛtā lokapālāḥ saśakrāḥ
sa sūtaputrastamapāṅgadeśe avāṅmukhaṃ sandhayati sma roṣāt
na taṃ sma jānāti mahānubhāva-- mapāṅgadeśe'bhiniviṣṭamājau
[na cāpi taṃ bubudhe sūtaputro bāṇe praviṣṭaṃ yogabalena nāgam
daśaśatanayano'hiṃ dṛśya bāṇe praviṣṭaṃ nihata iti suto me srastagātro babhūva jalajakusumayoniḥ śreṣṭhabhāvo jitātmā tridaśapatimavocanmā vyathiṣṭhā jaye śrīḥ
tato'bravīnmadrarājo mahātmā dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ prahiteṣu tamugram
grīvāyataḥ karṇa na saṃhito'yaṃ samīkṣya sandhatsva śaraṃ paraghnam
na sandhatte dviḥ śaraṃ śalya karṇo na mādṛśā jihmayudvā bhavanti
itīdamuktvā visasarja taṃ śaraṃ prayatnato varṣagaṇābhipūjitam
hatosi re phalguna ityadhikṣipa-- nnuvāca coccairniramūrjitāṃ vṛṣaḥ
rathasya cakraṃ sahasā nipīḍya pañcāṅgulaṃ majjayati sma vīraḥ
[divyāśca vācaḥ sahasā babhūvu-- rdivyāni puṣpāṇyatha siṃhanādāḥ tasmiṃstathā vai dharaṇīṃ nimagne rathe prayatnānmadhusūdanasya ]
tataḥ kirīṭaṃ bahuratnacitraṃ jaghāna nāgo'rjunamūrdhato balāt
svayaṃ kṛtaṃ yadvidhinā svayambhuvā mahārharūpaṃ dviṣatāṃ bhayaṅkaram
nijaghnate devaripūnsureśvaraḥ svayaṃ dadau yaddhi mudā'rjunāya
mahīviyaddyosalilāni vāyunā prasahya rugṇāni vighūrṇitāni vā
itīva śabdaṃ bhuvaneṣu tattathā janā vyavasyanti diśaśca vihvalāḥ
vinā kirīṭaṃ* śuśubhe sa pārthaḥ śyāmo yuvā śaila triśṛṅgaiḥ
tamutpatantaṃ dvipadāṃ variṣṭho dṛṣṭvā vacaḥ pārthamuvāca kṛṣṇaḥ
uvāca ko nveṣa mamādya nāgaḥ kṣayāya nāgādgaruḍasya vakram
yo'sau tvayā khāṇḍave citrabhānuṃ santarpayāṇena dhanurdhareṇa
sa eṣa tadvairamanusmaranvai tvāṃ prārthayatyātmavadhāya nūnam
tataḥ sa jiṣṇuḥ parivṛtya roṣā-- cciccheda ṣaḍbhirniśitaiḥ sudhāraiḥ
nāgaṃ viyattiryagivotpatataṃ sa cchinnagātro nipapāta bhūmau
[gate ca tasminbhujage kirīṭinā svayaṃ vibhuḥ pārthiva bhūtalādatha
samujjahārāśu punaḥ patantaṃ rathaṃ bhujābhyāṃ puruṣottamastataḥ ]
karṇasya pītvā rudhiraṃ viveśa vasundharāṃ śoṇitadigdhavājaḥ
tato vṛṣo bāṇanipātakopito mahorago daṇḍavighaṭṭito yathā
tadā''śukārī vyasṛjaccharottamān mahāviṣaḥ sarpa ivottamaṃ viṣam
janārdanaṃ dvādaśabhiḥ parābhina-- nnavairnavatyā ca śaraistathā'rjunam
śareṇa ghoreṇa punaśca pāṇḍavaṃ vidārya karṇo vyanadajjahāsa ca
tamasya harṣaṃ mamṛṣe na pāṇḍavo bibheda marmāṇi tato'sya marmavit
paraḥśataiḥ patribhirindravikrama-- stathā yathendro balamojasā raṇe
tataḥ śarāṇāṃ navatiṃ tadā'rjunaḥ sasarja karṇe'ntakadaṇḍasannibhām
taiḥ patribhirviddhatanuḥ sa vivyathe tathā yathā vajravidārito'calaḥ
mahādhanaṃ śilpivaraiḥ prayatnataḥ kṛtaṃ yadasyottamavarma bhāsvaram
sudīrghakālena tato'sya pāṇḍavaḥ kṣaṇena bāṇairbahudhā vyaśātayat
sa taṃ vivarmāṇamathottameṣubhiḥ śitaiścaturbhiḥ kupitaḥ parābhinat
tatakṣa karṇaṃ bahubhiḥ śarottamai-- rbibheda marmasvapi cārjunastvaran
dṛḍhāhataḥ patribhirugravegaiḥ pārthena karṇo vividhaiḥ śitāgraiḥ
tato rathasthaḥ sa mumoha ca skhalan praśīrṇamuṣṭiḥ subhṛśāhataḥ prabho
na cārjunastaṃ vyasane tadeṣivā-- nnihantumāryaḥ puruṣavrate sthitaḥ
tatastamindrāvarajaḥ susambhramā-- duvāca kiṃ pāṇḍava he pramādyase
naivāhitānāṃ satataṃ vipaścitaḥ kṣaṇaṃ pratīkṣantyapi durbalīyasām
viśeṣato'rīnvyasaneṣu paṇḍito nihatya dharmaṃ ca yaśaśca vindate
tadekavīraṃ tava cāhitaṃ sadā tvarasva karṇaṃ sahasā'bhimarditum
purā samarthaḥ samupaiti sūtajo bhindhi tvamenaṃ namuciṃ yathā hariḥ
śarottamaiḥ sarvakurūttamastvaraṃ-- stathā yathā śambarahā purā balim ]
sāśvaṃ tu karṇaṃ sarathaṃ kirīṭi samācinodbhārata vatsadantaiḥ
śaraiḥ śarīre bahubhiḥ samarpitai-- rvibhāti karṇaḥ samare viśāmpate
sa vāṇasaṅghānbahudhā vyavāsṛjan vibhāti karṇaḥ śarajālaraśmivān
sa lohito raktagabhastimaṇḍalo divākaro'stābhimukho yathā tathā
vivyādha pārthaṃ daśabhiḥ pṛṣatkaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ ca ṣaḍbhiḥ kupitāhikalpaiḥ
kālo hyadṛśyo nṛpa vipraśāpā-- nnidarśayankarṇavadhaṃ bruvāṇaḥ
bhūmistu cakraṃ grasatītyavoca-- tkarṇasya tasminvadhakāla āgate
na cāsya ghoraṃ pratibhāti cāstraṃ yadbhārgavo'smai pradadau mahātmā
cakraṃ ca vāmaṃ grasate bhūmirasya prāpte tasminvadhakāle nṛvīra
prāptaṃ vadhaṃ śaṃsati cāpyathāstraṃ praṇaśyamānaṃ dvijamukhyaśāpāt
magne rathe brāhmaṇaśāpamūḍho hyastraṃ ca taṃ moghamiṣu ca sarpam
amṛṣyamāṇo vyasanāni tāni hastau vidhunvanvijagarha dharmam
dharmapradhānaṃ kila pāti dharma ityabruvandharmavidaḥ sadaiva
vayaṃ ca dharme prayatāma nityaṃ cartuṃ yathāśakti yathāśrutaṃ ca sa cāpi nighnāti na pāti bhaktān manye na nityaṃ paripāti dharmaḥ
gāṇḍīvaṃ jyāṃ ca bāṇāṃśca so'numantrya parantapaḥ
tatastejomayā bāṇā rathātpārthasya niḥsṛtāḥ prādurāsanmahāvīryāḥ karṇasya rathamantikāt
sa karṇo'grasadasyāstraṃ kurvanmokṣaṃ mahārathaḥ tato'bravīdvṛṣṇivīrastasminnastre vināśite
visṛjāstraṃ paraṃ pārtha rādheyo grasate śarān
[dvitīyāṃ ca tṛtīyāṃ ca caturthī pañcamīṃ tathā
ṣaṣṭhīmathāsya ciccheda saptamīṃ ca tathā'ṣṭamīm navamīṃ daśamīṃ cāsya tathā caikādaśīṃ vṛṣaḥ
tasya jyācchedanaṃ karṇo jyāvadhānaṃ ca saṃyuge
tataḥ karṇo'rjunaṃ dṛṣṭvā svasyāstreṇa ca pīḍitam
tato'gnisadṛśaṃ ghoraṃ śaraṃ sarpaviṣopamam aśmasāramaṃ divyamabhimantryaṃ parantapaḥ
savyaṃ cakraṃ mahīgrastaṃ dṛṣṭvā daivādidaṃ mama
na tvaṃ kāpuruṣācīrṇaṃ mārgamāsthātumarhasi khyātastvamasi kaunteya viśiṣṭo raṇakarmasu
na vimuñcanti śastrāṇi śūrāḥ sādhuvrate sthitāḥ
tvaṃ ca śūratamo loke sādhuvṛttaśca pāṇḍava
na māṃ rathastho bhūmiṣṭhaṃ vikalaṃ hantumarhasi
athābravīdvāsudevo mahātmā rādheya diṣṭyā smarasīha dharmam
dharme hi baddhā satataṃ hi pārthā-- stebhyastato vṛddhisau dadāti
dharmādapetāḥ paripanthinaste tasmādgatā vai kuravo vināśam
prāyeṇa nīcā vyasaneṣu magnā nindanti daivaṃ na tu duṣkṛtaṃ svam
kṛṣṇāṃ sabhāṃ karṇa yadekavastrā-- mānītavāṃstvaṃ ca suyodhanaśca
duḥśāsanaḥ śakuniḥ saubalaśca dharmastadā te rucito na kasmāt
ānīya jitavanto vai kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
vanavāse vyatīte ca karṇa varṣe trayodaśe
na prayacchasi yadrājyaṃ kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
ācarattvanmate rājā kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
hantukāmāstadā yūyaṃ kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
sabhāyāṃ prāhasaḥ karṇa kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
upaprekṣasi rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇe śāśvataṃ narakaṃ gatāḥ patimanyaṃ vṛṇīṣveti vadaṃstvaṃ gajagāminīm
upaprekṣasi rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
yadā śakunimāśritya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
parivārya raṇe bālaṃ kva te dharmastadā gataḥ
[yadyeṣa dharmastatra na vidyate hi kiṃ sarvathā tāluviśoṣaṇena
adyeha dharmyāṇi vidhatsva sūta tathāpi jīvanna vimokṣyase hi
nalo hyakṣairnirjitaḥ puṣkareṇa punaryaśo rājyamavāpa vīryāt
prāptāstathā pāṇḍavā bāhuvīryā-- tsarvaiḥ sametāḥ parivṛttalobhāḥ
tathā gatā dhārtarāṣṭrā vināśaṃ dharmābhiguptaiḥ satataṃ nṛsiṃhaiḥ]
sa rāḍhaviddhaḥ samare mahātmā vidhūrṇamānaḥ ślathahastagāṇḍivaḥ
cacāla vībhatsuramitramardanaḥ kṣiteḥ prakampe ca yathā'calottamaḥ
rathādavaplutya nigṛhya dorbhyāṃ śaśāka daivānna mahābalo'pi
tataḥ kirīṭi pratilabhya saṃjñāṃ jagrāha bāṇaṃ yamadaṇḍakalpam
chindhyasya mūrdhānamareḥ śareṇa na yāvadārohati vai rathaṃ vṛṣaḥ
tathaiva sampūjya sa tadvacaḥ prabho-- stataḥ śaraṃ prajvalitaṃ pragṛhya jaghāna kakṣāmamalārkavarṇāṃ mahārathe rathacakre vimagne
yaśaśca darpaśca tathā priyāṇi sarvāṇi kāryāṇi ca tena ketunā
sākaṃ kurūṇāṃ hṛdayāni cāpatan babhūva hāheti ca niḥsvano mahān
nāśaṃsire sūtaputrasya sarve jayaṃ tadā bhārata ye tvadīyāḥ
jagrāha pārthaḥ sa śaraṃ prahṛṣṭo yo devasaṅghairapi durnivāryaḥ
sampūjito yaḥ satataṃ mahātmā devāsurānyo vijayenmaheṣuḥ
taṃ vai pramṛṣṭaṃ prasamīkṣya yuddhe cacāla sarvaṃ sacarācaraṃ jagat
tatastu taṃ vai śaramaprameyaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvā dhanuṣi vyayojayat
yuktvā mahāstreṇa pareṇa cāpaṃ vikṛṣya gāṇḍīvamuvāca satvaram
tapo'sti taptaṃ guravaśca toṣitā mayā yadīṣṭaṃ suhutaṃ yadi śrutam
anena satyena nihantvayaṃ śaraḥ susaṃhitaḥ karṇamariṃ mamorjitam
ityūcivāṃstaṃ pramumoca bāṇaṃ dhanañjayaḥ karṇavadhāya ghoram
kṛtyā hyatharvāṅgirasī pracoditā yathā tathā tvaṃ jahi śātravaṃ mama
tato vimukto balinā maheṣuḥ prajvālayāmāsa nabho diśaśca
sainyānyanekāni ca vipramohya gāṇḍīvamuktena tato mahātmā
pārtho'parāhṇe śira uccakarta vaikartanasyātha mahendrasūnuḥ chinnaṃ papātāñjalikena tūrṇaṃ kāyaśca paścāddharaṇīṃ jagāma
tato'sya dehaṃ satataṃ sukhaidhitaṃ surūpamatyarthasukhaṃ sugandhi ca
pareṇa kṛcchreṇa śiraḥ samatyaja-- dgṛhaṃ mahardhīnnivasanniveśvaraḥ
śarairvibhinnaṃ vyasu tatsuvarcasaḥ papāta karṇasya śarīmucchritam
dehācca karṇasya nipātitasya tejaḥ sūryaṃ khaṃ vitatyāviveśa
tadadbhutaṃ sarvamanuṣyayodhāḥ saṃdṛṣṭavanto nihate sma karṇe
tataḥ śaṅkhānpāṇḍavā dadhmuruccai-- rdṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ pātitaṃ phalgunena
tathaiva kṛṣṇaśca dhanañjayaśca haṣṭau yamau dadhmaturvārijātau
taṃ somakāḥ prekṣya hataṃ śayānaṃ sainyaiḥ sārdhaṃ siṃhanādānpracakruḥ
saṃvardhayantaśca narendra yodhāḥ pārthaṃ samājagmuratīva hṛṣṭāḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu karṇaṃ bhuvi vā vipannaṃ kṛttaṃ rathātsāyakairarjunasya
rarāja karṇasya śiro nikṛtta-- mastaṃgataṃ bhāskarasyeva bimbam
karṇaṃ tu śūraṃ patitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ śarācitaṃ śoṇitadigdhagātram
dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ bhuvi madrarāja-- śchinnadhvajenātha yayau rathena
hate karṇe kuravaḥ prādravanta bhayārditā gāḍhaviddhāśca saṅkhye
avekṣamāṇā muhurarjunasya dhvajaṃ mahāntaṃ vapuṣā jvalantam
taṃ dṛṣṭvā samaravimarda labdhanidraṃ daṣṭoṣṭhaṃ rudhirapīratakātarākṣam
na śobhate sūryasutena hīnaṃ vṛndaṃ grahāṇāmiva candrahīnam
vyūḍhoraskaṃ kamalavadanaṃ taptahemāvabhāsaṃ karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhuvi nipatitaṃ pārthabāṇābhitaptam
pāṃsugrastaṃ malinamasakṛtputramanvīkṣamāṇo mandammandaṃ vrajati savitā mandiraṃ mandaraśmiḥ
karṇaṃ tu śūraṃ patitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ śarācitaṃ śoṇitadigdhagātram
yadṛcchayā sūryamivāvaniṃ gataṃ didṛkṣavaḥ samparivārya tasthuḥ
pare tvadīyāśca raṇe viśāmpate yathāyatheṣṭaṃ pṛtanā tathā gatā
niśāmya karṇaṃ kuravaḥ pradudruvu-- rhatarṣabhaṃ kesariṇeva gokulam
kṛtvā dimardaṃ bhṛśamarjunena karṇaṃ hataṃ kesariṇeva nāgam
dṛṣṭvā śayānaṃ yudhi madrarāja-- śchinnadhvajenāpayayau rathena
karṇe hate pārthabhayātpradudruvu-- rvaikartane dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ saśalyāḥ
avekṣamāṇā muhurarjunasya ketuṃ mahāntaṃ yaśasā jvalantam
yayau sa tenaiva rathena tūrṇaṃ helīkṛtaḥ sṛñjayasomakaiśca
bhīmastu bhīmena tadā svareṇa samunnadadrodasī kampayaṃśca
āsphoṭayannṛtyati valgate ca hate karṇe trāsayandhārtarāṣṭrān
tadā rājansṛñjayāḥ somakāśca śaṅkhāndadhmuḥ sasvajuścāpi sarve
parasparaṃ kṣatriyā hṛṣṭarūpāḥ sūtātmaje vai nihate tadānīm
naitādṛśaṃ bhārata yuddhamāsī-- dyathā hi karṇārjunayorbabhūva
grastau hi karṇena sametya kṛṣṇā-- vanye hi sarve tava śātraveyāḥ
daivaṃ tu yattatsvavaśe pravṛttaṃ tatpāṇḍavānpāti nihanti cāsmān
tavārthasiddhyarthakarā hi sarve prasahya vīrā nihatā dviṣadbhiḥ
vīryeṇa śauryeṇa parākrameṇa taiścāpi yuktā vimalairguṇaughaiḥ
avadhyakalpā nihatā narendrā-- stavārthakāmā yudhi pāṇḍaveyaiḥ
tanmā śuco bhārata diṣṭameta-- tparyāyasiddhirna tu nityasiddhiḥ
etadvaco madrapaterniśamya svaṃ cāvinītaṃ manasā vicintya
dīnaistrasadbhiḥ parivṛttanetrai-- rmahī patadbhiḥ kṛpaṇā vabhūva
rathaiśca nāgaisturagaiśca nunnai-- rmahī mahāvaitaraṇīva bhāti
sahemapṛṣṭhāḥ saparaśvathāyudhāḥ śitāśca śūlā musalāḥ samudgarāḥ
citrāśca khaṅgā vimalāśca kośā gajāśca jāmbūnadapaṭṭanaddhāḥ
ṛṣṭyaśca pītā vimalāśca kośāḥ prāsāśca daṇḍāḥ kanakaprabhāsāḥ
śubhrāṇi vālavyajanāni śaṅkhā-- śchinnāvaruddhā virucaḥ srajaśca
dehāṃśca bhogāṃśca paricchadāṃśca tyaktvā manojñā nihatāḥ sukhāni
nivarta duryodhana yāntu sainikā vrajasva rājañśibirāṇi mānada
divākaro'pyeṣa vilambate prabho punastvamevātra narendra kāraṇam
etāvaduktvā virarāma śalyo duryodhanaṃ caiva nivartayitvā
yuddhāya rājanviniviṣṭabuddhi-- rhā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇam
taṃ droṇaputrapramukhā narendrāḥ sarve samāśvāsya tataḥ prajagmuḥ
nirīkṣamāṇā dhvajamarjunasya rathaṃ ca divyaṃ yaśasā jvalantam
naivāvatasthuḥ kuravaḥ samīkṣya pravrājitā naradevā yathā'kṣaiḥ
vadhena karṇasya suduḥkhitāste hā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇāḥ
spṛṣṭvā karāgraiḥ kṣatajānurūpaiḥ snātuṃ tadā'gādaparaṃ samudram
itīva sañcintya surarṣabhāśca samprasthitāste tu yathāniketam
sañcintya sarvā janatā visasru-- ryathāsukhaṃ khe ca mahītale ca
tadadbhutaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ bhayaṅkaraṃ niśāmya yuddhaṃ kuruvīramukhyayoḥ
sadevagandharvamanuṣyacāraṇai-- rmaharṣibhiryakṣamahoragairapi jayābhivṛddhyā parayā'bhipūjitau nihatya karṇaṃ paramāhave tadā
tatrādbhutamapaśyāma tava putrasya pauruṣam yadekaḥ sahitānsarvānraṇe'yudhyata pāṇḍavān
na taṃ deśaṃ prapaśyāmi yatra yātā bhayārditāḥ
gatānāṃ yatra vai mokṣaḥ pāṇḍavātkiṃ gatena vaḥ
alpaṃ ca balameteṣāṃ kṛṣṇau ca bhṛśavikṣatau
mṛto duḥkhaṃ na jānīte pretya cānantyamaśnute
śṛṇudhvaṃ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yāvantaḥ stha samāgatāḥ
yadā śūraṃ ca bhīruṃ ca mārayatyantako mayaḥ
ko na mūḍho na yudhyeta mādṛśaḥ kṣatriyavrataḥ
na yuddhadharmācchreyo hi panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ
evaṃ bruvati putre te sainikā bhṛśavikṣatāḥ
dṛṣṭvā tu sainyaṃ parivṛtyamānaṃ putreṇa te madrapatistadānīm
āhṛtya sa yaśo dīptaṃ suyuddhenātmano bhuvi
varṣitvā śaravarṣāṇi pratāpya ripuvāhinīm śrīmāniva sahasrāṃśurjvalansarvānpratāpya ca
saddhyaḥ sadā satpuruṣaḥ sa hato dvairathe vṛṣā
sa dātṝṇāṃ priyo rājandātā caiva manorathān
ādāya tava putrāṇāṃ jayāśāṃ sarma varma ca
hate ca karṇe sarito na sasru-- rjagāma cāstaṃ kaluṣo divākaraḥ
śveto grahaśca jvalitārkavarṇo yamasya putro'bhyuditaḥ sa tiryak
nabhaścacālātha nanāda corvī vavuśca vātāḥ paruṣāśca ghorāḥ
bṛhaspatiḥ samparivārya rohiṇīṃ babhūva candrārkasamo viśāmpate
hate karṇe na diśo vipracārāḥ sacandrārkā dyaurvicacāla bhūmiḥ
papāta colkā jvalanaprabhā ca niśācarā hṛṣṭatarā babhūvuḥ
śaśiprakāśānanamarjuno yadā jahāra karṇasya śiraḥ śareṇa
tato'ntarikṣe sahasaiva śabdo babhūva hāheti surairvimuktaḥ
rarāja rājanparameṇa tejasā yathā purā vṛtravadhe śatakratuḥ
narottamau yādavapāṇḍunandanau divākarau dīptahutāśanāviva raṇājire vītabhayau virejatuḥ samānayogāviva viṣṇuvāsavaiḥ
tato dhanurjyātalaneminisvanaiḥ prasahya kṛtvā ca ripūngataprabhān
sa sādhayitvā ca ripūñśaraughaiḥ kapidhvajaḥ pakṣivaradhvajaśca pradadhmatuḥ śaṅkhavarau sughoṣau manāṃsyarīṇāmupatāpayantau
cucumbatuḥ śaṅkhavarau nṛṇāṃ varau vighoṣayantau vijayaṃ jagattraye
tau śaṅkhaśabdena ninādayantau vanāni śailānsarito guhāśca
vitrāsayantau tava putrasenāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraṃ nandayituṃ prayātau
tataḥ prajagmuḥ kuravo javena śrutvaiva śaṅkhasvanamīryamāṇam
vihāya madrādhipatiṃ patiṃ ca duryodhanaṃ bhārata bhāratānām
mahāhave taṃ bahuśobhamānaṃ dhanañjayaṃ yodhagaṇaiḥ sametāḥ
rāvaṇaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasā rāghaveṇa vā
kṛtavarmā raṇe tūrṇaṃ vṛto bhārata tāvakaiḥ
jīvaneṣu ca rājyeṣu dāreṣu ca dhaneṣu ca
tato yudhiṣṭhiraṃ tatra niviṣṭaṃ vai mudānvitam
dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca pāṇḍavānāṃ ca ye rathāḥ
vāsudevaśca kaunteyaṃ praṇayādidamabravīt adya rājanhatāḥ sarve dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ
hate vaikartane karṇe rathānāṃ pravare rathe
tvaṃ hi śakto bhayāttrātuṃ yasya kasyacidāhave
tvamasya jagato goptā pāṇḍavānāṃ ca sarvadā
tvāṃ samāsādya śakro'pi modate divi nityaśaḥ
tvayā nāthena govinda nāthavanto vayaṃ yudhi
svapsyāmyadya sukhaṃ kṛṣṇanidrāṃ lapsye tvahaṃ kṣapām
vigataṃ hi bhayaṃ me'dya tvatprasādānna saṃśayaḥ
yasya te bhrātaraḥ śūrā bhīmasenādayo nṛpa
arhate ca bhavānnityaṃ priyaṃ nityaṃ ca madvitam
priyo hi me tvametena vacanena narottama
sa dadarśa raṇe karṇaṃ śayānaṃ puruṣarṣabham
saputraṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā karṇaṃ rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca nihataṃ karṇaṃ sa putraṃ pārthasāyakaiḥ
śrutvaitadapriyaṃ rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ papāta bhūmau niśceṣṭaḥ kauravyaḥ paramāsanāt
sa daivaṃ paramaṃ mene bhavitavyaṃ ca bhārata
jagāma śibiraṃ bhūyo hate karṇe mahātmani
sa dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ śalyaṃ rājānaṃ ca suyodhanam
tathaiva pāṇḍavīṃ senāṃ nihatāṃ prekṣya sañjayaḥ
evaṃ mahāyuddhamidaṃ mahātmano dhanañjayasyādhiratheśca yaḥ paṭhet
sa samyagiṣṭasya makhasya yatphalaṃ tadāpnuyādyaḥ śṛṇuyācca nityaśaḥ
makho hi viṣṇurbhagavānsanātano vahanti yaṃ cāpyanilendubhānavaḥ
ato'nasūyuḥ śṛṇuyātpaṭhecca yaḥ sa sarvalokāṃśca jayetsukhī bhavet
vidīryamāṇaṃ ca balaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā suyodhanaḥ
pāṇḍavaiḥ prāptakālaṃ ca kiṃ prāpadyata kauravaḥ
na hi tṛpyāmi pūrveṣāṃ śṛṇvānaścaritaṃ mahat
sa daivaṃ balavanmatvā prabhāte vimale sati
sa praviśya purīṃ sūto bhūjāvucchritya duḥkhitaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvaiva pure rājañjanaḥ sarvaḥ sma sañjayam
tathā sa vihvalaḥ sūtaḥ praviśya nṛpatikṣayam
dṛṣṭvā cāsīnamanaghaṃ samantātparivāritam snuṣāmirbharataśreṣṭha gāndhāryā vidureṇa ca
tameva cārthaṃ dhyāyantaṃ karṇasya nidhanaṃ prati
saṃśaptakā hatāḥ sarve kāmbhojāśca śakaiḥ saha
prācyā hatā mahārāja dākṣiṇātyāśca sarvaśaḥ udīcyāśca hatāḥ sarve pratīcyāśca narottamāḥ
duryodhano hato rājā yayoktaṃ pāṇḍavena ha
tava putrā hatāḥ sarve draupadeyāśca bhārata
te caiva bhrātaraḥ pañca vāsudevo'tha sātyakiḥ
kṛpaśca kṛtavarmā ca drauṇiśca jayatāṃ varaḥ
ete śeṣā mahārāja sarve'nye nidhanaṃ gatāḥ kālena nihataṃ sarvaṃ jagadvai bharatarṣabha
duryodhanaṃ vai purataḥ kṛtvā sarve narā hatāḥ
patitāḥ sahasā bhūmau śrutvā ghorataraṃ vacaḥ
kṛcchreṇa tu tato rājā dhṛtarāṣṭro mahīpatiḥ
labdhvā tu sa nṛpaḥ prāṇānvepamānaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ
nirīkṣya ca diśaḥ sarvāḥ kṣattāraṃ vākyamabravīt
viddhi kṣattarmahāprājña tvaṃ gatirbharatarṣabha mamānāthasya subhṛśaṃ putrairhīnasya sarvaśaḥ
evamuktvā tato bhūyo visaṃjño nipapāta ha
taṃ tathā patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā bāndhavā ye'sya kecana
sa tu dīrgheṇa kālena pratyāśvasto narādhipaḥ
tathā sarvāḥ striyaścaiva gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī
gacchantu yoṣitaḥ sarvā gāndhārī ca yaśasvinī
tatheme suhṛdaḥ sarve muhyate me mano bhṛśam
tato narapatistatra labdhvā saṃjñāṃ parantapaḥ gatirme ko bhavedadya iti cintāsamākulaḥ
adya caiva hatāñśrutvā dīryate me bhṛśaṃ manaḥ
śriyaṃ prāptāṃśca tāñśrutvā hṛṣṭa āsaṃ tadā'nagha
tvayā hīno mahābāho kāṃ nu yāsyāmyahaṃ gatim
śeṣe vinihato bhūmau prākṛtaḥ kunṛpo yathā
andhaṃ vṛdvaṃ ca māṃ vīra vihāya kva nu yāsyasi
sā kṛpā sā ca te prītiḥ sā ca rājasu mānitā
ko nu māmutthitaḥ kāle tātatāteti vakṣyati
pariṣvajya ca kaṃ kaṇṭhe snehena klinnalocanaḥ
bhūyasī mama pṛthvīyaṃ tāta pārthasya no tathā
ete cānye ca bahavo rājāno rājasattama
teṣāṃ madhye sthito yuddhe bhrātṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ
sātyakiṃ kuntibhojaṃ ca rākṣasaṃ ca ghaṭotkacam
kiṃ punaḥ sahitā vīrāḥ kṛtavairāśca pāṇḍavaiḥ
yotsyante saha rājendra haniṣyanti ca tānmṛdhe
karṇa eko mayā sārdhaṃ nihaniṣyati pāṇḍavān
te vai nṛpatayo vīrāḥ sthāsyanti mama śāsane
yaśca teṣāṃ praṇetā vai vāsudevo mahābalaḥ
evaṃ ca vadataḥ sūta bahuśo mama sannidhau
teṣāṃ madhye sthitā yatra hanyante mama putrakāḥ
karṇaśca nihataḥ saṅkhye divyāstrajño mahābalaḥ bhūriśravā hato patra somadattaśca saṃyuge
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ kṛtāstrā yuddhadurmadāḥ rājāno rājaputrāśca śūrāḥ parighabāhavaḥ
duryodhano hato yatra śalyaśca nihato yudhi
ekena samare yena hataṃ putraśataṃ mama
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā sūtaputraṃ ca pātitam
yaṃ yaṃ senāpraṇetāraṃ yudhi kurvanti māmakāḥ
acireṇaiva kālena taṃ taṃ nighnanti pāṇḍavāḥ
raṇamūrdhni hato bhīṣmaḥ paśyatāṃ vaḥ kirīṭinā
tadidaṃ mama mūḍhasya tathābhūtaṃ vacaḥ sma tat
anayasya phalaṃ tasya brūhi gāvalgaṇe punaḥ
arjunaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca ko vā pratyudyayau rathī
vāmaṃ ca yodvukāmasya ke vā vīrasya pṛṣṭhataḥ
kathaṃ ca vaḥ sametānāṃ madrarājo mahārathaḥ
nihataḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ saṅkhye putro vā mama sañjaya
yathā ca nihataḥ saṅkhye putro duryodhano mama
dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca draupadyāḥ pañca cātmajāḥ
yadyathā yādṛśaṃ caiva yuddhaṃ vṛttaṃ ca sāmpratam
abhijñānaṃ narendrāṇāṃ vikṛtaṃ prekṣya saṃyuge patitānavanīpālāndhavajāṃścaiva mahātmanām
kṛpāviṣṭaḥ kṛpo dṛṣṭvā vayaḥ śīlasamanvitaḥ abravīttatra tejasvī so'bhisṛtya janādhipam
śrutvā kuru mahārāja yadi te rocate'nagha
putro bhrātā pitā caiva svasrīyo mātulastathā
vadhe caiva paro dharmastathā'dharmaḥ palāyane te sma ghorāṃ samāpannā jīvikāṃ jīvitārthinaḥ
hate bhīṣme ca droṇe ca karṇe caiva mahārathe jayadrathe ca nihate tava bhrātṛṣu cānagha
lakṣmaṇe tava putre ca kiṃ śeṣaṃ paryupāsmahe
te santyajya tanūryātāḥ śūrā brahmavidāṃ gatim
uhyamānaśca kṛṣṇena vāyuneva balāhakaḥ tāvakaṃ tadbalaṃ rājannarjuno'straviśāradaḥ
gāhamānamanīkāni mahendrasadṛśaprabham vikṣobhayantaṃ senāṃ vai trāsayantaṃ ca pārthivān
ahaṃ kva ca kva cātmā te hārdikyaśca tathā kvanu
duḥśāsanaśca te bhrātā bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ kvanu
vāṇagocarasamprāptaṃ yudhyamānaṃ jayadratham sambandhinaste bhrātṝṃśca sāhayānmātulāṃstathā
ko veha sa pumānāste yo vijeṣyati pāṇḍavam
gāṇḍīvasya ca nirghoṣo dhairyāṇi harate hi naḥ
ātmano'rthe tvayā loke yatnataḥ sarva āhṛtaḥ
sa te saṃśayitastāta ātmā ca bharatarṣabha
bhinne hi bhājane tāta diśo gacchati tadgatam
hīyamānena vai sandhiḥ paryeṣṭavyaḥ samena vā
te vayaṃ pāṇḍuputrebhyo hīnāḥ sma balaśaktitaḥ
atra te pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ sandhiṃ manye kṣamaṃ prabho
na jānīte hi yaḥ śreyaḥ śreyasaścāvamanyate
sa kṣipraṃ bhraśyate rājyānna ca śreyo'nuvindati
aṇipatya hi rājānaṃ rājyaṃ yadi labhemahi
śreyaḥ syānna tu mauḍhyena rājangantuṃ parābhavam
dīrghamuṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasyaśuśoca ca mumoha ca
tato muhūrtaṃ sa dhyātvā tava putro mahāmanāḥ
kṛtaṃ ca bhavatā sarvaṃ prāṇānsantyajya yudhyatā
suhṛdā yadidaṃ vākyaṃ bhavatā śrāvito hyaham
na māṃ prīṇāti tatsarvaṃ mumūrṣoriva bheṣajam
ucyamānaṃ mahābāho na me viprāgrya rocane
sa kathaṃ mama vākyāni śraddadhyādbhūya eva tu
tathā dūtyena samprāptaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ pārthahite rataḥ pralabdhaśca hṛṣīkeśastacca karmāvicāritam
na tanmarṣayate kṛṣṇo na rājyaharaṇaṃ tathā
svasrīyaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhaṃ svapiti keśavaḥ
kṛtāgaso va yaṃ tasya hitaṃ me sa kathaṃ caret
sa kathaṃ maddhite yatnaṃ prakariṣyati yācitaḥ
pratijñātaṃ ca tenograṃ bhajyetāpi na sannamet
dhṛṣṭadyumnaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca kṛtavairau mayā saha
tau kathaṃ madvite yatnaṃ kuryātāṃ dvijasattama
yadā ca draupadī kliṣṭā madvināśāya duḥkhitā ugraṃ tepe tapaḥ kṛṣṇā bhartṝṇāmarthasiddhaye
iti sarvaṃ samunnaddhaṃ na nirvāti kathañcana
kathaṃ ca rājā bhuktvemāṃ pṛthivīṃ sāgarāmbarām
uparyupari rājñāṃ vai jvalitvā bhāskaro yathā
kathaṃ bhuktvā svayaṃ bhogāndattvā dāyāṃśca puṣkalān
nābhyasūyāmi te vākyamuktaṃ snigdhaṃ hitaṃ tvayā na tu sandhimahaṃ manye prāptakālaṃ kathañcana
nāyaṃ klībāyituṃ kālaḥ saṃyodvuṃ kāla eva naḥ
prāptāḥ kāmāḥ śrutā vedāḥ śatrūṇāṃ mūrdhni ca sthitam
pitṝṇāṃ gatamānṛṇyaṃ kṣatradharmasya cobhayoḥ na dhruvaṃ sukhamastīha kuto rāṣṭraṃ kuto yaśaḥ
iha kīrtirvicetavyā sā ca yudvena nānyathā
araṇye yo vimucyeta saṅgrāme vā tanuṃ nṛpaḥ
mriyate rudatāṃ madhye jñātīnāṃ na sa pūruṣaḥ
śūrāṇāmāryavṛttānāṃ saṅkrāmeṣvanivartinām dhīmatāṃ satyasandhānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kratuyājinām
mudā nūnaṃ prapaśyanti yudve hyapsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
taiḥ svayaṃ racito mārgo durgamo hi punarbhavet
ṛṇaṃ tatpratiyuñjāno na rājye mana ādadhe
jīvitaṃ yadi rakṣeyaṃ loko māṃ garhayedvruvam
kīdṛśaṃ ca bhavedrājyaṃ mama hīnasya bandhubhiḥ
suyuddhena hataḥ svargaṃ prāpsāmi na tadanyathā
ākāśe vidrume puṇye prasthe himavataḥ śubhe
aruṇāṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpya papuḥ sasnuśca tejalam
tava putrakṛtotsāhāḥ paryavartanta te tataḥ paryavasthāpya cātmānamanyonyena punastadā
tato muhūrtaṃ sa dhyātvā tava putro mahāmanāḥ
