jagrāha ca śaraiṣīkāṃ drauṇiḥ savyena pāṇinā
mahāstraviduṣaḥ pūrve ye'pyatītā mahārathāḥ naitadasraṃ manuṣyeṣu taiḥ prayuktaṃ kathañcana
dṛṣṭaiva muniśārdūlau tāvagnisamatejasau gāṇḍīvadhanvā sañcintya prāptakālaṃ mahārathaḥ
pāṇḍavāstvaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca sadā saṃrakṣyameva naḥ
aroṣastava caivāstu pārthāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ na hyadharmeṇa rājarṣiḥ pāṇḍavo jetumicchati
maṇiṃ caiva prayacchādya yaste śirasi tiṣṭhati
devebhyo dānavebhyo vā nāgebhyo vā kathañcana
na ca rakṣogaṇabhayaṃ na taskarabhayaṃ tathā
evaṃvīryo maṇirayaṃ na me tyājyaḥ kathañcana
yattu me bhagavānāha tanme kāryamanantaram ayaṃ maṇirayaṃ cāhamiṣīkā tu patiṣyati
evaṃ kuru na cānyatra buddhiḥ kāryā kathañcana
evaṃ kuru na cānyā te buddhiḥ kāryā kathañcana
sa tu garbho mṛto jāto dīrghamāyuravāpsyati
tvāṃ tu kāpuruṣaṃ pāpaṃ viṃduḥ sarve manīṣiṇaḥ
bhavitrī na hi te kṣudra janamadhyeṣu saṃsthitiḥ pūyaśoṇigandhī ca durgakāntārasaṃśrayaḥ
vicariṣyasi pāpātmaṃścirameko vasundharām vayaḥ prāpya parikṣittuṃ devavratamavāpya ca
kṛpācchāradvatācchūraḥ sarvāstrāṇyupapatsyate viditvā paramāstrāṇi kṣatradharmavrate sthitaḥ
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣāmi dharmātmā vasudhāṃ pālayiṣyati itaścordhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kururājo bhaviṣyati
parikṣinnāma nṛpatirmiṣataste sudurmate [ahaṃ taṃ jīvayiṣyāmi dagdhaṃ śastrāgnitejasā]
paśya me tapaso vīryaṃ satyasya ca narādhama
pradadau taṃ maṇiṃ divyaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt
ayaṃ bhadre tava maṇiḥ putrahantā jitaśca te
naiva me patayaḥ santi na putrā bhrātaro na ca
na vai tvamiti govinda śamamicchati rājani
vairasya gatamānṛṇyaṃ na sma vācyā vivakṣatām
śuśubhe sa tadā rājā sacandra iva parvataḥ
kathaṃ nu kṛṣṇa pāpena kṣudreṇa śaṭhabuddhinā
drauṇinā nihatāḥ sarve mama putrā mahārathāḥ
yasya droṇo maheṣvāso na prādādāhave mukham
nijaghne rathināṃ śreṣṭhaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ kathaṃ nu saḥ
kinnu tena kṛtaṃ karma tathāyuktaṃ nararṣabha
sthāṇureṣa jale magno visrabdhaḥ kuru vai prajāḥ
tāḥ sṛṣṭamātrāḥ kṣudhitāḥ prajāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatim
bhūtagrāme vivṛdve tu sṛṣṭe devāsure tadā
kiṃ kṛtaṃ salile śarva cirakālasthitena te
prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ pareṇemāḥ kiṃ kariṣyāmyanena vai
prajāḥ sṛṣṭāḥ pareṇemāḥ prajārthaṃ me pitāmaha
evamuktvā sa sakrodho jagāma vimanā bhavaḥ
na pratyabhācca yajñaḥ sa devatāstresire tathā
tataḥ sa yajñaṃ vivyādha raudreṇa hṛdi patriṇā
sa tu tenaiva rūpeṇa divistho vai vyarājata
apakrānte tato yajñe saṃjñā na pratyabhātsurān
prādravan tato devā yajñāṅgāni ca sarvaśaḥ
sa tu vidrāvya tatsarvaṃ śitikamṭho'vahasya ca
sa jalaṃ pāvako bhūtvā śoṣayatyaniśaṃ prabho
bhagasya nayane caiva bāhū ca savitustathā
tataḥ susthamidaṃ sarvaṃ babhūva punareva hi
prasanne ca punaḥ susthaṃ jagadbhavati bhārata
tataste nihatāḥ sarve tava putrā mahārathāḥ
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrāḥ pāñcālasya padānugāḥ
na tanmanasi karvyaṃ na ca taddrauṇinā kṛtam
hate duryodhane caiva hate sainye ca sarvaśaḥ
kiṃ śocasi mahārāja nāsti śoke sahāyatā akṣauhiṇyo hatāścāṣṭau daśa caiva viśāmpate
sahitāsva putreṇa sarve vai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ
pitṝṇāṃ putrapautrāṇāṃ jñātīnāṃ suhṛdāṃ tathā gurūṇāṃ cānupūrvyeṇa ye cānye'nucarā hatāḥ
papāta bhuvi durdharṣo vātāhata iva drumaḥ
na kṛtaṃ suhṛdāṃ vākyaṃ jāmadgnyasya ca sabhāmadhye tu kṛṣṇena yacchreyo'bhihitaṃ mama
na hi śrotā'smi bhīṣmasya śarmayuktaṃ prabhāṣitam
duryodhanasya ca tathā vṛṣabhasyeva nardataḥ duḥśāsanavadhaṃ śrutvā karṇasya ca viparyayam
yena māṃ duḥkhabhāgeṣu dhātā karmasu yuktavān
yathā yauvanajaṃ darpamāsthite te sute nṛpa
analpaṃ yena vai sarvaṃ śalyabhūtaṃ kṛtaṃ jagat
droṇasya ca mahārāja kṛpasya ca śaradvataḥ
kṛṣṇasya ca mahābāho nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathā'nyeṣāṃ vyāsasyāmitatejasaḥ na kṛtaṃ tena vacanaṃ tava putreṇa bhārata
kṣapitāḥ kṣatriyāḥ sarve śatrūṇāṃ vardhitaṃ yaśaḥ
dhūrdhareṇa tvayā bhārastulayā na samaṃ dhṛtaḥ
madhu yaḥ kevalaṃ dṛṣṭvā prapātaṃ nānupaśyati
dahyamānaḥ punastāpaṃ bhajate na sa paṇḍitaḥ
tasminsamiddhe patitāḥ śalabhā iva te sutāḥ
eṣā vai sarvasatvānāṃ lokeśvara parā gatiḥ
yadā śūraṃ ca bhīruṃ ca yamaḥ karṣati bhārata
tatkiṃ na yotsyanti hi te kṣatriyāḥ kṣatriyarṣabha
na kālasya priyaḥ kaścinna dveṣyaḥ kurusattama
yasya kālaḥ sa yātyagre tatra kā paridevanā
pramāṇaṃ yadi śāstrāṇi gatāste paramāṃ gatim
sarve svādhyāyavanto hi sarve ca caritavratāḥ
naite tava na teṣāṃ tvaṃ tatra kā paridevanā
hato hi labhate svargaṃ jitvā ca labhate yaśaḥ
ubhayaṃ no bahuguṇaṃ nāsti niṣphalatā raṇe
svargaṃ yānti tathā martyā yathā śūrā raṇe hatāḥ
āśiṣaḥ paramāḥ prāptā na śocyāḥ sarva eva hi
saṃsāreṣvanubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam
na kālasya priyaḥ kaścinna dveṣyaḥ kurusattama
na madhyasthaḥ kvacitkālaḥ sarvaṃ kālaḥ prakarṣati
kālaḥ pacati bhūtāni kālaḥ saṃharate prajāḥ
kālaḥ supteṣu jāgarti kālo hi duratikramaḥ
cintyamānaṃ hi na vyeti bhūyaścāpi pravardhate aniṣṭasamprayogācca viprayogātpriyasya ca
mānuṣā mānasairduḥkhairyujyante ye'lpabuddhayaḥ nārtho na dharmo na sukhaṃ yadetadanuśocati
tacca nāpnoti kāryārthaṃ trivargāccaiva bhraśyate anyonyabādhanāvasthāṃ prāpya vaiṣayikīṃ narāḥ
asantuṣṭāḥ pramuhyanti santoṣaṃ yānti paṇḍitāḥ prajñayā mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ hanyācchārīramauṣadhaiḥ
etadvijñānasāmarthyaṃ na bālaiḥ samatāmiyāt śayānaṃ cānuśete hi tiṣṭhantaṃ cānutiṣṭhati
anudhāvati dhāvantaṃ karma pūrvakṛtaṃ naram yasyāṃyasyāmavasthāyāṃ yatkaroti śubhāśubham
tasyāṃtasyāmavasthāyāṃ tattatphalamavāpnute [yenayena śarīreṇa yadyatkarma karoti yaḥ
śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā
kṛtaṃ bhavati sarvatra nākṛtaṃ vidyate kvacit
na hi jñānaviruddheṣu bahvapāyeṣu karmasu mūlaghātiṣu sajjante buddhimanto bhavadvighāḥ ]
bhūya eva tu vākyāni śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ
kathaṃ hi mānasaṃ duḥkhaṃ viprayujyanti paṇḍitāḥ
tavattasaḥ śagaṃ labdhvā sugatiṃ vindate budhaḥ
kadalīsannibho lokaḥ sāro hyasya na vidyate
kiṃ viśeṣaṃ prapaśyanti tatra teṣāṃ pare janāḥ
yena pratyavagaccheyuḥ kularūpaviśeṣaṇam kasmādanyonyamicchanti vipralabdhadhiyo narāḥ ]
yathā jīrṇamajīrṇaṃ vā vastraṃ tyaktvā tu pūruṣaḥ
vaicitravīrya satyaṃ hi duḥkhaṃ vā yadi vā sukham
karmaṇā prāpyate svargaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ ca bhārata
tato vahati taṃ bhāramavaśaḥ svavaśo'pi vā
yathā ca mṛnmayaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ cakrārūḍhaṃ vipadyate
ye tu prājñāḥ sthitā madhye saṃsārāntagataiṣiṇaḥ
samāgamajñā bhūtānāṃ te yānti paramāṃ gatim
tataḥ sarvāṅgasampūrṇo garbho māse tu jāyate
tataḥ kālāntare prāpte vyādhayaścāpi taṃ tathā
bādhyamānaśca tairbhūyo naiva tṛptimupaiti saḥ [tadā nāvaiti caivāyaṃ prakurvansādhvasādhu vā ]
yamadūtairvikṛṣyaṃśca mṛtyuṃ kālena gacchati vāgghīnasya ca yā mātrā iṣṭāniṣṭakṛtā'sya vai
aho vinikṛto loko lobhena ca vaśīkṛtaḥ
kiṃ viśeṣaṃ prapaśyanti tatra teṣāṃ pare janāḥ
yadā sarve samaṃ nyastāḥ svapanti dharaṇītale
pratyakṣaṃ ca parokṣaṃ ca yo niśamya śrutiṃ tvimām [adhruve jīvaloke'sminyo dharmamanupālayan ]
vīkṣamāṇo diśaḥ sarvāḥ śaraṇaṃ kva bhavediti sa teṣāṃ nāśamanvicchanpradruto bhayapīḍitaḥ
na ca niryāti vai dūraṃ na vā tairviprayujyate
sa tathā lambate tatra hyūrdhvapādo hyadhaḥ śirāḥ
atha tatrāpi cānyo'sya bhūyo jāta upadravaḥ
teṣāṃ madhūnāṃ bahudhā dhārā prasravate tadā
na cāsya tṛṣṇā viratā pibamānasya saṅkaṭe
abhīpsati ca tāṃ nityamatṛptaḥ sa punaḥ punaḥ
kṛṣṇāḥ śvetāśca taṃ vṛkṣaṃ nikṛntanti sma mūṣikāḥ
vyālaiśca tadvanaṃ durgaṃ striyā ca paramograyā
evaṃ sa vasate tatra kṣiptaḥ saṃsārasāgare
kathaṃ tasya ratistatra tuṣṭirvā vadatāṃ vara
sa deśaḥ kvanu yatrāsau vasate dharmasaṅkaṭe
kṛpā me mahatī jātā tasyābhyuddharaṇena hi
ucyate yattu kāntāraṃ mahāsaṃsāra eva saḥ
vanaṃ durgaṃ hi yaccaitatsaṃsāragahanaṃ hi tat
ye ca te kathitā vyālā vyādhayaste prakīrtitāḥ
yā sā nārī bṛhatkāyā adhyatiṣṭhata tatra vai
sa yastu kūpo nṛpate sa tu dehaḥ śarīriṇām yastatra vasate'dhastānmahāhiḥ kāla eva saḥ
kūpamadhye ca yā jātā vallī yatra sa mānavaḥ
sa yastu kūpapīnāhe taṃ vṛkṣaṃ parisarpati
ṣaḍvaktraḥ kuñjaro rājansa tu saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ
mukhāni ṛtavo māsāḥ pādā dvādaśā kīrtitāḥ
ye tu vṛṃkṣaṃ nikṛntanti mūṣikāḥ pannagāstathā
yāstu tā bahuśo dhārāḥ sravanti madhunisravam
bhūya eva tu me harṣaḥ śrotuṃ vāgamṛtaṃ tava
kurvanti durbudhā vāsaṃ mucyante tatra paṇḍitāḥ
carāṇāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ ca na gṛdhyettatra pāṇḍitaḥ
pratyakṣāśca parokṣāśca te vyālāḥ kathitā budhaiḥ
teṣāṃ hayānāṃ yo vegaṃ dhāvatāmanu dhāvati
[bhramamāṇā na muhyanti saṃsāre na bhramanti te
yatendriyo naro rājankrodhalobhanirākṛtaḥ santuṣṭaḥ satyavādī yaḥ sa śāntimadhigacchati ]
yāmyamāhū rathaṃ hyenaṃ muhyante yena durbudhāḥ
anutarṣulamevaitadduḥkhaṃ bhavati māriṣa rājyanāśaḥ suhṛnnāśaḥ sutanāśaśca bhārata
na vikramo na cāpyartho na mitraṃ na suhṛjjanaḥ
sa gacchati paraṃ sthānaṃ viṣṇoḥ padamanāmayam
nānāyogasamāyuktā buddhijālena saṃvṛtāḥ asūkṣmadṛṣṭayo mandā bhrāmyante tatratatra ha
kartumarhati tenaiva phala prāpsyati vai bhavān
taṃ tathā patitaṃ bhūmau niḥsaṃjñaṃ prekṣya bāndhavāḥ
sañjayaḥ suhṛdaścānye dvāsthā ye cāsya sammatāḥ
dhigastu khalu mānuṣyaṃ mānuṣye ca parigraham
yena dahyanti gātrāṇi yena prajñā vinaśyati
tadidaṃ maraṇaṃ prāptaṃ mayā bhāgyaviparyayāt [tasyāntaṃ nādhigacchāmi ṛte prāṇavimokṣaṇāt]
anityatāṃ hi bhūtānāṃ vijānāsi na saṃśayaḥ
adhruve jīvaloke ca sthāne vā śāśvate sati
putraṃ te kāraṇaṃ kṛtvā kālayogena nirmitaḥ
avaśyaṃ bhavitavye ca kurūṇāṃ saṅkṣaye nṛpa
na ca daivakṛto mārgaḥ śakyo bhūtena kenacit
ghaṭatā'pi ciraṃ kālaṃ niyantumiti me matiḥ
devatānāṃ hi yatkāryaṃ mayā pratyakṣataḥ śrutam
tatra cāpi mayā dṛṣṭā pṛthivī pṛthivīpate
dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṃ yastu jyeṣṭhaḥ śatasya vai
duryodhana iti khyātaḥ sa te kāryaṃ kariṣyati
taṃ ca prāpya mahīpālaṃ kṛtakṛtyā bhaviṣyasi
tataste bhavitā devi bhārasya yudhi nāśanam
gaccha śīghraṃ svakaṃ sthānaṃ lokāndhāraya śobhane
adharmo dharmatāṃ yāti svāmī ceddhārmiko bhavet
duṣṭaṃ rājānamāsādya gatāste tanayā nṛpa ] etamarthaṃ mahābāho nārado veda tattvavit
mā tāñśocasva rājendra na hi śoke'sti kāraṇam
na hi te pāṇḍavāḥ svalpamaparādhyanti bhārata
nāradena ca bhadraṃ te pūrvameva na saṃśayaḥ
kathaṃ te śokanāśaḥ syātprāṇeṣu ca dayā prabho
eṣa cārtho mahābāho pūrvameva mayā śrutaḥ
kṛtāntasya tu bhūtena sthāvareṇa careṇa ca
muhyate prāṇināṃ jñātvā gatiṃ cāgatimeva ca
tvāṃ tu śokena santaptaṃ muhyamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ
sa kathaṃ tvayi rājendra kṛpāṃ naiva kariṣyati
idaṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā tava devaniyogajam
vidurasya tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā tu puruṣarṣabhaḥ
kuntīṃ caiva tathā kṣattaḥ samānaya mamā'ntikam
saha kuntyā yato rājā saha strībhirupādravat
darśayanti hatā hi sma yugānte lokasaṅkṣayam
vrīḍāṃ jagmuḥ purā yāḥ sma sakhīnāmapi yoṣitaḥ
sarve hyabhimukhā rājñi yudhyamānā hatā yudhi na hi kaściddhi śūrāṇāṃ yudhyamānaḥ parāṅmukhaḥ
śastreṇa nidhanaṃ prāpto na ca kaścitkṛtāñjaliḥ
etāṃ tāṃ kṣatriyasyāhuḥ purāṇāḥ paramāṃ gatim
na cāpi śatravasteṣāṃ mucyante rājñi pāṇḍavāḥ
adharmeṇa hataṃ śrutvā bhīmasenena te sutam
prādravāma raṇe sthātuṃ na hi śakṣyāmahe trayaḥ
te hi śūrā maheṣvāsāḥ kṣiprameṣyanti pāṇḍavāḥ
teṣāṃ tu kilbiṣaṃ kṛtvā saṃsthātuṃ notsahāmahe
anujānīhi no rājñi mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
diṣṭāntaṃ paśya cāpi tvaṃ kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ ca kevalam
apakramya tu te rājansarva eva mahārathāḥ
sametya vīrā rājānaṃ tadā tvanudite raṣau
[samāsādyātha vai drauṇiṃ pāṇḍuputrā mahārathāḥ vyajayaṃste raṇe rājanvikramya tadanantaram ]
yuyudhānena ca tathā tathaiva ca yuyutsunā
ka nu dharmajñatā rājñaḥ kva nu sādyānṛśaṃsatā
ghātayitvā kathaṃ droṇaṃ bhīṣmaṃ cāpi pitāmaham
kiṃ nu rājyena te kāryaṃ pitṝnbhrātṝnapaśyataḥ
mā śuco dhṛtarāṣṭra tvaṃ naiva bhīmastvayā hataḥ
āyasī pratimā hyeṣā tvayā niṣpātitā vibho
na hi te rājaśārdūla bale tulyo'sti kaścana
evaṃ bāhvantaraṃ prāpya tava jīvenna kaścana
tava rājendra tena tvaṃ bhīmasenaṃ jighāṃsasi
na hi putrā mahārāja jīveyuste kathañcana
anumanyasva tatsarvaṃ mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
rājā hi yaḥ sthiraprajñaḥ svayaṃ doṣānavekṣate
deśakālavibhāgaṃ ca paraṃ śrayeḥ sa vindati
ucyamānastu yaḥ śreyo gṛhṇīte no hitāhite
evamuktaḥ sa kṛṣṇena sarvaṃ satyaṃ janādhipa
tataḥ sa bhīmaṃ ca dhanañjayaṃ ca mādyāśca putrau puruṣapravīrau
pasparśa gātraiḥ prarudansugātrā-- nāśvāsya kalyāṇamuvāca cainān
sarvaprāṇabhṛtāṃ bhāvaṃ satataṃ sa tu bṛdhyati
na kopaḥ pāṇḍave kāryo gāndhāri śamamāpnuhi
rajo nigṛhyatāṃ caiva śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
sā tathā yācyamānā tvaṃ yuddhakāle jayaiṣiṇā
vācā'pyatīte mā krodhe manaḥ kuru yaśasvini
kṣamāśīlā purā bhūtvā sā'dya na kṣamase katham
adharme jahi dharmajñe yato dharmastato jayaḥ
sā tvaṃ dharmaṃ parismṛtya vācaṃ coktāṃ manasvinī
kopaṃ saṃyaccha gāndhāri pāṇḍaveṣu suteṣu te
kathaṃ nu dharmaṃ dharmajñāḥ samuddiṣṭaṃ mahātmabhiḥ
adharmo yadi vā dharmastrāsāttatra mayā kṛtaḥ
na hi yuddhena putraste dharmeṇa sa mahābalaḥ
adharmeṇa jitaḥ pūrvaṃ tena cāpi yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
na tyakṣyati hṛtaṃ rājyamiti vai tatkṛtaṃ mayā
suyodhanaṃ tvasaṃhṛtya na śakyā bhūḥ sasāgarā
tatraiva vadhyaḥ so'smākaṃ durācāro'pba te sutaḥ
dharmarājājñayā caiva sthitāḥ sma samaye purā
kleśitāśca vane nityaṃ tata etatkṛtaṃ mayā
vairasyāsya gatāḥ pāraṃ hatvā duryodhanaṃ raṇe
rājyaṃ yudhiṣṭhire prāpte vayaṃ ca gatamanyavaḥ
na tasyaivaṃ vadhastāta yaṃ praśaṃsasi me sutam
śatrūṇāṃ tu prahṛṣṭānāṃ trāsaḥ sañjanito mayā
yathaivātmā tathā bhrātā viśeṣo nāsti kaścana
mā kṛthā hṛdi tanmātarna tatpītaṃ mayā'nadhe
krodhādyadabravaṃ cāhaṃ tacca me hṛdi vartate
nahi me jīvitenārtho na rājyena sukhena vā
tato bāṣpaṃ samutsṛjya saha putraistadā pṛthā
sā tānekaikaśaḥ putrānsaṃspṛśantī punaḥpunaḥ anvaśocata duḥkhārtā draupadīṃ nihatātmajām
ārye pautrāstu te sarve saubhadrasahitā gatāḥ na tvāṃ te'dyābhigacchanti ciraṃ dṛṣṭvā anindite
kinnu rājyena me kāryaṃ vihīnāyāḥ sutairvaraiḥ
maivaṃ putrīti śokārtā paśya māmapi duḥkhitāṃ
mā śuco na hi śocyāste saṅgrāme nidhanaṃ gatāḥ
etadevaṃvidhaṃ vīra sampaśyāyodhanaṃ vibho tvayā tu śrāvitaṃ karma puṣkarākṣa mahādyute
ye purā śerate vīrāḥ śayaneṣu yaśasvinaḥ
ākṣipanti śivā ghorā vinadantyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
etā dīrghamivocchvasya vikruśya ca vilapya ca
bahvyo dṛṣṭva śarīrāṇi krośanti vilapanti ca
bāhubhiśca sakhaṅgaiśca śirobhiśca sakuṇḍalaiḥ agamyakalpā pṛthivī māṃsaśoṇitakardamā
ito duḥkhataraṃ kinnu keśava pratibhāti me
sā tu labdhvā punaḥ saṃjñāṃ vikruśya ca vilapya ca
ityevaḷḷḷ pūrvaṃ naivaṃ śocāmi vai prabho
śayānaṃ vīraśayane paśya mādhava me sutam
so'vaṃ pāṃsuṣu śete'dya pañca kālasya paryayam
duvaṃ duryodhano vīro gatiṃ na sulabhāṃ gataḥ
sa śete nihato bhūmau putro me pṛthivīpatiḥ
pūrṇāṃ hastigavāśvaiśca vārṣṇeya na tu tacciram
kathaṃ tu śatadhā nedaṃ hṛdayaṃ mama dīryate
paśyantyā nihataṃ putraṃ pautreṇa sahitaṃ raṇe
tathā hyavasthitā bhāti putraṃ cāpyabhivīkṣya sā
yadi satyāgamāḥ santi yadi vai śrutayastathā
hataputrā raṇe bālāḥ paridhāvanti me snuṣāḥ
svasya bandhoḥ śiraḥ kṛṣṇa gṛhītvā paśya tiṣṭhati
pūrvajātikṛtaṃ pāpaṃ manye nālpamivānagha etābhirniravadyābhirmayā caivālpapuṇyayā
na hi nāśo'sti vārṣṇeya karmaṇoḥ śubhapāpayoḥ
sārasya iva vāśantyaḥ patitāḥ paśya mādhava
raukmāṇi caiva varmāṇi niṣkānapi ca kāñcanān
gadayā bhīmasenena paśya mādhava me sutam
priyaṃ cikīrṣatā bhrātuḥ karṇasya ca janārdana
dāsībhūtā'si pāñcāli kṣipraṃ praviśa no gṛhān
eṣa duḥśāsanaḥ śete vikṣipya vipulau bhujau
eṣa mādhava putro me vikarṇaḥ pājñasammataḥ
bhūmau vinihataḥ śete bhīmena śatadhā kṛtaḥ
vārayatyaniśaṃ bālā na ca śaknoti mādhava
sa kathaṃ nihato'mitraiḥ pāṃsūngrasati me sutaḥ
yaṃ sma taṃ paryupāsante bahudhā varayoṣitaḥ
śātakaumbhyā srajā bhāti kavacena ca bhāsvatā
pitrā tvayā ca dāśārha dṛptaṃ siṃhamivotkaṭam
yo bibheda camūmeko mama putrasya durbhidām
sa bhūtvā mṛtyuranyeṣāṃ svayaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ
hataṃ bālā patiṃ vīraṃ dṛṣṭvā śocatyaninditā
bale vīrye ca sadṛśastejasā caiva te'nagha
rūpeṇa ca tathā'tyarthaṃ śete bhuvi nipātitaḥ
kaccidadya śarīraṃ te bhūmau na paritapyate
mātaṅgabhujavarṣṇāṇau jyākṣepakaṭhinatvacau kāñcanāṅgadinau śete nikṣipya vipulau bhujau
evaṃ vilapatīmārtāṃ kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase
na smarāmyaparādhaṃ te kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase
na smarāmyaparādhaṃ me kiṃ māṃ na pratibhāṣase
pitṝnmāṃ caiva duḥkhārtāṃ vihāya kva gamiṣyasi
kathaṃ nu pāṇḍavānāṃ ca pāñcālānāṃ tu paśyatām
dṛṣṭvā bahubhirākrande nihataṃ tvāṃ pitā tava
na rājyalābho vipulaḥ śatrūṇāṃ ca parābhavaḥ
yadahaṃ tvāṃ raṇe dṛṣṭvā hataṃ jīvāmi durbhagā
parameṇa ca rūpeṇa girā ca smitapūrvayā
ṣaṇmāsānsaptame māsi tvaṃ vīra nidhanaṃ gataḥ
virāṭaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā krośanti vilapanti ca
śrameṇa ca vivarṇānāṃ vaktrāṇāṃ viplutaṃ vapuḥ
uttaraṃ cābhimanyuṃ ca kāmbhojaṃ ca sudakṣiṇam kārṣṇinā'bhihataṃ paśya lakṣmaṇaṃ priyadarśanam
taṃ paśya kadanaṃ kṛtvā śūraṇāṃ madhusūdana
kathamadya na tāṃ kṛṣṇa mānayanti sma te punaḥ
saindhavaṃ me sutā bālā praskhalantīva duḥkhitā
kinnu duḥkhataraṃ kṛṣṇa paraṃ mama bhaviṣyati
sa hatvā vipulāḥ senāḥ svayaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ
taṃ paśya kadanaṃ kṛtvā śūrāṇāṃ madhusūdana
kathamadya na tāṃ kṛṣṇa mānayanti sma te punaḥ
saindhavaṃ me sutā bālā prassvalantīva duḥkhitā
kinnu duḥkhataraṃ kṛṣṇa paraṃ mama bhaviṣyati
sa hatvā vipulāḥ senāḥ sarvayaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ
sa eṣa nihataḥ śete madrarājo mahābalaḥ
jayadrathe yadi brūyuruparodhaṃ kathañcana madraputre kathaṃ brūyuruparodhaṃ vivakṣavaḥ
āsyādviniḥ sṛtā jihvā bhakṣyate kṛṣṇa pakṣibhiḥ
yasya nāsti samo loke śaurye vīrye ca kaścan
sa eṣa nihataḥ śete bhīṣmo bhīṣmakṛdāhave
nāsti yuddhe kṛtī kaścinna vidvānna parākramī
yatra śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ śete'dya nihataḥ paraiḥ
sa gataḥ kurubhiḥ sārdhaṃ mahābuddhiḥ parābhavam
taṃ paśya patitaṃ droṇaṃ kurūṇāṃ gurumuttamam
yaṃ purodhāya kurava āhvayanti sma pāṇḍavān
sa bhūmau nihataḥ śete śāntārciriva pāvakaḥ
upāste vai mṛdhe droṇaṃ jaṭilā brahmacāriṇī
ta ete droṇamādāya gāyanti ca rudanti ca
apasavyāṃ citiṃ kṛtvā puraskṛtya kṛpīṃ tathā
snuṣāśca vividhāḥ sarvā diṣṭyā nādyeha paśyasi
eko dvābhyāṃ hataḥ śete kṣatradharmeṇa dhārmikaḥ
kinnu vakṣyati vai satsu goṣṭhīṣu ca sabhāsu ca
kinnu vakṣyasi saṃsatsu kathāsu ca janārdana
arjunasya mahatkarma svayaṃ vā sa kirīṭabhṛt
yaḥ purā hemadaṇḍābhyāṃ vyajanābhyāṃ sma vījyate
sa eṣa pakṣibhiḥ pakṣaiḥ śayāna upavījyate
sabhāyāṃ vipulaṃ rājyaṃ sa jahau jīvitaṃ katham
yathaiva mama putrāṇāṃ lokāḥ śastrajitāḥ prabho
kathaṃ ca nāyaṃ tatrāpi putrānme bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
kāṃ gatiṃ tu gamiṣyāmi tvayā hīnā janeśvara
klāntānāmapi nārīṇāṃ jahāti śrīrna vai tanūḥ
manaḥ śrutiharo nādo mano mohayatīva me
bhāsayanti mahīṃ bhāsā jvalitā iva pāvakāḥ
droṇena drupadaṃ saṅkhye paśya mādhava pātitam
etāstu drupadaṃ vṛddhaṃ snuṣā bhāryāśca duḥkhitāḥ
maheṣvāso hataḥ śete vajrāhata iva drumaḥ
droṇena samare paśya nikṛttaṃ bahudhā śaraiḥ
avadhyāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kṛṣṇa sarva eva tvayā saha
ta ime nihatāḥ saṅkhye paśya kālasya paryayam
nātibhāro'sti daivasya dhruvaṃ mādhava kaścana yadime nihatāḥ śūrāḥ kṣatriyaiḥ kṣatriyarṣabhāḥ
parasparakṛtaṃ nāśaṃ yataḥ prāpsyanti yādavāḥ ityuktavati dāśārhe pāṇḍavāstrastacetasaḥ
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha gāndhāri mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
mṛtaṃ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṃ yo'tītamanuśocati
taporthīyaṃ brāhmaṇī dhatta garbhaṃ gaurvoḍhāraṃ dhāvitāraṃ turaṅgī
śūdrā dāsaṃ paśupālaṃ ca vaiśyā vadhārthīyaṃ tvadvidhā rājaputrī
hatānāṃ yadi jānīṣe parimāṇaṃ vadasvaṃ me
koṭyaḥ ṣaṣṭiśca ṣaṭ caiva hyasminrājanmṛdhe hatāḥ
daśa cānyāni rājendra śataṃ ṣaṣṭiśca bhārata
ācakṣva me mahābāho sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ
yudhyamānā hatāḥ saṅkhye gandharvaiḥ saha saṅgatāḥ
tanme vada mahābāho śrotavyaṃ yadi vai mayā
divyaṃ cakṣurapi prāptaṃ jñānayogena vai purā
na yeṣāṃ śāntikartāro na ca ye'trāhitāgnayaḥ
vayaṃ ca teṣāṃ kuryāmo bahutvāttāta karmaṇām
teṣāṃ saṅkarṣaṇā lokā bhaviṣyanti na saṃśayaḥ
ādideśa sudharmāṇaṃ dhaumyaṃ sūtaṃ ca sañjayam
viduraṃ ca mahābuddhiṃ yuyutsuṃ caiva kauravam
ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ ca gandhāṃśca kṣaumāṇi vasanāni ca
śalyaṃ śalaṃ ca rājānaṃ bhūriśravasameva ca
dauḥśāsaniṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ ca dhṛṣṭaketuṃ ca pārthivam
śikhaṇḍinaṃ ca pāñcālyaṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaṃ ca pārṣatam
acalaṃ vṛṣakaṃ caiva bhagadatte ca pārthivam
etāṃścānyāṃsca subahūnpārthivāṃśca sahasraśaḥ dhṛtadhārāhutairdīptaiḥ pāvakaiḥ samadāhayan
sāmnāmṛcāṃ ca nādena strīṇāṃ ca ruditasvanaiḥ
te samāsādya gaṅgāṃ tu śivāṃ puṇyajalānvitām
hlādinīṃ ca prasannāṃ ca mahārūpāṃ mahāvanām
tataḥ pitṝṇāṃ bhrātṝṇāṃ pautrāṇāṃ svajanasya ca
yasya nāsti samo vīrye pṛthivyāmapi kaścana
yo vṛṇīta yaśaḥ śūraḥ prāṇairapi sadā bhuvi
sa hi vaḥ pūrvajo bhrātā bhāskarānmayyajāyata
yasyeṣupātamāsādya ko'nyastiṣṭheddhanañjayāt kathaṃ putro bhavatyāḥ sa devagarbhaḥ purā'bhavat
bhūmipānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ balaṃ balavatāṃ varaḥ
sa naḥ prathamajo bhrātā sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
aho bhavatyā mantrasya gūhanena vayaṃ hatāḥ
neha sma kiñcidaprāpya bhavedapi divi sthitam
na cedaṃ vaiśasaṃ ghorakaṃ kauravāntakaraṃ bhavet
tato vineduḥ sahasā striyastāḥ khalu sarvaśaḥ
sa rājā dhṛtarāṣṭraśca kṛtvā jalamatandritaḥ samuttatāra gaṅgāyā bhāryayā saha bhārata
ato manasi yadguhyaṃ strīṇāṃ tanna bhaviṣyati
ityuktvā sa tu gaṅgāyā uttatārākulendriyaḥ bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ sarvairgaṅgātīramupeyivān ]
kṛtvodakaṃ te suhṛdāṃ sarveṣāṃ pāṇḍunandanāḥ viduro dhṛtarāṣṭraśca sarvāśca bharatastriyaḥ
jitā seyaṃ mahī kṛtsnā dharmeṇa ca yudhiṣṭhira
kaccicchriyamimāṃ prāpya na tvāṃ śokaḥ prabādhate
idaṃ tu me mahadduḥkhaṃ vartate hṛdi nityadā
śīghrāstraścitrayodhī ca kṛtī cādbhutavikramaḥ gūḍhotpannaḥ sutaḥ kuntyā bhrātā'smākamasau kila
toyakarmaṇi taṃ kuntī kathayāmāsa me tadā
putraṃ sarvaguṇoyetaṃ karṇaṃ tyaktaṃ jale purā
sa sūryaputraḥ kuntyā yai bhrātā'smākaṃ ca mātṛtaḥ ajānatā mayā saḍkhye rājyalubdhena ghātitaḥ
na hi taṃ veda pārtho'pi bhrātaraṃ śvetavāhanaḥ
nāhaṃ na bhīmo na yamau sa tvasmānveda tatvataḥ
gatā kila pṛthā tasya sakāśamiti naḥ ścutam
asmākaṃ śamakāmā vai tvaṃ ca putro mametyatha
pṛthāyā na kṛtaḥ kāmastena cāpi mahātmanā
na hi śakṣyāmi saṃtyaktumahaṃ duryodhanaṃ raṇe
anāryatvaṃ nṛśaṃsatvaṃ kṛtaghnatvaṃ ca me bhavet
yudhiṣṭhireṇa sandhiṃ hi yadi kuryāṃ mate tava
bhīto raṇe śvetavāhāditi māṃ maṃsyate janaḥ
pañcaiva hi sutā devi bhaviṣyanti tava dhruvāḥ
sārjunā vā hate karṇe sakarṇā vā hate'rjune
bhrātṝṇāṃ svasti kurvīthā yeṣāṃ svasti cikīrṣasi
so'rjunena hato vīro bhrātrā bhrātā sahodaraḥ
na caiva niḥsṛto mantraḥ pṛthāyāstasya vā mune
tena me dūyate tīvraṃ hṛdayaṃ bhrātṛghātinaḥ
yadā hyasya giro rūkṣāḥ śrṛṇomi kaṭukodayāḥ
tadā naśyati me roṣaḥ pādau tasya nirīkṣya ha
kuntyā hi sadṛśau pādau karṇasyeti matirmama
kathaṃ nu tasya saṃgrāme pṛthivī cakramagrasat
kathaṃ nu śapto bhrātā me tattvaṃ vaktumihārhasi
kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ yathā śaptaḥ sa sūtajaḥ
buddhiṃ ca tava rājendra yamayorvinayaṃ tathā
arjunena samo yuddhe bhaveyamiti me matiḥ
samaḥ putreṣu ca snehaḥ śiṣyeṣu ca tava dhruvam
daurātmyaṃ caiva karṇasya viditvā tamuvāca ha
kṣatriyo vā tapasvī yo nānyo vidyātkathaṃcana
mayā tatra prasādaṃ me kuruṣveti punaḥ punaḥ
yatheyaṃ gaurhatā mūḍha pramattasya tvayā mama
gaccha vā tiṣṭha vā yadvā kāryaṃ yattatsamācara
sa daśyamāno'pi tathā kṛmiṇā tena bhārata
aho'smyaśucitāṃ prāptaḥ kimidaṃ ca kṛtaṃ tvayā
mokṣito narakādasmādbhavatā munisattama bhadraṃ ca te'stu siddhiśca priyaṃ me bhavatā kṛtam
kastvaṃ kasmācca narakaṃ pratipanno bravīhi tat
purā devayuge tāta bhṛgostu savayā iva
atiduḥkhamidaṃ mūḍha na jātu brāhmaṇaḥ sahet
brahmakṣatrāntare jātaṃ sūtaṃ māṃ viddhi bhārgava
rādheyaḥ karṇa iti māṃ pravadanti janā bhuvi
ato bhārgava ityuktaṃ mayā gotraṃ tavāntike
abrāhmaṇe na hi brahma ciraṃ tiṣṭhetkadācana
na tvayā sadṛśo yuddhe bhavitā kṣatriyo bhuvi
śiśupālo jarāsandho bhīṣmako vakra eva ca
viśokaḥ śatadhanvā ca bhojo vīraśca nāmataḥ
ete cānye ca bahavo dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ
tato vimardaḥ sumahānrājñāmāsīdyuyutsatām sannahyatāṃ tanutrāṇi rathānyojayatāmapi
āditkṛtabalaṃ karṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājā sa māgadhaḥ
[bāhukaṇṭakayuddhena tasya karṇo'tha yudhyataḥ ] vibhedaṃ saṃdhiṃ dehasya jarayā śleṣitasya hi
prītyā dadau sa karṇāya mālinīṃ nagarīmanu
vimuktaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ ca sahajena ca varmaṇā
na śocyaḥ puruṣavyāghra yuddhe hi nidhanaṃ gataḥ
jahi śokaṃ mahāprājña śrṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
yācitaḥ sa mayā pūrvaṃ bhrātā jñāpayituṃ tava
bhāskareṇa ca devena pitrā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
purā pratyanunetuṃ vā netuṃ vā'pyekatāṃ tvayā
amitrā naḥ samṛddhārthā vṛttārthāḥ kuravaḥ kila
vayaṃ tu lobhānmohācca dambhaṃ mānaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ
āmiṣaṃ caiva no naṣṭamāmiṣasya ca bhojinām
na pṛthivyā sakalayā na suvarṇasya rāśibhiḥ
na gajāśvena sarveṇa te tyājyā ya ime hatāḥ
yadi svasti prajāyante jātā jīvanti vā yadi saṃbhāghitā jātabalā vidadhyuryadi naḥ sukham
na te jayaphalaṃ kiṃcidbhoktāro jātu karhicit
pāñcālānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca hatā eva hi ye hatāḥ
na sakāmā vayaṃ te ca na cāsmābhirna tairjitam
na tairbhukteyamavanirna nāryo gītavāditam nāmātyasuhṛdāṃ vākyaṃ na ca śrutavatāṃ śrutam
na ratnāni parārdhyāni na bhūrna draviṇāgamaḥ
na ca dharmyānimām̐llokānprapadyāma svakarmabhiḥ vayamevāsya lokasya vināśe kāraṇaṃ smṛtāḥ
ṛddhimasmāsu tāṃ dṛṣṭvā vivarṇo hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
asaṃśayaṃ tvayaṃ rājā yathaivāhaṃ tathā gataḥ
yaśasaḥ patito dīptāddhātayitvā sahodarān imau hi vṛddhau śokāgnau prakṣipya sa suyodhanaḥ
ko hi bandhuḥ kulīnaḥ saṃstathā brūyātsuhṛjjane
ātmano hi vayaṃ doṣādvinaṣṭāḥ śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
pradahanto diśaḥ sarvā bhāsvarā iva tejasā
avadhyānāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā loke prāptāḥ sma vācyatāṃ
hatāḥ śūrāḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ viṣayo'sau vināśitaḥ
hatvā no vigato manyuḥ śoko māṃ dārayatyayam
dhanañjaya kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kalyāṇenopahanyate [khyāpanenānutāpena dānena tapasā'pi vā
tyāgavāṃśca punaḥ pāpaṃ nālaṃ kartumiti śrutiḥ tyāgavāñjanmamaraṇe nāpnotīti śrutiryataḥ
na hi kṛtsnatamo dharmaḥ śakyaḥ prāptumiti śrutiḥ
sa parigrahamutsṛjya kṛtsnaṃ rājyaṃ sukhāni ca gamiṣyāmi vinirmukto viśoko nirmamaḥ kvacit
praśāsadhvamimāmurvī kṣemāṃ nihatakaṇṭakām na mamārtho'sti rājyena bhogairvā kurunandana
hatāmitraḥ kathaṃ sa tvaṃ tyajethā buddhilāghavāt
klībasya hi kuto rājyaṃ dīrghasūtrasya vā punaḥ
yo hyājijīviṣedbhaikṣaṃ karmaṇā naiva kasya cit samārambhānbubhūṣeta hatasvastirakiñcanaḥ
saṃtyajya rājyamṛddhaṃ te loko'yaṃ kiṃ vadiṣyati
ākiñcanyaṃ munīnāṃ ca iti vai nahuṣo'bravīt
dharmaṃ sa harate tasya dhanaṃ harati yasya yaḥ
prāṇayātrā'pi lokasya vinā hyarthaṃ na sidhdyati
vicchidyante kriyāḥ sarvā grīṣme kusarito yathā
yasyārthāḥ sa pumām̐lloke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ
dharmaḥ kāmaśca svargaśca harṣaḥ krodhaḥ śrutaṃ damaḥ
sa vai rājankṛśo nāma na śarīrakṛśaḥ kṛśaḥ
jitvā mameyaṃ bruvate putrā iva pitṛrdhanam
rājarṣayo'pi te svargyā dharmo hyeṣāṃ nirucyate
aṃbarīpasya māndhātuḥ pṛthivī sā tvayi sthitā
sa tvāṃ dravyamayo yajñaḥ saṃprāptaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ
upetya tasyāvabhṛthe pūtāḥ sarve bhavanti te
dhārayannapi te śrutvā rocate vacanaṃ mama
sārthagamyamahaṃ mārgaṃ na jātu tvatkṛte punaḥ
kṣemyaścaikākinā gamyaḥ panthā kostīti pṛccha mām
manaḥkarṇasukhā nityaṃ śrṛṇvannuccāvacā giraḥ muditānāmaraṇyeṣu nadatāṃ mṛgapakṣiṇām
prajāḥ sarvāḥ svadharmasthāḥ samaḥ prāṇabhṛtaḥ prati
alpaṃ vā svādu vā bhojyaṃ pūrvālābhena jātucit
ekakālaṃ caranbhaikṣaṃ trīnatha dve ca pañca vā
alābhe sati vā lābhe samadarśī mahātapāḥ
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva nābhinandanna ca dvipan vāsyaikaṃ takṣato bāhuṃ candanenaikapukṣataḥ
pratigṛhṇāti tatpāpaṃ kartuḥ karmaphalaṃ hi tat
śastraṃ naiva grahīṣyāmo na vadhiṣyāma kaṃcana
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva sarvaṃ prāṇasya bhojanam
yathā hi puruṣaḥ khātvā kūpamaprāpya codakam
kāmī ca kāminīṃ labdhvā karmedaṃ nastathopamam
āpatkāle hi saṃnyāsaḥ kartavya iti śiṣyate
tadeva nindāṃ bhāṣeyurdhātā tatra na garhyate
śakyaṃ tu maunamāsthāya bibhratā''tmānamātmanā dharmacchajha samāsthāya cyavituṃ na tu jīvitum
neme mṛgāḥ svargajito na varāhā na pakṣiṇaḥ
śakyaṃ punararaṇyeṣu sukhametena jīvitum kecidgṛhānparityajya vanamabhyāgamandvijāḥ
puṇyaṃ bhavati karmaiṣāṃ praśastaṃ caiva jīvitam
śakune brūhi yacchreyo vayaṃ te śraddadhāmahe
tato'haṃ vaḥ pravakṣyāmi yāthātathyaṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ
catuṣpadāṃ gauḥ pravarā lohānāṃ kāñcanaṃ varam
śabdānāṃ pravaro mantro brāhmaṇo dvipadāṃ varaḥ
karmāṇi vaidikānyasya svargyaḥ panthāstvanuttamaḥ atha sarvāṇi karmāṇi mantrasiddhāni cakṣate
atha ye karma nindanto manuṣyāḥ kāpathaṃ gatāḥ
devā vai duṣkaraṃ kṛtvā vibhūtiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
tapaḥ śreṣṭhaṃ prajānāṃ hi mūlametanna saṃśayaḥ
te'pi karmaiva kurvanti vidhiṃ paśyasva pārthiva
na hi vedoktamutsṛjya vipraḥ sarveṣu karmasu
kṛtātmā sa mahārāja sa vai tyāgī smṛto naraḥ
ātmatyāgī mahārāja sa tyāgī tāpaso mataḥ
ayācakaḥ sadāyogī sa tyāgī pārtha bhikṣukaḥ
vipro vedānadhīte yaḥ sa tyāgī gurupūjakaḥ
āśramāṃstulayā sarvāndhṛtānāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ ekataśca trayo rājangṛhasthāśrama ekataḥ - - asamīkṣya tulayā pārtha kāmaṃ svargaṃ ca bhārata ayaṃ panthā maharṣīṇāpriyaṃ lokavidāṃ gatiḥ
iti yaḥ kurute bhāvaṃ sa tyāgī bharatarṣabha
yajño dhṛtiśca dharmaśca nityamārṣo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ
atraiva hi mahārāja trivargaḥ kevalaṃ phalam
na yajante mahārāja śāśvataṃ teṣu kilviṣam
bhūmiragniśca vāyuśca na cāpo na divākaraḥ
nakṣatrāṇi na candraśca na diśaḥ kāla eva ca
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca na gandho na rasaḥ kvacit
na ca santi pramāṇāni yaiḥ prameyaṃ prasādhyate
nārthāpattirna caitihyaṃ na dṛṣṭānto na saṃśayaḥ
na kvacinnirṇayo rājanna dharmādharma eva ca
tiryakva sthāvaraṃ caiva na devā na ca mānuṣāḥ varṇāśramavibhāgāśca na ca kartā na kāmakṛt
na cārthaśca vibhūtiśca na cārthasya viceṣṭitam
acetanaṃ manastvāsīdātmā eva sacetanaḥ īśvaraścetanastvekastenedaṃ gahanīkṛtam
mantrāśca cetanā rājanna ca dehena yojitāḥ
yogena ca samāviṣṭaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ ca śaṃbhunā
pradhānaṃ puruṣaḥ caiva ātmānaṃ sarvadehinām manasā viṣayaiścaiva cetanena pracoditāḥ
tvaṃ cānye ca mahārāja īśvarasya vaśe sthitāḥ
jīvante ca mriyante ca na svatantrāḥ kathaṃcana
hitvāhitvā ca bhūtāni hatvā sarvamidaṃ jagat
yajante karmaṇā devā na sa pāpena lipyate
devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca te ca yānti parāṃ gatim
pātitāḥ śatravaḥ pūrva sarvatra vasudhādhipaiḥ prajānāṃ hitakāmaiśca ātmanaśca hitaiṣibhiḥ
yadi tatra bhavetpāpaṃ kathaṃ te svargamāsthitāḥ na prāptā narakaṃ rājanveṣṭitāḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ
ye cānye kratavastāta brāhmaṇairabhipūjitāḥ tairyajasva mahīpāla śakro devapatiryathā
aśaraṇyaḥ prajānāṃ yaḥ sa rājā kalirucyate
nihatya śatrūṃstarasā samṛddhāñśakro yathā daityabalāni saṅkhye
kaḥ pārtha śocennirataḥ svadharme pūrvaiḥ smṛte pārthivaśiṣṭajuṣṭe
kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa parākrameṇa jitvā mahīṃ mantravidbhyaḥ pradāya
nākasya pṛṣṭhe'si narendra gantā na śocitavyaṃ bhavatā'dya pārtha
śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbhavati vā na vā
yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syāddviṣatāṃ tattathā'stu naḥ
yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ vā syātsuhṛdāṃ tattathā'stu naḥ
mameti dvyakṣaro mṛtyurna mameti ca śāśvatam
hitvā śarīraṃ bhūtānāṃ na hiṃsā pratipatsyate
naṣṭe śarīre naṣṭaḥ syādvṛthā ca syātkriyāpathaḥ
panthā niṣevitaḥ sadbhiḥ sa niṣevyo vijānatā
kṛtatretādiyuktāni guṇavanti ca bhārata yugāni bahuśastaiśca bhukteyamavanī nṛpa
na bhuṅkte yo nṛpaḥ samyakkiṃphalaṃ tasya jīvite
dravyeṣu yasya mamatā mṛtyorāsye sa vartate
ye tu paśyanti tadbhūtaṃ mucyante te mahābhayāt
ime te bhrātaraḥ pārtha śuṣyante stokakā iva
vayaṃ duryodhanaṃ hatvā mṛdhe bhokṣyāma medinīm
na klībo vasudhāṃ bhuṅkte na klībo dhanamaśnute
na klībasya gṛhe putrā matsyāḥ paṅka ivāsate
nādaṇḍasya prajā rājñaḥ sukhaṃ vindanti bhārata
arājake hi loke'sminsarvato vidrute bhayāt rakṣārthamasya lokasya rājānamasṛjatprabhuḥ
sa kuberaḥ sa varuṇaḥ sa mahendraḥ pratāpavān
pitāmahasya devasya viṣṇoḥ śarvasya caiva hi
kāryaṃ yo'vekṣya śaktiṃ ca deśakālau ca tatvataḥ
mṛtyuśca vasati krodhe sarvatejomayo hi saḥ
taṃ yastu dveṣṭi saṃmohātsa vinaśyati mānavaḥ
tasya sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
deśakālau ca śaktiṃ ca kāryaṃ cāvekṣya tatvataḥ
sa rājā puruṣo daṇḍaḥ sa netā śāsitā ca saḥ
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati
daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
susamīkṣya dhṛto daṇḍaḥ sarvā rañjayati prajāḥ
prajāstatra na muhyanti netā cetsādhu paśyati
tato durgaṃ ca rāṣṭraṃ ca lokaṃ ca sacarācaram
daṇḍaḥ praṇetuṃ śakyo hi susahāyena dhīmatā
viṣṇunā caiva devena śakreṇa ca mahātmanā
lokapālaiśca bhūtaiśca pāṇḍavaiśca mahātmabhiḥ dharmādvicalitā rājandhārtarāṣṭrā nipātitāḥ
tānnihatya na doṣaste svalpo'pi jagatīpate chalena māyayā vā'tha kṣatradharmeṇa vā nṛpa
eṣa rājñāṃ paro dharmaḥ samare cāpalāyanam
na śrutena na dānena na sāṃtvena na cejyayā
tvayeyaṃ pṛthivī labdhā na saṃkocena cāpyuta
ekaiko'pi sukhāyaiṣāṃ mama syāditi me matiḥ
kiṃ punaḥ puruṣavyāghrāḥ patayo me nararṣabhāḥ
kurute mūḍha evaṃ hi yaḥ śreyo nādhigacchati
unmattirapanetavyā tava rājanyadṛcchayā bheṣajaiḥ sa cikitsyaḥ syādya unmārgeṇa gacchati
tādṛśānāṃ vadhe doṣaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi karhicit
akāraṇena hantā ca yaśca bhāryāṃ parāmṛśet
gobrāhmaṇārthe vyasane ca rājñāṃ rāṣṭropamarde svaśarīrahetoḥ
strīṇāṃ ca vikruṣṭarutāni śrutvā vipro'pi yudhyeta mahāprabhāvaḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā'pyantyajopi vā
sahasrāṇi ca varṣāṇi nihatya narake patet
tāvatīḥ sa samāḥ pāpo narake parivartate
brahmahā sa tu vijñeyaḥ prāyaścittī narādhamaḥ
śrotriyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā tathā''treyīṃ ca brāhmaṇīm
brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaṃ śūdraṃ vā ghātayennṛpaḥ
chittvā hastau ca pādau ca nāsikoṣṭhau ca bhūpatiḥ
kṣatriyaṃ vaiśyaśūdrau ca śastreṇaiva ca ghātayet
pretānāṃ na ca deyāni piṇḍadānāni kenacit
brahmaghnena pibantaśca viprā deśāḥ purāṇi ca
durbalānāṃ balaṃ rājā balino ye ca sādhavaḥ
sākṣiṇaṃ sādhuvākyaṃ ca jitaṃ tamapi nirdiśet
rājājñayā samāhūto yo na gacchetsabhāṃ naraḥ
brahmahatyāṃ ca cauryaṃ ca rājadrohaṃ ca pañcamam
mahāntaṃ gurutalpe ca mitradrohe ca pātakam
triṣu varṇeṣu yo daṇḍaḥ praṇīto brahmaṇā purā
nārīṇāṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ gopateśca mahāmatiḥ pāpānāṃ durvinītānāṃ prāṇāntaṃ ca bṛhaspatiḥ
sarveṣāṃ pāpabuddhīnāṃ pāpakarmaiva kvurvatām dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāṇāṃ daṇḍo nirdoṣa iṣyate
saubalasya ca durbuddheḥ karṇasya ca durātmanaḥ
paśyatāṃ caiva śūrāṇāṃ yā'haṃ dyūte sabhāṃ tadā rajasvalā samānītā bhavatāṃ paśyatāṃ nṛpa
divākareṇa devena vivastrā na kṛtā tadā
eteṣāṃ yatamānānāṃ na me'dya vacanaṃ mṛṣā
tvaṃ tu sarvāṃ mahīṃ tyaktvā kuruṣe svayamāpadam
praśādhi pṛthivīṃ devīṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
daṇḍaḥ śāsti prajāḥ sarvā daṇḍa evābhirakṣati
daṇḍaḥ supteṣu jāgarti daṇḍaṃ dharmaṃ vidurbudhāḥ
daṇḍena rakṣyate dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ daṇḍena rakṣyate
evaṃ sāṃsiddhike loke sarvaṃ daṇḍe pratiṣṭhitam
dhanadaṇḍāḥ smṛtā vaiśyā nirdaṇḍaḥ śūdra ucyate
prajāstatra na muhyanti netā cetsādhu paśyati
nāghnataḥ kīrtirastīha na vittaṃ na punaḥ prajāḥ indro vṛtravadhenaiva mahendraḥ samapadyata
māhendraṃ ca gṛhaṃ lebhe lokānāṃ ceśvaro'bhavat
na brahmāṇaṃ na dhātāraṃ na pūṣāṇaṃ kathaṃcana
na hi paśyāmi jīvantaṃ loke kaṃcidarhisayā
tānatti puruṣaḥ sarvānpaśya dharmo yathā gataḥ
prāṇasyānnamidaṃ sarvaṃ jaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca yat
vinā vadhaṃ na kurvanti tāpasāḥ prāṇayāpanam
udake bahavaḥ prāṇāḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca phaleṣu ca
kaunteya sarvabhūtānāṃ tatra me nāsti saṃśayaḥ
satyaṃ batedaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvamuktaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajā rakṣati sādhunītaḥ
sarvo daṇḍajito loko durlabho hi śucirjanaḥ
daṇḍo vidhātrā vihito dharmārthauṃ bhuvi rakṣitum
na brahmacāryadhīyīta na kālyaṃ duhate ca gauḥ
na kanyodvahanaṃ gacchedyadi daṇḍo na pālayet
mamatvaṃ na prajānīyuryadi daṇḍo na pālayet
na vidyāṃ prāpnuyātkaścidyadi daṇḍo na pālayet
na vidyāṃ prāpnuryānāni yadi daṇḍo na pālayet
na preṣyā vacanaṃ kuryurna bālo jātu karhicit
tiṣṭhetpiturmate dharme yadi daṇḍo na pālayet
daṇḍe sthitāḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhayaṃ daṇḍe vidurbudhāḥ
daṇḍe svargo manuṣyāṇāṃ loko'yaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ
na tatra kūṭaṃ pāpaṃ vā vañcanā vā'pi dṛśyate
haretkākaḥ puroḍāśaṃ yadi daṇḍo na pālayet
kāryastatra na śoko vai bhuṅkṣva bhogānyajasva ca
arthe sarve samārambhāḥ samāyattā na saṃśayaḥ
sa ca daṇḍe samāyattaḥ paśya daṇḍasya gausvam
paśūnāṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ chittvā tato bhindanti nassu tān
yaja dehi prajā rakṣa dharmaṃ samanupālaya
mā ca te nighnataḥ śatrūnmanyurbhavatu pārthiva
na tena bhrūṇahā sa syānmanyustaṃ manyumārcchati
avadhye cātmani kathaṃ vadhyo bhavati kasyacit
yathā hi puruṣaḥ śālāṃ punaḥ saṃpraviśennavām
upaśikṣāma te vṛttaṃ sadaiva na ca śaknumaḥ
na vakṣyāmi na vakṣyāmītyevaṃ me manasi sthitam
viklabatvaṃ ca naḥ prāptamabalatvaṃ tathaiva ca
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca na te'styaviditaṃ prabho
evaṃ gate mahārāja rājyaṃ prati janādhipa
duḥkhena labhate duḥkhaṃ dvāvanarthau ca vindati
śītoṣṇe caiva vāyuśca trayaḥ śārīrajā guṇāḥ
teṣāmanyatamodreke vidhānamupadiśyate uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ prabādhyate
satvaṃ rajastaya iti mānasāḥ syustrayo guṇāḥ
teṣāmanyatamodreke vidhānamupadiśyate harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate
sa tvaṃ na duḥkhī duḥkhasya na sukhī ca sukhasya ca nāduḥkhī duḥkhabhāgasya nāsukhī ca sukhasya ca
athavā te svabhāvo'yaṃ yena pārthiva tuṣyase dṛṣṭvā sabhāgatāṃ kṛṣṇāmekavastrāṃ rajasvalām
yatra nāsti śaraiḥ kāryaṃ na mitrairna ca bandhubhiḥ
yo hyanāḍhyaḥ sa patitastaducchiṣṭaṃ tadalpakam bahvapathyaṃ balavato na kiṃcitrāyate balam
diṣṭyā duryodhanaḥ pāpo nihataḥ sānugo yudhi
draupadyāḥ keśapakṣasya diṣṭyā te padavīṃ gatāḥ
vayaṃ te kiṃkarāḥ pārtha vāsudevaśca vīryavān
jayodaraṃ pṛthivyā te śreyo nirjitayā jitam
yogaḥ kṣemaśca rāṣṭrasya dharmādharmau tvayi sthitau
na ca tuṣyanti rājānaḥ paśya buddhyantaraṃ yathā
tulyāśmakāñcano yaśca sa kṛtārtho na pārthivaḥ
api gāthāṃ purā gītāṃ janakena vadantyuta
anantaṃ bata me vittaṃ yasya me nāsti kiṃcana
dṛśyaṃ paśyati yaḥ paśyansa cakṣuṣmānsa buddhimān
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
śriyaṃ hitvā pradīptāṃ tvaṃ śvavatsaṃprati vīkṣyase
tāṃśca tvaṃ viphalānkṛtvā kaṃ nu lokaṃ gamiṣyasi
naiva te'sti paro loko nāparaḥ pāpakarmaṇaḥ
nipānaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtvā tvaṃ pāvanaṃ mahata
ya imāṃ kuṇḍikāṃ bhindyāntriviṣṭabdhaṃ ca yo haret
yadanena kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kimidaṃ mama dīyate
kā vā'haṃ tava ko me tvaṃ kaśca te mayyanugrahaḥ
saukhikaiḥ saṃbhṛto yo'rthaḥ sa saṃtyajati kiṃnu taṃ
sadaiva yācamāno vai tathā śāmyati na dvijaḥ
prabhavaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāṃ ca dāntā vindanta āsate
tyāgānna bhikṣukaṃ vindyānna mauḍhyānna ca yācanāt
ṛjustu yo'rthaṃ tyajati taṃ muktaṃ viddhi bhikṣukam
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sa vai mukto mahīpate
trayīṃ ca nāmavārtāṃ ca tyaktvā putrānvrajanti ye
vedāhaṃ tāta śāstrāṇi aparāṇi parāṇi ca
ubhayaṃ vedavacanaṃ kuru karma tyajeti ca
niścayaścaiva yo mantre vedāhaṃ taṃ yathāvidhi
śāstrārthaṃ tattvato gantuṃ na samarthaḥ kathaṃcana
tenāpyevaṃ na vācyo'yaṃ yadi dharmaṃ prapaśyasi
nyāyyaṃ yuktaṃ ca kaunteya prīto'haṃ tena te'rjuna
vāsudevasamaṃ caiva na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
balamindre ca vāyau ca balaṃ yacca janārdane
tadvalaṃ bhīmasene ca tvayi cārjunā vidyate
na tvayā sadṛśaḥ kaścintriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
dhārmikaṃ dharmayuktaṃ ca niḥśeṣaṃ jñāyate mayā dharmasūkṣmaṃ tu yadvācyaṃ tatra duṣprataraṃ tvayā
parasparaṃ jyāya eṣāmiti naḥ śreyasī matiḥ
tapaḥ svādhyāyaśīlā hi dṛśyante dhārmikā janāḥ
dakṣiṇena tu panthānaṃ yaṃ bhāsvantaṃ pracakṣate
ete kriyāvatāṃ lokā ye śmaśānāni bhejire
anirdeśyā gatiḥ sā tu yāṃ prapaśyanti mokṣiṇaḥ
tasmāttyāgaḥ pradhāneṣṭaḥ sa tu duḥkhaṃ praveditum
vipāṭya kadalīstambhaṃ sāraṃ dadṛśire na te
kalyāṇagocaraṃ kṛtvā mānaṃ tṛṣṇāṃ nigṛhya ca
kriyāsu niratā nityaṃ dāne yajñe ca karmaṇi
tapasā mahadāpnoti buddhyā vai vindate mahat
ajātaśatro dharmeṇa kṛtsnā te vasudhā jitā
tāṃ jitvā ca vṛthā rājanna parityaktumarhasi
catuṣpadī hi niḥśreṇī brahmaṇyeṣā pratiṣṭhitā tāṃ krameṇa mahābāho yathāvajjaya pārthiva
ātmanā tṛpito buddhyā bhrūṇahatyāṃ na budhyate
yajñāya sṛṣṭāni dhanāni dhātrā yajñādiṣṭaḥ puruṣo rakṣitā ca
tasmātsarvaṃ yajña evopayojyaṃ dhanaṃ tato'nantara eva kāmaḥ
mahādevaḥ sarvayajñe mahātmā hutvā''tmānaṃ devadevo babhūva
āvikṣitaḥ pārthivo'sau marutto vṛddhyā śakraṃ yo'jayaddevarājam
yajñe yasya śrīḥ svayaṃ sanniviṣṭā yasminbhāṇḍaṃ kāñcanaṃ sarvamāsīt
ṛddhyā śakraṃ yo'jayanmānuṣaḥ saṃ stasmādyajñe sarvamevopayojyam
saṃtoṣo vai svargasamaḥ saṃtoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham
na vibheti yadā cāyaṃ yadā cāsmānna bibhyati
kāmadveṣau ca jayati tadā''tmānaṃ ca paśyati
yadā'sau sarvabhūtānāṃ na druhyati na kāṅkṣati
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma saṃpadyate tadā
evaṃ kaunteya bhūtāni taṃtaṃ dharmaṃ tathātathā
naikaṃ na cāparaṃ kecidubhayaṃ ca tathā'pare
yajñameke praśaṃsanti saṃnyāsamapare janāḥ naikaṃ na cāparaṃ kecidubhayaṃ ca tathā'pare
hatvā chittvā ca bhittvā ca kecidekāntaśīlinaḥ
adroheṇaiva bhūtānāṃ yo dharmaḥ sa satāṃ mataḥ
yo hi rājye sthitaḥ śaśvadvaśī tulyapriyāpriyaḥ
ya evaṃ vartate rājansa rājā dharmaniścitaḥ
nirvāṇaṃ hi suduṣprāpyaṃ bahuvighnaṃ ca me matam
evaṃ rudrāḥ savasavastathā''dityāḥ paraṃtapa sādhyā rājarṣisaṅghāśca dharmametaṃ samāśritāḥ
jitvā cārīnnaraśreṣṭha tapyate kiṃ bhṛśaṃ bhavān
kṣatriyāṇāṃ ca nidhanaṃ saṃgrāme vihitaṃ prabho
praśastaṃ jīvitaṃ loke kṣatraṃ hi brahmasaṃbhavam
na tyāgo na punaryajño na tapo manujeśvara
tyaktvā saṃtāpajaṃ śokaṃ daṃśito bhava karmaṇi
indro vai brahmaṇaḥ putraḥ kṣatriyaḥ karmaṇā'bhavat
taccāsya karma pūjyaṃ ca praśasyaṃ ca viśāṃpate
śāstradṛṣṭaḥ paro dharmaḥ smṛto gārhasthya āśramaḥ
taṃ carādya vidhiṃ pārtha duścaraṃ durbalendriyaiḥ
vedajñānaṃ ca te kṛtsnaṃ tapaścācaritaṃ mahat
tapo yajñastathā vidyā bhaikṣyamindriyasaṃyamaḥ dhyānaṃ vidyā samutthānaṃ saṃtoṣaśca śriyaṃ prati
kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu vakṣyāmi tavāpi viditaṃ punaḥ
vedajñānaṃ tathā kṛtsnaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ tathā
imaṃ lokamamuṃ caiva sādhayantīti naḥ śrutam
balaṃ hi kṣatriye nityaṃ bale daṇḍaḥ samāhitaḥ
saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāptaḥ śrotumicchāmi taṃ nṛpam
bhakṣayantaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā śaṅkho bhrātaramabravīt
stenaṃ māṃ tvaṃ viditvā ca svadharmamanupālaya
śīghraṃ dhāraya corasya mama daṇḍaṃ narādhipa
bhakṣitāni mahārāja tatra māṃ śādhi māciram
brūhi kāmānato'nyāṃstvaṃ kariṣyāmi hi te vacaḥ
na kupye tava dharmajña na tvaṃ dūṣayase mama sunirmalaṃ kulaṃ brahmannasmiñjagati viśrutam
tvaṃ gatvā bāhudāṃ śīghraṃ tarpayasva yathāvidhi
brahmahatyāṃ surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamam mahānti pātakānyāhuḥ saṃyogaṃ caiva taiḥ saha
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyaḥ śūdro'thavā dvija
sarve kāmakṛte pāpe hantavyā na vicāraṇā
uddhṛtaṃ naḥ kulaṃ brahmannājñādaṇḍe dhṛte tvayi
tataḥ sa vismito bhrāturdarśayāmāsa tau karau
mā ca te'va viśaṅkā bhūddaivamatra vidhīyate
kiṃtu nāhaṃ tvayā pūtaḥ pūrvameva mahādyute
sa ca pūto narapatistvaṃ cāpi pitṛbhiḥ saha
sa rājā pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha śreyānvai tena karmaṇā
utpathebhyo mahārāja mā sma śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
daṇḍa eva hi rājendra kṣatradharmo na muṇḍanam
araṇye vasatāṃ tāta bhrātṝṇāṃ te manisvinām
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca bhrātṛbhiḥ saha bhārata
arthināṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ ca devatānāṃ ca bhārata
ānṛṇyaṃ gaccha kaunteya tataḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyasi
ākāra iṅgitaṃ caiva gatiśceṣṭā ca bhārata
pratyakṣamanumānaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ yonirucyate pramāṇajño hi śaknoti daṇḍayonau vicakṣaṇaḥ
śāstrajāṃ buddhimāsthāya yujyate nainasā hi saḥ
tarasā buddhipūrvaṃ vā nigrāhyā eva śatravaḥ
pāpaiḥ saha na saṃdadhyādrājyaṃ puṇyaṃ ca kārayet
mantre ca vyavahāre ca niyoktavyā vijānatā
vedajñā ye ca śāstrajñāste ca rājansubuddhayaḥ
ānvīkṣakītrayīvārtādaṇḍanītiṣu pāragāḥ te tu sarvatra yoktavyāste ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ
enasā yujyate rājā durdānta iti cocyate
kṛte puruṣakāre tu nainaḥ spṛśati pārthivam
yatkarma vai nigrahe śātravāṇāṃ yogaścāgryaḥ pālane mānavānām
kṛtvā karma prāpya kīrti sa yuddhā dvājigrīvo modate svargaloke
aśvagrīvaḥ karmaśīlo mahātmā saṃsiddhārtho modate svargaloke
dhanuryūpo raśanā jyā śaraḥ sru ksruvaḥ khaṅgo rudhiraṃ yatra cājyam
ratho vedī kāmajo yuddhamagni ścāturhotraṃ caturo vājimukhyāḥ
prāṇānhutvā cāvabhṛthe raṇe sa vājigrīvo modate devaloke
rāṣṭraṃ rakṣanbuddhipūrvaṃ nayena saṃtyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā
sarvāṃllokānvyāpya kīrtyā manasvī vājigrīvo modate devaloke
daivīṃ siddhiṃ mānuṣīṃ daṇḍanītiṃ yoganyāsaiḥ pālayitvā mahīṃ ca
tasmādrājā dharmaśīlo mahātmā vājigrīvo modate devaloke
vidvāṃstyāgī śraddadhānaḥ kṛtajña styaktvā lokaṃ mānuṣaṃ karma kṛtvā
medhāvināṃ viduṣāṃ saṃmatānāṃ tanutyajāṃ lokamākramya rājā
cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme vājigrīvo modate devaloke
jitvā saṃgrāmānpālayitvā prajāśca somaṃ pītvā tarpayitvā dvijāgryān
yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ yuddhe kṣīṇe modate devaloke
vṛttaṃ yasya ślāghanīyaṃ manuṣyāḥ santo vidvāṃso'rhayantyarhaṇīyam
svargaṃ jitvā vīralokānavāpya siddhiṃ prāptaḥ puṇyakīrtirmahātmā
na pārthivamidaṃ rājyaṃ na bhogāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ
prīṇayanti mano me'dya śoko māṃ dārayatyayam
na karmaṇā labhyate cejyayā vā nāpyasti dātā puruṣasya kaścit
paryāyayogādvihitaṃ vidhātrā kālena sarvaṃ labhate manuṣyaḥ
na buddhiśaktyā''dhyayanena śakyaṃ prāptuṃ viśeṣaṃ manujairakāle
mūrkho'pi cāpnoti kadācidarthā nkālo hi sarvaṃ puruṣasya dātā
na bhūrakāleṣu phalaṃ dadāti śilpāni mantrāśca tathauṣadhāni
tānyeva kālena samāhitāni siddhyanti vardhanti ca bhūtikāle
kālena śīghrāḥ pravahanti vātāḥ kālena vṛṣṭirjaladānupaiti
kālena pajhotpalavañjalaṃ ca kālena puṣyanti vaneṣu vṛkṣāḥ
kālena kṛṣṇāśca sitāśca rātryaḥ kālena candraḥ paripūrṇabimbaḥ
nākālataḥ puṣpaphalaṃ drumāṇāṃ nākālavegāḥ sarito vahanti
nākālataḥ strīṣu bhavanti garbhā nāyantyakāle śiśiroṣṇavarṣāḥ
nākālato mriyate jāyate vā nākālato vyāharate ca bālaḥ
nākālato vardhate hīyate ca candraḥ samudro'pi mahormimālī
saṃjñaiṣā laukikī rājanna hinasti na hanyate
naṣṭe dhane vā dāre vā putre pitari vā mṛte
paśya duḥkheṣu duḥkhāni bhayeṣu ca bhayānyapi
ātmā'pi cāyaṃ na mama sarvā'pi pathivī mama
jīveṣu parivartante duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca
na nityaṃ labhate duḥkhaṃ na nityaṃ labhate sukham
sukhāntaprabhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ duḥkhāntaprabhavaṃ sukham yannimitto bhavecchokastāpo vā duḥkhamūrcchitaḥ
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ priyaṃ vā yadi vā'priyam
tato jñāsyasi kaḥ kasya kena vā kathameva ca
ye ca mūḍhatamā loke ye ca buddheḥ paraṃ gatāḥ
ta eva sukhamedhante madhyamaḥ kliśyate janaḥ
paraduḥkhena duḥkhī yo na sa jātu sukhī bhavet
duḥkhānāṃ hi kṣayo nāsti jāyate hyaparātparam
sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca bhavābhavau ca lābhālābhau maraṇaṃ jīvitaṃ ca
paryāyataḥ sarvamavāptuvanti tasmānna muhyenna ca saṃprahṛṣyet
dīkṣāṃ rājñāṃ saṃyuge dharmamāhu ryogaṃ rājye daṇḍanītiṃ ca samyak
vittatyāgaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ caiva yajñe samyagdānaṃ pāvanānīti vidyāt
rakṣanrājyaṃ buddhipūrvaṃ nayena saṃtyaktātmā yajñaśīlo mahātmā
jitvā saṃgrāmānpālayitvā ca rāṣṭraṃ somaṃ pītvā vardhayitvā prajāśca
yuktyā daṇḍaṃ dhārayitvā prajānāṃ paścātkṣīṇāyurmodate devaloke
yajanti yajñānvijayanti rājyaṃ rakṣanti rāṣṭrāṇi priyāṇi caiṣām
samyagvedānprāpya śāstrāṇyadhītya samyagrājyaṃ pālayitvā ca rājā cāturvarṇyaṃ sthāpayitvā svadharme pūtātmā vai modate devaloke
dhṛṣṭadyumne virāṭe ca drupade ca mahīpatau
vṛṣasene ca dharmajñe dhṛṣṭaketau tu pārthive
na ca muñcati māṃ śoko jñātighātinamāturam
sa mayā rājyalubdhena gāṅgeyo yudhi pātitaḥ
ghūrṇamānaṃ yathā śailaṃ tadā me kaśmalo'bhavat
svayaṃ mṛtyuṃ rakṣamāṇaḥ pāñcālyaṃ yaḥ śikhaṇḍinam
yena saṃvardhitā bālā yena sma parirakṣitāḥ sa mayā rājyalubdhena pāpena gurudhātinā
abhigamya raṇe mithyā pāpenoktaḥ sutaṃ prati
satyamākhyāhi rājaṃstvaṃ yadi jīvati me sutaḥ
aśvatthāmā hata iti niruktaḥ kuñjare hate
kṛṣṇaṃ ca puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ kilviṣī bhrūṇahā yathā
na bhokṣye na ca pānīyamupayokṣye kathaṃcana
buddhudā iva toyeṣu bhavanti na bhavanti ca
nālaṃ sukhāya suhṛdo nāle duḥkhāya śatravaḥ
na ca prajñālamarthebhyo na sukhebhyo'pyalaṃ dhanam
yathā sṛṣṭo'si kaunteya dhātrā karmasu tatkraru
ata eva hi siddhiste neśastvaṃ hyātmano nṛpa
aśmānaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prājñaṃ vaideho janako nṛpaḥ
āgame yadi vā'pāye jñātīnāṃ draviṇasya ca
ye ca viṃśativarṣā vā triṃśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ bhūtānāṃ paryupasthitam
pūrve vayasi madhye vā'pyuttare vā narādhipa
kule janma tathā vīryamārogyaṃ rūpameva ca
niryāṇe yasya yaddiṣṭaṃ tena gacchati setunā dṛśyate nāpyatikrāmanna niṣkrānto'thavā punaḥ
samṛddhe ca kule jātā vinaśyanti pataṅgavat
prāyeṇa śrīmatāṃ loke bhoktuṃ śaktirna vidyate
daridrāṇāṃ tu bhūyiṣṭhaṃ kāṣṭhamaśmā hi jīryate
mṛgayākṣāḥ striyaḥ pānaṃ prasaṅgā ninditā budhaiḥ
jyotīṃṣi saritaḥ śailānkaḥ karoti bibhatiṃ ca
nauṣadhāni na śastrāṇi na homā na punarjapāḥ
yathā kāṣṭhaṃ ca kāṣṭhaṃ ca sameyātāṃ mahodadhau
saṃsāreṣvanubhūtāni kasya te kasya vā vayam
kvāse kva ca gamiṣyāmi ko'nvahaṃ kimihāsthitaḥ
te pibantaḥ kaṣāyāṃśca sarpīṣi vividhāni ca
na hyahāni nivartante na māsā na punaḥ samāḥ
deho vā jīvitādvyeti dehī vā'pyeti dehataḥ
kvanu te'dya pitā rājankvanu te'dya pitāmahāḥ
na tvaṃ paśyasi tānadya na tvāṃ paśyanti te'nagha
na caiva puruṣo draṣṭā svargasya narakasya ca
sa yajñaśīlaḥ prajane niviṣṭaḥ prāgbrahmacārī pravibhaktabhaikṣaḥ
ārādhayetsvargamimaṃ ca lokaṃ paraṃ ca muktvā hṛdayavyalīkam
samyaksvadharmaṃ carato nṛpasya dravyāṇi cābhyāharato yathāvat
aśmānamāmantrya viśuddhabuddhi ryayau gṛhaṃ svaṃ prati śāntaśokaḥ
tathā tvamapyadya vimucya śoka muttiṣṭha śakropama harṣamehi
kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa mahī jitā te tāṃ bhuṅkṣva kuntīsuta māvamaṃsthāḥ
sarve sma te saṃśayitāḥ punareva janārdana
mā kṛthāḥ puruṣavyāghra śokaṃ tvaṃ gātraśoṣaṇam
na hi te sulabhā bhūyo ye hatā'sminraṇājire
tathā te kṣatriyā rājanye vyatītā mahāraṇe
kṣatradharmaratāḥ śūrā vedavedāṅgapāragāḥ prāptā vīragatiṃ puṇyāṃ tānna śocitumarhasi
sukhaduḥkhairahaṃ tvaṃ ca prajāḥ sarvāśca sṛñjaya
mahābhāgyaṃ purā rājñāṃ kīrtyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu
mṛtānmahānubhāvāṃstvaṃ śrutvaiva pṛthivīpatīn śamamānaya saṃtāpaṃ śṛṇu vistaraśaśca me
āvikṣitaṃ maruttaṃ ca mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
suhotraṃ ca dvatithinaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ
aṅgaṃ bṛhadrathaṃ caiva mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
yasya yajñeṣu rājendra śatasaṅkhyeṣu vai purā
na jāto janitā nānyaḥ pumānyaḥ saṃpradāsyati
na voḍhāraṃ dhuraṃ tasya kaṃcinmene prajāpatiḥ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarvarājasu sṛñjaya
bharataṃ caiva dauṣyantiṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
sahasraṃ yatra pajhānāṃ kaṇvāya bharato dadau
rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ caiva mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
na vyālato bhayaṃ cāsīdrāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
sarvā droṇadughā gāvo rāme rājyaṃ praśāsati
sa caturdaśa varṣāṇi vane proṣya mahātapāḥ
yuvā śyāmo lohitākṣo mātaṅga iva yūthapaḥ
sa cenmamāra sṛñjaya caturbhadratarastvayā putrātpuṇyataraścaiva mā putramanutapyathāḥ
bhagīrathaṃ ca rājānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśrum
yasyendro vitate yajñe somaṃ pītvā madotkaṭaḥ
sarvā rathagatāḥ kanyā rathāḥ sarve caturyujaḥ
dilīpaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
te devāṃ karma kurvāṇāḥ śakrajyeṣṭhā upāsata
yasyebhā hemasaṃchannāḥ pathi mattāḥ sma śerate
trayaḥ śabdā na jīryante dilīpasya niveśane
yaṃ devā maruto garbhaṃ pituḥ pārśvādapāharan
yatra sūrya udeti sma yatra ca pratitiṣṭhati
yayātiṃ nāhuṣaṃ caiva mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
ya imāṃ pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ vijitya sahasāgarām
ambarīṣaṃ ca nābhāgaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
yaṃ prajā vavrire puṇyaṃ goptāraṃ nṛpasattamam
kanyāṃkanyāṃ śataṃ nāgā nāgaṃnāgaṃ śataṃ rathāḥ
dadato me kṣayo mā bhūddharme śraddhā ca vardhatām
rantidevaṃ ca sāṃkṛtyaṃ mṛtaṃ sṛñjaya śuśruma
annaṃ ca no bahu bhavedatithīṃśca labhemahi
śraddhā ca no mā vyagamanmā ca yāciṣma kaṃcana
tubhyaṃtubhyaṃ niṣkamiti yadā krośanti vai dvijāḥ
anvāhāryopakaraṇaṃ dravyopakaraṇaṃ ca yat ghaṭāḥ pātryaḥ kaṭāhāni sthālyaśca piṭharāṇi ca
ālabhyanta śataṃ gāvaḥ sahasrāṇi ca viṃśatiḥ
sūpaṃ bhūyiṣṭhamaśnīdhvaṃ nādya māṃsaṃ yathā purā
sagaraṃ ca mahātmānaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya
rājānaṃ ca pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ mṛtaṃ śuśruma sṛñjaya
kṣatādyo vai trāyatīti sa tasmātkṣatriyaḥ smṛtaḥ
pṛthuṃ vainyaṃ prajā dṛṣṭvā raktāsmeti yadabruvan
kiṃ vā tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyase sṛñjaya tvaṃ na me rājanvācimamāṃ śṛṇopi
na cenmoghaṃ vipralaptaṃ mamedaṃ pathyaṃ mumūrṣoriva suprayuktam
śṛṇomi te nārada vācamenāṃ vicitrārthāṃ srajamiva puṇyagandhām
rājarṣīṇāṃ puṇyakṛtāṃ mahātmanāṃ kīrtyā yuktānāṃ śokanirnāśanārthām
na te moghaṃ vipralaptaṃ maharṣe dṛṣṭvaivāhaṃ nārada tvāṃ viśokaḥ
śuśrūṣe te vacanaṃ brahmavādi nna te tṛpyāmyamṛtasyeva pānāt
sutasya saṃjīvanamadya me syā ttava prasādātsutasaṅgamāpnuyām
yaste putraḥ śayitoyaṃ vijātaḥ svarṇaṣṭhīvī yamadātparvataste
punastaṃ te putramahaṃ dadāmi hiraṇyanābhaṃ varṣasabasriṇaṃ ca
parvatena kimathe vā dattastena mamāra ca
prītimantau mudā yuktau samayaṃ caiva cakratuḥ
yo bhaveddhṛdi saṃkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vā'śubhaḥ
anyonyasya ca ākhyeyo mṛṣā śāpo'nyathā bhavet
āvāṃ bhavati vatsyāvaḥ kaṃcitkālaṃ hitāya te
tatheti kṛtvā rājā tau satkṛtyopacacāra ha
ekaiva mama kanyaiṣā yuvāṃ paricariṣyati darśanīyānavadyāṅgī śīlavṛttasamāhitā
paramaṃ saumyamityuktaṃ tābhyāṃ rājā śaśāsa tām
sā tu kanyā tathetyuktvā pitaraṃ dharmacāriṇī
vavṛdhe hi tatastasya hṛdi kāmo mahātmanaḥ
yathā śuklasya pakṣasya pravṛttau candramāḥ śanaiḥ
na ca taṃ bhāgineyāya parvatāya mahātmane
śaśaṃsa manmathaṃ tīvraṃ vrīḍamānaḥ sa dharmavit
kāmārtaṃ nāradaṃ kruddhaḥ śaśāpainaṃ tato bhṛśam
yo bhaveddhṛdi saṃkalpaḥ śubho vā yadi vā'śubhaḥ
anyonyasya sa ākhyeya iti tadvai mṛṣā kṛtam
na hi kāmaṃ pravartantaṃ bhavānācaṣṭa me purā
śapsye tasmātsusaṃkruddho bhavantaṃ taṃ nibodha me
sukumārī ca te bhāryā bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ vānaratvaṃ ca te kanyā vivāhātprabhṛti prabho
sa tadvākyaṃ tu vijñāya nāradaḥ parvataṃ tathā
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa satyena ca damena ca
tau tu śāvā bhṛśaṃ kruddhau parasparamamarṣaṇau
sā tu kanyā yathāśāpaṃ nāradaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha
upatasthe ca bhartāraṃ na cānyaṃ manasā'pyagāt
devaṃ munīṃ vā yakṣaṃ vā patitve pativatsalā
adyaprabhṛti vai vāsaṃ svarge nāvāpsyasīti ha
tava naitadvisadṛśaṃ putrasthāne hi me bhavān
sānunītā bahuvidhaṃ parvatena mahātmanā śāpadoṣaṃ ca taṃ bhartuḥ śrutvā prakṛtimāgatā
eṣa vakṣyati te pṛṣṭo yathāvṛttaṃ narottama
kāryasyāsya tu yaccheṣaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi pṛcchataḥ
ahaṃ ca parvataścaiva svasrīyo me mahāpnuniḥ
tata āhūya rājānaṃ sṛñjayaṃ jayatāṃ varam
tadgṛhāṇa mahārāja pūjārho nau mato bhavān
prītau bhavantau yadi me kṛtametāvatā mama
eṣa eva paro lābho nirvṛtto me mahāphalaḥ
śṛṇu rājansusaṃkalpaṃ yatte hṛdi ciraṃ sthitam
ahaṃ te dayitaṃ putraṃ pretarājavaśaṃ gatam
evamuktvā tu nṛpatiṃ prayātau svo yathepsitam
babhūva kāñcanaṣṭhīvī yathārthaṃ nāma tasya tat
vyāghro bhūtvā jahīmaṃ tvaṃ rājaputramiti prabho
hṛṣṭaḥ sāntaḥ puro rājā vananityo babhūva ha
vyasuḥ papāta medinyāṃ tato dhātrī vicukruśe
sa dadarśa śayānaṃ taṃ gatāsuṃ pītaśoṇitam
abhyadhāvanta taṃ deśaṃ yatra rājā sa sṛñjayaḥ
tataḥ sa rājā sasmāra māmeva gatamānasaḥ
kārayāmāsa rājyaṃ ca pitari svargate nṛpa
sa tvaṃ rājendra saṃjātaṃ śokamekaṃ nivartaya
yathā tvaṃ keśavaḥ prāha vyāmaśca sumahātapāḥ
brāhmaṇeṣu tu yo dharmaḥ sa nityo vedaniścitaḥ
tathā yaḥ pratihantyasya śāsanaṃ viṣaye naraḥ
bhṛtyo vā yadi vā putrastapasvī vā'tha kaścana
dharmaṃ vinaśyamānaṃ hi yo na rakṣetsa dharmahā
rājā hi hanyāddadyācca prajā rakṣecca dharmataḥ
aparokṣo hi te dharmaḥ sarvadharmavidāṃ vara
tāni karmāṇi me brahmandahanti ca pacanti ca
īśvaro vā bhavetkartā puruṣo vā'pi bhārata
haṭho vā vartate loke karmajaṃ vā phalaṃ smṛtam
īśvareṇa niyukto hi sādhvasādhu ca bhārata
na caitadiṣṭaṃ kaunteya yadanyena kṛtaṃ phalam
evamapyaśubhaṃ karma na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati
tyaja tvaṃ rājaśārdūla maivaṃ śoke manaḥ kṛthā
dṛṣṭvā jñātivadhaṃ ghoraṃ hatāṃśca śataśaḥ parān
vyaktaṃ saukṣmyācca dharmasya prāpsyāmaḥ strīvadhaṃ vayam
te vayaṃ suhṛdo hatvā kṛtvā pāpamanantakam
nakare nipatiṣyāmo hyadhaḥ śirasa eva ha
parīkṣya nipuṇaṃ buddhyā ṛṣiḥ provāca pāṇḍavam
kāṅkṣamāṇāḥ śriyaṃ kṛtsnāṃ pṛthivyāṃ ca mabadyaśaḥ
nṛ tvaṃ hantā na bhīmo'yaṃ nārjuno na yamāvapi
na tasya mātāpitarau nānugrāhyo hi kaścana
idaṃ tu śrūyate pārtha yuddhe devāsure purā
ekaṃ hatvā yadi kule śiṣṭānāṃ syādanāmayam
kulaṃ hatvā ca rāṣṭre ca na tadvṛttopaghātakam
prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti hrāso vā pāpakarmaṇaḥ
kiṃ kṛtvā mucyate tatra tanme brūhi pitāmaha
vāgdattaṃ ca manodattaṃ dhārādattaṃ ca yo haret
svajanaiḥ kalahaṃ caiva āśritānāmarakṣaṇam etānyenāṃsi sarvāṇi vyutkrāntasamayaśca yaḥ
akāryāṇi tu vakṣyāmi yāni tāni nibodha me
yāni kurvannikurvaṃśca prāyaścittīyate naraḥ etānyeva tu karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni mānavaiḥ
iti cāpyatra kaunteya mantro vedeṣu paṭhyate
gurutalpaṃ hi gurvarthaṃ na dūṣayati mānavam
svayamaprāśitā yaśca na sa pāpena lipyate
pārivittyaṃ tu patite nāsti pravrajite tathā
bhikṣite pāradāryaṃ ca taddharmasya na dūṣakam
satkārāṇāṃ tathā tīrthe nityaṃ vā pratipādanam
api sā pūyate tena na tu bhartā praduṣyati
tattvaṃ jñātvā tu somasya vikrayaḥ syādadoṣavān
prāyaścittāni vakṣyāmi vistareṇaiva bhārata yāni kṛtvā naraḥ pūto bhaviṣyati narādhipa
tapasā karmaṇā caiva pradānena ca bhārata
dhanaṃ vā jīvanāyālaṃ gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam
kratunā cāśvamedhena pūyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ye cāpyavabhṛthasnātāḥ kecidevaṃvidhā narāḥ
te sarve dhūtapāpmāno bhavantīti parā śrutiḥ
dogdhrīṇāṃ sa ca pāpebhyaḥ sarvebhyo vipramucyate
sādhubhyo vai daridrebhyo dattvā mucyeta kilviṣāt
manorathaṃ tu yo dadyādekasmā api bhārata
na kīrtayeta dattvā yaḥ sa ca pāpātpramucyate
samitiṃ brāhmaṇo gacchediti vai brahmaṇaḥ śrutiḥ
punarna ca pibedrājansaṃskṛtaḥ sa ca śudhyati
gurvarthe vā hato yuddhe sa mucyetkarmaṇo'śubhāt
saṃvatsaraṃ vratī bhūtvā tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt
na tu striyā bhaveddoṣo na tu sā tena lipyate
rajasā tā viśudhyante bhasmanā bhājanaṃ yathā
pādona iṣṭo rājanye tathā dharmo vidhīyate
tathā vaiśye ca śūdre ca pādaḥ pādo vidhīyate
ahaḥ su satataṃ tiṣṭhedabhyākāśaṃ niśāḥ svapan
tasmāddānena tapasā karmaṇā ca phalaṃ śubham
dadyānnityaṃ ca vittāni tathā mucyeta kilbiṣāt
jānatā tu kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ guru sarvaṃ bhavatyuta
kiṃ bhakṣyaṃ cāpyabhakṣyaṃ ca kiṃca deyaṃ praśasyate
kiṃca pātramapātraṃ vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
kathamantraṃ kathaṃ dānaṃ gamyāgamyāḥ kathaṃ striyaḥ
kāryākāryaṃ ca yatsarvaṃ śaṃsa vai tvaṃ prajāpate
etāni medhyaṃ puruṣaṃ kurvantyāśu na saṃśayaḥ
sa eva dharmaḥ so'dharmo deśakāle pratiṣṭhitaḥ
apravṛtteramartyatvaṃ martyatvaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam aśubhasyāśubhaṃ vidyācchubhasya śubhameva ca
krodhamohakṛte caiva dṛṣṭāntāgamahetubhiḥ śarīrāṇāmupakleśo manasaśca priyāpriye
kṣayaṃ śokaṃ prakurvāṇo na mriyeta yadā naraḥ
varjayanti ca ye dharmaṃ teṣāṃ dharmo na vidyate
yadbrūyuḥ kārya utpanne sa dharmo dharmasaṃśaye
bhāsā haṃsāḥ suparṇāśca cakravākāḥ plavā bakāḥ
mānuṣīṇāṃ kharīṇāṃ ca na pibedbrāhmaṇaḥ payaḥ
mṛṣyanti ye copapatiṃ strījitānnaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
vāmahastāhṛtaṃ cānnaṃ śuṣkaṃ paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
yathā pravrajito bhikṣustathaiva sve gṛhe vaset
na matte caiva nonmatte na stene na ca kutsake
na vāgghīne vivarṇe vā nāṅgahīne na vāmane
na durjane dauṣkule vā vratairyo vā na saṃskṛtaḥ
kapāle yadvadāpaḥ syuḥ śvadṛtau ca yathā payaḥ
āptācarita ityeva dharma ityeva vā punaḥ
yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ
yathā ṣaṇḍho'phalaḥ strīṣu yathā gaurgavi cāphalā
grāmasthānaṃ yathā śūnyaṃ yathā kūpaśca nirjalaḥ
āpatsu ca yathā nītiḥ praṇetavyā dvijottama
dharmacaryā ca rājyaṃ ca nityameva virudhyate
janayāmāsa yaṃ devī divyā tripathagā nadī
kuru priyamamitraghna lokasya ca hitaṃ kuru
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ
narayānena tu jyeṣṭhaḥ pitā pārthasya bhārata
kurustriyaśca tāḥ sarvāḥ kuntī kṛṣṇā ca mādhavī
sitāḥ sumanaso gaurāḥ sthāpitāstatra tatra ha
dhanyā tvamasi pāñcāli yā tvaṃ puruṣasattamān
diṣṭyā rājyaṃ punaḥ prāptaṃ dharmeṇa ca balena ca
bhava nastvaṃ mahārāja rājeha śaradāṃ śatam
tāṃstu vai pūjayāmāsa kaunteyo vidhivaddvijān sumanomodakai ratnairhiraṇyena ca bhūriṇā
dhaumyaṃ guruṃ puraskṛtya jyeṣṭhaṃ pitarameva ca praviveśa sabhāṃ rājā sudharmāṃ vāsavo yathā
niḥśabde ca sthite tatra tato viprajane punaḥ
sāṅkhyaḥ śikhī tridaṇḍī ca dhṛṣṭo vigatasādhvasaḥ
ime prāhurdvijāḥ sarve samāropya vaco mayi
kiṃ te rājyena kaunteya kṛtvemaṃ jñātisaṃkṣayam
ghātayitvā gurūṃścaiva mṛtaṃ śreyo na jīvitam
iti te vai dvijāḥ śrutvā tasya duṣṭasya rakṣasaḥ
tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
na vayaṃ brūma dharmātmanvyetu te bhayamīdṛśam
tatastatra tu rājānaṃ tiṣṭhante bhrātṛbhiḥ saha
vareṇa cchandyamānaśca brahmaṇā ca punaḥ punaḥ
tānuvāca tato devo vihitaṃ tatra vai mayā
rājā duryodhano nāma sakhā'sya bhavitā nṛṣu
dhakṣyanti vāgbalāḥ pāpaṃ tato nāśaṃ gamiṣyati
sa eṣa nihataḥ śete brahmadaṇḍena rākṣasaḥ
sa tvamātiṣṭha kāryāṇi mā te bhūdvuddhiranyathā
dhṛtarāṣṭro yato rājā tataḥ sarve samāviśan
pṛthivīṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca
tata utthāya dāśārhaḥ śaṅkhamādāya pūritam abhyaṣiñcatpatiṃ pṛthvyāḥ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram
tvaṃ cāpi kuśalī rājanmādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
anugrāhyā vayaṃ nūnaṃ bhavatāmiti me matiḥ
dhṛtarāṣṭro mahārājaḥ pitā no daivataṃ param
etadarthaṃ hi jīvāmi kṛtvā jñātivadhaṃ mahat
eṣa nātho hi jagato bhavatāṃ ca mayā saha
asya prasāde pṛthivī pāṇḍavāḥ sarva eva ca
mantre ca niścaye caiva ṣāṅguṇyasya ca cintane
tane gopyo hi nṛpatiḥ sarvāvastho viśāṃpate
viduraṃ saṃjayaṃ caiva yuyutsuṃ ca mahāmatim
tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā jñātīnāṃ ye hatā yudhi
dhṛtarāṣṭro dadau rājā putrāṇāmaurdhvadehikam sarvakāmaguṇopetamannaṃ gāśca dhanāni ca
ye cānye pṛthivīpālā yeṣāṃ nāsti suhṛjjanaḥ
sa vijitya mahīṃ kṛtsnāmānṛṇyaṃ prāpya vairiṣu
tava kṛṣṇa prasādena nayena na balena ca
buddhyā ca yaduśārdūla tathā vikramaṇena ca
viṣṇo jiṣṇo hare kṛṣṇa vaikuṇṭha puruṣottama
adityāḥ saptadhā tvaṃ tu purāṇo garbhatāṃ gataḥ
samrāḍ virāṭ svarāṭ caiva svarāḍbhūtamayo bhavaḥ
ambhonidhistvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ pavitraṃ dhāma dhāmavit
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ puruṣaḥ svadhā svāhā ca keśavaḥ
yonistvamasya pralayaśca kṛṣṇa tvamevedaṃ sṛjasi viśvamagre
viśvaṃ cedaṃ tvadvaśe viśvayone namostu te śārṅgacakrāsipāṇe
evaṃ stuto dharmarājena kṛṣṇaḥ sabhāmadhye prītimānpuṣkarākṣaḥ
etannāmaśataṃ viṣṇordharmarājena kīrtitam yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
mumude tacca labdhvā'sau kailāsaṃ dhanado yathā
vidurāya ca rājā'sau pūjāṃ cakre yatavrataḥ
tathā sarvaṃ sa nagaraṃ prasādya bharatarṣabha
naupamyaṃ vidyate tasya triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcana
sukhena te niśā kaccidvyuṣṭā buddhimatāṃ vara
vayaṃ rājyamanuprāptāḥ pṛthivī ca vaśe sthitā
jayaṃ prāptā yaśaścāgryaṃ na ca dharmacyutā vayam
indriyāṇi manaścaiva buddhau saṃveśitāni te caturthaṃ dhyānamārgaṃ tvamālambya puruṣarṣabha
apakrānto yato jīvastena me vismitaṃ manaḥ
indriyāṇi ca sarvāṇi manasi sthāpitāni te
vākca satvaṃ ca govinda buddhau saṃveśitāni te
sarve caiva guṇā devāḥ kṣetrajñe te niveśitāḥ
neṅganti tava romāṇi sthirā buddhistathā manaḥ
yadi śrotumihārhāmi na rahasyaṃ ca te yadi
tvaṃ hi kartā vikartā ca tvaṃ kṣaraścākṣaraśca ha
tvaṃ prapannāya bhaktāya śirasā praṇatāya ca
māṃ dhyāti puruṣavyāghrastato me tadgataṃ manaḥ
na ca rāmeṇa nistīrṇastamasmi manasā gataḥ
vasiṣṭhaśiṣyaṃ taṃ tāta gato'smi manasā nṛpa
ekīkṛtyendriyagrāmaṃ manaḥ saṃyamya medhayā śaraṇaṃ māmupāgacchattato me tadgataṃ manaḥ
sa hi bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca bhavacca bharatarṣabha
tathā tannātra saṃdeho vidyate mama mādhava
darśanaṃ tvasya lābhaḥ syāttvaṃ hi brahmamayo nidhiḥ
pārśvasthaṃ sātyakiṃ prāha ratho me yujyatāmiti
dārukaṃ prāha kṛṣṇasya yujyatāṃ ratha ityuta
sa sātyakerāśu vaco niśamya rathottamaṃ kāñcanabhūṣitāṅgam
prājāpatye ca nakṣatre madhyaṃ prāpte divākare samāveśayadātmānamātmatyeva samāhitaḥ
tathā jaimininā caiva pailena ca mahātmanā
dhaumyo vibhāṇḍo māṇḍavyodhaumraḥ kṛṣṇānubhautikaḥ ulūkaḥ paramo vipro mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ
svareṇa hṛṣṭapuṣṭena tuṣṭāva madhusūdanam yogeśvaraṃ pajhanābhaṃ viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ jagatpatim
anādyantaṃ paraṃ brahma na devā narṣayo viduḥ
yaṃ na jānanti ko hyeṣa kuto vā bhagavāniti
yamāhurjagataḥ kośaṃ yasmiṃśca nihitāḥ prajāḥ yasmim̐llokāḥ sphurantyete jāle śakunayo yathā
yasminviśvāni bhūtāni tiṣṭhanti ca viśanti ca
yaṃ ca viśvasya kartāraṃ jagatastasthuṣāṃ patim vadanti jagato'dhyakṣamadhyātmaparicintakāḥ
yasminnitye tate tantau dṛḍhe sragiva tiṣṭhati
prāhurnārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ yaṃ viśvasya parāyaṇam aṇīyasāmaṇīyāṃsaṃ sthaviṣṭhaṃ ca sthavīyasām
garīyasāṃ gariṣṭhaṃ ca śreṣṭhaṃ ca śreyasāmapi
[yasminnityaṃ tapastaptaṃ yadaṅgeṣvanutiṣṭhati sarvātmā sarvavitsarvaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ ]
ekaṃ dvādaśadhā jajñe tasmai sūryātmane namaḥ
yaśca rājā dvijātīnāṃ tasmai somātmane namaḥ
hutāśanamukhairdevairdhāryate sakalaṃ jagat haviḥ prathamabhoktā yastasmai hotrātmane namaḥ
yaṃ jñātvā mṛtyumatyeti tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ
yaṃ bṛhantaṃ bṛhatyukthe yamagnau yaṃ mahādhvare
yaṃ viprasaṅghā gāyanti tasmai vedātmane namaḥ
[yajñāṅgo yo varāho vai bhūtvā gāmujjahāraha lokatrayahitārthāya tasmai vīryātmane namaḥ ]
yaṃ saptatantuṃ tanvanti tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ
[caturbhiśca caturbhiśca dvābhyāṃ pañcabhireva ca hūyate ca punardvābhyāṃ tasmai homātmane namaḥ ]
[yataḥ sarve prasūyante hyanaṅgātmāṅgadehinaḥ unmādaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tasmai kāmātmane namaḥ ]
śāntāḥ saṃnyāsino yānti tasmai mokṣātmane namaḥ
[yo niṣaṇṇo bhavedrātrau divā bhavati viṣṭhitaḥ iṣṭāniṣṭasya ca draṣṭā tasmai draṣṭrātmane namaḥ ]
vaikuṇṭhasya hi tadrūpaṃ tasmai kāryātmane namaḥ
brahma vaktaṃ bhujau kṣatraṃ kṛtsnamūrūdaraṃ viśaḥ
yo dhārayati bhūtāni tasmai prāṇātmane namaḥ
[prāṇānāṃ dhāraṇārthāya yo'nnaṃ bhuṅkte caturvidham antarbhūtaḥ pacatyagnistasmai pākātmane namaḥ ]
yasya tu jñāyate tatvaṃ tasmai guhyātmane namaḥ
candrārdhakṛtaśīrṣāya vyālayajñopavītine pinākaśūlahastāya tasmai ugrātmane namaḥ ]
yasminsarvaṃ yataḥ sarvaṃ yaḥ sarvaṃ sarvataśca yaḥ
yaṃ hi sūkṣmaṃ vicinvanti paraṃ sūkṣmavido janāḥ
sūkṣmātsūkṣmaṃ ca yadbrahma tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥ
matsyo bhūtvā viriñcāya yena vedāḥ samāhṛtāḥ
yaṃ na devā na gandharvā na daityā na ca dānavāḥ tatvato hi vijānanti tasmai sūkṣmātmane namaḥ ]
vāmanaṃ rūpamāsthāya baliṃ saṃyamya māyayā trailokyaṃ krāntavānyastu tasmai krāntātmane namaḥ
mahīṃ niḥkṣatriyāṃ cakre tasmai rāmātmane namaḥ
[vibhajya pañcadhā''tmānaṃ vāyurbhūtvā śarīragaḥ yaśceṣṭayati bhūtāni tasmai vāyvātmane namaḥ ]
jaghāna rāvaṇaṃ saṅkhye tasmai kṣatrātmane namaḥ
dadau rājyaṃ mahendrāya tasmai sāṅkhyātmane namaḥ
namaste dikṣu sarvāsu tvaṃ hi sarvaparāyaṇam
tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśaḥ saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ
tacca paśyāmi tatvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ padbhyāṃ devī vasuṃdharā
[diśo bhujā raviścakṣurvīrye śukraḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ saptamārgā niruddhāste vāyoramitatejasaḥ ]
ye namasyanti govindaṃ na teṣāṃ vidyate bhayam
daśāśvamedhī punareti janma kṛṣṇapraṇāmī na punarbhavāya
kṛṣṇavratāḥ kṛṣṇamanusmaranto rātrau ca kṛṣṇaṃ punarutthitā ye
te kṛṣṇadehāḥ praviśanti kṛṣṇa mājyaṃ yathā mantrahutaṃ hutāśe
yathā viṣṇumayaṃ satyaṃ yathā viṣṇumayaṃ haviḥ
tathā viṣṇumayaṃ sarvaṃ pāpmā ne naśyatāṃ tathā
bhīṣmaṃ ca śanakaiḥ sarve praśaśaṃsuḥ punaḥ punaḥ
adhigamya tu yogena bhaktiṃ bhīṣmasya mādhavaḥ
trailokyadarśanaṃ jñānaṃ divyaṃ dattvā yayau hariḥ
tato giraḥ puruṣavarastaveritāṃ dvijeritāḥ pathiṣu manāk sa śuśruve
kṛtāñjaliṃ praṇatamathāparaṃ janaṃ sa keśihā muditamanāsthanandata
iti smaranpaṭhati ca śārṅgadhanvanaḥ śṛṇotu vā yadukulanandanastavam
yaṃ yoginaḥ prāṇaviyogakāle yatnena citte viniveśayanti
sa taṃ purastāddharimīkṣamāṇaḥ prāṇāñjahau prāptaphalo hi bhīṣmaḥ
imaṃ naraḥ stavarājaṃ mumukṣuḥ paṭhañśuciḥ kaluṣitakalmaṣāpaham
atītya lokānmalinaḥ samāmatā npadaṃ sa gacchatyamṛtaṃ mahātmanaḥ
tataḥ sa ca hṛṣīkeśaḥ sa ca rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
kṛpādayaśca te sarve catvāraḥ pāṇḍavāśca te
amī rāmahradāḥ pañca dṛśyante pārtha dūrataḥ
ihedānīṃ tato rāmaḥ karmaṇo virarāma ha
rāmeṇeti yadāttha tvamatra me saṃśayo mahān
āgamo hi paraḥ kṛṣṇa tvatto no vāsavānuja
tato vrajanneva gadāgrajaḥ prabhuḥ śaśaṃsa tasmai nikhilena tattvataḥ
śṛṇu kaunteya rāmasya prabhāvo yo mayā śrutaḥ
maharṣīṇāṃ kathayatāṃ kāraṇaṃ tasya janma ca
yathā ca jāmadagnyena koṭiśaḥ kṣatriyā hatāḥ
udbhūtā rājavaṃśeṣu ye bhūyo bhārate hatāḥ
bhartrā dattaṃ prasannena mātre hṛṣṭā nyavedayat
mātā tu tasyāḥ kaunteya duhitre svaṃ caruṃ dadau
mātrā'si vyaṃsitā bhadre caruvyatyāsahetunā tasmājjaniṣyate putraḥ krūrakarmā'tyamarṣaṇaḥ
viśvaṃ hi brahma sumahaccarau tava samāhitam
kṣatravīryaṃ ca sakalaṃ tava mātre samarpitam
mātuste brāhmaṇo bhūyāttava ca kṣatriyaḥ sutaḥ
brāhmaṇāpaśadaṃ putraṃ prāpsyasīti hi māṃ prabho
naiṣa saṃkalpitaḥ kāmo mayā bhadre tathā tvayi
iccham̐llokānapi mune sṛjethāḥ kiṃ punaḥ sutam
[dṛṣṭametatpurā bhadre jñātaṃ ca tapasā mayā brahmabhūtaṃ hi sakalaṃ pitustava kulaṃ bhavet ]
putre nāsti viśeṣo me pautre ca varavarṇini
yathā tvayoktaṃ vacanaṃ tathā bhadre bhaviṣyati
dadau sa pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ saptadvīpāṃ saparvatām
tvayā na varjitaṃ yasmānmamedaṃ hi mahadvanam
arjunastu mahātejā balī nityaṃ śamātmakaḥ brahmaṇyaśca śaraṇyaśca dātā śūraśca bhārata
taṃ bhramantaṃ tato vatsaṃ jāmadagnyaḥ svamāśramam
arjunasya sutāste tu saṃbhūyābuddhayastadā gatvā''śramamasaṃbuddhā jamadagnermahātmanaḥ
candrabimbārdhasaṃkāśaṃ paraśuṃ gṛhya bhārgavaḥ tataḥ pitṛvadhāmarṣādrāmaḥ paramamanyumān
sa tathā sumahātejāḥ kṛtvā niḥkṣatriyāṃ mahīm
ye te yayātipatane yajñe santaḥ samāgatāḥ
pratardanaprabhṛtayo rāma kiṃ kṣatriyā na te
sā punaḥ kṣatriyaśataiḥ pṛthivī sarvataḥ stṛtā
jātaṃjātaṃ sa garbhaṃ tu punareva jaghāna ha
na te madviṣaye rāma vastavyamiha karhicit
pṛthivī dakṣiṇā dattā vājimedhe mama tvayā punarasyāḥ pṛthivyā hi dattvā dātumanīśvaraḥ
vadhyante na hi vitteṣu prabhutvaṃ kasyacittadā
vaiśyāḥ satpathasaṃsthāśca śūdrā ye caiva dhārmikāḥ
ānvīkṣakī trayī vārtā na ca nītiḥ pravartate
vrātyatāṃ samanuprāptā bahavo hi dvijātayaḥ adharottarāpacāreṇa mlecchabhūtāśca sarvaśaḥ
tataḥ kālena pṛthivī pīḍyamānā durātmabhiḥ viparyayeṇa tenāśu praviveśa pasātalam
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā dravatīṃ tatra saṃtrāsātsa mahāmanāḥ ūruṇā dhārayāmāsa kaśyapaḥ pṛthivīṃ tataḥ
haihayānāṃ kule jātāste saṃrakṣantu māṃ mune
vane saṃvardhito gobhiḥ so'bhirakṣatu māṃ mune
vatsaiḥ saṃvardhito goṣṭhe sa māṃ rakṣatu pārthivaḥ
teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca yeṣāṃ vaṃśāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
evaṃ bruvaṃstaṃ ca yadupravīro yudhiṣṭhiraṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ variṣṭham
tato rāmasya tatkarma śrutvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
aho dhanyo nṛloko'yaṃ samāgyāśca narā bhuvi
dūrādeva tamālokya kṛṣṇo rājā ca dharmajaḥ
abhivādya tu govindaḥ sātyakiste ca pārthivāḥ
kaccinna vyākulā caiva buddhiste vadatāṃ vara
sumūkṣmo'pi tu dehe vai śalyo janayate rujam
yacca bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhavacca puruṣarṣabha
viditaste mahāprājña tvaṃ hi dharmamayo nidhiḥ
tva, hi rājye sthitaṃ sphīte samagrāṅgamarogiṇam
satye tapasi dāne ca yajñādhikaraṇe tathā
dhanurvede ca vede ca nityaṃ caivānvavekṣaṇe
sa tvaṃ bhīṣma mahābāho vasūnāṃ vāsavopamaḥ
manuṣyeṣu manuṣyendra na dṛṣṭo na ca me śrutaḥ
bhavato hi guṇaistulyaḥ pṛthivyāṃ puruṣaḥ kvacit
cāturvidye ca ye proktāścāturhotre ca bhārata
yoge sāṅkhye ca niyatā ye ca dharmāḥ sanātanāḥ
cāturvarṇyasya yaścokto dharmo na sma virudhyate
pratilomaprasūtānāṃ mlecchānāṃ caiva yaḥ smṛtaḥ deśajātikulānāṃ ca jānīṣe dharmalakṣaṇam
vedokto yaśca śiṣṭoktaḥ sadaiva viditastava pravṛttaśca nivṛttaśca sa cāpi viditastava
dharmaśāstraṃ ca sakalaṃ nityaṃ manasi te sthitam
teṣāṃ chettā nāsti loke tvadanyaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
sa pāṇḍaveyasya manaḥsamutthitaṃ narendra śokaṃ vyapakarṣa medhayā
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ bhīṣmo vāsudevasya dhīmataḥ
tvaṃ hi kartā hṛṣīkeśa saṃhartā cāparājitaḥ
tena paśyāmi te divyānbhāvāṃstriṣu ca vartmasu
tacca paśyāmi tatvena yatte rūpaṃ sanātanam
divaṃ te śirasā vyāptaṃ pabhdyāṃ devī vasuṃdharā
yataḥ khalu parā bhaktirmayi te puruṣarṣabha
na hyabhaktāya rājendra bhaktāyānṛjave na ca
dame tapasi satye ca dāne ca nirataḥ śuciḥ
arhastvaṃ bhīṣma māṃ draṣṭuṃ tapasā svena pārthiva
tava hyupasthitā lokā yebhyo nāvartate punaḥ
pañcāśataṃ ṣaṭ ca kurupravīra śeṣaṃ dinānāṃ tava jīvitasya
tataḥ śubhaiḥ karmaphalodayaistvaṃ sameṣyase bhīṣma vimucya deham
ete hi devā vasavo vimānā nyāsthāya sarve jvalitāgnikalpāḥ
amuṃ ca lokaṃ tvayi bhīṣma yāte jñānāni sarvāṇi parābhaviṣyan
atastu sarve tava sannikarṣaṃ samāgatā dharmavivecanāya
yadā vācogataṃ sarvaṃ tava vāci samāhitam
yacca kiṃcitkṛtaṃ loke kartavyaṃ kriyate ca yat
tvattastanniḥ sṛtaṃ deva loke buddhimato hite
gātrāṇi cāvasīdanti na ca buddhiḥ prasīdati
na ca me pratibhā kācidasti kiṃcitprabhāṣitum
balaṃ me prajahātīva prāṇāḥ satvarayanti ca
na diśaḥ saṃprajānāmi nākāśaṃ na ca medinīm
kathaṃ tvayi sthite kṛṣṇe śāśvate lokakartari
na te glānirna te mūrcchā na tāpo na ca te rujā
satvasthaṃ ca mano nityaṃ tava bhīṣma bhaviṣyati
bhīṣma drakṣyasi tattvena jale mīna ivāmale
tataḥ sarvārtavaṃ divyaṃ puṣpavarṣaṃ na bhastalāt
vavau śivaḥ sukho vāyuḥ sarvagandhavahaḥ śuciḥ
sātyakiḥ sañjayaścaiva sa ca śāradvataḥ kṛpaḥ
śvaḥ sameṣyāma ityuktvā yatheṣṭaṃ tvaritā yayuḥ
tato rathaiḥ kāñcanacitrakūbarai rmahīdharābhaiḥ samadaiśca dantibhiḥ
yayau rathānāṃ purato hi sā camū stathaiva paścādatimātrasāriṇī
puraśca paścācca yathā mahānadī tamṛkṣavantaṃ girimetya narmadā
divākarāpītarasā mahauṣadhīḥ punaḥ svakenaiva guṇena yojayan
tataḥ puraṃ surapurasaṃmitadyuti praviśya te yaduvṛṣapāṇḍavāstadā
sahāsa iva vistīrṇaḥ śuśruve tasya veśmani
api sañjo mahātejā bhīṣmaṃ draṣṭuṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
na sainikaiśca yātavyaṃ yāsyāmo vayameva hi
na ca pīḍayitavyo me bhīṣmo dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ
ataḥ puraḥsarāścāpi nivartantu dhanañjaya adyaprabhṛti gāṅgeyaḥ paraṃ guhyaṃ pravakṣyati
rathasthāḥ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā sukhāṃ pṛṣṭvā ca śarvarīm
tato'vatīrya govindo rathātsa ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ bhīmo gāṇḍīvadhanvā ca yamau sātyakireva ca
sa taiḥ parivṛto rājā nakṣatrairiva candramāḥ
na glāyate ca hṛdayaṃ na ca te vyākulaṃ manaḥ
dāho mohaḥ śramaścaiva klamo glānistathā rujā
śiṣṭaiśca dharmo yaḥ proktaḥ sa ca me hṛdi vartate
caturṣvāśramadharmeṣu yo'rthaḥ sa ca hṛdi sthitaḥ
yacca yatra ca vaktavyaṃ tadvakṣyāmi janārdana
tava prasādāddhi śubhā mano me buddhirāviśat
svayaṃ kimarthaṃ tu bhavāñśreyo na prāha pāṇḍavam
kiṃ te vivakṣitaṃ cātra tadāśu vada mādhava
yaśasaḥ śreyasaścaiva mūla māṃ viddhi kaurava
tathaiva yaśasā pūrṇe mayi ko vismayiṣyati
ādheyaṃ tu mayā bhūyo yaśastava mahādyute
tato me vipulā buddhistvayi bhīṣma samāhitā
yāvaddhi prathate loke puruṣasya yaśo bhuvi
janmaprabhṛti te kiṃcidvṝjinaṃ na dadarśa ha
tebhyaḥ piteva putrebhyo rājanbrūhi paraṃ nayam
dharmaṃ śuśrūṣamāṇebhyaḥ pṛṣṭena na satā punaḥ
apratibruvataḥ kaṣṭo doṣo hi bhavitā prabho
tava prasādādgovinda bhūtātmā hyasi śāśvataḥ yudhiṣṭhirastu dharmātmā māṃ dharmānanupṛcchatu
ahṛṣyannṛṣayaḥ sarve sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
yasya nāsti samaḥ kaścitsa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
yasminnojaśca tejaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
saṃmānayati satkṛtya sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
yasminnetāni sarvāṇi sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
kuryādadharmaṃ dharmātmā sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
yo dadāti satāṃ nityaṃ sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
kṣāntaḥ śrutarahasyaśca sa māṃ pṛcchatu pāṇḍavaḥ
nihanti samare pāpānkṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit
nihanti yastaṃ samare kṣatriyo vai sa dharmavit
mahīṃ karoti yuddheṣu kṣatriyo yaḥ sa dharmavit
dharmyaṃ svargyaṃ ca lokyaṃ ca yuddhaṃ hi manurabravīt
athāsya pādau jagrāha bhīṣmaścāpi nananda tam
māṃ pṛccha tāta visrabdhaṃ mā bhaistvaṃ kurusattama
rājñāṃ vai paramo dharma iti dharmavido viduḥ
mahāntametaṃ bhāraṃ ca manye tadbrūhi pārthiva
atra vai saṃpramūḍhe tu dharme rājarṣisevite
lokasya saṃsthā na bhavetsarvaṃ ca vyākulībhavet
prabrūhi bharataśreṣṭha tvaṃ hi dharmabhūtāṃ varaḥ
namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase
ānṛṇyaṃ yāti dharmasya lokena ca samarcyate
pauruṣaṃ hi paraṃ manye daivaṃ niścitya muhyate
vipanne ca samārambhe santāpaṃ mā sma vai kṛthāḥ
na hi satyādṛte kiṃcidrājñāṃ vai siddhikārakam
satye hi rājā nirataḥ pretya ceha ca nandati
sudarśaḥ sthūlalakṣyaśca na bhraśyeta sadā śriyaḥ
ārjavaṃ sarvakāryeṣu śrayethāḥ kurunandana punarnayavicāreṇa trayīsaṃvaraṇena ca
mṛdurhi rājā satataṃ laṅghyo bhavati sarvaśaḥ
adaṇḍyāścaiva te putra viprāḥ syurdadatāṃ vara
manunā cātra rājendra gītau ślokau mahātmanā
dharmeṣu sveṣu kauravya hṛdi tau kartumarhasi
teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati
brahma ca kṣatriyo dveṣṭi tadā sīdanti te trayaḥ
evaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja namasyā eva te dvijāḥ
ślokau cośanasā gītau purā tāta maharṣiṇā
evaṃ caiva naraśreṣṭha rakṣyā eva dvijātayaḥ
brahmaghne gurutalpe ca bhrūṇahatye tathaiva ca
na śokaḥ paramā tuṣṭī rājñāṃ bhavati saṃcayāt
durgeṣu ca mahārāja ṣaṭsu ye śāstraniścitāḥ
na ca kṣāntena te nityaṃ bhāvyaṃ puruṣasattama
adharmo hi mṛd rājā kṣamāvāniva kuñjaraḥ
vārhaspatye ca śāstre ca śloko'yaṃ niyataḥ prabho
vasante'rka iva śrīmānna śīto na ca gharmadaḥ
parīkṣyāste mahārāja sve pare caiva nityaśaḥ
yathā hi garbhiṇī hitvā svaṃ priyaṃ manaso'nugam
svaṃ priyaṃ tu parityajya yadyallokahitaṃ bhavet
na santyājyaṃ ca te dhairyaṃ kadācidapi pāṇḍava
kartavyo rājaśārdūla doṣamatra hi me śṛṇu
sve sthāne na ca tiṣṭhanti laṅghyanti ca tadvacaḥ
vāntaṃ niṣṭhīvanaṃ caiva kurvate cāsya sannidhau
hayaṃ vā dantinaṃ vā'pi rathaṃ vā nṛpasaṃmatam
idaṃ te duṣkaraṃ rājannidaṃ te durviceṣṭitam
kruddhe cāsminhasantyeva na ca hṛṣyanti pūjitāḥ
visraṃsayanti mantraṃ ca vivṛṇvanti ca duṣkṛtam
na vṛttyā paritṛṣyanti rājadeyaṃ haranti ca
saptāṅgasya ca rājyasya viparītaṃ ya ācaret
gururvā yadi vā mitraṃ pratihantavya eva saḥ
maruttena hi rājñā vai gītaḥ ślokaḥ purātanaḥ
bāhoḥ putreṇa rājñā ca sagareṇa ca dhīmatā
na hiṃsyātparavittāni deyaṃ kāle ca dāpayet
vikrāntaḥ satyavākkṣānto nṛpo na calate pathaḥ
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca mokṣe ca satataṃ rataḥ
na viśvasecca nṛpatirna cātyarthaṃ ca viśvaset
svayaṃ prahartā dātā ca vaśyātmā vaśyasādhanaḥ
kāle dātā ca bhoktā ca śuddhācārastathaiva ca
vidyāvido lokavidaḥ paralokānvavekṣakān dharme ca niratānsādhūnacalānacalāniva
pratyakṣā ca parokṣā ca vṛttiścāsya bhavetsamā
evaṃ kurvannarendro hi na khedamiha vindati
yasya rājñaḥ pradṛśyante sa rājā rājasattamaḥ
putrā iva piturgehe viṣaye yasya mānavāḥ
vaśyā yattā vinītāśca na ca saṅgharṣaśīlinaḥ
viṣaye dānarucayo narā yasya sa pārthivaḥ
na yasya kūṭaṃ kapaṭaṃ na māyā na ca matsaraḥ
yasya cārāśca mantrāśca nityaṃ caiva kṛtākṛtāḥ
na jñāyante hi ripubhiḥ sa rājā rājyamarhati
rājānaṃ prathamaṃ vindettato bhāryāṃ tato dhanam
ṛte rakṣāṃ tu vispaṣṭāṃ rakṣā lokasya dhāriṇī
grāmakāmaṃ ca gopālaṃ vanakāmaṃ ca nāpitam
rājñāṃ rājīvatāmrākṣa sādhanaṃ cātra me śṛṇu
satāṃ saṃgrahaṇaṃ śauryaṃ dākṣyaṃ satyaṃ prajāhitam
utthānena mahendreṇa śraiṣṭhyaṃ prāptaṃ divīha ca
hṛdi yaccāsya jihnaṃ syātkāraṇārthaṃ ca yadbhavet
sopyasya vipulo dharma evaṃ vṛttā hi bhūmipāḥ
tato dvijātīnabhivādya keśavaḥ kṛpaśca te caiva yudhiṣṭhirādayaḥ
upāsya saṃdhyāṃ vidhivatparaṃtapā stataḥ puraṃ te viviśurgajāhvayam
sukhāṃ ca rajanīṃ pṛṣṭvā gāṅgeyaṃ rathināṃ varam
ekasya tu prasādena kṛtsno lokaḥ prasīdati
kṛtsnaṃ tanme yathātattvaṃ prabrūhi vadatāṃ vara
naiva rājyaṃ na rājā''sīnna ca daṇḍo na dāṇḍikaḥ
dharmeṇaiva prajāḥ sarvā rakṣanti sma parasparam
te trastā naraśārdūla brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ
trivarga iti vikhyāto gaṇa eva svayaṃbhuvā
sahāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ caiva ṣaḍvargo nītijaḥ smṛtaḥ
trayī cānvīkṣikī caiva vārtā ca bharatarṣabha
sāmabhedaḥ pradānaṃ ca tato daṇḍaśca pārthiva
mantraśca varṇitaḥ kṛtsno mantrabhedārtha eva ca
rathā nāgā hayāścaiva pādātāścaiva pāṇḍava viṣṭirnāvaścarāścaiva deśikā iti cāṣṭamaḥ
ḍambho liṅgaṃ samāśritya śatruvarge prayujyate śāṭhyaṃ niśceṣṭatā proktā cittadoṣapradūṣikā

tathākhyātavidhānaṃ ca yogaḥ saṃcāra eva ca
śaṅkitatvaṃ ca sarvasya pramādasya ca varjanam
upārjanaṃ ca dravyāṇāṃ paramarma ca tāni ṣaṭ
ekena ca yathottheyaṃ satyatvaṃ madhurā giraḥ
rakṣaṇaṃ caiva paurāṇāṃ rāṣṭrasya ca vivardhanam
dūṣaṇaṃ srotasāṃ caiva varṇitaṃ ca sthirāmbhasām
etatkṛtvā subhaṃ śāstraṃ tataḥ sa bhagavānprabhuḥ
daṇḍena nīyate cedaṃ daṇḍaṃ nayati vā punaḥ
jāyamānaḥ pitā putre putraḥ pitari caiva hi
buddhiṃ viśvasṛje dattvā brahmāṇḍaṃ yena nirmitam
kartā sarvasya lokasya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ sa devaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ mahādevaḥ sanātanaḥ
saṃcikṣepa tataḥ śāstraṃ mahāstraṃ brahmaṇā kṛtam
sahastraiḥ pañcabhistāta yaduktaṃ bāhudantakam adhyāyānāṃ sahastraistu tribhireva bṛhaspatiḥ
eko yo'rhati martyebhyaḥ śraiṣṭhya vai taṃ samādiśa
prakhyātā triṣu lokeṣu yā sā venamajījanat
anayā kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ tanme tattvena śaṃsata
tadahaṃ vaḥ kariṣyāmi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā
niyato yatra dharmo vai tamaśaṅkaḥ samācara
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mānaṃ cotsṛjya dūrataḥ
tayo prīto dadau rājā pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān
vaiṣamyaṃ hi paraṃ bhūmeriti naḥ paramā śrutiḥ
dhanuṣkoṭyā mahārāja tena śailā vimarditāḥ sa viṣṇunā ca devena śakreṇa vibudhaiḥ saha
dharme cārthe ca kāme ca samarthaṃ pradadau dhanam
na jarā na ca durbhikṣaṃ nādhayo vyādhayaḥ kutaḥ sarīsṛpebhyaḥ stenebhyo na cānyebhyaḥ kadācana
teneyaṃ pṛthivī dugdhā sasyāni daśa sapta ca
māhātmyena ca saṃyukto vaiṣṇavena naro bhuvi
subhagaṃ cārthavantaṃ ca rūpavantaṃ ca paśyati
bhuvi vācogataṃ yacca tacca sarvaṃ samarpitam
tato jagati rājendra satataṃ śabditaṃ budhaiḥ
ke dharmāḥ sarvavarṇānāṃ cāturvarṇyasya ke pṛthak
kena vai vardhate rāṣṭraṃ rājā kena vivardhate
kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca durgaṃ ca sahāyānmantriṇastathā
kuto vā''tmā dṛḍhaṃ rakṣyastanme brūhi pitāmaha
dvaidhībhāve ca bhṛtyānāṃ śapathaḥ kīdṛśo bhavet
sarvametadyathātatvaṃ vyavahāraṃ ca tādṛśam samāsavyāsayogena kathayasva pitāmaha
namo dharmāya mahate namaḥ kṛṣṇāya vedhase
prajanaṃ sveṣu dāreṣu śaucamadroha eva ca
brāhmaṇasya tu yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi kevalam
kṣatriyasyāpi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata
dadyādrājā na yāceta yajeta na ca yājayet
vaiśyasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi śāśvatam
rakṣayā sa hi teṣāṃ vai mahatsukhamavāpnuyāt
brāhmaṇāya ca rājñe ca sarvāḥ paridade prajāḥ
laye ca saptamo bhāgastathā śṛṅge kalā khure
na ca vaiśyasya kāmaḥ syānna rakṣeyaṃ paśūniti
śūdrasyāpi hi yo dharmastaṃ te vakṣyāmi bhārata
saṃcayāṃśca na kurvīta jātu śūdraḥ kathaṃcana
rājñā vā samanujñātaḥ kāmaṃ kurvīta dhārmikaḥ
avaśyaṃ bharaṇīyo hi varṇānāṃ śūdra ucyate
śūdrāyaiva pradeyāni tasya dharmadhanaṃ hi tat
kalpyāṃ tena tu tasyāhurvṛttiṃ dharmavido janāḥ
śūdreṇa tu na hātavyo bhartā kasyāṃcidāpadi
na hi svamasti śūdrasya bhartṛhāryadhano hi saḥ
śūdraḥ paijavano nāma sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ dadau
agre sarveṣu yajñeṣu śraddhāyajño vidhīyate daivataṃ hi mahacchraddhā pavitraṃ yajatāṃ ca yat
daivataṃ hi paraṃ viprāḥ svenasvena parasparam
devānāmapi ye devā yadbrūyuste paraṃ hitam
ṛgyajuḥ sāmavitpūjyo nityaṃ syāddevavaddvijaḥ anṛgyajurasāmā ca prājāpatya upadravaḥ
nāsya yajñakṛto devā īhante netare janāḥ
svaṃ daivataṃ brāhmaṇaḥ svena nityaṃ parānvarṇānayajannaivamāsīt
adharo vitānastvatha tatra sṛṣṭo na brāhmaṇastriṣu varṇeṣu rājan
tasmādvarṇā ṛjavo jñātivarṇāḥ saṃsṛjyante tasya vikāra eva
ekaṃ sāma yajurekamṛgekā vipraśvaiko niścaye teṣu sṛṣṭaḥ
vahniṃ juhoti dharmeṇa śraddhā vai kāraṇaṃ mahat
steno vā yadi vā pāpo yadi vā pāpakṛttamaḥ
yaṣṭumicchati yajñaṃ yaḥ sādhumeva vadanti tam
na hi yajñasamaṃ kiṃcitriṣu lokeṣu vidyate tasmādyaṣṭavyamityāhuḥ puruṣeṇānasūyatā
svadāratuṣṭastvṛtukālagāmī niyogasevī na śaṭho na jihnaḥ
mitāśano devarataḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyo mṛduścānṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvān
dānto vidheyo havyakavyāpramatto hyannasya dātā satataṃ dvijebhyaḥ
mahārthamatyantatapaḥ prayuktaṃ taducyamānaṃ hi mayā nibodha
satyārjavaṃ cātithipūjanaṃ ca dharmastathārthaśca ratiḥ svadāraiḥ
