niṣevitavyāni sukhāni loke hyasminpare caiva mataṃ mamaitat
evaṃ hi yo brāhmaṇo yajñaśīlo gārhasthyamadhyāvasate yathāvat
gṛhasthavṛttiṃ pratigāhya samya ksvarge viśuddhaṃ phalamaśnute saḥ
brahmacārī vratī nityaṃ nityaṃ dīkṣāparo vaśī gurucchāyānugo nityamadhīyānaḥ suyantritaḥ
uktāni karmāṇi bahūni rāja nsvargyāṇi rājanyaparāyaṇāni
śāstrasya sarvasya vidhau smṛtāni kṣātre hi sarvaṃ vihitaṃ yathāvat
kṣātrāṇi vaiśyāni ca sevamānaḥ śaudrāṇi karmāṇi ca brāhmaṇaḥ sat
asmim̐lloke nindito mandacetāḥ pare ca loke nirayaṃ prayāti
yā saṃjñā vihitā loke dāse śuni vṛke paśau
vikarmaṇi sthite vipre tāṃ saṃjñāṃ kuru pāṇḍava
yo yasminkurute karma yādṛśaṃ yena yatra ca
jyākarṣaṇaṃ śatrunivarhaṇaṃ ca kṛpirvaṇijyā paśupālanaṃ ca
sevyaṃ tu brahma ṣaṭkarma gṛhasthena manīṣiṇā
śūdro rājanbhavati brahmabandhu rduścāritro yaśca dharmādapetaḥ
vṛpalīpatiḥ piśuno nartanaśca grāmapreṣyo yaśca bhavedvikarmā
evaṃvidho brāhmaṇaḥ kauravendra vṛttāpeto yo bhavenmandacetāḥ
japanvedānajapaṃścāpi rājan samaḥ śūdrairdāsavaccāpi bhojyaḥ ete sarve śūdrasamā bhavanti rājannetānvarjayeddevakṛtye
havyaṃ kavyaṃ yāni cānyāni rājan deyānyadeyāni bhavanti tasmin
tasmāddharmo vihito brāhmaṇasya damaḥ śaucaṃ cārjavaṃ cāpi rājan
tathā viprasyāśramāḥ sarva eva purā rājanbrahmaṇā saṃnisṛṣṭāḥ
yaḥ syāddāntaḥ somapāścāryaśīlaḥ sānukrośaḥ sarvasaho nirāśīḥ
ṛjurmṛduranṛśaṃsaḥ kṣamāvān sa vai vipro netaraḥ pāpakarmā
vipraṃ vaiśyaṃ rājaputraṃ ca rājan lokāḥ sarve saṃśritā dharmakāmāḥ
lokaścāyaṃ sarvalokasya na syā ccāturvarṇyaṃ vedavādāśca na syuḥ
sarvāścejyāḥ sarvalokakriyāśca sadyaḥ sarve cāśramāścaiva na syuḥ
tathā vaiśyasya rājendra rājaputrasya caiva hi
saṃtānādīni karmāṇi kṛtvā somaṃ niṣevya ca
saṃgrāme vijayaṃ prāpya tathā'lpaṃ yadi vā bahu
sthāpayitvā prajāpālaṃ putraṃ rājye ca pāṇḍava
sarve dharmāḥ sopadharmāstrayāṇāṃ rājño dharmaṃ nītiśāstre śṛṇomi
mahāśrayaṃ bahukalyāṇarūpaṃ kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ netaraṃ prāhurāryāḥ
sarve dharmā rājadharmapradhānāḥ sarve varṇāḥ pālyamānā bhavanti
sarvastyāgo rājadharmeṣu rājaṃ styāgaṃ dharmaṃ cāhuragryaṃ purāṇam
majjetrayī daṇḍanītau hatāyāṃ sarve dharmāḥ prakṣayeyurviruddhāḥ
sarve dharmāścāśramāṇāṃ hatāḥ syuḥ kṣātre naṣṭe rājadharme purāṇe
sarve bhogā rājadharmeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ sarvā dīkṣā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ
sarvā vidyā rājadharmeṣu yuktāḥ sarve lokā rājadharme praviṣṭāḥ
sarve dharmā rājadharmeṣu dṛṣṭāḥ sarve bhogā rājadharmeṣu rājan
sarve yogā rājadharmeṣu coktāḥ sarve dharmā rājadharme praviṣṭāḥ tasmāddharmo rājadharmādviśiṣṭo nānyo loke vidyate'jātaśatro
evaṃ dharmā rājadharmairviyuktāḥ saṃcinvanto nādriyante svadharmam
dharmāśrame'dhyavasināṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira yathā trayāṇāṃ varṇānāṃ saṃkhyātopaśrutiḥ purā
udāhṛtaṃ te rājendra yathā viṣṇuṃ mahaujasam sarvabhūteśvaraṃ devaṃ brāhmaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ purā
sādhyā devā vasavaścāśvinau ca rudrāśca viśve marutāṃ gaṇāśca
sṛṣṭāḥ purā hyādidevena devāḥ kṣātre dharme vartayante ca siddhāḥ
babhūva rājā rājendra māndhātā nāma vīryavān
sa pārthivairvṛtaḥ sadbhirarcayāmāsa taṃ prabhum tasya pārthivasaṅghasya tasya caiva mahātmanaḥ
kimiṣyase dharmabhūtāṃ variṣṭha yaṃ draṣṭukāmo'si tamaprameyam
nāsau devo viśvarūpo mayā'pi śakyo draṣṭuṃ brahmaṇā vā'pi sākṣāt
ye'nye kāmāstava rājanhṛdisthā dāsye caitāṃstvaṃ hi martyeṣu rājā
satye sthito dharmaparo jitendriyaḥ śūro dṛḍhaprītirataḥ surāṇām
buddhyā bhaktyā cottamaḥ śraddhayā ca tataste'haṃ dajhi varānyatheṣṭam
asaṃśayaṃ bhagavannādidevaṃ vakṣyāmi tvā'haṃ śirasā saṃprasādya
tyaktvā kāmāndharmakāmo hyaraṇya micche gantuṃ satpathaṃ sādhujuṣṭam
kṣātrāddharmādvipulādaprameyā ślokāḥ prāptāḥ sthāpitaṃ svaṃ yaśaśca
dharmo yo'sāvādidevātpravṛtto lokaśreṣṭhaṃ taṃ na jānāmi kartum
asainikā dharmaparāśca dharme parāṃ gatiṃ na nayante hyayuktam
kṣātro dharmo hyādidevātpravṛttaḥ paścādanye śeṣabhūtāśca dharmāḥ
śeṣāḥ sṛṣṭā hyantavanto hyanantāḥ saprasthānāḥ kṣātradharmā viśiṣṭāḥ
asmindharme sarvadharmāḥ praviṣṭāḥ kṣātraṃ dharmaṃ śreṣṭhatamaṃ vadanti
na ca brahmā naiva lokādikartā santo dharmāścādidharmāśca na syuḥ
cāturvarṇyaṃ cāturāśramyadharmāḥ sarve na syurbrāhmaṇānāṃ vināśāt
naṣṭā dharmāḥ śatadhā śāśvatāste kṣātreṇa dharmeṇa punaḥ pravṛddhāḥ
yugeyuge hyādidharmāḥ pravṛttā lokajyeṣṭhaṃ kṣātradharmaṃ vadanti
ātmatyāgaḥ sarvabhūtānukampā lokajñānaṃ pālanaṃ mokṣaṇaṃ ca
viṣaṇṇānāṃ mokṣaṇaṃ pīḍitānāṃ kṣātre dharme vidyate pārthivānām
nirmaryādāḥ kāmamanyupravṛttā bhītā rājño nādhigacchanti pāpam
loke bhūtāni sarvāṇi carante nātra saṃśayaḥ
evaṃvīryaḥ sarvadharmopapannaḥ kṣātraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadharmeṣu dharmaḥ
bhūsaskāraṃ dharmasaṃskārayogyaṃ dīkṣācaryāṃ pālanaṃ ca prajānām
tyāgaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ munayo vai vadanti sarvaśreṣṭhaṃ yaccharīraṃ tyajanti
nityaṃ vyaktaṃ rājadharmeṣu sarve pratyakṣaṃ te bhūmipālā yathaite
nityaṃ dharmaṃ kṣatriyo brahmacārī caredeko hyāśramaṃ dharmakāmaḥ
sāmānyārthe vyavahāre pravṛtte priyāpriye varjayannaiva yatnāt
vaṃsvaṃ dharmaṃ yena caranti varṇā stāṃstāndharmānanyathārthānvadanti
traividyānāṃ yā gatirbrāhmaṇānāṃ ye caivoktāḥ svāśramā brāhmaṇānām
anyathā vartamānasya na sā vṛttiḥ prakalpyate
karmaṇā vardhate dharmo yathā dharmastathaiva saḥ
yo vikarmasthito vipro na sa sanmānamarhati
ete varṇāḥ sarvadharmaiśca hīnā utkraṣṭavyāḥ kṣatriyaireva dharmāḥ
tasmācchreṣṭhā rājadharmā na cānye vīryaśreṣṭhā rājadharmā matā me
uṣṭrāḥ pulindā āraṭṭāḥ kācā mlecchāśca sarvaśaḥ
madvidhaiśca kathaṃ sthāpyāḥ sarve vai dasyujīvinaḥ
tadā dharmo na calate saṃbhūtaḥ śāśvataḥ purā
na tasya dattaṃ na kṛtaṃ na śrutaṃ phalati kvacit
pravṛttasya hi dharmasya buddhyā yaḥ smarate gatim
sa me mānyaśca pūjyaśca sa ca kṣatre pratiṣṭhitaḥ
antarā vilayaṃ yānti yathā pathi vicakṣuṣaḥ
śrutā me kathitāḥ pūrvaṃ catvāro mānavāśramāḥ
yattu liṅgāntaragataṃ pṛcchase māṃ yudhiṣṭhira dharmaṃ dharmabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭha tannibodha narādhipa
vetti dānaṃ visargaṃ ca vigrahānugrahau tathā
mṛtyurvā rakṣaṇaṃ veti yasya rājño viniścayaḥ
yaḥ sthitaḥ puruṣo dharme dhātrā sṛṣṭe yathārthavat
yasminna naśyanti guṇāḥ kaunteya puruṣe sadā
ye dharmakuśalā loke dharmaṃ kurvanti bhārata
pārthivāḥ puruṣavyāghra teṣāṃ pāpaṃ haranti te
ye ca rakṣāsahāyāḥ syuḥ pārthivānāṃ yudhiṣṭhira
ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati mānavaḥ
yadā sarvatra nirmuktaḥ kāmo nāsya hṛdi sthitaḥ
yadā satyānvito vṛttaistadā brahma sama śnute
vane caranti ye dharmamāśrameṣu ca bhārata
eṣa te vividho dharmaḥ pāṇḍavaśreṣṭha kīrtitaḥ
yudhiṣṭhira tvamenaṃ vai pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sanātanam
bhūyāṃsaṃ labhate kleśaṃ yā gaurbhavati durduhā
atha yā suduhā rājannaiva tāṃ vitudantyapi
indrāya sa praṇamate namate yo balīyase
pāpā hyapi tadā kṣemaṃ na labhante kadācana
ekasya hi dvau harato dvayośca bahavo'pare
adāsaḥ kriyate dāso hriyante ca balātstriyaḥ
arājakāḥ prajāḥ pūrvaṃ vineśuriti naḥ śrutam
parasparaṃ bhakṣayanto matsyā iva jale kṛśān
yaśca naḥ samayaṃ bhindyāttyājyā nastādṛśā iti viśvāsārthaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ varṇānāmaviśeṣataḥ
yaṃ pūjayema saṃbhūya yaśca naḥ pratipālayet
sukhe dhāsyasi naḥ sarvānkubera iva nairṛtān
yaṃ ca dharmaṃ cariṣyanti prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya tvatsaṃsthaṃ no bhaviṣyati
tena dharmeṇa mahatā sukhaṃ labdhena bhāvitaḥ
mānaṃ vidhama śatrūṇāṃ dharmaṃ janaya naḥ sadā
sa niryayau mahātejā balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
tasya dṛṣṭvā mahatvaṃ te mahendrasyeva devatāḥ apatatrasire sarve svadharme ca dadurmanaḥ
tato mahīṃ pariyayau parjanya iva vṛṣṭimān
evaṃ ye bhūtimiccheyuḥ pṛthivyāṃ mānavāḥ kvacit
namasyeraṃśca taṃ bhaktyā śiṣyā iva guruṃ sadā
devā iva ca devendraṃ narā rājānamantikāt
tasmācchatraṃ ca patraṃ ca vāsāṃsyābharaṇāni ca
īkṣitaḥ prativīkṣeta mṛdu valgu ca carju ca
rājā vasumanā nāma kausalyo dhīmatāṃ varaḥ
kena bhūtāni vardhante kṣayaṃ gacchanti kena vā
evaṃ pṛṣṭo mahāprājñaḥ kausalyenāmitaujasā rājasatkāramavyagro rājyasya ca vivardhanam
mamedamiti loke'sminna bhavetsvaparigrahaḥ na dārā na ca putraḥ syānna dhanaṃ na parigrahaḥ
viṣvaglopaḥ pravarteta yadi rājā na pālayet
hareyuḥ sahasā pāpā yadi rājā na pālayet
adharmaḥ pragṛhītaḥ syādyadi rājā na pālayet
kliśnīyurapi hiṃsyurvā yadi rājā na pālayet
anyāṃśca krośato hiṃsyurloko'yaṃ dasyuvadbhavet vadhabandhaparikleśo nityamarthavatāṃ bhavet
mamatvaṃ ca na vindeyuryadi rājā na pālayet
patedbahuvidhaṃ rājyaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet
na yonidoṣo varteta na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ
majjeddharmastrayī na syādyadi rājā na pālayet
na vivāhāḥ samājo vā yadi rājā na pālayet
ghoṣāḥ praṇāśaṃ gaccheyuryadi rājā na pālayet
kṣaṇena vinaśetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet
vidyāsnātā vratasnātā yadi rājā na pālayet
hartā svacchendriyo gacchedyadi rājā na pālayet
bhayārtaṃ vidravetsarvaṃ yadi rājā na pālayet
yadi rājā na samyaggāṃ rakṣayatyapi dhārmikaḥ
vārtāmūlo hyayaṃ lokastayā vai dhāryate sadā
yadā rājā dhuraṃ śreṣṭhāmādāya vahati prajāḥ
bhāve ca bhāvo nityaṃ syātkastaṃ na pratipūjayet
na hi jātvavamantavyo manuṣya iti bhūmipaḥ
kṣemaṃ ca kṛtvā vrajati tadā bhavati bhāskaraḥ
aśucīṃśca yadā kruddhaḥ kṣiṇoti śataśo narān
tadā vaiśravaṇo rājā loke bhavati bhūmipaḥ
putro bhrātā vayasyo vā yadyapyātmasamo bhavet
na tu rājñā'bhipannasya śeṣaṃ kvacana vidyate
rājā bhojo virāṭ samrāṭ kṣatriyo bhūpatirnṛpaḥ
ya ebhiḥ stūyate śabdaiḥ kastaṃ nārcitumarhati
rājā pragalbhaṃ puruṣaṃ karoti rājā bhṛśaṃ bṛṃhayate manuṣyam
rājābhipannasya kutaḥ sukhāni rājā'bhyupetaṃ sukhinaṃ karoti
rājā prajānāṃ prathamaṃ śarīraṃ prajāśca rājño'pratimaṃ śarīram
rājñā vihīnā na bhavanti deśā deśairvihīnā na nṛpā bhavanti
rājā prajānāṃ hṛdayaṃ garīyo gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā sukhamuttamaṃ ca
samāśritā lokamimaṃ paraṃ ca jayanti samyakpuruṣā narendra
narādhipaścāpyanuśiṣya medinīṃ damena satyena ca sauhṛdena
kathaṃ rakṣyo janapadaḥ kathaṃ vadhyāśca śatravaḥ
ātmā jeyaḥ sadā rājñā tato jeyāśca śatravaḥ
saṃsthāneṣu ca sarveṣu puṭeṣu nagarasya ca
amātyeṣu ca sarveṣu mitreṣu trividheṣu ca
yathā na vidyuranyonyaṃ praṇidheyāstathā hi te
cāre ca vihate sarvaṃ hataṃ bhavati bhārata
praṣṭavyo brāhmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ nītiśāstrasya tatvavit paścātpṛccheta bhūpālaḥ kṣatriyaṃ nītikovidam
vyāsaktaṃ ca pramattaṃ ca durbalaṃ ca vicakṣaṇaḥ
pūrvaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ ca yātrāyāṃ nagare tathā
na ca paśyo bhavedasya nṛpo yaścātivīryavān
sāntvena tu pradānena bhedena ca narādhipa
yathā putrāstathā paurā draṣṭavyāste na saṃśayaḥ
ākare lavaṇe śulke tare nāgabale tathā
ete guṇāḥ samastāḥ syurnṛpasya satataṃ sthirāḥ
vyavahārasya lopena kutaḥ svargaḥ kuto yaśaḥ
yadā tu pīḍito rājā bhavedrājñā balīyasā
tridhā tu kṛtvā mitrāṇi vidhānamupakalpayet ghoṣānnyaseta mārgeṣu grāmānutthāpayedapi
śrūyate hi nikumbhena saudāsasya balaṃ hatam maheśvaragaṇeśena vārāṇasyāṃ narādhipa
teṣāṃ ca dvāravadguptiḥ kāryā sarvātmanā bhavet
yathāsaṃbhavaśailāni caiṣṭakāni ca kārayet mṛṇmayāni ca kurvīta jñātvā deśaṃ balābalam
tailaṃ madhu ghṛtaṃ sasyamauṣadhāni ca sarvaśaḥ
auṣadhāni ca sarvāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca
nirvedayitvā tu paraṃ hatvā vā kurunandana
rājñā saptaiva rakṣyāṇi tāni caiva nibodha me
ātmā'mātyāśca kośāśca daṇḍo mitrāṇi caiva hi
ṣāṅguṇyaṃ ca trivargaṃ ca trivargaparamaṃ tathā
yo vetti puruṣavyāghra sa bhuṅkte pṛthivīmimām
kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiśca trivargaḥ paramastathā
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca trivargo vai sanātanaḥ mantraścaiva prabhāvaśca utsāhaścaiva tāntrikaḥ
kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ caiva kartā ca parikīrtitaḥ etatparataraṃ vidyāntrivargādapi bhārata
kāryasya sarvathā nāśo mokṣa ityabhidhīyate tena mokṣaparaścaiva devadevaḥ pitāmahaḥ
jagato laukikī yātrā yatra nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitā dharmo'rthaścaiva kāmaśca sevitavyāḥ svakālataḥ
sevā dharmasya kartavyā satataṃ bhūrivatsaraiḥ puruṣairnaraśārdūla tanmūlāḥ sarvathā kriyāḥ
dharmeṇa ca mahīpālaściraṃ rakṣati medinīm yaḥ kaściddhārmiko rājā sa vipanno'pi bhūpatiḥ
asminnarthe hi dvau ślokau gītāvaṅgirasā svayam
kiṃ tasya tapasā rājñaḥ kiṃca tasyādhvaraiḥ kṛtaiḥ
viṣaṃ māyā ca daivaṃ ca pauruṣaṃ cātmasiddhaye
ṣaṭpañca ca vinirjitya daśa cāṣṭau ca bhūpatiḥ
na buddhiṃ parigṛhṇīta strīṇāṃ mūrkhajanasya ca daivopahatabuddhīnāṃ ye ca vedairvivarjitāḥ
vidvāṃsaḥ prathitā ye ca ye cāptāḥ sarvakarmasu
daivaṃ puruṣakāraṃ ca trivargaṃ ca samāśritaḥ daivatāni ca viprāṃśca praṇamya vijayī bhavet
tatra kiṃ kurvataḥ siddhistanme brūhi pitāmaha
some prayatnaṃ kurvanti vayo varṇā yathāvidhi
kālo vā kāraṇaṃ rājño rājā vā kālakāraṇam
iti te saṃśayo mābhūdrājā kālasya kāraṇam
tadā kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartate
vidhavā na bhavantyatra nṛśaṃso nātra jāyate
nādharmo vidyate tatra dharma eva tu kevalam
tatastu dvāparaṃ nāma sa kālaḥ saṃpravartate
kalāvadharmo bhūyiṣṭho dharmo bhavati na kvacit
rasāḥ sarve kṣayaṃ yānti yadā necchati bhūmipaḥ
yugasya ca caturthasya rājā bhavati kāraṇam
tato vasati duṣkarmā narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ
prajānāṃ kalmaṣe magno'kīrti pāpaṃ ca vindati
daṇḍanītiṃ puraskṛtya kṣatriyeṇa vijānatā lipsitavyamalabhyaṃ ca labdhaṃ rakṣyaṃ ca bhārata
eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā daṇḍanītimān
evaṃ vṛttaḥ prajā rakṣansvargaṃ jetāsi durjayam
nāparīkṣya nayeddaṇḍaṃ na ca mantraṃ prakāśayet
striyaḥ seveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuñjīta nāhitam
seveta praṇayaṃ hitvā dakṣaḥ syānna tvakālavit
evaṃ carasva rājyastho yadi śreya ihecchasi
idaṃ vacaḥ śāntanavasya śuśruvā nyudhiṣṭhiraḥ pārthivamukhyasaṃvṛtaḥ
tadā vavande ca pitāmahaṃ nṛpo yathoktametacca cakāra buddhimān
dharme ca nāparādhnoti tanme brūhi pitāmaha
ārjavena ca saṃpanno dhṛtyā buddhyā ca bhārata
na sa dharmaṃ na cāpyarthaṃ pratigṛhṇāti bāliśaḥ
mā sma lubdhāṃśca mūrkhāṃśca kāmārthe ca prayūyujaḥ
dāpayitvā karaṃ dharmyaṃ rāṣṭraṃ nītyā yathāvidhi
dharmārthāvadhruvau tasya yo na śāstraparo bhavet
ūdhaśchindyāttu yo dhenvāḥ kṣīrārthī na labhetpayaḥ
yavasodakamādāya sāntvena vinayena ca yo hi dogdhrīmupāste ca sa nityaṃ vindate payaḥ
dogdhrī dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca mahī rājā surakṣitā
nityaṃ svebhyaḥ parebhyaśca tṛptā mātā yathā payaḥ
mā sma te brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā dhanasthaṃ pracalenmanaḥ
svargyaṃ puṇyaṃ yaśo nityaṃ prāpsyase kurunandana
eṣa eva paro dharmo yadrājā rakṣati prajāḥ
bhūtānāṃ hi yadā dharmo rakṣaṇaṃ paramā dayā
yo rājā rakṣaṇe yukto bhūteṣu kurute dayām
yadahnā kurute dharmaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālayan
tasmādrājaiva nānyo'sti yo dharmaphalamāpnuyāt sa rājyaṃ dhṛtimānprāpya dharmeṇa paripālaya
indraṃ tarpaya somena kāmaiśca suhṛdo janān
kīdṛśo brāhmaṇo rājā kāryākāryavicāraṇe kṣamaḥ kartuṃ samartho vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
ya eva tu sato rakṣedasataśca nivartayet
bāhubhyāṃ kṣatriyaḥ sṛṣṭa ūrubhyāṃ vaiśya eva ca
sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇasyedaṃ yatkiṃcidiha dṛśyate dharmayuktaṃ praśastaṃ ca jagatyasminnṛpātmaja
dharmataḥ saha vittena samyagvāyo pracakṣva me
dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca striyo ratnāni vāhanam
maṅgalaṃ ca praśastaṃ ca yaccānyadapi vidyate jyeṣṭhenābhijaneneha taddharmakuśalā viduḥ
svameva brāhmaṇo bhuṅkte svaṃ vaste svaṃ dadāti ca
gururhi sarvavarṇānāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaśca vai dvijaḥ
patyabhāve yathaiva strī devaraṃ kurute patim ānantaryāttathā kṣatraṃ pṛthivī kurute patim
eṣa te prathamaḥ kalpa āpadyanyo bhavedataḥ
yadi svarge paraṃ sthānaṃ dharmataḥ parimārgasi
brāhmaṇo hi kule jātaḥ kṛtaprajño vinītavān
rājā carati yaṃ dharmaṃ brāhmaṇena nidarśitam
brāhmaṇaṃ ca savidvāṃsaṃ rājaśāstravipaścitam samyagvṛttāḥ svadharmasthā na kutaścidbhayānvitāḥ
rāṣṭre caranti yaṃ dharmaṃ rājñā sādhvabhirakṣitāḥ
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhāgaṃ tu vindati
chāyāyāmapsu vāyau ca sukhamuṣṇe'dhigacchati agnau vāsasi sūrye ca sukhaṃ śīte'dhigacchati
śabde sparśe rase rūpe gandhe ca ramate manaḥ
teṣu bhogeṣu sarveṣu na bhīto labhate sukham
abhayasya hi yo dātā tasyaiva sumahatphalam
na hi prāṇasamaṃ dānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate indro rājā yamo rājā dharmo rājā tathaiva ca
rājā bibharti bhūtāni rājñā sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam
rājñā purohitaḥ kāryaḥ kīdṛśo varṇato bhavet
gauro vā lohito vā'pi śyāmo vā nīrujaḥ sukhī akrodhano hyacapalaḥ sarvataśca jitendriyaḥ
ucchiṣṭaḥ sa bhavedrājā yasya nāsti purohitaḥ
śatrūṇāṃ ca bhavedvadhyo yasya nāsti purohitaḥ
raudrahomasahasraṃ ca svasya rājñaḥ priyaṃ hitam
etānhitvā divaṃ yāti rājā sapta mahāmalān
ṛgvede sāmavede ca yajurvede ca vājinām
na nirdiṣṭāni karmāṇi triṣu sthāneṣu bhūbhṛtām
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva ariṣṭānāṃ ca śātanam
bahvṛcaṃ sāmagaṃ caiva vājinaṃ ca vivarjayet bahvṛco rāṣṭranāśāya rājanāśāya sāmagaḥ
śāntike pauṣṭike caiva nityaṃ karmaṇi varjayet
vedāścatvāra ityete brāhmaṇā ye ca tadviduḥ
jātyā na kṣatriyaḥ proktaḥ kṣatatrāṇaṃ karoti yaḥ
vaitānaṃ karma yaccaiva gṛhyakarma ca yatsmṛtam
śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva tathā'bhicaraṇaṃ ca yat
paurohityaṃ tu kurvāṇā nāśaṃ yāsyanti bhūbhṛtām
yasya yājyo mṛtaścaiva bhraṣṭaḥ pravrajito yathā
prajāguṇāḥ purodhāśca purohitaguṇāḥ prajāḥ rājā vai saguṇo yeṣāṃ kuśalaṃ teṣu sarvaśaḥ
yau bhavetāṃ sthitau dharme śraddheyau sutapasvinau
yadā hi brahma prajahāti kṣatraṃ kṣatraṃ yadā vā prajahāti brahma
dvidhā hi rāṣṭraṃ bhavati kṣatriyasya brahma kṣatraṃ yatra virudhyatīha
anvagbalaṃ dasyavastadbhajante tathā varṇaṃ tatra vidanti santaḥ
naiṣāṃ brahma ca vardhate nota putrā na gargaro mathyate no jayante
naiṣāṃ putrā devamadhīyate ca yadā brahma kṣatriyāḥ saṃtyajanti
naiṣāmartho vardhate jātu gehe nādhīyate tatprajā no yajante
apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti ye brāhmaṇānkṣatriyāḥ saṃtyajanti
kṣatraṃ vai brahmaṇo yoniryoniḥ kṣatrasya vai dvijaḥ
tayoḥ sandhirbhidyate cetpurāṇa stataḥ sarvaṃ bhavati hi saṃpramūḍham
nātra pāraṃ labhate pāragāmī mahodadhau nauriva saṃprabhinnā
cāturvaṇyaṃ bhavati hi saṃpramūḍhaṃ prajāstataḥ kṣayasaṃsthā bhavanti
brahmavṛkṣo rakṣyamāṇo madhu hema ca varṣati
abrahmacārī caraṇādapeto yadā brahma brahmaṇi trāṇamicchet
āścaryato varṣati tatra deva statrābhīkṣṇaṃ duṣprabhāścāviśanti
striyaṃ hatvā brāhmaṇaṃ vā'pi pāpaḥ sabhāyāṃ yatra labhate sādhuvādam
rājñaḥ sakāśe na vibheti cāpi tato bhayaṃ vidyate kṣatriyasya
pāpaiḥ pāpe kriyamāṇe'tivelaṃ tato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ
pāpaiḥ pāpāḥ saṃjanayanti rudraṃ tataḥ sarvānsādhvasādhūnhinasti
kuto rudraḥ kīdṛśo vā'pi rudraḥ satvaiḥ satvaṃ dṛśyate vadhyamānam
etatsarvaṃ kaśyapa me pracakṣva yato rudro jāyate deva eṣaḥ
ātmā rudro hṛdaye mānavānāṃ svaṃ svaṃ dehaṃ paradehaṃ ca hanti
vātotpātaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rudramāhu rdevaṃ jīmūtaiḥ sadṛśaṃ rūpamasya
na vai vātaḥ parivṛṇoti kaści nna jīmūto varṣati tatra devaḥ
tathā yukto dṛśyate mānuṣeṣu kāmadveṣādvadhyate muhyate ca
yathaikagehājjātavedāḥ pradīptaḥ kṛtsnaṃ grāmaṃ dahate ca tvarāvān
vimohanaṃ kurute deva epa tataḥ sarvaṃ spṛśyate puṇyapāpaiḥ
yadi daṇḍaḥ spṛśate'puṇyapāpaṃ pāpaṃ pāpe kriyamāṇe viśeṣāt
kasya hetoḥ sukṛtaṃ nāma kuryā dduṣkṛtaṃ vā kasya hetorna kuryāt
śuṣkeṇārdraṃ dahyate miśrabhāvā nna miśraḥ syātpāpakṛdbhiḥ kathaṃcit
evamasminvartate loka eṣa nāmutraivaṃ vartate rājaputra
pretyaitayorantarāvānviśeṣo yo vai puṇyaṃ carate yaśca pāpam
tatra pretya modate brahmacārī na tatra mṛtyurna jarā nota duḥkham
pāpasya loko nirayo'prakāśo nityaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokabhūyiṣṭhameva
tatrātmānaṃ śocati pāpakarmā vahvīḥ samāḥ pratapannapratiṣṭhaḥ
evaṃ jñātvā kārya eveha vidvān purohito naikavidyo nṛpeṇa
agraṃ hi brāhmaṇaḥ proktaṃ sarvasyaiveha dharmataḥ
pūrvaṃ hi brahmaṇaḥ sṛṣṭiriti brahmavido viduḥ
sarvaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca nivedyaṃ tasya dhīmataḥ
avaśyametatkartavyaṃ rājñā balavatā'pi hi brahma vardhayati kṣatraṃ kṣatrato brahma vardhate
rājñaḥ sarvasya cānyasya svāmī rājñaḥ purohitaḥ
idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi brahmakṣatravinirṇayam brahmakṣatraṃ hi sarvasya kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ param
yogakṣemo hi rāṣṭrasya tābhyāmāyatta eva ca
yogakṣemo hi rājño hi samāyattaḥ purohite
dṛṣṭaṃ ca rājā bāhubhyāṃ tadrājyaṃ sukhamedhate
sa hanyamāne sainye sve mucukundo narādhipaḥ
na caivaṃ samavartanta yathā tvamiva vartase
tathā ca māṃ pravartantaṃ kiṃ garhasyalakādhipa
nācchinde vā'pyanirdiṣṭamiti jānīhi pārthiva praśādhi pṛthivīṃ kṛtsnāṃ maddattāmakhilāmimām
tato vaiśravaṇo rājā vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayau
yaśaśca tejaśva mahīṃ ca kṛtsnāṃ prāpnoti rājanvipulāṃ ca kīrtim
pradhānadharmaṃ nṛpate niyaccha tathā ca dharmasya caturthamaṃśam
sarvāścaiva prajā nityaṃ rājā dharmeṇa pālayan
rājñā hi pūjito dharmastataḥ sarvatra pūjyate
yaṃ hi dharmaṃ carantīha prajā rājñā surakṣitāḥ
caturthaṃ tasya dharmasya rājā bhāgaṃ ca vindati
caturthaṃ tasya pāpasya rājā bhārata vindati
tādṛśātkilbipādrājā śṛṇu yena pramucyate pratyāhartumaśakyaṃ syāddhanaṃ corairhṛtaṃ yadi
sarvavarṇaiḥ sadā rakṣyaṃ brahmasvaṃ brāhmaṇā yathā
brahmasve rakṣyamāṇe tu sarvaṃ bhavati rakṣitam
na hi kāmātmanā rājñā satataṃ śaṭhabuddhinā
dharmārthaṃ rocaye rājyaṃ dharmaścātra na vidyate
tadala mama rājyena yatra dharmo na vidyate
śantanuśca mahīpālaḥ sarvakṣatrasya pūjitaḥ tavaitāṃ prājñatāṃ tāta yathā carasi medhayā
śauryaṃ balaṃ ca satyaṃ ca pitā tava sadā'bravīt
nityaṃ svāhā svadhā nityaṃ cobhe mānuṣadaivate
kule dhuri ca yuktānāṃ vahatāṃ bhāramīdṛśam
samantato vinīto yo vahatyaskhalito hi saḥ
dharmī gṛhī vā rājā vā brahmacāryathavā dvijaḥ
yaṃ hi vaidyāḥ kule jātā hyavṛttibhayapīḍitāḥ
kiṃ nvataḥ paramaṃ svargyaṃ kā tataḥ prītiruttamā
kiṃ tataḥ paramaiśvaryaṃ brūhi me yadi paśyasi
bhava rājā jaya svargaṃ sato rakṣā'sato jahi
anu tvāṃ tāta jīvantu suhṛdaḥ sādhubhiḥ saha
aiśvaryakāmā ye cāpi sāmipā vā'pi bhārata
tānsarvāndhārmiko rājā baliṃ viṣṭiṃ ca kārayet
[ṛtvikpurohito mantrī dūto vārtānukarṣakaḥ ete kṣatrasamā rājanbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhavantyuta ]
gatvā tu brāhmaṇastāṃśca caṇḍālaḥ pretya ceha ca
brāhmaṇo ṛgyajuḥ sāmnāṃ mūḍhaḥ kṛtvā tu viplavam
vrātye mlecche tathā śūdre taskare pattite'śucau
kudeśe ca surāpe ca brahmaghne vṛṣalīpatau
anadhīteṣu sarvatra bhuñjāne yatra tatra vā
mitradruhi kṛtaghne ca goghne caiva kathaṃcana
sa teṣāṃ viplavaḥ prokto mantravidbhiḥ sanātanaiḥ
yadi bhītaḥ prapanno vā kudeśaṃ śaucavarjitam
krūrakarmā vikarmā vā karmabhirvañcito'thavā tattvavittarate pāpaṃ śīlavānsayatendriyaḥ
abrāhmaṇānāṃ vittasya svāmī rājeti naḥ śrutiḥ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca yekecidvikarmasthā iti śrutiḥ
yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ
rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante tadvido janāḥ
rājansa rājñā bhartavya iti vedavido viduḥ
yajñaḥ śrutamapaiśunyamarhisā'tithipūjanam damaḥ satyaṃ tapo dānametadbrāhmaṇalakṣaṇam
kayā ca vṛttyā varteta tanme brūhi pitāmaha
yasya sma viṣaye rājñaḥ steno bhavati vai dvijaḥ
rājña evāparādhaṃ taṃ manyante kilviṣaṃ nṛpa
na me steno janapade na kadaryo na madyapaḥ
saṃvibhāgaṃ damaṃ śaucaṃ sauhṛdaṃ ca vyapāśritāḥ
svatantro jātu na krīḍe mā mamāntaramāviśaḥ
kṛtaṃ rājyaṃ mayā sarvaṃ rājyasthenāpi kāryavat nāhaṃ vyutkrāmitaḥ satyānmā mamāntaramāviśaḥ
śuklakarmāsmi sarvatra na durgatibhayaṃ mama dharmacārī gṛhasthaśca mā mamāntaramāviśaḥ
dānena divyānabhivāñchāmi lokān satyenātha brāhmaṇānāṃ ca guptyā
śuśrūṣayā cāpi gurūnupaimi na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ
na me rāṣṭre vidhavā brahmabandhu rna brāhmaṇaḥ kitavo nota coraḥ
nāyājyayājī na ca pāpakarmā na me bhayaṃ vidyate rākṣasebhyaḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyā yatra śūdrāśca dhārmikāḥ
nā'nāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ tatra na durbhikṣaṃ na vibhramaḥ
dhārmiko yatra bhūpālo na tatrāsti parābhavaḥ
utpātā na ca dṛśyante na divyā na ca mānuṣāḥ
yeṣāṃ gobrāhmaṇā rakṣyāḥ prajā rakṣyāśca kekaya
na rakṣo'bhyo bhayaṃ teṣāṃ kuta eva tu pātakam
yeṣāṃ purogamā viprā yeṣāṃ brahma paraṃ balam
vṛṣabhānmadhu māṃsaṃ ca kṛtānnaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yathā karmaḥ sanātanaḥ
atha tāta yadā sarvāḥ śastramādadate prajāḥ
tadā trātā tu ko nu syātko dharmaḥ kiṃ parāyaṇam
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ brūhi vistareṇa pitāmaha
yadā tu vijayī rājā kṣemaṃ rāṣṭre'bhisandadhet
unmaryāde pravṛtte tu dasyubhiḥ saṃkare kṛte
sarve varṇā na duṣyeyuḥ śastravanto yudhiṣṭhira
kastatra brāhmaṇāṃstrātā ko dharmaḥ kiṃ parāyaṇam
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa śastreṇa ca balena ca
amāyayā māyayā ca niyantavyaṃ tadā bhavet
kṣatraṃ ca brāhmaṇaṃ dveṣṭi tadā śāmyanti te trayaḥ
ye tatra yuddhaṃ kurvanti tyaktvā jīvitamātmanaḥ
brāhmaṇānparirakṣanto dharmamātmānameva ca manasvino manyumantaḥ puṇyām̐llokānvrajantyamī
tebhyo namaśca bhadraṃ ca ye śarīrāṇi juhvati
brahmalokajitaḥ svargyānvīrāṃstānmanuravravīt yathā'śvamedhāvabhṛthe snātāḥ pūtā bhavantyuta
dharmyāḥ pāpāni kurvāṇā gacchanti paramāṃ gatim
brāhmaṇo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama
dasyubhyo yaḥ prajā rakṣeddaṇḍaṃ dharmeṇa dhārayet
kāryaṃ kuryānna vā kuryātsa vāryo vā bhavenna vā
apāre yo bhavetpāramaplaveḥ yaḥ plavo bhavet
śūdro vā yadi vā'pyanyaḥ sarvathā mānamarhati
kimanaḍuhā yo na vahetkiṃ dhenvā vā'pyadugdhayā
yathā dārumayo hastī yathā carmamayo mṛgaḥ
yathā hyadakṣaḥ puruṣaḥ pathi kṣetraṃ yathoparam
yathā vipro'nadhīyāno rājā yaśca na rakṣitā
megho na varṣate yaśca sarva eva nirarthakāḥ
sa eva rājā kartavyastena sarvamidaṃ dhṛtam
kva samarthāḥ kathaṃśīlā ṛtvijaḥ syuḥ pitāmaha
yasminnetāni dṛśyante sa purohita ucyate dhīmānsatyadhṛtirdānto bhūtānāmavihiṃsakaḥ
ājñā śāstrasya ghore yaṃ na śaktiṃ samavekṣate
na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā
taṃ ca vikretumicchanti na tathā vṛttiriṣyate
tena krītena dharmeṇa tato yajñaḥ pratāyate
anyāyavṛttaḥ puruṣo na parasya na cātmanaḥ
tatte tapaḥ pravakṣyāmi vidvaṃstadapi me śṛṇu
nibodha daśahotṝṇāṃ vidhānaṃ pārtha yādṛśam cittiḥ sruk cittamājyaṃ ca pavitraṃ jñānamuttamam
na śāṭhyaṃ na ca jihyatvaṃ kālo deśaśca te daśa
kiṃśīlaḥ kiṃsamācāro rājño yaḥ sacivo bhavet
kīdṛśe viśvasedrājā kīdṛśe na ca viśvaset
dharmātmā pañcamaṃ mitraṃ sa tu naikasya na dvayoḥ
yato dharmastato vā syānmadhyastho vā tato bhavet
yo yasyārtho na roceta na taṃ tasya prakāśayeta mitrāṇāṃ prakṛtirnāsti tvamitrāṇāṃ ca bhārata
dharmādharmeṇa rājānaścaranti vijigīṣavaḥ caturṇāṃ madhyamau śreṣṭhau nityaṃ śaṅkyau tathā'parau
na hi rājñā pramādo vai kartavyo mitrarakṣaṇe
ariśca mitraṃ bhavati mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati
yastu vṛddhyā na tapyeta kṣaye dīnataro bhavet
tasminkurvīta viśvāsaṃ yathā pitarī vai tathā
taṃ śaktyā vartamānaṃ ca sarvataḥ paribṛṃhayet
ye yasya kṣayamicchanti te tasya ripavaḥ smṛtāḥ
vyasanānnityabhīto yaḥ samṛddhyā yo na duṣyati
viśvāsaste bhavettatra yathā pitari vai tathā
naiva dvau na trayaḥ kāryā na mṛṣyeranparasparam
samarthānyaśca na dveṣṭi nānarthānkurute ca yaḥ
ete karmāṇi kurvanti spardhamānā mithaḥ sadā
teṣu santi guṇāścaiva nairguṇyaṃ caiva lakṣyate
viśvastavadaviśvastasteṣu varteta sarvadā na hi doṣo guṇo veti nirūpyasteṣu dṛśyate
kṛtsnāṃ buddhiṃ ca te prekṣya saṃpṛcche tridivaṅgama
vācā duruktaṃ devarṣe tanmāṃ dahati nityadā
yasya na syurna vai sa syādyasya syuḥ kṛtsnameva tat
syātāṃ yasyāhukākrūrau kiṃ nu duḥkhataraṃ tataḥ
yasya cāpi na tau syātāṃ kiṃ nu duḥkhataraṃ tataḥ
mahākṣayaṃ vyayo vā syādvināśo vā punarbhavet
anāyasaṃ mune śastraṃ mṛdu vidyāmahaṃ katham
girā tvaṃ hṛdayaṃ vācaṃ śamayasya manāṃsi ca
durge pratītaḥ sugavo bhāraṃ vahati durvaham
yathā tvāṃ prāpya notsīdedayaṃ saṅghastathā kuru
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca na te'styaviditaṃ prabho
tvaṃ guruḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jānīṣe tvaṃ parāṃ gatim
yaḥ kaścidvedayedarthaṃ rājñā rakṣyaḥ sa mānavaḥ
hriyamāṇamamātyena bhṛtyo vā yadi vā bhṛtaḥ
sa kākaṃ pañjare baddhvā viṣayaṃ kṣemadarśinaḥ
adhīye vāyasīṃ vidyāṃ śaṃsanti mama vāyasāḥ
sa buddhvā tasya rāṣṭrasya vyavasāyaṃ hi sarvaśaḥ
asau cāsau ca jānīte rājakeśastvayā hṛtaḥ
na cāsya vacanaṃ kiṃcidanṛtaṃ śrūyate kvacit
vāyasaṃ tu vinirbhinnaṃ dṛṣṭvā vāṇena pañjare
kariṣyāmi hi te vākyaṃ yanmāṃ vipra pravakṣyasi
iti rājanyamaḥ prāha vartate ca tathaiva tat
na ca me'tra bhavāngarhyo na ca yeṣāṃ bhavānpriyaḥ
ye tvādānaparā eva vasanti bhavato gṛhe
tairhi me saṃdhito bāṇaḥ kāke nipatitaḥ prabho
sthāṇvaśmakaṇṭakavartīṃ siṃha vyāghrasamākulām durāsadāṃ duṣprasahāṃ guhāṃ haimavatīmiva
agninā tāmasaṃ durgaṃ naubhirāpyaṃ ca gamyate
neha viśvasituṃ śakyaṃ bhavatā'pi kuto mayā
ato nāyaṃ śubho vāsastulye sadasatī iha
vadho hyevātra sukṛte duṣkṛte na ca saṃśayaḥ
nyāyato duṣkṛte ghātaḥ sukṛte na kathanam
sītā nāma nadī rājanplavo yasyāṃ nimajjati
asatāmiva te bhāvo vartate na satāmiva
durgatīrthā bṛhatkūlā kāverī corasaṃyutā nadī madhurapānīyā yathā rājaṃstathā bhavān
uṣitaṃ śaṅkamānena pramādaṃ parirakṣatā antaḥ sarpa ivāgāre vīrapatnyā ivālaye
kaccideṣāṃ priyo rājā kaccidrājñaḥ priyāḥ prajāḥ
amātyā me na rocante vitṛṣṇasya yathodakam bhavato'rthakṛdityevaṃ mayi te doṣamādadhan
vidyate kāraṇaṃ nānyaditi me nātra saṃśayaḥ
na hi teṣāmahaṃ drogdhā tatteṣāṃ drohavadgatam
pūjito brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha bhūyo vasa gṛhe mama
ye tvāṃ brāhmaṇa necchanti te na vatsyanti me gṛhe
yathā syātsudhṛto daṇḍo yathā ca sukṛtaṃ kṛtam
adarśayannimaṃ doṣamekaikaṃ durbalaṃ kuru tataḥ kāraṇamājñāya puruṣaṃpuruṣaṃ jahi
bilvena ca yathā bilvamākāraṃ chādya buddhimān aśuddhaṃ sacivaṃ rājannaśuddhenaiva nāśaya
vayaṃ tu brāhmaṇā nāma mṛdudaṇḍāḥ kṛpālavaḥ
svasti cecchāma bhavataḥ pareṣāṃ ca yathā''tmanaḥ
rājannātmānamācakṣe saṃbandhī bhavato hyaham muniḥ kālakavṛkṣīya ityevamabhisaṃjñitaḥ
pituḥ sakhā ca bhavataḥ saṃmataḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ
snehāttvāṃ tu bravīmyetanmā bhūyo vibhro diti
ubhe dṛṣṭvā duḥkhasukhe rājyaṃ prāpya yadṛcchayā
tato rājakule nāndī saṃjajñe bhūyasā punaḥ
tathā ca kṛtavānrājā yathoktaṃ tena bhārata
śaktāḥ kathayituṃ samyakte tava syuḥ sabhāsadaḥ
kulīnaḥ pūjito nityaṃ na hi śaktiṃ nigūhati prasannamaprasannaṃ vā pīḍitaṃ hatameva vā
anāryā ye na jānanti samayaṃ mandacetasaḥ
yastveko bahubhiḥ śreyānkāmaṃ tena gaṇaṃ tyajet
śūraḥ kṛtajñaḥ satyaśca śreyasaḥ pārtha lakṣaṇam
yo vā'pyasthirasaṃkalpo buddhimānāgatāgamaḥ - - bupāyajño'pi nālaṃ sa karma prāpayituṃ ciram
satkṛtaḥ saṃvibhakto vā na mantraṃ śrotumarhati
satkṛtaḥ sthāpitaḥ so'pi na mantraṃ śrotumarhati
sarvakarmasu yaḥ śuddhaḥ sa mantraṃ śrotumarhati
mantriṇāṃ mantramūlaṃ hi rājño rāṣṭraṃ vivardhate
mantragrāhā hi rājasya mantriṇo ye manīṣiṇaḥ
teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ trividhaṃ vimarśaṃ vibudhya cittaṃ viniveśya tatra
niṣṭhā kṛtā tena yadā sahaḥ syā ttaṃ mantramārgaṃ praṇayedasaktaḥ
na vāmanāḥ kubjakṛśā na khañjā nāndhā jaḍāḥ strī ca napuṃsakāśca
na cātra tiryakca puro na paścā nnordhvaṃ na cādhaḥ praparetkathaṃcit
āruhya vā veśma tathaiva śūnyaṃ sthalaṃ prakāśaṃ kuśakāśahīnam
dveṣyo bhavati bhūtānāṃ sa sāntvamiha nācaran
prītiṃ ca janayatyevaṃ na cāsyodvijate janaḥ
sukṛtasya hi sāntvasya ślakṣṇasya madhurasya ca
prāpya dharmaṃ ca kīrti ca lokānāpnotyasau śuciḥ
ye caiva pūrvakathitā guṇāste puruṣaṃ prati
naikasminpuruṣe hyete vidyanta iti me matiḥ
na cāpi gūḍhaṃ dravyaṃ te grāhyaṃ kāryopaghātakam
kārye khalu vipanne tvāṃ yo dharmastaṃ ca pīḍayet
svargaṃ yāti mahīpālo niyuktaiḥ sacivaiḥ saha kāryeṣvadhikṛtāḥ samyagakurvanto nṛpānugāḥ
ātmānaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā yāntyadhaḥ saha pārthivāḥ
nātho vai bhūmipo nityamanāthānāṃ nṛṇāṃ bhavet
rājño vadhaṃ cikīrṣedyastasya citro vadho bhavet
yuktasya vā nāstyadharmo dharma eva hi śāśvataḥ
na tu hanyānnṛpo jātu dūtaṃ kasyāṃcidāpadi
putreṣvapi hi rājendra viśvāso na praśasyate
kṛtaṃ vā kārayitvā vā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
nyāyyaṃ ca paripraṣṭuṃ vṛttiṃ guptiṃ ca bhārata
manuṣyadurgaṃ mṛddurgaṃ vanadurgaṃ ca tāni ṣaṭ
tatra kośaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ vyavahāraṃ ca vardhayet
prājñā medhāvino dāntā dakṣāḥ śūrā bahuśrutāḥ
cāraiḥ suviditaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ karma prayojayet
carānmantraṃ ca kośaṃ ca daṇḍaṃ caiva viśeṣataḥ
prajānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ dharmabādhakam
yogakṣemaṃ ca vṛttiṃ ca nityameva prakalpayet
te kasyāṃcidavasthāyāṃ śaraṇaṃ śaraṇārthine rājñe dadyuryathākāmaṃ tāpasāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ
na cāpyabhīkṣṇaṃ seveta bhṛśaṃ vā pratipūjayet
rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca me rājanrāṣṭrasyaiva tu saṃgraham
rāṣṭraguptiṃ ca te samyagrāṣṭrasyaiva tu saṃgraham
grāmaṃ grāmaśatādhyakṣo bhoktumarhati satkuraḥ mahāntaṃ bharataśreṣṭha susphītaṃ janasaṃkulam
teṣāṃ saṃgrāmakṛtyaṃ syādvāmakṛtyaṃ ca teṣu yat
utpattiṃ dānavṛttiṃ ca śilpaṃ saṃprekṣya cāsakṛt
śilpaṃ prati karānevaṃ śilpinaḥ prati kārayet
phalaṃ karma ca saṃprekṣya tataḥ sarvaṃ prakalpayet
phalaṃ karma ca nirhetu na kaścitsaṃpravartate
yathā rājā ca kartā ca syātāṃ karmaṇi bhāginau
saṃvekṣya tu tathā rājñā praṇeyāḥ satataṃ karāḥ
pradviṣṭasya kutaḥ śreyo saṃvṛto labhate śriyam
bhṛto vatso jātabalaḥ ṣīḍāṃ sahati bhārata
na karma kurute vatso bhṛśaṃ dugdho yudhiṣṭhira
rāṣṭramapyātidugdhaṃ hi na karma kurute mahat
bāhyaṃ janaṃ bhedayitvā bhoktavyo madhyamaḥ sukham
evaṃ nāsya prakupyanti janāḥ sukhitaduḥ khitāḥ
arayo me samutthāya bahubhirdasyubhiḥ saha idamātmavadhāyaiva rāṣṭramicchanti bādhitum
pratidāsye ca bhavatāṃ sarvaṃ cāhaṃ bhayakṣaye
na vaḥ priyataraṃ kāryaṃ dhanaṃ kasyāṃcidāpadi
gomināṃ pārtha kartavyaḥ saṃvibhāgaḥ priyāṇi ca
prabhāvayanti rāṣṭraṃ ca vyavahāraṃ kṛṣiṃ tathā
yathā tāsāṃ ca manyeta śreya ātmana eva ca
tathā dharmāṇi sarvāṇi rājā rāṣṭreṣu vartayet
na cāsthāne na cākāle karāṃstebhyo nipātayet
sarva eva ime lokā na bhaveyurasaṃśayam
bhuṅkte sa tasya pāpasya caturbhāgamiti śrutiḥ
bhoktā tasya tu pāpasya sukṛtasya yathātathā
niyantavyāḥ sadā rājñā pāpā ye syurnarādhipa
kṛtapāpastvasau rājā ya etānna niyacchati tathā kṛtasya dharmasya caturbhāgamupāśnute
āpadyeva tu yācante yeṣāṃ nāsti parigrahaḥ
mā te rāṣṭre yācanakā bhaveyurmā ca dasyavaḥ
ye bhūtānyanugṛhṇanti vardhayanti ca ye prajāḥ
tete rāṣṭreṣu vartantāṃ mā bhūtānāṃ prabādhakāḥ
prājñaḥ śūro dhanasthaśca svāmī dhārmika eva ca
evaṃ daṇḍaṃ ca kośaṃ ca mitraṃ bhūmiṃ ca lapsyasi
ūrdhvaṃ caiva trayī vidyā sā bhūtānbhāvayatyuta
ye kecittānna rakṣanti tairartho nāsti kaścana
kiṃ chidraṃ konu saṅgo me kiṃvā'styavinipātitam
atītadivase vṛttaṃ praśaṃsanti na vā punaḥ
jānīta yadi me vṛttaṃ praśaṃsanti na vā punaḥ
rāṣṭre tu ye'nujīvanti ye tu rājño'nujīvinaḥ
amātyānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ madhyasthānāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
sarvānsupariṇītāṃstānkārayethā yudhiṣṭhira ekāntena hi sarveṣāṃ na śakyaṃ tāta rocitum
kathaṃ syādadhikaḥ kaścitsa ca bhuñjīta mānavān
ye bahanti dhuraṃ rājñāṃ te bharantītarānapi
ekapādaṃ trayaḥ pādā bhakṣayanti dinedine tasmātsarvaprayatnena pādaṃ rakṣa yudhiṣṭhira
eṣā te rāṣṭravṛttiśca rājñāṃ guptiśca bhārata
dharmāma rājā bhavati na kāmakaraṇāya tu
dharme tiṣṭhanti bhūtāni dharmo rājani tiṣṭhāti
taṃ rājā sādhu yaḥ śāsti sa rājā śriyamaśnute
devāśca garhāṃ gacchanti dharmo nāstīti cocyate
idaṃ mama idaṃ neti sādhūnāṃ tāta dharmataḥ
na vai vyavasthā bhavati yadā pāpo na vāryate
naiva bhāryā na paśavo na kṣetraṃ na niveśanam
devāḥ pūjāṃ na jānanti na svadhāṃ pitarastadā
na pūjyante hyatithayo yadā pāpo na vāryate
na yajñāṃstanvate viprā yadā pāpo na vāryate
manuṣyāṇāṃ mahārāja yadā pāpo na vāryate
vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmo yastasya kurute layam
dhanāni spauti dharmo hi dhāraṇādveti niścayaḥ
rājā bhavati taṃ jitvā dāsastena parājitaḥ
atyāśāṃ cābhimānaṃ ca dambhaṃ krodhaṃ ca varjayet
avijñātāsu ca strīṣu klībāsu svairiṇīṣu ca
ete cānye ca jāyante yadā rājā pramādyati
aśīte vidyate śītaṃ śīte śītaṃ na vidyate
arakṣitātmā yo rājā prajāścāpi na rakṣati
prajāśca tasya kṣīyante tataḥ so'nu vinaśyati
kālavarṣī ca parjanyo dharmacārī ca pārthivaḥ
saṃpadyadeṣā bhavati sā bibharti sukhaṃ prajāḥ
yo na jānāti nirhartuṃ vastrāṇāṃ rajako malam
ratnāni vā śodhayituṃ yathā nāsti tathaiva saḥ
brahmacaryaṃ tapo mantrāḥ satyaṃ cāpi dvijātiṣu
teṣāṃ yaḥ kṣatriyo veda pātrāṇāmiva śodhanam
sarva eva pramuhyante yadā rājā pramādyati
rājaiva kartā bhūtānāṃ rājaiva ca vināśakaḥ
dharmātmā yaḥ sa kartā syādadharmātmā vināśakaḥ
sametya sarve śocanti yadā rājā pramādyati
yaśca bhūtaṃ saṃbhajate ye ca bhūtāstadanvayāḥ adharmasthe hi nṛpatau sarve śocanti pārthiva ]
mā sma tāta balasthastvaṃ bhuñjīthā durbalaṃ janam
yadi nātmani putreṣu na cetpautreṣu napnṛṣu
na hi pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sadyaḥ phalati gauriba
yuktā yadā jānapadā bhikṣante brāhmaṇā iva
mahānvṛkṣo jāyate vardhate ca taṃ caiva bhūtāni samāśrayanti
yadā vṛkṣaśchidyate dahyate ca tadāśrayā aniketā bhavanti
yadā rāṣṭre dharmamagryaṃ caranti saṃskāraṃ kā rājaguṇaṃ bruvāṇāḥ
taiścādharmaścarito dharmamohā ttūpa jahyātsukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ ca
yatra pāpā jñāyamānāścaranti sabhāṃ kalirvindate tatra rājñaḥ
yatra rājā śāsti narānna śaktyā na tadrājyaṃ vardhate bhūmipasya
yaścāmātyānmānayitvā yathā hi mantre ca yuddhe ca nṛpo'nuyuñjyāt
bibardhate tasya rāṣṭraṃ nṛpasya bhuṅkte mahīṃ cāpyakhilāṃ cirāya
atrāpi sukṛtaṃ karma vācaṃ caiva subhāṣitām
nihanti balinaṃ dṛptaṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate
trāyate hi yadā sarvaṃ vācā kāyena karmaṇā
putrasyāpi na mṛṣyecca sa rājño dharma ucyate
tadā bhavanti balinaḥ sa rājño dharma ucyate
yadā jayati saṃgrāme sa rājño dharma ucyate
priyasyāpi na mṛṣyeta sa rājño dharma ucyate
bhinatti na ca maryādāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate
harṣaṃ saṃjanayannṝṇāṃ sa rājño dharma ucyate
saṃpūjayati sādhūṃśca sa rājño dharma ucyate
satyaṃ pālayati prītyā nityaṃ bhūmiṃ prayacchati
asmim̐lloke pare caiva rājā sa prāpnute phalam
yadā samyakpragṛhṇāti sa rājño dharma ucyate
sa paśyati ca yaṃ dharma sa dharmaḥ puruṣarṣabha
apramādena śikṣethāḥ kṣamāṃ buddhiṃ dhṛtiṃ matim
saṃgrahaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk
na jātvadakṣo nṛpatiḥ prajāḥ śaknoti rakṣitum
bhāro hi sumahāṃstāta rājyaṃ nāma sudurvaham
atastvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmaṃ vetsyasi vai param
svadeśe paradeśe vā na te dharmo vinaṅkṣyati
dharmecārthe ca kāme ca dharma evottaro bhavet
saṃgrahaścaiva bhūtānāṃ dānaṃ ca madhurā ca vāk
apramādaśca śaucaṃ ca rājño bhūtikaraṃ mahat
dharmavṛttaṃ hi rājānaṃ pretya ceha ca bhārata
dharmaṃ kṛtvā mahīṃ rakṣa svarge sthānamavāpsyasi
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ kuruśreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha
yena vṛttena vai tiṣṭhanna cyaveyaṃ svadharmataḥ
dharme sthitā hi rājāno jayanti pṛthivīminām
arthasiddheḥ paraṃ dharmaṃ manyate yo mahīpatiḥ
vṛddhyāṃ ca kurute bṛddhiṃ sa dharmeṇa virājate
api sarvāṃ mahīṃ labdhvā kṣiprameva vinaśyati
etāni śṛṇvam̐llabhate yaśaḥ kīrti śriyaṃ prajāḥ
atha pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ buddhyā na ca paśyatyabuddhimān
yasya nāsti gururdharme na cānyānapi pṛcchati
priyo ati bhūtānāṃ na ca vibhraśyate śriyaḥ
apriyaṃ yasya kurvīta bhūyastasya priyaṃ caret
amāyayaiva varteta na ca satyaṃ tyajedbudhaḥ damaṃ dharmaṃ ca śīlaṃ ca kṣatradharmaṃ prajāhitam
na tvareta na cāsūyettathā saṃgṛhyate paraḥ
priye nātibhṛśaṃ hṛṣyedapriye na ca saṃjvaret
yaḥ priyaṃ kurute nityaṃ guṇato vasudhādhipaḥ
tasya karmāṇi siddhyanti na ca saṃtyajyate śriyā
śreyaso lakṣaṇaṃ caitadvikramo yatra dṛśyate kīrtipradhāno yaśca syātsamaye yaśca tiṣṭhati
kārye mahati yuñjāno hīyate nṛpatiḥ śriyā
prajāśca tasya vardhante sukhaṃ ca mahadaśnute
vikrameṇa mahīṃ labdhvā prajā dharmeṇa pālayet
tasmāddharme sthito rājā prajā dharmema pālayet
etāni yasya guptāni sa rājā rājasattama
asaṃtyaktamanuṣyaṃ ca taṃ janāḥ kurvate nṛpam
agrāmyacaritāṃ vṛttiṃ yo na seveta nityadā
sa vai vyasanamāsādya sādhumārgaṃ na vindati
na cāpyalabdhaṃ lipseta mūle nātidṛḍhe sati
na hi durbalamūlasya rājño lābho vivardhate
alpenāpi sa daṇḍena mahīṃ jayati pārthivaḥ
daṇḍo hi balavānyatra tatra sāma prayujyate
trayāṇāṃ viphalaṃ karma yadā paśyeta bhūmipaḥ
upekṣā tatra kartavyā vadhyatā balināṃ balam
durbalo hi mahīpālo yadā bhavati bhārata upekṣā tatra kartavyā caturṇāmavirodhīni
upekṣā tatra kartavyā vācyatāṃ balināṃ balam
śaṭhānāṃ ucivānāṃ ca mlecchānāṃ ca mahīpate
dāsānāṃ ca pradṛptānāmetadeva hi kārayet caṇḍālamlecchajātīnāṃ daṇḍenaiva nivāraṇam
durvinītā vinītāśca sarve sādhyāḥ prayatnataḥ caṇḍālamlecchajātyāśca pāṣaṇḍāśca vikarmiṇaḥ
krodhaṃ nihantuṃ yo veda tasya dveṣṭā na vidyate
idaṃ vṛttaṃ manuṣyeṣu vartate yo mahīpatiḥ
atha yo vijigīṣeta kṣatriyaḥ kṣatriyaṃ yudhi
kastasya vijaye dharmo hyetaṃ pṛṣṭo bravīhi me
brūyādahaṃ yo rājeti rakṣiṣyāmi ca vaḥ sadā
mama dharmabaliṃ datta kiṃvā māṃ pratipatsyatha
te coktamāgataṃ tatra ghṛṇīyuḥ kuśalaṃ bhavet
athaḥ yaḥ kṣatriyo rājā kṣatriyaṃ pratyupāvrajet
eka ekena bhāvyaśca visṛjeti kṣipāmi ca
vyasane na prahartavyaṃ na bhītāya jitāya ca
hastinā yodhayennāgaṃ kadācicchikṣito hayaḥ divyāstrabalasaṃpannaḥ kāmaṃ yudhyeta sarvadā
nāge bhūmau same caiva rathenāśvena vā punaḥ
[sādhūnāṃ tu yadā bhedātsādhuścedvyasanī bhavet ] niṣprāṇo nābhihantavyo nānapatyaḥ kathaṃcana
cikitsyaḥ syātsvaviṣaye prāpyo vā svagṛhe bhavet
nirvraṇaśca sa bhoktavya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
satsu nityaḥ satāṃ dharmastamāsthāya na nāśayet
dharmeṇa nidhanaṃ śreyo na jayaḥ pāpakarmaṇā
pāpena karmaṇā vittaṃ labdhvā pāpaḥ prahṛṣyati
na dharmo'stīti manvānaḥ śucīnavahasanniva aśraddadhānaśca bhavedvināśamupagacchati
adharmavijayaṃ labdhvā ko nu manyeta bhūmipaḥ
balena vijito yaśca na taṃ yudhyeta bhūmipaḥ
na tu vadhye dhanaṃ tiṣṭhetpibeyurbrāhmaṇāḥ payaḥ
maryādāṃ śāśvatīṃ bhindyādbrāhmaṇaṃ yo'bhilaṅghayet atha cellaṅghayedeva maryādāṃ kṣatriyabruvaḥ
sāntvena bhogadānena sa rājñāṃ paramo nayaḥ
pūjārhāḥ pūjitā yasya sa vai lokaviducyate
etenaiva ca vṛttena mahīṃ prāpa surottamaḥ
na māyayā na dambhena ya icchedbhūtimātmanaḥ
apayāne ca yuddhe ca rājā hanti mahājanam
atha sma karmaṇā kena lokāñjayati pārthivaḥ
nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ saṃgraheṇa ca
ta eva vijayaṃ prāpya vardhayanti punaḥ prajāḥ
hinasti dhānyakakṣaṃ ca na ca dhānyaṃ vinaśyati
na tasmāntridaśāḥ śreyo bhuvi paśyanti kiṃcana
tasya śastrāṇi yāvanti tvacaṃ bhindanti saṃyuge
na tapo'sti tato bhūya iti dharmavido viduḥ
yadi śūraṃ tathā kṣeme pratīkṣeranyathā bhaye
pratirūpaṃ janāḥ kuryurna ca tadvartate tathā
yadi te kṛtamājñāya namaskuryuḥ sadaiva tam
yuktaṃ nyāyyaṃ ca kuryuste na ca tadvartate tathā
tyāgena yaḥ sahāyānāṃ svānprāṇāṃstrātumicchati taṃ hanyuḥ kāṣṭhalohairvā daheyurvā kaṭāgninā
na gṛhe maraṇaṃ tāta kṣatriyāṇāṃ praśasyate
idaṃ kṛcchramaho duḥkhaṃ pāpīya iti niṣṭanan
vīro dṛpto manasvī ca nedṛśaṃ mṛtyumarhati
sa saṅkhye nidhanaṃ prāpya praśastaṃ lokapūjitam
bhavanti nidhanaṃ prāpya tanme brūhi pitāmaha
ambarīṣo hi nābhāgaḥ svargaṃ gatvā sudurlabham
sa daṣṭvāpari gacchantaṃ senāpatimudāradhīḥ śūrasthānamanuprāptaṃ sudevaṃ nāma nāmataḥ
ṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā sudevasya vismitaḥ prāha vāsavam
de--ja sudevo'yaṃ mama senāpatiḥ purā āsādyodhaḥ praśāntātmā so'yaṃ kasmādatīva mām
yadanena kṛtaṃ karma pratyakṣaṃ te mahīpate
tathā tasmiñśubhe kāle tava yajñaṃ vitanvataḥ
tasya te khalu vighnārthamāgatā rākṣasāstrayaḥ koṭīśataparīvārāṃ rākṣasānāṃ mahācamūm
vihvalāśca prajāḥ sarvāḥ sarve ca tava sainikāḥ
śrutvā teṣāṃ vaco bhūyaḥ sopadhaṃ vasudhādhipaḥ
saṃprāptaśca sa taṃ deśaṃ yatra bandīkṛtāḥ prajāḥ
neyaṃ śakyā camūrjetumapi sendraiḥ surāsuraiḥ nāmbarīṣaḥ kalāmekāmeṣāṃ kṣapayituṃ kṣamaḥ
tataḥ senāṃ punaḥ sarvāṃ preṣayāmāsa pārthiva
tato rudraṃ mahādevaṃ prapanno jagataḥ patim
sa pāṇiḥ saha śastreṇa dṛṣṭvā cedamuvāca ha
kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ putra kurtakāmo vadasva me
sa uvāca mahādevaṃ śirasā tvavanīṃ gataḥ
bhagavanvāhinīmenāṃ rākṣasānāṃ sureśvara aśakto'haṃ raṇe jetuṃ tasmāttyakṣyāmi jīvitam
rathaṃ ca sumahābhāgaṃ yena tantripuraṃ hatam dhanuḥ pinākaṃ khaṅgaṃ ca raudramastraṃ ca śaṃkaraḥ
māyayā mohito bhūmau na padaṃ kartumarhasi
rathaṃ sūryasahasrābhaṃ kimu yoddhuṃ tvayā saha
sa jitvā rākṣasānsarvānkṛtvā bandīvimokṣaṇam ghātayitvā ca tānsarvānbāhuyuddhe tvayaṃ hataḥ
sannaddho dīkṣitaḥ sarvo yodhaḥ prāpya camūmukham
kāni yajñe havīṃṣyasminkimājyaṃ kā ca dakṣiṇā
ṛjuḥ suniśitaḥ pītaḥ sāyakaśca sruvo ma--
[saṅkhyāsamayavistīrṇamabhijātodbhavaṃ bahu ] āvedhādyacca rudhiraṃ saṃgrāme sravate bhuvi
chindhi bhindhīti yaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate vāhinīmukhe
kuñjarāṇāṃ hayānāṃ ca varmiṇāṃ ca samuccaya
agniḥ śyenacito nāma yajñe tasya vidhīyate
uttiṣṭhate kabandho'tra sahasre patite tu yaḥ
udgātā tatra saṃgrāme trisāmā dundubhirnṛpa brahmasve hriyamāṇe tu tyaktvā yuddhe priyāṃ tanum
na bhayādvinivarteta tasya lokā yathā mama
yasya vedirupastīrṇā tasya lokā yathā mama
vigāhya vāhinīmadhyaṃ tasya lokā yathā mama
yastu yodhaḥ parāvṛttaḥ saṃtrasto hanyate paraiḥ
apratiṣṭhaḥ sa narakaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
nāyakaṃ tatkumāraṃ vā yo vā syāttatra pūjitaḥ
jīvagrāhaṃ pragṛhṇāti tasya lokā yathā mama
āhave tu hataṃ śūraṃ na śoceta kathaṃcana
aśocyo hi hataḥ śūraḥ svargaloke mahīyate
na hyannaṃ nodakaṃ tasya na snānaṃ nāpyaśaucakam
vṛddhabālau na hantavyau na ca strī naiva pṛṣṭhataḥ
ahaṃ vṛtraṃ balaṃ pākaṃ mahākāyaṃ virocanam
durāvāraṃ ca namuciṃ śatamāyaṃ ca śambaram
vipracittiṃ ca daiteyaṃ danoḥ putrāṃśca sarvaśaḥ
ya evaṃ vyūhate rājā sa nityaṃ jayate ripūn
na hi prahartumicchanti śūrāḥ pradravato bhayāt
ato bhayārtāḥ praṇipatya bhūyaḥ kṛtvāñjalīnupatiṣṭhanti śūrān
na hi śauryātparaṃ kiṃcintriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
śūraḥ sarvaṃ pālayati sarvaṃ śūre pratiṣṭhitam
santyeva hi sthitā dharma upapattyā tathā pare
ubhe prajñe veditavye ṛjvī vakrā ca bhārata
caitre vā mārgaśīrṣe vā senāyogaḥ praśasyate
ete hi yogāḥ senāyāḥ praśastāḥ parabādhane
[agrataḥ puruṣānīkaṃ śaktaṃ cāpi kulodbhavam ] āvāsastoyavānmārgaḥ paryākāśaḥ praśasyate
bahubhirguṇajātaiśca ye yuddhakuśalā janāḥ [upanyāso bhavettatra balānāṃ nātidūrataḥ ]
yato vāyuryataḥ sūryo yataḥ somastato jayaḥ
anīkaṃ ye vibhidanti bhinnaṃ saṃsthāpayanti ca
jātigotraṃ ca vijñāya karma cānuttamaṃ śubham samānadeharakṣārthe kāryā dviguṇavetanāḥ
triguṇaṃ caturguṇaṃ caiva vetanaṃ teṣu kārayet
yathā jayārthaṃ saṃgrāme na jahyāma parasparam
ihaiva te nivartantāṃ ye ca kecana bhīravaḥ
[na sannipāte pradaraṃ vadhaṃ vā kuryurīdṛśāḥ ] ātmānaṃ ca svapakṣaṃ ca pālayanhanti saṃyuge
pratidhvastoṣṭhadantasya nyastasarvāyudhasya ca hitvā palāyamānasya sahāyānprāṇasaṃśaye
rāśivardhanamātrāste naiva te pretya no iha
śriyaṃ jānīta dharmasya mūlaṃ sarvasukhasya ca
jayanto vadhyamānā vā prāpnuyāma ca sadgatim
saṃprayukte nikṛṣṭe vā satyaṃ vā yadi vā'nṛtam
pragṛhya bāhūnkrośeta hanta bhagnāḥ pare iti
kiṃsannāhāḥ kathaṃśastrā janāḥ syuḥ saṃyuge nṛpāḥ
tathā yavanakāmbhojā madhurāmabhitaśca ye ete'śvayuddhakuśalā dākṣiṇātyā'sicarmiṇaḥ
prāyo deśāḥ samuddiṣṭā lakṣaṇāni tu me śṛṇu
siṃhaśārdūlavāṅgetrāḥ siṃhaśārdūlagāminaḥ pārāvatakuliṅgākṣāḥ sarve śūrāḥ pramāthinaḥ
puraskāryāḥ sadā sainye hanyante ghnanti cāpi te
maṅgala ni ca kurvanti śamayantyahitāni ca
yasyāṃ bhavanti senāyāṃ dhruvaṃ tasyā jayo bhavet
gambhīraśabdāśca mahāsvanāśca śaṅkhyāśca bheryaśca nadanti yatra
iṣṭā mṛgāḥ pṛṣṭhato vāmataśca saṃprasthitānāṃ ca gamiṣyatāṃ ca
jighāṃsatāṃ dakṣiṇāḥ siddhimāhu rye tvagrataste pratiṣedhayanti
māṅgalyaśabdāñśakunā vadanti haṃsāḥ krauñcāḥ śatapatrāśca cāṣāḥ
hṛṣṭā yodhāḥ satvavanto bhavanti jayasyaitadbhāvino rūpamāhuḥ
śabdāḥ sparśāstathā gandhā vicaranti manaḥ priyāḥ
dhairyaṃ cāviśate yodhānvijayasya mukhaṃ ca tat
bhagnā ityeva bhajyante vidvāṃso'pi na kāraṇam
sannipāto na mantavyaḥ śakye sati kathaṃcana
teṣāṃ sandanti gātrāṇi yodhānāṃ vivayasya ca
teṣāṃ sāntvaṃ krūramiśraṃ praṇetavyaṃ punaḥ punaḥ
yaśca tasmātparo rājā tena saṃdhiḥ praśasyate
na hi tasyānyathā pīḍā śakyā kartuṃ tathāvidhā
kṣamā vai sādhumāyāti na hyasādhūnkṣamā sadā
manyante karṣayitvā tu kṣamā sādhvīti śāmbarāḥ
asaṃtaptaṃ tu yaddāru pratyeti prakṛtiṃ punaḥ
na me priyā ye sma hatāḥ saṃprahṛṣṭāḥ pare'pi ca
kṛtaṃ mamāpriyaṃ tena yenāyaṃ nihato mṛdhe
hantṝṇāṃ ca hatānāṃ ca pūjāṃ kuryādyathārthataḥ
kathaṃ mṛdau kathaṃ tīkṣṇe mahāpakṣe ca bhārata
kiṃ kurvāṇaṃ na māṃ jahyājjvalitā śrīḥ pratāpinī
krodhaṃ bhayaṃ ca harṣaṃ ca niyamya svayamātmani
yathā vaitaṃsiko yukto dvijānāṃ sadṛśasvaraḥ tāndvijānkurute vaśyāṃstathāyukto mahīpatiḥ
na sannipātaḥ kartavyaḥ sāmānye vijaye sati
na tveva khalu saṃsargaṃ rocayedaribhiḥ saha
tathā priyaṃ ca vaktavyaṃ yathā visrambhamāpnuyāt na sadyo'rīnvihanyācca draṣṭavyo vijayo dhruvaḥ
bhūyaḥ śalyaṃ ghaṭayati navaṃ ca kurute vraṇam
prāpte ca praharetkāle na ca saṃvartate punaḥ
durlabhaḥ sa punastena kālaḥ karma cikīrṣatā
vihāya kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca tathā'haṃkārameva ca
aśakyamiti kṛtvā vā tato'nyaiḥ saṃvidaṃ caret
bhedaṃ ca prathamaṃ vidyāttūṣṇīṃ daṇḍaṃ tathaiva ca
na hyato duṣkaraṃ karma kiṃcidasti surottama
mātīkṣṇo mā mṛdurbhūstvaṃ tīkṣṇo bhava mṛdurbhava
sāmnā dānena bhedena daṇḍena ca puraṃdara
na sāma daṇḍopaniṣatpraśasyate na mārdavaṃ śatruṣu yātrikaṃ sadā
na sasyaghāto na ca saṃkarakriyā na cāpi bhūyaḥ prakṛtervicāraṇā
pureṣu nītiṃ vihitāṃ yathāvidhi prayojayanto balavṛtrasūdana
pradāya gūḍhāni vasūni nāma pracchidya bhogānapahāya ca svān
duṣṭāḥ svadoṣairiti kīrtayitvā pureṣu rāṣṭreṣu ca yojayanti
āsane śayane yāne bhāvā lakṣyā viśeṣataḥ
sa tadvacaḥ śatrunibarhaṇe rata stathā cakārāvitathaṃ bṛhaspateḥ
cacāra kāle vijayāya cārihā vaśaṃ ca śatrūnanayatpuraṃdaraḥ
kṣemadarśī nṛpasuto yatra kṣīṇabalaḥ purā muniṃ kālakavṛkṣīyamājamāmeti naḥ śrutam
artheṣu māgī puruṣa īhamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
tvaktvā prītiṃ ca śokaṃ ca labdhvā buddhimayaṃ vasu
mama hyarthāḥ subahavo naṣṭāḥ svapnagatā iva
anityaṃ sarvamevaitadahaṃ ca mama cāsti yat
evaṃ na vyathate prājñaḥ kṛcchrāmapyāpadaṃ gataḥ
yaddhi bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyacca dhruvaṃ tanna bhaviṣyati
ye ca pūrvasamārambhā ye ca pūrvatare pare
sarvaṃ nāstīti te caiva tajjñātvā ko nu saṃjvaret
bhūtvā ca na bhavatyetadabhūtvā ca bhaviṣyati
śoke na hyasti sāmarthyaṃ śoceta sa kathaṃ naraḥ
kvanu te'dya pitā rājankvanu te'dya pitāmahaḥ
na tvaṃ paśyasi tānadya na tvāṃ paśyanti te'pi vā
buddhyā caivānubuddhyasva dhruvaṃ hi na ca vidyate
ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca nṛpate suhṛdaḥ śatravaśca te
avaśyaṃ na bhaviṣyāmaḥ sarvaṃ ca na bhaviṣyati
ye tu viṃśativarṣā vai triṃśadvarṣāśca mānavāḥ
arvāgeva hi te sarve mariṣyanti śaracchatāt
anāgataṃ yanna mameti vidyā datikrāntaṃ yanna mameti vidyāt
diṣṭaṃ balīya iti manyamānā ste paṇḍitāstatsatāṃ vṛttimāhuḥ
na ca tvamiva śocanti tasmāttvamapi mā śucaḥ
kiṃ na tvaṃ tairnaraiḥ śreyāṃstulyo vā buddhipauruṣaiḥ
dhātāraṃ garhate nityaṃ labdhārthaśca na mṛṣyate
kaccittvaṃ na tathā prājña matsarī kosalādhipa
sahasva śriyamanyeṣāṃ yadyapi tvayi nāsti sā anyatrāpi satīṃ lakṣmīṃ kuśalā bhuñjate narāḥ
śriyaṃ ca putrapautraṃ ca manuṣyā dharmacāriṇaḥ
tyaktaṃ svāyaṃbhuve vaṃśe śubhena bharatena ca
tathā'nyairbhūmipālaiśca tyaktaṃ rājyaṃ mahodayam tyaktvā rājyāni te sarve vane vanyaphalāśinaḥ
gatāśca tapasaḥ pāraṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ ca bhūmipā
anityaṃ tatsukhaṃ matvā śriyamanye na lipsate
anityāṃ tāṃ śriyaṃ matvā śriyaṃ vā kaḥ parīpsati
na jīvitārthaṃ manyante puruṣā hi dhanādṛte
saṃcaye ca vināśānte maraṇānte ca jīvite
dhanaṃ vā puruṣo rājanpuruṣaṃ vā punardhanam
anyatropanatā hyāpatpuruṣaṃ toṣayatyuta tena śāntiṃ na labhate nāhameveti kāraṇāt
anyeṣāmapi naśyanti suhṛdaśca dhanāni ca paśya buddhyā manuṣyāṇāṃ tulyāmāpadamātmanaḥ
mahāhradaḥ saṃkṣubhita ātmanaiva prasīdati evaṃ naraḥ svatmānaiva kṛtaprajñaḥ prasīdati
etadevaṃ gatasyāhaṃ sukhaṃ paśyāmi kevalam asaṃbhave śriyo rājanhīnasya sacivādibhiḥ
daive pratiniviṣṭe ca kiṃ śreyo manyate bhavān
bravīmyahaṃ tu te nītiṃ rājyasya pratipattaye
ācariṣyasi cetkarma mahato'rthānavāpsyasi rājyaṃ vā rājyamantraṃ vā mahatīṃ vā punaḥ śriyam
amogha eva me'dyāstu tvayā saha samāgamaḥ
hitvā mānaṃ ca dambhaṃ ca krodhaṃ harṣa bhayaṃ tathā pratyamitrāṇi sevasva praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ
tataḥ sahāyānsotsāhām̐llapsyase'vyasanāñśucīn vartamānaḥ svaśāstre vai saṃyatātmā jitendriyaḥ
tenaiva tvaṃ dhṛtimatā śrīmatā cāpi satkṛtaḥ
pramāṇaṃ sarvabhūteṣu gatvā ca grahaṇaṃ mahat
tataḥ suhṛdbalaṃ labdhvā mantrayitvā sumantritam sāntvena bhedayitvā'rīnbilvaṃ bilvena śātaya
alabhyā ye śubhā bhāvāḥ striyaścācchādanāni ca
yadyevaṃ pratiṣeddhavyo yadyupekṣaṇamarhati sadaiva rājaśārdūla viduṣā hitamicchatā
na jātu vivṛtaḥ kāryaḥ śatruḥ sunayamicchatā
te tvā priyaṃ kariṣyanti tacchetsyanti vṛkā iva
ubhayatra prayuktasya dharme cādharma eva ca
api tyāgaṃ bubhūṣeta kaccidgacchedanāmayam siddhenauṣadhiyogena sarvaśatruvināśinā
ete cānye ca bahavo dambhayogāḥ sucintitāḥ
śakyā vipahatā kartuṃ na klībena nṛpātmaja
na nikṛtyā na dambhena brahmannicchāmi jīvitum
yena pāpaṃ na śaṅketa yadvā kṛtsnaṃ hitaṃ bhavet
ubhayoreva sāhyārthe yatiṣye tava tasya ca
amātya śuddha eva syādbuddhisaṃpanna eva vā
tasmāccaiva bhayaṃ rājñaḥ paśya rājyasya yojanam
dharmātmanāṃ kvacilloke nānyāsti gatirīdṛśī tadā rājaputro'yaṃ satāṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ
ayuddhvaiva niyogānme vaśe kuru hite sthitaḥ
na ca kāmānna ca drohātsvadharmaṃ hātumarhasi
naiva nityaṃ jayastāta naiva nityaṃ parājayaḥ
etaddhi paramaṃ śreyo na me'trāsti vicāraṇā
dharmato buddhitaścaiva balena ca jitaṃ mayā
nāvamanyāmi te buddhiṃ nāvamanye ca pauruṣam
tataḥ saṃpūjya tau vipraṃ viśvastau jagmaturgṛhān
dadau duhitaraṃ cāsmai ratnāni vividhāni ca
eṣa rājñāṃ paro dharmaḥ samau jayaparājayau
dharmavṛttaṃ ca vittaṃ ca vṛttyupāyāḥ phalāni ca
rājñāṃ vṛttaṃ ca kośaṃ ca kośasaṃcayanaṃ jayaḥ
madhyamasya ca tuṣṭyarthaṃ yathā stheyaṃ vivardhatā
yathā gaṇāḥ pravardhante na bhidyante ca bhārata
yathā ca te na bhidyeraṃstacca me vada bhārata
gaṇānāṃ ca kulānāṃ ca rājñāṃ bharatasattama
bhede gaṇā vinaśyurhi bhinnāstu sujayāḥ paraiḥ
mānayantaḥ sadā yuktā vivardhante gaṇā nṛpa
krodho bhedo bhayaṃ daṇḍaḥ karṣaṇaṃ nigraho vadhaḥ
na gaṇāḥ kṛtsnaśo mantraṃ śrotumarhanti bhārata
jātyā ca sadṛśāḥ sarve kulena sadṛśāstatha
na codyogena buddhyā vā rūpadravyeṇa vā punaḥ
kiṃ kāryaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ garīyo bhavato matam
yathā'haṃ paramaṃ dharmamiha ca pretya cāpnuyām
yaṃ me te'bhyanujānīyuḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ
eta eva trayo lokā eta evāśramāstrayaḥ
eta eva trayo vedā eta eva trayo'gnayaḥ
pitṛvṛttyā tvimaṃ lokaṃ mātṛvṛttyā tathā param
yaśaḥ prāpsyasi bhadraṃ te dharmaṃ ca sumahāphalam
kīrti puṇyaṃ yaśo lokānprāpsyase tvaṃ janādhipa
sarve tasyādṛtā lokā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ
na cāyaṃ na paro loko na yaśastasya bhārata
na cāsminna pare loke yaśastasya prakāśate
tebhya eva hi yatsarvaṃ kṛtyaṃ yannisṛjāmyaham tadāsīnme śataguṇaṃ sahasraguṇameva ca
pitṝndaśa tu mātaikā sarvāṃ vā pṛthivīmapi
śarīrametau sṛjataḥ pitā mātā ca bhārata
avadhyā hi sadā mātā pitā cāpyupacāriṇau
na sa duṣyati tatkṛtvā na ca te dūṣayanti tam
ya āvṛṇotyavitathena karmaṇā ṛtaṃ bruvannamṛtaṃ saṃprayacchan
taṃ manyethāḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca tasmai na druhyetkṛtamasya jānan
vidyāṃ śrutvā ye guruṃ nādriyante pratyutpannā manasā karmaṇā vā
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ nānyastebhyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke yathaiva te gurubhirbhāvanīyā stathaiva teṣāṃ guravo'bhyarcanīyāḥ
ṛṣayaśca hi devāśca prīyante pitṛbhiḥ saha
na ca mātā na ca pito tādṛśo yādṛśo guruḥ
upādhyāyaṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ye vidruhyante manasā karmaṇā vā
teṣāṃ pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviśiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke
bhṛto bhartāraṃ yo na vibhirti putraḥ svayonijaḥ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca
tasya pāpaṃ bhrūṇahatyāviṣiṣṭaṃ tasmānnānyaḥ pāpakṛdasti loke
satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param
yattu loke sudurjñeyaṃ tatte vakṣyāmi bhārata
yaḥ syātprabhavasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ
asmindharme sthito rājannaro bhadrāṇi paśyati śrauto vadhātmako dharma ahiṃsāparamārthikaḥ
yaḥ syāddhāraṇasaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścaḥ
yaḥ syādahiṃsāsaṃyuktaḥ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ
śrutiṃ dharmaṃ vadantyanye mānānyāhuḥ pare janāḥ
na ca taṃ svabhyasūyāmo na hi sarvaṃ vidhīyate
tebhyastu na tadākhyeyaṃ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ
na stenaḥ saha saṃbandhānmucyate śapathādapi śreyastatrānṛtaṃ vaktuṃ satyāditi hi dhāraṇā
yaḥ pāpaiḥ saha saṃbandhānmucyate śapathādapi na ca tebhyo dhanaṃ dadyācchakye sati kathaṃcana
pāpebhyo hi dhanaṃ dattaṃ dātāramapi pīḍayet
svaśarīroparodhena dhanamādātumicchataḥ satyasaṃpratipattyarthaṃ yadbrūyuḥ sākṣiṇaḥ kvacit
pratiśrutya na dātavyaṃ śvaḥ kāryastu balātkṛtaḥ
avivāhyā hyasaṃbhojyā nikṛtyā nirayaṃ gatāḥ cyutā devamanuṣyebhyo yathā pretāstathaiva te
[niryajñāstapasā hīnā mā sma taiḥ saha saṃgamaḥ ]
idaṃ te rocatāṃ dharma iti vācyaṃ prayatnataḥ
na kaścidasti pāpānāṃ dharma ityeṣa niścayaḥ
tathāvidhaṃ ca yo hanyānna sa pāpena lipyate
svakarmaṇā hataṃ hanti hata eva sa hanyate
yasminyathā vartati yo manuṣya stasmiṃstathā vartitavyaṃ sa dharmaḥ
ye dambhānnācaranti sma yeṣāṃ vṛttiśca saṃyatā
pratyāhurnocyamānā ye na hiṃsanti ca hiṃsitāḥ
ye vā pāpaṃ na kurvanti karmaṇā manasā girā
āhaveṣu ca ye śūrāstyaktvā mṛtyukṛtaṃ bhayam
karmāṇyakutsanārthāni yeṣāṃ vācaśca sūnṛtāḥ yeṣāmarthāśca sādhvarthā durgāṇyatitaranti te
anadhyāyeṣu ye viprāḥ svādhyāyaṃ naiva kurvate
yeṣāṃ na kaścitrasati na trasanti hi kasyacit
paraśriyā na tapyanti ye santaḥ puruṣarṣabhāḥ
ye na mānitvamicchanti mānayanti ca ye parān
ye ca śrāddhāni kurvanti tithyāṃtithyāṃ prajārthinaḥ
na ca ruṣyanti bhṛtyānāṃ durgāṇyatitaranti te
madhu māṃsaṃ striyo nityaṃ varjayantīha mānavāḥ
yātrārthaṃ bhojanaṃ yeṣāṃ saṃtānārthaṃ ca maithunam
suhṛddhātā ca mitraṃ ca saṃbandhī ca tavācyuta
sthitaḥ priyahite nityaṃ sa eṣa puruṣottamaḥ
ya enaṃ saṃśrayantīha bhaktyā nārāyaṇaṃ harim
te tarantīha durgāṇi na cātrāsti vicāraṇā
asminnarpitakarmāṇaḥ sarvabhāvena bhārata kṛṣṇe kamalapatrākṣe durgāṇyatitaranti te
yaṃ viṣṇurindraḥ śaṃbhuśca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ stuvanti vividhaiḥ stotrairdevadevaṃ maheśvaram
durgātitaraṇaṃ ye ca paṭhanti śrāvayanti ca
tarate yena durgāṇi paratreha ca mānavaḥ
purikāyāṃ puri purā śrīmatyāṃ pauriko nṛpaḥ
saṃsmṛtya pūrvajātiṃ svāṃ nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ
parṇahāraḥ kadācicca niyamavratavānapi kadā cadudakenāpi vartayanna tu yantritaḥ
cālayanti sma tāṃ buddhiṃ vacanaiḥ praśrayottaraiḥ
bhuṅkṣva śaucaṃ parityajya yaddhi bhuktaṃ tadasti te
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā pratyuvāca samāhitaḥ
prārthayāmi ca tatkarma yena vistīryate yaśaḥ
śmaśāne yadi me vāsaḥ samādhirme niśāmyatām
kiṃtu tatpātakaṃ na syāttadvā dānaṃ vṛthā bhavet
iha cāmutra cāniṣṭāṃ tasmādvṛttiṃ na rocaye
taṃ śuciṃ paṇḍitaṃ matvā śārdūlaḥ khyātavikramaḥ
saumya vijñātarūpastvaṃ gaccha yātrāṃ mayā saha
tīkṣṇā iti vayaṃ khyātā bhavantaṃ jñāpayāmahe
na yokṣyati hi me śīlaṃ tava bhṛtyaiḥ purātanaiḥ
pānīyaṃ vā nirāyāsaṃ svādvannaṃ vā guṇottaram
vicārya khalu paśyāmi tatsukhaṃ yatra nirvṛttiḥ
yadi vā tanmamā kāryaṃ mṛgendra yadi manyase
madīyā mānanīyāste śrotavyaṃ ca hitaṃ vacaḥ
kalpitā yā ca me vṛttiḥ sā bhavettvayi susthirā
tītimantaḥ parīpsanto vṛthā brūyuḥ pare mayi
eka ekena saṃgamya raho brūyāṃ hitaṃ vacaḥ
madīyānāṃ ca kupito mā tvaṃ daṇḍaṃ nipātayeḥ
taṃ tathā satkṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā yujyamānaṃ ca karmasu
mitrabuddhyā ca gomāyuṃ sāntvayitvā praveśya ca
athāsya samayaṃ kṛtvā vināśāya sthitāḥ pare
īpsitaṃ tu mṛgendrasya māṃsaṃ yattatra saṃskṛtam
apanīya svayaṃ taddhi tairnyastaṃ tasya veśmani
tasya tadviditaṃ sarvaṃ kāraṇārthaṃ ca marṣitam
samayo'yaṃ kṛtastena sācivyamupagacchatā nopaghātastvayā kāryo rājanmaitrīmihecchatā
iti tasya ca mantrasya sthityarthaṃ tadupekṣitam
[kṣudhitasya mṛgendrasya bhoktumabhyutthitasya ca] bhojane copahartavye tanmāṃsaṃ nahyadṛśyata
chidraṃ tu tasya tadṛṣṭvā procuste pūrvamantriṇaḥ sarveṣāmeva so'smākaṃ vṛttibhaṅge pravartate
idaṃ tasyedṛśaṃ karma kiṃ tena na kṛtaṃ bhavet
śrutaśca svāminā pūrvaṃ yādṛśo naiva tādṛśaḥ
yadi vipratyayo hyeṣa tadidaṃ darśayām te
śucerapi hi yuktasya doṣa eva nipātyate
[munerapi vanasthasya svāni karmāṇi kurvataḥ utpādyante trayaḥ pakṣā mitrodāsīnaśatravaḥ ]
lubdhānāṃ śucayo dveṣyāḥ kātarāṇāṃ tarasvinaḥ mūrkhāṇāṃ paṇḍitā dveṣyā daridrāṇāṃ mahādhanāḥ
sunyrastaṃ te gṛhe māṃsaṃ yadadyāpahṛtaṃ tava
na caivāsti talaṃ vyomni khadyote na hutāśanaḥ
ślāghanīyā yaśasyā ca loke prabhavatāṃ kṣamā
svayaṃ copadrutā bhṛtyā ye cāpyupahitāḥ paraiḥ
hṛtasvā mānino ye ca tyaktopāttā mahepsavaḥ
avamānena yuktasya sthāpitasya ca me punaḥ
na vācyaṃ tasya vaiguṇyaṃ pratijñāṃ parirakṣatā
evaṃ cāvamatasyeha viśvāsaṃ me na yāsyasi
duḥkhena śliṣyate bhinnaṃ śliṣṭaṃ duḥkhena bhidyate
bhinnaśliṣṭe tu yā prītirna sā snehena vardhate
kiṃ pārthivena kartavyaṃ kiṃca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet
yathā rājñeha kartavyaṃ yacca kṛtvā sukhī bhavet
pratilabhya varaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ yayāvuṣṭraḥ svakaṃ vanam
sa dṛṣṭvā māṃsajīvī tu subhṛśaṃ kṣucchramānvitaḥ
yadā tvabudhyatātmānaṃ bhakṣyamāṇaṃ sa vai paśu
sa hatvā bhakṣayitvā ca tamuṣṭraṃ jambukastadā
rājyaṃ tiṣṭhati dakṣasya saṃgṛhītendriyasya ca [ārtasya buddhimūlaṃ hi vijayaṃ manurabravīt ]
asahāyavato hyarthā na tiṣṭhanti kadācana parīkṣitasahāyasya tiṣṭhantīha yudhiṣṭhira
idaṃ hi sadbhiḥ kathitaṃ vidhijñaiḥ purā mahendrapratimaprabhāvaḥ
mayā'pi coktaṃ tava śāstradṛṣṭyā tvamapramattaḥ pracarasva rājan
saritāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ sāgarasya ca bhārata
ajñayā vā nānītaḥ kiṃ ca vā tena vaḥ kṛtam
yathā cemāni kūlāni hitvā nāyāti vetasaḥ
sa ca vege hyatikrānte sthānamāpadyate punaḥ
oṣadhyaḥ pādapā gulmā na te yānti parābhavam
pūrvaṃ na sahate vegaṃ kṣiprameva vinaśyati
jānanvicarati prājño na sa yāti parābhavam
iti saṃślāghate nityaṃ tena pāpena karmaṇā idamukto mayā kaścitsarvato janasaṃsadi
prakṛtyā hi praśaṃsanvā nindanvā kiṃ kariṣyati
pratyakṣaṃ guṇavādī yaḥ parokṣaṃ tu vinindakaḥ
parivādaṃ bruvāṇo hi durātmā vai mahājane
taṃ svakarmaṇi kurvāṇaṃ pratikartuṃ ya icchati
anāryajuṣṭe pathi vartamānaṃ damādapetaṃ vinayācca pāpam
arivrataṃ nityamabhūtikāmaṃ dhigastu taṃ pāpamatiṃ manuṣyam
uccasya nīcena hi saṃprayogaṃ vigarhayanti sthirabuddhayo ye
kruddho daśedvā'pi ca tāḍayedvā sa pāṃsubhirvā vikirettuṣairvā
vivṛtya dantāṃśca vibhīṣayedvā siddhaṃ hi mūḍhe kupite nṛśaṃse
vigarhaṇāṃ nā'pi durātmanā kṛtāṃ saheta yaḥ saṃsadi durjanānām
paṭhedidaṃ cāpi nidarśanaṃ sadā na vāṅbhayaṃ sa labhati kiṃcidapriyam
ayatyāṃ ca tadātve ca kṣemavṛddhikaraṃ ca tat
annapāne śarīre ca hitaṃ yattadbravīhi me
abhiṣikto hi yo rājā rājyastho mitrasaṃvṛta
tasya bhṛtyā vimukhatāṃ yānti sarve kulodgatāḥ
na ca bhṛtyabalairarthaiḥ sa rājā saṃprayujyate
śāsatā puruṣavyāghra tvaṃ naḥ kulahite rataḥ
kṣattā caiko mahāprājño yo naḥ śaṃsati sarvadā
kīdṛśaiḥ kiṃ kulīnairvā saha yātrā vidhīyate
na hyeko bhṛtyarahito rājā bhavati rakṣitā
na ca praśāstuṃ rājyaṃ hi śakyamekena bhārata
labdhuṃ labdhā hyapi sadā rakṣituṃ bharatarṣabha
na santi kulajā yatra sahāyāḥ pārthivasya tu akulīnāśca kartavyā na vā bharatasattam
uktvā ca te sukhapraśnaṃ sarve yānti yathāsukham
provāca śvā muniṃ tatra tacchṛṇuṣva viśāṃpate
śvaśatrurbhagavanneṣa dvīpī māṃ hantumicchati tvatprasādādbhayaṃ na syādasmānmama mahāmune
sa munistasya vijñāya bhāvajño bhayakāraṇam rutajñaḥ sarvasatvānāṃ tamaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ ]
na bhayaṃ dvīpinaḥ kāryaṃ mṛtyutaste kathaṃcana
taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃmukhe dvīpī ātmanaḥ sadṛśaṃ paśum
vyāghraṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣudhā bhugnaṃ daṃṣṭriṇaṃ vanacāriṇam
sa dvīpī vyāghratāṃ nīto ripubhyo balavattaraḥ
sa tu ścā vyāghratāṃ prāpya balavānpiśitāśanaḥ
na mūlaphalabhogeṣu spṛhāmapyakarottadā yathā mṛgapatirnityaṃ prakāṅkṣati vanaukasaḥ
sa ta-ḥ siṃhatāṃ nīto gajendro muninā tadā
taṃ dṛṣṭvā śarabhaṃ yāntaṃ siṃhaḥ parabhayānvitaḥ ṛṣiṃ śaraṇamāpede vepamānaḥ kṛtāñjaliḥ
saṃ muniḥ śarabhaṃ cakre balotkaṭamariṃdama tataḥ sa śarabho vanyo muneḥ śarabhamagrataḥ
sa evaṃ śarabhasthāne nyasto vai muninā tadā
na dadāti balaṃ tuṣṭaḥ satvasyānyasya kasyacit
tāvadenamahaṃ vipraṃ vadhiṣyāmi ca śīghrataḥ sthātuṃ mayā śakyamiha munighātānna saṃśayaḥ
vijñāya ca muniḥ prājñastataḥ śāpaṃ prayuktavān
mama vaśyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ devā yacca carācaram santi devāśca ye bhītāḥ svadharmaṃ na tyajanti ye
kimaṅga tvaṃ mayā nītaḥ śarabhatvamanāmayam krūraḥ sa sarvabhūteṣu hīnaścāśucireva ca
ārjavaṃ prakṛtiṃ satvaṃ śrutaṃ vṛttaṃ kulaṃ damam
anukrośaṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ prabhāvaṃ praśamaṃ kṣamām
kākaḥ śvāno'kulīnaśca biḍālaḥ sarpa eva ca
akulīnā ca yā nārī tulyāste parikīrtitāḥ
nārīṃ vā puruṣaṃ vā'tha śīlaṃ tatrāpi kāraṇam
duṣkulīnā ca yā strī syādduṣkulīnaśca yaḥ puma
vṛttasthamapi caṇḍālaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ
dvīpinaṃ śarabhaṃ siṃhaṃ vyāghraṃ kuñjarameva ca
mahiṣaṃ ca varāhaṃ ca sūkaraṃ śvānapannagān
brāhmaṇaḥ pāpakarmā ca mleccho vā dhārmikaḥ śu vaḥ
prakṛtiṃ tasya vijñāya sthirāṃ vā yadi vā'sthirām
śīlaṃ vā'nuttamaṃ karma kuryādrājā samāhitaḥ niyuñjīta mahīpālo durvṛttaṃ pāpakarmasu
kṛtajñaṃ balavantaṃ ca kṣāntaṃ dāntaṃ jitendriyam
dhīro marṣī śuciḥ śīghraḥ kāle puruṣakāravit
naipuṇaṃ cārthacaryāsu yasyaite tasya sā mahī
yastaitāni na vidyante tasyaiva suciraṃ mahī
dharmacaryāḥ sadā yasya tasyeyaṃ suciraṃ mahī
utthānaṃ caiva daivaṃ ca tayornānātvameva ca
manunā varṇitaṃ pūrvaṃ vakṣye śṛṇu tadeva hi
durhṛdāṃ chidradarśī yaḥ suhṛdāmupakāravān viśeṣavicca bhṛtyānāṃ sa rājyaphalamaśnute
sarvasaṃgrahaṇe yukto nṛpo bhavati yaḥ sadā
vyāghro vyāghra iva sthāpyo dvīpī dvīpī yathā tathā
na bāliśā na ca kṣudrā nāprājñā nājitendriyāḥ
nākulīnā janāḥ pārśve sthāpyā rājñā guṇaiṣiṇā
siṃhasya satataṃ pārśve siṃha eva jano bhavet
yastu siṃhaḥ śvabhiḥ kīrṇaḥ siṃhakarmaphale rataḥ
na sa siṃhaphalaṃ bhoktuṃ śaktaḥ śvabhirupāsitaḥ
kulīnaiḥ saha śakyeta kṛtsnā jetuṃ vasuṃdharā
nāvaidyo nānṛjuḥ pārśve nāprājño nā mahāyaśāḥ
ye bhṛtyāḥ pārthivahitāsteṣu sāntvaṃ sadā caret
koṣṭhāgāraṃ ca te nityaṃ sphītaṃ dhānyaiḥ susaṃcitaiḥ sadā tvaṃ satsu saṃnyastadhanadhānyapako bhava
eṣā te naiṣṭhikī buddhiḥ prajñā cābhihitā maṣā
śvāte nidarśanaṃ tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
tathā bahuvidhaṃ rājā rūpaṃ kurvīt dharmavit
bahurūpasya rājño hi sūkṣmo'pyartho na sīdati
praṇayedvā'pi tāṃ bhūmiṃ praṇaśyedgrahaṇe punaḥ evaṃ mayūradharmeṇa vartayansatataṃ naraḥ
nāsūyeccāvagarhyāṇi sannivāsānnivāsayet sadā barhisamaṃ kāmaṃ praśastaṃ kṛtamācaret
saṃnikṛṣṭāṃ kathāṃ prājño yadi buddhyā bṛhaspatiḥ
mṛduṃ krūraṃ tathā prājñaṃ śūraṃ cārthavidhānavit
dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ saṃyamo buddhirātmā dhairyaṃ śauryaṃ deśakālāpramādaḥ
alpasya vā mahato vā vivṛddhau dhanasyaitānyaṣṭa samiṃdhanāni
kṣayodayau vipulau sanniyamyau tasmādalpaṃ nāvamanyeta vittam
bālo'pyabālaḥ sthaviro ripuryaḥ sadā pramattaṃ puruṣaṃ nihanyāt
kālenānyastasya mūlaṃ haret kālajñānaṃ pārthivānā variṣṭham
ripurdveṣṭā durbalo vā balī vā tasmācchatrornaiva bibhyedyathātmā
kṣayaṃ śatroḥ saṃcayaṃ pālanaṃ vā ubhāvarthau sahitau dharmakāmau
buddhirdīptā balavantaṃ hinasti balaṃ buddhyā pālyate vardhamānam
śatrurbuddhyā sīdate pīḍyamāno buddhipūrvaṃ karma yattatpraśastam
yaścātmānaṃ prārthayate'rthyamānaiḥ śreyaḥ pātraṃ pūrayate ca nālpam
tasmādrājā pragṛhītaḥ prajāsu mūlaṃ lakṣmyāḥ sarvaśo hyādadīta
dīrghaṃ kālaṃ hyapi saṃpīḍyamāno vyuṣyātsaṃpadvyavasāyena śaktyā
vidyā tapo vā vipulaṃ dhanaṃ vā sarvaṃ hyetadvyavasāyena śakyam
yatrāsate matimanto manasvinaḥ śakro viṣṇuryatra sarasvatī ca
vasanti bhūtāni ca yatra nityaṃ tasmādvidvānnāvamanyeta deham
lubdhaṃ hanyātsaṃpradānāddhi nityaṃ lubdhastṛptiṃ paravittasya naiti
sarvo lubdhaḥ sarvaguṇopabhogo yo'rthairhīno dharmakāmau jahāti
dhanaṃ bhogaṃ putradāraṃ samṛddhiṃ sarvaṃ lubdhaḥ prārthayate pareṣām
lubdhe doṣāḥ saṃbhavantīha sarve tasmādrājā na pragṛhṇīt lubdham
dharmānviteṣu vijñātā mantraguptiṃśca pāṇḍava āpto rājankulīnaśca paryāpto rāṣṭrasaṃgrahe
imānvidadhyādanusṛtya yo vai rājā mahīṃ pālayituṃ sa śaktaḥ
sunītijaṃ yasya vidhānajaṃ sukhaṃ dharmapraṇītaṃ vidhivatprasiddhyati
na nindyate tasya gatirmahīpate sa vindate rājyasukhaṃ hyanuttamam
paśyedupāyānvividheṣu karmasu na cānupāyena matiṃ niveśayet
śriyaṃ viśiṣṭāṃ vipulaṃ yaśo dhanaṃ na doṣadarśī puruṣaḥ samaśnute
prītipravṛttiṃ vinivartanaṃ ca suhṛsu vijñāya vicārya cobhayoḥ
etānmayoktāṃścara rājadharmā nnṛṇāṃ ca guptau matimādadhatsva
avāpsyase puṇyaphalaṃ sukhena sarvo hi loko nṛpa dharmamūlaḥ
ityetaduktaṃ bhavatā daṇḍe vai sacarācaram paśyatāṃ loka āyattaṃ sasurāsuramānuṣam
ko daṇḍaḥ kīdṛśo daṇḍaḥ kiṃrūpaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ
jāgarti ca kathaṃ daṇḍaḥ prajāsu vihitātmakaḥ
kaśca vijñāyate pūrvaḥ ko varo daṇḍasaṃjñitaḥ
śṛṇu kauravya yo daṇḍo vyavahāro yathā ca saḥ
yasminhi sarvamāyattaṃ sa dharma iti kevalaḥ
tasya lopaḥ kathaṃ na syāllokeṣviha mahātmanaḥ
prajā rakṣati yaḥ samyagdharma eva sa kevalaḥ
daṇḍa eva sa sarvātmā loke carati mūrtimān
antaścādiśca madhyaṃ ca kṛtānāṃ ca prapañcanam
madaḥ pramodo darpaśca dambho dhairyaṃ nayānayau
anṛtaṃ cājñatā satyaṃ śraddhāśraddhe tathaiva ca
asūyā cānasūyā ca dharmādharmau tathaiva ca
na syādyadīha daṇḍo vai pramatheyuḥ parasparam
babhūva yajño devebhyo yajñaḥ prīṇāti devatāḥ
tasmātprajāḥ pratiṣṭhante daṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca
īśvaraḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ satvaṃ vṛttaṃ prajāpatiḥ
kulaṃ bahudhanāmātyāḥ prajñā proktā balāni tu
kośo mitrāṇi dhānyaṃ ca sarvopakaraṇāni ca
rājyasya daṇḍamevāṅgaṃ daṇḍaḥ prabhava eva ca
daṇḍo dattaḥ sadā goptā daṇḍo hīdaṃ sanātanam
rājā pūjyatamo nānyo yathā dharmaḥ pradarśitaḥ
jñeyo naḥ sa narendrastho daṇḍaḥ pratyaya eva ca
yaśca daṇḍaḥ sa dṛṣṭo no vyavahāraḥ sanātanaḥ
vyavahāraśca dṛṣṭo yaḥ sa veda iti naḥ śrutiḥ
yaśca vedaḥ sa vai dharmo yaśca dharmaḥ sa satpathaḥ
sa manuṣyoragavatāṃ kartā caiva sa bhūtakṛt
mātā pitā ca bhrātā ca bhāryā caiva purohitaḥ
nādaṇḍyo vidyate rājño yaḥ svadharmeṇa tiṣṭhati
sa rājā dharmavinnityaṃ saha patnyā mahātapāḥ muñjapṛṣṭhaṃ jagāmātha devarṣigaṇasevitam
muñjapṛṣṭha iti proktaḥ sa deśo rudrasevitaḥ
vasuhomo'pi rājño vai gāmardhyaṃ ca nyavedayat
kiṃ vā'sya pūrvaṃ jāgarti kiṃ vā paramamucyate
ṛtvijaṃ nātmanastulyaṃ dadarśeti hi naḥ śrutam
atha pūrṇe sahasre tu sa garbhaḥ kṣuvato'patat
naiva kāryaṃ na vā kāryaṃ bhojyābhojyaṃ na vidyate
gamyāgamyaṃ tadā nāsītsvaṃ parasvaṃ ca vai samam
ayaṃ viṣṇuḥ sakhā tubhyaṃ dharmasya parirakṣaṇe
tvaṃ hi sarvavidhānajñaḥ satvānāṃ tvaṃ gatiḥ parā saṃkaro na bhavedatra yathā tadvai vidhīyatām
brahmaviṣṇvindrasahitaḥ sarvaiśca sasurāsuraiḥ lokasandhāraṇārthaṃ ca lokasaṃkaranāśanam
yathā'sau nīyate daṇḍaḥ satataṃ pāpakāriṣu daṇḍasya nayanātsā hi daṇḍanītirihocyate
bhūyaḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlagharaḥ prabhuḥ
arthaśāstraṃ caturthaṃ tu vidyā hyaṣṭādaśaiva tu
daśa cāṣṭau ca vikhyātā etā dharmasya saṃhitāḥ
vyāsa eva tu vidyānāṃ mahādevena kīrtitaḥ
tantraṃ pāśupataṃ nāma pañcarātraṃ ca viśrutam
yogaśāstraṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ ca tantraṃ lokāyataṃ tathā
daśa cāṣṭau ca vijñeyāḥ paurāṇā yajñasaṃhitāḥ
nānārthāni ca sarvāṇi tataḥ śāstrāṇi śaṃkaraḥ
śaśvadabhyasyate loke veda eva tu sarvaśaḥ
etāsāṃ pārago yaśca sa cokto vedapāragaḥ
brahmā ca paramo devaḥ sadā sarvaiḥ surāsuraiḥ
ahaṃ śāntanavo bhīṣmaḥ prasādānmādhavasya ca śaṃkarasya prasādācca brahmaṇaśca kurūdvaha
śivena brahmaṇā caiva viṣṇunā ca vikalpitāḥ
bhūyaḥ sa bhagavāndhyātvā ciraṃ śūlavarāyudhaḥ tasyatasya nikāyasya cakāraikaikamīśvaram
apāṃ rājye surāṇāṃ ca vidadhe varuṇaṃ prabhum
parvatānāṃ patiṃ meruṃ saritāṃ ca mahodadhim
daśa caikaśca ye rudrāstasyaite mūrtisaṃbhavāḥ nānārūpadharo devaḥ sa eva bhagavāñśivaḥ
vīrudhāṃ vasumantaṃ ca bhūtānāṃ ca prabhuṃ varam
viṣṇurbrahmā śaśī sūryaḥ śakro devāśca sānvayāḥ
sṛjate grasate caitattamobhūtamidaṃ yathā aprajñātaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yadā hyeko maheśvaraḥ
daṇḍaṃ dharmasya goptāraṃ viṣṇave satkṛtaṃ dadau
vibhajya daṇḍaḥ kartavyo daṇḍe tu nayamicchatā
durvācā nigraho daṇḍo hiraṇyaṃ bāhyataḥ kriyā
prajā jāgrati loke'smindaṇḍo jāgarti tāsu ca
jāgarti kālaḥ pūrvaṃ ca madhye cānte ca bhārata
īśaḥ sarvasya kālo hi mahādevaḥ prajāpatiḥ
devadevaḥ śivaḥ sarvo jāgarti satataṃ prabhuḥ
iti te sarvamākhyātaṃ yo daṇḍo manujarṣabha
vasuhomācchrutaṃ rājñā māndhātrā bhūbhṛtā purā mayāpi kathitaṃ rājannākhyānaṃ prathitaṃ mayā
śreṣṭhabuddhistrivargasya udayaṃ prāpnuyātkṣaṇāt [karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyartho na vā punaḥ ]
buddhyā buddha ihārthena tadahnā tu nikṛṣṭayā
ariṣṭasya ca saṃvādaṃ kāmandasya ca bhārata
adharmaṃ dharma iti ca yo mohādācarennaraḥ
taṃ cāpi prathitaṃ loke kathaṃ rājā nivartayet
taṃ prajā nānurajyante na viprā na ca sādhavaḥ
sevitavyā trayī vidyā satkāro brāhmaṇeṣu ca
guravo hi paraṃ dharmaṃ yaṃ brūyustaṃ tathā kuru
ime janā manuṣyendra praśaṃsanti sadā bhuvi
dharmasya śīlamevādau tato me saṃśayo mahān
kiṃlakṣaṇaṃ ca tatproktaṃ brūhi me vadatāṃ vara
yadīcchasi śriyaṃ tāta yādṛśī sā yudhiṣṭhire
śīlena hi trayo lokāḥ śakyā jetuṃ na saṃśayaḥ
na hi kiṃcidasādhyaṃvai loke śīlavatāṃ satām
ete hi pārthivāḥ sarve śīlavanto yaśonvitāḥ
śa---māśritya daityena trailokyaṃ ca vaśe kṛtam
indrastu bhūyaḥ papraccha ko viśeṣo bhavediti
tatrāgamaya bhadraṃ te bhūya eva surottama
sa tatra brāhmaṇo bhūtvā prahlādaṃ pākaśāsanaḥ
stutvā provāca medhāvī śreya icchāmi veditum
tathetyuktvā dadau kāle jñānatattvaṃ dvije tadā
pṛṣṭaśca tena bahuśaḥ prāptaṃ kathamariṃdam trailokyarājyaṃ dharmajña kāraṇaṃ tadbravīhi me
kāmyāni vadatāṃ teṣāṃ saṃyacchāmi vahāmi ca
te visrabdhāḥ prabhāṣante saṃyacchanti ca māṃ sadā
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te pradātā'smi na saṃśayaḥ
datte vare gate vipre cintā'sīnmahatī tadā
prahlādasya mahārāja niścayaṃ na ca jagmivān
pratyāha taṃ tu śīlosmi tyakto gacchāmyahaṃ tvayā
tasmindvijottame rājanvatsyāmyahamariṃdama yo'sau śiṣyatvamāgamya tvayi nityaṃ samāhitaḥ
dharmaṃ prahlāda māṃ viddhi yatrāsau dvijasattamaḥ
tatra yāsyāmi daityendra yataḥ śīlaṃ tato hyaham
ko bhavāniti pṛṣṭaśca tamāha sa mahādyutiḥ
vṛttaṃ prahlāda māṃ viddhi yataḥ satyaṃ tato hyaham
pṛṣṭaścāha balaṃ viddhi yato vṛttamahaṃ tataḥ
ityuktvā prayayau tatra yato vṛttaṃ narādhipa
tvayā yuktā gamiṣyāmi balaṃ hyanugatā hyaham
apṛcchata ca tāṃ bhūyaḥ kva yāsi kamalālaye
tvaṃ hi satyavratā devī lokasya parameśvarī
śīlena hi trayo lokāstvayā dharmajña nirjitāḥ
tadvijñāya surendreṇa tava śīlaṃ hṛtaṃ prabho
dharmaḥ satyaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ balaṃ caiva tathā'pyaham
evamuktvā gatā śrīstu te ca sarve yudhiṣṭhira
prāpyate ca yathā śīlaṃ taṃ copāyaṃ bravīhi me
yadanyeṣāṃ hitaṃ na syādātmanaḥ karma pauruṣam
tattu karma tathā kuryādyena ślādhyeta saṃsadi
na bhuñjate ciraṃ tāta samūlāśca patanti te
etadviditvā tattvena śīlavānbhava putraka yadīcchasi śriyaṃ tāta suviśiṣṭāṃ yudhiṣṭhirāt
śīlaṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣe kathitaṃ te pitāmaha
kathamāśā samutpannā kā ca sā tadvadasva me
chettā ca tasya nānyo'sti tvattaḥ parapuraṃjaya
prāpte yuddhe tu tadyuktaṃ tatkartā'yamiti prabho
atra te vartayiṣyāmi yudhiṣṭhira nibodha me
sa ca rājā balī tūrṇaṃ sasāra mṛgamantikāt
tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyādaurasana balena ca
punaśca javamāsthāya javano mṛgayūthapaḥ [atītyātītya rājendra punarabhyeti cāntikam ]
[tato gavyūtimātreṇa mṛgayūthapayūthapaḥ ] tasya bāṇapathaṃ muktvā tasthivānprahasanniva
taṃ kārmukadharaṃ dṛṣṭvā śramārtaṃ kṣudhitaṃ tadā
te tasya rājño vacanaṃ pratigṛhya tapodhanāḥ
kasminkule tu jātastvaṃ kiṃnāmā cāsi brūhi naḥ
tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabha
mṛgastu viddho bāṇena mayā sarati śalyavān
duḥkhaṃ karoti me tīvraṃ yathā''śā vihatā mama
bhavatāṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ
kiṃnu jyāyastaraṃ loke mahattve pratibhāti vaḥ
yadi guhyaṃ na vo nityaṃ tadā prabrūta mā ciram
yadi vā'sti kathāyogo yo'yaṃ praśno mayeritaḥ
yatra sā badarī ramyā saro vaihāyasaṃ tathā
kṛśatā cāpi rājarṣe na dṛṣṭā tādṛśī mayā
śiraḥ kāyānurūpaṃ ca karṇau netre tathaiva ca
tasya vākcaiva ceṣṭā ca sāmānye rājasattama
dṛṣṭvā'haṃ taṃ kṛśaṃ vipraṃ bhītaḥ paramadurmanāḥ
nivedya nāmagotre ca tathā kāryaṃ nararṣabha
iha drakṣyāmi taṃ putraṃ drakṣyāmīheti bhārata
durlabhaḥ sa mayā draṣṭuṃ bhūya eva ca dhārmika
na sa śakyo mayā draṣṭumāśā ca mahatī mama
durlabhaṃ kiṃnu devarṣe āśāyāścaiva kiṃ mahat
[avajñāpūrvakenāpi na saṃpāditavāṃstataḥ ] nirviṇṇaḥ sa tu viprarṣirnirāśaḥ samapadyata
ardhyaṃ tataḥ samānīya pādyaṃ caiva mahāyaśāḥ
vīradyumna iti khyāto rājā'haṃ dikṣu viśrutaḥ
ekaḥ putraḥ sa viprāgrya bāla eva ca so'naghaḥ
sa hi tena purā vipro rājñā nātyarthamānitaḥ
anyeṣāṃ caiva varṇānāmiti kṛtvā dhiyaṃ tadā
āśā hi puruṣaṃ bālamālāpayati tasthūṣī tāmahaṃ vyapaneṣyāmi iti kṛtvā vyavasthitaḥ
āśāyāḥ kiṃca vṛttaṃ vai kiṃceha bhuvi durlabham
tasyā vai durlabhatvācca prārthitaḥ pārthivo mayā
yadi guhyaṃ na te vipra loke kiṃceha durlabham
yā saktā sarvabhūteṣu sā''śā kṛśatarī mayā
kṛtaghneṣu ca yā saktā nṛśaṃseṣvalaseṣu ca
ekaputraḥ pitā putre naṣṭe vā proṣite'pi vā
pravṛttiṃ yo na jānāti sā''śā kṛśatarī matā
tathā narendra dhanināṃ sā'śā kṛśatarī matā
prasādaye tvāṃ bhagavanputreṇecchāmi saṃgamam yadetaduktaṃ bhavatā saṃprati dvijasattama
vṛṇīṣva ca varānvipra yānicchasi yathāvidhi abravīccaiva tadvākyaṃ rājā rājīvalocanaḥ
evaṃ tvamapi kaunteya śrutvā vāṇīmimāṃ mama
tvaṃ hi śrutvā ca pṛṣṭvā ca kṛcchreṣvartheṣu teṣviha
nāmṛtasyeva paryāptirmamāsti bruvati tvayi [yathāhi svātmavṛttisthastathā tṛpto'smi bhārata ]
tasmātkathaya bhūyo'pi tvaṃ mameha pitāmaha [na hi tṛptimahaṃ yāmi pibandharmāmṛtaṃ hi te ]
gautamasya ca saṃvādaṃ yamasya ca mahātmanaḥ
asaṃvihitarāṣṭrasya deśakālāvajānataḥ aprāpyaṃ ca bhavetsāntvaṃ bhedo vā'pyatipīḍanāt
jīvitaṃ tvarthahetorvā tatra kiṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet
pravaktuṃ notsahe pṛṣṭo dharmametaṃ yudhiṣṭhira dharmo hyaṇīyānvacanādvuddheśca bharatarṣabha
karmaṇā buddhipūrveṇa bhavatyāḍhye na vā punaḥ
duḥkhādāna iha hyeṣa syāttu paścātkṣamo mama
adharmo jāyate tasminniti vai kavayo viduḥ
sarvātmanaiva dharmasya na parasya na cātmanaḥ
bhaikṣacaryā na vihitā na ca viṭśūdrajīvikā
ārtānāṃ rakṣitāraṃ ca prajānāṃ kṣatriyaṃ viduḥ
kośaṃ daṇḍaṃ balaṃ mitraṃ yadanyadapi saṃcitam
na kurvītāntaraṃ rāṣṭre rājā parigataḥ kṣudhā
tadarthaṃ pīḍayitvā ca na doṣaṃ prāpnumarhati
yūpaṃ chindanti yajñārthaṃ tatra ye paripanthiḥ
drumāḥ kecana sāmantā dhruvaṃ chindanti tānapi
te cāpi nipatanto'nyānnighnantyapi vanaspatīn evaṃ kośasya mahato ye narāḥ paripanthinaḥ
dhanena jayate lokamimaṃ cāmuṃ ca bhārata
na ca rājñaḥ samo dharmaḥ kaścidasti kathaṃcana
sarvaṃ balavataḥ prāpyaṃ sarvaṃ tarati kośavān
javena sandhiṃ kurvīta pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ vimokṣayet
[yo'dharmavijigīṣuḥ syādbalavānpāpaniścayaḥ ] ātmanaḥ sannirodhena sandhiṃ tenāpi rocayet
na tvevātmā pradātavyaḥ śakye sati kathaṃcana
kṣīṇe kośe śrute mantre kiṃ kāryamavaśiṣyate
kṣipraṃ vā sandhikāmaḥ syātkṣipraṃ vā tīkṣṇavikrama
na vācyaḥ parivādo vai na śrotavyaḥ kathaṃcana
karṇau tatra pidhātavyau gantavyaṃ vā tato'nyataḥ
na satāṃ śīlametadvai parivādo na paiśunam
aheriva hi dharmasya padaṃ duḥkhaṃ gaveṣitum
yathā mṛgasya viddhasya mṛgavyādhaḥ padaṃ nayet
sa kośaḥ śuddhabhāvena na nṛśaṃsena jāyate
abalasya kutaḥ kośo hyakośasya kuto balam
śriyo hi kāraṇādrājā satkriyāṃ labhate parām
sā'sya gūhati pāpāni vāso guhyamiva striyāḥ
ṛddhimasyānutapyante purā viprakṛtā narāḥ sālāvṛkā ivājasnaṃ jighāṃsūneva vindati
nāyaṃ loko'sti na para iti vyavasito janaḥ
atrāpyudāharantīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam atra kāmandavacanaṃ kīrtayanti purāvidaḥ
tau tu na vyavadhātavyau parokṣā dharmayātanā
ubhau satyādhikārau tau trāyete mahato bhayāt
anīśvaro balaṃ dharmo drumaṃ vallīva saṃśritā
sukhaṃ ca vittaṃ bhuñjīta vṛttenaikena gopayet
api tebhyo mṛgānhatvā nayecca satataṃ vane yasminna pratigṛhṇanti dasyubhojanaśaṅkayā
loke ca labhate pūjāṃ paratreha mahatphalam
api tebhyo mṛgānhatvā nināya satataṃ vane
teṣāmāsajya geheṣu kalya eva sa gacchati
mā vadhīstvaṃ striyaṃ bhīruṃ mā śiśuṃ mā tapasvinam
nāyudhyamāno hantavyo na ca grāhyā balātstriyaḥ
sarvathā strī na hantavyā sarvasatveṣu budhyata
nityaṃ gobrāhmaṇe svasti yoddhavyaṃ ca tadarthataḥ
satyaṃ ca nāpi hartavyaṃ sāravighnaṃ ca mā kṛthāḥ
na tasya triṣu lokeṣu trātā bhavati kascana
sūryodaya iva dhvānte dhruvaṃ tasya parābhavaḥ
śiṣṭyarthaṃ vihito daṇḍo na vadhārthaṃ vidhīyate
ye ca śiṣṭānprabādhante dharmasteṣāṃ vadhaḥ smṛtaḥ
ye ca rāṣṭroparodhena vṛddhiṃ kurvanti kecana
ye punardharmaśāstreṇa varteranniha dasyavaḥ api te dasyavo bhūtvā kṣipraṃ siddhimavāpnuyuḥ
na bhayaṃ tasya martyebhyo nāmartyebhyaḥ kathaṃcana
na sato nāsato rājansa hyaraṇyeṣu gopatiḥ
na dhanaṃ yajñaśīlānāṃ hāryaṃ devasvameva ca
imāḥ prajāḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ rakṣyā hanyāśca bhārata
thanaṃ hi kṣatriyasyeha dvitīyasya na vidyate
tadasya syādbalārthaṃ vā dhanaṃ yajñārthameva vā
yo vai na devānna pitṛnna martyānhaviṣā'rcati
na hi na prīṇayellokānna loke garhate nṛpam
ātmānaṃ saṃkramaṃ kṛtvā manye dharmavideva saḥ
[tathātathā jayellokāñśaktyā caiva yathāyathā ] audbhidā jantavo yadvacchrutvā vājo yathātathā
saiva vṛttirhi yajñeṣu yathā dharmo vidhīyate
na tu kāryā tvarā tāvaditi me niścitā matiḥ
prāpte kāle na me kiṃcinnyāyataḥ parihāsyate
sarvāneva ca tāṃstatra te vi--- iti
sa vinaśyati vai kṣipraṃ dīrghasūtro yathā jhaṣaḥ
ādau na kurute śreyaḥ kuśalo'smīti yaḥ pumān
kāṣṭhā kalā muhūrtāśca dinarātryaḥ kṣaṇā lavāḥ
māsāḥ pakṣāḥ ṣaḍṛtavaḥ kālaḥ saṃvatsarāṇi ca
pṛthivī deśa ityuktaḥ sa ca kālo na dṛśyate
sarvatra buddhiḥ kathitā śreṣṭhā te bharatarṣabha
tadicchāmi parāṃ buddhiṃ śrotuṃ te bharatarṣabha
yathā rājā na muhyeta śatrubhiḥ paripīḍitaḥ
kathaṃ nu puruṣaḥ kuryātkṛtvā kiṃ vā sukhī bhavet
vigrahaṃ kena vā kuryātsaṃdhiṃ vā kena yojayet
śṛṇu me putra kārtsnyena guhyamāpatsu bhārata
amitro mitratāṃ yāti mitraṃ cāpi praduṣyati
amitrairapi saṃdheyaṃ prāṇā rakṣyā hi bhārata
mārjārasya ca saṃvādaṃ nyagrodhe mūṣikasya ca
vasati sma mahāprājñaḥ palito nāma mūṣikaḥ
śākhāṃ tasya samāśritya vasati sma sukhaṃ tadā
gṛhaṃ gatvā sukhaṃ śete prabhātāmeti śarvarīm
tatra sma nityaṃ badhyante naktaṃ bahuvidhā mṛgāḥ
taṃ kālaṃ palito jñātvā pracacāra sunirbhayaḥ
gataṃ hi sahasā bhūmiṃ nakulo māmavāpnuyāt
viṣamastho hyayaṃ śatruḥ kṛtyaṃ cāsya mahanmayā
mūḍho grāhayituṃ svārthaṃ saṃgatyā yadi śakyate
śreṣṭho hi paṇḍitaḥ śatrurna ca mitramapaṇḍitaḥ
jīvitaṃ hi tavecchāmi śreyaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ hi nau
na te saumya bhayaṃ kāryaṃ jīviṣyasi yathā purā
ahaṃ tvāmuddhariṣyāmi prāṇāñjahyāṃ hi te kṛte
yena śakyastvayā mokṣaḥ prāpnuṃ śreyastathā mayā
ātmārthaṃ ca tvadarthaṃ ca śreyaḥ sādhāraṇāṃ hi nau
idaṃ hi nakulolūkaṃ pāpabuddhyā hi saṃsthitam
na dharṣayati mārjāra tena te svasti sāṃpratam
satāṃ sāptapadaṃ maitraṃ sa sakhā me'si paṇḍitaḥ
sāhāyyakaṃ kariṣyāmi nāsti te prāṇato bhayam
na hi śakto'si mārjāra pāśaṃ chettuṃ mayā vinā
ahaṃ chetsyāmi pāśāṃste yadi māṃ tvaṃ na hiṃsasi
sa tārayati tatkāṣṭhaṃ sa ca kāṣṭhena tāryate
ahaṃ tvāṃ tārayiṣyāmi māṃ ca tvaṃ tārayiṣyasi
nandāmi saumya bhadraṃ te yo māṃ jīvitumicchasi
śreyaśca yadi jānīṣe kriyatāṃ mā vicāraya
dvayorāpannayoḥ sandhiḥ kriyatāṃ mā cirāya ca
mayi kṛcchrādvinirmukte na vinaṅkṣyati te kṛtam
tathā nideśavartī ca bhavantaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
vihito yastu mārgo me hitārthaṃ śṛṇu taṃ mama
trāyasva māṃ mā vadhīśca śakto'smi tava rakṣaṇe
ulūkāccaiva māṃ rakṣa kṣudraḥ prārthayate hi mām
ahaṃ chetsyāmi te pāśānsakhe satyene te śape
taṃ saṃpūjyātha palitaṃ mārjāraḥ sauhṛde sthitam
kṣipramāgaccha bhadraṃ te tvaṃ me prāṇasamaḥ sakhā
sarvakāryāṇi kartā'haṃ priyāṇi ca hitāni ca
ekaḥ karoti hi kṛte niṣkāraṇameva kurute'nyaḥ
grāhayitvā tu taṃ svārthaṃ mārjāraṃ mūṣikastathā
dṛṣṭvā tayoḥ parāṃ prītiṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatau
līnaḥ sa tasya gātreṣu palito deśakālavit
chindhi pāśānamitraghna purā śvapaca eti saḥ
tūṣṇīṃ bhava na te saumya tvarā kāryā na saṃbhramaḥ
akāle vipramuktānme tvatta eva bhayaṃ bhavet
tasminkāle'pi ca tatā divākīrtibhayārditaḥ mama na grahaṇe śaktaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ
tato bhavatyapakrānte traste bhīte ca lubdhakāt
yathā tvaṃ mokṣitaḥ kṛcchrāttvaramāṇena vai mayā tathā hi tvaramāṇena tvayā kāryamidaṃ mama
na tanmanasi kartavyaṃ kṣāmaye tvāṃ prasīda me
śrutaṃ me tava mārjāra svamarthaṃ parigṛhṇataḥ
kṛtvā balavatā saṃdhimātmānaṃ yo na rakṣati
arthairarthā nibadhyante gajairiva mahāgajāḥ na ca kaścitkṛte kārye kartāraṃ samavekṣate
tathaiva ca susaṃtrastau taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghorasaṃkulam
tataściccheda taṃ tantuṃ mārjārasya sa mūṣikaḥ
bilaṃ viveśa palitaḥ śākhāṃ lebhe sa lomaśaḥ
