kā nu prajñā śrutaṃ vā kiṃ vṛttirvā kā nu te mune
hrāsaṃ vṛddhiṃ vināśaṃ ca na prahṛṣye na ca vyathe
antavanti ca bhūtāni guṇayuktāni paśyataḥ utpattinidhanajñasya kiṃ paryāyeṇopalakṣaye
divi saṃcaramāṇāni hrasvāni ca mahānti ca
acalamanidhanaṃ śivaṃ viśokaṃ śucimatulaṃ viduṣāṃ mate praviṣṭam
sukhamasukhamalābhamarthalābhaṃ ratimaratiṃ maraṇaṃ ca jīvitaṃ ca
na hṛdayamanurudhyate mano vā priyasukhadurlabhatāmanityatāṃ ca
bahu kathitamidaṃ hi buddhimadbhiḥ kavibhirapi prathayadbhirātmakīrtim
ajagaracaritaṃ vrataṃ mahātmā ya iha naro'nucaredvinītarāgaḥ
apagatabhayalobhamohamanyuḥ sa khalu sukhī vicaredimaṃ vihāram
bāndhavāḥ karma vittaṃ vā prajñā veha pitāmaha
narasya kā pratiṣṭhā syādetatpṛṣṭo vadasva me
prajñā pratiṣṭhā bhūtānāṃ prajñā lābhaḥ paro mataḥ
prajñā niḥśreyasī loke prajñā svargo mataḥ satām
sarve lābhāḥ sābhimānā iti satyavatī śrutiḥ
aho siddhārthatā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ santīha pāṇayaḥ [atīva spṛhaye teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ santīha pāṇayaḥ ]
pāṇimadbhyaḥ spṛhā'smākaṃ yathā tava dhanasya vai
atha yeṣāṃ punaḥ pāṇī devadattau daśāṅgulī
adhiṣṭhāya ca gāṃ loke bhuñjate vāhayanti ca
sahante tāni duḥkhāni diṣṭyā tvaṃ na tathā mune
diṣṭyā tvaṃ na śṛgālo vai na kṛmirna ca mūṣakaḥ
na sarpo na ca maṇḍūko na cānyaḥ pāpayonijaḥ
bhavestvaṃ yadyapi tvāḍhyo na rājā na ca daivatam
devatvaṃ prāpya cendratvaṃ naiva tuṣyestathā sati
na tṛptiḥ priyalābhe'sti tṛṣṇā nādbhiḥ praśāmyati
astyeva tvayi śoko'pi harṣaścāpi tathā tvayi
sukhaduḥkhe tathā cobhe tatra kā paridevanā
na ca pāṇestṛtīyasya yannāsti na tato bhayam
na tvaṃ smarasi vāruṇyā laṭvākānāṃ ca pakṣiṇām
tābhyāṃ cābhyadhiko bhakṣyo na kaścidvidyate kvacit
puruṣasyaiṣa niyamo manye śreyo na saṃśayaḥ
te khalvapi ramante ca modante ca hasanti ca
svakarmaṇā tu niyataṃ bhavitavyaṃ tu tattathā
na pulkaso na caṇḍāla ātmānaṃ tyaktumicchati
tayā tuṣṭaḥ svayā yonyā māyāṃ paśyasva yādṛśīm
aṅgāni ca samagrāṇi na ca lokeṣu dhikkṛtaḥ
satyaṃ damaṃ ca dānaṃ ca spardhiṣṭhā mā ca kenacit
icchantaste vihārāya sukhaṃ mahadavāpnuyuḥ ye'nujātāḥ sunakṣatre sutithau sumuhūrtake
ākroṣṭā cātivaktā ca brahmavākyeṣu ca dvijān
yadahaṃ mānuṣīṃ yoniṃ sṛgālaḥ prāpnuyāṃ punaḥ
jñeyaṃ jñātā bhaveyaṃ vai varjyaṃ varjayitā tathā
yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ vā tapastaptaṃ tathaiva ca
gurūṇāṃ vā'pi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
yathā'smiṃśca tathā tatra jānīyāṃ nṛpasattama duṣkartāro yathā loke yatkurvanti tathā śṛṇu
svakarma kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā duḥkhe mahati dhīyate
pulākā iva dhānyeṣu puttikā iva pakṣiṣu
tadvidhāste manuṣyeṣu yeṣāṃ dharmo na kāraṇam
acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
svaṃ kālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam
bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaśca yatkaroti śubhāśubham
tapasā tapyate dehastapasā vindate mahat upavāsaiḥ prataptānāṃ dīrghaṃ sukhamanantaram
padaṃ yathā na dṛśyeta tathā dharmavidāṃ gatiḥ
pralaye ca kimabhyeti tanme brūhi pitāmaha
kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ
asmāllokādamuṃ lokaṃ sarvaṃ śaṃsatu no bhavān
kathaṃ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni kathaṃ varṇavibhaktayaḥ śaucāśaucaṃ kathaṃ teṣāṃ dharmādharmāvatho katham
kīdṛśo jīvatāṃ jīvaḥ kva vā gacchanti ye mṛtāḥ
prakṛteḥ parato nityamindriyairapyagotaraḥ sa sisṛkṣuḥ sahasrāṃśādasṛjatpuruṣaṃ prabhuḥ
mānaso nāma yaḥ pūrvo viśruto vai maharṣibhiḥ
yataḥ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni tiṣṭhanti ca mriyanti ca
so'sṛjatprathamaṃ devo mahāntaṃ nāma nāmataḥ mahānsasarjāhaṃkāraṃ sa cāpi bhagavānatha
tataste gemayaṃ divyaṃ padmaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā
brahmā vai sa mahātejā ya ete pañcadhātavaḥ
nabhaścordhvaṃ śirastasya kṣitiḥ pādau bhujau diśaḥ
te cāpyantaṃ na paśyanti nabhasaḥ prathitaujasaḥ
evamantaṃ hi nabhasaḥ pramāṇaṃ salilasya ca
paṭhanti caiva munayaḥ śāstreṣu vividheṣu ca
adṛśyatvādagamyatvātkaḥ pramāṇamudāharet siddhānāṃ devatānāṃ ca yadā parimitā gatiḥ
nāmadheyānurūpasya mānasasya mahātmanaḥ yadā tu rdivyaṃ yadrūpaṃ hrasate vardhate punaḥ
brahmāṇaṃ pūrvajaṃ cāha bhavānsaṃdeha eva me
karṇikāṃ tasya padmasya merurgagamucchritaḥ tasya madhye sthito lokānsṛjate jagataḥ prabhuḥ
merumadhye sthito brahmā kathaṃ sa sasṛje prajāḥ
yatprāṇaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vardhante yena ca prajāḥ
pṛthivī parvatā meghā mūrtimantaśca ye pare
kathaṃ vā medinī sṛṣṭetyatra me saṃśayo mahān
ta ete dhātavaḥ pañca brahmā yānasṛjatpurā
sthāvarāṇāṃ na dṛśyante śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ
na śṛṇunte na paśyanti na gandharasavedinaḥ
na casparśaṃ vijānanti te kathaṃ pāñcabhautikāḥ
ūṣmato mlāyate varṇaṃ tvakphalaṃ puṣpameva ca
jaṅgamānāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śarīre pañca dhātavaḥ
tvakca māṃsaṃ tathā'sthīni majjā snāyuśca pañcamam
śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ tathā''syaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ koṣṭhameva ca
śleṣmā pittamatha svedo vasā śoṇitameva ca
ityāpaḥ pañcadhā dehe bhavanti prāṇināṃ sadā
bhūmergandhaguṇānvetti rasaṃ cādbhyaḥ śarīravān jyoteḥ paśyati rūpāṇi sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyutaḥ
gandhaḥ sparśo raso rūpaṃ śabdaścātra guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
iṣṭaścāniṣṭagandhaśca madhuraḥ kaṭureva ca nirhārī saṃhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca
jyotiḥ paśyati cakṣurbhyāṃ sparśaṃ vetti ca vāyunā
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca rasaścāpi guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
rasajñānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca triguṇaṃ jyotirucyate jyotiḥ paśyati rūpāṇi rūpaṃ ca bahudhā smṛtam
śuklaḥ kṛṣṇastathā raktaḥ pīto nīlāruṇastathā kaṭhinaścikkaṇaḥ ślakṣṇaḥ picchilo mṛdudāruṇaḥ
vāyavyastu guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparśaśca bahudhā smṛtaḥ
uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca tathā kharo mṛdū rūkṣo laghurgurutaro'pi ca
evaṃ dvādaśadhā sparśo vyāvyo guṇa ucyate
[mṛdaṅgabherīśaṅkhānāṃ stanayitno rathasya ca yaḥ kaścicchrūyate śabdaḥ prāṇino prāṇino'pi vā
evaṃ bahuvidhākāraḥ śabda ākāśasaṃbhavaḥ ākāśajaṃ śabdamāhurebhirvāyuguṇaiḥ saha ]
āpyāyyante ca te nityaṃ dhātavastaistu dhātubhiḥ
prāṇo mūrdhani cāgnau ca vartamāno viceṣṭane
sa jantuḥ sarvabhūtātmā puruṣaḥ sa sanātanaḥ
evaṃ tviha sa sarvatra prāṇena paripālyate
prayatne karmaṇi bale ya ekastriṣu vartate
ūṣmā sogniriti jñeyo yo'nnaṃ pacati dehinām
eṣa mārgo'tha yogānāṃ yena gacchanti tatpadam
evaṃ sarveṣu vihitaḥ prāṇāpāneṣu dehinām tasminyo'vasthito nityamagniḥ sthālyāmivāhitaḥ
yadi vāyumayo jīvaḥ saṃśleṣo yadi vāyunā
śleṣmaṃ vā yadi vā jīvaḥ saha tena praṇaśyati
kiṃ vedayati vā jīvaḥ kiṃ śṛṇoti bravīti ca
yo dattvā mriyate jantuḥ sā gauḥ kaṃ tārayiṣyati
gauśca pratigrahītā ca dātā caiva samaṃ yadā
chinnasya yadi vṛkṣasya na mūlaṃ pratirohati
na praṇāśo'sti jīvānāṃ dattasya ca kṛtasya ca
yāti dehāntaraṃ prāṇī śarīraṃ tu viśīryate
yathā samitsu dagdhāsu na praṇaśyati pāvakaḥ
agneryathā samiddhasya yadi nāśo na vidyate
matiryasya pramāṇaṃ vā saṃsthānaṃ vā na dṛśyate
jīvasya cendhanāgneśca sadā nāśo na vidyate samidhāmupayogānte sannevāgnirna dṛśyate
patitaṃ yāti bhūmitvamayanaṃ tasya hi kṣitiḥ
jaṅgamānāṃ hi sarveṣāṃ sthāvarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca ākāśaṃ pavano'nveti jyotistamanugacchati
śārīre mānase duḥkhe kastāṃ vedayate rujam
śṛṇoti kathitaṃ jīvaḥ karṇābhyāṃ na śṛṇoti tat
na paśyati na cāghrāti na śṛṇoti na bhāṣate
na ca sparśarasau vetti nidrāvaśagataḥ punaḥ
hṛṣyati krudhyate ko'tra śocatyudvijate ca kaḥ
icchati dhyāyati dveṣṭi vācamīrayate ca kaḥ
sa vetti gandhāṃśca rasāñśrutīśca sparśaṃ ca rūpaṃ ca guṇāśca ye'nye
sa vetti duḥkhāni sukhāni cātra tadviprayogāttu na vetti dehī
yadā na rūpaṃ na sparśo noṣmabhāvaśca pañcake
tadā śānte śarīrāgnau dehaṃ tyaktvā na naśyati
tatrātmā mānaso brahmā sarva bhūteṣu lokakṛt
[ātmā kṣetrajña ityuktaḥ saṃyuktaḥ prākṛtairguṇaiḥ taireva tu vinirmuktaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ ]
tamo rajaśca sattvaṃ ca viddhi jīvaguṇānimān
sacetanaṃ jīvaguṇaṃ vadanti sa ceṣṭate ceṣṭayate ca sarvam
tataḥ paraṃ kṣetravido vadanti prāvartayadyo bhuvanāni sapta
na jīvanāśo'sti hi dehabhede mithyaitadāhurmuta ityabuddhāḥ
cittasya hi prasādena hitvā karma śubhāśubham
tataḥ satyaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca tapo brahma ca śāśvatam
ācāraṃ caiva śaucaṃ ca sargādau vidadhe prabhuḥ
brāhmaṇānāṃ sito varṇaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ tu lohitaḥ
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobhaḥ śokaścintā kṣudhā śramaḥ
na viśeṣo'sti varṇānāṃ sarvaṃ brāhmamidaṃ jagat
dharmo yajñakriyā caiṣāṃ nityaṃ na pratiṣidhyate
ityete caturo varṇā yeṣāṃ brāhmī sarasvatī
brahma vaiva paraṃ sṛṣṭaṃ ye tu jānanti te dvijāḥ
ṛṣibhiḥ svena tapasā sṛjyante cāpare paraiḥ
brāhmaṇaḥ kena bhavati kṣatriyo vā dvijottama
vaiśyaḥ śūdraśca viprarṣe tadbrūhi vadatāṃ vara
nityavratī satyaparaḥ sa vai brāhmaṇa ucyate
tapaśca dṛśyate yatra sa brāhmaṇa iti smṛtaḥ
tyaktavedastvanācāraḥ sa vai śūdra iti smṛtaḥ
śūdre caitadbhavellakṣyaṃ dvije tacca na vidyate
na vai śūdro bhavecchradro brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ
tyāge yasya hutaṃ sarvaṃ sa tyāgī ca sa buddhimān
ahiṃsraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ maitrāyaṇagatiścaret parigrahānparityajya bhavedbuddhyā jitendriyaḥ
sukhaṃ vai brāhmaṇo brahma sa vai tenādhigacchati
satyaṃ brahma tapaḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ sṛjati ca prajāḥ
satyena dhāryate lokaḥ svargaṃ satyena gacchati
anṛtaṃ tamaso rūpaṃ tamasā nīyate hyadhaḥ
svargaḥ prakāśa ityāhurnarakaṃ tama eva ca
tatra tvevaṃvidhā loke vṛttiḥ satyānṛte bhavet
dharmādharmau prakāśaśca tamo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ tathā
tatra yatsatyaṃ sa dharmo yo dharmaḥ sa prakāśo yaḥ prakāśastatsukhamiti tatra yadanṛtaṃ so'dharmo yo'dharmastattamo yattamastadduḥkhamiti
sukhaṃ hyanityaṃ bhūtānāmiha loke paratra ca
rāhugrastasya somasya yathā jyotsnā na bhāsate

tatkhalu dvividhaṃ sukhamucyate śārīraṃ mānasaṃ ca iha khalvamuṣmiṃśca loke sarvārambhapravṛttayaḥ sukhārthamabhidhīyante na hyataḥ paraṃ trivargaphalaṃ viśiṣṭataramasti sa eṣa kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo dharmārthaguṇārambhastaddheturasyotpattiḥ sukhaprayojanārtha ārambhaḥ

yadetadbhavatā'bhihitaṃ sukhānāṃ paramārthasthitiriti tanna gṛhṇīmo na hyeṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ tapasi sthitānāmaprāpya eva kāmyo guṇaviśeṣo na cainamabhilaṣanti ca tapasi śrūyate trilokekṛdbrahmā prabhurekākī tiṣṭhati brahmacārī na kāmasukheṣvātmānamavadadhāti apica bhagavānviśveśvara [umāpatiḥ] kāmamabhivartamānamanaṅgatvena nāśamanayat tasmādbrūmo na tu mahātmabhiḥ pratigṛhīto'yamartho tatveṣa tāvadviśiṣṭo guṇagaṇa iti naitadbhagavānpratyeti bhagavatoktaṃ sukhānāṃ paramārthasthitiriti lokapravādo hi dvividhaḥ phalodayaḥ sukṛtātsukhamavāpyate duṣkṛtādduḥkhamiti

atrocyate anṛtātkhalu tamaḥ prādurbhūtaṃ tatastamograstā adharmamevānuvartante na dharmam krodhalobhamohamadādibhiravacchannā na khalvasmim̐lloke nāmutra sukhamāpnuvanti vividhavyādhivraṇarujopatāpairavakīryante vadhabandhananirodhaparikleśādibhiśca kṣutpipāsāśramakṛtairupatāpairupatapyante caṇḍavātātyuṣṇātiśītakṛtaiśca pratibhayaiḥ śārīrairduḥkhairupatapyante bandhudhanavinanāśaviprayogakṛtaiśca mānasaiḥ śokairabhibhūyante jarāmṛtyukṛtaiścānyairiti
na caite doṣāḥ svarge prādurbhavanti tatra khalu bhavanti
kṣutpipāsāśramo nāsti na jarā na ca pātakam
narake duḥkhamevāhuḥ sukhaṃ tu paramaṃ padam
dānasya kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ dharmasya caritasya ca
dānaṃ tu dvividhaṃ prāhuḥ paratrārthamihaiva ca
kiṃ kasya dharmācaraṇaṃ kiṃ vā dharmasya lakṣaṇam

pūrvameva bhagavatā brahmaṇā lokahitamanutiṣṭhatā dharmasaṃrakṣaṇārthamāśramāścatvāro'bhinirdiṣṭāḥ tatra gurukulavāsameva prathamamāśramamudāharanti samyagyatra śaucasaṃskāraniyamavrataviniyatātmā ubhesandhye bhāskarāgnidaivatānyupasthāya vihāya nidrālasye gurorabhivādananavedābhyāsaśravaṇapavitrīkṛtāntarātmā [triṣavaṇamupaspṛśya brahmacaryāgniparicaraṇaguruśuśrūṣānityabhikṣyādisarvaniveditāntarātmā] guruvacanirdeśānuṣṭhānāpratikūlo guruprasādalabdhasvādhyāyatatparaḥ syāt

gārhasthyaṃ khalu dvitīyamāśramaṃ vadanti tasya samudācāralakṣaṇaṃ sarvamanuvyākhyāsyāmaḥ samāvṛttānāṃ sadācārāṇāṃ sahadharmacaryāphalārthināṃ gṛhāśramo vidhīyate dharmārthakāmāvāptyarthaṃ trivargasādhanamapekṣyāgarhitena karmaṇā dhanānyādāya svādhyāyopalabdhaprakarṣeṇa vā brahmarṣinirmitena vā havyakavyaniyamābhyāṃ daivatapūjāsamādhiprasādavidhyupalabdhena dhanena gṛhastho gārhasthyaṃ vartayet taddhi sarvāśramāṇāṃ mūlamudāharanti gurukulanivāsinaḥ parivrājakā ye cānye saṃkalpitavrataniyamadharmānuṣṭhāyinastepāmaṣyata eva bhikṣābalisaṃvibhāgāḥ pravartante

vānaprasthānāṃ ca dravyopaskāra iti prāyaśaḥ khalvete sādhavaḥ sādhupathyāśinaḥ svādhyāyaprasaṅginastīrthābhigamanadeśadarśanārthaṃ pṛthivīṃ paryaṭanti teṣāṃ pratyutthānābhigamanābhivādanānasūyavākpradānasukhaśaktyāsanasukhaśayanābhyavahārasatkriyāceti
sa tasya duṣkṛtaṃ dattvā puṇyamādāya gacchati
api cātra yajñakriyābhirdevatāḥ prīyante nivāpena pitaro vedavidyābhyāsaśravaṇadhāraṇena ṛṣaya apatyotpādanena prajāpatiriti

vānaprasthāḥ khalvṛṣidharmamanuvartante puṇyāni tīrthāni nadīprasravaṇānyucaranti suvibhakteṣyaraṇyeṣu mṛgamahiṣavarāhaśārdūlasṛmaragajākīrṇeṣu tapasyanto'nusaṃcaranti tyaktagrāmyavastrābhyavahāropabhogā vanyauṣadhiphalamūlaparṇaparimitavicitraniyatāhārāḥ sthānāsanino bhūmipāṣāṇasikatāśarkarāvālukābhasmaśāyinaḥ kāśakuśacarmavalkalasaṃvṛtāṅgāḥ keśaśmaśrunakharomadhāriṇo niyatakālopasparśanā askannakālabahihomānuṣṭhāyinaḥ samitkuśakusumāpahārārcanasaṃmārjanahomāntalabdhaviśrayāḥ śītoṣṇa [varṣa]pavanaviniṣṭaptavibhinnasarvatvaco vividhaniyamayogacaryānuṣṭhānahṛta [pariśuṣka] māṃsaśoṇitatvagasthibhūtā dhṛtiparāḥ satvayogāccharīrāṇyudvahanti

parivrājakānāṃ punarācāraḥ tadyathā vimucyadhanakalatraparibarhaṇaṃ saṅgeṣvātmanaḥ snehapāśānavadhūya parivrajanti samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanāstrivargapravṛtteṣvārambheṣvasaktabuddhayo'rimitrodāsīnānāṃ tulyadarśanāḥ sthāvarajaṅgamānāṃ jarāyujāṇḍajasvedajodbhijjānāṃ bhūtānāṃ vāṅbhanaḥ karmabhirabhidrohiṇo'niketāḥ parvatapulinavṛkṣamūladevatāyatanānyananucaranto vāsārthamupeyurnagaraṃ grāmaṃ vā nagare pañcarātrikā grāme caikarātrikāḥ praviśca ca prāṇadhāraṇārthaṃ dvijātīnāṃ bhavanānyasaṃkīrṇakarmaṇāmupatiṣṭheyuḥ pātrapatitā'yācitabhaikṣyāḥ kāmakrodhadarpalobhamohakārpaṇyadambhaparivādābhimānahiṃsānivṛttā iti
yo bhaikṣacaryopagatairhavirbhi ścitāgninā prāpya sa yāti lokā
mokṣāśramaṃ yaḥ kurute yathoktaṃ śuciḥ susaṃkalpitabuddhiyuktaḥ
anindhanaṃ jyotiriva praśāntaṃ sa brahmalokaṃ śrayate dvijātiḥ
puṇyaḥ kṣemyaśca kāmyaśca sa paro loka ucyate
sa svargasadṛśo lokastatra hyuktāḥ śubhā guṇāḥ
nātra mṛtyuḥ prabhavati spṛśanti vyādhayo na ca
na cānyonyavadhastatra dravyeṣu ca na vismayaḥ
iha śramo bhayaṃ mohaḥ kṣudhā nidrā ca jāyate
yastadvedobhayaṃ prājñaḥ pāpmanā na sa lipyate
iha cintā bahuvidhā dharmādharmasya karmaṇaḥ karmabhūmiriyaṃ loke iha kṛtvā śubhāśubham
ihatyāstatra jāyante ye vai puṇyakṛto janāḥ
ihaiva parivarntate na te yāntyuttarāṃ diśam
dharmādharmau hi lokasya yo vai vetti sa buddhimān
śrotumicchāmi dharmajña sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ
purīṣaṃ yadi vā mūtraṃ ye na kuvanti mānavāḥ rājamārge gavāṃ madhye dhānyamadhye śivālaye
agnyagāre tathā tīre ye na kurvanti te śubhāḥ
atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca
loṣṭamadīṃ tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī tu yo naraḥ
maithunaṃ satataṃ dharmyaṃ guhye caiva samācaret
tīrthānāṃ hṛdayaṃ tīrthaṃ śucīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ śuciḥ
sāyaṃ prātaśca viprāṇāṃ pūjanaṃ ca yathāvidhi paṇyānāṃ śobhate paṇyaṃ kṛṣīṇāmṛddhyatāṃ kṛṣiḥ
bahukāraṃ ca sasyānāṃ vāhye vāho gavāṃ tathā
saṃpannaṃ bhojane nityaṃ pānīye tarpaṇaṃ tathā
pratyādityaṃ na meheta na paśyedātmanaḥ śakṛt
sutaiḥ striyā ca śayanaṃ saha bhojyaṃ ca varjayet
pāpenāpihitaṃ pāpaṃ pāpamevānuvartate dharmeṇāpihito dharmo dharmamevānuvartate
pāpaṃ kṛtaṃ na smaratīha mūḍho vivartamānasya tadeti kartuḥ
rāhuryathā candramupaiti cāpi tathā'budhaṃ pāpamupaiti karma
tadbudhā na praśaṃsanti maraṇaṃ na pratīkṣate
eka eva careddharmaṃ nāsti dharme sahāyatā
[sṛṣṭipralayasaṃyuktamācāryaiḥ paridarśitam ] yajjñātvā puruṣo leke prītiṃ saukhyaṃ ca vindati
tasminprakāśate nityaṃ tamaḥ somo yathaiva tat
tadvidvānnaṣṭayāpmaiṣa brahmabhūyāya kalpate aṇḍāvaraṇabhūtānāṃ paryantaṃ hi yathā tamaḥ
yataḥ sṛṣṭāni tatraiva tāni yānti punaḥpunaḥ
prasārya ca yathāṅgāni kūrmaḥ saṃharate punaḥ
yadvinā naiva śṛṇute na paśyati na dīpyate
ākāśātkhalu yājyeṣu bhavanti sumahāguṇāḥ iti tanmayamevaitatsarvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam
pralaye ca tamabhyeti tasmādutsṛjyate punaḥ mahābhūteṣu bhūtātmā sṛṣṭvā saṃharate punaḥ
akarotteṣu vaiṣamya tattu jīvo na paśyati
vāyoḥ sparśastathā ceṣṭā tvakcaiva tritayaṃ smṛtam
rasaḥ kledaśca jihvā ca trayo jalaguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca ete bhūmiguṇāstrayaḥ
mahābhūtāni pañcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ ca mana ucyate
tamo rajaśca satvaṃ ca te'pi bhāvāstadāśritāḥ
etāṃ buddhvā naro buddhyā bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim
na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate
indriyāṇi hi sarvāṇi pravartayati sā tadā
prītiḥ satvaṃ rajaḥ śokastamo mohastu te trayaḥ
yeye ca bhāvā loke'sminsarveṣveteṣu vai triṣu
iti buddhigatiḥ sarvā vyākhyātā tava bhārata
sātvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti bhārata sukhasparśaḥ sattvaguṇo duḥkhasparśo rajoguṇaḥ
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet
pravṛttaṃ raja ityeva tanna saṃrabhya cintayet
manaḥ suniyataṃ yasya sa sukhī pretya ceha ca
sṛjate tu guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān
pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tau saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā
yathā matsyo jalaṃ caiva saṃprayuktau tathaiva tau
na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ sa guṇānveti sarvaśaḥ
āśrayo nāsti satvasya kṣetrajñasya ca kaścana
satvaṃ manaḥ saṃsṛjate na guṇānvai kadācana
yathā vāricaraḥ pakṣī salilena na lipyate
svabhāvasiddhyā yuktastu sa nityaṃ sṛjata guṇān
malināḥ prāpnuyuḥ śuddhiṃ yathā pūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ
na tu tapyati tattvajñaḥ phale jñāte taratyuta
etāṃ buddhā naraḥ sarvāṃ bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim
trivargo yasya viditaḥ prekṣya taṃ sa vimucyate
pratigṛhya ca nihnoti hyanyathā ca pradṛśyate
na sarpati ca yaṃ prāhuḥ sarvatra pratihanyate
na bhavati viduṣāṃ tato bhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet
na hi gatiradhikāsti kasyaci tsati hi guṇe pravadantyatulyatām
yaḥ karotyanabhisandhipūrvakaṃ tacca nirṇudati yatpurā kṛtam
nāpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ kutaḥ priyaṃ tasya tajjanayatīha sarvataḥ
loka āturajanānvirāviṇa stattadeva bahu paśya śocataḥ tatra paśya kuśalānaśocato
hanta vakṣyāmi te pārtha dhyānayogaṃ caturvidham
yaṃ jñātvā śāśvatīṃ siddhiṃ gacchantīha maharṣayaḥ
yathā svanuṣṭhitaṃ dhyānaṃ tathā kurvanti yoginaḥ
caturvidheṣu bhāveṣu yo'rthasaktaḥ sadaiva hi tajjñātvā vāstavaṃ teṣāmartheṣu parivartate
śabdaṃ na vindecchrotreṇa tvacā sparśaṃ na vedayet
rūpaṃ na cakṣuṣā vidyājjihvayā na rasāṃstathā
sahasā vāriṇā siktā na yānti paribhāvanam
na tatpuruṣakāreṇa na ca daivena kenacit
kiṃ phalaṃ japatāmuktaṃ kva vā tiṣṭhanti jāpakāḥ
japasya ca vidhiṃ kṛtsnaṃ vaktumarhasi se'nagha
etanme sarvamācakṣva sarvajño hyasi me mataḥ
yamasya yatpurā vṛttaṃ kālasya brāhmaṇasya ca
ikṣvākoścaiva mṛtyośca vivāde dharmakāraṇāt saṃnyāsa eva vedānte vartate japanaṃ prati
mārgau tāvapyubhāvetau saṃśritau na ca saṃśritau
sālambanamiti jñeyaṃ japayajñātmakaṃ śubham manaḥ samādhirevātra tathendriyajayaḥ smṛtaḥ
yathā nivartate dharmo japato brahmacāriṇaḥ na japo na ca vai dhyānaṃ necchā na dveṣaharṣaṇau
yathā saṃśrūyate jāpo yena vai jāpako bhavet
yadanyaducitaṃ śuddhaṃ vedasmṛtyupapāditam etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa yathoktaṃ parivartayet
dvividaṃ mārgamāsādya vyaktāvyaktamanāmayam kuśoccayaniṣaṣṇaḥ sankuśahastaḥ kuśaiḥ śikha
taddhiyā dhyāyati brahma japanvai saṃhitāṃ hitām
yasminnevābhipatitaṃ manastatra niveśayet samādhau sa hi mantre tu saṃhitāṃ vā yathāvidhi
arāgamoho nirdvandvo na śocati na sajjate
na cārthagrahaṇe yukto nāvamānī na cākriyaḥ
nirālambo bhavetsmṛtvā maraṇāya samādhimān sarvāllom̐kānsamākramya kramātprāpnoti vai param
utkrāmati ca mārgastho naiva kvacana jāyate
avamānena kurute na tuṣyati na śocati
īdṛśo jāpako yāti nirayaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
rāgeṇa jāpako japyaṃ kurute yaśca mohitaḥ
na saṃpūrṇo na vā yukto nirayaṃ so'dhigacchati
kīdṛśaṃ nirayaṃ yāti jāpako varṇayasva me
abhayaṃ cānimittaṃ ca na ca kleśabhayāvṛtam
kālaḥ saṃpacyate tatra kālastatra na vai prabhuḥ
etadvai brahmaṇaḥ sthāne jāpakasya mahātmanaḥ tatrasthaṃ paramātmānaṃ dhyāyanvai susamāhitaḥ
īdṛśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ nirayāste ca tādṛśāḥ
ete te nirayāḥ proktāḥ sarva eva yathātatham
kālasya mṛtyośca tathā yadvṛttaṃ tannibodha me yathā sa teṣāṃ saṃvādo yasminsthāne'pi cābhavat
soyaṃ brāhmaṃ pastepe saṃhitāṃ saṃyato japan
tasya varṣasahasraṃ tu niyamena tathā gatam
sa devyā darśitaḥ sākṣātprītāsmīti tadā kila
diṣṭyā devi prasannā tvaṃ darśanaṃ cāgatā mama
yadi cāpi prasannāsi japye me ramatāṃ manaḥ
kiṃ prārthayasi viprarṣe kiṃ ceṣṭaṃ karavāṇi te
prabrūhi japatāṃ śreṣṭha sarvaṃ tatte bhaviṣyati
ityuktaḥ sa tadā devyā vipraḥ provāca dharmavit
japyaṃ prati mameccheyaṃ vardhatviti punaḥ punaḥ
nirayaṃ naiva yātā tvaṃ yatra yātā dvijarṣabhāḥ
niyato japa caikāgro dharmastvāṃ samupaiṣyati kālo mṛtyuryamaścaiva samāyāsyanti te'ntikam
bhavitā ca vivādo'tra tava teṣāṃ ca dharmataḥ
dvijāte paśya māṃ dharmamahaṃ tvāṃ draṣṭumāgataḥ
japyasyāsya phalaṃ yattatpraṃprāptaṃ tacca me śṛṇu
jitā lokāstvayā sarve ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ
kṛtaṃ lokena me dharma gaccha tvaṃ ca yathāsukham
acalaṃ te manaḥ kṛtvā tyaja dehaṃ mahāmate anena kiṃ te saṃyogaḥ kathaṃ mohaṃ gamiṣyasi
avaśyaṃ bhoḥ śarīraṃ te tyaktavyaṃ munipuṅgava
svargamāroha bho vipra kiṃ vā vai rocate'nagha
kimuktaṃ dharma kiṃ neti kasmānmāṃ proktavānasi
tyaja dehaṃ dvijeti tvaṃ sasaṃbudhyātra me yadi
na rocaye svargavāsaṃ vinā dehamahaṃ vibho
gaccha dharma na me śraddhā svargaṃ gantuṃ vinā''tmanā
alaṃ dehe manaḥ kṛtvā tyaktvā dehaṃ sukhī bhava
gaccha lokānarajaso yatra gatvā na śocasi
saśarīreṇa gantavyaṃ mayā svargaṃ na cānyathā
evaṃ te kāyasaṃprātirvartate munisattama yadi tvaṃ necchasi tyaktuṃ śarīraṃ paśya vai dvija
atha vaivasvataḥ kālo mṛtyuśca tritayaṃ vibho
mṛtyuṃ māṃ viddhi dharmajña rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam
kālena codito vipra tvāmito netumadya vai
mṛtyave cātha dharmāya kiṃ kāryaṃ karavāṇi vaḥ
ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ ca dattvā sa tebhyastatra samāgama
sarvāneva tu rājarṣiḥ saṃpūjyātha praṇamya ca
tasmai so'thāsanaṃ dattvā pādyamardhyaṃ tathaiva ca
dadāni vasu kiṃcitte prārthitaṃ tadvadasva me
tebhyaḥ prayaccha dānāni ye pravṛttā narādhipa ahaṃ na pratigṛhṇāmi kimiṣṭaṃ kiṃ dadāmi te
brūhi tvaṃ nṛpatiśreṣṭha tapasā sādhayāmi kim
kṣatriyo'haṃ na jānāmi dehīti vacanaṃ kvacit
tuṣyasi tvaṃ svadharmeṇa tathā tuṣṭā vayaṃ nṛpa
yāce tvāṃ dīyatāṃ mahyaṃ japyasyāsya phalaṃ dvija
yuddhaṃ mama sadā vāṇī yācatīti vikatthase
na ca yuddhaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ kimarthaṃ yācase punaḥ
vāgyuddhaṃ tadidaṃ tīvraṃ mama vipra tvayā saha
seyamadya pratijñā me svaśaktyā kiṃ pradīyatām
brūhi dāsyāmi rājendra vibhave sati māciram
yattadvarṣaśataṃ pūrṇaṃ japyaṃ vai japatā tvayā
paramaṃ gṛhyatāṃ tasya phalaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā
kṛtaṃ sarveṇa bhadraṃ te japyaṃ yadyācitaṃ mayā
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi kiṃca tasya phalaṃ vada
phalaprāptiṃ na jānāmi dattaṃ yajjapitaṃ mayā
ayaṃ dharmaśca kālaśca yamo mṛtyuśca sākṣiṇaḥ
ajñātamasya dharmasya phalaṃ kiṃ me kariṣyati phalaṃ bravīṣi dharmasya na cejjapyakṛtasya mām
nādade'paradattaṃ vai dattaṃ vā cāphalaṃ mayā
vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ rājarṣe mamādya tava caiva hi
dadasveti tvayā coktaṃ dattaṃ vācā phalaṃ mayā
na vācaṃ dūṣayiṣyāmi satyaṃ rakṣa sthiro bhava
athaivaṃ vadato me'dya vacanaṃ na kariṣyasi
na yuktā tu mṛṣāvāṇī tvayā vaktumariṃdama
tathā mayā'pyabhihitaṃ mithyā kartuṃ na śakyate
tanme nisṛṣṭaṃ gṛhṇīṣva bhava satyesthitopi ca
nāyaṃ loko'sti na paro na ca pūrvānsa tārayet
yathā satyaṃ pare loke tatheha puruṣarṣabha
tapāṃsi yāni cīrṇāni cariṣyanti ca yattapaḥ
satyamekaṃ paraṃ brahma satyamekaṃ paraṃ tapaḥ
satyamekaṃ paro yajñaḥ satyamekaṃ paraṃ śrutam
satyaṃ vedeṣu jāgarti phalaṃ satye paraṃ smṛtam
tapo dharmo damaścaiva sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam
prāṇināṃ jananaṃ satyaṃ satyaṃ santatireva ca
satyaṃ yajñastapo vedāḥ stobhā mantrāḥ sarasvatī
tulāmāropito dharmaḥ satyaṃ caiveti naḥ śrutam
samāṃ kakṣāṃ dhārayato yaḥ satyaṃ tato'dhikam
yato dharmastataḥ satyaṃ sarvaṃ satyena vardhate
satye kuru sthiraṃ bhāvaṃ mā rājannanṛtaṃ kṛthāḥ
yadi japyaphalaṃ dattaṃ mayā necchasi vai nṛpa
saṃśrutya yo na ditseta yācitvā yaśca necchati
yoddhavyaṃ rakṣitavyaṃ ca kṣatradharmaḥ kila dvija
dātāraḥ kṣatriyāḥ proktā gṛhṇīyāṃ bhavataḥ katham
na cchandayāmi te rājannāpi te gṛhamāvrajam
ihāgamya tu yācitvā na gṛhṇīṣe punaḥ katham
svargaṃ māṃ viddhi rājendra rūpiṇaṃ svayamāgatam
kṛtaṃ svargeṇa me kāryaṃ gaccha svarga yathāgatam
vipro yadīcchate dātuṃ cīrṇaṃ gṛhṇātu me phalam
nivṛttaṃ māṃ cirādrājanvipralobhayase katham svena kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi tvatto necche phalaṃ nṛpa
yadi vipra visṛṣṭaṃ te japyasya phalamuttamam
yadi dharmaḥ kṣuto vipra sahaiva phalamastu nau
mā vā bhūtsaha bhojyaṃ nau madīyaṃ phalamāpnuhi
pratīccha matkṛtaṃ dharmaṃ yadi te mayyanugrahaḥ
satyaṃ bravīmyahamidaṃ na me dhārayate bhavān anṛtaṃ vadasīha tvamṛṇaṃ te dhārayāmyaham
parīkṣyau tu yathā syāva nāvāmiha vigarhitau
dadataśca na gṛhṇāti vikṛto me mahīpate
mithyā bravītyayaṃ hi tvāṃ satyābhāsaṃ narādhipa
virūpa kiṃ dhārayate bhavānasya bravītu me
śrutvā tathā kariṣye'hamiti me dhīyate manaḥ
gāvau ca kapile krītvā vatsale bahudohane
kuru dharmamadharmaṃ vā vinaye nau samādadha
yadi necchati me dānaṃ yathā dattamanena vai
bhavānatra sthiro bhūtvā mārge sthāpayitā'dya nau
dīyamānaṃ na gṛhṇāsi ṛṇaṃ kasmāttvamadya vai
nāyaṃ me dhārayatyatra gacchatāṃ yatra vāñchati
dadato'sya na gṛhṇāsi viṣamaṃ pratibhāti me
daṇaḍyo hi tvaṃ mama mato nāstyatra khalu saṃśayaḥ
mayā'sya dattaṃ rājarṣe gṛhṇīyāṃ tatkathaṃ punaḥ
dīyamānaṃ yadi mayā na gṛhṇāsi kathaṃcana
svayaṃ mayā yācitena dattaṃ kathamihādya tat
kathaṃ na lipyeyamahaṃ pāpena mahatā'dya vai
tau covāca sa rājarṣiḥ kṛtakāryau gamiṣyathaḥ
gṛhāṇa dhāraye'haṃ ca yācitaṃ saṃśrutaṃ mayā
na cedbhahīṣyase rājañśapiṣye tvāṃ na saṃśayaḥ
ityarthaṃ me grahītavyaṃ kathaṃ tulyaṃ bhavediti
kāmakrodhau viddhi nau tvamāvābhyāṃ kārito bhavān jijñāsamānau yuvayormanotthaṃ tu dvijottama
saheti ca yaduktaṃ te samā lokāstavāsya ca
kālo dharmastathā mṛtyuḥ kāmakrodhau tathā yuvām
sarve gacchāma yatra svānsvām̐llokāṃśca tathā vayam gaccha lokāñjitānsvena karmaṇā yatra vāñchasi
asmākaṃ yaḥ smṛto mūrdhā brahmalokamiti smṛtaṃ
tatrasthau hi bhavantau hi yuvābhyāṃ nirjitā vayam yuvayoḥ kāma āpannastatkāmyamaviśaṅkayā
gatiḥ sthānaṃ ca lokāśca jāpakena yathā jitāḥ
sa taijasena bhāvena yadi tatra ramatyuta
atha tatra virāgī sa paraṃ gacchatyasaṃśayam
brahmabhūtaḥ sa nirdvandvaḥ sukhī śānto nirāmayaḥ
nispṛhaḥ sarvato muktastatra vai ramate sukham
kimuttaraṃ tadā tau sma cakratustasya bhāṣite
brāhmaṇo vā'thavā rājā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
athavā tau gatau tatra yadetatkīrtitaṃ tvayā
saṃvādo vā tayoḥ ko'bhūtkiṃ vā tau tatra cakratuḥ
yamaṃ kālaṃ ca mṛtyuṃ ca svargaṃ saṃpūjya cārhataḥ
pūrvaṃ ye cāpare tatra sametā brāhmaṇarṣabhāḥ
bhavatā cābhyanujñāto japeyaṃ bhūya eva ha
varaśca mama pūrvaṃ hi datto devyā mahābala
śraddhā te japato nityaṃ bhavatviti viśāṃpate
yadyevaṃ saphalā siddhiḥ śraddhā ca japituṃ tava
gaccha vipra mayā sārdhaṃ jāpakaṃ phalamāpnuhi
saha tulyaphalāvāvāṃ gacchāvo yatra nau gatiḥ
sādhyāśca viśve maruto vākyāni sumahānti ca
nadyaḥ śailāḥ samudrāśca tīrthāni vividhāni ca
ājagāma ca deveśo brahmā vedamayo'vyayaḥ viṣṇuḥ sahasraśīrṣaśca devo'cintyaḥ samāgamat
saṃsiddhastvaṃ mahābhāga tvaṃ ca siddhastathā nṛpa
evaṃ tau manasi sthāpya dadhatuḥ prāṇayormanaḥ
uṣyatāṃ mayi cetyuktvā vyādade sa tato mukham
yaśca yoge bhavedbhaktaḥ so'pi nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ vidhinānena dehānte mama lokānavāpnuyāt
sādhaye gamyatāṃ caiva yathā sthānāni siddhaye
āmantrya ca tato devā yayuḥ svaṃsvaṃ niveśanam
te ca sarve mahātmāno dharmaṃ satkṛtya tatra vai
kiṃ phalaṃ jñānayogasya vedānāṃ niyamasya ca
bhūtātmā ca kathaṃ jñeyastanme brūhi pitāmaha
bṛhaspatiḥ praśnamimaṃ purāṇaṃ prapaccha śiṣyo'tha guruṃ praṇamya
yatkāraṇaṃ mantravidhiḥ pravṛtto jñāne phalaṃ yatpravadanti viprāḥ
phalaṃ mahadbhiryadupāsyate ca kiṃ tatkathaṃ vā bhavitā kva vā tat
mahī mahījāḥ pavano'ntarikṣaṃ jalaukasaścaiva jalaṃ tathā dyauḥ
divaukasaścāpi yataḥ prasūtā staducyatāṃ me bhagavanpurāṇam
jñānaṃ yataḥ prārthayate naro vai tatastadarthā bhavati pravṛttiḥ
na cāpyahaṃ veda paraṃ purāṇaṃ mithyāpravṛttiṃ ca kathaṃ nu kuryām
ṛksāmasaṅghāṃśca yajūṃṣi cāhaṃ chandāṃsi nakṣatragatiṃ niruktam
adhītya ca vyākaraṇaṃ sakalpaṃ śikṣāṃ ca bhūtaprakṛtiṃ na vedmi
sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu sarvameta tsāmānyaśabdaiśca viśeṣaṇaiśca
sa me bhavāñśaṃsatu tāvadeta jjñāne phalaṃ karmaṇi vā yadasti
yathā ca dehāccyavate śarīrī punaḥ śarīraṃ ca yathā'bhyupaiti
yadyatpriyaṃ yasya sukhaṃ tadāhu stadeva duḥkhaṃ pravadantyaniṣṭam
iṣṭaṃ ca me syāditaracca na syā detatkṛte karmavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ
iṣṭaṃ tvaniṣṭaṃ ca na māṃ bhajete tyetatkṛte jñānavidhiḥ pravṛttaḥ
nānāvidhe karmapathe sukhārthī naraḥ pravṛtto nirayaṃ prayāti ]
iṣṭaṃ tvaniṣṭaṃ ca sukhāsukhe ca sāśīstapaśchandati karmabhiśca
prajāḥ sṛṣṭā manasā karmaṇā ca dvāvevaitau satpathau lokajuṣṭau
dṛṣṭaṃ karmāśāśvataṃ cāntavacca manastyāge kāraṇaṃ nānyadasti
nānāvidhe karmaphale sukhārthī naraḥ pramatto na paraṃ prayāti phalaṃ hi tatkarmaphalādapetaṃ nirāśiṣo brahma paraṃ hyupetam
svenātmanā cakṣuriva praṇetā niśātyaye tamasā saṃvṛtātmā
jñānaṃ tu vijñānaguṇena yuktaṃ karmāśubhaṃ paśyati varjanīyam
ajñāmatastatra patanti mūḍhā jñāne phalaṃ paśya yathā viśiṣṭam
kṛtsnastu mantro vidhivatprayukto yajñā yathoktāstviha dakṣiṇāśca
annapradānaṃ manasaḥ samādhiḥ pañcātmakaṃ karmaphalaṃ vadanti
guṇātmakaṃ karma vadanti vedā stasmānmantro mannapūrvaṃ hi karma
vidhirvidheyaṃ manasopapattiḥ phalasya bhoktā tu tathā śarīrī
śabdāśca rūpāṇi rasāśca puṇyāḥ sparśāśca gandhāśca śubhāstathaiva
naro'tra hi sthānagataḥ prabhuḥ syā detatphalaṃ siddhyati karmaṇo'sya
yadyaccharīreṇa karoti karma śarīrayuktaḥ samupāśnute tat
vācā tu yatkarma karoti kiṃci dvācaiva sarvaṃ samupāśnute tat
manastu yatkarma karoti kiṃci nmanaḥstha evāyamupāśnute tat
yathāyathā karmaguṇāṃ phalārthī karotyayaṃ karmaphale niviṣṭaḥ
matsyo yathā srota ivābhipātī tathā kṛtaṃ pūrvamupaiti karma
śubhe tvasau tuṣyati duṣkṛte tu na tuṣyate vai paramaḥ śarīrī
yato jagatsarvamidaṃ prasūtaṃ jñātvā''tmavanto hyupayānti śāntim
yanmantraśabderakṛtaprakāśaṃ taducyamānaṃ śaṇu me paraṃ yat
na strī pumānnāpi napuṃsakaṃ ca na sanna cāsatsadasacca tanna
paśyanti tadbrahmavido manuṣyā stadakṣaraṃ na kṣaratīti viddhi
ime śarīrairjalameva gatvā jalācca tejaḥ pavanāntarikṣam
khādvai nivartanti na bhāvinaste ye bhāvinaste paramāpnuvanti
noṣṇaṃ na śītaṃ mṛdu nāpi tīkṣṇaṃ nāmlaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ na tiktam
na śabdavannāpi ca gandhavatta nna rūpavattatparamasvabhāvam
sparśaṃ tanurveda rasaṃ ca jihvā ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhāñśravaṇe ca śabdān
rūpāṇi cakṣurnaca tatparaṃ ya dgṛhṇantyanadhyātmavido manuṣyāḥ
nivartayitvā rasanāṃ rasebhyo ghrāṇaṃ ca gandhācchravaṇe ca śabdāt
sparśāttanuṃ rūpaguṇāttu cakṣu stataḥ paraṃ paśyati tatsvabhāvam
yato gṛhītvā hi karoti yacca yasmiṃśca yāmārabhate pravṛttim
yasmai ca yadyena ca yaśca kartā yatkāraṇaṃ taṃ svamupeyamāhuḥ
yadvā'pyabhūdvyāpakaṃ sādhakaṃ ca yanmantravatsthāsyati cāpi loke
yaḥ sarvahetuḥ paramārthakārī tatkāraṇaṃ kāryamato yadanyat
yathā hi kaścitsukṛtairmanuṣyaḥ śubhāśubhaṃ prāpnute cāvirodhāt
yathā pradīptaḥ purataḥ pradīpaḥ prakāśamanyasya karoti dīpyan
yathā ca rājño bahavo hyamātyāḥ pṛthak pramāṇaṃ pravadanti yuktāḥ
tadvaccharīreṣu bhavanti pañca jñānaikadeśāḥ paramaḥ sa tebhyaḥ
yathārciṣo'gneḥ pavanasya vegā marīcayo'rkasya nadīṣu cāpaḥ
gacchanti cāyānti ca saṃyatāśca tadvaccharīrāṇi śarīriṇāṃ tu
yathā ca kaścitparaśuṃ gṛhītvā dhūmaṃ na paśyejjvalanaṃ ca kāṣṭhe
tadvaccharīrodarapāṇipādaṃ chittvā na paśyanti tato yadanya
tānyeva kāṣṭhāni yathā vimathya dhūmaṃ ca paśyejjvalanaṃ ca yogāt
tadvatsubuddhiḥ samamindriyārthai rbuddhaḥ paraṃ paśyati tatsvabhāvam
yathātmano'ṅgaṃ patitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ svapnāntare paśyati cātmano'nyat
śrotrādiyuktaḥ sumanāḥ subuddhi rliṅgāttathā gacchati liṅgamanyat
anena liṅgena tu liṅgamanya dgacchatyadṛṣṭaḥ pratisandhiyogāt
na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na cāpi saṃsparśamupaiti kiṃcit
na cāpi taiḥ sādhayate svakāryaṃ te taṃ na paśyanti sa paśyate tān
yathā samīpe jvalato'nalasya saṃtāpajaṃ rūpamupaiti kaścit
na cāntarā rūpaguṇaṃ bibharti tathaiva taddṛśyate rūpamasya
tathā manuṣyaḥ parimucya kāya madṛśyamanyadviśate śarīram
visṛjya bhūteṣu mahatsu dehaṃ tadāśrayaṃ caiva bibharti rūpam
khaṃ vāyumagniṃ salilaṃ tathorvī samantato'bhyāviśate śarīrī
śrotraṃ nabho ghrāṇamatho pṛthivyā stejomayaṃ rūpamatho vipākaḥ
jalāśrayaṃ teja uktaṃ rasaṃ ca vāyvātmakaḥ sparśakṛto guṇaśca
mahatsu bhūteṣu ca santi pañca pañcendriyārtheṣu tathendriyāṇi
sarvāṇi caitāni manonugāni buddhiṃ mano'nveti matiḥ svabhāvam
śubhāśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ yadasya tadeva pretyādadate'nyadehe
calaṃ yathā dṛṣṭipathaṃ paraiti sūkṣmaṃ mahadrūpamivāvabhāti
tātapyamāno na patecca dhīraḥ paraṃ tathā buddhipathaṃ paraiti
teṣvindriyeṣūpahateṣu paścā tsa buddhirūpaḥ paramaḥ svabhāvaḥ
yathākramaṃ saṃcarate sa vidvāṃ stasmātsa ekaḥ paramaḥ śarīrī
na tairnibaddhaḥ sa tu badhnāti viśvaṃ na cānuyātīhāguṇānparātmā tathendriyāṇyāviśate śarīrī hutāśanaṃ vāyurivendhanastham
na cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpamātmano na paśyati sparśanamindriyendriyam
na śrotraliṅgaṃ śravaṇena darśanaṃ tathā kṛtaṃ paśyati tadvinaśyati
yathā himavataḥ pārśve pṛṣṭhaṃ candramaso yathā
na dṛṣṭapūrvaṃ manujairna ca tannāsti tāvatā
paśyannapi yathā lakṣma janaḥ somena vindati
evamasti na cotpannaṃ na ca tanna parāyaṇam
gajānāṃ ca gajaireva jñeyaṃ jñānena gṛhyate
tathaiveha parā buddhiḥ paraṃ buddhyā na paśyati
na ca nāśo'sya bhavati tathā viddhi śarīriṇam
yathā kośāntaraṃ prāpya candramā bhrājate punaḥ
sā tu candramaso vyaktirna tu tasya śarīriṇaḥ
candra eva tvamāvāsyāṃ tathā bhavati mūrtimān
yathā vyaktamidaṃ śete svapne carati cetanam
yathā'mbhasi prasanne tu rūpaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā
sa eva lulite tasminyathā rūpaṃ na paśyati
sa dṛṣṭvaiva tu pūtātmā viṣayebhyo nivartate
antargatena pāpena dahyamānena cetasā śubhāśubhavikāreṇa na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate
indriyebhyo manaḥ pūrvaṃ buddhiḥ paratarā tataḥ
yastāṃstyajati śabdādīnsarvāśca vyaktayastathā prasṛtānīndriyāṇyeva pratisaṃharati kūrmavat
udyanhi savitā yadvatsṛjate raśmimaṇḍalam dṛśyate maṇḍalaṃ tasya na ca dṛśyeta maṇḍalī
grastaṃ hyudgirate nityamudgīthaṃ vetti nityaśaḥ bālye rathābhyāṃ yogena tatvajñānaṃ tu saṃmatam
sa evāstamupāgacchaṃstadevātmani yacchati ādatte sarvabhūtānāṃ rasabhūtaṃ vikāsavān
antarātmā tathā dehamāviśyendriyaraśmibhiḥ prāpyendri guṇānpañca so'stamāvṛttya gacchati
raśmimaṇḍa hīnastu na cāsau nāsti tāvatā
praṇītaṃ karmaṇā mārgaṃ nīyamānaḥ punaḥ punaḥ
tadā saṃpadyate brahma tatraiva pralayaṃ gatam
tasmātparatarā buddhirjñānaṃ tasmātparaṃ smṛtam tataḥ sūkṣmastato hyātmā tasmātparataraṃ na ca
parityajati yo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā'pyubhayaṃ naraḥ
abhyeti brahma sotyantaṃ na te śocanti paṇḍitāḥ
duḥkhamarthā hi yujyante pālane na ca te sukham
tadā prajñāyate brahma nikaṣaṃ nikaṣe yathā
guṇahīno hi taṃ mārgaṃ bahiḥ samanuvartate
tadā tatparamaṃ brahma saṃmuktaṃ prakṛteḥ param
nivartante nivṛttau ca svarge naivopayānti ca
yathāhi sāraṃ jānāti na kathaṃcana saṃsthitam
vinā kāyaṃ na sā cchāyā tāṃ vinā kāyamastyuta
idaṃ vai nāsti nedamasti paraṃ vinā
sarveṣāṃ na hi dṛśyo hi taṭidvatsphurati hyasau
brāhmaṇasya samādṛśyo vartate so'pi kiṃ punaḥ
śrutireṣā tato nityā tasmādekaḥ paro mataḥ
tādṛśostviti mantavyastathā satyaṃ mahātmanā nānāsaṃsthena bhedena sadā gativibhedavat
tasya bhedaḥ samākhyāto bhedo hyasti tathāvidhaḥ
sarvasādhāraṇaḥ sarvairupāsyaśca mahātmabhiḥ vāsudeveti vikhyātastaṃ viditvā'śnute'mṛtam
yadā te pañcabhiḥ pañca yuktāni manasā saha
tadeva ca yathā sūtraṃ suvarṇe vartate punaḥ
tadevamiṣyate brahma saṃkhyānādvinibhidyate jñānānāṃ ca phalānāṃ ca jñeyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ tathā
mahaddhi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ yuktāḥ paśyanti yoginaḥ
tadbrahma paramaṃ proktaṃ taddhāma paramaṃ padam
na yatnasādhyaṃ tadbrahma nādimadhyaṃ na cāntavan
na tena martyāḥ paśyanti yena gacchānta tatpadam
sūkṣmeṇa manasā vidmo vācā vaktuṃ na śaknumaḥ
mano hi manasā grāhyaṃ darśanena ca darśanam
guṇādāne viprayoge ca teṣāṃ manaḥ sadā viddhi parāvarābhyām
anenaiva vidhinā saṃpravṛtto guṇādāne brahma śarīrameti
sarvairayaṃ cendriyaiḥ saṃprayukto dehaṃ prāptaḥ yañcabhūtāśrayaḥ syāt
pṛthvyā naraḥ paśyati nāntamasyā hyantaścāsyā bhavitā ceti viddhi
paraṃ na yātīha vilobhyamāno yathā plavaṃ vāyurivārṇavastham
tathāṃ hyasau muniriha nirviśeṣavān sa nirguṇaṃ praviśati brahma cāvyayam
anāgataṃ sukṛtavatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ prabhavanidhānamavyayam
muniṃ nibandhanaṃ śuṣkaṃ dhamanīyākṛtiṃ tathā nirārambhaṃ nirālambamasajjantaṃ ca karmaṇi
uttiṣṭha mūḍha kiṃ śeṣe nirapekṣaḥ suhṛjjanaiḥ
nirālambo dhanopāye paitṛkaṃ tava kiṃ dhanam
tameva pitaraṃ gatvā dhanaṃ tiṣṭhati śāśvatam
sa tathā lambate tatra ūrdhvapādo hyadhaśśirāḥ
teṣāṃ madhūnāṃ bahudhā dhārā pravavṛte tadā
na tasya tṛṣṇā viratā pīyamānasya saṃkaṭe
parīpsati ca tāṃ nityamatṛptaḥ sa punaḥ punaḥ
evaṃ sa vasate tatra duḥkhiduḥkhī punaḥ punaḥ
mayā tu taddhanaṃ deyaṃ tava dāsyāmi cecchasi
tasya ca prārthitaḥ sotha datvā muktimavāpa saḥ
sā ca tyaktvā'rthasaṃkalpaṃ jagāma paramāṃ gatim
evaṃ saṃsāracakrasya svarūpaṃ viditaṃ na me
paitṛkaṃ tu dhanaṃ proktaṃ kiṃ tadvidvanmahātmanā
kāntāramiti kiṃ proktaṃ ko hastī sa tu kūpakaḥ
evaṃ me saṃśayaṃ viddhi dhanaśabdaṃ kimucyate
kathaṃ labdhaṃ dhanaṃ tena tathā ca kimidaṃ tviha
etaduktaṃ hi kāntāraṃ mahānsaṃsāra eva saḥ
ye te pratiṣṭhitā vyālā vyādhayaste prakīrtitāḥ
tāmāhuśca jarāṃ prājñāḥ pariṣvaktaṃ yayā jagat
yastatra kūpe vasate mahāhiḥ kāla eva saḥ
yo vṛkṣaḥ sa ca mṛtyurhi svakṛtaṃ tasya tatphalam
ye tu kṛṣṇāḥ sitā rājanmūṣikā rātryahāni vai
sa ca saṃvatsaraḥ proktaḥ pāśamāsartavo mukhāḥ
ekaḥ kartā sa kṛṣṇaśca jñānināṃ paramā gatiḥ
pradakṣiṇaṃ tu tāṃ kṛtvā vividhadhvanayastu tām
tataḥ sarveṇa viprarṣiḥ kanyāṃ papraccha tāṃ śubhām
na jāne tvāṃ mahādevi brūhi satyamanindite
sāvitrī nāma viprarṣe śṛṇu bhadraṃ tavāstu vai
kiṃ kariṣyāmi tadbrūhi tava yaccetasi sthitam
etaṃ me saṃśayaṃ devi vaktumarhasi śobhane
yastu vai prathamotpannaḥ ko'sau sa puruṣākṛtiḥ
tṛtīyaḥ sāmavedastu saṃśayo vyetu te mune
ṛṣe jñeyaṃ mayā cā'pītyuktvā cāntaradhīyata tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo nāradaḥ puruṣarṣabha
dhyānayuktaḥ sa tu ciraṃ na bubodha mahāmatiḥ
bhadramastu ṛṣe tubhyaṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata
yatte manasi suvyaktamasti ca pradadāmi tan
yaddṛṣṭaṃ mama rūpaṃ tu vedānāṃ śirasi tvayā
taṃ māṃ paśyanti satataṃ tānpṛccha yadihecchasi
ye yogino mahāprājñā madaṃśā ye vyavasthitāḥ
te yānti sāyujyamatīva durlabha mitīva nityaṃ hṛdi varṇayanti
keśavasya mayā rājanna śakyā varṇituṃ guṇāḥ īdṛśo'sau hṛṣīkeśo vāsudevaḥ parātparaḥ
vāyurjyotistathā cāpaḥ khaṃ ca gāṃ cānvakalpayat
sa sṛṣṭvā pṛthivīṃ caiva sarvabhūteśvaraḥ prabhuḥ
apsu vyomagataḥ śrīmānyoganidrāmupeyivān tasmātsaṃjajñire devā brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ
dadau dharmāya dharmajño dakṣa eva prajāpatiḥ
hartāraṃ sarva bhūtānāṃ sasarja ca janārdanaḥ
ahorātraṃ ca kālaṃ ca yathartu madhusūdanaḥ
na caiṣāṃ maithuno dharmo babhūva bharatarṣabha
ye tu kāmbhojagāndhārāḥ kirātā barvaraiḥ saha
sa eva bhagavāndevo veditvaṃ ca gatā mahī
akṣaraṃ tatparaṃ nityaṃ vairūpyaṃ jagato hareḥ
ya enaṃ prativartante vedāntāni ca sarvaśaḥ
sarvabhūteṣu bhūtātmā tattadbuddhiṃ samāsthitaḥ tasmādbuddhastvamevainaṃ dhyāhi nityamatandritaḥ
evaṃvidho'sau puruṣaḥ ko vainaṃ vetti sarvadā
ke carṣayo mahābhāgā dikṣu pratyekaśaḥ sthitāḥ
prajānāṃ patayo ye ca dikṣu ye carṣayaḥ smṛtāḥ
brahmaṇaḥ sapta vai putrā mahātmānaḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ
sapta brahmaṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ
tasya dve nāmanī loke dakṣaḥ ka iti cocyate
marīceḥ kaśyapaḥ putrastasya dve nāmanī smṛte
aryamā caiva bhagavānye cāsya tanayā vibho
putrāṇāṃ ca na te saṃcidicchantyanyaṃ prajāpatim
sa yogī yogamāpannastataḥ sāyucyatāṃ gataḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi devāṃstribhuvaneśvarān
savitā caiva ghātā ca vivasvāṃśca mahābalaḥ
sāvitraśca jayantaśca pinākī cāparājitaḥ ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ
pūrvameva mahābhāgā vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ eta evavidhā devā manoreva prajāpateḥ
te ca pūrvaṃ surāśceti dvividhāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
aśvinau tu smṛtau śūdrau tapasyugre samāsthitau smṛtāstvaṅgiraso devā brāhmaṇā iti niścayaḥ
yasyāṃyasyāṃ diśi hyete tāṃ diśaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
yaccāsya tejaḥ sumahadyacca karma purā kṛtam
tanme sarvaṃ yathātattvaṃ brūhi tvaṃ puruṣarṣabha
tataste madhuparkeṇa pūjāṃ cakruratho mayi pratigṛhya ca tāṃ pūjāṃ cakruratho mayi
na sahante sma devānāṃ samṛddhiṃ tāmanuttamām
niyutaṃ vatsarāṇāṃ tu vāyubhakṣo'bhavattadā hiraṇyākṣo mahāraudro lebhe devātpitāmahāt
gṛhītvā pṛthivī devī pātāle nyavasattadā tatastrailokyamakhilaṃ niroṣadhigaṇānvitam
na śakṣyāmo vayaṃ tatra praveṣṭuṃ jaladurgamam
śoṣite tu samudre ca devāḥ sarṣipurogamāḥ brahmāṇaṃ praṇipatyocurmuninā śoṣitaṃ jalam
iti bhūyaḥ samācakṣva kiṃ kariṣyāmahe vibho
te vareṇābhisaṃpannā balena ca madena ca nāvabuddhyanti saṃmūḍhā viṣṇumavyaktadarśanam
eṣa vegena gatvā hi yatra te dānavādhamāḥ antarbhūmigatā ghorā nivasanti sahasraśaḥ
dṛṣṭvā ca sahitāḥ sarve daityāḥ satvamamānuṣam
nāśaknuvaṃśca kiṃcitte tasya kartuṃ tadā vibho
sannāditā yena lokāḥ sarvāścaiva diśo daśa
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva tena nādena mohitam
tataste dānavāḥ sarve tena nādena bhīṣitāḥ
trastāṃśca devānālokya brahmā prāha pitāmahaḥ yogeśvaro'yaṃ bhagavānvārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ
tato harirmahātejā brahmāṇamabhinandya ca rasātalagataścāpi varāhastridaśadviṣām
nādena tena mahatā sanātana iti smṛtaḥ
nādo'yaṃ kīdṛśo deva netaṃ vidma vayaṃ prabho kosau hi kasya vā nādo yena vihvalitaṃ jagat
jaghāna ca hiraṇyākṣamantarbhūmigataṃ hariḥ tadākarṇya mahātejā brahmā madhuramabravīt
na saṃtāpo na bhīḥ kāryā śoko vā surasattamaiḥ
nārado māṃ purā prāha yāmahaṃ te vadāmi tām
devarṣirnāradaḥ pūrvaṃ tatvaṃ vetsyāmi vai hareḥ
iti saṃcintya manasā dadhyau brahma sanātanam

ahaṃ dadāmi te jñānaṃ dharmādyaṃ vā vṛṇīṣva mām
kastvaṃ bhavānaṇḍaṃ bibheda madhye samāsthito vākyamudīrayanmām

na māṃ mūḍhā vijānanti jñānino māṃ vidantyuta
bhavantaṃ jñātumicchāmi tava tatvaṃ bravīhi me
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradaṃ prāha lokapaḥ
jñānena māṃ vijānīhi nānyathā śaktirasti te
kīdṛgvidhaṃ tu tajjñānaṃ yena jānāmi te tanum
vikalpahīnaṃ vipulaṃ tasya cūraṃ śivaṃ param
jñānaṃ tattena jānāsi sādhanaṃ prati te mune
tvameva tava yattatvaṃ brūhi lokaguro mama
prāheśaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ na me cāsyaṃ śrutirna ca
na ghrāṇajihve dṛkcaiva tvacā nāsti tathā mune
tajjñātvā vismayāviṣṭo munirāha praṇamya tam yena tvaṃ pūrvamātmānamananto'haṃ bṛhattaraḥ
tvamenaṃ brūhi cātmānaṃ yadi śaknoṣi nārada
ātmā yathā tava mune viditastu bhaviṣyati māṃ ca jānāsi tena tvamekaṃ sādhanamāvayoḥ

enāṃ pṛcchāmi taruṇīṃ saiṣā nūnamuvāca mām
āścaryāsi ca dhanyāsi vṛhatī tvaṃ vasundhare
nāhaṃ hi bṛhatī vipra na cānantā ca sattama
kāraṇaṃ mama yo gandho gandhātmānaṃ bravīhi tam
kāraṇaṃ me jalaṃ matto bṛhattaratamaṃ hi tat
tato rasātma--munimāha punaḥ punaḥ mamāpi kāraṇaṃ pṛccha tejorūpaṃ vibhāvasum

kāraṇaṃ mama rūpaṃ yattaṃ pṛccha munisattama
tato yogakrameṇaiva pratītaṃ taṃ praviśya saḥ

śrutvā ca nāradoktaṃ tu devānāmīśvaraḥ svayam
ityukto nāradaḥ prāha prāñjaliḥ praṇataḥ sthitaḥ
yaḥ prabhuḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
brahmayonirhi viśvātmā sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
yaḥ purā pralaye prāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
ekastiṣṭhati viśvātmā sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
huyate ca punardvābhyāṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
parjanyaḥ pṛthivī sasyaṃ kālo dharmaḥ kriyākriye
yastejayati tejāṃsi sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu
na pradhāno na ca mahānpuruṣaścetano hyajaḥ
cintayanto hi yaṃ nityaṃ brahmeśānādayaḥ prabhum
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
agrāhyaṃ nirguṇaṃ nityaṃ tamasmi śaraṇaṃ gataḥ
somārkāgnimayaṃ tejo yā ca tāramayī dyutiḥ
divi saṃjāyate yo'yaṃ sa mahātmā prasīdatu
sūkṣmaḥ sarvagato yogī sa mahātmā prasīdatu
yaṃ viditvā vimucyante sa mahātmā prasīdatu
mahānguṇāṃśca yo bhuṅkte sa mahātmā prasīdatu
sūryamadhye sthitaḥ somastasya madhye ca yā sthitā
bhūtabāhyā ca yā dīptiḥ sa mahātmā prasīdatu
ye ca tvāṃ nābhijānanti saṃsāre saṃsaranti te
tvayi tāni ca teṣu tvaṃ na teṣu tvaṃ na te tvayi
samosi sarvabhūteṣu na te dveṣyosti na priyaḥ
samatvamabhikāṅkṣe'haṃ bhaktyā vai nānyacetasā carācaramidaṃ sarvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
tvayā tvayyeva tatprotaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
ahaṅkāreṇa buddhyā vā na te yogastribhirguṇaiḥ
na mokṣadharmo vā na tvaṃ nārambho janma vā punaḥ
pṛthivīṃ yātu gandho vai rasaṃ yātu jalaṃ tathā
tejo hutāśanaṃ yātu sparśo yātu ca mārutam
niṣkevalaṃ padaṃ tāta kāṅkṣe'haṃ paramaṃ tava
ekībhāvastvayā me'stu na me janma bhavetpunaḥ
pūrvadehakṛtā ye tu vyādhayaḥ praviśantu mām
ardayantu ca duḥkhāni ṛṇaṃ me pravimuñcatu
anudhyāto'si deveśa na me janma bhavetpunaḥ
tasmādbravīmi karmāṇi ṛṇaṃ me na bhavediti
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāsi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
tato buddheḥ paraṃ buddhvā labhate na punarbhavam
api pāpasamācāraḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
oṃ namo bhagavate tasmai dehināṃ paramātmane
jvalannagniṃ smaredyo māṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
kiṃ punarye yajante māṃ sādhakā vidhipūrvakam
karmāṇyādyantavantīha madbhakto'mṛtamaśnute māmeva tasmāddevarṣe dhyāhi nityamatandritaḥ
avāpsyasi tataḥ siddhiṃ drakṣyasyeva padaṃ mama

evaṃ dattvā naraśreṣṭha śreyo vīryaṃ ca vindati
evaṃ pṛṣṭaḥ purā tena nāradena surarṣiṇā
yaduvāca tadā'sau bho taduktaṃ tava suvrata
idaṃ japanvai prāpnoti tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam
imāṃ rahasyāṃ paramāmanusmṛti madhītya buddhiṃ labhate ca naiṣṭhikīm
vihāya duḥkhānyavamucya saṅkaṭā tsa vītarāgo vigatajvaraḥ sukhī
etanme sarvamācakṣva na me tṛptirhi tatvataḥ
kārito'haṃ tvayā rājanyadṝttaṃ ca purā mama
purāhaṃ tapa āsthāya vāsudevaparāyaṇaḥ dhyāyanstuvannamasyaṃśca yajamānastamevaca
mātā ca mama tā devī jananī lokapāvanī
tasminkāle'dbhutaḥ śrīmānsarvavedamayaḥ prabhuḥ suparṇaḥ patatāṃśreṣṭho merumandarasannibhaḥ
tataḥ kathāntare taṃ vai vacanaṃ cedamavravam
nārāyaṇaṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ sahamāno'niśaṃ harim jānāsi taṃ yathā vaktuṃ yādṛgbhūto janārdanaḥ
śṛṇu bhīṣma yathānyāyaṃ purā tvamiha sattamāḥ
pakṣīndra vāsudevasya tatvaṃ vetsi paraṃ padam
svasā sayo na tasyāsti sannikṛṣṭapriyopi ca
abravaṃ ca yathāvṛttaṃ mama nārāyaṇasya ca
ākāśe patamānastu vākyaṃ tatra śṛṇomi vai
ityāha sma dhruvaṃ tatra māmāha bhagavānpunaḥ

asūyati ca māṃ mūḍha tacchrutvā garvamāsthitaḥ
ahaṃ devanikāyānāṃ madhye vacanamabravam ṛṣe pūrvaṃ varaṃ mattastvaṃ vṛṇīṣva tato hyaham

jetukāmo hyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ māyayā māyinaṃ harim

nāhaṃ dvijā vijānāmi kva hi gacchāma saṃgatāḥ

sanaddhāma dvijā gatvā pṛcchadhvaṃ sa ca vakṣyati
athāhedaṃ taṃ bhagavānsanantaṃ mahāmune viddhi māṃ paṇḍito'si
ṛṣiṃ purāṇaṃ satataikarūpaṃ yamakṣayaṃ vedavido vadanti
punastamāhedamasau mahātmā svarūpasaṃsthaṃ vada āha pārtha
athāha gambhīratarānuvādaṃ vākyaṃ mahātmā hyaśarīra ādiḥ
na te mune śrotramukhe'pi cāsyaṃ na pādahastau prapadātmake na
ṛṣe kathaṃ vākyamidaṃ bravīṣi na cāsya mantā na ca vidyate cet
āgatānbhagavānāha jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣaḥ jñātaṃ mayā munigaṇā vākyaṃ tadaśarīriṇaḥ
kathaṃ vayaṃ jñānanidhiṃ vareṇyaṃ yakṣyāmahe viśvarūpaṃ kumāra
prasīda no bhagavañjñānaleśaṃ madhuprayātāya sukhāya santaḥ
yattatpadaṃ viśvarūpaṃ mahāmune tatra brūhi kiṃ tatra mahānubhāva
aneka sāhasrakaleṣu caiva prasannadhātuṃ ca śubhājñayā sat

śṛṇudhvaṃ paramaṃ kāraṇamasti kathamavagamyate ahanyahani pākaviśeṣo dṛśyate tena miśraṃ sarvaṃ miśrayate yathā maṇḍalī dṛśi sarveṣāmasti nidarśanam asti cakṣuṣmatāmasti jñāne svarūpaṃ paśyati yathā darpaṇāntaṃ nidarśanam
sa eva sarvaṃ vidvānna bibheti na gacchati kutrāhaṃ kasya nāhaṃ kena kenetyavartamāno vijānāti
sa yugato vyāpī sa pṛthaksthitaḥ tadaparamārthaḥ
yathā vāyurekaḥ sanbahudheritaḥ āśrayaviśeṣo vā yasyāśrayaṃ yathāvaddvije mṛge vyāghre ca manuje veṇuṃsaśrayo bhidyate vāyurathaikaḥ ātmā tathā'sau paramātmā'sāvanya iva bhāti
evamātmā sa eva gacchati sarvamātmā paśyañśṛṇoti na ca ghrāti na bhāṣate
cakre'sya taṃ mahātmānaṃ parito daśa raśmayaḥ
tāvubhau na ravau cāstāṃ tathā vitta śarīriṇam
patite vitta viprendraṃ bhakṣaṇe caraṇe paraḥ
saṃcitaṃ saṃcitaṃ pūrvaṃ bhramaro vartate bhramam
yo'bhimānīva jānāti na muhyati na hīyate
na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścanainaṃ hṛdā manīṣā paśyati rupamasya
na śuklaṃ na kṛṣṇaṃ paramārthabhāvaṃ guhāśayaṃ jñānadevīkarastham
brāhmaṇasya na sādṛśye vartate so'pi kiṃ punaḥ
naiva dharmī na cādhamīṃ dvandvātīto vimatsaraḥ
jñānatṛptaḥ sukhaṃ śete hyamṛtātmā na saṃśayaḥ
na jānāti vimūḍhātmā kāraṇaṃ cātmano hyasau
dhyātā draṣṭā tathā mantā boddhā dṛṣṭānsa eva saḥ ko vidvānparamātmānamanantaṃ lokabhāvanam
yattu śakyaṃ mayā proktaṃ gacchadhvaṃ munipuṅgavāḥ
purāṇapuṃsā ṛṣiṇā mahātmanā mahāmunīnāṃ pravareṇa tadbhuvam
yadidaṃ tapa ityāhuḥ kiṃ tapaḥ saṃprakīrtitam upavāsamathānyattu vedācāramatho nu kim
śāstraṃ tapo mahāprājña tanme brūhi pitāmaha
pakṣamāsopavāsādīnmanyante vai tapodhanāḥ vedavratādīni tapa apare vedapāragāḥ
ṛtugāmī tathā prokto vighasāśī smṛto budhaiḥ
bhṛtyaśeṣaṃ tu yo bhuṅkte yajñaśeṣaṃ tathā'mṛtam
keṣāṃ lokā hyaparyantāḥ sarve satyavrate sthitāḥ ye'pi karmamayaṃ prāhuste dvijā brāhmaṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
anyāni ca sahasrāṇi nāmāni vividhāni ca
dṛḍhaṃ sarvaṃ prākṛtakabhidaṃ sarvatra paśya vai
hetunā kena jātā sā nirdvandvā naṣṭasaṃśayā
andhāya māṃ mahāprājña dehi vīkṣya sulocanam
na śakyaṃ prārthituṃ vatse tvayā'dya pratibhāti me andhatā'nandhatā ceti vicāro mama jāyate
viddhi vaitādṛśaṃ loke sa māṃ bhajati vedavit
yānyāṃstvaṃ manyase dātuṃ māṃ dvijottama tāniha
tatheti coktvā tāṃ vipraḥ preṣayāmāsa śiṣyakān ṛṣeḥ prabhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā te kanyāyāśca dvijottamāḥ
yadīcchasi varaṃ bhadre taṃ vipraṃ varaya svayam
yadyasti saṃmato vipro hyandho'nandhaḥ sa me varaḥ
sohaṃ bhadre samāvṛttastvayokto yaḥ purā dvijaḥ
śabde sparśe tathā rūpe rase gandhe sahetukam na me pravartate ceto na pratyakṣaṃ hi teṣu me
yena paśyati suśroṇi bhāṣate spṛśate punaḥ
bhujyate ghrāyate nityaṃ śṛṇoti manute tathā
taccakṣurvidyate mahyaṃ yena paśyati vai sphuṭam sulocano'haṃ bhadre vai pṛccha vā kiṃ vadāmi te
sā viśuddhā tato bhūtvā śvetaketuṃ mahāmunim
praṇamya pūjayāmāsa tāṃ bhāryāṃ sa ca labdhavān
yadidaṃ karma loke'smiñśubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
kartā svittasya puruṣa utāho neti saṃśayaḥ
kāñcane vā'tha loṣṭhe vā ubhayoḥ samadarśanam
bhaktaṃ bhāgavataṃ nityaṃ nārāyaṇaparāyaṇam dhyāyantaṃ paramātmānaṃ hiraṇyakaśipoḥ sutam
yaiḥ kaiścitsaṃmato loke guṇaiḥ syātpuruṣo nṛṣu
atha te lakṣyate buddhiḥ samā bālajanairiha
śriyā vihīnaḥ prahlāda śocitavye na śocasi
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo na budhyate
sa vai pāti jagatsraṣṭā viṣṇurityabhiśabditaḥ punardarśati saṃprāpte------sureścaraḥ
sarve bhāvāstathā bhāvāḥ puruṣārtho na vidyate
svayaṃ ca kurvatastasya jātu māno bhavediha
tasya doṣavatī prajñā atattvajñeti me matiḥ
ātmapratiṣṭhā prajñā vā mama nāsti tato'nyathā
vikārāneva yo veda na veda prakṛtiṃ parām
buddhyamānasya darpo vā māno vā kiṃ kariṣyati
prakṛtau ca vikāre ca na me prītirna ca dviṣe
dveṣṭāraṃ ca na paśyāmi yo mamādya virudhyati
na hi jñeye na vijñāne nājñāne vidyate'ntaram
karoti sadbhiḥ saṃsargamalaṃ santaḥ sukhāya vai
vācake vā'pi ca sthānaṃ na hantyeva vimocitaḥ
sārkṣye cāsya ratirnityaṃ saṃsāre ca ratirbhavet
āśaucaṃ vardhate nityaṃ na śāmyati kathaṃcana
na śāstrāṇi śṛṇotyeva mānadarpasamanvitaḥ svataḥsiddhaṃ na bhogastaṃ svataḥ siddhaṃ na vetti ca
nānāyonigatastena bhrāmyamāṇaḥ svakarmabhiḥ tīrṇapāraṃ na jānāti mahāmohasamanvitaḥ
tadabhāve tu śokādyā na vartante sureśvara
jñānena paśyate karma jñānināṃ na pravartakam
tadante taṃ prayātyeva na vidvāniti me matiḥ
tenatena ca bhāvena apāyaṃ tatra paśyati
trayyantavidbhiḥ parigīyate'sau viṣṇurvibhurvāsti guṇo na nityam
varṇeṣu lokeṣu viśeṣaṇeṣu sa vāsudevo vasanānmahātmā ṭa
guṇānurūpaṃ sa ca karmarūpaṃ dadāti sarvasya samastarūpam na saṃdṛśe tiṣṭhati rupamasya na cakṣuṣā paśyati kaścidenam
bhaktyā ca dhṛtyā ca samāhitātmā jñānasvarūpaṃ paripaśyatīha
vadanti tanme bhagavāndadau sa sa eva śeṣaṃ maghavānmahātmā
evaṃ mamopāyamavaihi śakra tasmālloko nāsti mahyaṃ sadaiva
yasya sma dadato vittaṃ na kadācana hīyate
taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim
sa vāyurvaruṇaścaiva sa raviḥ sa ca candramāḥ
so'gnistapati bhūtāni jalaṃ ca sa bhavatyuta
taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim
sa eva hyastamayate sa sma vidyotate diśaḥ
taṃ baliṃ nādhigacchāmi brahmannācakṣva me balim
uṣṭreṣu yadi vā goṣu khareṣvaśveṣu vā punaḥ
hanyāmenaṃ na vā hanyāṃ tadbrahmannanuśādhi mām
mā sma śakra baliṃ hiṃsīrna balirvadhamarhati
tato dadarśa sa baliṃ kharaveṣeṇa saṃvṛtam
idaṃ te yonirasamā śocasyāho na śocasi
idaṃ ca te'dya vyasanaṃ śocasyāho na śocasi
na te paśyāmi bhṛṅgāraṃ na cchatraṃ vyajanaṃ na ca
brahmadattāṃ ca te mālāṃ na paśyāmyasurādhipa
aho hi tava bāliśyamiha devagaṇādhipa ayuktaṃ devarājasya tava kaṣṭamidaṃ vacaḥ
na tvaṃ paśyasi bhṛṅgāraṃ na cchannaṃ vyajanaṃ na ca
brahmadattāṃ ca me mālāṃ na tvaṃ drakṣyasi vāsava
guhāyāṃ nihitāni tvaṃ mama ratnāni pṛcchasi
yadā me bhavitā kālastadā tvaṃ tāni drakṣyasi
na jānīṣe bhavānsiddhiṃ śubhāṅgasvarūparūpiṇīm kālena bhavitā sarvo nātra gacchati vāsava
na tvetadanurūpaṃ te yaśaso vā kulasya ca
na hi duḥkheṣu śocante na prahṛṣyanti carddhiṣu
tvaṃ tu prākṛtayā buddhyā puraṃdara vikatthase
aiśvaryamadamatto māṃ sa tvaṃ kiṃcinna buddhyase rājyādvinipatānena sohaṃ na tvaparājitaḥ
garvaṃ hitvā tathā mānaṃ devarāja śṛṇuṣva me
antavanta ime dehā bhūtānāṃ ca surādhipa
tena śakra na śocāmi nāparādhādidaṃ mama
jīvitaṃ ca śarīraṃ ca jātyā vai saha jāyate
ubhe saha vivardhete ubhe saha vinaśyataḥ
te kṛcchraṃ prāpya sīdanti buddhiryeṣāṃ praṇaśyati
tatastu ye nivartante jāyante vā punaḥ punaḥ
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ phalaṃ caiva na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye
hataṃ hanti hato hyeva yo naro hanti kaṃcana
ubhau tau na vijānīto yaśca hanti hataśca yaḥ
akartā hyeva bhavati kartā hyeva karoti tat
kṛtaṃ hi tatkṛtenaiva kartā tasyāpi cāparaḥ
sarvaṃ kālaḥ samādatte gambhīraḥ svena tejasā
tasminkālavaśaṃ prāpte kā vyathā me vijānataḥ
nāsya dvīpaḥ kutaḥ pāro nāvāraḥ saṃpradṛśyate
yadi me paśyataḥ kālo bhūtāni na vināśayet
tuṣabhakṣaṃ tu māṃ jñātvā praviviktajane gṛhe
kālaḥ sarvaṃ samādatte kālaḥ sarvaṃ prayacchati
kālena vihitaṃ sarvaṃ mā kṛthāḥ śakra pauruṣam
purā sarvaṃ pravyathitaṃ mayi kruddhe puraṃdara vidravanti tvayā sārdhaṃ sarva eva dibaukasaḥ
avaimi tvasya lokasya karmaṃ śakra sanātanam
prabhavaśca prabhāvaśca nātmasaṃsthaḥ kadācana kaumārameva te cittaṃ tathaivādya yathā purā
āsansarve mama vaśe tatsarvaṃ vettha vāsava
evaṃ me niścitā buddhiḥ śāstustiṣṭhāmyahaṃ vaśe
dṛśyate hi kule jāto darśanīyaḥ pratāpavān
alakṣaṇā virūpā ca subhagā dṛśyate parā
na karma tava nānyeṣāṃ kuto mama śatakrato
evaṃ naiva na cetkālo māmākramya sthito bhavet
kālaḥ sthāpayate sarvaṃ kālaḥ pacati vai tathā
nāhaṃ kartā na caiva tvaṃ nānyaḥ kartā śacīpate
paryāyeṇa hi bhujyante lokāḥ śakra yadṛcchayā
āhuḥ sarvamidaṃ cintyaṃ janāḥ kecinmanīṣayā anityapañcavarṣāṇi ṣaṣṭho dṛśyati dehinām
asyāḥ pañcaiva cintāyāḥ paryeṣyāmi ca pañcadhā tatastāni na paśyāmi kāle tamapi vṛtrahan
yamindriyāṇi sarvāṇi nānupaśyanti pañcadhā taṃ kālamiti jānīhi yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe
yo dhāvatā na hātavyastiṣṭhannapi na hīyate
taṃ kālamiti jānīhi yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe
ya idaṃ sarvamādatte tasmācchakra sthiro bhava
mayā tvayā ca pūrvaiśca na sa śakyo'tivartitum
sthitā mayīti tanmithyā naiṣā hyekatra tiṣṭhati
maivaṃ śakra punaḥ kārṣīḥ śānto bhavitumarhasi tvāmapyevaṃvidhaṃ jñātvā kṣipramanyaṃ gamiṣyati
kālena coditā śakra mā te garvaḥ śatakrato
sarvāsurāṇāmadhipaḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ jitavānbrahmaṇo lokaṃ ko vidyādāgataṃ gatim
na hīmāmāsurīṃ vedmi na daivīṃ ca na mānuṣīm
tvamenāṃ pṛccha vā mā vā yatheṣṭaṃ kuru vāsava
kā tvaṃ tiṣṭhasi māmevaṃ dīpyamānā svatejasā
na māṃ virocano veda nāyaṃ vairocano baliḥ
āhurmāṃ duḥsahetyevaṃ vidhitseti ca māṃ viduḥ
tvaṃ māṃ śakra na jānīṣe sarve devā na māṃ viduḥ
kimidaṃ tvaṃ mama kṛte utāho balinaḥ kṛte
no dhātā na vidhātā māṃ vidadhāti kathaṃcana
kathaṃ tvayā balistyaktaḥ kimarthaṃ vā śikhaṇḍini
kathaṃ ca māṃ na jahyāstvaṃ tanme brūhi śucismite
satye sthitā'smi dāne ca vrate tapasi caiva hi
parākrame ca dharme ca parācīnastato baliḥ
yajñaśīlaḥ sadā bhūtvā māmeva yajate svayam
apakrāntā tataḥ śakra tvayi vatsyāmi vāsava
naiva devo na gandharvo nāsuro naṃ ca nrākṣasaḥ
tiṣṭhethā mayi nityaṃ tvaṃ yathā tadbrūhi me śubhe
sthāsyāmi nityaṃ devendra yathā tvayi nibodha tat
ahaṃ vai tvāṃ nidhāsyāmi yathāśakti yathābalam
na tu me'tikramaḥ syādvai sadā lakṣmi tavāntike
sā te pādaṃ titikṣeta samarthā hīti me matiḥ
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ bhūmau pratiṣṭhitaḥ
dvitīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamapsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ
tṛtīyaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yamagnau pratiṣṭhitaḥ
caturthaṃ śakra pādaṃ me tasmātsunihitaṃ kuru
ye vai santo manuṣyeṣu brahmaṇyāḥ satyavādinaḥ
eṣa me nihitaḥ pādo yo'yaṃ satsu pratiṣṭhitaḥ
evaṃ hi nihitāṃ śakra bhūteṣu paridhatsva mām
bhūmiśuddhiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā adbhiḥ saṃtarpayanti ye
ye kriyābhiḥ suraktābhirhetuyuktāḥ samāhitāḥ jñānavanto vivatsāyāṃ labdhā mādyanti yoginaḥ
bhūtānāmiha yo vai tvāṃ mayā vinihitāṃ satīm
upahanyātsa me dveṣyastathā śṛṇvantu me vacaḥ
tatheti coktvā sā bhraṣṭā sarvalokanamaskṛtā vāsavaṃ pālayāmāsa sā devī kamalālayā
tathā madhyaṃdine sūryo nāstameti yadā tadā
tadā devāsure yuddhe jetā'haṃ tvāṃ śatakrato
tena te'haṃ bale vajraṃ na vimuñjāmi mūrdhani
yatheṣṭaṃ gaccha daityendra svasti te'stu mahāsura
ajasraṃ pariyātyeṣa satyenāvatapanprajāḥ ayanaṃ tasya ṣaṇmāsā uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ tathā
vyasaneṣu nimagnasya kiṃ śreyastadbravīhi me bhūya eva mahābāho sthityarthaṃ taṃ bravīhi me
śriyā vihīno namuce śocasyāho na śocasi
anavāpyaṃ ca śokena śarīraṃ copaśuṣyati amitrāśca prahṛṣyanti śoke nāsti sahāyatā
yathāyathā hi puruṣaḥ kalyāṇe kurute manaḥ
ekaḥ śāstā na dvitīyo'sti śāstā garbhe śayānaṃ puruṣaṃ śāsti śāstā
tenānuyuktaḥ pravaṇādivodakaṃ yathā niyukto'smi tathā bhavāmi
bhāvābhāvāvajinānangarīyo jānāmi śreyo na tu tatkaromi
āśāsu harmyāsu hṛdāsu kurvan yathā niyukto'smi tathā vahāmi
yatrayatraiva saṃyukto dhātrā garbhe punaḥ punaḥ
iti yasya sadā bhāvo na sa śocetkadācana
ṛṣīṃśca devāṃśca mahāsurāṃśca traividyavṛddhāṃśca vane munīṃśca
kā nāpado nopanamanti loke parāvarajñāstu na saṃbhramanti
na paṇḍitaḥ kruddhyati nābhiṣajyate na cāpi saṃsīdati na prahṛṣyati
na cārthakṛcchravyasaneṣu śocate sthitaḥ prakṛtyā himavānivācalaḥ
yamarthasiddhiḥ paramā na harṣaye ttathaiva kāle vyasanaṃ na mohayet
sukhaṃ ca duḥkhaṃ ca tathaiva madhyamaṃ niṣevate yaḥ sa dhuradharo naraḥ
evaṃ pravṛddhaṃ praṇudanmanojaṃ saṃtāpanīlaṃ sakalaṃ śarīrāt
na tatsadaḥ satpariṣatsabhā ca sā prāpya yāṃ na kurute sadā bhayam
dharmatattvamavagāhya buddhimā nyo'bhyupaiti sa dhuraṃdharaḥ pumān
prājñasya karmāṇi duranvayāni na vai prājño muhyati mohakāle
sthānāccyutaścenna mumoha gautama stāvatkṛcchrāmāpadaṃ prāpya vṛddhaḥ
na mantrabalavīryeṇa prajñayā pauruṣeṇa ca [na śīlena na vṛttena tathā naivārthasaṃpadā ]
prāptavyānyeva cāpnoti duḥkhāni ca sukhāni ca
etadviditvā kārtsnyena yo na muhyati mānavaḥ
kuśalī sarvaduḥkheṣu sa vai sarvadhanī naraḥ
magnasya vyasane kṛcchre kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣasya hi
tvaṃ hi naḥ paramo vaktā loke'sminbharatarṣabha
putradāraiḥ sukhaiścaiva viyaktasya dhanena ca magnasya vyasane kṛcchre dhṛtiḥ śreyaskarī nṛpa
dhairyeṇa yuktasya sataḥ śarīraṃ na viśīryate
[viśokatā sukhaṃ dhatte dhatte cārogyamuttamam ] ārogyācca śarīrasya sa punarvindate śriyam
tasyaiśvaryaṃ ca dhairyaṃ ca vyavasāyaśca karmasu
caturdantaṃ sudāntaṃ ca vāraṇendraṃ śriyā vṛtam
surendramindraṃ daityendro na śuśoca na vivyathe
īśvaro hi purā bhūtvā pitṛpaitāmahe pade
tattvamadya hṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā sapatnaiḥ kiṃ na śocasi
nigṛhīte mayi bhṛśaṃ śakra kiṃ katthitena te
hastaprāptasya vīrasya taṃ caiva puruṣaṃ viduḥ
mā ca te bhūtsvabhāvo'yaṃ mayi dānavapuṅgave
ahamāsaṃ yathā'dya tvaṃ bhavitā tvaṃ yathā vayam
paryāyeṇāsi śakratvaṃ prāptaḥ śakra na karmaṇā
kālaḥ kāle nayati māṃ tvāṃ ca kālo nayatyayam
tenāhaṃ tvaṃ yathā nādya tvaṃ cāpi na yathā vayam
na vidyā na tapo dānaṃ na mitrāṇi na bāndhavāḥ
idaṃ tu duḥkhaṃ yacchakra kartā'hamiti manyase
yadi kartā bhavetkartā na kriyeta kadācana
gantā gatimatāṃ kālaḥ kālaḥ kalayati prajāḥ
kathaṃ kālaparītasya mama vā madvidhasya vā
ahaṃ ca tvaṃ ca ye cānye bhaviṣyanti surādhipāḥ
