na vyājahāra tasthau ca prahvā bhagavadunmukhī
sā tatra paramaṃ devī tapo'carata duścaram
samā hyekapade tasthau daśapadmāni pañca ca
tāṃ tathā kurvatīṃ tatra tapaḥ paramaduścaram
kuruṣva me vaco mṛtyo tadanādṛtya satvarā
tasthau padmāni ṣaṭ caiva pañca dve caiva mānada
bhūyaḥ padmāyutaṃ tāta mṛgaiḥ saha cacāra sā
apsu varṣasahasrāṇi sapta caikaṃ ca pārthiva
tato jagāma sā kanyā kauśikīṃ nṛpasattama
tato yayau mahābhāgā gaṅgāṃ meruṃ ca kevalam
tato himavato mūrdhniṃ yatra devāḥ samījire
kimidaṃ vartase putri kriyatāṃ mama tadvacaḥ
na hareyaṃ prajā deva punastvā'haṃ prasādaye
adharmo nāsti te mṛtyo saṃyacchemāḥ prajāḥ śubhe
mayā'pyuktaṃ mṛṣā bhadre bhavitā neha kiṃcana
ahaṃ ca vibudhāścaiva tvaddhite niratāḥ sadā
imanyaṃ ca te kāmaṃ dadāni manasepsitam
na tvāṃ doṣeṇa yāsyanti vyādhisaṃpīḍitāḥ prajāḥ
adharmaste na bhavitā yathā dhyāsyāmyahaṃ śubhe
tvaṃ hi śaktā ca yuktā ca pūrvotpannā ca bhāmini
anuśiṣṭā ca nirdoṣā tasmāttvaṃ kuru me matam
te vyādhayo mānavānghorarūpāḥ prāpte kāle pīḍayiṣyanti mṛtyo
sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ prāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau sahitau yojayethāḥ
evaṃ dharmastvāmupaiṣyatyamogho na cādharmaṃ lapsyase tulyavṛttiḥ
evaṃ dharmaṃ pālayiṣyasyatho tvaṃ na cātmānaṃ mañjayiṣyasyadharme
tasmātkāmaṃ rocayābhyāgataṃ tvaṃ sā tvaṃ sādho saṃharasveha jantūn
sā vai tadā mṛtyusaṃjñā kṛtāstrī śāpādbhītā bāḍhamityabravīttam
atho prāṇānprāṇināmantakāle kāmakrodhau prāpya nityaṃ nihanti
mṛtyorye te vyādhayaścāścupātā manuṣyāṇāṃ yujyate yaiḥ śarīram
sarveṣāṃ vai prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte tasmācchokaṃ mā kṛthā buddhya buddhyā
sarve devāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇanānte gatvā vṛttāḥ sannivṛttāstathaiva
evaṃ sarve mānavāḥ prāṇanānte gatvā vṛttā devavadrājasiṃha
vāyurbhīmo bhīmanādo mahaujāḥ sarveṣāṃ ca prāṇināṃ prāṇabhūtaḥ
sarve devā martyasaṃjñāviśiṣṭāḥ sarve martyā devasaṃjñāviśiṣṭāḥ
tasmātputraṃ mā śuco rājasiṃha putraḥ svargaṃ prāpyate modate he
evaṃ mṛtyurdevasṛṣṭā prajānāṃ prāpte kāle saṃharantī yathāvat
tasyāścaiva vyādhayaste'śrupātāḥ prāpte kāle saṃharantīha jantūn
ime vai mānasāḥ sarve dharmaṃ prati viśaṅkitāḥ
ko'yaṃ dharmaḥ kuto dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha
ubhayārtho hi vā dharmastanme brūhi pitāmaha
ubhayatra sukhodarka iha caiva paratra ca
alabdhvā nipuṇaṃ dharmaṃ pāpaḥ pāpe prasajjati
na ca pāpakṛtaḥ pāpānmucyante kecidāpadi apāpavādī bhavati yathā bhavati dharmavit
tadā teṣāṃ spṛhayate ye vai tuṣṭāḥ svakairdhanaiḥ
satyasya vacanaṃ sādhu na satyādvidyate param
satyena vidhṛtaṃ sarvaṃ sarvaṃ satye pratiṣṭhitam
api pāpakṛto raudrāḥ satyaṃ kṛtvā mithaḥkṛtam
na hyatyantaṃ balayutā bhavanti sukhinopi vā
asādhubhyo'sya na bhayaṃ na caurebhyo na rājataḥ
yo'nyasya syādupapatiḥ sa kaṃ kiṃ vaktumarhati
yadanyasya tataḥ kuryānna mṛṣyediti me matiḥ
jīvituṃ yaḥ svayaṃ cecchetkathaṃ so'nyaṃ praghātayet
bhūyāṃso hṛdaye ye me praśnāste vyāhṛtāstvayā
na dharmaḥ paripāṭhena śakyo bhārata veditum
anye kaliyuge dharmā yathāśakti kṛtā iva
te cetsarvapramāṇaṃ vai pramāṇaṃ hyatra vidyate
yadā vikriyate saṃsthā tataḥ sā'pi praṇaśyati
vidmaścainaṃ na vā vidmaḥ śakyaṃ vā vedituṃ na vā
nipānānīva gobhyāśe kṣetre kulye ca bhārata
smṛto hi śāśvato dharmo viprahīṇo na dṛśyate
apsu vaihāyasaṃ gacchenmayā yo'nyaḥ saheti vai
abruvaṃśca piśācāstaṃ naivaṃ tvaṃ vaktumarhasi tulādhāro vaṇigdharmā vārāṇasyāṃ mahāyaśāḥ
so'pyevaṃ nārhate vaktuṃ yathā tvaṃ dvijasattama
kiṃ kṛtaṃ duṣkaraṃ tāta karma jājalinā purā
atīva tapasā yukto ghoreṇa sa babhūva ha
tasthau kāṣṭhavadavyagro na cacāla ca karhicit
yadā na sa calatyeva sthāṇubhūto mahātapāḥ
buddhvā ca sa mahātejā na cacāla ca jājaliḥ
dharme kṛtamanā nityaṃ nādharmaṃ sa tvarocayat
vyavardhanta ca tatraiva na cākampata jājaliḥ
tathā te divasaṃ cāpi gatvā sāyaṃ punarnṛpa
siddhosmīti matiṃ cakre tatastaṃ māna āviśat
dharmeṇa na samastvaṃ vai tulādhārasya jājale
so'pyevaṃ nārhate vaktuṃ yathā tvaṃ bhāṣase dvija
vikrīṇantaṃ ca paṇyāni tulādhāraṃ dadarśa saḥ
na ca dharmasya saṃjñāṃ tvaṃ purā vettha kathaṃcana
tataḥ siddhasya tapasā tava vipra śakuntakāḥ
jātapakṣā yadā te ca gatā saṃcarituṃ tataḥ manyamānastato dharmaṃ caṭakaprabhavaṃ dvija
karavāṇi priyaṃ kiṃ te tadbrūhi dvijasattama
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena tulādhāreṇa dhīmatā
sarvabhūtahitaṃ maitraṃ purāṇaṃ yaṃ janā viduḥ
yā vṛttiḥ sa paro dharmastena jīvāmi jājale
sarveṣāṃ yaḥ suhṛnnityaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca hite rataḥ
karmaṇā manasā vācā sa dharmaṃ veda jājale
nānurudhye virudhye vā na dveṣmi na ca kāmaye samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu paśya me jājale vratam
tulā me sarvabhūteṣu samā tiṣṭhati jājale
nāhaṃ pareṣāṃ kṛtyāni praśaṃsāmi na garhaye
kṛpā me sarvabhūteṣu samā tiṣṭhati jājale iṣṭāniṣṭaniyuktasya priyadveṣau bahiṣkṛtau
iti māṃ tvaṃ vijānīhi sarvalokasya jājale
yadā cāyaṃ na bibheti yadā cāsmānna bibhyati
yadā necchati na dveṣṭi tadā siddhyati vai dvija
yadā na kurute bhāvaṃ sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma saṃpadyate tadā
na bhūto na bhaviṣyo'sti na ca dharmosti kaścana
abhayaṃ sarvabhūtebhyaḥ sa prāpnoti sadā mune
na bhūtānāmahiṃsāyā jyāyāndharmo'sti kaścana yasmānnodvijate bhūtaṃ jātu kiṃcitkathaṃcana
na sa dharmamavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca
bravīmi te satyamidaṃ śraddhatsva mama jājale
sa eva subhago bhūtvā punarbhavati durbhagaḥ
vyāpattiṃ karmaṇāṃ dṛṣṭvā jugupsanti janāḥ sadā
akāraṇo hi naivāsti dharmaḥ sūkṣmo hi jājale
ye ca cchindanti vṛṣaṇānye ca bhindanti nastakān vahanti mahato bhārānbadhnanti damayanti ca
hatvā satvāni khādanti tānkathaṃ na vigarhase
tāni jīvāni vikrīya kā mṛteṣu vicāraṇā
kā taile kā dhṛte brahmanmadhunyapsvoṣadhīṣu vā
na manye bhrūṇahatyā'pi viśiṣṭā tena karmaṇā
kṛpiṃ sādhviti manyante sā ca vṛttiḥ sudāruṇā
adhnyā iti gavāṃ nāma ka etā hantumarhati
mahaccakārākuśalaṃ vṛthā yo gāṃ nihanti ha
ṛpayo yatayo hyetannahupe pratyavedayan gāṃ mātaraṃ cāpyavadhīrvṛpabhaṃ ca prajāpatim
bhrṛṇahaṃ nahuṣaṃ tvāhurna taṃ bhokṣyāmahe vayam ityuktvā te mahātmānaḥ sarve tattvārthadarśinaḥ
yo hanyādyaśca māṃ stauti tatrāpi śṛṇu jājale samau tāvapi me sthātāṃ na hi me staḥ priyāpriye
na hi vartedayaṃ loko vārtāmutsṛjya kevalām
vakṣyāmi jājale vṛttiṃ nāsmi brāhmaṇa nāstikaḥ
na yajñaṃ ca vinindāmi yajñavittu sudurlabhaḥ
namo brāhmaṇa yajñāya ye ca yajñavido janāḥ
ataḥ stainyaṃ prabhavati vikarmāṇi ca jājale
yadeva sukṛtaṃ havyaṃ tena tuṣyanti devatāḥ namaskāreṇa haviṣā svādhyāyairauṣadhaistathā
lubdhebhyo jāyate lubdhaḥ samebhyo jāyate samaḥ
na te yajñeṣvātmasu vā phalaṃ paśyanti kiṃcana
kartavyamiti kartavyaṃ vetti vai brāhmaṇo bhayam
brahmaiva vartate loke naiva kartavyatāṃ punaḥ
viguṇaṃ ca punaḥ karma jyāya ityanuśuśrum
akhilaṃ daivataṃ sarvaṃ brahma brahmaṇi saṃśritam
yatra gatvā na śocanti ca cyavanti vyathanti ca
te tu tadbrahmaṇaḥ sthānaṃ prāpnuvantīha sātvikāḥ
naiva te svargamicchanti na yajanti yaśodhanāḥ
svameva cārthaṃ kurvāṇā yajñaṃ cakruḥ punardvijāḥ
tasmāttānṛtvijo lubdhā yājayantyaśubhānnarān prāpayeyuḥ prajāḥ svarge svadharmācaraṇena vai
iti me vartate buddhiḥ samā sarvatra jājale
prayuñjate yena yajñe sadā prājñā dvijarṣabhāḥ
tena te devayānena pathā yānti mahāmune
ubhau tau devayānena gacchato jājale yathā
svayaṃ caiṣāmanaḍuho yuñjanti ca vahanti ca
śraddhayā gāṃ puraskṛtya tadṛtaṃ prabravīmi te
akṣīṇaṃ kṣīṇakarmāṇaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ
na śrāvayanna ca yajanna dadadbrāhmaṇeṣu ca kāmyāṃ vṛttiṃ lipsamānaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ yāti jājale
idaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt
[na vai munīnāṃ śṛṇumaḥ sma tattvaṃ pṛcchāmi te vāṇija kaṣṭametat
pūrvepūrve cāsya nāvekṣamāṇā nātaḥ paraṃ tamṛṣayaḥ sthāpayanti
yasminnevātmatīrthena paśavaḥ prāpnuyurmakham ] atha sma karmaṇā kena vāṇija prāpnuyātsukham
śaṃsa me tanmahāprājña bhṛśaṃ vai śraddadhāmi te
uta yajñā utāyajñā masvaṃ nārhanti te kvacit ājyena payasā dadhnā satkṛtyāmikṣayā tvacā
iṣṭaṃ tu daivataṃ kṛtvā yathā yajñamavāpnuyāt
puroḍāśo hi sarveṣāṃ paśūnāṃ medhya ucyate sarvā nadyaḥ sarasvatyaḥ sarve puṇyāḥ śiloccayāḥ
pratyakṣaṃ kriyatāṃ sādhu tato jñāsyasi tadyathā
asaṃśayaṃ pitā vai tvaṃ putrānāhvaya jājale
ahiṃsādi kṛtaṃ karma iha caiva paratra ca
śraddhāṃ nihanti vai brahmansā hatā hanti taṃ naram
kurvatāṃ yajña ityeva na yajño jātu neṣyate
śraddhā vai sātvikī devī sūryasya duhitā dvija
vāgvṛddhaṃ trāyate śraddhā manovṛddhaṃ ca jājale
jyāyasī yā pavitrāṇāṃ nivṛttiḥ śraddhayā saha
kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ vṛttena kimātmanā
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
śraddhāṃ kuru mahāprājña tataḥ prāpsyasi yatparam
na vai munīnāṃ śṛṇumaśca tatvaṃ pṛcchāmi te vāṇija tatvametat
pūrve hi pūrve'pyanavekṣamāṇā nātaḥ paraṃ te ṛṣayaḥ sthāpayanti
yasminnevānutīrthena paśavaḥ prāpnuyuḥ sukham patnīvratena vidhinā prakaroti niyojayan
tato'cireṇa kālena tulādhāraḥ sa eva ca divaṃ gatvā mahāprājñau viharetāṃ yathāsukham
samānāṃ śraddadhānānāṃ yuktānāṃ ca yathābalam kurvatāṃ yajña ityeva nāyajño jātu neṣyate
yathā śarīraṃ na mlāyennaiva mṛtyuvaśaṃ bhavet tathā karmasu varteta samartho dharmamācaret
chinnasthūṇaṃ vṛpaṃ dṛṣṭvā virāvaṃ ca gavāṃ bhṛśam
gogṛhe yajñavāṭe ca prekṣamāṇaḥ sa pārthivaḥ
svasti gobhyo'stu lokeṣu tato nirvacanaṃ kṛtam
ahiṃsā hyeva sarvebhyo dharmebhyo jyāyasī matā
upoṣya saṃśito bhūtvā hitvā vedakṛtāṃ śuciḥ
vṛthā māṃsāni khādanti naipa dharmaḥ praśasyate
surāṃ matsyānmadhu māṃsamāsavaṃ kṛsaraudanam dhūrtaiḥ pravartitaṃ hyetannaitadvedeṣu kalpitam
yajñiyāścaiva ye vṛkṣā vedeṣu parikalpitāḥ yaccāpi kiṃcitkartavyamanyaccokṣaiḥ susaṃskṛtam
kathaṃ kāryaṃ parīkṣeta śīghraṃ vā'tha cireṇa vā
gautamasya sutā hyāsanvīyāṃścirakārikaḥ cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika
ityuktvā sa tadā vipro gautamo japatāṃ varaḥ
piturājñāṃ kathaṃ kuryāṃ na hanyāṃ mātaraṃ katham
asvatantraṃ ca putratvaṃ kiṃtu māṃ nānupīḍayet
striyaṃ hatvā mātaraṃ ca ko hi jātu sukhī bhavet
so'haṃ mātrā svayaṃ pitrā putratve prakṛtaḥ punaḥ
vijñānaṃ me kathaṃ na syāddvau buddhye cātmasaṃbhavam
pitā yadāha dharmaḥ sa vedeṣvapi suniścitaḥ
prītimātraṃ pituḥ putraḥ sarvaṃ putrasya vai pitā
pitā dharmaḥ pitā svargaḥ pitā hi paramaṃ tapaḥ
kliśyannapi sutasnehaiḥ pitā putraṃ na muñcati
yo hyayaṃ mayi saṃghāto martyatve pāñcabhautikaḥ
asya me jananī hetuḥ pāvakasya yathā'raṇiḥ
samarthaṃ vā'samarthaṃ vā kṛśaṃ vāpyakṛśaṃ tathā
rakṣatyeva sutaṃ mātā nānyaḥ poṣṭā vidhānataḥ
tadā sa vṛddho bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ
tadā śūnyaṃ jagattasya yadā mātrā viyujyate
nāsti mātṛsamā cchāyā nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ
nāsti mātṛsamaṃ trāṇaṃ nāsti mātṛsamā priyā
taṃ mātā ca pitā ceti bhūtārtho mātari sthitaḥ
mātā jānāti yadgotraṃ mātā jānāti yasya saḥ
yadā yāsyanti puruṣāḥ striyo nārhanti yāpyatāṃ
guṇasyāsya nivṛttau tu na bhartā na punaḥ patiḥ
striyā hi paramo bhartā daivataṃ paramaṃ smṛtam
evaṃ nārīṃ mātaraṃ ca gaurave cādhike sthitām
ardhyaṃ pādyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ mayā ca pratipāditaḥ
atra cākuśale jāte striyā nāsti vyatikramaḥ
evaṃ na strī na caivāhaṃ nādhvagastridaśeśvaraḥ
hatvā sādhvīṃ ca nārīṃ ca vyasanitvācca vāsitām
bhartavyatvena bhāryāṃ ca ko nu māṃ tārayiṣyati
yadyadya cirakārī syātsa māṃ trāyeta pātakāt
cirakārika bhadraṃ te bhadraṃ te cirakārika
trāhi māṃ mātaraṃ caiva tapo yaccārjitaṃ tvayā
gautamastaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā śirasā patitaṃ bhuvi
na hi sā tena saṃbhedaṃ patnī nītā mahātmanā
hanyā iti samādeśaḥ śastrapāṇau sute sthite
tataḥ pitrā ciraṃ stutvā ciraṃ cāghrāya mūrdhani
cirakārika bhadraṃ te cirakārī ciraṃ bhava
cirāya yadi te saumya ciramasmi na duḥkhitaḥ
cireṇa mitraṃ badhnīyāccireṇa ca kṛtaṃ tyajet
cireṇa hi kṛtaṃ mitraṃ ciraṃ dhāraṇamarhati
rāge darpe ca māne ca drohe pāpe ca karmaṇi
bandhūnāṃ suhṛdāṃ caiva bhṛtyānāṃ strījanasya ca
evaṃ sa gautamastatra prītaḥ putrasya bhārata
cireṇa niścayaṃ kṛtvā ciraṃ na paritapyate
ciraṃ dhārayate roṣaṃ ciraṃ karma niyacchati
ciraṃ pṛṣṭo'pi ca brūyācciraṃ na paritapyate
samāḥ svargaṃ gato vipraḥ putreṇa sahitastadā
kathaṃ rājā prajā rakṣenna ca kiṃcitpratāpayet
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha
lokayātrā na caiva syādaśca cedvettha śaṃsa naḥ
sarva eva trayo varṇāḥ kāryā brāhmaṇabandhanāḥ
ayaṃ me na śṛṇotīti tasminrājā pradhārayet
tattvābhāvena yacchāstraṃ tatkuryānnānyathā vadhaḥ asamīkṣyaiva karmāṇi nītiśāstraṃ yathāvidhi
bhāryā mātā pitā putro hanyante puruṣeṇa te
na mūlaghātaḥ kartavyo naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
yadā purohitaṃ vā te paryeyuḥ śaraṇaipiṇaḥ
tadā visargamarhanti na yathā prathame tathā
yatrayatraiva śakyeransaṃyantuṃ samaye prajāḥ sa tāvānprocyate dharmo yāvanna pratilaṅghyate
na gandharvapitṛṇāṃ ca kaḥ kasyeha na kaścana
yo rājā lobhamohena kiṃcitkuryādasāṃpratam sarvopāyairniyamyaḥ sa tathā pāpānnivartate
vardhante tatra pāpāni dharmo hrasati ca dhnuvam
iti kāruṇyaśīlastu vidvānvai brāhmaṇo'nvaśāt iti caivānuśiṣṭo'smi pūrvaistātapitāmahaiḥ
etatprathamakalpena rājā kṛtayuge jayet pādonenāpi dharmeṇa gacchetretāyuge tathā
dvāpare tu dvipādena pādena tvavare yuge
tathā kaliyuge prāpte rājño duścaritena ha
āyuḥ śaktiṃ ca kālaṃ ca nirdiśya tapa ādiśet
satyāya hi yathā neha jahyāddharmaphalaṃ mahat
haṃho vedā yadi matā dharmāḥ kenāpare matāḥ
gṛhastho brahmacārī ca ubhau tāvapi gacchataḥ
phalaṃ prakalpya pūrvaṃ hi tato yajñaḥ pratāyate
ete grāmyāḥ samākhyātāḥ paśavaḥ sapta sādhubhiḥ
siṃhā vyāghrā varāhāśca mahiṣā vāraṇāstathā hariṇaḥ śalalāścaiva saptāraṇyāstathā smṛtāḥ
ko jātu na vicinvīta vidvānsvāṃ śaktimātmanaḥ
svargamevābhikāṅkṣante na ca svargosti te makhāt
oṣadhyaḥ paśavo vṛkṣā vīrudājyaṃ payo dadhi
yajñārthāni hi sṛṣṭāni yathārthā śrūyate śrutiḥ
omiti brahmaṇo yonirnamaḥ svāhā svadhā vaṣaṭ
na tasya triṣu lokeṣu paralokabhayaṃ viduḥ
yasminnetāni sarvāṇi bhavantīha sa vai dvijaḥ
agnyādheye yadbhavati yacca some sute dvija
teṣāṃ gatiṃ parāṃ prāpya gārhasthye kiṃ prayojanam
yadyeṣāṃ paramā niṣṭhā yadyeṣāṃ paramā gatiḥ
dānaṃ gavāṃ paśūnāṃ vā piṇḍānāmapsu majjanam
evaṃ krośatsu vedeṣu kuto mokṣo'sti kasyacit
na vai pāpairhiyate kṛṣyate vā yo brāhmaṇo yajate vedaśāstraiḥ
ūrdhvaṃ yajanpaśubhiḥ sārdhameti tataḥ punastarkayate na kāmān
na vedānāṃ paribhavānna śāṭhyena na māyayā
caturdvāraṃ puruṣa carturmukhaṃ caturmukho nainamupaiti nindā
bāhubhyāṃ padbhyāmudarādupasthā tteṣāṃ dvāraṃ dvārapālo bubhūṣet
kruddho na caiva prahareta dhīmāṃ stathāsya tatpāṇipādaṃ suguptam
nākrośamṛcchenna vṛthā vadecca na paiśunaṃ janavādaṃ ca kuryāt
nānāśanaḥ syānna mahāśanaḥ syā nna lolupaḥ sādhubhirāgataḥ syāt
na vīrapatnīṃ vihareta nārīṃ na cāpi nārīmanṛtāvāhvayīta
upasthamudaraṃ pāṇī vākcaturthī sa vai dvijaḥ
kiṃ tasya tapasā kāryaṃ kiṃ yajñena kimātmanā
bāhūpadhānaṃ śāmyantaṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ
dvandvārāmeṣu sarveṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ
gatijñaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ taṃ devā brāhmaṇaṃ viduḥ
phalavanti ca karmāṇi vyuṣṭimanti dhravāṇi ca
viguṇāni ca paśyanti tathā naikāni kena ca
yathā ca vedaprāmāṇyaṃ tyāgaśca saphalo yathā
imaṃ ca saṃśayaṃ ghoraṃ bhagavānprabravītu me pratyakṣamiha paśyanto bhavantaḥ satpathe sthitāḥ
etadbravītu bhagavānupapanno'smyadhīhi bho naiva tyāgī na saṃtuṣṭo nāśoko na nirāmayaḥ
bhavanto'pi ca hṛṣyanti śocanti ca yathā vayam
evaṃ caturṇāṃ varṇānāmāśramāṇāṃ pravṛttiṣu ekamālambamānānāṃ nirṇaye kiṃ nirāmayam
yasya yatra hyanuṣṭhānaṃ tasya tattu nirāmayam
sarvaṃ prāpayati jñānaṃ ye jñānaṃ hyanuvartate
jñānādapetya yā vṛttiḥ sā vināśayati prajāḥ
teṣāṃ tamaḥ śarīrāṇāṃ tama eva parāyaṇam
yo yathāprakṛtirjantuḥ prakṛteḥ syādvaśānugaḥ tasya dveṣaśca kāmaśca krodho dambho'nṛtaṃ madaḥ
yaḥ kaścinnyāyya ācāraḥ sarvaṃ śāstramiti śrutiḥ
śāstrādapetaṃ paśyanti bahavo'tyarthamāninaḥ śāstradoṣānna paśyanti iha cāmutra cāpare
nātyantaṃ vandamānena śaktena vijitātmanā vedavādaṃ vyapāśritya mokṣo'stīti prabhāpitum
dhikkartāraṃ ca kāryaṃ ca śramaścāyaṃ nirarthakaḥ
vedāḥ pramāṇaṃ lokānāṃ na vedāḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtāḥ
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat
caranti dharmaṃ kṛcchre'pi durge caivāpi saṃhatāḥ
asyāṃ sthitau sthitānāṃ hi prāyaścittaṃ na vidyate
yadā tu durbalātmānaḥ prāyaścittaṃ tadā bhavet
teṣā yajñāśca vedāśca karmāṇi ca yathāgamam
taṃ santo vidhivatprāpya gacchanti paramāṃ gatim
vyastamekaṃ caturdhā tu brāhmaṇā āśramaṃ viduḥ
sarve sarvatra tiṣṭhanto gacchanti paramāṃ gatim eva evaṃvidhāḥ prāhuḥ purāṇā brahmacāriṇaḥ
ta ete divi dṛśyante jyotirbhūtā dvijātayaḥ nakṣatrāṇīva dhiṣṇyeṣu bahavastārakāgaṇāḥ
karmaiva puruṣasyāha śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
sādhāraṇaḥ kevalo vā yathābalamupāsyate gacchante balinaḥ kṣemaṃ durbalo'trāvasīdati
ye bhuñjate ye dadate yajante'dhīyate ca ye
na tu tyāgasukhaṃ prāptā etattvamapi paśyasi
śarīrapaktiḥ karmāṇi jñānaṃ tu paramā gatiḥ
pakve kaṣāyavijñānaṃ yathā jñānaṃ ca tiṣṭhati
yāṃ viprāḥ sarvataḥ śāntā viśuddhā jñānaniścayāḥ
vedāṃśca veditavyaṃ ca viditvā ca yathāsthitim
vede hi niṣṭhā sarvasya yadyadasti ca nāsti ca
eṣaiva niṣṭhā sarvatra yattadasti ca nāsti ca
etadantaṃ ca madhyaṃ ca saccā'sacca vijānataḥ
samāptaṃ tyāga ityeva śama ityeva niścitam
ṛtaṃ satyaṃ viditaṃ veditavyaṃ sarvasyātmā sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca
sarvaṃ sukhaṃ yacchivamuttaraṃ ca brahmāvyaktaṃ prabhavaścāvyayaṃ ca
tejaḥ kṣamā śāntiranāmayaṃ śubhaṃ tathāvidhaṃ vyoma sanātanaṃ dhruvam
etaiḥ śabdairgamyate buddhinetrai stasmai namo brahmaṇe brāhmaṇāya
dharmamarthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca vedāḥ śaṃsanti bhārata
kasya lābho viśiṣṭo'tra tanme brūhi pitāmaha
ayaṃ me dhāsyati śreyo vapuretaddhi tādṛśam
eṣa me dāsyati dhanaṃ prabhūtaṃ śīghrameva ca
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca core bhagnavrate tathā
lobhaḥ putro nikṛtyāstu kṛtaghno nārhati prajāṃ
tataḥ sa brāhmaṇaḥ svapne kuṇḍadhārasya tejasā
śamena tapasā caiva bhaktyā ca nirupaskṛtaḥ
tatra devāḥ prayacchanti rājyāni ca dhanāni ca
yadi prasannā devā me bhakto'yaṃ brāhmaṇo mama
tatastaṃ māṇibhadrastu punarvacanamabravīt devānāmeva vacanātkuṇḍadhāraṃ māhadyutim
uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhadraṃ te kṛtakṛtyaḥ sukhī bhava
sadā dharmaphalaṃ rājyaṃ sukhāni vividhāni ca
prītāste devatāḥ sarvā dvijasyāsya tathaiva ca
ayaṃ na sukṛtaṃ vetti ko nvanyo vetsyate kṛtam
dharme ca śraddadhānasya tapasyugre ca vartataḥ
yadi dadyāmahaṃ rājyaṃ tuṣṭo vai yasya kasyacit
samāgamya sa tenātha pūjāṃ cakre yathāvidhi
paśya rājñāṃ gatiṃ vipra lokāṃścaiva tu cakṣuṣā
māṃ pūjayitvā bhāvena yadi tvaṃ duḥkhamāpnuyāḥ
kṛtaṃ mayā bhavetkiṃ te kaśca te'nugraho bhavet
tato'paśyatsa kāmaṃ ca krodhaṃ lobhaṃ bhayaṃ madam nidrāṃ tandrīṃ tathā''lasyamāvṛttya puruṣānsthitān
eṣa śaktosmi tapasā dātuṃ rājyaṃ dhanāni ca
dharmācchaktyā tathā yogādyā caiva paramā gatiḥ
suprasannā hi te devā yatte dharme ratā matiḥ
dhane sukhakalā kāciddharme tu paramaṃ sukham
dharmārthaṃ na sukhārthārthaṃ kathaṃ yajñaḥ samāhitaḥ
tiktaṃ ca virasaṃ śākaṃ tapasā svādutāṃ gatam
mā bhoḥprakṣipa hotre tvaṃ gaccha svargamatandritaḥ
kiṃnu duścaritaṃ yajñe didṛkṣuḥ sā rasātalam
tataḥ sa hariṇo gatvā padānyaṣṭau nyavartata
sādhu hiṃsaya māṃ satya hato yāsyāmi sadgaditam
paśya hyapsaraso divyā mayā dattena cakṣuṣā
tataḥ sa suciraṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛhālagnena cakṣuṣā
sa tu dharmo mṛgo bhūtvā bahuvarṣoṣito vane
samādhānaṃ ca bhāryāyā lebhe sa tapasā param
satyaṃ te'haṃ pravakṣyāmi no dharmaḥ satyavādinām
kathaṃ bhavati pāpātmā kathaṃ dharmaṃ karoti vā
kena nirvedamādatte mokṣaṃ vā kena gacchati
śṛṇu mokṣaṃ sanirvedaṃ pāpaṃ dharmaṃ ca mūlataḥ
prāpyatāṃ vartate kāmo dveṣo vā bharatarṣabha
na dharme jāyate buddhirvyājāddharmaṃ karoti ca
tatraiva kurute buddhiṃ tataḥ pāpaṃ cikīrṣati
pāpaṃ cintayate karma prabravīti karoti ca
sa neha sukhamāpnoti kuta eva paratra vai
evaṃ bhavati pāpātmā dharmātmānaṃ tu me śṛṇu
prājño dharme ca ramate dharmaṃ caivopajīvati
tasyaiva siñcate mūlaṃ guṇānpaśyati yatra vai
dharmātmā bhavati hyevaṃ mitraṃ ca labhate śubham
sa mitradhanalābhāttu pretya ceha ca nandati
śabde sparśe rase rūpe tathā gandhe ca bhārata
sa tu dharmaphalaṃ labdhvā na tṛṣyati yudhiṣṭhira
dharme sthitānāṃ kaunteya sarvabhogakriyāsu ca atṛpyamāṇo nirvedamādatte jñānacakṣuṣā
śabde sparśe tathā rūpe na ca bhāvayate manaḥ
vimucyate tadā kāmānna ca dharmaṃ vimuñcati
sarvatyāge ca yatate dṛṣṭvā lokaṃ kṣayātmakam
dharmātmā caiva bhavati mokṣaṃ ca labhate param
etatte kathitaṃ tāta yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
karaṇe ghaṭasya yā buddhirghaṭotpattau na sā matā
pūrve samudre yaḥ panthāḥ sa na gacchati paścimam
ekaḥ panthā hi mokṣasya tanme vistarataḥ śṛṇu
icchāṃ dveṣaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca dhairyeṇa vinivartayet
anityatvena ca snehaṃ kṣudhaṃ yogena paṇḍitaḥ
maunena bahubhāṣāṃ ca śauryeṇa ca bhayaṃ jayet
kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca bhayaṃ svapnaṃ ca pañcamam
sidhyanti cāsya saṃkalpā vijñānaṃ ca pravartate
eṣa mārgo hi mokṣasya prasanno vimalaḥ śuciḥ
āsīnaṃ devalaṃ vṛddhaṃ buddhvā buddhimatāṃ varam
pañcaiva tāni kālaśca bhāvābhāvau ca kevalau
cakṣuṣī nāsikākarṇau tvak jihveti ca pañcamī
darśanaṃ śravaṇaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ rasanaṃ tathā
rūpaṃ gandho rasaḥ sparśaḥ śabdaścaivātha tadguṇāḥ
rūpaṃ gandhaṃ rasaṃ sparśaṃ śabdaṃ caivātha tadguṇān
manasastu parā buddhiḥ kṣetrajño buddhitaḥ paraḥ
pūrvaṃ cetayate janturindriyairviṣayānpṛthak vicārya manasā paścādatha buddhyā vyavasyati
pāṇiṃ pādaṃ ca pāyuṃ ca mehanaṃ pañcamaṃ mukham
gamanendriyaṃ tathā pādau karmaṇaḥ karaṇe karau
visarge ca purīṣasya visarge cāpi kāmike
ānandaḥ karmaṇāṃ siddhiḥ pratipattiḥ parā gatiḥ
indriyāṇi ca bhāvāśca guṇāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ
teṣāmaṣṭādaśo dehī yaḥ śarīre sa śāśvataḥ
saṃśritāstadviyoge hi saśarīrā na santi te
athavā saṃvibhāgena śarīraṃ pāñcabhautikam ekaśca daśa cāṣṭau ca guṇāḥ saha śarīriṇām
ūṣmaṇā saha viśo vā saṃghātaḥ pāñcabhautikaḥ
tathaivotpadyate kiṃcitpañcatvaṃ gacchate tathā puṇyapāpavināśānte puṇyapāpasamīritaḥ
naiva saṃjāyate janturna ca jātu vipadyate
tatkṣaye hṛdi paśyanti brahmabhāve parāṃ gatim
bhrātaraḥ pitaraḥ pautrā jñātayaḥ suhṛdaḥ sutāḥ
susukhaṃ bata jīvāmi yasya me nāsti kiṃcana
mithilāyāṃ pradīptāyāṃ na me dahyati kiṃcana
arthāḥ khalu samṛddhā hi gāḍhaṃ duḥkhaṃ vijānatām
yacca kāmasukhaṃ loke yacca divyaṃ mahatsukham
yathaiva śṛṅgaṃ goḥ kāle vardhamānasya vardhate
na kāmānanurudhyeta duḥkhaṃ kāmeṣu vai ratiḥ
kṛtakṛtyo viśuddhātmā sarvaṃ jyajati vai svayam
bhayābhaye ca saṃtyajya bhava śānto nirāmayaḥ
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ
yosau prāṇāntiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukhaṃ
dharmātmā labhate kīrti pretya ceha yathāsukham
kiṃ śreyaḥ pratipadyeta tanme brūhi pitāmaha
pituḥ putreṇa saṃvādaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira
putro babhūva medhāvī medhāvī nāma nāmataḥ
dhīraḥ kiṃsvittāta kuryātprajānan kṣipraṃ hyāyurbhraśyate mānavānām
pitastathā''khyāhi yathārthayogaṃ mamānupūrvyā yena dharmaṃ careyam
amodhāsu patantīṣu kiṃ dhīra iva bhāṣase
amoghāḥ kāḥ patantīha kiṃnu bhīṣayasīva mām
gādhodake matsya iva sukhaṃ vindeta kastadā
yāmekarātriṃ prathamāṃ garbho viśati mātaram tāmeva rātriṃ prasvāpya maraṇāya vivartakaḥ
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vā'sya na vā kṛtam
adyaiva kuru yacchreyo mā tvāṃ kālo'tyagānmahān
ko hi jānāti kasyādya mṛtyukālo maviṣyati
kṛte dharma bhavetprītiriha pretya ca śāśvatī
saptaṃ vyāyaṃ mahaugho vā mṛtyurādāya gacchati
durbalaṃ balavantaṃ ca prājñaṃ śūraṃ jaḍaṃ kavim
asaṃtyājyaṃ yadā martyaiḥ kiṃ svastha iva tiṣṭhati
mṛtyorvā gṛhametadvai yā grāme vasato ratiḥ
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ
chittvaināṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca dvayaṃ dehe pratiṣṭhitam
ātmayajño bhaviṣyāmi na māṃ tārayati prajā
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham
naitādṛśaṃ brāhmaṇasyāsti vittaṃ yathaikatā samatā satyatā ca
kiṃ te dhanairbāndhavairvā'pi kiṃ te kiṃ te dāraibrāhmaṇa yo mariṣyasi
ātmānamanviccha gṛhā praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahāste kva gatāḥ pitā ca
hārītena purā gītaṃ taṃ nibodha yudhiṣṭhira
na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayetparam
na pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā dūṣaṇaṃ vyāharetkvacit
pradakṣiṇaṃ ca savyaṃ ca grāmamadhye ca nācaret
atīte pātrasaṃcāre bhikṣāṃ lipseta vai muniḥ
alābhe na vihanyeta lābhaścainaṃ na harṣayet
abhyastaṃ bhautikaṃ paśyanbhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim vismitaḥ sarvadarśī ca pakvāpakvena vartayan
etānvegānvinayedvai tapasvī nindā cāsya hṛdayaṃ nopahanyāt
ajñātalipsaṃ lipseta na cainaṃ harṣa āviśet
kadā vayaṃ gamiṣyāmo rājyaṃ hitvā paraṃtapa
na cāpi gamyate rājannaiṣa doṣaḥ prasaṅgataḥ
tata eva samutthena tamasā rudhyate'pi ca
ayatnasādhyaṃ munayo vadanti ce cāpi muktāstadupāsitavyāḥ
tvayā ca lokena ca sāmareṇa tasmānna śāmyanti maharṣisaṅghāḥ
satyena tapasā caiva viditvā saṃkṣayaṃ hyaham
na śocāmi na hṛṣyāmi bhūtānāmāgatiṃ gatim
kṣapayitvā tu taṃ kālaṃ gaṇitaṃ kālacoditāḥ
yathā karma tathā lābha iti śāstranidarśanam
sukhaduḥkhe priye dveṣye caritvā pūrvameva ca
kālasaṅkhyānasaṅkhyeyaṃ sṛṣṭisthitiparāyaṇam taṃ bhāṣamāṇaṃ bhagavānuśanā pratyabhāṣata
aiśvaryaṃ tapasā prāptaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ tacca svakarmabhiḥ
nūnaṃ tu tasya tapasaḥ sāvaśeṣaṃ mamāsti vai
kiṃ vā phalaṃ paraṃ prāpya jīvastiṣṭhati śāśvataḥ
kena vā karmaṇā śakyamatha jñānena kena vā
itīdamuktaḥ sa munistadānīṃ pratyāha yattacchṛṇu rājasiṃha
mayocyamānaṃ puruṣarṣabha tva mananyacittaḥ saha sodarīyaiḥ
yasya pṛthvī talaṃ tāta sākāśaṃ bāhugocaraḥ
mūrdhā yasya tvanantaṃ ca sthānaṃ dānavasattama
asmingacchanti vilayamasmācca prabhavantyuta avatyeṣa mahābāhurbhūtagrāmaṃ carācaram
eṣa cākṣipate kāle kāle ca sṛjate punaḥ
naiṣa dānava te śakyastapasā naiva cejyayā
bāhye cābhyantare caiva karmaṇā manasi sthitaḥ
na muñcati svakaṃ gandhaṃ tathā sūkṣmasya darśanam
karmaṇā svena raktāni viraktāni ca dānava
devaḥ sṛjati bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
eṣa sarveṣu bhūteṣu kṣaraścākṣara eva ca
pādau tasya mahīṃ viddhi mūrdhānaṃ divameva ca
bhruvoranantarāstasya grahā dānavasattama nakṣatracakraṃ netraṃ ca āsyamagniṃ ca dānava
taṃ viśvabhūtaṃ viśvādiṃ paramaṃ viddhi ceśvaram
akarmaṇaḥ phalaṃ caiva sa eva paramo'vyayaḥ
chandāṃsi yasya romāṇi hyakṣaraṃ ca sarasvatī
mitro'tha varuṇaścaiva yamo'tha dhanadastathā te pṛthagdarśanāstasya saṃvidanti tathaikatām
ekasya viddhi devasya sarvaṃ jagadidaṃ vaśe
prajāvisargasya ca pārimāṇyaṃ vāpīsahasrāṇi bahūni daitya
āyāmataḥ pañcaśatāśca sarvāḥ pratyekaśo yojanataḥ pravṛddhāḥ
vāpyā jalaṃ kṣipyati vālakoṭyā tvahnā sakṛccāpyatha na dvitīyam
tāsāṃ kṣaye viddhi paraṃ visargaṃ saṃhāramekaṃ ca tathā prajānām
ṣaḍjīvavarṇāḥ paramaṃ pramāṇaṃ kṛṣṇo dhūmro nīlamathāsya madhyam
raktaṃ punaḥ sahyataraṃ sukhaṃ tu hāridravarṇaṃ susukhaṃ ca śuklam
paraṃ tu śuklaṃ vimalaṃ viśokaṃ gataklamaṃ siddhyati dānavendra
gatvā tu yoniprabhavāṇi daitya sahasraśaḥ siddhimupaiti jīvaḥ
gatiṃ ca yāṃ darśanamāha devo gatvā śubhaṃ darśanameva cāpi
śataṃ sahasrāṇi caturdaśeha parā gatirjīvagaṇasya daitya
ārohaṇaṃ tatkṛtameva viddhi sthānaṃ tathā niḥsaraṇaṃ ca teṣām
yo'smādatha bhraśyati kālayogā tkṛṣṇe varṇe tiṣṭhati sarvakṛṣṭe
atiprasakto nirayācca daitya tatastataḥ saṃparivartate ca
kṛṣṇasya varṇasya gatirnikuṣṭā sa majjate narake pacyamānaḥ
śataṃ sahasrāṇi tataścaritvā prāpnoti varṇaṃ haritaṃ tu paścāt
sa caiva tasminnivasatyaniśo yugakṣayaṃ tamasā saṃvṛtātmā
sa vai yadā satvaguṇena yukta stamo vyapohanghaṭate svabuddhyā
sa lohitaṃ varṇamupaiti nīlā nmanuṣyaloke parivartate ca
tataḥ sa hāridramupaiti varṇaṃ saṃhāravikṣepaśate vyatīte
avipramukto niraye ca daitya tataḥ sahasrāṇi daśāparāṇi
gatīḥ sahasrāṇi ca pañca tasya catvāri saṃvartakṛtāni caiva
vimuktamenaṃ nirayācca viddhi sarveṣu cānyeṣu ca saṃbhaveṣu
so'smādaya bhraśyati kālayogā tkṛṣṇe tale tiṣṭhati sarvakṛṣṭe
daivāni sa vyūhaśatāni sapta rakto haridro'tha tathaiva śuklaḥ
aṣṭau ca ṣaṣṭiṃ ca śatāni caiva manoviruddhāni mahādyutīnām
śuklasya varṇasya parā gatiryā trīṇyeva ruddhāni mahānubhāva
ṣaṣṭhasya varṇasya parā gatiryā siddhāvasiddhasya gataklamasyara
saṃhāravikṣepamaniṣṭamekaṃ catvāri cānyāni vasatyanīśaḥ tasmādupāvṛtya manuṣyaloke tato mahānmānuṣatāmupaiti
tasmādupāvṛtya tataḥ krameṇa sogreṇa saṃtiṣṭhati bhūtasargam
tato'vyayaṃ sthānamanantameti devasya viṣṇoratha brahmaṇatha śeṣasya caivātha narasya caiva devasya viṣṇoḥ paramasya caiva
ceṣṭātmano devagaṇāśca sarve ye brahmaloke hyamarāḥ sma te'pi
prajānisarge tu sa śeṣakāle sthānāni svānyeva saranti jīvāḥ

evaṃ gate me na viṣādosti kaści tsamyakca paśyāmi vacastathaitat
śrutvā tu te vācamadīnasatva vikalmaṣosmyadya tathā vipāṣmā
viṣṇoranantasya sanātanaṃ ta tsthānaṃ sargā yatra sarvaṃ pravṛttāḥ sa vai mahātmā puruṣottamo vai tasmijjagatsarvamidaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
turīyāṃśena tasyemaṃ viddhi keśavamacyutam turīyāṃśena brahmāṇaṃ tasya viddhi mahātmanaḥ
arvāksthitastu yaḥ sthāyī kalpānte parivartate sa śete bhagavānapsu yo'sāvatibalaḥ prabhuḥ
sarvāṇyaśūnyāni karotyanantaḥ sanātanaḥ saṃcarate ca lokān
sa cāniruddhaḥ sṛjate mahātmā tatsthaṃ jagatsarvamidaṃ vicitram
vayaṃ tu bhṛśamāpannā raktāḥ kaṣṭāḥ sukhe'sukhe
prajāvisargaṃ ca sukhena loke pretyānyedeheṣu sukhāni bhuktvā
sukhena saṃyāsyatha siddhasaṅkhyāṃ mā vo bhayaṃ bhavatu na vo'stu pāpam
kathaṃ vā rājaśārdūla padaṃ tu jñātavānasau
vṛtraḥ sa rājaśārdūla yathā śakreṇa nirjitaḥ
vistareṇa mahābāho paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
rathenendraḥ prayāto vai sārdhaṃ suragaṇaiḥ purā
na saṃbhramo na bhīḥ kācidāsthā vā samajāyata
śakrasya ca surendrasya vṛtrasya ca mahātmanaḥ
eṣa brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śivaścaiva jagatpatiḥ
samudvignaṃ samīkṣya tvāṃ svastītyūcurjayāya te mā kārṣīḥ kaśmalaṃ śakra kaścidevetaro yathā
āryāṃ yuddhe matiṃ kṛtvā jahi śatrūnsurādhipa
stavena śakra divyena stuvanti tvāṃ jayāya vai
aindraṃ samāviśudvajraṃ lokasaṃrakṣaṇe rataḥ tato bṛhaspatirdhīmānupāgamya śatakratum
eṣa vṛtro mahāñśakre balena mahatā vṛtaḥ
ṣaṣṭiṃ varṣasahasrāṇi brahmā cāsmai varaṃ dadau
vṛtramevaṃ tvavadhyaṃ taṃ vajreṇa jahi dānavam
abhavanyāni liṅgāni śarīre tāni me śṛṇu
sā viniḥsaramāṇaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā śakraṃ mahaujasam
anusṛtya tu yatnātsa tayā vai brahmahatyayā
tasyā vyapohane śakraḥ paraṃ yatnaṃ cakāra ha
gṛhīta eva tu tayā devendro bharatarṣabha
brūhi kiṃ te karomyadya kāmaṃ kiṃ tvamihecchasi
kṛtameva hi manyāmi nivāsaṃ tu vidhatsva me
sthāpanā vai sumahatī tvayā deva pravartitā
prīte tu tvayi dharmajña sarvalokeśvara prabho
tatheti tāṃ prāha tadā brahmavadhyāṃ pitāmahaḥ
mama mokṣasya ko'nto vai brahmandhyāyasva vai prabho
yastvāṃ jvalantamāsādya svayaṃ vai mānavaḥ kvacit
tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati
brahmavadhyā havyavāha vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
iyaṃ putrādanuprāptā brahmahatyā mahābhayā puruhūtaṃ caturthāṃśamasyā yūyaṃ pratīcchata
vayamagniṃ tathā śītaṃ varṣaṃ ca pavaneritam
brahmavadhyāmimāmadya bhavataḥ śāsanādvayam grahīṣyāmastrilokeśa mokṣaṃ cintayatāṃ bhavān
parvakāle tu saṃprāpte yo vai chedanabhedanam
tameṣā yāsyati kṣipraṃ vyetu vo mānaso jvaraḥ
evaṃ bhavatu lokeśa yathā vadasi naḥ prabho
tvaṃ hi deveśa sarvasya jagataḥ paramā gatiḥ
ko'nyaḥ prasādyo hi bhavedyaḥ kṛcchrānnaḥ samuddharet
alpā iti matiṃ kṛtvā yo naro buddhimohitaḥ
tamiyaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ tatraiva ca nivatsyati
tathā vo bhavitā mokṣa iti satyaṃ bravīmi vaḥ
śrūyate ca mahārāja saṃprāptā vāsavena vai
ime hi bhūtale devāḥ prathitāḥ kurunandana
vipramadhye vadiṣyanti na te prāpsyanti kilviṣaṃ
kathitaṃ karma te tāta kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
paryaṅka iva vibhrājannupaviṣṭo babhūva ha śailarājasutā cāsya nityaṃ pārśve sthitā babhau
yakṣāṇāmīśvaraḥ śrīmānkailāsanilayaḥ prabhuḥ śaṅkhapadmanidhibhyāṃ ca lakṣmyā paramayā saha
uvāca vacanaṃ sādhvī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim
brūhi tattvena tattvajña saṃśayo me mahānayam
kena vā pratiṣedhena gamanaṃ te na vidyate
yajñeṣu sarveṣu mama na bhāga upakalpitaḥ
na me surāḥ prayacchanti bhāgaṃ yajñasya dharmataḥ
evamuktvā tu sā devī devaṃ paśupatiṃ patim
atha devyā mataṃ jñātvā hṛdgataṃ yaccikīrṣitam
taṃ tu yajñaṃ tathārūpaṃ gacchantamupalabhya saḥ
bhavatopi surāḥ sarve bhāgaṃ dāsyanti vai prabho
imā hi devatāḥ sarvā ṛṣayaśca paraṃtapa
ekībhūtasya na tvasya dhāraṇe tejasaḥ prabho
ityukto brahmaṇā devo bhāge cāpi prakalpite
avāpa ca tadā bhāgaṃ yathoktaṃ brahmaṇā bhavaḥ
apāṃ tu nīlikāṃ viddhi nirmokaṃ bhujageṣu ca
mānuṣeṣu tu dharmajña jvaro nāmaiṣa viśrutaḥ
maraṇe janmani tathā madhye cāviśate naram
anena hi samāviṣṭo vṛtro dharmabhūtāṃ varaḥ
praviśya bajraṃ vṛtraṃ ca dārayāmāsaṃ bhārata
imāṃ jvarotpattimadīnamānasaḥ paṭhetsadā yaḥ susamāhito naraḥ
vimuktarogaḥ sa sukhī mudā yuto labheta kāmānsa yathā manīṣitān
prācetasasya dakṣasya kathaṃ vaivasvatentare vināśamagamadbrahmanhayamedhaḥ prajāpateḥ
devyā manyukṛtaṃ matvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ prasādāttasya dakṣeṇa sa yajñaḥ saṃdhitaḥ katham
purā himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe dakṣo vai yajñamāharat
ādityā vasavo radrāḥ sādhyāḥ saha marudgaṇaiḥ
āhūtā mantritāḥ sarve devāśca saha patnibhiḥ
nāyaṃ yajño na vā dharmo yatra rudro na ijyate
vadhabandhaṃ prapannā vai kiṃnu kālasya paryayaḥ
upasthitaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ na budhyanti yahādhvare
sa paśyati mahādevaṃ devīṃ ca varadāṃ śubhām
nāradaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ tasyā devyāḥ samīpataḥ
saṃtoṣaṃ paramaṃ lebhe iti niścitya yogavit
ekamantrāstu te sarve yeneśo na nimantritaḥ
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me na ca vakṣye kadācana
santi no bahavo rudrāḥ śūlahastāḥ kapardinaḥ
sarveṣāmeva mantro'yaṃ yenāsau na nimantritaḥ yathā'haṃ śaṃkarādūrdhvaṃ nānyaṃ paśyāmi daivatam
kiṃ nāma dānaṃ niyamaṃ tapo vā kuryāmahaṃ yena patirmamādya
labheta bhāgaṃ ca tathaiva sarvaṃ prabhurvibhuścāhavanīya eṣaḥ labheta bhāgaṃ bhagavānacintyo hyardhaṃ tathā bhāgamatho tṛtīyam
na vetsi māṃ devi kṛśodarāṅgi kiṃ nāma yuktaṃ vacanaṃ makheśe
ahaṃ vijānāmi viśālanetre dhyānena hīnā na vidantyasantaḥ
tavādya mohena ca sendradevā lokāstrayaḥ sarvata eva mūḍhāḥ
māṃ brāhmaṇā brahmavido yajante mamādhvaryavaḥ kalpayante ca bhāgam
stauti garvāyate cāpi svamātmānaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
nātmānaṃ staumi deveśi paśya me tanumadhyame
devyā manyuvyapohārthaṃ hato dakṣasya vai kratuḥ
agnayo naiva dīpyante naiva dīpyati bhāskaraḥ
grahā caiva prakāśante nakṣatrāṇi na candramāḥ
ṛṣayo na prakāśante na devā na ca mānuṣāḥ
pānakāni ca divyāni lehyacoṣyāṇi yāni ca
chittvā śiro vai yajñasya nanāda ca mumoda ca
ūcuḥ prāñjalayaḥ sarve kathyatāṃ ko bhavāniti
nāhaṃ rudro na vā devī naiva bhoktumihāgataḥ
devyā manyukṛtaṃ matvā kruddhaḥ sarvātmakaḥ prabhuḥ
draṣṭuṃ vā naiva viprendrānnaiva kautūhalena vā
varaṃ krodho'pi devasya varadānaṃ na cānyataḥ
smitaṃ kṛtvā'vravīdvākyaṃ brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
śrāvite ca makhādhyāye devānāṃ guruṇā tataḥ
yadi vā'habhanugrāhyo yadi vā varado mama
cūrṇīkṛtāpaviddhaṃ ca yajñasaṃbhāramīdṛśam dīrghakālena mahatā prayatnena susaṃcitam
vaktumarhasi me tāta śrotuṃ śraddhā mamānagha
sarvā vai devatā hyasmingāvo goṣṭha ivāsate
ādityamatha vai viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatim
namo bhavāya śarvāya rudrāya varadāya ca
namaḥ stutāya stutyāya stūyamānāya vai namaḥ
namo nābhāya nābhyāya namaḥ kaṭakaṭāya ca
ugrāya ca namo nityaṃ namostu daśabāhave
namo vṛṣāya vṛṣyāya govṛṣāya vṛṣāya ca
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya namaḥ śāntatamāya ca
namo yajñāya yajine hutāya prahutāya ca
namo ghuṣyāya ghoṣāya namaḥ kalakalāya ca
sarva sarvada sarvaghna saṃndhyārāga namostu te
mahābala mahābāho mahāsatva mahādyute mahāmeghacalaprakhya mahākāla namostu te
carācarasya sraṣṭā tvaṃ pratihartā tathaiva ca
manasaḥ paramā yoniḥ khaṃ vāyurjyotiṣāṃ nidhiḥ
brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā varṇāvarāśca ye
yugaṃ nimeṣāḥ kāṣṭhāstvaṃ nakṣatrāṇi grahāḥ kalāḥ
vṛkṣāṇāṃ kakudosi tvaṃ girīṇāṃ śikharāṇi ca
kṣīrādo hyudadhīnāṃ ca yantrāṇāṃ dhanureva ca
vajraḥ praharaṇānāṃ ca vratānāṃ satyameva ca
tvameva dveṣa icchā ca rāgo mohaḥ kṣamākṣame
tvaṃ gadī tvaṃ śarī cāpī khaṭvāṅgī jharjharī tathā
chettā bhettā prahartā tvaṃ netā mantā pitā mataḥ
gaṅgā samudrāḥ saritaḥ palvalāni saṃrāsi ca
ādiścāntaśca devānāṃ gāyatryoṅkāra eva ca harito rohito nīlaḥ kṛṣṇo raktastathā'ruṇaḥ
suvarṇanāmā ca tathā suvarṇapriya eva ca
hotraṃ hotā ca homyaṃ ca hutaṃ caiva tathā prabhuḥ
pavitraṃ ca pavitrāṇāṃ maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
giriko hiṇḍuko vṛkṣo jīvaḥ pudgala eva ca
prāṇopānaḥ samānaśca udāno vyāna eva ca
dhātā vidhātā saṃdhātā vidhātā dhāraṇo dharaḥ
śreṣṭhaḥ sthiraśca sthāṇuśca niṣkampaḥ kampa eva ca
amṛtapāstvaṃ jagannātha devadeva gaṇeśvaraḥ viṣāgnipā mṛtyupāśca kṣīrapāḥ somapāstathā
hiraṇyaretāḥ puruṣastvameva tvaṃ strī pumāṃstvaṃ ca napuṃsakaṃ ca
bālo yuvā sthaviro jīrṇadaṃṣṭrastvaṃ nāgendra śakrastvaṃ viśvakṛdviśvakartā
candrādityau cakṣuṣī te hṛdayaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ
mahodadhiḥ sarasvatī vāgbalamanalo' nilaḥ ahorātraṃ nimeṣonmeṣakarmā
na brahmā na ca govindaḥ paurāṇā ṛṣayo na te
māhātmyaṃ vedituṃ śaktā yāthātathyena te śiva
yā mūrtayaḥ susūkṣmāste na mahyaṃ yānti darśanam
trāhi māṃ satataṃ rakṣa pitā putramivaurasam
rakṣa māṃ rakṣaṇīyo'haṃ tavānagha namostu te
tiṣṭhatyekaḥ samudrānte sa me goptā'stu nityaśaḥ
praviśya vadanaṃ rāhoryaḥ somaṃ pibate niśi
namastebhyaḥ svadhā svāhā prāpnuvantu mudaṃ tu te
rakṣantu te hi māṃ nityaṃ nityaṃ cāpyāyayantu mām
yena rodanti dehasthā dehino rodayanti ca
ye nadīṣu samudreṣu parvateṣu guhāsu ca
yeṣu pañcasu bhūteṣu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca
rasātalagatā ye ca ye ca tasmai paraṃ gatāḥ
yeṣāṃ na vidyate saṅkhyā pramāṇaṃ rupameva ca
sarvabhūtāntarātmā ca tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ
tvameva kartā sarvasya tena tvaṃ na nimantritaḥ
athavā māyayā deva sūkṣmayā tava mohitaḥ
prasīda mama bhadraṃ te bhava bhāvagatasya me
tvayi me hṛdayaṃ deva tvayi buddhirmanastvayi
dakṣa dakṣa na kartavyo manyurvighnamimaṃ prati
bhūyaśca te varaṃ dadmi taṃ tvaṃ gṛhṇīṣva suvrata
taccāstu te mahābhāga tyajyatāṃ mānaso jvaraḥ evamuktvā mahādevaḥ sapatnīkaḥ sahānugaḥ
anenaiva tu dehena gaṇānāṃ samatāṃ vrajet
tejasā yaśasā caiva yukto bhavati nirmalaḥ
na rākṣasāḥ piśācā vā na bhūtā na vināyakāḥ
vighnaṃ kuryurgṛhe tasya yatrāyaṃ paṭhyate stavaḥ
devasya ca guhasyāpi devyā nandīśvarasya ca
baliṃ suvihitaṃ kṛtvā damena niyamena ca
mṛtaśca svargamāpnoti tiryakṣu ca na jāyate
tadvyākhyāsyāmi te tāta tasya vyākhyāmimāṃ śṛṇu
satataṃ hi pralīyante guṇāste prabhavanti ca
tataḥ sṛṣṭāni bhūtāni tāni yānti punaḥ punaḥ
vāyoḥ prāṇo rasastvadbhyo rūpaṃ tejasa ucyate
rasaḥ snehaśca jihvā ca apāmete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
ghreyaṃ ghrāṇaṃ śarīraṃ ca ete bhūmiguṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
prāṇaḥ sparśaśca ceṣṭā ca vāyorete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ kālaḥ karma buddhiśca bhārata
indriyāṇi nare pañca ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu mana ucyate
indriyāṇi ca kartā ca vicetavyāni bhāgaśaḥ
tamaḥ satvaṃ rajaśceti kālaḥ karma ca bhārata guṇairnenīyate buddhirbuddhirevendriyāṇi ca
manaḥ ṣaṣṭhāni sarvāṇi buddhyabhāve kuto guṇāḥ
jighratī bhavati ghrāṇaṃ rasatī rasanā rasān
yadā prārthayate kiṃcittadā bhavati sā manaḥ
na sukhena na duḥkhena kadācidapi vartate
avidyā rāgamohau ca pramādaḥ stabdhatā bhayam
tatra yatprītisaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet
atha yanmohasaṃyuktaṃ kāye manasi vā bhavet
sṛjate'tra guṇāneka eko na sṛjate guṇān
pṛthagbhūtau prakṛtyā tu saṃprayuktau ca sarvadā
na guṇā vidurātmānaṃ sa guṇānveda sarvataḥ
paridraṣṭā guṇānāṃ tu saṃsraṣṭā manyate yathā
tāmyeyuḥ pracyutāḥ pṛthvīṃ mohapūrṇāṃ nadīṃ narāḥ
adhyātmaviduṣo dhīrā jñānaṃ tu paramaṃ plavaḥ
na bhavati viduṣāṃ mahadbhayaṃ yadaviduṣāṃ sumahadbhayaṃ bhavet
na hi gatiradhikā'sti kasyaci tsakṛdupadarśayatīha tulyatām
yatkaroti bahudoṣamekata stacca dūṣayati yatpurā kṛtam
nāpriyaṃ tadubhayaṃ karotyasau yacca dūṣayati yatkaroti ca
ubhayaṃ no yathā na syāttanme brūhi pitāmaha
nāradasya ca saṃvādaṃ samaṅgasya ca bhārata
udvegaṃ na hi te kiṃcitsusūkṣmamapi lakṣaye
teṣāṃ tattvāni jānāmi tato na vimanā hyaham
loke phalāni citrāṇi tato na vimanā hyaham
yadā na śocemahi kiṃ nu naḥ syā ddharmeṇa vā nārada karmaṇā vā
kṛtāntavaśyāni yadā sukhāni duḥkhāni vā yanna vidharṣayanti
yasmai prājñāḥ kathayante manuṣyāḥ prajñāmūlaṃ hīndriyāṇāṃ prasādaḥ
muhyanti śocanti tathendriyāṇi prajñālābho nāsti mūḍhendriyasya
mūḍhasya darpaḥ sa punarmoha eva mūḍhasya nāyaṃ na paro'sti lokaḥ
na hyeva duḥkhāni sadā bhavanti sukhasya vā nityaśo lābha eva
bhāvātmakaṃ saṃparivartamānaṃ na mādṛśaḥ saṃjvaraṃ jātu kuryāt
samāhito na spṛhayetpareṣāṃ nānāgataṃ cābhinandecca lābham
na cāpi hṛṣyedvipule'rthalābhe tathā'rthanāśe ca na vai viṣīdet
na bāndhavā na ca vittaṃ na kaulyaṃ na ca śrutaṃ na ca mantrā na vīryam
duḥkhāntrātuṃ sarva evotsahante paratra śīlena tu yānti śāntim
na ca mṛtyorna cādharmānna lobhānna kutaścana
tena nārada saṃprāpto na māṃ śokaḥ prabādhate
śravaṇaṃ caiva vidyānāṃ kūṭasthaṃ śreya ucyate
yaiḥ kaiścitsaṃmato loke guṇaiśca puruṣo nṛṣu
idaṃ śreya idaṃ śreya iti sarve prabodhitāḥ
śāstraṃ yadi bhavedekaṃ śreyo vyaktaṃ bhavettadā
satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyajñānaṃ tu duṣkaram
ahaṃkārasya ca tyāgaḥ pramādasya ca nigrahaḥ
jvalanti yaśasā loke yāni na vyāharanti ca
na tatra vāsaṃ kurvīta śreyorthī vai kathaṃcana
puṇyaṃ puṇyeṣu vimalaṃ pāpaṃ pāpeṣu cāpnuyāt
pradīptamiva celāntaṃ kastaṃ deśaṃ na saṃtyajet
na tānanuvasejjātu te hi pāpakṛto janāḥ
yatra rājā ca rājñaśca puruṣāḥ pratyanantarāḥ
yatra rājā dharmanityo rājyaṃ dharmeṇa pālayet
na hi śakyaṃ pradhānena śreyaḥ saṅkhyātumātmanaḥ
kathaṃ nu yuktaḥ pṛthivīṃ caredasmadvidho nṛpaḥ
sukhaṃ mokṣasukhaṃ loke na ca mūḍho'vagacchati
snehapāśasito mūḍho na sa mokṣāya kalpate
muktā vītabhayā loke caranti sukhino narāḥ
svajane na ca te cintā kartavyā mokṣabuddhinā
ime mayā vinābhūtā bhaviṣyanti kathaṃ tviti
bhojanācchādane caiva mātrā pitrā ca saṃgraham
ko hetuḥ svajanaṃ dveṣṭuṃ rakṣitaṃ vā'dṛḍhātmanaḥ
svajanaṃ hi yadā mṛtyurhantyeva bhuvi paśyataḥ
yadā mṛtaṃ ca svajanaṃ na jñāsyasi kathaṃcana

krodho lobhastathā mohaḥ satvavānmukta eva saḥ

yaḥ paśyati sa saṃtuṣṭo napaśyaṃśca vihanyate

sadā devāḥ sādhubhiḥ saṃvadante na mānuṣaṃ viṣayaṃ yānti draṣṭum
nenduḥ samaḥ syādasamo hi vāyu ruccāvacaṃ viṣayaṃ yaḥ sa veda
tenaiva devāḥ prīyante satāṃ mārgasthitena vai
viśnodare ye niratāḥ sadaiva stenā narā vākyaruṣāśca nityam
na vai devā hīnasatvena toṣyāḥ sarvāśinā duṣkṛtakarmaṇā vā
satyavratā ye tu narāḥ kṛtajñā dharme ratāstaiḥ saha saṃbhajante
avyāhṛtaṃ vyāhṛtācchreya āhuḥ satyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ taddvitīyam
dharmyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ tattṛtīyaṃ priyaṃ vadedvyāhṛtaṃ taccaturtham
kenāyamāvṛto lokaḥ kena vā na prakāśate
kena tyajati mitrāṇi kena svargaṃ na gacchati
kaḥ svideko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ kaḥ svideko bahubhirjoṣamāste
kaḥ svideko balavāndurbalopi kaḥ svideṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvavaiti
prājña eko ramate brāhmaṇānāṃ prājñaścaiko bahubhirjoṣamāste
prājña eko balavāndurbalo'pi prājña eṣāṃ kalahaṃ nānvabaiti
asādhutve ca kiṃ teṣāṃ kimeṣāṃ mānuṣaṃ matam
etadyaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ puṇyaṃ svargāya ca dhruvam darśitaṃ devadevena parameṇāvyayena ca
kṣetraṃ vai karmaṇāṃ yoniḥ sadbhāvaḥ satyamucyate
sāṅkhye yoge ca me tāta viśeṣaṃ vaktumarhasi
tava dharmajña sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ kurusattama
sāṅkhyāḥ sāṅkhyaṃ praśaṃsanti yogā yogaṃ dvijātayaḥ
vijñāyeha gatīḥ sarvā virakto viṣayeṣu yaḥ
svapakṣe kāraṇaṃ grāhyaṃ samarthaṃ vacanaṃ hitam
śiṣṭānāṃ hi mataṃ grāhyaṃ tvadvidhaiḥ śiṣṭasaṃmataiḥ
ubhe caite mate tattve mama tāta yudhiṣṭhira
ubhe caite mate jñāne nṛpate śiṣṭasaṃmate
tulyaṃ śaucaṃ tayorekaṃ dayā bhūteṣu cānagha vratānāṃ dhāraṇaṃ tulyaṃ darśanaṃ na samaṃ tayoḥ
yadi tulyaṃ vrataṃ śaucaṃ dayā cātra phalaṃ tathā
na tulyaṃ darśanaṃ kasmāttanme brūhi pitāmaha
rāgaṃ mohaṃ tathā snehaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca kevalam
yathā cānimiṣāḥ sthūlā jālaṃ chittvā punarjalam
tathaiva vāgurāṃ chittvā balavanto yathā mṛgāḥ
chittvā yogātparaṃ mārgaṃ gacchanti vimalaṃ śivam
balahīnāśca kaunteya yathā jālaṃ gatā jhaṣāḥ
yathā ca śakunāḥ sūkṣmaṃ prāpya jālamariṃdama
tatra saktā vipadyante mucyante ca balānvitāḥ
abalā vai vinaśyanti mucyante ca balānvitāḥ
sa eva ca yadā rājanvahnirjātabalaḥ punaḥ
na yamo nāntakaḥ kruddho na nṛtyurbhīmavikramaḥ
yogaḥ kuryādbalaṃ prāpya taiśca sarvairmahīṃ caret
ātmanaśca samādhāne dhāraṇāṃ prati vā vibho
apramatto yathā dhanvī lakṣyaṃ hanti samāhitaḥ
snehapūrṇe yathā pātre mana ādhāya niścalam
yathā ca nāvaṃ kaunteya karṇadhāraḥ samāhitaḥ
prāpnotyāśu paraṃ sthānaṃ lakṣaṃ mukta ivāśugaḥ
nābhyāṃ kaṇṭhe ca śīrṣe ca hṛdi vakṣasi pārśvayoḥ
kaṇānāṃ bhakṣaṇe yuktaḥ piṇyākasya ca bhārata
kāmaṃ jitvā tathā krodhaṃ śītoṣṇe varṣameva ca
aratiṃ durjayāṃ caiva ghorāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ ca pārthiva
sparśaṃ nidrāṃ tathā tandrīṃ durjayāṃ nṛpasattama
vipannā dhāraṇāstāta nayanti na śubhāṃ gatim
maraṇaṃ janma duḥkhaṃ ca sukhaṃ ca sa vimuñcati
paraṃ hi tadbrahmamayaṃ mahātma nbrahmāṇamīśaṃ varadaṃ ca viṣṇum
bhavaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca ṣaḍānanaṃ ca ṣaṭbrahmaputrāṃśca mahānbhāvān
tamaśca kaṣṭaṃ sumahadrajaśca satvaṃ viśuddhaṃ prakṛtiṃ parāṃ ca
siddhiṃ ca devīṃ varuṇasya patnīṃ tejaśca kṛtsnaṃ sumahacca dhairyam
tārādhipaṃ khe vimalaṃ satāraṃ viśvāṃśca devānuragānpitṛṃśca
śailāṃśca kṛtsnānudadhīṃśca ghorā nnadīśca sarvāḥ savanānghanāṃśca
parātparaṃ prāpya mahānmahātmā viśeta yogī nacirādvimuktaḥ
kathā ca yeyaṃ nṛpate prasaktā deve mahāvīryatamau śubheyam
yogī sa sarvānabhibhūya martyā nnārāyaṇātmā kurute mahātmā
sāṅkhye tvidānīṃ kārtsnyena vidhiṃ prabrūhi pṛcchate
triṣu lokeṣu yajjñānaṃ sarvaṃ tadviditaṃ hi te
śṛṇu me tvamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ sāṅkhyānāṃ viditātmanām
āyuṣaśca paraṃ kālaṃ loke vijñāya tattvataḥ
sukhasya ca paraṃ tattvaṃ vijñāya vadatāṃ vara
prāpte kāle ca yadduḥkhaṃ satataṃ viṣayaiṣiṇām
tiryakṣu patatāṃ duḥkhaṃ patatāṃ narake ca yat
svargasya ca guṇānkṛtsnāndoṣānsarvāṃśca bhārata parisaṃkhyānasaṃkhyānaṃ satvaṃ sāṃkhyaguṇātmakam
vedavāde ye'pi doṣā guṇā ye cāpi vaidikāḥ
jñānayoge ca ye doṣā guṇā yoge ca ye nṛpa sāṅkhyajñāne ca ye doṣāstathaiva ca guṇā nṛpa
itareṣu ca ye doṣā guṇāsteṣu ca bhārata
satvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ jñātvā rajo navaguṇaṃ tathā
ṣaṅguṇaṃ ca mano jñātvā nabhaḥ pañcaguṇaṃ tathā
buddhiṃ caturguṇāṃ jñātvā tamaśca triguṇaṃ tathā
dviguṇaṃ ca rajo jñātvā satvamekaguṇaṃ punaḥ
sargaṃ vijñāya tattvena pralaye prekṣya cātmanaḥ
prāpnuvanti śubhaṃ mokṣaṃ sūkṣmā iva nabhaḥ param
rūpeṇa dṛṣṭiṃ saṃyuktāṃ ghrāṇaṃ gandhaguṇena ca
śabde saktaṃ tathā śrotraṃ jihvā rasaguṇeṣu ca
tvacaṃ sparśe tathā saktāṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam
viṣṇau krāntaṃ balaṃ śakre koṣṭhe saktaṃ tathā'nalam
tejaḥ sūkṣme ca saṃyuktaṃ vāyuṃ nabhasi cāśritam
nabho mahati saṃyuktaṃ mahadbuddhau ca saṃśritam
buddhiṃ tamasi saṃsaktāṃ tamo rajasi saṃśritam
rajaḥ satve tathā saktaṃ satvaṃ saktaṃ tathā''tmani
devaṃ mokṣe ca saṃsaktaṃ mokṣaṃ saktaṃ tu na kvacit
prāṇāpānau samānaṃ ca vyānodānau ca tattvataḥ
āvahaṃ cānilaṃ jñātvā pravahaṃ cānilaṃ punaḥ
mahatāṃ bhūtasaṅghānāṃ śrutvā nāśaṃ ca pārthiva
tārāṇāṃ patanaṃ dṛṣṭvā nakṣatrāṇāṃ ca paryayam
dvandvānāṃ viprayogaṃ ca vijñāya kṛpaṇa nṛpa
bālye mohaṃ ca vijñāya kṣayaṃ dehasya cāśubham
rāge mohe ca saṃprāpte kvacitsatvaṃ samāśritam
viṣayāṇāṃ ca daurātmyaṃ vijñāya nṛpate punaḥ
vāsaṃ kuleṣu jantūnāṃ duḥkhaṃ vijñāya bhārata
tena jñānena vijñāya gatiṃ cāśubhakarmaṇām tiryagyonigatānāṃ ca vijñāya ca gatiṃ pṛthak
kṣayaṃ saṃvatsarāṇāṃ ca māsānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ tathā
pakṣakṣayaṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā divasānāṃ ca saṃkṣayam
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiṃ ca candrasya dṛṣṭvā pratyakṣatastathā
vṛddhiṃ dṛṣṭvā samudrāṇāṃ kṣayaṃ teṣāṃ tathā punaḥ
kṣayaṃ dhanānāṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punarvṛddhiṃ tathaiva ca
saṃyogānāṃ kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā yugānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
kṣayaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā śailānāṃ kṣayaṃ ca saritāṃ tathā
varṇānāṃ ca kṣayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṣayāntaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
jarā mṛtyustathā janma dṛṣṭvā duḥkhāni caiva ha
dehadoṣāṃstathā jñātvā teṣāṃ duḥkhaṃ ca tattvataḥ
ātmadoṣāṃśca vijñāya sarvānātmani saṃśritān svadehādutthitāngabdhāṃstathā vijñāya cāśubhān
kāmakrodhau bhayaṃ nidrā pañcamaḥ śvāsa ucyate
sūkṣmaḥ śītaḥ sugandhī ca sukhasparśaśca bhārata saptānāṃ marutāṃ śreṣṭho lokāngacchati yaḥ śubhān
sa tānvahati kaunteya nabhasaḥ paramāṃ gatim
nabho vahati lokeśa rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim tamo vahati lokeśa rajasaḥ paramāṃ gatim
rajo vahati rājendra satvasya paramāṃ gatim
satvaṃ vahati rājendra paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
amṛtatvāya kalpante na nivartanti vā vibho
paramā sā gatiḥ pārtha nirdvandvānāṃ mahātmanām
ājanmamaraṇaṃ vā te smarantyuta na vā'nagha
yadi tatraiva vijñāne vartante yatayaḥ pare
pravṛttilakṣaṇaṃ dharmaṃ paśyāmi paramaṃ nṛpa magnasya hi pare jñāne kiṃ na duḥkhataraṃ bhavet
yathānyāyaṃ tvayā tāta praśnaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ susaṃkaṭaḥ
vinaśyanti na saṃdehaḥ phenā iva mahārṇave
sa paśyati yathānyāyaṃ sparśānspṛśati vā vibho
indriyāṇīha sarvāṇi sve sve sthāne yathāvidhi
ātmā ca yāti kṣetrajñaṃ karmaṇī ca śubhāśubhe
śiṣyā iva mahātmānamindriyāṇi ca taṃ prabho
paraṃ nārāyaṇaṃ devaṃ nirdvandvaṃ prakṛteḥ param
śiṣṭaṃ tatra manastāta indriyāṇi ca bhārata
śakyaṃ cālpena kālena śāntiṃ prāptuṃ guṇārthinā
jñānenānena kaunteya tulyaṃ jñānaṃ na vidyate
atra te saṃśayo mā bhūjjñānaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ paraṃ matam
kūṭasthaṃ caiva nityaṃ ca yadvadanti śamātmakāḥ
sarve viprāśca devāśca tathā śamavido janāḥ
jñānaṃ mahadyaddhi mahatsu rāja nvedeṣu sāṅkhyeṣu tathaiva yoge
yaccāpi dṛṣṭaṃ vividhaṃ purāṇe sāṅkhyāgataṃ tannikhilaṃ narendra
yaccetihāseṣu mahatsu dṛṣṭaṃ yaccārthaśāstre nṛpa śiṣṭajuṣṭe
jñānaṃ ca loke yadihāsti kiṃci tsāṅkhyāgataṃ tacca mahanmahātman
śamaśca dṛṣṭaḥ paramaṃ balaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ ca yathāvaduktam
tapāṃsi sūkṣmāṇi sukhāni caiva sāṅkhye yathāvadvihitāni rājan
viparyaye tasya hi pārtha devā ngacchanti sāṅkhyāḥ satataṃ sukhena
tāṃścānusaṃcārya tataḥ kṛtārthāḥ patanti vipreṣu yateṣu bhūyaḥ
hitvā ca dehaṃ praviśanti mokṣaṃ divaukaso dyāmiva pārtha sāṅkhyāḥ
ato'dhikaṃ te'bhiratā mahārthe sāṅkhye dvijāḥ pārthiva śiṣṭajuṣṭe
teṣāṃ na tiryaggamanaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ nārvāggatiḥ pāpakṛtādhivāsaḥ
ca cābudhānāmapi te dvijātayo ye jñānametannṛpate'nuraktāḥ
sāṅkhyaṃ viśālaṃ paramaṃ purāṇaṃ mahārṇavaṃ vimalamudāharanti
kṛtsnaṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ nṛpate mahātmā nārāyaṇo dhārayate'prameyam
etanmayoktaṃ naradeva tattvaṃ nārāyaṇo viśvamidaṃ purāṇam
sa sargakāle ca karoti sargaṃ saṃhārakāle ca tadatti bhūyaḥ
saṃhṛtya sarvaṃ nijadehasaṃsthaṃ kṛtvā'psu śete jagadantarātmā
tvayi pratigate śreyaḥ kutaḥ śroṣyāmahe vayam
papraccha janako rājā jñānaṃ naiḥśreyasaṃ param
śabdaḥ sparśaśca rūpaṃ ca raso gandhastathaiva ca
śrotraṃ tvakcakṣuṣī jihvā ghrāṇameva ca pañcamam
vākca hastau ca pādau ca pāyurmeḍhraṃ tathaiva ca
ahanyahani bhūtātmā tataḥ kṣara iti smṛtaḥ
viviktāni ca japyāni vratāni vividhāni ca
satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva dharmārthau kāma eva ca
prakṛtiḥ kurute devī bhavaṃ pralayameva ca
puṇyameva tu kartavyaṃ tatkutvā susukhaṃ mama
yāvadantaṃ ca me saukhyaṃ jātyāṃ jātyāṃ bhaviṣyati
mahadduḥkhaṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ niraye cāpi majjanam
ya evaṃ vetti nityaṃ vai nirātmātmaguṇairvṛtaḥ
sa evaṃ phalamāpnoti triṣu lokeṣu mūrtimān prakṛtiḥ kurute karma śubhāśubhaphalātmakam
akartā kartṛ cātmānamabījo bījamātmanaḥ akṣaraḥ kṣaramātmānamabuddhistvabhimanyate
nityametaṃ vijānīhi somaṃ vai ṣauḍaśīṃ kalām
ṣoḍaśī tu kalā sūkṣmā sa soma upadhāryatām
ṛte tu puruṣaṃ neha strī garbhaṃ dhārayatyuta
ṛte striyaṃ na puruṣo rūpaṃ nirvartayettathā
ye guṇāḥ puruṣasyeha ye ca mātṛguṇāstathā
asthi snāyu ca majjānaṃ jānīmaḥ paitṛkāndvija
pramāṇaṃ yacca vedoktaṃ śāstroktaṃ yacca paṭhyate
paśyāmi bhagavaṃstasmānmokṣadharmo na vidyate athavā'nantarakṛtaṃ kiṃcideva nidarśanam
na ca granthasya tattvajño yathāvattvaṃ nareśvaraḥ
yo hi vede ca śāstre ca granthadhāraṇatatparaḥ
māraṃ sa vahate tasya granthasyārthaṃ na vetti yaḥ
sa kathaṃ mandavijñāno granthaṃ vakṣyati nirṇayāt
nirṇayaṃ cāpi chidrātmā na taṃ vakṣyati tattvataḥ
ekaṃ sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa buddhimān
tvaṅbhāṃsaṃ rughiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjā ca snāyu ca
guṇā guṇeṣu jāyante tatraiva niviśanti ca
evaṃ guṇāḥ prakṛtito jāyante niviśanti ca
tvaṅbhāṃsaṃ rudhiraṃ medaḥ pittaṃ majjā'sthi snāyu ca
aṣṭau tānyatha śukreṇa jānīhi prākṛtāni vai
guṇā guṇavataḥ santi nirguṇasya kuto guṇāḥ
yattaṃ buddheḥ paraṃ prāhuḥ sāṅkhyayogāśca sarvaśaḥ
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca kārtsnyena pṛthakcaivāpṛthakca ha
yogakṛtyaṃ tu yogānāṃ dhyānameva paraṃ balam
mano buddhyā sthiraṃ kṛtvā pāṣāṇa iva niścalaḥ
na śṛṇoti na cāghrāti na rasyati na paśyati
na ca sparśaṃ vijānāti na saṃkalpayate manaḥ
na cābhimanyate kiṃcinna ca budhyati kāṣṭhavat
pañca caiva viśeṣā vai tathā pañcendriyāṇi ca
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca yadā'sṛjat
ekatvaṃ pralaye cāsya bahutvaṃ ca pravartanāt
kṣetraṃ jānāti cāvyaktaṃ kṣetrajña iti cocyate
anyadeva ca kṣetraṃ syādanyaḥ kṣetrajña ucyate
sāṅkhyāḥ prakurvate caiva prakṛtiṃ ca pracakṣate
sāṅkhyāḥ saha prakṛtyā tu nistattvaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
yadā tu budhyate''tmānaṃ tadā bhavati kevalaḥ
ya enamabhijānanti na bhayaṃ teṣu vidyate
ekatvaṃ ca bahutvaṃ ca prakṛteranu tattvavit parasparaṃ tu vidyāṃ vai tvaṃ nibodhānupūrvaśaḥ
buddhīndriyāṇāṃ ca tathā viśeṣā iti naḥ śrutam
vidyā jñeyā naraśreṣṭha vidhiśca paramaḥ smṛtaḥ
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva yaduktaṃ tannibodha me
kāraṇaṃ tu pravakṣyāmi yathākhyāto na jānataḥ
kṣaro bhavatyeṣa yadā tadā guṇavatī mithaḥ
tadaiṣā tvanyatāmeti na ca miśratvatāṃ vrajet
paśyate cāparaṃ paśyaṃ tadā paśyanna saṃsvajet
kimahaṃ kṛtavānevaṃ yohaṃ kālamimaṃ janam yadā matsyodakaṃ jñānamanuvartitavāṃstadā
nirmamasya mamatvena kiṃ kṛtaṃ tāsu tāsu ca
ātmānaṃ bahudhā kṛtvā yeyaṃ bhūyo yunakti mām
niḥsaṃdigdhaṃ ca sūkṣmaṃ ca vibuddhaṃ vimalaṃ yathā
asmiṃśca śāstre yogānāṃ punardadhi punaḥ śaraḥ
na tveva budhyate'vyaktaṃ saguṇaṃ vā'tha nirguṇam
budhyate yadi vā'vyaktametadvai pañcaviṃśakam budhyamāno bhavatyeṣa saṅgātmaka iti śrutiḥ
sa tu taṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviśaṃ ca budhyate
avyaktaṃ tattu tadbrahma budhyate tāta kevalam
kevalaṃ pañcaviṃśaṃ ca caturviśaṃ ca paśyati
budhyate ca parāṃ buddhiṃ vimalāmamalāṃ yadā
eṣa muñcati tattvaṃ hi kṣipraṃ buddhatvalakṣaṇam
ekatvaṃ vai bhavatyasya yadā buddhyā na budhyate
pareṇa paradharmā ca bhavatyeṣa sametya vai
viśuddharmā śuddhena buddhena ca sa buddhimān
kevalātmā tathā caiva kevalena sametya vai
etāvadetatkathitaṃ mayā te tathyaṃ mahārāja yathārthatattvam
amatsaratvaṃ pratigṛhya cārthaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma viśuddhamādyam
nāvedaniṣṭhasya janasya rāja npradeyametatparamaṃ tvayā bhavet
na deyametacca tathā'nṛtātmane śaṭhāya klībāya na jihnabuddhaye
na paṇḍitajñānaparopatāpine deyaṃ tvayedaṃ vinibodha yādṛśe
viśuddhayogāya budhāya caiva kriyāvate ca kṣamiṇe hitāya
vijānate caiva damakṣamāvate śaktāya caikātmaśamāya dehinām
etairguṇairhīnatame na deya metatparaṃ brahma viśuddhamāhuḥ
na śreyasā yokṣyati tādṛśe kṛtaṃ dharmapravaktāramapātradānāt
pṛthvīmimāṃ yadyapi ratnapūrṇāṃ dadyānna deyaṃ tvidamavratāya
karāla mā te bhayamastu kiṃci detacchrutaṃ brahma paraṃ tvayā'dya
agādhajanmāmaraṇaṃ ca rāja nnirāmayaṃ vītabhayaṃ śivaṃ ca
samīkṣya mohaṃ tyaja bā'dya sarva jñānasya tattvārthamidaṃ viditvā
prasādya yatnena tamugratejasaṃ sanātanaṃ brahma yathā'dya vai tvayā
pṛṣṭastvayā cāsmi yathā narendra tathā mayedaṃ tvayi coktamadya
tathā'vāptaṃ brahmaṇo me narendra mahājñānaṃ mokṣavidāṃ parāyaṇam

kiṃnu sargāpyayaṃ kati sargāḥ kiṃ bhūtaṃ kiṃ bhaviṣyaṃ kiṃ bhavyaṃ ca kiṃ jñānam
ko jñātā kiṃ buddhaṃ kimaprabuddhaṃ kiṃ budhyamānaṃ kati parvāṇi
kati srotāṃsi kati karmayonayaḥ kimekatvaṃ nānātvam
yadbhavānāha kiṃ vyaktiṃ kimavyaktamiti atra brūmaḥ
vyakta uttamo rajaḥ satvaṃ tatpradhānaṃ tatvamakṣamajaramityevamādīnyavyaktanāmāni bhavanti
tadetadavyaktam prasnavā ghāraṇādānasvabhāvamāpodhāraṇe prajanane dāne guṇānāṃ prakṛtiḥ saparāpramattaṃ tadetadasminkāryakaraṇe

yadapyuktaṃ kimavyaktamiti tatra brūmaḥ vyaktaṃ nāmā''sure yatpūrvamavyaktādutpannatatvamīśvaramapratibuddhaguṇasyagetatpuruṣasaṃjñikaṃ mahadityuktaṃ buddhiriti ca sattā smṛtirdhṛtirmedhā vyavasāyaḥ samādhiprāptirityevamādīni vyaktaparyāye nāmāni vadantyevamāha

vyaktāvyaktataraṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ puruṣasaṃjñakam tadetadubhayorviriñcavairiñcayorekaika utpattiḥ viriñco'bhimāninyaviveka īrṣyā kāmaḥ krodho lobho mado darpo mamakāraścaitānyahaṃkāraparyāyanāmāni bhavantyevamāha
ahaṃkārādyugapadunmādayāmāsa pañca mahābhūtāni śabdasparśarūparasagandhalakṣaṇāni tānyeva buddhyanta ityevamāha

bhūteṣu cāpyahaṃkāramaśvarūpastathocyate punarviṣayahetvarthe sa manassaṃjñakaḥ smṛtaḥ vikharādvaikharaṃ yugapadindriyaiḥ sahotpādayati śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ cakṣurjihvā tvagityetāni śabdasparśarūparasagandhānavabudhyanta iti pañca buddhīndriyāṇi vadantyevamāhurācāryāḥ vāgghastau pādapāyurānandaśceti pañcendriyāṇi viśeṣamādityośvīni nakṣatrāṇītyetānīndriyāṇāṃ paryāyanāmāni vadantyevamāha
na sa pāpena lipyeta nirmuktaḥ sarvasaṃkarāt
yadapyuktaṃ ihādyaṃ madhyamaṃ ca tatvānāmityatra brūmaḥ
evamādyaṃ madhyamaṃ coktaṃ buddhyādīni trayoviṃśatitatvāni viśeṣaparyavasānāni jñātavyāni bhavantītyeva māmakenetyatrocyate

tadeva tadyadā dattabrāhmaṇakṣatriyavaiśyaśūdracaṇḍālapulkasādiretāni jñātavyāni buddhyādīni viśeṣaparyavasānāni mantavyāni pratyetavyābhyuktāni etadādyaṃ madhyamaṃ ca etasmāttatvānāmutpattirbhavati atra pralīyante kecidāhurācāryāḥ
yogadaśamapuruṣadarśanānāṃ tu pañcaviṃśatitatvānāṃ pratibudhyamānayorvyatiriktaṃ śucivyabhramityāhurācāryāḥ evamāha
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
dharmaṃ putra nipevasva sutīkṣṇau ca himātapau
kṣutpipāse ca vāyuṃ ca jaya nityaṃ jitendriyaḥ
satye tiṣṭha rato dharme hitvā sarvamanārjavam
jīvite likhyamāne ca kimutthāya na dhāvasi
ye tu tuṣṭāḥ śrutiparā mahātmāno mahābalāḥ
tiṣṭhantaṃ ca śayānaṃ ca mṛtyuranveṣate yadā
brāhmaṇasya tu deho'yaṃ na kāmārthāya jāyate
iha kleśāya tapase pretya tvanupamaṃ sukham
brāhmaṇyaṃ bahubhiravāpyate tapobhi stallabdhvā na ratipareṇa helitavyam
svādhyāye tapasi dame ca nityayuktaḥ mokṣārthī kuśalaparaḥ sadā yatasva
yakṣuste yadi na parapraṇetṛneyaṃ dharme te ramatu manaḥ paraṃ niśāmya
rājā sadā dharmaparaḥ śubhāśubhasya goptā samīkṣya sukṛtināṃ dadhāti lokān
śvāno bhīṣaṇakāyā ayomukhāni vayāṃsi balagṛdhrakurarapakṣiṇāṃ ca saṃghātam
maryādā niyatāḥ svayambhuvā ya ihemāḥ prabhinatti daśa guṇā mano'nugatvāt
nivasati bhṛśamasukhaṃ pitṛviṣaya vipinamavagāhya sa pāpaḥ
yo lubdha subhṛśaṃ priyānṛtaśca manuṣyaḥ satatanikṛtivañcanābhiratiḥ syāt
kiyattaveha jīvitaṃ yame na cāsti vārakaḥ
purā vivāti māruto yamasya yaḥ puraḥsaraḥ
purā sa eka eva te pravāti māruto'ntakaḥ
purā ca vibhramanti te diśo mahābhayāgame
dhanasya yasya rājato bhayaṃ na cāsti corataḥ
mṛtaṃ ca yanna muñcati samārjayasva taddhanam
yadeva yasya yautakaṃ tadeva tatra so'śnṛte
paratra tena jīvyate tadeva putra jīyatām
apakva eva yāvake purā pralīyate tvaram
na mātṛputrabāndhavā na saṃstutaḥ priyo janaḥ
na putra śāntirasti te kṛtākṛtasya karmaṇaḥ
ta eva tasya sākṣiṇo bhavanti dharmadarśinaḥ
svameva karma rakṣyatāṃ svakarma tatra gacchati
tathā kṛtaṃ svakarmajaṃ tadeva bhujyate phalam
tathā gatiṃ gamiṣyataḥ kimātmanā pareṇa vā
na santi yasya vārakāḥ kuraṣva dharmasaṃnidhim
idaṃ nidarśanaṃ mayā taveha putra saṃmatam
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ
chittvaitāṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chidanti duṣkṛtaḥ
kiṃ te dhanena kiṃ bandhubhiste kiṃ te putraiḥ putraka yo mariṣyasi
ātmānamanviccha guhāṃ praviṣṭaṃ pitāmahāste kva gatāśca sarve
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaṃ vā'sya na vā'kṛtam
na dehabhede maraṇaṃ vijānatāṃ na ca praṇāśaḥ svanupālite pathi
dharmaṃ hi yo bardhayate sa paṇḍito ya eva dharmāccyavate sa dahyate
prayuktayoḥ karmapathi svakarmaṇoḥ phalaṃ prayoktā labhate yathāvidhi
nihīnakarmā nirayaṃ prapadyate triviṣṭapaṃ gacchati dharmapāragaḥ
na tena kiṃcinna prāptaṃ tanme bahumataṃ phalam
anāgatānyatītāni kasya te kasya vā vayam
na taṃ paśyāmi yasyāhaṃ tanna paśyāmi yo mama
na teṣāṃ bhavatā kāryaṃ na kāryaṃ tava tairapi
iha loke hi dhaninā paro'pi svajanāyate
dhanena kiṃ yanna dadāti nāśnute balena kiṃ yena ripuṃ na bādhate
śrutena kiṃ yena na dharmamācare tkimātmanā yo na jitendriyo vaśī
yadyasti dattamiṣṭaṃ vā tapastaptaṃ tathaiva ca
gurūṇāṃ vā'pi śuśrūṣā tanme brūhi pitāmaha
sa karma kaluṣaṃ kṛtvā kleśe mahati dhīyate
pulākā iva dhānyeṣu pūtyaṇḍā iva pakṣiṣu
tadvidhāste manuṣyeṣu yeṣāṃ dharmo na kāraṇam
acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
svaṃ kālaṃ nātivartante tathā karma purākṛtam
bālo yuvā vā vṛddhaśca yatkaroti śubhāśubham
malinaṃ hi yathā vastraṃ paścācchudhyati vāriṇā
padaṃ yathā na dṛśyeta tathā puṇyakṛtāṃ gatiḥ
kathaṃ vyāsasya dharmātmā śuko jajñe mahātapāḥ
siddhiṃ ca paramāṃ prāptastanme brūhi pitāmaha
na hyasya jananīṃ vidmo janma cāgryaṃ mahātmanaḥ
kathaṃ ca bālasya sataḥ sūkṣmajñāne ratā matiḥ
māhātmyamātmayogaṃ ca vijñānaṃ ca śukasya ha
na hāyanairna palitairna vittairna ca bandhubhiḥ
ṛṣayaścakrire dharmaṃ yo'nūcānaḥ sa no mahān
yogasya kalayā tāta na tulyaṃ vidyate phalam
vīryeṇa saṃmitaḥ putro mama bhūyāditi sma ha
atiṣṭhanmārutāhāraḥ śataṃ kila samāḥ prabhuḥ ārādhayanmahādevaṃ bahurūpamumāpatim
na cāsya hīyate prāṇo na glānirupajāyate
etā adyāpi kṛṣṇasya tapasā tena dīpitāḥ
evaṃvidhena tapasā tasya bhaktyā ca bhārata
tatastasya mahādevo darśayāmāsa sāmbikaḥ uvāca caivaṃ bhagavāṃkhyambakaḥ prahasanniva
yathā''kārāstathā śuddho bhavitā te suto mahān
atha rūpaṃ paraṃ rājanbibhratīṃ svena tejasā
sā ca dṛṣṭvā tadā vyāsaṃ kāmasaṃvignamānasam
sa tu dhairyeṇa mahatā nigṛhṇanhṛcchayaṃ muniḥ na śaśāka niyantuṃ tadvyāsaḥ pravisṛtaṃ manaḥ
araṇīṃ mamantha brahmarṣistasyāṃ jajñe śuko nṛpa
śukre nirmathyamāne sa śuko jajñe mahātapāḥ
taṃ gaṅgā saritāṃ śreṣṭhā merupṛṣṭhe janeśvara
antarikṣācca kauravya daṇḍaḥ kṛṣṇājinaṃ ca ha
taṃ mahātmā svayaṃ prītyā devyā saha mahādyutiḥ
yathā me manasaḥ śāntiḥ paramā saṃbhavetprabho
śrutvā putrasya tu vacaḥ paramarṣiruvāca tam
adhīhi putra mokṣaṃ vai dharmāṃśca vividhānapi
yogaśāstraṃ ca nikhilaṃ kāpilaṃ caiva bhārata
sa taṃ brāhnayā śriyaḥ yuktaṃ brahmatulyaparākramam
sa te vakṣyati mokṣārthaṃ nikhilaṃ mithileśvaraḥ
praṣṭuṃ dharmasya niṣṭhāṃ vai mokṣasya ca parāyaṇam
syātavyaṃ ca vaśe tasya sa te chetsyati saṃśayam
evamuktaḥ sa dharmātmā jagāma mithilāṃ muniḥ
mehorhareśca dve varṣe varṣaṃ haimavataṃ tataḥ
pattanāni ca ramyāṇi sphītāni nagarāṇi ca
ratnāni ca vicitrāṇi paśyannapi na paśyati
sthito dhyānaparo mukto viditaḥ praviveśa ha
pratāmyati glāyati vā nāpaiti ca tathā''tapāt
taṃ darśayitvā sa śukaṃ mantrī janakamuttamam
vaśyendriyo jitakrodho na hṛṣyati na kupyati
pādaśaucaṃ tu kṛtvaiva śukraḥ saṃdhyāmupāsya ca
pūrvarātre tu tatrāsau hutvā dhyānaparāyaṇaḥ madhyarātre yathānyāyaṃ nidrāmāhārayatprabhuḥ
tāṃ ca rātriṃ nṛpakule vartayāmāsa bhārata
tataḥ sa rājā janako mantribhiḥ saha bhārata
āsanaṃ ca puraskṛtya ratnāni vividhāni ca
tatropaviṣṭaṃ taṃ kārṣṇi śāstrataḥ pratipūjya ca
pādyaṃ nivedya prathamamardhyaṃ gāṃ ca nyavedayat
anāmayaṃ ca rājendra śukaḥ sānucarasya ha
kuśalaṃ cāvyayaṃ caiva pṛṣṭvā vaiyāsakiṃ nṛpaḥ
videharājo yājyo me janako nāma viśrutaḥ
tatra gacchasva vai tūrṇaṃ yadi te hṛdi saṃśayaḥ
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā sa te cchetsyati saṃśayaṃ
kathaṃ ca mokṣaḥ prāptavyo jñānena tapasā'thavā
utpādya putraṃ pautraṃ tu vanyāśramapade vaset
yathā vedārthatattvena brūhi me tvaṃ janādhipa
guruḥ plāvayitā tasya jñānaṃ plava ihocyate
kṛtvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma mokṣo nāmeha labhyate
atra gāthāḥ purā gītāḥ śṛṇu rājñā yayātinā
na bibheti paro yasmānna bibheti parācca yaḥ
yaśca necchati na dveṣṭi brahma saṃpadyate tu saḥ
yadā bhāvaṃ na kurute sarvabhūteṣu pāpakam
karmaṇā manasā vācā brahma saṃpadyate tadā
tyaktvā kāmaṃ ca mohaṃ ca tato brahmatvamaśnute
yadā śrāvye ca dṛśye ca sarvabhūteṣu cāpyayam
samo bhavati nirdvandvo brahma saṃpadyate tadā
yadā stutiṃ ca nindāṃ ca samatvenaiva paśyati
kāñcanaṃ cāyasaṃ caiva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathaiva ca
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ caiva brahma saṃpadyate tadā
tamaḥ parigataṃ veśma yathā dīpena dṛśyate
etatsarvaṃ ca paśyāmi tvayi buddhimatāṃ vara
yaccānyadapi noktaṃ me tattvato veda tadbhavān
jñānaṃ divyaṃ mamāpīdaṃ tenāsi vidito mama
adhikaṃ tava caiśvaryaṃ tacca tvaṃ nāvabudhyase
utpanne cāpi vijñāne nādhigacchati tāṃ gatiṃ
nāsti te sukhaduḥkheṣu viśeṣo nāsti lolupaḥ
na bandhuṣvanubandhaste na bhayeṣvasti te bhayam
tatraiva ca kumāreṇa bālye kṣiptā divaukasaḥ
yo brahmaṇyo dvitīyo'sti triṣu lokeṣu vīryavān
śaktyāṃ tu kampyamānāyāṃ viṣṇunā balinā tadā
jagrāha tāṃ tadā śaktiṃ na caināmabhyakampayat
nādaṃ mahāntaṃ muktvā sa mūrcchito girimūrghani
jaiminiṃ ca mahāprājñaṃ pailaṃ cāpi tapasvinam
ebhiḥ śiṣyaiḥ parivṛto vyāsa āste mahātapāḥ tatrāśramapadaṃ ramyaṃ dadarśa pituruttamam
athocuste tadā vyāsaṃ śiṣyāḥ prāñjalayo gurum
mahatā tejasā yuktā yaśasā cāpi vardhitāḥ
iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā brahmarṣistānuvāda ha
ucyatāmiti tadvatsā yadvaḥ kāryaṃ priyaṃ mayā
punaḥ prāñjalayo bhūtvā praṇamya śirasā gurum
yadi prīta upādhyāyo dhanyāḥ smo munisattama
kāṅkṣāmastu vayaṃ sarve varaṃ dattaṃ maharṣiṇā
paṣṭhaḥ śiṣyo na te khyātiṃ gacchedatra prasīda naḥ
iha vedāḥ pratiṣṭheranneṣa naḥ kāṅkṣito varaḥ
brāhmaṇāya sadā deyaṃ brahma śuśrūṣave tathā
nāśiṣye saṃpradātavyo nāvrate nākṛtātmani ete śiṣyaguṇāḥ sarve vijñātavyā yathārthataḥ
na niyojyāśca vaḥ śiṣyā aniyoge mahābhaye
tanno manasi saṃrūḍhaṃ kariṣyāmastathā ca tat
vedānanekadhā kartuṃ yadi te rucitaṃ prabho
kṣitiṃ vā devalokaṃ vā gamyatāṃ yadi rocate
apramādaśca vaḥ kāryo brahma hi pracuracchalam
jagmuḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vyāsaṃ mūrdhnā'bhivādya ca
etasminneva kāle tu devarṣirnāradastathā himavantamagaṃ draṣṭuṃ siddhacāraṇasevitam
bhobho maharṣe vāsiṣṭha brahmaghoṣo na vartate
rajasā tamasā caiva somaḥ sopaplavo yathā
viyuktā brahmaghoṣeṇa na bhrājante yathā purā
sarvajñaḥ sarvadarśī ca sarvatra ca kutūhalī
triṣu lokeṣu yadvṛttaṃ sarvaṃ tava mate sthitam
tadājñāpaya viprarṣe brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
malaṃ pṛthivyā bāhvīkāḥ strīṇāṃ kautūhalaṃ malam
* uvāca ca mahāprājñaṃ nāradaṃ punareva hi
kīdṛśāścaiva vāhlīkā brūhi me vadatāṃ vara
mehanti ca malaṃ pāpā visṛjanti jaleṣu vai
nityaṃ bhūtilaketyannaṃ tajjalaṃ ca pibanti ca
haribāhyāstu bāhīkā na smaranti hariṃ kvacit aihalaukikamokṣaṃ te māṃsaśoṇitavardhanāḥ
vṛthā jātā bhaviṣyanti bāhlīkā iti viśrutāḥ
tathā bhūtilake snātvā bāhlīkāṃśca nirīkṣya vai
āgatā'si tathā snātuṃ kathaṃ svargaṃ na gacchasi
udyuktā brāhmaṇī bhītā pratiyātā sutaiḥ saha
anantasya hareḥ śuddhaṃ nāma vai dvādaśākṣaram
namaste brāhmaṇi śubhe pūtā'haṃ tava darśanāt
harernāmnā ca māṃ sādhvī jalena spraṣṭumarhasi
ityuktā brāhmaṇī hṛṣṭā putraiḥ saha śubhavratā
dvaipāyanastu bhagavāṃstacchrutvā munisattamāt śukena saha putreṇa vedābhyāsamathākarot
divyaṃ te cakṣurutpannaṃ svasthaṃ te niścalaṃ manaḥ
tamasā rajasā cāpi tyaktaḥ satve vyavasthitaḥ
dvāvetau pretya panthānau divaṃ cādhaśca gacchataḥ
prathamaḥ prathame mārge āvaho nāma yo'nilaḥ
caturthaḥ saṃvaho nāma vāyuḥ sa girimardanaḥ
vāyunā vihatā meghā na bhavanti balāhakāḥ
pañcamaḥ sa mahāvego vivaho nāma mārutaḥ
yo niraṃśuḥ sahasrasya yena bhāti vasuṃdharā
yena sṛṣṭaḥ parābhūto yātyeva na nivartate
parāvaho nāma paro vāyuḥ sa duratikramaḥ
devarṣi tu śuko dṛṣṭvā nāradaṃ samupasyitam
kena tvāṃ śreyasā vatsa yojayāmīti hṛṣṭavat
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā śukaḥ provāca bhārata
nāsti rāgasamaṃ duḥkhaṃ nāsti tyāgasamaṃ sukham
nānuvayasukhaṃ prāpya yaḥ sajjati na mucyate
ānṛśaṃsyaṃ paro dharmaḥ kṣamā ca paramaṃ balam
ātmajñānaṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ na satyādvidyate param
satyasya vacanaṃ śreyaḥ satyādapi hitaṃ vadet
yena sarvaṃ parityaktaṃ sa vidvānsa ca paṇḍitaḥ
yasya bhūtaiḥ saha mune sa śreyo vindate param
nedaṃ janma samāsādya vairaṃ kurvīta kenacit
dvandvārāmeṣu bhūteṣu ya eko ramate muniḥ
viddhi prajñānatṛptaṃ taṃ jñānatṛpto na śocati
vidyā karma ca śaucaṃ ca jñānaṃ ca bahuvistaram
nibandhanī rajjureṣā yā grāme vasato ratiḥ
chittvaitāṃ sukṛto yānti naināṃ chindanti duṣkṛtaḥ
tyāgavātādhvagāṃ śīghrāṃ nautāryāṃ tāṃ nadīṃ taret
tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja
mahābhūtāni khaṃ vāyuragnirāpastathā mahī ṣaṣṭhaṃ tu cetanā yā tu ātmā saptamamucyate
aṣṭamaṃ tu mano jñeyaṃ buddhistu navamī smṛtā
indriyāṇi ca pañcaiva tamaḥ satvaṃ rajastathā
trivargaṃ tu sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ tathā
ya idaṃ veda tattvena sa veda prabhavāpyayau
sarvavitsarvajitsiddhau bhava bhāvavivarjitaḥ saṃyamena navaṃ bandhaṃ nivartya tapaso balāt
niśamya labhate buddhiṃ tāṃ labdhvā sukhamedhate
nārtho na dharmo na yaśo yo'tītamanuśocati
mṛtaṃ vā yadi vā naṣṭaṃ yo'tītamanuśocati
nāśru kurvanti ye buddhyā dṛṣṭvā lokeṣu saṃtatim
cintyamānaṃ hi na vyeti bhūyaścāpi pravardhate
parityajati yo duḥkhaṃ sukhaṃ vā'pyubhayaṃ naraḥ
abhyeti brahma sotyantaṃ na taṃ śocanti paṇḍitāḥ
tyajante duḥkhamarthā hi pālanena ca te sukhāḥ
atṛptā yānti vidhvaṃsaṃ saṃtoṣaṃ yānti paṇḍitāḥ
bhūteṣu bhāvaṃ saṃcintya ye buddhvā manasaḥ param
na śocanti gatādhvānaḥ paśyantaḥ paramāṃ gatiṃ
śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca gandheṣu ca raseṣu ca
cakṣuḥśrotre ca manasā mano vācaṃ ca vidyayā
vicaredasamunnaddhaḥ sa sukhī sa ca paṇḍitaḥ
nainaṃ prajñā sunītaṃ vā trāyate nāpi pauruṣam
vañcanāyāṃ ca lokasya sa sukheṣveva jīryate
tasya yonau prasaktasya garbho bhavati vā na vā
āyuṣmāñjāyate putraḥ kathaṃ pretaḥ piteva ha
kena yatnena jīvantaṃ garbhaṃ tvamiha paśyasi
dhāraṇe vā visarge vā na kartā vidyate'vaśaḥ
sa tasya sahajātasya saptamīṃ navamīṃ daśām
prāpnuvanti tataḥ pañca na bhavanti śatāyuṣaḥ
te cāpi nipuṇā vaidyāḥ kuśalāḥ saṃbhṛtauṣadhāḥ
te pibantaḥ kaṣāyāṃśca sarpīṣi vividhāni ca
śvāpadāni daridrāṃśca prāyo nārtā bhavanti te
na dhanena na rājyena nogreṇa tapasā tathā
yatate ca yathāśakti na ca tadvartate tathā
tyaja dharmamadharmaṃ ca ubhe satyānṛte tyaja
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā yena tyajasi taṃ tyaja
yena devāḥ parityajya martyalokaṃ divaṃ gatāḥ
paraṃ bhāvaṃ hi kāṅkṣāmi yatra nāvartate punaḥ
na tu yogamṛte śaktyā prāpnuyāṃ paramāṃ gatim
na hyepa kṣayatāṃ yāti somaḥ suragaṇairyathā
paśyantu yogavīryaṃ me sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ
śrutvā carṣistadvacanaṃ śukasya prīto mahātmā punarāha cainam
bhobho putra sthīyatāṃ tāvadadya yāvaccakṣuḥ prīṇayāmi tvadarthe
same deśe vivikte sa niḥśalāka upāviśat
na tatra pakṣisaṃpāto na śabdo nāpi darśanam
prajahāsa tato hāsaṃ śukaḥ saṃprekṣya tatparam
tataḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā devarṣi nāradaṃ tataḥ
nivedayāmāsa ca taṃ svaṃ yogaṃ paramarṣaye
dṛṣṭo mārgaḥ pravṛttosmi svasti te'stu tapodhana
taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve gandharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ
tataḥ paramadharmātmā triṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ bhāskaraṃ samudīkṣansa prāṅbhukho vāgyato'gamat
tamāpatantaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā sarvāpsarogaṇāḥ saṃbhrāntamanaso rājannāsanparamavismitāḥ
tamo hyaṣṭaguṇaṃ hitvā jahau pañcavidhaṃ rajaḥ
drumāḥ śākhāśca mumucuḥ śikharāṇi ca parvatāḥ
na babhāse sahasrāṃśurna jajvāla ca pāvakaḥ
na ca pratijaghānāsya sa gatiṃ parvatottamaḥ
dṛṣṭvā śukamatikrāntaṃ parvataṃ ca dvidhā kṛtam
sa dadarśa dvidhā kṛtvā parvatāgraṃ śukaṃ gatam
tāṃ muktatāṃ tu vijñāya muniḥ putrasya vai tadā
vīryeṇa sadṛśaḥ putraḥ purā mattastvayā vṛtaḥ
chāyāṃ paśyanparāvṛttaḥ sa muniḥ parayā mudā
ya icchetsiddhimāsthātuṃ devatāṃ kāṃ yajeta saḥ
kuto hyasya dhruvaḥ svargaḥ kuto naiḥśreyasaṃ param
vidhinā kena juhuyāddaivaṃ pitryaṃ tathaiva ca
svargataścaiva kiṃ kuryādyena na cyavate divaḥ
devatānāṃ ca ko devaḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca pitā tathā
yasya prasādaṃ kurvāte sa devau draṣṭumarhati
kāṃ devatāṃ tu yajataḥ pitṝnvā kānmahāmatī
iti saṃcintya manasā bhaktyā nārāyaṇasya tu
kṛte daive ca pitrye ca tatastābhyāṃ nirīkṣitaḥ
yajante tvāmaharaharnānāmūrtisamāsthitam pitā mātā ca sarvasya devatānāṃ ca śāśvatam
kaṃ tvadya yajase devaṃ pitaraṃ kaṃ na vidmahe
āvābhyāṃ pūjyate yo hi daive pitrye ca kalpyate
nāsti tasmātparo'nyo hi pitā devo'thavā dvija
ātmā hi nau sa vijñeyastatastaṃ pūjayāvahe
vasiṣṭhaḥ parameṣṭhī ca vivasvānsoma eva ca
kardamaścāpi yaḥ proktaḥ krodho vikrīta eva ca
daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca satataṃ tasya vijñāya tattvataḥ
kalāḥ pañcadaśa tyaktvā te muktā iti niścayaḥ
dṛśyate jñānayogena āvāṃ ca prasṛtau tataḥ
bhaktyā saṃpūjayantyadya gatiṃ caiṣāṃ dadāti saḥ
ye tu tadbhāvitā loke hyekāntitvaṃ samāsthitāḥ
bhaktyā premṇā ca viprarṣe asmadbhaktyā ca te śrutaḥ
jagāda vākyaṃ dvipadāṃ variṣṭhaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ lokahitādhivāsam
tatsādhyatāṃ lokahitārthamadya gacchāmi draṣṭuṃ prakṛtiṃ tavādyām
vedāḥ svadhītā mama lokanātha taptaṃ tapo nānṛtamuktapūrvam
pūjāṃ gurūṇāṃ satataṃ karomi parasya guhyaṃ na tu bhinnapūrvam
guptāni catvāri yathāgamaṃ me śatrau ca mitre ca samosmi nityam
taṃ cādidevaṃ satataṃ prapanna ekāntabhāvena vṛṇobhyajasram
tato visṛṣṭaḥ parameṣṭhiputraḥ so'bhyarcayitvā tamṛṣiṃ purāṇam
tatrāvatasthe ca munirmurhuta mekāntamāsādya gireḥ sa śṛṅkte
kṣīrodadheryottarato hi dvīpaḥ śvetaḥ sa nāmnā prathito viśālaḥ
meroḥ sahasraiḥ sa hi yojanānāṃ dvātriṃśatordhvaṃ kavibhirniruktaḥ
śvetāḥ pumāṃso gatasarvapāpā ścakṣurmuṣaḥ pāpakṛtāṃ narāṇām
ṣaṣṭhyā dantairyuktāḥ śuklairaṣṭābhirdaṃṣṭrābhirye jihvābhirye viśvavakraṃlelihyante sūryaprakhyam
devaṃ bhaktyā viśvotpannaṃ yasmātsarve lokāḥ saṃprasūtāḥ
sarvagātrāśca sūkṣmāḥ sahāṅgakā vedā dharmā munayaḥ śāntā devāḥ sarve tasya nisarga iti
kathaṃ te puruṣā jātāḥ kā teṣāṃ gatiruttamā
ye ca muktā bhavantīha narā bharatasattama
tasmānme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
yaiṣā tava hi vaktavyā kathāsāro hi sā matā
śantanoḥ kathayāmāsa nārado munisattamaḥ rājñā pṛṣṭaḥ purā prāha tatrāhaṃ śrutavānpurā
ātmarājyaṃ dhanaṃ caiva kalatraṃ vāhanaṃ tathā
tasya praśāsato rājyaṃ dharmeṇāmitraghātinaḥ nānṛtā vāksamabhavanmano duṣṭaṃ na cābhavat
na ca kāyena kṛtavānsa pāpaṃ paramaṇvapi
ye hi te ṛṣayaḥ khyātāḥ sapta citraśikhaṇḍinaḥ
idaṃ śreya idaṃ brahma idaṃ hitamanuttamam
tatra dharmārthakāmā hi mokṣaḥ paścācca kīrtitaḥ
maryādā vividhāścaiva divi bhūmau ca saṃsthitāḥ
ārādhya tapasā devaṃ hariṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vai sarve te ṛṣibhiḥ saha
śabde cārthe ca hetau ca eṣā prathamasargajā
yathāpramāṇaṃ hiṃ mayā kṛto brahma prasādataḥ rudraśca krodhajo viprā yūyaṃ prakṛtayastathā
sarve pramāṇaṃ hi yathā tathā tacchāstramuttamam
tena śāstreṇa lokeṣu kriyāḥ sarvāḥ kariṣyati
etadarthyaṃ ca dharmyaṃ ca rahasyaṃ caitaduttamam
sa ca rājaśriyā yukto bhaviṣyati mahānvasuḥ
sa rājā bhāvitaḥ pūrvaṃ daivena vidhinā vasuḥ
grāhyaḥ svayaṃ hi devena matpratyakṣaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
kimarthamiha na prāpto darśanaṃ me harirnṛpa
tataḥ sa taṃ samudbhūtaṃ bhūmipālo mahānvasuḥ
tvaṃ devaṃ paśyase nityaṃ na paśyeyamahaṃ katham
paśuhiṃsā vāritā ca yajurvedādimantrataḥ ahaṃ na vāraye hiṃsāṃ drakṣyāmyekāntiko harim
tasmātkopo na kartavyo bhavatā guruṇā mayi
vasumevaṃ bruvāṇaṃ tu kruddha eva bṛhaspatiḥ
uvāca ṛtvijaścaiva kiṃ naḥ karmeti vārayan
athaikato dvitaścaiva tritaścaiva maharṣayaḥ ūcuścainamasaṃbhrāntā na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi
śṛṇu tvaṃ vacanaṃ putra asmābhiḥ samudāhṛtam naiṣa dharmaḥ kṛtayuge yattvaṃ roṣamihāhithāḥ
aroṣaṇo hyasau devo yasya bhāgo'yamudyataḥ na śakyaḥ sa tvayā draṣṭumasmābhirvā bṛhaspate
yasya prasādaṃ kurute sa vai taṃ draṣṭumarhati
vayaṃ hi brahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
sa deśo yatra nastaptaṃ tapaḥ paramadāruṇam
vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ taṃ vai devadevaṃ sanātanam
kathaṃ paśyemahi vayaṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ tviti
yūyaṃ jijñāsavo bhaktāḥ kathaṃ drakṣyatha taṃ vibhum
anindriyā nirāhārā aniṣpandāḥ sugandhinaḥ ekāntinaste puruṣāḥ śvetadvīpanivāsinaḥ - - ca gacchadhvaṃ tatra munayastatrātmā me prakāśitaḥ
atha śrutvā vayaṃ sarve vācaṃ tāmaśarīriṇīm
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ taccittāstaddidṛkṣavaḥ sahasā hi gatāḥ sarve tejasā tasya mohitāḥ
mānaso nāma sa japo japyate tairmahātmabhiḥ
tejonivāsaḥ sa dvīpa iti vai menire vayam
tato hi vadatāṃ teṣāmaśrauṣma vipulaṃ dhvanim
vayaṃ tu tejasā tasya sahasā hṛtacetasaḥ
jitaṃ te puṇḍarīkākṣa namaste viśvabhāvana namaste'stu hṛṣīkeśa mahāpuruṣa pūrvaja
vayaṃ tvenaṃ na paśyāmo mohitāstasya māyayā
mārute sannivṛtte ca balau ca pratipādite
na sa śakyastvabhaktena draṣṭuṃ devaḥ kathaṃcana
devo'smābhirna dṛṣṭaḥ sa kathaṃ tvaṃ draṣṭumarhasi
evamekatavākyena dvitatritamatena ca anunītaḥ sadasyaiśca bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ
kimarthaṃ sa paribhraṣṭo viveśa vivaraṃ bhuvaḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ caiva saṃvādaṃ tridaśānāṃ ca bhārata
iyaṃ vai karmabhūmiḥ syātsvargo bhogāya kalpitaḥ
tasmādindro mahīṃ prāpya yajanāpa tu dīkṣitaḥ
tacchrutvā devatāḥ sarvā idamūcurdvijottamam bṛhaspatiṃ māṃsagṛddhāḥ pṛthakpṛthagidaṃ punaḥ
sa ca chāgopyajo jñeyo nānyaḥ paśuriti sthitiḥ
naiṣa dharmaḥ satāṃ devā yatra badhyeta vai paśuḥ
idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ kathaṃ vadhyeta vai paśuḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā''yāntaṃ vasuṃ te tvantarikṣagam
ūcurdvijātayo devāneṣa cchetsyati saṃśayam yajvā dānapatiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvabhūtahitapriyaḥ
evaṃ te saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā vibudhā ṛṣayastathā
etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ chindhi pramāṇaṃ no bhavānmataḥ
kasya vai ko mataḥ pakṣo brūta satyaṃ dvijottamāḥ
devānāṃ tu paśuḥ pakṣo mato rājanvadasva naḥ
devānāṃ tu mataṃ jñātvā vasunā pakṣasaṃśrayāt
asmācchāpābhighātena mahīṃ bhittvā pravekṣyasi viruddhaṃ vedasūtrāṇāmuktaṃ yadi bhavennṛpa
mānanā tu dvijātīnāṃ kartavyā vai mahātmanām
asmatpakṣanimittena vyasanaṃ prāptamīdṛśam ekaṃ tvanugrahaṃ tubhyaṃ dadmo vai nṛprasattama
evaṃ dattvā varaṃ rājñe sarve te ca divaukasaḥ ṛtuṃ samāpya piṣṭena munīnāṃ vacanāttadā
vasuṃ vicintya śakraśca pravineśāmarāvatīm vasurvivaragastatra vyalīkasya phalaṃ guroḥ
mānitāste tu viprendrāstvaṃ tu gaccha dvijottam
tataḥ śīghraṃ jahau śāpaṃ brahmalokamavāpa ca
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ saṃbhūtā mānavā yathā nārado'pi yathā śvetaṃ dvīpaṃ sa gatavānṛṣiḥ
stotraṃ jagau sa viśvāya nirguṇāya guṇātmane

vediṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ darbhānmaṇirūpāṃstathā kuśān ajinaṃ daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ ca jvalitaṃ ca hutāśanam
na ca māṃ te dadṛśire na ca drakṣyati kaścana
vṛṇīṣva ca varaṃ priya mattastvaṃ yadihecchasi
adya me tapaso deva yamasya niyamasya ca
uvāca vacanaṃ bhūyo gaccha nārada māciram
na dṛśyaścakṣuṣā yo'sau na spṛśyaḥ sparśanena ca
na ghreyaścaiva gandhena rasena ca vivarjitaḥ
satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva na guṇāstaṃ bhajanti vai
yaṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā vai dvijasattamāḥ
paśya devasya māhātmyaṃ mahimānaṃ ca nārada
etānguṇāṃstu kṣetrajño bhuṅkte naibhiḥ sa bhujyate
khe vāyuḥ pralayaṃ yāti manasyākāśameva ca
mano hi paramaṃ bhūtaṃ tadavyakte pralīyate
nityaṃ hi nāsti jagati bhūtaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam ṛte tamekaṃ puruṣaṃ vāsudevaṃ sanātanam
na vinā dhātusaṃghātaṃ śarīraṃ bhavati kvacit
sa jīvaḥ parisaṃkhyātaḥ śeṣaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
tasmātprasūto yaḥ kartā kāraṇaṃ kāryameva ca
so'niruddhaḥ sa īśāno vyaktiḥ sā sarvakarmasu
jñeyaḥ sa eva rājendra jīvaḥ saṃkarṣaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
akṣaraṃ ca kṣaraṃ caiva saccāsaccaiva nārada
māṃ praviśya bhavantīha muktā bhaktāstu ye mama
ahaṃ hi puruṣo jñeyo niṣkriyaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
māyā hyeṣā mayā sṛṣṭā yanmāṃ paśyasi nārada
ahaṃ hi jīvasaṃjño vai mayi jīvaḥ samāhitaḥ
maivaṃ te buddhiratrābhūrddṛṣo jīvo mayeti vai
siddhā hi te mahābhāgā narā hyekāntino'bhavan
tamorajobhyāṃ nirmuktāḥ pravekṣyanti ca māṃ mune
ahaṃ kartā ca kāryaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ cāpi narāda na dṛśyaścakṣuṣā devaḥ spṛśyo na sparśanena ca
āghreyo naiva gandhena rasena ca visarjitaḥ
satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva na guṇāste bhavanti hi sa hi sarvagataḥ sākṣī lokasyātmeti kathyate
nāsatyaṃ caiva dasraṃ ca bhiṣajau paśya pṛṣṭhataḥ
śriyaṃ lakṣmīṃ ca kīrtiṃ ca pṛthivīṃ ca kakudminī
vedānāṃ mātaraṃ paśya matsthāṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm
dhruvaṃ ca jyotiṣāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ paśya nārada khecaram
devānāṃ ca pitṛṇāṃ ca pitā hyeko'hamāditaḥ
pibāmi suhutaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca śraddhayā'nvitam
mayā sṛṣṭaḥ purā brahmā māṃ yajñamayajatsvayam
tvayā kṛtāṃ ca maryādāṃ nātikraṃsyati kaścana
etāṃścānyāṃśca rucirānbrahmaṇe'mitatejase evaṃ rudrāya manave indrāyāmitatejase
sa hi saṃkarṣaṇaḥ proktaḥ pradyumnaḥ sopyajījanat
etāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vijānīhi kalpādiṣu punaḥ punaḥ yathā sūryasya gaganādudayāstamane iha
nāradaḥ pariprapaccha bhagavantaṃ janārdanam ekārṇave mahāghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṅgame
śṛṇu nārada tatvena prādurbhāvānmahāmune matsyaḥ kūrmo varāhaśca narasiṃho'tha vāmanaḥ
rāmo rāmaśca rāmaśca buddhaḥ kalkīti te daśa
maprāṃ mahārṇave ghore bhārākrāntāṃ bhuvaṃ punaḥ tato balādahaṃ vidvansarvabhūtahitāya vai
satvairākrāntasarvāṅgāṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām ānayiṣyāmi svaṃ sthānaṃ vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ
virocanasya balavānbaliḥ putro mahāsuraḥ avadhyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ sadevāsurarakṣasām
sa dadyānmayi saṃprītaḥ pratiṣiddhaśca mantribhiḥ yāvajjalaṃ hastagataṃ tribhirvikramaṇairyutam
saṃdhau tu samanuprāpte tretāyāṃ dvāparasya ca
tayorye tvanvaye jātā bhaviṣyanti vanaukasaḥ mahābalā mahāvīryāḥ śakratulyaparākramāḥ
te sahāyā bhaviṣyanti surakārye mama dvija tato rakṣaḥpatiṃ ghoraṃ pulastyakulapāṃsanam
vibhīṣaṇāya dāsyāmi rājyaṃ tasya yathākramam ayodhyāvāsinaḥ sarvānneṣye'haṃ lokamavyayam
haniṣye narakaṃ bhaumaṃ muraṃ pīṭhaṃ ca dānavam
kṛkalāsa bhūtaṃ ca nṛgaṃ mocayiṣye ca vai punaḥ
tatra pautranimittena gatvā vai śoṇitaṃ puram vāṇasya ca puraṃ gatvā kariṣye kadanaṃ mahat
cāṇūraṃ ca mahāvīryaṃ muṣṭikaṃ ca mahābalam
kālīyaṃ ca vaśe kṛtvā yamunāyā mahāhrade
apakrānte tato varṣe girimūrdhniṃ vyavasthitaḥ indreṇa saha saṃvādaṃ kariṣyāmi tadā dvija
laghvācchidya dhanaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevaṃ ca pauṇḍrakam
jarāsandhaśca balavānsarvarājavirodhanaḥ bhaviṣyatyasuraḥ sphīto bhūmipālo girivraje
duryodhanāparādhena yudhiṣṭhiraguṇena ca samāgateṣu baliṣu pṛthivyāṃ sarvarājasu
vāsaviḥ susahāyo vai mama tveko bhaviṣyati
śastrairnipatitāḥ sarve nṛpā yāsyanti vai divam
na śṛṇvanti pituḥ putrā na snuṣā naiva bhrātaraḥ
na pautrā na kalatrā vā vartante'pyadhamottamāḥ
ye naṣṭadharmaśrotāraste samāḥ pāpaniścaye tasmādetā na saṃbhāṣyā na spṛśyā ca hitārthibhiḥ
tasminnāśe vanagrāme tiṣṭhetsonnāsimo hayaḥ sahayā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve tairahaṃ sahitaḥ punaḥ
tataḥ paścādbhaviṣyāmi yajñeṣu nirataḥ sadā rājyaṃ praśāsati punaḥ kuntīputra yudhiṣṭhire
haṃsaḥ kūrmaśca matsyaśca prādurbhāvā dvijottama varāho narasiṃhaśca vāmano rāma eva ca
sarvadāḥ saśrutīkāśca kṛtāḥ pūrvaṃ kṛte yuge
atikrāntāḥ purāṇeṣu śrutāste yadi vā kvacit
lokakāryāṇi kṛtvā ca punaḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gatāḥ
yattvayā prāptamadyeha ekāntagatabuddhinā etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ brahmanbhaktimato mayā
purāṇaṃ ca bhaviṣyaṃ ca sarahasyaṃ ca sattama
kiṃ vai brahmā na jānīte yataḥ śuśrāva nāradāt
sargasyādau smṛto brahmā prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ jānāti devapravaraṃ bhūyaścātodhikaṃ nṛpa
aṣṭāviṃśatsahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanām ātmānugāmināṃ brahmā śrāvayāmāsa tatvataḥ
varṣaṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭivarṣaśatāni ca sūryasya tapato lokānnirmitā ye puraḥsarāḥ
devānāṃ tu sakāśādvai tataḥ śrutvā'sito dvijaḥ
mama cāpi pitā tāta kathayāmāsa śaṃtanuḥ
tato mayāpi śrutvā ca kīrtitaṃ tava bhārata
ākhyānamuttamaṃ cedaṃ śrāvayedyaḥ sadā nṛpa tadaiva manujo bhaktaḥ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ bhūtvā candraprabho naraḥ
sa hi mātā pitā caiva kṛtsnasya jagato guruḥ
yo hyasmākaṃ guruḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ
yūyaṃ hi taptatapasaḥ sarve ca caritavratāḥ śaunakasya mahāsatraṃ prāptāḥ sarve dvijottamāḥ
nivṛttaṃ cāsthito dharmaṃ kṣemī bhāgavataḥ prabhuḥ
etaṃ naḥ saṃśayaṃ saute chindhi guhyaṃ sanātanam
mokṣaścoktastvayā brahmannirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ sukham ye tu muktā bhavantīha puṇyapāpavivarjitāḥ
ākāśaṃ jagatī caiva ye ca śeṣā divaukasaḥ
tatastenāsthitā mārgaṃ dhruvamakṣaramavyayam smṛtvā kālaparīmāṇaṃ pravṛttiṃ ye samāsthitāḥ
kathaṃ bhāgaharāḥ proktā devatāḥ kratuṣu dvija
ye ca bhāgaṃ pragṛhṇanti yajñeṣu dvijasattama
te yajanto mahāyajñaiḥ kasya bhāgaṃ dadanti vai
