aho gūḍhatamaḥ praśnastvayā pṛṣṭo janeśvara nātaptatapasā hyeṣa nāvedaviduṣā tathā
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanme pṛṣṭaḥ purā guruḥ
ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai pañcamaśca śukaḥ smṛtaḥ
eṣa vai yastvayā pṛṣṭastena teṣāṃ prakīrtitaḥ
tataḥ śruto mayā cāpi tavākhyeyo'dya bhārata
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca jānīyāmiti sattamāḥ
yathā vṛttaṃ hi kalpādau dṛṣṭaṃ me jñānacakṣuṣā
yo'haṃkāra iti proktaḥ sarvatejomayo hi saḥ
marīciraṅgirāścātriḥ pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ vasiṣṭhaśca mahātmā vai manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvastathā
jñeyāḥ prakṛtayo'ṣṭau tā yāsu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
te rudrāḥ prakṛratiścaiva sarve caiva surarṣayaḥ
vayaṃ sṛṣṭā hi bhagavaṃstvayā ca prabhaviṣṇunā
kathaṃ balakṣayo na syādyuṣmākaṃ hyātmanaśca vai
vijñātaṃ vo mayā kāryaṃ tacca lokahitaṃ mahat
yūyaṃ ca vibudhaśreṣṭhā māṃ yajadhvaṃ samāhitāḥ
tataste vibudhāḥ sarve brahmā te ca maharṣayaḥ
yena yaḥ kalpito bhāgaḥ sa tathā māmupāgataḥ prīto'haṃ pradiśāmyadya phalamāvṛttilakṣaṇam
yajñairye cāpi yakṣyanti sarvalokeṣu vai surāḥ
sa tathā yajñabhāgārho vedasūtre mayā kṛtaḥ
yūyaṃ hi bhāvitā yajñaiḥ sarvayajñeṣu mānavaiḥ
māṃ tato bhāvayiṣyadhvameṣā vo bhāvanā mama
nirmāṇametadyuṣmākaṃ pravṛttiguṇakalpitam mayā kṛtaṃ suraśreṣṭhā yavātkalpakṣayādiha
vasiṣṭha iti saptaite manasā nirmitā hi te
saptaite mānasāḥ proktā ṛṣayo brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ
pravṛttau vā nivṛttau vā tatphalaṃ sośnute'vaśaḥ
eṣa mātā pitā caiva yuṣmākaṃ ca pitāmahaḥ
idaṃ kṛtayugaṃ nāma kālaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pravartitaḥ
prokṣitā yatra paśavo vadhaṃ prāpsyanti vai makhe
yatra pādaścaturtho vai dharmasya na bhaviṣyati
tato vai dvāparaṃ nāma miśraḥ kālo bhaviṣyati
devā devarṣayaścocustamevaṃvādinaṃ gurum ekapādasthite dharme yatra kvacana gāmini
guravo yatra pūjyante sādhuvṛttasamanvitāḥ vastavyaṃ tatra yuṣmābhiryatra dharmo na hīyate
yatra vedāśca yajñāśca tapaḥ satyaṃ damastathā ahiṃsā dharmasaṃyuktāḥ pracareyuḥ surottamāḥ
sa vo deśaḥ sevitavyo mā vo'dharmaḥ padā spṛśet
taṃ devo darśayāmāsa kṛtvā hayaśiro mahat
lokakāryagatīḥ sarvāstvaṃ cintaya yathāvidhi dhātā tvaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tvaṃ prabhurjagato guruḥ
yadā ca surakāryaṃ te aviṣahyaṃ bhaviṣyati
sa ādiḥ sa madhyaḥ sa cāntaḥ prajānāṃ sa dhātā sa dheyaṃ sa kartā sa kāryam
yugānte prasuptaḥ susaṃkṣipya lokān yugādau prabuddho jagaddhyutsasarja
aśvibhyāṃ pataye caiva marutāṃ pataye tathā
vacasāṃ pataye nityaṃ saritāṃ pataye tathā
kapardine varāhāya ekaśṛṅgāya dhīmate vivasvate'śvaśirase caturmūrtidhṛte sadā
eṣa devaḥ saṃcarati sarvatra gatiravyayaḥ [eṣa caitatparaṃ brahma jñeyo vijñānacakṣuṣā ]
kathitaṃ tacca vai sarvaṃ mayā pṛṣṭena tattvataḥ
aputro labhate putraṃ kanyā caivepsitaṃ patim
yo yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate sa tamāpnoti ca dhruvam
idaṃ maharṣervacanaṃ viniścitaṃ mahātmanaḥ puruṣavarasya kīrtitam
samāgamaṃ carṣidivaukasāmimaṃ niśamya bhaktāḥ susukhaṃ labhante
yāni nāmāni te deva kīrtitāni maharṣibhiḥ
na hyanyo varṇayennāmnāṃ niruktaṃ tvāmṛte prabho
sāṅkhye ca yogaśāstre ca āyurvede tathaiva ca
gauṇāni tatra nāmāni karmajāni ca kānicit
kathyamānaṃ mayā tāta tvaṃ hi me'rdhaṃ smṛtaḥ purā
yosau yonirhi sarvasya sthāvarasya carasya ca
prakṛtiḥ sā parā mahyaṃ rodasī lokadhāriṇī
tapo yajñaśca yaṣṭā ca purāṇaḥ puruṣo virāṭ
ahnaḥ kṣaye lalāṭācca suto devasya vai tathā
yadyahaṃ nārcayeyaṃ vai īśānaṃ varadaṃ śivam
mayā pramāṇaṃ hi kṛtaṃ lokaḥ samanuvartate
yastaṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yo'nu taṃ sa hi māmanu
na hi me kenaciddeyo varaḥ pāṇḍavanandana
na hi viṣṇuḥ praṇamati kasmaicidvibudhāya ca
bhaviṣyatāṃ vartatāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ caiva bhārata
sarveṣāmagraṇīrviṣṇuḥ sevyaḥ pūjyaśca nityaśaḥ namasva havyadaṃ viṣṇuṃ tathā śaraṇadaṃ namaḥ
caturvidhā mama janā bhaktā eva hi me śrutam
ye ca śiṣṭāstrayo bhaktāḥ phalakāmā hi te matāḥ
brahmāṇaṃ śitikaṇṭhaṃ ca yāścānyā devatāḥ smṛtāḥ
tvaṃ caivāhaṃ ca kaunteya naranārāyaṇau smṛtau
āpo nārā iti proktā āpo vai narasūnavaḥ
gatiśca sarvabhūtānāṃ prajanaścāpi bhārata vyāpte ma rodasī pārtha kāntiścābhyadhikā mama
damātsiddhiṃ parīpsanto māṃ janāḥ kāmayanti ha
divaṃ corvī ca madhyaṃ ca tasmāddāmodaro hyaham
tataḥ sa brahmaṇaḥ putra ādyo hyṛṣivarastritaḥ
etadbṛhaspatiḥ śrutvā cukrodha ca śaśāpa ca
sa hi dīrghatamā nāma nāmnā hyāsīdṛṣiḥ purā
evaṃ hi varadaṃ nāma keśaveti mamārjuna
api hi purāṇe bhavati ekayonyāvagnīṣomau devāścāgnimukhā iti ekayonitvācca parasparaṃ harṣayanto lokāndhārayanta iti
eṣa me saṃśayo vīra taṃ chindhi madhusūdana
na vai rātryāṃ na divase na sati nāsati na vyakte nacāpyavyakte vyavasthite

etasyāmavasthāyāṃ nārāyaṇaguṇāśrayādajarāmarādatīndriyādagrāhyādasaṃbhavātsatyādahiṃsyāllavādibhiradvitīyādapravṛttiviśeṣādavairādakṣayādamarādajarādamūrtitaḥ sarvavyāpinaḥ sarvakartuḥ śāśvatāttamasaḥ parātpuruṣaḥ prādurbhūtosya puruṣasya brahmayonerbrahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāve hariravyayaḥ
nāsīdaho na rātrirāsīnna sadāsīnnāsadāsīttama eva purastādabhavadviśvarūpam sā viśvarūpasya rajanī hi evamasyārtho'nubhāṣyate

tasyedānīṃ tamaḥ saṃbhavasya puruṣasya brahmayonerbrahmaṇaḥ prādurbhāve sa puruṣaḥ prajāḥ sisṛkṣamāṇo netrābhyāmagnīṣomau sasarja tato bhūtasargeṣu sṛṣṭeṣu prajāḥ kramavaśādbrahmakṣatramupātiṣṭhan yaḥ somastadbrahma yadbrahma te brāhmaṇā yo'gnistatkṣatraṃ kṣatrādbrahmabalavattaram kasmāditi paraṃ bhūtaṃ notpannapūrvaṃ dīpyamāne'gnau juhoti yo brāhmaṇamukhe juhotīti kṛtvā bravīmi bhūtasargaḥ kṛto brahmaṇā bhūtāni ca pratiṣṭhāpya trailokyaṃ dhāryata iti mantravādopi hi bhavati
tvamagne yajñānāṃ hotā viśveṣāṃ hito devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ ca jagata iti
nidarśanaṃ cātra bhāvati viśvepāmagne yajñānāṃ tvaṃ hoteti tvaṃ hito devairmanuṣyairjagata iti
agnirhi yajñānāṃ hotā kartā sa cāgnirbrahma

na hyṛte mantrāṇāṃ havanamasti na vinā puruṣaṃ tapaḥ saṃbhavati havirmantrāṇāṃ saṃpūjā vidyate devamānupaṛṣīṇāmanena tvaṃ hoteti niyuktaḥ ye ca mānuṣahotrādhikārāste cakrurbrāhmaṇasya hi yājanaṃ vidhīyate na kṣatravaiśyayordvijātyostasmādbrāhmaṇā hyagnibhūtā yajñānudvahanti yajñāste devāṃstarpayanti devāḥ pṛthivīṃ bhāvayanti śatapathe'pi hi brāhmaṇamukhe bhavati
agnau samiddhe sa juhoti yo vidvān brāhmaṇamukhenāhutiṃ juhoti
evamapyagnibhūtā brāhmaṇā vidvāṃso'gniṃ bhāvayanti agnirviṣṇuḥ sarvabhūtānyanupraviśya prāṇāndhārayati
apicātra sanatkumāragītāḥ ślokā bhavanti brahmā viśvaṃ sṛjatpūrvaṃ sarvādirniravaskaraḥ
dhārayanti mahīṃ dyāṃ ca śaityādvāyvamṛtaṃ tathā
nāsti satyātparo dharmo nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pretya ceha ca bhūtaye
naiṣāmukṣā vahati nota vāhā na gargaro mathyati saṃpradāne
apadhvastā dasyubhūtā bhavanti yeṣāṃ rāṣṭre brāhmaṇā vṛttihīnāḥ
vāksaṃyamakāle hi tasya varapradasya devadevasya brāhmaṇāḥ prathamaṃ prādurbhūtā brāhmaṇebhyaśca śeṣā varṇāḥ prādurbhūtāḥ
itthaṃ ca surāsuraviśiṣṭā brāhmaṇā vedamayā brahmabhūtena purā svayamevotpāditāḥ surāsuramaharṣayo bhūtaviśeṣāḥ sthāpitā nigṛhītāśca teṣāṃ prabhāvaḥ śrūyatām
ahalyādharṣaṇanimittaṃ hi gautamāddhariśmaśrutāmindraḥ prāptaḥ gautamanimittaṃ cendro muṣkaviyogaṃ mepavṛṣaṇatvaṃ cāvāpa
ṛtuvadhaprāptamanyunā ca dakṣeṇa bhūyastapasā cātmānaṃ saṃyojya trinetrākṛtiranyā lalāṭe rudrasyotpāditā

tripuravadhārthaṃ dīkṣāmupagatasya rudrasya uśanasājaṭāḥ śirasa utkṛtyāgnau prayuktāstataḥ prādurbhūtā bhujagāstairasya bhujagaiḥ pīḍyamānaḥ kaṇṭho nīlatāmupagataḥ pūrve ca manvantare svāyaṃbhuve nārāyaṇahastabandhagrahaṇānnīlakaṇṭhatvamupanītaḥ

amṛtotpādane punarbhakṣaṇatāṃ vāyusamīkṛtasya viṣasyopagataśca tadbhakṣaṇamiti tannimittameva candrakalā brahmaṇā nihitā āṅgirasabṛhaspaterupaspṛśato na prasādaṃ gatavatyaḥ kilāpaḥ atha bṛhaspatiradbhyaścukrodha yasmānmamopaspṛśataḥ kalupībhūtā naca prasādamupagatāstatasmādadyaprabhṛti jhaṣamakaramatsyakacchapajantumaṇḍūkasaṃkīrṇāḥ kaluṣībhavateti tadāprabhṛtyāpo yādobhiḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ kaluṣībhavateti tadāprabhṛtyāpo yādobhiḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ
viśvarūpo hi vai tvāṣṭraḥ purīhito devānāmāsīt svastrīyosurāṇāṃ sa pratyakṣaṃ devebhyo bhāgamadātparokṣamasurebhyaḥ

atha hiraṇyakaśiṣuṃ puraskṛtya viśvarūpamātaraṃ svasāramasurā varamayācanta he svasarayaṃ te putrastvāṣṭro viśvarūpastriśirā devānāṃ purohitaḥ pratyakṣaṃ devebhyobhāgamadāt parokṣamasmākaṃ tato devā vardhante vayaṃ kṣīyāmastadenaṃ tvaṃ vārayitumarhasi tathā yathā'smānbhajediti
atha viśvarūpaṃ nandanavanamupagataṃ mātovāca putra kiṃ parapakṣavardhanastvaṃ mātulapakṣaṃ nāśayasi nārhasyevaṃ kartumiti sa viśvarūpo māturvākyamanatikramaṇīyamiti matvā saṃpūjya hiraṇyakaśipumagāt
hairaṇyagarbhācca vasiṣṭhāddhiraṇyakaśiṣuḥ śāpaṃ prāptavānyasmāttvayā'nyo vṛto hotā tasmādasamāptayajñastvamapūrvātsatvajātādvadhaṃ prāpsyasīti tacchāpadānāddhiraṇyakaśiṣuḥ prāptavānvadham

atha viśvarūpo mātṛpakṣavardhanotyarthaṃ tapasvyabhavattasya vratabhaṅgārthamindro bahnīḥ śrīmatyo'psaraso niyuyoja tāśca dṛṣṭvā manaḥ kṣubhitaṃ tasyābhavattāsu cāpsaraḥsu nacirādeva sakto'bhavatsaktaṃ cainaṃ jñātvā apsarasa ūcurgacchāmahe vayaṃ yathāgatamiti
tāstvāṣṭra uvacā kva gamiṣyathāsyatāṃ tāvanmayā saha śreyo bhaviṣyatīti tāstamabruvanvayaṃ devastriyo'psarasa indraṃ devaṃ varadaṃ purā prabhaviṣṇuṃ vṛṇīmaha iti

atha tā viśvarūpo'bravīdadyaiva sendrā devā nabhaviṣyantīti tato mantrāñjajāpa tairmantrairavardhatatriśirā ekenāsyena sarvalokeṣu yathāvaddvijaiḥ kriyāvadbhiryajñeṣu suhṛtaṃ somaṃ papau eke nānnamekena sendrāndevānathendrastaṃ vivardhamānaṃ somapānāpyāyitasarvagātraṃ dṛṣṭvā cintāmāpede saha devaiḥ
te devāḥ sendrā brahmāṇamabhijagmusta ūcurviśvarūpeṇa sarvayajñeṣu suhutaḥ somaḥ pīyate vayamabhāgāḥ saṃvṛttā asurapakṣo vardhate vayaṃ kṣīyāmastadarhasi no vidhātuṃ śreyo'nantaramiti
tānbrahmovāca ṛṣirbhārgavastapastapyate dadhīcaḥ sa yācyatāṃ varaṃ sa yathā kalevaraṃ jahyāt tasyāsthibhirvajraṃ kriyatāmiti
tato devāstatrāgacchanyatra dadhīco bhagavānṛṣistapastepe sendrā devāstamabhigamyocurbhagavaṃstapasā kuśalamavighnaṃ ceti
tāndadhīca uvāca svāgataṃ bhavatāṃ ucyatāṃ kiṃ kriyatāṃ yadvakṣyatha tatkariṣyāmi

evamukto dadhīcastānabravīt sahasraṃ varṣāṇāmaindraṃ padamavāpyate mayā yadi jahyām tathetyuktvendraḥ svasthānaṃ datvā tapasvyabhavat indro dadhīco'bhavat tāvatpūrveṇa sendrā devā āgamankālo'yaṃ dehanyāsāyeti atha dadhīcastathaivā vimanāḥ sukhaduḥkhasamo mahāyogī ātmani paramātmānaṃ samādhāya śarīraparityāgaṃ cakāra

śrutirapyatra bhavati indro dadhīcosthibhikṛtamiti tasya paramātmanyapasṛte tānyasthīti vidhātā saṃgṛhya vajramakarottena vajreṇābhedyenāmadhṛṣyeṇa brahmāsthisaṃbhūtena viṣṇupraviṣṭenendro viśvarūpaṃ jaghāna śirasāṃ cāsya cchedanamakarottakṣṇa yajñapaśoḥ śiraste dadānītyuktvā tasmādanantara viśvarūpagātramathanasaṃbhavaṃ tvāṣṭrotpāditamevāriṃ vṛtramindro jaghāna
tasyāṃ dvaidhībhūtānāṃ brahmavadhyāyāṃ bhayādindro devarājyaṃ paryatyajadapsu saṃbhavāṃ ca śītalāṃ mānasasarogatāṃ nalinīṃ pratipede tatra caiśvaryayogādaṇumātro bhūtvā visagranthiṃ praviveśa

atha brahmavadhyākṛte pranaṣṭe trailokyanāthe śacīpatau jagadanīśvaraṃ babhūva devān rajastamaścāviveśamantrā na prāvartanta mahārṣīṇāṃ rakṣāṃsi prādurabhavan brahma cotsādanaṃ jagāmānindrāścābalālokāḥ supradhṛṣyā babhūvuḥ
atha devā ṛṣayaścāyuṣaḥ putraṃ nahuṣaṃ nāma devarājye'bhiṣipicurnahuṣaḥ pañcabhiḥ śatairjyotiṣāṃ lalāṭe jvaladbhiḥ sarvatejoharaistriviṣṭapaṃ pālayāṃbabhūva
atha lokāḥ prakṛtimāpedire svasthāśca hṛṣṭāśca babhūvuḥ

athovāca nahuṣaḥ sarvaṃ māṃ śakropabhogyamupasthitamṛte śacīmiti sa evamuktvā śacīsamīpamagamadvṛhaspatigṛhe cāsīnāmuvācanāṃ subhage'hamindro devānāṃ bhajasva māmiti taṃ śacīpratyuvāca prakṛtyā tvaṃ dharmavatsalaḥ somavaṃśodbhavaśca nārhasi parapatnīdharṣaṇaṃ kartumiti

tāmathovāca nahuṣa aindraṃ padamadhyāsyate mayā'hamindrasya rājyaratnaharo nātrādharmaḥ kaścittvamindropabhukteti sā tamuvācāsti mama kiṃcidbratamaparyavasitaṃ tasyāvabhṛthe tvāmupagamiṣyāmi kaiścidevāhobhiriti sa śacyaivamabhihito jagāma

atha śacī duḥkhaśokārtā bhartṛdarśanalālasānahuṣabhayagṛhītā bṛhaspatimupāgacchatsa ca tāmatyudvignāṃ dṛṣṭvaiva dhyānaṃ praviśya bhartṛkāryatatparāṃ jñātvā bṛhaspatiruvācānenaiva vratena tapasā cānvitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutimāhvaya tadā sā te indraṃ darśayiṣyatīti sā'tha mahāniyamasthitā devīṃ varadāmupaśrutiṃ mantrairāhvayatsopaśrutiḥ śacīsamīpamagāduvāca caināmiyamastīti tvayā''hūtopasthitā kiṃ te priyaṃ karavāṇīti tāṃ bhūrdhnā praṇamyovāca śacī bhagavatyarhasi me bhartāraṃ darśayituṃ tvaṃ satyā mātā satāṃ ceti saināṃ mānasaṃ saro'nayattatrendraṃ visagranthigatamadarśayat

tāmatha patnīṃ śacīṃ kṛśāṃ ralānāṃ cendro dṛṣṭvā cintayāṃbabhūva aho mama duḥkhamidamupagataṃ naṣṭaṃ hi māmiyamanviṣya yatpatnyabhyagamadduḥsvārteti tāmindra uvāca kathaṃ varyasīti sā tamuvāca nahu po māmāhvayati patnīṃ kartuṃ kālaścāsya mayā kṛta iti tāmindra uvāca gaccha nahuṣastvayā vācyo'pūrveṇa māmṛṣiyuktena yānena tvamadhirūḍha udvahasveti indrasya mahānti vāhanāni santi manaḥ priyāṇyadhirūḍhāni mayā tvamanyenopayātumarhatīti saivamuktā hṛṣṭā jagāmendropi visagranthimevāviveśa bhūyaḥ
athendrāṇīmabhyāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā tāmuvāca nahuṣo yanme tvayā kālaḥ parikalpitaḥ pūrṇaḥ sa kāla iti taṃ śacyabravīcchakreṇa yathoktaṃ sa maharṣiyuktaṃ bāhanamadhirūḍhaḥ śacīsamīpamupāgacchat

atha maitrāvaruṇiḥ kumbhayoniragastya ṛṣivaro maharṣīn dhikkriyamāṇāṃstānnahuṣeṇāpaśyat tadduṣkaramiti svayamapi gṛhītaḥ padbhyāṃ cāspṛśyata tataḥ sa nahuṣamabravīdakāryapravṛtta pāpa patasva mahīṃ sarpo bhava yāvadbhūmirgirayaśca tiṣṭheyustāvaditi samaharṣivākyasamakālameva tasmādyānādavāpatat

athānindraṃ punastrailokyamabhavat tato devā ṛṣayaśca bhagavantaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaraṇamindrārthe'bhijagmurūcuścainaṃ bhagavannindraṃ brahmahatyābhibhūtaṃ trātumarhasīti tataḥ sa varadastānabravīdaśvamedhaṃ yajñaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śakro'bhiyajatāṃ tataḥ svasthānaṃ prāpsyatīti tato devā ṛṣayaścendraṃ nāpaśyanyadā tadā śacīmūcurgaccha subhage indramānayasveti sā tatsara indramāhvayat indraśca tasmātsarasaḥ pratyutthāya gatvā sarasvatīmabhijagāma bṛhaspatiścāśvameghaṃ mahākratuṃ śakrāyāhārat tatra kṛṣṇasāraṅgaṃ medhyamaśvamatsṛjya pāvanaṃ tameva kṛtvā indraṃ marutpatiṃ bṛhaspatiḥ svaṃ sthānaṃ prāpayāmāsa

tataḥ sa devarāṭ devairṛṣibhiḥ stūyamānastriviṣṭapastho niṣkalmaṣo babhūva ha brahmavadhyāṃ caturṣu sthāneṣu vyabhajat vanitāvṛkṣagiryavaniṣu vanitāsu rajaḥ vṛkṣeṣu niryāsaḥ giriṣu śimbaḥ pṛthivyāmūṣaraḥ te'spṛśyāḥ tasmāddhaviralavaṇaṃ pacyate, evamindro brahmatejaḥ prabhāvopavṛṃhitaḥ śatruvadhaṃ kṛtvā svaṃ sthānaṃ prāpitaḥ
nahuṣasya śāpamokṣārthaṃ devairṛṣibhiśca yācyamāno'gastyaḥ prāha yāvatsvakulajaḥ śrīmāndharmarāḍbhrātṛbhiryutaḥ
bhīmastasyānujastaṃ tvaṃ grahītā tu yudhiṣṭharaḥ kathayitvā svakānpraśnāṃstvāṃ ca taṃ ca vimokṣyati
ākāśagaṅgāgataśca purā bharadvājo maharṣirupāspṛśatrīnkramānkramatā viṣṇunā'bhyāsādita sa bharadvājena salakṣaṇena pāṇinorasi tāḍitaḥ salakṣaṇoraskaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ

aditirvai devānāmannamapacadetadbhuktvā surā asurānhaniṣyantīti tatra budho vratacaryārāmāptāvāgacchadaditiṃ cāyācadbhikṣāṃ dehīti tatra devaiḥ pūrvametatprāśyaṃ nānyenetyaditirbhikṣāṃ nādādatha bhikṣāpratyākhyānarūṣitena budhena brahmabhūtenāditiḥ śaptā adirerudare bhaviṣyati vyathā vivasvato dvitīyajanmanyaṇḍasaṃjñitasya aṇḍaṃ māturadityā māritaṃ sa mārtāṇḍo vivasvānabhavacchrāddhadevaḥ

dakṣasya yā dai duhitaraḥ ṣaṣṭirāsaṃstāsāṃ kaśyapāraya trayodaśa prādāddaśa dharmāya daśa manave saptavim̐śatimindave tāsu tulyāsu nakṣatrākhyāṃ gatāsu somo rohiṇyāmabhyadhikaṃ prītimāna bhūttatastāḥ śiṣṭāḥ patnya irṣyāvratyaḥ pituḥ samīpaṃ gatvemamarthaṃ śaśaṃsurbhagavannasmāsu tulyaprabhāvāsu somo rohiṇīṃ pratyadhikaṃ bhajatīti so'bravīdyakṣmainamāvekṣyata iti dakṣaśāpācca somaṃ rājānaṃ yakṣmā viveśa sa yakṣmaṇā''viṣṭo dakṣamagāddakṣaścainamabravīnna samaṃ vartasa iti tatrarṣayaḥ somamabruvankṣīyase yakṣmaṇā paścimāyāṃ diśi samudre hiraṇyasarastīrthaṃ tatra gatvā ātmānamabhiṣecayasvetyathāgacchatsomastatra hiraṇyasarastīrthaṃ gatvā cātmanaḥ secanamakarot snātvā cātmānaṃ pāpmano mokṣayāmāsa tatra cāva bhāsitastīrthe yadā somastadāprabhṛti ca tīrthaṃ tatprabhāsamiti nāmnā khyātaṃ babhūva
tacchāpādadyāpi kṣīyate somo'māvāsyāntarasthaḥ paurṇamāsīmātre'dhiṣṭhito meghalekhāpraticchannaṃ bapurdarśayati meghasadṛśaṃ varṇamagamattadasya śaśalakṣmavimalamabhavat

sthūlaśirā maharṣirmeroḥ prāguttare digvibhāge tapastepe tatastasya tapastapyamānasya sarvagandhavahaḥ śucirvāyurvāyamānaḥ śarīramaspṛśatsa tapasā tāpitaśarīraḥ kṛśo vāyunopavījyamāno hṛdaye paritoṣamagamattatra kila tasyānilavyajanakṛtaparitoṣasya sadyo vanaspatayaḥ puṣpaśobhāṃ nidarśitavanta iti sa etāñśaśāpa na sarvakālaṃ puṣpaphalavanto bhaviṣyatheti

nārāyaṇo lokahitārthaṃ vaḍavāmukho nāma purā maharṣirbabhūva tasya merau tapastapyataḥ samudra āhūto nāgatastenāmarṣitenātmagātroṣmaṇāḥ samudraḥ stimitajalaḥ kṛtaḥ svedaprasyandanasadṛśaścāsya lavaṇabhāvo janitaḥ

uktaścāpyapeyo bhaviṣyastetacca te toyaṃ baḍavāmukhasaṃjñitena pepīyamānaṃ madhuraṃ bhaviṣyati tadetadadyāpi baḍavāmukhasaṃjñitenānuvartinā toyaṃ samudrātpīyate punarumā dakṣakopāddhimavato girerduhitā babhūva

himavato girerduhitaramumāṃ kanyāṃ rudraścakame bhṛgurapi ca maharṣirhimavantamāgatyābravīt kanyāmimāṃ me dehīti tamabravīddhimavānabhilaṣito varo duhiturhi rudra iti tamabravīdbhṛguryasmāttvayā'haṃ kanyāvaraṇakṛtabhāvaḥ pratyākhyātastasmānna ratnānāṃ bhavānbhājanaṃ bhaviṣyatīti
kṣatramapi ca brāhmaṇaprasādādeva śāśvatīmavyayāṃ ca pṛthivīṃ patnīmabhigamya bubhuje
nāmnāṃ niruktaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikāgramānasaḥ sūryācandramasau śaśvatkeśairme aṃśusaṃjñitaiḥ
bodhanāttāpanāccaiva jagato harṣaṇaṃ bhavet agnīṣomakṛtairebhiḥ karmabhiḥ pāṇḍunandana
naṣṭāṃ ca dharaṇīṃ pūrvamavindaṃ vai guhāgatām
śipiviṣṭeti cākhyāyāṃ hīnaromā ca yo bhavet
na hi jāto na jāyeyaṃ na janiṣye kadācana
ṛtā brahmasutā sā me satyadevī sarasvatī
satvānna cyutapūrvo'haṃ satyaṃ vai viddhi matkutam
kṛṣāṇi medinīṃ pārtha bhūtvā kārṣṇāyaso mahān
vāyuśca tejasā sārdhaṃ vaikuṇṭhatvaṃ tato mama
nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ brahma dharmo'sau para ucyate
te māṃ gāyanti prāgvaṃśe adhokṣaja iti smṛtaḥ
nānyo hyadhokṣajo loke ṛte nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
trayo hi dhātavaḥ khyātāḥ karmajā iti ye smṛtāḥ
pittaṃ śleṣmā ca vāyuśca eṣa saṃghāta ucyate
vṛṣo hi bhagavāndharmaḥ khyāto lokeṣu bhārata
na cādiṃ na madhyaṃ tathā caiva nāntaṃ kadācidvimante dvijā me surāśca
na ca pāpāni gṛhṇāmi tato'haṃ vai śuciśravāḥ
yogaiḥ saṃpūjyate nityaṃ sa evāhaṃ vibhuḥ smṛtaḥ
ekaviṃśatisāhasraṃ ṛgvedaṃ māṃ pracakṣate sahasraśākhaṃ yatsāma ye vai vedavido janāḥ
bābhravyagotraḥ sa babhau prathamaṃ kramapāragaḥ nārāyaṇādvaraṃ labdhvā prāpya yogamanuttamam
kramaṃ praṇīya śikṣāṃ ca praṇayitvā sa gālavaḥ
puṇḍarīko'tha rājā ca brahmadattaḥ pratāpavān jātīmaraṇajaṃ duḥkhaṃ smṛtvāsmṛtvā punaḥ punaḥ
tacchūlaṃ bhasmasātkṛtvā dakṣayajñaṃ savistaram āvayoḥ sahasā'gacchadvadaryāśramamantikāt
tata enaṃ samuddhūtaṃ kaṇṭhe jagrāha pāṇinā
ucchepaṇabhāgo vai rudrastasyocchepaṇena hotavyamiti sarve gamyarūpeṇa tadā
vedā na pratibhānti sma ṛṣīṇāṃ bhāvitātmanāṃ
vasudhā saṃcakampe ca nabhaśca vipaphāla ha
tasminnevaṃ samutpanne nimitte pāṇḍunandana brahmā vṛto devagaṇārṛṣibhiśca mahātmabhiḥ
so'ñjalipragraho bhūtvā caturvakro niruktagaḥ uvāca vacanaṃ rudraṃ lokānāmastu vai śivam
yadakṣaramathāvyaktamīśaṃ lokasya bhāvanam kūṭasthaṃ kartṛnirdvandvamakarteti ca yaṃ viduḥ
mayā ca sārdhaṃ varada vibudhaiśca maharṣibhiḥ
brahmaṇā tvevamuktastu rudraḥ krodhāgnimutsṛjan prasādayāmāsa tato devaṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum
śaraṇaṃ ca jagāmādyaṃ vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ harim
yastvāṃ vetti sa māṃ vetti yastvāmanu sa māmanu
evaṃlakṣaṇamutpādya parasparakṛtaṃ tadā sakhyaṃ caivātulaṃ kṛtvā rudreṇa sahitāvṛṣī
eṣa te kathitaḥ pārtha nārāyaṇajayo mṛdhe nāmāni caiva guhyāni niruktāni ca bhārata
brahmalokaṃ ca kaunyeya golokaṃ ca sanātanam
mayā tvaṃ rakṣito yuddhe mahāntaṃ prāptavāñjayam
yastu te sograto yāti yuddhe saṃpratyupasthite
taṃ viddhi rudraṃ kaunteya devadevaṃ kapardinam
kālaḥ sa eva vihitaḥ krodhajeti mayā tava
yaśca te kathitaḥ pūrvaṃ krodhajeti punaḥ punaḥ
tasya prabhāva evāgre yacchrutaṃ te dhanaṃjaya
yacchrutvā munayaḥ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ
na tathā phaladaṃ saute nārāyaṇakathā yathā
navanītaṃ yathā dadhno malayāccandanaṃ yathā araṇyakaṃ ca vedebhya oṣadhībhyo'mṛtaṃ yathā
na tato'sti paraṃ manye pāvataṃ divi ceha ca
na tathā phaladaṃ cāpi nārāyaṇakathā yathā
na citraṃ kṛtavāṃstatra yadāryo me dhanaṃjayaḥ
na cāsya kiṃcidaprāpyaṃ manye lokeṣvapi triṣu
tebhyo dhanyataraścaiva nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ dṛṣṭavānyo hariṃ devaṃ nārāyaṇamajaṃ vibhum
śvetadvīpaṃ samāsādya yena dṛṣṭaḥ svayaṃ hariḥ
naranārāyaṇau draṣṭuṃ kiṃ nu tatkāraṇaṃ mune
śvetadvīpānnivṛttaśca nāradaḥ parameṣṭhijaḥ badarīmāśramaṃ prāpya samāgamya ca tāvṛṣī
śvetadvīpādupāvṛtte tasminvā sumahātmani kimabrūtāṃ mahātmānau naranārāyaṇāvṛṣī
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanastadā śaśāsa śiṣyamāsīnaṃ vaiśaṃpāyanamantike
gurorvacanamājñāya sa tu viprarṣabhastadā ācacakṣe tataḥ sarvamitihāsaṃ purātanam
prāpya śvetaṃ mahādvīpaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam nivṛtto nārado rājastarasā merumāgamat
ṣaṣṭidantāvaṣṭadaṃṣṭrau meghaughasadṛśasvanau svāsyau pṛthulalāṭau ca subhrūsuhanunāsikau
tau dṛṣṭvā nārado hṛṣṭastābhyāṃ ca pratipūjitaḥ
sa copaviviśe tatra pīṭhe kuśamaye śubhe
śvetadvīpe tvayā dṛṣṭa āvayoḥ prakṛtiḥ parā
sarve lokā hi tatrasthāstathā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ
dṛṣṭau yuvāṃ mayā tatra tasya devasya pārśvataḥ
ko hi nāma bhavettasya tejasā yaśasā śriyā
tena me kathitaḥ kṛtsno dharmaḥ kṣetrajñasaṃjñitaḥ
prādurbhāvāśca kathitā bhaviṣyā iha ye yathā
te'rcayanti sadā devaṃ taiḥ sārdhaṃ ramate ca saḥ
sa kartā kāraṇaṃ caiva kāryaṃ cātibaladyutiḥ
tapasā yojya sotmānaṃ śvetadvīpātparaṃ hi yat
śāntiḥ sā triṣu lokeṣu vihitā bhāvitātmanā
nāgāḥ suparṇā gandharvāḥ siddhā rājarpayaśca te
havyaṃ kavyaṃ ca satataṃ vidhiyuktaṃ prayuñjate
tāḥ sarvāḥ śirasā devaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vai svayaṃ
āsiṣye tatparo bhūtvā yuvābhyāṃ saha nityaśaḥ
sthānasya sā bhavettasya svayaṃ tena virājatā
kṣamā kṣamāvatāṃ śreṣṭha yayā bhūmistu yujyate
āpo hi tena yujyante dravatvaṃ prāpnuvanti ca
sarvaloke tamohantā ādityo dvāramucyate jvālāmālī mahātejā yenedaṃ dhāryate jagat
paramāṇubhūtā bhūtvā tu taṃ devaṃ praviśantyuta
tatastraiguṇyahīnāste paramātmānamañjasā praviśanti dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṣetrajñaṃ nirguṇātmakam
āvāmapi ca dharmasya guhe jātau dvijottama
ye tu tasyaiva devasya prādurbhāvāḥ surapriyāḥ
svārthena vidhinā yuktaḥ sarvakṛcchravrate sthitaḥ āvābhyāmapi dṛṣṭastvaṃ śvetadvīpe tapodhana
sarvaṃ hi nau saṃviditaṃ trailokye sacarācare
yadbhaviṣyati vṛttaṃ vā vartate vā śubhāśubham
daivaṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ pitryaṃ cakre tataḥ param
tatastaṃ vacanaṃ prāha jyeṣṭho dharmātmajaḥ prabhuḥ
ka ijyate dvijaśreṣṭha daive pitrye ca kalpite
tvayā matimatāṃ śreṣṭha tanme śaṃsa yathātatham
daivataṃ ca paro jñeyaḥ paramātmā sanātanaḥ
evaṃ sa eva bhagavānpitā mātā pitāmahaḥ
kathaṃ tu piṇḍasaṃjñāṃ te pitaro lebhire purā
imāṃ hi dharaṇīṃ pūrvaṃ naṣṭāṃ sāgaramekhalām
sthāpayitvā tu dharaṇīṃ sve sthāne puruṣottamaḥ
āśritā dharaṇīṃ pīḍya tasmātpitara eva te
bhavantu pitaro loke mayā sṛṣṭāḥ sanātanāḥ
pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ ahamevātra vijñeyastriṣu piṇḍeṣu saṃsthitaḥ
nāsti matto'dhikaḥ kaścitko vānyorcyo mayā svayaṃ
ityetaduktvā vacanaṃ devadevo vṛṣākapiḥ varāhaparvate vipra dattvā piṇḍānsavistarān
karmaṇā manasā vācā viṣṇumeva yajanti te
uṣitvā varṣasāhasraṃ naranārāyaṇāśrame śrutvā bhagavadākhyānaṃ dṛṣṭvā ca harimavyayam
kathaṃ nāma bhaveddveṣya ātmā lokasya kasyacit
ātmā hi puruṣavyāghra jñeyo viṣṇuriti śrutiḥ
ya eṣa gururasmākamṛṣirgandhavatīsutaḥ tenaitatkathitaṃ tāta māhātmyaṃ paramātmanaḥ
tasmācchrutaṃ mayā cedaṃ kathitaṃ ca tavānagha
evameṣa mahāndharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṃ nṛpottama
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaṃ vyāsaṃ viddhi nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum ko hyanyaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣānmahābhāratakṛdbhavet
nāradena purā yadvai gurave tu niveditam
śamaniyamanidhiryamaniyamaparo dvijavara sahitastava ca bhavatu gatirhariramarahitaḥ
ekāntināṃ śaraṇado'bhayado gatido gatidostu vaḥ sukhabhāgakaraḥ madhukaiṭabhahā kṛtadharmavidāṃ gatido bhayado makhabhāgaharostu śaraṇaṃ sa te
taṃ lokasākṣiṇamajaṃ puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ ravivarṇamīśvaraṃ gatiṃ bahuśaḥ
sa hi lokayonirasṛtasya padaṃ sūkṣmaṃ parāyaṇamacalaṃ hi padam
pravṛttau ca nivṛttau ca yo yathā parikalpitaḥ
yacca tatkathitaṃ pūrvaṃ tvayā hayaśiro mahat
etannaḥ saṃśayaṃ brahmanpurāṇaṃ brahmasaṃbhavam kathayasvottamamate mahāpuruṣasaṃśritam
pāvitāḥ sma tvayā brahmanpuṇyāḥ kathaya tāḥ kathāḥ
jyotirbhūte jale cāpi līne jyotiṣi cānile
vyakte manasi saṃlīne vyakte cāvyaktatāṃ gate
avyakte puruṣaṃ yāte puṃsi sarvagate'pi ca
tasya cintayataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ mahānātmaguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ahaṃkārastato jāto brahmā śubhacaturmukhaḥ
vedā me paramaṃ cakṣurvedā me paramaṃ balam
vedā me paramaṃ dhāma vedā me brahma cottaram
mama vedā hṛtāḥ sarve dānavābhyāṃ balāditaḥ
andhakārā hi me lokā jātā vedairvinā kṛtāḥ
vedānṛte hi kiṃ kuryā lokānāṃ sṛṣṭimuttamām
ko hi śokārṇave magnaṃ māmito'dya samuddharet
tato jagau paraṃ japyaṃ sāñjalipragrahaḥ prabhuḥ
ॐ namaste brahmahṛdaya namaste mama pūrvaja
tvatto me mānasaṃ janma prathamaṃ dvijapūjitam
cākṣuṣaṃ vai dvitīyaṃ me janma cāsītpurātanam
tvatprasādāttu me janma tṛtīyaṃ vācikaṃ mahat
tvattaḥ śravaṇajaṃ cāpi caturthaṃ janma me vibho
nāsatyaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ pañcamamucyate
aṇḍajaṃ cāpi me janma tvattaḥ ṣaṣṭhaṃ vinirmitaṃ
idaṃ ca saptamaṃ janma padmajanmeti vai prabho
tvayā vinirmito'haṃ vai vedacakṣurvayotiga te me vedā hṛtāścakṣurandho jātosmi jāgṛhi
dadasva cakṣūṃṣi mama priyo'haṃ te priyosi me
aiśvaryeṇa prayogeṇa dvitīyāṃ tanumāsthitaḥ sunāsikena kāyena bhūtvā candraprabhastadā
cakṣuṣī somasūryauṃ te nāsā saṃdhyā punaḥ smṛtā
dantāśca pitaro rājansomapā iti viśrutāḥ goloko brahmalokaśca oṣṭhāvāstāṃ mahātmanaḥ
antardadhau sa viśveśo viveśa ca rasāṃ prabhuḥ
sasvaraḥ sānunādī ca sarvaśaḥ snigdha eva ca
prādācca brahmaṇe bhūyastataḥ svāṃ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
dadṛśāte ca puruṣaṃ tamevādikaraṃ prabhum śvetaṃ candraviśuddhābhamaniruddhatanau sthitam ṭa
ūcatuśca samāviṣṭau rajasā tamasā ca tau
ayaṃ sa puruṣaḥ śvetaḥ śete nidrāmupāgataḥ
anena nūnaṃ vedānāṃ kṛtamāharaṇaṃ rasāt kasyaiṣa konu khalveṣa kiṃca svapiti bhogavān
nirīkṣya cāsurendrau tau tato yuddhe manodadhe
pāñcālena kramaḥ prāpto rāmeṇa pathi deśite
eṣa yogaśca sāṅkhyaṃ ca brahma cāgryaṃ havirvibhuḥ
jyotiṣāṃ ca paraṃ rūpaṃ smṛtaṃ nārāyaṇātmakam
kāraṇaṃ puruṣo hyeṣāṃ pradhānaṃ cāpi kāraṇam
svabhāvaścaiva karmāṇi daivaṃ yeṣāṃ ca kāraṇam
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham
vividhā ca tathā ceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam
manīṣitaṃ vijānāti keśavo na tu tasya te
ye kecitsarvalokeṣu daivaṃ pitryaṃ ca kurvate
dānāni ca prayacchanti tapyante ca tapo mahat
ayaṃ hi nityaḥ paramo maharṣi rmahāvibhūtirguṇavānguṇākhyaḥ
naivāsya vindanti gatiṃ mahātmano na cāgatiṃ kaścidihānupaśyati
jñānātmakāḥ saṃyamino maharṣayaḥ paśyanti nityaṃ puruṣaṃ guṇādhikam
vidhiprayuktāṃ pūjāṃ ca gṛhṇāti śirasā svayam
teṣāṃ ca yā hi nirdiṣṭā pāramparyāgatā gatiḥ
caturthyāṃ caiva te gatyāṃ gacchanti puruṣottamam
kenaiṣa dharmaḥ kathito devena ṛṣiṇā'pi vā
ekāntināṃ ca kā caryā kadā cotpāditā vibho
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me
arjune vimanaske ca gītā bhagavatā svayam
āgatiśca gatiścaiva pūrvaṃ te kathitā mayā
yathā tatkathitaṃ tatra nāradena tathā śṛṇu
tena dharmeṇa kṛtavāndaivaṃ pitryaṃ ca bhārata
tato yogasthito rudraḥ purā kṛtayuge nṛpa
tapasā vai sutaptena damena niyamena ca
sṛja prajāḥ putra sarvā mukhataḥ pādatastathā
dharmaṃ ca matto gṛhṇīṣva sātvataṃ nāma nāmataḥ
dharmaṃ cāgryaṃ sa jagrāha sarahasyaṃ sasaṃgraham
tataḥ prāvartata tadā ādau kṛtayugaṃ śubham
tato hi sātvato dharmo vyāpya lokānavasthitaḥ
tataḥ svārociṣaḥ putraṃ svayaṃ śaṅkhapadaṃ nṛpa
tataḥ śaṅkhapadaścāpi putramātmajamaurasam diśāpālaṃ sudharmāṇamadhyāpayata bhārata
so'ntardadhe tato bhūyaḥ prāpte tretāyuge punaḥ
kukṣipālāya ca dadau viśālāya ca dharmiṇe
antardadhe tato rājanneṣa darmaḥ prabho hareḥ
yadidaṃ saptamaṃ janma padmajaṃ brahmaṇo nṛpa
tatraiṣa dharmaḥ kathitaḥ svayaṃ nārāyaṇena ha
tato jyeṣṭhe tu dauhitre prādāddakṣo nṛpottama
yatīnāṃ cāpi yo dharmaḥ sa te pūrvaṃ nṛpottama
akartā caiva kartā ca kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca
ekāntino hi puruṣā durlabhā bahavo nṛpa
devaṃ paramakaṃ brahma śvetaṃ candrābhamacyutam yatra caikāntino yānti nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ
tadeva paramaṃ sthānaṃ muktānāṃ kevalaṃ bhavet
na kurvanti kathaṃ viprā anye nānāvrate sthitāḥ
sātvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī caiva bhārata
nārāyaṇāṃ paraṃ mokṣe tato vai sātvikaḥ smṛtaḥ
sātvikastu sa vijñeyo bhavenmokṣe ca niścitaḥ
nārāyaṇātmake mokṣe tato yānti parāṃ gatiṃ
rājasī tāmasī caiva vyāmiśre prakṛtī smṛte tadātmakaṃ hi puruṣaṃ jāyamānaṃ viśāṃpate
hīnāḥ satvena sūkṣmeṇa tato vaikārikāḥ smṛtāḥ
vada sarvaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ pravṛttiṃ ca yathākramam
ime tathā jñānamahājalaughā nārāyaṇaṃ vai punarāviśanti
eṣa te kathito dharmaḥ sātvato yadubāndhava
evaṃ hi sa mahābhāgo nārado gurave mama
sa evāyaṃ mayā tubhyamākhyātaḥ prasṛto guroḥ
itthaṃ hi duścaro dharma eṣa pārthivasattama
yathaiva tvaṃ tathaivānye na bhajanti ca mohitāḥ
kṛṣṇa eva hi lokānāṃ bhāvano mohanastathā
prabrūhi vai mayā pṛṣṭaḥ pravṛttiṃ ca yathākramam
kathaṃ vaikāriko gacchetpuruṣaḥ puruṣottamam vadasva tvaṃ mayā pṛṣṭaḥ pravṛttiṃ ca yathākramam
jajñe bahujñaṃ paramatyudāraṃ yaṃ dvīpamadhye sutamātmavantam
ahaṃ caturthaḥ śiṣyo vai śuko vyāsātmajastathā
mama tvaṃ nābhito jātaḥ prajāsargakaraḥ prabhuḥ
kā śaktirmama deveśa prajāḥ sraṣṭuṃ namostu te
sa evamukto bhagavānbhūtvā'thāntarhitastataḥ cintayāmāsa deveśo buddhiṃ buddhimatāṃvaraḥ
yogena caināṃ niryogaḥ svayaṃ niyuyuje tadā
uvāca vacanaṃ devo buddhiṃ vai prabhuravyayaḥ brahmāṇaṃ praviśasveti lokasṛṣṭyarthasiddhaye
athainaṃ buddhisaṃyuktaṃ punaḥ sa dadṛśe hariḥ
bhūyaścaiva vacaḥ prāha sṛjemā vividhāḥ prajāḥ
prāpa cainaṃ muhūrtena svaṃ sthānaṃ devasaṃjñitam
sṛṣṭāḥ prajā imāḥ sarvā brahmaṇā parameṣṭhinā
nigraheṇa ca pāpānāṃ sādhūnāṃ pragraheṇa ca
mayā hyeṣā hi dhriyate pātālasthena bhoginā
vārāhaṃ nārasihaṃ ca vāmanaṃ mānuṣaṃ tathā
tapasā ca sutaptena yamena niyamena ca
punastiṣye ca saṃprāpte kuravo nāma bhāratāḥ
kṛṣṇe yuge ca saṃprāpte kṛṣṇavarṇo bhaviṣyasi
yaṃ mānasaṃ vai pravadanti viprāḥ pitāmahasyottamabuddhiyuktam
vasiṣṭhamagryaṃ ca taponidhānaṃ yasyātisūryaṃ vyariricyate bhāḥ
tasyānvape cāpi tato maharṣiḥ parāśaro nāma mahāprabhāvaḥ
pitā sa te vedanidhirvariṣṭho mahātapā vai tapaso nivāsaḥ
kānīnagarbhaḥ pitṛkanyakāyāṃ tasmādṛṣestvaṃ bhavitā ca putraḥ
anādinidhanaṃ loke cakrahastaṃ ca māṃ mune anudhyānānmama mune naitadvacanamanyathā
* śanaiścaraḥ sūryaputro bhaviṣyati manurmahān tasminmanvantare caiva manvādigaṇapūrvakaḥ
[yatkiṃcidvidyate loke sarvaṃ tanmadviceṣṭitam anyo hyanyaṃ cintayati svacchandaṃ vidadhāmyaham ]
etadvaḥ kathitaṃ sarvaṃ yanmāṃ pṛcchata putrakāḥ
pūrvajanma bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhaktānāṃ snehato mayā
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaḥ pāñcarātraṃ vedāḥ pāśupataṃ tathā
sāṅkhyasya vaktā kapilaḥ paramarṣiḥ sa ucyate
niḥsaṃśayeṣu sarveṣu nityaṃ vasati vai hariḥ
sāṅkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca sanātane dve vedāśca sarve nikhilena rājan
śubhāśubhaṃ karma samīritaṃ ya tpravartate sarvalokeṣu kiṃcit
tasmādṛpestadbhavatīti vidyā ddivyantarikṣe bhuvi cāpsu ceti
bahavaḥ puruṣā brahmannutāho eka eva tu
ko hyatra puruṣaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ ko vā yonirihocyate
tathā taṃ puruṣaṃ viśvaṃ vyākhyāsyāmi guṇādhikam
atha tatrā''satastasya caturvakrasya dhīmataḥ lalāṭaprabhavaḥ putraḥ śiva āgādyadṛcchayā
taṃ pādayoniṃpatitaṃ dṛṣṭvā savyena pāṇinā atthāpayāmāsa tadā prabhurekaḥ prajāpatiḥ
svāgataṃ te mahābāho diṣṭyā prāptosi me'ntikam kaccitte kuśalaṃ putra svādhyāyatapasoḥ sadā
nityamugratapāstvaṃ hi tataḥ pṛcchāmi te punaḥ
kautūhalaṃ cāpi hi me ekāntagamanena te
sṛjyante cāpare brahmansa caikaḥ puruṣo virāṭ
etanme saṃśayaṃ chindhi mahatkautūhalaṃ hi me
bahavaḥ puruṣāḥ putra tvayā ye samudāhṛtāḥ
ādhāraṃ tu pravakṣyāmi ekasya puruṣasya te
tathā taṃ puruṣaṃ viśvaṃ paramaṃ sumahattamam
na sa śakyastvayā draṣṭuṃ mayā'nyairvā'pi sattama
vasannapi śarīreṣu na sa lipyati karmabhiḥ
mamāntarātmā tava ca ye cānye dehasaṃjñitāḥ
kṣetrāṇi hi śarīrāṇi bījaṃ cāpi śubhāśubham
tāni vetti sa yogātmā tataḥ kṣetrajña ucyate
sāṅkhyena vidhinā caiva yogena ca yathākramam
cintayāmi gatiṃ cāsya na gatiṃ vedmi cottarām
yathājñānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi puruṣaṃ tu sanātanam
tasyaikatvaṃ mahattvaṃ ca sa caikaḥ puruṣaḥ smṛtaḥ
eko hutāśo bahudhā samidhyate ekaḥ sūryastapaso yonirekā
eko vāyurbahudhā vāti loke mahodadhiścāmbhasāṃ yonirekaḥ puruṣaścaiko nirguṇo viśvarūpa staṃ nirguṇaṃ puruṣaṃ cāviśanti
hitvā guṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ karmaṃ hitvā śubhāśubham
ubhe satyānṛte tyaktvā evaṃ bhavati nirguṇaḥ
acintyaṃ cāpi taṃ jñātvā bhāvasūkṣmaṃ catuṣṭayam
tatra yaḥ paramātmā hi sa nityo nirguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
sa hi nārāyaṇo jñeyaḥ sarvātmā puruṣo hi saḥ
karmātmā tvaparo yosau mokṣabandhaiḥ sa yujyate
yattatkṛtsnaṃ lokatantrasya dhāma vedyaṃ paraṃ bodhanīyaṃ ca vedaiḥ
mantā mantavyaṃ prāśitā prāśanīyaṃ ghrātā ghreyaṃ sparśitā sparśanīyam
draṣṭā draṣṭavyaṃ śrāvitā śrāvaṇīyaṃ jñātā jñeyaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ ca
yadvai proktaṃ tāta samyakpradhānaṃ nityaṃ caitacchāśvataṃ cāvyayaṃ ca
yadvai sūte dhāturādyaṃ vidhānaṃ tadvai viprāḥ pravadante'niruddham
yadvai loke vaidikaṃ karma sādhu āśīryuktaṃ taddhi tasyopabhogyam
devāḥ sarve manuyaḥ sādhu dāntā staṃ prāgvaṃśe yajñabhāgaṃ bhajante
ahaṃ brahmā ādya īśaḥ prajānāṃ tasmājjātastvaṃ ca mattaḥ prasūtaḥ
matto jagajjaṅgamaṃ sthāvaraṃ ca sarve vedāḥ sarahasyā hi putra
evaṃ sa bhagavāndevaḥ svena jñānena bodhayat
yasminyasmiṃśca viṣaye yo yo yāti viniścayam
imāṃ ca tvaṃ naravyāghra śrotumarhasi me kathām
na hyastyaviditaṃ loke devarṣe tava kiṃcana
śrutaṃ vā'pyanubhūtaṃ vā dṛṣṭaṃ vā kathayasva me
yathā yena ca kalpena sa tasmai dvijasattamaḥ
saumyaḥ somānvaye jāto jitātmā gotrato bhṛguḥ
tataḥ sa dharmaṃ vedoktaṃ tathā śāstrāktameva ca
śiṣṭācīrṇaṃ ca dharmaṃ ca trividhaṃ cintya cetasā
kiṃnu me syācchubhaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ kṛtaṃ kiṃ parāyaṇam
ityevaṃ cintayannityaṃ na ca yāti viniścayam
sa tasmai satkriyāṃ cakre kriyāyuktena hetunā
dharmaṃ paramakaṃ kuryāṃ ko hi mārgo bhaveddvija
utpannā me matiriyaṃ kuto dharmamayaḥ plavaḥ
saṃyujyamānāni niśāmya loke niryātyamānāni ca sātvikāni
na me mano rajyati bhogarāgai rdṛṣṭvā gatiṃ prārthayataḥ paratra
tenātithe buddhibalāśrayeṇa dharmeṇa dharme viniyuṅkṣva māṃ tvam
provāca vacanaṃ ślakṣaṇaṃ prājño madhurayā girā
na ca saṃniścayaṃ cāmi bahudvāre triviṣṭaye
ahiṃsayā pare svargaṃ satyena ca tathā'pare
upadeśaṃ tu te vipra kariṣye'haṃ yathākramam
guruṇā me yathākhyātamarthatattvaṃ tu me śṛṇu
sa vācā karmaṇā caiva manasā ca dvijarṣabhaḥ
sa te paramakaṃ dharmaṃ na mithyā darśayiṣyarati
yajvā dānapatiḥ kṣānto vṛtte ca parame sthitaḥ
vāḍhamevaṃ kariṣyāmi yathā me bhāṣate bhavān
imāṃ hi rajanīṃ sādho nivasasva mayā saha
uvāsa kila tāṃ rātriṃ saha tena dvijena vai
vyatītā sā niśā kṛtsnā sukhena divasopamā
tataḥ sa vipraḥ kṛtakarmaniścayaḥ kṛtābhyanujñaḥ svajanena dharmakṛt
sa vanāni vicitrāṇi tīrthāni ca sarāṃsi ca
taṃ sa tena yathoddiṣṭaṃ nāgaṃ vipreṇa brāhmaṇaḥ
tattasya vacanaṃ śrutvā rūpiṇī dharmavatsalā darśayāmāsa taṃ vipraṃ nāgapatnī pativratā
tataḥ sa viprastāṃ nāgīṃ samādhāya punaḥpunaḥ
sarve saṃbhūya sahitā hyasya nāvasya bāndhavāḥ
mūlaṃ phalaṃ vā parṇaṃ vā payo vā dvijasattama
na hi no bhrūṇahā kaścitpannageṣviha vidyate
kartavyo na ca saṃtāpo gamyatāṃ ca yathāgatam
atha kāle bahutithe pūrṇe prāpto bhujaṅgamaḥ
upapannāṃ ca tāṃ sādhvīṃ pannagaḥ paryapṛcchata
ahaṃ kasya kuto vā'pi kaḥ ko me ha bhavediti
sā'haṃ dharmaṃ vijānantī dharnanitye tvayi sthite
tacca kāryaṃ na me khyāti darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣati
mānuṣaṃ kevalaṃ vipraṃ devaṃ vā'tha śucismite
ko hi māṃ mānuṣaḥ śakto draṣṭukāmo yaśasvini
manuṣyāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa nāvekṣyā iti me matiḥ
sa hi kāryāntarākāṅkṣī jalepsuḥ stokako yathā
varṣaṃ varṣapriyaḥ pakṣī darśanaṃ tava kāṅkṣate
rājā vā rājaputro vā bhrūṇahatyaiva yujyate
na yāti nirayaṃ kaściditi dharmavido viduḥ
abhimānairna māno me jātidoṣeṇa vai mahān
roṣaḥ saṃkalpajaḥ sādhvi dagdho vāgagninā tvayā
na ca roṣādahaṃ sādhvi paśyeyamadhikaṃ tamaḥ
roṣasya hi vaśaṃ gatvā daśagnīvaḥ pratāpavān
nigṛhīto mayā roṣaḥ śrutvaivaṃ vacanaṃ tava
yasya me tvaṃ viśālākṣi bhāryā guṇasamanvitā
eṣa tatraiva gacchāmi yatra tiṣṭhatyasau dvijaḥ
bhobho kṣāmyābhibhāṣae tvāṃ na roṣaṃ kartumarhasi
vivikte gomatītīre kaṃ vā tvaṃ paryupāsase
dharmāraṇyaṃ hi māṃ viddhi nāgaṃ draṣṭumihāgatam
ahaṃ sa nāgo viprarṣe yathā māṃ vindate bhavān
ājñāpaya yathāsvairaṃ kiṃ karomi priyaṃ tava
vayaṃ hi bhavatā sarve guṇakrītā viśeṣataḥ
vivasvato gacchati paryayeṇa voḍuṃ bhavāṃstaṃ yathamekacakram
āścaryabhūtaṃ yadi tatra kiṃci ddṛṣṭaṃ tvayāśaṃsitumarhasi tvam
vibhajyaṃ taṃ tu viprarṣe prajānāṃ hitakāmyayā
yasya maṇḍalamadhyastho mahātmā paramatviṣā - - dīptaḥ samīkṣate'lokānkimāścaryamataḥ param
yato bījaṃ mahī ceyaṃ dhāryate sacarācaram
ka eṣa divamākramya gataḥ sūrya ivāparaḥ
naiṣa devo'nilasakho nāsuro na ca yannagaḥ
na hi devā na gandharvā nāsurā na ca pannagāḥ
etadevaṃvidhaṃ dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ tatra me dvija saṃsiddho mānuṣaḥ kāmaṃ yosau siddhagatiṃ gataḥ
anuktvā hṛdgataṃ kāryaṃ kvedānīṃ prasthito bhavān
na hi māṃ kevalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tyaktvā praṇayavāniha
tvayi cāhaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha bhavānmayi na saṃśayaḥ
loko'yaṃ bhavataḥ sarvaḥ kā cintā mayi te'nagha
sa eva tvaṃ sa evāhaṃ yo'haṃ sa tu bhavānapi
ahaṃ bhavāṃśca bhūtāni sarve yatra gatāḥ sadā
eṣa me niścayaḥ sādho kṛtaṃ kāraṇamuttamam
devarājena ca purā kathitaiṣā kathā śubhā
tadeva paramo dharmo yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārata
sa ca kila kṛtaniścayo dvijo bhujagapatipratidaśitātmakṛtyaḥ
śaratalpe mahātmānaṃ śayānamaparājitam yudhiṣṭhira upāgamya praṇipatyedamabravīt
na ca me hṛdaye śāntirasti śrutvedamīdṛśam
matkṛte nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ kinnu kaṣṭataraṃ tataḥ
kṛtvedaṃ ninditaṃ karma prāpsyāmaḥ kāṃ gatiṃ nṛpa
idaṃ tu dhārtarāṣṭrāsya śreyo manye janādhipa
imāmavasthāṃ saṃprāptaṃ yadasau tvāṃ na paśyati
na sa paśyati duṣṭātmā tvāmadya patitaṃ kṣitau
ataḥ śreyo mṛtaṃ manye neha jīvitamātmanaḥ
ahaṃ hi samare vīra gamitaḥ śatrubhiḥ kṣayam abhaviṣyaṃ yadi purā saha bhrātṛbhiracyuta
nūnaṃ hi pāpakarmāṇo dhātrā sṛṣṭāḥ sma he nṛpa
anyasminnapi loke vai yathā mucyema kilbiṣāt
tathā praśādhi māṃ rājanmama cedicchasi priyam
tāṃ cābravīdayaṃ te sa putrahā pannagādhamaḥ
brahi kṣipraṃ mahābhāge vadhyatāṃ kena hetunā
visṛjainamabuddhistvamavadhyo'rjunaka tvayā ko hyātmānaṃ guruṃ kuryātprāptavye sati cintayan
asyotsarge prāṇayuktasya jantormṛtyuṃ loke ko na gacchedanante
jānāmyahaṃ neha guṇāguṇajñāḥ sadāyuktā guravo vai bhavanti
svargasya te sūpadeśā bhavanti tasmātkṣudraṃ sarpamenaṃ haniṣye
śamamīpsantaḥ kālayogaṃ tyajanti sadyaḥ śucaṃ tvarthavidastyajanti
śriyaḥ kṣayaḥ śocatāṃ nityaśo hi tasmācchucaṃ muñca hate bhujaṅge
na caivārtirvidyate'smadvidhānāṃ dharmātmānaḥ sarvadā sañjanā hi
nityāyasto bālajano na cāhaṃ dharmopaiti prabhavāmyasya nāham
na brāhmaṇānāṃ kopo'sti kutaḥ kopācca yātanā
hatvā lābhaḥ śreya evāvyayaḥ syātsadyolābhaḥsyādbalibhyaḥ praśastaḥ
kālāllābho yastu sadyo bhaveta śreyolābhaḥ kutsite tvīdṛśi syāt
kā'rthaprāptirgṛhya śatruṃ nihatya kā kāmāptiḥ prāpya śatruṃ na muktvā
kasmātsaumyāhaṃ na kṣame no bhujaṅge mokṣārthaṃ vā kasya hetorna kuryām
asmādekādbahavo rakṣitavyā naiko bahubhyo gautami rakṣitavyaḥ
kṛtāgasaṃ dharmahetostyajanti sarīsṛpaṃ pāpamimaṃ tyaja tvam
nāsminhate pannage putrako me samprāpsyate lubdhaka jīvitaṃ vai
guṇaṃ cānyaṃ nāsya vadhe prapaśye tasmātsarpaṃ lubdhaka muñca jīvam
vṛtraṃ hatvā devarāṭ śreṣṭhabhāgvai yajñaṃ hatvā bhāgamavāpa caiva
śūlī devo devavṛttaṃ cara tvaṃ kṣipraṃ sarpaṃ jahi mā bhūtte viśaṅkā
ko nvarjunaka doṣo'tra vidyate mama bāliśa
tasyāyaṃ vacanāddaṣṭo na kopena na kāmyayā tasya tatkilbiṣaṃ lubdha vidyate yadi kiñcana
kilbiṣī cāpi me vadhyaḥ kilbiṣī cāsi pannaga
evaṃ sati na doṣo me nāsmi vadhyo na kilbiṣī
kāraṇaṃ yadi syādvai na kartā syāstvamapyuta
vināśe kāraṇaṃ tvaṃ ca tasmādvadhyo'si me mataḥ
asatyapi kṛte kārye neha pannaga lipyate
tasmānnātraiva hetuḥ syādvadhyaḥ kiṃ bahu bhāṣase
yathā havīṃṣi juhvānā makhe vai lubdhakartvijaḥ
na phalaṃ prāpnuvantyatra phalayoge tathā hyaham
sātvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasā ye ca kecana
jaṅgamāḥ sthāvarāścaiva divi vā yadi vā bhuvi
pravṛttayaśca loke yā tathaiva ca nivṛttayaḥ
tāsāṃ vikṛtayo yāśca sarvaṃ kālātmakaṃ smṛtam
agniḥ khaṃ pṛthivī mitraḥ parjanyo vasavo'ditiḥ
sarve kālena sṛjyante hriyante ca punaḥpunaḥ
evaṃ jñātvā kathaṃ māṃ sadoṣaṃ sarpa manyase
atha caivaṃ gate doṣe mayi tvamapi doṣavān
nirdoṣaṃ doṣavantaṃ vā na tvāṃ mṛtyo bravīmyaham
yadi kāle tu doṣo'sti yadi tatrāpi neṣyate
doṣo naiva parīkṣyo me na hyatrādhikṛtā vayam
nirmokṣastvasya doṣasya mayā kāryo yathā tathā
mṛtyorapi na doṣaḥ syāditi me'tra prayojanam
sarpo'thārjunakaṃ prāha śrutaṃ te mṛtyubhāṣitam nānāgasaṃ māṃ pāśena santāpayitumarhasi
mṛtyoḥ śrutaṃ me vacanaṃ tava caiva bhujaṅgama
dhiṅbhṛtyuṃ ca durātmānaṃ krūraṃ duḥkhakaraṃ satām
nāvāṃ dopeṇa gantavyau tvayā lubdhaka karhicit
na hyahaṃ nāpyayaṃ mṛtyurnāyaṃ lubdhaka pannagaḥ
kilbiṣī jantumaraṇe na vayaṃ hi prayojakāḥ
yadanena kṛtaṃ karma tenāyaṃ nidhanaṃ gataḥ
tathā karma ca kartā ca sambaddhāvātmakarmabhiḥ
evaṃ nāhaṃ na vai mṛtyurna sarpo na tathā bhava n
na ceyaṃ brāhmaṇī vṛddhā śiśurevātra kāraṇam
tasmiṃstathā bruvāṇe tu brāhmaṇī gautamī nṛpa
naiva kālo na bhujago na mṛtyuriha kāraṇam
mayā ca tatkṛtaṃ karma yenāyaṃ me mṛtaḥ sutaḥ
etacchrutvā śamaṃ gaccha mā bhūḥ śokaparo nṛpa
naiva tvayā kṛtaṃ karma nāpi duryodhanena vai
satye tapasi dāne ca yasya nityaṃ rataṃ manaḥ
dhanurvede ca vede ca nirato yo'bhavatsadā
putro dyutimatastvāsīdrājā paramadhārmikaḥ sarvalokeṣu vikhyātaḥ suvīro nāma nāmataḥ
na tasya viṣaye cābhūtkṛpaṇo nāpi durgataḥ
vyādhito vā kṛśo vā'pari tasminnābhūnnaraḥ kvacit
yajvā ca dānto medhāvī brahmaṇyaḥ satyasaṅgaraḥ
taṃ narmadā devanadī puṇyā śītajalā śivā
tasyāṃ jajñe tadā nadyāṃ kanyā rājīvalocanā
tasyā manoharaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā devo hutāśanaḥ
bālātapena tulitaṃ sasvedapulakodgamam bimbādharoṣṭhavadanaṃ vibuddhamiva paṅkajam
dvijapriye prasīdasva bhaja māṃ subhagā hyasi
mātā pitā prabhavataḥ pradāne bāndhavāśca ye
pāṇigrahaṇamantraiśca hute caiva vibhāvasau satāṃ madhye niviṣṭāyāḥ kanyāyāḥ śaraṇaṃ patiḥ
sā'haṃ nātmavaśā deva pitaraṃ varayasva me
na tu rājā pradānāya tasmai bhāvamakalpayat daridraścāsavarṇaśca mamāyamiti pārthivaḥ
iti tasmai na vai kanyāṃ ditsāṃ cakre narādhipaḥ
tataḥ sa bhīto nṛpatirbhṛśaṃ pravyathitendriyaḥ mantriṇo brāhmaṇāṃścaiva papraccha kimidaṃ bhavet
tataḥ sa rājā tacchrutvā vacanaṃ brahmavādinām
avāpya paramaṃ harṣaṃ tatheti prāha buddhimān
ayācata ca taṃ śulkaṃ bhagavantaṃ vibhāvasum
dṛṣṭaṃ hi sahadevena diśaṃ vijayatā ca tat
tasyā rūpeṇa śīlena kulena vapuṣā śriyā
atitheḥ pratikūlaṃ te na kartavyaṃ kathañcana
apyātmanaḥ pradānena na te kāryā vicāraṇā
pramāṇaṃ yadi vāmoru vacaste mama śobhane
idaṃ vacanamavyagrā hṛdi tvaṃ dhārayeḥ sadā
āsanaṃ caiva pādyaṃ ca tasmai dattvā dvijātaye
provācaughavatī vipraṃ kenārthaḥ kiṃ dadāmi te
tato vihasya viprarṣiḥ sā caivopaviveśa ha
tasmai prativacaḥ sā tu bhartre na pradadau tadā
karābhyāṃ tena vipreṇa spṛṣṭā bhartṛvratā satī
atha tāṃ kinviti punaḥ provāca sa sudarśanaḥ
kva sā sādhvī kva sāyātā garīya kimato mama
atithiṃ viddhi samprāptaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pāvake ca mām
surataṃ te'stu viprāgrya prītirhi paramā mama
atithiḥ pūjito yasya gṛhasthasya tu gacchati
buddhirātmā manaḥ kālo diśaścaiva guṇā daśa
tena satyena māṃ devāḥ pālayantu dahantu vā
vapuṣā dyāṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca vyāpya vāyurivodyataḥ
prāptaḥ satyaṃ ca te jñātvā prītirme paramā tvayi
randhrānveṣī tava sadā tvayā dhṛtyā vaśīkṛtaḥ
eṣā hi tapasā svena saṃyuktā brahmavādinī
ardhenaughavatī nāma tvāmardhenānuyāsyati śarīreṇa mahābhāgā yogo hyasyā vaśe sthitaḥ
nirjitaśca tvayā mṛtyuraiśvaryaṃ ca tavottamam pañcabhūtānyatikrāntaḥ svavīryācca manojavaḥ
gṛhasthadharmeṇānena kāmakrodhau ca te jitau sneho rāgaśca tandrī ca moho drohaśca kevalaḥ
mṛtyurātmā ca lokāśca jitā bhūtāni pañca ca buddhiḥ kālo mado mohaḥ kāmakrodhau tathaiva ca
atithiḥ pūjito yaddhi dhyāyate manasā śubham
pātraṃ tvatithimāsādya śīlāḍhyaṃ yo na pūjayet
sa dattvā tuṣkṛtaṃ tasmai puṇyamādāya gacchati
prajñāśrutābhyāṃ vṛttena śīlena ca yathā bhavān
bhavānviśiṣṭo buddhyā ca prajñayā tapasā tathā sarveṣāmeva jātānāṃ satāmetanna saṃśayaḥ
kṣatriyo yadi vā vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā rājasattama
brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpaṃ tribhirvarṇairnarādhipa tapasā vā sumahatā karmaṇā vā śrutena vā
taṃ dṛśya nasi nirbhinnaṃ gardabhī putragṛddhinī
brāhmaṇo dāruṇo nāsti maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate
ayaṃ tu pāpaprakṛtirbāle na kurute dayām
brūhi rāsabhi kalyāṇi mātā me yena dūṣitā kena māṃ vetsi caṇḍālaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ kena me'naśat
brāhmaṇyāṃ vṛṣalena tvaṃ mattāyāṃ nāpitena ha
kuśalaṃ tu kutastasya yasyeyaṃ jananī pitaḥ
mataṅga tapsyase kiṃ tvaṃ bhogānutsṛjya mānuṣān
varaṃ dadāmi te hanta vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ yadicchasi
yaccāpyavāpyaṃ hṛdi te sarvaṃ tadbrūhi mā ciram
gaccheyaṃ tadavāpyeha vara eṣa vṛto mayā
brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ tāta prārthayāno na lapsyase
mā kṛthāḥ sāhasaṃ putra naiṣa dharmapathastava
vimārgato mārgamāṇaḥ sarvathā nabhaviṣyasi na hi śakyaṃ tvayā prāptuṃ brāhmaṇyamiha durmate
sa jāyate pulkaso vā caṇḍālo vā'pyasaṃśayaḥ
tatastriṃśadgaṇe kāle labhate vaiśyatāmapi vaiśyatāyāṃ ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
tataḥ ṣaṣṭiguṇe kāle rājanyo nāma jāyate
taṃ ca prāpya ciraṃ kālaṃ tatraiva parivartate
tadevaṃ śokaharṣau tu kāmadveṣau ca putraka
atha te vai jayantyenaṃ tālaṃ pakvamivāpatet
vṛṇīṣva kāmamanyaṃ tvaṃ brāhmaṇyaṃ hi sudurlabham
anyaṃ kāmaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ mā vṛthā te'stvayaṃ śramaḥ
tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā sa tatāpeti naḥ śrutam
brāhmaṇaḥ kurute taddhi yathā yadyacca vāñchati
anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ durlabho'yaṃ hi te varaḥ
kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām
tvāṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ na bubhūṣase
nūnaṃ daivaṃ na śakyaṃ hi pauruṣeṇātivartitum
yadarthaṃ yatnavāneva na labhe vipratāṃ vibho
evaṃgate tu dharmajña dātumarhasi me varam
chandodeva iti khyātaḥ strīṇāṃ pūjyo bhaviṣyasi
kīrtiśca te'tulā vatsa triṣu lokeṣu yāsyati
putrāḥ pañcaśataṃ cāpi śaptāḥ śvapacatāṃ gatāḥ
tasyaitāni ca karmāṇi tathā'nyāni ca kaurava
śrūyatāṃ pārtha tattvena viśvāmitro yathā purā
kanyā jajñe sutāttasya vane nivasataḥ sataḥ
ṛcīka iti vikhyāto vipule tapasi sthitaḥ
sa tāṃ na pradadau tasmai ṛcīkāya mahātmane
daridra iti matvā vai gādhiḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ
śulkaṃ pradīyatāṃ mahyaṃ tato vatsyasi me sutām
kiṃ prayacchāmi rājendra tubhyaṃ śulkamahaṃ nṛpa
tato vai gādhaye tāta sahasraṃ vājināṃ śubham
ṛcīkaḥ pradadau prītaḥ śulkārthaṃ tapatāṃ varaḥ
tataḥ sa vismito rājā gādhiḥ śāpabhayena ca
dadau tāṃ samalaṅkṛtya kanyāṃ bhṛgusutāya vai
sā ca taṃ patimāsādya paraṃ harṣamavāpa ha
sa tutoṣa ca brahmarṣistasyā vṛttena bhārata
mamāpi putri bhartā te prasādaṃ kartumarhati
tataḥ sā tvaritaṃ gatvā tatsarvaṃ pratyavedayat
guṇavantaṃ ca putraṃ vai tvaṃ ca sā'tha janiṣyatha
tava caiva guṇaślāghī putra utpatsyate mahān
ṛtusnātā ca sā'śvatthaṃ tvaṃ ca vṛkṣamudumbaram
tvaṃ ca sā copabhuñjītaṃ tataḥ putrāvavāpsyathaḥ
tāmuvāca tato mātā sutāṃ satyavatīṃ tadā
enaṃ prayaccha mahyaṃ tvaṃ madīyaṃ tvaṃ gṛhāṇa ca
tato me tvaccarau bhāvaḥ pādape ca samudhyame kathaṃ viśiṣṭo bhrātā me bhavedityeva cintaya
tathāca kṛtavatyau te mātā satyavatī ca sā
atha garbhāvanuprāpte ubhe te vai yudhiṣṭhira
dṛṣṭvā garbhamanuprāptāṃ bhāryāṃ sa ca mahānṛṣiḥ
vyatyāsaḥ pādape cāpi suvyaktaṃ te kṛtaḥ śubhe
mayā hi viśvaṃ yadbrāhma tvaccarau sanniveśitam
kṣatravīryaṃ ca sakalaṃ carau tasyā niveśitam
sā ca kṣatraṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vai tata etatkṛtaṃ mayā
vyatyāsastu kṛto yasmāttvayā mātrā ca te śubhe
tasmātsā brāhmaṇaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mātā te janayiṣyati
na hi te tatkṛtaṃ sādhu mātṛsnehena bhāmini
pratilabhya ca sā sañjñāṃ śirasā praṇipatya ca
prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe na me syāttratriyaḥ sutaḥ
na tu me syātsuto brahmanneṣa me dīyatāṃ varaḥ
tataḥ sā janayāmāsa jamadagniṃ sutaṃ śubham
līlāḍhyo nāradaścaiva tathā kūrcāmukhaḥ smṛtaḥ vādulirmusalaścaiva vakṣogrīvastathaiva ca
ambhorudaścārumatsyaḥ śirīṣī cātha gārdabhiḥ ūrjayonirudāpekṣī nāradī ca mahānṛṣiḥ
tatratatra ca māṃ brūhi cchettā'smi tava saṃśayān
vītahavyaśca nṛpatiḥ śruto me vipratāṃ gataḥ
sa kena karmaṇā prāpto brāhmaṇyaṃ rājasattamaḥ
haihayasya tu rājendra daśasu strīṣu bhārata śataṃ babhūva putrāṇāṃ śūrāṇāmanivartinām
dhanurvede ca vede ca sarvatraiva kṛtaśramāḥ
taṃ tu hatvā narapatiṃ haihayāste mahārathāḥ
gaṅgāyā uttare kūle vaprānte rājasattam gomatyā dakṣiṇe kūle śakrasyevāmarāvatīm
sa niṣkramya dadau yuddhaṃ tebhyo rājā mahābalaḥ
sa tu yuddhe mahārāja dinānāṃ daśatīrdaśa
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ te sarvaṃ prabūhi me nṛpa
yatte priyaṃ tatkariṣye na me'trāsti vicāraṇā
ekaśeṣaḥ kṛto vaṃśo mama taiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ
na bhetavyaṃ na bhetavyaṃ saudeva vyetu te bhayam
vedaṃ cāpi jagau kṛtsnaṃ dhanurvedaṃ ca bhārata
tataḥ sa kavacī dhanvī stūyamānaḥ surarṣibhiḥ
sa rathī baddhanistriṃśo babhau dīpta ivānalaḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ harṣaṃ sudevatanayo yayau
sarathaḥ sa tu saṃtīrya gaṅgāmāśu parākramī
yayau bhṛguṃ ca śaraṇaṃ vītahavyo narādhipaḥ abhayaṃ ca dadau tasmai vītahavyāya bhārgavaḥ
bhobho ke'trāśrame santi bhṛgoḥ śiṣyā mahātmanaḥ
uvāca cainaṃ rājendra kiṃ kāryaṃ brūhi pārthiva
asya putrairhi me kṛtsno brahmanvaṃśaḥ praṇāśitaḥ
utsāditaśca viṣayaḥ kāśīnāṃ ratnasañcayaḥ etasya vīryadṛptasya hataṃ putraśataṃ mayā
ya eṣa rājā vīryeṇa svajātiṃ tyājito mayā
anujānīhi māṃ brahmandhyāyasva ca śivena mām
tyājito hi mayā jātimeva rājā bhṛgūdvaha
ghṛtācyāṃ tasya putrastu rururnāmodapadyata pramadvarāyāṃ tu ruroḥ putraḥ samudapadyata
eṣa te kathito vaṃśo rājangārtsamado mayā
nābījaṃ jāyate kiñcinna bījene vinā phalam
sukṛte duṣkṛte vā'pi tādṛśaṃ labhate phalam
yathā bījaṃ vinā kṣetramuptaṃ bhavati niṣphalam
tathā puruṣakāreṇa vinā daivaṃ na sidhyati
śubhena karmaṇā saukhyaṃ duḥkhaṃ pāpena karmaṇā
kṛtaṃ sarvatra labhate nākṛtaṃ bhujyate kvacit
tathā svargaśca bhogaśca niṣṭhā yā ca manīṣitā
artho vā mitravargo vā aiśvaryaṃ vā kulānvitam
śaucena labhate vipraḥ kṣatriyo vikrameṇa tu
nādātāraṃ bhajantyarthā na klībaṃ nāpi niṣkriyam
yena lokāstrayaḥ sṛṣṭā daityāḥ sarvāśca devatāḥ
sa eṣa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ samudre tapyate tapaḥ
na tathā mānuṣe loke phalamasti śubhāśubhe
kathaṃ karma vinā daivaṃ sthāsyati sthāpayiṣyataḥ
ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca sadā bhavati vigrahaḥ
kasya vācā hyadaivaṃ syādyato daivaṃ pravartate
puṇyahīnaṃ naraṃ prāpya kiṃ daivaṃ prakariṣyati
dvijastrīṇāṃ vadhaṃ kṛtvā kiṃ daivena na vāritaḥ
vipulamapi dhanaughaṃ prāpya bhogāntriyo vā puruṣa iha na śaktaḥ karmahīno hi bhoktum
suvihitamapi cārthaṃ daivate rakṣyamāṇaṃ puruṣa iha mahātmā prāpnute nityayuktaḥ
vyayagumapi sādhuṃ karmaṇā saṃśrayante bhavatī manujalokāddaivaloko viśiṣṭaḥ
bahutarasusamṛddhyā mānuṣāṇāṃ gṛhāṇi pitṛvanabhavanābhaṃ dṛśyate cāmarāṇām
na ca phalati vikarmā jīvaloke na daivaṃ vyapanayati vimārgaṃ nāsti daive prabhutvam
gurumiva kṛtamagryaṃ karma saṃyāti daivaṃ nayati puruṣakāraḥ sañcitastatratatra
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārata rahasyaṃ yadṛṣīṇāṃ tu tacchṛṇuṣva yudhiṣṭhira
yā gatiḥ prāpyate yena pretyabhāve cirepsitā
te hyasya sākṣiṇo nityaṃ ṣaṣṭha ātmā śubhāśubhe
avākśirāstu yo lambedudavāsaṃ ca yo vaset
maṇḍūkaśāyī ca naro labhate cepsitāṃ gatim
striyastriṣavaṇaṃ snātvā vāyuṃ pītvā kratuṃ labhet
vitṛṣṇānāṃ vedajapātsvargamokṣaphalaṃ smṛtam mānasaṃ hi carandharma svargalokamupāśnute
yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ
acodyamānāni yathā puṣpāṇi ca phalāni ca
jīryanti jīryataḥ keśā dantā jīryanti jīryataḥ
cakṣuḥ śrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā na tu jīryate
yena prīṇanti pitarastena prītaḥ prajāpatiḥ mātā ca yena prīṇāti pṛthivī tena pūjitā
sarve tasyādṛtā dharmā yasyaite traya ādṛtāḥ
yanmantre bhavati vṛthopayujyamāne yatsome bhavati vṛthā'bhiṣūyamāṇe
yaccāgnau bhavati vṛthā'bhihūyamāne tatsarvaṃ bhavati vṛthā'bhidhīyamāne
vāsavasya ca saṃvādaṃ śukasya ca mahātmanaḥ
na jahāti śuko vāsaṃ tasya bhaktyā vanaspateḥ
pṛcche tvāṃ śukamenaṃ tvaṃ kasmānna tyajasi drumam
atha pṛṣṭaḥ śukaḥ prāha mūrdhnā samabhivādya tam
kimarthaṃ sevase vṛkṣaṃ yadā mahadidaṃ vanam
vimṛśya prajñayā dhīra jahīmaṃ hyasthiraṃ drumam
kimanukrośyaṃ vaiphalyamutpādayasi me'nagha anuraktasya bhaktasya saṃspṛśe na ca pāvakam
nārhase māṃ sahasrākṣa drumaṃ tyājayituṃ cirāt
varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tadā sa ca vavre varaṃ śukaḥ
viditvā ca dṛḍhāṃ bhaktiṃ tāṃ śuke śīlasampadam
sarvārthasiddhiṃ labhate śukaṃ prāpya yathā drumaḥ
yathaiva te namaskāryāḥ proktāḥ śakreṇa mānada
spṛhayāmi dvijātibhyo yeṣāṃ brahma paraṃ dhanam
udvahanti na sīdanti tebhyo vai spṛhayāmyaham
ye cāpi teṣāṃ śrotāraḥ sadā sadasi sammatāḥ
susaṃskṛtāni prayatāḥ śucīni guṇavanti ca dadatyannāni tṛptyarthaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo yudhiṣṭhara
śūrā vīrāśca śataśaḥ santi loke yudhiṣṭhira
bhadraṃ tu janma samprāpya bhūyo brāhmaṇako bhavet bandhumadhye kule jātaḥ sudurāpamavāpnuyāt
dhanyaḥ syāṃ yadyahaṃ bhūyaḥ saumyabrāhmaṇakopi vā
tena satyena gaccheyaṃ lokānyatra sa śantanuḥ
na me pituḥ pitā vā'pi ye cānye'pi suhṛñjanāḥ
na hi me vṛjinaṃ kiñcidvidyate brāhmaṇeṣviha
aṇu vā yadi vā sthūlaṃ vidyate sādhukarmasu
karmaṇā manasā vā'pi vācā vā'pi paraṃtapa
teṣu me tāta gantavyamahnāya ca cirāya ca
yathā bhartrāśrayo dharmaḥ strīṇāṃ loke yudiṣṭhira
sa devaḥ sā gatirnānyā kṣatriyasya tathā dvijāḥ
pitāputrau ca vijñeyau tayorhi brāhmaṇo guruḥ
nārī tu patyabhāve vai devaraṃ kurute patim
brāhmaṇānujñayā grāhyaṃ rājyaṃ ca sapurohitaiḥ tadrakṣaṇena svargo'sya tatkopānnarako'kṣayaḥ
putravaccaiva te rakṣyā upāsyā guruvacca te
hanyuḥ kruddhā mahārāja brāhmaṇā ye tapasvinaḥ
daṇḍapāṇiryathā goṣṭhaṃ pālo nityaṃ hi rakṣayet
na skandate na vyathate nāsyordhvaṃ sarpate rajaḥ
na ceddhanti pitaraṃ mātaraṃ vā na brāhmaṇaṃ nāpavādaṃ karoti
yatkrodhano yajate yaddadāti yadvā tapastapyati yajjuhoti
vaivasvato harate sarvamasya moghaṃ ceṣṭaṃ bhavati krodhanasya
yathā'haṃ tatra nāśnāmi yatra nāśnanti vai dvijāḥ etena satyavākyena pādaḥ kumbhasya pūryatām
vaitāne karmaṇi tate kuntīputra yathā purā
ka ijyate kaśca yajñaḥ ko yūpaḥ kramate ca kaḥ
kaścādhvare śasyate gītiśabdaiḥ kaścādhvare gīyate valgubhāṣaiḥ
ko brahmaśabdaiḥ stutibhiḥ stūyate ca kasyeha vai haviradhvaryavaḥ kalpayanti
varṇāśrame gophale kaśca some kaścoṃkāraḥ kaśca vedārthamārgaḥ
pṛṣṭastanme brūhi sarvaṃ maharṣe lokajyeṣṭhaṃ kasya vijñānamāhuḥ
lokajyeṣṭhaṃ yasya vijñānamāhu ryonijyeṣṭhaṃ yasya vadanti janma
pūtātmāno brāhmaṇā vedamukhyā asminpraśno dīyatāṃ keśavāya
bālo jātyā kṣatradharmārthaśīlo jāto devakyāṃ śūraputreṇa vīra
vettuṃ vedānarhate kṣatriyo vai dāśārhāṇāmuttamaḥ puṣkarākṣaḥ
pārāśarya brūhi yadbrāhmaṇebhyaḥ prītātmā vai brahmakalpaḥ sumedhāḥ
pṛṣṭo yajñārthaṃ pāṇḍavasyātitejā etacchreyastasya lokasya caiva
chettuṃ vispaṣṭaṃ tiṣṭhati tvadvidhe vai lokajyeṣṭhe viśvarūpe sunābhe
tattvaṃ vākyaṃ brūhi yattvaṃ maharṣe yasminkṛṣṇaḥ procyate vai yathāvat
prītaste'haṃ jñānaśaktyā yathāvattasmānnirdeśe karmaṇāṃ brūhi siddhim
uktavākye sattame yādavānāṃ kṛṣṇo vyāsaḥ prāñjalirvāsudevam
vipraiḥ sārdhaṃ pūjayandevadevaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāsudevaṃ babhāṣe
ānantyaṃ te viśvakarmaṃstavaivaṃ rūpaṃ paurāṇaṃ śāśvataṃ ca dhruvaṃ ca
viṣṇuṃ krāntaṃ vāsudevaṃ vijānanvipro vipratvaṃ gacchate tatvadarśī
viṣṇuryajñastvijyate cāpi viṣṇuḥ kṛṣṇo viṣṇuryaśca kṛtsnaḥ prabhuśca
kṛṣṇo vedāṅgaṃ vedavādāśca kṛṣṇa evaṃ jānanbrāhmaṇo brahma eti
sthānaṃ sarvaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yajñamārge cāturhotraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tatra kṛṣṇaḥ
somaṃ sadbhāvādye ca jātaṃ pibanti dīptiṃ karma ye vidānāścaranti
ekāntamiṣṭaṃ cintayanto divisthāste vai sthānaṃ prāpnuvanti vratajñāḥ
omityetaddhyāyamāno na gaccheddurgaṃ panthānaṃ pāpakarmāpi vipraḥ
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ hi vigrāḥ kṛtvā dhyānaṃ durgatiṃ na prayānti
ājyaṃ yajñaḥ sruksruvau yajñadātā icchā patnī patniśālā havīṃṣi
idhyāḥ puroḍāśaṃ sarvadā hotṛkartā kṛtsnaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃvijānaṃstameti
yogeyoge karmaṇāṃ cābhihāre yukte vaitāne karmaṇi brāhmaṇasya
śraddātyāgaṃ nirvṛtiṃ cāpi pūjāṃ satyaṃ dharmaṃ yaḥ kṛtaṃ cābhyupaiti
kāmadveṣau tyajya sarveṣu tulyaḥ śraddhāpūtaḥ sarvayajñeṣu yogyaḥ
yasminyajñe sarvabhūtāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ sarve cārambhāḥ śāstradṛṣṭāḥ pravṛttāḥ
dharmyairarthyairye yajante dhruvaṃ te pūtātmāno dharmamekaṃ bhajante
ekākṣaraṃ dvyakṣaramekameva sadā yajante niyatāḥ pratītāḥ
dṛṣṭvā manāgarcayitvā sma viprāḥ satāṃ mārgaṃ taṃ dhruvaṃ sambhajante
pāpātmānaḥ krodharagābhibhūtāḥ kṛṣṇe bhaktā nāma saṅkīrtayantaḥ
eko vedo brāhmaṇānāṃ babhūva catuṣpādastriguṇo brahmaśīrṣaḥ
pādaṃpādaṃ brāhmaṇā vedamāhustretākāle taṃ ca taṃ viddhi śīrṣam
sarve vedāḥ sarvavedyāḥ saśāstrāḥ sarve yajñāḥ sarva ityaśca kṛṣṇaḥ
viduḥ kṛṣṇaṃ brāhmaṇāstatvato ye teṣāṃ rājansarvayajñaḥ samāptaḥ
jñeyo yogī brāhmaṇairvedatatvairāraṇyakaiḥ saiṣa kṛṣṇaḥ prabhutvāt
sa eṣa devaḥ śakramīśaṃ yajānaṃ prītyā prāha kratuyaṣṭāramagryam
na mā śakro vedavedārthatatvādbhakto bhaktyā śuddhabhāvapradhānaḥ
mā jānante brahmaśīrṣaṃ variṣṭhaṃ viśve viśvaṃ brahmayoniṃ hyayonim
sarve devā vāsudevaṃ yajante tato buddhyā mārgamāṇāstanūnām
kṛṣṇo yajñairijyate yāyajūkaiḥ kṛṣṇo vīryairijyate vikramadbhiḥ
kṛṣṇo vākyairijyate sammṛśānaiḥ kṛṣṇo muktairijyate vītamohaiḥ
vidyāvantaḥ somapā ye vipāpā iṣṭvā yajñergocaraṃ prārthayante
sarvaṃ krāntaṃ devalokaṃ viśālamante gatvā muktilokaṃ bhajanti
evaṃ sarve tvāśramāḥ suvratā ye māṃ jānanto yānti lokānadīnān
pūjyante māṃ pūjayantaḥ prahṛṣṭā māṃ jānantaḥ śraddhayā vāsudevam
bhaktyā tuṣṭo'haṃ tasya sattvaṃ prayacche satvaspṛṣṭo vītamoho'yameti
jyotīṃṣi śuktāni ca yāni loke trayo lokā lokapālāstrayaśca
trayo'gnayaścāhutayaśca pañca sarve devā devakīputra eva
jagāma pṛthvīṃ śirasā mahātmā namaśca kṛṣṇāya cakāra bhīṣmaḥ
garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāṃ śreṣṭha iti pūrvaṃ pitāmaha
atra kautūhala iti śravaṇe jāyate matiḥ
tvaṃ hi śaure mahābāho suparṇaḥ procyase purā
yathaiva māṃ bhavānveda tathā veda yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
yathā ca garuḍo jātastathā'smai brūhi tatvataḥ
yathā ca bhujagānhanti tathā me bruvataḥ śṛṇu
apṛcchaṃ sa ca māṃ prītaḥ pratyuvāca yudhiṣṭhira
te tu dharmeṇopayeme mārīcaḥ kaśyapaḥ prabhuḥ
tatra kadrūrvaraṃ vavre putrāṇāṃ daśataḥ śatam
vinatā tu vavre dvau putrau vīrau bharatasattama
sa tu tābhyāṃ varaṃ prādāttathetyuktvā mahātapāḥ
aṇḍe dve vinatā caiva darśanīyatare śubhe
nahi pañcaśate kāle purā putrau dadarśa sā
mātaraṃ ca palāśī ha hato'hamiti cāsakṛt
pañcavarṣaśatāni tvaṃ spardhase vai yayā saha
eṣa caiva mahābhāge balī balavatāṃvaraḥ mokṣayiṣyati te mātardāsībhāvānmamānujaḥ
pratīkṣate sma taṃ kālaṃ yaḥ putroktastadā'bhavat
hayasya varṇaḥ ko nvatra brūhi yaste mataḥ śubhe
ekavarṇo hayo rājñi sarvaśveto mato mama
varṇaṃ vā kīdṛśaṃ tasya manyate tvaṃ manasvini
yadyārye dīvyasi tvaṃ me kaḥ paṇo no bhaviṣyati
sā tajjñātvā paṇeyaṃ vai jñātvā tu vipaṇe tvayā
rocate me paṇe rājñi dāsītvena na saṃśayaḥ
satyamātiṣṭha bhadraṃ te satye sthāsyāmi cāpyaham
mayā kṛtaḥ paṇaḥ putrā mitho vinatayā saha
jitā dāsī bhavetputrāḥ sā vā'haṃ vā na saṃśayaḥ
sā'haṃ dāsī bhaviṣyāmi jitā putrā na saṃśayaḥ
nikṛtyā na jayaḥ śreyānmātaḥ satyā giraḥ śṛṇu
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca na ca dharmo'tra vidyate
sā tvaṃ dharmādapetaṃ vai kulasyaivāhitaṃ tava
nikṛtyā vijayaṃ mātarmā sma kārṣīḥ kathañcanā
tvayā nāma nivāryāḥ sma mā kurudhvamiti dhruvam
te vayaṃ tvāṃ parityajya draviṣyāma diśo daśa
yatra vākyaṃ na te mātaḥ punaḥ śroṣyāma īdṛśam
na ca tatpaṇitaṃ mandāḥ śakyaṃ jetumato'nvathā
iha vā tārayetputraḥ pretya vā tārayetpitṝn
te yūyaṃ tāraṇārthāya mama putrā manojavāḥ
nikṛtyā vijayo veti dāsatvaṃ vā parābhave
ubhayaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā jayo vai dhārmiko varaḥ
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ mātuḥ kruddhāyāste bhujaṅgamāḥ
evaṃ śaptā diśaḥ prāptāḥ pannagā dharmacāriṇaḥ
vihāya mātaraṃ kruddhā gatā vairakarīṃ tadā
tatra ye vṛjinaṃ tasyā anāpannā bhujaṅgamāḥ
ekavarṇo na vā bhadre paṇo nau suvyavasthitaḥ
utakāduttarantaṃ taṃ hayaṃ caiva ca bhāmini
hanta paśyāva gacchāvaḥ sukṛto nau paṇaḥ śubhe
dāsī vā te bhaviṣyāmi tvaṃ vā dāsī bhaviṣyasi
evaṃ sthiraṃ paṇaṃ kṛtvā hayaṃ te taṃ dadarśatuḥ
sā dṛṣṭvaiva hayaṃ mandaṃ vinatā śokakarśitā
tatra sā vrīlitā vākyaṃ vinatā sāśrubindukā
dāsī māṃ preṣaya svārthe yathā kāmavaśāṃ śubhe
dāsyaśca kāmakārā hi bhartṛṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
dāsīvatpreṣayāmāsa sā ca sarvaṃ cakāra tat
na vivarṇā na saṃkṣubdhā na ca kruddhā na duḥkhitā
atha sma vainateyaṃ vai baladarpau samīyatuḥ
kiṃ darpavaśamāpanno na vai paśyasi mātaram
janayitrī mayi sute jātā dāsī tapasvinī
nikṛtyā pannagendrasya mātrā putraiḥ purā saha
kathaṃ jitā nikṛtyā sā bhagavañjananī mama
brūhi tanme yathāvṛttaṃ śrutvā vetsye tataḥ param
jagāma yatra mātā'sya kṛcchre mahati vartate
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca pauruṣe pratitasthuṣaḥ
yadi dharmeṇa me mātā jitā yadyapyadharmataḥ
jyeṣṭhā tvamasi me mātā dharmaḥ sarvaḥ sa me mataḥ
iyaṃ tu me syātkṛpaṇā mayi putre'mba duḥkhitā
nāhaṃ tava na te māturvainateya kathañcana
kuryāṃ priyamaniṣṭātmā māṃ bravīṣi khaga dvijā
jyeṣṭhā tvamasi kalyāṇi māturme bhāmini priyā sodaryī mama cāsi tvaṃ jyeṣṭhā mātā na saṃśayaḥ -- - ḷ kadrūruvāca
adāsīṃ mama paśyemāṃ vainateya na saṃśayaḥ
kāmaṃ vai sūnṛtā vāco visṛjya ca muhurmuhuḥ
yaccāpyanujñāṃ māturvai na ca sā hyanumanyate
sā mā bahuvidhā vāco vajrakalpā visṛjya vai
rakṣyate hi bhṛśaṃ putra rakṣibhistannibodha me
ayasmayena vai tāta vṛtrahantuḥ sma śāsanāt
tattvamevaṃvidhaṃ tāta kathaṃ prārthayase'mṛtam surakṣitaṃ vajrabhṛtāṃ vainateya vihaṅgama
tathā balamameyaṃ te bhavitā tanna saṃśayaḥ
kva tau krūrau mahābhāga vartete hastikacchapau
parvato vai samudrānte nabhaḥ stabdhveva tiṣṭhati
gorutāni sa vistīrṇaḥ kacchapaḥ kuñjaraśca saḥ
yadā sa nāgo vrajati pipāsustaṃ jalāśayam
tau gaccha sahitau putra yadi śaknoṣi bhakṣaya
na tau pṛthaktayā śakyāvapramattau bale sthitau
jalajaṃ nirgataṃ tāta pramattaṃ caiva vāraṇam
tāṃ sa nāgo girervīthiṃ samprāpta iva bhārataḥ
atha vegena mahatā khecaraḥ sa mahābalaḥ
sa tu nāgaḥ prabhagro'pi pipāsurna nyavartata
caraṇena tu savyena jagrāha sa gajottamam
tāndṛṣṭvā sa yatīṃstatra samāsīnānsuraiḥ saha tuṇḍena gṛhya tāṃ śākhāmutpapāta khageśvaraḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā gurusambhāraṃ pragṛhyotpatitaṃ khagam ṛṣayaste'bruvansarve garuḍo'yamiti sma ha
evaṃ te samayaṃ sarve vasavaśca divaukasaḥ
mumukṣaḥ śākhinaḥ śākhāṃ na sma deśamapaśyata
pātyatāṃ śākhinaḥ śākhā na hi te dharmaniścayāḥ
uddeśaṃ yatra te mandāḥ kuvindāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ
tato gatvā tataḥ śākhāṃ mumoca patatāṃvaraḥ
sa deśo rājaśārdūla khyātaḥ paramadāruṇaḥ śākhāpataga ityeva kuvindānāṃ mahātmanām
hatvā taṃ pakṣiśārdūlaḥ kuvindānāṃ janaṃ vratī upopaviśya śailāgre bhakṣayāmāsa tāvubhau
vāraṇaṃ kaccharpa caiva saṃhṛṣṭaḥ sa patatrirāṭ
tayoḥ sa rudhiraṃ pītvā medasī ca parantapa saṃhṛṣṭaḥ yatatāṃśreṣṭho labdhvā balamanuttamam
jvalantaṃ pāvakaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakṣitvaṃ cātmanaḥ prabho
payasā śāmyate vatsa sarpiṣā ca hutāśanaḥ
navanītaṃ payo vā'pi pāvake tvaṃ samādadheḥ tato gaccha yathākāmaṃ na tvā dhakṣyati pāvakaḥ
sa bhittvā śirasā jālaṃ vajravegasamo balī
tato vai mātaliṃ prāha śīghraṃ vāhaya vājinaḥ
atha divyaṃ mahāghoraṃ garuḍāya sasarja ha
tattu tūrṇaṃ tadā vajraṃ svena vegena bhārata
tato vrajraṃ sahasrākṣo dṛṣṭvā saktaṃ varāyudham
na te suparṇa paśyāmi prabhāvaṃ tena yodhaye ityukte na mayā rakṣā śakyā kartumato'nyathā
idaṃ vajraṃ mayā sārdhaṃ nivṛttaṃ hi yathāgatam
svāgataṃ svāhṛtaṃ cedamamṛtaṃ vinatātmaja adāsī jananī te'dya putra kāmavaśā śubhā
evamukte tadā sā ca samprāptā vinatā gṛham upanīya yathānyāyaṃ vihago balināṃvaraḥ
smṛtvā nikṛtyā vijayaṃ mātuḥ sampratipadya ca vadhaṃ ca bhujagendrāṇāṃ ye vālāstasya vājinaḥ
babhūvurasitaprakhyā nikṛtyā vai jitaṃ tvayā tāmuvāca tato nyāyyaṃ vihago balināṃvaraḥ
uñjahārāmṛtaṃ tūrṇamutpapāta ca raṃhasā tadgṛhītvā'mṛtaṃ tūrṇaṃ prayāntamaparājitam
punarharati durbuddhe mā jātu vṛjitaṃ kṛthāḥ
āhṛtaṃ tadidaṃ śīghraṃ muktā ca jananī mama
yadi māṃ bhavatī brūyādamṛtaṃ me ca dīyatām tathā kuryāṃ na vā kuryāṃ na hi tvamamṛtakṣamā
mayā dharmeṇa satyena vinatā ca samuddhṛtā
tato gatvā'tha garuḍaḥ purandaramuvāca ha idaṃ mayā vṛtrahantarhṛtaṃ te'mṛtamuttamam
uvāca ca mudā yukto diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti vāsavaḥ
te sarve ca mudā yuktā viśvedevāstathaiva ca
ūcuḥ purandaraṃ dṛṣṭā garuḍo labhatāṃ varam
tadetadbharataśreṣṭha mayā''khyānaṃ prakīrtitam suparṇasya mahābāho kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te
brāhmaṇānāṃ tu ye loke pratiśrutya pitāmaha
na prayacchanti lobhātte ke bhavanti mahāmate
pratiśrutya durātmāno na prayacchanti ye narāḥ
yo na dadyātpratiśrutya svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu
yāṃ rātriṃ jāyate pāpo yāṃ ca rātriṃ vinaśyati
yacca tasya hutaṃ kiñciddattaṃ vā bharatarṣabha
sṛgālasya ca saṃvādaṃ vānarasya ca bhārata
tau sakhāyau purā hyāstāṃ mānuṣatve paraṃtapa anyāṃ yoniṃ samāpannau sṛgālīṃ vānarīṃ tathā
kiṃ tvayā pāpakaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ karma sudāruṇam
kiṃ tvayā pātakaṃ karma kṛtaṃ yenāsi vānaraḥ
sa cāpyāha phalāhāro brāhmaṇānāṃ plavaṅgamaḥ tasmānna brāhmaṇasvaṃ tu harttavyaṃ viduṣā sadā
śrutaṃ cāpi mayā bhūyaḥ kṛṣṇasyāpi viśāṃpate
kathāṃ kathayataḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati pāṇḍava
na hartavyaṃ vipradhanaṃ kṣantavyaṃ teṣu nityaśaḥ
evameva ca māṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ saṃdiśanti vai
sa eva hi yadā tuṣṭo vacasā pratinandati
brāhmaṇasya hi dattena dhruvaṃ svargo hyanuttamaḥ
śakyaḥ prāptuṃ viśeṣeṇa dānaṃ hi mahatī kriyā
velāyāṃ na tu kasyāṃ cidgacchedvipro hyapūjitaḥ
sūkṣmā gatirhi dharmasyi yatra muhyanti mānavāḥ
atra te vartayiṣyāmi śṛṇu rājanyathākramam maduktaṃ vacanaṃ rājanyathānyāyaṃ yathāgamam
upadeśo na kartavyo jātihīnasya kasya cit
nādhyāpayecchūdramiha tathā naiva ca yājayet nidarśanamidaṃ rājañśṛṇu me bharatarṣabha
āsyatāṃ yadi te buddhiḥ śuśrūṣānirato bhava
kathamatra mayā kāryaṃ śruddhā dharmaparā ca me
tatra vedīṃ ca bhūmiṃ ca devatāyatanāni ca
baliṃ ca kṛtvā hutvā ca devatāṃ cāpyapūjayat
evaṃ hi sumahānkālo vyatyakrāmata tasya vai
pitṛkārye kṛte cāpi visṛṣṭaḥ sa jagāma ha
atha dīrghasya kālasya sa tapyañśūdratāpasaḥ vane pañcatvamagamatsukṛtena ca tena vai
ajāyata mahārāja vaṃśe sa ca mahādyutiḥ
evaṃ tau tatra sambhūtāvubhau śūdramunī tadā
atharvavede vede ca babhūvarṣiḥ suniṣṭhitaḥ kalpaprayoge cotpanne jyotiṣe ca paraṃ gataḥ
sāṅkhye caiva parā prītistasya caivaṃ vyavardhata
puṇyāhavācane nityaṃ dharmakāryeṣu cāsakṛt utsmayanprāhasaccāpi dṛṣṭvā rājā purohitam
utsmayantaṃ ca satataṃ dṛṣṭvā taṃ manyumānabhūt
atha śūnye purodhāstu saha rājñā samāgataḥ
varāṇāṃ te śataṃ dadyāṃ kiṃ bataikaṃ dvijottama
snehācca bahumānācca nāstyadeyaṃ hi me tava
ekaṃ vai varamicchāmi yadi tuṣṭisi pārthiva
yadi jñāsyāmi vakṣyāmi ajānanna tu saṃvade
śāntihomeṣu ca sadā kiṃ tvaṃ hasasi vīkṣya māṃ
savrīḍaṃ vai bhavati hi mano me hasatā tvayā
bhāvyaṃ hi kāraṇenātra na te hāsyamakāraṇam
kautūhalaṃ me subhṛśaṃ tattvena kathamasva me
vṛsyāṃ darbheṣu havye ca kavye ca munisattama
ahaṃ rājā ca viprendra paśya kālasya paryayam
evaṃ tavograṃ hi tapa upadeśena nāśitam
gṛhyatāṃ draviṇaṃ vipra pūtātmā bhava sattama
tato visṛṣṭo rājñā tu vipro dānānyanekaśaḥ
brāhmaṇebhyo dadau vittaṃ bhūmiṃ grāmāṃśca sarvaśaḥ
kṛcchrāṇi cīrtvā ca tato yathoktāni dvijottamaiḥ
tīrthāni cāpi gatvā vai dānāni vividhāni ca
tameva cāśramaṃ gatvā cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto brāhmaṇo rājasattama
neṣitavyaṃ sadā vācā dvijena nṛpasattama na ca pravaktavyamiha kiñcidvarṇāvare nare
upadeśo na kartavyo hyajñātvā yasyakasya cit
satyānṛtena hi kṛta upadeśo hinasti hi
śrīḥ padmā vasate nityaṃ tanme brūhi pitāmaha
kānīha bhūtānyupasevase tvaṃ santiṣṭhase kāni ca sevase tvam
tāni trilokeśvarabhūtakānte tattvena me brūhi maharṣikanye
evaṃ tadā śrīrābhibhāṣyamāṇā devyā samakṣaṃ garuḍadhvajasya
uvāca vākyaṃ madhurābhidhānaṃ manoharaṃ candramukhī prasannā
vasāmi nityaṃ subhage pragalbhe dakṣe nare karmaṇi vartamāne
nākarmaśīle puruṣe vasāmi na nāstike sāṅkarike kṛtaghne
na bhinnavṛtte na nṛśaṃsavṛtte na cāvinīte na guruṣvasūyake
ye cālpatejobalasattvamānāḥ kliśyanti kupyanti ca yatratatra
na caiva tiṣṭhāmi tathāvidheṣu nareṣu saṅguptamanoratheṣu
dyaśca svabhāvopahatāntarātmā nareṣu nāhaṃ nivasāmi smyak
svadharmaśīleṣu ca dharmavitsu vṛddhopasevānirate ca dānte
kṛtātmani kṣāntipare samarthe kṣāntāsu dāntāsu tathā'balāsu satyasvabhāvārjavasaṃyutāsu vasāgi devadvijapūjikāsu
yāneṣu kanyāsu vibhūṣaṇeṣu yajñeṣu megheṣu ca vṛṣṭimatsu
vasāmi phullāsu ca padminīṣu nakṣatravīthīṣu ca śāradīṣu
matte gaje govṛṣabhe narendre simhāsane satpuruṣeṣu nityam
yasmiñcano havyabhujaṃ juhoti gobrāhmaṇaṃ cārcati devatāśca
kāle ca puṣpairbalayaḥ kriyante tasmingṛhe nityamupaimi vāsam
svādhyāyanityeṣu sadā dvijeṣu kṣatre ca dharmābhirate sadaiva
vaiśye ca kṛṣyābhirate vasāmi śūdre ca śuśrūṣaṇanityayukte
nārāyaṇe tvekamanā vasāmi sarveṇa bhāvena śarīrabhūtā
tasminhi dharmaḥ sumahānniviṣṭo brahmiṇyatā cātra tathā priyatvam
nāhaṃ śarīreṇa vasāmi devi naivaṃ mayā śakyamihābhidhātum
bhāvena yasminnivasāmi puṃsi sa vardhate dharmayaśorthakāmaiḥ
ye cāpyante pare tāta kṛtaghnā nirapatrapāḥ
kṛtaghnānāṃ gatistāta narake śāśvatīḥ samāḥ mātāpitṛgurūṇāṃ ca ye na tiṣṭhanti śāsane
yadā tvapagataṃ varṣaṃ vṛṣṭivātasamanvitam tato mahiṣarupeṇa dharmo dharmabhṛtāṃvara
dṛṣṭvā ca pṛthivīṃ sarvāṃ salilena pariplutām
kṛtaghnā narakaṃ yānti ye ca viśvastaghātinaḥ
kṛtaghnatāṃ ca samprāpya maraṇāntā ca niṣkṛtiḥ
sa meruśikharaṃ gatvā nisyaṅkenāntarātmanā prāyaścittaṃ kartukāmaḥ śarīraṃ tyaktumudyataḥ
indro jñātvā tu taṃ yajñaṃ mahābhāgaḥ sureśvaraḥ antaraṃ tasya rājarṣeranvicchanniyatātmanaḥ
atha pītodakaṃ so'śvaṃ vṛkṣe baddhvā nṛpottamaḥ
ārohiṣye kathaṃ tvaśvaṃ kathaṃ yāsyāmi vai puram
mṛdutvaṃ ca tanutvaṃ ca parādhīnatvameva ca hāsabhāvādi lāvaṇyaṃ strīguṇādvā kutūhalam
vyāyāmaḥ karkaśatvaṃ ca vīryaṃ ca puruṣe guṇāḥ
mahatā tvatha khedena āruhyāśvaṃ narādhipaḥ punarāyātpuraṃ tāta strībhūto nṛpasattamaḥ
kinnvidaṃ tviti vijñāya vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ
athovāca sa rājarṣiḥ strībhūto vadatāṃvaraḥ mṛgayāmasmi niryāto balaiḥ parivṛto dṛḍham
tatrāvagāḍhaḥ strībhūto vyaktaṃ daivānna saṃśayaḥ atṛpta eva putrāṇāṃ dārāṇāṃ ca dhanasya ca
nāmagotrāṇi cābhāvya dārāṇāṃ mantriṇāṃ tathā āha putrāṃstataḥ so'tha strībhūtaḥ pārtivottamaḥ
sa putrāṇāṃ śataṃ rājā abhiṣicya vanaṃ gataḥ
gatvā caivāśramaṃ sā tu tāpasaṃ pratyapadyata
puruṣatve sutā yūyaṃ strītve ceme śataṃ sutāḥ
tāndṛṣṭvā bhātṛbhāvena bhuñjānānrājyamuttamam cintayāmāsa devendro manyunā'tha pariplutaḥ
bhrātṛṇāṃ nāsti saubhrātraṃ ye'pyekasya pitaḥ sutāḥ kaśyapasya surāścaiva asurāśva sutāstathā
rājyahetorvivaditāḥ kaśyapasya surāsurāḥ yūyaṃ bhaṅgāsvanāpatyāstāpasasyetare sutāḥ
tacchrutvā tāpasī cāpi saṃtaptā praruroda ha
kena duḥkhena saṃtaptā rodiṣi tvaṃ varānane
brāhmṇaṃ taṃ tato dṛṣṭvā sā strī karaṇamabravīt
ahaṃ rājā'bhava vipra tatra pūrvaṃ śataṃ mama
teṣāṃ ca vairamutpannaṃ kālayogena vai dvija
purā suduḥsahaṃ bhadre mama duḥkhaṃ tvayā kṛtam indradviṣṭena yajatā māmanāhūya dhiṣṭhitam
indro'hamasmi durbuddhe vairaṃ te pātitaṃ mayā
indraṃ dṛṣṭvā tu rājarṣiḥ pādayoḥ śirasā gataḥ prasīda tridaśaśreṣṭha putrakāmena sa kratuḥ
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ puruṣasyātha ye'bhavan
strībhūtasya hi ye putrāste me jīvantu vāsava
indrastu vismito dṛṣṭvā striyaṃ papraccha tāṃ punaḥ
puruṣotpāditā ye te kathaṃ dveṣyāḥ sutāstava
strībhūtasya hi ye jātāḥ snehastebhyo'dhikaḥ katham
striyāstvabhyadhikaḥ sneho na tatā puruṣasya vai
tasmātte śakra jīvantu ye jātāḥ strīkṛtasya vai
varaṃ ca vṛṇu rājendra yaṃ tvamicchasi suvrata
strītvameva vṛṇe śakra puṃstvaṃ necchāmi vāsava
puruṣatvaṃ kathaṃ tyaktvā strītvaṃ rocayase vibho
ramābhi cādhikaṃ strītve satyaṃ vai devasattama
kathaṃ vai lokayātrāṃ tu kiṃśīlaśca samācaret
deve nārāyaṇe bhaktiḥ śaṃkare sādhupūjayā dhyānenātha japaḥ kāryaḥ svadharmaiḥ śucicetasā
kāyena trividhaṃ karma vācā cāpi caturvidham
tasmādvākvāyamanasā nācaredaśubhaṃ naraḥ śubhānyevācaram̐lloke bhakto nārāyaṇasya hi
cittaṃ me dūyate tāta loke paramavindataḥ
yudhiṣṭhira mahāprājña mayā dṛṣṭaṃ ca saṅgare
tvatta eva tu rājendra rājadharmāśca puṣkalāḥ śrutaṃ purāṇamakhilaṃ nāradena niveditam
kathitā vai mahābhāga tvayā vai madanugrahāt
svāhā svadhā praṇīte ca iṣṭāpūrtaphalaṃ tathā
anāśitānāṃ ye lokā ye ca pañcatapā narāḥ
loke cakracarāṇāṃ ca dvijānāṃ yatphalaṃ smṛtam
rājñāṃ dharmāśca ye loke samyakpālayatāṃ prajāḥ
ye ca satyavratā loke ye tīrthe kṛtaśramāḥ
śrutāḥ pañca mahāyajñā yeṣu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
tatprabhedeṣu ye dharmāste'pi vai kṛtsnaśaḥ śrutāḥ
na ca dūṣayituṃ śakyāḥ sadbhiruktā hi te tathā
bhogānte cāpi patanaṃ gatiḥ pūrvaṃ prabhāṣitā
na me prītikarāstvete viṣodarkā hi me matāḥ
vadhātkṛṣṭataraṃ manye garbhavāsaṃ mahādyute diṣṭānte yāni duḥkhāni puruṣo vindate vibho
tasmānme niścayo jāto dharmeṣveteṣu bhārata tadicchāmi kuruśreṣṭha tvatprasādānmahāmate
taṃ dharmaṃ ceha vettuṃ vai yo jarājanmamṛtyuhā
yenoṣṇadā vaitaraṇī asipatravanaṃ ca tat kuṇḍāni cāgnitaptāni kṣuradhārāpathastathā
mātāpitṛkate cāpi suhṛnmitrārthakāraṇāt ātmahetośca pāpāni kṛtānīha naraiśca yaiḥ
vedanārtā hi krandanti pūrayanto diśo daśa
teṣāmekaḥ phalaṃ bhuṅkte kaṣṭaṃ vaivasvate gṛhe
yatra vāsakṛto yogaḥ kukṣau vāso vidhīyate
jāto vistīrṇaśokaḥ syādbhaveta vigatajvaraḥ na caiṣa labhyate kāmo jātamātraṃ hi mānavam
garbheṣu mriyate kaścijjāyamānastathā'paraḥ jātā mriyante bahavo yauvanasthāstathā'pare
madhyabhāve tu naśyanti sthaviro mṛta eva tu
ko janmano nodvijate svayambhūrapi yo bhavet
ye tu taṃ kila dharmajñā dharmaṃ nārāyaṇeritam
putradārasahasrāṇi iṣṭāniṣṭaśatāni ca prāptānyadhiṣṭhānavaśādatītāni tathaiva ca
na kvacinna sukhaṃ prāptaṃ na kvacicchāśvatī sthitiḥ
sthānairmahadbhirvibhraṃśo duḥkhalabdhaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ dhananāśaśca samprāpto labdhvā duḥkhena taddhanam
buddhiśca me samutpannā vaiṣṇave dharmavistare tadeṣa śirasā pādau gato'smi bhagavaṃstava
śaraṇaṃ ca prapanno'smi gantavye śaraṇe dhruve
etadādyayugodbhūtaṃ tretāyāṃ tattirohitam sa eva dharmamakhilamṛṣirdvaipāyano'bravīt
sadṛśaṃ rājaśārdūla vṛttasya ca kulasya ca
ko rājyaṃ vipulaṃ gṛhya sphītākāraṃ punarmahat
rājye rājyaguṇā ye ca tānvyudasya narādhipa
sa eṣa prākṛto dharmo bhrājatyādiyuge nṛpa vikāradharmāḥ śeṣeṣu yugeṣu bharatarṣabha
kāmaṃ kāmayamāneṣu brāhmaṇeṣu tirohitaḥ kupatheṣu tu dharmeṣu prādurbhūteṣu kaurava
jāto mandapracāro hi dharmaḥ kaliyuge nṛpa
brahmādyā api devāśca yaṃ sadā paryupāsate
taṃ ca nārāyaṇaṃ viddhi paraṃ brahmeti śāśvatam
tatkarma kuru kāyena dhyāyasva manasā ca tam
kīrtayasva ca tannāma vācā sarvatra bhūpate
ityetadviṣṇumāśritya saṃsāragrahamokṣaṇam kathitaṃ te mahābāho kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
yatprāpya kleśaṃ nāpnoti tanme brūhi pitāmaha
jātamātrāśca te sarve pratibuddhā iti śrutiḥ
mūrtimanto'mṛtībhūtāstejasā'titaponvitāḥ sanakaprabhṛtayastatra ye ca prāptāḥ paraṃ padam
niyuktā rājaśārdūla teṣāṃ sṛṣṭiṃ śṛṇuṣva me
sapta brahmaṇa ityete purāṇe niścayaṃ gatāḥ
sarve vedeṣu caivoktāḥ khileṣu ca na saṃśayaḥ
pitṛṇāṃ caiva rājendra putrā devā iti śrutiḥ
pitrā ca mama rājendra śrāddhakāle prabhāṣitam
paraṃ rahasyaṃ vedāntaṃ priyaṃ hi paramātmanaḥ
ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchasi bhārataḥ tadihaikamanobuddhiḥ śṛṇuṣvāvahito nṛpa
sāṅkhyayogaṃ ca yo veda pāṇāvāmalakaṃ yathā
adhyātmamadhibhūtaṃ ca adhidaivaṃ tathaiva ca kālasaṅkhyāśca sargaṃ ca sraṣṭāraṃ puruṣaṃ prabhum
eṣa sraṣṭā vidhātā ca bhartā pālayitā prabhuḥ
paraṃ na vedmi tatsargaṃ yāvāṃścāyaṃ yathāpyaham
yathā kālaparīmāṇaṃ tatvānāmṛṣisattama adhyātmamadhibhūtaṃ ca adhidaivaṃ tathaiva ca
kālasaṃkhyāṃ ca sargaṃ ca sarvameva mahāmune
mahārṇavo'rṇavaścaiva salilaṃ ca guṇāstathā vedāstapāṃsi yajñāśca dharmāśca bhagavānvibhuḥ
hiraṇyagarbhaṃ visvātmā brahmāṇāṃ jalavanmunim bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya kartāramanaghaṃ vibhum
śabde sparśe ca rūpe ca rase gandhe tathaiva ca
ananta iti vikhyātaḥ pañcamaḥ sarga ucyate
manaḥ sarvamidaṃ tāta viśvaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagat
na tathānyāni bhūtāni balavanti yathā manaḥ
ūrdhvasrotastu vai sargaṃ saptamaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ
etāni nava sargāṇi tatvāni ca mahāmune
sarvasya prabhavaḥ pūrvamukto nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ avyayaḥ prabhavaścaiva avyaktasya mahāmune
adhyātmamadhibhūtaṃ ca adhidaivaṃ tathaiva ca yathāśrutaṃ yathādṛṣṭaṃ tatvato vai nibodha me
adhaḥsrotasi sarge ca tiryaksrotasi caiva hi
tataḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca
mahābhūtāni dagdhāni svāṃ yoniṃ gamitāni vai
nirvṛkṣā nistṛṇā caiva dagdhā kālāgninā tadā
mahatā balavegena ādatte taṃ hi bhānumān
praśāmyati tadā vāyuḥ khaṃ tu tiṣṭhati nānadat
tasya taṃ ninadaṃ śabdamādatte vai manastadā
bhuṅkte ca sa tadā vyoma manastāta digātmakam
yena viśvamidaṃ kṛtsnaṃ nirmitaṃ vai guṇārthinā mūrtaṃ jalecaramapi vyavasāyaguṇātmakam
ākāśaṃ prathamaṃ bhūtaṃ śrotramadhyātmaṃ śabdodhibhūtaṃ diśodhidaivataṃ
vāyurdvitīyaṃ bhūtaṃ tvagadhyātmaṃ sparśodhibhūtaṃ vidyudadhidaivataṃ syāt
jyotistṛtīyaṃ bhūtaṃ cakṣuradhyātmaṃ rūpamadhibhūtaṃ sūryodhidaivataṃ syāt
āpaścaturthaṃ bhūtaṃ jihvādhyātmaṃ rasodhibhūtaṃ varuṇodhidaivataṃ syāt
pṛthivī pañcamaṃ bhūtaṃ dhrāṇamadhyātmaṃ gandhodhibhūtaṃ vāyuradhidaivataṃ syāt
yathā''dityoṃ'śujālaṃ kṣipati samharate ca evamavyakto guṇānsṛjati samharate ca
yathā'rṇavādūrmimālānica yaścordhvamuttiṣṭhate samharate ca yathā cāntarikṣādabhramākāśamuttiṣṭhati stanitagarjitonmiśraṃ tadvattatraiva prāṇaśat
yathā kūrmo'ṅgāni kāmātprasārayate punaśca praveśayati evamavyakto bhagavānlokānprakāśayati praveśayate ca
evaṃ cetanaśca bhagavānpañcaviṃśaḥ śucistenādhiṣṭhitā prakṛtiścetayati nityaṃ sahadharmā ca bhagavato'vyaktasya kriyāvatokriyāvataśca prakṛtiḥ kriyāvānajarāmaraḥ kṣetrajño nārāyaṇākhyaḥ puruṣaḥ
ityetannāradāyoktaṃ kumāreṇa ca dhīmatā etacchrutvā dvijo rājansarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet
vaikuṇṭhasya ca saṃvādaṃ suparṇasya ca bhārata
amṛtasya samutpattau devānāmasuraiḥ saha ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi daivāsuramavartata
vaikuṇṭhaṃ śaraṇaṃ devaṃ pratipede ca taiḥ saha
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ ca maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
tato devagaṇānāṃ ca dānavānāṃ ca yudhyatām
