tvayā kṛtaṃ bisastainyaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ śunaḥsakha
tasmādasmyāgato viprā vāsavaṃ māṃ nibodhata alobhādakṣayā lokāḥ prāptā vaḥ sārvakāmikāḥ
evamete mahātmāno yogairbahuvidhairapi kṣudhā paramayā yuktāśchandyamānā mahātmabhiḥ
arthabhāgī ca bhavati na ca durgāṇyavāpnute
purā prabhāse ṛṣayaḥ samagrāḥ sametā vai mantramamantrayanta
carāma sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ puṇyatīrthāṃ tannaḥ kāmaṃ hanta gacchāma sarve
śukro'ṅgirāścaiva kaviśca vidvāṃstathā hyagastyo nāradaparvatau ca
bhṛgurvasiṣṭhaḥ kaśyapo gautamaśca viśvāmitro jamadagniśca rājan
jagmuḥ puraskṛtya mahānubhāvaṃ śatakratuṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ narendrāḥ
tīrthāni sarvāṇi paribhramanto māghyāṃ yayuḥ kauśikīṃ puṇyatīrthām
devasya tīrthe jalamagnikalpā vigāhya te bhuktabisaprasūnāḥ
athāpaśyanpuṣkaraṃ te hriyantaṃ hradādagastyena samuddhṛtaṃ tat
nānāha sarvānṛṣimukhyānagastyaḥ kenāhṛtaṃ puṣkaraṃ me sujātam
yuṣmāñśaṅke puṣkaraṃ dīyatāṃ me na vai bhavanto hartumarhanti padmam
śṛṇomi kālo hiṃsate dharmavīryaṃ seyaṃ prāptā vartate dharmapīḍā
purā'dharmo vartate neha yāvattāvadgacchāmaḥ suralokaṃ cirāya
dharmottaraṃ yāvadidaṃ na vartate tāvadvrajāmi paralokaṃ cirāya
tasmādyāsyāmi paralokaṃ cirāya na hyutsahe draṣṭumīdṛṅnṛloke
tamāhurārtā ṛṣayo maharṣiṃ na te vayaṃ puṣkaraṃ corayāmaḥ
mithyābhiśaṃsā bhavatā na kāryā śapāma tīkṣṇaiḥ śapathairmaharṣe
te niścitāstatra maharṣayastu sampaśyanto dharmametaṃ narendrāḥ
tato'śapanta śapathānparyayeṇa sahaiva te pārthiva putrapautraiḥ
pure ca bhikṣurbhavatu yaste harati puṣkaram
sarvatra sarvaṃ paṇatu nyāse lobhaṃ karotu ca
karṣako matsarī cāstu yaste harati puṣkaram
tasya lokānsa vrajatu yaste harati puṣkaram
vṛthā māṃsaṃ samaśnātu divā gacchatu maithunam
preṣyo bhavatu rājñaśca yaste harati puṣkaram
vidyāṃ prayacchatu bhṛto yaste harati puṣkaram
nihantu brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi yaste harati puṣkaram
śulkena dadatu kanyāṃ yaste harapi puṣkaram
padā ca gāṃ saṃspṛśatu sūryaṃ ca prati mehatu
śunaḥ karṣatu vṛttyarthe yaste harati puṣkaram
tattasyāstu sadā pāpaṃ yaste harati puṣkaram
dattvā dānaṃ kīrtayatu yaste harati puṣkaram
ekā svādu samaśnātu yā te harati puṣkaram
duhyeta paravatsena yā te harati puṣkaram
sahasrākṣo devarāṭ samprahṛṣṭaḥ samīkṣya taṃ kopanaṃ vipramukhyam
yathābravīnmaghavā pratyayaṃ svaṃ svayaṃ samāgatya tamṛṣiṃ jātaroṣam
brahmarṣidevarṣinṛparṣimadhye yaṃ taṃ nibodheha mamādya rājan
atharvaṇaṃ vedamadhītya vipraḥ snāyīta yaḥ puṣkaramādadāti
brahmaṇaḥ sadanaṃ yātu yaste harati puṣkaram
ārṣo vai śāśvato nityamavyayo'yaṃ mayā śrutaḥ
ityuktaḥ sa mahendreṇa tapasvī kopano bhṛśam
na mūrkhaṃ janayetputraṃ na bhavecca nirākṛtiḥ
yathā cākṣayyatāṃ prāptaṃ puṇyatāṃ ca yathāgatam
itihāsaṃ purāvṛttamidaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa jamadagneśca saṃvādaṃ sūryasya ca mahātmanaḥ
atha tena sa śabdeni jyāyāścaiva śarasya ca
prahṛṣṭaḥ sampracikṣepa sā ca pratyājahāra tān
tasthau tasyā hi santaptaṃ śiraḥ pādau tathaiva ca
sthitā sā tu mūhūrtaṃ vai bhartuḥ śāpabhayācchubhā yayāvānayituṃ bhūyaḥ sāyakānasitekṣaṇā
sā vai prasvinnasarvāṅgī padbhyāṃ duḥkhaṃ niyacchatī
śirastaptaṃ pradīptau me pādau caiva tapodhana
etacchrutvā mama vibho mā krudhastvaṃ patodhana
sa viṣphārya dhanurdivyaṃ gṛhītvā ca śarānbahūṃn
atha taṃ prekṣya sannaddhaṃ sūryo'bhyetya vaco'bravīt
rasaṃ hṛtaṃ vai varṣāsu pravarṣati divākaraḥ
annaṃ prāṇā iti yathā vedeṣu paripaṭhyate
annataḥ sampravartante yathā tvaṃ vettha bhārgava
sarvaṃ hi vettha vipra tvaṃ yadetatkīrtitaṃ mayā
prasādaye tvāṃ viprarṣe kiṃ te sūryo nipātyate
calaṃ nimittaṃ viprarṣe sadā sūryasya gacchataḥ
kataṃ calaṃ bhetsyasi tvaṃ sadā yāntaṃ divākaram
sthiraṃ cāpi calaṃ cāpi jāne tvāṃ jñānacakṣuṣā
madhyāhne vai nimeṣārdhaṃ tiṣṭasi tvaṃ divākara
tatra bhetsyāmi sūrya tvāṃ na me'trāsti vicāraṇā
na bhīḥ sūrya tvayā kāryā praṇipātagato hyasi
saumyatāṃ caiva somasya gāmbhīryaṃ varuṇasya ca
dīptimagneḥ prabhāṃ meroḥ pratāpaṃ dhanadasya ca
bhavetsa gurutalpī ca brahmihā ca sa vai bhavet
maharṣe śirasastrāṇāṃ chatraṃ madraśmivāraṇam pratigṛhṇīṣva padbhyāṃ ca trāṇārthaṃ carmapāduke
śubhraṃ śataśalākaṃ vai sa pretya sukhamedhate
goloke sa mudā yukto vasati pretya bhārata
ke ca śuśrūṣayā lokā vihitā bharatarṣabha
karmaṇā manasā vācā cakṣuṣā ca caturvidham
anyathā vartamāno hi na śūdro dharmamarhati amārgeṇi prayātānāṃ pratyakṣādupalabhyate
tathā te hi śakāścīnāḥ kāmbhojāḥ pāradāstathā
na naśyati kṛtaṃ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
vyucchedāttasya dharmasya nirayāyopapadyate tato mlecchā bhavantyete nirghṛṇā dharmavarjitāḥ
tatrāpi śūdro bhikṣūṇāmidaṃ śeṣa ca kalpayet
bhikṣubhiḥ sukṛtaprajñaiḥ kevalaṃ darmamāśritaiḥ samyadgarśanasampannairgatādhvani hitārthibhiḥ
sajalaṃ bhājanaṃ sthāpya mṛttikāṃ ca parīkṣitām
parīkṣya bhūmiṃ mūtrārthī tata āsīta vāgyataḥ
asamāpte tathā śauce na vācaṃ kiñcidīrayet
vipruṣaśca yatā na syuryathā corū na saṃspṛśet
apāne mṛttikāstisraḥ pradeyāstvanupūrvaśaḥ hastābhyāṃ ca tathā vipro hastaṃ hastena saṃspṛśet
yathā ghāto hi na bhavetkledajaḥ paridhānake
tathā gudaṃ pramārjeta śaucārthaṃ tu punaḥpunaḥ
pratipādaṃ tatastyaktvā śaucamutthāya kārayet savye dvādaśa deyāḥ syustisrastisraḥ punaḥ punaḥ
deyā kūrparake haste pṛṣṭhe bandhe punaḥ panaḥ
tato'nyāṃ mṛttikāṃ gṛhya kāryaṃ śaucaṃ punastayoḥ hastayorevametaddhi mahāśauca vidhīyate
ato'nyathā tu yaḥ suryātprāyaścittīyate tu saḥ
kāmaṃ dattvā gude dadyāttisraḥ padbhyāṃ tathaiva ca
ṛgvedaṃ tena prīṇāti prathamaṃ yaḥ pibedapaḥ
dvitīyaṃ tu yajurvedaṃ tṛtīyaṃ sāma eva ca
prīṇāti vāyuṃ ghrāṇaṃ ca diśaścāpyatha śrotrayoḥ
prīṇāti viṣṇuḥ padbhyāṃ tu salilaṃ vai samādadhat prāṅmukhodaṅmukho vā'pi antarjānurupaspṛśet
sarvatra vidhirityeṣa bhojanādiṣu nityaśaḥ anneṣu dantalagneṣu ucchiṣṭaḥ punarācamet
vidhireṣa samuddiṣṭaḥ śauce cābhyukṣaṇaṃ smṛtam śūdrasyaiva vidhirdṛṣṭo gṛhānniṣkramatastataḥ
ātithyena tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdro dāsyena śobhate
yatātmanā tu śūdreṇa śuśrūṣā nityameva ca
ato'nyathā tu kurvāṇaḥ śreyo nāpnoti mānavaḥ
nātaḥ paraṃ mamāpyanya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ

yatretaro bhavennityaṃ doṣaṃ tatra na kārayet

yadyetadevaṃ manyeta śūdro hyapi ca buddhimān

brāhmaṇyā tu sametasya samā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ
anena vidhinā vā'pi sthāvareṣu na saṃśayaḥ
kṛtvā tu mānasaṃ pāpaṃ tathaivaikaguṇaṃ smṛtam
traivārṣikaṃ dvivārṣikaṃ vā vārṣikaṃ vā samutthitam
karṇau pidhāya hastābhyāṃ śabdaṃ na śṛṇute yadi
luptasaṃjñaṃ hi karaṇaṃ sadyo mṛtyuṃ samādiśet
na taṃ kālaṃ parīkṣeta yathā'riṣṭaṃ prakalpitam
abhyāsena tu kālasya gaccheta pulinaṃ śuci
avāpya tatra vai janma sa pūto devakarmaṇā
sa tatra vasate ṣaṣṭiṃ padmānīha mudānvitaḥ
viśvebhiścaiva devaiśca tathā brahmarṣibhiḥ punaḥ devarṣibhiścāpratimaistathaivāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
sa tatra ramate prītaḥ saha devaiḥ saharṣibhiḥ
parameṣṭhiranantaśrīrlokānāṃ prabhavāpyayaḥ yataḥ sarvāḥ pravartante sargapralayavikriyāḥ
yatri gatvā na mriyate janma cāpi na vidyate
garbhakleśāmayāḥ prāptā jāyatā ca punaḥ punaḥ
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā nirmucyi grahabandhanāt
yogaśāstraṃ ca sāṅkhyaṃ ca viditvā so'rthatatvataḥ
ekarātraṃ dvirātraṃ vā na kvacitsajjate dvijaḥ
ūrdhvaṃ nādho na tiryakca na kiñcidabhikāmayet
sa visṛjya svakaṃ dehaṃ praviśedbrahma śāśvatam
nirguṇaṃ ca prakṛtimannirvikāraṃ ca sarvaśaḥ bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyasya kālasya parameśvaram
yatkaroti tadaśnāti śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
nākṛtaṃ bhujyate karma na kṛtaṃ naśyate phalam
tathā śubhasamācāraḥ śubhamevāpnute phalam tathā'śubhasamācāro hyaśubhaṃ samavāpnute
imaṃ hi dharmimāsthāya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ striyo vaiśyāśca śūdrāśca prāpnuyuḥ paramāṃ gatim
phalaṃ jñānasya hi śamaḥ praśāmāya yatetsadā
na cāyuktena śakyeta draṣṭuṃ dehe maheśvaraḥ
yuktastu paśyate buddhyā sanniveśya mano hṛdi
atha tvevaṃ na śaknoti kartuṃ hṛdayadhāraṇam
tanmātrāṇyapabi pañcaiva mano'haṅkāra eva ca aṣṭamaṃ cāpyathāvyaktametāḥ prakṛtisaṃjñitāḥ
evaṃ varṣma samuttīrya tīrṇo bhavati nānyathā
ahanyahani śāntātmā pāvanāya hitāya ca evameva prasaṃkhyāya tatvabuddhirvimucyate
śuśrūṣayā vṛttagatiṃ samādhinā samādhiyuktaḥ prayayau svamāśramam
dharmaṃ cārthaṃ ca kāmaṃ ca yeṣāṃ cintayatāṃ matiḥ
katyāgastasya na vai kāryo yo''tmānaṃ nāvabudhyate
ṛddhimāpnoti kiṃ kṛtvā manuṣya iha pārthiva
papraccha bharataśreṣṭha māṃ tvaṃ yatpṛcchase'dya vai
gārhasthyaṃ dharmamāśritya mayā vā madvidhena vā
kimavaśyaṃ dhare kāryaṃ kiṃ vā kṛtvā sukhaṃ bhavet
manuṣyebhya iti prāhurbaliṃ dvāri gṛhasya vai
niśācarebhyo bhūtebhyo baliṃ naktaṃ yathā haret
evaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ samyagdadyādbhikṣāṃ dvijāya vai

gṛhasthaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇa śiṣṭāśī ca sadā bhavet
rājartvijaṃ snātakaṃ ca guruṃ śvaśurameva ca
sa iharddhiṃ parāṃ prāpya pretya loke mahīyate
iha loke yaśaḥ prāpya pretya svargamavāpsyasi
varṇato hemavarṇaḥ sa suvarṇa iti viśrutaḥ
tatra tau kathayantau stāṃ kathā nānāvidhāśrayāḥ
kimetatkathamutpannaṃ phalaṃ yogaṃ ca śaṃsa me
śukrasya ca baleścaiva saṃvādaṃ vai mahātmanoḥ
etasminnantare caiva vīrudoṣadhya eva ca somasyātmā ca bahudhā sambhūtaḥ pṛthivītale
amṛtaṃ manasaḥ prītiṃ sadyastṛptiṃ dadāti ca
mano glapayate tīvraṃ viṣaṃ gandhena sarvaśaḥ
amṛtaṃ mano hlādayate śriyaṃ cāpi dadāti ca
devatābhyaḥ sumanaso yo dadāti naraḥ śuciḥ
maṅgalārtaṃ sa tenāsya prīto bhavati daityapa
āsurāṇi ca mālyāni daivatebhyo hitāni ca
rakṣasāmuragāṇāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ ca tathā priyāḥ
dvividho hi smṛto gandha iṣṭo'niṣṭaśca puṣpajaḥ
padmaṃ ca tulasī jātirāpaḥ sarveṣu pūjitā jalajāni ca mālyāni padmādīni ca yāni vai
sadyaḥ prīṇāti devānvai te prītā bhāvayantyuta
devāḥ prīṇanti satataṃ mānitā mānayanti ca
yathā yena yadā caiva pradeyā yādṛśāśca te
suvarṇāya manuḥ prāha suvarṇo nāradāya ca
sarvaṃ tasya gṛhe rājñaḥ prāvartata mahātmanaḥ
kathameṣa mayā śakyaḥ śaptuṃ yasya mahāmune
varadena varo datto bhavato viditaśca saḥ
yo me dṛṣṭipathaṃ gacchetsa me vaśyo bhavediti
ityanena varaṃ devo yācito gacchatā divam
evaṃ na dagdhaḥ sa mayā bhavatā ca na saṃśayaḥ

so'haṃ vai viditaḥ sarvairdūrago vanino vane sādhūnāṃ paribhāvepsurviprāṇāṃ garvito dhanaiḥ
ahaṃ hi pāpayonyāṃ vai prasūtaḥ kṣatriyarṣabha
śubhane yena mokṣaṃ vai prāptumicchāmyahaṃ nṛpa
ityuktaḥ sa tadā tena brahmasvārthe parantapa
eko lokastu kṛtināṃ svarge loke pitāmaha
uta tatrāpi nānātvaṃ sarvaṃ brūhi pitāmaha
karmabhiḥ pārtha nānātvaṃ lokānāṃ yānti mānavāḥ
sa tu dīrgheṇa kāleni babhūvātibalo mahān
hriyamāṇaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā gautamaḥ saṃśitavrataḥ
maitraṃ satāṃ saptapadaṃ vadanti mitradroho neha rājanspṛsettvām
śiṣṭaṃ dāntaṃ kṛtajñaṃ ca priyaṃ ca satataṃ mama
gavāṃ sahasraṃ bhavate dadāni śatāni niṣkasya dadāni pañca
anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ maharṣe kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha gajena kṛtyam
tavaiva gāvo hi bhavantu rājandāsyaḥ saniṣkā vividhaṃ ca ratnam
anyacca vittaṃ vividhaṃ narendra kiṃ brāhmaṇasyeha dhanena kṛtyam
brāhmaṇānāṃ hastibhirnāsti kṛtyaṃ rājanyānāṃ nāgakulāni vipra
svaṃ vāhanaṃ nayato nāstyadharmo nāgaśreṣṭhaṃ gautamāsmānnivarta
yatra preto nandati puṇyakarmā yatra pretaḥ śocate pāpakarmā
vaivasvatasya sadane mahātmanastatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
ye niṣkriyā nāstikāḥ śraddhadhānāḥ pāpātmāna indriyārthe nisṛṣṭāḥ
yamasya te yātanāṃ prāpnuvanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
vaivasvatī saṃyamanī janānāṃ yatrānṛtaṃ nocyate yatra satyam
yatrāṃbalānbalino ghātayanti tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
jyeṣṭhāṃ svasāraṃ pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca gurūnyathā'mānayantaścaranti
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
gandharvayakṣairapsarobhiśca juṣṭā tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
atithivratāḥ suvratā ye janā vai pratiśrayaṃ dadati brāhmaṇebhyaḥ
śiṣṭāśinaḥ saṃvibhajyāśritebhyo mandākinīṃ te'pi hi bhūṣayanti
meroragre yadvanaṃ bhāti ramyaṃ supuṣpitaṃ kinnarīgītajuṣṭam
sudarśanā yatra jambūrviśālā tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
ye brāhmaṇā mṛdavaḥ satyaśīlā bahuśrutāḥ sarvabhūtābhirāmāḥ
ye'dhīyate setihāsaṃ purāṇaṃ madhvāhutyā juhvati vai dvijebhyaḥ
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
yadanyatte viditaṃ sthānamasti tadbrūhi tvaṃ tvarito hyeṣa yāmi
supuṣpitaṃ kiṃnararājajuṣṭaṃ priyaṃ vanaṃ nandanaṃ nāradasya
gandharvāṇāmapsarasāṃ ca sadma tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
ye nṛtyagīte kuśalā janāḥ sadā devātmānaḥ priyakāmāścaranti
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
yatrottarāḥ kuravo bhānti ramyā devaiḥ sārdhaṃ modamānā narendraḥ
yatra śakro varṣati sarvakāmānyatra striyaḥ kāmacārā bhavanti
yatra cerṣyā nāsti nārīnarāṇāṃ tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
na hiṃsanti sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamāni bhūtānāṃ ye sarvabhūtātmabhūtāḥ
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
tato'pare bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā vītaśokāḥ
somasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
ye dānaśīlā na pratigṛhṇate sadā na cāpyarthāṃścādadate parebhyaḥ
ye kṣantāro nābhijalpanti cānyāñśaktā bhūtvā satataṃ puṇyaśīlāḥ
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
tato'pare bhānti lokāḥ sanātanā virājasā vitamaskā viśokāḥ
ādityadevasya padaṃ mahātmanastatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
tathāvidhānāmeṣa loko maharṣe viśuddhānāṃ bhāvito vāgyatānām
satye sthitānāṃ vedavidāṃ mahātmanāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
tato'pare bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā viśokāḥ
varuṇasya rājñaḥ sadane mahātmanastatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
cāturmāsyairye yajante janāḥ sadā tatheṣṭīnāṃ daśaśataṃ prāpnuvanti
ye cāgnihotraṃ juhvati śraddadhānā yathānyāyaṃ trīṇi varṣāṇi viprāḥ
svadāragāṇāṃ dharmakṛtāṃ mahātmanāṃ yathodite vartmani susthitānām
dharmānmanāmudvahatāṃ gatiṃ tāṃ paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
indrasya lokā virajā viśokā duranvayāḥ kāṅkṣitā mānavānām
tasyāhaṃ te bhavane bhūritejaso rājannimaṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
śatavarṣajīvī yaśca śūro manuṣyo vedādhyāyī yaśca yajvā'pramattaḥ
ete sarve śakralokaṃ vrajanti paraṃ gantā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
prājāpatyāḥ santi lokā mahānto nākasya pṛṣṭhe puṣkalā vītaśokāḥ
manīṣiṇāṃ sarvalokābhayānāṃ tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
ye rājāno rājasūyābhiṣiktā dharmātmāno rakṣitāraḥ prajānām
ye cāśvamedhāvabhṛthe plutāṅgāsteṣāṃ lokā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra
tataḥparaṃ bhānti lokāḥ sanātanāḥ supuṇyagandhā virajā vītaśokāḥ
tasminnahaṃ durlabhe cāpyadhṛṣye gavāṃ loke hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
yo gosahasrī śatado mahātmā yo gośatī daśa dadyācca śaktyā
tathā daśabhyo yaśca dadyādihaikāṃ pañcabhyo vā dānaśīlastathaikām
ye jīryante brahmacaryeṇi viprā brāhmīṃ vācaṃ parirakṣanti caiva
manasvinastīrthayātrāparā ye te tatra modanti tato vimānaiḥ
puṇyaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ tīrthaṃ bāhudāṃ karatoyinīm
sarasvatīdṛṣadvatyau yamunāṃ ye tu yānti ca
prayānti puṇyagandhāḍhyā dhṛtarāṣṭro na tatra vai
na kṣutpipāse na glānirna duḥkhaṃ na sukhaṃ tathā
na dveṣyo na priyaḥ kaścinna bandhurna ripustathā na jarāmaraṇe tatra na puṇyaṃ na ca pātakam
na tatra dhṛtarāṣṭraste śakyo draṣṭuṃ mahāmune
rathantaraṃ yatra bṛhacca gīyate yatra vediḥ puṇyajanairvṛtā ca
yatropayāti haribhiḥ somapīthī tatra tvā'haṃ hastinaṃ yātayiṣye
budhyāmi tvāṃ vṛtrahaṇaṃ śatakratuṃ vyatikramantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā
kaccinna vācā vṛjinaṃ kadācidakārṣaṃ te manaso'bhiṣaṅkāt
śvetaṃ kareṇuṃ mama putraṃ hi nāgaṃ priyaṃ tu me ṣaṣṭivarṣaṃ tu bālam
yo me vane vasato'bhūddvitīyastameva me dehi surendra nāgam
pādau ca te nāsikayopajighrate śreyo mamādhyāhi namaśca te'stu
śivaṃ sadaiveha surendra tubhyaṃ dhyāyāmi pūjāṃ ca sadā prayuñje
mamāpi tvaṃ śakra śivaṃ dadasva tvayā dattaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi nāgam
yeṣāṃ vedā nihitā vai guhāyāṃ manīṣiṇāṃ satyavatāṃ mahātmanām
hantaihi brāhmaṇi kṣipraṃ saha putreṇa hastinā
tvaṃ hi prāptuṃ śubhām̐llokānahnāya ca cirāya ca
sa gautamaṃ puruskṛtya saha putreṇa hastinā
idaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnityaṃ yaḥ paṭhedvā jitendriyaḥ
sa yāti brahmaṇo lokaṃ brāhmaṇo gautamo yathā
svadāratuṣṭiścoktā te phalaṃ dānasya vā'pi yat
atītya suralokaṃ ca gavāṃ lokaṃ ca bhārata
taṃ tu dṛṣṭvā vacaḥ prāha brahmā rājanbhagīratham
na hi devā na gandharvā na manuṣyā bhagīratha
brāhmaṃ vrataṃ nityamāsthāya vidvanna tvevāhaṃ tasya phalādihāgām
jyotiṣṭomānāṃ ca śataṃ yadiṣṭaṃ phalena tenāpi ca nāgato'ham
adāṃ ca tatrāśvatarīsahasraṃ nārīpuraṃ na ca tenāhamāgām
samānavatsāḥ payasā samanvitāḥ suvarṇakāṃsyopaduhā na tena
dogdhrīṇāṃ vai gavāṃ cāpi prayutāni daśaiva ha
prādāṃ hemasrajāṃ brahmankoṭīrdaśa ca sapta ca
padmino vai sahasrāṇi prādāṃ daśa ca sapta ca
sahasraṃ niṣkakaṇṭhānāmadadaṃ dakṣiṇāmaham vijitya bhūpatīnsarvānarthairiṣṭvā pitāmaha
trayodaśadvādaśāhaiśca deva sapauṇḍarīkairna ca teṣāṃ phalena
ekaikaṃ vai kāñcanaṃ śṛṅgamebhyaḥ patnīścaiṣāmadadaṃ niṣkakaṇṭhīḥ
gavāṃ dhanaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiśca brahmaṃsteṣāṃ phaleneha na cāgato'smi
vanaṃ cūtānāṃ ratnavibhūṣitānāṃ nacaiva teṣāmāgato'haṃ phalena
śataṃ gavāmaṣṭaśatāni caiva dinedine hyadadaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ
prādāṃ nityaṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sureśa nehāgatastena phalena cāham
śamyākṣepeṇa pṛthivīṃ tridhā paryacaraṃ yajan triṃśadagnīnahaṃ brahmannayajaṃ yacca nityadā
gavāṃ śatānāmayutamadadaṃ na ca tena vai
indreṇa guhyaṃ nihitaṃ vai guhāyāṃ yadbhārgavastapasehābhyavindat
brāhmaṇārthāya karmāṇi raṇaṃ caiva karomi yat tato me brāhmaṇāstuṣṭāstasminkarmaṇi sādhite
kāmaṃ yathāvadvihitaṃ vidhātrā pṛṣṭena vācyaṃ tu mayā yathāvat
tapo hi nānyaccānaśanānmataṃ me namostu te devavara prasīda
ityuktavantaṃ brahmi tu rājānaṃ sa bhagīratham
vāsobhirannairgobhisca śubhairnaiveśikairapi śubhaiḥ surakṣaṇaiścāpi stoṣyā eva dvijāstathā
kena vā labhate kīrtiṃ kena vā labhate śriyam
yena vā labhate kīrtiṃ yena vā labhate śriyam
trasanti cāsya bhūtāni tathā paribhavanti ca
svāni karmāṇi kurvāṇaṃ taṃ janāḥ kurvate priyam
loṣṭhamardī tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī ca yo naraḥ
brāhme muhūrte budhyeta dharmārthau cānucintayet utthāya copatiṣṭheta pūrvāṃ sandhyāṃ kṛtāñjaliḥ
nopasṛṣṭaṃ na vāristhaṃ na madhyaṃ nabhaso gatam
sadarbhapāṇistatkurvanvāgyatastanmanāḥ śuciḥ tasmāttiṣṭhetsadā pūrvāṃ paścimāṃ caiva vāgyataḥ
ye na pūrvāmupāsante dvijāḥ saṃdhyāṃ na paścimām
yāvanto romakūpāḥ syuḥ strīṇāṃ gātreṣu nirmitāḥ
pūrvāhṇa eva kurvīta devatānāṃ ca pūjanam
purīṣamūtre nodīkṣennādhitiṣṭhetkadācana nātikalyaṃ nātisāyaṃ na ca madhyaṃdine sthite
nājñātaiḥ saha gaccheta naiko na vṛṣalaiḥ saha
panthā deyo brāhmaṇāya gobhyo rājabhya eva ca
catuṣpathaṃ na seveta ubhe sandhye tathaiva ca
upānahau na vastraṃ ca dhṛtamanyairna dhārayet
brahmacārī ca nityaṃ syātpādaṃ pādena nākramet
vṛthā māṃsaṃ na khādeni pṛṣṭhamāṃsaṃ tathaiva ca
ākrośaṃ parivādaṃ ca paiśunyaṃ ca vivarjayet
nāruntudaḥ syānna nṛśaṃsavādī na hīnato varamabhyādadīta
ativādabāṇā mukhato niḥsaranti yairāhataḥ śocati rātryahāni
parasya vā marmasu ye patanti tānpaṇḍito nāvasṛjetpareṣu
vācā duruktaṃ bībhatsaṃ na saṃrohati vākkṣatam
vākśalyastu na nirhartuṃ śakyo hṛdiśayo hi saḥ
nāstikyaṃ vedanindāṃ ca paranindāṃ ca kutsanam
amāvāsyāmṛte nityaṃ dantadhāvanamācaret itihāsapurāṇāni dānaṃ vedaṃ ca nityaśaḥ
kṛtvā mūtrapurīṣe tu rathyāmākramya vā punaḥ
yāvakaṃ kṛsaraṃ māṃsaṃ śaṣkulīṃ pāyasaṃ tathā
ātmārthaṃtaṃ na prakartavyaṃ devārthaṃ tu prakalpayet
dantakāṣṭhe ca sandhyāyāṃ malotsarge ca maunagaḥ
na cābhyuditasāyī syātprāyaścittī tathā bhavet mātāpitaramutthāya pūrvamevābhivādayet
varjayeddantakāṣṭhāni varjanīyāni nityaśaḥ bhakṣayecchāstradṛṣṭāni parvasvapi vivarjayet
akṛtvā devapūjāṃ ca nācareddantadhāvanam akṛtvā devapūjāṃ ca nānyaṃ gacchetkadācana
anyatra tu guruṃ vṛddhaṃ dhārmikaṃ vā vicakṣaṇam
na cājñātāṃ striyaṃ gacchedgarbhiṇīṃ vā kadācana
udakśirā na svapeta tathā pratyakśirā na ca
na bhagne nāvaśīrṇo ca śayane prasvapīta ca
āsanaṃ tu padā''kṛṣya na prasajjettathā naraḥ
na nagnaḥ karhicitsnāyānna niśāyāṃ kadācana snātvā ca nāvamṛjyeta gātrāṇi suvicakṣaṇaḥ
ārdra eva tu vāsāṃsi nityaṃ seveta mānavaḥ
udakyayā ca sambhāṣāṃ na kurvīta kadācana
notsṛjeta puriṣaṃ ca kṣetre mārgasya cāntike
devālaye'tha govṛnde caitye sasyeṣu viśrame bhokṣyaṃ bhuktvā kṣute'dhvānaṃ gatvā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ
bhuktvā cānnaṃ tathaiva trirdviḥ punaḥ parimārjayet
dhanyaṃ paścānmukho bhuṅkta ṛtaṃ bhuṅkta udaṅmukhaḥ
agrāsano jitakrodho bālapūrvastvalaṅkṛtaḥ ghṛtāhutiviśuddhānnaṃ hutāgniśca kṣipangraset
gātrāṇi caiva sarvāṇi nābhiṃ pāṇitale tathā
mūtraṃ nottiṣṭhatā kāryaṃ na bhasmani na govraje
ārdrapādastu bhuñjāno varṣāṇāṃ jīvate śatam trīṇi tejāṃsi nocchiṣṭa ālabheta kadācana
agniṃ gāṃ brāhmaṇaṃ caiva tatā hyāyurna riṣyate
ūrdhvaṃ prāṇā hyutkramanti yūnaḥ sthavira āgate
na cāsītāsane bhinne bhinnakāṃsyaṃ ca varjayet
spaptavyaṃ naiva nagnena na cocchiṣṭopi saṃviśet
keśagrahaṃ prahārāṃśca sirasyetānvivarjayet na saṃhātābhyāṃ pāṇibhyāṃ kaṇḍūyedātmanaḥ śiraḥ
vāte ca pūtigandhe ca manasā'pi na cintayet
ye mehanti ca panthānaṃ te bhavanti gatāyuṣaḥ
raktamālyaṃ na dhāryaṃ syācchuklaṃ dhāryaṃ tu paṇḍitaiḥ
varjayitvā tu kamalaṃ tathā kuvalayaṃ prabho
raktaṃ śirasi dhāryaṃ tu tathā vāneyamityapi
kāñcanīyā'pi mālā yā na sā duṣyati karhicit
tathā nānyadhṛtaṃ dhāryaṃ na cātivikṛtaṃ tathā
upavāsaṃ ca kurvīta snātaḥ śuciralaṅkṛtaḥ nopavāsaṃ vṛthā kuryāddhanaṃ nāpaharediha
nāsaṃniviṣṭo medhāvī nāśucirni ca satyu ca
pippalaṃ ca vaṭaṃ caiva śaṇaśākaṃ tathaiva ca
udumbaraṃ na khādeśca bhavārthī puruṣo nṛpa
ājaṃ gavyaṃ ca yanmāṃsaṃ māyūraṃ caiva varjayet
varjayecchuṣkamāṃsaṃ ca tathā paryuṣitaṃ ca yat
na pāṇau lavaṇaṃ vidvānprāśnīyānna ca rātriṣu
vālena tu na bhuñjīta paraśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca
bhūmau sadaiva nāśnīyānnāśaucaṃ na ca śabdavat
nirasya śeṣamanyeṣāṃ na pradeyaṃ tu kasyacit
dadhi cāpyanu pānaṃ vai na kartavyaṃ bhavārthinā
pāṇiṃ mūrdhni samādhāya spṛṣṭvā cāgniṃ samāhitaḥ
tena pitryāṇi kurvīta spṛṣṭvā''po nyāyataḥ sadā
saṃsargaṃ ca na gaccheta tathā''yurvindate mahat
na divā maithunaṃ gacchenna kanyāṃ na ca bandhakīm
triḥ pītvā''po dviḥ pramṛjya kṛtaśauco bhavennaraḥ
kurvīta pitryaṃ daivaṃ ca vedadṛṣṭena karmaṇā
brāhmaṇārthe ca yacchaucaṃ tacca me śṛṇu kaurava
niṣṭhīvya tu tathā kṣutvā spṛśyāpo hi śucirbhavet
niṣṭhivane maithune ca kṣute akṣyāvimecane udakyā darśane tadvannagnasyācamanaṃ smṛtam
vṛddho jñātistathā mitramanāthā ca svasā guruḥ kulīnaḥ paṇḍita iti rakṣyā niḥsvaḥ svaśaktitaḥ
śuddhaṃ jalaṃ suvarṇaṃ ca rajataṃ gṛhamaṅgalam gṛheṣvete na pāpāya yathā vai tailapāyikāḥ
amaṅgalyaḥ satāṃ śāpastathā''krośo mahātmanām mahātmanotiguhyāni na vaktavyāni karhicit
agamyāśca na gaccheta rājñaḥ patnīṃ sakhīstathā vaidyānāṃ bālavṛddhānāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ ca yudhiṣṭhira
bandhūnāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tathā śāraṇikasya ca
sandhyāyāṃ na svapedrājanvidyāṃ na ca samācaret
na bhuñjīta ca medhāvī tathā''yurvindate mahat
naktaṃ na kuryātpitryāṇi naktaṃ caiva prasādhanam
pānīyasya kriyā naktaṃ na kāryā bhūtimicchatā
sauhityaṃ na ca kartavyaṃ rātrau na ca samācaret na bhuktvā maithunaṃ gacchenna dhāvennātihāsakam
dvijacchedaṃ na kurvīta bhuktvā na ca samācaret
tailaṃ janmadine'ṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ ca parvasu nakṣatre na ca kurvīta yasmiñjāto bhavennaraḥ
na proṣṭhapadayoḥ kāryaṃ tathā''gneye ca bhārata
dāruṇeṣu ca sarveṣu pratyariṃ ca vivarjayet
jyotiṣe yāni coktāni tāni sarvāṇi varjayet
satāṃ gurūṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ kulastrīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ parivādaṃ na ca brūyātpareṣāmātmanastathā
samārṣāṃ vyaṅgikāṃ ścaiva mātuḥ sakulajāṃ tathā
vṛddhāṃ pravrajitāṃ caiva tathaiva ca pativratām tathā nikṛṣṭavarṇā ca varṇotkṛṣṭāṃ ca varjayet
ayoniṃ ca viyoniṃ ca na gaccheta vicakṣaṇaḥ
śvitriṇāṃ ca kule jātāṃ kṣayiṇāṃ manujeśvara
suromaśāmatisthūlāṃ kanyāṃ mātṛpitṛsthitām alajjāṃ bhrātṛjāṃ tuṣṭāṃ varjayedraktakeśinīm
lakṣaṇairanvitā yā ca praśastā yā ca lakṣaṇaiḥ
avarā patitā caiva na grāhyā bhūtimicchatā
vede ca brāhmaṇaiḥ proktāstāśca sarvāḥ samācaret
na cerṣyā strīṣu kartavyā rakṣyā dārāśca sarvaśaḥ
prātarniśāyāṃ ca tathā ye cocchiṣṭā bhavanti ca
sandhyāṃ na bhuñjyānna snāyenna purīṣaṃ samutsṛjet
animantrito na gaccheta yajñaṃ gaccheta darśakaḥ
na caikena parivrajyaṃ na gantavyaṃ tathā niśi
ekoddiṣṭaṃ na bhuñjīta prathamaṃ tu viśeṣataḥ
hitaṃ cāpyahitaṃ cāpi na vicāryaṃ nararṣabha
kṣatriyastu viśeṣeṇa dhanurvedaṃ samabhyaset dhanurvede ca vede ca yatnaḥ kāryo nārādhipa
yuktiśāstraṃ ca te jñeyaṃ śabdaśāstraṃ ca bhārata
mahātmanāṃ ca caritaṃ śrotavyaṃ nityameva te
na strīṣu sajjeddraṣṭavyaṃ śaktyā dānarucirbhavet na brāhmaṇānparibhavetkārpaṇyaṃ brāhmaṇairvṛtam
pañcame divase nārī ṣaṣṭhe'hani pumānbhavet āṣoḍaśādṛturmukhyaḥ putrajanmani śabditaḥ
jyeṣṭhavattāta vartasva jyeṣṭhosi hi tathā bhavān
gurau hi sadṛśī vṛttiryathā śiṣyasya bhārata
andhaḥ syādandhavelāyāṃ jaḍaḥ syādapi vā budhaḥ
pratyakṣaṃ bhinnahṛdayā bhedayeyuryathā'hitāḥ śriyā'bhitaptāstadbhedānnabhinnāḥ syuḥ samāhitāḥ
jyeṣṭhaḥ kulaṃ vardhayati vināśayati vā punaḥ
atha yo vinikurvīta jyeṣṭho bhrātā yavīyasaḥ
viphalaṃ tasya putratvaṃ moghaṃ janayituḥ smṛtam
sarve cāpi vikarmasthā bhāgaṃ nārhanti sodarāḥ jyeṣṭho'pi durvinītastu kaniṣṭhastu viśeṣataḥ
bhrātṝṇāmavibhaktānāmutthānamapi cetsaha na putrabhāgaṃ viṣamaṃ pitā dadyātkadācana
na jyeṣṭho vā'vamanyeta duṣkṛtaḥ sukṛto'pi vā
gurūṇāmaparādho hi śakyaḥ kṣantavya eva ca
daśācāryānupādhyāya upādhyāyānpitā daśa daśa caiva pitṝnmātā sarvāṃ vā pṛthivīmapi
mātā garīyasī yacca tenaitāṃ manyate gurum
jyeṣṭho bhrātā pitṛsamo mṛte pitari bhārata
śarīrametau sṛjataḥ pitā matā ca bhārata
ācāryaśiṣṭā yā jātiḥ sā satyā sā'jarāmarā jyeṣṭhā mātṛsamā cāpi bhaginī bharatarṣabha
bhrāturbhāryā ca tadvatsyādyasyā bālye stanaṃ pibet
upavāse matiriyaṃ kāraṇaṃ ca na vidmahe
brahmakṣatreṇa niyamāḥ kartavyā iti naḥ śrutam upavāse kathaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtamasti pitāmaha
svargaṃ puṇyaṃ ca labhate kathaṃ bharatasattama
upoṣya cāpi kiṃ tena prayojyaṃ syānnarādhipa
yathā māṃ tvaṃ tathaivāhaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃstaṃ tapodhanam
trirātraṃ vā dvirāitraṃ vā tayorvyuṣṭirna vidyate
pañcamyāṃ vā'pi ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca bhārata
yajiṣṇuḥ pañcamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kule bhojayate dvijān aṣṭamīmatha kauravya kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśīm
mārgaśīrṣaṃ tu vai māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet
pauṣamāsaṃ tu kaunteya bhaktenaikena yaḥ kṣipet
bhagadaivatamāsaṃ tu ekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet subhago darśanīyaśca yaśobhāgī ca jāyate
strīṣu vallabhatāṃ yāti vaśyāścāsya bhavanti tāḥ
caitraṃ tu niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet
naro vā yadi vā narī jñātīnāṃ śreṣṭhatāṃ vrajet
śrāvaṇaṃ niyato māsamekabhaktena yaḥ kṣipet rūpadraviṇasampannaḥ sukhī bhavati nityaśaḥ
kārtikaṃ tu naro māsaṃ yaḥ kuryādekabhojanam
tithīnāṃ niyamā ye tu śṛṇu tānapi pārthiva
ete tu niyamāḥ sarve kartavyāḥ śarado daśa
yastu prātastathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet
ṣaḍbhiḥ sa varṣairnṛpate sidhyate nāitra saṃśayaḥ
taptakāñcanavarṇābhaṃ vimānamadhirohati pūrṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ ca brahmiloke mahīyate
ṣaṣṭhe kāle tu kaunteya naraḥ saṃvatsaraṃ kṣipan
pakṣepakṣe gate rājanyo'śnīyādvarṣameva tu ṣaṇmāsānaśanaṃ tasya bhagavānaṅgirā'bravīt
viṇānāṃ vallakīnāṃ ca veṇūnāṃ ca viśāmpate
phalaṃ viśvajitastāta prāpnoti sa naro nṛpa
saptatiṃ ca sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ divi modate
padepade yajñaphalaṃ sa prāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ modate sa divi prabho
śataṃ cāpsarasaḥ kanyā ramayantyapi taṃ naram
ārto vā vyādhito vā'pi gacchedanaśanaṃ tu yaḥ
śataṃ varṣasahasrāṇāṃ modate sa divi prabho
na caitadrocate teṣāṃ ye dhanaiḥ sukhamedhitāḥ
nāsti vedātparaṃ śāstraṃ nāsti mātṛsamo guruḥ
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ divi ceha ca
sarva eva divaṃ prāptāḥ kṣamāvanto maharṣayaḥ
yaḥ pradarśayate nityaṃ na sa duḥkhamavāpnute
imaṃ tu kaunteya yathākramaṃ vidhiṃ pravartitaṃ hyaṅgirasā maharṣiṇā
paṭhecca yo vai śṛṇuyācca nityadā na vidyate tasya narasya kilbiṣam
vimucyate cāpi sa sarvasaṅkarairna cāsya doṣairabhibhūyate manaḥ
viyonijānāṃ ca vijānate rutaṃ dhruvāṃ ca kīrtiṃ labhate narottamaḥ
guṇāścaiṣāṃ yathātathyaṃ pretya ceha ca sarvaśaḥ
na tai śakyā daridreṇa yajñāḥ prāptuṃ pitāmaha
yo daridrairapi vidhiḥ śakyaḥ prāptuṃ sadā bhavet arthanyūnairavaguṇairekātmabhirasaṃhataiḥ
yastu kalyaṃ tathā sāyaṃ bhuñjāno nāntarā pibet ahiṃsānirato nityaṃ juhvāno jātavedasam
ṣaḍbhireva sa varṣaistu sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
taptakāñcanavarṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ devastrīṇāmadhīvāse nṛttagītaninādite
trīṇi varṣāṇi yaḥ prāśetsatataṃ tvekabhojanam dharmatnīrato nityamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet
kṣānto dānto jitakrodhaḥ sa gacchati parāṃ gatim
mayūrahaṃsayuktaṃ ca vimānaṃ labhate naraḥ saptarṣīṇāṃ sadā loke sopsarobhirvasetsaha
nivartanaṃ ca tatrāsya trīṇi padmāni vai viduḥ
divase yaścaturthe tu prāśnīyādekabhojanam sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam
indrikanyābhirūḍhaṃ ca vimāna labhate naraḥ sāgarasya ca paryante vāsavaṃ lokamāvaset
divase yastu ṣaṣṭhe vai muniḥ prāśeta bhojanam
padmānyaṣṭādaśa tathā patāke dve tathaiva ca
sumanovarṇakaṃ caiva madhu māṃsaṃ ca varjayan
yastu saṃvatsaraṃ bhuṅkte daśāhe vai gategate
rūpavatyaśca taṃ kanyā ramayanti sadā naram
ekādaśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ
paristriyaṃ nābhilaṣedvācātha manasā'pi vā anṛtaṃ ca na bhāṣeta mātāpitroḥka kṛte'pi vā
sa tasmai darśanaṃ prāpto divasedivase bhavet
divase dvādaśe yastu prāpto vai prāśate haviḥ
trayodaśe tu divase prāpte yaḥ prāśate haviḥ
tatra śaṅkupatāke dve yugāntaṃ kalpameva ca
ayutāyutaṃ tathā padmaṃ samudraṃ ca tathā vaset
caturdaśe tu divase yaḥ pūrṇe prāśate haviḥ
yastu pakṣe gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ jitendriyaḥ
ekastambhaṃ caturdvāraṃ saptabhaumaṃ sumaṅgalam vaijayantīsahasraiśca śobhitaṃ gītaniḥsvanai
ṣoḍaśe divase yastu samprāpte prāśate haviḥ
divase saptadaśame yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ
mārutaṃ śayanaṃ caiva brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati
bhūrbhuvaḥsvaśca devarṣirviśvarūpamavekṣate tatra devādhidevasya kumāryo ramayanti tam
tatra kalpasahasraṃ sa kanyābhiḥ saha modate
pūrṇe'tha viṃśe divase yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam
ekaviṃśo tu divase yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam sadā dvādaśamāsānvai juhvāno jātavedasam
aśvinormarutāṃ caiva sukheṣvabhirataḥ sadā anabhijñaśca duḥkhānāṃ vimānavaramāsthitaḥ
dvāviṃśe divase prāpte yo bhuṅkte hyekabhojanam
trayoviṃśe tu divase prāśedyastvekabhojanam sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu mitāhāro jitendriyaḥ
caturviṃśe tu divase yaḥ prāpte prāśate haviḥ sadā dvādaśamāsāṃśca juhvāno jātavedasam
divyamālyāmbaradharo divyagandhānulepanaḥ vimāne kāñcane divye haṃsayukte manorame
siṃhavyāgraprayuktaistu meghaniḥsvananāditaiḥ sa rathairnandighoṣaiśca pṛṣṭhato hyanugamyate
vimānamuttamaṃ divyamāsthāya sumanoharam tatra kalpasahasraṃ vai vasate strīśatāvṛte
ṣaḍviṃśe divase yastu prakuryādekabhojanam sadā dvādaśamāsāṃstu niyato niyatāśanaḥ
vimānaiḥ sphāṭikairdivyaiḥi sarvaratnairalaṅkṛtaiḥ gandharvairapsarobhiści pūjyamānaḥ pramodate
dve'rbudānāṃ sahasre tu divye divyena tejasā
phalaṃ prāpnoti vipulaṃ devaloke ca pūjyate
vimānaṃ sūryacandrābhaṃ divyaṃ samadhigacchati jātarūpamayaṃ yuktaṃ sarvaratnasamanvitam
rudrāṇāṃ ca tathā lokaṃ brahmalokaṃ ca gacchati
yastu māse gate bhuṅkte ekabhaktaṃ samāhitaḥ
etha te bharataśreṣṭha yajñānāṃ vidhiruttamaḥ vyākhyāto hyānupūrvyeṇa upavāsaphalātmakaḥ
mayā śrutā ṛṣīṇāṃ tu saṃnidhau keśavasya ca
kathāḥ kathaya rājendra tvadanyaḥ ka udāharet
jñāte tu yasmiñjñātavyaṃ jñātaṃ bhavati bhārata
tadyathā bhagavantaṃ sanatkumāramāsīnamaṅguṣṭhaparvamātraṃ mahati vimānavare yojanasahasramaṇḍale taruṇa
bhāskarapratīkāśe śayanīye mahati baddhāsanamanudhyāyantamamṛtamanāvartakaramamūrtamakṣayajamathopadiṣṭamupasasarpa bhagavantamācāryaṃ bhagavānācāryo rudraḥ
taṃ provāca svāgataṃ maheśvara brahmasuta etadāsanamāstāṃ bhagavān
ityukte cāsīno bhagavānanantarūpo rudrastaṃ provāca bhagavānapi dhyānamāvartayati ityukte cāha
kālasaṅkhyā ca kā deva draṣṭavyā tasya brahmaṇaḥ
parisāṅkhyaṃ ca sāṅkhyānāṃ dhyānaṃ yogeṣu cārthavat
daivatāni ca sarvāṇi nikhilenānupūrvaśaḥ yānyāśritāni deheṣu dehināṃ yatisattama
śreṣṭho bhavānhi sarveṣāṃ brahmajñānāmaninditaḥ caturthastvaṃ trayāṇāṃ tu ye gatāḥi paramāṃ gatim
vayaṃ tu vaikṛtaṃ mārgamāśritā vai kṣaraṃ sadā
kecidāhustrayoviṃśaṃ yathāśrutinidarśanāt vayaṃ tu pañcaviṃśaṃ vai tadadhiṣṭhānasaṃjñitam
saha caiva vinā caiva tāvanyonyaṃ pratiṣṭhitau
anyathā ye'nupaśyanti te na paśyanti brahmaja
nistatvaścaiṣa deveśa boddhavyaṃ tu na buddhyate yadi buddhyetparaṃ buddhaṃ buddhyamānaḥ surarṣabhaḥ
tatvasaṅkhyā śrutā caiṣā yeṣāṃ brahmavidāṃvara sargasaṅkhyā mayā proktā navānāmānupūrvyaśaḥ
yatnena dṛṣṭaṃ paramātmatatvaṃ tatvena prāpyaṃ tu yathoktametat paraṃ parebhyastvamṛtārthatatvaṃ svabhāvasatvasthamanīśamīśam

sannipātaya vijñānaṃ sarvakarma ca tatra ha
jñāpataṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ karma sadā smṛtam

anādyantaṃ paraṃ brahma na devā ṛṣayo viduḥ

mukhe juhoti yo nityaṃ kṛtsnaṃ viśvamidaṃ jagat

na prabuddho na varteta pānīyaṃ matsyako yathā
ūrdhvameva na tiryakca tathaivābhrānti te manaḥ
yukto yo na vikampeta yogī yogavidhiḥ śrutaḥ

yaṃ dṛṣṭvā yatayastāta na śocanti gatajvarāḥ

nigadiṣyāmi deveśa vimokṣaṃ trividhaṃ ca te
bhūya eva nibodha tvaṃ devānāṃ devasattama

subhago darśanīyaśca jñānabhāgyatha jānate jāyate paripūrṇāṅgaḥ paurṇamāsyeva candramāḥ ]
kena vṛttena rājendra vartamānā narā bhuvi
prāpnuvantyuttamaṃ svargaṃ kathaṃ ca narakaṃ nṛpa
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ prayāntyamuṃ lokamitaḥ ko vai tānanugacchati bhīṣma uvāca

pūjāmanuṣamāṃ cakre sarve te ca sabhāsadaḥ
bhagavansarvadharmajña sarvaśāstraviśārada martyasya kaḥ sahāyo vai pitā mātā suto guruḥ jñātisambandhivargaśca mitravargastathaiva ca
mṛtaṃ śarīramutsṛjya kāṣṭhaloṣṭasamaṃ janāḥ gacchantyamuṃ ca lokaṃ vai ka etānanugacchati bṛhaspatiruvāca
na sahāyaḥ pitā mātā tathā bhrātā suto guruḥ
dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca tritayaṃ jīvite phalam etattrayamavāptavyamadharmaparivarjitam yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
śrutaṃ bhagavato vākyaṃ dharmayuktaṃ paraṃ hitam
mṛtaṃ śarīraṃ hi nṛṇāṃ sūkṣmamavyaktatāṃ gatam acakṣurviṣayaṃ prāptaṃ kathaṃ dharmo'nugacchati bṛhaspatiruvāca
buddhirātmā ca sahitā dharmaṃ paśyanti nityadā
tvagasthi māṃsaṃ śukraṃ ca śoṇitaṃ ca mahāmate
tato dharmasamāyuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ sukhamedhate iha loke pare caiva kiṃ bhūyaḥ kathayāmi te yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
taddarśitaṃ bhagavatā yathā dharmo'nugacchati etattu jñātumicchāmi kathaṃ retaḥ pravartate bṛhaspatiruvāca
tato garbhaḥ sambhavati śleṣātstrīpuṃsayornṛpa etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ bhūyaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasi yudhiṣṭhira uvāca
ākhyātaṃ me bhagavatā garbhaḥ sañjāyate yathā yathā jātastu puruṣaḥ prapadyati taducyatām bṛhaspatiruvāca
āsannamātraḥ puruṣastairbhūtairabhibhūyate viprayuktaśca tairbhūtaiḥ punaryātyaparāṃ gatim
sa ca bhūtasamāyuktaḥ prāpnute jīva eva hi
tato'sya karma paśyanti śubhaṃ vā yadi vāśubham devatāḥ pañcabhūtasthāḥ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi yudhiṣṭhira uvāca

karmaṇā yena yeneha yasyāṃ yonau prajāyate
yamasya viṣayaṃ ghoraṃ martyo lokaḥ prapadyate
yenayena tu bhāvena karmaṇā puruṣo gatim

tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata

sa jīva iha saṃsārāṃstrīnāpnoti na saṃśayaḥ

manasā'pi gurorbhāryāṃ yaḥ śiṣyo yāti pāpakṛt
śvayonau tu sa sambhūtastrīṇi varṣāṇi jīvati

kharo jīvati māsāṃstu daśa śvā ca caturdaśaḥ
tāḍayitvā tu tāveva jāyate kacchapo nṛpa

śvā'tha bhūtvā tu ṣaṇmāsāṃstato jāyati mānuṣaḥ
nyāsāpahartā tu naro yamasya viṣayaṃ gataḥ
tatra jīvati varṣāṇi daśapañca ca bhārata
duṣkṛtasya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānuṣaḥ
viśvāsahartā tu naro mīno jāyati durmatiḥ
chāgastu nidhanaṃ prāpya pūrṇe saṃvatsare tataḥ
gauḥ sa sañjāyate jantustato jāyati mānuṣaḥ
tataḥ pretya mahārāja mṛto jāyati sūkaraḥ
śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva
bhūtvā śvā pañcavarṣāṇi tato jāyati mānavaḥ
paradārābhimarśaṃ tu kṛtvā jāyati vai vṛkaḥ
śvā śṛgālastato gṛdhro vyālaḥ kaṅko bakastathā
bhrāturbhāryāṃ tu pāpātmā yo dharmayati mohitaḥ
upasthite vivāhe tu yajñe dāne'pi vā vibho
mohātkaroti yo vighnaṃ sa mṛto jāyate kṛmiḥ
kṛmirjīvati varṣāṇi daśa pañca ca bhārata
adharmisya kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato jāyati mānavaḥ
pūrvaṃ dattvā tu yaḥ kanyāṃ dvitīye dātumicchati
krauñco jīvati varṣaṃ tu tato jāyati cīrakaḥ
śvā tato jāyate mūḍhaḥ karmaṇā tena pārthiva
tato garbhaṃ samāsādya tatraiva mriyate śiśuḥ
phalaṃ vā mūlakaṃ hṛtvā apūpaṃ vā pipīlikāḥ
ayo hṛtvā tu durbuddhirvāyaso jāyate naraḥ
kāṃsyaṃ hṛtvā tu durbaddhirhārito jāyate naraḥ

kauśikaṃ tu tato hṛtvā naro jāyati vartakaḥ

karmaṇā ca kṛteneha kena yānti śubhāṃ gatim
yathāyathā naraḥ samyagadhramamanubhāṣate samāhitena manasā vimucyeta tathātathā
pradānāni tu vakṣyāmi yāni dattvā yudhiṣṭhira
hṛṣṭena manasā dattaṃ na sa tiryaggatirbhavet
sarvātithyaṃ paraṃ hyeṣāṃ tasmāddānaṃ paraṃ smṛtam
yaḥ prayacchati viprebhyo na sa durgāṇi paśyati
dānavadbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
te hi prāṇasya dātārastebhyo dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
kāryaṃ pātrāgataṃ nityamannaṃ hi paramā gatiḥ
annasya hi pradānena naro raudraṃ na sevate
na yāti narakaṃ ghoraṃ saṃsārāṃśca na sevate
tapo'tha guruśuśrūṣā kiṃ śreyaḥ puruṣaṃ prati
ātmanaḥ sukhamanvicchansa pretya na sukhī bhavet
ātmopamastu bhūteṣu yo vai bhavati pūruṣaḥ
prakhyāpane ca dāne ca sukhaduḥkhe priyāpriye
yathā paraḥ prakramate pareṣu tathā pare prakramante parasmin
niṣevate svasamāṃ jīvaloke yathā dharmo naipuṇenopadiṣṭaḥ
vācā ca manasā caivaṃ tato duḥkhātpramucyate
evaṃ lokeṣvahiṃsā tu nirdiṣṭā dharmataḥ purā
karmṇā lipyate janturvācā ca manasā'pi ca
pūrvaṃ tu manasā tyaktvā tyajedvācā'tha karmaṇā
hiṃsāṃ tu nopayuñjīta tathā hiṃsā caturvidhā
kāye manasi vākye'pi doṣā hyete prakīrtitāḥ

hiṃsāṃ kṛtvā'vaśaḥ pāpo bhūyiṣṭhaṃ jāyate tathā
rasaśca hṛdi jihvāyā jñānaṃ prajñāyate yathā
niṣeviṣyanti vai mandā māṃsabhakṣāḥ kathaṃ narāḥ
pareṣāṃ dhanadhānyānāṃ hisakāḥ stāvakāstathā praśaṃsakāśca māṃsasya nityaṃ svarge bahiṣkṛtāḥ
bhasma viṣṭhā kṛmirvā'pi niṣṭhā yasyedṛśī dhruvā sa kāyaḥ parapīḍābhiḥ kathaṃ dhāryovipaścitā
jīvitaṃ hi parityajya bahavaḥ sādhavo janāḥ
jāto naḥ saṃśayo dharme māṃsasya parivarjane
hanyādvā yaḥ parasyārthe krītvā vā bhakṣayennaraḥ
taṃ me śṛṇu yathātattvaṃ yaścāsya vidhiruttamaḥ
babhūva teṣāṃ tu mataṃ yattacchṛṇu yudhiṣṭhira
na bhakṣayati yo māṃsaṃ na ca hanyānna ghātayet
dadāti yajate cāpi tapasvī ca bhavatyapi
na khādati ca yo māṃsaṃ samametanmataṃ mama
sadā yajati satreṇa sadā dānaṃ prayacchati
sarve vedā na tatkuryuḥ sarve yajñāśca bhārata
bhakṣayitvā nimitte'pi duṣkaraṃ kurute tapaḥ duṣkaraṃ ca rasajñena māṃsasya parivarjanam
sarvabhūteṣu yo vidvāndadātyabhayadakṣiṇām dātā bhavati loke sa prāṇānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
evaṃ vai paramaṃ dharmaṃ praśaṃsanti manīṣiṇaḥ
vikīrṇakarṇakenāpi tṛṇamaspandane bhayam kiṃ punarhanyamānānāṃ tarasā jīvitārthinām
ahiṃsā paramaṃ satyaṃ tato dharmaḥ pravartate
hatvā jantuṃ tato māṃsaṃ tasmāddoṣastu bhakṣaṇe
yadi cetsvādako na syānna tadā ghātako bhavet
idaṃ tu khalu kaunteya śrutamāsītpurā mayā
yo hi khādati sāṃsāni prāṇināṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām
sadā bhavati vai pāpaḥ prāṇihantā tathaiva saḥ
māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe dharmo viśiṣṭa iti naḥ śrutiḥ
saṃskartā copabhoktā ca ghātakāḥ sarva eva te
haviryatsaṃskṛtaṃ mantraiḥ prokṣitābhyukṣitaṃ śuci vedoktena pramāṇena pitṝṇāṃ prakriyāsu ca
vidhihīnaṃ naraḥ pūrvaṃ māṃsaṃ rājanna bhakṣayet
śrūyate hi purākalpe nṛṇāṃ vrīhimayaḥ paśuḥ
abhakṣyamapi māṃsaṃ yaḥ prāha bhakṣyamiti prabho
idaṃ tu śṛṇu rājendra māṃsasyābhakṣaṇe guṇāḥ [abhakṣaṇe sarvasukhaṃ māṃsasya manujādhipa ]
varjayanti hi māṃsāni māsaśaḥ pakṣaśopi vā teṣāṃ hiṃsānivṛttānāṃ brahmaloko vidhīyate ]

ityuktaḥ sa tu saṃ prāha kutaḥ kīṭa sukhaṃ tava

ahamāsaṃ manuṣyo vai śūdro bahudhanaḥ prabho
devārthaṃ pitṛyajñārthaṃ na ca śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā
īrṣyuḥ parasukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā anyasya na bubhūṣakaḥ
mātā ca pūjitā vṛddhā brāhmaṇaścārcito mayā
śubhena karmaṇā yadvai tiryagyonau na muhyase
mamaiva kīṭa tatkarma yena tvaṃ na pramuhyase
jānāmi pāpaiḥ svakṛtairgataṃ tvāṃ kīṭa kīṭatām
avāpsysi paraṃ rdharmaṃ mānuṣye yadi manyase
dhanyā api manuṣyeṣu kāmārthāśca yathā guṇāḥ
bruvannapi kathāṃ puṇyāṃ tatra kīṭa tvameṣyasi
guṇabhūtāni bhūtāni tatra tvamupabhokṣyase kramātte'haṃ vineṣyāmi brahmatvaṃ yadi cecchasi
stuvanti māṃ yathā devā mahendraṃ priyavādinaḥ
prasādātsatyasandhasya bhavato'mitatejasaḥ yadahaṃ kīṭatāṃ prāpya smṛtijātā jugupsitām
[namaste'stu mahāprājña kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām tvattapobalanirdiṣṭamidaṃ hyadhigataṃ mayā ]
śūdreṇārthapradhānena nṛśaṃsenātatāyinā mamaitaddarśanaṃ prāptaṃ tacca vai sukṛtaṃ purā
tiryagyonyāḥ śūdratāmabhyapaiti śūdro vaiśyaṃ kṣatriyatvaṃ ca vaiśyaḥ
vṛttaślāghī kṣatriyo brāhmaṇatvaṃ svargaṃ puṇyādbrāhmaṇaḥ sādhuvṛttaḥ
tyaktvā hi kīṭatāṃ rājaṃścacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ
upapadyati dharmajña yathādharmaṃ yathāvratam tasmānmṛtyubhayātkīṭa mā vyathiṣṭhāḥ kathañcana
dharmamūlaṃ śubhaṃ prāpya pāpmā naṣṭa ihādya me
bhagavadvacanātkīṭo brāhmaṇyaṃ prāpya durlabham akarotpṛthivīṃ rājanyajñayūpaśatāṅkitām
atha pāpaharaṃ kīṭaḥ pārta brahma sanātanam
samprāptāste gatiṃ puṇyāṃ tanmā tvaṃ śoca putraka
vidyā tapaśca dānaṃ ca kimeteṣāṃ viśiṣyate
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ satāṃ śreṣṭha tanme brūhi pitāmaha
tamutsmayantaṃ samprekṣya maitreyaḥ kṛṣṇamabravīt kāraṇaṃ brūhi dharmātmanvyasmayiṣṭhāḥ kutaśca te
tapobhāgyānmahābhāga sukhabhāgyāttathaiva ca pṛthagācaritaṃ tāta pṛthagācaritātmanaḥ
na druhyeccaiva dadyācca satyaṃ caiva parānvadet
idānīṃ caiva naḥ kṛtyaṃ purastācca pariśrutam
śubhaṃ sarvapavitrebyo dānameva paraṃ dvija [nocetsarvapavitrebhyo dānameva paraṃ bhavet ]
teṣāṃ śreṣṭhataraṃ dānamiti me nātra saṃśayaḥ
dānavadbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā yena yānti manīṣiṇaḥ
te hi prāṇasya dātārasteṣu dharmaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
tvaṃ hi tāta sukhādeva śubhameṣyasi śobhanam
dṛśyate hi mahāprājña niyataṃ vai svabhāvataḥ
yathā svakarmanirvṛttaṃ na puṇyaṃ na ca pāpakam
ye'bhidruhyanti bhūtāni te vai pāpakṛto janāḥ
dravyāṇyādadate caiva duḥkhaṃ yānti patanti ca
tato'nyatkarma yatkiṃcinna puṇyaṃ na ca pātakam
nityaṃ cākṛpaṇo bhuṅkte svajanairdehi yācataḥ bhāgyakṣayeṇa kṣīyante nopabhogena sañcayāḥ
ramasvaidhasva modasva dehi dāne ramasva ca
na tvāmatibhaviṣyanti vaidyā na ca tapasvinaḥ
atyantaṃ śrīmati kule jātaḥ prājño bahuśrutaḥ
brūhi tatvaṃ mahāprājña śuśruṣe vacanaṃ tava
tribhirguṇaiḥ samuditaḥ snāto bhavati vai dvijaḥ
asmiṃstṛpte ca tṛpyanti pitaro daivatāni ca
asaṃskārātkṣatravaiśyau naśyete brāhmaṇādṛte śūdro naśyatyaśuśrūṣurāśramāṇāṃ yathārhataḥ
[andhaṃ syāttama evedaṃ na prajñāyeta kiñcana cāturvarṇyaṃ na varteta dharmādharmāvṛtānṛte ]
yathāhi sukṛte kṣetre phalaṃ vindati mānavaḥ
evaṃ dattvā śrutavate phalaṃ dātā samaśnute
brāhmaṃ hyanupayogī yo dadaṃścānnamasaṃśayam yastārayati vai vidvānpitṝndevānsadā'mṛtān
tairhi sadbhiḥ kṛtaḥ panthā devayāno na muhyate
te hi svargasya netāro yajñavāhāḥ sanātanāḥ
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavānmaitreyaṃ pratyabhāṣata diṣṭyaitattvaṃ vijānāsi diṣṭyā te buddhirīdṛśī?
yānīhāgamaśāstrāṇi yāśca kāścitprivṛttayaḥ tāni vedaṃ puraskṛtya pravṛttāni yathākramam
tapaḥ pavitraṃ vedasya tapaḥ svargasya sādhanam
tapasā mahadāpnoti vidyayā ceti naḥ śrutam
sarvaṃ vai tapasā'bhyoti tapo hi balavattaram
dānapradāḥ sukhaṃ pretya prāpnuvantīha ca śriyam
imaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ ca lokaṃ ca balavattaram
sa dātā yatra yatraiti sarvataḥ sampraṇūyate
akartā caiva kartā ca labhate yasya yādṛśam
yo bhartā vāsitātuṣṭo bhartustuṣṭā ca vāsitā
yasminnevaṃ kule sarvaṃ kalyāṇaṃ tatra vartate
adbhirgātrānmalamiva tamo'gniprabhayā yathā ] dānena tapasā caiva viṣṇorabhyarcanena ca
praṇavopāsanaparāḥ paramārthiparāstviha etaiḥ pāvaya cātmānaṃ sarvapāpamapohya ca
taṃ praṇamyātha maitreyaḥ kṛtvā cāpi pradakṣiṇam
kena vṛttena kalyāṇi samācāreṇa kena vā
na tvamalpena tapasā dānena niyamena vā
imaṃ lokamanuprāptā tvaṃ hi tattvaṃ vadasva me
na ca muṇḍā ca jaṭilā bhūtvā devatvamāgatā
ahitāni ca vākyāni sarvāṇi paruṣāṇi ca
devatānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca pūjane
paiśunye na pravartāmi na mamaitanmano gatam
advāri na ca tiṣṭhāmi ciraṃ na kathayāmi ca
bhakṣyaṃ vā yadi vā lehyaṃ tatsarvaṃ varjayāmyaham
bālānāṃ varjaye nityaṃ śāpaṃ kopaṃ pratāpanam
avikṣiptāni dhānyāni nānnavikṣepaṇaṃ gṛhe raktavatspṛhaye gehe gāvaḥ sayavasodakāḥ
samudgamya ca śuddhā'haṃ bhikṣāṃ dadyāṃ dvijātiṣu
pravāsaṃ yadi me yāti bhartā kāryeṇa kenacit
notthāpayāmi bhartāraṃ sukhaṃ suptamahaṃ sadā ātureṣvapi kāryeṣu tena tuṣyati me manaḥ
notthāpaye sukhaṃ suptaṃ hyāturaṃ pālaye patim
sa devalokaṃ samprāpya nandane sa sukhī vaset
śrotavyaṃ ca tvayā samyagjñātavyaṃ ca viśāmpate
yaḥ paraḥ prakṛte proktaḥ puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ
tānyeva cāyanaṃ tasya tena nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ
nārāyaṇaḥ paraṃ brahma tatvaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ paraḥ
vāsudevaṃ tathā viṣṇumātmānaṃ ca tathā viduḥ
namo nārāyaṇāyeti yo veda brahma śāśvatam
keśavārādhanaṃ hitvā naiva yāti parāṃ gatim
atha kālena mahatā tathā pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ
gataḥ samprajitaḥ sarvaiḥ sa yoginilayo hariḥ
sāmni cāpi pradānena ca jyāyaḥ kiṃ bhavato matam
gṛhītvā rakṣasā mukto dvijātiḥ kānane yathā
sāmaivāsmai prayuñjāno na mumoha na vivyadhe
rakṣastu vācā sampūjya praśnaṃ papraccha taṃ dvijam
mokṣyase brūhi me praśnaṃ kenāsmi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
avajānanti nūnaṃ tvāṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
jitaṃ tvāṃ manyate sādho tenāsi harimaḥ kṛśaḥ
vañcayitvā gatastvāṃ vai tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
na bhāti kāle'bhihitaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
anunetuṃ na śakroṣi tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
tajjñairna pūjyase vyaktaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
māyāvīti ca jānanti tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
guṇāste na virājante tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
yuvā sulalitaḥ kāmī tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
dārā vā pratikūlāste tenāsi harimaḥ kṛśaḥ
bhrātaro'tīva viṣamāḥ pitā vā kṣutkṣato mṛtaḥ
mātā jyoṣṭho gururvā'pi tenāsi harimaḥ kṛśaḥ
brāhmaṇo vā hato gaurvā brahmasvaṃ vāpahṛtaṃ purā
devasyaṃ vā hṛtaṃ kāle tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
hṛtadāro'tha vṛddho vā loke dviṣṭo'thavā naraiḥ
vārdhakārthaṃ dhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā svā śrīrvā'pi parairhṛtā
yaśaḥ prārthayase nityaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
dharmyamarthyaṃ ca kāmyaṃ ca deśe ca rahitaṃ vacaḥ
na prasiddhyati te nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
prāpya vartayase nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
dhruvaṃ garhayase nūnaṃ tenāsi hariṇaḥ kṛśaḥ
evaṃ sampūjitaṃ rakṣo vipraṃ taṃ pratyapūjayat
dharmāṇāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ bhīṣmaḥ provāca pārthivam
yena yaḥ prīyate devaḥ prīyante pitarastathā
ṛṣayaḥ pramathāḥ śrīśca citragupto diśāṃ gajāḥ
daśasūnāsamaṃ cakraṃ daśacakrasamo dhvajaḥ daśadhvajasamā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ
ye paṭhanti sadā martyā yeṣāṃ caivopatiṣṭhati
śrutvā ca phalamācaṣṭe svayaṃ nārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ
gavāṃ phalaṃ tīrthaphalaṃ yajñānāṃ caiva yatphalam
śrotāraḥ śraddhadhānāśca yeṣāṃ śuddhaṃ ca mānasam
teṣāṃ vyaktaṃ jitā lokāḥ śraddadhānena sādhunā
mucyate kilbiṣāccaiva na sa pāpena lipyate
dharmaṃ ca labhate nityaṃ pretya lokagato naraḥ
kemarthaṃ ca trayaḥ piṇḍāḥ pravibhaktāḥ pṛthakpṛthak
prathamaḥ kasya dātavyo madhyamaḥ kva ca gacchati
svāgataṃ te'stu bhadraṃ te śrūyatāṃ khecarottama
śrāddhaṃ dattvā ca bhuktvā ca puruṣo yaḥ striyaṃ vrajet
piṇḍaṃ tu madhyamaṃ tatra patnītvekā samaśnute piṇḍastṛtīyo yasteṣāṃ taṃ dadyājjātavedasi
eṣa śrāddhavidhiḥ prokto yathā dharmo na lupyate
pitṝṇāṃ triṣu sarveṣāṃ niruktaṃ kathitaṃ tvayā
kaṃ vā prīṇayate devaṃ kathaṃ tārayate pitṝn
madhyamaṃ tu tadā patnī bhuṅkte'nujñātameva hi
bhavate kā gatistasya kaṃ vā samanugacchati
etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ piṇḍeṣu triṣu yā gatiḥ
phalaṃ vṛttiṃ ca mārgaṃ ca yaścainaṃ pratipadyate
etadeva praśaṃsanti devāśca munayastathā te'pyevaṃ nābhijānanti pitṛkāryaviniścayam
apo gacchati yo hyatra śaśinaṃ hyeṣa prīṇayet
bhuṅkte tu patnīṃ yaṃ caiṣāmanujñātā tu madhyamam
havyavāhe tu yaḥ piṇḍo dīyate tannibodha me pitarastena tṛpyanti prītāḥ kāmāndiśanti ca
etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ triṣu piṇḍeṣu yā gatiḥ
śucinā tu sadā śrāddhaṃ bhoktavyaṃ khecarottama
ye mayā kathitā doṣāste tathā syurna cānyathā
tasmātsnātaḥ śuciḥ kṣāntaḥ śrāddhaṃ bhuñjīta vai dvijaḥ
pitaraśca mahābhāgāḥ pūjayanti sma taṃ munim
kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ gaṅgāṃ prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca etāni manasā dhyātvā avagāhettato jalam
tathā mucyati pāpeni rāhuṇā candramā yathā
tryahaṃ snātaḥ sa bhavati nirāhāraśca vartate
spṛśate yo gavāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ vāladhiṃ ca namasyati
śrūyatāṃ cāparaṃ guhyaṃ rahasyamṛṣicintitam śrutaṃ me bhāṣamāṇasya sthāṇoḥ sthāne bṛhaspateḥ

havyavāhe pradīpte ca samidhaṃ ye na juhvati

dhanyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ svargyaṃ ca paramaṃ yaśaḥ
trivargo hi vaśe yuktaḥ sarveṣāṃ saṃvidhīyate
kulocitānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ yatāvatparipālanam kulasandhāraṇaṃ caiva pauruṣeṇaiva sarvaśaḥ
evamādi śubhaṃ sarvaṃ tasya vṛttamiti sthitam
vṛddhasevī bhavennityaṃ hitārthaṃ jñānakāṅkṣayā parārthaṃ nāhareddravyamanāmantrya tu sarvathā
hitaṃ pathyaṃ sadāhāraṃ jīrṇaṃ bhuñjīta mātrayā
śeṣaṃ bhuñjecchucirbhūtvā na ca bhāṣeta vipriyam
pratiśrayaṃ ca pānīyaṃ baliṃ bhikṣāṃ ca sarvataḥ
madhyāhne vā'rdharātre vā gamanāya na rocayet
bhayādvā yadi lobhādvā na kurvīta kadācana
ārabheta tadā karbha śubhaṃ vā yadi vetarat
manasā karmaṇā vācā na ca kāṅkṣeta pātakam
bhagavanbhaganetraghna kālasūdana śaṅkara ime varṇāśca catvāro vihitāḥ svasvabhāvataḥ
evaṃ me saṃśayapraśnastaṃ me chettuṃ tvamarhasi
tacca karmaviśeṣeṇa punarjanmani jāyate tasmātteṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ karmapākajam
tatkṣaye brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tathaiva nṛṣu jāyate
anyathā vartamānastu jātikarmāṇi varjayet śūdravadvicarelloke śūdrakarmābhilāṣavān
tathaiva śūdrastvaparaḥ śūdrakarmāṇi varjayet satyārjavaparo bhūtvā dānadharmaparastathā
evaṃ yuktasamācāraḥ śūdropi maraṇaṃ gataḥ svargaloke hi jāyeta tatkṣaye nṛṣu jāyate
tasmājjātiṃ viśiṣṭāṃ tu kathaṃcitprāpya paṇḍitaḥ sarvathā tāṃ tathā rakṣenna punarbhraśyate yathā
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
etajjanmaphalaṃ nityaṃ sarveṣāṃ gṛhavāsinām evaṃ gṛhasthitairnityaṃ vartitavyamiti sthitiḥ
etatsarvaṃ mayā proktaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
surāsurapate deva varada prītivardhana mānuṣeṣveva ye ke cidāḍhyāḥ kleśavivarjitāḥ
kimarthaṃ mānuṣe loke na samatvena kalpitāḥ
ādisarge purā brahmā samatvenāsṛjatprajāḥ nityaṃ na bhavato hyasya rāgadveṣau prajāpateḥ
tadā tasmātsurāḥ sarve babhūvuḥ samato narāḥ
teṣāṃ hāniṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tulyānāmeva bhāmini
putrabhāve same deva kimarthaṃ no bhavetkaliḥ
yūyaṃ mā brūta me doṣaṃ svakṛtaṃ smaratha prajāḥ
yuṣmābhireva yuṣmākaṃ grathitaṃ hi śubhāśubham yādṛśaṃ kurute karma tādṛśaṃ phalamaśnute
evaṃ vijñātatatvāste dānadharmaparāyaṇāḥ śubhāni vidhivatkṛtvā kāladharmagatāḥ punaḥ
mānuṣeṣvatha ye keciddhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ bhogahīnāḥ pradṛśyante sarvabhogeṣu satsvapi
na bhuñjate kimarthaṃ te tanme śaṃsitumarhasi
paraiḥ saṃcoditā dharmaṃ kurvate na svakāmataḥ
svayaṃ śraddhāṃ bahiṣkṛtya kurvanti ca rudanti ca
tādṛśā maraṇaṃ prāptāḥ punarjanmani śobhane phalāni tāni samprāpya bhuñjate na kadācana
iti te kathitaṃ devi kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchasi
apare yatamānāśca na labhante tu kiñcana
abhigamya svayaṃ tatra grāhayanti prasādya ca
punarjanmani te devi tādṛśāḥ śobhanā narāḥ
apare ye ca dānāni dadatyeva prayācitāḥ
tāvatkālaṃ tato devi punarjanmani te narāḥ
te punarjanmani śubhe yatanto bahudhā narāḥ
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tatvaṃ samāhitā
ārabhante punardharmaṃ dātuṃ dānāni vā narāḥ
te punarjanmani śubhe prāpya tāni phalānyuta
bhagavandevadeveśa mānuṣeṣveva kecana rūpayuktāḥ pradṛśyante śubhāṅgā priyadarśanāḥ
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu tatvaṃ samāhitā
ye purā manujā devi lajjāyuktāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ
śaktāḥ sumadhurā nityaṃ bhūtvā caiva svabhāvataḥ
amāṃsabhojinaścaiva sadā prāṇidayāyutāḥ pratikarmapradā vā'pi vastradā dharmakāraṇāt
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
evaṃ yuktasamācārā yamaloke sudaṇḍitāḥ kathaṃcitprāpya mānuṣyaṃ tatra te rūpavarjitāḥ
ye purā manujā devi saumyaśīlāḥ priyaṃvadāḥ
dākṣiṇyenaiva vartante pramadāsvapriyāsvapi na tu pratyādiśantyeva strīdoṣānguṇasaṃśritān
evaṃ yuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani śobhane mānuṣāste bhavantyeva satataṃ subhagā bhṛśam
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvaṃ samāhitā
evaṃ yuktasamācārāḥ panarjanmani te narāḥ durbhagāstu bhavantyeva strīṇāṃ hṛdayavipriyāḥ
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
ye purā manujā devi śrutavantopi kevalam
niṣkiñcanā bhavantyeva anuptaṃ hi na rohati
mūrkhā loke pradṛśyante vṛthā mūḍhā vicetasaḥ jñānavijñānarahitāḥ samṛddhāśca samantataḥ
ye purā manujā devi bāliśā api sarvataḥ
bhagavandevadeveśa mānuṣeṣveva kecana medhāvinaḥ śrutadharā bhavanti viśadākṣarāḥ
ye purā manujā devi guruśuśrūṣakā bhṛśam
jñānārthaṃ te tu saṅgṛhya tīrthato vidhipūrvakam
vidhinaiva parāṃścaiva grāhayanti ca nānyathā aślāghamānā jñānena praśāntā yatavācakāḥ
vidyāsthānāni ye loke sthāpayanti ca yatnataḥ
apare mānuṣā deva yatantopi yatastataḥ bahiṣkṛtāḥ pradṛśyante śrutavijñānabuddhitaḥ
jñānādasūyāṃ kurvanti na sahante ca cāparān
tādṛśā maraṇaṃ prāptāḥ punarjanmani śobhane mānuṣyaṃ sucirātprāpya tatra bodhavivarjitāḥ
jñātibhiḥ saha modante avighnaṃ tu dinedine
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu sarvaṃ samāhitā
ye purā manujā devi āḍhyā vā itare'pi vā
dātāraḥ pātrato dānaṃ vratairniyamasaṃyutāḥ svaduḥkhamiva saṃsmṛtya paraduḥkhavivarjitāḥ
divi vā bhuvi vā devi jāyante karmabhoginaḥ
rūpaṃ dravyaṃ balaṃ cāyurbhogaiśvaryaṃ balaṃ śrutam ityetatsarvasādguṇyaṃ dānādbhavati nānyathā
bhayaistribhiḥ samājuṣṭā vyādhikṣudbhayasaṃyutāḥ duṣkalatrābhibhūtāśca satataṃ vighnadarśakāḥ
ye purā manujā devi āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
bhagavandevadeveśa mama prītivivardhana jātyandhāścaiva dṛśyante jātā vā naṣṭacakṣuṣaḥ
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
yadi cenmānuṣaṃ janma labheraṃste tathāpi vā svabhāvato vā jātā vā andhā eva bhavanti te
ādiprabhṛti vai martyā jātā vā'pyatha kāraṇāt
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāhitā
kuvaktārastu ye devi jihvayā kaṭukaṃ bhṛśam
jihvābādhāṃ tadā'nyeṣāṃ kurvate kopakāraṇāt prāyaśo'nṛtabhūyiṣṭhā narāḥ kāryavaśena vā
anye duḥkhāśritā doṣāḥ sarve cātmakṛtaṃ phalam
ye purā manujā devi kāmakrodhavaśā bhṛśam
bhavantyevaṃ tathā devi yathā caivaṃ tathā kṛtam
dṛśyante satataṃ deva vyādhibhirmehanāśritaiḥ pīḍyamānāstathā martyā aśmarīśarkarādibhiḥ
tiryagyoniṣu dhūrtā vai maithunārthaṃ caranti ca
kāmadoṣeṇi ye dhūrtāḥ kanyāsu vidhavāsu ca
tādṛśā maraṇaṃ punarjanmani śobhane yadi cenmānuṣaṃ janma labheraṃste tathāvidhāḥ
ye purā manujā devi māṃsalubdhāḥ sulolupāḥ
ye purā manujā devi pareṣāṃ rūpanāśanāḥ
yadi vai mānuṣaṃ janma labheraṃsteṣu duḥkhitāḥ
kecittvagdoṣasaṃyuktā vraṇakuṣṭhaiśca saṃyutāḥ śvitrakuṣṭhayutā vā'pi bahudhā kṛcchrasaṃyutāḥ
bhavantyeva narā devi yathā tena kṛtaṃ phalam
ye purā manujā devi lobhamohasamāvṛtāḥ prāṇināṃ prāṇahiṃsārthamaṅgavighnaṃ prakurvate
evaṃ yuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani śobhane tadaṅgahīnā vai pretya bhavantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
svabhāvato vā jātā vā paṅgavaśca bhavanti te
ye purā manujā devi granthibhedakarā nṛṇām muṣṭiprahāraparuṣā nṛśaṃsāḥ pāpakāriṇaḥ
ye purā manujā devi krodhalobhasamanvitāḥ manujā devatāsthānaṃ svapādairbhraṃśayantyuta
rogairbahuvidhairdeva kliśyamānāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ asamastaiḥ samastaiśca āḍhyā vā durgatāstathā
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
ye purā manujā devi tvāsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
evaṃyuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani śobhane yadi vai mānuṣaṃ janma labheraṃste tathāvidhāḥ
āḍhyā vā durgatā vā'pi dṛśyante vyādhipīḍitāḥ
evamātmakṛtaṃ karma bhuñjante tatratatra te abhibhūtuṃ na śakyaṃ hi kenacitsvakṛtaṃ phalam
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
bhagavanmānuṣāḥ keciddṛśyante mānuṣeṣu vai unmattāśca piśācāśca paryaṭanto yatastataḥ
mohayanti parānbhogairmadanairlobhakāraṇāt vṛddhāngurūṃśca ye mūrkhā vṛthaivāpahasanti ca
bhagavanmānuṣāḥ kecinnirapatyāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ yatanto na labhantyeva apatyāni yatastataḥ
ye purā manujā devi sarvaprāṇiṣu nirdayāḥ
evaṃyuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani śobhane mānuṣyaṃ vā cirātprāpya nirapatyā bhavanti te
ye śvabhiḥ krīḍamānāśca trāsayanti vane mṛgān
prāṇihiṃsāṃ tathā devi kurvanti ca yatastataḥ
yeṣāṃ gṛheṣu vai śvānastrāsayanti vṛthā narān
dadatyeva ca ye mūrkhāḥ ślāghayā'vajñayā'pi vā
evaṃyuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani śobhane kudeśe mlecchabhūyiṣṭhe durgame vanasaṃkaṭe
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
kāmavighnakarā ye tu dveṣapaiśunyakāraṇāt evaṃyuktasamācārāḥ kāladharmaṃ gatāstu te
strīṇāmapi tathā devi yathā puṃsāṃ tu karmajam
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
bhagavandevadeveśa śūlapāṇe vṛṣadhvaja puṃścalya iva yā strīṣu nīcavṛttiratāḥ smṛtāḥ
evaṃyuktasamācārā yamaloke sudaṇḍitāḥ yadi vai mānuṣaṃ janma labheraṃstāstathāvidhāḥ
pauścalyaṃ yattu tadvṛttaṃ strīṇāṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ smṛtam
tataḥprabhṛti tā devi patantyeva na saṃśayaḥ
kuṭumbaṃ tatra ve patyurnāśayanti vṛthā tathā
evaṃyuktasamācārā yamaloke sudaṇḍitāḥ nirayasthāściraṃ kālaṃ kathaṃcitprāpya mānuṣam
tatra tā bhogarahitā vidhavāstu bhavanti vai
bhagavanpramadā loke patyau jñātiṣu satsuca liṅginyaḥ sampradṛśyante pāṣaṇḍaṃ matamāśritāḥ
evaṃyuktasamācārāḥ punarjanmani tāḥ striyaḥ alakṣaṇasamāyuktāḥ pāṣaṇḍaṃ dharmamāśritāḥ
ye purā manujā devi stabdhamānayutā bhṛśam
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu kalyāṇi kāraṇam
ye purā manujā devi pareṣāṃ vittahārakāḥ
kathañcitprāpya mānuṣyaṃ tatra te devi sarvathā
teṣāṃ karmāṇi kurvanti yeṣāṃ te dhanahārakāḥ
paśubhūtāstathā cānye bhavanti dhanahārakāḥ tattathā kṣīyate karma teṣāṃ pūrvāparādhajam
ato'nyathā na tacchakyaṃ karma bhoktuṃ surāsuraiḥ
prītipūrvaṃ tu yo bhartrā mukto muktaḥ svapāpataḥ
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
nīcakarmaratā deva sarveṣāṃ malahārakāḥ durgatāḥ kleśabhūyiṣṭhā virūpā duṣṭacetasaḥ
ye purā manujā devi atimānayutā bhṛśam
praṇāmaṃ tu na kurvanti gurūṇāmapi pāmarāḥ
parānsaṃnāmayantyeva ājñayātmani ye balāt ṛddhiyogātparānnityamavamanyanti mānavān
virūpāḥ pāpayonisthāḥ sparśanādivivarjitāḥ kuvṛttimupajīvanti bhutvā te rajakādayaḥ
tānapyavastākṛpaṇāṃścaṇḍālānapi buddhimān na ca nindennāpi kupyedbhuñjate svakṛtaṃ phalam
caṇḍālā api tāṃ jātiṃ śocantaḥ śuddhimāpnuyuḥ
draṣṭuṃ jñāpayituṃ caiva na labhante ca yatnataḥ
rājñāṃ vā rājamātrāṇāṃ dvāri tiṣṭhanti vāritāḥ
karma vijñāpituṃ draṣṭuṃ na labhante kathañcana
ye purā mānuṣā devi āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
śastreṇa vā'nyathā vā'pi prāpnuvanti vadhaṃ narāḥ
nirdayāḥ prāṇihiṃsāyāṃ tathā prāṇivighātakāḥ viśvastaghātakāścaiva tathā suptavighātakāḥ
tiryagyoniṃ punaḥ prāpya tatra duḥkhaparikṣayāt yadi cenmānupaṃ janma labheraṃste tathāvidhāḥ
āḍhyā vā durgatā vā'pi bhuñjate svakṛtaṃ phalam
bhagavanmānuṣāḥ kecidrājanītiviśāra daiḥ daṇḍyante mānuṣe loke mānuṣāḥ sarvatobhayāḥ
ye purā manujā devi mānuṣāṃścetarāṇi vā kliṣṭaghātena nighnanti prāṇānprāṇiṣu nirdayāḥ
na tathā mānuṣāṇāṃ syādantardhāya bhaveddhi tat
taireva hi śarīreṇa bhuñjante karmaṇāṃ phalam
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi tattvaṃ śṛṇu samāhitā
teṣāṃ tatpūrvakaṃ karma daṇḍyate yatra rājabhiḥ
devi karma kṛtaṃ caiṣāṃ heturbhavati śāsane
prāgeva ca mayā proktaṃ tatra niḥsaṃśayā bhava
bhagavanbhuvi martyānāṃ daṇḍitānāṃ nareśvaraiḥ daṇḍenaiva tu teneha pāpanāśo bhavenna vā
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi śṛṇu tatvaṃ samāhitā
yamaloke na daṇḍyante tatra te yamadaṇḍanaiḥ
adaṇḍitā vā ye mithyā mithyā vā daṇḍitā bhuvi tānyamo daṇḍayatyeva sa hi veda kṛtākṛtam
rājā yamaśca kurvāte daṇḍamātraṃ tu śobhane ubhābhyāṃ yamarājabhyāṃ daṇḍito'daṇḍitopi vā
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ nirviśaṅkā bhava priye
kimarthaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtvā mānuṣā bhuvi nityaśaḥ
sarvapāpaharaṃ ceti hayamedhaṃ vadanti ca prāyaścittāni cānyāni pāpanāśāya kurvate
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi śṛṇu tatvaṃ samāhitā
saṃśayo hi mahāneva pūrveṣāṃ ca manīṣiṇām
dvidhā tu kriyate pāpaṃ sadbhiścāsadbhireva ca
viddhyevaṃ pāpake kārye nirviśaṅkā bhava priye
iti te kathitaṃ devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
bhagavandevadeveśa mānuṣāścetarā api mriyante mānuṣā loke kāraṇākāraṇādapi
evameva yathā loke mānuṣānghnanti mānuṣāḥ kāraṇenaiva tenātha tatā svaprāṇanāśanam
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ karmapākaphalaṃ priye
yaiḥ purā manujairdevi yasminkāle yathā kṛtam
tasmankāle tathā devi kāraṇenaiva tena tu
iti satyaṃ prajānīhi loke tatra vidhiṃ prati
karmakartā naro bhoktā sa nāsti divi vā bhuvi
yadanyacca mayā noktaṃ yasmiṃste karmasaṅgrahe buddhitarkeṇa tatsarvaṃ tathā veditumarhasi
prasādātte mahādeva śrutā me karmaṇāṃ gatiḥ
tatsarvaṃ nirviśaṃkā tvaṃ pṛccha māṃ śubhalakṣaṇe
kṛtvā tatpuruṣaḥ karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vetarat
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyeha kadā bhuṅkte phalaṃ punaḥ
iha vā pretya vā deva tanme śaṃsitumarhasi
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi taddhi guhyatamaṃ nṛṣu
pūrvadehakṛtaṃ karma bhuñjate tadiha prajāḥ ihaiva yatkṛtaṃ puṃsāṃ tatparatra phaliṣyatai
devānāmasurāṇāṃ ca amaratvāttapobalāt ekenaiva śarīreṇa bhujyate karmaṇāṃ phalam
loke grahakṛtaṃ sarvaṃ matvā karma śubhāśubham tadeva grahanakṣatraṃ prāyaśaḥ paryupāsate
eṣa me saṃśayo deva taṃ me tvaṃ chettumarhasi
mānavānāṃ mahābhāge na tu karmakarāḥ svayam
kintu tatra śubhaṃ karma sugrahaistu nivedyate
pṛthaggrahāḥ pṛthakkartā kartā svaṃ bhuñjate phalam
iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ viśaṅkāṃ jahi śobhane
bhagavanvividhaṃ karma kṛtvā jantuḥ śubhāśubham kiṃ tayoḥ pūrvakataraṃ bhuṅkte janmāntare punaḥ
eṣa me saṃśayo deva taṃ me tvaṃ chettumarhasi
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi tatte vakṣyāmi tatvataḥ aśubhaṃ pūrvamityāhurapare śubhamityapi
mithyā tadubhayaṃ proktaṃ kevalaṃ tadbravīmi te
mānuṣe tu pade karma yugapadbhujyate sadā
ṛddhiṃ hāniṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tatsarvamubhayaṃ bhayam
narake svargaloke ca na tathā saṃsthitiḥ priye
nityaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi narake svarge nityaṃ sukhaṃ tathā
nirantaraṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ svarge ca narake bhavet
tadahaṃ te pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu satyaṃ samāhitā
akarmayogyaṃ saṃśīrṇaṃ tyaktvā dehī tato vrajet
tathā dhāvati kālo'yaṃ kṣaṇaṃ kiñcinna tiṣṭhati
śṛṇu tatkāraṇaṃ devi nirṇayastveka eva saḥ

prakalpayecca manasā tatphalaṃ pretyabhāvataḥ karma dharmakṛtaṃ yacca satataṃ phalakāṅkṣayā etatkṛtaṃ vā dattaṃ vā paratra viphalaṃ bhavet
ityevaṃ mana āviśya dātavyaṃ satataṃ budhaiḥ
ajasraṃ dharmakāryaṃ ca tathā naimittikaṃ priye
sneho gandhaśca bhaiṣajyaṃ tilāśca lavaṇaṃ tathā
arcayīta prayatnena sa hi yajño varapradaḥ
kṛtvā tu pātakaṃ karma yo dadyādannamarthinām
putro yasya tu pautro vā śrotriyaṃ bhojayiṣyati
janmāpi mānuṣe loke tadarthaṃ hi vidhīyate
tatra te suciraṃ kālaṃ vihṛtyāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ
sarvakālaṃ ca sarvasya sarvatra ca sadaiva ca
api pāpakṛtaṃ krūraṃ dattaṃ rukmaṃ prakāśayet
dyutiṃ medhāṃ vapuḥ kīrtiṃ punarjāte labeddhruvam
nahi gobhyaḥ paraṃ dānaṃ vidyate jagati priye
saumyāḥ puṇyāḥ prāṇadāḥ kāmadāśca tasmātpūjyāḥ puṇyakāmairmanuṣyaiḥ
dhenuṃ dattvā nibhṛtāṃ suśīlāṃ kalyāṇavatsāṃ ca payasvinīṃ ca
yāvanti romāṇi bhavanti tasyāstāvatsamāḥ svargaphalāni bhuṅkte
prayacchate yaḥ kapilāṃ sacelāṃ sakāṃsyadohāṃ kanakāgryaśṛṅgīm
putrāśca pautrāṃśca kulaṃ ca sarvamāsaptamaṃ tārayate paratra ca
antarjātāḥ krītakā dyūtalabdhāḥ prāṇakrītāḥ sodakāścaujasā vā
samānavatsāṃ yo dhenuṃ dattvā gaurīṃ payasvinīm
yuvānaṃ balinaṃ śyāmaṃ śatena saha yūthapam
na cāsāṃ māṃsamaśnīyādgoṣu bhaktaḥ sadā bhavet
gāvaḥ pavitraṃ paramaṃ goṣu lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ
goṣu pūjā ca bhaktiśca narasyāyuṣyatāṃ vahet
grahītāramalaṅkṛtya vastrapuṣpānulopanaiḥ sabhṛtyaṃ saparīvāraṃ bhojayitvā yatheṣṭataḥ
vimuktaḥ kaluṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ śakalokaṃ sa gacchati
grāhayitvā nijāṃ bhūmiṃ na yānti yamasādanam
tathā bhūmeḥ kṛtaṃ dānaṃ sasyesasye vivardhate
vṛttyātīṃ yathā kṛtvā sadgṛhe tau niveśayet
evaṃ kṛtvā vadhūdānaṃ tasya dānasya gauravāt
vidyādānaṃ tathā devi pātrabhūtāya vai dadat
pretyabhāve labhenmartyo medhāṃ vṛddhiṃ dhṛtiṃ smṛtim
svayaṃ dattena tulyaṃ syāditi viddhi śubhānane
tvatpriyārthaṃ mayā devi bhūyaḥ śrotuṃ kimicchasi
tasya tasya phalaṃ brūhi dattasya ca kṛtasya ca
tilāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpaghnāḥ supuṇyā iti saṃsmṛtāḥ
nyāyatastu tilāñśuddhānsaṃhṛtyātha svaśaktinaḥ tilarāśiṃ punaḥ kuryātparvātābhaṃ surasnakam
suvarṇarajatābhyāṃ ca maṇimuktāpravālakaiḥ alaṅkṛtya yathāyogaṃ sapatākaṃ savedikam
kevalaṃ vā tilaireva bhūmau kṛtvā gavākṛtim savastrakaṃ saratnaṃ ca puṃsā godānakāṅkṣiṇā
rājapīḍāvimokṣaṃ tu chatrado labhate phalam dāsīdāsapradānāttu bhavetkarmāntabhāṅnaraḥ
yānāni vāhanaṃ caiva tadarhāya dadannaraḥ pādarogaparikleśānmuktaḥ śvasanavāhavān
varṣākāle tu rātrau vā labhetpakṣabalaṃ śubham
dīrghāyuṣyaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ tatā pretya gatiṃ śubhāṃ
sa ca puṇyaphalaṃ pretya labhate kṛcchramokṣaṇam
vedagoṣṭhāḥ śubhāḥ śālā bhikṣūṇāṃ ca pratiśrayam
yaḥ kuryāllabhate nityaṃ naraḥ pretya phalaṃ śubham
ramyaṃ taṃ daivagovāṭaṃ yaḥ kuryāllabhate naraḥ
pretya bhāve śubhāṃ jātiṃ vyādhimokṣaṃ tathaiva ca
kṛtaṃ dattaṃ yathā yāvattasya tallabhate phalam
pretyibhāve śṛṇu phalaṃ dattasya ca kṛtasya ca dānaṃ ṣaṅguṇayuktaṃ tu tadarhāya yathāvidhiḥ
rūpeṇa saptadhā bhūtvā mānuṣyaṃ phalati dhruvam
yaddattaṃ tattadeva syānna tu kiñcana labhyate
dhruvaṃ devyattame dānaṃ madhyame tvadhamaṃ phalam
devatānāṃ tu pūjā yā yajñeṣveva samāhitā
idaṃ tu sakalaṃ divyaṃ divi vā bhuvi vā priye
evaṃ vijñāya tatkartā sadāraḥ satataṃ dvijaḥ
tathā kṛteṣu yajñeṣu devānāṃ toṣaṇaṃ bhavet
tasmādyajvā divaṃ gatvā amaraiḥ saha modate
nāsti yajñasamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti yajñasamo nidhiḥ
devagoṣṭhe'dhisaṃskṛtya cotsavaṃ yaḥ karoti vai yāgāndevopahārāṃśca śucirbhūtvā yathāvidhi
kevalaiḥ stutibhirdevi gandhamālyasamāhitaiḥ prayataiḥ śuddhagātraistu śuddhadeśe supūjitāḥ
santoṣaṃ yānti te devā bhaktaiḥ sampūjitāstathā
evaṃ kṛtvā śubhākāṅkṣī paratreha ca modate anyathā mana āviśya kṛtaṃ na phalati priye
ṛte'pi tu mano devi aśubhaṃ phalati dhruvam
lokeṣu pitaraḥ pūjyā devatānāṃ ca devatāḥ
tasya deśāḥ kurukṣetraṃ gayā gaṅgā sarasvatī
prabhāsaṃ puṣkaraṃ ceti teṣu dattaṃ mahāphalam
tīrthāni saritaḥ puṇyā viviktāni vanāni ca
pūrvāhṇe śuklapakṣe ca rātrau janmadineṣu vā
yugmeṣvahassu ca śrāddhaṃ na ca kurvīta paṇḍitaḥ
eṣa kālo mayā proktaḥ pitṛmedhasya pūjitaḥ
yasmiṃśca brāhmṇaṃ pātraṃ paśyetkālaḥ sa ca smṛtaḥ
kutapaḥ khaṅgapātraṃ ca kuśā darbhāstilā madhu
saṃvatsaraṃ ca gavyena haviṣā pāyasena ca
tataḥ prastīrya darbhāṇāṃ prastaraṃ dakṣiṇāmukham tatsamīpe'gnimiddhvā ca svadhāṃ ca juhuyāttataḥ
etena vidhinā dattaṃ pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhavet tato viprānyathāśakti pūjayenniyataḥ śuciḥ
sadakṣiṇaṃ sasambhāraṃ yathā tuṣyanti te dvijāḥ
yatra tatkriyate tatra na jalpanna japenmithaḥ
niyamya vācyaṃ dehaṃ ca śrāddhakarma samārabhet
patnīṃ vā madhyamaṃ piṇḍaṃ putrakāmo hi prāśayet
śrāddhāni puṣṭikāmā vai ye prakurvanti paṇḍitāḥ
teṣāṃ puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ caiva dāsyanti pitaraḥ sadā
pitaraḥ svasti te tatra kathaṃ tiṣṭhanti devavat
pitṝṇāṃ katamo deśaḥ piṇḍānaśnanti vai katham
anne datte mṛtānāṃ tu kathamāpyāyanaṃ bhavet
babhūva sarvā muditā śrotuṃ hi paramaṃ hitam
sthāne saṃśayitaṃ devi śṛṇu kalyāṇi tatvataḥ
guhyānāṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ hitānāṃ paramaṃ hitam
yathā devagaṇā devi tathā pitṛgaṇāḥ priye
dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi śubhe sarve pitṛgaṇāḥ sthitāḥ
tena tuṣyanti pitaro na pretāḥ pitaraḥ smṛtāḥ
dvividhaṃ kriyate karma havyakavyasamāśritam tayorhavyakriyā devānkavyamāpyāyate pitṝn
āpyāyante ca te śrāddhaiḥ punarāpyāyayanti tān
aniṣṭā ca pitṝnpūrvaṃ yaḥ kriyāṃ prakaroti cet
rakṣāṃsi ca piśācāśca phalaṃ bhokṣyanti tasya tat
karmakṣetraṃ hi mānuṣyaṃ tadanyatra na vidyate
iti te kathitaṃ devi devaguhyaṃ sanātanam
yatsārastu naro loke taddānaṃ cottamaṃ smṛtam
prasthaṃ sāraṃ daridrasya śataṃ koṭidhanasya ca
śṛṇu dattasya vai devi pañcadhā phalakalpanām
ānantyaṃ ca mahaccaiva samaṃ hīnaṃ hi pātakam
teṣāṃ viśeṣaṃ vakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi samāhitā
dustyajasya ca vai dānaṃ pātra ānantyamucyate
yathāśraddhaṃ tu vai dānaṃ yathārhaṃ samamucyate
guṇatastu tathā hīnaṃ dānaṃ hīnamiti smṛtam
mahatastu tathā kālaṃ svargaloke tu pūjyate
samasya tu tadā dānaṃ mānuṣyaṃ bhogamāvahet
aśubhasyāpi dānasya śubhaṃ syācca phalaṃ katham
anyāni dharmakāryāṇi śṛṇu sadbhiḥ kṛtāni ca
govāṭaśca taṭākaśca sabhā śālā ca sarvaśaḥ
pretyabhāve labhetpuṇyaṃ nāsti tatra vicāraṇā rūpaṃ saubhāgyamārogyaṃ balaṃ saukhyaṃ labhennaraḥ
