ūṣmā sogniriti jñeyaḥ sonnaṃ pacati dehinām
prasīdati manaḥ kṣipraṃ prasanne dṛśyate param
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ svapnaḥ snehamatyaśanaṃ tathā
vaicityaṃ vyādhirālasyaṃ lobhaṃ ca daśamaṃ smṛtam
aṇimā mahimā caiva prāptiḥ prākāmyameva hi
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca yatra kāmāvasāyitā
arcayitvā yathāśakti svakaṃ deśaṃ viśanti te
sāyujyānāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca māmakaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ tathā
māṃ prāpya na nivartante viṣṇu vā śubhalocane
iti te kathito devi yogadharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
kathaṃ paricarantyete bhaktāstvāṃ parameṣṭhinam ācāraḥ kīdṛśasteṣāṃ kena tuṣṭo bhavedbhavān
yena te na nivartante yuktāḥ paramayoginaḥ
sāṅkhyayogau mayā sṛṣṭau sarvaṃ cāpi carācaram
na māṃ viduḥ suragaṇā munayaśca tapodhanāḥ
vyācakhye'haṃ tathā devi yogaṃ pāśupataṃ mahat
gṛhītaṃ tacca taiḥ sarvaṃ mukhācca mama dakṣiṇāt
śrutvā tattriṣu lokeṣu sthāpitaṃ cāpi taiḥ punaḥ
idānīṃ ca tvayā pṛṣṭo vadāmyekamanāḥ śṛṇu
ahaṃ pasupatirnāma madbhaktā ye ca mānavāḥ
rakṣārthaṃ maṅgalārthaṃ na pavitrārthaṃ ca bhāmini
liṅgārthaṃ caiva bhaktānāṃ bhasma dattaṃ mayā purā
sthāpitaṃ triṣu lokeṣu śivaliṅgaṃ mayā mama
sa cāpi labhate puṇyaṃ priyaṃ ca labhate naraḥ
gosavasya tu yajñasya yatphalaṃ tasya tadbhavet
yastu nānāvidhaiḥ puṣpairmama liṅgaṃ samarcayet sa hi dhenusahasrasya dattasya phalamāpnuyāt
phalaṃ vā yadi vā śākaṃ puṣpaṃ vā yadi vā jalam
svargaṃ kīrtiṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ sa labheta narottamaḥ
parāvarajñe dharmāṇāṃ tapovananivāsinām dīkṣāvidhidamopete satataṃ vratacāriṇi
pṛcchāmi tvāṃ varārohe pṛṣṭā vada mamepsitam
sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ patnī kauśikasya śacī śubhā
lakṣmīrviṣṇoḥ priyā bhāryā dhṛtirbhāryā yamasya tu
ayaṃ hi strīgaṇastvāṃ tu anuyāti na muñcati
tvayā coktaṃ viśeṣeṇa guṇabhūtaṃ hi tiṣṭhati
striya eva sadā loke strīgaṇasya gatiḥ priye
tvayaiṣa vidito hyarthaḥ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
tasmāttvāṃ prati pṛcchāmi pṛṣṭā vada mamepsitam
evamuktā tadā devī mahādevena śobhanā sodvegā ca salajjā ca nāvadattatra kiñcana
punaḥ punastadā devī devaḥ kimiti cābravīt
bhagavandevadeveśa surāsuranamaskṛta tvadantike mayā vaktuṃ strīṇāṃ dharmaḥ kathaṃ bhavet maheśvara uvāca
manniyogādavaśyaṃ tu vaktavyaṃ tu mama priye
vipāśāṃ ca vitastyāṃ ca candrabhāgāṃ sarasvatīm
śatadruṃ deviktāṃ sindhuṃ gautamīṃ kauśikīṃ tathā
tathā devanadīṃ gaṅgāṃ śreṣṭhāṃ tripathagāṃ śubhām sarvatīrthodakavahāṃ sarvapāpavināśinīm
tavaivārhati kalyāṇi evaṃ sāntvaprasādanam aśakyamapi ye mūrkhāḥ svātmasambhāvanāyutāḥ
tvaṃ hi śaktā satī devī vaktuṃ praśnamaśeṣataḥ
tvamevārhasi tadvaktuṃ strīṇāṃ vṛttaṃ śubhāśubham yācāmahe vayaṃ śrotumamṛtaṃ tvanmukhodgatam
bhagavandevadeveśa sureśvara maheśvara tvatprasādātsuraśreṣṭha tavaiva priyakāmyayā
evaṃ bruvantyāṃ strīdharmaṃ devyāṃ devasya śāsanāt
tāṃ tu kanyāṃ pitā mātā bhrātā mātula eva vā
dattā yasya bhavedbhāryā eteṣāṃ yena kena cit
yadā dattā bhavetkanyā tasmādbhāryārthine svakaiḥ tadāprabhṛti sā nārī daśarātraṃ vilajjayā
manasā karmaṇā vācā anukūlā ca sā bhavet
yadyadicchati vai bhartā dhramakāmārthakāraṇāt tathaivānupriyā bhūtvā tathaivopacaretpatim
daivataṃ satataṃ sādhvī bhartāraṃ yā tu paśyati
kasya cittvatha viprasya bhārye dve hi babhūvatuḥ
bhartāraṃ daivataṃ kṛtvā cakāra kila tatpriyam
evaṃ vivartamāne tu yugapanmaraṇe'dhvani gate kila mahādeva tatraikā yā pativratā
tāṃ yamo lokapālastu babhāṣe puṣkalaṃ vacaḥ
mā śucastvaṃ nivartasva na lokāḥ santi te'naghe
svadharmavimukhā sā tvaṃ tasmāllokā na santi te
moheni tvaṃ varārohe na jānīṣe svadaivatam
tasmāttvaṃ hi nivartasva kuru patyāśritaṃ hitam tadā gantāsi lokāṃstānyāngacchanti pativratāḥ
tathaiva kuryāttatsarvaṃ yathā patyuḥ priyaṃ bhavet
yathā bhartā tathā nārī gurūṇāṃ pratipadyate
āgataṃ tu patiṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā paricāraṇam
vihārakāle vai bharturjñātvā bhāvaṃ hṛdi sthitam
yasyāṃ kāmī bhavedbhartā tasyāḥ prītikarī bhavet
dāsīdāsabalīvardāṃścaṇḍālaṃ ca śunastathā anāthānkṛpaṇāṃścaiva bhikṣukāṃśca tathaiva ca
yatā sa tuṣṭaḥ svasthaśca tathā santoṣayetpatim
bahirālokanaṃ caiva mohaṃ vrīḍāṃ ca paiśunam
yatkiñcitpatinā dattaṃ labdhvā tatsā sukī bhavet
na ca bhoge na caiśvarye na sukhe na dhane tathā
spṛhā yasyāstathā bhartuḥ sā nārīṇāṃ pativratā
nānyaṃ gatimahaṃ paśye pramadāyā yathā patiḥ
jātiṣvapi ca vai strītvaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ me matiḥ prabho kāyakleśena mahatā puruṣaḥ prāpnuyātphalam
yathāsukhaṃ patimatī sarvaṃ patyanukūlataḥ īdṛśaṃ dharmasākalyaṃ paśya tvaṃ pramadāṃ prati
tapaścaryā ca dānaṃ ca patau tasyāḥ samarpitam
āḍhyaṃ vā rūpayuktaṃ vā virūpaṃ dhanavarjitam
yā patiṃ toṣayetsādhvī sā patnīnāṃ viśiṣyate
evaṃ pravartamānāyāḥ patiḥ pūrvaṃ mriyeta cet
etadevaṃ mayā proktaṃ striyastu bahudhā smṛtāḥ
yathā śubhaṃ pravakṣyāmi strīṇāṃ dharmaṃ maheśvara
svabuddhiniratā bhūtvā jīvanti ca yathā tathā
ghorā māṃsapriyā nityaṃ hasanti ca rudanti ca patīnvyabhicarantyeva durmārgeṇa yathā tathā
athavā bhartsitā deva nivṛttāḥ sveṣu karmasu
aparā mohasaṃyuktā nirlajjā rodanapriyāḥ aśuddhā maladigdhāṅgya pānamāṃsaratā bhṛśam
duṣpasādā mahākrodhāḥ svapnaśīlā nirantaram tāmasyo naṣṭatatvārthā mandaśīlā mahodarāḥ
kaṣṭaṃ tatrāpi bhuñjante svakṛtaṃ duḥkhajaṃ bahu daridrāḥ kleśabhūyiṣṭhā virūpāḥ kutsitāḥ paraiḥ
vrajetpatiṃ ca pāpena saṃyojya svakulaṃ tathā
avamatya ca yāḥ pūrvaṃ patiṃ duṣṭena cetasā
ūrdhvaṃ gacchati sā pūtā bhartrā'numaraṇaṃ gatā
evaṃ mṛtāyā vai lokānahaṃ paśyāmi cakṣuṣā
athavā bhartari mṛte vaidhavyaṃ dharmamāśritāḥ tūṣṇīṃ bhaumaṃ jale nityamañjalisnānamuttamam
vrataṃ ca patimuddiśya kuryaścaiva vidhiṃ tataḥ
iti te kathitaṃ deva strīṇāṃ dharmimanuttamam
tatastu devadeveśo devīṃ vacanamabravīt śṛṇu kalyāṇi madvākyaṃ saṃvādo'yaṃ mayā tava
puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ khyātaṃ ca bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ
saṃhartā caiva bhūtānāṃ sthāvarasya carasya ca
na tasmātparamaṃ bhūtaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiñcana
sanātano vai madhuhā govinda iti viśrutaḥ
sarvāḥ sukhaṃ saṃśritāśca śarīre tasya devatāḥ
uttamena sa śīlena damena ca śamena ca
aṅgo nāma manoḥ putro antardhāmā tataḥ paraḥ
vṛjinīvataśca bhavitā uṣaṅguraparājitaḥ uṣaṅgorbhavitā putraḥ śūraścitrarathastathā
tasya tvavarajaḥ putraḥ śūro nāma bhaviṣyati
sa śūraḥ kṣatriyaśreṣṭho mahāvīryo mahāyaśāḥ svavaṃśavistarakaraṃ janayiṣyati mānadaḥ
tasya putraścaturbāhurvāsudevo bhaviṣyati dātā brāhmaṇasatkartā brahmabhūto dvijapriyaḥ
yo hi māṃ draṣṭumiccheta brahmāṇaṃ ca pitāmaham
dṛṣṭe tasminnahaṃ dṛṣṭo na me'trāsti vicāraṇā
pitāmaho vā deveśa iti vitta tapodhanāḥ
yaśca taṃ mānave loke saṃśrayiṣyati keśavam
dharma eva paro hi syāttasminnabhyarcite vibhau
divi śreṣṭho hi bhagavānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ vandito hi sa vandeta mānito mānayīta ca
karmaṇā manasā vācā sa namasyo dvijaiḥ sadā
eṣa vo'bhihito mārgo mayā vai munisattamāḥ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvaśo devaṃ dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ surasattamāḥ
tatra ca tritayaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ
samastā hi vayaṃ devāstasya dehe vasāmahe
halī bala iti khyāto bhaviṣyati dharādharaḥ
samādiṣṭaśca vibudhairdarśaya tvamiti prabho suparṇo yasya vīryeṇa kaśyapasyātmajo balī
sa ca śeṣo vicarate parayā vai mudā yutaḥ
yo rāmaḥ sa hṛṣīkeśo yocyutaḥ sa dharādharaḥ
prāvṛṣīva ca parjanyo vavṛṣe nirmalaṃ payaḥ
vyabhraṃ ca gaganaṃ sadyaḥ kṣaṇena samapadyata
dṛṣṭvā ca vismitāḥ kṛṣṇa sā ca naḥ smṛtirāgatā
na hi naḥ sā rati svarge yā ca tvaddarśane vibho
na ca te'viditaṃ kiñcittriṣu lokeṣu vidyate
na hi kiñcittadāścaryaṃ yanna vetti bhavāniha
divi vā bhuvi vā deva sarvaṃ hi viditaṃ tava
pūrṇe ca daśame māsi putro'sya paramādbhutaḥ
rukmiṇyāṃ sammato jajñe śūro vaṃśadharaḥ prabho
pratiyoddhuṃ na śakyo hi mānuṣaireva saṃyuge
kaḥ śaknotyanyathā kartuṃ tadyadi syāttathā śṛṇu
na hi pratijñā yā dattā tāṃ prahātumariṃdama
vayaṃ ca kālena hatāḥ kālo hi parameśvaraḥ
na hi kālena kālajñaḥ spṛṣṭaḥ śocitumarhasi
vyāsasya vacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya ca dhīmataḥ
śṛṇuyātkathayedvā yaḥ sa śreyo labhate param
pretya svargaṃ ca labhate naro nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
te tvayā manasā dhāryāḥ kururāja divāniśam
yastasya vipulo daṇḍaḥ samyagdharmaḥ sa kīrtyate
saṃdeśo devapūjārthaṃ taṃ tathā kuru pāṇḍava
etadatyadbhutaṃ vṛttaṃ puṇye hi bhavati prabho
dhruvaṃ śreyaḥ paraṃ tāta bhaviṣyati tavottamam
yasya te puruṣavyāghraḥ sakhā cāyaṃ janārdanaḥ
duryodhanaṃ tu śocāmi pretya loke'pi durmatim
tūṣṇīṃ babhūva kauravyo madhye teṣāṃ mahātmanām
jñānasya ca parasyeha tanme brūhi pitāmaha
śravaṇaṃ tatkathānāṃ ca vidvatsaṃrakṣaṇaṃ tathā vidvacchuśrūṣaṇaprītirupadeśānupālanam
sa dhyānena japenanāśu mucyate prākṛtopi vā
paurāṇikotha vidvadbhiḥ kathitaḥ smārta eva ca
suvratā bandhuhīnaikā vane pūrvaṃ yamena tu
viprasya maraṇe hetustatpatnī pitṛśokadā vaiśyā tvamatilābho'yaṃ viprakanyeti sāmpratam
jātā viprakule samyak śreyaścāpi bravīhi me
kimekaṃ daivataṃ loke kiṃ vā'pyekaṃ parāyaṇam
ko dharmaḥ sarvadharmāṇāṃ bhavataḥ paramo mataḥ
paramaṃ yo mahattejaḥ paramaṃ yo mahattapaḥ
paramaṃ yo mahadbrahma paramaṃ yaḥ parāyaṇam
pavitrāṇāṃ pavitraṃ yo maṅgalānāṃ ca maṅgalam
daivataṃ devatānāṃ ca bhūtānāṃ yo'vyayaḥ pitā
amutāṃśūdbhavo bījaṃ śaktirdevakinandanaḥ trisāma hṛdayaṃ tasya śāntyarthe viniyujyate
pūtātmā paramātmā ca muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ
avyayaḥ puruṣaḥ sākṣī kṣetrajño'kṣara eva ca
īśānaḥ prāṇadaḥ prāṇo jyeṣṭhaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ prajāpatiḥ
īśvaro vikramī dhanvī medhāvī vikramaḥ kramaḥ
vedyo vaidyaḥ sadāyogī vīrahā mādhavo madhuḥ
subhujo durdharo vāgmī mahendro vasudo vasuḥ
iṣṭo viśiṣṭaḥ śiṣṭeṣṭa śikhaṇḍī nahuṣo vṛṣaḥ
karaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ kartā vikartā gahano guhaḥ
rāmo virāmo virajo mārgo neyo nayo'nayaḥ
vaikuṇṭhaḥ puruṣaḥ prāṇaḥ prāṇadaḥ praṇavaḥ pṛthuḥ
yajña ijyo mahejyaśca kratuḥ satraṃ satāṅgatiḥ
suvrataḥ sumukhaḥ sūkṣmaḥ sughoṣaḥ sukhadaḥ suhṛt
trisāmā sāmagaḥ sāma nirvāṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhiṣak
eko naikaḥ savaḥ kaḥ kiṃ yattatpadamanuttamam
śaṅkhabhṛnnandakī cakrī śārṅgadhanvā gadādharaḥ rathāṅgapāṇirakṣobhyaḥ sarvapraharaṇāyudhaḥ
na bhayaṃ kvacidāpnoti vīryaṃ tejaśca vindati
na krodho na ca mātsaryaṃ na lobho nāśubhā matiḥ
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ satvaṃ tejo balaṃ dhṛtiḥ
yogo jñānaṃ tathā sāṅkhyaṃ vidyāḥ śilpādikarma ca
paṭhedya icchetpuruṣaḥ śreyaḥ prāptuṃ sukhāni ca
viśveśvaramajaṃ devaṃ jagataḥ prabhavāpyayam bhajanti ye puṣkarākṣaṃ na te yānti parābhavam
na te yānti parābhavam oṃ nama iti
yo māṃ nāmasahasreṇa stotumicchati pāṇḍava sohamekena ślokena stuta eva na saṃśayaḥ
stuta eva na saṃśaya oṃ nama iti
sahasranāmne puruṣāya śāśvate sahasrakoṭiyugadhāriṇe namaḥ śrīsahasrakoṭiyugadhāriṇe nama iti
kiṃ japyaṃ japato nityaṃ bhaveddharmaphalaṃ mahat
prasthāne vā praveśe vā pravṛtte vā'pi karmaṇi
daive vā śrāddhakāle vā kiṃ japyaṃ karmasādhanam
puruṣastu susiddhārthaḥ pretya ceha ca modate
namo vasiṣṭhāya mahāvratāya parāśaraṃ vedanidhaiṃ namaste
namostvṛṣibhyaḥ paramaṃ pareṣāṃ deveṣu devaṃ varadaṃ varāṇām
api yajñasya vettāro dattasya sukṛtasya ca
viśvedevāḥ pitṛgaṇā mūrtimantastapodhanāḥ munayaścaiva siddhāśca tapomokṣaparāyaṇāḥ
pṛthivyāṃ tapasā siddhāḥ sthāvarāśca carāsca ha
bhuvi kṛtvā śubhaṃ karma modante divi daivataiḥ
yasyāṃyasyāṃ diśi hyete tanmukhaḥ śaraṇaṃ vrajet
aputro labhate putraṃ daridro labhate dhanam
tathā dharmārthakāmeṣu siddhiṃ ca labhate naraḥ
gavāmayena yajñena yeneṣṭaṃ vai kṛte yuge
sāṅkhyaṃ yogaṃ ca paramaṃ havyaṃ kavyaṃ tathaiva ca
ete vai yānti varṣanti bhānti vānti sṛjanti ca
ete vināyakāḥ śreṣṭhā dakṣāḥ kṣāntā jitendriyāḥ
vāstumadhye tu paṭhataḥ kule svastyayanaṃ bhavet
kṣetramadhye tu paṭhataḥ sarvaṃ sasyaṃ prarohati
ātmanaśca sutānāṃ ca dārāṇāṃ ca dhanasya ca
vrajanti ripavo nāśaṃ kṣemaṃ ca parivartate
etāndaive ca pitrye ca paṭhataḥ puruṣasya hi
bhuñjate pitaraḥ kavyaṃ havyaṃ ca tridivaukasaḥ
na vyādhiśvāpadabhayaṃ na dvipānna hi taskarāt
kaśmalaṃ laghutāṃ yāti pāpmanā ca pramucyate
yānapātre ca yāne ca pravāse rājaveśmani
na ca rājabhayaṃ teṣāṃ na piśācānna rākṣasāt
na tatra bālo mriyate na ca tiṣṭhanti pannagāḥ
na teṣāṃ vidyate duḥkhaṃ gacchanti paramāṃ gatim
gavāṃ madhye tu paṭhato gāvo'sya bahuvatsalāḥ
prasthāne vā pravāse vā sarvāvasthāṃ gataḥ paṭhet
japatāṃ juhvatāṃ caiva nityaṃ ca prayatātmanām
paṭhanti śucayo nityaṃ sāvitrīṃ prāṇināṃ gatiṃ
abhyāse nityaṃ devānāṃ saptarṣīṇāṃ dhruvasya ca
bhāradvājamataṃ ṛcīkatanayaiḥ prāptaṃ vasiṣṭhātpunaḥ sāvitrīmadhigamya śakravasubhiḥ kṛtsnā jitā dānavāḥ
yo gośataṃ kanakaśṛṅgamayaṃ dadāti viprāya vedaviduṣe ca bahuśrutāya
divyāṃ ca bhāratakathāṃ kathayecca nityaṃ tulyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati tasya ca tasya caiva
dharmo vivardhati bhṛgoḥ parikīrtanena vīryaṃ vivardhati pasiṣṭhanamonatena
saṅgrāmajidbhavati caiva raghuṃ namasyansyādaśvinau ca parikīrtayato na rogaḥ
ke pūjyāḥ ke namaskāryā kathaṃ varteta keṣu ca
tapo yeṣāṃ dhanaṃ nityaṃ vākcaiva vipulaṃ balam
dhuri ye nāvasīdanti viṣame saddhayā iva
samaṃ yeṣāṃ dukūlaṃ ca śāṇakṣaumājināni ca
devānāmapi ye devāḥ kāraṇaṃ kāraṇasya ca
avidvānbrāhmaṇo devaḥ pātraṃ vai pāvanaṃ mahat
śmaśāne hyapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati
sarvathā brāhmaṇo mānyo daivataṃ viddhi tatparam
kāṃ tu brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā janādhipa
kaṃ vā dharmodayaṃ matvā tānarcasi mahāmate
svavittaṃ tena dattaṃ tu dattātreyāya karmaṇe
mama bāhusahasraṃ tu paśyantāṃ sainikā raṇe
caturthaṃ tu varaṃ yāce tvāmahaṃ dvijasattama
ityuktaḥ sa dvijaḥ prāha tathāstviti narādhipam
na tvaṃ mūḍha vijānīṣe brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatriyādvaram
sahito brāhmaṇeneha kṣatriyaḥ śāsti vai prajāḥ
kuryāṃ bhūtāni tuṣṭo'haṃ kruddho nāśaṃ tathā naye
karmṇā manasā vācā na mattosti varo dvijaḥ
brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśritāḥ kṣatraṃ na kṣatraṃ brāhmaṇāśritam
na ca māṃ cyāvayedrāṣṭrāttriṣu lokeṣu kaścana
devo vā mānuṣo vā'pi tasmājjyeṣye dvijānaham
atha ca tvāṃ mahīpāla śamayiṣyanti vai dvijāḥ
taṃ rājā kastvamityāha tatastaṃ prāha mārutaḥ
yādṛśaṃ pṛthivībhūtaṃ tādṛśaṃ brūhi me dvijam
apāṃ vai sadṛśaṃ vahneḥ sūryasya nabhaso'pi vā
ye tvayā kīrtitā rājaṃstebhyo'tha brāhmaṇo varaḥ
tyaktvā mahītvaṃ bhūmistu spardhayā kāśyapasya ha
nāśaṃ jagāma tāṃ vipro vyastamyayata kaśyapaḥ
akṣayā brāhmaṇā rājandivi ceha ca nityadā
tasminnahaṃ ca kruddhe vai jagattyaktvā tato bhayāt
ahalyāṃ kāmayāno vai dharmārthaṃ ca na hiṃsitaḥ
tathā samudro nṛpate pūrṇo dṛṣṭaśca vāriṇā
tvayā ca vipulaṃ rājyaṃ balaṃ dharmaṃ śrutaṃ tathā
sa hi sarvasya lokasya havyavāṭ kiṃ na vetsi tam
yenedaṃ vipulaṃ viśvaṃ janitaṃ sthāvaraṃ caram
dṛṣṭavānetadevaṃ hi kathaṃ jāyedajo hi saḥ
nāstyantamasti tu brahmā sa rājā lokabhāvanaḥ
imāṃ bhūmiṃ dvijātibhyo ditsurvai dakṣiṇāṃ purā
aṅgo nāma nṛpo rājaṃstataścintāṃ mahī yayau
kathamicchati māṃ dātuṃ dvijebhyo brahmaṇaḥ sutām
sāhaṃ tyaktvā gamiṣyāmi bhūmitvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ padam
tatastāṃ kaśyapo dṛṣṭvā vrajantīṃ pṛthivīṃ tadā
pṛthavī kāśyapī jajñe sutā tasya mahātmanaḥ
anyaṃ prabrūhi vā tvaṃ ca kaśyapātkṣatriyaṃ varam
bhadrā somasya duhitā rūpeṇa paramā matā
sā ca tīvraṃ tapastepe mahābhāgā yaśasvinī
sa cāgamya vanaprasthaṃ yamunāyāṃ jahāra tām
provāca gaccha brūhi tvaṃ varuṇaṃ paruṣaṃ vacaḥ
somena dattā bhāryā me tvayā cāpahṛtā'dya vai
iti śrutvā vacastasya so'tha taṃ varuṇo'bravīt
mamaiṣā supriyā bhāryā naināmutsraṣṭumutsahe ityukto varuṇenātha nāradaḥ prāpya taṃ munim
na prayacchati te bhāryāṃ yatte kāryaṃ kuruṣva tat
adṛśyā gaccha bhīru tvaṃ sarasvati marūnprati
tataḥ sa labdhvā tāṃ bhāryāṃ varuṇaṃ prāha dharmavit
yajñāścaiṣāṃ hṛtāḥ sarve pitṝṇāṃ ca svadhāstathā
abhivādya tu taṃ devāḥ pṛṣṭvā kuśalameva ca
ubhau lokau parityajya gatāḥ kāṣṭhāṃ tu dakṣiṇām
ityuktaḥ prāha devānsa na śaktosmi mahīgatān
dagdhuṃ tapo hi kṣīyenme na dhakṣyāmīti pārthiva
evaṃ dagdhā bhagavatā dānavāḥ svena tejasā
vaikhānasavidhānena gaṅgātīraṃ samāśritāḥ ādityāḥ satramāsanta saro vaikhānasaṃ prati
vasiṣṭhaṃ manasā gatvā jñātvā tatvasya gocaram
hatā hatā vai tatraite jīvantyāplutya dānavāḥ
sa ca tairvyathitaḥ śakro vasiṣṭhaṃ saraṇaṃ yayau
kailāsaṃ prasthitāṃ caiva nadīṃ gaṅgāṃ mahātapāḥ
ānayattatsaro divyaṃ tayā bhinnaṃ ca tatsaraḥ
saro bhinnaṃ tayā nadyā sarayūḥ sā tato'bhavat
hatāśca balino yatra sa deśe balino'bhavat
bravīmyanyaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ vasiṣṭhātkṣatriyaṃ varam
atha te tamasā grastā nihanyante sma dānavaiḥ
nādhigacchāma śāntiṃ ca bhayāttrāyasva naḥ prabho
timiraghnaśca savitā dasyuhantā ca no bhava
dṛṣṭvā nātiprabhaṃ somaṃ tathā sūryaṃ ca pārthiva
atriṇā dahyamānāṃstāndṛṣṭvā devā mahāsurān parākramaiste'piṃ tadā vyaghnannatrisurakṣitāḥ
phalabhakṣeṇa rājarṣe paśya karmātriṇā kṛtam tasyāpi vistareṇoktaṃ karmātreḥ sumahātmanaḥ
bravīmyanyaṃ brūhi vā tvamatritaḥ kṣatriyaṃ varam
aśvibhyāṃ saha necchāmaḥ somaṃ pātuṃ mahāvrata
kriyatāṃ madvaco devā yathā vai samudāhṛtam
aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ vai na pāsyāmi dvijottama
mayā pramathitaḥ sadyaḥ somaṃ pāsyasi vai makhe
te sammantrya tato devā madasyāsya samīpagāḥ
aśvibhyāṃ saha somaṃ ca pibāma vigatajvarāḥ
tataḥ sa praṇataḥ śakraścakāra cyavanasya tat
akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān
bravīmyanyaṃ brūhi vā tvaṃ kṣatriyaṃ brāhmaṇādvaram
śṛṇu me brāhmaṇeṣveva mukhyaṃ karma janādhipa
ubhau lokau hṛtau matvā te devā duḥkhitā'bhavan
cyavanena hṛtā bhūmiḥ kapaiścaiva divaṃ prabho
tacchrutvā preṣito dūto brāhmaṇebhyo dhanī kapaiḥ
sa ca tānbrāhmaṇānāha dhanī kapavaco yathā
bhavadbhiḥ sadṛśaḥ sarve kapāḥ kimiha vartate
sarve vedavidaḥ prājñāḥ sarve ca kratuyājinaḥ
śrīścaiva ramate teṣu dhārayanti śriyaṃ ca te
vṛthā dārānna gacchanti vṛthā māṃsaṃ na bhuñjate
dīptamagniṃ juhvate ca gurūṇāṃ vacane sthitāḥ
sarve ca niyatātmāno bālānāṃ saṃvibhāginaḥ upetya śanakairyānti na sevanti rajasvalām
pūrvāhṇeṣu na dīvyanti divā caiva na śerate
vijeṣyatha nivartadhvaṃ nivṛttānāṃ sukhaṃ hi vaḥ
kapānvayaṃ vijeṣyāmo ye devāste vayaṃ smṛtāḥ
dhanī gatvā kapānāha na vo viprāḥ priyaṅkarāḥ
hatvā vai dānavāndevāḥ sarve sambhūya saṃyuge
nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā prītāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ
teṣāṃ tejastathā vīryaṃ devānāṃ vavṛdhe tataḥ
tvayā proktāni kārtsnyena śrutāni prayatena ca
kaṃ tu dharmodayaṃ dṛṣṭvā tānarcasi janādhipa
kāṃ vā brāhmaṇapūjāyāṃ vyuṣṭiṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāvrata
balaṃ śrotre vāṅmanaścakṣuṣī ca jñānaṃ tathā naviśuddhaṃ mamādya
dehanyāso nāticirānmato me na cātitūrṇaṃ savitā'dya yāti
uktā dharmā ye purāṇe mahānto rājanviprāṇāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśāṃ ca
yeye śūdrāṇāṃ dharmamupāsate te tāneva kṛṣṇadupaśikṣasva pārthaḥ
ahaṃ hyenaṃ vedmi tattvena kṛṣṇaṃ yo'yaṃ hi yaccāsya balaṃ purāṇam
ameyātmā keśavaḥ kauravendra soyaṃ dharmaṃ vakṣyati sarvametat
kṛṣṇaḥ pṛthvīmasṛjatsvaṃ divaṃ ca kṛṣṇasyi dehānmedinī sambabhūva
varāho'yaṃ bhīmabalaḥ purāṇaḥ sa parvatānvyasṛjadvai diśaśca
asya nābhyāṃ puṣkaraṃ samprasūtaṃ yatrotpannaḥ svayamevāmitaujāḥ
yenācchinnaṃ tattamaḥ pārtha ghoraṃ yatra tiṣṭhantyarṇavāstacchayānāḥ
balaṃ tvāsīddvāpare pārtha kṛṣṇaḥ kalau tvadharmaḥ kṣitimevājagāma
sa eva pūrvaṃ nijaghāna daityānsa eva devaśca babhūva samrāṭ
sa bhūtānāṃ bhāvano bhūtabhavyaḥ sa viśvasyāsya jagataścābhigoptāḥ
yadā dharmo glāti vaṃśe surāṇāṃ tadā kṛṣṇo jāyate mānuṣeṣu
dharme sthitvā sa tu vai bhāvitātmā parāṃśca lokānaparāśca pāti
tyājyāṃstyaktvā cāsurāṇāṃ vadhena kāryākārye kāraṇaṃ caiva pāti
kṛtaṃ kariṣyatkriyate ca devo rāhuṃ somaṃ viddhi ca śakramenam
sa viśvakarmā sa hi viśvarūpaḥ sa viśvabugviśvasṛgviśvajicca
taṃ gandharvāṇāmapsarasāṃ ca nityamupatiṣṭhante vibudhānāṃ śatāni
taṃ rākṣasāśca parisaṃvadanti rājanyānāṃ sa vijigīṣurekaḥ
tamadhvare śaṃsitāraḥ stuvanti rathantare sāmagāśca stuvanti
taṃ brāhmaṇā brahmamantraiḥ stuvanti tasmai haviradhvaryavaḥ kalpayanti
sa paurāṇīṃ brahmaguhāṃ praviṣṭo mahīsatraṃ bhāratāgre dadarśa
taṃ ghoṣārthe gīrbhirindrāḥ stuvanti sa cāpīśo bhārataikaḥ paśūnām
tasyāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivī divaṃ ca sarvaṃ vaśe tiṣṭhati śāśvatasya
sa kumbhe retaḥ sasṛje surāṇāṃ yatrotpannamṛṣimāhurvasiṣṭham
sa mātariśvā vibhuraśvavājī sa raśmivānsavitā cādidevaḥ
tenāsurā vijitāḥ sarva eva tadvikrāntairvijitānīha trīṇi
sa devānāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ tamevāhuryajñavidāṃ vitānam
sa eva kālaṃ vibhajannudeti tasyottaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cāyane dve
taṃ brāhmaṇā vedavido juṣanti tasyādityo gāmupayujya bhāti
sa evoktaścakramidaṃ trinābhi saptāśvayuktaṃ vahate vai tridhāmā
mahātejāḥ sarvagaḥ sarvasiṃhaḥ kṛṣṇo lokāndhārayate yathaikaḥ haṃsaṃ tamoghnaṃ ca tameva vīra kṛṣṇaṃ sadā pārtha kartāramehi
sa ekadā kakṣagato mahātmā tuṣṭo vibhuḥ khāṇḍave dhūmaketuḥ
sa eva pārthāya śvetamaśvaṃ prāyacchatsa evāśvānatha sarvāṃścakāra
sa vihāyo vyadadhātpañcanābhiḥ sa nirmame gāṃ divamantarikṣam
alaṅghayadvai sarito jighāṃsañśakraṃ vajraṃ praharantaṃ nirāsa
sa mahendraḥ stūyate vai mahādhvare vipraireko ṛksahasraiḥ purāṇaiḥ
durvāsā vai tena nānyena śakyo gṛhe rājanvāsayituṃ mahaujāḥ
vedāṃśca yo vedayate'dhidevo vidhīṃśca yaścāśrayate purāṇān
kāme vede laukike yatphalaṃ ca viṣvaksenaḥ sarvametatpratīhi
jyotīṃṣi śuklāni hi sarvaloke trayo lokā lokapālāstrayaśca
trayo'grayo vyāhṛtayaśca tisraḥ sarve devā devakīputra eva
sa ktsaraḥ sa ṛtuḥ so'rdhamāsaḥ so'horātraḥ sa kalā vai sa kāṣṭhāḥ
mātrā muhūrtāśca lavāḥ kṣaṇāśca viṣvaksenaḥ sarvametatpratīhi
rudrādityā vasavo'thāśvinau ca sādhyāśca viśve marutāṃ gaṇāśca
vāyurbhūtvā vikṣipate ca viśvamagnirbhūtvā dahate viśvarūpaḥ
āpo bhūtvā majjayate ca sarvaṃ brahma bhūtvā sṛjate viśvasaṅghān
vedyaṃ ca yadvedayate ca vedyaṃ vidhiśca yaśca śrayate vidheyam
dharme ca vede ca bale ca sarvaṃ carācaraṃ keśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi
sarvaṃ kṛṣṇātsthāvaraṃ jaṅgaṃ ca viśvātmānaṃ viṣṇumenaṃ pratīhi
viśvāvāsaṃ nirguṇaṃ vāsudevaṃ saṅkarṣaṇaṃ jīvabhūtaṃ vadanti
tataścakārāvanimārutau ca khaṃ jyotirambhaści tathaiva pārtha
sa sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caivametaccaturvidhaṃ lokamimaṃ ca kṛtvā
tato devānasurānmānavāṃśca lokānṛṣīṃścāpi pitṝnprajāśca samāseni vividhānpāti lokānsarvānsadā bhūtapatiḥ sisṛkṣuḥ
yadvartate yacca bhaviṣyatīha sarvaṃ hyetatkeśavaṃ tvaṃ pratīhi
bhūtaṃ ca yacceha na vidma kiñcidviṣvaksenātsarvametatpratīhi
yatpraśastaṃ ca lokeṣu puṇyaṃ yacca śubhāśubham
vettā tvamasya cārthasya veda tvāṃ hi pitāmahaḥ
sadā dvijātīnsampūjya kiṃ phalaṃ tatra mānada
sa svairaṃ carate lokānye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ
paribhāṣāṃ ca me śrutvā ko nu dadyātpratiśrayam
yo māṃ kaścidvāsayīta na sa māṃ kopayediti
tadaiva tu mayā tasya cittajñena gṛhe janaḥ
taṃ bhuktvaiva sa tu kṣipraṃ tato vacanamabravīt
kṣipramaṅgāni limpasva pāyaseneti sa sma ha
sa dadarśa tadā'bhyāśe mātaraṃ te śubhānanām
tamārudya rathaṃ caiva niryayau sa gṛhānmama
na ca me stokamapyāsīdduḥ khamīrṣyākṛtaṃ tadā
tathā sa rājamārgeṇi mahatā niryayau bahiḥ
tato vilokya tejasvī brāhmaṇo māmuvāca ha
prasannasya ca me tāta paśya vyuṣṭiṃ yathāvidhām
yathaivānne tathā teṣāṃ tvayi bhāvo bhaviṣyati
yāvacca puṇyā lokeṣu tvayi kīrtirbhaviṣyati triṣu lokeṣu tāvacca vaiśiṣṭyaṃ pratipatsyase
yatte bhinnaṃ ca dagdhaṃ ca yacca kiñcidvināśitam
na tu pādatale lipte tasmātte mṛtyuratra vai
na tvāṃ jarā vā rogo vā vaivarṇyaṃ cāpi bhāmini
variṣṭhā ca salokyā ca keśavasya bhaviṣyasi
etadvratamahaṃ kṛtvā mātrā te saha putraka
yadbhinnaṃ yacca vai dagdhaṃ tena vipreṇa putraka
tato'haṃ vismayaṃ prāptaḥ sarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā navaṃ dṛḍham
apūjayaṃ ca manasā raukmiṇeya sadā dvijān
mahābhāgyaṃ ca yattasya nāmāni ca mahātmanaḥ
śivaḥ sarvakato rudraḥ sraṣṭā yastvaṃ śṛṇuṣva me prajāpatistamasṛjattamaso'nte mahātapāḥ
iha triṣvapi lokeṣu bhūtānāṃ prabhavo hi saḥ
na hi bhūtaṃ samaṃ tena triṣu lokeṣu vidyate
gandhenāpi hi saṅgrāme tasya kruddhasya śatravaḥ
visaṃjñā hatabhūyiṣṭhā vepanete ca patanti ca
ghoraṃ ca ninadaṃ tasya parjanyaninadopam śrutvā viśīryeddhṛdayaṃ devānāmapi saṃyuge
na surā nāsurā loke na gandharvā na pannagāḥ
te na śarma kutaḥ śānti viṣādaṃ lebhire surāḥ
viddhe ca sahasā yajñe kupite ca maheśvare
andhena tamasā lokāḥ prāvṛtā na cakāśire
pranaṣṭā jyotiṣāṃ bhāśca saha sūryeṇa bhārata
bhṛśaṃ bhītāstataḥ śāntiṃ catruḥ svastyayanāni ca
punaśca sandadhe rudro dīptaṃ suniśitaṃ śaram
rudrasya vikramaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītā devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ
rudrasya bhāgaṃ yajñe ca viśiṣṭaṃ te tvakalpayan
tena caiva hi tuṣṭena sa yajñaḥ sandhito'bhavat
śalyamagniṃ tathā kṛtvā puṅkhaṃ vaivasvataṃ yamam
oṅkāraṃ ca dhanuḥ sarvāñjyāṃ ca sāvitrimuttamāṃ
brahmāṇaṃ sārathiṃ kṛtvā viniyujya ca sarvaśaḥ
triparvaṇā triśalyena tena tāni bibheda saḥ
taṃ caivāṅkagataṃ dṛṣṭvā bālaṃ pañcaśikhaṃ punaḥ
ayaṃ śreṣṭha iti jñātvā vavande tamumāpatim
tataḥ prasādayāmāsurumāṃ rudraṃ ca te surāḥ
babhūva sa tadā bālaḥ prayayau tu yathāpuram
sa cāpi brāhmaṇo bhūtvā durvāsā nāma vīryavān
sa vai rudraḥ sa ca śivaḥ sogniḥ sarvaḥ sa sarvajit
sa caivendraśca vāyuśca so'svinau sa ca vidyutaḥ
sa candramāḥ sa ceśānaḥ sa sūryo varuṇaśca saḥ
sa kālaḥ sontako mṛtyuḥ sa yamo rātryahāni ca
sadhātā sa vidhātā ca viśvakarmā sa sarvavit
ekadhā ca dvidhā caiva bahudhā ca sa eva hi
na hi śakyā guṇā vaktumapi varṣaśatairapi
ekākṣaṃ tryambakaṃ caiva viśvarūpaṃ śivaṃ tathā
dve tanū tasya devasya vedajñā brāhmaṇā viduḥ
ghorāmanyāṃ śivāmanyāṃ te tanū bahudhā punaḥ
śivā saumyā ca yā tvasya dharmastvāpotha candramāḥ
dahatyūdhvaṃ sthito yacca prāṇānnṝṇāṃ sthiraśca yat
yadasya bahudhā rūpaṃ bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhavattathā
viśvedevāśca yattasminviśvarūpastataḥ smṛtaḥ sahasrākṣo'yutākṣo vā sarvatokṣimayopi vā
nityena brahmacaryeṇa liṅgamasya yadā sthitam bhaktānugrahaṇārthāya gūḍhaliṅgastataḥ smṛtaḥ
vigrahaṃ pūjayedyo vai liṅgaṃ vā'pi mahātmanaḥ
ṛṣayaścāpi devāśca gandharvāpsarasastathā liṅgamevārcayanti sma yattadūrdhvaṃ samāsthitam
eṣa eva śmaśāneṣu devo vasati nirdahan
sa ca vāyuḥ śarīreṣu prāṇapālaḥ śarīriṇām
tasya ghorāṇi rūpāṇi dīptāni ca bahuni ca
sa dadāti manuṣyebhyaḥ sa evākṣipate punaḥ
sa eva sthāpako nityaṃ trailokyasya śubhāśubhe
maheśvaraśca lokānāṃ mahātāmīśvaraśca saḥ bahubhirvividhai rūpairviśvaṃ vyāptamidaṃ jagat
pratyakṣamāgamo veti kiṃ tayoḥ kāraṇaṃ bhavet
nāstyatri saṃśayaḥ kaściditi me vartate matiḥ
śṛṇu vakṣyāmi te prājña samyaktvaṃ me'nupṛcchasi
jyotiḥ sarvasya lokasya vipulaṃ pratipadyate na tveva gamanaṃ rājanhetuto gamanaṃ tathā
dharma ityeva sambuddhastānupāssva ca pṛccha ca
na teṣāṃ bhidyate vṛttaṃ yajñāḥ svādhyāyakarma ca
punareva hi me buddhi saṃśaye parimuhyati
eka eveti jānīhi tridhā dharmasya darśanam
pṛthaktve ca na me buddhistrayāṇāmapi vai tathā
jijñāsā na tu kartavyā dharmasya paritarkaṇāt
sadaiva bharataśreṣṭha mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ
ahiṃsā satyamakrodho dānametaccatuṣṭayam ajātaśatro sevasya dharma eṣa sanātanaḥ ]
na sa pramāṇatāmarho viṣādajanano hi saḥ
eteṣveva tvime lokāḥ kṛtsnā iti nibodha tān
ye ca dharmamasūyante ye cainaṃ paryupāsate
bravītu me bhavānetatkva te gacchanti tādṛśāḥ
ye tu dharmaṃ mahārāja satataṃ paryupāsate
manuṣyā yadi vā devāḥ śarīramupatāpya vai
asādhoḥ kīdṛśaṃ śīlaṃ sādhoścaiva tu kīdṛśam
rājamārge gavāṃ madhye janamadhye ca dharmiṇaḥ
na jalpanti ca bhuñjānā na nidrāntyārdrapāṇayaḥ
brāhmaṇaṃ dhārmikaṃ vṛddhaṃ ye kurvanti pradakṣiṇam
brāhmaṇānāṃ gavāṃ rājñāṃ panthānaṃ dadate ca ye
atithīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ preṣyāṇāṃ svajanasya ca
bahulā nāma gaustena gatimagryāṃ gatā kila
vimucya pītavatsāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā smṛtvā purātanam
tathā śaraṇakāmānāṃ goptā syātsvāgatapradaḥ sāyaṃ prātarmanuṣyāṇāmaśanaṃ devanirmitam
nāntarā bhojanaṃ dṛṣṭamupavāsavidhirhi saḥ homakāle yathā vahniḥ kāle homaṃ pratīkṣate
nānyadā gacchate yastu brahmacaryaṃ ca tatsmṛtam
karma vai saphalaṃ kṛtvā guruṇāṃ pratipādayet
darśanānāṃ paraṃ jñānaṃ santoṣaḥ paramaṃ sukham
saṃskṛtaṃ pāyasaṃ nityaṃ yāvakaṃ kṛsaraṃ haviḥ
na jātu tvamiti brūyādāpannopi mahṛttaram tvaṃkāro vā vadho veti vidvatsu na viśiṣyate
na māṃ manuṣyāḥ paśyanti na māṃ paśyanti devatāḥ
taddharmasādhanaṃ nityaṃ saṅkalpāddhanamārjayet mananaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ dharmamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ
tasmātsarvāṇi bhūtāni dharmameva samāsate eka eva careddharmaṃ na dharmadhvajiko bhavet
dharmavāṇijakā hyete ye dharmamupabhuñjate arceddevānadambhena sevetā'māyayā gurūn
yadi yatno bhavenmartyaḥ sa sarvaṃ phalamāpnuyāt
yathā pipāsāṃ jayati puruṣaḥ prāpya vai jalam
iṣṭārtho vidyayā hyeva na vidyāṃ prajahennaraḥ
bhāvaśuddhistu tapasā devatānāṃ ca mūjayā sanātanena śuddhyā ca śrutadānajapairapi
kāryāvetau hi dharmoṇi dharmo hi vijayāvahaḥ
na tu kaścinnayetprājño gṛhītvaiva kare naram ūhyamānastu dharmeṇa prāpnuyātparamacyutam
lokadharme ca dharme ca viśeṣakaraṇaṃ kṛtam
adhruvo hi kathaṃ lokaḥ smṛto dharmaḥ kathaṃ dhruvaḥ
yatra kālo dhruvastāta tatra dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
kālo dharmeṇa saṃyuktaḥ śeṣa eva svayaṃ guruḥ
evaṃ sati na doṣo'sti bhūtānāṃ dharmasevane
tiryagyonāvapi satāṃ loka eva mato guruḥ
vipāpmā sa bhavetkena kiṃ vā kalmaṣanāśanam
nāndho na badhiraḥ kāle kurute svastimānsadā
tiryagyoniṃ na gacchecca narakaṃ saṅkarāṇi ca
na ca duḥkhamayaṃ tasya maraṇe sa na muhyati
varuṇaḥ saha gauryā ca saha ṛddhyā dhaneśvaraḥ
viśvācī ca ghṛtācī ca pañcacūḍā tilottamā
ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sāśvinaḥ pitaropi ca
dharmaḥ śrutaṃ tapo dīkṣā vyavasāyaḥ pitāmahaḥ
sindhuśca devikā caiva prabhāsaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca
gaṅgā mahānadī veṇā kāverī narmadā tathā
godāvarī ca veṇyā ca kṛṣṇaveṇā tathā'drijā
prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca puṇyaṃ naimiṣameva ca
hiraṇvatī vitastā ca tathā plakṣavatī nadī
carmaṇvatī nadī puṇyā kauśikī yamunā tathā
nadī bhīmarathī caiva bāhudā ca mahānadī
pāntu naḥ satataṃ devāḥ kīrtitā'kīrtitā mayā
paścimāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān
atreḥ putraśca dharmātmā tathā sārasvataḥ prabhuḥ uttarāṃ diśamāśritya ya edhante nibodha tān
devaśarmā ca dhaumyaśca hastikāśyapa eva ca
mā vighnaṃ mā ca me pāpaṃ mā ca me paripanthinaḥ
dhruvo jayo me nityaḥ syātparatra ca śubhā gatiḥ
pālaya tvaṃ prajāḥ sarvāḥ śāntātmā tvanuśāsitā
upāste tvāṃ naravyāghra saha kṛṣṇena dhīmatā
uvāca cainaṃ madhuraṃ nṛpaṃ śāntanavo nṛpaḥ
praviśasva purīṃ rājandharme ca dhriyatāṃ manaḥ
śreyasā yokṣyase caiva vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ
anuṃ tvāṃ tāta jīvantu mitrāṇi suhṛkadastathā
āgantavyaṃ ca bhavatā samaye mama pārthiva
ghṛtaṃ mālyaṃ ca gandhāṃśca kṣaumāṇi ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
mālyāni ca varārhāṇi ratnāni vividhāni ca
śṛṇoṣi cenmahābāho brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
yathoktaṃ bhavatā kāle sarvameva ca tatkṛtam
bahuśrutā hi te viprā bahavaḥ paryupāsitāḥ
na śocitavyaṃ kauravya bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā
yathā pāṇḍoḥ sutā rājaṃstathaiva tava dharmataḥ
dharmarājo hi śuddhātmā nideśe sthāsyate tava
tvadbhaktaṃ tvadgatiṃ śāntamudāramaparigraham trāyasva puṇḍarīkākṣa puruṣottama nityaśaḥ
yataḥ kṛṣṇastato dharmo yato dharmastato jayaḥ
sandhānasya paraḥ kālastaveti ca punaḥpunaḥ na ca me tadvaco mūḍhaḥ kṛtavānsa sumandadhīḥ
ghātayitveha pṛthivīṃ tataḥ sa nidhanaṃ gataḥ
tathā me nāradaḥ prāha vyāsaśca sumahātapāḥ
sa māṃ tvamanujānīhi kṛṣṇa mokṣye kalevaram
tena mṛtyustava vaśe sthito bhṛtya ivānataḥ
satyeṣu yatitavyaṃ vaḥ satyaṃ hi paramaṃ balam
ityuktvā suhṛdaḥ sarvāṃstathā sampūjya caiva ha dhanaṃ bahuvidhaṃ rājandattvā nityaṃ dvijātiṣu
yadyanmuñcati gātraṃ hi sa śantanusutastadā tattadviśalyamabhavadyogayuktasya vai kramāt
tatastvādāya dārūṇi gandhāṃśca vividhānbahūn citāṃ cakrurmahātmānaḥ pāṇḍavā vidurastathā
cāmare vyajane śubhre bhīmasenārjunāvubhau uṣṇīṣe parigṛhṇītāṃ mādrīputrāvubhau tathā
yudhiṣṭhireṇa sahito dhṛtarāṣṭraśca pādataḥ vṛddhā striyaḥ kauravāṇāṃ bhīṣmaṃ kurukulodvaham
tato bhāgīrathī devī tanayasyodake kṛte utthāya salilāttasmādrudatī śokavihvalā
nibodhata yathāvṛttamucyamānaṃ mayā nṛpāḥ rājavṛttena sampannaḥ prajñayābhijanena ca
jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yaḥ purā na parājitaḥ
apaśyantyāḥ priyaṃ putraṃ yanna dīryati me'dya vai
yasya nāsti bale tulyaḥ pṛthivyāmapi kaścana
hataṃ śikhaṇḍinā śrutvā yanna dīryati me manaḥ
samāśvasihi bhadre tvaṃ mā śucaḥ śubhadarśane
gataḥ sa paramaṃ lokaṃ tava putro na saṃśayaḥ
na śaktaḥ saṃyuge hantuṃ sākṣādapi śatakratuḥ
na śaktā vinihantuṃ hi raṇe taṃ sarvadevatāḥ
vasūneṣa gato devi putraste vijvarā bhava
ityuktā sā tu kṛṣṇena vyāsena tu saridvarā
tyaktvā śokaṃ mahārāja svaṃ vāryavatatāra ha
satkṛtya te tāṃ saritaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇamukhā nṛpa
papāta tīre gaṅgāyā vyādhaviddha iva dvipaḥ
taṃ sīdamānaṃ jagrāha bhīmaḥ kṛṣṇena coditaḥ
tamārtaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau śvasantaṃ ca punaḥ punaḥ
rājā tu dhṛtarāṣṭrastaṃ tathā dīno mahābhujam
śocitavyaṃ mayā caiva gāndhāryā ca mahīpate
yayoḥ putraśataṃ naṣṭaṃ svapnalabdhaṃ yathā dhanam
svasti cedicchase rājankulasya kuru me vacaḥ
atha necchasi rājānaṃ kuntīputraṃ yudhiṣṭhiram vināśamupayāstanti tava putrā na saṃśayaḥ
vṛddhau hi te'dya pitarau paśya nau duḥkhitau nṛpa
viditaṃ veditavyaṃ te kartavyamapi te kṛtam
yuktaṃ hi yaśasā kṣātraṃ svargaṃ prāptumasaṃśayam
tyaja śokaṃ mahārāja bhavitavyaṃ hi tattathā
na śakyāste punardraṣṭuṃ tvayā ye'sminraṇe hatāḥ
govinda mayi yā prītistava sā viditā mama
kṛtakṛtyo bhaviṣyāmi iti me niścitā matiḥ
na hi śāntiṃ prapaśyāmi pātayitvā pitāmaham nṛśaṃsaḥ puruṣavyāghraṃ guruṃ vīryabalānvitam
karmaṇā tadvidhatsveha yena śudhyati me manaḥ
mokṣadharmāśca nikhilā yāthātathyena te śrutāḥ yathā vai kāmajāṃ māyāṃ parityuktaṃ tvamarhasi
rājadharmāśca te sarve dānadharmāśca te śrutāḥ
yudhiṣṭhira tava prajñā na samyagiti me matiḥ
na hi kaścitsvayaṃ martyaḥ svavaśaḥ kurute kriyām
īśvareṇa ca yukto'yaṃ sādhvasādhu ca mānavaḥ
taranti nityaṃ puruṣā ye sma pāpāni kurvate
yajñena tapasā caiva dānena ca narādhipa
yathā ca bharato rājā dauṣyantiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ
imaṃ jñātivadhaṃ kṛtvā sumahāntaṃ dvijottama ahamārādhayiṣyāmi kathaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ
dānamalpaṃ na śaknomi dātuṃ vittaṃ ca nāsti me
na ca pratinidhiṃ kartuṃ cikīrṣāmi tapodhana
vidyate draviṇaṃ pārtha girau himavati sthitam
kasmiṃśca kāle sa nṛpo babhūva dadatāṃvara
yadi śuśrūṣase pārtha śṛṇu kāraṃdhamaṃ nṛpam
viṃśasya putraḥ kalyāṇo viviṃśo nāma bhārata
tamapāsya ca tadrājye tasya putraṃ suvarcasam
sa piturvikriyāṃ dṛṣṭvā rājyānnirasanaṃ ca tat
ārtimārcchatparāṃ rājā saha bhṛtyaiḥ pureṇa ca
samyagvṛtto hi rājā sa dharmanityo yudhiṣṭhira
yadā tu paramāmārtiṃ gato'sau sapuro nṛpaḥ
tataḥ pradadhmau sa karaṃ prādurāsīttato balam
kāraṃdhama iti khyāto babhūva jagatīpatiḥ tasya sarve mahīpālā vartante sma vaśe tadā
sa hi samrāḍabhūtteṣāṃ vṛttena ca balena ca
karmaṇā manasā vācā damena praśamena ca
tasya putro'ticakrāma pitaraṃ guṇavattayā marutto nāma dharmajñaścakravartī mahāyaśāḥ
cakruḥ suvarṇakartāro yeṣāṃ saṅkhyā na vidyate
tasyaiva ca samīpe tu yajñavāṭo babhūva ha īje tatra sa dharmātmā vidivatpṛthivīpatiḥ
kathaṃ ca jātarūpeṇa samayujyata vai nṛpaḥ
bṛhaspatiḥ sa saṃvartaṃ bādhate sma punaḥpunaḥ
sa bādhyamānaḥ satataṃ bhrātrā jyeṣṭhena bhārata
indratvaṃ prāpya lokeṣu tato vavre purohitam
vīryeṇāpratimo loke vṛttena ca balena ca śatakraturivaujasvī dharmātmā saṃśitavrataḥ
vāhanaṃ yasya yodhāśca mitrāṇi vividhāni ca
śayanāni ca mukhyāni mahārhāṇi ca sarvaśaḥ
saṃjīvya kālamiṣṭaṃ ca saśarīro divaṃ gataḥ
spardhate sa sma satataṃ devarājena nityadā
yatamānopi yaṃ śakro na viśeṣayati sma ha
bṛhaspate maruttasya mā sma kārṣīḥ kathañcana
daivaṃ karmātha pitryaṃ vā kartāsi mama cetpriyam
ahaṃ hi triṣu lokeṣu surāṇāṃ ca bṛhaspate
māṃ vā vṛṇīṣva bhadraṃ te maruttaṃ vā mahīpatim
parityajya maruttaṃ vā yathājoṣaṃ bhajasva mām
tvaṃ bibharṣi bhuvaṃ dyāṃ ca sadaiva balasūdana
grahīṣyāmi sruvaṃ yajñe śṛṇu cedaṃ vaco mama
bhāsaṃ tu na raviḥ kuryānna tu satyaṃ calenmayi
yājyosmi bhavataḥ sādho tatprāpnuhi vidhatsva ca
vṛtosmi devarājena pratijñātaṃ ca tasya me
pitryamasmi tava kṣetraṃ bahumanye ca te bhṛśam
tavāsmi yājyātāṃ prāpto bhajamānaṃ bhajasva mām
marutta gaccha vā mā vā nivṛttosmyadya yājanāt
na tvāṃ yājayitāsmyadya vṛṇu yaṃ tvamihecchasi
yajñārthamṛtvijaṃ praṣṭuṃ sa ca māṃ nābhyanandata
evamuktastu rājñā sa nāradaḥ pratyuvāca ha
taṃ gacca yadi yājyaṃ tvāṃ na vāñchati bṛhaspatiḥ
paśyeyaṃ kva nu saṃvartaṃ śaṃsa me vadatāṃvara
kathaṃ ca tasmai varteyaṃ kathaṃ māṃ na parityajet
tasyā dvāraṃ samāsādya nyasethāḥ kuṇapaṃ kvacit
taṃ dṛṣṭvā yo nivarteta saṃvartaḥ sa mahīpate
pṛcchettvāṃ yadi kenāhaṃ tavākhyāta iti sma ha
brūyāstvaṃ nāradeneti sa kutra iti śatruhan
sa tatheti pratiśrutya pūjayitvā ca nāradam
tatra gatvā yathoktaṃ sa puryā dvāre mahāyaśāḥ
tataḥ sa kuṇapaṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasā saṃnyavartata
sa ca taṃ vijane dṛṣṭvā pāṃsubhiḥ kademena ca
sa tathā bādhyamāno vai saṃvartena mahīpatiḥ
kathamasmi tvayā jñātaḥ kena vā kathitosmi te
satyaṃ te bruvataḥ sarve sampatsyante manorathāḥ
mithyā ca bruvato mūrdhā śatadhā te sphuṭiṣyati
guruputro mameti tvaṃ tato me prītiruttamā
bhrātā mama samarthaśca vāsavena ca saṅgataḥ
vartate yājane caiva tena karmāṇi kāraya
gārhasthyaṃ caiva yājyāśca sarvā gṛhyāśca devatāḥ
yājayeyaṃ kathaṃcidvai sa hi pūjyatamo mama
sa tvaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ gacca tamanujñāpya cāvraja
śakreṇa pratiṣiddho'haṃ maruttaṃ mā sma yājaye
spardhate hi mayā vipra sadā hi sa tu pārthivaḥ
sa māmadhigataṃ premṇā yājyatve na bubhūṣati
na hi me vartate buddhirgantuṃ brahmanbṛhaspatim
sthairyamatra kathaṃ me syātsa tvaṃ niḥsaṃśayaṃ kuru
kupitastvāṃ na hīdānīṃ bhasma kuryā savāndhavam
viṣayaiḥ saṅgataṃ cāstu tyajeyaṃ saṅgataṃ yadi
yājanaṃ hi mamāpyeva vartate hṛdi pārthiva
na tu me vartate buddhirdhane yājyeṣu vā punaḥ
priyaṃ ca te kariṣyāmi satyametadbravīmi te
śriyā jvalandṛśyate vai bālādityasamadyutiḥ na rūpaṃ śakyate tasya saṃsthānaṃ vā kadācana
noṣṇaṃ na śiśiraṃ tatra na vāyurna ca bhāskaraḥ
na jārā kṣutpipāse vā na mṛtyurna bhayaṃ nṛpa
tatra gatvā samanvāsya mahāyogeśvaraṃ śivam kuru praṇāmaṃ rājarṣe bhaktyā paramayā yatuḥ
tasmai bhagavate kṛtvā namaḥ śarvāya vedhase ebhistaṃ nāmabhirdevaṃ sarvavidyādharaṃ stuhi
tryakṣṇe pūṣṇo dantabhide vāmanāya śivāya ca
paśūnāṃ pataye caiva bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ
abhivaktrāya pataye sarvadevamayāya ca sruvahastāya pataye dhanvine bhārgavāya ca
tathā rudrāya pataye pṛthave kṛttivāsase vilohitāya dīptāya dīptākṣāya mahaujase
īśānaṃ śaṅkaraṃ sarvaṃ śivaṃ viśveśvaraṃ bhavam
ugraṃ sthāṇuṃ śivaṃ raudraṃ śarvaṃ gaurīśamīśvaram
praṇamya prāñjaliḥ śarvaṃ prayāmi śaraṇaṃ haram
yaṃ viduḥ saṅginaṃ muktāḥ sāmānyaṃ samadarśinaḥ
bhaktānāṃ sulabhaṃ taṃ hi durlabhaṃ dūrapātinām
namāmi sarvalokasthaṃ vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ śivam evaṃ kṛtvā namastasmai mahādevāya raṃhase
labhante gāṇapatyaṃ ca tadekāgrā hi mānavāḥ
kiṃ punaḥ svarṇibhāṇḍāni tasmāttvaṃ gaccha mā ciraṃ
mahattaraṃ hi te lābhaṃ hastyaśvoṣṭrādibhiḥ saha suvarṇamāhariṣyantastatra gacchantu te narāḥ
kubera iva tatprāpya mahādevaprasādataḥ tato'timānuṣaṃ sarvaṃ cakre yajñasya saṃvidhim
sauvarṇāni ca bhāṇḍāni saṃcakrustatra śilpinaḥ śālāśca sarvasambhārāṃstatra saṃvartaśāsanāt
bhaviṣyati hi me śatruḥ saṃvarto vasumāniti
kaccitsukhaṃ svapiṣi tvaṃ bṛhaspate kaccinmanojñāḥ paricārakāste
sukhaṃ śaye śayane devarāja tathā manojñāḥ paricārakā me
tathā devānāṃ sukhakāmosmi nityaṃ devāśca māṃ subhṛśaṃ pālayanti
kuto duḥkhaṃ mānasaṃ dehajaṃ vā pāṇḍurvivarṇaśca kutastvamadya
ācakṣva me brāhmaṇa yāvadetānnihanmi sarvāṃstava duḥkhakartṝn
saṃvarto yājayatīti me śrutaṃ tadicchāmi na sa taṃ yājayet
sarvānkāmānanuyātosi vipra tvaṃ devānāṃ mantrayase purodhāḥ
ubhau ca te jarāmṛtyū vyatītau kiṃ saṃvartastava kartā'dya vipra
devaiḥ saha tvamasurānsampraṇudya jighāṃsase cāpyuta sānubandhān
yaṃyaṃ samṛddhaṃ paśyasi tatratatra duḥkhaṃ sapatneṣu samṛddhibhāvaḥ
atosmi devendra vivarṇarūpaḥ sapatno me vardhate tanniśamya
sarvopāyairmaghavansaṃniyaccha saṃvartaṃ vā pārthivaṃ vā maruttam
ehi gaccha prahito jātavedo bṛhaspatiṃ paridātuṃ marutte
ayaṃ vai tvāṃ yājayitā bṛhaspatistathā'maraṃ caiva kariṣyatīti
ahaṃ gacchāmi tava śakrādya dūto bṛhaspatiṃ paridātuṃ marutte
vācaṃ satyāṃ puruhūtasya kartuṃ bṛhaspateścāpacitiṃ cikīrṣuḥ
āsanaṃ salilaṃ pādyaṃ gāṃ copānaya vai mune
indreṇa tu samādiṣṭaṃ viddhi māṃ dūtamāgatam
kacciddevā asya vaśe yathāvatprabrūhi tvaṃ mama kārtsnyena deva
śakro bhṛśaṃ susukhī pārthivendra prātiṃ cecchatyajarāṃ vai tvayā saḥ
devāśca sarve vaśagāstasya rājansaṃdeśaṃ tvaṃ śṛṇu me devarājñaḥ
yadarthaṃ māṃ prāhiṇottvatsakāśaṃ bṛhaspatiṃ paridātuṃ marutte
ayaṃ gururyājayatāṃ nṛpa tvāṃ martyaṃ santamamaraṃ tvāṃ karotu
saṃvarto'yaṃ yājayitā dvijo māṃ bṛhaspaterañjalireṣa tasya
na caivāsau yājayitvā mahendraṃ martyaṃ santaṃ yājayannadya śobhet
ye vai lokā devaloke mahāntaḥ samprāpsyase tāndevarājaprasādāt
tvāṃ cedasau yājayedvai bṛhaspatirnūnaṃ svargaṃ tvaṃ jayeḥ kīrtiyuktaḥ
tathā lokā mānuṣā ye ca divyāḥ prajāpateścāpi ye vai mahāntaḥ
tete jitā devarājyaṃ ca kṛtsnaṃ bṛhaspatiryājayeccennarendra
mā smaiva tvaṃ punarāgāḥ kathaṃcidbṛhaspatiṃ paridātuṃ marutte
mā tvāṃ dhakṣye cakṣuṣā dāruṇena saṃkruddho'haṃ pāvaka tvaṃ nibodhaḥ
taṃ vai dṛṣṭvā prāha śakro mahātmā bṛhaspateḥ sannidhau havyavāham
yastvaṃ gataḥ prahito jātavedo bṛhaspatiṃ paridātuṃ marutte
tatkiṃ prāha sa nṛpo yakṣyamāṇaḥ kaccidvacaḥ pratigṛhṇāti tacca
na te vācaṃ rocayate marutto bṛhaspaterañjaliṃ prāhiṇotsaḥ
saṃvarto māṃ yājayitetyuvāca punaḥ punaḥ sa mayā yācyamānaḥ
uvācedaṃ mānuṣā ye ca divyā prajāpaterye ca lokā mahāntaḥ
tāṃścellabheyaṃ saṃvidaṃ tena kṛtvā tathāpi neccheyamiti pratītaḥ
punargatvā pārthivaṃ tvaṃ sametya vākyaṃ madīyaṃ prāpaya svārthayuktam
punaryadyukto na kariṣyate vacastvatto vajraṃ samprahartāsmi tasmai
gandharvarāḍyātvayaṃ tatra dūto bibhemyahaṃ vāsava tatra gantum
daheyaṃ tvāṃ cakṣuṣā dāruṇena saṃkruddha ityetadavaihi śakra
tvamevānyāndahase jātavedo na hi tvadanyo vidyate bhasmakartā
divaṃ devendra pṛthivīṃ ca sarvāṃ saṃveṣṭayestvaṃ svabalenaiva śakra
nagaṇḍikākārayogaṃ kare'ṇuṃ na cārisomaṃ prapibāmi vahne
na kṣīṇaśaktau prahārāmi vajraṃ ko me sukhāya prahareta martyaḥ
divaḥ prahlādamavasānamānayaṃ ko me'sukhāya prahareta mānavaḥ
taṃ tvaṃ kruddhaḥ pratyaṣedhīḥ purastāccharyātiyajñaṃ sma taṃ mahendra
vajraṃ gṛhītvā ca purandara tvaṃ samprāhārṣīścyavanasyātighoram
sa te vipraḥ saha vajreṇi bāhumapāgṛhṇāttapasā jātamanyuḥ
tato roṣātsarvato ghorarūpaṃ sapatnaṃ te janayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
madaṃ nāmnā cāsuraṃ viśvarūpaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ dṛṣṭvā cakṣuṣī saṃnyamīlaḥ
hanurekā jagatīsthā tathaikā divaṃ gatā mahato dānavasya
sahasraṃ dantānāṃ śatayojanānāṃ sutīkṣṇānāṃ ghorarūpaṃ babhūva
vṛttāḥ sthūlā rajatastambhavarṇā daṃṣṭrāścatasro dve śate yojanānām
taṃ nāpaśyastvaṃ tadā ghorarūpaṃ sarve vai tvāṃ dadṛśurdarśanīyam
sohaṃ jānanbrahmatejo yathāvanna saṃvarta gantumicchāmi śakra
āvikṣitasya tu balaṃ na mṛṣye vajramasmai prahariṣyāmi ghoram
dhṛtarāṣṭra gaccha prahito maruttaṃ saṃvartena saṅgataṃ taṃ vadasva
bṛhaspatiṃ tvamupaśikṣasva rājanvajraṃ vā te prahariṣyāmi ghoram
tato gatvā dhṛtarāṣṭro narendraṃ provācedaṃ vacanaṃ vāsavasya
gandharvaṃ māṃ dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ nibodha tvāmāgataṃ vaktukāmaṃ narendra
aindraṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇu me rājasiṃha yatprāha lokādhipatirmahātmā
bṛhaspatiṃ yājakaṃ tvaṃ vṛṇīṣva vajraṃ vā te prahariṣyāmi ghoram
tvaṃ caivaitadvettha purandaraśca viśvedevā vasavaścāśvinau ca
mitradrohe niṣkṛtirnāsti loke mahatpāpaṃ brahmahatyāsamaṃ tat
saṃvarto māṃ yājayitā'dya rājanna te vākyaṃ tasya vā rocayāmi
ghoro nādaḥ śrūyatāṃ vāsavasya nabhastale garjato rājasiṃha
vyaktaṃ vajraṃ mokṣyate te mahendraḥ kṣemaṃ rājaṃścintyatāmeṣa kālaḥ
ityevamukto dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa rājañśrutvā nādaṃ nadato vāsavasya
taponityaṃ dharmavidāṃ variṣṭhaṃ saṃvartaṃ taṃ jñāpayāmāsa kāryam
paśyātmānaṃ plavamānaṃ tvamārādadhvā dūraṃ tena na dṛśyate'dya
prapadye'haṃ śarma viprendra tvattaḥ prayaccha tasmādabhayaṃ vipramukhya
bhayaṃ śakrādvyetu te rājasiṃha praṇotsye'haṃ bhayametatsughoram
ahaṃ saṃstambhayiṣyāmi mā bhaistvaṃ śakrato nṛpa
diśo vajraṃ vrajatāṃ vāyuretu varṣaṃ bhūtvā varṣatāṃ kānaneṣu
āpaḥ plavantvantarikṣe vṛthā ca saudāmanī dṛśyate mā'pi bhaistvam
vahnirdevastrātu vā sarvataste kāmānsarvānvarṣatu vāsavo vā
vajraṃ tathā sthāpayatāṃ vadhāya mahāghoraṃ puvamānaṃ jalaughaiḥ
ghoraḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate vai mahāsvano vajrasyaiṣa sahito mārutena
ātmā hi me pravyathate muhurmuhurna me svāsthyaṃ jāyate cādya vipra
vajrādugrādvyetu bhayaṃ tavādya vāto bhūtvā vrajatu narendra vajram
bhayaṃ tvaktvā varamanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva kaṃ te kāmaṃ tapasā sādhayāmi
indraḥ sākṣātsahasā'bhyetu vipra haviryajñe pratigṛhṇātu caiva
svaṃsvaṃ haviścaiva juṣantu devā hutaṃ somaṃ pratigṛhṇantu caiva
tato devaiḥ sahito devarājo rathe yuṅktvā tānharīnvājimukhyān
tamāyāntaṃ sahitaṃ devasaṅghaiḥ pratyudyayau sapurodhā maruttaḥ
cakre pūjāṃ devarājāya cāgryāṃ yathāśāstraṃ vidhivatprīyamāṇaḥ
susvāgataṃ te puruhūteha vidvanyajño'pyayaṃ sannihite tvayīndra
śośubhyate balavṛtraghna bhūyaḥ pibasva somaṃ sutamudyataṃ mayā
śivena māṃ paśya namaśca te'stu prāpto yajñaḥ saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ me
ayaṃ yajñaṃ kurute me surendra bṛhaspateravaro janmanā ca
jānāmi te gurumenaṃ tapodhanaṃ bṛhaspateranujaṃ tigmatejasam
yasyāhvānādāgato'haṃ narendra prītirme'dya tvayi manyuḥ pranaṣṭaḥ
yadi prītastvamasi vai devarāja tasmātsvayaṃ śādhi yajñe vidhānam
svayaṃ sarvānkuru bhāgānsurendra jānātvayaṃ sarvalokaśca deva
klṛptāḥ sthūṇāḥ kurutārohaṇāni gandharvāṇāmapsarasāṃ ca śīghram
yatra nṛtyerannapsarasaḥ samastāḥ svargopamaḥ kriyatāṃ yajñavāṭaḥ
tato vākyaṃ prāha rājānamindraḥ prīto rājanpūjyamāno maruttam
eṣa tvayā'hamiha rājansametya ye cāpyante tava pūrve narendra
sarvāścānyā devatāḥ prīyamāṇā havistubhyaṃ pratigṛhṇantu rājan
āgneyaṃ vai lohitamālabhantāṃ vaiśvadevaṃ bahurūpaṃ hi rājan
nilaṃ cokṣāṇaṃ medyamapyālabhantāṃ calacchiśnaṃ sampradiṣṭaṃ dvijāgryāḥ
tato yajño vavṛdhe tasya rājanyatra devāḥ svayamannāni jahruḥ
tataḥ saṃvartaścaityagato māhātmā yathā vahniḥ prajvalito dvitīyaḥ
tataḥ pītvā balabhitsomamagryaṃ ye cāpyante somapā devasaṅghāḥ
sarve'nujñātāḥ prayayuḥ pārthivena yathājoṣaṃ tarpitāḥ prītimantaḥ
tato rājā jātarūpasya rāśīnpadepade kārayāmāsa hṛṣṭaḥ
dvijātibhyo visṛjanbhūri vittaṃ rarāja vitteśa ivārihantā
tato vittaṃ vividhaṃ sannidhāya yathotsāhaṃ kārayitvā ca kośam
anujñāto guruṇāṃ saṃnivṛttya śaśāsa gāmakhilāṃ sāgarāntām
evaṃguṇaḥ sambabhūveha rājā yasya kratau tatsuvarṇaṃ prabhūtam
tattvaṃ samādāya narendra vittaṃ yajasva devāṃstapanīyairvidhānaiḥ
tato rājā pāṇḍavo hṛṣṭarūpaḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ satyavatyāḥ sutasya
manaścakre tena vittena yaṣṭuṃ tato'mātyairmantrayāmāsa bhūyaḥ
naiva te'nuṣṭhitaṃ karma naiva te śatravo jitāḥ
vṛtreṇa pṛthivī vyāptā purā kila narādhipa dṛṣṭvā sa pṛthivīṃ vyāptāṃ gandhasya viṣaye hṛte
viveśa sahasā toyaṃ jagrāha viṣayaṃ tataḥ
apsu vṛtragṛhītāsu rase ca viṣaye hṛte
vyāpte jyotiṣi vṛtreṇa rūpe'tha viṣaye hṛte
viveśa sahasā vāyuṃ jagrāha viṣayaṃ tataḥ
vyāpte vāyau tu vṛtreṇa sparśe'tha viṣaye hṛte
ākāśe vṛtrabhūte'tha śabde ca viṣaye hṛte
viveśa sahasā śakraṃ jagrāha viṣayaṃ tataḥ
idaṃ dharmyaṃ rahasyaṃ vai śakreṇoktaṃ maharṣiṣu
śarīre jāyate vyādhiḥ śarīraḥ sa nigadyate
uṣṇena bādhyate śītaṃ śītenoṣṇaṃ ca bādhyate
harṣeṇa bādhyate śoko harṣaḥ śokena bādhyate
sa tvaṃ na duḥkhī duḥkhasya na sukhī susukhasya vā smartumicchasi kaunteya daivaṃ hi balavattaram
yatra naiva śaraiḥ kāryaṃ na bhṛtyairna ca bandhubhiḥ
śārīraṃ dravyamutsṛjya siddhirbavati vā na vā
yo dharmo yatsukhaṃ caiva dviṣatāmastu tattava
mamatvaṃ yasya naiva syātkiṃ tayā sa kariṣyati
athavā vasataḥ pārtha vane vanyena jīvataḥ
mamatā yasya vitteṣu mṛtyorāṃsye sa vartate
yanna paśyati tadbhūtaṃ mucyate sa mahābhayāt
kāmātmānaṃ na praśaṃsanti loke nehākāmā kācidasti pravṛttiḥ
sarve kāmā manaso'ṅga prabhūtā yānpaṇḍitaḥ saṃharate vicintya bhūyobhūyo janmano'bhyāsayogādyogī yogaṃ sāramārgaṃ vicintya
dānaṃ ca vedādhyayanaṃ tapaśca kāmyāni karmāṇi ca vaidikāni
vrataṃ yajñānniyamāndhyānayogānkāmena yo nārabhate viditvā yadyaccāyaṃ kāmayate sa dhamo nayo dharmo niyamastasya mūlam
yo māṃ prayatate hantuṃ jñātvā praharaṇe balam
yo māṃ prayatate hantuṃ dhṛtyā satyaparākramaḥ
bhāvo bhavāmi tasyāhaṃ sa ca māṃ nāvabudhyate
yo māṃ prayatate hantuṃ tapasā saṃśitavrataḥ
yo māṃ prayatate hantuṃ mokṣamāsthāya paṇḍitaḥ tasya mokṣaratisthasya nṛtyāmi ca hasāmi ca
dharme kuru mahārāja tatra te sa bhaviṣyati
kīrtiṃ loke parāṃ prāpya gatimagryāṃ gamiṣyasi
arcayāmāsa devāṃśca brāhmaṇāṃśca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kṛtvā'tha pretakāryāṇi sarveṣāṃ kurunandanaḥ
bahvāścaryo hi deśaḥ sa śrūyate dvijasattama
tathā bhagavatā citraṃ kalyāṇaṃ bahu bhāṣitam
evamuktāstu te rājñā sarva eva maharṣayaḥ
evaṃ nātimahānkālaḥ sa teṣāṃ saṃnyavartata kurvatāṃ śaucakāryāṇi bhīṣmasya nidhane tadā
dharmasatyapradhānāśca satyaṃ sadviṣayānvitam dharmāsanasthaḥ sadbhiḥ sa strībālāturavṛddhakān
icchā na jāyate'nyatra varṇeṣu na ca saṅkaraḥ
manvādibhiḥ kṛtāḥ pūrvaṃ maryādā mānaveṣu yāḥ anatikramya tāḥ sarvāḥ kuleṣu samayāni ca
evaṃ bhāratavarṣaṃ svaṃ rājā svargaṃ surendravat
tīrtheṣu caiva puṇyeṣu palvaleṣu nadīṣu ca
praviśya tāṃ sabhāṃ ramyāṃ vijahrāte ca bhārata
dharmeṇa nihataḥ saṅkhye sa ca rājā suyodhanaḥ
bhuṅkte dharmasuto rājā tvayā guptaḥ kurūdvaha
kimu yatra jano'yaṃ vai pṛthā cāmitrakarmana
yatra dharmasuto rājā yatra yatra bhīmo mahābalaḥ
satyaṃ dharmo matiścāgryā sthitiśca satataṃ sthirā
tatra gatvā mahātmānaṃ yadi te rocate'rjuna
kuto gantuṃ mahābāho purīṃ dvārāvatīṃ prati
pṛthivī ca vaśe tāta dharmaputrasya dhīmataḥ
dharmeṇa rājā dharmajñaḥ pātu sarvāṃ vasundharām
taṃ mayā saha gatvā'dya rājānaṃ kuruvardhanam
idaṃ śarīraṃ vasu yacca me gṛhe niveditaṃ pārtha sadā yudhiṣṭhire
priyaśca mānyaśca hi me yudhiṣṭhiraḥ sadā kurūṇāmadhipo mahāmatiḥ
prayojanaṃ cāpi nivāsakāraṇe na vidyate me tvadṛte nṛpātmaja
sthitā hi pṛthvī tava pārtha śāsane guroḥ suvṛttasya yudhiṣṭhirasya ca
kṛṣṇena sahitaḥ pārthaḥ svaṃ rājyaṃ prāpya kevalam
tasyāṃ sabhāyāṃ divyāyāṃ vijahāra mudā yutaḥ
yattu tadbhavatā proktaṃ purā keśava sauhṛdāt
mama kautūhalaṃ tvasti teṣvartheṣu punaḥ punaḥ
na ca sā'dya punarbhūyaḥ smṛtirme sambhaviṣyati
sa hi dharmaḥ suparyāpto brahmaṇaḥ padavedane
paraṃ hi brahma kathitaṃ yogayuktena tanmayā
dīpyamānaṃ śriyā brāhmayā kramamāṇaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
taṃ samāsādya medhāvī sa tadā dvijasattamaḥ caraṇau dharmakāmo vai sa tasya susamāhitaḥ
gacchantīha gatiṃ martyā devaloke ca vā sthitim
aśubhā gatayaḥ prāptāḥ kaṣṭā me pāpasevanāt
punaḥ punaśca maraṇaṃ janma caiva punaḥ punaḥ
sukhāni ca vicitrāṇi duḥkhāni ca mayā'nagha
loke'sminnanubhūyāhamimaṃ mārgamanuṣṭhitaḥ tataḥ siddhiriyaṃ prāptā prasādādātmano mayā
itaḥ paraṃ gamiṣyāmi tataḥ parataraṃ punaḥ
prītosmi te mahāprājña brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te
bahumanye ca te buddhiṃ bhṛśaṃ sampūjayāmi ca
yenāhaṃ bhavatā buddho medhāvī hyasi kāśyapa
ātmānaṃ vā kathaṃ yuktvā taccharīraṃ vimuñcati
kathaṃ śubhāśubhe cāyaṃ karmaṇī svakṛte naraḥ
asminnevāśu phaladā āyuṣyāstu kriyāḥsmṛtāḥ āyuḥkīrtikarāṇīha yāni kṛtyāni sevate
sattvaṃ balaṃ ca kālaṃ cāviditvā cātmanastathā
atyarthamapi vā bhuṅkte na vā bhuṅkte kadācana
guru cāpyamitaṃ bhuṅkte nātijīrṇe divā punaḥ
tasya taiḥ kāraṇairjantoḥ śarīraṃ cyavate tadā
bhinatti jīvasthānāni tāni karmaṇi viddhi ca
tataḥ savedanaḥ sadyo jīvaḥ pracyavate kṣaran śarīraṃ tyajate jantuśchidyamāneṣu marmasu
garbhasaṃkramaṇe cāpi garbhāṇāpupasarpaṇe tādṛśīmeva labhate vedanāṃ mānavaḥ punaḥ
yaḥ sa pañcasu bhūteṣu prāṇāpāne vyavasthitaḥ sa gacchatyūrdhvago vāyuḥ kṛcchrānmuktvā śarīriṇaḥ
tatraiva kurute kāye yaḥ sa jīvaḥ sanātanaḥ
teṣu marmasu bhinneṣu tataḥ sa samudīrayan
āviśya hṛdayaṃ jantoḥ sattvaṃ cāśu ruṇaddhi vai
tataḥ sacetano janturnābhijānāti kiñcana tamasā saṃvṛtajñānaḥ saṃvṛteṣveva marmasu
tataḥ sa taṃ mahocchvāsaṃ bhṛśamucchvasya dāruṇam
sa jīvaḥ pracyutaḥ kāyātkarmabhiḥ svaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ
itaraṃ kṛtapuṇyaṃ vā taṃ vijānanti lakṣaṇaiḥ
ihaivāśubhakarmāṇaḥ karmabhirnirayaṃ gatāḥ avāggatiriyaṃ kaṣṭā yatra pacyanti mānavāḥ
ūrdhvaṃ tu jantavo gatvā yeṣu sthāneṣvavasthitāḥ
karmakṣayācca te sarve cyavante vai punaḥ punaḥ
na ca tatrāpi saṃtoṣo dṛṣṭvā dīptatarāṃ śriyam
tathā syādvipulaṃ puṇyaṃ śuddhena manasā kṛtam
pāpaṃ cāpi tathaiva syātpāpena manasā kṛtam
naro garbhaṃ praviśati tatrāpi śṛṇu cottaram
kṣetraṃ karmajamāpnoti śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
sa jīvaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ garbhamāviśya bhāgaśaḥ dadhāti cetanā sadyaḥ prāṇasthāneṣvavasthitaḥ
lohapiṇḍaṃ yathā vahniḥ praviśya hyatitāpayet tathā tvamapi jānīhi garbhe jīvopapādanam
yathā ca dīpaḥ śaraṇaṃ dīpyamānaḥ prakāśayet
yadyacca kurute karma śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
tatte dharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi sukhī bhavati yena vai
tato dharmaḥ prabhavati yaḥ prajāḥ pāti śāśvatīḥ
evaṃ satsu sadā paśyettatrachāpyeṣā dhruvā sthitiḥ
teṣu tatkarma nikṣiptaṃ yaḥ sa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ
yaśca yogī ca muktaśca sa aitebhyo viśiṣyate
evaṃ pūrvakṛtaṃ karma sarvo jantuḥ prapadyate
ityevaṃ saṃśaye loke tacca vakṣyāmyataḥ param
yayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ yāṃ loke paramāṃ viduḥ
sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni ityeṣā paurvikī śrutiḥ
yacca kiñcitsukhaṃ tacca duḥkhaṃ dṛṣṭamiti smaran
ātmavatsarvabhūteṣu yaścarenniyataḥ śuciḥ nityameva yathānyāyaṃ yaścarenniyatendriyaḥ
amānī nirabhīmānaḥ sarvato mukta eva saḥ
jīvitaṃ maraṇaṃ cobhe sukhaduḥkhe tathaiva ca
lābhālābhe priyadveṣye yaḥ samaḥ sa ca mucyate
nirdvandvo vītarāgātmā sarvathā mukta eva saḥ
naiva dharmī na cādharmī pūrvopacitahā ca yaḥ
aguṇaṃ guṇabhoktāraṃ yaḥ paśyati sa mucyate
indriyāṇi tu saṃhṛtya mana ātmani dhārayet
tīvraṃ taptvā tapaḥ pūrvaṃ mokṣayogaṃ samācaret
yogī niṣkṛṣya cātmānaṃ tathā paśyati dehataḥ
yadā hi yuktamātmānaṃ samyak paśyati dehabhūt
vinirbhidya jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ na śocati na hṛṣyati
vinaśyatsu ca lokeṣu na bhayaṃ tasya jāyate
kliśyamāneṣu bhūteṣu na sa kliśyati kenacit
nainaṃ śastrāṇi vidhyante na mṛtyuścāsya vidyate
purasyābhyantare tasya manaḥ sthāpyaṃ na bāhyataḥ purasyābhyantare tiṣṭhanyasminnāvasathe vaseta
tasminkāye manaścāsya na ca kiñcana bāhyataḥ
intāṃstālu ca jihvāṃ ca galaṃ grīvāṃ tathaiva ca
ityuktaḥ sa mayā śiṣyo medhāvī madhusūdana
kathaṃ rasatvaṃ vrajati śoṇitatvaṃ kathaṃ punaḥ
tathā māṃsaṃ ca medaśca snāyvasthīni ca poṣayet
vardhante vardhamānasya vardhate ca kathaṃ balam
nirāsanaṃ niṣkasanaṃ malānāṃ ca pṛthak pṛthak
kuto vā'yaṃ praśvasiti ucchvasityapi vā punaḥ
jīvaḥ kathaṃ vahati ca ceṣṭamānaḥ kalevaram
kiṃvarṇaṃ kīdṛśaṃ caiva niveśayati vai manaḥ
yathā svakoṣṭhe prakṣipya bhāṇḍaṃ bhāṇḍamanā bhavet
na tvasau cakṣuṣā grāhyo na ca sarvairapīndriyaiḥ
sa tamutsṛjya dehaṃ svaṃ pārayedbrahma kevalam
tadevamāśrayaṃ kṛtvā mokṣaṃ yāti tato mayi
idaṃ sarvarahasyaṃ te mayā proktaṃ dvijottama
ityuktaḥ sa tadā kṛṣṇa mayā śiṣyo mahātapāḥ
ityuktvā sa tadā vākyaṃ māṃ pārtha dvijasattamaḥ
parā hi sā gatiḥ pārtha yattadbrahma sanātanam
yatrāmṛtatvaṃ prāpnoti tyaktvā duḥkhaṃ sadā sukhī
imaṃ dharmaṃ samāsthāya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
kiṃ punarbrahmaṇāḥ pārtha kṣatriyā vā bahuśrutāḥ
siddhiṃ phalaṃ ca mokṣaśca duḥkhasya ca vinirṇiyaḥ
kaṃ nu lokaṃ gamiṣyāmi tvāmahaṃ patimāśritā
tvāmahaṃ patimāsādya kāṃ gamiṣyāmi vai gatim
grāhyaṃ dṛśyaṃ tathā śrāvyaṃ yadidaṃ karma vidyate
karmaṇā manasā vācā śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham
yatra tadbrahma nirdvandvaṃ yatra somaḥ sahāgninā
vyavāyaṃ kurute nityaṃ dhīro bhūtāni dhārayan

stainyaṃ hiṃsā jugupsā ca paritāpaḥ prajāgaraḥ
dambho darpo'tha rāgaśca bhaktiḥ prītiḥ pramodanam
dyūtaṃ ca janavādaśca sambandhāḥ strīkṛtāśca ye
sarva ete guṇā viprā rājasāḥ samprakīrtitāḥ
asmim̐loke pramodante jāyamānāḥ punaḥpanaḥ pretyabhāvikamīhante halaukikameva ca
rajoguṇā vo bahudhānukīrtitā yathāvaduktaṃ guṇavṛttameva ca
naropi yo veda guṇānimānsadā sa rājasaiḥ sarvaguṇairvimucyate
divyaṃ prāpya tu te dhīrāḥ kurvate vai tatastanūḥ
īśitvaṃ ca vaśitvaṃ ca laghutvaṃ cāṇutā tathā
yadyadicchanti tatsarvaṃ bhajante vibhajanti ca ityetatsātvikaṃ vṛttaṃ kathitaṃ vo dvijarṣabhāḥ
prakīrtitāḥ sattvaguṇā viśeṣato yathāvaduktaṃ guṇavṛttameva ca
narastu yo veda guṇānimānsadā guṇānsa bhuṅkte na guṇaiḥ sa yujyate
naiva śakyā guṇā vaktuṃ pṛthaktvenaiva sarvaśaḥ
alpaṃ tatratha rajo jñeyaṃ satvamalpataraṃ tathā
udriktaṃ ca rajo yatra madhyasrotogataṃ bhavet
alpaṃ tatra tamo jñeyaṃ satvamalpataraṃ tathā
alpaṃ tatra tamo jñeyaṃ rajaścālpataraṃ tathā
na hi satvātparo bhāvaḥ kaścidanyo vidhīyate
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti satvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ
tamaḥ śūdre rajaḥ kṣatre brāhmaṇe satvamuttamam
tridhā dānāni dīyante tridhā yajñaḥ pravartate
bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca dharmo'rthaḥ kāma eva ca
trayo guṇāḥ pravartante hyavyaktā nityameva tu
tamo'vyaktaṃ śivaṃ dhāma rajo yoniḥ sanātanaḥ
anudriktamanūnaṃ vā'pyakampamacalaṃ dhruvam sadasaccaiva tatsarvamavyaktaṃ triguṇaṃ smṛtam
avyaktanāmāni guṇāṃśca tattvato yo veda sarvāṇi gatīśca kevalāḥ
mahānātmā matirviṣṇurjiṣṇuḥ śaṃbhuśca vīryavān buddhiḥ prajñopalabdhiśca tatā khyātirdhṛtiḥsmṛtiḥ
ātmano mahato veda yaḥ puṇyāṃ gatimuttamām
evaṃ hi yo veda guhāśayaṃ prabhuṃ paraṃ purāṇaṃ puruṣaṃ viśvarūpam
hiraṇmayaṃ buddhimatāṃ parāṃ gatiṃ sa buddhimānbuddhimatītya tiṣṭhati
vaikārikaḥ sarvamidaṃ viceṣṭate svatejasā rañjayate jagattathā
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ
sa tadbrahma śubhaṃ yāti tasmādbhūyo na vidyate
śrotraṃ tvak cakṣuṣī jihvā nāsikā caiva pañcamī
etaṃ grāmaṃ jayetpūrvaṃ tato brahma prakāśate
ubhayatra mano jñeyaṃ buddhistu dvādaśī bhavet
trīṇi sthānāni bhūtānāṃ caturthaṃ nopapadyate sthalamāpastathā''kāśaṃ janma cāpi caturvidham
bhittvā tu pṛthivīṃ yāni jāyante kālaparyayāt
tapaḥ karma ca yatpuṇyamityeṣa viduṣāṃ nayaḥ
vividhaṃ karma vijñeyamijyā dānaṃ ca tanmakhe
dvitīyaṃ mārutaṃ bhūtaṃ tvagadhyātmaṃ ca viśrutam
adhibhūtaṃ tathā śukraṃ daivataṃ ca prajāpatiḥ
virajāḥ sarvato mukto yo naraḥ sa sukhī sadā
agnī rūpaṃ rasaṃ sroto vāyuḥ sparśanameva ca mahī gandhadharā ghrāṇamākāśaḥ śravaṇaṃ tathā
sa vai viṣṇuśca mitraśca varuṇo'gniḥ prajāpatiḥ
sa hi dhātā vidhātā ca sa prabhuḥ sarvatomukhaḥ
taṃ viprasaṅghāśca surāsurāśca yakṣāḥ piśācāḥ pitaro vayāṃsi
rakṣogaṇā bhūtagaṇāśca sarve maharṣayaścaiva sadā stuvanti
manuṣyāṇāṃ tu rājyaḥ kṣatriyo madhyamo guṇaḥ
gavāṃ govṛṣabhaścaiva strīṇāṃ puruṣa eva ca
oṣadhīnāṃ patiḥ somo viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ tvaṣṭā'dhināṃ patiḥ somo viṣṇurbalavatāṃ varaḥ
dakṣiṇānāṃ tathā yajño vedānāmṛca eva ca
eṣa bhūtādhipaḥ sargaḥ prajānāṃ ca prajāpatiḥ
bhūtaṃ parataraṃ matto viṣṇorvā'pi na vidyate
īśvaraṃ taṃ vijānīmaḥ sa vibhuḥ sa prajāpatiḥ
māheśvarī mahādevī procyate pārvatī hi sā
rājñāṃ hi viṣaye yeṣāṃ sādhavaḥ parirakṣitāḥ
pārtivo yastu gandho vai ghrāṇena hi sa gṛhyate
apāṃ dhātū raso nityaṃ jihvayā sa tu gṛhyate
tejasastu guṇo rūpaṃ cakṣuṣā tacca gṛhyate
vāyavyastu sadā sparśastvacā prajñāyate ca saḥ
tvaksthaścaiva sadā vāyuḥ sparsane sa vidhīyate
ākāśasya guṇo ghoṣaḥ śrotreṇa ca sa gṛhyate
manasaśca guṇaścintā prajñayā sa tu gṛhyate
sadā paśyāmyahaṃ līnaṃ vijānāmi śṛṇomi ca
na satyaṃ veda vai kaścitkṣetrajñastveva vindati
ahaḥ pūrvaṃ tato rātrirmāsāḥ śuklādayaḥ smṛtāḥ
oṅkāraḥ sarvavedānāṃ vacasāṃ prāṇa eva ca
prasarpiṇāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jyeṣṭhaḥ sarpo dvijottamāḥ
brahmakṣetraṃ sadā puṇyaṃ plakṣaḥ pravarajaḥ smṛtaḥ
ahaṃ prajāpatīnāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
diśāṃ ca pradiśāṃ cordhvaṃ dikpūrvā prathamā tathā
āśramāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ gārhasthyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
sukhasyāntaṃ sadā duḥkhaṃ duḥkhasyāntaṃ sadā sukhama
sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ vināśāntaṃ jātasya maraṇaṃ dhruvam
iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ tapo'dhītaṃ vratāni niyamāśca ye
yastu veda naro nityaṃ na sa bhūteṣu muhyati
na ca vāgaṅgacapala iti śiṣṭasya gocaraḥ
trīṇi dhārayate nityaṃ kamaṇḍalumatandritaḥ ekamācamanārthāya ekaṃ vai pādadhāvanam
trīṇi karmāṇi jānīta brāhmaṇānāṃ tu jīvikāḥ
atha śeṣāṇi cānyāni trīṇi karmāṇi yāni tu
dhārayīta sadā daṇḍaṃ bailvaṃ pālāśameva vā
sarvaṃ kāṣāyaraktaṃ vā vāso vā'pi dvijasya ha
dānto maitraḥ kṣamāyuktaḥ kaśāñśamaśru ca dhārayan
vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhaikṣyaṃ lipseta mokṣavit lābhena ca na hṛṣyeta nālābhe vimanā bhavet
dayārtaṃ caiva bhūtānāṃ samīkṣya pṛthivīṃ caret
sañcayāṃśca na kurvīta snehavāsaṃ ca varjayet
parebhyo na pratigrāhyaṃ na ca deyaṃ kadācana
na kiñcidviṣayaṃ bhuktvā spṛhayettasya vai punaḥ
na dveṣṭā nopadeṣṭā ca bhavecca nirupaskṛtaḥ
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu sthāvareṣu careṣu ca
na cakṣuṣā na manasā na vācā dūṣayetkvacit
na pratyakṣaṃ parokṣaṃ vā kiñcidduṣṭaṃ samācaret
ātmasaṅgī ca tattvajño mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ ye paśyanti na te mṛtāḥ
na tatra kramate buddhirnendriyāṇi na devatāḥ
vedā yajñāśca lokāśca na tapo na vratāni ca
ya evaṃ vṛttasampannaḥ sa muniḥ śreṣṭha ucyate
brāhmaṇā brahmayonisthā jñānaṃ brahma paraṃ viduḥ
jñānena tapasā caiva dhīrāḥ paśyanti tatparam
saṃnyāsaniratā nityaṃ ye ca brahmavido janāḥ
jñānaṃ vai paramaṃ vidyātsaṃnyāsaṃ tapa uttamam
yo vidvānsahavāsaṃ ca vivāsaṃ caiva paśyati
hitvā guṇamayaṃ sarvaṃ karma jantuḥ śubhāśubham
ubhe satyānṛte hitvā mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
enaṃ chittvā ca bhittvā ca tattvajñānāsinā budhaḥ
kecidbrahmamayaṃ vṛkṣaṃ kecidbrahmamayaṃ vanam kecitparamamavyaktaṃ kecitparamanāmayam
satvātparataraṃ nānyatpraśaṃsantīha tadvidaḥ anumānādvijānīmaḥ puruṣaṃ satvasaṃśrayam
satvaṃ ca puruṣaścaiva tatra nāsti vicāraṇā
āhureke ca vidvāṃso ye jñāne supratiṣṭhitāḥ
kecinmokṣaṃ praśaṃsanti kecidbhogānpṛthagvidhān dhanāni kecidicchanti nirdhanatvamathāpare
idaṃ śreya idaṃ śreya ityevaṃ vyusthito janaḥ
yo hi yasminrato dharma sa taṃ pūjayate sadā
hanta vaḥ samprakṣyāmi yanmāṃ pṛcchatha sattamāḥ
etatpadamanudvignaṃ variṣṭhaṃ dharmalakṣaṇam jñānaṃ niḥśreya ityāhurvṛddhā niścitadarśinaḥ
kurvate ye tu karmāṇi śraddhadhānā vipaścitaḥ
viṣayī puruṣo nityaṃ satvaṃ ca viṣayaḥ smṛtaḥ
vyākhyātaṃ pūrvakalpeni maśakodumbaraṃ yathā bhujyamānaṃ na jānīte nityaṃ satvamacetanam
yastvevaṃ taṃ vijānīte yo bhuṅkte yaśca bhujyate
yathā dravyaṃ ca kartā ca saṃyogo'pyanayostathā yathā pradīpamādāya kaścittamasi gacchati
etadviprā vijānīta hanta bhūyo bravīmi vaḥ
tathā karmasu vijñeyaṃ phalaṃ bhavati vā na vā
nāvā cāpi yathā prājño vibhāgajñaḥ svaritrayā
evaṃ karma kṛtaṃ vitta viṣayasthaṃ pṛthakpṛthak
yathā karma kṛtaṃ loke tathā tadupapadyate
yannaiva gandhi no rasyaṃ na rūpasparsaśabdavat
manyate na mano buddhyā tatpradhānaṃ pracakṣate
pṛthaktvena hi bhūtānāṃ viṣayā vai guṇāḥsmṛtāḥ
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ raso gandhaśca pañcamaḥ
pārthivaśca sadā gandho gandhaśca bahudhā smṛtaḥ
nirhārī saṃhataḥ snigdho rūkṣo viśada eva ca
evaṃ daśavidho jñeyaḥ pārthivo gandha ityuta
śabdaḥ sparśastathā rūpaṃ dravaścāpāṃ guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ
rasajñānaṃ tu vakṣyāmi rasastu bahudhā smṛtaḥ
jyotiṣaśca guṇo rūpaṃ rūpaṃ ca bahudhā smṛtam
śuklaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tathā raktaṃ nīlaṃ pītāruṇaṃ tathā
vāyoścāpi guṇaḥ sparśaḥ sparsaśca bahudhā smṛtaḥ
uṣṇaḥ śītaḥ sukho duḥkhaḥ snigdho viśada eva ca
ṣaḍjarṣabhaḥ sagāndhāro madhyamaḥ pañcamastathā ataḥ paraṃ tu vijñeyo niṣādo dhaivatastathā
niyame ca visarge ca bhūtānāṃ mana eva ca
indriyāṇi mano buddhiḥ kṣetrajñe yujyate sadā
evaṃ yo vetti vidvānvai sadā brahmamayaṃ ratham
loke'sminyāni satvāni trasāni sthāvarāṇi ca tānyevāgre pralīyante paścādbhūtakṛtā guṇāḥ
sarve svabhāvataḥ sṛṣṭā na kriyābhyo na kāraṇāt
ete viśvasṛjo viprā jāyantīha punaḥ punaḥ tebhyaḥ prasūtāsteṣveva mahābhūteṣu pañcasu
tatsarvaṃ tapasā sādhyaṃ tapo hi duratikramam
yāni cānyāni bhūtāni carāṇi sthāvarāṇi ca
tathaiva tapasā devā mahābhāgā divaṃ gatāḥ
kṣetrajña iti taṃ vidyādyastaṃ veda sa vedavit
mameti ca bhavenmṛtyurna mameti ca śāśvatam
ye tu vṛddhā mahātmāno na praśaṃsanti karma te
vidyāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo na tu karmamayaḥ smṛtaḥ
vaśyātmānamasaṃśliṣṭaṃ yo veda na mṛto bhavet
apūrvamakṛtaṃ nityaṃ ya enamavicāriṇam ya evaṃ vindedātmānamagrāhyamamṛtāśanam
agrāhyo hyamṛto bhavati sa ebhiḥ kāraṇairdhruvaḥ
sa tadbrahma śubhaṃ vetti yasmādbhūyo na vidyate
ityuktāste tu munayo guruṇā brahmaṇā tathā
ityuktaḥ sa tadā śiṣyo guruṇā dharmamuttamam
tatpadaṃ samanuprāpto yatra gatvā na śocati
ko nvasau brāhmaṇaḥ kṛṣṇa kaśca śiṣyo janārdana
ahaṃ gururmahābāho manaḥ śiṣya ca viddhi me
mayā tava mahābāho tasmādatra manaḥ kuru
mayā tu bharataśreṣṭha ciradṛṣṭaḥ pitā prabhuḥ
namaste sarvalokātmannārāyaṇa parātpara manomalāttapośakyaṃ karma cāvidyayā hatam
yadi gantuṃ kṛtā buddhirvāsudeva namostu te gacchāvo nagaraṃ kṛṣṇa gajasāhvayamadya vai
nāthavantaśca bhavatā pāṇḍavā madhusūdana bhavantaṃ plavamāsādya tīrṇāḥ sma kurusāgaram
ratiḥ krīḍāmayī tubhyaṃ māyā te rodasī vibho
tvayi sarvamidaṃ viśvaṃ yadidaṃ sthāṇu jaṅgamam
tvaṃ hi sarvaṃ vikuruṣe bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham
prāṇo vāyuḥ satatagaḥ krodho mṛtyuḥ sanātanaḥ
prasāde cāpi padmā śrīrnityaṃ tvayi mahāmate
sudīrgheṇāpi kālena na te śakyā guṇā mayā
ātmā ca paramo vaktuṃ namaste nalinekṣaṇa
tvayā dagdhaṃ hi tatsainyaṃ mayā vijitamāhave
bhavatā tatkṛtaṃ karma yenāvāpto jayo mayā
saindhavasya ca pāpasya bhūriśravasa eva ca
tasmāttvameva sañcintya hitaṃ kuru yathā tathā ahaṃ ca prīyamāṇena tvayā devakinandana
āhṛtaṃ hi mamaitatte dvārakāgamanaṃ prabho acirādeva draṣṭā tvaṃ mātulaṃ me janārdana
viduraṃ ca mahābuddhiṃ rājānaṃ ca yudhiṣṭhiram
bhīmasenaṃ ca durdharṣaṃ mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau
gāndhārīṃ ca mahāprajñāṃ pṛthā kṛṣṇāṃ ca bhāminīm
kṣattāraṃ cāpi saṅgṛhya pṛṣṭvā kuśalamavyayam pariṣvajya mahātmānaṃ veśyāputraṃ mahāratham
taiḥ sārdhaṃ nṛpatiṃ vṛddhaṃ tatastau paryupāsatām
janārdanaṃ ca medhāvī vyasarjayata vai gṛhān
te'nujñātā nṛpatinā yayuḥ svaṃ svaṃ niveśanam
prabhātāyāṃ tu śarvaryāṃ kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām dharmarājasya bhanaṃ jagmatuḥ paramārcitau
tataḥ sa rājā medhāvī vivakṣū prekṣya tāvubhau
vivakṣū hi yuvāṃ manye vīrau yadukurūdvahau
brūtaṃ kartāsmi sarvaṃ vāṃ nacirānmā vicāryatām
puṇḍarīkākṣa bhadraṃ te gaccha tvaṃ madusūdana
rocate me mahābāho gamanaṃ tava keśava
mātulaściradṛṣṭo me tvayā devī ca devakī
sametyi mātulaṃ gatvā baladevaṃ ca mānada
smarethāścāpi māṃ nityaṃ bhīmaṃ ca balināṃ varam
phālgunaṃ sahadevaṃ ca nakulaṃ caiva mānada
sa gaccha ratnānyādāya vividhāni vasūni ca
iyaṃ ca vasudhā kṛtsnā prasādāttava keśava
svargāpavargaviṣayaṃ tvadbhaktānāṃ na durlabham saṃsāragahane ceddhapāpāgnipraśamāmbuda
tavaiva ratnāni dhanaṃ ca kevalaṃ dharā tu kṛtsnā tu mahābhujādya vai
yadasti cānyaddraviṇaṃ gṛhe mama tvameva tasyeśvara nityamīśvaraḥ
viniryayau nāgapurādgadāgrajo rathena divyena caturbhujaḥ svayam
agādhabuddhirviduraśca mādhavaṃ svayaṃ ca bhīmo gajarājavikramaḥ
nivartayitvā kururāṣṭravardhanāṃstataḥ sa sarvānviduraṃ ca vīryavān
janārdano dārukamāha satvaraḥ pracodayāśvāniti sātyakiṃ tathā
kṛcchreṇaiva tu tāṃ pārto govinde viniveśitām
vavarṣa vāsavaścaiva toyaṃ śuci sugandhi ca
maharṣiṃ siddhatapasaṃ sarvalokāntaviśrutam sa taṃ sampūjya tejasvī muniṃ pṛthulalocanaḥ
sa pṛṣṭaḥ kuśalaṃ tena sampūjya madhusūdanam
svarāṣṭre te ca rājānaḥ kaccitprāpsyanti vai sukham
yā me sambhāvanā tāta tvayi nityamavartata
api sā saphalā tāta kṛtā te bharatānprati
kṛto yatno mayā pūrvaṃ sauśāmye kauravānprati nāśakyanta yadā sāmye te sthāpayitumañjasā
na diṣṭamapyatikrāntuṃ śakyaṃ buddhyā balena vā
yasmācchaktena te kṛṣṇa na trātāḥ kurupuṅgavāḥ
na ca te prasabhaṃ yasmātte nigṛhya nivāritāḥ
tvayā śaktena hi satā mithyācāreṇi mādhava
te parītāḥ kuruśreṣṭhā naśyantaḥ sma hyupekṣitāḥ
śrutvā ca me tadadhyātmaṃ muñcethāḥ śāpamadya vai
na ca māṃ tapasā'lpena śakto'bhibhavituṃ pumān
na ca te tapaso nāśamicchāmi tapatāṃ vara
śrutvā śreyo'bhidhāsyāmi śāpaṃ vā te janārdana
tamo rajaśca satvaṃ ca viddhi bhāvānmadāśrayān
praṇavātmā ca śabdādīṃstriguṇātmā carācaram tathā rudrānvasūnvā'pi viddhi matprabhavāndvija
sthita ityabhijānīhi mā te bhūdatra saṃśayaḥ
ye cāśrameṣu vai dharmāścaturṣu vihitā mune
vaidikāni ca karmāṇi viddhi sarvaṃ madātmakam
asacca saccaiva ca yadviśvaṃ sadasataḥ param
yūpaṃ somaṃ caruṃ homaṃ tridaśāpyāyanaṃ makhe
hotāramapi havyaṃ ca viddhiṃ māṃ bhṛgunandana
bhūtagrāmasya sarvasya sraṣṭā saṃhāra eva ca
dharmasya setuṃ badhnāmi calite calite yuge
nāgayonau yadā caiva tadā vartāmi nāgavat
mānuṣye vartamāne tu kṛpaṇaṃ yācitā mayā
na ca te jātasammohā vaco'gṛhṇanta mohitāḥ
bhayaṃ ca mahaduddiśya trāsitāḥ kuravo mayā
dharmeṇa nihatā yuddhe gatāḥ svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
vinivṛttaśca me kopa iti viddhi paraṃtapa
tataḥ sa tasmai prītātmā darśayāmāsa tadvapuḥ
sa dadarśa mahātmānaṃ viśvarūpaṃ mahābhujam sahasrasūryapratimaṃ dīptimatpāvakopamam
vismayaṃ ca yayau viprastaṃ dṛṣṭvā parameśvaram
dayayā duḥkhamohānmāṃ sumuddhartumihārhasi karmabhirbahubhiḥ pāpairbaddhaṃ pāhi janārdana
padmyāṃ te pṛthivī vyāptā śirasā cāvṛtaṃ nabhaḥ
tamuvāca prasannātmā govindo janamejaya varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti tadā tamudaṅko'bravīdidam
tamabrakavītpunaḥ kṛṣṇo mā tvamatra vicāraya avaśyametatkartavyamamoghaṃ darśanaṃ mama
smaranneva ca taṃ prāha mātaṅgaḥ prahasanniva ehyudaṅka pratīcchasva matto vāri bhṛgūdvaha
kṛpā hi me sumahatī tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā tṛṭsamāśritam
ityuktastena sa munistattoyaṃ nābhyanandana cikṣepa ca sa taṃ dhīmānvāgbhirugrābhiracyutam
na yuktaṃ tādṛśaṃ dātuṃ tvayā puruṣasattama
yādṛśeneha rūpeṇa yogyaṃ dātuṃ dhṛtena vai
tādṛśaṃ khalu te dattaṃ yacca tvaṃ nāvabudhyathāḥ
sa māmuvāca devendra na martyo'martyatāṃ vrajet
yadyevaṃ pratigṛhṇāti bhārgavo'mṛtamadya vai pradātumeṣa gacchāmi bhārgavasyāmṛtaṃ vibho
sa tathā samayaṃ kṛtvā tena rūpeṇa vāsavaḥ upasthitastvayā cāpi pratyākhyāto'mṛtaṃ dadat
yattu śakyaṃ mayā kartuṃ bhūya eva tavepsitam
udaṅgameghā ityuktāḥ khyātiṃ yāsyanti cāpi te
ityuktaḥ prītimānvipraḥ kṛṣṇena sa babhūva ha
udaṅkaḥ kena tapasā saṃyukto vai mahāmanāḥ
sa tasya damaśaucābhyāṃ vikrāntena ca karmaṇā
taṃ krameṇa jarā tāta pratipede mahāmunim
tataḥ kāṣṭhaiḥ saha tadā papāta dharaṇītalam
tato gurusutā tasya padmapatranibhānanā jagrāhāśrūṇi suśroṇī kareṇa pṛthulocanā
tasyā nipetaturdagdhau karau tairaśrubindubhiḥ na hi tānaśrupātāṃstu śaktā dhārayituṃ mahī
sa svairaṃ brūhi viprarṣe śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ
jareyaṃ nāghabuddhā me nābhijñātaṃ sukhaṃ ca me
kiṃ tvadya yadi te śraddhā gamanaṃ prati bhārgava
gurvartaṃ kaṃ prayacchāmi brūhi tvaṃ dvijasattama
dakṣiṇāparitoṣo vai gurūṇāṃ sadbhirucyate tavi hyācarato dharmaṃ tuṣṭo'haṃ vai na saṃśayaḥ
itthaṃ ca parituṣṭaṃ māṃ vijānīhi bhṛgūdvaha
yuvā ṣoḍaśavarṣo hi yadyadya bhavitā bhavān dadāni patnīṃ kanyāṃ ca svāṃ te duhitaraṃ dvija
kiṃ bhavatyai prayacchāmi gurvarthaṃ viniyuṅkṣa mām
priyaṃ hitaṃ ca kāṅkṣāmi prāṇairapi dhanairapi
tadānayeyaṃ tapasā na hi me'trāsti saṃśayaḥ
parituṣṭā'smi te vipra nityaṃ bhaktyā tavānagha
ājñāpayasva māṃ mātaḥ kartavyaṃ ca tava priyam
te samānaya bhadraṃ te gurvarthaḥ sukṛto bhavet
iti pṛṣṭā tamācaṣṭa kuṇḍalārthe gataṃ ca sā
tataḥ provāca patnīṃ sa na te samyagidaṃ kṛtam
śaptaḥ sa pārthivo nūnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ taṃ vadhiṣyati
udaṅko'pi vane śūnye rājānaṃ taṃ dadarśa ha
sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā tathābhūtaṃ rājānaṃ ghoradarśanam
cakāra na vyathāṃ vipro rājā tvenamathābravīt
diṣṭyā tvamasi kalyāṇa ṣaṣṭhe kāle mamāntikam
na śakyastvaṃ samutsraṣṭuṃ kṣudhitena mayā'dya vai
evamastu mahārāji samayaḥ kriyatāṃ tu me
tvadadhīnaḥ sa rājendra taṃ tvāṃ bhikṣe nareśvara
dadāsi vipramukhyebhyastvaṃ hi ratnāni nityadā dātā ca tvaṃ naravyāghra pātrabhūtaḥ kṣitāviha
pātraṃ pratigrahe cāpi viddhi māṃ nṛpasattama
satyaṃ te pratijānāmi nātra mithyā kathañcana
yadi mattastavāyatto gurvarthaḥ kṛta eva saḥ
yadi cāsti pratigrāhyaṃ sāmprataṃ tadvadasva me
pratigrāhyo mato me tvaṃ sadaiva puruṣarṣabha
varayārthaṃ tvamanyaṃ vai taṃ te dāsyāmi suvrata
alaṃ te vyapadeśena pramāṇaṃ yadi te vayam
pradāsyati dvijaśreṣṭha kuṇḍale te na saṃśayaḥ
kva patnī bhavataḥ śakyā mayā draṣṭuṃ nareśvara
ṣaṣṭhe kāle na hi mayā sā śakyā draṣṭumadya vai
ime hi divye maṇikuṇḍale me devāśca yakṣāśca maharṣayaśca
ete divāpi bhāsete rātrau ca dvijasattama
hrasvena caite āmukte bhavato hrasvake tadā
na caivaiṣā gatiḥ kṣemyā na cānyā vidyate gatiḥ
śrutvā ca sā tadā prādāttataste maṇikuṇḍale
avāpya kuṇḍale te tu rājānaṃ punarabravīt
na hi rājñā viśeṣeṇa viruddhena dvijātibhiḥ
śakyaṃ hi loke sthātuṃ vai pretya vā sukhamedhitum
tadiṣṭe te mayā datte ete sve maṇikuṇḍale
yaḥ kṛtaste'dya samayaḥ saphalaṃ taṃ kuruṣya me
praśnaṃ ca kañcitpraṣṭuṃ tvāṃ vyavasiṣye paraṃtapa
brūhi vipra yathākāmaṃ prativaktāsmi te vacaḥ
chettāsmi saṃśayaṃ te'dya na me'trāśti vicāraṇā
mitreṣu yaśca viṣamaḥ stena ityeva taṃ viduḥ
sa me buddhiṃ prayacchasva sammatāṃ puruṣarṣabha
bhavatsakāśamāgantuṃ kṣamaṃ mama na veti vai
āgacchato hi te vipri bhavenmṛrtyuna saṃśayaḥ
ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājā kṣamaṃ buddhimatā hitam
tathā te kuṇḍale badhvā tadā kṛṣṇājine'nayat
bilvaṃ dadarśa viprarṣirāruroha ca taṃ tataḥ
yasmiṃste kuṇḍale baddhe tadā dvijavareṇa vai
airāvatakulodbhūtaḥ śīghro bhūtvā tadā hi saḥ
hriyamāṇe tu dṛṣṭvā sa kuṇḍale bhujagena ha
[ahāni triṃśadavyagraḥ pañca cānyāni bhārata ] krodhāmarṣābhisaṃtaptastadā brāhmaṇisattamaḥ
tasya vegamasahyaṃ tamasahantī vasundharā daṇḍakāṣṭhābhinunnāṅgī cacāla bhṛśamākulā
tataḥ khanata evātha viprarṣerdharaṇītalam nāgalokasya panthānaṃ kartukāmasya niścayāt
sa tu taṃ brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tasya duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ
ito hi nāgaloko vai yojanāni sahasraśaḥ
na daṇḍakāṣṭhasādhyaṃ ca manye kāryamidaṃ tava
nāgaloke yadi brahmanna śakye kuṇḍale mayā
sa tena mārgeṇa tadā nāgalokaṃ viveśa ha
tasya lokasya ca dvāraṃ sa dadarśa bhṛgūdvahaḥ
mā jugupsāṃ kṛthāḥ putra tvamatrārthe kathañcana
prasādya brāhmaṇaṃ te tu pādyamarghyaṃ nivedya ca
agniṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā jagāma gurusadma tat
evaṃprabhāvaḥ sa munirudaṅko bharatarṣabha pareṇa tapasā yukto yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi
ata ūrdhvaṃ mahābāhuḥ kiṃ cakāra mahāyaśāḥ
etākābhirvicitrābhiḥ saghaṇṭābhiḥ samantataḥ puṃbhiḥ strībhiśca saṃghuṣṭaḥ pragīta iva cābhavat
mattānāṃ hṛṣṭarūpāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca bhārata
dīnāndhakṛpaṇādibhyo dīyamānena cāniśam babhau paramakalyāṇo mahastasya mahāgireḥ
tvayā satkriyate deva ja jānīmo'tra māyayā
brahmādīnāṃ ca govinda sānnidhvaṃ śaraṇaṃ namaḥ
iti stute mānuṣaiśca pūjite devakīsute śakrasadmapratīkāśo babhūva sa hi śailarāṭ
tataḥ sampūjyamānaḥ sa viveśa bhavanaṃ śubham
sa tānabhyarcya medhāvī pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalaṃ tadā
tvaṃ tu pratyakṣadarśī ca kāryajñaśca mahābhujaḥ
gupto bhīmena medhāvī mitreṇa varuṇo yathā
tataḥ pārthaṃ samāsādya pataṅga iva pāvakam
hate karṇe tu kauravyā nirutsāhā hataujasaḥ
hate śalye tu śakuniṃ sahadevo mahāmanāḥ
hrade dvaipāyane cāpi salilasthaṃ dadarśa tam
tataḥ sa nihato rājā dhārtarāṣṭro mahāraṇe
śṛṇvatāṃ tu mahārāja kathāṃ tāṃ romaharṣaṇīm
dṛṣṭvaiva ca papātorvyāṃ so'pi duḥkhena mūrchitaḥ
tadbhāgineyanidhanaṃ tattvenācakṣva me prabho sadṛśākṣastava kathaṃ śatrubhirnihato raṇe
durbharaṃ bata vārṣṇeya kāle'prāpte nṛbhiḥ saha
yatra me hṛdayaṃ duḥkhācchatadhā na vidīryate
māṃ cāpi puṇḍarīkākṣi capalākṣaḥ priyo mama
āhavaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā kaccinna nihataḥ paraiḥ
kaccinmukhaṃ na govinda tenājau vikṛtaṃ kṛtam
sa hi kṛṣṇa mahātejāḥ ślāghanniva mamāgrataḥ bālabhāvena vijayamātmano'kathayatprabhuḥ
sa hi droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca karṇaṃ ca balīnāṃ varam
spardhate sma raṇe nityaṃ duhituḥ putrako mama
na teni vikṛtaṃ vaktraṃ kṛtaṃ saṅgrāmamūrdhani
eko hyekena satataṃ yudhyamāno yadi prabho
na sa śakyeta saṅgrāme nihantumapi vajriṇā
tataḥ śatruvadhaṃ kṛtvā sumahāntaṃ reṇe pitaḥ
nūnaṃ ca sa gataḥ svargaṃ jahi śokaṃ mahāmate
sa śokaṃ jahi jurdharṣa mā ca manyuvaśaṃ gamaḥ
śastrapūtāṃ hi sa gatiṃ gataḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
tasmiṃstu nihate vīre subhadreyaṃ svasā mama
duḥkhārtā'tho sutaṃ prāpya kurarīva nanāda ha
ārye kva dārakāḥ sarve draṣṭumicchāmi tānaham
uttarāṃ cābravīdbhadre bhartā sa kva nu te gataḥ
kṣipramāgamanaṃ mahyaṃ tasya tvaṃ vedayasva ha
nanu nāmādya vairāṭi śrutvā mama giraṃ sadā
ācakṣva me'dya saṅgrāmaṃ yathāpūrvamarindama kasmādevaṃ vilapatīṃ nādyeha pratibhāṣase
pitrā ca lālito bālaḥ sa hataḥ kāladharmaṇā
putro hi tava durdharṣaḥ samprāptaḥ paramāṃ gatim
uttarāṃ tvamavekṣasva gurviṇīṃ mā śucaḥ śubhe
bhartāraṃ prati suśroṇi garbhasthaṃ rakṣa vai śiśum
evaṃ sa nidhanaṃ prāpto dauhitrastava mānada
saṃtāpaṃ tyaja durdharṣa mā ca śoke manaḥ kṛthāḥ
vāsudevo'tha dāśārho baledevaḥ sasātyakiḥ abhimanyostadā śrāddhamakurvansatyakastadā
dhiyamāṇe tu tasmiṃstu garbhe kukṣistha eva ca
ājagāma tato vyāso jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā
janiṣyate mahātejāḥ putrastava yaśasvini prabhāvādvāsudevasya mama vyāharaṇādapi
puroktaṃ tattathā bhāvi mā te'trāstu vicāraṇā
na sa śocyastvayā vīro na cānyaiḥ kurubhistathā
aśvamedhaṃ prati tadā kiṃ bhūyaḥ pracakāra ha
tadavāpa kathaṃ ceti tanme brūhi dvijottama
bhīṣmeṇa ca mahāprājña govindeni ca dhīmatā
āyatyāṃ ca tadātve ca sarveṣāṃ taddhi no hitam
iyaṃ hi vasudhā sarvā kṣīṇaratnā kurūdvahāḥ
taccācaṣṭa tadā vyāso maruttasya dhanaṃ nṛpāḥ yadyetadvo bahumataṃ manyadhvaṃ vā kṣamaṃ yadi
tadānayāmahe sarve kataṃ vā bhīma manyase
rocate me mahābāho yadidaṃ bhāṣitaṃ tvayā
taṃ vibhuṃ devadeveśaṃ śūlapāṇiṃ trilocanam anādinidhanaṃ śaṃbhuṃ namasyāmi maheśvaram
rakṣante ye ca taddravyaṃ kinnarā raudradarśanāḥ
te ca vaśyā bhaviṣyanti prasanne vṛṣabhadhvaje
sa hi devaḥ prasannātmā bhaktānāṃ parameśvaraḥ
dadātyamaratāṃ cāpi kiṃ punaḥ kāñcanaṃ prabhuḥ
vayaṃ sarve hi tadbhaktāḥ sa cāsmākaṃ prasīdati
abhimanyorvadhe vṛtte pratijñāte dhanañjaye jayadrathavadhārthāya svapne lokagururniśi
kastāṃ senāṃ mahārāja manasā'pi pradharṣayet droṇikarṇabalairyuktāṃ maheṣvāsaiḥ prahāribhiḥ
tasyaiva ca prasādeva nihatāstava śatravaḥ aśvamedhasya saṃsiddhiṃ tava sampādayiṣyati
śrutvaivaṃ vadatastasya vākyaṃ bhīmasya bhārata prīto dharmātmajo rājā babhūvātīva bhārata
tato yayuḥ pāṇḍusutā brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ sabhāryaṃ vai pṛthāṃ ca pṛthulocanām
mūle nikṣipya kauravyaṃ yuyutsuṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajam sampūjyamānāḥ pauraiśca brāhmaṇaiśca manīṣibhiḥ
smindeśe ca rājendra yatra taddravyamuttamam cakre niveśanaṃ rājā pāṇḍavaḥ sahasainikaiḥ
śive deśe same caiva tadā bharatasattama
na naḥ kālātyayo vai syādihaiva parilambatām
śrutvā tu teṣāṃ dvijasattamānāṃ kṛtopavāsā rajanīṃ narendrāḥ
ūṣuḥ pratītāḥ kuśasaṃstareṣu yathā'dhvare prajvalitā hutāśāḥ
tato niśā sā vyagamanmahātmanāṃ saṃśṛṇvatāṃ viprasamīritā giraḥ
tataḥ prabhāte vimale dvijarṣabhā vaco'bruvandharmasutaṃ narādhipam
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ teṣāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
mantrasiddhaṃ caruṃ kṛtvā purodhāḥ sa yayai tadā
sumanobhiśca citrābhirlājairuccāvacairapi sarvaṃ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ hutvā vidhivadvedapāragaḥ
tathā'nyeṣāṃ ca yakṣāṇāṃ bhūtānāṃ patayaśca ye
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sahasrāṇi gavāṃ datvā tu bhūmipaḥ
kṛtvā pūjāṃ tu rudrasya gaṇānāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ
yayau vyāsaṃ puraskṛtya nṛpo ratnanidhiṃ prati
śaṅkhādīṃśca nidhīnsarvānnidhipālāṃśca sarvaśaḥ arcayitvā dvijāgryā svasti vācya ca vīryavān
vāraṇāśca mahārāja sahasraśatasaṃmitāḥ śakaṭāni rathāścaiva tāvadeva kareṇavaḥ
svarāṇāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ ca parisaṅkhyā na vidyate
mahādevaṃ prati yayau puraṃ nāgāhayaṃ prati
pṛṣṭhato draupadīṃ caiva subhadrāṃ ca yaśasvinīm
tataḥ kṛṣṇaṃ samāsādya kuntī bhojasutā tadā
tvaṃ no gatiḥ pratiṣṭhā ca tvadāyattamidaṃ kulam
uttarāṃ ca subhadrāṃ ca draupadīṃ māṃ ca mādhava
dharmaputraṃ ca bhīmaṃ ca phalgunaṃ nakulaṃ tathā
pāṇḍośca piṇḍo dāśārha tathaiva śvaśurasya me
abhimanyośca bhadraṃ te priyasya sadṛśasya ca
mātulasya kulaṃ bhadre tava putro gamiṣyati
astrāṇi ca vicitrāṇi nitīśāstraṃ ca kevalaṃ
svastrīyo vāsudevasya mṛto jāta iti prabho
utthitāyāṃ pṛthāyāṃ tu subhadrā bhrātaraṃ tadā
puṇḍarīkākṣa paśya tvaṃ pautraṃ pārthasya dhīmataḥ
sottarāyāṃ nipatitā vijaye mayi caiva ha
seyaṃ jvalantī hṛdaye mayi tiṣṭati keśava
yanna paśyāmi durdharṣa sahaputraṃ tu taṃ prabho
bhīmasenārjunau cāpi mādravatyāḥ sutau ca tau
abhimanyuḥ priyaḥ kṛṣṇa pitṝṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ
bhavitā naḥ paraṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃnu manye janārdana
sā'haṃ prasādaye kṛṣṇa tvāmadya śirasā natā
pṛtheyaṃ draupadī caiva tāḥ paśya puruṣottama
yadyetattvaṃ pratiśrutya na karoṣi vaca śubham
abhimanyoḥ suto vīra na saṃjīvati yadyayam
jīvati tvayi durdharṣa kiṃ kariṣyāmyahaṃ tvayā
svaseti vā mahābāho hataputreti vā punaḥ
vākyenaitena hi tadā taṃ janaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
astraiśca vimalairnyastaiḥ pāvakaiśca samantataḥ vṛddhābhiścāpi rāmābhiḥ parivārārthamāvṛtaḥ
dadarśa ca sa tejasvī rakṣoghrānyapi sarvaśaḥ
sā'pi bāṣpakalāṃ vācaṃ nigṛhyāśrūpi caiva ha
abhimanyuṃ ca māṃ caiva haṭhāttulyaṃ janārdana
yadi sma dharmarājñā vā bhīmasenena vā punaḥ
ahameva vinaṣṭā syāṃ nāyamevaṃ gato bhavet
sā tvāṃ prasādya śirasā yāce śatrunibarhaṇa
te droṇaputreṇa hatāḥ kiṃnu jīvāmi keśava
viphalā me kṛtāḥ kṛṣṇa hṛdi sarve manorathāḥ
yaḥ pāṇḍavīṃ śriyaṃ tyaktvā gato'dya yamasādanaṃ
idānīṃ māṃ gatāṃ tatra kiṃnu vakṣyati phālguniḥ
putra gatvā mama vaco brūyāstvaṃ pitaraṃ tvidam
durmaraṃ prāṇināṃ vīra kāle prāpte kathañcana
yā'haṃ tvayā vinā'dyeha patyā putreṇa caiva ha
bhakṣayiṣye viṣaṃ ghoraṃ pravekṣye vā hutāśanam
athavā durbharaṃ tāta yadidaṃ me sahasradhā
āryāṃ ca paśya pāñcālīṃ sātvatīṃ ca tapasvinīm
māṃ ca paśya suduḥkhārtāṃ vyādhaviddhāṃ mṛgīmiva
evaṃ vipralapantīṃ tu dṛṣṭvā nipatitāṃ punaḥ
śrutvā sa tasyā vipulaṃ vilāpaṃ puruṣarṣabhaḥ
yathā me dayito dharmo brāhmaṇaśca viśeṣataḥ
abhimanyoḥ suto jāto mṛto jīvatvayaṃ tathā
virodhaṃ tena satyena mṛto jīvatvayaṃ śiśuḥ
yathā satyaṃ ca dharmaśca mayi nityaṃ pratiṣṭhitau
yathā kaṃsaśca keśī ca dharmeṇa nihatau mayā
ityuktvā vāsudevo'tha taṃ bālaṃ bharatarṣabha pādena kamalābhena brahmarudrārcitena ca
spṛṣṭamātrastu kṛṣṇena sa bālo bharatarṣabha śanaiḥśanairmahārāja prāpadyata sa cetanām
tato rakṣāṃsi sarvāṇi neśustyaktvā gṛhaṃ tu tat
striyo bharatasiṃhānāṃ nāvaṃ labdhveva pāragāḥ kuntī drupadaputrī ca subhadrā cottarā tathā
tatastasyai dadau prīto bahuratnaṃ viśeṣataḥ tathaiva vṛṣṇiśārdūlo nāma cāsyākarotprabhuḥ
māsajātastu te vīra pitā bhavati bhārata
nāsīttatra nṛpaḥ kaścidabhārārto nṛpaṃ vinā bhīmādayo'pi yajñārthaṃ vahante kiṃ punarjanāḥ
tānsamīpagatāñśrutvā pāṇḍavāñśatrukarśanaḥ vāsudevaḥ sahāmātyaḥ prayayau sasuhṛdgaṇaḥ
te sametya tathādharmaṃ pāṇḍavā vṛṣṇibhiḥ saha
te kośānagrataḥ kṛtvā viviśuḥ svaṃ puraṃ tadā
viduraṃ yūjayitvā ca vaiśyāputraṃ sametya ca
pūjyamānāḥ sma te vīrā vyarocanta viśāmpate
śuśruvuste tadā vīrāḥ pituste janma bhārata
tasya sarve yathānyāyaṃ pūjā cakruḥ kurūdvahāḥ
tvadadhīnā vayaṃ sarve kṛṣṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ
teneṣṭvā tvaṃ vipātmā vai bhavitā nātra saṃśayaḥ
